questions.prompt: My sister is only six, but  ______  can help with some housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹只有六岁，但她可以帮忙做一些家务。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；it它；they他们。空处指代“My sister”，作主语，需用代词she。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Linda, do you use the Internet every day? —No, I don’t. I only use it  ______  weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——琳达，你每天都上网吗？——不，我不是。我只在周末用它。 考查介词辨析。for为了；of属于……的；on在上面；in在里面。on weekends“在周末”，固定短语。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Tom, why do you like lions? — ______  they’re strong. They can run fast, too.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你为什么喜欢狮子？——因为它们是强壮的。他们也能跑得很快。 考查连词辨析。And并且；Or或者；So因此；Because因为。根据“why do you like lions”可知，答语应该解释原因，Because符合题意。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me.  ______  are the bananas? —They’re 13 yuan a kilo.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下。香蕉多少钱？——13元一公斤。 考查特殊疑问句。How often多久一次；How long多长时间；How old几岁；How much多少钱。根据答语“They’re 13 yuan a kilo.”可知，上句是询问多少钱，用how much。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Chris! What is Jeff doing? —He  ______  the football match online.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，Chris！Jeff在做什么？——他正在网上看足球赛。 考查现在进行时。根据“What is Jeff doing?”可知提问现在正在发生的事情，回答要使用现在进行时，be+现在分词形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Steve, what do you often do after school? —I often  ______  basketball with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——史蒂夫，你放学后经常做什么？——我经常和我的朋友们打篮球。 考查一般现在时。play动词原形； played 一般过去时；will play将来时；am playing现在进行时。由于often是一般现在时的标志词，主语是I第一人称，故用动词原形play。故选A。

questions.prompt: My grandpa  ______  with me about his hometown yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我爷爷和我谈论了他的家乡。 考查一般过去时。talks用于一般现在时；talked用于一般过去时；will talk用于一般将来时；is talking用于现在进行时。由“yesterday”可知，句子应用一般过去时，动词使用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s cloudy all day today, but it  ______  tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天一整天都是多云，但是明天天气将会变化。 考查一般将来时。根据“tomorrow”可知，后半句描述将来的事情，要用一般将来时，will+动词原形，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Amy, what did you do last Saturday? —I  ______  my mother clean the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：——艾米，你上星期六做什么了？——我在帮妈妈打扫厨房。 考查动词时态。根据“what did you do last Saturday?”可知，时态是一般过去时，所以空处用动词的过去式helped。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Would you like something to drink? — ______. I’d like a cup of tea.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你想喝点什么吗？——是的，我想喝杯茶。 考查情景交际。No, thanks不，谢谢；Sorry, I don’t know对不起，我不知道；Yes, please好的；Sure, here you are当然可以，给你。根据“I’d like a cup of tea.”可知，空出应是肯定回答，想要喝，C项符合语境，故选C。 三、完形填空 (每题1分,共5分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项. Vote (投票) for Bill Kelly’s friend Bill is busy these days. He is running for class president. He  ______ 15 ______  last year, but he failed (失败). This time, he is sure of himself. On Sunday, Bill spent the whole afternoon making a poster. He put his  ______ 16 ______  on it. Because he wanted everyone to see his bright and confident smile. And then he wrote down his promises (允诺) on the poster. Next, Bill made a campaign shirt out of his father’s old T-shirt. On it, he wrote “Vote for Bill”. On Monday morning, Bill put on this campaign shirt and went to school very early. He put the  ______ 17 ______  at the back of his classroom. The next two days, Bill talked to every student in his class. He made them believe in him. Then Bill asked for their votes on Friday. He spent all of Thursday evening writing a speech (演讲) for the campaign. He  ______ 18 ______  it several times in front of his friends Kelly, Jimmy and Lucy. When he finished, they praised him. Today is Friday. Bill feels a little  ______ 19 ______. This morning, he put on his favorite pants, his lucky socks, and a new shirt. The shirt is not his. It’s his brother Peter’s. Peter hopes it will bring Bill good luck (好运). At this moment, Bill is giving his speech. Everyone is listening carefully. Most of them are going to vote for Bill.

questions.prompt: He often has  ______  egg and  ______  hamburger for lunch.
questions.explanation: 句意：他午饭经常吃一个鸡蛋和一个汉堡包。 考查冠词辨析。an修饰元音音素开头的单词；a修饰辅音音素开头的单词。egg为元音音素开头的词，hamburger为辅音音素开头的词，an egg“一个鸡蛋”；a hamburger“一个汉堡包”。故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  your mother  ______  carrots?
questions.explanation: 句意：你妈妈吃胡萝卜吗？ 考查一般疑问句。eat“吃”是实义动词，结合主语“your mother”是第三人称单数可知，此时的一般疑问句应用助动词does位于句首。故选A。

questions.prompt: Many kids like reading books  ______  it’s interesting.
questions.explanation: 句意 ：很多孩子喜欢读书，因为它很有趣。 考查从属连词辨析。so因此；because因为；but但是；and并且。根据“it’s interesting”可知，因为读书有趣，所以孩子们喜欢读书，后句是原因，故选B。

questions.prompt: Carl  ______  hamburgers, because he thinks  ______  unhealthy.
questions.explanation: 句意：Carl不喜欢汉堡，因为他认为它们不健康。 考查否定句和人称代词。like“喜欢”，实义动词；由“because he thinks... unhealthy.”可知，Carl不喜欢汉堡；主语“Carl”是第三人称单数，故应用助动词doesn’t+动词原形；再根据“hamburgers”是复数名词，故应用they来指代，be动词用are。故选D。

questions.prompt: For students, we have schoolbags  ______  red, green and yellow.
questions.explanation: 句意：对于学生，我们有红色，绿色和黄色的书包。 考查介词辨析。in穿着，带着；of……的；on在……上；at在。根据“schoolbags... red, green and yellow”可知，此处指书包的颜色是红色、绿色和黄色的，应用介词in；“in+颜色”表示某物具有的颜色。故选A。

questions.prompt: How much  ______  do you want?
questions.explanation: 句意：你想要多少鸡肉？ 考查名词的数。tomatoes 西红柿，可数名词；bananas香蕉，可数名词； hamburgers汉堡包，可数名词； chicken鸡肉，不可数名词。how much 后接不可数名词，只有D为不可数名词，故选D。

questions.prompt: Miss Zhang is  ______  teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：张老师是Tom和Marry的老师。 考查名词所有格。Tom and Marry表示人名；Tom’s and Marry’s表示Tom的和Marry的，后接复数名词；Tom and Marry’s表示Tom和Marry共同拥有的，后接单数名词；Tom’s and Marry语法错误。teacher为单数，前需有名词所有格作定语，表示双方共同拥有。故选C。

questions.prompt: Jack wants  ______  the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jack想去图书馆。 考查非谓语动词。根据want to do sth.“想做某事”可知，应用不定式。故选B。

questions.prompt: This shirt is very cheap. I’ll  ______  it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这件衬衫很便宜。我要买下它。 考查动词辨析。bring拿来，带来；take拿走，带走；want想要；believe相信。根据“This shirt is very cheap.”可知，衬衫便宜，所以要买。英语里常用take来表达“买”意思。故选B。

questions.prompt: Most students in our class like  ______  books.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们班的大多数学生喜欢读书。 考查动词辨析和非谓语动词。read阅读；see看见。由“books”可知，空处应用read，表示喜欢读书，read books“读书”；再根据like doing sth.“喜欢做某事”可知，应用动名词作宾语。故选B。

questions.prompt: March is the  ______  month of the year.
questions.explanation: 句意：三月是一年中的第三个月份。 考查序数词。second第二；first第一；third第三；fifth第五。March“三月”，可知，三月是一年中的第三个月份。故选C。

questions.prompt: Teachers’ Day is  ______  September 10th.
questions.explanation: 句意：教师节在9月10日。 考查时间介词。on用于具体某一天前；in用于较长一段时间如年月季节等前；at用于时刻前；to向，朝着。根据“September 10th”是具体某一天可知，应用介词on。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Thank you very much. — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——非常感谢你。——不用谢。 考查情景交际。Here you are给你；You’re welcome不用谢。在英语中，对别人感谢的回答应该为：You’re welcome。故选B。 五、完型填空 课内完型（共 4分, 每⼩题 1分） 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写一个适当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 Come and buy your clothes at our great  ______ 15 ______  (sell)! We sell all our clothes at very good prices. Do you like sweaters? We have green sweaters  ______ 16 ______  only $15! Yellow sweaters are only $12! Do you need trousers? For  ______ 17 ______  (boy), we have black trousers for only $22. And shorts are only $16! For girls, we have skirts in purple for only $20. How much  ______ 18 ______  (be) our jackets? Only $30! And we have black shoes for only $28. Socks are only $2 for three pairs! Come to Mr. Cool’s Clothes Store now! 【答案】15. sale

questions.prompt: That boy is from England.  ______  name is Tom.
questions.explanation: 句意：那个男孩来自英国。他名叫Tom。 考查代词辨析。He他，主格；His他的，形容词性物主代词；She她，主格；Her她的，形容词性物主代词。根据“That boy”和“name”可知，此处指“他的”名字，应用His。故选B。

questions.prompt: He wants to see the movie Minions: The Rise of Gru,  ______  he is too busy these days.
questions.explanation: 句意：他想看电影《小黄人大眼萌：神偷奶爸前传》，但他这些天太忙了。 考查连词辨析。so因此；and而且；but但是；or或者。根据“He wants to see the movie Minions: The Rise of Gru”和“he is too busy these days”可知，前后句为转折关系，应用but连接。故选C。

questions.prompt: We sell all our clothes  ______  very good prices.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们以非常好的价格出售我们所有的衣服。 考查介词辨析。at在……；in在……里；on在……上；of……的。这里是固定词组，at good prices“以很好的价格”。故选A。

questions.prompt: My socks are red. But this pair of socks  ______  purple.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的袜子是红色的。但是这双袜子是紫色的。 考查主谓一致。this pair of作主语，谓语动词需要和pair保持一致，pair是单数，be动词用is。故选C。

questions.prompt: John’s birthday dinner is next week. Let’s  ______  the food.
questions.explanation: 句意：约翰的生日晚宴在下周。让我们想想食物。 考查动词短语辨析。ask about询问；think about考虑；find about寻找；get about传播。根据“birthday dinner”和“food”可知，是考虑晚宴做什么食物。故选B。

questions.prompt: Do you like  ______  long blue and yellow socks?
questions.explanation: 句意：你喜欢这些蓝黄相间的长袜子吗？ 考查指示代词。a不定冠词，用在以辅音音素开头的单词前；an不定冠词，用在以元音音素开头的单词前；that那个，后接名词单数；these这些，后接名词复数。根据“long blue and yellow socks”可知，应用these。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Let’s play computer games. —That  ______  interesting.
questions.explanation: 句意：——让我们玩电脑游戏吧。——听起来很有趣。 考查主谓一致。本句是一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数，谓语动词sound“听起来”应用动词三单形式sounds。故选B。

questions.prompt: I like ice-cream, but I don’t eat it. I don’t want  ______  fat.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢冰淇淋，但我不吃。我不想变胖。 考查动词不定式。want to do sth.“想做某事”，是固定搭配，所以空处应是to be。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Two dollars for one pair and three dollars for two pairs. —Great!  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——一双两美元，两双三美元。——很好！我要两双。 考查情景交际。Thank you谢谢你；Here you are给你；I want them我想要她们；I’ll take two pairs我要两双。根据“Two dollars for one pair and three dollars for two pairs.”可知此处是购物场景，结合“Great!”可知说话人觉得买两双有优惠，所以买两双。故选D。 五、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择可以填入空白处的最佳选项。 Winning Isn’t Everything Jimmy was good at everything. He was a good athlete. He was good at music. He did well in school. I couldn’t  ______ 11 ______  the fact that he was always first in everything he did. So when I heard that there was going to be a soapbox race, I thought, “This is my chance to  ______ 12 ______  him to be more humble.” Everyone worked hard all week to build the best race car. The day of the race, I saw his racer. Of course, it was beautiful. It was red and had a big flame on the side. It was smooth and had wheels that looked very expensive. I was so upset and  ______ 13 ______  that I did something I should not have. When he wasn’t looking I kicked one of his expensive  ______ 14 ______. “Now let’s see who wins!” I thought. I got back in my racer and waited for the race to start. BANG! We were off slowly at first, and then faster as we picked up  ______ 15 ______  going down the hill. Jimmy and I were both pulling away from the pack Suddenly, his wheel started to wobble badly, and then it came off! He started to swerve! I realized I had made his racer dangerous. He couldn’t steer it as we approached the big turn at the bottom of the hill! The race was  ______ 16 ______  to win, but I realized that I could not win this way, no matter how much I disliked Jimmy. I hit the brake and grabbed his cart to keep it beside me. I had to steer and brake for both of us. We stopped just before the edge of the road, and the other racers  ______ 17 ______  past us. “Jimmy,” I said, “I kicked your wheel because I could not stand to see you win again. I’m sorry.” It was  ______ 18 ______  to admit what I had done, but Jimmy forgave me and we eventually became good friends. I realized that winning isn’t everything, and so did Jimmy.

questions.prompt: —Is this  ______  pen? —Yes,  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是你的钢笔吗？——是的，是我的。 考查代词。your你的；you你；his他的；her她的；根据前面的问句是Is this和后面的回答yes是肯定回答，肯定回答应该是it is，不能用it's，排除C、D选项；问句后面的pen钢笔是名词，前面用形容词性物主代词； you是人称代词的宾格，故排除B，故选A。

questions.prompt: Sam has  ______  brother. He is  ______  university teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：Sam有一个哥哥。他是一个大学老师。 考查不定冠词。brother是以辅音音素开头，应用a；university是以辅音音素开头，应用a。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What does your mother do? —She is a  ______. She works in a hospital.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妈妈是做什么工作的？——她是一名医生。她在一家医院工作。 考查名词辨析。teacher老师；doctor医生；cook厨师；driver司机。根据“She works in a hospital.”可知，妈妈是一名医生。故选B。

questions.prompt: I have two brothers, and  ______  of them are teachers.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有两个哥哥，他们两个都是老师。 考查代词辨析。each每一个；all全都；both两者都；every每个。根据“I have two brothers, and...of them are teachers”可知是两个哥哥都是老师，用both。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Do Simon and Sam like to play basketball? — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——西蒙和丹尼尔喜欢打篮球吗？——不，他们不喜欢。 考查一般疑问句的回答。根据“Simon and Sam”可知，是两个人，是复数，此句是含有实义动词的一般疑问句，根据问句的助动词用do，所以否定回答用don’t，即No, they don’t。故选D。

questions.prompt: My grandma and grandpa  ______  over 60 years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的爷爷奶奶60多岁了。 考查主谓一致和be动词。主语“My grandma and grandpa”是两个人，故be动词应用are。故选C。

questions.prompt: —When  ______  your mother  ______  up in the morning? —At 6 o’clock.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妈妈早上什么时候起床？——六点钟。 考查特殊疑问句。主语your mother是第三人称单数，助动词用does，后加动词原形。故选B。

questions.prompt: Sue is good at  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：她擅长跳舞。 考查非谓语动词。be good at doing sth.“擅长做某事”，介词at后接动名词dancing作宾语。故选B。

questions.prompt: My sister  ______  very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姐姐唱得非常好。 考查动词用法。句中缺少谓语动词，本句是一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数，谓语动词用单三形式sings。故选B。 二、完型填空（共8分，每题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 My name is Mary Green. I am a shop assistant. I work in a small  ______ 13 ______. My job is to sell some school things. The shop is next to  ______ 14 ______. Every day many students come to the shop to  ______ 15 ______  things. They buy pens, erasers, exercise books, notebooks  ______ 16 ______  other things. I’m often very happy after school is over. My home is far from the shop. I often  ______ 17 ______  at 6:00. After I have breakfast, I put some food in my lunch box and then I go to work  ______ 18 ______  bike. I get to the shop at about 6:50. At 7:00, people begin to arrive. They come to buy things. At noon, I have not enough time to go home for  ______ 19 ______, so I have my meal from my lunch box at 12:00. At 7:00 in the evening we close the door. I tidy things up and then go home for dinner. Some people may think my work is  ______ 20 ______. But I like it very much. I think it’s fun.

questions.prompt: Tony’s father is a manager.  ______  works in a restaurant.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼的父亲时一名经理。他在一家餐馆上班。 考查人称代词。He’s他是；He他；She她；His他的。根据“Tony’s father is a manager”以及“works”可知，空格处主语指代托尼的父亲，应用He；且空格处所在句子已经包含实义动词works作谓语，不再需要be动词，故选B。

questions.prompt: The students in this school are from the city.  ______  homes are not far from the school.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个学校里的学生来自城里。他们的家离学校不远。 考查代词辨析。We我们，主格；They他们，主格；Our我们；Their他们的。根据“The students in this school”和“homes”可知是说学生们的家，应用形容词性物主代词their来表示“他们的”，修饰名词homes。故选D。

questions.prompt: We’ve got a lot of orange juice at home but we haven’t got  ______  milk.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们家里有很多橙汁，但我们没有牛奶了。 考查代词辨析。some一些，常用于肯定句；much许多，修饰不可数名词；any任何，用于否定句和疑问句；many许多，修饰可数名词复数形式。milk是不可数名词，排除D选项。根据“ but we haven’t got… milk”可知，没有牛奶了，此句是否定句应填any，故选C。

questions.prompt: We usually start lessons  ______  8:00 from Monday to Friday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们通常从周一到周五八点开始上课。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体的时刻前面；to到；on后加具体的某一天；in后接某年某月某季节。根据“8:00”可知，此处指在上午八点，具体的钟点前用介词at。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Hello, Miss Li.  ______  my parents. —Nice to meet you!
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，李小姐。这是我的父母。——很高兴见到你们！ 考查代词辨析。This is这是；These are这些是；That is那是；Those are那些是。介绍某人用固定句式：This is/These are，根据parents可知，此处应填复数代词，故选B。

questions.prompt: There  ______  some pencils and a ruler on the teacher’s desk.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师的桌子上有一些铅笔和一把尺子。 考查there be句型。there be不能与have连用，排除D选项。遵循“就近原则”，离be动词最近的名词pencils是复数形式，be动词用are，故选C。

questions.prompt: Jim’s grandpa watches TV news and newspapers in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆的爷爷在晚上看电视新闻和读报纸。 考查一般现在时。题干and连接两个并列的谓语动词，选项A和B属于非谓语形式，故排除；由第一个谓语动词watches“观看”可知，句子时态属于一般现在时，read“读”是与watches并列的第二个谓语动词，二者主语相同，所以也用第三人称单数形式，即reads，故选D。 四、完形填空 (共 6 分，每小题 1 分) 阅读下面短文，根据短文内容从后面各题所给的选项中，选择最佳选项。 There are two children in my family. I am three years younger than my  ______ 9 ______, Emily. I think she is great. I like to play with her and her friends. But they don’t like that. Over time, there is a distance (距离) between us although (虽然) we live in the same  ______ 10 ______. When she says she’s going to China, I’m not so sad. But after she leaves, I feel that my life is so different. I cry sadly. But as the night falls, my tears (眼泪) turn into tears of calm (冷静), tears of  ______ 11 ______  beginnings—I start to do something. I pick up the phone. “Hello?” “Hey, Emily. It’s me. Sara. I’m just calling to tell you I love you.” My words come out quickly. I know that if I stop in the middle, I won’t  ______ 12 ______  them. “I know we aren’t as close as some sisters,  ______ 13 ______  that doesn’t mean I don’t love you.” After a long time, she says, “Your words make me feel you are by my side. I love you, too.” I never feel so great to have Emily as my sister. I’m hoping to see  ______ 14 ______  back home this December.

questions.prompt: My daughter often helps  ______  do some housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我女儿经常帮我做一些家务活。 考查代词辨析。I我；me我，宾格；my我的。此处是help sb do sth“帮助某人做某事”的结构，位于动词后，应用人称代词宾格me。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What’s this  ______  English? —A blackboard.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个用英语怎么说？——一块黑板。 考查介词辨析。on在……上面；for为了；in用。根据答语“A blackboard.”以及“What’s this...English”可知，问句是问“这个用英语怎么说”，in English表示“用英语”。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to go to the cartoon show with me? —It sounds like fun,  ______  I’m too busy.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你愿意和我一起去看卡通片吗？——听起来很有趣，但我太忙了。 考查连词辨析。but但是；so因此；and和。分析句子可知，前后句之间是转折关系，需用连词but“但是”连接。故选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______  apples on the table.
questions.explanation: 句意：桌子上有一些苹果。 考查主谓一致。空后“apples”是复数，作There be句型的主语，所以be动词用are。故选B。

questions.prompt: Betty’s mom often  ______  a movie at the weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂的妈妈经常在周末看电影。 考查动词时态。根据often可知，此句是一般现在时，主语是单数形式，动词用三单，故选C。

questions.prompt: Look!  ______  happy family!
questions.explanation: 句意：看！多么幸福的家庭啊！ 考查感叹句。本句中心词family是可数名词单数，符合结构：What a/an+形容词+可数名词单数+主谓。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Are there  ______  bananas in it? —Let me see. Oh, there are  ______  bananas in it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——里面有香蕉吗？——让我看看。哦，里面有一些香蕉。 考查some/any的用法。some一些，一般用于肯定句；any一些，一般用于否定句和疑问句。第一句是一般疑问句，应用any；第二句是肯定句，应用some。故选C。

questions.prompt: Can you  ______  very well?
questions.explanation: 句意：你画得很好吗？ 考查情态动词用法。空前有情态动词can，所以动词用原形，故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  my cousin, Jenny. We  ______  good friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我的表妹，珍妮。我们是好朋友。 考查主谓一致。第一空后名词是单数，所以be动词用is，排除B；第二空前主语是复数，be动词用are，故选C。 （二）根据短文内容，从各题所给的A、B两个选项中选出正确选项。 A Beijing is the capital of China. There are many  ______ 13 ______  places and also a lot of delicious food in Beijing. Beijing Roast Duck is famous in the world. People in Beijing are very friendly and warm-hearted, and they always try  ______ 14 ______  best to help others.

questions.prompt: My aunt is a doctor at a children’s hospital.  ______  always works very hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姑妈是一家儿童医院的医生。她总是工作很努力。 考查人称代词。She她；He他；We我们；They他们。根据“My aunt…”可知，此处指代上文中提到的“aunt”，故用She指代。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What’s Mrs. Smith’s telephone number? — ______  telephone number is 6789247.
questions.explanation: 句意：——史密斯太太的电话号码是多少？——她的电话号码是6789247。 考查代词辨析。His他的，形容词性物主代词；He他，人称代词主格；Her她的，形容词性物主代词；She她，人称代词主格。Mrs. Smith是女性，此处应用形容词性物主代词her，作定语修饰telephone number。故选C。

questions.prompt: The bus stop is  ______  the left of the hospital.
questions.explanation: 句意：公共汽车站在医院的左边。 考查介词辨析。in在……里面；on在……上面；at在；behind在……后面。on the left of“在……的左边”，故选B。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a tiger and two lions in the zoo. Let’s go there this weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：动物园里有一头老虎和两头狮子。我们这周末去那吧。 考查there be句型。根据“there”可知，句子是there be句型，排除B和D，there be句型中be动词取决于离它最近的名词，“a tiger”是可数名词单数，所以用be动词的单数is，排除A，故选C。

questions.prompt: —What’s the weather like in Harbin  ______  winter? —It’s cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：——哈尔滨冬天的天气怎么样？——很冷。 考查介词辨析。on其后加星期或具体的时间；at其后加点钟；in其后加早中晚，月份，季节，年份等；to到。in winter“在冬天”，故选C。

questions.prompt: My name is Tony Smith  ______  I’m English.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的名字是托尼·史密斯而且我是英国人。 考查连词辨析。so因此；but但是；or否则；and和。空前后都在介绍自己，用and连接表等同关系的并列句。故选D。

questions.prompt: We haven’t got meat for dinner. Let’s buy ______ chicken.
questions.explanation: 句意：晚饭我们没有肉吃。我们买些鸡肉吧。本题考查some与any的用法。some和any都可以表示一些，some用在肯定句中。any一般用在否定句或者疑问句中。根据We haven’t got ______  meat for dinner. 可知，该句话是否定句，因此第一个空用any；排除A/B；句子Let’s buy  ______  chicken.是肯定句，因此填some。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  is your brother’s favorite sport? — His favorite sport is football.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你哥哥做喜欢的运动是什么？——他最喜欢的运动是足球。 考查特殊疑问句。What什么；Who谁；Why为什么；How怎么样。根据“His favorite sport is football.”可知，上文应该问最喜欢的运动是什么。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Have you got any friends in China? — ______. Daming and Lingling are my good friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你在中国有朋友吗？——是的，我有。大明和玲玲是我的好朋友。 考查一般疑问句。以“Have you”开头的一般疑问句，肯定回答用：Yes, I have. 否定回答用：No, I haven’t. 根据“Daming and Lingling are my good friends.”可知在中国有朋友，用肯定回答。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What day is it today? — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天星期几？——星期四。 考查情景交际。It’s Thursday今天是星期四；It’s May 5今天是5月5日；It’s 9:30现在是9:30；It’s sunny天气晴朗。根据“What day is it today?”可知要回答今天星期几。故选A。 二、完形填空 (每题 0.5 分，共 5 分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A 、B 、C 、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 One day, Mother Monkey is playing with her children in the park. Later, they are hungry, so Mother Monkey takes them out to look for  ______ 11 ______. She finds a banana tree. Mother Monkey wants her daughters to  ______ 12 ______  some  ______ 13 ______  on the tree. But no one wants to do it. Mother Monkey has to do it herself. Some hours later,  ______ 14 ______  gets a lot of bananas. She says to her children, “Who would like to  ______ 15 ______  these bananas into our house?” No one wants to do it. So she takes the bananas home herself. When she gets  ______ 16 ______, she says, “Who can help to make fruit salad?” Her daughters all say, “Sorry, Mom, we are not  ______ 17 ______.”  ______ 18 ______  she makes the salad, she says to them, “Who wants to eat the salad?” “I will, Mom!” They all say. “No, you can’t  ______ 19 ______  you don’t do anything before I make the salad. You must  ______ 20 ______  ‘No pains, no gains(不劳无获)’. ” Then she eats the salad herself.

questions.prompt: This is my uncle.  ______  is an English teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我的叔叔。他是一名英语老师。 考查代词辨析。He他，人称代词主格；She她，人称代词主格；They他们，人称代词主格；Her她（的），人称代词宾格或形容词性物主代词。句中缺少主语，用人称代词主格，根据“This is my uncle.”可知主语用He作主语。故选A。

questions.prompt: I get up  ______  half past six, and then have breakfast.
questions.explanation: 句意：我六点半起床，然后吃早餐。 考查时间介词。in用于年、月、季节等较长一段时间前；on用于具体某一天前；at用于时刻前；to向，朝着。根据“half past six”可知，此处要用时间介词at。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  we got any coffee? —No, we haven’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们有咖啡吗？——不，我们没有。 考查一般疑问句。Do助动词，构成一般疑问句时，主语后用动词原形；Can能够；Have有，动词原形；Has有，have的第三人称单数形式。根据“... we got any coffee?”可知用have got表示“有”，主语we前用have的原形。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is the library? — It’s on the left of the dining hall.
questions.explanation: 句意：——图书馆在哪里？——它在餐厅的左边。 考查特殊疑问句。Where在哪里；What什么；How old多大年龄；How much多少钱。根据“It’s on the left of the dining hall.”可知，问句是询问位置，应用Where。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Betty.  ______  is your sister? —She is ten years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，Betty。你妹妹几岁了？——她十岁了。 考查特殊疑问句。How如何；What什么；How many多少；How old多少岁。根据“She is ten years old.”可知询问年龄。故选D。

questions.prompt: Juice is a healthy drink,  ______  cola isn’t a healthy drink.
questions.explanation: 句意：果汁是一种健康饮品，但可乐不是一种健康饮品。 考查连词辨析。and和；or否则；so因此；but但是。空前介绍健康饮品，空后介绍不健康饮品，句意出现转折，用but表转折。故选D。

questions.prompt: Let’s  ______  shopping for some food and drink.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们去买些食物和饮料吧。 考查非谓语动词。let sb. do sth.“让某人做某事”，是固定搭配。此处用省略to的动词不定式作宾语补足语。故选A。

questions.prompt: I like swimming because it is  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢游泳因为它很有趣。 考查形容词辨析。tired劳累的；boring无聊的；interesting有趣的；hard困难的。根据“I like swimming”可知介绍喜欢游泳的原因，应是有趣的。故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  some milk in the bottle.
questions.explanation: 句意：瓶子里有一些牛奶。 考查主谓一致。主语“some milk”是不可数名词，There be句型中be动词用is。故选B。

questions.prompt: My grandfather watches TV news and  ______  newspapers in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爷爷晚上看电视新闻并看报纸。 考查主谓一致。and连接并列谓宾结构，根据“watches”可知主语“My grandfather”后并列谓语都用第三人称单数形式。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  every day because it’s good for my health.
questions.explanation: 句意：我每天都吃早饭因为它对我的健康有好处。 考查常识和一般现在时。have breakfast“吃早饭”；has是have的第三人称单数形式；don’t have breakfast 不吃早饭；doesn’t用于主语为第三人称单数时。吃早饭有益于健康是一个生活常识，所以排除C和D；该句主语“I”后面跟动词原形，排除B。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Let’s go to the park this Saturday. —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们这个星期六去公园吧。——好主意。 考查情景交际。Thank you谢谢；Good idea好主意；You are right你是对的；Yes, I can是的，我能。根据“Let’s go to the park this Saturday.”可知，此处表示建议，如果对他人的建议表示赞同，其答语通常用Good idea。故选B。 五、完形填空 (共 8 分，每小题 1 分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I am a little helper in the school library. Usually the library is  ______ 13 ______  from nine to four. But on Tuesday and Thursday, it opens very early at 7:50. I have to get there by 7:40 to  ______ 14 ______  the librarian (图书管理员). Usually, I do some cleaning with the librarian first. We  ______ 15 ______  the floor and then the table. After that, we put the  ______ 16 ______  and chairs in place. Students always give back books after school. The next morning, we have to put those books back. It takes lots of  ______ 17 ______. I have to know where  ______ 18 ______  kinds of books should go. After we put all the books back, we turn on (打开) the computer to work. The students can come in and borrow books. We’re always very  ______ 19 ______, but we are happy that students  ______ 20 ______  a lot.

questions.prompt: Mary is my sister.  ______  is in Class Eight.
questions.explanation: 句意：Mary是我的姐姐。她在八班。 考查代词辨析。she她；his他的；he他。根据“sister”可知是女性，且此处是作主语，应用she，故选A。

questions.prompt: Look at the photo. Who is the man  ______  the right of your father?
questions.explanation: 句意：看看这张照片。你父亲右边的那个人是谁？ 考查介词辨析。in在……里面；at在；on在……上。此处是固定短语on the right of“……的右边”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Tony, Daming, Lingling, and Betty  ______  good friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼、大明、玲玲和贝蒂是好朋友。 考查主谓一致。根据“Tony, Daming, Lingling, and Betty”可知主语是复数，所以be动词用are，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  students are there in your class? —Thirty-eight.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你们班级里有多少学生？——三十八个。 考查特殊疑问词。how many多少，修饰可数名词复数；how much多少，修饰不可数名词；how old多大年龄。根据“Thirty-eight.”可知是问学生的数量，应用how many，故选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a book on the desk. Is that yours, Lucy?
questions.explanation: 句意：桌子上有一本书。这是你的吗，露西？ 考查be动词。本句是there be句型，主语是a book，be动词用单数，故选C。

questions.prompt: Ice cream is delicious,  ______  it’s not healthy.
questions.explanation: 句意：冰淇淋很美味，但它不健康。 考查并列连词辨析。but但是；and并且；so因此。根据“Ice cream is delicious”和“it’s not healthy”可知，冰淇淋美味，但不健康，两句存在转折关系，应用并列连词but来连接。故选A。

questions.prompt: My mother is a(n)  ______  and she works in a hospital.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈是一名医生，她在医院工作。 考查名词辨析。doctor医生；actor演员；driver司机。根据“works in a hospital”可知在医院工作的是医生，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Have we got  ______  orange juice? —Not much. Let’s go and get some.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们有橙汁吗？——并不多。我们去买一些吧。 考查代词辨析。some一些，用于肯定句；any任何，用于否定句或一般疑问句；an一，后接可数名词单数。根据“juice”不可数名词，可排除C；此处是一般疑问句，用any而不用some。故选B。 Alice and her  ______ 9 ______  study at the same school, but they are in different grades. She is in Grade Seven. Her brother Tony is in Grade Five, and Peter is in Grade Six. They live in a house near the school. They  ______ 10 ______  to school together every day.

questions.prompt: ______  city is very beautiful. We like it very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的城市很美丽。我们都很喜欢它。 考查代词的用法。Our“我们的”，形容词性物主代词后加名词；We“我们”，人称代词主格形式，作主语；I“我”，人称代词主格形式，作主语；You“你，你们”，人称代词主格或宾格形式，作主语或宾语。根据“...city is very beautiful.”可知此空缺少形容词性物主代词。故选A。

questions.prompt: His name is Jackie Chan, so his family name is  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：他名叫Jackie Chan，因此他的姓氏是Chan。 考查常识与习语。根据“His name is Jackie Chan”和常识可知，英文名字通常是名在前，姓在后；全名为Jackie Chan，姓氏为Chan。故选B。

questions.prompt: Who is the boy  ______  you in the picture?
questions.explanation: 句意：照片中你旁边的男孩是谁？ 考查介词短语。on the left在左边；in front在前面；next to在……旁边；in the left在左边的……，后需要加名词。根据“the boy...you”可知空格后是代词，选项AB后需要加介词后再加代词，选项D后需要加名词，故排除ABD。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Are those girls your friends? —Yes,  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——那些女孩是你的朋友吗？——是的，她们是。 考查一般疑问句的回答。根据“Are those girls...”可知其肯定回答为Yes, they are。故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  some tea and three oranges on the table.
questions.explanation: 句意：桌子上有一些茶和三个橙子。 考查主谓一致。there be“有”遵循就近原则，根据“some tea”可知此处be动词用is。故选A。

questions.prompt: I can’t play the guitar,  ______  my friend Jack can.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不会弹吉他，但我的朋友杰克会。 考查连词辨析。but但是；and和；so所以；because因为。分析句子可知，前后两句是转折关系，用but连接。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  bottles of milk can you put in the fridge? —Maybe eleven.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能冰箱里放几瓶牛奶？——也许11瓶。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少；What什么；How much多少钱；How如何。根据“Maybe eleven.”可知，问句是询问数量，且修饰可数名词bottles，应用How many。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Are there  ______  students in the class? —Yes. There are  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——班上有学生吗？——是的，有一些。 考查代词。some一些，常用于肯定句或希望得到对方回答的疑问句中；any常用于否定句或疑问句中。第一个句子是疑问句，用any；第二个句子是肯定句，用some。故选D。

questions.prompt: Delicious chicken soup  ______  you.
questions.explanation: 句意：美味的鸡汤对你有好处。 考查形容词短语。be good for对……有好处；be bad for对……有害。根据“Delicious chicken soup... you.”可知，鸡汤对人有好处；主语“chicken soup”是不可数名词，be动词用is。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  your classroom  ______  in China? —It’s big and clean.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你们在中国的教室是什么样的？——它又大又干净。 考查特殊疑问句。根据“It’s big and clean.”可知，问句是问学校是什么样的，用句型What’s... like?表示“……怎么样？”。故选B。 五、完形填空（共12分，每小题1.5分） What is the best  ______ 11 ______  to study? This is a very important question. Some Chinese students often  ______ 12 ______  very hard  ______ 13 ______  long hours. This is a  ______ 14 ______  habit, but it is not a better way to study. A good student must  ______ 15 ______  enough sleep, enough food and enough rest. Every day you  ______ 16 ______  to take a walk or play basketball or play ping-pong or sing a song. When you return to your studies, you’ll find yourself stronger than before  ______ 17 ______  you’ll learn more. Perhaps we can say that learning English is like Chinese medicine, we mean that like medicine, the effects (效果) of your study  ______ 18 ______  slowly but surely. Learn every day and effects will come just like Chinese medicine.

questions.prompt: My mother is  ______  actor and my father is  ______  manager.
questions.explanation: 句意：我母亲是一名演员，我父亲是一名经理。 考查冠词的用法。“actor”是以元音音素开头的单词，其前应使用不定冠词an修饰；“manager”是以辅音音素开头的单词，其前应使用不定冠词a修饰。故选D。

questions.prompt: The girl over there is my friend.  ______  English name is Mary.
questions.explanation: 句意：那边的女孩是我的朋友。她的英文名字是玛丽。 考查代词辨析。He他；She她；Her她的，形容词性物主代词；His他的，形容词性物主代词。根据“English name is Mary”可知此处是形容词性物主代词修饰名词短语English name“英文名”；girl对应her。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  your friend from America? — No, he’s from Korea.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的朋友来自美国吗？——不，他来自韩国。 考查be动词。主语是your friend，be动词用is。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What’s your grandfather like? — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的爷爷是什么样子的？——他非常友善。 考查情景交际。问句是一个特殊疑问句，疑问词what用于询问某人或某物的特征、性质或状态，D项“爷爷非常友善”符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: Betty’s mother is a nurse, and she works at a  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂的妈妈是一名护士，她在一家医院工作。 考查名词辨析。factory工厂；theater剧院；hotel宾馆；hospital医院。根据“Betty’s mother is a nurse”知，护士在医院里工作。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Are these his books? —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些是他的书吗？——是的，它们是。 考查一般疑问句。问句是一个以Are开头的一般疑问句，用来询问这些书是否属于某人；答句应用主格代词they作主语代替问句中的these books，肯定和否定回答应分别是“Yes, they are”和“No, they aren’t”。C项“是的，它们是”符合要求。故选C。

questions.prompt: — What’s your job? —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的工作是什么？——我是一名老师。 考查特殊疑问句。I’m from England我来自英国；I’m twelve我十二岁；I’m fine, thank you我很好，谢谢；I’m a teacher我是一名老师。根据“What’s your job?”可知回答应该是职业。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Where are the students? —They are having lunch in the  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——学生们在哪里？——他们正在餐厅吃午饭。 考查名词辨析。dining hall餐厅；library图书馆；sports hall体育馆；science lab科学实验室。根据“having lunch”可知，他们是在餐厅里吃饭。故选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a lot of furniture in our classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们教室里有很多家具。 考查there be句型。根据“There”可知，此处为There be句型，谓语动词遵循“就近原则”。由“a lot of furniture”可知，furniture“家具”，不可数名词，be动词应用is。故选A。 10 –Are there any students in the classroom? -- ______. It is Sunday today. A. Yes, there is. B. Yes, there are. C. No, there isn’t. D. No, there aren’t. 【答案】D 【解析】 【详解】句意：——在教室里有学生吗？——不，没有。今天是星期天。 本题考查there be 句型的基本用法。There be句型的一般疑问句形式，are there…?其回答形式为：Yes, there are. I go to school by  ______ 12 ______  every day. I live in Beijing. There are four people in my  ______ 13 ______. They are my father, my mother, my  ______ 14 ______  and I. My father is a manager and my mother is a  ______ 15 ______  at a hospital. My sister and I are  ______ 16 ______  school. There are some  ______ 17 ______  in my city. questions.prompt: （1分） ______ classroom building is tall.How about ______ ？（　　）
（1分） Look!There are so many black clouds in the sky.I think it ______.（　　）
（1分） These kids are looking forward ______ their favourite star.（　　）

Mr. Wang is our history teacher.  ______  is very kind to us.
questions.explanation: 句意：王老师是我们的历史老师。他对我们很友善。 考查代词辨析。It它；He他；She她；They他们/她们/它们。 根据“Mr. Wang”可知，王老师是男的，应用表示男性的“he”。故选B。

questions.prompt: There is  ______  big tree in the garden. I often play under it with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：花园里有一棵大树。我经常和朋友们在树下玩。 考查冠词。a不定冠词，用于辅音音素开头的单词前；an不定冠词，用于元音音素开头的单词前；the定冠词；/零冠词。根据“There is...big tree in the garden.”可知，此处指花园里有一棵大树，应用不定冠词a/an，“big”是辅音音素开头的单词，应用a。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Whose book is that? — Oh, it’s  ______  book.
questions.explanation: 句意：——那是谁的书？——哦，它是我的书。 考查代词辨析。I我，主格；me我，宾格；my我的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词。此空修饰名词book，应填形容词性物主代词，故选C。

questions.prompt: My classmates  ______  very nice and we often have fun together.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的同学都很友好，我们经常一起玩。 考查be动词。is用于第三人称单数；am用于第一人称单数；be原形；are用于第二人称和第一、三人称复数。根据“My classmates”可知，主语是第三人称复数，应用are。故选D。

questions.prompt: Jason usually gets up at 6 o’clock  ______  the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰森通常早上6点起床。 考查介词辨析。in后加某年某月某季节；to到；at后加具体的时刻；on后加具体到某一天。根据“the morning”可知，此处是指“in the morning”“在早上”，是固定短语。故选A。

questions.prompt: Tina can speak Chinese,  ______  she cannot write.

questions.prompt: Dale is on the school baseball team and he  ______  baseball every day.

questions.prompt: What a fine day today! Let’s  ______  to the park.

questions.prompt: I often go shopping with my mum  ______  Saturdays.

questions.prompt: —Do you like playing football? —Yes, I  ______.

questions.prompt: David has a sister and two  ______.

questions.prompt: — ______  is that? —That’s Li Ming’s grandpa.

questions.prompt: My grandparents live near  ______. We often visit them.

questions.prompt: My teacher  ______  us to the History Museum last Sunday.

questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下。你知道去医院的路吗？——抱歉，我不知道。请问那个人。 考查情景交际。I’m sure我确信；OK, thanks好的，谢谢；Sorry, I don’t know对不起，我不知道；It’s quite near它很近；根据答句“Please ask that man”提示，回答者不知道去医院的路，所以建议问其他人。故选C。 二、完形填空（共8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 The Read family come to a new big city. Mrs. Read’s son, Bob, is not happy. He doesn’t have anyone to play with. “Don’t worry!” says his mother. “You will soon make  ______ 13 ______  here.” One morning, there is a knock at the door. Bob’s mother, Mrs. Read,  ______ 14 ______  it. There stands a woman with round glasses. It is Mrs. Miller. She comes to borrow some eggs. She wants to make cakes. Mrs. Read gives her two. In the afternoon, there is another knock at the door. Mrs. Read opens it and she sees a  ______ 15 ______  standing there. “My name is Jack Miller,” he says. “My mother sends you this  ______ 16 ______  and two eggs.” “Well, thank you, Jack,” says Mrs. Read. “ ______ 17 ______  and meet my son, Bob.” Look! Bob and Jack are having the cake. They are talking  ______ 18 ______. Now they are friends! Jack says, “I’m glad you live next door.” Bob says, “I must thank your mother for coming to borrow eggs.” Jack laughs and tells Bob, “My mother doesn’t want the two eggs, but she wants to make friends with your mother!” Bob says, “That’s a  ______ 19 ______  way to make friends. It’s an easy way, too. It can work!” So if you want to make friends, you can always  ______ 20 ______  some ways!

questions.prompt: Miss Wang is my Chinese teacher.  ______  class is really interesting.
questions.explanation: 句意：王老师是我的语文老师。她的课真的很有趣。 考查形容词性物主代词。My我的；Your你的；Her她的；His他的。根据“Miss Wang”和“class”可知，此处应填形容词性物主代词。“Miss”是指女性，故选C。

questions.prompt: It’s great for hiking  ______  autumn because of the cool weather.
questions.explanation: 句意：秋天天气凉爽，非常适合徒步旅行。 考查介词辨析。in用于年/月/季节前；on用于具体某一天前；at用于具体的时刻前；to（距整点）差。根据所给空后面的“autumn”可知，此处用in接季节。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Cathy,  ______  do you exercise? —Almost every day. It’s good for my health.
questions.explanation: 句意：——凯茜，你多久锻炼一次？——几乎每天都锻炼。这对我的健康有好处。 考查由how组成的疑问词组。how many多少（提问可数名词的数量）；how much多少（提问不可数名词的数量），多少钱；how long多久（提问时长）；how often多久一次（提问频率）。根据“Almost every day.”可知，这是对频率进行的提问，因此疑问词应用how often。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  penguins fly like other birds? —No, but they can swim very fast like fish.
questions.explanation: 句意：——企鹅能像其他鸟一样飞吗？——不能，但它们能像鱼一样游得很快。 考查情态动词辨析。Can可以，能；Should应该；Must必须；May也许。根据“but they can swim very fast like fish”可知，问句提问企鹅是否能像其他鸟一样飞。故选A。

questions.prompt: I’m not good at English speaking  ______  I won’t give up.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不擅长英语口语，但我不会放弃。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；or或者；because因为。根据“I’m not good at English speaking”以及“I won’t give up”可知，前后句之间表达的是转折关系，应该用but连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: —How did you spend the Dragon Boat Festival last week? —I  ______  zongzi and watched dragon boat race on TV.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上周你怎么度过端午节的？——我吃了粽子，观看电视上的龙舟赛。 考查一般过去时。根据“last week”和“watched”可知，句子应用一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: Let’s be quiet. Grandpa  ______  in the next room now.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们安静点吧。爷爷现在正在隔壁房间里睡觉。 考查现在进行时。根据“now"可知，句子应用现在进行时，其谓语结构为：主语+am/is/are+现在分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What will Tom do next Sunday? —He  ______  the Science Museum with his friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆下周日将做什么？——他将和朋友一起参观科学博物馆。 考查一般将来时。根据“next Sunday”可知，此处表示将来发生的动作，应用一般将来时will do。故选D。 二、完形填空。 阅读读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C. D四个选项中选择最佳选项。 Many years ago, when I was 5 years old, my mother grew some plants on the balcony (阳台). As  ______ 9 ______  came, some flowers came out. I enjoyed looking at them very much. They were so  ______ 10 ______. But they didn’t give out any sweet smells (气味). How can I  ______ 11 ______  them to smell as good as they look? After  ______ 12 ______  about the problem for a few days, I had a good idea. One day, when my parents were not at home, I picked a bottle of perfume (香水) from my mother’s dressing table. Then I  ______ 13 ______  the bottle cap and poured (倾倒) some perfume onto the plants. I was very  ______ 14 ______  that I helped to make my lovely flowers become better. But to my surprise (惊讶), a few days later, I noticed the flowers fell (凋落), before summer arrived, the plants lost their lives. I cried and I knew I did something wrong. Later, my mother told me the  ______ 15 ______. She said the perfume was really bad for plants. Some beautiful flowers have no smells at all. We can’t change it as we like. Everything in life follows the ways of nature (自然). We must not put our ideas into  ______ 16 ______  before we learn about the ways of nature. What a lesson!

questions.prompt: — ______  are these apples? —They’re 20 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些苹果多少钱？——它们二十元。 考查特殊疑问句。How much表示数量，提问不可数名词和价钱等；How long多久，提问时间；How often多久一次，提问频率；How many表示数量，提问可数名词。根据答语“They’re 20 yuan.”可知是对价格提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: I want to have a trip  ______  I’m too busy.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想去旅行，但我太忙了。 考查连词辨析。and和；or或者、否则；but但是；so所以。根据“I want to have a trip... I’m too busy.”可知，空前后句是转折关系，用but连接。故选C。

questions.prompt: —There  ______  a concert at the Bird’s Nest next Sunday. Would you like to come? —Sure. I’d love to!
questions.explanation: 句意：——下星期天鸟巢将有一场音乐会。你愿意来吗？——当然，我很乐意！ 考查时态。根据“next Sunday”可知，时态用一般将来时，其结构为“will+动词原形”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Lucy loves writing. She  ______  a diary every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：露西喜欢写作。她每天写日记。 考查一般现在时。根据“every day”可知，“写日记”是经常性的动作，应用一般现在时。故选B。

questions.prompt: Mum  ______  in the kitchen now. Let’s help her together.
questions.explanation: 句意：妈妈现在正在厨房做饭。让我们一起帮助她。 考查时态。根据“now”及“Let’s help her together.”可知，此处是指妈妈现在正在做饭，用现在进行时am/is/are doing，主语是三单，be用is。故选C。

questions.prompt: Last week, I  ______  to Beijing Zoo with my parents and saw the cute pandas.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周，我和父母去了北京动物园，看到了可爱的熊猫。 考查一般过去时。根据“Last week”可知，此处表示过去发生的动作，应用一般过去时。故选A。 二、用所给词的适当形式填空阅读下面的短文用括号中所给单词的正确形式填入空白处补全文章。 In the past, my hometown was very small. People lived a hard life. The houses were old and small. There was rubbish everywhere. There weren’t many cars or  ______ 7 ______  (bus). So only a few visitors came here. Now there are many great changes in my hometown. The mountains turn greener and the rivers turn clearer. There are trees, flowers and grass everywhere. People live a better life. There are new and large houses. Many people also have  ______ 8 ______  (they) own cars. A lot of people want  ______ 9 ______  (visit) this beautiful place. I’m sure my hometown will become better in the future. 【答案】7. buses

questions.prompt: —Hi,Tom. I can’t find my eraser. May I use  ______? —Sure. Here you are.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，汤姆。我找不到我的橡皮擦了。我可以用你的吗？——当然。给你。 考查代词辨析。hers她的；his他的；yours你的、你们的；mine我的。根据“Hi,Tom. I can’t find my eraser.”可知，是找不到自己的橡皮擦了，因此这里应是说我可以用你的吗，设空处后面没有名词，所以要用名词性物主代词yours。故选C。

questions.prompt: — you speak French? —Yes, but only a little.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会说法语吗？——是的，但是只会一点。 考查情态动词辨析。can能，会；must一定，必须；may可以，可能；need需要。根据“...you speak French?”可知，此处询问对方会不会说法语。故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  Chinese food for my friends tomorrow evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：我明天晚上将为我的朋友们做中国食物。 考查时态。根据“tomorrow evening”可知用一般将来时，其结构为be going to do。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is your T-shirt? —It’s M.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的T恤是什么尺码？——M码。 考查特殊疑问句。What color什么颜色；What size什么尺码；How many多少，修饰可数名词复数；How much多少，修饰不可数名词。根据“It’s M.”可知，对尺寸提问用What size。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me! Is there a bookstore near here? —Yes. There is one  ______  the left of the bank at the corner.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下！这附近有书店吗？——是的。在银行左边的拐角处有一家。 考查介词辨析。on在……上；for为了；in在……里面；of……的。on the left of，固定搭配，意为“在……的左边”。故选A。

questions.prompt: It ______ for hours last night so the air is very clean today.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天晚上下了几个小时的雨, 所以今天的空气很干净。 考查时态。根据 last night，可知时态是一般过去时，用动词过去式。故选A。

questions.prompt: Tony always the best score in matches. He really enjoys sports.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼总是在比赛中取得最好的成绩。他真的很喜欢运动。 考查时态辨析。根据句中关键词“always”和题干可知，句子的时态为一般现在时态，主语Tony是第三人称单数，故动词get要使用第三人称单数形式gets。故选A。

questions.prompt: I often spend two hours  ______  some English books on weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常在周末花两个小时读一些英语书。 考查非谓语动词。根据“spend”可知，spend+时间+(in) doing sth“花费时间做某事”，此处为动名词作宾语。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to see a film with us? — ______. A That’s right
questions.explanation: 句意：——你想和我们一起看电影吗？——是的，我乐意。 考查情景交际。That’s right那是正确的；You’re welcome不用谢；It doesn’t matter没关系；Yes, I’d like to是的，我乐意。根据“Would you like to see a film with us?”是邀请对方一起去看电影，D选项符合题意，表示接受邀请。故选D。 二、完形填空,阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 When I was nine years old, I loved to go fishing with my dad. But the only thing that wasn’t very fun was that he could catch many fish but I couldn’t. I was usually  ______ 11 ______  and kept asking him why. He always answered, “Son, if you want to catch a fish, you have to  ______ 12 ______  like a fish”. I became even more confused (困惑的) because “I’m not a fish!” I didn’t know how to think like one. Also, how could what I think  ______ 13 ______  me catch a fish? As I got a little older, I began to understand what my dad really meant. I read some books on fish. I even  ______ 14 ______  a fishing club and went to their meetings every month. I learned that a fish is a cold-blooded (冷血的) animal so its body temperature (温度) changes when the water temperature changes. That’s why they love to stay in shallow (浅的) water. It is  ______ 15 ______  there when there is sunlight. But fish don’t have any eyelids (眼皮) and the sun hurts their  ______ 16 ______. The more I understood fish, the better I became at finding and catching them. When I  ______ 17 ______  and started my first job, my boss said, “We all need to think like sales people.” But I didn’t think so. My dad never said, “If you want to catch a fish you need to think like a fisherman.” What he said was, “You need to think like a fish.” So I tried to think like my customers (顾客). Over the years, I found out what they really liked and needed. It is not a (an)  ______ 18 ______  job, but it is what made me successful.

questions.prompt: My mother is a doctor.  ______  works in a hospital.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的母亲是一名医生，她在医院工作。 考查人称代词的主格。He他，主格，放于句首作主语；His他的，形容词性物主代词，后接名词；She她，主格，放于句首作主语；Her她的，形容词性物主代词，后接名词。谓语动词works前面缺少主语，又因为my mother是女士，故代词用She，作主语。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What time do you usually get up? —I usually get up  ______  6:00.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你通常几点起床？——我通常6点起床。 考查介词辨析。in用于年/月/季节或泛指的某一天的上午，下午和晚上前；at用于具体的钟点前；on用于具体的某一天或者具体某一天的上/下午/晚上；from从。根据“6:00”可知，指的是具体的某一时刻。故选B。

questions.prompt: Ice-cream tastes good,  ______  it is not good for health.
questions.explanation: 句意：冰淇淋很好吃，但对健康不好。 考查连词辨析。so因此；and和；but但是；or或者。根据“Ice-cream tastes good,... it is not good for health.”可知，前后句表达的是转折关系，因此应用but来连接。故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  many flowers in our school yard. They look very nice.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校的院子里有很多花。它们看起来很好看。 本题考查there be 句型。there be 句型指“某处存在……”、“有……”的意思。be动词单复数取决于就近be动词的名词单复数。flowers是复数名词，be动词用复数形式are。根据“They look very nice.”可知，句子的时态是一般现在时，There be句型是倒装句式，此空故填are，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  does your brother look like? —He is tall and thin.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你哥哥长什么样？——他又高又瘦。 考查特殊疑问句。Where哪里；Why为什么；When何时；What什么。根据“He is tall and thin”可知，此处是询问外貌，句型为What does sb. look like，表示“某人长什么样”。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  you play the guitar? —Yes, I can. And I’m good at it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会弹吉他吗？——是的，我会。并且我很擅长这个。 考查动词辨析。Can能，会；May可以；Must必须；Need需要。根据“Yes, I can”可知，一般疑问句用什么问用什么答，此处应询问对方是否会弹吉他，表示一种能力，应用can。故选A。

questions.prompt: Please be quiet. My baby sister  ______  now.
questions.explanation: 句意：请保持安静。我的小妹妹正在睡觉。 考查动词时态。根据“Please be quiet…now”可知，此处是指小妹妹正在睡觉，时态应用现在进行时，其结构为“be doing”。故选C。

questions.prompt: We  ______  the Olympic Park last Saturday and we had a wonderful time.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们上周六参观了奥林匹克公园，我们玩得很高兴。 考查一般过去时。根据“last Sunday”可知事情发生在过去，谓语用动词的过去式表示。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  sports with my classmates after school every Monday.
questions.explanation: 句意：每周一放学后，我都和同学一起参加体育运动。 考查动词时态。由时间状语“every Monday”可知，本句时态为一般现在时；I作主语，动词要用原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: My brother is coming home from Shanghai. I will meet  ______  at the train station.
questions.explanation: 句意：我弟弟要从上海回家。我将在火车站接他。 考查人称代词。it它；her她；him他；them他们。根据“My brother is coming home from Shanghai.”可知，弟弟为男性，用him指代，故选C。

questions.prompt: I’m going to the zoo with my sister  ______  January 15th. It’s her birthday.
questions.explanation: 句意：1月15日，我要和姐姐一起去动物园。那天是她的生日。 考查介词辨析。in表示某个时间段、某个月份、季节或年份；on表示某一天、某一日的早中晚或某个具体的星期几；at表示具体的时刻或某个时间点；to朝，向。根据“January 15th”可知，1月15日是具体的某一天，要用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: I have to leave now,  ______  I will be late for the meeting.
questions.explanation: 句意：我现在必须走了，否则我开会要迟到了。 考查连词辨析。for为了；but但是；or否则；so所以。根据空格前“I have to leave now”和空格后“I will be late for the meeting”可知，我现在必须要走，“否则”开会就要迟到，所以空格处填连词or。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you play basketball, Daming? —Twice a week. I play basketball with my friends after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：——大明，你多久打一次篮球？——一周两次。放学后我和朋友们一起打篮球。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长、多久；How often多久一次，询问频度；How much多少，后接不可数名词；How soon多久以后。根据“Twice a week.”可知是频度，应用How often提问。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Tom, what are you doing? —I  ______  my email.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你在干什么？——我正在查看我的电子邮件。 考查动词时态。问句“what are you doing?”时态为现在进行时，故答语时态也为现在进行时，其结构为“am/is/are+doing”，主语I是第一人称单数形式，所以be用am。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where is Mary? —She is in her bedroom. She  ______  her homework now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玛丽在哪儿？——她在她的卧室里。她现在正在做作业。 考查动词的时态。根据“now”可知，此句应用现在进行时：主语+be动词+动词的现在分词。故选D。

questions.prompt: Jane sometimes  ______  around the city with her parents on weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：简有时在周末和她的父母一起在城市里旅行。 考查动词时态。根据“sometimes”可知，表示经常性或习惯性的动作要用一般现在时，主语Jane是第三人称单数，动词要用三单形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: Yesterday, Lily  ______  her homework because she was ill.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天，莉莉没有做作业，因为她生病了。 考查一般过去时。根据“Yesterday”可知，事情发生在过去，因此此处用一般过去时，其谓语动词构成是动词过去式，此处用didn’t do。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tim  ______  some trees in his garden next weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：蒂姆下周末打算在他的花园里种一些树。 考查动词时态。根据“next weekend”可知，句子时态为一般将来时态，结构为will+do 或 am/is/are going to do。故选D。

questions.prompt: Monkeys always move  ______  when they see bananas.
questions.explanation: 句意：当猴子看到香蕉时动作总是很快。 考查词义辨析及用法。quick快的，形容词；slow慢的，形容词；quickly快速地，副词；slowly缓慢地，副词。根据“Monkeys always move...when they see bananas.”可知，此处指猴子动作快，结合设空处修饰动词move，所以选填副词quickly。故选C。

questions.prompt: We haven’t got  ______  bananas. Let’s go and buy  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们没有香蕉了。我们去买一些吧。 考查some和any的用法。some一些，一般用于肯定句；any一些，用于否定句或疑问句中。根据“We haven’t got... bananas. Let’s go and buy...”可知，第一句是否定句，空处用any；第二句是肯定句，空处用some。故选A。 三、完形填空。 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Power of Dream (梦想) As Tony walked with his family along the river, he saw a man playing the saxophone by the river. At the same time, he was  ______ 18 ______  to the beautiful music from his saxophone. There were many people around him. When Tony’s family had already walked on up the river, he was still lost in the  ______ 19 ______  of playing the saxophone one day. Two weeks later, it was Tony’s birthday. When he opened his  ______ 20 ______  from his parents, he was glad to find it was a saxophone! He blew (吹) the mouth of the saxophone and tried to  ______ 21 ______  it, but the saxophone wouldn’t make a sound. Then his dad told him to  ______ 22 ______  the instrument (乐器) book to learn what to do. After about 15 minutes, he raised it slowly to his lips (嘴唇) as his family watched. But  ______ 23 ______  there was no sound. He blew and blew but he couldn’t get the saxophone to work. He was almost  ______ 24 ______  when suddenly the saxophone made the most beautiful sound which made him think of the music of the man by the river. Then he began to take saxophone classes after school. His  ______ 25 ______  taught him how to play it. When he was learning, he always  ______ 26 ______  the man playing the saxophone by the river. His  ______ 27 ______  of playing musical instrument were gradually improved and at last he could play music with his saxophone. Now Tony is in the TV studio. He is waiting to be called to give his first show on TV.

questions.prompt: —Betty, is this your watch? —No. Mary lost one last week. Maybe it’s  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——贝蒂，这是你的手表吗？——不是。玛丽上周丢了一块手表。也许这是她的。 考查代词辨析。she她（人称代词）；her她的（形容词性物主代词，其后要接名词）；hers她的（名词性物主代词，其后不接名词）。根据“Mary lost one last week. Maybe it’s...”和选项可知，此处表示这块手表也许是她的，空后没有名词，应用hers。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me, is the National Stadium near here? —Yes. Walk along the street for five minutes, and it is  ______  your left.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，国家体育场在这附近吗？——是的。沿着这条街走五分钟，它就在你的左边。 考查介词辨析。to到；in在……里面；on（表示方向）在，向。on one’s left“在某人的左边”，是固定短语。故选C。

questions.prompt: —There  ______  any cola in the fridge. Let’s buy some. —It is bad for your health. What about some milk?
questions.explanation: 句意：——冰箱里没有可乐了。我们买一些吧。 ——这对你的健康有害。来点牛奶怎么样？ 考查主谓一致。isn’t修饰可数名词单数形式或不可数名词；aren’t修饰可数名词复数形式；won’t为助动词，用于一般将来时，后接动词。分析题干，该句为“there be”句型，应遵循“主谓一致”原则，即谓语的数应与该主语的数相一致，主语cola为不可数名词，be动词应用is。故选A。

questions.prompt: During the Tang Dynasty, Du Fu  ______  poems to show care for the poor.
questions.explanation: 句意：在唐代，杜甫写诗来表达对穷人的关心。 考查动词时态。writes写，动词三单形式；will write一般将来时；wrote过去式；根据“During the Tang Dynasty”及常识可知，杜甫写诗这件事发生在过去，该句应为一般过去时，动词应用过去式。故选C。

questions.prompt: With more hard work, we  ______  our city more beautiful in the future.
questions.explanation: 句意：通过更多的努力，我们将在未来使我们的城市更加美丽。 考查一般将来时。根据“in the future”可知，此处表示将来要发生的动作，应用一般将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Quiet, please. Sarah  ______  for an exam now. — Sorry. I didn’t know that. A works
questions.explanation: 句意：——请安静，Sarah现在正在为考试而学习。——对不起，我不知道是那样。 考查现在进行时。根据“now”可知句子用现在进行时。结构是be doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: —My grandparents  ______  Beijing Opera next Saturday. —What a fantastic weekend!
questions.explanation: 句意：——我祖父母下周六要去看京剧。——真是一个很棒的周末！ 考查一般将来时。根据“next Saturday.”可知句子用一般将来时，故选A。

questions.prompt: My elder brother  ______  every week because he loves fitness.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥每周都去健身房，因为他喜欢健身。 考查一般现在时。went to the gym去健身房，一般过去时；goes to the gym去健身房，一般现在时；will go to the gym去健身房，一般将来时。结合“every week”可知，该句应用一般现在时表示平时习惯，主语“My elder brother”为三人称单数，谓语动词应用go的三单形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  are you going to stay in Yunnan? —About ten days. There are so many interesting places.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你打算在云南待多久？——大约十天。那里有如此多有趣的地方。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多久（提问时长）；How far多远（提问距离）；How often多长时间一次（提问频率）。根据“About ten days.”可知，问句提问时长。故选A。 四、完形填空（共10 分，每小题1 分） 根据短文内容，从方框中选出恰当的词。 A. join B. life C. hungry D. enjoy I usually go back to my hometown with my mum during holidays. Last summer, my aunt and cousins joined us. It was one of the best train journeys of my  ______ 11 ______. We took the train after a big meal my mum cooked for us. We planned to stay up late to  ______ 12 ______  the journey in each other’s company. We began the fun by playing cards. Two boys who were sitting behind wanted to  ______ 13 ______  us. We all thought it was fun to play cards with more players. After playing cards for almost four hours, we felt a little tired and  ______ 14 ______. We took out chocolates and biscuits from our bags. We were talking about funny things and laughing a lot while eating the delicious snacks. It was an unforgettable journey. 【答案】11. B 12. D

questions.prompt: Lucy and Lily are sisters.  ______  often help their mother clean the house.
questions.explanation: 句意：露西和莉莉是姐妹。她们经常帮助她们母亲打扫房子。 考查代词辨析。I我；You你，你们；We我们；They他们；根据题干“Lucy and Claire are sisters.”可知，她们经常帮助她们的母亲打扫房间。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  did you go yesterday, John? —I went to the zoo with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——约翰，你昨天去哪儿了？ ——我和我的朋友去了动物园。 考查特殊疑问句。Who谁；When什么时候；Where在哪里；How如何。根据“I went to the zoo with my friends（我和朋友们去了动物园）”可知，此处是对地点提问，应用Where引导特殊疑问句。故选C。

questions.prompt: Sanya on Hainan Island is great for a holiday  ______  winter.
questions.explanation: 句意：海南岛上的三亚是冬季度假的好去处。 考查介词。at在，后加具体的时间点；in在……里，后加一天中的上午，下午或晚上，加月份，季节；on在，后加星期几，节日及具体的日期；to到……。根据“winter”可知，此处是在冬天。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Tim,  ______  you play the piano？ —Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——蒂姆， 你会弹钢琴吗？——是的，我会。 考查情态动词。can会、可以、能；must必须；should应该；need需要。根据“Yes, I can.”可知，一般疑问句用can开头。故选A。

questions.prompt: Giraffes can run fast  ______  they cannot run for a long time.
questions.explanation: 句意：长颈鹿可以跑得很快，但它们不能跑很长时间。 考查连词辨析。and和，然后；but但是；or或者，否则；so因此。根据上文“Giraffes can run fast长颈鹿可以跑得很快”与“they cannot run for a long time不能跑很长时间”之间为转折关系，应用连词but表示转折，意为“但是”。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  are the tomatoes? —They’re 10 yuan a kilo.
questions.explanation: 句意：——西红柿多少钱？——10元一公斤。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少钱；How often多久一次；How long多长；How soon多久以后。根据“They’re 10 yuan a kilo.”可知，设空处是询问价格，故选A。

questions.prompt: Mr. Smith is a great writer and we all like reading  ______  books.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯先生是一位伟大的作家，我们都喜欢读他的书。 考查代词辨析。his他的，名词性或形容词性物主代词；her她、她的，人称代词宾格或形容词性物主代词；their他们的，形容词性物主代词。your你的，你们的，形容词性物主代词。结合“we all like reading…books”可知，此处缺修饰词作定语，且该句主语“Mr. Smith”为男性单数，应用其对应的形容词性物主代词his作定语，修饰名词books。故选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a shop near our home ten years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：十年前我们家附近有一家商店。 考查there be句型的一般过去时。根据时间状语ten years ago“十年前”可知，本句要用一般过去时，a shop 是单数名词， 故be动词应用was。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Peter, what are you doing? —Oh, I  ______  a story about my dog.
questions.explanation: 句意：——皮特，你正在做什么？——哦，我正在写一篇关于我的狗的故事。 考查动词的时态。根据“what are you doing?”可知，事情正在发生，故应用现在进行时，即am/is/are doing的结构。故选B。

questions.prompt: My father and I  ______  basketball last Sunday. A play
questions.explanation: 句意：我和我父亲上个星期天打篮球了。 考查动词的时态。根据“last Sunday”可知，句子为一般过去时，故此处应用过去式。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Ben, what do you usually do after school? —I usually  ______  some sports with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Ben，你放学后通常做什么？ ——我通常和我的朋友做一些运动。 考查动词时态。do做，用于一般现在时；did做，用于一般过去时；will do做，用于一般将来时；am doing正在做，用于现在进行时。根据“what do you usually do after school”可知，此处询问平常习惯或经常性动作，时态应用一般现在时。故选A。

questions.prompt: Susan  ______  her grandma next week.
questions.explanation: 句意：苏珊下星期要去看望她的奶奶。 考查动词时态。visits一般现在时态；will visit一般将来时态；is visiting现在进行时态；visited一般过去时态。根据题干，时间状语next week应用一般将来时，其构成是will+do。故选B。 完形填空（每题 1分, 共 8分）阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 My parents were very excited on my first day at school and so was I. My dad gave me his father’s old pen. He loved that pen, so I was  ______ 13 ______  to have it with me that day. My mum straightened (整理) my clothes and then she  ______ 14 ______  me my lunch bag. I said goodbye to my mum and waited for my dad in the garden. Hand in hand my dad and I soon got to school. He didn’t  ______ 15 ______  long. I was on my own. I didn’t know anyone, so I decided (决定) to  ______ 16 ______  other kids on the playground. It wasn’t difficult for me to make new friends that day. There were many children in the first grade. All of them were nice and two of them were  ______ 17 ______. They were sisters and they were twins (双胞胎). It was amazing (神奇的). You couldn’t tell the  ______ 18 ______  between them. “Did your mum prepare (准备) anything for your lunch?” A girl asked me as I  ______ 19 ______  my lunch bag. “Yes, she did.” I answered. “Would you like to have some cheese?” “Sure, thanks!” She said, “Have some of my fruit, too.” We shared (分享) our  ______ 20 ______, and after lunch we played together on the playground. It was a memorable day for me.

questions.prompt: —Look at this nice watch. Is it  ______, Daming? —No, it isn’t. I think it’s Betty’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——看这只漂亮的手表。这是你的吗，大明？ ——不，不是。我想是贝蒂的。 考查代词辨析。mine我的；yours你的、你们的；his他的；hers她的。根据“Is it..., Daming?”可知，此处是问大明“手表是你的吗”，空处后面没有名词，因此应用名词性物主代词yours。故选B。

questions.prompt: In China, the Spring Festival is often  ______  January or February.
questions.explanation: 句意：在中国，春节通常是在一月或二月。 考查时间介词。on时间介词，用于节日、星期、具体某一天前；at时间介词，用于具体时间点前；for原因介词；in时间介词，用于年、月、季节前。空后为月份，用时间介词in。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you cook? —Yes, I  ______. And I like cooking very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会做饭吗？——是的，我会。我非常喜欢做饭。 考查动词辨析。can会、可以、能；can’t不能；do助动词原形；don’t助动词否定形式。Can开头的一般疑问句，肯定回答用Yes, 主语+can。故选A。

questions.prompt: Tony’s grandparents like to stay healthy,  ______  they get some exercise in the park every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼的祖父母喜欢保持健康，所以他们每天都在公园里锻炼身体。 考查连词辨析。for因为；but但是；or或者；so所以。根据“Tony’s grandparents like to stay healthy,”和“they get some exercise in the park every day.”可知，前后两句是因果关系，前因后果，此处应用so连接句子。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  was your first teacher? —My first teacher was Mrs. Lane. She was strict but very nice.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的第一位老师是谁？ ——我的第一位老师是莱恩太太。她很严格，但人很好。 考查特殊疑问句。Who谁；When什么时候；Where在哪里；Whose谁的。根据“My first teacher was Mrs. Lane.”可知，此处是询问对方第一位老师是谁，应用疑问词Who。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Lingling and I  ______  going to have a picnic at the weekend. Would you like to join us? —I’d love to.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玲玲和我打算周末去野餐。你想加入我们吗？——我很乐意。 考查be动词。am主语为I；is主语为单数；are主语为复数；be动词原形。根据“Lingling and I…going to have a picnic at the weekend”可知题干使用了表示一般将来时的be going to do sth.句型，主语是复数形式，be动词用are。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What is Tom doing now? —He  ______  the house with his parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆现在在做什么？——他正在和父母打扫房子。 考查现在进行时。由“What is Tom doing now”可知，问句为现在进行时，故答语时态也为现在进行时，其结构为：am/is/are+doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: We  ______  a new kind of clothes in the future. They’ll be warm when we’re cold, and cool when we’re hot.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们将在未来穿一种新型的衣物。当我们感到寒冷时，它会保暖，当我们感到炎热时，它会清凉。 考查动词时态。根据“in the future”可知，句子时态为一般将来时态，其构成是：will+do 或 am/is/are going to do。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  a dress for my little sister on her birthday last week.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周我小妹妹生日那天，我给她买了一件衣服。 考查一般过去时。根据“last week”可知，本句表述过去发生的事情，要用一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式。故选D。

questions.prompt: David usually  ______  football on TV at weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：大卫周末通常会在电视上观看足球赛。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语“at weekends”可知句子应用一般现在时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Do you like rock music? —No, I don’t. I think it’s  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你喜欢摇滚乐吗？——不，我没有。我觉得太吵了。 考查形容词辨析。noisy吵闹的；lively活泼的；funny有趣的；fantastic了不起的。根据“Do you like rock music?”和“No, I don’t.”可知，此处需填入一个贬义词，noisy符合语境。故选A。

questions.prompt: We Chinese often  ______  and smile when we meet visitors.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们中国人经常在遇到访客时握手并微笑 考查常识。kiss each other互相亲吻；shake hands握手；hug each other互相拥抱；touch noses摸鼻子。根据“We Chinese”和常识可知，中国人见面打招呼的方式就是互相握手。故选B。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Beth Jones was only eight years old when she first tried playing the drums. One day, she went to the music room. Of all the musical instruments (乐器), the  ______ 13 ______  caught her eyes. She thought they looked cool, and there were many different kinds of drums. She hit them to hear how they sounded. Now Beth is a drummer and gives concerts with her band (乐队) around the country. Many people like their  ______ 14 ______, but she has never had a drum lesson. “It’s easy to  ______ 15 ______  drums on the Internet. So I don’t think it’s important for me to take classes.” said Beth. Giving concerts wasn’t  ______ 16 ______  for Beth in the beginning. She practiced (练习) a lot, but she never played in front of many people. At her first concert, she could feel hundreds of pairs of  ______ 17 ______  around her. They were looking at her, and that made her feel  ______ 18 ______. But soon she got used to (适应) playing in front of lots of people. Beth is very famous in her city now. So, does she enjoy being famous? “I never  ______ 19 ______  to be famous,” she said. “I just want to show (展示) others what I  ______ 20 ______. I want everyone to have a great time at my concerts.”

questions.prompt: Lucy is my friend.  ______  is from Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：Lucy是我的朋友。她来自北京。 考查人称代词。She她；He他；It它；Who谁。根据句意可知，该空代指上句话中提到的“Lucy”，是一个女孩的名字，应用She代替。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What’s your twin brother’s name? —  ______  name is Liu Ming.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的双胞胎哥哥叫什么名字？——他的名字叫刘明。 考查物主代词。My我的；His他的；Her她的；Their他(她、它)们的。根据问题中“…your twin brother’s name”可知，这里问的是兄弟的名字，应用形容词性物主代词His。故选B。

questions.prompt: I get up early  ______  the morning every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：每天早上我都起得很早。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体的时刻前面；in用在年、月、上下午、季节的前面；for为了；with和、带有。in the morning“在早上”，是固定搭配。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Why are you unhappy these days, Julie? —I can’t see the blackboard because two tall boys sits  ______  me.
questions.explanation: 句意：——朱莉，你最近为什么不开心？——我看不见黑板，因为两个高个子男孩坐在我前面。 考查介词短语辨析。behind在……后面；next to紧挨；in front of在……的前面；between在……之间，多与and连用。本句是because引导的原因状语从句，提到“I can’t see the blackboard ”，可知高个子男孩在我前面，因此看不见。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  there forty students in your classroom this year? —You’re right. We work and play together.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今年你们教室里有四十名学生吗？——你是对的。我们一起工作和玩耍。 考查系动词。从答语看，句子要用一般现在时，故而排除A和C；forty students为复数形式，故前面的be动词用are，排除B。故选D。

questions.prompt: Sometimes we can see  ______  stars, but sometimes we can’t see  ______  stars at night.
questions.explanation: 句意：有时我们可以看到许多星星，但有时我们在晚上看不到任何星星。 考查代词辨析。many许多，修饰可数名词复数；much许多，修饰不可数名词；some一些，多用于肯定句；any任何，一些，多用于否定句和疑问句。第一空，“stars”是可数名词复数，空处用many；第二空，否定句中用any。故选A。

questions.prompt: Mr. and Mrs. Brown  ______  a new house.
questions.explanation: 句意：Brown先生和夫人有一个新房子。 考查主谓一致和一般现在时。have got有；has got有，主语为第三人称单数；is是，为单数；are是，主语为复数或第二人称you。该句主语为“Mr. and Mrs. Brown”两人，其后谓语动词不用单数，因此排除B和C；D选项are意义不合适，表示“拥有”用have got。故选A。

questions.prompt: I have plenty of time but I don’t have  ______  money.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有充足时间，但是我没有太多钱。 考查代词辨析。some一些，可以修饰可数或不可数名词；much很多，修饰不可数名词；many许多，修饰可数名词复数；a 一个，修饰可数名词。空后“money”是不可数名词，排除C和D；some用于肯定句，该句是否定句，故排除。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  every day because it’s good for my health.
questions.explanation: 句意：我每天都吃早饭因为它对我的健康有好处。 考查常识和一般现在时。have breakfast“吃早饭”；has是have第三人称单数形式；don’t have breakfast 不吃早饭；doesn’t用于主语为第三人称单数时。吃早饭有益于健康是一个生活常识，所以排除C和D；该句主语“I”后面跟动词原形，排除B。故选A。

questions.prompt: She often  ______  to work.
questions.explanation: 句意：她经常乘坐公共汽车去上班。 考查时态及主谓一致。根据“often”可知要用一般现在时，主语“She”后接动词的第三人称单数形式takes。故选A。 “Are you listening, Simon” Simon’s teacher asks. Simon smiles and shakes (摇晃) his head. He doesn’t often  ______ 11 ______  or try hard in class. Talking is so much better. He wants to be heard. That evening, Simon starts to feel a bit sick. By bedtime, his throat (咽喉) feels really  ______ 12 ______. He has cakes and hot chocolate to make his throat feel better, but he isn’t sure it’ll  ______ 13 ______. The next morning, when he  ______ 14 ______  his mouth to say, “Good morning,” nothing comes out. When he gets to school, Mrs. Jacobs says “hello” to him, and he just nods (点头). When his friends start to ask him what TV shows he watches, he just can’t say anything. By the time they start work, almost everyone is looking at him as if he’s got a third eye. Simon sits in class, bored (无聊的)  ______ 15 ______  he can’t talk to his classmates. He watches them talk to each other, but he can’t even do that. You know what? It isn’t that bad. He can really do his homework that night. It gives  ______ 16 ______  more TV and game time because his  ______ 17 ______  is all finished. The next day, his voice is  ______ 18 ______  back, but he stays quiet (安静的) again. The third day, he can talk  ______ 19 ______, but he doesn’t talk. He listens and puts up his  ______ 20 ______  to speak. What a difference that one day makes!

questions.prompt: There is  ______  picture of  ______  elephant on the wall.
questions.explanation: 句意：墙上有一张大象的照片。 考查冠词辨析。a不定冠词，表泛指，用于辅音音素开头的单词前；an不定冠词，表泛指，用于元音音素开头的单词前。picture以辅音音素发音开头，其前加a；elephant以元音音素发音开头，其前加an。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Why don’t you sit down, Chris? —I can’t see the words clearly. Three tall girls are sitting  ______  me.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你为什么不坐下，克里斯？——我看不清单词。三个高个子女孩坐在我面前。 考查介词及介词短语。next to在……旁边；in front of在……前面；between在……中间；behind在……后面。根据“I can’t see the words clearly. Three tall girls are sitting”可知，因为三个高个子女孩坐在克里斯的前面，克里斯看不清单词，所以站着。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What are these  ______  English? —They are bananas.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些用英语怎么说？——它们是香蕉。 考查介词辨析。on在……上面；with和；of……的；in用（某种语言）。此处是in English“用英语”。故选D。

questions.prompt: We didn’t enjoy the day  ______  the weather was so bad.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们不喜欢这一天，因为天气太糟糕了。 考查连词辨析。if如果，表条件；but但是，表转折；or或者，表选择；because因为，表原因。分析前后句可知，两句话构成因果关系，此处表示原因。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Kate,  ______  did you go yesterday? —I went to the zoo with my friend.
questions.explanation: 句意：—凯特，你昨天去哪儿了？—我和朋友去动物园了。 考查特殊疑问句。A. where在哪儿；B. which哪一个；C. when什么时候；D. what什么。根据回答“我和朋友去动物园了。”可知问句是“你昨天去哪儿了？”故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  is your younger brother? —He is just 3 years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你弟弟多大？——他只有3岁。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少，询问数量；How much多少，询问数量或价格；How old多大，询问年龄；How long多长时间，询问一段时间。根据“He is just 3 years old.”可知，此处询问年龄，故用How old。故选C。

questions.prompt: My father is a tea lover. He tea every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲是个茶爱好者。他每天喝茶。考查动词时态辨析题。every day每天，用于一般现在时，he是单数第三人称，动词需用三单形式，可排除ACD三个选项；根据句意语境，可知选B。

questions.prompt: I visited the National Museum of China yesterday and I  ______  a present for you.
questions.explanation: 句意：我昨天参观了中国国家博物馆，并为你买了一份礼物。 考查动词时态。根据“yesterday”可知，时态是一般过去时，谓语动词用其过去式。故选C。

questions.prompt: It’s time  ______  now, Tony.
questions.explanation: 句意：该走了，托尼。 考查非谓语。It’s time to do sth.“到了该做某事的时候了”，固定句式，故用不定式“to go”。故选D。

questions.prompt: My brothers and I like table tennis. I play with  ______  every weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：我和我的兄弟们都喜欢乒乓球。我每个周末都和他们一起玩。 考查代词辨析。me我；them他们；him他；us我们。根据“My brothers”可知，此处用代词“them”指代上文中提到“brothers”。故选B。

questions.prompt: Students care about  ______  grades at school.
questions.explanation: 句意：学生们在学校关心他们的成绩。 考查代词辨析。they他们，人称代词主格；them它们，人称代词宾格；their他们的，形容词性物主代词；theirs他们的，名词性物主代词。此处用形容词性物主代词their，作定语修饰名词grades。故选C。

questions.prompt: Be quiet, please. The baby  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：请安静。婴儿正在睡觉。 考查动词时态。根据“Be quiet”可知，婴儿正在睡觉，故为现在进行时，结构是be doing。故选C。 四、 完形填空。（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Some people don’t like sports. They say, “Why  ______ 13 ______  time playing sports? They are so  ______ 14 ______ ”. To these people, I want to say, “You have not found the  ______ 15 ______  of sports!”. Let me take you through a game I played last Saturday, and share the ups and downs of the game  ______ 16 ______  you. It was a basketball game in our city, and a lot of people watched it. questions.prompt: Peter likes sports and soccer is  ______  favorite.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得喜欢运动，足球是他的最爱。 考查代词辨析。she她，主格；him他，宾格；her她的，形容词性物主代词； his他的，形容词性物主代词。根据“Peter likes sports”可知，此次是足球是他的最爱。故选D。

questions.prompt: My dad usually goes to work  ______  7:30  ______  the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爸爸通常早上7:30去上班。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体的某一时刻之前；in用于年、月和季节之前以及固定短语中；on用于具体的某一天之前。“7:30”是具体某一时刻，其前介词应用at；in the morning“在早上”，固定短语。故选A。

questions.prompt: Lucy is good at playing  ______  violin and she wants to join the music club.
questions.explanation: 句意：露西擅长拉小提琴，她想加入音乐俱乐部。 考查冠词。a不定冠词，表泛指，用于以辅音音素开头的单词前；an不定冠词，表泛指，用于以元音音素开头的单词前；the定冠词，表特指；/零冠词。表示演奏西洋乐器时，乐器的前面要加定冠词“the”，故选C。

questions.prompt: People cut down many trees,  ______  a lot of animals are losing their homes.
questions.explanation: 句意：人们砍伐了很多树，所以许多动物失去了它们的家园。 考查连词辨析。but但是；or否则，或者；so因此；because因为。“人们砍伐了很多树”是“许多动物失去了它们的家园”的原因，前因后果，用so连接表因果关系的并列句。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is it from your home to the cinema? —It’s about twenty minutes’ walk.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从你家到电影院有多远？——步行大约20分钟。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长；How far多远；How often多久一次；How many多少。根据“It’s about twenty minutes’ walk.”可知，此处对距离进行提问，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Can I go out and play basketball for a while? —I’m afraid you  ______. Work must come first.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以出去打一会儿篮球吗？——恐怕你不能。工作必须是第一位的。 考查情态动词。needn’t不必；mustn’t禁止；shouldn’t不应该；can’t不能。根据“Work must come first”可知是不同意对方的请求，不能出去，用情态动词can’t。故选D。

questions.prompt: My Chinese teacher always tells us  ______  stories and we laugh a lot.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的语文老师总是给我们讲有趣的故事，我们笑得很开心。 考查形容词辨析。interesting有趣的；scary可怕的；easy容易的；boring无聊的。根据“we laugh a lot”可知，我们笑了，所以故事是有趣的，故选A。

questions.prompt: The task is so difficult. I think it will take Bob three months  ______  it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个任务太难了。我想鲍勃要花三个月的时间才能完成。 考查it固定句型。It takes sb+时间+to do sth“花费某人时间做某事”，动词不定式作真正主语，故选A。

questions.prompt: —What’s that terrible noise upstairs? —The children  ______  a party now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——楼上那可怕的噪音是什么？——孩子们正在开派对。 考查现在进行时。根据“The children...a party now.”可知，此处强调动作正在发生，用现在进行时，主语是复数，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Let’s see the pandas first. — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——让我们先看熊猫吧。——听起来不错。 考查情景交际。Thank you谢谢你；Good luck祝你好运；You’re welcome不客气；That sounds good听起来不错。上句“Let’s see the pandas first.”是提出建议，答语应是“听起来不错”，表示赞同。故选D。 五、完形填空(共8分, 每小题1分) Abby’s Lesson Abby’s father was taking her to visit her grandmother. Her dad had to pay a big fine as well. The police officer said that she could have “animal smuggler (走私者)” next to her name. Then she wouldn’t be able to visit her grandmother again. Abby learned there was a very good reason for rules.

questions.prompt: —Is this your mother’s bag? —No.  ______  is blue.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是你妈妈的包吗？——不。她的是蓝色的。 考查名词性物主代词。She“她”，人称代词主格；Herself“她自己”，反身代词；Hers“她的”，名词性物主代词。根据“Is this your mother’s bag? No...is blue.”可知，此处答语是她的包是蓝色的，空处需填名词性物主代词，作主语，hers“她的”，名词性物主代词。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where  ______  you born? —I was born  ______  Shanghai.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你出生在哪里？——我出生在上海。 考查be动词和介词辨析。in在……里，表示“在某范围之内”；on在……上，表示“接壤”。根据“Where...you born? I was born...Shanghai.”可知，主语是you，be动词用were，可排除B选项；空二表示“在上海”，其英文表达为in Shanghai。故选A。

questions.prompt: I was very tired last night,  ______  I went to bed early.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚我很累，所以我很早就上床睡觉了。 考查连词辨析。but但是；so所以；or或者。根据“I was very tired last night”和“I went to bed early”可知，因为昨晚很累，所以上床睡觉早，前后句为因果关系，故应用so来连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s a bit dark. Please turn on the  ______. I want to read a book.
questions.explanation: 句意：光线有点暗。请把灯打开。我想看本书。 考查名词辨析。TV电视；computer电脑；light灯。根据“I want to read a book”可知，看书需要明亮的光线，因此要开灯。故选C。

questions.prompt: Every day  ______  people come to Tian’an Men Square.
questions.explanation: 句意：每天成千上万的人来到天安门广场。 考查数词的表达。表示确切的数量，用基数词+数词单数；表示概数，用数词复数+of。结合三个选项可知，只有A的结构正确，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  are you going after you finish your homework? —I’m going to the park to walk my dog.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你做完作业后打算去哪里？——我打算去公园遛狗。 考查疑问词。What“什么”，对事物，事件提问，疑问代词；Where“哪里”，对地点提问，疑问副词；Who“谁”，对人提问，疑问代词。根据“...are you going after you finish your homework?”可知，询问的是你做完作业后去哪儿，对地点提问。故选B。

questions.prompt: As a fan of music, Lucy often  ______  the violin in her spare time. A is playing
questions.explanation: 句意：作为一个乐迷，露西经常在业余时间拉小提琴。 考查动词时态。根据often可知，此句是一般现在时，主语Lucy是第三人称单数形式，动词用三单，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  you teach me how to make a video? —No problem. I will be free tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能教我如何制作一个视频吗？——没问题。我明天有空。 考查情态动词辨析。May可能，也许；Can能，可以；Must必须。根据“... you teach me how to make a video?”可知，此处是表示请求，应用Can。故选B。

questions.prompt: Lingling is going to  ______  this weekend because there is going to be an important exam next week.
questions.explanation: 句意：玲玲这周末打算复习功课因为下周将会有一个重要的考试。 考查动词短语。go over lessons表示“复习功课”；do the housework表示“做家务”；go camping表示“去露营”。根据“Lingling is going to...this weekend because there is going to be an important exam next week.”可知，这周末玲玲要复习功课，因为下周有重要考试，A选项“复习功课”符合语境。故选A。

questions.prompt: Today I am pretty busy. I will spend several hours  ______  for my speech.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天我很忙。我将花几个小时准备我的演讲。 考查动名词作宾语。to prepare动词不定式；preparing动名词；prepare“为……做准备”，动词。根据“I will spend several hours...for my speech.”可知，Sb spend(s) some time doing sth表示“某人花费一些时间做某事”，空处需填动名词，作宾语，preparing为动词prepare“为……做准备”动名词。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Where is Tina? —She is in the kitchen. She  ______  dinner.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tina在哪里？——她在厨房里。她正在做晚饭。 考查时态。根据“She is in the kitchen. She... dinner.”可知，此处表示她正在做晚饭，时态要用现在进行时，结构为be doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me.  ______? —Yes. There is a hospital opposite the school.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Is there a hospital near here

choices.label: B
choices.text: Where is the hospital C How far is the hospital

questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，这附近有医院吗？——有的。学校对面有一家医院。 考查情景交际。Is there a hospital near here这附近有医院吗；Where is the hospital医院在哪里；How far is the hospital医院有多远。根据答语“Yes.”判断空处为一般疑问句，再根据“There is a hospital opposite the school.”可知，空处是询问附近是否有医院。故选A。 四、完形填空（本大题共 12 小题，每小题 1 分，共 12 分） A. flying (v.) B. balloons (n.) C. but (conj.) D. see (v.) Larry is going to be a pilot. He wants to fly an airplane. But Larry is not a rich man. He doesn’t have an airplane. He has only a chair. Larry ties forty-five big  ______ 13 ______  to his chair and then sits in the chair. The chair goes up. For a few minutes, everything is fine. The view from the chair is beautiful. Larry can  ______ 14 ______  houses and trees below him. He is happy. He is flying. The chair goes up very high. Larry is afraid. “I don’t want to go very high,” Larry thinks. “I want to go down a little.” With a small gun, Larry shoots ten balloons. Then something terrible happens. Larry drops the gun, and it falls to the ground. Larry can’t shoot more balloons. The chair goes up and up. Larry is three miles above the ground. Airplanes are  ______ 15 ______  over him and under him. Larry has a small radio. “Help! Help!” he says into the radio. “I’m flying in a chair, and I want to come down!” People hear Larry,  ______ 16 ______  they can’t help him. Larry flies in the chair for 45 minutes. Then the balloons begin to lose air. Slowly the chair comes down, and Larry is back on the ground. He is not hurt. Larry says, “For 45 minutes, I am a pilot—the pilot of a chair.” 【答案】13. B 14. D 15. A 16. C 【解析】 【导语】本文是一篇记叙文。文章主要讲述了拉里想当飞行员，用气球将椅子带上天，因为意外不能下来，最后气球没气了，拉里才着陆。 【13题详解】 句意：拉里把四十五个大气球系在椅子上，然后坐在椅子上。根据“Larry ties forty-five big...to his chair...”可知，在椅子上系了45个大气球，“基数词（one除外）+名词复数”，B选项balloons“气球”为名词balloon的复数形式，符合语境。故选B。 【14题详解】 句意：拉里能看见房屋和树木在他下面。根据“Larry can...houses and trees below him.”可知，能看到他下面的房屋和树木，情态动词can后需填动词原形，D选项see“看见”符合语境。故选D。 【15题详解】 句意：飞机正从他旁边和下面飞过。根据“Airplanes are...over him and under him.”可知，飞机正在他周围飞行，时态为现在进行时，动词用现在分词，A选项flying“飞行”为动词fly的现在分词，符合语境。故选A。 16题详解】 句意：人们听到了拉里的声音，但是不能帮助他。根据“People hear Larry,...they can’t help him.”可知，人们听到拉里的呼救，但是无法帮助他，句子为转折关系，C选项but“但是”符合语境。故选C。 （二）阅读短文，掌握其大意，然后从各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I love you, Mum and Dad! Tears go out of my eyes when I talk to my parents on the phone. What are they doing when I call them? This is what I want to know most. I have supper at 5 o’clock in the dining hall. There is no need for me to  ______ 17 ______  by myself, no need to wash the dishes. However, now it is the busiest time for my parents. Dad works from seven o’clock in the morning to nine o’clock in the evening. Therefore, all the housework is left to my mum. Besides her own job, she also has to work at the vineyard (葡萄园). Every day she gets up at 4 o’clock in the morning, and then works till dark. One day I called her at 7:30 in the evening, and she told me that she was still in the vineyard and hadn’t had supper yet. Tears ran down from  ______ 18 ______  cheeks (脸颊), and I was filled with  ______ 19 ______. I promise her to study hard in the university, because I am her hope. I promise her to take care of myself, because I am important to her... I promise her so much and I just want her to promise me that she can take care of herself and dad because they are just like the blood in my body. I cannot  ______ 20 ______  without them. In my  ______ 21 ______, everyone is common. We are willing to earn our living by our own hands. We are very happy to have the meal together on the New Year’s Eve. My mother has ever said that everyone in the family is important, no one can be absent (缺席的). Mum has ever said that the  ______ 22 ______  time for Dad and her is when my sister and I come back home. We play cards in the room, watch TV, do anything we like with dad and mum preparing delicious food in the  ______ 23 ______. It is also the happiest time for me. At that moment, I could forget all the difficulties and unhappiness. The only thing I would like to do is to  ______ 24 ______  the time with my parents. Love, sometimes, speaks louder than words. Give your parents a call, and tell them you miss them...

questions.prompt: My brother often does  ______  homework first after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥经常放学后先做作业。 考查形容词性物主代词。根据“My brother often does…homework first after school.”可知，do one’s homework“做家庭作业”是固定搭配，所以空处需用形容词性物主代词，主语是my brother，所以空处需用形容词性物主代词his。故选B。

questions.prompt: Li Lei often gets up  ______  6:50 every morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：李雷经常早上6:50起床。 考查时间介词。at后加具体时刻；on用在节日、星期和具体的某一天前；in用在年、月、季节前；for持续。根据“6:50 every morning”，可知6:50是具体时刻。故选A。

questions.prompt: I like tigers  ______  my friend Jane doesn’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢老虎但是我的朋友简不喜欢。 考查连词辨析。and而且，表示并列；so所以，表示因果；because因为，表示因果；but但是，表示转折。根据“I like tigers”和“my friend Jane doesn’t.”可知，前后是转折关系，用but。故选D。

questions.prompt: —  ______  you play the piano? — No. But I can play the violin.
questions.explanation: 句意：--你会弹钢琴吗？--不。但是我会拉小提琴。 考查情态动词，A. Can 能，会；B. May可能；C. Must必须；D. Should应该，根据答句句意，可知问的是“你会弹钢琴吗？”，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  is it from your home to school, Mary? — It’s about 5 minutes’ bus ride.
