questions.explanation: 句意：——Mary从你家到学校多远？——大约5分钟的公交车程。 考查特殊疑问词。How long多长时间，对一段时间提问；How far多远，问距离；How如何，问方式；When什么时间，问时间。根据“It’s about 5 minutes’ bus ride.”可知此处是提问距离。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Listen! What’s the noise? —My father  ______  the TV show in the living room.
questions.explanation: 句意：——听！这噪音是什么？——我的爸爸正在客厅看电视节目。 考查现在进行时。根据“Listen! What’s the noise?”可知，动作正在进行，用现在进行时，结构为am/is/are+doing，且主语为my father，是单数，be动词用is。故选C。

questions.prompt: Many students  ______  to school by bus every morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：许多学生每天早上乘坐公共汽车去上学。 考查时态及主谓一致。根据“every morning”可知用一般现在时，主语“Many students”是复数，其后谓语用动词原形。故选C。

questions.prompt: Let’s  ______  a walk after supper.
questions.explanation: 句意：晚饭后让我们去散步吧。 考查非谓语动词。let sb. do sth.“让某人做某事”，let后用省略to的动词不定式作宾语补足语。故选A。

questions.prompt: —My family want to see the animals in the zoo this Saturday. — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这周六我家人想要在动物园里看动物。——玩得愉快。 考查情景交际。Thank you谢谢你；Good luck祝你好运；Here you are给你；Have a good time玩得愉快。根据“My family want to see the animals in the zoo this Saturday.”可知要去动物园里看动物，应祝福其玩得愉快。故选D。 五、选词填空（共 5 分，每小题 0.5 分） 阅读下列短文，掌握其大意，从方框中选择适当的词，并用其适当形式填空。每词限用一次。 A swim, volleyball, taste, shower, vegetable Mary is my sister. She usually gets up at six thirty. Then she always takes a  ______ 10 ______  and eats a good breakfast. After that, she goes to school at eight thirty. At twelve, she eats lots of fruit and  ______ 11 ______  for lunch. After lunch, she sometimes plays  ______ 12 ______. She always eats ice-cream after dinner. She knows it’s not good for her, but it  ______ 13 ______  good! In the evening, she does her homework and usually  ______ 14 ______  or takes a walk. At nine thirty, she goes to bed. 【答案】10. shower

questions.prompt: My mom really cares about me. I often tell  ______  about what happens at school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈真的很关心我。我经常告诉她学校里发生的事情。 考查代词辨析。he他；his他的；her她，宾格；she她。分析题干可知，此处是代指妈妈，应用宾格动词her，故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  the afternoon of April 13th, many visitors arrived in Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：4月13日下午，许多游客来到北京。 考查介词辨析。in后加某年某月某季节；on后加具体的某一天，或某一天的早中晚；from从；at后加具体的时刻。根据“the afternoon of April 13th”可知是具体到了某一天下午，应用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Can he play  ______  chess? —No, he  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——他会下棋吗？——不，他不会。 考查冠词和一般疑问句的回答。第一空后是棋类运动，前面不加冠词，排除AD选项；第二空根据“No”可知是作否定回答，应用can’t。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What time  ______  your teacher  ______  dinner? —Usually at 7 o’clock.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的老师什么时候吃晚餐？——通常在7点。 考查特殊疑问句和一般现在时。根据“What time...your teacher...dinner?”和答句“Usually at 7 o’clock.”可知，该疑问句应用一般现在时，主语是your teacher，所以疑问句中的助动词应用does，排除选项C和D；而助动词does后的动词应用原形，所以第二空应是eat。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  does it take you to get to the cinema? —About 30 minutes by bike. A How
questions.explanation: 句意：——到电影院要花你多长时间？——骑自行车大概要30分钟。 考查特殊疑问句。How怎么样；How long多久；How far多远；How often多久一次。根据答句“About 30 minutes by bike.”可知，此疑问句“...does it take you to get to the cinema?”应是在询问到电影院要多久，所以此空应是how long。故选B。

questions.prompt: If you want to visit the Palace Museum, I  ______  tickets for you tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你想参观故宫博物院，我明天就给你买票。 考查动词时态。if引导的条件状语从句，从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时：will do。故选C。

questions.prompt: How about  ______  to Cape Town this summer vacation?
questions.explanation: 句意：这个暑假去开普敦怎么样？ 考查非谓语动词。根据“How about...to Cape Town this summer vacation?”可知，此疑问句应是在询问这个暑假去开普敦怎么样，可用how about doing sth.表示“做某事怎么样”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Why not  ______  basketball with us this afternoon?
questions.explanation: 句意：为什么今天下午不和我们一起打篮球呢？ 考查特殊疑问句。why not do sth“为什么不做某事”，为固定短语。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What’s Laura doing now? —She  ______  at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——劳拉现在在干什么？——她正在家里做饭。 考查动词时态。根据“What’s Laura doing now?”可知问句是现在进行时，所以答句也应用现在进行时回答，其结构为“am/is/are+动词现在分词”，主语为she，be动词用is，故选D。 五、语法填空（共5分，每小题1分） 用所给词的适当形式填空。 Nowadays, you can see more and more people ride bikes on the road and my brother Jim is one of them. He usually  ______ 10 ______  (go) to school by bike because he thinks it’s the best way. Why does he like riding a bike? Let me  ______ 11 ______  (tell) you. First, he thinks it’s not expensive to buy a bike. Second, he can always  ______ 12 ______  (relax) while riding a bike. It’s good for his health. Third, the most important thing is that riding bikes helps  ______ 13 ______  (make) our environment clean. It’s one of the best  ______ 14 ______  (way) to stop pollution. 【答案】10. goes

questions.prompt: His car is very cheap, but  ______  is very expensive.
questions.explanation: 句意：他的车很便宜，但我们的车很贵。 考查代词辨析。we“我们”，人称代词主格；us“我们”，人称代词宾格；ours“我们的”，名词性物主代词；our“我们的”，形容词性物主代词。空处作主语，指代“我们的车”，应该用名词性物主代词ours。故选C。

questions.prompt: She is good at English. She  ______  sing that song in English.
questions.explanation: 句意：她英语很好。她会用英语唱那首歌。 考查情态动词。need需要；can会；must必须；may可以。根据“She is good at English.”可知此处表示能力，会用英语唱那首歌。故选B。

questions.prompt: —How do you go to school every day? — By bike. My dad  ______  with me in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你每天怎么去学校？——骑自行车。我的父亲每天早上和我一起骑自行车去。 考查一般现在时。根据“every day”可知，此句是一般现在时。“My dad”是第三人称单数，故ride要用第三人称单数形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  Chinese food for my friends tomorrow evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：我明天晚上将为我的朋友们做中国食物。 考查时态。根据“tomorrow evening”可知用一般将来时，其结构为be going to do。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  in ten minutes? —Yes, it will. Let’s hurry up! I don’t want to be late!
questions.explanation: 句意：——电影十分钟后开始吗？——是的。让我们快点！我不想迟到！ 考查一般疑问句。根据“是的，会的。让我们快点！我不想迟到！”可知此处是Will开头的一般疑问句。故选A。

questions.prompt: Your hands are dirty!  ______  and wash your hands.
questions.explanation: 句意：你的手很脏！去洗洗手。 考查祈使句。根据“... and wash your hands.”可知此处是“祈使句+and+陈述句”的结构，故空格处应填动词原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the T-shirt? —About 100 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这件T恤多少钱？——大约100元。 考查特殊疑问句。What color什么颜色；How many多少；What size多大尺寸；How much多少钱。根据“About 100 yuan.”可知询问T恤的价格，用How much。故选D。

questions.prompt: Walk across the street, and the bank is  ______  the bookstore.
questions.explanation: 句意：步行穿过街道，银行就在书店的对面。 考查介词词义辨析。next“紧接着的”，形容词，用作介词时后面需加to，next to“紧邻；在……近旁”；over“在……上面”；between“在……中间”；opposite“在……对面”。分析语境可先排除BC，又因题干中没有to，因此应填opposite，表示“银行在书店的对面”。故选D。

questions.prompt: I cannot find  ______  pen. Can I borrow  ______?
questions.explanation: 句意：我找不到我的钢笔了。我可以借你的吗？ 考查代词用法。mine我的，名词性物主代词；my我的，形容词性物主代词；your你的，形容词性物主代词；yours你的，名词性物主代词。第一空后有名词，应用形容词性物主代词，排除AC选项；第二空后没有名词，应用名词性物主代词。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you often play  ______  soccer with your friends? —No, I don’t like sports. I often play  ______  piano in my free time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你经常和你的朋友踢足球吗？——不，我不喜欢运动。我经常在空闲时间弹钢琴。 考查冠词的用法。a不定冠词，表示泛指，用于辅音之前；the定冠词，表示特指；/零冠词。在球类运动前，不加任何冠词，故空一不填冠词；在乐器前必须加定冠词the，故空二应填the。故选A。

questions.prompt: I often visit my grandparents  ______  Sunday evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常在星期天晚上去探望我的祖父母。 考查介词辨析。at在（后面常接具体时间点）；on在……之时（后面常接星期/日期）；in当……时（后面常接季节/月份/早、中、晚等）；with和……一起。根据“I often visit my grandparents...Sunday evening.”可知，此处表示在星期天晚上，具体到某一天的晚上，应用时间介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Must I return the book today? —No, you  ______. You can return it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我今天必须还书吗？——不，你不必。你可以明天归还。 考查情态动词。can’t不能；mustn’t禁止；shouldn’t不应该；needn’t不必。根据“Must I...”以及“You can return it tomorrow”可知此处指不必今天还，用needn’t。故选D。

questions.prompt: I’m looking forward to  ______  my parents soon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我期盼着很快能见到我的父母。 考查动名词的用法。根据“I’m looking forward to...my parents soon.”可知，此处表示期盼着很快能见到父母，可用look forward to doing sth.“期盼着做某事”，所以此空应是动名词seeing。故选B。

questions.prompt: —These apples look fresh and I’d like to buy some. —Sure,  ______  would you like?
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些苹果看起来很新鲜，我想要买一些。——好，你想要多少？ 考查特殊疑问句。how much多少（后接不可数名词）；how many多少（后接可数名词复数）how long多久；how soon多久之后。根据“These apples look fresh and I’d like to buy some.”和“Sure...would you like?”可知，此疑问句应是在询问对方想要买多少苹果，apples“苹果”，为可数名词复数，所以此空应是how many。故选B。

questions.prompt: I am interested in books and I  ______  two hours every night reading novels.
questions.explanation: 句意：我对书感兴趣，每晚花两个小时看小说。 考查动词辨析。cost花费，主语是物；take花费，主语是形式主语it；spend花费，主语是人；pay支付，主语是人。根据“two hours every night reading novels”可知此处是结构spend time doing sth.“花费时间做某事”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Choose me and I promise  ______  our classroom beautiful.
questions.explanation: 句意：选择我，我保证让我们的教室变得美丽。 考查非谓语动词。promise to do sth“保证做某事”，为固定短语。故选A。

questions.prompt: David  ______  about 1,000 meters every morning to keep fit.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了保持健康，David每天早上跑大约1000米。 考查一般现在时。根据“every morning”可知，句子应用一般现在时，说明经常性动作，句子主语是David，所以该句的谓语动词应用三单形式runs。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Hello, may I speak to Mr Green, please? —Sorry. He  ______  a meeting. Can you call him later?
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，可以请格林先生接一下电话吗？ ——对不起，他正在开会，你可以等会再给他打电话吗？ 考查动词时态。根据“may I speak to Mr Green, please”以及“Can you call him later?”可知，格林先生正在开会不方便接电话，表示动作正在进行，用现在进行时态。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Where is John? —He is out. He  ______  back in an hour.
questions.explanation: 句意：——John在哪里？——他出去了，他一个小时后会回来。 考查一般将来时。根据“He...back in an hour.”可知，in an hour“一个小时后”，该句应用一般将来时，谓语结构是will/be going to do，所以此空应是will come。故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a volleyball match between Class 1 and Class 2 this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天下午一班和二班将有一场排球赛。 考查there be的一般将来时。分析题干可知本句是there be句型的一般将来时，结构为there will be或there is/are going to be。主语“a volleyball match”是单数，be动词用is。故选A。 四、完形填空。（共 8 分，每小题 1 分） 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Are you interested in collecting (收集) pictures or any other things? Maybe you have heard of the scrapbook (剪贴簿),  ______ 13 ______  you don’t know what it is. I know. Let me tell you more about it now. Scrapbooks are useful and  ______ 14 ______  things. They have been popular for more than 500 years. People usually use scrapbooks to keep pictures, letters, poems and other things they want to  ______ 15 ______. Today people collect more things with scrapbooks. Some people have  ______ 16 ______  collections like the world’s stupid ideas or pictures of the ugly dogs. Some people even collect videos about bad weather. In fact, it is easy to start making your own scrapbook. First, you should decide (决定)  ______ 17 ______  you want to collect. Start with just one idea. Next, you need a  ______ 18 ______  with a white background (背景), a pair of scissors and glue. You need the scissors to cut out the  ______ 19 ______  or the stories of magazines and newspapers. You also need the glue to stick (粘贴) them on the notebook. You can be active and collect many things, or be  ______ 20 ______  and collect a few things. It’s up to you. It will be interesting to make your scrapbook and you can share it with your friends.

questions.prompt: —Mary, do you know that girl over there? —Yes, I know  ______, but I can’t remember  ______  name.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玛丽，你认识那边的那个女孩吗？——是的，我认识她，但我不记得她的名字。 考查代词。her她或她的，宾格作宾语，形容词性物主代词后接名词；she 她，人称代词主格形式， 一般作主语；hers她的，名词性物主代词，相当于形容词性物主代词+名词。根据句意，可知第一个空“know”为谓语动词，后面加宾语her；第二个空“...name”，应用形容词性物主代词+名词，表示她的名字“her name”。故选C。

questions.prompt: I can play  ______  chess and my sister can play  ______  guitar.
questions.explanation: 句意：我会下棋，我妹妹会弹吉他。 考查冠词辨析。球类棋类前面不加the，即play chess；乐器前面要加the，即play the guitar。故选C。

questions.prompt: I can’t play basketball after school  ______  school days.
questions.explanation: 句意：在上学的时候，放学后我不能打篮球。 考查介词辨析。at在，指具体的时刻；in表时间，指较长的一段时间；with和；on在……时，指具体的日期。根据“school days”可知，此处指具体的日期，其前用介词on。故选D。

questions.prompt: One of the school rules is that students  ______  be on time for class.
questions.explanation: 句意：学校规定之一是学生必须准时上课。 考查情态动词。might可能；will将；could可以；must必须。根据“One of the school rules is that students …be on time for class”可知，学生必须按时上课，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  is it from your home to school? —It’s about ten kilometers.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从你家到学校有多远？——大约十公里。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多久，提问时段；How far多远，提问距离；How many多少，提问可数名词复数；How much多少，提问不可数名词。根据“It’s about ten kilometers.”可知，上文问的是距离。故选B。

questions.prompt: Dolphins are  ______  animals and they can remember a lot of things.
questions.explanation: 句意：海豚是聪明的动物，它们能记住很多事情。 考查形容词辨析。lazy懒的；friendly友好的；beautiful美丽的；smart聪明的。根据“they can remember a lot of things”可知，它们能记住很多东西，应该是“聪明的”。故选D。

questions.prompt: My sister is 6, and she often  ______  to the stories before sleep.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹6岁，她经常在睡前听故事。 考查时态。根据“My sister is 6”以及“often”可知，句子应用一般现在时，主语是she，动词用三单形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me, where is Miss Smith? —She  ______  on the phone outside the office now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，史密斯小姐在哪里？——她现在正在办公室外面打电话。 考查时态。根据“now”可知，时态是现在进行时态，结构是is/am/are+动词的现在分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What a fine day! Let’s go out for a walk. — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——多好的天气啊！我们出去散散步吧。——听起来不错。 考查情景交际。Sounds good听起来不错；Thank you very much非常感谢你；You’ re welcome不客气；The same to you你也一样。根据“What a fine day! Let’s go out for a walk.”可知此处是同意对方的建议，选项A符合语境。故选A。 五、选词填空。（共 5 分, 每小题 1 分） 阅读下列短文, 掌握其大意, 从方框中选择适当的词, 并用其适当形式填空。每词限用一次。 difficult like movie she play Dave is an English boy. He likes China. And he  ______ 10 ______  to learn Chinese. It is  ______ 11 ______  for a foreigner to learn it, but he thinks he can learn it well. Tom is Dave’s brother. He likes China, too. He likes Chinese action  ______ 12 ______. He thinks they are exciting. “I can’t speak Chinese well. But I like Chinese kungfu,” he tells his Chinese friends. Sally is Dave’s sister. She is a sports star in the school. She can  ______ 13 ______  ping-pong very well.  ______ 14 ______  favorite player is Wang Nan. 【答案】10. likes

questions.prompt: I’m sorry there are  ______  apples in the fridge. You must go and buy some right now.
questions.explanation: 句意：对不起，冰箱里几乎没有苹果了。你必须马上去买一些。 考查代词辨析。a little一点，修饰不可数名词；little没有多少，修饰不可数名词；a few一些，修饰可数名词；few没有多少，修饰可数名词。此空修饰可数名词apples，排除A和B选项。根据“You must go and buy some right now.”可知，没有多少苹果了，所以需要去买一些，故选D。

questions.prompt: In the future, people  ______  a new kind of clothes that will be warm when they are cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：在未来，人们会穿一种新的衣服，当他们冷的时候会很暖和。 考查时态。根据“In the future”可知要用一般将来时，其结构为will do。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Look at those purple gloves! Are they  ______, Mary? —No, they aren’t.  ______  are pink.
questions.explanation: 句意：——看那些紫色的手套！它们是你的吗，Mary？——不，它们不是。我的是粉色的。 考查代词辨析。you你，人称代词主格或宾格；I我，人称代词主格；your你的，形容词性物主代词；My我的，形容词性物主代词；yours你的，名词性物主代词；Mine我的，名词性物主代词；Me我，人称代词宾格。第一空“Are they..., Mary?”问手套是“你的”吗，用名词性物主代词yours作表语；否定回答后要讲“我的（手套）”是粉色的，用名词性物主代词Mine作主语。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What  ______  your sister  ______  this Saturday? —Something special, because it’s her birthday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妹妹这个星期六打算做什么？——一些特别的事情，因为那天是她的生日。 考查时态。根据“this Sunday”可知要用一般将来时，其结构为am/is/are going to do，主语“your sister”是第三人称单数，be动词用is。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  Tom play the piano? —Yes, very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tom会弹钢琴吗？——是的，弹得非常好。 考查情态动词辨析。Can能够，可以；May可能；Must必须；Should应该。根据答语“Yes, very well”可知，询问是否有弹钢琴的能力，故选A。

questions.prompt: People cut down many trees  ______  elephants are losing their homes.
questions.explanation: 句意：人们砍伐了很多树，所以大象失去了它们的家园。 考查连词辨析。if如果；but但是；so因此；or否则。“人们砍伐了很多树”是“大象失去了它们的家园”的原因，前因后果，用so引导表因果关系的并列句。故选C。

questions.prompt: Excuse me, how long does it  ______  to walk to the library?
questions.explanation: 句意：请问走到图书馆要多长时间？ 考查动词辨析。take花费，常用搭配是It takes sb+一段时间+to do sth；spend花费，常用搭配是sb spends+时间/金钱+in doing sth；cost花费，常用搭配是sth cost sb+金钱；pay支付，常用搭配是sb pays+金钱+for sth。根据“how long does it… to walk to the library”可知，此处用的是It takes sb+一段时间+to do sth的搭配，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Do you like to watch Spider Man? —Yes. I enjoy  ______  Marvels.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你喜欢看《蜘蛛侠》吗？——喜欢。我喜欢看漫威作品。 考查非谓语动词。enjoy doing sth“喜欢做某事”，动名词作宾语，故选B。

questions.prompt: The man lost his camera and he  ______  it now.
questions.explanation: 句意：那个人丢了他的照相机，他现在正在找。 考查动词时态以及动词辨析。find找到，强调结果；look for寻找，强调动作。根据“now”可知，句子时态是现在进行时，且此处是强调找相机的动作，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Can you play tennis? — ______, but I’m good at football.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会打网球吗？——不，我不会，但是我擅长足球。 考查一般疑问句。根据“but I’m good at football”可知but后句意出现转折，由此推出应是不会打网球会踢足球，用否定回答；以“Can you”开头的一般疑问句，否定回答用“No, I can’t”。故选C。

questions.prompt: My mother’s birthday is coming. I want to buy a new shirt  ______  her.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈的生日快到了。我想给她买一件新衬衫。 考查介词辨析。at在；for为；to朝；with和。buy sth. for sb.“为某人买某物”。故选B。 二、完形填空。（每题 1 分，共 8 分） From a plane we can see the fields, cities, mountains or seas below. If we go into space, we see more and more of the earth. People and man-made satellites have been sent out into space to look at the earth  ______ 13 ______  and people have learnt more about the earth in the last years. The sea  ______ 14 ______  very beautiful when the sun is shining on it. But it can be very terrible when there is a strong wind. The sea is very big and it nearly  ______ 15 ______  three quarters of the earth. The sea is also very  ______ 16 ______  in some places. There is one place in the sea is about 11 kilometres deep.  ______ 17 ______, the highest mountain in the world is about 9 kilometres high. If that mountain was put into the sea at that place there would be still 2 kilometres of water above it! In most parts of the sea there are many kinds of fishes and  ______ 18 ______. Some live near the top of the sea. Others live deep down. There are also a lot of small living things and lots of fishes live by eating them. The sea can be very  ______ 19 ______. The further people go down the sea becomes colder and colder. At one time only some men could go down into the deep sea. But in 1970 five women scientists lived in the deep sea for fourteen days. They watch and research the deep sea carefully and they discover many secrets about the sea. In the future,  ______ 20 ______  will keep studying the sea deeper and more so that we can protect the sea well and develop the sea better.

questions.prompt: —Is this eraser  ______? I found it in the lost and found box. —No, it isn’t  ______. It’s Tom’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个橡皮是你的吗？我在失物招领箱里找到了它。——不，它不是我的。这是汤姆的。 考查代词辨析。hers她的；yours你的；mine我的；his他的。结合语境可知，此处是两个人进行对话，根据“No, it isn’t”结合人称惯用习惯可知，应该是问这个橡皮是不是对方的，因为是否定回答，所以回答不是自己的。故选C。

questions.prompt: We have a geography lesson  ______  three o'clock  ______  Thursday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们周四下午三点的时候上地理课。 考查介词。at 用于具体的时刻前面；in用在年、月的前面；on用于具体的某一天或具体某一天的上午，下午或晚上。“three o'clock”三点钟是具体的时刻，第一空用介词at。“Thursday afternoon”周四下午是具体的一天的下午，第二空用介词on。故选D。

questions.prompt: Wash your hands before meals,  ______  you may get ill.
questions.explanation: 句意：饭前洗手，否则你可能会生病的。 本题考查连词。and而且，but但是，or否则，so所以。结合句意，“饭前不洗手”是“你可能会生病”的条件，故选C。

questions.prompt: —I hear you have a home robot. —Yes, it’s amazing. It  ______  do all my housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我听说你有一个家用机器人。——是的，它非常令人惊讶。它会做所有的家务。must必须，should应该，could可能，can能。根据it’s amazing.可知它令人惊讶，应是会做所有的家务，故用情态动词can。故选D。 【点睛】must必须，表示要求；should应该，表示建议；could可能，表示猜测；can能，表示能力。

questions.prompt: The two boys lost their bags. That’s  ______  they look sad.
questions.explanation: 句意：这两个男孩丢了包。这就是他们看起来很伤心的原因。 考查连词辨析。what什么；why为什么；when什么时候；how如何。根据“The two boys lost their bags”可知，因为丢了包，所以他们看起来很伤心，此处应用why引导表语从句，表示原因，故选B。

questions.prompt: —I’d like some beef.  ______  is it? —80 yuan a kilo.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我想要些牛肉。它多少钱？——80元一公斤。 考查疑问词组。How often多久一次；How much多少钱；How long多久；How many多少。根据“80 yuan a kilo.”可知用How much询问牛肉的价格。故选B。

questions.prompt: Mr. Wang has left for Guangzhou. He  ______  a speech there next week.
questions.explanation: 句意：王先生已经动身去广州了。他下周将在那里发表演讲。 考查时态。根据“next week”可知用一般将来时，其结构为will do。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What do you plan to do this weekend? —I  ______  litter in a park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这周末你计划做什么？——我打算在公园里收集垃圾。 考查时态及主谓一致。根据“this weekend”可知用一般将来时，其结构为be going to do；主语“I”后接be动词am。故选A。

questions.prompt: Mary is a kind girl. She often  ______  her classmates with their homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽是一个善良的女孩。她经常帮助同学做家庭作业。 考查动词时态。根据“often”可知，经常性的动作用一般现在时，主语she是第三人称单数，因此动词要用三单形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: The teacher speaks loudly to the students  ______  they can hear clearly.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师大声地对学生说话所以他们能听清楚。 考查并列连词辨析。because因为；so所以；and和；or或者。根据“The teacher speaks loudly to the students...they can hear clearly.”可知，空格前后为因果关系，前因后果，故选B。

questions.prompt: There are  ______  students in the meeting room.
questions.explanation: 句意：会议室里有数以百计的学生。 考查数词用法。基数词后hundred用原形，hundreds of“数以百计的”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Does Alice like her new school? —Yes. She  ______  her classmates and she has got many good friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爱丽丝喜欢她的新学校吗？——是的。她和同学们相处得很好，她有很多好朋友。 考查动词短语。is good for对……有好处；is careful with小心；gets on well with与……相处融洽；worries about担忧。根据“she has got many good friends”可知，爱丽丝有很多好朋友，说明她和同学们相处得很好。故选C。 四、完形填空（共 8 分，每小题 1 分） 阅读下面短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A, B, C, D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 A Long Time to Waft Rob tapped his foot on the ground impatiently（不耐烦地）. His friend, Steve, should meet him in five minutes. They were going to meet and watch a movie together, and Rob didn't want to miss a single minute of the show. Both of them really liked  ______ 13 ______  and tried to see one almost every week, but lately Steve had been arriving later and later. Rob complained about late friends in a low voice while he waited. Rob began pacing（踱步）back and forth. When pacing didn't  ______ 14 ______  him, he started to look at his watch from time to time. There were only three minutes left before he went in without his friend, Rob decided. Pacing was making him more impatient. He wondered why Steve couldn't be on time. He wondered what ______ 15 ______  Steve would have this time. Last time Steve had said it was because his dad needed help in the garden. What would be this time? There was only one minute Left. Then he heard a familiar voice, " Rob, I  ______ 16 ______ it! " Rob turned around and saw Steve. "You made it, and you are on time, too! " Rob said excitedly. "Of course, " Steve replied, "I really wanted to see this movie." "Well let's go then." Rob suggested. He  ______ 17 ______  for his wallet, so he could buy a ticket. Where was his wallet? "What's wrong?" Steve asked. "I don't have my wallet." Rob replied  ______ 18 ______. "Go check in your car." "I might be late then." Rob answered, feeling foolish. Here he'd been standing around waiting, and he was going to be the late one now. He ran across the parking lot. By the time he got his wallet from his car and bought a ticket, he'd already  ______ 19 ______  the beginning and he didn't have time to get popcorn or a drink. Steve shared his popcorn, but Rob could hardly eat it. He felt guilty（内疚的）during the whole movie. When the movie was over, he apologized to Steve. "I'm sorry, Steve. I was complaining about you being late, but then I was the one who was late." Steve said. "Don't worry. It happens to all of us." "I see that now. Thanks for  ______ 20 ______. " "That's what friends, for." Steve replied.

questions.prompt: —Excuse me. Is this Karen’s coat? —No, it’s not  ______. It’s my coat.
questions.explanation: 句意：——对不起。这是凯伦的外套吗？——不，不是她的。这是我的外套。 考查代词辨析。hers她的，名词性物主代词；her她的，形容词性物主代词/宾格代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词；my我的，形容词性物主代词。根据“Is this Karen’s coat?”以及“No”可知，此处是指不是她的外套，空后没有名词，需用名词性物主代词。故选A。

questions.prompt: Tony is very helpful. He often  ______  his ideas with us.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼很乐于助人。他经常和我们分享他的想法。 考查动词时态。根据“often”可知，本句是一般现在时，且主语“He”是第三人称单数，动词需用三单。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you play table tennis? — ______  And I can also play tennis.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会打乒乓球吗？——是的，我会。我还会打网球。 考查一般疑问句的回答。根据“Can you play table tennis?”可知，此处是can开头的一般疑问句，用can问要用can/can’t回答，可排除BD选项。再根据“And I can also play tennis.”可知，此处是肯定回答。故选A。

questions.prompt: My mother and I usually ride a bike to school  ______  a fine day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我和妈妈通常在晴朗的日子骑自行车上学。 考查介词辨析。on后加具体到某一天或具体某一天的早晨、下午和晚上；in后加某年某月某季节；at后加具体的时刻；with和。空后“a fine day”是指具体的某一天，用介词on。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Will there be a concert in People’s Theatre next week? —  ______. Let’s go together.
questions.explanation: 句意：——下周人民剧院有音乐会吗？——会有的。让我们一起去吧。 考查一般疑问句。 “Will there be...”开头的一般疑问句，肯定回答用“Yes, there will”，否定回答用“No, there won’t”；结合“Let’s go together.”可知，此处用肯定回答。故选C。

questions.prompt: Not only I but also Ted  ______  a film tomorrow afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：明天下午不仅我，而且特德都要去看电影。 考查动词时态和主谓一致。根据“tomorrow afternoon”可知，本句是一般将来时，可排除AB选项；且not only...but also连接两个主语时，遵循“就近原则”，谓语动词由离得最近的“Ted”决定，用is。故选D。

questions.prompt: I like pop music  ______  my mother doesn’t like it at all.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢流行音乐，但我妈妈一点也不喜欢。 考查连词辨析。so因此；or或者，否则；and和；but但是。根据“I like pop music...my mother doesn’t like it at all.”可知，前后句之间是转折关系，用连词but。故选D。

questions.prompt: Look, the children  ______  the flowers in the garden.
questions.explanation: 句意：看，孩子们正在花园里给花浇水。 考查现在进行时。根据“Look”可知，时态是现在进行时，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  bags of milk would you like, Mrs. Green? —Two.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你想要几袋牛奶，格林太太？——两袋。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少钱，多少（对不可数名词数量提问）；How long多长；How old多大年龄；How many多少（对可数名词数量提问）。根据“Two.”可知，此处对数量提问，且bags是可数名词复数，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Where  ______  you born? —I  ______  born in Cambridge.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你出生在哪里？——我出生在剑桥。 考查be动词。was是be动词的过去式，用于主语是单数或不可数的时候；were是be动词的过去式，用于主语是复数或第二人称you的时候。第一个空主语是you，故用were；第二个空前主语是I，故用was。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Can I help you? —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我能帮你吗？——是的，我要一些牛肉。 考查情景交际。You are welcome不客气；Yes, I’d like some beef是的，我想要一些牛肉；Wait a minute等一下；All right好吧。根据“Can I help you?”可知，这是点餐购物常用的话语，B选项“是的，我想要一些牛肉”符合语境。故选B。 二、（每题 1 分，共 8 分） 选词填空。用方框中所给词语的适当形式填空。 health, food, eat, wrong, help, fresh, choose, boring Most people think that only fat and unhealthy people need exercise. That’s  ______ 13 ______. In fact, it’s necessary for each of us to exercise every day. Exercise can help us to keep away from illnesses and have a  ______ 14 ______  body. It also  ______ 15 ______  us do well in our life. Different people can do sports in different times. Many people like to do some sports in the morning, because they think it is the best time to do sports. That’s true. The main reason is that in the morning, the air is very  ______ 16 ______  and it’s not very cold or hot. You can walk or jog or do other exercises. If you think it’s  ______ 17 ______  to do exercises by yourself, you can find someone to do them with you. It will be very nice. Some people  ______ 18 ______  to do sports in the evening. They are off work and have enough time at that time. It’s also OK as long as they don’t stay up late doing vigorous(剧烈的) activities. However, you should know that doing morning exercise without  ______ 19 ______  anything is bad for your health. So the best way is to get up early, have some simple  ______ 20 ______  and go out to exercise. 【答案】13. wrong

questions.prompt: Mr. Jack often takes  ______  underground to the factory, but today he goes there by  ______  bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克先生经常乘地铁去工厂，但今天他乘公共汽车去。 考查冠词辨析。take the underground“乘地铁”，by bus“乘公共汽车”，都是固定搭配，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Is this Linda’s notebook? —No, it’s mine. The thick one on the desk is  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是琳达的笔记本吗？——不，是我的。桌子上那个厚的是她的。 考查代词辨析。she她（主格）；her她（宾格）；hers她的（名词性物主代词）；herself她自己。根据“No, it’s mine. The thick one on the desk is...”可知，空格处表达“她的笔记本”，用名词性物主代词。故选C。

questions.prompt: The environment becomes better and better.  ______  birds are coming back.
questions.explanation: 句意：环境变得越来越好。数千只鸟正飞回来。 考查thousand的用法。thousand“千”，其前有具体数字时，用其单数形式；其前没有具体数字时，用其复数形式，且其后加of，故选D。

questions.prompt: －When is Jay’s concert? -It's three o'clock the afternoon of July 18th.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jay的音乐会是什么时候？——它是7月18日下午三点。考查时间介词。第一个空，根据后面的three o'clock“三点”，指的是具体时刻，用介词at；第二个空根据后面的the afternoon of July 18th“7月18日下午”，指的是具体的某一天的下午，用介词on；故答案选B。

questions.prompt: —Do you have any plans for tonight? —Yes, I  ______  at the new French restaurant in the city.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你今晚有什么计划吗？——有，我打算去城里新开的法国餐馆吃饭。 考查动词时态。根据问句“Do you have any plans for tonight?”可知句子时态为一般将来时态，其构成是“will+do或am/is/are going to do”。故选B。

questions.prompt: I am good at singing  ______  I want to join the Music Club.
questions.explanation: 句意：我擅长唱歌，所以我想加入音乐俱乐部。 考查连词辨析。so所以；because因为；or否则、或者；but但是。前后两句构成因果关系，前因后果，用so连接，故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  meat do you want?
questions.explanation: 句意：你想要多少肉？ 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少，修饰可数名词复数；What size什么尺码；How much多少，修饰不可数名词；What about怎么样。根据“meat do you want?”可知问的是“你想要多少肉”，这里修饰不可数名词meat“肉”，用How much。故选C。

questions.prompt: They  ______  their homework in about one and a half hours.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们将在大约一个半小时内完成家庭作业。 考查动词时态。根据“in about one and a half hours”可知句子使用一般将来时，结构为“will+动词原形”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Our cleaning monitor always  ______  a lot to make our classroom clean and tidy.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的卫生委员总是做很多事情来使我们的教室干净整洁。 考查动词时态。根据“always”可知，本句是一般现在时。主语是第三人称单数，动词用三单形式。故选C。

questions.prompt: He is an American, but he  ______  speak Chinese really  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：他是美国人，但他中文说得很好。 考查情态动词与副词。can’t不能；can能；good好的，形容词；well好，副词。第一空根据“He is an American, but…speak Chinese well”可知“but”表示转折，应填can。第二空处应填副词well修饰动词“speak”。故选D。

questions.prompt: I like ______  basketball, but now I’d like ______  tennis.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢打篮球，但是现在我想要打网球。 考查动名词和动词不定式的用法。like doing sth“喜欢做某事”，故第一空为动名词playing；would like to do sth“想要做某事”，故第二空为to play，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me,  ______? —Sure! Turn left at the second street and it’s on your right.

choices.label: B
choices.text: could you tell me the time

choices.label: C
choices.text: what can I do for you

choices.label: D
choices.text: could you tell me the way to the nearest bank

questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，你能告诉我最近的银行怎么走吗？——当然！在第二条街左转，它就在你的右边。 考查情景交际。what are you doing你在干什么；could you tell me the time你能告诉我时间吗；what can I do for you我能帮你忙吗；could you tell me the way to the nearest bank你能告诉我到最近银行的路吗。根据答语“Turn left at the second street and it’s on your right.”可知询问的是到银行的路该怎么走，故选D。 五、完形填空（每小题8分，共8分） 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 My little brother, Evan, is 12 years old. Most kids don’t  ______ 13 ______  Evan at all. He has never been invited to the parties. Nobody asks him to do sports together. Too many people see only the ways Evan is  ______ 14 ______. They don’t see that in so many ways, he’s just like anyone else. He loves video games, reading, and being outdoors. He was born 1.5 weeks early and has something called cerebral palsy（脑瘫）. He has problems with  ______ 15 ______  and speaking. Evan’s cerebral palsy may make him seem different when you first meet him. He walks with braces（支架）on his legs. And sometimes he makes sudden big sounds when speaking. It can also be  ______ 16 ______  for him to understand what other people are thinking and feeling. Sometimes that makes Evan  ______ 17 ______  too much. But he doesn’t mean to take over（控制）the talking. Usually he’s just really excited and doesn’t want to lose people’s attention. The way Evan looks and does things can sometimes surprise people or make them  ______ 18 ______. But think about this: When Evan was born, doctors said he might never walk or talk. He has worked so hard to be able to do these things. So what if he looks and sounds a little different when he does them? None of Evan’s progress（进展）has come easy. He has had many surgeries（手术）. He visits his  ______ 19 ______  each week, working on his legs and his speech. Now he’s even able to help with some housework. As his sister, I am so proud of all that Evan has done. The next time you see Even, you can say hi to him. That way he wouldn’t feel left out and he will face those  ______ 20 ______  in his life.

questions.prompt: —Why are you in  ______  hurry, Mike? —I’ll be late.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Kate，你为什么这么着急？——我要迟到了。 考查冠词辨析。in a hurry“匆忙”，固定搭配，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Here is a book! —It’s  ______. My name is on  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这里有一本书！——它是我的。我的名字在上面。 考查代词的用法。his他的，物主代词；its它的，物主代词；mine我的，物主代词；it它，人称代词。根据“My name is on…”可知第一空应用物主代词表示“我的”，且第一空后没有名词，因此应用名词性物主代词mine，排除选项A和B；第二空指代“book”，应用人称代词“it”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Mark always goes to bed  ______  nine o’clock in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：马克总是在晚上九点钟上床睡觉。 考查时间介词辨析。in后接某年某月某季节；on后接具体一天；at后接具体时刻；for后接一段时间。“nine o’clock”是具体的时刻，应填at，故选C。

questions.prompt: Every family will have a small plane,  ______  traveling will be easy.
questions.explanation: 句意：每个家庭都会有一架小型飞机，因此出行会很容易。 考查连词辨析。as因为，当……时；because因为；so因此；for因为，由于。根据“Every family will have a small plane”可知，因为有小型飞机，所以出行很容易，两个句子存在因果关系，前因后果，因此应用并列连词so来连接。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is this coat? —It’s 109 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这件外套多少钱？——109元。 考查特殊疑问词。How much多少钱；How far多远；How often多久一次；How long多长时间。根据“109 yuan.”可知问的是价格，故选A。

questions.prompt: You’re going to like the future because people will not do all the  ______  work, and we’ll only do  ______  work.
questions.explanation: 句意：你会喜欢未来的，因为人们不用做所有繁重的工作，而只做轻松的工作。 考查形容词辨析。heavy繁重的；light轻松的；hard艰难的。根据“You’re going to like the future”及选项可知，喜欢未来应是因为不用做繁重的工作，只做轻松的工作。第一空应用“heavy”，表示“繁重的”，第二空应用其反义词“light”，表示“轻松的”。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What time do you usually get up in the morning? —At about six o’clock. But I get up  ______  at the weekend, at about half past eight.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你通常早上几点起床？——大约六点钟。但是周末我起床晚，大约八点半。 考查副词辨析。late晚地；early早地；last最后；first最初。根据“At about six o’clock. But I get up...at the weekend, at about half past eight”可知，周末八点半起床，平时六点起床，周末比平时起床晚。故选A。

questions.prompt: Do you think this idea about life in the future will  ______?
questions.explanation: 句意：你认为这个关于未来生活的想法会实现吗？ 考查动词短语辨析。come back回来；go over仔细检查；go back回来；come true实现。根据“this idea about life in the future”可知，此处询问这种想法会不会实现，故选D。

questions.prompt: Don’t talk about that thing  ______. It’s a secret.
questions.explanation: 句意：不要再谈论那件事了。它是一个秘密。 考查副词短语的用法。some more再来一些；one more再一个；any more再，用于否定句，表示“不再……”；no more不再……，用于肯定句。此句是否定句，应用“not…any more”表示“不再……”。故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a basketball match on TV tomorrow evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：明天晚上电视上将有一场篮球赛。 考查一般将来时。根据“tomorrow evening”可知，此处用there be句型的一般将来时结构there will be，故选A。

questions.prompt: She was born in Quincy and at that time she  ______  in a big house with several rooms.
questions.explanation: 句意：她出生在昆西，那个时候她住在一个有好几个屋子的大房子里。 考查动词的时态。根据时间状语“at that time”可知此句应用一般过去时，因此此空应用动词的过去式“lived”。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Are you ready for the coming math exam? —Never! Math is too difficult and I'm sure I  ______  pass it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你准备好即将到来的数学测试了吗？——绝对没有！数学太难了，我确定我通不过。 考查动词时态。don't一般现在时；won't一般将来时；aren't一般现在时；didn't一般过去时。根据问句可知，是叙述将来的事情，所以句子应是一般将来时，故选B。 二、完形填空（1x8=8分） 先通读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳答案。 What do you think of robots in 50 or 100 years’ time? I think  ______ 13 ______  will do different things. For example, workers often get tired when they do the  ______ 14 ______  jobs over and over again. In the future, robots can  ______ 15 ______  people to do those jobs. Robots will talk like us and people will have robots in their homes. Robots will not  ______ 16 ______  help busy parents but also teach their children to learn. Robots will do  ______ 17 ______  housework such as cleaning windows, sweeping the floor and cooking meals. Robots  ______ 18 ______  become our best friends. Robots will do most of the work, so people will  ______ 19 ______  more free time. Maybe they’ll work only two or three days a week. They’ll be able to fly to the moon  ______ 20 ______  plane and spend their holidays there.

questions.prompt: —Uncle Lee, may I use your bike? —Sorry,  ______  is broken.
questions.explanation: 句意：——李叔叔，我能用你的自行车吗？——对不起，我的坏了。 考查代词辨析。hers她的，名词性物主代词；his他的，物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词；my我的，形容词性物主代词。根据“Sorry...is broken.”可知，此处李叔叔应回答“我的自行车坏了”，空后面没有名词，应用名词性物主代词，mine“我的”，相当于my bike。故选C。

questions.prompt: I often help my parents with housework  ______  Sundays.
questions.explanation: 句意：星期天我经常帮父母做家务。 考查介词辨析。on用于星期前；in泛指一般意义的上午、下午或晚上；at用于具体的时刻前；to向，朝着。根据“Sundays”可知，应用时间介词on。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Can you finish reading the book in two weeks? —No, I  ______. I am too busy these days.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能两周内读完这本书吗？——不，我不能。我这些天太忙了。 考查一般疑问句回答。由情态动词“Can”引出的一般疑问句，否定回答为“No，主语+can’t.”。故选B。

questions.prompt: My best friend Lisa wants to join the Art Club  ______  she is good at painting.
questions.explanation: 句意：我最好的朋友Lisa想加入艺术俱乐部，因为她擅长绘画。 考查连词辨析。because因为；although尽管；or或者；so因此。根据“My best friend Lisa wants to join the Art Club... she is good at painting.”可知，Lisa想加入艺术俱乐部的原因是她擅长画画，前后句为因果关系，前果后因，故用because连接。故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  are the potatoes? — They are 7 yuan a kilo.
questions.explanation: 句意：——土豆多少钱？——它们是一公斤7元。 考查特殊疑问句。how long多久；how old多大；how much多少/多钱；how many多少。根据“They are 7 yuan a kilo”可知，此处询问多钱，故选C。

questions.prompt: You must be very tired. Why not  ______  to take a rest?
questions.explanation: 句意：你一定非常累。为什么不停下来去休息？ 考查固定句式。建议停下来休息，用句型“Why not do sth.为什么不做某事”，空处应用动词原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What’s that noise, Sam? —My little brother  ______  with his toy car now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——萨姆，那是什么声音？——我的弟弟现在正在玩他的玩具汽车。 考查现在进行时。play玩。will play一般将来时；is playing现在进行时；plays动词的第三人称单数形式；played动词的过去式。根据问句“What’s that noise, Sam?”可知提到的声响是现有的，结合答句中“now”可知是说现在正在进行的动作，用现在进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —How long do you  ______  on your homework every day? —One or two hours.
questions.explanation: 句意：——每天你花费多长时间在作业上？——一个或者两个小时。 考查动词辨析。pay支付；cost花费；take花费；spend花费。“sb spend 时间 on sth”表示“在某事上花费时间”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Why is Mike looking forward to this weekend? —Because he and his friends  ______  their favorite team play basketball.
questions.explanation: 句意：——为什么麦克盼着这个周末？——因为他和他的朋友打算去看他们最喜欢的球队打篮球。 考查时态。根据“looking forward to this weekend”可知，时态是一般将来时，谓语结构为be going to+动词原形。故选D。

questions.prompt: —There ______ a football match and a concert this weekend.Which one would you like to go to? —The football match, of course.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个周末将有一场足球比赛和一场音乐会。你想去哪一个?——当然是足球比赛。 考查there be句型。is是；have有；will be一般将来时；will have一般将来时（将会有）；there be不能与have/has连用，排除B、D；根据“this weekend”可知是一般将来时，可推测出此处是“will be”，故选C。

questions.prompt: The twins  ______  in Dalian last year. They  ______  here now.
questions.explanation: 句意：这对双胞胎去年在大连。他们现在都在这。 考查时态和主谓一致。根据“last year”可知第一句用一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式，主语“The twins”是复数，应用were。根据“now”可知第二句用一般现在时，主语“They”是复数，应用are。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to fly a kite with me? — ______. It’s fun.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你愿意和我一起放风筝吗？ ——当然，我很乐意。它很有趣。 考查情景交际。Sorry, I can’t“对不起，我不能”；Sure, I’d love to“当然，我很乐意”；Not much“不多”；Yes, please“好的，谢谢”。根据“It’s fun.”判断，应该是我很乐意和你一起去放风筝。故选B。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择能填入相应空白处的最佳选项，将其字母代号写在题前括号内。 I used to hate running because I was always the last student to cross the finishing line. Then, in 2019, my friend asked me to run a 10 km-running event (比赛项目) with him. “No. I hate  ______ 13 ______.” I immediately said. Over the weekend I thought about his question. I thought, “Why do I hate running? I haven’t  ______ 14 ______  it since I was in Grade 7.” Finally, I decided to have a try, so I told my friend I’d like to. He was pleased and advised me to look for a running program on the Internet to help me  ______ 15 ______  how to run. There were lots of running programs on the Internet. I chose a 14-week running program that would teach me how to  ______ 16 ______  running for 30 minutes. I found it very easy to follow. I enjoyed following the program as I could see the improvement in my running each week. I went from not being able to run for more than 30 seconds to running for over 30 minutes. I went from hating running to  ______ 17 ______  running. On the day of the 10 km-running event, I was both excited and nervous.  ______ 18 ______, it was time to put my new skills into practice. My friends and family came to support (支持) me. It was lovely to have them there. With their support and my training, I managed to finish the 10 km running in 72 minutes. It was hard but I felt very  ______ 19 ______  for having tried it. From this  ______ 20 ______, I learnt it was a good idea to try something before saying I hated it.

questions.prompt: —May I use your pen? I think  ______  works better. —Certainly, here you are.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以用一下你的钢笔吗？我觉得你的用起来更好。——当然，给你。 考查代词辨析。yours你的，名词性物主代词；your你的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词。首先此空是代指“你的钢笔”，所以应用名词性物主代词。其次根据“May I use your pen?”可知是指对方的钢笔用起来更好，应用yours。故选A。

questions.prompt: Kate is nice. I like to work with  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：凯特很好。我喜欢和她一起工作。 考查代词辨析。she她，人称代词主格；her她，人称代词宾格；hers她的，名词性物主代词。此处是指和凯特一起工作，空前是介词，空处应填代词宾格。故选B。

questions.prompt: They often have a picnic in the park  ______  Sunday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：星期天下午他们经常在公园里野餐。 考查时间介词。at一般用在时间点的名词前，in一般用在较长的时间段名词前，例如，上午、下午、月，年等，表示 “在(一段时间)内、(将来时中) ……之后 ”；on指在具体的某一天或某一天的上午，下午，晚上，例如，星期几或几月几日。由“Sunday afternoon”可知用时间介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Chris,  ______  I join the Music Club with you? —Of course, you can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——克里斯，我能和你一起加入音乐俱乐部吗？——当然，你可以。 考查情态动词。can可以；must必须；need需要。根据“...I join the Music Club with you?”可知，此处是表示请求，应用can I...“我能……”的结构，故选A。

questions.prompt: He is fit and he’s good at sports,  ______  I’ll choose him to be our PE monitor.
questions.explanation: 句意：他身体健康，擅长运动，所以我会选他做我们体育课的课代表。 考查连词辨析。or或者；but但是；so因此。“He is fit and he’s good at sports”与“I’ll choose him to be our PE monitor”是因果关系，因为擅长运动，所以要选他为体育课的课代表，故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a basketball match between Class 1 and Class 2 next Monday.
questions.explanation: 句意：下周一一班和二班将举行一场篮球赛。 考查there be句型的一般将来时。根据所给空后面的“next Monday”可知，时态是一般将来时，结合“There”可知是there be句型的一般将来时：there is/are going to be。故选C。

questions.prompt: My father often watches TV in the evening, but he  ______  tomorrow evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爸爸晚上经常看电视，但是他明天晚上要去游泳。 考查动词时态。根据“tomorrow evening”可知，此处用一般将来时be going to do的结构，故选B。

questions.prompt: Please don’t make so much noise. The baby  ______  in the next room now.
questions.explanation: 句意：请不要制造这么大的噪音。婴儿现在正在隔壁房间睡觉。 考查动词时态。根据“now”可知，此句用现在进行时be doing的结构，故选C。

questions.prompt: — These books are Betty’s, and  ______  are those? — Ah, they are mine. Thank you, Mr. Lin.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些书是贝蒂的，那些是谁的？——啊，它们是我的。谢谢你，林先生。 考查特殊疑问句。whose谁的；who谁；where在哪里。根据回答“they are mine”可知，询问哪些是谁的（书），故选A。

questions.prompt: —What about  ______  with me tomorrow? —Great!
questions.explanation: 句意：——明天和我一起看电影怎么样？——太棒了。 考查非谓语动词。What about…？表示“……怎么样？”，about是介词，后面跟动名词作宾语，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Could you tell me how to  ______  the museum? —Well, take No. 3 bus and get off at the Railway Station. It’s opposite the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我去博物馆怎么走吗？——哦，坐3路公共汽车，在火车站下车。它在公园的对面。 考查动词短语辨析。get to到达；get on上车；get up起床。根据“Could you tell me how to … the museum”和“Well, take No. 3 bus and get off at the Railway Station”可知，此处询问如何到达博物馆，故选A。

questions.prompt: I’ll  ______  the whole summer living in a small village.
questions.explanation: 句意：我要花整个夏天住在一个小村庄。 考查动词辨析。use使用；cost花费，主语是物；spend花费，主语是人。根据“the whole summer living in a small village.”可知是指花费整个夏天住在一个小村庄，且主语是人，应用spend，sb spend time doing“某人花费时间做”，为固定短语。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Is this pencil-box Tom’s? —No. This is a red one.  ______  is black.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个铅笔盒是汤姆的吗？——不是。这是一个红色的。他的是黑色的。 考查代词。He他，是主格；Him他，是宾格；His他的（东西），是名词性物主代词；Hers她的（东西），是名词性物主代词。根据“Is this pencil-box Tom’s?”可知，此处回答汤姆的铅笔盒，用代词his代指Tom’s pencil-box，故选C。

questions.prompt: Lily often goes shopping with her mum  ______  Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉经常在星期天早上和妈妈一起去购物。 考查介词辨析。in用于年，月，季节，一段时间或泛指的一天的上午，下午，晚上之前；on用在具体的某一天或某一天的早，中，晚前；at用于具体的时刻前；from来自。根据“Sunday morning”可知，此处指在星期天的早上，用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Jim, why are you so excited? —Oh, you know, there  ______  a basketball match tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jim，你为什么这么激动？——哦，你知道，明天将有一场篮球比赛。 考查there be句型的一般将来时。分析句子可知，此句为there be句型的一般将来时，结构为：there will be或there is/are going to be。主语是单数，be动词用is。故选B。

questions.prompt: I must go now because my friend Lucy  ______  for me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我现在必须走了，因为我的朋友露西在等我。 考查时态。根据“I must go now because my friend Lucy... for me.”可知，现在必须走是因为露西正在等我，时态应用现在进行时，结构为be doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: Good news! Our head teacher Mr. Wang  ______  back tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：好消息！我们的班主任王老师明天会回来。 考查动词时态。comes动词单三；come动词原形；came动词过去式；will come一般将来时。根据时间状语“tomorrow”可知，此句应用一般将来时态。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Can you drive a car? — No, I  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意“-你能开车吗？-不，我不能”。A.用于以can问的一般疑问句；B.用于以do问的一般疑问句；C.用于以will问的一般疑问句；D.用于以have问的一般疑问句。can译为“能”，否定回答为can’t，故选A。

questions.prompt: Please  ______  the bus and walk with me to the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：请下车，和我一起走到公园。 考查动词短语。get down下来；get off下车；get up起床；get on（同……）和睦相处。根据“walk with me to the park”可知此处指下车，用get off。故选B。

questions.prompt: — I want to join the Food and Drink Club, but I can’t cook. —  ______. I can teach you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我想要加入饮食俱乐部，但是我不会做饭。——别担心。我可以教你。 考查情景交际。Don’t worry别担心；You’re welcome别客气；It’s my pleasure这是我的荣幸；Thanks谢谢。根据“I can teach you.”可知，此处是表示安慰对方，选项A符合语境。故选A。 Ⅳ. 完形填空。（共 12 分，每小题 1 分） （一） 根据短文内容，从方框中选择恰当的词，并将指代该词的字母填涂在答题卡的相应位置上。 A. information B. different C. see D. send We live on the planet（星球）Earth. Could we live on a  ______ 9 ______  planet? To find out, scientists have been studying Mars for a long time. They  ______ 10 ______  special machines to Mars. These machines are called rovers. Scientists on Earth tell rovers what to do. Talking to rovers is something like playing a computer game. From Earth scientists can  ______ 11 ______  what rovers are doing. Rovers usually move along the surface of Mars. They take pictures, study the planet and send the  ______ 12 ______  back to Earth. They help us learn many things about Mars. 【答案】9. B 10. D

questions.prompt: —Is this your book? —No, it’s not mine. Jenny is looking for her English book. Maybe it’s  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是你的书吗？——不，不是我的。珍妮正在找她的英语书。可能是她的。 考查物主代词辨析。her她的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词；hers她的，名词性物主代词。根据“Jenny is looking for her English book.”可知珍妮在找书，由此推测可能是她的，而空格处末尾没有名词，应用名词性物主代词。故选C。

questions.prompt: We like to play football  ______  Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们喜欢在星期六下午踢足球。 考查介词辨析。in后加某年某月某季节；at后加具体的时刻；on后加具体的某一天，或某一天的早中晚。根据“Saturday afternoon.”可知具体到周六下午，应用介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Can I use your pen, Mr. Smith? —Of course, you  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——史密斯先生，我可以用你的笔吗？——当然，你可以。 考查情态动词。根据问句“Can I use your pen”，可知是用情态动词can提问，回答时候应用情态动词回答，表示允许。故选A。

questions.prompt: You are going to like the future  ______  robots will do the heavy work.
questions.explanation: 句意：你会喜欢未来的，因为机器人干重活。 考查连词辨析。so因此；because因为；but但是。“robots will do the heavy work”是会喜欢未来的原因，前果后因，用because引导原因状语从句。故选B。

questions.prompt: Mr. Brown  ______  the football match next week.
questions.explanation: 句意：布朗先生下周将会去看足球赛。 考查时态。根据“next week”可知用一般将来时，其结构为be going to do。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What  ______  does she take? —Small, please.
questions.explanation: 句意：——她穿多大号？——小号。 考查名词词义辨析。colour颜色；price价格；size尺寸。由答语“Small, please.”可知，此句是问尺寸，故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  two pencils and a pen on the desk?
questions.explanation: 句意：桌子上有两支铅笔和一支钢笔吗？ 考查there be结构。There be结构表示某地有某人或某物，be动词与最临近的主语保持一致，句中“two pencils”表示复数，be动词用are，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  does your brother spend buying this T-shirt? —100 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你哥哥花多少钱买这件T恤？——100元。 考查特殊疑问词辨析。How long多长，多久；How many多少；How much多少钱。根据回答可知应提问价钱，应用How much提问。故选C。

questions.prompt: All the students in our class  ______  litter in the park next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们班上的所有学生下周日将会在公园里收集垃圾。 考查谓语动词时态。根据“next Sunday”可知句子应用一般将来时，结构为will+动词原形。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tom, we are going to have a party tonight. Would you like  ______  us?
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆，我们打算今晚举办派对。你想要加入我们吗？ 考查非谓语动词。would like to do sth.“想要做某事”，动词不定式to join作宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: I don’t like shopping for clothes online because I can’t  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不喜欢在网上买衣服，因为我不能试穿。 考查动词短语。try on“试穿”，与人称代词连用时人称代词置于短语中间；再由“I don’t like shopping for clothes online”可知此处用them指代上文提到的“clothes”。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What can I do for you Madam? — ______

choices.label: B
choices.text: I’d like to buy some beef.

questions.explanation: 句意：——女士我可以为你做什么？——我想买一些牛肉。 考查情景交际。Certainly当然；I’d like to buy some beef我想买一些牛肉；All right好的。根据问句“What can I do for you, Madam? ”可知想知道可以为对方做什么，回答可回答具体事项，选项B符合。故选B。 二、完形填空(共8分，每小题1分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C四个选项中选择最佳选项。 “Are you listening, Simon?” Simon’s teacher asks. Simon smiles and shakes(摇晃) his head. He doesn’t often  ______ 13 ______  or try hard in class. Talking is so much better. He wants to be heard.That evening, Simon starts to feel a bit sick. By bedtime, his throat(咽喉) feels really bad. He has cakes and hot chocolate to make his throat feel better but he isn’t sure it’ll work. The next  ______ 14 ______, when he opens his mouth to say, “Good morning,” nothing comes out. When he gets to school, Mrs. Jacobs says “hello” to him, and he just nods(点头). When his friends start to ask him what TV shows he watches, he just can’t say anything. By the time they start  ______ 15 ______, almost everyone is looking at him as if he’s got a third eye. Simon sits in class, bored  ______ 16 ______  he can’t talk to his classmates. He watches them talk to each other, but he can’t even do that. You know what? It isn’t that bad. He can really do his homework that night. It gives  ______ 17 ______  more TV and game time because his work finished. The next day, his voice is  ______ 18 ______  back, but he stays quiet(安静的) again. The third day, he can talk  ______ 19 ______, but he doesn’t talk. He listens and puts up his  ______ 20 ______  to speak. What a difference that one day makes!

questions.prompt: My pen doesn’t work well. Could I borrow  ______, John?
questions.explanation: 句意：我的钢笔不好写。约翰，我能借用你的吗？ 考查代词辨析。you你，你们；her她，她的；yours你的；hers她的。空后无名词，所以此处使用名词性物主代词，故排除A和B；根据“John”可知，此处向约翰提出请求，应使用第二人称，即yours。故选C。

questions.prompt: They met  ______  the school gate at 8 o’clock  ______  a rainy night.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们在一个雨夜8点钟在学校门口见面。 考查介词辨析。in后加某年某月某季节，或后加大地点；at后加具体的时间点，或后加小地点；on后加具体的某一天或某一天的早中晚。第一空后是指在学校门口，应用介词at；第二空是具体到某一天的晚上，所以应用介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  we’ll be late for school!
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则我们上学要迟到了。 考查连词辨析。and和，并且；but但是；or否则，或者；so所以。根据“Hurry up”和“we’ll be late for school”可知，此处为“祈使句+or+陈述句”的结构，表示“做某事，否则将会……”，or后常表示一种不好的结果。故选C。

questions.prompt: Kitty has three cousins.  ______  of them like playing football.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉蒂有三个表弟。他们都喜欢踢足球。 考查代词辨析。other其他的；all三者或三者以上都；both两者都；either两个中的任何一个。根据“Kitty has three cousins.”可知，此处表示三个人都喜欢踢足球，使用all。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  I bring my ID card with me next time? —No, you needn’t. I have copied and stored it in my computer.
questions.explanation: 句意：——下次我必须带来我的身份证吗？——不，你不必。我已经复制并储存在我的电脑里了。 考查情态动词的用法。can可以；must必须；may可以；need需要。根据“No, you needn’t.”可知，此处使用must引导一般疑问句。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the gym? —Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去一次健身房？——一个月两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少；How much多少钱；How often多久一次；How far多远。根据“Twice a month.”可知，此处使用how often，提问频率。故选C。

questions.prompt: Steven’s parents  ______  him off at the airport tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：史蒂文的父母明天将到机场为他送行。 考查一般将来时。根据“tomorrow”可知，句中时态为一般将来时，结构will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: Listen! Someone  ______  in the next room. Who is that?
questions.explanation: 句意：听！有人在隔壁房间唱歌。那是谁？ 考查动词时态。根据“Listen”可知句子是现在进行时，主语是不定代词，be动词用单数。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  you free this weekend? —I’m afraid not. I have to visit my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个周末你有空吗？——恐怕不行。我必须去拜访我的朋友。 考查一般疑问句。首先主语是第二人称you，does和is不符合，排除；另外free“有空的”是形容词，所以此处应用be动词are，构成系表结构。故选C。

questions.prompt: Linda wants to know when the train  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：Linda想知道火车什么时候到达。 考查动词的用法。arrive是不及物动词，后面跟宾语的时候，需要加介词in或者at；后面不跟宾语的时候，则不需要加介词。分析题干可知，空后没有具体的宾语，排除C、D两项，结合wants可知，从句也用一般现在时，主语the train提示谓语动词用第三人称单数形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —You look great with your new glasses! — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你带着你的新眼镜真好看！ ——谢谢。 考查情景交际。No，I’m not不，我不是；Thank you谢谢；You’re welcome不客气；I’m sorry to hear that听到这个消息我很难过。根据“You look great with your new glasses!”可知，对别人的夸赞应表示感谢。故选B。

questions.prompt: We are going to meet at the school gate after school.  ______  late!
questions.explanation: 句意：放学后我们将在学校门口见面。不要迟到！ 考查祈使句。祈使句的否定形式为：Don’t+动词原形/No+doing，排除C和D；late是形容词，其前应用be动词构成系表结构。故选B。

questions.prompt: Let’s  ______  in the woods.
questions.explanation: 句意：让我们在树林里散步吧。 考查动词短语和非谓语动词。take a walk“散步”，是固定短语，排除D选项；let sb do sth“让某人做某事”，为固定短语，故选B。 五、完形填空（共18分，每小题1. 5分） “But I feel good doing this!” the little boy’s voice rang in my ears when I entered the mall. He stood raising  ______ 14 ______  for cancer research. In the cold wind, he pulled his hat down over his ears. He warmed one hand in his pocket and held a list with the other hand. I noticed him greeting the people passing by  ______ 15 ______  gloves on his hands. I checked my purse but I didn’t find any change. I was  ______ 16 ______  ready to give money because I wished cancer could be cured (治愈) one day. “I’ll bring you some money when I returned” I  ______ 17 ______  the little boy. “Thank you!” he smiled and he seemed almost  ______ 18 ______  in the cold air. I suggested he come inside the mall, but he said, “The guard there said  ______ 19 ______  is allowed to raise money for charities (慈善) in the mall. But I feel good doing this here. It’s OK.” I did my shopping and  ______ 20 ______  about buying something for him. Finally, I bought a pair of gloves, brown ones. The cashier (收银员) felt curious when I  ______ 21 ______  the boy’s words “But I feel good doing this!” The boy still stood where he had been. I offered some money to him and  ______ 22 ______  in the list that he handed to me. Then he told me that his best friend George had leukemia (白血病). He did this in order to help him out of  ______ 23 ______. With tears full of my eyes, I put the gloves that I bought for him into his hands. “Will the cancer research give you something to thank you for doing this?” “Oh yes!” the boy said and his eyes  ______ 24 ______  up with joy “They sure do! Now I can stand here much  ______ 25 ______  than I expected!” “What do you receive then?” I asked. He answered with a smile, “I get another new, empty list.”

questions.prompt: My grandpa likes watching TV.  ______  always watches sports shows in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爷爷喜欢看电视。他总是在晚上看体育节目。 考查代词辨析。He他，主格；She她，主格；His他的，物主代词；Him他，宾格。空处指代“My grandpa”，男性，且在句中作主语，所以用he，故选A。

questions.prompt: Is there  ______  butter in the fridge?
questions.explanation: 句意：冰箱里有黄油吗？ 考查词汇辨析。a不定冠词，表示泛指，修饰以辅音音素开头的单词；an不定冠词，表示泛指，修饰以元音音素开头的单词；any任何，用于疑问句和否定句中；some一些，通常用于肯定句和希望得到肯定回答的疑问句中。本句是一般疑问句，且butter“黄油”是不可数名词，所以用any修饰，故选C。

questions.prompt: I like sandwiches,  ______  I don’t like hot dogs.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢三明治，但是我不喜欢热狗。 考查连词辨析。and“和”，表并列关系；or“或者”，表选择关系；so“因此”，表因果关系；but“但是”，表转折关系。根据“I like sandwiches,...I don’t like hot dogs.”可知，我喜欢吃三明治，但不喜欢吃热狗，两个句子为转折关系，用连词but连接。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Is there a museum  ______  the left of Green Road? —Yes, there is.
questions.explanation: 句意：——在格林路左边有一家博物馆吗？——是的，有。 考查介词短语。on the left of...“在……的左边”，固定短语，故选B。

questions.prompt: My mother usually  ______  the kitchen in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈通常在晚上打扫厨房。 考查动词时态。根据“usually ”可知，时态是一般现在时，主语是My mother，谓语动词用三单形式，故选C。

questions.prompt: Listen, they  ______  happily in the room.
questions.explanation: 句意：听，他们正在房间里高兴地交谈。 考查现在进行时态。根据“listen”可知，用现在进行时态，结构是be doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: My grandparents  ______  a walk after dinner every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的祖父母每天晚餐后散步。 考查一般现在时。take一般现在时态；took一般过去时态；will take一般将来时态；are taking现在进行时态。由“every day”可知句子描述的是经常性、习惯性的动作，句子用一般现在时态。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What’s your brother doing now? —He ______  the room.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你哥哥现在在干什么？——他正在打扫房间。 考查动词时态。根据问句“What’s your brother doing now?”可知，答句要用现在进行时描述正在进行的动作（be doing），故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  some fish and beef in the fridge.
questions.explanation: 句意：冰箱里有些鱼和牛肉 考查there be句型。there be表示“有”，不与have/has连用，该句型遵循就近一致原则，即be动词的形式要与相邻最近名词的单复数保持一致，由于“some fish”指的是“一些鱼肉”，为不可数名词，因此be动词用is。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the beef? —It’s $ 299 a pound.
questions.explanation: 句意：——牛肉多少钱？——每磅2.99美元。 考查疑问词辨析。How many多少；How much多少钱；How often多久一次；How long多长时间。根据“It’s $ 2.99 a pound.” 可知，应是询问价格，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What would you like? —I’d like a  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你想要点什么？——我想要一个汉堡包。 考查名词辨析。hamburger汉堡包，可数名词；water水，不可数名词；rice大米，不可数名词；butter黄油，不可数名词。根据“a”可知，空处应使用可数名词单数形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the cinema with your friends? —Twice a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久和你的朋友去看一次电影？——一周两次。 考查疑问词辨析。How often多久一次；How long多长时间；How many多少，修饰可数名词复数；How much多少钱。根据“Twice a week.”可知，空处是询问频率，所以用how often，故选A。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 What do you do on weekends? Some people like to stay at home, but others like to go out for a walk  ______ 13 ______  have a picnic. My friend John works hard in a factory during the  ______ 14 ______. On weekends he always  ______ 15 ______  the same thing. On Saturday he  ______ 16 ______  his car and on Sunday he takes his family to a nearby village. His uncle and aunt have a farm there. It isn’t a  ______ 17 ______  one, but there are always  ______ 18 ______  things to do. The children help with the animals and give them some  ______ 19 ______. John and his wife work in the fields. At the end of the day, they are all tired but  ______ 20 ______. And John’s aunt cooks a big dinner for them.

questions.prompt: —Do you know the girl over there? —Yes.  ______  name is Jennifer Smith.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认识那边的那个女孩吗？——是的。她的名字是詹妮弗•史密斯。 考查代词辨析。Her她的；His他的；My我的；Your你的。根据“Do you know the girl over there?”可知，此处是指女孩的名字，即她的名字。故选A。

questions.prompt: Tom usually goes to school  ______  7:00 in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆通常早上7点去上学。 考查介词辨析。in用在年、月、上下午的前面；at用于具体的时刻前面；on用于具体的某一天或具体某一天的上午，下午或晚上；to朝向。根据“7:00”可知，几点用介词at。故选B。

questions.prompt: Lisa is only four years old,  ______  she can play the piano very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：丽莎只有四岁，但她钢琴弹得很好。 考查并列连词的辨析。so所以；and和；or或者、否则；but但是。根据“Lisa is only four years old, …she can play the piano very well.”可知，丽莎只有四岁，她钢琴弹得很好。前后句是转折的关系。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Where’s your sister, Mary? —Look, she  ______  the flowers in the garden.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玛丽，你妹妹在哪？ ——看，她正在花园里浇花。 考查动词时态。water用作动词时，意思是“浇水”。根据答语中的“Look”可知，句子的时态是现在进行时态，结构是“am/is/are doing”，主语是第三人称单数，因此be动词是is。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Emma,  ______  you sing a song at the party? —Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——艾玛，你能在派对上唱首歌吗？——是的，我能。 考查情态动词辨析。may可以（与第二人称连用表示祝福）；must必须；need需要；can能。根据“Yes, I can.”可知，一般疑问句用can开头。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Linda,  ______  is your new dress? —200 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——琳达，你的新裙子多少钱? ——200元。 考查特殊疑问句。how much多少钱；how many多少，修饰可数名词复数；how long多久，对一段时间或长度提问；how often多久一次，对频度提问。根据答语“200 yuan”可知，上句应是对价钱提问，需用how much。故选A。

questions.prompt: Aunt Lily always  ______  to keep healthy.
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉阿姨总是锻炼保持身体健康。 考查动词时态。根据“always”可知，本句是一般现在时，且主语“Aunt Lily”是第三人称单数，动词需用三单形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a big library in my school. I like reading books there.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的学校有一个很大的图书馆。我喜欢在那里读书。 考查there be句型。根据关键词“there” 和“in my school在我的学校”可知此题是there be 结构， 且用一般现在时态；主语“a big library”是单数名词, 因此be动词用“is”。故选C。 二、完形填空（共8分, 每小题8分）阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 As usual, Jenny is playing on the playground. Then she  ______ 9 ______  a quiet “meow” and looks around. She finds a kitten sitting at the corner. He wears a collar （颈圈） ______ 10 ______  the name“Lucky”. Picking it up, she walks to her teacher and says, “I find this kitten on the playground. He has a collar, so he must have his owner. But there’s no  ______ 11 ______  or phone number on the collar. Could we help find his home as a class project? ” “Certainly! Would you like to be the  ______ 12 ______  in this project? ” Mrs March asks. Jenny says “yes”. She thinks of an idea and begins taking charge （负责）. “Okay, we’ll need to make posters （海报） to put up around the neighborhood. We should call the newspaper. What else? ” She asks the class. John thinks that they should call the animal center in case （万一） the owner calls there. “Good idea!” Jenny says as she adds （添加） it to the list. Soon students are busy  ______ 13 ______  posters. Two students are making phone calls. Then one student says  ______ 14 ______, “The animal center says that a family  ______ 15 ______  a lost kitten named Lucky!” The class cheer （欢呼）. Twenty minutes later, a woman shows up and says with joy, “Thank you! We’ve been looking all over for our cat! He is very ‘lucky’ to be found （找到） by such a  ______ 16 ______  group of students like you!”

questions.prompt: This is  ______  eraser and that is  ______  UFO.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是一个橡皮擦，那是一个飞碟。 考查不定冠词。a/an不定冠词，表泛指，表示一类人或物；a用于辅音音素开头的单词前， an用于元音音素开头的单词前；eraser是以元音音素开头的单词，所以其前用an；UFO是以辅音音素开头的单词，所以其前用a。故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  you  ______  your name, please?
questions.explanation: 句意：你能拼一下你的名字吗？ 考查一般疑问句的用法。根据“...your name, please”并结合句意可知，此处表示“你能拼你的名字吗？”，用句型“Can+主语+动词原形+其他？”。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Are Tony and Mary your friends? — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼和玛丽是你的朋友吗？——是的，他们是。 考查一般疑问句。Yes, They are错误，不是句首，首字母不大写；Yes, they are是，他们是；No, they not错误，缺少系动词；No, he isn’t不，他不是；一般疑问句通常用肯定或否定来回答。主语是Tony and Mary，第三人称复数，所以用they代替；肯定回答用Yes, they are； 否定回答用No, they aren’t。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Is that  ______  pen? —Yes, it is. It’s  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——那是他的钢笔么？——是的。是他的钢笔。 考查形容词性物主代词和名词性物主代词的用法。his他的，形容词性物主代词或名词性物主代词；him他，宾格；he他，主格。第一空后跟名词pen，可知要用形容词性物主代词，故排除D；第二空缺少名词性物主代词作表语。故选C。

questions.prompt: It is not ______ book.
questions.explanation: 句意：它不是我的书。 放在名词前的应该是一个形容词性物主代词；此时不要再用冠词来限定。故选C。

questions.prompt: —The blue pen is hers. — ______  that one?
questions.explanation: 句意：——这支蓝色的钢笔是她的。——那支呢？ 考查特殊疑问句。What什么；What about怎么样；How如何；How are是怎么样。根据句意，询问那支钢笔的情况，因此用what about，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Where are my pencils? — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的铅笔在哪里？——对不起，我不知道。 考查特殊疑问句。It's on the table.它在桌子上；Yes, they are.是的，它们是；Sorry, I don't know.对不起，我不知道；They are pencils.它们是铅笔。根据“Where are my pencils?”可知，此处回答它们的位置，排除BD两项，用代词they代指my pencils，因此排除A项，故选C。

questions.prompt: This set of keys  ______  in  ______  bag.
questions.explanation: 句意：这串钥匙在他的包里。 考查主谓一致和形容词性物主代词。“This set of keys”是作为一个整体，所以谓语动词用单数，排除A和C。he他，人称代词主格；his他的，形容词性物主代词。“bag”是名词，应用形容词性物主代词修饰，故选B。

questions.prompt: Is that your ID card? Please  ______  me at 8762356.
questions.explanation: 句意：那是你的身份证吗？请拨打这个电话8762356联系我。 考查动词。say说；call打电话；see看见；tell告诉。短语“call sb. at +电话号码”意为“拨打xxxx号码联系某人”，符合句意，故选B。

questions.prompt: Thank you ______ the photo of your family. It’s very nice.
questions.explanation: 句意：谢谢你的家庭照，它是很好的。 考查介词的用法。短语thank sb for+ sth因为某事而感谢某人。故选D。

questions.prompt: Look at this photo. This is my sister and  ______ are my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：看这张照片。这是我妹妹，这些是我的朋友。 A. this这个；B. these这些；C. it它；D. that那个。and连接两个并列句，后面的句子缺少主语；由are可知，主语应是复数；these这些，复数。故选B。

questions.prompt: Where  ______  the notebook and the tape player? I can't find  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：那个笔记本和那个录音机在哪里？我找不到它们。 考查主谓一致和代词。it它；them它们；主语the notebook and the tape player是复数形式，用代词them代指，因此谓语用复数形式are。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 New Beginnings There are two children in my family. I am three years younger than my  ______ 13 ______  Tova, and I think everything she does is great. When I was a kid, I liked to follow her and her friends around, hoping to become one of them, but there wasn't much  ______ 14 ______  for a troublesome sister. Over time, there is a distance（距离）between us although we live in the same  ______ 15 ______. So when she tells me she's going to China to study, I don't care much. But the first night after she leaves, I kept thinking that something is  ______ 16 ______. The house is too quiet. I feel just how different it is when she isn't at home. I cry sadly. But as the night falls, my tears turn into tears of calm（平静）, tears of  ______ 17 ______  beginnings—I decide to do something. I pick up the phone. "Hello?" Her voice sounds familiar（熟悉的）. "Hey, Tova. It's me. Sara. I'm just  ______ 18 ______  to tell you I love you. "My words come out quickly. I know that if I stop in the middle, I won't  ______ 19 ______  them. "I know we aren't as close as some sisters, but that doesn't mean I'm not missing you. " After a long silence, she finally says, "Your voice makes me feel that you are by my side. "And before the call ends, she says very quickly, "I love you, too." I never feel so  ______ 20 ______  to have Tova as my sister. I'm hoping to see my sister back home this December.

questions.prompt: There is map of China on the wall in my room.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我房间的墙上有一张中国地图。 考查冠词辨析。a一个，泛指，用于辅音音素开头的单词前；an一个，泛指，用于元音音素开头的单词前；the特指。根据语境可知，表示“一张地图”应用泛指，且map为辅音音素开头，用a，故选A。

questions.prompt: Frank is my brother.  ______  likes collecting stamps.
questions.explanation: 句意：弗兰克是我哥哥。他喜欢集邮。 考查代词辨析。she她，主格代词；her她，宾格代词；he他，主格代词；him他，宾格代词。根据前句“Frank”是男孩和空处是作句子主语可知，空处应用主格代词he，故选C。

questions.prompt: This isn’t  ______  book. Mine is in the backpack.
questions.explanation: 句意：这不是我的书。我的在背包里。 考查代词辨析。I我，主格代词；my我的，形容词性的物主代词；me我，宾格代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词。空处的词是修饰名词，应用形容词性的物主代词。故选B。

questions.prompt: My classmates  ______  very nice to me. They help me a lot with my study.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的同学对我很好。他们在学习上帮了我很多忙。 考查系动词辨析。am用于第一人称单数形式；is用于第三人称单数形式；be动词原形；are用于复数和第二人称。主语“My classmates”是复数形式，故系动词应用are。故选D。

questions.prompt: My uncle is a policeman. He works  ______  Shanghai.
questions.explanation: 句意：我叔叔是个警察。他在上海工作。 考查介词辨析。on在……上；to到……；at在……，后加小地方；in在……里，后加大地方。Shanghai“上海”是个大地方，应用in。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Who are these two girls in the picture? —They are my sister Cindy  ______  my cousin Helen.
questions.explanation: 句意：——照片里的两个女孩是谁？——她们是我妹妹Cindy 和我表妹Helen。 考查连词辨析。so因此；and和；but但是；for因为。根据句意可知，空前后是并列关系，应用and。故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  is Bill, John? I can’t find him. —Look! He is on the playground
questions.explanation: 句意：——Bill在哪，John？我找不到他。——看！他在操场上。 考查特殊疑问词辨析。Where哪里；What什么；When什么时候；Who谁。根据答语“He is on the playground.”可知。应是问Bill在哪。故选A。

questions.prompt: Jim’s grandpa watches TV news and newspapers in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆的爷爷在晚上看电视新闻和读报纸。 考查一般现在时。题干and连接两个并列的谓语动词，选项A和B属于非谓语形式，故排除；由第一个谓语动词watches“观看”可知，句子时态属于一般现在时，read“读”是与watches并列的第二个谓语动词，二者主语相同，所以也用第三人称单数形式，即reads，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Hey, Grace! Is this your dictionary? — ______. I am looking for it everywhere!
questions.explanation: 句意：——嘿，Grace！这是你的字典吗？——是的，谢谢你，我到处找它！ 考查交际用语。Here you are给你；No problem没问题；Yes, thank you是的，谢谢你； Excuse me打扰一下。根据上文“Is this your dictionary?”是一般疑问句，应该用yes或no回答，根据下文“I am looking for it everywhere!”可知，此处是让对方表示感谢。故选C。 五．（共5分，每小题1分） 语法填空 Peter brings home a toy car. He puts it in his room and goes out. The toy car  ______ 10 ______  (look) around and wants to find a place to stay. It jumps onto the desk. There are some  ______ 11 ______ (book)on it. They say, “This is our place. You can’t stay here.”It jumps onto the chair.There ______ 12 ______ (be) a hat.The hat says, “You hurt  ______ 13 ______ (I)!” “Where is my place?” asks the toy car. “Come here!”says the bed.The toy car finds its place at last.It is now  ______ 14 ______ the floor,under the bed. 【答案】10. looks

questions.prompt: Miss Smith is very kind. We all like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯小姐很善良。我们都喜欢她。 考查代词。he他（主格）；him他（宾格）；she她（主格）；her她（宾格）。根据“We all like...”可知，空格处作宾语，用宾格，“Miss Smith”是女士。故选D。

questions.prompt: We can’t go out  ______  school nights.
questions.explanation: 句意：上学的晚上我们不能出去。 考查介词词义辨析。at表示具体的时间点；in泛指上午、下午或晚上；on表示具体某一天的早上、下午或晚上；by到……时候。根据school nights，可知这里表示的是具体某一天的晚上，应用介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Can you swim or dance? —I  ______  dance.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会游泳还是会跳舞？——我会跳舞。 考查情态动词。need需要；have to不得不；must必须；can会。根据“Can you swim or dance?”可知，前者在问后者会做什么，回答也用can，表能力。故选D。

questions.prompt: —  ______  does it take you to get there by bus? —About five minutes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——坐公共汽车到那里需要多长时间？ ——大约五分钟。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长时间，是对时间段提问；How far多远，是对距离提问； How much多少钱，是对价格提问；How many多少，对数量提问。根据“About five minutes.”可知，此处是对时间段提问，用how long。故选A。

questions.prompt: Listen! Someone  ______  an English song now.
questions.explanation: 句意：听！现在有人正在唱英文歌。 考查现在进行时。根据“Listen!”可知句中sing这个动作正在进行，此句应用现在进行时，其结构为“am/is/are+doing”，主语Someone是不定代词，be动词用is。故选C。

questions.prompt: —How’s it going? — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——近况如何？——很好。 考查情景交际。Long time no see好久不见；Pretty good很好；It’s going to rain就要下雨了；I’m drawing a picture我在画一幅画。根据“How’s it going?”可知，此处要回答“很好”，其它选项语意不通。故选B。 五、语法填空共6分,每小题 1分. 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写 1个适当的单词，在提示词的空白处用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空。 Elephants are smart animals. They can play soccer or music. They can also draw very  ______ 7 ______  (good). People say that “an elephant never ______ 8 ______  (forget).” Elephants can walk for a long time and never get lost. They can also remember  ______ 9 ______  (place) with food and water. This helps them to live. A new library is opened in the hill. Many animals go there to have a look. Three ducklings are ______ 10 ______  (stand) beside their father. “Why are there so many books here, dad?” one of them asks. Their father answers, “ ______ 11 ______  it is a library. Library is a storehouse of books. It is a place for us ______ 12 ______  (read). Reading makes us smart.” 【答案】7. well

questions.prompt: Mr. Smith is a good teacher and we all like  ______  class.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯先生是一个好老师，我们都喜欢他的课。 考查形容词性物主代词辨析。his他的；her她的；their他们的；your你的。根据“Mr. Smith is a good teacher”可知此处代指史密斯先生的课，故选A。

questions.prompt: I often make breakfast for my family  ______  Saturday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常在周六早上为我的家人做早餐。 考查介词辨析。at作为时间介词时，通常用在具体的时刻前；in作为时间介词时，通常用在年，月，季节等时间前；on作为时间介词时，通常用在具体的某一天或具体某一天的上午、下午或晚上等前；to到。“Saturday morning”为具体的一天的上午，应用介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: They often go home late  ______  they often clean their classroom after class.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们经常回家很晚，因为他们经常课后打扫教室。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；so因此；because因为。“they often clean their classroom after class”是“They often go home late”的原因，用because引导原因状语从句，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mum, where is Dad? —He  ______  flowers in the garden now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，爸爸在哪里？——他现在正在花园里浇花。 考查现在进行时。根据“now”可知，动作正在发生，时态是现在进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do your parents play baseball, Tom? —They never play baseball. They like playing tennis and they play tennis twice a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你父母多久打一次棒球？——他们从来不打棒球。他们喜欢打网球，一周打两次网球。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少钱；How often多久一次；How long多长；How many多少。根据答语“They never play baseball.”可知，对频率提问，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Jenny. Let’s go home together. —Wait a minute. I  ______  an e-mail.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，Jenny。让我们一起回家吧！——等一会。我正在发送一个电子邮件。 考查现在进行时。根据“Wait a minute”可知此时还不能走，因为正在发电子邮件，所以时态为现在进行时，其谓语结构为“be+doing”，故选C。

questions.prompt: Peter’s grandma always  ______  the evening news on TV. She wants to know what is happening around the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得的奶奶总是看晚间新闻。她想知道世界各地正在发生什么。 考查时态。根据“Peter’s grandma always...the evening news on TV.”可知，时态是一般现在时，主语是“Peter’s grandma”，动词用三单。故选B。

questions.prompt: My brother likes playing baseball, but he ______  playing basketball.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的弟弟喜欢打棒球，但是他不喜欢打篮球。 考查动词时态。but“但是”表转折，其前为肯定句，此处应为否定句，而主语he为第三人称单数，否定句的助动词应用does，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Kate,  ______  does your first class start on Wednesday? — At 8:00. We have four classes in the morning. In the afternoon, we go to different clubs.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Kate，周三你的第一节课什么时候开始？——在8点。我们上午有四节课。下午我们去不同的俱乐部。 考查特殊疑问词辨析。when什么时候；how怎样；how many多少；how often多久一次。根据“At 8:00”可知是询问时间，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me,  ______  is the nearest post office? —Go down this road and the post office is on the right, beside the bank. A what
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，最近的邮局在哪里？——沿着这条路走，邮局就在右边，银行旁边。 考查特殊疑问句。what什么；how怎样；where在哪里；which哪一个。根据“the post office is on the right, beside the bank”可知此处询问地点，故选C。

questions.prompt: My friends and I like doing sports. We often ______  table tennis after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的朋友和我喜欢做运动。我们经常在放学后打乒乓球。 考查一般现在时。根据“often”可知句子时态为一般现在时，主语we为复数，故选A。

questions.prompt: — What are you doing, Jia Ming? — I  ______  my room. It is too messy.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你正在做什么，贾明？——我正在打扫房间。它是太乱了。 考查现在进行时。根据“What are you doing, Jia Ming?”可知时态为现在进行时，其谓语结构为“be+doing”，主语为I，其后be动词应用am，故选C。 二、完形填空(共8分，每小题1分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 My mom lives alone(独自) and works at a hotel. My work and my two children make it impossible(不可能) for me to visit her very often. One day, on her way home from work, she sees a  ______ 13 ______. It is very small and has white and black hair. At first, my mom just walks  ______ 14 ______  because it is a really windy evening and it is very dark. But the cat follows(跟随) my mom a long way. It seems very hungry (饥饿) and  ______ 15 ______. At last mom stop and it walks into my mom’s heart and life. A month later, I go to  ______ 16 ______  my mom. She tells me excitedly(兴奋地) about her little cat. I see it for the first time. It is  ______ 17 ______  for us to become friends. When I just sit down on the sofa, it jumps up onto my lap(大腿) and touches my hands with its head. When I call its name, it looks at me with its big eyes and says“meow” to me. It is so cute that I love it right away. This cat makes my mom laugh. She is always happy with the cat around. She cares about it very much and  ______ 18 ______  it fish all the time. The cat will stay in the room when it feels cold or just doesn’t want to be outside. My mom loves it and always tries to make it feel comfortable(舒服). The cat loves my mom, too. It must think of my mom as its mom. It is really attached to(依恋) her. It makes her  ______ 19 ______  full of love and happiness. It also makes me happy because I love to  ______ 20 ______  the smile in my mom’s eyes.

questions.prompt: My brother loves sports.  ______  usually plays basketball after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我弟弟喜欢运动。他通常放学后打篮球。 考查代词。We我们；They他们；She她；He他；此处指代“My brother”，应用he代替，故选D。

questions.prompt: My friend Lanlan is a nice girl. We all like  ______  very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的朋友兰兰是个漂亮的女孩。我们都非常喜欢她。 考查人称代词。him他；them他们；her她；you你。此空指上一句的兰兰，因此用指代女性的her。故选C。

questions.prompt: I often get up at half past seven  ______  Saturday morning. A in
questions.explanation: 句意：在周六早上，我经常七点半起床。 考查介词。in在……时候（加抽象时间）；on在……时候（加具体时间）；at在……时候（加钟点）；for为了。根据“Saturday morning”可知，此处应用介词on，表示“在周六早上”。故选B。

questions.prompt: I waited  ______  the bus stop for ten minutes yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我在公共汽车站等了十分钟。 考查介词。at在……；for为了；on在……上；from从……；根据“the bus stop”可知，此处指的是“在公共汽车站”，小地点前用介词at，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Mr. Li, it’s raining today.  ______  are we going to have PE class? —In the classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：——李老师，今天下雨了。我们在哪里上体育课？——教室里。 考查特殊疑问句。when何时；why为什么；where哪里；how怎样。根据“In the classroom.”可知对地点询问用where。故选C。

questions.prompt: I want to buy a magazine,  ______  I don’t have enough money.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想买一本杂志，但是我没有足够的钱。 考查连词。and和；but但是；or或者；so所以；空格前后两句之间为转折关系，应用but连接，故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  Harry and Lucy from London? — Yes, they are.
questions.explanation: 句意：——哈里和露西来自伦敦吗？——是的，他们是。 考查一般疑问句。根据答语“Yes, they are.”可知，主语是复数，用be动词are，故选A。

questions.prompt: We  ______  our classroom after class every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们每天下课后打扫教室。 考查一般现在时。根据“every day”可知，时态是一般现在时，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mum, can you help me with my homework? —I’m sorry. I can’t help you at the moment. I  ______  dinner.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，你能帮我做一下作业吗？——对不起。现在我不能帮你。我在做晚餐。 考查时态。根据“I can’t help you at the moment.”可知现在不能帮忙，因为现在正在做晚饭，用现在进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Does your sister go to school by bus? —No, she  ______. She goes to school by bike.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你姐姐乘公共汽车上学吗？——不，她不乘（公共汽车）。她骑自行车上学。 考查一般疑问句。问句“Does your sister go to school by bus?”用Does提问，答语也用does或doesn’t回答。故选A。

questions.prompt: Linda is busy now. She  ______  in her bedroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：Linda现在很忙。她正在卧室读书。 考查时态。根据“Linda is busy now. ”可知此处指现在进行的动作，用现在进行时。故选A。 选词填空。用方框中所给词语的适当形式填空。 tired read books, get ready for, cousin, outdoors, farm, housework, love Every summer Jessica goes to the countryside. She stays at her uncle’s  ______ 13 ______  and helps him. She works very hard, and she likes it because she  ______ 14 ______  to spend time with her  ______ 15 ______, Nancy. Every morning she wakes up at six o’clock. First she collects the eggs and feeds the chickens, and then she has breakfast at 6:30. After breakfast, she helps her aunt with the  ______ 16 ______  for an hour. She can’t wait to spend time with Nancy. They always have a great time together. They climb trees, or pick fruits and flowers. They love being  ______ 17 ______. They come back home before dark and  ______ 18 ______  dinner. After dinner, they go out and feed the animals. Before they go to bed, they watch TV for a little bit or  ______ 19 ______. They are always very  ______ 20 ______  at the end of the day and usually fall asleep watching TV or reading. 【答案】13. farm

questions.prompt: Alice’s father works at a hospital.  ______  is a doctor.
questions.explanation: 句意：爱丽丝的父亲在一家医院工作。 他是一名医生。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；his他的；her她的。此空在句中作主语，应用人称代词主格，排除C和D选项。father是男性，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Is it Mary’s camera? —Yes. It’s  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——是玛丽的相机吗？——是的。它是她的。 考查名词性物主代词。her她的，形容词性物主代词；hers她的，名词性物主代词；my我的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词。根据“Yes.”可知，是玛丽的相机，hers相当于her camera。故选B。

questions.prompt: We plan to celebrate my cousin’s birthday  ______  the 10th of August.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们计划在8月10日庆祝我表弟的生日。 考查时间介词辨析。in后接某年某月某季节；for后接一段时间；at后接具体时刻；on后接具体一天。“the 10th of August”是具体的一天，应用介词on，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Alex, can you take these bowls  ______  the kitchen? —I’m coming. Dad.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Alex，你能把这些碗拿到厨房去吗？——我来了。爸爸。 考查介词辨析。on在……上面；in在……里面；to到；at在。take sth to sp“把某物带到某地”，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  did you have for breakfast today? —Some bread and juice.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你今天早餐吃了什么？——一些面包和果汁。 考查特殊疑问句。why为什么；where哪里；what什么；how怎样。根据答语“Some bread and juice.”可知，询问早餐吃了什么，故选C。

questions.prompt: I like my art teacher Mr. Yang very much,  ______  he is very friendly.
questions.explanation: 句意：我非常喜欢我的美术老师杨先生，因为他很友好。 考查连词辨析。because因为；or或者；but但是；so因此。根据“I like my art teacher Mr. Yang very much, … he is very friendly”可知，空格后“他非常友好”是喜欢他的原因，用because引导原因状语从句，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Did you go to school by bus this morning? —Yes, I  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天早上你是坐公共汽车去上学的吗？——是的，我乘汽车。 考查一般疑问句。根据“Did you go to school by bus this morning?”可知，助动词是did，回答也用did；故选D。

questions.prompt: —Lily, what does your brother usually do at weekends? —He  ______  football with his friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Lily，你的哥哥通常在周末做什么？——他和他的朋友们踢足球。 考查一般现在时。根据“what does your brother usually do at weekends”可知应用一般现在时，主语he为第三人称单数，所以谓语动词应用动词的第三人称单数形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: Tony  ______  Palace Museum with his classmates next Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼下周日上午将和他的同学去参观故宫。 考查动词时态。根据“next Sunday morning”可知，此句用一般将来时will do的结构，故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a good film on TV yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天电视上有一部好电影。 考查there be的一般过去时。根据“There”可知，是there be句型，排除选项C、D；再根据“yesterday”可知用一般过去时。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What is your sister doing now? —She  ______  a book in her room.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妹妹现在在干什么？——她正在她的房间里看书。 考查现在进行时。根据“What is your sister doing now?”可知，是现在进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: My grandparents  ______  in Tianjin ten years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的祖父母十年前住在天津。 考查一般过去时。根据“ten years ago”可知用一般过去时。故选D。 二、完形填空 (每题1分, 共8分) It was a sunny morning. Daniel sat down at the table and had his favorite breakfast. “What do you want to do today?” Daniel’s mom asked him. “I’m going to play in the woods (树林) behind the house,” Daniel said.
