Daniel quickly finished his  ______ 13 ______  and ran to get dressed. “Mom, I’ll be back later!” When he opened the door, Daniel felt the  ______ 14 ______  air. He smiled at the sun. Perfect weather to play, he thought. The leaves were just beginning to grow on the trees. Daniel picked up a long stick (木棍) and used it to  ______ 15 ______  a way through the woods. Suddenly, he saw something that wasn’t a rock or a leaf. When he got closer, he found a small bird among the fallen leaves. He looked around and saw its nest in a tree. He carefully climbed up the tree to get a closer look. He didn’t see any birds around. Then, he  ______ 16 ______  to tell his mom about all this. “Mom, I found a bird and it couldn’t move!” he told her as he hurried through the door. She looked for a  ______ 17 ______  and then she said, “Well, let’s go and have a look.” Daniel took his mom back to the bird. His mom looked carefully at it. “Let’s try to  ______ 18 ______  it!” she said. She picked up the bird and put it in the box. Then she said, “We can take it to the animal hospital in town.” They took the bird to the animal hospital. After a few days, with the bird, an animal doctor  ______ 19 ______  Daniel’s house. The animal doctor said, “The bird is ready to go back to its home in the trees.” Daniel was so  ______ 20 ______. He looked at the bird and said, “I’m happy you’re all right. I hope I can see you again. Bye!”

questions.prompt: Mr. Li is our Chinese teacher. We all like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：李先生是我们的语文老师。我们都喜欢他。 考查代词辨析。her她；him他；us我们；根据“Mr. Li”可知，是男性，应用him，故选B。

questions.prompt: There is  ______  orange in the bag. The orange is for you.
questions.explanation: 句意：袋子里有一个橙子。这个橙子是给你的。 考查冠词辨析。a不定冠词，表示泛指，用于以辅音音素开头的单词之前；an不定冠词，表示泛指，用于以元音音素开头的单词之前；the定冠词，表示特指。结合句意，空处表示泛指，且orange以元音音素开头，应用不定冠词an。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you like science? —Because it’s interesting.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你为什么喜欢科学？——因为它有趣。 考查疑问词的用法。What什么；When何时；Why为什么。根据“Because it’s interesting.”可知，空处是对原因进行提问，用疑问词why。故选C。

questions.prompt: Computer is difficult for my grandparents,  ______  it’s really easy for me.
questions.explanation: 句意：电脑对我的祖父母来说很难，但对我来说真的很容易。 考查连词。but但是；and和；so因此。空格前后之间是转折关系，应用but连接，故选A。

questions.prompt: My father’s birthday is  ______  October 2nd.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲的生日是在10月2日。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体时刻前面；in用于年、月、季节等时间前面；on用于具体某一天前面。根据October 2nd “10月2日”可知具体到日，故选C。

questions.prompt: He doesn’t  ______  math Because it’s boring.
questions.explanation: 句意：他不喜欢数学，因为它太无聊了。 考查否定句。空前有助动词“doesn’t”，后接动词原形，故选A。

questions.prompt: This is my sister. And these  ______  my brothers.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我妹妹。这些是我的兄弟。 考查动词辨析。am用于第一人称单数形式；is用于第三人称单数形式；are用于复数和第二人称。these“这些”是复数形式，故系动词应用are。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the shirt? —Only 10 dollars.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个衬衫多少钱？——只要10美元。 考查特殊疑问词。How many多少，提问可数名词复数；How much多少，提问不可数名词或提问价格；How about……怎么样；根据句意理解及后句的Only 10 dollars可知，这里提问的是价格，所以应该用How much，故选B。 五、完形填空（6分） 阅读短文, 根据短文内容, 从所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 I am a twelve-year-old girl. questions.prompt: I often take an English dictionary to school.  ______  is useful.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常带一本英语词典去学校。它是有用的。 考查代词She她；He他；It它；I我。此处代指an English dictionary，用代词it，故选C。

questions.prompt: Liu Wei has no arms,  ______  he can do lots of things.
questions.explanation: 句意：刘伟没有手臂，但他可以做很多事情。 考查连词辨析。but但是；and和；so因此；or或者。根据“Liu Wei has no arms”和“he can do lots of things”可知，“刘伟没有手臂”和“可以做很多事”是转折关系，应用but。故选A。

questions.prompt: Betty is a tidy girl. She keeps everything  ______  her room well.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂是一个整洁的女孩。她把她房间里的所有东西都保持得很好。 考查介词辨析。with“和”；over“在……上面”；in“在……里”；on“在……上”，两者有接触面。根据“her room”可知，此处指房间里，要用in。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What is your favourite subject? —My favourite subject  ______  English.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你最喜欢科目是什么？——我最喜欢的科目是英语。 考查be动词。are“是”，主语为复数；is“是”，主语为单数；have“有”，原形；has“有”，第三人称单数。主语“My favourite subject”是单数，排除A、C项；根据问句的“is”可知，该句结构为主系表，不能用has。故选B。

questions.prompt: My pet dog always  ______  for me at the door every afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的宠物狗总是每天下午在门口等我。 考查时态。根据“always”和“every afternoon”可知，时态为一般现在时；主语“My pet dog”是单数，谓语动词要用第三人称单数。故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  two beautiful parks near my home.

questions.prompt: This is my father.  ______  is a maths teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我的父亲。他是一名数学老师。 考查人称代词。he他；she她；it它。因为前文是“my father”，可知我的父亲应是男性，且在后文句中作主语，要用人称代词主格he。故选A。

questions.prompt: My mother gets up  ______  six o’clock every morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈每天早晨六点起床。 考查介词辨析。in后面接季节/年/月等；at后面接具体的某一时刻；on后面接具体的某一天。根据空后的“six o’clock”是具体的某一时刻，所以用介词at，故选B。

questions.prompt: Those students  ______  from my class. They are my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：那些学生是我班的。他们是我的朋友。 考查be动词。am是，用于主语是I的情况；is是，be动词的单数；are是，be动词的复数，根据主语“Those students”是复数，所以用be动词的复数形式are，故选C。

questions.prompt: There isn’t  ______  milk in the fridge. I want to buy some.
questions.explanation: 句意：冰箱里没有牛奶了。我想买一些。 考查不定代词及冠词。some一些，常用于肯定句中；any一些，常用于否定句与疑问句中；a一个。根据后文“milk”可知牛奶是不可数名词，可排除C。又因为前文“isn't”可判断是否定句，用any表示“一些”。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Do you like monkeys, Lily? —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Lily，你喜欢猴子吗？——是的，我喜欢。 考查一般疑问句。根据含助动词do的一般疑问句，回答也用do，故选A。

questions.prompt: I often do my homework  ______  read books in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常在晚上做作业和看书。 考查连词辨析。but“但是”，表示转折关系；so“因此”，表示因果关系；and“和，而且”，表示并列和递进关系。根据句意可知做作业和读书是并列关系，应用and，故选C。

questions.prompt: Mrs. White likes  ______  friends at Spring Festival.
questions.explanation: 句意：怀特太太喜欢在春节拜访朋友。 考查动名词作宾语。根据前文中“like”可知，这里的用法是like doing sth.表示“喜欢做某事”。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Is that your aunt, Betty? —Yes. She usually  ______  a silk scarf.
questions.explanation: 句意：——贝蒂，那是你的阿姨吗？——是的。她通常戴一条丝巾。 考查动词时态。根据语境及句中“usually”可知本句为一般现在时。又因为主语是“she”是第三人称，所以谓语动词要用动词三单形式wears。故选B。

questions.prompt: Look! The girls  ______  red lanterns now.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！女孩们现在正在做红灯笼。 考查现在进行时。make“制作”，根据“Look”可知，时态是现在进行时，构成：主语+am/is/are+动词现在分词，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Amy,  ______  do you often do on the computer? —I often listen to music on it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Amy，你经常在电脑上做什么？——我经常在电脑上听音乐。 考查特殊疑问句。what什么；where在哪；when什么时候。根据“I often listen to music on it”可知，应该问的是在电脑上做什么，用what，故选A。 二、完形填空 （每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Children’s Day is coming and Mrs. Black is reading a newspaper story to her class. questions.prompt: —Lingling, is this your bag? —Yes, it’s  ______.

questions.prompt: —Where were you born, Meimei? —I was born  ______  Tianjin.
questions.explanation: 句意：——梅梅，你在哪里出生的？——我在天津出生的。 考查介词辨析。on在……上；to到；in在……里；for为了。be born in“出生于某地”，故选C。

questions.prompt: Tony likes rock music  ______  his father doesn’t like it at all.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼喜欢摇滚音乐，但他的父亲一点也不喜欢。 考查连词辨析。because因为；so所以；but但是；or或者。根据“Tony likes rock music...his father doesn’t like it at all.”可知前后是转折关系，用but连接。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me,  ______  is the bank? —It’s over there, near the shop.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，银行在哪里？——它在那边，靠近商店。 考查特殊疑问句。what什么；where哪里；why为什么；who谁。根据“It’s over there, near the shop”可知，空处是询问地点，疑问词用where。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  you play the violin, Daming? —Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——大明，你会拉小提琴吗？——是的，我会。 考查情态动词辨析。can能够；may可以；shall将；need需要。根据答语“ play the violin”和“Yes, I can”可知，此处应用can引导一般疑问句，can在这里表示能力，故选A。

questions.prompt: —This T-shirt looks nice.  ______  is it? —It’s 60 yuan.

questions.prompt: —What are you going to do this weekend? —I  ______  a piano lesson on Saturday afternoon.

questions.prompt: Machines  ______  the heavy and difficult jobs in the future.

questions.prompt: There  ______  a small lake in the garden two years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：两年前，花园里有一个小湖。 考查be动词。根据“two years ago”可知，句子时态为一般过去时，主语为单数“a small lake”，be动词应用was。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  this film last month. It’s very interesting.

questions.prompt: —Where is Mary? —Look! She  ______  the flowers over there.

questions.prompt: We Chinese often  ______  when we meet visitors.

questions.prompt: Tom and I are classmates and  ______  math teacher is Ms. Brown.
questions.explanation: 句意：Tom和我是同学，我们的数学老师是布朗夫人。 考查代词辨析。us我们，宾格；ours我们的，名词性物主代词；our我们的，形容词性物主代词；we我们，人称代词主格。空后有名词，用形容词性物主代词修饰。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Look! There is  ______  English dictionary under the desk. — Oh, it is mine.
questions.explanation: 句意：——看！桌子下面有一本英语词典。——哦，是我的。 考查冠词。句中“dictionary”为单数可数名词，此处表示泛指，“English”以元音音素开头，应用不定冠词an，故选B。

questions.prompt: We usually have an art festival  ______  June every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们通常在每年的六月举办艺术节。 考查介词。in用于泛指的年、月、季节等前；on用于具体的某一天前；at用于具体的钟点前；for后接一段时间；结合“June”可知，月份前要用介词in，故选A。

questions.prompt: Tom likes listening to English songs,  ______  he isn’t good at singing them.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆喜欢听英文歌曲，但他不擅长唱。 考查连词辨析。so因此；or或者；but但是；and和；空格前后两句之间是转折关系，应用but连接，故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  are these trousers? — 70 yuan for one pair.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些裤子多少钱？——一条70元。 考查特殊疑问句。How far多远；How many多少，后接复数名词；How long多长；How much多少，后接不可数名词，或问价格；根据“70 yuan for one pair.”可知，此处问的是价格，故选D。

questions.prompt: — What do you like to drink for breakfast? — Milk  ______  my favorite.
questions.explanation: 句意：——早饭你喜欢喝什么？——牛奶是我的最爱。 考查连系动词。are是，主语是复数，主语是人称代词you, we, they；is是，主语是人称代词的单数，主语是复数形式；be是原形；am是，主语是I，milk是不可数名词，be动词用is，故选B。

questions.prompt: Mary is a sports fan. She always  ______  volleyball with her friends after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽是个体育迷。放学后她总是和朋友们打排球。 考查时态。根据“always”可知，句子应用一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数“She”，动词用三单形式，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Thank you for  ______ me find my lost keys. —You’re welcome.
questions.explanation: 句意：——谢谢你帮我找回丢失的钥匙。——不用谢。 考查非谓语动词。Thank sb. for doing sth.“感谢某人做某事”，for为介词，跟动词时用动名词形式作宾语，故选C。

questions.prompt: My brother is good at painting and  ______  wants to join the art club.
questions.explanation: 句意：我兄弟很擅长画画，他想要加入美术俱乐部。 考查人称代词主格。he他，主格；his他的，形容词性物主代词或名词性物主代词；she她，主格；her她，宾格，她的，形容词性物主代词。wants为谓语动词，其前应用人称代词主格作主语，My brother是兄弟，男性，因此人称代词应用he。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Is there a bank near here? —Yes. It is  ______  Center Street, behind the police office.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这附近有银行吗？——是的。它在中央大街，在警察局后面。 考查介词。over在……上方；to朝；on在……上；from从……；空后是“Center Street”，表示“在……街”应用介词on，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Linda,  ______  you play the piano? We need someone to play for the music festival. —Yes, I can, Ms. Brown. And I’d like to help.
questions.explanation: 句意：——琳达，你会弹钢琴吗？——是的，我会，布朗老师。并且我希望我能帮得上忙。 考查情态动词。can可以，情态动词；are是，be动词；do做，实义动词；does做，动词的第三人称单数。根据答语“Yes, I can.”说明问句应是情态动词can引导的一般疑问句。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What does your mother look like? —She isn’t heavy  ______  thin. She is of medium build and has long curly hair.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妈妈长得怎么样？——她不胖也不瘦。她中等身材，留着长卷发。 考查并列连词辨析。so所以；or或者；but但是；and并且。根据“She is of medium build”可知她中等身材，说明她不胖也不瘦，在否定句中应用连词or来连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: 一 ______  is it from your home to the new bookstore? — About 2 kilometers.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从你家到新书店有多远？——大约2公里。 考查特殊疑问词辨析。How far多远，是对距离的提问；How much多少，对不可数名词数量或价格进行提问；How often多久一次，提问频率；How long多长，是对长度或一段时间的提问。根据“ About 2 kilometers.”可知，上文对距离进行提问，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Where is Peter now? —He  ______  volleyball on the playground.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得现在在哪里？——他正在操场上打排球。 考查现在进行时。根据“Where is Peter now?”可知，此处用现在进行时，回答彼得此时此刻正在做的事情，结构：be doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: —How was your school trip to the science museum last Sunday? —Wonderful. I  ______  how to make a model bridge from the robot teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上星期天你们学校去科学博物馆的旅行怎么样？——太棒了。我从机器人老师那里学会了如何制作桥梁模型。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语“last Sunday”可知，句子为一般过去时，故动词用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: My sister  ______  in the park every morning. She likes the clean air there.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹每天早上在公园锻炼。她喜欢那里的新鲜空气。 考查谓语动词。空处作谓语，结合“every morning”可知，句子应用一般现在时，主语是单数名词，动词用三单形式，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mom I want to cook noodles for Grandma on her 70th birthday. — ______! She must be very happy.
questions.explanation: 句意：—— 妈妈，我想在奶奶70岁生日的时候给她做面条。——听起来不错！她一定会很高兴。 考查情景交际。See you再见；Good luck祝你好运；Have fun玩得开心；Sounds great听起来不错。根据“She must be very happy.”可知，此处推测奶奶会很高兴，说明对方“给奶奶做面条”的主意听起来不错。故选D。 五、选词填空（共5分, 每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，从方块中选择适当的词并用其适当形式填空。每词限用一次。 life, bring, shout, dinner, tired One day, a strong dog was running after a rabbit. The dog wanted to have it for  ______ 10 ______. However, the little rabbit ran so fast that the  ______ 11 ______  dog had to give up the hunt. A sheep saw this and laughed at the dog, saying that the little rabbit was faster than the big beast（猛兽）. Hearing the sheep saying that, the dog  ______ 12 ______  to the sheep angrily, “The rabbit was running for its  ______ 13 ______! BUT I was running only for dinner. questions.prompt: That boy is from America.  ______  name is Tom.
questions.explanation: 句意：那个男孩来自美国。他的名字是汤姆。 考查代词辨析。my我的；his他的；its它的；her她的。根据“That boy is from America”可知是指男孩的名字叫汤姆，应用his。故选B。

questions.prompt: We don’t have a science class  ______  Friday.
questions.explanation: 句意：在周五我们没有科学课。 考查介词辨析。at作时间介词时，用在具体点刻前面；on作时间介词时，用在具体的某一天前面；in作时间介词时，用在年月及季节等前面；to到。根据“Friday”可知是具体的某一天，故选A。

questions.prompt: There ______  many students in the library after school every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：每天放学后图书馆里有许多学生。 考查there be句型。在there be句型中，be动词的形式是就近原则，many students是可数名词复数，可知填are；选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you usually do your homework every day? — At about 7 o’clock in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你每天通常什么时候写作业？——大约在晚上7点。 考查特殊疑问句。when什么时候；where哪儿；why为什么；how怎么样。根据答句“At about 7 o’clock in the evening.”可知问句针对时间进行提问，故选A。

questions.prompt: We often play basketball in our PE class,  ______  I’m really not good at it. A so
questions.explanation: 句意：我们经常在体育课上打篮球，但我真的不擅长。 考查连词辨析。so所以；or或者；but但是；and而且。根据“We often play basketball in our PE class”和“I’m really not good at it.”可知，前后句为转折关系，应用转折连词but。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What does your friend Carl do after school? —He  ______  basketball in a club. He’s a good player.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的朋友卡尔放学后做什么？——他在俱乐部打篮球。他是个好球员。 考查一般现在时。根据“What does your friend Carl do after school?”可知问句是在询问卡尔经常性的动作，时态为一般现在时，故答句时态也应为一般现在时，主语“He”提示谓语动词应为第三人称单数。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Where is Jim? —He’s  ______  the tree, so you can’t see him.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jim在哪儿？——他在树后面，因此你看不到他。 考查方位介词。behind在……后面；in front of在……前面；beside在……旁边；on the left of在……的左边。根据“so you can’t see him”可知他在树后面，所以你看不见他。故选A。

questions.prompt: Our English teacher Mr. Smith is kind and helpful. We like  ______  a lot. A her
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的英语老师史密斯先生很和蔼，乐于助人。我们很喜欢他。 考查代词辨析。her她；you你；it它；him他。根据“Mr. Smith”可知，男性应用代词宾格him，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you swim? — ______  I think it’s too difficult for me.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会游泳吗？——不，我不会。我觉得那对我来说太难了。 考查含有情态动词的一般疑问句。根据问句“Can you swim?”可知是含有情态动词can的一般疑问句，因此其答句中也应含有情态动词can，其肯定回答为：Yes, I can. 否定回答为：No, I can’t. 根据“I think it’s too difficult for me.”可知游泳对我来说太难了，因此可推断我应是不会游泳的，应作否定回答。故选C。

questions.prompt: My cousin Betty is  ______  football fan.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的堂姐贝蒂是一个足球迷。 考查冠词。此处泛指“一个足球迷”，且football首字母发辅音音素，用a。故选D。

questions.prompt: Mike  ______  two sisters and one brother.
questions.explanation: 句意：迈克有两个姐姐和一个哥哥。 考查动词三单。此处在句中作谓语，排除CD；主语是Mike，动词用三单。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  is your mum? — She is forty years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妈妈多大了？——她40岁。 考查特殊疑问词。How often“多久一次”，提问频率；How much“多少钱”，提问价格；How tall“多高”，提问高度；How old“多大”，提问年龄。根据“ She is forty years old.”可知此处问的是年龄。故选D。 第二节: 完形填空。 阅读下面短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。（共 15 分, 每小题 1.5 分） Pen Pals (笔友) We are learning how to write friendly letters at school. questions.prompt: I’m Lily.  ______  am 12 years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：我是Lily。我12岁。 考查代词。I我；You你；He他；She她；根据“I’m Lily.”可知，此处应用第一人称I，故选A。

questions.prompt: Jim is Lily’s brother.  ______  favourite subject is PE.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jim是Lily的兄弟。他最喜欢的科目是体育。 考查代词辨析。My我的；Your你的；His他的；Her她的；根据“Jim is Lily’s brother.”可知，是男性，作定语修饰subject，用形容词性物主代词形式，故选C。

questions.prompt: These  ______  my old balls and I like them.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我的旧球，我喜欢它们。 考查系动词。am是（主语是第一人称）；is是（主语是第三人称单数）；are是（主语是第二人称或复数）；be（be动词原形）。根据主语是these“这些”可知，此处系动词应该用are。故选C。

questions.prompt: The English class is  ______  the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：英语课在早上。 考查介词辨析。at其后一般加时间点；in其后一般加早中晚/季节/月份/年份等；on其后一般加星期/具体的时间；for其后一般加时间段，表示持续多长时间。此处是in the morning短语，意为“在早上”，故选B。

questions.prompt: We  ______  art every Friday. It’s my favourite.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们每周五上美术课。这是我最喜欢的。 考查动词辨析及时态。have有；stand站立。此处表达“上美术课”，用动词have， 根据“every Friday”知应使用一般现在时，故选A。

questions.prompt: My brother likes fishing,  ______  I don’t like it.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥喜欢钓鱼，但我不喜欢。 考查连词辨析。for为了；so所以；but但是；or或者。前后句是转折关系，所以用but。故选C。

questions.prompt: There are some  ______  on the shelves. I like reading them.
questions.explanation: 句意：书架上有一些书。我喜欢读它们。 考查名词辨析。erasers橡皮；books书；pencils铅笔；balls球。根据“I like reading them”可知，此处是说“书”。故选B。

questions.prompt: Kate has  ______  cat and its name is Mimi.
questions.explanation: 句意：凯特有一只猫，它的名字叫咪咪。 考查冠词。此处泛指“一只猫”，用不定冠词，cat是以辅音音素开头，所以用a。故选A。

questions.prompt: We plant some flowers  ______  the garden in spring.
questions.explanation: 句意：春天我们在花园里种植了一些花。 考查介词。on在……上面；to到……；in在……里面；of……的。根据句意和常识可知，花应该种在花园里，故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is that? — She is my aunt.
questions.explanation: 句意：——那是谁？——她是我的姑妈。 考查特殊疑问句。What 什么；Who谁；Where哪里；When何时；根据“She is my aunt.”可知，此处对人提问，故用疑问词who。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Can you play the piano? — Yes, I  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会弹钢琴吗？——是的，我会。 考查一般疑问句。用can提问，用can/can’t回答，根据“Yes”可知，此处是肯定回答。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Can I  ______  your pencil, John? — Sure! I can  ______  it to you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——约翰，我能借用一下你的铅笔吗？——当然！我可以借给你。 考查动词辨析。borrow借入；lend借出；第一空主语是“I”，后面是your pencil，此处指的是“借入”，应用borrow；第二空主语是“I”，结合“I can...it to you.”可知，此处指的是借出，应用lend，故选C。 二、填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写1个恰当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 My Day  ______ 13 ______  Saturday I get up  ______ 14 ______  eight o’clock. questions.prompt: This is my little brother. ______  name is John.

questions.prompt: — When does Mike have PE class? —He has PE class  ______  Wednesday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克什么时候有体育课？——他星期三上午有体育课。 考查时间介词用法。on用于具体的某一天或者具体某一天的上午、下午或晚上。in用在年、月、上下午的前面；at用于具体的时刻前面；根据“Wednesday morning”可知，在具体某一天用on。故选A。

questions.prompt: I like eating  ______  apple every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢每天吃一个苹果。 考查冠词的用法。根据“I like eating... apple every day.”可知，此处泛指一个苹果；“apple”是以元音音素开头的单词，不定冠词用an。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Nancy, can you play tennis with me now? —Sorry. I  ______. I have to practice my piano first.
questions.explanation: 句意：——南希，你现在能和我一起打网球吗？——抱歉。我不能。我得先练钢琴。 考查can引导的一般疑问句。don’t不；can’t不能；can能。上文是情态动词can引导的一般疑问句，肯定回答是Yes, I can，否定回答是No, I can’t。结合“Sorry.”可知，此处是否定回答，应用can’t。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  dog is this? — It’s Tom’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是谁的狗？——它是汤姆的。 考查特殊疑问句。Whose谁的；Who谁；Whom谁（who的宾格）。根据“It’s Tom’s.”可知，问句询问的是狗属于谁的，应用Whose。故选A。

questions.prompt: Mr. White is old  ______  he thinks he is young.
questions.explanation: 句意：怀特先生老了，但是他认为他很年轻。 考查并列连词。and和，表示并列；so因此，表示因果；but但是，表示转折。根据句意可知，前后句之间是转折关系，因此用“but”连接。故选C。

questions.prompt: —My name is Li Hua. I am from China.  ______  are you from? —I am from Australia.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我叫李华。我来自中国。你从哪里来的？——我来自澳大利亚。 考查特殊疑问词。what什么；where在哪里；when什么时候。根据“I am from Australia.”可知是问对方来自哪里，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Tom,  ______  there a big supermarket near your home? —No, there isn’t, but there are some small shops.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你家附近有大超市吗？——没有，但是有一些小商店。 考查there be句型和主谓一致。根据“... there a big supermarket near your home?”和“No, there isn’t”可知，句式结构为there be；主语“a big supermarket”表示单数，故be动词用is。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me.  ______? —It is 4:30.
questions.explanation: 句意：——对不起。几点了？——4:30。 考查特殊疑问句。What’s your name你叫什么名字；Where are you from你来自哪里；What’s the time几点了。答语“It is 4:30.”表时间，故此处询问时间。故选C。 阅读理解（共24分) 三、阅读下列短文，根据短文内容,从短文后各题所给的A、B、C三个选项中，选择最佳选项。(共18分,每小题2分) A School Club Swimming Club Can you swim? questions.prompt: —Kate, can you see my eraser? —Look! There’s one under your desk. Is it ______?
questions.explanation: 句意：——Kate，你看到我的橡皮吗？——看，你的桌子底下有一块，它是你的吗？ 考查代词。your 你的；yours 你的；mine 我的。此处意为“它是你的橡皮吗？”，即Is it your eraser? your eraser = yours，形容词性物主代词+名词=名词性物主代词。故选B。

questions.prompt: I sometimes help my mom with her housework ______  Saturdays.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：在表示时间时，at表示在时间的一点；on 表示在具体某一天； in表示在一个时间范围，或者接一段时间，表示多久之后；to表示差几分到几点。句意：在周六，我有时帮助我的母亲做家务。根据下文Saturdays，可知本句中表示在具体某一天，故用介词on。选C。 考点：考查介词辨析

questions.prompt: — ______  glasses are these? —I think they are our teacher’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是谁的眼镜？——我想它们是我们老师的。 考查特殊疑问句。Who谁；What什么；Whom谁（Who的宾格）；Whose谁的。根据“I think they are our teacher’s.”可知，问句是提问“谁的”眼镜。故选D。

questions.prompt: We don’t play basketball on the playground  ______  it rains outside.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们不在操场上打篮球，因为外面下雨。 考查连词辨析。so所以；because因为；and和；but但是。分析空格前后句可知，此处构成因果关系，空格后表示原因，用“because”。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Lily,  ______  you finish the letter in ten minutes? — Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Lily，你可以在十分钟之后完成这封信吗？——是的，我能。 must必须；should应该；need需要；can能，可以。根据下面的回答Yes, I can可知，一般疑问句也应用can，故选D。

questions.prompt: They  ______  play basketball next weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们打算下周末打篮球。 考查一般将来时。根据“next weekend”可知，时态是一般将来时，可用be going to表示，主语是they，be动词用are。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tony is very kind. He often  ______  me English when he is free.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼很善良。他有空的时候经常教我英语。 考查一般现在时。此处作谓语，根据“when he is free”可知，时态是一般现在时，主语是he，动词用第三人称单数，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Where is Bob? — He  ______  in the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：——鲍勃在哪里?-——他在图书馆读书。根据提问，可知回答的是现在在图书馆正读书，故用现在进行时，故选B。

questions.prompt: What  ______  Tom and his friend going to do tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆和他的朋友明天打算做什么？ 考查一般将来时和主谓一致。根据“going to do tomorrow”可知，该句为一般将来时，其谓语结构是：be going to+动词原形，主语“Tom and his friend”是第三人称复数，be动词用“are”。故选D。

questions.prompt: My mother promises  ______  toys for me, but she forgets it soon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈答应给我买玩具，但她很快就忘了。 考查非谓语动词。promise to do sth.承诺做某事。故用动词不定式作宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: I’m good at singing so I’d like  ______  the Music Club.
questions.explanation: 句意：我擅长唱歌，所以我想去音乐俱乐部。 考查非谓语动词。would like to do sth.想要做某事。故选A。

questions.prompt: My father and I often go  ______  at weekends so I can  ______  very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲和我经常在周末去游泳，所以我能游得很好。 考查非谓语动词和情态动词用法。go swimming去游泳；情态动词“can”后接动词原形，故第二空填“swim”。故选A。 五、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 “Ring…Ring…” the telephone suddenly rings. Sam gets up to  ______ 13 ______  the call. It is his aunt. “Sam, why are you still at home?” she asks surprisingly. Sam looks at the  ______ 14 ______. It is already 7:30 a.m. “Oh, my goodness! There’s an important  ______ 15 ______  today.” Sam shouts out. He hurries to wash his face and get dressed. When he plans to  ______ 16 ______  the house, he remembers that he has not put away his books. He runs quickly to the  ______ 17 ______  and put them into the bag. He then goes to the bus stop to go to school as fast as he can. When he gets into the classroom, his  ______ 18 ______  are busy writing on their papers. “Why are you so  ______ 19 ______?” asks the teacher. “I’m sorry, sir,” Sam answers, afraid of looking up. “It is my clock. It fails to wake me up this morning and…” “Don’t say anything about it!” his teacher  ______ 20 ______  him. “Don’t try to come late next time!” Sam says yes and walks to his seat quickly. But when he tries to do the test paper, he can’t think in a right way. He puts his head on the desk and says, “What a bad day it has been for me!”

—What’s that  ______  English? —It’s a desk.
— ______  is she? —She’s fine.
-What color is it? -- ______  is red.

The girl is ten years old(岁).  ______  name is Cindy.
I’m Nick Black. Nick is name.
My name ______ Tony, and ______ name is Lucy.

I am  ______ 17 ______  America. My parents come to work in China, so I come here, too. I am thirteen  ______ 18 ______  old. Now I am in Class Four, Grade Seven at No.1 Secondary School. I am a(n)  ______ 19 ______  student at school. My English teacher is Miss Lin, she is also new. She is very  ______ 20 ______  to me. I have a brother.  ______ 21 ______  name is John. He is seventeen years old. I have many hobbies(爱好). I like all kinds of  ______ 22 ______, like running, swimming and playing basketball. I don't wear glasses, but my brother  ______ 23 ______. At the weekend, I often  ______ 24 ______  with my classmates. My brother  ______ 25 ______  eating fish. So he is very strong.

questions.prompt: ______  are my parents.  ______  work in an office.
questions.explanation: 句意：这两位是我的父母。他们在一家办公室工作。 考查代词辨析。These这些；They他们；This这个；He他；They他们；It它。第一处在介绍“my parents”是复数，应用指示代词these；第二处指“my parents”是复数，在句中作主语，所以用主格。故选A。

questions.prompt: They go to the cinema  ______  six o’clock  ______  Saturday evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们在周六晚上六点钟去看电影。 考查时间介词。in后接某年某月某季节；on后接具体某一天；at后接具体时刻。“six o’clock”是具体的时刻，所以第一个空填at。“Saturday evening”是具体的一天，所以第二个空填on，故选C。

questions.prompt: They  ______  a history lesson on Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们周二上历史课。 考查动词。do做；has有，第三人称单数形式；have有；have lessons上课，固定短语；句子描述客观事实，时态采用一般现在时；主语为they，第三人称复数 ，所以谓语动词用have。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is the science lab? —It’s behind the office.
questions.explanation: 句意：——科学实验室在哪里？——在办公室后面。 考查特殊疑问句。Where哪里；What什么；When何时。根据答语“It’s behind the office.”可知，此处对地点提问，故选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______  eleven players in a football team.
questions.explanation: 句意：一个足球队有11名队员。 考查there be句型。该句是叙述一件事实，因此用一般现在时；there be…有，由空后“eleven players”可知，be动词应用are。故选B。

questions.prompt: I have got some apples,  ______  I don’t have got any potatoes.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有一些苹果，但是我没有一些土豆。 考查并列连词辨析。and和，表并列；but但是，表转折；so所以，表结果。分析“I have got some apples”和“I don’t have got any potatoes”可知，两者之间构成转折关系，所以用but连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: Lingling is behind Tony, so Tony is  ______  Lingling.
questions.explanation: 句意：玲玲在托尼的后面，所以托尼在玲玲的前面。 考查介词短语。at the front of在……的前面，指内部； in front of在……的前面，指外部；next to紧挨着；根据“Lingling is behind Tony, so Tony is…Lingling.”可知，玲玲在托尼的后面，所以托尼在玲玲的前面；这里指外部的前面。故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s five o’clock in the afternoon. Let’s  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在是下午五点。让我们回家吧。 考查动词短语辨析。go home回家；go to bed上床睡觉；go to school去上学。根据“It’s five o’clock in the afternoon.”可知，下午五点钟应该是回家的时间，故选A。

questions.prompt: Angela  ______  up at six in the morning every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：安吉拉每天早上六点起床。 考查一般现在时。根据“every day”可知，本句时态是一般现在时，主语“Angela”是第三人称单数，所以用动词三单，故选B。

句意：——我13岁了，你呢？——我14岁。 考查情景交际。How are you你好吗；What about you你呢；Where are you from你从哪里来；根据答语“14.”可知，上文是在询问对方的年龄，即“我13岁，你呢？”故选B。 五、短文语法填空 A My favourite club is the football club. I like it best because I'm interested in ______ 11 ______  (A.play B. playing) football and I want to be a famous football player in the future. Besides, I can make new ______ 12 ______ (A. friends B. friend) there and understand the true meaning of teamwork. In the club, we practice twice a week and we all work hard in our training. We often have football matches with other teams. 【答案】11. B 12. A 【解析】 本文介绍了作者最喜欢足球俱乐部的原因。 【11题详解】 句意：我最喜欢它，因为我对踢足球感兴趣，我想在未来成为一名著名的足球运动员。be interested in doing sth对做某事感兴趣，故选B。 【12题详解】 句意：而且，我可以在那里交新朋友，明白团队合作的真正意义。make friends交朋友，故选A。 B Is juice a healthy drink? Many people think it is, but scientists don't. They say it is not good  ______ 13 ______  (A. to drink B. drink) too much juice. Why? That's because it has too ______ 14 ______  (A. much B. many) sugar and little fiber（纤维）. They believe it is better to have some real fruit. 【答案】13. A 14. A 【解析】 本文介绍了科学家认为喝太多果汁不好。 【13题详解】 句意：他们说喝太多果汁是不好的。It is +形容词+to do sth.“做某事是......”，it是形式主语，to do sth.是真正主语，故选A。 【14题详解】 句意：那是因为它有很多糖，很少的纤维。sugar是不可数名词，用too much修饰，故选A。 C Bicycles are still very popular in Beijing. It is easy to go to school and go to work  ______ 15 ______ (A. by B. with) bike. But now  ______ 16 ______  (A. more and more B. fewer and fewer) people buy cars and it makes air dirty and causes air pollution. People can keep healthy by riding bicycles. I prefer riding a bicycle because it is cheap and it can also keep air clean and keep me fit. 【答案】15. A 16. A 【解析】 文章讲述买轿车的人越来越多使空气变脏，引起空气污染，作者建议骑自行车，因为便宜，能让空气保持清洁同时还能让人健康。 【15题详解】 句意：骑自行车去上学或去上班很容易。此处是方式状语，表示“骑自行车”用介词短语by bike。故选A。 【16题详解】 句意：但是现在越来越多的人买轿车，这使得空气变脏引起空气污染。根据“it makes air dirty and causes air pollution”可知买轿车的人越来越多，此处用比较级more and more。故选A。 六、完形填空 阅读短文，根据上下文内容，从所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选择最佳选项，使文章完整。 "Are you listening, Simon?" Simon's teacher asks. Simon smiles and shakes（摇晃）his head. He doesn't often ______ 17 ______  or try hard in class. Talking is so much better. He wants to be heard. That evening, Simon starts to feel a bit sick. By bedtime, his throat（咽喉）feels really bad. He has cakes and hot chocolate to make his throat feel better, but he isn't sure it'll  ______ 18 ______. The next ______ 19 ______, when he opens his mouth to say, "Good morning," nothing comes out. When he gets to school, Mrs. Jacobs says "hello" to him, and he just nods（点头）. When his friends start to ask him what TV shows he watches, he just can't say anything. By the time they start  ______ 20 ______, almost everyone is looking at him as if he's got a third eye. Simon sits in class, bored（无聊的） ______ 21 ______  he can't talk to his classmates. He watches them talk to each other, but he can't even do that. You know what? It isn't that bad. He can really do his homework that night. It gives ______ 22 ______  more TV and game time because  ______ 23 ______ is all finished. The next day, his voice is  ______ 24 ______  back, but he stays quiet(安静的) again. The third day, he can talk ______ 25 ______, but he doesn't talk. He listens and puts up his ______ 26 ______ to speak. What a difference that one day makes!

questions.prompt: Terry and Jim are new students in our class.  ______  favorite subject is maths.
questions.explanation: 句意：特里和吉姆是我们班的新生。他们最喜欢的科目是数学。 考查代词。Them他们，宾格；Their他们的，形容词性物主代词；They他们，主格；Theirs他们的，名词性物主代词；空格在句中修饰的是其后的名词“subject”，指的是“他们的”，所以要用形容词性物主代词，故选B。

questions.prompt: ______ Helen like watching TV?
questions.explanation: 句意：海伦喜欢看电视吗？ 考查助动词。like是实义动词，疑问句用助动词帮忙，排除A和B，主语Helen是第三人称单数，所以用助动词does，排除D，故选C。

questions.prompt: What  ______  nice day! Let's go for a picnic.
questions.explanation: 句意：多么好的天气啊！让我们去野餐吧。 考查冠词辨析。a和an是不定冠词，修饰可数名词单数形式，表示泛指一个……，a用于以辅音音素开头的单词前；an用于以元音音素开头的单词前；the是定冠词，修饰名词表示特指。根据句子结构可知，这句话是一个感叹句，句型是What a+形容词+可数名词单数。故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  are you from, Steve? — I’m from Australia.
questions.explanation: 句意：——斯蒂文，你来自哪里？——我来自澳大利亚。 考查特殊疑问词。who谁；why为什么；what什么；where哪里。由“I’m from Australia.”可知此处是询问地点。故选D。

questions.prompt: Jenny’s dinner time is  ______  6:30.
questions.explanation: 句意：珍妮的晚餐时间是6:30。 考查介词辨析。at后接具体的钟点；in后接年/月/季节或泛指的上/下午/晚上；on后接具体的某一天或具体的某一天的上/下午/晚上；for后接一段时间；空格后的时间是“6:30”，是具体的钟点，所以要用介词at，故选A。

questions.prompt: Look! The cat is  ______  the bottle.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！这个猫在瓶子里。 考查介词词义辨析。under在……下面；in在……里；on在……上面；between在……之间。从图片上看猫在瓶子里。故选B。 三、交际用语。 选择恰当的选项补全对话。 A: Hi, Tina. Happy birthday! B:  ______ 17 ______  A:  ______ 18 ______  B: Go straight and then turn left. A:  ______ 19 ______  B: I’m fifteen years old. A: What time is it? B:  ______ 20 ______  A. How old are you? B. It’s eleven o’clock. C. Hi, Amy. Where is the library? D. Thank you very much. 【答案】17. D 18. C 19. A 20. B 【解析】 对话主要是两个人分别关于致谢、问路、问年龄以及问时间的对话。 【17题详解】 根据“ Happy birthday!”可知，别人祝你生日快乐时，要对别人表示感谢，D项“非常感谢”最符合语境，故选D。 【18题详解】 根据答句“Go straight and then turn left”可知，应该是问路，选项C“你好，艾米，图书馆在哪？”最符合语境，故选C。 【19题详解】 根据答句“I’m fifteen years old”可知，应该问的是年龄，选项A“你多大了”最符合语境，故选A。 【20题详解】 根据问句“What time is it?”可知，应该回答几点了，选项B“11点了”最符合语境，故选B。 四、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Mary is 9 years old and she lives in America. She likes  ______ 21 ______ very much. She thinks they are people’s good friends. Of all the animals, pandas are  ______ 22 ______ favorite. To her, these black and  ______ 23 ______  animals are cute and smart and she likes going to the zoo to see them. Today, Mary gets up early and gets dressed  ______ 24 ______  because she will see the pandas! When she arrives at the zoo, she  ______ 25 ______  to the pandas house. There are two pandas, Joe and Jim, in the zoo. They are like her old friends. She is happy to see them every time. But this time, when she gets close to the pandas house, she sees a lot of people  ______ 26 ______  in front of the house. And it’s kind of noisy(喧闹的). “What happens?” She asks worriedly. “Don’t worry. The pandas are fine,” an old man says. Then Mary looks into the house. Joe and Jim are playing  ______ 27 ______  a ball in the house. But there is a new friend in the house! “Who is this new friend?” She asks. “Oh, it is a panda from China,” says one man in the uniform. “And next year, you may see a baby panda here!” “A baby panda! I can’t  ______ 28 ______! ” Mary says happily.

questions.prompt: — Could you just tell  ______  to call me back? — Sure, no problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能让他给我回个电话吗？——当然，没问题。 考查代词辨析。he他，人称代词主格；she她，人称代词主格；his他的，物主代词；him他，人称代词宾格。此空位于动词tell后，用人称代词him作宾格，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Is this bag  ______, Betty? — No, it’s not mine. It’s Lucy’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Betty，这个包是你的吗？——不，它不是我的。它是Lucy的。 考查代词辨析。yours你的；hers她的；his他的；theirs他们的。根据“No, it’s not mine”可知，此处询问是否是“你的包”，问句用第二人称，故选A。

questions.prompt: There is a bank  ______  the hotel and the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：在旅馆和图书馆之间有一家银行。 考查介词辨析。on在……上；above在……之上；between在……之间；with带有。根据“the hotel and the library”可知，此处用between…and表示“在……和……之间”，故选C。

questions.prompt: After school, I play  ______  piano again, usually for an hour.
questions.explanation: 句意：放学后，我又弹钢琴，通常弹一个小时。 考查冠词辨析。演奏西洋乐器类，乐器前要加定冠词the，故选C。

questions.prompt: We all like Jenny  ______  she is kind and helpful.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们都喜欢Jenny，因为她很善良，乐于助人。 考查连词辨析。and和；because因为；but但是；or否则，或者。“她很善良且乐于助人”是“我们都喜欢她”的原因，用because引导原因状语从句。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  book is this? —It’s Mary’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是谁的书？——它是Mary的。 考查疑问词辨析。What什么；How怎样；Where在哪里；Whose谁的。根据“It’s Mary’s.”可知表示所属关系，问是谁的书，用Whose符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: —  ______  are the potatoes? — They are 7 yuan a kilo.
questions.explanation: 句意：——土豆多少钱？——它们是一公斤7元。 考查特殊疑问句。how long多久；how old多大；how much多少/多钱；how many多少。根据“They are 7 yuan a kilo”可知，此处询问多钱，故选C。

questions.prompt: — When do you usually have history class? —  ______  Friday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你通常什么时候上历史课？——在周五。 考查介词辨析。On后接具体某一天、星期等；To朝，向；At后接具体时刻或节日等；In后接年、月、季节等。根据“Friday”可知此处表示在周五上历史课，用介词On。故选A。

questions.prompt: My grandfather  ______  reading after supper every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爷爷每天晚饭后喜欢看书。 考查时态辨析及主谓一致。根据“every day”可知用一般现在时，主语“My grandfather”后接动词的第三人称单数形式likes。故选D。

questions.prompt: Look! Some of the children  ______  football on the playground.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！一些孩子正在操场上踢足球。 考查动词时态。根据提示语“look”可知此句应该用现在进行时，谓语动词是be+doing，故选B。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A Little Bear A little bear is called Herry. He doesn’t like brushing  ______ 11 ______. Every day his mother says to him, “Herry, it’s time for you to brush your teeth and go to bed.” “I know, Mom.” says Herry unhappily. He goes to the  ______ 12 ______  and turns on the tap(龙头). He keeps water running. His mother thinks he is brushing his teeth. “Too many teeth! How can I brush all these teeth?” Herry feels sad. “Maybe I can do it tomorrow morning. It is too bad to brush teeth every day.” He looks at his  ______ 13 ______ teeth and thinks, “I don’t want to brush my teeth today. I can brush them twice tomorrow. That will be OK.” But the next day, he doesn’t brush his teeth. He always thinks he can do it tomorrow. One morning, when he gets up, he finds all of his teeth have gone  ______ 14 ______. He cries, “My teeth! My teeth! ” His mother comes into his bedroom and says, “What’s  ______ 15 ______?” “I don’t have any teeth now, Mom! I  ______ 16 ______ to brush my teeth every day. ” He cries again and again. His mother takes him to see the  ______ 17 ______. The doctor says, “Oh, little bear! I am sorry to say you can’t eat any food now. There aren’t any teeth in your mouth.” The little bear cries and cries  ______ 18 ______. Suddenly he wakes up, “Oh, thank goodness! It is a dream. A terrible dream.” He gets up at once and goes to brush his teeth. He tells himself to brush his teeth every day.

questions.prompt: I have a big brother.  ______ name is Paul.
questions.explanation: 试题分析： His形容词性和名词性物主代词，他的；her形容词性物主代词，她的。人称代词宾格，她；its形容词性和名词性物主代词它的；your形容词性物主代词，你的，你们的。联系前文，我有一个哥哥。可知后半句指的是我的哥哥的名字。故选A。 考点：考查代词辨析

questions.prompt: This is my mother. I love  ______  so much.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我的妈妈。我非常爱她。 考查代词宾格。he他，主格；him他，宾格；she她，主格；her她，宾格。love是动词，后跟代词宾格；由前面的my mother，可知应用she的宾格形式her；故选D。

questions.prompt: I can’t find  ______  book Can I borrow  ______  book?
questions.explanation: 句意：我找不到我的书了。我可以借你的书吗？ 考查形容词性的物主代词。my我的，形容词性的物主代词；your你的、你们的，形容词性的物主代词；me我，人称代词宾格；you你、你们，人称代词的主格或宾格。根据题干可知，设空处后面都有名词book，因此两个空都应该用形容词性的物主代词，结合选项，只有A选项符合题意，故选A。

questions.prompt: I sometimes help my mom with her housework ______  Saturdays.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：在表示时间时，at表示在时间的一点；on 表示在具体某一天； in表示在一个时间范围，或者接一段时间，表示多久之后；to表示差几分到几点。句意：在周六，我有时帮助我的母亲做家务。根据下文Saturdays，可知本句中表示在具体某一天，故用介词on。选C。 考点：考查介词辨析

questions.prompt: Xinxin is good  ______  math.
questions.explanation: 句意：欣欣擅长数学。 考查介词辨析。in在……里；for为了；at在；with和，根据前面的“Xinxin is good”和后面的“math”以及固定搭配be good at“擅长……”可知，应该是欣欣擅长数学，故选C。

questions.prompt: It’s time  ______  dinner.
questions.explanation: 句意：该吃晚饭了。 考查介词辨析。to到；for为了；at在；about关于。“It’s time for sth”或“It’s time to do sth”均为固定句式，意为“该做某事了”，for后接名词/动名词，to后接动词；dinner“晚餐”是名词，因此用介词for；故选B。

questions.prompt: — What’s this  ______  English? — It’s a dictionary.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个用英语怎么说？——它是一个字典。 考查介词辨析。in在……里，用；at在；for为了；to给。根据答语“It’s a dictionary”可知，此处指用英语怎么说，in English“用英语”。故选A。

questions.prompt: I’d like to go with you,  ______ I’m too busy.
questions.explanation: A. or或者，表示前后是选择关系； B. and和，表示前后是并列关系； C. so因此，表示前后是因果关系； D. but但是，表示前后是转折关系。句意：我想和你一块去，但是我太忙了。根据句意这里表示转折关系，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______ people are there in your family? —Three.
questions.explanation: 句意：--你家里有几口人？—三口。 考查疑问词辨析。How often多久一次；how long多长；how many多少个；how much多少。根据下文：三个。可知上文对数量提问，how many后面一般接可数名词复数，how much接不可数名词，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______ do you spell it? — P—E—N.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你怎么拼读它？——P—E—N。 考查疑问代词词义辨析。What什么；When何时，问时间；Why为什么，问原因；How怎样，问方式。根据答句“P—E—N”可知，是询问你怎么拼读它，所以空格处的疑问词是怎样的意思。故选D。

questions.prompt: —  ______  does your father do? — He is a bus driver.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的爸爸是做什么的？——他的职业是公共汽车司机。 考查特殊疑问句。What什么；Where在哪；Who谁；Why为什么，根据答句“He is a bus driver”可知，应该是问职业，What do/does sb do？是问职业的句型，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Can you swim? — No, I  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会游泳吗？——不，我不会。 考查一般疑问句的否定回答。can’t不能、不会；shouldn’t不应该；wouldn’t不会；needn’t不需要。根据上文“Can you swim?”可知本句是由情态动词can引导的一般疑问句，否定回答为No，主语+ can’t。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Sally, can you  ______  Chinese? — Yes. A little
questions.explanation: 句意：——Sally，你会说中文么？——会，一点点。 考查动词词义辨析。say说，后跟说话内容；speak说话，后跟说话方式或语言；tell告诉；talk交谈。根据Chinese“中文”可知，指你会说中文么，空格后跟语言，故空格处用speak。故选B。

questions.prompt: — What do you often do at weekends? — I often  ______  my grandparents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——在周末你经常做什么？——我经常拜访我的祖父母。 考查动词时态。根据“often”，可知，句子用一般现在时，主语I是第一人称，动词用原形，故选A。

questions.prompt: My parents always ask me  ______  hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父母总是要求我努力学习。 考查非谓语动词。study学习，动词原形；studying动名词或动词现在分词；studies动词的第三人称单数形式；to study动词不定式。ask sb to do sth.是固定搭配，意为“要求某人做某事”，故选D。

questions.prompt: Look there!  ______  are my close friends in the club.
questions.explanation: 句意：看那边！那些是我在俱乐部的密友。 考查代词。This这个，指近距离；These这些，指近距离；That那个，指远距离；Those那些，指远距离，根据后面的“are”可知，应该用复数形式，排除A和C，由“Look there”可知，应该是表远距离的。故选D。

questions.prompt: Come here. Look at  ______ ball!
questions.explanation: 句意：到这来，看看这个球。 考查代词词义辨析。this这；these这些；that那；those那些。根据ball是单数形式，可知空格处的指示代词是单数，故排除BD；再根据“Come here”可知，是指近地方的这个球。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Where’s the library? — Go straight and  ______  right.
questions.explanation: 句意：——图书馆在哪里？——直走然后右转。 考查动词辨析。take拿走；go去；turn转向；get得到。根据“Go straight and … right”，可知，直走然后转向右边，故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  some apple juice and two bottles of milk on the table.
questions.explanation: 句意：桌子上有一些苹果汁和两瓶牛奶。 考查There be句型。根据前面的“There”可知，应该是There be句型，表示“有”，排除C和D，there be句型遵循“就近原则”，be动词的单复数取决于后面最近的名词，由“some apple juice”是不可数名词，所以用is，排除B，故选A。

questions.prompt: — What about buying him some books? I know he likes reading very much. — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——给他买些书怎么样？我知道他非常喜欢阅读。——好主意。 考查情景交际。You are welcome不用谢；Good idea好主意；That’s all right没关系；Not at all一点也不。根据“What about buying him some books? ”可知，对于给他买些书的建议，如果表示赞同，回答Good idea“好主意”。故选B。 二、完形填空 A Dear Dr. Know， I’m not  ______ 21 ______. I have too many rules (规矩) in my family. I have to  ______ 22 ______  at 6:00 every morning. I can’t be late  ______ 23 ______  school. I can’t meet my friends after school  ______ 24 ______  I have to take my dog for a walk. I have to get home  ______ 25 ______  5:00 pm. I can’t watch TV on school nights. And I have to  ______ 26 ______  in bed by ten o’clock. On weekends, I have to clean my room and wash my clothes. Then I have to  ______ 27 ______  English books. Later in the afternoon I have to go to the Children’s Palace  ______ 28 ______  how to play the piano. In the  ______ 29 ______, I have to play the piano for one hour. After that I can go to bed, I don’t have any  ______ 30 ______. What can I do? Yours, Cindy

questions.prompt: My brother and I like English and  ______  often learn it together.
Chinese kids have Children’s Day  ______  June 1st every year.
The gifts in the shop are  ______, so we don’t buy any.
There is some  ______  in the noodles.
Listen! Tony and Kate  ______  in the next room.
— Hi, Tom. How was your trip to the farm? — Oh, great. We  ______  a good time there.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，汤姆。你的农场之旅怎么样？——哦，太棒了。我们在那里玩得很开心。 考查一般过去时。根据问句“How was your trip to the farm?”可知，问的是过去发生的旅行，答句时态应是一般过去时，表示在过去某一具体时间发生的事，动词要用过去式had。故选C。 五.语法填空（共6分, 每小题6分） 阅读短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写1个适当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空。 Smiles are beautiful. A smile usually  ______ 7 ______  (give) people love and help. On my first day of class, the teacher asked us to tell something about our names and hobbies one by one. When it was my turn, I stood up. I wanted to say something about myself,  ______ 8 ______  I couldn’t say a word. I was afraid to speak in front of all the  ______ 9 ______  (classmate). Just then, a boy smiled at me and said, “Yes, you can. Take it easy.”  ______ 10 ______  (he) smile was so warm and it made me feel better. Finally, I  ______ 11 ______  (do) a good job and finished my words. Later, the boy and I became good friends. Now I always smile to others and everyone says I’m a happy and  ______ 12 ______  (friend) girl. I keep smiling because I know something small can make a big difference. 【7~12题答案】 【答案】7. gives

questions.prompt: I have a big brother.  ______ name is Paul.
questions.explanation: 试题分析： His形容词性和名词性物主代词，他的；her形容词性物主代词，她的。人称代词宾格，她；its形容词性和名词性物主代词它的；your形容词性物主代词，你的，你们的。联系前文，我有一个哥哥。可知后半句指的是我的哥哥的名字。故选A。 考点：考查代词辨析

questions.prompt: My mum is a nurse.  ______  works very hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈是一名护士。她工作很努力。 考查代词辨析。he他，人称代词主格；her她的，物主代词；she她，人称代词主格；his他的，物主代词。空处缺少主语，所以用人称代词主格，My mum是女性。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What's this? —It is  ______  apple.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是什么？——它是苹果。 考查冠词。a/an一个，不定冠词，表示泛指；the定冠词，表示特指；/零冠词；空格修饰其后的名词apple，表示“一个”，“apple”是元音音素开头的单词，所以应用不定冠词an，故选B。

questions.prompt: Daniel likes swimming,  ______ he doesn’t like running.
questions.explanation: 句意：丹尼尔喜欢游泳，但是他不喜欢跑步。 考查连词辨析。or或者；and和；also而且；but但是。空前说的是喜欢做的事情，空后说的是不喜欢做某事，前后句意是转折关系，用but连接。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the library? — Go straight and turn right.
questions.explanation: 句意：——图书馆在哪？——直走然后右转。 考查特殊疑问句。What什么；How怎样；Where在哪里；Whose谁的，根据答句的“Go straight and turn right”可知，应该问图书馆在哪，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  people are there in your family? —There are three people.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你家里有几口人？——有三口人。 考查特殊疑问词。how long多长，对物体长度或一段时间提问；how old多大，对年龄提问；how much多少，对价格或不可数名词提问； how many多少，对可数名词复数提问。此题people是集体名词，所以用 how many提问。故选D。

questions.prompt: That’s our dinner. We have it at 7:00 ______  the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我们的晚餐。我们晚上7点吃。 考查时间介词。at后跟钟点时刻；in后跟年、月、季节等大时间，或泛指在早上、中午、晚上；of……的；on后跟具体的某一天的时间。in the evening“在晚上”，表示泛指 。故选B。

questions.prompt: My grandpa  ______  a big pet dog.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爷爷有一只大宠物狗。 考查一般现在时。此句表示是现在情况，可知此句时态为一般现在时，主语My grandpa是第三人称单数，可知谓语动词使用三单形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a lot of students in the library after school every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：每天放学后图书馆里有很多学生。 考查there be句型。由“every day”可知此句时态为一般现在时，所以此句是there be句型的一般现在时（there is/are...)，be动词的形式是就近原则，根据“a lot of students”是可数名词复数，可知填are；故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  Jimmy play the guitar? — Yes, he can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——吉米会弹吉他吗？——是的，他会。 考查一般疑问句和情态动词。can会；must必须；need需要；may可能。根据答句“Yes, he can.”可知，应是情态动词can开头的一般疑问句。故选A。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A Baby Brother Little Mary lives in a big house with her parents. She is the only child in the family. She really wants to have a baby  ______ 11 ______. One day, when she comes home from school, Mom and Dad are waiting for her. “We have some good news,” they say. “You will have a baby brother soon.” Mary is very very  ______ 12 ______. “Is this true? When will he be here?” she asks. “I can’t wait for him.” Her father says, “We will get him in two weeks.” “Two weeks?” asks Mary. “Doesn’t it take longer than that for a baby?” Mom smiles at Mary. “We are going to adopt (收养) a baby boy,” she  ______ 13 ______. “That means that we are going to choose (选择) a baby who has no  ______ 14 ______. We will be his new family. We will take care of him.” Mary is so excited. She will be a big sister in just two weeks!

questions.prompt: Our English teacher often tells  ______  to speak English in class.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的英语老师经常告诉我们在课堂上说英语。 考查代词辨析。us我们，宾格；we我们，主格；our我们的，形容词性物主代词；ours我们的，名词性物主代词。根据题干可知，本题考查固定搭配：tell sb. to do sth.意为“告诉某人去做某事”，sb.作tell的宾语，因此用宾格形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: I’m hungry. I’d like some bread and  ______  egg.
questions.explanation: 句意：我饿了。我要一些面包和一个鸡蛋。 考查冠词辨析。此处表示“一个鸡蛋”，表泛指，且egg是以元音音素开头的单词，用不定冠词an修饰，故选B。

questions.prompt: We go to Xiadu Park  ______  Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们在周日早上去夏都公园。 考查时间介词辨析。for后接一段时间；to到；on后接具体某一天；at后接具体时刻。根据“Sunday morning”可知，这是具体的时间，用时间介词on修饰，故选C。

questions.prompt: I’d like to go boating with you,  ______  I’m too busy today.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想和你去划船，但是我今天太忙了。 考查连词辨析。or或者；and和、而且；so所以；but但是。根据“I’d like to go boating with you,”以及“I’m too busy today.”可知前后句之间表达的是转折关系，因此应用but连接，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  does Jerry visit his grandparents? — About once a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰瑞多久去看一次祖父母？——大约一个月一次。 考查特殊疑问词。How long多长时间；How many多少，提问可数名词的数量；How often多久一次；How much多少，提问不可数名词的数量；根据回答“About once a month.”可知，此处是对频率的提问，应用how often，故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  you sing the English song? — Yes, I can. But only a little.
questions.explanation: 句意：—你能唱这首英文歌吗？—是的，我能，但是只会一点点。 考查情态动词。Can能；May可以，可能；Must必须，一定；Need需要。根据“Yes, I can. ”可知上文问的是，你能唱这首英语歌曲吗？问句是can引导的特殊疑问句。故选A。

questions.prompt: Jim  ______  books after dinner every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆每天晚饭后读书。 考查动词时态。根据“every day”可知，句子是一般现在时，主语Jim是第三人称，动词用三单形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Where is your father now, Mike? — He  ______  in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你爸爸现在在哪里，迈克?——他正在厨房做饭。 考查现在进行时态。根据上文“Where is your father now, Mike?”结合选项，可推测是爸爸现在正在厨房做饭，因此时态用现在进行时，其结构为be+动词的现在分词，故选D。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a class meeting in our school tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：明天我们学校有班会。 考查时态。根据句中的时间“tomorrow”可知，句子应用一般将来时，结构是“will+动词原形”，故选D。

questions.prompt: I live in Beijing now, but I  ______  in Hunan five years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：我现在住在北京，但是五年前我住在湖南。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语“five years ago”，可知设空处描述的是过去发生的事情，时态用一般过去时，因此动词用过去式，故选B。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 My Dream I had a dream yesterday. My  ______ 11 ______  and I were enjoying ourselves in the playground. Some of us were playing basketball and running, and others were just talking. We were  ______ 12 ______  without any pressure (压力) of schoolwork.  ______ 13 ______, my alarm (闹钟) woke me up, and it was time to get up. A new day started. For a boy in the middle school,  ______ 14 ______  takes up most of my time. My real dream is a simple one. I wish I could have some time for myself every day. I want to have a short break and dream about what I’d like to be when I  ______ 15 ______  up. It’s just like seeing an  ______ 16 ______  after a long tiring journey (旅行) at sea. I don’t want to become a foolish boy, studying all the time without any time to play. Luckily (幸运地), our teachers and parents start to  ______ 17 ______  us now. After working hard for a long time, our teachers will let us go outside and breathe the fresh air. My parents will sometimes take me out for a meal or to enjoy the beautiful nature. It’s so wonderful. I’m like a  ______ 18 ______  flying to the nest. Then I start to find my own study pace, and I am becoming one of the top students in my class. I want to say, enjoying your free time will make you study better.

questions.prompt: Mr. Black is a math teacher in our school. We all like  ______  class.
— What do you often do  ______  the park? — We often fly kites with my friends.
Sam is ill,  ______  he is not at school today.
— What will you do this weekend? — We  ______  the Science Museum.
—Emma can you sing an English song? —Yes, I  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——艾玛，你能唱一首英文歌吗？——是的，我能。 考查情态动词。can能，会；must必须；need需要；may可能；问句中用的是can提问，其答语也用can来回答，故选A。

questions.prompt: It is 8 o’clock in the morning. The Blacks  ______  breakfast at home now.
My father  ______  in a small village ten years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲十年前住在一个小村庄里。 考查时态。根据时间状语“ten years ago”可知，句子时态为一般过去时态，动词使用过去式，live的过去式是lived，故选B。 二.完形填空（共8分, 每小题8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 I used to hate (曾经厌恶) running because I was always the last student to cross the finishing line. Then, in 2019, my friend asked me to run a 10 km﹣running event with him. “No. I hate  ______ 9 ______.” I immediately said. Over the weekend I thought about his question. I thought, “Why do I hate running? I haven’t  ______ 10 ______  it since I was in Grade 7.” Finally, I decided (决定) to have a try, so I told my friend I’d like to. He was pleased and advised (建议) me to look for a running program on the Internet to help me  ______ 11 ______  how to run. There were lots of running programs on the Internet. I chose a 14﹣week running program that would teach me how to  ______ 12 ______  running for 30 minutes. I found it very easy to follow. I enjoyed following the program as I could see the improvement in my running each week. I went from not being able to run for more than 30 seconds to running for over 30 minutes. I went from hating running to  ______ 13 ______  running. On the day of the 10 km﹣running event I was both excited and nervous.  ______ 14 ______, it was time to put my new skills into practice. My friends and family came to support (支持) me. It was lovely to have them there. With their support and my training, I managed (设法) to finish the 10 km running in 72 minutes. It was hard but I felt very  ______ 15 ______  for having tried it. From this  ______ 16 ______  I learnt it was a good idea to try something before saying I hated it.

questions.prompt: —Where were you born, Lingling? —I was born  ______  a small city.

questions.prompt: I like pop music  ______  my mother doesn’t like it at all.

questions.prompt: —The strawberries look fresh.  ______  are they? —30 yuan a kilo

questions.prompt: —What are you going to do this weekend, Tony? —I  ______  a kite in the park with my friends.

questions.prompt: My sister is 6, and she often  ______  to the stories before sleep.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹6岁，她经常在睡前听故事。 考查时态。根据“My sister is 6”以及“often”可知，句子应用一般现在时，主语she，动词用三单形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a small lake near the village ten years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：十年前，村子附近有一个小湖。 考查be动词。根据“ten years ago”可知，句子时态为一般过去时，主语为单数“a small lake”，be动词应用was。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What did you do last Saturday? —I  ______  Zhang Yimou’s new film Cliff Walker with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上周六你做了什么？——我和父母一起看了张艺谋的新片《悬崖之上》。 考查一般过去时。根据问句中的“last Saturday”可知，答句的时态为一般过去时，表示过去某个时间发生的事，动词应用过去式形式，see的过去式为saw。故选B。

questions.prompt: Look! The children  ______  flowers in the garden.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！孩子们正在花园里浇花。 考查现在进行时。根据“Look!”可知，浇花的动作正在进行，应用现在进行时，结构为“be doing”，主语为复数“the children”，be动词用are。故选D。

questions.prompt: We  ______  red songs to celebrate the 100th birthday of our party in May, 2021.

questions.prompt: My uncle and I  ______  the Great Wall next week. I’m looking forward to that.

questions.prompt: The little girl is my sister.  ______  name is Linda.

questions.prompt: My grandparents don’t know how to use the computer,  ______  I often help them.

questions.prompt: —Have you got  ______  photos about animals? —Sure!
questions.explanation: 句意：——你有关于动物的照片吗？——当然！ 考查不定代词辨析。some一些，用于肯定句；any任何，用于疑问句或否定句；much许多，修饰不可数名词。photos是可数名词的复数形式，排除C选项，此句是一般疑问句，故选B。

questions.prompt: There  ______  many new books in the library. I want to get some to read.

questions.prompt: —Hi, Bob, football time! Where is your brother? —He  ______  a football match

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go on the Internet? —Once a week.

questions.prompt: My uncle and aunt often  ______  skiing in Chongli, Zhangjiakou.

questions.prompt: — Liu Yin,  ______  there a big park near your home? —No, there isn’t.

questions.explanation: 句意：——蒂姆什么时候上体育课？——他星期三上午上体育课。 考查一般现在时。has有（动词的三单形式）；have有（动词原形）；having有（动名词/动词的现在分词）。根据“When does Tim have PE class?”可知，空格所在句为一般现在时，主语“He”是第三人称单数，谓语用动词的三单形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: —How many  ______  are there under the desk? —Three.
questions.explanation: 句意：——桌子下面有多少盒子？——三个。 考查名词复数。box箱子，盒子，是一个名词。句中How many提问数量，修饰可数名词复数，box的复数形式应该在词尾加es。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Mike,  ______  ball is this? —It’s Ben's ball. The shoes are his, too.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Mike，这是谁的球？——是Ben的球。这双鞋也是他的。 考查疑问词辨析。who谁；whose谁的；which哪一个。根据回答“It’s Ben’s ball”可知，这里问“球是谁的”，故选B。

questions.prompt: My friend Rachel likes  ______  very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的朋友Rachel非常喜欢画画。 考查非谓语动词。draw画画，是一个动词。该句中谓语动词是“likes”，意为“喜欢”，常用于句型like doing sth.“喜欢做某事”。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is Jenny’s kite? —It is behind the door.
questions.explanation: 句意：——珍妮的风筝在哪里？——它在门后面。 考查特殊疑问句。How怎么样；When何时；Where哪里。根据“It is behind the door.”可知，问句提问风筝在“哪里”。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Hey, Steve! Here are your science books. —Oh.  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嘿，Steve！这是你的科学书。——哦，非常感谢。 考查情景交际。Thank you very much.非常感谢；You’re right.你说的对；Very good.很好。根据语境可知，第一个说话人把Steve的科学书给了他，Steve应向对方表示感谢。故选A。 阅读理解（共34分） 二、阅读下列短文，根据短文内容，从短文后各题所给的A、B、C三个选项中, 选择最佳选项。（共12分，每小题2分） A School Holiday Clubs The Music Club Time: February 1-7 Age: 11-13 Kids can learn music here. They can learn how to play the piano, violin and sing Chinese traditional（传统的）songs. Their teacher is Li Bing. His English name is Jeffrey. Are you coming? The Blue Sports Club Time: February 12-18 Age: 8-11 You can learn basketball, football and badminton here. The basketball teacher is Alan Green. He's from America. The football teacher is Paul Miller. He's from England. The badminton teacher is Ma Yingwen. She is Chinese. Welcome to our club. The Art Club Time: February 19-25 Age: 13-15 You can learn how to draw or paint pictures here. We can use different things: pencils, watercolors, oil paints. The art teacher is John Smith. He is from France. Come and join us.

questions.prompt: — Hello, Wei Hua! Nice to meet you. — Hello, Wang Hao!  ______
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，魏华！很高兴见到你。——-你好，王皓！很高兴见到你。 考查交际用语。Fine, thank you.很好，谢谢；How are you? 你好吗；I’m fine, too.我也很好； Nice to meet you, too.也很高兴见到你；根据上文“ Nice to meet you. ”——推断答语是“也很高兴见到你”；故选D。
句意： 通过944-5632给托尼打电话。 考查介词辨析。in在……里面；with和……一起，表伴随；of……的，表所属；at在……具体的某个地点；从文字的的表层意思推断空格指“通过944-5632这个电话号码”；“call sb at +电话号码”意为“通过……号码给……打电话”；故选D。

questions.prompt: — What’s this  ______  English? — It’s  ______  orange.
questions.explanation: 句意：——用英语说这个是什么？——它是桔子。 考查介词辨析、不定冠词。“in +语言”意为“用某种语言”；to到、去……，表动词的方向；不定冠词a/an用于单数可数名词前表泛指，a用于以辅音音素开头的名词前，an用于以元音音素开头的名词前；定冠词the表特指；从文字的的表层意思推断空格1指“用英语”；所以，空格1填in；空格2指“桔子”——表泛指，指事物的名称，所以用不定冠词，orange以元音音素开头，不定冠词用an ；故选C。

questions.prompt: — Is it  ______  notebook? — Yes. It’s my notebook.
questions.explanation: 句意：——是你的笔记本吗？——是的。它是我的笔记本。 考查物主代词辨析。your你的；her她的；his他的；my我的；根据答语“Yes. It’s my notebook.”——做肯定回答，下文加以说明是“我的笔记”，推断上文是问“是你的笔记吗”，根据空格后的名词，空格使用形容词性物主代词；故选A。

questions.prompt: — How do you  ______  your name? — J-I-M, Jim.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的名字怎么拼？——J-I-M，Jim。 考查动词辨析。look看；spell拼写；be是；say说；根据答语“J-I-M, Jim”—— 拼写名字，推断上文是问“怎么拼写”；故选B。

questions.prompt: — Mom,  ______  my good friends, Susan and Sam. — Nice to meet you!
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，这是我的好朋友，苏珊和山姆。——很高兴见到你！ 考查交际用语。these are这些是；there are有……；that is那是； this is这是；从文字的表层意思推断，句子的表达是“介绍朋友给妈妈”，介绍他人单数用“This is…”，复数用“These are…”；“my good friends”是复数形式，判断“These are…”；故选A。

questions.prompt: — Is Mr Hu your English teacher? —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——胡先生是你的英语老师吗？——是的，他是。 考查一般疑问句。Yes, he is是的，他是；He’s a Chinese teacher他是汉语老师；No, she isn’t不，她不是；Yes, she is是的，她是；上文是一般疑问句，用Yes或No回答，所以，排除选项B；Mr Hu是男性，下文再次提到时用人称动词he指代，所以，排除选项C、D；故选A。

questions.prompt: Mary doesn’t play soccer. She only watches them  ______  TV.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽不喜欢踢足球，但是却喜欢在电视上看足球。介词辨析。在电视上”在……上；in“在……里面”；to“到”；at“在”；on TV是固定搭配，在电视上，通过电视.；故选A。

questions.prompt: Peter  ______  a baseball, but he doesn’t  ______  a baseball bat.
—  ______  you have a soccer ball? —Yes, I  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你有足球吗？——是的，我有。 考查助动词。am和are是一般现在时be动词的形式；do是一般现在时含有行为动词的句子的助动词；根据文中“have a soccer ball”——是动宾结构，判断助动词用do；一般疑问句的助动词和答语的助动词要一致；故选B。

questions.prompt: I don’t like playing  ______  violin at home. Let’s play  ______  basketball at school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不喜欢在家拉小提琴。我们在学校打篮球吧。 考查定冠词。从文字的表层意思推断空格1指“拉小提琴”，表示乐器的前面要有定冠词the；空格2指“打篮球”，表示球类的前面不加任何冠词；故选B。

questions.prompt: Welcome to  ______ sports centre.
questions.explanation: 句意：欢迎来到我们的体育中心。 考查物主代词。you你，人称代词、主格或宾格； our我们的，形容词性物主代词；we我们，人称代词、主格； they人称代词、主格；空格在名词前，判断填形容词性物主代词；故选B。

questions.prompt: Linda  ______  baseball. She plays tennis.
questions.explanation: 句意：琳达不打棒球。她打网球。 考查否定句。句子是一般现在时，主语Linda是单数第三人称，助动词用does，所以排除A；其否定式doesn’t 之后动词的单三形式要恢复原形，所以，排除C；选项D是错误表达；故选B。

questions.prompt: — Let’s play computer games. —That  ______  fun.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们玩电脑游戏吧。——听起来很有趣。 考查主谓一致、一般现在时。从文字的表层意思推断空格意为“听起来很有趣”，是系表结构“系动词+形容词”；主语that指代上文提到的事情，是单数第三人称，所以谓语动词要用单三形式，动词词尾+s，所以，排除选项B；选项A、D是错误表达；故选C。

questions.prompt: This schoolbag  ______  to Linda.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个书包是琳达的。 考查一般现在时、主谓一致。 belongs一般现在时、单三形式；belong原形； belonging动名词；belonged一般过去式；句子是陈述事实，所以用一般现在时；主语“This schoolbag”是单数形式，所以谓语动词要用单三形式，动词词尾+s，故选A。 完型填空 I have a good friend.  ______ 16 ______  name is Mary. She  ______ 17 ______  from America. She is  ______ 18 ______ China with her father and mother. She can  ______ 19 ______  a little Chinese. She is in the No. 15 Middle School in Beijing. Her father and mother  ______ 20 ______. They are in the No. 50 Middle School. Mary is a good student. She  ______ 21 ______  school five days a week. She  ______ 22 ______  up early. She  ______ 23 ______  to be late. She often goes to school very early. But today she got up late. So she got to the classroom at seven thirty.  ______ 24 ______ there weren’t any students in the classroom. She wasn’t late. She was still early. It was Saturday today. The students were all  ______ 25 ______.

questions.prompt: —Kate, can you see my eraser? —Look! There’s one under your desk. Is it ______?
questions.explanation: 句意：——Kate，你看到我的橡皮吗？——看，你的桌子底下有一块，它是你的吗？ 考查代词。your 你的；yours 你的；mine 我的。此处意为“它是你的橡皮吗？”，即Is it your eraser? your eraser = yours，形容词性物主代词+名词=名词性物主代词。故选B。

questions.prompt: I sometimes help my mom with her housework ______  Saturdays.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：在表示时间时，at表示在时间的一点；on 表示在具体某一天； in表示在一个时间范围，或者接一段时间，表示多久之后；to表示差几分到几点。句意：在周六，我有时帮助我的母亲做家务。根据下文Saturdays，可知本句中表示在具体某一天，故用介词on。选C。 考点：考查介词辨析

questions.prompt: There’s ______ in the meeting room. Shall we have a talk there?
questions.explanation: 句意：大家都在会议室里，我们在那儿会谈吗？ 考查复合不定代词辨析。somebody 某人；everybody 每个人；nobody 无人。根据后面提建议“Shall we have a talk there?”可知应是“大家”都在，才定在会议室的。故选B。

questions.prompt: I enjoy ______ very much so I want ______ a dancer in the future.
questions.explanation: 句意：因为我非常喜欢跳舞，所以我想要在未来成为一名舞者。 考查非谓语。dance 跳舞（原形）；to be 成为（动词不定式）；to dance 跳舞（动词不定式）；be 成为（原形）；dancing 跳舞（动名词或现在分词）。enjoy doing sth. “喜欢做某事”；此处动名词作宾语。want to do sth. “想要做某事”，此处不定式做宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: She’d like to join the music club because she ______ play the piano well.
questions.explanation: 句意：她想要加入音乐俱乐部，因为她钢琴弹的特别好。 考查情态动词。can 可以，能；may 或许；must 必须。根据句意，她想要加入音乐俱乐部的原因是她“可以”把钢琴弹得很好，表示能力。故选A。

questions.prompt: He missed（错过）his first class ______ he got up late.
questions.explanation: 句意：他错过了第一节课，因为他起床晚了。 考查连词。or 否则；或者；so 所以；because 因为。根据句意可知两句为因果关系，故选C。

questions.prompt: I ______ a film with my friends next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：下周我打算和我的朋友去看电影。 考查时态。see 原形（一般现在时态）；sees 第三人称单数形式（一般现在时态）；am going to see 打算看（一般将来时态）。根据next Sunday可知事情发生在未来，应该用一般将来时态，其结构be going to do sth. / will do 故选C。 【点睛】一般将来时的标志词： tomorrow next ~ (next Sunday; next month…) in the future in + 段时间 (in two days 意为“两天后”，还未发生) 用how soon进行提问

questions.prompt: Every year ______ people come to see the wonderful view on top of the mountain.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年数以千计的人来到山顶看美景。 考查数词。two thousands 两千（表述错误）；thousand of 数以千计的（表述错误）；thousands of 数以千计的。表达具体数字时，即“基数词+hundred/thousand/million/billion”，原形即可。表达概数词时，即“hundreds/thousands/millions/billions of”分别译为数以百/千/百万/十亿计的。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Can you ride a horse? — No, I ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会骑马吗？——不，我不会。 考查一般疑问句的答语。needn't 不必要；can't 不能；mustn't 不准，禁止。根据Can you do... 可知否定答语为No, I can't. 故选B。 【点睛】“can”的用法： can是情态动词，表示能力，其陈述句，否定句，一般疑问句以及答语的形式如下： 主语 + can do sth. 否定句：主语 + can’t do sth. 一般疑问句：Can + 主语 + do sth.? 答语：Yes, 主语 + can. / No, 主语 + can’t.

questions.prompt: — Rick, Let’s go to the ______ this weekend. A wonderful art show is on. — Good idea.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Rick，我们这周去电影院吧。一部特别精彩的艺术片要上映。——好主意。 考查名词辨析。museum 博物馆；church 教堂；theatre 电影院。根据后面的“A wonderful art show is on.”可知上映的艺术片要在电影院看。故选C。

questions.prompt: Where is Tom? His mother ______ him now.
questions.explanation: 句意：Tom在哪里？他妈妈现在正找他呢。 考查时态。is looking for 现在进行时态；will look for 一般将来时态；looks for 一般现在时态。根据now可知是现在进行时态，结构为am/is/are doing。故选A。 【点睛】现在进行时的标志词有哪些？ now at this/the moment look/listen 祈使句 these days

questions.prompt: Jim is looking forward to ______ his friend.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jim期待收到他朋友的来信。 考查非谓语动词。hear from 收到来信（原形）；hears from （第三人称单数形式）；hearing from（动名词或现在分词）。look forward to doing sth. “期待做某事”。此处动名词做宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What are the kids doing at the school gate? —They are waiting in line to ______ the school bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：——孩子们在校门口干什么呢？——他们在排队上校车。 考查动词短语辨析。get to 到达；get up 起床；get on 上车。根据宾语the school bus可知应是“上车”。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______ will you get to the school? —In ten minutes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久之后到学校？——十分钟以后。 考查特殊疑问句。How soon 多久以后；How long 多长时间；How much 多少（钱）根据答语in + 一段时间 表示多长时间之后，用How soon进行提问，是一般将来时态的标志词。故选A。

questions.prompt: There ______ a football match in our school this weekend. Would you like to go and see it?
questions.explanation: 句意：这周末在我们学校将有一场足球比赛，你想要去观看吗？ 考查一般将来时和there be的用法。is going to have 将有（表述错误）；are going to be 将有；is going to be 将有。there be “有”；be going to do sth. “打算做某事”。故“将有”的表达为there is/are going to be。根据this weekend可知事情发生在未来；根据a football match可知主语为单数。故选C。 【点睛】“将有”的表达： have 意为“有”，表示主观上拥有； there be 意为“某处有某物”，表示客观存在； 一般将来时的结构有will do/be going to do两种形式，那么“将有”的表达有四种： there will be there is/are going to be will have be going to have 二、完型填空。 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Four of my friends and I gathered at our favorite restaurant for Anna’s birthday. We were all having a good time when suddenly Julia said, “Hey! Let’s go to  ______ 16 ______ house and party on!” “I’m not sure if it’s a good idea,” I said. I looked to the others for support ( 支 持 ), but it seemed they were  ______ 17 ______ going to Julia’s house, for they didn’t know  ______ 18 ______ to say “no” to Julia. Julia always tries to bully (欺负) the rest of us. She knew that we would all get into trouble with our parents if we left the restaurant. But that didn’t  ______ 19 ______ her. “Don’t forget Anna’s mother will bring the birthday cake at 8:30,” I said, “We should wait  ______ 20 ______ Anna’s mother arrives!” “Don’t be silly. She’ll find us,” Julia said, laughing, like it was no big deal. “My mother is coming here to pick me up,” I  ______ 21 ______, not wanting to tell her I knew my mother wouldn’t allow me to go. “Stay here by yourself,” Julia said, “The rest of us are going.” Then she began calling me names. I felt tears coming to my eyes, so I ran to the bathroom. I felt so childish, crying alone. It’s really  ______ 22 ______ to go against your friends, especially when you’re hoping to be popular with them. A moment later, Amanda came in and said, “Julia is just that  ______ 23 ______. I agree with you. If we get out right now, maybe we can persuade (劝说) the others to stay.” “I’m staying here with Susan,” Amanda said as soon as we  ______ 24 ______ to the table. Then she said something I hadn’t  ______ 25 ______. “If I leave, I’ll get into trouble with my parents, so let’s take( 采 纳 ) Susan’s  ______ 26 ______.” Anna looked happy again as she said, “My mother wouldn’t agree, either. I’ll stay with you two.” “Okay, I’ll stay, too.” Ellie added. “Well, I’m not going alone. I have to stay! Oh!” Julia said. I was surprised it was so  ______ 27 ______. None of the girls left and I knew it was because Amanda sided(支持) with me. I guess it’s true that there’s strength（力量） in numbers. Friends can influence(影响) each other, for good or bad.

questions.prompt: My mother is a science teacher. ______  works in a high school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈是一名科学老师。她在一所高中工作。 考查代词。She她，人称代词；Her她的，物主代词；He他，人称代词；His他的，物主代词。分析句子结构，后句缺少主语；根据前句“My mother我的妈妈”可知，应用人称代词she代替。故选A。

questions.prompt: There ______  a big blackboard in the classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：教室里有一个大黑板。 考查there be结构。have/ has是实义动词，作谓语，表示某人拥有某物，不符合句意，故排除A、B。表达某处有某物（人）用“There be”句型，结构：（1）There is +单数名词/不可数名词+ 地点状语.（2）There are +复数名词+地点状语.；空格后面“a big blackboard”是单数，故用is。故选C。

questions.prompt: They usually go to the park  ______ six o’clock on Saturday evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们通常在星期六晚上六点钟去公园。 考查时间介词。in用在年、月、季节、泛指的上午、下午、晚上等；on用在具体某一天；at用在具体时刻；to表示几点差几分。six o’clock是具体时刻。故选C。

questions.prompt: The girl is from ______  and she is ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个女孩来自中国，她是中国人。 考查词汇辨析。China中国，Chinese中国人（的）；English英国人，England英国；American美国人（的），America美国。be from来自，后接国家；由is可知，第二个空是表示哪国人的形容词，故排除B、C、D。故选A。

questions.prompt: -Have we got  ______  juice? -Yes, we have got ______  juice. But we haven't got ______  milk.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们有些果汁吗？——是的，我们有一些果汁。但是我们没有牛奶。 考查词汇辨析。some一些，一般用在肯定句；any一些，一般用在否定句和疑问句。第一句与第三句分别为一般疑问句和否定句，故用any；第二句是肯定句，故用some。故选B。 【点睛】some修饰可数名词的复数或不可数名词，主要用于肯定句和表示请求或建议的疑问句中（一般含有情态动词）。any可以修饰可数名词的单数或复数，也可修饰不可数名词，一般用于否定句和疑问句中，也可用于表示“任何”含义的肯定句中。

questions.prompt: -  ______  rooms are there in the building? - There are 60 rooms.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这栋楼有多少个房间？——有60个房间。 考查疑问词短语。How old多大，询问年龄；How long多长，询问时间或物体的长度；How many多少，后接可数名词复数；How much多少，后接不可数名词。由答语可知上句询问数量，“rooms”是名词复数。故选C。

questions.prompt: My uncle likes books,  ______  he doesn't have much time to read.
questions.explanation: 句意：我叔叔喜欢书，但是他没有太多时间看书。 考查连词。and和，表并列关系；or或者，表选择关系；because因为；but但是，表转折关系。前句“My uncle likes books我叔叔喜欢书”和后句“he doesn't have much time to read他没有太多时间看书”是转折关系。故选D。

questions.prompt: Fruit and vegetables are good ______  you.
questions.explanation: 句意：水果和蔬菜对你有好处。 考查形容词短语。be good to对……友好；be good for对……有好处；be good at 擅长；be good with与……处好。结合句意：水果和蔬菜对你有好处。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Is this an English car? — ______. It’s a Chinese car.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是一辆英国汽车吗？——不，它是一辆中国车。 考查一般疑问句。Is this…？的回答：Yes, it is. / No, it isn’t. 根据答语It’s a Chinese car.可知，是否定回答。故选B。

questions.prompt: -Tony, let's play football after school. - ______!
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼，放学后我们去踢足球吧。——好主意！ 考查交际用语。Thank you谢谢；I don't like it我不喜欢它；You're welcome不用谢；Good idea好主意。Let’s do sth.让我们做某事，表示提建议。故选D。 完形填空。请从四个选项中选出最佳答案 I'm a student from Luoyang Middle School. My school is not far from my home, so I usually go to school ______ 11 ______. Walking makes me strong, Now I’d like to ______ 12 ______  you around our school. It is a nice school with many rest ______ 13 ______.We like the school garden best. The garden is behind the library. It is not big, but very beautiful. There is always a lot to see and a lot to ______ 14 ______  in the garden. Every class can grow some flowers and ______ 15 ______  in the garden. And we need to look after them well. The students go to work in the garden twice a month. Sometimes we feel tired, but we are always ______ 16 ______. We think the garden is our small farm and we all enjoy ______ 17 ______ there. It is ______ 18 ______  now and it is the season of harvest（丰收），we can eat the vegetables in the garden. We also give some of them to the old people’s home（养老院）.The old people there like the vegetables, too. They also tell us ______ 19 ______  to look after vegetables. The vegetables help us make friends with the old people. They bring the young and the old together. I am very happy to study here. I ______ 20 ______  you can visit my school soon.

questions.prompt: I have a sister. name is Paul.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有一个妹妹，她的名字叫保罗。 A. 她的； B. 他的；C. 我的；D. 你的；根据句意理解可知，这里表达的是我有一个妹妹，妹妹是女性，所以选择女性类的词，而句子当中空格后面是名词，所以用形容词的物主代词，所以选择A答案。

questions.prompt: We often play table tennis  ______  our friends at school.
questions.explanation: 考查介词。句意：“我们经常和学校里的朋友打乒乓球。”，A. to介词“向; 到; 对;”或动词不定式；B. of“…的”；C. for“为了”；D. with“和”，结合句意，故选：D。

questions.prompt: There is interesting story book and some pens in my bag.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的包里有一本有趣的故事书和一些笔。 本题考查的是冠词。根据句意理解可知，表达的是一本有趣的故事书， book可数名词的单数，there be句型的主语一般不用定冠词修饰；interesting是元音开头，所以要用an，表示一本，所以选择B答案。 【点睛】英语中冠不定冠词，a/ an的选择要根据单词的发音来判断。元音开头用an，辅音开头用a，本题中interesting是元音开头，所以选择an。

questions.prompt: Sam is not a boy. His things are everywhere in the bedroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：Sam不是一个整洁的男孩儿。他卧室里的东西到处都是。 A. 整洁的；B. 健康的； C. 好的；D. 脏的；本题考查形容词的用法。根据His things are everywhere in the bedroom.语境及后句的内容可知，这里表达的是Sam不整洁，所以选择A。

questions.prompt: — is my watch? —It’s on the desk.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的手表在哪里？——在桌子上。 A. 什么；B. 怎么样；C. 谁；D. 哪里；根据句意理解及回答可知，在桌子上是一个地点，所以应该问的是我的手表在哪里，所以哪里用where，所以选择D答案。 【点睛】英语中特殊疑问句的选择还是要根据句意来理解，问什么答什么，本题中回答是on the desk在桌子上，是表示地点，所以选择疑问词用where。

questions.prompt: Let’s to invite Lily to have Lunch next Friday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们下星期五请莉莉吃午饭吧。 根据句意理解可知，这里表示的是让我们做某事，英语当中是一个固定的结构let's后面接动词原形，所以本题选择A答案。

questions.prompt: He a sister, but he doesn’t have a brother.
questions.explanation: 句意：他有一个妹妹，但是他没有一个哥哥。 本题主要考查主谓一致。主语he是第三人称单数则排除A、C选项，又因为句中but之后是否定，but是表转折关系的连词，则前面应该是肯定句，所以本题选B。 【点睛】英语中动词的判断一定要根据主语来确定。主语是单数，谓语动词用相对应的单数形式，主语是复数，动词就用复数，也就是原形，本题中主语是he，是第三人称，动词要用三单的形式有has。

questions.prompt: —Hello, Tony. I’m Frank. —
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，Tony。我是Frank。——见到你很高兴。 A. 你呢；B. 你叫什么名字；D. 不客气；根据句中所表述的情境，两人应是第一次见到，第一个人在作自我介绍，所以对方应该说Nice to meet you“见到你很高兴”，故正确选项C。 短文填空 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写一个适当的单词， 在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 A Hi, I’m Jenny. Here are two nice  ______ 9 ______ (photo) of my family. My grandfather and grandmother are in the  ______ 10 ______ (one) photo. These are my parents, Alan and Mary. In the next picture are my brothers, Bob and Eric. These two girls  ______ 11 ______ ( be )my sister Cindy and my cousin Helen. Coco is in my  ______ 12 ______, too. 【答案】9. photos

questions.prompt: —Where is Daniel from? —He  ______  from Britain.
questions.explanation: 句意: ——丹尼尔从哪里来？——他来自英国。 考查系动词单数形式。A. come“来”动词；B. be系动词原形；C. is “是”be的三单形式；D. am“是”用于第一人称单数，根据句意和问句Where is Daniel from? 可知本句为一般现在时，be from=come from “来自…”，答句主语为“He”，所以用系动词“is”，或谓语用实意动词comes。故选C。

questions.prompt: This boy is my best friend，Wang Hui． ______  English name is Henry.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个男孩是我最好的朋友，王辉，他的英文名字是Henry。 考查形容词性物主代词。A. He“他”主格；B. His“他的”形容词性物主代词；C. She“她”主格；D. Her“她的”形容词性物主代词，根据This boy，可知王辉是男孩，根据句意，“他的英文名字”“他的…”用形容词性物主代词his，句首大写，故选B。

questions.prompt: My mother’s birthday is coming．I want to buy a present for  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈的生日就要到了，我想为她买件礼物。 考查代词宾格形式。A. her“她”，宾格；B. she“她”，主格；C. he“他”主格；D. him“他”宾格，buy a present for “为某人买礼物”，其中for“为了…”介词，后面用代词宾格形式，“我妈妈”为女性，所以用her，故选A。 【点睛】主格和宾格的用法分别如下： 一、主格用法： 人称代词主格作主语，代替上文提到的人、物或事，通常放在句子的句首。例句：

questions.prompt: My parents work every day． ______  never get tired.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父母每天都工作。他们从不感到疲劳。 考查代词主格形式。A. He“他”主格；B. She“她”主格；C. They“他们”主格；D. Their“他们的”形容词性物主代词，根据句意，句中“ ______  never get tired.”明显缺主语，所以用they“他们”指代上句的“My parents”，故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  some water in the glass.
questions.explanation: 句意：被子里有一些水。因为主语water是不可数名词，故此处谓语用单数形式is。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tony Smith’s  ______  name is Smith.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼·史密斯的姓是史密斯。 考查人名表达。A. first“第一个”；B. second“第二个”；C. middle“中间的”；D. last“最后的”，根据外国人名的表达习惯可知，Tony在前面，叫first name“名儿”， Smith 在后面，叫last name“姓氏”，故选D。 【点睛】在英语中，“名字”是放在最前面的，因此叫做 first name，也叫 given name。“姓氏”放在最后边，因此叫做 last name 或 family name。family name=last name =姓，first name=名。middle name中间的那部分名儿，中国人没有中间名。

questions.prompt: This is a map of my school．There  ______  two dining halls and three buildings in it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我学校的地图，里面有两个餐厅和三个建筑物。 考查主谓一致。A. be系动词原形；B. am用于主语是I；C. is用于主语是单数名词；D. are用于主语是复数名词，本句为“there be”句型，谓语动词遵循就近原则，空后面的“two dining halls”为复数名词，所以系动词用are。故选D。 【点睛】There be句型的就近原则是主谓一致语法项目的重要考点。There be句型中be动词的单复数形式由后面挨近的一项的单复数决定。 如：There is a pen，two books and many pencils on the desk. 在本句中尽管有钢笔、书和铅笔，但是由于离be动词最近的一项是单数a pen，因此be动词用单数is。 又如：有一本书和三只猫。There is a book and three cats. 反过来，有三只猫和一本书。There are three cats and a book.

questions.prompt: —Henry，who is the girl  ______  the left of your mum in this picture? —That’s my cousin，Mary.
questions.explanation: 句意：——亨利，这张照片里你妈妈左边的那个女孩是谁？——那是我的表妹，玛丽。 考查介词辨析。 在…的左边“on the left of…”，介词词组，属于固定搭配，根据句意the girl on the left of your mum“在你妈妈左边的女孩”，介词词组后置作定语，修饰名词the girl，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Who are  ______  two boys over there? —They are my classmates，Aaron and Ben.
questions.explanation: 句意：——那边那两个男孩是谁？——他们是我的同学，Aaron和Ben。 考查指示代词。A. this“这个”，指代较近的单数名词；B. these“这些”，指代较近的复数名词；C. that“那个”，指代较远的单数名词；D. those“那些”指代较远的复数名词，over there意为“在那边”，属于较远的地方。 two boys是名词复数，指代较远的复数名词用those。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Is there  ______  bread on the table? —Yes，there is.
questions.explanation: 句意：——桌子上有些面包吗？——是的，有。 考查不定代词。A. some“一些”，常用于肯定句； B. any“一些”，常用于否定句和疑问句；C. something“某物”复合不定代词，常用于肯定句；D. anything“某物”复合不定代词，常用于疑问句，根据句意，这里指一些面包，some bread 是名词词组，some 修饰名词 bread，在疑问句，把some 改为any，故选B。 【点睛】Some和something的区别： some是形容词或者代词，用在可数或不可数名词前，意思是“一些”。 如：some people 一些人，some books 一些书 ，some water 一些水 如：I want some apples. 句中some就是“一些”的意思，apple就是可数名词。 I want some coffee. coffee是不可数名词。 something 是不定代词，指不确定的某样东西，某件事。译为“某事，某物”。 如：I have something to eat. 我有些可吃的东西。

questions.prompt: Amy and her best friend often  ______  books together.
questions.explanation: 句意：Amy和她最好的朋友经常一起读书。 考查时态。A. read“读”，动词原形；B. reads“读”，动词单三形式；C. is reading，“正在读”现在进行时；D. to read动词不定式，由often可知本句为一般现在时，主语Amy and her best friend“Amy和她最好的朋友”可知是两个人，主语是复数，所以谓语用动词原形read，read books“读书”，根据句意，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  is my notebook? — Look! It’s in your schoolbag.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的笔记本呢？——看！在你书包里。 考查特殊疑问句。A. What“什么”特殊疑问词；B. Which“哪一个”特殊疑问词；C. Where“在哪里”特殊疑问词；D. How“怎样”特殊疑问词，根据答语Look! It’s in your schoolbag. 看！在你书包里。可知上句询问“笔记本在哪儿”，所以用where，故选C。

questions.prompt: —How do we read 8:30  ______  English? —Half past eight. A at
questions.explanation: 句意：—我们怎么用英语读8：30？—Half past eight. 考查介词。A. at（表示位置）在，介词；B. from从…，介词； C. in采用（某种方式），在…里面，介词；D. on在…上，介词，固定搭配“in English”的意思是：用英语，用英语说。根据句意“怎么用英语读8：30”，可知是用英语说，in这里指“用英语”这种方式，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Nice to meet you. — ______.
questions.explanation: ——很高兴见到你。——也很高兴见到你。 考查交际用语。A. See you“再见”；B. I’m fine “我很好”；C. Thank you“谢谢”；D. Nice to meet you，too“也很高兴见到你。”，在日常交际用语中，Nice to meet you.的答语常用：Nice to meet you，too.，其他选项不符合语境，故选D。 I don’t know her name．She  ______ 15 ______  one of the workers in our school canteen(食堂)．I just call her Lunch Lady．She’s my friend．There are several nice ladies in the canteen，but the Lunch Lady is the nicest of all．Every day she  ______ 16 ______  at me when I go through the line.

questions.prompt: Hello, Betty. This ______ your new English teacher, Mr. Wang.
questions.explanation: 句意：你好，贝蒂。这是你的新英语老师，王老师。 考查be动词。分析句子可知，此处用于表示单数的代词this之后，所以应用表示单数的be动词is，故选B。

questions.prompt: Helen and Tom  ______  good friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：海伦和汤姆是好朋友。 考查be动词。分析句子可知，此句的主语Helen and Tom是两个人，所以用表示复数的be动词are，故选C。 【点睛】be动词口诀： 英语有个动词be，面孔不同要注意。 我用am你用are ，is连着他她它。 主语单数用is，主语复数都用are。 变疑问，将be往前提，变否定，be后加not； 句首大写莫忘记，句末标点莫忘记。

questions.prompt: --Where is Tony? ---He is ______  the right of the classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼在哪？——他在教室的右边。 考查介词辨析。分析句子可知，此处构成固定搭配on the right of…，翻译为“在……的右边”，故选B。

questions.prompt: Daming is a boy.  ______  is from England.
questions.explanation: 句意：大明是一个男孩。他来自英国。 考查代词辨析。He他，人称代词主格；His他的，形容词性物主代词/名词性物主代词；Him他，人称代词宾格。根据句中“Daming is a boy”可知，大明是个男孩并且此处用在句首作主语，所以应用人称代词主格形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a library in our school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校有一个图书馆。 考查there be句型。分析句子可知，此句的主语是a library表示单数，所以此处应用表示单数的is，故选C。 【点睛】there be句型中be动词的选择取决于其后修饰的名词，且取决于离它最近的名词，即“就近原则”。例句： There are three books and a pen on the desk. There is a pen and three books on the desk.

questions.prompt: ---  ______  is the boy? -- He’s ten years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个男孩几岁了？——他十岁了。 考查特殊疑问词辨析。What什么；How如何，怎样；How old多大，多少岁。根据答语“He's ten years old.”可知，答语是在回答男孩年龄，故选C。

questions.prompt: Tom is  ______  English boy and Daming is  ______ Chinese boy.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆一个英国男孩，大明是一个中国男孩。 考查冠词辨析。分析句子可知，第一空用在English之前，English首字母发元音音素，所以用an；第二空用在Chinese之前，Chinese首字母发辅音音素，所以用a。故选B。

questions.prompt: ----Where are you from? ---- ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你来自哪里？——我来自中国。 考查情景交际。I'm from China我来自中国；I'm thirteen我十三岁；I'm a student我是一名学生。分析问句“Where are you from?”可知，此处是在问“你来自哪里”，所以答句应回答“我来自……”，故选A。

questions.prompt: -- What’s  ______  favourite food? ---- I like fish.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你最喜欢的食物是什么？——我喜欢鱼。 考查代词辨析。I我，人称代词主格；your你的，形容词性物主代词；you你，人称代词主格/宾格。分析句子可知，此处用在名词短语favourite food之前，所以应用形容词性物主代词修饰，故选B。

questions.prompt: -- Hello, Jack. Nice to meet you! ---  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，杰克。见到你很高兴！——见到你也很高兴。 考查情景交际。Thanks谢谢；Fine, thank you很好，谢谢你；Nice to meet you, too. 见到你也很高兴。根据前一句“Nice to meet you!”可知，此处应为答语“见到你也很高兴。”，故选C。 完形填空 Hello, I’m Tom. I’m a middle school  ______ 11 ______. It’s nice to meet you here. There are five people in my  ______ 12 ______. They are my mother, my father, my sister, my brother and  ______ 13 ______. My father is a worker. My mother is  ______ 14 ______  English teacher. She  ______ 15 ______  in a university in Beijing. My sister is eighteen and my brother is sixteen. I’m twelve. We  ______ 16 ______  go to the same school. We all like playing football games. My home is at West Street. There  ______ 17 ______  some trees around my house. There is a pear tree and some apple trees,  ______ 18 ______  there aren’t  ______ 19 ______  pears or apples on them now. Here’s a photo of my house.
