In the photo, you can see three cats in my house. They are all black. We like  ______ 20 ______  very much.

questions.prompt: —What’s Mrs. Smith’s telephone number? — ______  telephone number is 578-2945.
questions.explanation: 句意：——史密斯太太的电话号码是多少？——她的电话号码是578-2945。 考查代词辨析。Her她的；She她；His他的；He他。此处指Mrs. Smith，是女性，作定语修饰telephone number，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Is Mr. Brown in the office? —No, he isn’t. You can call him  ______  632-4567.
questions.explanation: 句意：——布朗先生在办公室吗？——不，他不在。你可以打632-4567给他。 考查介词辨析。in在……里面；with和……一起；for为了；at在……地方。“call sb. at+电话号码”表示“打某人电话”。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  is your quilt? —It is pink.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的被子什么颜色？——它是粉色的。 考查特殊疑问句。What size什么尺寸；What color什么颜色；How long多久；How much多少钱。根据答语“It is pink”可知，询问是什么颜色，故选B。

questions.prompt: We can see  ______  UFO in the picture.  ______  UFO is gray.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们能看到照片中有一个UFO。这个UFO是灰色的。 考查冠词。第一空泛指一个UFO，UFO以辅音音素开头，其前用不定冠词a；第二空特指上文提到过的UFO，其前用定冠词the。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______, Jack. We’re late for the movie. —Wait a minute, mom. I’m looking for my hat.
questions.explanation: 句意：——快点，Jack，我们看电影要迟到了。——等一下妈妈，我在找我的帽子。 考查短语辨析。Come in进来；Come on 快点；加油；Thank you谢谢你；Goodbye再见。根据句意“We’re late for the movie”可知，妈妈在催促Jack。故选B。

questions.prompt: My name in Tom Green. My first name is Tom  ______  my last name is Green.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的名字是汤姆·格林。我的名字是汤姆，我的姓是格林。 考查连词辨析。but但是；so因此；or或者；and并且。根据“My first name is Tom… my last name is Green”可知，空格前后句是顺承关系，故选D。

questions.prompt: Here  ______  a set of keys. All the keys are white.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是一串钥匙。所有的钥匙都是白色的。 考查主谓一致。句子是一般现在时，且a set of修饰主语时，be动词用is，故选A。

questions.prompt: How many people  ______  in your family?
questions.explanation: 句意：你家里有多少口人？ 考查there be句型以及特殊疑问句。这是一个特殊疑问句，疑问词+一般疑问句的结构，be动词放在there前，排除C和D选项。主语people是复数形式，be动词要用are，故选B。

questions.prompt: Thank you for  ______  me. Next time, please let me  ______  you.
questions.explanation: 句意：感谢你帮助我。下次，请让我来帮助你。 考查非谓语动词。for是介词，后接动名词作宾语；let是使役动词，后接省略to的动词不定式作宾补，let sb do sth“让某人做某事”，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Have a nice day! — ______
questions.explanation: 句意：——祝您有个美好的一天！——谢谢。 考查情景交际。Nice to meet you!很高兴认识你；Thank you.谢谢；You are welcome.不客气；How do you do?您好。根据“Have a nice day!”可知，答句应该是感谢。故选B。 五、完形填空（共8分, 每题1分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Fall has finally arrived. The weather is getting a bit cold and the leaves are changing their colors. Before we  ______ 12 ______  it, the last signs of summer will be gone. Each country has its own way to celebrate fall. China celebrates the Mid-Autumn Festival every year. During this holiday, it is a tradition for  ______ 13 ______  to get together to enjoy the moon and eat mooncakes. Do other counties have fall traditions? The US has many, in fact. From enjoying  ______ 14 ______  leaves to picking up apples, fall is a fun time in this country. When fall arrives, the leaves of different kinds of trees change their colors  ______ 15 ______. Some will turn bright red, while others will be yellow or green. In some parts of the US, it is popular to have a “color  ______ 16 ______  ”. Families will get in their cars and drive around the countryside （乡村）, looking at all the beautiful colors of the trees. As the leaves change color, they also fall to the ground and make the yards messy. People have to rake （用耙子耙） their yards to keep them  ______ 17 ______. They will rake these leaves into piles （堆）, and kids can then  ______ 18 ______  into the leaves to play. It’s quite fun! Apple picking is another fun family tradition for many American families. Outside of New York city, owners of farms and orchards often  ______ 19 ______  customers （顾客） to “pick your own”. Customers will be charged by weight when they leave. This apple picking activity gives families a good chance to experience farm life. Apple pie, spiced apple cider （苹果酒）.

questions.prompt: I  ______  a boy My name  ______  Wang Lei.
questions.explanation: 句意：我是一个男孩，我的名字是王磊。 本题考查系动词的用法。第一人称单数I后面用am，第三人称单数he, she, it及能用这三个词代替的词要用is，my name能用it代替，要用is，故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s warm and windy  ______  spring in my hometown.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我的家乡，春天天气暖和有风。 本题考查介词的用法。at在(某处); 在(某时间或时刻)；in在……里，用在世纪、年份、季节、月份前；on在……上；of关于，……的；在世纪、年份、季节、月份前用in，spring春天属于季节，要用in，故选B。

questions.prompt: We play football  ______  Thursday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们在星期四踢足球。 本题考查介词的用法。at在(某处); 在(某时间或时刻)；in在……里；on在……上；of关于，……的；表示星期几或某一特定的日期，用 on；故选C。 【点睛】表示时间，注意以下用法：① 表示时间的某一点、某一时刻或年龄等用 at。如I get up at six in the morning. 我早上六点钟起床。 He got married at the age of 25. 他 25 岁结婚。② 泛指一般意义的上午、下午或晚上以及月或年等较长的时间，一般用 in。如：We watch TV in the evening. 我们晚上看电视。 He went to Japan in 1946. 他于 1946 去了日本。③ 表示星期几或某一特定的日期，则用 on。如： He left here on the fifth of May. 他于 5 月 5 日离开这儿。

questions.prompt: –Where are you from? --We are from  ______. We are  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你们来自哪里？——我们来自英格兰。我们是英国人。 本题考查名词辨析。England英格兰、英国；English英国的、英国人；be from来自，后接国家，故选D。

questions.prompt: My father is  ______  actor, and my mother is  ______  hotel manager.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父亲是一名演员，我的母亲是一个旅馆经理。 本题考查不定冠词的用法。a用在以辅音音素开头的单数可数名词前；an用在以元音音素开头的单数可数名词前。Actor是以元音音素开头的单词，前面用an；hotel是以辅音音素开头的单词，前面用a；故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  is a teacher and  ______  students like her very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：她是一名老师，她的学生们非常喜欢她。 本题考查人称代词和物主代词的用法。she人称代词主格；her人称代词宾格或形容词性物主代词。根据句意，第一根空线处要用人称代词主格形式she她；第二根空线处要用形容词性物主代词her她的；故选B。

questions.prompt: There a book and two pens in my schoolbag.
–Are there any students in the classroom? -- ______. It is Sunday today.
questions.explanation: 句意：——在教室里有学生吗？——不，没有。今天是星期天。 本题考查there be 句型的基本用法。There be句型的一般疑问句形式，are there…?其回答形式为：Yes, there are. No there aren’t. 依据“It is Sunday today.”“今天星期天，”所以教室里应该是没人，要用否定形式。故选D。

questions.prompt: –Excuse me!  ______  is the dining hall? --It’s next to the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰了，请问餐厅在哪？——紧挨着图书馆。 本题考查特殊疑问词。What 什么；how怎样；where哪儿；how old多大；依据回答 “It’s next to the library.”“紧挨着图书馆”，回答的是方位，可知应该用where提问。故选C。

questions.prompt: I can’t play with Alan,  ______  I have a lot of work to do.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不能与阿伦一起玩，因为我有很多工作要做。 本题考查连词的用法。so所以；because因为；but但是；and并且。依据题干，前面的“I can’t play with Alan”是结果，后面的“I have a lot of work to do.”是原因，构成因果关系，故选B。

questions.prompt: Music and art  ______  my favorite lessons.
questions.explanation: 句意：音乐和美术是我最喜欢的科目。 根据句意可知划线处填“是”，have，has 有，翻译出来不合适，排除C，D；动词be有三种形式am、is、are，表达“是”第一人称单数用am，第二人称和复数用are，第三人称单数和不可数名词用is，主语Music and art复数；故选B。 【点睛】动词be有三种形式am、is、are，意为“是”，第一人称单数用am，例如：I am a student.；第二人称单数和一、二、三人称复数用are，例如：You are a good boy./You are students.；第三人称单数和不可数名词用is，例如：He is my son./Milk is white.。动词have、has意思是“有”，第一人称和第二人称和复数用have，例如：I have a pen. You have two pens.；第三人称单数用has，例如：He has two pens。

questions.prompt: Let’s  ______  table tennis after class.
questions.explanation: 句意：让我们课下打乒乓球吧！ 本题考查let的用法。playing动名词或现在分词形式； play动词原形； plays动词的单三形式； to play动词不定式形式。Let让，其用法为let sb do sth.后接省略to的不定式，四个选项中是动词原形的只有play，故选B。 阅读理解 A Have you got any friends? What are they like? Here are some best friends of some students from different countries. Susan, the USMy best friend is Fanny. She is clever and interesting. We always look after each other. The first week we met, I got sick and she looked after me every day.Betty, EnglandMy best friend is Ana. She is honest and serious. We were born in the same city in England. Then I moved to America with my family. I thought I would never see Ana again. When I went to college in New work, Ana and I shared the same room!Ken, JapanI love to spend time with Daisuke because he is funny and smart. We enjoy talking about the funny things we did when we were children, and telling the same stupid jokes over and over again.Lily, AustraliaLinda is a very confident girl and she is really kind. Some people may wonder why Linda and I are best friends because we are totally different, but I think this is why we are such good friends.

questions.prompt: ______  is Ms. Zhang.  ______  father is a teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：她是张女士。她的爸爸是老师。 考查代词。he人称代词主格，他；his形容词性物主代词，他的；she人称代词主格，她；her形容词性物主代词，她的。由“Ms. Zhang.”可知，是一位女士，第二空是这位女士的爸爸。故选B。 【点睛】同学们要注意人称代词和物主代词之间的区别，人称代词主格常常作主语，形容词性物主代词需要加上名词才可以表示完整的意义。

questions.prompt: —Who  ______  you? — I  ______  Millie. Amy  ______  my good friend.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你是谁？——我是米莉，艾米是我的好朋友。 考查be动词。第一人称单数用am；第二人称和复数用are，第三人称单数用is。第一空主语为you，用are；第二空主语为I，用am；第三空主语为Amy，第三人称单数，用is。故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is my skirt? —  ______  behind the door.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的裙子在哪儿？——它在门后。 考查特殊疑问词。what什么；where在哪；it它；it’s它是。由“ ______ behind the door”可知，回答的是地点，所以是问裙子在哪，本句中缺少主谓，用it’s，故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s time  ______  lunch.
questions.explanation: 句意：到吃午餐的时间了。 考查介词。over超过；to去到；for为了；at在……。本题固定搭配“到做某事的时间了it is time for sth./to do sth.”。lunch为名词，故选C。

questions.prompt: My favourite  ______  are maths and English.
questions.explanation: 句意：我最喜欢的科目是数学和英语。 考查名词辨析。school学校；subject科目；sport运动；colour颜色。由“maths and English”可知，是科目，故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  colour is the ruler? — It’s  ______ green.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这把尺子是什么颜色的？——是绿色的。 考查特殊疑问句。how怎样；what什么。由“green”可知，问的是什么颜色，用what；再由green是形容词“绿色的”，前面不用冠词，故选C。

questions.prompt: —When do you usually have breakfast? —I usually have breakfast ______  6 o'clock.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你通常什么时候吃早餐？——我通常6点吃早餐。 考查介词。at加时间点；in加一段时间；on加具体某一天；with表示伴随。由“6 o'clock”是具体的时间点，故选A。

questions.prompt: My mother has(有) three  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的妈妈有三个孩子。 考查名词。child孩子，单数；children复数；girl女孩，单数；boy男孩，单数。three加可数名词复数，故选B。

questions.prompt: -—What does your father do? —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的父亲做什么？——他是一位老师。 考查情景交际。He is Mr. Green.他是格林先生。He is from Japan.他来自日本。He often plays tennis.他经常打网球。He is a teacher.他是一位老师。由问题“What does your father do?”你父亲做什么工作？问题在问工作，所以回答他是一位老师，故选D。 【点睛】本题是一道易错题，学生千万注意“What does your father do”的翻译，翻译为“你父亲做什么工作”，而不是“他在做什么”。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me, Sir.  ______. —Go straight and turn right. It’s next to a white house.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，先生，工厂在哪里？——往前走，向右拐。它挨着一个白色的房子。 考查情景交际。How’s the weather? 天气怎么样？Whose bag is this? 这是谁的书包？What time is it?几点了？ Where’s the factory? 工厂在哪里？由回答“Go straight and turn right.”可知，是在问地点在哪里，故选D。 完形填空 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择能填入相应空白处的最佳选项。 There ______ 11 ______ two new students in our class. Their  ______ 12 ______  are Lucy and Lily. They are twins(双胞胎）. They look ______ 13 ______. They are American. They are  ______ 14 ______  the same row(排）. This is a picture of  ______ 15 ______  classroom. This is  ______ 16 ______ desk and that is Lily’s. Where are ______ 17 ______  bags? They are behind the chairs. Look! ______ 18 ______ that under the chair? Is it a hat? No, it’s a cat.

questions.prompt: Suzhou ______ famous for gardens.
questions.explanation: 句意：苏州以园林闻名。 考查系动词用法。am是，用于第一人称I + am； are是，复数名词+are，第二人称you+are; 第一人称复数we+are； 第三人称复数they+are。is是，第三人称单数+is，如he(男) +is; she(女)+is; it(它)+is。根据句意，句子的主语是Suzhou，所以后用is。故选B。

questions.prompt: Butterflies are insects. ______ look very beautiful.
questions.explanation: 句意：蝴蝶是昆虫，它们看起来很漂亮。 考查人称代词。They它（他、她）们，人称代词主格；Them，它（他、她）们，人称代词宾格；Their它（他、她）们的，形容词性物主代词。根据空处单词look，可知空处是句子的主语，应该用人称代词主格形式；根据前面句子主语是Butterflies，要用人称代词主格they代替。故选A。

questions.prompt: The UK is a small ______ beautiful country.
questions.explanation: 句意：英国是一个小但是美丽的国家。 考查连词。and并且，表并列关系；but但是，表转折关系；so所以，表因果关系。根据句意，small与beautiful在意义上两者之间是转折关系，所以用but。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______ is Xiamen? --It's in the south of China.
questions.explanation: 句意：——厦门在哪儿？——它在中国南方。 考查特殊疑问词。How怎样；What什么；Where哪儿。根据回答It's in the south of China.，可知是在说方位；所以应该用where提问。故选C。

questions.prompt: The Nile is ______ river in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：尼罗河是世界上最长的河流。 考查最高级。long长的，形容词原级；longer更长的，形容词比较级；the longest最长的，形容词最高级。根据空后“in the world.”可知比较范围是三者以上，结合句意可知是说尼罗河是世界上最长的河流，所以用最高级。故选C。

questions.prompt: The elephant is the only animal ______ a trunk- a special long nose.
questions.explanation: 句意：大象是唯一有象鼻的动物——一个特殊的长鼻子。 考查介词辨析。For给，因为；with带有，和；to向，到。根据句意，可知空处是介词短语作后置定语用，修饰animal；结合选项，可知是with a trunk修饰空前animal，意为带有象鼻的动物。故选B。

questions.prompt: Yesterday my friend and I ______ to the zoo.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我和朋友去了动物园。 考查动词时态。go去，动词原形；goes去，动词第三人称单数形式；went去，动词过去式。根据句中yesterday，可知本句为一般过去时态，所以动词要用过去形式went。故选C。 完形填空 选词填空。认真阅读下面的短文，选择并抄写合适的单词使短文意思完整。 A sure, hope, mountains, north, also, interesting, snow-capped, Dear Mary, I'm glad to know your mum is coming to China. I ______ 8 ______  she can stay in Beijing for some time. It is in the  ______ 9 ______ of China. She can visit the great Wall and the Summer Palace there. Shanghai is also a(n) ______ 10 ______  big city. It is in the east of China. She can visit the Bund, Yuyuan Garden and the City God Temple. I'm ______ 11 ______ she will love the snacks there, too. Guilin is in the south of china. she can see beautiful rivers and ______ 12 ______  there. I hope she can ______ 13 ______  go to Lhasa. It is in the west of China. She can visit the Potala Palace and see ______ 14 ______ mountains. Yours, Yaoyao 【答案】8. hope

questions.prompt: —What's phone number? — phone number is 562-3487.
questions.explanation: 句意：——鲍勃的电话号码是多少？——他的电话号码是562-3487。 She她； he 他；Bob's 鲍勃的；he他。第一空表示某人的电话号码用形容词性物主代词或名词所有格。排除ABD；第二空是代替Bob's的，用his来回答，这里表示他的电话号码。。根据题意，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where are the balls? —Look! They’re the floor.
questions.explanation: 句意：——球在哪里？——看，它在地板上。 A. at在……；B. in在……里面；C. on在……上；D. under在……下面。根据上文Where are the balls?可知下文是说在地板上用介词on。根据题意，故选C。

questions.prompt: There two chairs beside the sofa in my room.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我的房间的沙发旁边有两把椅子。 A. is是，单数；B. are是，复数；C. be是，原形； D. was是，过去式。这里是说房间里有两把椅子，是一般现在时态，排除D；这里是there be句型，主语是two chairs，谓语动词用复数are。根据题意，故选B。

questions.prompt: — do you spell your name? —J-A-C-K.
questions.explanation: 句意：——怎样拼写你的名字？——J-A-C-K.。 A. How怎样；B. When何时，当……的时候；C. Where在哪；D. Why为什么。根据J-A-C-K.可知上文是在问如何拼写。用特殊疑问句how。根据题意，故选A。

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  you will be late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则你上学就迟到了。 考查并列连词辨析。and又，和，表示并列关系；but但是，表示转折关系；or否则，表相反假设，用于警告或忠告；so因此，表因果关系；句型“祈使句+or+陈述句”表示以陈述句为条件下的相反假设，意为“否则，要不然”，所以，用连词or。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Must I find my ID card today? —No, you. You can look for it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天我必须找到我的身份证吗？——不，你不必。你可以明天找它。 A. shouldn’t不应该；B. can’t不能；C. mustn’t禁止；D. needn’t不必。对于must开头的一般疑问句，做简略回答要用needn’t来代替. mustn’t，根据题意，故选D。

questions.prompt: —My sister is ill in hospital. —I’m sorry that.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的妹妹在医院生病。——听到这个很难过。 A. hear听见；原形；B. heard听见，过去式；C. to hear听见，动词不定式；D. hearing听见，现在分词。be sorry to do sth.表示做某事很抱歉。根据题意，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Have you seen Mr. Smith? —Yes. Look, he ______  the flowers in the garden.
questions.explanation: 句意“-你已经见到史密斯先生了吗？-是的，看！他正在花园里浇花”。 A.一般现在时；B.现在进行时；C.一般过去时；D.现在完成时。根据look可知，表示“史密斯先生正在浇花”，用现在进行时，故选B。 【点睛】与现在进行时连用的时间状语：now, at present, at the moment, these days, look, listen等。

questions.prompt: —-Who are Tom and Bill? —The two boys blue school uniforms.
questions.explanation: 句意：--Tom 和Bill是谁？—正穿着蓝色的校服的那两个男孩。 A. wear穿，原形；B. wore穿，过去式；C. wears穿，第三人称单数；D. wearing穿，现在分词。这里是现在分词作后置定语。这里是正穿蓝色校服的那两个男孩。根据题意，故选D。

questions.prompt: Mom, have you seen my pencil case? I don’t know _I have left it.
questions.explanation: 句意：妈妈，你看见我的铅笔盒了吗？我不知道我把它落在哪里了。 A. why为什么； B. when何时；C. how怎么样；D. where在哪。根据上文Mom, have you seen my pencil case?可知下文是where引导的宾语从句，根据题意，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Hello! Nice to meet you. —.
questions.explanation: 句意：—你好，见到你很高兴。—我见到你也很高兴。 A. Thank you谢谢你； B. Good morning早上好；C. Nice to meet you, too我见到你也很高兴；D. My name’s Gina我的名字是Gina。对于Nice to meet you.回答，下文也是Nice to meet you, too，根据题意，故选C。 完型填空。 A 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I’m sure many great people think about how they can make a difference in the world. In fact, sometimes little things can make a really big difference. I learned this  ______ 13 ______ one day five years ago with my father, when I was just acting like myself—a nine-year-old kid. Papa came home late from work after 9 p.m. and he looked even more tired than usual. His eyes were already half- closed. I followed him to his bedroom. Papa  ______ 14 ______ up the stairs, slowly lifting his feet one after the other. I was afraid that I would have to start pushing him. Fortunately, he  ______ 15 ______ it to the bedroom on his own. Papa sat down on the bed and started removing his shoes and socks. “How was work?” I asked cheerfully. “Oh, it was OK,” he replied. “It’s just that I’m tired.” “Oh, um...you want me to leave?” Papa gave me a tired  ______ 16 ______ that made me more comfortable. I made me feel like he wasn’t going to scold me, as he often did when I made some  ______ 17 ______. “No,” he said kindly, “of course I don’t want you to leave.” I opened my mouth and started  ______ 18 ______ out the Disney movie Lilo & Stitch. Papa always loved it when I did that, and he started laughing loudly. I was happy that I had made my father laugh so much. “Did you like it?” I asked. “Of course I did,” he said. “Did you know that  ______ 19 ______ you make me laugh, you make me feel a lot better?” I was  ______ 20 ______ that I could really do a thing like that.

questions.prompt: — Is this your book? — No it’s not mine. Jenny is looking for her English book. Maybe it’s  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是你的书吗？ ——不，不是我的。珍妮正在找她的英语书。也许这是她的书。 考查物主代词。A. her她的，形容词性物主代词；B. mine我的，名词性物主代词；C. his他的，形容词性物主代词和名词性物主代词；D. hers她的，名词性物主代词。根据上文Jenny is looking for her English book可知，此处在推测这是珍妮的书，故应填入意为“她的”物主代词，B、C选项可排除。空格后没有名词，故空格处应填入名词性物主代词hers，故选D。

questions.prompt: ______  the morning of my birthday, I usually find many gifts on my bed.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我生日那天早上，我通常会在床上找到许多礼物。 考查介词。A. In用于指早午晚、年、月、季节、一段时间后；B. During在……期间；C. On用于指具体某一天，如星期几，节日以及具体某一天的早中晚；D. At用于指某一特定的时刻。空格后为the morning of my birthday，指具体某一天的早上应用介词on，故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  dictionary is this? It’s very nice. — I think it is Mary’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是谁的字典。它看起来很漂亮。 ——我觉得它应该是玛丽的。 考查特殊疑问句。A. Who’s谁是；B. Who谁，主格；C. Whom谁，宾格；D. Whose谁的。根据答句I think it is Mary’s可知，问句问的是字典是谁的，D选项符合句意，故选D。

questions.prompt: My birthday day is coming. My mother promises  ______  a cake for me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的生日就快到了。母亲承诺要为我做个蛋糕。 考查固定搭配。A. to make动词不定式；B. making动名词；C. make动词原形；D. makes动词第三人称单数形式。promise to do sth.为固定搭配，意为“承诺做某事”，符合句意，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Tom, we are going to have a party tonight. Would you like to join us? —  ______
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，我们今晚有个聚会。你要不要加入我们啊？ ——好的，我想去。 考查情景交际。A. Yes, I like it.是的，我喜欢它；B. No, I won’t.不，我不会；C. Yes, I’d love to. 是的，我很乐意去；D. Yes, please.好的，请吧。根据问句可知，是在对汤姆进行邀请，C选项Yes, I’d love to是接受别人的邀请时的应答，符合语境，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Can't you see the sign "No smoking"? Don't smoke here. —Sorry, I  ______  that again.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你没看到“禁止吸烟”的标志吗？不要在这里吸烟。——对不起，我不会再那样做了。 考查动词时态。am not doing现在进行时；won't do一般将来时；can't do情态动词否定，不能做；don't do一般现在时。根据句意，结合语境可知，答句是对将来行为的保证，所以用一般将来时，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What are you good at, Jeremy? — ______.  ______  I want to take part in the basketball game this year.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Playing all kinds of balls; That's because

choices.label: B
choices.text: Play all kinds of balls; That's why

choices.label: C
choices.text: Playing all kinds of balls; That's why

choices.label: D
choices.text: Play all kinds of balls; That's because

questions.explanation: 句意：——你擅长什么，杰里米？ ——打各种各样的球。这就是我今年想参加篮球比赛的原因。 分析句子结构可知，第一个空的答语应该是I’m good at playing all kinds of balls. 的省略句。因此排除B/D；其次“Playing all kinds of balls.”又是“I want to take part in the basketball game this year.”的原因，因此用That's why引导。故选C。

questions.prompt: —My dad is going to take me to Disneyland this summer holiday. —Wow, that's wonderful. Enjoy  ______!
questions.explanation: 句意：——今年暑假我爸会带我去迪斯尼乐园。——哇，好棒，好好享受吧。 考查反身代词。oneself自己；ourselves我们自己；myself我自己；yourself你自己。enjoy oneself祝玩得痛快，尽情享受，根据上文对方的爸爸带对方去玩，可知是yourself。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Are you ready for the coming math exam? —Never! Math is too difficult and I'm sure I  ______  pass it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你准备好即将到来的数学测试了吗？——绝对没有！数学太难了，我确定我通不过。 考查动词时态。don't一般现在时；won't一般将来时；aren't一般现在时；didn't一般过去时。根据问句可知，是叙述将来的事情，所以句子应是一般将来时，故选B。

questions.prompt: After staying at home for three months, all of us are looking forward to  ______  to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：在家呆了三个月之后，我们都期待上学。 考查动名词作宾语。look forward to doing sth.期待做某事，是固定搭配，此处用going符合题意。故选D。

questions.prompt: Let's hope in the near future, there  ______  special drugs and vaccines (疫苗) for this terrible disease.
questions.explanation: 句意：让我们希望在不远的将来，将会有针对这种可怕疾病的特效药和疫苗。 考查there be句型。are是；will have将会有；will be将会是；have有。根据前文“Let's hope in the near future”可知时态是一般将来时，根据there可知考查的是there be句型，所以是will be。故选C。

questions.prompt: Hundreds of people  ______ their belongings on the train as they are always  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：成百上千的人们把他们的东西落在火车上，因为他们总是匆匆忙忙。 考查动词和词组辨析。leave遗留，丢下；forget忘记；hurry up赶紧，赶快；in a hurry匆忙地。由“on the train”可知，只能用leave，leave sth. sp.把某物忘在某地；hurry up一般单独使用，in a hurry，表示一种状态，可作表语。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Molly, can you swim? —Yes, I  ______. I do it really well!
questions.explanation: 句意：——茉莉，你会游泳吗？——是的，我会，我游得非常好。 考查情态动词。can能够，可以；can’t不能；need需要；must必须。根据提问“can”可知回答也是用can，根据“Yes”可知是肯定回答，所以用can，表示能力。故选A。

questions.prompt: Maggie is popular among us because she gets on well  ______  every one and is always ready  ______  others.
questions.explanation: 句意：麦琪在我们之间很受欢迎，因为她跟每个人都相处得很好，而且随时准备帮助别人。 考查介词和非谓语。for为了，with和；to help去帮助，不定式；helping帮助，现在分词。get on well with sb.和某人相处得很好，固定搭配；根据短语be ready to do sth.准备做某事，用不定式。故选B。

questions.prompt: It is getting dark and we'd better hurry up. I don't want Mom to be  ______  about us.
questions.explanation: 句意：天快黑了，我们最好快点。我不想让妈妈担心我们。 考查形容词辨析。worry担心，worrying是动名词形式，worries是其三单形式；worried担心的，形容词。be worried about为……而担心，固定短语；本句缺表语形容词，根据句意结构，可知选D。 第三部分：文章词汇，从下各题选项中选择一个最佳选项。

questions.prompt: She was involved in a serious car  ______  last week and lost her legs unfortunately.
questions.explanation: 句意：她上周遭遇了一场严重的车祸，不幸地失去了双腿。 考查名词辨析。accident事故；exhibit展品；sculpture雕塑；profit利润。根据“lost her legs unfortunately不幸地失去了双腿”，可知后面三项不合句意，故选A。

questions.prompt: At birth, most babies  ______  between 6 and 8 pounds (磅).
questions.explanation: 句意：大多数婴儿出生时体重在6到8磅之间。 考查动词辨析。weight重量；weigh重，动词；high高的，形容词；height高度。根据“between 6 and 8 pounds在6到8磅之间”，可知是重量；本句缺谓语，故选B。

questions.prompt: Taking down notes is no trouble at all; on the  ______, it will be helpful for you to review.
questions.explanation: 句意：做笔记一点也不麻烦;相反，它会帮助你复习。 考查形容词辨析。obvious明显的；dominant首要的；contrary相对立的/相反的事实；aggressive挑衅的。on the contrary恰恰相反，固定短语；根据题干，可知前后语义相反，故选C。

questions.prompt: The crocodile (鳄鱼) is a kind of fierce and strange-looking  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：鳄鱼是一种凶猛而长相奇特的生物。 考查名词辨析。feature特征；factor要素；creature生物；sculpture雕塑。根据“The crocodile 鳄鱼”，可知是是一种生物，creature符合句意，故选C。

questions.prompt: Climate change could  ______  20% of the world's lizard (蜥蜴) species by 2080, according to a study.
questions.explanation: 句意：一项研究表明，到2080年，气候变化可能会使世界上20%的蜥蜴灭绝。 考查动词短语辨析。wipe down抹去；wipe up擦掉；wipe off擦去；wipe out使灭绝。根据“Climate change…20% of the world's lizard species气候变化……世界上20%的蜥蜴”，可知前面三项意思都与句意不合，故选D。

questions.prompt: His words might not sound  ______  to the ear but he meant well.
questions.explanation: 句意：他的话听起来可能不好听，但他的本意是好的。 考查形容词辨析。terrible可怕的；pleasant高兴的；opposite相反的；tropical热带的。but表转折，根据“but he meant well但他的本意是好的”，可知not sound pleasant（听起来不好听）符合句意，故选B。

questions.prompt: Tony  ______  sitting in an office all day, so he is going to leave the company.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼厌倦了整天坐在办公室里，所以他打算离开公司。 考查固定搭配。tired疲倦的；(be) tired of厌烦；(be) too tired to后接不定式，空格后是动名词形式，可排除BD两项。根据“so he is going to leave the company所以他打算离开公司”，可知是厌倦了坐办公室；本句是系表结构，故选C。

questions.prompt: If you don't lace up (系好带子) your shoes you'll  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你不系好鞋带，你会被绊倒的。 考查动词短语辨析。trip绊，绊倒；trip up将…绊倒；trip out出局；trip off 跳开，断开；trip over绊在障碍物上而跌跤，是固定短语。根据“If you don't lace up your shoes如果你不系好鞋带”，可知会绊倒，故选D。

questions.prompt: Heavy drinking can  ______  permanent damage (永久性伤害) to the brain.
questions.explanation: 句意：重度饮酒会引起脑部永久伤害。 考查动词辨析。cause引起的意思，own是拥有的意思，earn获得，挣的意思，cling是紧贴，坚持的意思。根据宾语damage可知，此处表示“引起伤害”。故选A。

questions.prompt: I like all kinds of sports,  ______  swimming.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢各种运动，尤其是游泳。 考查副词辨析。especial格外的；especially尤其；special特别的；specially专门地。swim游泳，动词需用副词修饰；根据句意语境，可知需用especially强调尤其喜欢游泳，故选B。 【点睛】首先，swim（游泳）是动词性质，需用副词修饰，可排除AC两项形容词。而especially是副词，相当于in particular“尤其；特别”，在句中通常作状语，用来加强语气，后面常跟要强调的内容。例如：I love the country, especially in spring.我喜爱乡村，尤其是在春天。

questions.prompt: We Chinese people usually clean and  ______  our houses before Spring Festival.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们中国人通常在春节前打扫和装饰我们的房子。 考查动词辨析。decorate装饰，decoration是其名词形式，decorates是其三单形式，decorating是其动名词形式。and连接并列结构，前后词性相同；clean打扫，动词；根据句意结构，可知需用原形动词，故选A。

questions.prompt: The  ______  of the word is still obscure (尚不清楚); people believe it was first used from the 17th century.
questions.explanation: 句意：单词的来源仍然不清楚，人们认为这个单词第一次被使用是从17世纪开始的。 考查名词的辨析。surface表面；medium媒介；aquarium鱼缸；origin起源。根据“the word”可知此处指的是单词的“起源，来源”，用名词origin。故选D。 二、完形填空：阅读短文，从各题所给的四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Modern inventions, such as trains and lights, make our everyday lives easier,  ______ 36 ______  many of these inventions cause troubles also. One thing is they use up natural resources (资源). Cars burn gas to get us where we want to go. This pollutes (污染) the air. Electric heat and light make our homes  ______ 37 ______, but they also burn up coal and oil. We need factories, but factory waste pollutes our waterways. It seems terrible, right? However, experts (专家) believe that  ______ 38 ______  the way we live may be good for our planet's health in the future. We can use cleaner energy and less chemicals as we build the towns of tomorrow. Here are some ideas and predictions (猜测) that will probably  ______ 39 ______  our planet a cleaner place to live in. Work and Transportation (交通) More and more people will be working in their  ______ 40 ______  using computers and satellite receivers, without going outside. Today, more electric trains are being built, and new hydrogen-power (氢动力) and electric cars are being developed. In the future, most cars will probably use this. Shopping and entertainment may be as close as a ride  ______ 41 ______  an Earth-friendly bicycle. Food We will grow  ______ 42 ______, grains, and vegetables close to our home, either in our gardens or on nearby organic (有机的) farms. The farms  ______ 43 ______  use chemicals (化学物质) to control pests. Instead, different kinds of insects will stop harmful bugs. That will help keep chemicals out of our food. Energy Energy from windmills (风车) and solar panels (太阳能电池板) is available now to some homeowners. In the future, every home will probably use this kind of energy. Rooftop (屋顶) solar panels will help make hydrogen (氢) from  ______ 44 ______. Our appliances (电器) will run on this gas. At  ______ 45 ______, hydrogen will be turned into electricity or light.

questions.prompt: Miss Yang teaches  ______  English this year.
questions.explanation: 句意：王老师今年教我们英语。 考查代词辨析。we我们，人称代词主格；us我们，人称代词宾格；our我们的，形容词性物主代词；ours我们的，名词性物主代词。空格前teach是动词，后接人称代词宾格作宾语，所以空格处填us。故选B。

questions.prompt: Lucy is good at playing  ______  violin and she wants to join the music club.
questions.explanation: 句意：Lucy小提琴拉得很好，她想加入音乐俱乐部。 考查冠词用法。a/an为不定冠词，表示泛指；the为定冠词，表示特指。violin小提琴，为乐器名词， play the ＋乐器，中间必须加定冠词the，故答案选B。

questions.prompt: Lily can’t go out for dinner  ______  school nights.
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉不能在上学的晚上出去吃晚饭。 考查介词辨析。on用于具体某一天；in用于一段时间；to表示差几分到下一个钟点；at用于具体时间点。 school nights上学的晚上，是具体某一天，用介词on，on school nights在上学的晚上，故答案选A。

questions.prompt: Bruce always  ______  his teeth at 6:15 every morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：布鲁斯总是在每天早上6:15刷牙。 考查动词时态。brush刷，动词原形，主语是复数；brushes一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数；is brushing现在进行时，主语是单数；are brushing现在进行时，主语是复数；根据题干中的always可知句子时态用一般现在时，主语Bruce是第三人称单数，所以谓语动词也要用第三人称单数形式，故答案选B。

questions.prompt: Don’t forget  ______  the dishes after dinner.
questions.explanation: 句意：别忘了饭后洗碗。 考查动词非谓语。do做，动词原形；doing动名词或现在分词；does第三人称单数；to do动词不定式。forget to do sth.忘记做某事，为固定搭配，故答案选D。

questions.prompt: ______  these tigers  ______  from?
questions.explanation: 句意：这些老虎来自于哪里？ 考查特殊疑问句。where哪里，what什么。由句意和选项，可判断本题考查come from和be from句子变成疑问的区别，疑问副词要用where，因此不选B。由于come 为实义动词，主语为复数，变疑问句要在句首加do，因此不选C。有be动词，变疑问句要提到主语前，因此不选A，故答案选D。

questions.prompt: I like koalas because they are  ______  friendly.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢考拉，因为它们有点友好的。 考查副词短语。a kind of一种、一类，后接名词；kind of有点、稍许，用来修饰形容词或副词的原级，相当于a little或a bit；kinds of各种各样的，用来修饰名词，通常会和all、different或基数词等连用；a kind没有这种用法。根据I like koalas because they are  ______  friendly. 可知是我喜欢考拉，因为它们有点友好的，kind of修饰形容词friendly，故答案选B。

questions.prompt: We are in the library. Please  ______  quiet.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们在图书馆。请保持安静。 考查动词辨析。is是，主语第三人称单数；do做，动词原形；be是，动词原形；are是，主语是复数。根据题干：quiet是形容词，前面要用系动词be，please后面要用动词原型，故答案选C。

questions.prompt: He’s never  ______  class.
questions.explanation: 句意：他上课从来不迟到。 考查形容词短语。late迟到、晚的，be late for因……而迟到，固定词组；arrive到达、抵达，后面常接at或者in；根据句意可知是他上课从不迟到，应用be late for，故答案选A。

questions.prompt: Let’s  ______  TV, Tom.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆，让我们一起看电视。 考查非谓语动词辨析。watching动名词/现在分词；watches动词的三单形式；watch动词原形；to watch动词不定式。根据句子结构，是一个祈使句，结构为Let+宾语+动词原形+其他，所以空格处填watch。故选C。

questions.prompt: Li Lei often takes a walk early  ______  the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：李雷经常一大早去散步。 考查介词辨析。at通常指具体时刻；on指具体的某一天，或某一天早上、下午、晚上；in后跟年份、月份和季节等；for后通常跟时间段，用于现在完成时态。结合语境，此处泛指“在上午”，所以用in the morning，故答案选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is it from your home to the bookstore? — About 15 kilometers.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你家离书店有多远?——大约15公里。 考查特殊疑问词辨析。How far多远，是对距离的提问；How much多少，对不可数名词数量或价格进行提问；How long多长，是对长度或一段时间的提问；How many多少，对可数名词数量进行提问。根据答语About 15 kilometers.，可知上文对距离进行的提问，故答案选A。

questions.prompt: — Why do you call him Mr. Know? —  ______  he knows almost everything that we want to know.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你为什么叫他万事通先生？——因为他几乎知道我们想知道的一切。 考查连词辨析。so因此，所以，引导原因状语从句，不能和because连用；or或者，并列连词，表示选择关系；but但是，表转折关系；because因为，引导原因状语从句，回答why提问的句子。故选D

questions.prompt: — Let’s meet at my home at six. We can eat out. —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们六点在家见。我们可以出去吃。——到时见。 考查情景交际。根据语境及常识可知，约好时间后的答语通常是“See you then”，结合选项，只有A符合句意，故选A。 五、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Tens of thousands of  ______ 15 ______  returned to school in Shanghai and Beijing on Monday (April 27) after months of closures to curb the spread of the coronavirus, as China’s major cities  ______ 16 ______  return to normality. Shanghai students in their final year of middle and high school returned to classrooms, while only high-school seniors in Beijing were allowed back  ______ 17 ______  campus to prepare for the “gaokao” (university entrance exam). China has largely curbed the spread of the deadly disease, but is still on  ______ 18 ______  alert (警戒), with growing fears of imported cases and a  ______ 19 ______  wave of domestic infections in the northeast. Teenager Meng Xianghao said he was taking extra precautions on his first day back at Beijing’s Chenjinglun High School. “I haven’t been out since the outbreak of the epidemic. I brought masks, garbage bags and disinfectant,” Meng, who had just taken the subway for the first time in  ______ 20 ______. Students are eager to go back to school. “I’m glad. It’s been too long since I’ve seen my classmates,” said 18-year-old student Hang Huan. “I’ve missed them  ______ 21 ______.” “At school, there’s a certain atmosphere for learning  ______ 22 ______  at home, there is not,” said Wang Yuchen, a 17-year-old student. Students in the capital will have their temperatures measured at school gates and  ______ 23 ______  show a “green” health code on a special app that calculates (评估) a infection risk, according to China’s Ministry of Education. And in some cafeterias, students are assigned fixed seating spots spaced at least 1m apart. Beijing student Xiao Shuhan said he thought some form of social distancing would  ______ 24 ______  even as classmates and friends reunite. “We’ll no longer put our arms around each other’s shoulders,” he said.

questions.prompt: Jenny and Gina  ______  good friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：珍妮和吉娜是好朋友。 根据句意理解及句子结构可知，句子主语是复数名词，所以句中be动词要用复数的形式，be动词的复数是are，所以选择D答案。 【点睛】be动词的单数复数形式的用法要注意。单复数取决于句子当中的主语，如果主语是单数，be动词用is，如果主语是复数，be 动词就用are，但是如果主语是I，be动词就只能用am。

questions.prompt: My father is a teacher.  ______  telephone number is 58756666.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲是一名教师。他的电话号码是58756666。 根据前句主语my father可知，这里说的是爸爸的电话，爸爸是男性，所以只能用he相关的词来代替，而句子当中说的是他的电话，英语中表达某人的要用物主代词，所以这里要用物主代词his，所以选择B答案。 【点睛】英语中人称代词翻译成某人，做主语用主格，做宾语用宾格，物主代词翻译成某人的，如果后面有名词，就用形容词物主代词，如果后面没有名词，就要用名词性的物主代词来代替，使用时要注意区分，比如说本题中句子后面有telephone电话，那就只能用形容词性的物主代词his。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is my pencil? — It’s under the chair.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的铅笔在哪里？——在椅子下面。 A. 什么；B. 哪里；C. 什么时候；D. 谁；根据句子的回答under the chair在椅子下面可知，这里表达的是地点，应该提问在哪里，所以选择B答案。 【点睛】英语中特殊疑问词的选择一定要翻译句子，句子当中翻译成什么意思就用相对应的特殊疑问词，比如本题当中根据答句：在椅子下面得知，表达的是问在哪里，英语中哪里是where，所以选择B答案。

questions.prompt: She is Mary Brown. Brown is her  ______  name.
questions.explanation: 句意：她是玛丽·布朗。布朗是她的姓。 A. 第一；B. 满的；C. 最后的；D. 中间的；英语中姓名的表达方式是名在前姓在后，所以Brown是她的性，英语中性表达为last name，所以选择C。

questions.prompt: This is my uncle and his son Ed is my  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我叔叔，他的儿子埃德是我堂弟。 A. 阿姨；B. 兄弟；C. 堂弟，表弟；D. 姐妹；根据句意理解及常识可知，叔叔的儿子只能是叫做堂弟或是表弟，父母生的孩子才能称brother，所以选择C答案。

questions.prompt: — Are  ______  your books? — Yes, they  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些是你的书吗？——是的，他们是。 根据句意理解及句子结构分析可知，第一句中动词是复数，所以主语也要用复数形式，而答句中主语是they，谓语be动词要用are，所以本题选择B。

questions.prompt: — Is this  ______  CD? — No, it isn’t. It’s  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是你的CD吗？——不，不是。这个是我们的。 根据句意理解可知。第一句问的是你的CD，空格后有名词，所以要用形容词性物主代词，而第二空指代的是我们的CD，后面没有名词，所以要用名词性物主代词，所以综合之后，本题选择D。

questions.prompt: — We need more office supplies. — Ok. Let’s  ______  a list.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们需要更多的办公用品。——好的。我们列个单子吧。 根据句意理解及句中的let's可知，英语中让某人做某事是let sb do sth，let后面接动词原形，所以选择C。

questions.prompt: — How are you, Jim? —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好吗，吉姆？——好，谢谢。根据前句问句，how are you你好吗？回答fine，thank you这是问候语的固定用法，所以选择D答案。

questions.prompt: A dictionary is always  ______  to have in the office.
questions.explanation: 句意：办公室里有一本字典总是有帮助的。 A. 有帮助的；B. 生气的；C. 坏的；D. 美丽的；根据句意理解可知，字典是一种有用的工具，英语中有用的是helpful，所以选择A答案。

questions.prompt: James like numbers. So he is good at  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个是喜欢数字，所以他擅长于数学。 A. 数学；B. 英语；C. 体育；D. 科学；根据句意理解及前句like numbers喜欢数字可知，数字是在数学当中出现的比较多，所以选择A答案。

questions.prompt: Li Ming  ______  volleyball. He only watch it on TV.
questions.explanation: 句意：李明不打排球，他只在电视上看。 根据后句only watch it on TV只在电视上看，说明他生活中并不玩这个运动，并不打排球，所以这里要用否定的形式，句子主语是名词单数，变否定要加助动词does，所以选择B。

questions.prompt: My brother is good at maths. He  ______  it is interesting.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的弟弟擅长于数学，他认为很有趣。 根据句意理解可知，这里表达的是认为，英语中想认为这种主观想法的词只能用于现在时，主语he是第三人称，动词只能用三单形式，所以选择B答案。

questions.prompt: We like to play football  ______  Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢踢足球在星期六下午。 根据句意理解可知，这里表达在周六下午，英语中具体到某一天的上下午前面要用介词on，所以这里选择C。 【点睛】时间介词in，at，on的用法要注意区别。口诀为：时间长的要用in，年代、季节和月份；具体某天要用on，几月几号，星期几；时间点时用at，包括noon和night；上下午晚上很特殊，单独出现要用in，具体描述要用on。

questions.prompt: ______  two pencils and a pen on the desk?
questions.explanation: 句意：桌子上有两支铅笔和一支钢笔吗？ 根据句意理解及句子结构可知，这里表达某地有某物，英语中用there be结构，而句中and并列前面部分是复数名词，所以be动词用复数形式，而there be疑问句直接把ne动词提前，所以这里选择D。 【点睛】there be句型中be动词的用法遵循就近原则，也就是be动词的单复数取决于离它最近的名词，比如：There are some books and some water on the table.中有两部分主语，一部分是some books，另一部分是some water，be动词要按照离最近的some books一致，所以要用are。英语中可以就近原则的词还有neither……nor，either……or，not only……but also。 完形填空 A I’m Kate, and my sister is Gina. I’m tidy.  ______ 16 ______  Gina is not. In our room, my books and tapes are in the bookcase. My keys are in the schoolbag. I have a clock. It’s on the desk. Gina’s book are  ______ 17 ______  on her bed, on the sofa and under the chair. The white model plane is  ______ 18 ______. It’s under the desk. “Where are my keys? Where’s my pen? Where’s my schoolbag?” Gina always  ______ 19 ______.

questions.prompt: —What's this in English? —It is ______ apple.
questions.explanation: 句意：--这个用英语怎么说？ --它是一个苹果。 A. a一个，不定冠词，B. an一个，不定冠词，C. the这，定冠词，D. /零冠词。 此题考查不定冠词a/an，a 、an 是不定冠词，都表示一个，a用于辅音音素开头的单词前，an用于元音音素开头的单词前，此题中泛指一个苹果 ，apple 是以元音音素开头的单词，应该用an；故选B。

questions.prompt: —How  ______  you? —I  ______  fine, thanks.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好吗？——我很好，谢谢！ 考查主谓一致。问句中主语you，所以用系动词are，答句主语I，所以空处用系动词am，与形容词fine“好”构成系表结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you do? —I'm a driver.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你是做什么的？——我是个司机。 考查特殊疑问句。A. How怎样；B. Where什么地方；C. Why为什么；D. What什么，根据答语I'm a driver.“我是个司机”，可知上句在寻问职业，What do you do?表示询问职业“你是做什么的？”故选D。

questions.prompt: This is  ______  room.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是Lucy和Lily的房间。 考查名词所有格。A. Lucy's and Lily 表示“Lucy的和Lily”；B. Lucy and Lily's表示两个人共用的；C. Lucy's and Lily's表示Lucy和Lily各自有的；D. Lucy and Lily表示“Lucy和Lily两个人”，通过题意可知，room是单数形式，所以应该是Lucy和Lily共用的，不应该是各自的。故选B。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a girl and three boys in the room.
questions.explanation: 句意：房间里有一个女孩和三个男孩。 考查主谓一致。根据选项都是系动词，可知此句型为there be句型，其主谓一致遵循就近原则，空后a girl“一个女孩”为单数名词，所以用系动词单数形式is，故选B。 【点睛】There be句型的就近原则是主谓一致语法的考点。There be句型中be动词的单复数形式由后面挨近的一项的单复数决定。 如：There is a pen，two books and many pencils on the desk. 在本句中尽管有钢笔、书和铅笔，但是由于离be动词最近的一项是单数a pen，因此be动词用单数is。 又如：有一本书和三只猫。There is a book and three cats. 反过来，有三只猫和一本书。There are three cats and a book.

questions.prompt: There is a playground  ______  the school.
questions.explanation: 句意：学校前面有一个操场。 考查介词词组。in front of 在.......的前面(物体外部）。而in the front of 在...的前面 （物体内部）。操场属于学校的一部分，属于在学校内部，故选A。 【点睛】in front of与in the front of的区别： in front of 在...（范围外）的前面 There is a tree in front of the classroom. in the front of 在...（范围内）的前面 There is a blackboard in the front of the classroom.

questions.prompt: — ______  is my coat? —It's on the bed.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的外套在哪里？——它在床上。 考查特殊疑问句。A. What什么；B. How怎样；C. Why为什么；D. Where在哪里，根据答语It's on the bed.“在床上”，可知在问“在哪儿”，所以用疑问词where，故选D。

questions.prompt: He is an English student.  ______  name is Tom.
questions.explanation: 句意：他是一名英国学生。他的名字是Tom。 考查形容词性物主代词辨析。A. His他的；B. Her她的；C. My我的；D. Its它的，根据主语He“他”，可知“他的名字”应该为his name，故选A。

questions.prompt: Is his mother a teacher  ______  a doctor?
questions.explanation: 句意：他的妈妈是老师还是医生？ 考查连词。A. or或者；B. and和；C. with和，随着；D. but但是，根据句子中“a teacher  ______  a doctor”可知本句为选择疑问句，其结构为“一般疑问句+or+选择内容？”or“或者”连词，故选A。

questions.prompt: I haven't got  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我没有兄弟。 考查不定代词和名词单复数。A. some brothers一些兄弟；B. any brothers任何兄弟；C. brother兄或弟；D. sister姐或妹， 因为brother和sister都是可数名词，需要在前面添加冠词修饰，所以排除选项C和D，some，any修饰可数名词复数和不可数名词，但是some 常用于陈述句，any常用于疑问句和否定句，根据hasn't got，可知本句为否定句，所以用any修饰brothers，故选B。 【点睛】名词一般不单独存在，需要在前面添加冠词修饰，冠词就是名词的一顶帽子。可数名词的单数，一般加a、an、the三类冠词，a、an表示“泛指一个”，the表示特指“这个”，但是也有不加冠词的名词，即专有名词，如城市(Beijing、Shanghai等)，部分专有名词(如太阳，the Sun)是要加冠词the，作用是特指。

questions.prompt: Mike and Tom are good  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：Mike和Tom是好朋友。 考查名词单复数。A. friends朋友（复数）；B. friend朋友；C. student学生；D. a friend一个朋友，BC选项中的friend和student为可数名词的单数，需要在前面添加冠词修饰，所以排除BC选项，根据系动词are，可知空处用名词复数形式，故选A。
句意：让我们来帮你。 考查代词宾格。A. I我（主格），you你（主宾格）；B. me我（宾格）， your你的（物主代词）；C. we我们（主格），your你的（物主代词）；D. us我们（宾格），you（主宾格），句中let“让”使动词，后面跟代词宾格形式，help“帮助”动词，后面也跟代词宾格形式，由此可知，两个空都用宾格形式，故选D。

questions.prompt: Most children like sport, so they like having ______  classes.
questions.explanation: 句意：大多数孩子喜欢运动，所以他们喜欢上体育课。 考查名词辨析 。A. geography地理；B. art美术；C. PE体育；D. history历史，根据Most children like sport“大多数孩子喜欢运动”，可知他们喜欢上体育课。故选C。

questions.prompt: Jenny hasn't got  ______  brothers or sisters.
questions.explanation: 句意：珍妮没有兄弟姐妹。 考查不定代词。A. some一些；B. any任何；C. much许多；D. a little一点儿，“brothers or sisters” 兄弟姐妹，为名词复数，much和 a little 修饰不可数名词，所以排除选项C和D，some，any修饰可数名词复数和不可数名词，但是some 常用于陈述句，any常用于疑问句和否定句，根据hasn't got，可知本句为否定句，所以用any修饰brothers or sisters，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What's your father? — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你父亲是做什么的？——一名经理。 考查特殊疑问句。A. A manager一名经理；B. About forty大约四十；C. He's old他老了；D. He's at home他在家，因为What's your father?是询问职业，结合选项，可知A manager一名经理符合句意，故选A。

questions.prompt: Do you like  ______  books?
—Nice to meet you. — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——很高兴见到你。——遇见您我也很高兴。 考查交际用语。A. And you.你呢；B. Thank you!谢谢；C. Nice to meet you, too. 遇见您我也很高兴；D. Fine, thank you.很好，谢谢，当别人说Nice to meet you时，我们经常用Nice too meet you, too来作回应，故选C。

questions.prompt: My car is  ______  John's.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的车和John的一样。 考查固定搭配。same表示“相同的”“同样的”等，通常与定冠词连用，表示“与……一样”，要用固定搭配 the same as，根据句意“我的车和John的一样。故选B。”

questions.prompt: There are many  ______  on the table.
questions.explanation: 句意：桌子上有许多西红柿。 考查名词复数。A. tomato西红柿；B. tomatoes西红柿复数形式；C. tomatos错误形式；D. beef牛肉，many“许多”，修饰可数名词复数形式，beef“牛肉”不可数名词，所以排除选项D，tomato的复数形式为tomatoes，故选B。

questions.prompt: Our school sports meeting will start  ______  Saturday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校的运动会将于星期六上午开始。 考查介词辨析。A. on在…之时；B. at在（某时间或时刻）；C. in在…之内；D. to朝着，向，根据morning前的限定词Saturday，可知为“星期六上午”，表示某一天的上午用介词on，故选A。 【点睛】morning，afternoon，evening 这些都是专有名词，表示早上，中午，晚上，此时为不可数名词；但当它们前面有了限定词，表示“在一个…的早上/中午/晚上”时为可数名词，此时前面常用介词on。如： 介词＋a/an＋形容词＋morning/afternoon/evening． on a cold morning在一个寒冷早上 on Monday evenings在每个周一的晚上 完形填空 根据短文内容， A 从方框中选出恰当的词完成短文内容。 forest, train, England, yellow, wind People travel to see autumn's colourful leaves. Many people visit the Northeastern United States, Canada, Japan and ______ 21 ______. People especially enjoy ______ 22 ______ tours in autumn. The train takes them through the ______ 23 ______. They can see the bright fall colours from the train. People write poems to describe autumn. Here is one: Leaves are falling all around. Red and gold, ______ 24 ______ and brown. A chilly wind blows them here and there. The feeling of autumn is in the air. 【答案】21. England

questions.prompt: — Are you often late for school? — No, ______. I go to school early every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你经常上学迟到吗？——不，从不迟到，我每天早早去上学。 考查副词辨析。always总是；usually通常；sometimes有时候；never从不。根据答句中“I go to school early every day.”可知，我每天早早去上学，所以此处是“我从不迟到”，所以此处用副词never。故选D。 【点睛】本题中考查的是频度副词的用法，always（总是），usually（通常），often（经常），sometimes（有时候），seldom（很少），never（从不）均为频度副词，表示事情发生的频率，从左至右，表示的频率依次降低，本题中考查的是never的用法。

questions.prompt: —May I speak to Mr. Black? —Sorry. He ______ a class. Please call him later.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以和布莱克先生讲话吗？——对不起，他正在上课，请稍后给他打电话。 考查现在进行时。have进行（课、活动等），has是have的第三人称单数形式，having是have的现在分词形式；is having正在进行（课、活动等）。根据答句中“Please call him later.”可知，请稍后给他打过来，因为他现在正在上课，所以使用现在进行时，结构为be doing，结合选项可知，此处使用is having。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Do you often play  ______  soccer with your friends? —No,I don’t like sports, I often play  ______  piano in my free time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你经常和你的朋友踢足球吗？——不，我不喜欢运动，我经常在空闲时间弹钢琴。 考查冠词的用法。a，不定冠词，表示泛指，用于辅音之前；the，定冠词，表示特指；/，零冠词。在球类运动前，不加任何冠词，故空一不填冠词；在乐器前必须加定冠词the，故空二应填the。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______ she ______ lunch at school? —Yes, she  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——她在学校吃午饭吗？——是的。 考查一般疑问句和动词形式。do作为助动词时无实际意义，用于实义动词前构成疑问句，也可以代替实义动词以避免重复，does是do的第三人称单数形式；have吃（饭），has是have的第三人称单数形式。根据回答部分yes，可知此处是一般疑问句，主语she是第三人称单数形式，所以用助动词does，主语she后面的动词使用原形have；答句中是肯定回答，即She has lunch at school.此时为了避免动词has重复，可以用does代替。故选D。

questions.prompt: Kate’s mother never ______ late because she thinks ______ up is bad for her health.
questions.explanation: 句意：凯特的妈妈从不熬夜，因为她认为熬夜对她的健康有害。 考查主谓一致和动名词作主语。stay up熬夜，stays是stay的第三人称单数形式，staying是stay的动名词形式。句中主语Kate’s mother是第三人称单数形式，所以动词应使用第三人称单数形式，所以排除A和B；根据句中“she thinks”可知，she是主语，thinks是谓语，此处需要宾语，可以用宾语从句来充当宾语，宾语从句中从句部分的主语可以用动名词，所以第二空使用staying。故选D。

questions.prompt: It’s 5:45. We ______ candles on the cake.
questions.explanation: 句意：5点45了，我们正在往蛋糕上放蜡烛。 考查现在进行时。put放置，puts是put的第三人称单数形式，putting是put的动名词形式；are putting正在放。根据第一局中“It’s 5:45.”可知，此处的时间是5点45，所以放蜡烛这件事情是此时此刻正在发生，应使用现在进行时，结构为be doing，结合选项可知，此处使用are putting。故选C。

questions.prompt: The students ______ to the farm and help the farmer every spring.
questions.explanation: 句意：学生们每年春天都去农场帮助农民。 考查一般现在时。are going to打算去；go去；went是go的过去式；will go将要去。根据句中“every spring”可知，学生们去农场帮忙是经常发生的事情，应使用一般现在时，主语是students，所以此处使用动词go。故选B。 【点睛】本题考查的是一般现在时的用法，一般现在时表示我们经常做的事情、目前的爱好、能力等以及不受时限的客观事实，根据人称和数的不同，行为动词有原形和第三人称单数形式两种。例如：We have lunch at school. He plays football everyday.

questions.prompt: I often get up ______ six ______ Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常在星期天早上六点起床。 考查介词辨析。about关于；at在（某时刻）；on在（某一天）；with用。句中six是表示具体时刻，所以第一空使用介词at；句中Sunday morning表示具体某一天的早上，所以第二空使用介词on。故选B。 【点睛】本题中考查时间介词的使用，at用在年龄、具体时刻前，on用在日期、星期、具体一天中的早上、下午或晚上；in用在世纪、年份、月份以及早上、中午或晚上。例如：at the age of 16在16岁的时候；on a cold morning在一个寒冷的早晨；in 2020在2020年。

questions.prompt: ______ you are hungry, you can have lunch in the restaurant.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你饿了，你可以在餐厅吃午饭。 考查连词辨析。And并且；If如果；But但是；Or否则。根据句中“you can have lunch in the restaurant”可知，此处是“如果你饿了，可以在餐厅吃饭”，所以此处使用if。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______ do you go running? —Every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久跑一次步？——每天。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长（时间或距离）；How far多远；How often多久一次；How much多少。根据答句部分“Every day.”可知，此处是回答跑步的频率，提问频率使用how often。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______ you ______ a picture? —Yes. I am drawing a horse.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你正在画画吗？——是的，我正在画一匹马。 考查现在进行时的一般疑问句。do助动词；draw画画，drawing是draw的动名词形式；are是。根据答句中“Yes. I am drawing a horse.”可知，此处是现在进行时，并且问句为一般疑问句，现在进行时结构为be doing，结合选项可知此处使用are和drawing。故选C。 【点睛】现在进行时结构为be doing，表示“某人正在做某事”，可以表示说话时正在进行或发生的动作，也可以表示当前一段时间内的活动或现阶段正在进行的动作。例如：We are waiting for you here. We are working hard this term.现在进行时变成一般疑问句时，将be动词提至句首即可，例如：Are you waiting for me here?

questions.prompt: He’s very hungry. Please give him ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：他非常饿，请给他两片面包。 考查不可数名词的数量表达。two pieces of bread两片面包；two bread，two piece of bread， two pieces of breads表述错误。bread是不可数名词，表示数量时不能直接在名词前加基数词，也不能在名词后加s，所以排除A和D；piece是可数名词，意为“块，片”，其前面的基数词为two，所以此处使用pieces，所以排除B。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Kate, you look so tired. What’s the matter? —I ______ well last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：——凯特，你看起来如此累，怎么了？——昨天晚上我没有睡好。 考查一般过去时和实义动词的否定。didn’t sleep没有睡觉，时态为一般过去时；don’t sleep没有睡觉，时态为一般现在时；haven’t slept没有睡觉，时态为现在完成时；wasn’t sleep表述错误。根据答句中“last night”可知，句中时态为一般过去时，所以排除B和C；sleep是实义动词，变成否定形式时要在前面加don’t或didn’t，所以D项错误。故选A。

questions.prompt: Look at those clouds. It ______ soon, I’m afraid.
questions.explanation: 句意：看那些云，恐怕很快就要下雨了。 考查一般将来时。rain下雨；is raining正在下雨；will rain将要下雨；rains是rain的第三人称单数形式。根据句中soon可知，此处是描述将来发生的事情，应使用一般将来时，结构为will do。故选C。 二．完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I live in Mexico. In my country, corn（玉米）is my favourite food. We use it to make many kinds of food. Most  ______ 15 ______  eat a tortilla. It is my  ______ 16 ______ meal because my mother makes delicious food. Dinner is the time that the family sits at table. Sometimes we have tamales(玉米粉蒸肉). Tamales come from corn and banana with some chicken. Many Mexican ______ 17 ______  wear white T-shirts and pants. Sometimes, they wear hats called “sombreros”. The sombreros keep them from the sun and rain. The women in Mexico usually ______ 18 ______ skirts and blouses. Sports here are fun! They are ______ 19 ______  things to see! Our favourite sport is soccer! My father sometimes  ______ 20 ______  me to watch soccer games. We can have a good time then. We have seven to ten people in a ______ 21 ______. The mother usually does the cooking and the cleaning. I’m glad that I’m only fourteen, or I have to ______ 22 ______  my room. That’s what I’m talking about!

questions.prompt: —Is this your brother, Alice? —Yes.  ______  name is Harry.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是你弟弟吗，爱丽丝？——是的。他叫哈里。 考查形容词性物主代词，A. My我的；B. Your你（们）的；C. His他的；D. Her她的。观察句子，这里指代的是“your brother你的兄弟”，那么应该是“他的”，故选C。

questions.prompt: We have four lessons  ______  the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们上午有四节课。 考查时间介词，A. in+年/月/日/季节或早晨、下午和晚上；B. on+具体的某一天上午或下午；C. at+具体时间短；D. for+一段时间。这里是固定用法“in the morning上午”，符合语法，故选A。 【点睛】In，on和at在表达时间方面的区别 in+年、月、季节;泛指在上午，下午，晚上，如：in the morning(afternoon，evening) in spring 在春季 in September 在九月 on指在某一天或某一天上午，下午，晚上，具体到某一天、节日 如：on Monday，on Sunday afternoon，on July 1，1999 on New Year’s Day at，一般表示点时间，如at six o’clock, at three thirty. 习惯用法：at night，at noon, 注意：在英语中，如果时间名词前用this，last，next 等修饰时，像这样表示，“在某时”的时间短语前，并不需要任何介词。 例如：last month 在上个月 this year在今年 next year在明年。

questions.prompt: Too much sugar  ______  bad for our teeth.
questions.explanation: 句意：过多的糖对我们的牙齿有害。 考查be动词用法，A. be原形；B. am主语为第一人称单数；C. is主语为单数或不可数名词；D. are主语为复数，主语为“sugar 不可数名词”，谓语应该用is，故选C。 【点睛】Be动词用法口诀： 我用am，你用are，is连接他，她，它。 单数名词用is，复数名词全用are。变疑问，往前提，句末问号莫丢弃。 变否定，更容易，be后not莫忘记。疑问否定任你变，句首大写莫迟疑。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you play computer games, Lily? —I only play on Friday night.
questions.explanation: 句意：——莉莉，你什么时候玩电脑游戏？——我只在周五晚上玩。 考查疑问词，A. How怎样；B. Where哪里；C. Why为什么；D. When何时。结合回答，应该是对时间的提问，故选D。

questions.prompt: I like chocolate,  ______  I don't eat a lot.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢巧克力，但我吃得不多。 考查连词，A. and和，表并列；B. but但是，表转折；C. because因为，表原因；D. or或者，表选择，观察句子前后逻辑应该是虽然喜欢但是不多吃，故选B。

questions.prompt: My father likes  ______ football matches on TV.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爸爸喜欢在电视上看足球比赛。 考查非谓语，A. watch动词原形；B. watching动名词以及现在分词；C. watches动词三单形式；D. to watching中to是介词，后接doing形式。根据like to do sth则常指某个具体的动作，表示偶尔一次喜欢做某事、或者突然喜欢干某事；like doing sth表示长时间的喜欢做某事，是向来都喜欢的，指兴趣爱好。在意义上比较一般和抽象，时间观念不强。结合句意，故选B。

questions.prompt: Tony often  ______  to the library after lunch.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼经常在午饭后去图书馆。 考查动词时态，A. goes动词三单形式；B. go动词原形；C. going动词现在分词；D. is going现在进行时。观察句子，这里表示经常性的行为，应该用一般现在时，由于主语为he，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Where is Tony? I can't find him. —Look, he  ______  photos over there.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼在哪里？我找不到他。——看，他在那边拍照。 考查动词时态，A. take动词原形；B. takes动词三单形式；C. is taking现在进行时；D. taking现在分词以及动名词。根据look可知，这里对话表示正在进行的动作，应该用现在进行时，故选C。 选词填空 用方框中所给单词的适当形式补全短文。 drink magazine Chinese sister breakfast hard cinema walk Hello, my name is Ann. I live in a large house in London. I have two  ______ 9 ______. They are called Rosa and Maria. I usually get up at seven o'clock every morning, and I have some bread and milk for  ______ 10 ______. I leave home at eight and  ______ 11 ______  to school. I finish classes at three every day, and I get home at half past three. This month I work very  ______ 12 ______  for my exams (考试). It's eight o'clock on Saturday morning now. Rosa and I are having breakfast, my mother  ______ 13 ______ coffee, and Maria is reading a  ______ 14 ______. On Saturday afternoons I play tennis with my friends, or I go to the  ______ 15 ______. Today, I'm going to see a new film. Sometimes I watch  ______ 16 ______  films on the computer. It's a good way to learn Chinese. 【答案】9. sisters

questions.prompt: Mary lives far from school. It takes ______  a long time to go to school every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：Mary住的离学校远。每天去上学花费她很长时间。 考查代词辨析。she她，人称代词主格；her她（的），人称代词宾格或形容词性物主代词；he他，人称代词主格；him他，人称代词宾格。“takes”是动词，其后接人称代词宾格，排除AC；“Mary”是女名，用her而不用him，排除D。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tony enjoys  ______  football in the sports club.
questions.explanation: 句意：Tony喜欢在运动俱乐部踢足球。 考查非谓语动词。enjoy doing sth.喜欢做某事，此处用动名词playing作宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______   ______  is it from your home to school. —About three kilometers.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从你家到学校有多远。 ——大约三公里。 考查特殊疑问句。How far多远，询问距离远近；How long 多长，提问距离长度；How old多大，提问年龄。根据“About three kilometers.”大约三公里。可知，问的是距离远近。故选A。 【点睛】（1）how far 表示“多远”对距离的提问，如: —How far is your home from school? 你家离学校有多远？ —My house is three miles from school. 我家里学校有三英里。 （2）how long 对从某个时刻都另一时刻（各时态皆可）间的时间长短提问，但后跟的谓语动词必须为延续性动词，回答为 for+一段时间。也用作对长短提问。 如：—How long did he be away? (leave为短暂性动词,故换为短语be away) —For ten years. （3）how old主要用来询问年龄。如：How old is Mr. Wang? 王先生多大年龄？

questions.prompt: — ______  you play the violin? —No. But I can play the piano.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会拉小提琴吗？——不。但我会弹钢琴。 考查情态动词。May可能；Can能，会；Must必须；Should应该。根据答句中“But I can play the piano.”可知此处是问会不会拉小提琴，用Can符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: Listen! The boy  ______ online class in the next room
questions.explanation: 句意：听，那个男孩正在隔壁房间上网课。考查时态。由“listen”可知，用现在进行时态，结构是be doing，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where is Supermarket? —Go along Center Street and it’s  ______  your right.
questions.explanation: 句意：——超市在哪里？——沿着中央大街走，它就在你的右边。 考查介词辨析。at在（某处）；for为了；in在……里；on（表示方向）在，向，对。根据空后“your right”可知此处表示在右边，是方向，用介词on符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: He usually  ______  some reading in the evening, but he  ______  sports yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：他通常在晚上做一些阅读，但他昨天晚上做运动。 考查时态辨析。根据“usually”可知并列句前半句用一般现在时，主语“He”是第三人称单数，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式does；再由“yesterday evening”可知并列句后半句用一般过去时，动词用过去式played。故选C。

questions.prompt: I’m hungry. I would like  ______  a large bowl of porridge.
questions.explanation: 句意：我饿了。我想要吃一大碗粥。 考查非谓语动词。would like to do sth.愿意做某事，想要做某事。此处用动词不定式to eat作宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: My best friend  ______  eats breakfast because he always gets up late.
questions.explanation: 句意：我最好的朋友从不吃早餐，因为他总是起床晚。 考查频度副词。never从不；always总是；often经常；sometimes有时。根据题干中“because he always gets up late”可知起床晚，由此可推出从不吃早餐，用never符合语境。故选A。

questions.prompt: —I want to go to the park with my parents this weekend. — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个周末我想和我的父母去公园。——玩得愉快。 考查情景交际。Thank you谢谢你；Good luck祝你好运；Here you are给你；Have a good time玩得愉快。根据“I want to go to the park with my parents this weekend.”可知对方周末要去公园玩，应该祝对方玩得愉快。故选D。 四、短文填空 阅读下列短文，根据所学内容填空。 I live in a  ______ 11 ______  neighborhood. There is a post office  ______ 12 ______  my house and a clothes store. But my favorite place is the  ______ 13 ______. It’s very  ______ 14 ______  and I enjoy  ______ 15 ______  there. When I read books, time  ______ 16 ______  quickly! You can get to the library  ______ 17 ______. Just go down North Road and turn left. It is across from the park. 【答案】11. noisy

questions.prompt: My mother is busy these days, so I often help  ______ with housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈最近很忙，所以我经常帮她做家务。 考查人称代词宾格。her她；him他；me我；you你，四个单词都是人称代词宾格。根据主语My mother is busy these days可知，帮助的对象是my mother，所以用her代替。故选A。

questions.prompt: My grandmother often takes a walk early  ______ the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我奶奶经常一大早散步。 考查介词辨析。at表示某时刻；on后接具体星期，日期，和具体某天的上下午，晚上；in后接月份，年份，季节以及上下午晚上。for为了，给。根据题意“我奶奶经常一大早散步”，不是特定的早上，故用in。故选C。

questions.prompt: Follow the teachers' instructions,  ______  you may get hurt when exercising.
questions.explanation: 句意：遵照老师的指示做，否则你在运动的时候会受伤。 考查连词。so因此；or否则；but但是；and和。根据句意可知前后两句有选择关系，要么遵照指示，要么受伤。故选B。

questions.prompt: Amy can help her mother  ______ housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米可以帮她妈妈做家务。 考查介词。with有；具有；to向，朝；for为了；in在…内。此处是help sb. with sth.：帮助（某人）（一起做）某事。其中的with是介词，其后接名词或代词。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  she sing English songs? —Yes, she can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——她会唱英语歌吗？——是的，她会。 考查情态动词的用法。can能；must必须；need需要；should应该。根据回答Yes, she can.可知问句应是以情态动词can开头，可以简单记忆为can问can回答。故选A。

questions.prompt: Mary  ______  to school on foot every morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽每早上步行上学。 考查一般现在时。根据时间状语every morning可知此空应用一般现在时态，主语Mary是第三人称单数，所以谓语动词用第三人称单数，故选B。

questions.prompt: Carla asked us  ______ the magic club yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天卡拉要我们加入魔术俱乐部。 考查非谓语动词。joins动词单数形式；join动词原形；to join动词不定式；joining动名词；ask sb. to do sth.要求某人做某事，不定式做宾补；故选C。

questions.prompt: He can play  ______. And he can play  ______, too.
questions.explanation: 句意：他会打篮球。他也会弹钢琴。 考查冠词。从文字的表层意思可知空格1指打篮球，表球类前，不用任何冠词，所以排除B、C；演奏西洋乐器名词前，用定冠词，所以排除D；故选A。

questions.prompt: She is a great swimmer and she  ______ swimming.
questions.explanation: 句意：她游泳很棒，而且擅长游泳。 考查形容词短语辨析。is good to 对……友好； is good with善于应付……； is good at 擅长……； is good for对……有益。根据文中“She is a great swimmer”可知，这里是说她擅长游泳。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is it from your home to our school? —About 3 km.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从你家到我们学校多远？——大约3千米。 考查疑问词辨析。how much 多少钱，答语应该是价格；how soon 多久，答语应该是in+时间段；how far 多远，问的是距离；how long 多长，答语可以是时间段或者物体的长度。根据句意，需用多远，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______ does Emma go to work every day? —By bike.
questions.explanation: 句意：——艾玛每天怎么上班？——骑自行车。 考查疑问词。what什么，问事或物；how怎样，问方式；when什么时候，问时间；why为什么，问原因；根据答语“By bike”骑自行车；推断空格是问上班的方式；故选B。

questions.prompt: —Mr. Yang, must I hand in my writing this afternoon? —No, you  ______. You can hand it in tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杨老师，今天下午我必须交上我的写作吗？——不，你不必，你可以明天上午交。 考查情态动词。shouldn’t不应该；can’t不能；wouldn’t将不；needn’t不必要；must引导的一般疑问句，否定回答用needn't；故选D。

questions.prompt: We saw some people  ______ in the park in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：早上，我们看到一些人在公园里锻炼。 考查固定搭配。exercise锻炼，动词。saw是see的过去式，“看见、看到”，其常用结构：see sb. doing sth.看到某人正在做某事，表示动作正在进行。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What a nice silk scarf! —Thanks. My aunt  ______  for me last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：——多漂亮的丝巾啊！——谢谢，我阿姨去年给我买的。 考查时态。buys一般现在时态（主语单三）；bought一般过去时态；has bought现在完成时态；will buy一般将来时态；根据last year去年，可知用一般过去时态；故选B。

questions.prompt: He  ______ at 6:00 every afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：他每天六点种回到家。 考查主谓一致，get home回家。根据时间every afternoon每天下午，可判断是一般现在时，回家是get home，不加介词，主语是He，所以谓语动词get用单三形式加s。故选C。

questions.prompt: I have to practice  ______ the guitar before dinner.
questions.explanation: 句意：晚饭前我不得不练习弹吉他。 考查非谓语动词。playing动名词；plays动词单数；played过去式；play动词原形； practice doing sth.练习做某事，动名词作宾语；故选A。

questions.prompt: —Where  ______ the pandas  ______? —China.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些熊猫来自哪里？——中国。 考查动词短语和时态。are from来自……；do …from形式错误，from是一个介词，应为do...come from；are coming from是现在进行时。本句是特殊疑问句，后面跟一般疑问句。be from和come from都可以表示来自……，be from的一般疑问句需要把be动词提前，而come　from的一般疑问句需要借助助动词do或does，本句主语the pandas是复数，要借助助动词do，后面跟动词原形，可知B和C错误。这句话表示的是客观事实，应用一般现在时，故选A。

questions.prompt: I don’t like this TV program. It’s  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不喜欢这个电视节目，它是无聊的。 考查形容词词义辨析。A. fun 乐趣； B. difficult 困难的； C. boring 无聊的； D. relaxing放松的。因为前面叙述的是不喜欢这个节目，所以应该是节目应该是无聊的。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______ do they kill elephants? —Because they kill them  ______ their ivory.
questions.explanation: 句意：——他们为什么杀大象？——因为他们为了象牙杀了它们。 考查特殊疑问句、介词辨析。What什么，问事或物；why为什么，问原因；on在……上面；for为、给……，表动作的对象、原因；根据答语“Because they kill them…”判断空格1是为什么，疑问词用why；从文字的表层意思可知空格2指为了象牙杀了它们，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where is your father? —He  ______ the World Cup in the living room.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你爸爸在哪里？——他在客厅看世界杯。 考查时态。is watching现在进行时态；watching动名词或现在分词；watches一般现在时态（主语单三）；is watched一般现在时态被动语态；根据问爸爸在哪里，可知回答爸爸正在客厅看世界杯，所以用现在进行时态；故选A。

questions.prompt: —What’s the weather like? — ______. I can skate on the river.
questions.explanation: 句意：——天气怎么样？——天气很冷。我可以在河面上滑冰。 考查形容词词义辨析。warm温暖的，cold寒冷的，hot炎热的，cool凉爽的。由下文“我可以在河面上滑冰”可知，“天气是寒冷的”。故选B。

questions.prompt: The  ______  song can help us be  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这首轻松的歌可以帮助我们放松。relaxing“令人放松的”，常用来修饰说明物；relaxed“放松的”，常用来形容人。由此得知选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______ a pen and two books on the table.
questions.explanation: 句意：在桌子上有一只钢笔和两本书。 考查there be句型。am用于I；is用于单数和不可数名词；are用于第二人称和复数；be原形；a pen and two books一只钢笔和两本书，根据there be的动词用就近原则，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Is there a library in your school? — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你们学校有图书馆吗？ ——是的，有。 there be句型的一般疑问句的答语，只能用there be来回答；肯定：Yes, there be.；否定No, there be not. 结合选项可知 D正确。

questions.prompt: I want to have some  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想吃牛肉胡萝卜饺子。 考查名词作定语及复数形式。beef牛肉；carrot胡罗卜；dumpling饺子；这里是名词作定语用单数。beef and carrot dumpling牛肉胡萝卜饺子，some加可数名词复数。这里dumpling用复数形式。some beef and carrot dumplings一些牛肉胡萝卜饺子。故选B。

questions.prompt: He is not tall  ______ short.
questions.explanation: 句意：他不高也不矮。 考查连词的辨析。and和（常用于肯定句连接两个并列成分）；or或者，否则（常用于否定句或者疑问句）；so所以，非常。because因为。分析句意他不高也不矮，本句是否定句，连接两个成分用or。故选B。

questions.prompt: There is some  ______ on the table.
questions.explanation: 句意：桌子上有一些羊肉。 考查名词辨析。potato土豆（可数名词）；mutton羊肉（不可数名词）；tomato西红柿（可数名词）；eggs鸡蛋，复数形式；根据some，可数名词要用复数，排除A和C；根据is，主语要用不可数名词；故选B。

questions.prompt: You paid 10 yuan for  ______ this morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天上午你花了10元买了4瓶牛奶。 考查不可数名词的数量表达。milk牛奶，不可数名词，没有复数形式，排除C；bottle瓶，可数名词，4瓶用复数形式，排除A；a bottle of一瓶……；故选B。

questions.prompt: —What  ______ of dumplings do you want? —Carrot and beef dumplings.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你想要什么种类的水饺？——胡萝卜牛肉水饺。 考查名词辨析。size尺码；kind种类；bowl碗；color颜色；根据Carrot and beef dumplings胡萝卜牛肉水饺；可知问什么种类的；故选B。

questions.prompt: —Look! There a number of apples on those trees. —Wow! I think the number of the apples over 100.
questions.explanation: 句意：——看！在那些树上长着许多的苹果。——哇！我认为苹果的总数超过了100. 考查主谓一致用法。There be句型表示“某地(或某时)存在有某人(或某物)”，句中有若干个名词作主语，动词be常与后面主语中的第一个名词在数上一致。根据第一句中be后的名词是复数，所以填are。.the number of +名词复数，“……的数量”，作主语看做单数，故选C。

questions.prompt: What did you  ______ yesterday?
questions.explanation: 句意：你昨天买了什么？ 考查一般过去时。buy一般现在时、原形；bought过去式；buying动名词、现在分词；is buying现在进行时；空格在did后面，判断填动词原形；故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择可以填入空白处的最佳选项。 New Land, New Home Joe immigrated(移民) to Canada at the age of 41. There were many stressful days as he had his whole family to take care of. He rented an apartment and bought a few pieces of furniture and some cookware. Since he had no  ______ 33 ______, the savings they brought with them were diminishing(减少) rapidly. They needed to buy groceries and pay the rent After getting his family settled, Joe went out to look for a job. As he walked, he saw many things on the street that people threw away on garbage day---TVs, washers, furniture and refrigerators. Joe could not believe his eyes. “Why would people get rid of such things?” he asked himself. Seeing all the “junk”, Joe decided to take the  ______ 34 ______ home to see what the problem was. After all, he was an electrician before he came to Canada. Since he was twelve years old, Joe’s main hobby has been electronics. He assembled a radio back in the 1970s which was quite something for a  ______ 35 ______ boy. Now, he had no job and no income. All he had was time and his hobby. He plugged the television into a wall plug. There were images on the screen,  ______ 36 ______ there was no sound. He opened the back cover using the tools he’d brought with him. Before long, Joe diagnosed the  ______ 37 ______. The loudspeaker was broken. He went out again. And there was garbage placed on the sidewalk waiting to be picked up in the morning. He found a toy keyboard. He was delighted and carried the keyboard home. The keyboard didn’t  ______ 38 ______, but luckily its loudspeaker did.
