The  ______ 39 ______ was the same from everyone: repair services were too expensive. He discovered that people would rather buy new products. Joe made up his mind to open an electronics repair shop that would offer fair(公平的) prices. Today, Joe has much success in his new country. He could have lost hope. Instead, he chose to make the best out of a  ______ 40 ______ situation.

questions.prompt: This boy is my best friend，Wang Hui． ______  English name is Henry.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个男孩是我最好的朋友，王辉，他的英文名字是Henry。 考查形容词性物主代词。A. He“他”主格；B. His“他的”形容词性物主代词；C. She“她”主格；D. Her“她的”形容词性物主代词，根据This boy，可知王辉是男孩，根据句意，“他的英文名字”“他的…”用形容词性物主代词his，句首大写，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Henry,who is the girl ______ the left of your mum in this picture? —That's my cousin,Mary.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Henry，照片里在你妈妈左边的女孩是谁呀？——她是我的堂姐，玛丽。 考查介词辨析。at后跟地方表示在……；in在……里面；on在……上面；under在……下面。根据句意在左边，固定搭配on the left。故选C。

questions.prompt: My mother is ______ English teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈是一个英语老师。 考查不定冠词用法。a是不定冠词，放在辅音音素前面，表示泛指；an是不定冠词，放在元音音素前面，表示泛指；he人称代词，主格表示他。根据句意指一个英语老师，主语My mother是单数，表示一个；English首字母发元音/ ɪ /，所以用不定冠词an修饰。故选B。

questions.prompt: There ______ some water in the bottle.
questions.explanation: 句意：在瓶子里有一些水。 考查be动词的用法。There be句型表示某处有某物，be动词的形式由名词的形式决定；名词water水是不可数名词，所以只能用is修饰。故选A。

questions.prompt: Amy and her best friend often ______ books together.
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米和她最好的朋友经常一起看书。 考查动词的搭配和主谓一致。read看，后跟书籍或者杂志表示读书；look看，一般指看的动作。根据句意是看书，排除CD；主语Amy and her best friend是2个人，复数，所以动词用原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Who are  ______  two boys over there? —They are my classmates，Aaron and Ben.
questions.explanation: 句意：——那边那两个男孩是谁？——他们是我的同学，Aaron和Ben。 考查指示代词。A. this“这个”，指代较近单数名词；B. these“这些”，指代较近的复数名词；C. that“那个”，指代较远的单数名词；D. those“那些”指代较远的复数名词，over there意为“在那边”，属于较远的地方。 two boys是名词复数，指代较远的复数名词用those。故选D。

questions.prompt: November is the ______ month of a year.
questions.explanation: 句意：十一月是一年的第11个月。 考查序数词的用法。first第一；eighth第八；eleventh第十一；twelfth第十二。November是十一月，所以是第11个月。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______ are these eggs? —They are 30 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些鸡蛋多少钱？——30元。 考查短语搭配和情景交际用语。How big多大；How long时间多久；How many数量多少（可数名词）；How much数量多少（不可数名词），或者问价钱多少。根据答句可知是问价钱。故选D。

questions.prompt: My room is very tidy, ______ my sister, Gina’s is not.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的房子很干净，但是我的妹妹，吉娜的房间不是。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；or或者；\不填。根据句意我的很干净，但是妹妹的不是，表示转折关系。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Let's play computer games. —Great!That sounds ______. I like it very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们玩电脑游戏吧。——好的，那听起来很有趣，我很喜欢游戏。 考查形容词词义辨析。boring无聊的；difficult困难的；sad伤心的；interesting有趣的。根据句意，我很喜欢它，可知是有趣的意思。故选D。

questions.prompt: —When is your birthday party? —It's ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的生日派对是什么时候？——在5月24号的6点。 考查介词用法。介词at后跟时间，表示具体几点钟，6点钟前要用介词at，故排除BCD；具体的几月几号前用介词on，所以5月24号前用介词on，且时间的表达遵循从小到大的原则。故选A。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的 A,B,C,D 四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 Dear Linda, I'm happy to get your e-mail. I'm now in a new school. Let me tell you about my ______ 13 ______. My math teacher is Mr.Green. He is ______ 14 ______, so he always wears ( 穿 )a big shirt. My English teacher is Miss White. She has ______ 15 ______ English CDs. She often plays English songs in Class. My music teacher is a young man called Jack. He likes wearing a white T-shirt and his ______ 16 ______  is very cool. Mrs.Black ______ 17 ______  my science teacher. She is old, but her classes are very interesting. My P.E. teacher is Mr.Smith. He can ______ 18 ______  all kinds of balls. My favorite teacher is Miss Jones — my art teacher, because I think ______ 19 ______ is great fun. Who is your favorite teacher? Please ______ 20 ______  back to me soon. I can't wait to read it! Your friend, Alice

questions.prompt: This boy is my friend.  ______  is from England.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个男孩是我的朋友。他来自英国。 考查代词。she她，人称代词主格；he他，人称代词主格；her她/她的，人称代词宾格/形容词性物主代词；his他的，形容词性物主代词/名词性物主代词。此空在句中作主语，用人称代词主格，指代前文“this boy”，男性，故选B。

questions.prompt: We have English classes  ______  8:50 in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们早上8:50上英语课。 考查介词辨析。at其后一般加时间点；in其后一般加早中晚/季节/月份/年份等；on其后一般加星期/具体的时间；for其后一般加段时间，表示持续多长时间。根据“8:50”可知，此处加的是时间点，所以用at，故选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a big park near my home. My mum and dad like it a lot.
questions.explanation: 句意：我家附近有一个大公园。我妈妈和爸爸非常喜欢它。 考查there be结构。描述一般情况，用一般现在时；there be“有”，遵循“就近原则”，主语是“a big park”，be动词用is。故选D。

questions.prompt: My friend Tom is very  ______. He often helps me with my English.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的朋友汤姆非常友好。他经常帮助我学英语。 考查形容词词义辨析。old老；kind友好的；young年轻的；pretty漂亮的。根据“He often helps me with my English”可知他非常的友好。故选B。

questions.prompt: My mum is a good  ______. The food is yum.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的妈妈是一个好厨师。这食物很棒。 考查名词词义辨析。teacher老师；nurse护士；doctor医生；cook厨师。根据“The food is yum.”可知，妈妈是一名厨师。故选D。

questions.prompt: There is a lake near my home. I often  ______  with my dad there on weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：我家附近有一个湖。我经常在周末和我爸爸去那里钓鱼。 考查动词短语辨析。go fishing去钓鱼；watch TV看电视；play the piano弹钢琴；see films看电影。根据“There is a lake near my home.”可知，有一个湖，所以是去钓鱼，故选A。

questions.prompt: Can you  ______  your dictionary to me? I don’t know this word.
questions.explanation: 句意：你能把字典借我用一下吗？我不认识这个单词。 考查动词辨析。carry携带；lend借；help帮助；buy买。结合语境可知，此处表示“借某物给某人”，lend sth to sb，固定短语，故选B。

questions.prompt: My grandma is old  ______  she thinks she is very young.
questions.explanation: 句意：我奶奶老了，但是她认为她非常年轻。 考查连词辨析。and和；so因此；but但是；or或者。根据前后的语境可知，前后是转折关系，用but。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  you write songs? — No, I can’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会写歌吗？——不，我不会。 考查一般疑问句。do助动词原形；are主语是第二人称或复数时be动词形式；can会，情态动词；must必须，情态动词。根据“No, I can’t”可知此处表示“能力”，用can。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  classes do you have every day? — We have seven.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你们每天有多少节课？——我们有七节课。 考查特殊疑问句。Which哪个；What什么；How old多大（年龄）；How many多少。根据答语“We have seven.”可知，此处在询问数量，故选D。

questions.prompt: There is  ______  ruler on the desk. Please give it to me.
questions.explanation: 句意：桌子上有一把尺子。请把它给我。 考查冠词的辨析。ruler是可数名词，这里是单数，且是第一次提到。所以不用定冠词the，应该用不定冠词a/an。ruler是辅音音素开头，前面用a。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Give me  ______  pen. It’s over there. —OK.
questions.explanation: 句意：——给我那只钢笔。它在那边。——好的。 考查指示代词。this这个，单数，表示近指；that那个，单数，表示远指；these这些，复数，表示近指；those那些，复数，表示远指。根据“It’s over there.”可知，笔在那边，并且是一支笔，用单数。故选B。

questions.prompt: My father likes  ______  sports a lot. He is very strong.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父亲非常喜欢做运动。他很强壮。 考查非谓语动词。like doing sth.喜欢做某事，是固定搭配。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Thank you for helping me with English. —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——感谢你帮助我学习英语。——不客气。 考查情景对话。Good idea好主意；I’m fine. Thanks我很好，谢谢；Happy birthday生日快乐；You are welcome不客气。根据“Thank you for helping me with English”，可知，对方表达感谢时，要回复“不客气”，故选D。

questions.prompt: — What time do you have dinner every day, James? — I often  ______  dinner at 7:00 every evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：——James，你每天什么时候吃晚餐？——我经常每天晚上7点吃晚餐。 考查动词时态。“often”是一般现在时标志词，主语I是第一人称，动词用原形，故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______, Ben? — He is a worker.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Ben，你父亲是做什么的？——他是一名工人。 考查特殊疑问句及情景对话。What does your father do你父亲是做什么的；How old is your father你父亲多大；What does your father like你爸爸喜欢什么；What can your father do你父亲可以做什么。根据“He is a worker”，可知，此处询问一位男性的工作职业，故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A Letter from Henry Dear Annie, Thank you for your letter. I'm happy you like your school. I  ______ 17 ______  our school in China, too. I go to school from Monday to Friday. We  ______ 18 ______  four classes in the morning and two classes in the  ______ 19 ______. We have many interesting things to do after class. On Monday afternoon, we play sports. We  ______ 20 ______  basketball or ping pong. It's relaxing（放松的）! On Tuesday afternoon, some of us have a singing class, and on Thursday afternoon, some have a  ______ 21 ______  class. It's a little difficult（困难的）. But I can draw  ______ 22 ______  pictures. On Wednesday afternoon, our English class finishes（结束，完成） at 4: 00. My Chinese friends want to talk with me in  ______ 23 ______. They think I look like an English teacher. I like Friday best because I can learn Beijing Opera on  ______ 24 ______  afternoon. It is great! On Saturdays and Sundays, I don’t go to school. Very often I go to the park and have a good time with my family there. Best wishes! Yours, Henry

questions.prompt: Miss Li is our English teacher. She is very kind. We all like ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：李老师是我们的英语老师。她很善良，我们都喜欢她。 考查代词宾格。it它；her她，宾格；him他，宾格；them他们，宾格，like喜欢，动词，结合选项可知其后用代词宾格形式，由She她，可知其宾格her，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______ is your best friend? ——Lucy. She is very nice. We are in the same school.
questions.explanation: 句意：——谁是你最好的朋友？——Lucy。她很好。我们在同一所学校。 考查特殊疑问句。How怎样；What什么；Where在哪；Who谁，根据答语“Lucy”，可知上句在问“是谁”，故选D。

questions.prompt: Peter often plays the guitar in the music club ______ Sundays
questions.explanation: 句意：星期天，彼得经常在音乐俱乐部弹吉他。 考查介词辨析。to向，朝着；in用于表示一天中的上午、下午或晚上；at表示某个时刻；on用于表示某日，Sundays周日，所以用on，on Sundays在周日，故选D。 【点睛】介词at, in, on的区别: 表示时间时，注意以下用法： (1) 表示时间的某一点、某一时刻或年龄等用 at。如： I get up at six in the morning. 我早上六点钟起床。 He got married at the age of 25. 他 25 岁结婚。 (2) 泛指一般意义的上午、下午或晚上以及月或年等较长的时间，一般用 in。如： We watch TV in the evening. 我们晚上看电视。 He went to Japan in 1946. 他于 1946 去了日本。 (3) 若表示星期几或某一特定的日期，则用 on。如： He left here on the fifth of May. 他于 5 月 5 日离开这儿。

questions.prompt: —Susan, ______ you play basketball? —Yes, I can. I am good at it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——苏珊，你会打篮球吗？——是的，我可以。我很擅长。 考查情态动词。can会，能；may可以；need需要；must必须，根据答语“Yes, I can.”，可知在问“can you…”故选A。

questions.prompt: —Peter, what can you see in the picture? —I can see a farm. And there ______ some animals on it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，你能在照片里看到什么？——我能看到一个农场。上面有一些动物。 考查主谓一致。 are（be动词的复数形式）；（be动词的单数数形式）； will be将来时；be动词原形，there be句型中be动词遵循就近原则，空后some animals为名词复数形式，根据句意，本句用一般现在时，所以用be的复数形式are，故选A。

questions.prompt: I like sports. I often ______ basketball in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢运动。我经常在早上打篮球。 考查时态。play玩，打球类；plays单三形式，用于一般现在时；is playing现在进行时；played一般过去时，根据句中“often经常”可知本句时态为一般现在时，主语I，所以谓语动词用原形，故选A。

questions.prompt: Linda is short, ______ she is good at basketball.
questions.explanation: 句意：Linda很矮，但她擅长篮球。 考查并列连词。so因此；and然后，和 ；or不然；but但是，根据上下句句意，可知两句之间是转折关系，故选D。

questions.prompt: My father ______ a doctor. He works very hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲是个医生。他工作很努力。 考查系动词做谓语。am是，用于主语是I；is是，用于主语是单数名词或单词； are是，用于第二人称单复数现在时，第一、三人称复数现在时；D. be是，有，系动词原形，主语My father为第三人称单数，所以用is，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______ do you usually have lunch? — At twelve o'clock
questions.explanation: 句意：——你通常什么时候吃午饭？——12点钟。 考查特殊疑问句。How怎样；What什么；When什么时候；Where什么地方，根据答语At twelve o'clock在12点，可知上句问“什么时间”，故选C。

questions.prompt: My mother often asks me ______ a coat with me when it is cold outside.
questions.explanation: 句意：当外面冷的时候，我妈妈经常让我带上一件外套。 考查非谓语动词。take带，动词原形；taking现在分词或动名词；took过去式；to take动词不定式，固定搭配ask sb. to do sth.“要求某人做某事”，可知空处用动词不定式形式，故选D。

questions.prompt: It's sunny outside. Let's ______ for a walk.
questions.explanation: 句意：外面阳光明媚。我们去散散步吧。 考查非谓语动词。to go动词不定式；going现在分词或动名词； go动词原形；goes动词go的单数形式，固定搭配let sb. do“让某人做某事”，let是使役动词，其宾语后接动词原形（不带to的动词不定式），故选C。

questions.prompt: —Jack, thank you very much for helping me. —— ______
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，非常感谢你帮助我。——不客气。 考查交际用语。You're welcome不客气，不用谢。Here you are给你。Nice to meet you很高兴见到你。That's a good idea.好主意。根据上句thank you谢谢，可知用You're welcome不用谢，故选A。 完形填空。 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 Two Eggs, Two Pairs of Friends! The Black family come to a new big city. Mrs. Black's son, Bob, is not ______ 13 ______  He doesn't have any friends to play with. “Don't worry!”says his mother. “You will soon make friends here”. One ______ 14 ______, there is a knock at the door. Bob's mother Mrs Black,opens it, There stands a woman with brown hair. It is Mrs. White. She comes to ______ 15 ______ some eggs. She wants to make cakes. Mrs. Black lends her two. In the afternoon, there is another knock at the door. Mrs Black opens it and sees a ______ 16 ______ standing there. “My name is Jack White,”he says. "My mother sends (送) you this cake and the two eggs.Well, thank you, Jack,”says Mrs Black. "Come in and ______ 17 ______ my son Bob.” Jack gets in the room and talks with Bob happily. Look! Bob and Jack are ______ 18 ______  the cake and milk. They are playing football. Now they are friends! Jack says, “I'm glad you live next door.” Bob says, “I must thank your mother for coming for eggs.”Jack laughs and tells Bob,"She doesn't want the two eggs, but she wants to make friends with your mother. Bob says, “That's a(n) ______ 19 ______  way to make friends. It's an easy way, too. It can work!” So if you' re willing(乐意的) to make friends, you can always ______ 20 ______ some ways!

questions.prompt: I don’t like math  ______  it’s too difficult.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不喜欢数学，因为它太难了。 考查连词辨析，but但是；and和；so所以；because因为，根据所给空前面的I don’t like math和后面的it’s too difficult可知，是因果关系，故选D。

questions.prompt: There is an  ______  on the table.
questions.explanation: 句意：在桌子上有一个橘子。 考查名词辨析。book书；orange橘子；watch手表；oranges橘子（复数），由所给空前面的an可知，应该用可数名词复数，排除D，由an可知，应该是以元音音素开头的单词，排除A和C，故选B。

questions.prompt: Let’s  ______  a football match on TV.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们在电视上看足球赛吧。 考查使役动词及动词辨析。watch观看；see看见，根据所给空前面的let是使役动词，后面跟动词原形，排除B和D，由所给空后面的a football match on TV可知，应该是观看，排除C，故选A。

questions.prompt: A new term begins  ______  September.
questions.explanation: 句意：新学期在九月份开始。 考查介词辨析。at后面接具体的某一时刻；in后面接不是具体的某一天；on后面接具体的某一天；to到，根据所给空后面的September不是具体的某一天，所以用in，故选B。

questions.prompt: August is  ______  eighth month of the year.
questions.explanation: 句意：八月是一年中的第八个月。 考查定冠词。a一个；an一个；the表特指，由序数词前面要加定冠词the以及所给空后面的eighth可知，应该用的是定冠词the，故选C。

questions.prompt: We have math and Chinese  ______  Friday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们星期五有数学和语文课。 考查介词辨析。for后面接段时间；in后面接不是具体的某一天；at后面接某一时刻；on后面接具体的某一天，由所给空后面的Friday是具体的某一天，所以用on，故选D。 【点睛】at, in, on，for与时间搭配： at加时间点、时刻以及节日前用at。如at noon, at night; at New Year。 in表示较长的时间（年、月、世纪、上午、下午、晚上等）。如in the 1990s, in the morning。 on用于具体到某一天的日子或早晨、下午、晚上前有修饰词的时候。如on October 1st, on the morning of January 4th。 for+时间段。 例如题目中，由所给空后面的Friday是具体的某一天，所以用on，故选D。

questions.prompt: He often plays basketball  ______  two hours every Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：每周日他经常打两个小时的篮球。 考查介词辨析。at后面接具体的某一时刻；in后面接不是具体的某一天；for后面接段时间；on后面接具体的某一天，根据所给空后面的two hours是段时间，所以用for，故选C。

questions.prompt: Mr. Zhang is  ______  Science teacher.  ______  are his students.
questions.explanation: 句意：Mr. Zhang是我们的科学老师。我们是他的学生。 考查人称代词。根据第一个空后面的Science teacher可知，应该用的是形容词性物主代词，排除C，由第二个空后面的are his students可知，应该用的是主格且为复数，排除B，A项的第一个空和第二个空带入题干中不符合，所以排除A，故选D。

questions.prompt: May is  ______  month of the year.
questions.explanation: 句意：五月是一年中第五个月。 考查序数词。The fourth第四；the fiveth错误表达；the sixth第六；the fifth第五，由所给空前面的May“五月”可知，应该是第五个月，所以用the fifth，故选D。 【点睛】序数词表示顺序，意为“第几”，前面要加定冠词the。 例如题目中，由所给空前面的May“五月”可知，应该是第五个月，所以用the fifth，故选D。

questions.prompt: He sings  ______  and he is a  ______  singer(歌手)．
questions.explanation: 句意：他唱得好，他是一个好歌手。 考查形容词和副词。good形容词，好的，在句中可作表语，定语或补语；well副词，好地，在句中修饰动词作状语。第一空修饰动词sings可知填副词well，第2空修饰名词singer作定语可知填形容词，可知填good；故选D。

questions.prompt: Where  ______  Tom’s English books? Can you see  ______?
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆的英语书在哪里？你能看见它们吗？ 考查be动词及人称代词。根据第一个空后面的Tom’s English books可知，be动词用are，排除A和B，由Tom’s English books可知，应该用them代指，排除C，故选D。

questions.prompt: My father is a worker.  ______  works very hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爸爸是个工人。他很努力工作。 考查人称代词。A. He（他）；B. She（她）；C. They（他们）；D. It（它）； “我爸爸”是第三人称单数、男性，下文再次提到用he“他”指代，故填A。

questions.prompt: There are some flowers spring.
questions.explanation: 句意：春天有一些花。 考查介词辨析。at后面接具体的某一时刻；in后面接不是具体的某一天；on后面接具体的某一天；to到，根据所给空后面的spring不是具体的某一天，所以用in，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the office building? —It's between the sports hall and the science building.
questions.explanation: 句意：——办公楼在哪里？——它在体育馆和科学楼之间。 考查疑问词。A. Where（在哪里，问地点）；B. How（怎样，问方式）；C. What（什么，问主语或宾语）；D. Why（为什么，问原因）；根据答语It's between the sports hall and the science building.“它在体育馆和科学楼之间”，判断是对“地点”提问，故选A。

questions.prompt: Tony is English  ______  he is thirteen years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼是英国人他13岁。 考查连词。A. but（“但是”，表转折）；B. and（“和”，表并列）；C. or（“或者”，表选择）；D. so（“因此”，表因果）；“托尼是英国人”和“他13岁”，2个单句是并列关系，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  Ann in Class 3? —Yes, she is.
questions.explanation: 句意：——安在3班吗？—— 是的，她是。 考查助动词。根据答语Yes, she is.判断上文一般疑问句助动词是is；do、does用于含有实意动词的一般疑问句，排除；are对应的主语是复数，排除；故选C。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Ben. What are you doing? —We  ______  the Forbidden City.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，本。你在做什么？——我们正在参观紫禁城。 考查时态。A. visit（一般现在时、原形）；B. visits（一般现在时、单三）；C. is visiting（现在进行时）；D. are visiting（现在进行时）；根据问句判断答语时态是现在进行时，谓语动词是be+ doing；主语we 是复数，所以谓语动词是are visiting；故选D。

questions.prompt: I often  ______  the Internet on my computer for my homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常使用电脑因特网做作业。 考查时态。A. use（一般现在时、原形）； B. uses（一般现在时，单三）；C. using（动名词）；D. are using（现在进行时）；根据句中的频度副词often判断句子用一般现在时；主语是I，故选A。

questions.prompt: He usually  ______  basketball after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：他通常在放学后打篮球。 考查时态。A. play（一般现在时、原形）；B. plays（一般现在时，单三）；C. playing（动名词）；D. is playing（现在进行时）；根据句中的频度副词usually判断句子用一般现在时；主语是he，谓语动词用单三形式，词尾+s/es；故选B。 完形填空。 One afternoon just before Christmas an old man was walking through the city center.The  ______ 21 ______  were all filled with good things and crowded with  ______ 22 ______  shoppers. Suddenly he saw a dirty boy ______ 23 ______  on the ground crying sadly. When the kind old man asked him why he was crying, the little boy told him that he had  ______ 24 ______  the ten-penny (便士) piece that his uncle had  ______ 25 ______  him. At once the old man ______ 26 ______  out a handful of coins. He  ______ 27 ______  out a shining new ten-penny piece and handed it to the poor child."Thank you very much," said the little boy, drying his  ______ 28 ______  He cheered up at once. About an hour  ______ 29 ______, the old man was on his way back home by the same road. To his surprise he saw the dirty boy in the same place, crying sadly as before. He went up to the boy and asked him if he had lost ten-penny piece he had just given him. The boy told him that he had not lost the second coin  ______ 30 ______  he still couldn't find the first one. "If I could find my own piece," he cried, "I would have twenty pennies now."

questions.prompt: Mike is very tall and likes playing basketball
questions.explanation: 句意：Mike很高，他喜欢打篮球。 考查人称代词主格。She她主格；he他，主格；her她的，形容词性物主代词；his他的，形容词性物主代词，根据所给空后面的likes playing basketball可知，应该填主格，排除C和D，由Mike可知，应该是他，排除A，故选B。

questions.prompt: For boys, we have black trousers only $22.
questions.explanation: 句意：对于男孩，我们只有22美元的黑色裤子。 考查介词。for对，或用于等价交换；on在……上；in在……里；at在，根据for后面可以加价格以及所给空后面的only $22可知，应该用的是for，故选A。

questions.prompt: I like sports, I don't play them.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢运动，但是我不做它们。 考查连词辨析。because因为；so所以；and并且；but但是，根据所给空前面的句子I like sports和后面的句子I don't play them可知，应该是转折关系，故选D。

questions.prompt: There is egg on the table.
questions.explanation: 句意：在桌子上有一个鸡蛋。 考查不定冠词。a一个，用在辅音音素前；an一个，用在元音音素前；the特指，根据所给空后面的egg可知，应该用 不定冠词，排除C和D，由egg是元音音素开头的单词，所以用an，排除A，故选B。

questions.prompt: My sister and I in the same school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的姐妹和我在同一所学校。 考查be动词的形式。am是，主语是I；is是，主语是可数名词单数或不可数名词；are是，主语是可数名词复数；be是be动词原形，根据所给空前面的主语My sister and I可知，应该用be动词复数形式，故选C。

questions.prompt: I like history because it is very.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢历史因为它是很有趣的。 考查形容词辨析。Boring令人厌烦；busy忙碌的；difficult困难的；interesting有趣的，根据所给空前面的I like history可知，应该是有趣的，故选D。

questions.prompt: —— is the hat? —— It's twenty yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个帽子多少钱？——20元。 考查疑问词短语辨析。How many多少，修饰可数名词复数；How old多大；How much多少，修饰不可数名词，多少钱；How long多长时间，根据答句It's twenty yuan可知，问的是价格，故选C。

questions.prompt: Let's fishing next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：下周日让我们去钓鱼吧。 考查使役动词let的用法。go fishing去钓鱼；goes是动词go的第三人称单数形式；going是go的动名词形式；to go是动词go的不定式形式，根据所给空前面的使役动词let后面跟动词原形可知，应该用的是go，故选A。

questions.prompt: My father often sports programs on TV.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的爸爸经常在电视上看体育节目。 考查动词的第三人称单数形式。watch观看，动词原形；watches观看，动词的第三人称单数形式；watching观看，动词的动名词形式；to watch去观看，动词的不定式形式，根据often可知，时态是一般现在时，主语my father是第三人称单数，所以要用动词的第三人称单数形式watches，故选B。

questions.prompt: —— Can I help you? ——.I need a sweater for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：——需要帮忙吗？——是的，我需要一件上学穿的毛衣。 考查交际应用。Not at all不客气；You're welcome不客气；See you回头见；Yes, please是的，根据问句Can I help you?和所给空后面的I need a sweater for school可知，Yes, please最符合语境，故选D。 短文填空 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空，每空一词。 A Cindy Smith has good eating habits. She  ______ 11 ______ (like) to eat fruit for breakfast. Although she doesn't like bananas, she likes oranges and  ______ 12 ______  (apple) For lunch, she really likes salad. She doesn't like hamburgers for dinner because they're not  ______ 13 ______  (health). She likes chicken for dinner. She says she likes ice-cream, but she doesn't eat it, because she doesn't  ______ 14 ______  (want) to be fat. 【答案】11. likes

questions.prompt: Look! That old man is carrying a heavy box. Let's go and help ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！那个老人提着一个沉重的箱子。我们去帮他吧。 考查人称代词。me我；him他；her她；them他们；四个选项都是人称代词宾格，根据文字表达的逻辑关系，推断空格指帮助上文提到的that old man——单数第三人称、男性；故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______ is your best friend, Linda?. —Betty. She is my classmate.
questions.explanation: 句意：——琳达，你最好朋友是谁？——-贝蒂。她是我的同学。 考查疑问词。How 怎样，问方式；What什么，问事或物；Who谁，问身份；Where在哪里，问地点；根据答语“Betty. She is my classmate”推断空格是问身份；故选C。

questions.prompt: Lily often goes to visit her grandma  ______  Sundays.
Jim usually goes to school by bike, ______ today he walked to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆通常骑自行车上学，但今天他步行上学。 考查连词辨析。and和，表顺承；but但是，表转折；or或者，表选择；so因此，表因果；上文“Jim usually goes to school by bike”根据空格后今天去学校的方式与以往不同，推断上下句之间含有转折之意，故选B。

questions.prompt: Tom two English classes on Monday.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆星期一有两节英语课。 考查一般现在时、单三形式。has一般现在时、单三形式；have 一般现在时；to have不定式；having动名词、现在分词；根据时间状语on Monday可知句子是一般现在时，主语Tom是单数第三人称，谓语动词用单数形式；故选A。

questions.prompt: There some milk in the fridge. Do you want some? A are
questions.explanation: 句意：冰箱里有一些牛奶。你想要一些吗？ 考查主谓一致。在there be句型中，are与之搭配的是复数名词；is与之搭配的是单数可数名词或不可数名词；being是be动词的现在分词，be原形；根据there be句型的就近原则，some milk是不可数名词，be动词形式用is；故选B。

questions.prompt: The girl in the red dress is from Australia. is my new friend.
questions.explanation: 句意：穿红色连衣裙的女孩来自澳大利亚。她是我的新朋友。 考查人称代词、主格。She她；He他；You你；They他们；根据文字表达的逻辑关系，推断空格指代the girl——单数第三人称、女性，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Can you make a paper plane? —Yes, I.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能做一架纸飞机吗？——是的，我可以。 考查情态动词。may可以，表许可；must必须，表必须，表命令；shall用于第一人称，表征求意见；can能，表能力、可能；根据上文“Can you make a paper plane?”是一般疑问句、询问能力，其肯定回答句式中的助动词与上文一致；故选D。

questions.prompt: Every year many people from other countries to China to learn Chinese.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年都有许多来自其他国家的人来中国学习汉语。 考查时态、一般现在时。come一般现在时、原形；comes一般现在时、单三形式；coming动名词、现在分词；to come不定式；根据时间状语every year可知句子是一般现在时，主语many people from other countries是复数名词，谓语动词用原形；故选A。

questions.prompt: Our study group often meets the school library.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的学习小组经常在学校图书馆见面。 考查介词辨析。below在……下方、低于；to去、到……，表动作的方向；on在……上面；at在具体的地点或时间；从文字的表层意思推断空格指在学校图书馆，表示在具体的某个地方；故选D。

questions.prompt: My brother Dawei is basketball fan.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥大伟是个篮球迷。 考查不定冠词。不定冠词a/an用于单数可数名词前表泛指，a用在以辅音音素开头的名词前，an用在以元音音素开头的名词前；定冠词the表特指；从文字的表层意思推断空格指“是个篮球迷”——表泛指，所以，空格用不定冠词；basketball以辅音音素开头，不定冠词用a；故选A。

questions.prompt: My father trees on the hills in spring every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲每年春天在山上种树。 考查一般现在时。will plant一般将来时；planted一般过去时； plants一般现在时、单三形式；is planting现在进行时；根据时间状语every year可知句子是一般现在时，主语My father是单数第三人称，谓语动词用单三形式；故选C。 完形填空。阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Some people call autumn fall. You can call it either one. Autumn is the time when leaves ( 树 叶 ) change color. They  ______ 18 ______ beautiful gold, orange and red. It looks like and artist comes along a  ______ 19 ______  all the trees. The air starts to get a little ______ 20 ______  in autumn. We begin to wear ______ 21 ______ or sweaters. We go back to school in autumn. Autumn is the time when old friends get back together and talk about what they did on their ______ 22 ______  holidays. Halloween comes in autumn. We dress up in costumes. Some of them are scary (可怕的), and some of them are funny. We go from door to door and say, “Trick or treat” and people give us candies. We wear masks ( 面 具 ) on our ______ 23 ______, and we have a lot of fun. The autumn winds start to blow ( 吹). The wind blows the leaves right  ______ 24 ______ the trees. My friends and I like to have a lot of fun outside before the cold winter comes. We often play football at school. After school, we ______ 25 ______  our bikes through the dry leaves. The ______ 26 ______ go flying through the air as we ride through them. The skies get a little cloudier in autumn, and we know that soon there will be snow, ______ 27 ______ we enjoy the cool autumn weather while we can.

questions.prompt: — Whose hat is it? — It’s  ______. Thank you very much.

questions.prompt: Look at room. It’s so clean.
questions.explanation: 句意：看看这个房间。它是如此干净。 考查冠词。a用于以辅音音素开始的单词前，表示一个；an用于以元音音素开始的单词前，表示一个；the表示特指，定冠词；根据“Look at room. It’s so clean.”可知此处是特指这个房间是干净的，所以用the，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Where is Jane? — She is the classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：——简在哪儿?——她在教室里。 考查介词。in在……里面；with用；on在……上面；to到；根据“— Where is Jane?— She is the classroom.”可知简在教室里，是在教室内部，所以用“in”，故选A。

questions.prompt: — whose ruler is this? — It's my sister's. The book is, too.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是谁的尺子?——是我姐姐的。这本书也是她的。 考查名词性物主代词。mine我的（东西）；its它的（东西）；his他的（东西）；hers她的（东西）；根据“It's my sister's. ”可知是我姐姐的，所以此处用“hers”，故选D。

questions.prompt: — do you play basketball, Mike? — I play basketball on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克，你什么时候打篮球?——我星期六打篮球。 考查特殊疑问句。Who谁（对人物提问）；What什么（对事情提问）；Where哪里（对地点提问）；When何时（对时间提问）；根据“I play basketball on Saturday.”可知我星期六打篮球，可推断出此处是对时间提问，所以用“When”，故选D。

questions.prompt: I live in the city. There two shops near my home.
questions.explanation: 句意：我住在城市里。我家附近有两家商店。 考查be动词。am是，主语是I；are 是，主语是复数；is是，主语是单数或不可数名词；be是，be动词原形；there be 句型考虑“就近原则”，根据“two shops”可知此处是复数，所以此处用“are”，故选B。 【点睛】be动词口诀：英语有个动词be，面孔不同要注意。我用am你用are ，is连着他她它。主语单数用is，主语复数都用are。变疑问，将be往前提,变否定，be后加not；句首大写莫忘记，句末标点莫忘记。本题还考查了there be句型，所以学生在做题时需注意“就近原则”，此题中“two shops”可知此处用“are”。

questions.prompt: — Can I borrow your eraser? —. Here you are.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我能借用一下你的橡皮吗?——当然。给你。 考查情景交际。Excuse me不好意思，打扰了；Sure当然；You're welcome没关系；Thanks a lot非常感谢；根据“Here you are.”可知此处是可以借用橡皮，所以回答是“Sure”，故选B。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Cathy is an American girl. questions.prompt: —What’s this in English? —It’s  ______  apple. I like it very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这用英语怎么说？——苹果我非常喜欢它。 考查冠词的辨析，此处表示一个，是泛指，故排除CD，apple第一个音节是元音因素，所以前用an，故选B。

questions.prompt: Betty is a new student in Class 2.  ______  likes swimming very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂是2班的新学生。她非常喜欢游泳。 考查代词辨析，He他（主格）； His他的（形容词性物主代词）； She她（主格）； Her她的（形容词性物主代词）。Betty是女名，此处在句子中做主语，表示“她”，故选C。

questions.prompt: —When do you have history at school? —We have history  ______ Monday and Wednesday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你什么时候在学校上历史课？——我们上历史课在星期一和星期三。 考查介词辨析，A. in在……里，（后加年月四季）B. a t在，后加具体时刻； C. of关于; 属于…的；on在…上（后加具体的某一天）。Monday and Wednesday是具体的某天，故选D。

questions.prompt: My grandfather is over 70  ______  he thinks he is very young.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的祖父已经70多岁了，但是他认为他很年轻。 考查连词辨析，and和（表并列）；so所以；because因为（引导原因）； but但是（表转折）。结合句意，此处表示转折的意思，故选D。

questions.prompt: There ______  a ruler and two pens in my pencil case.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我铅笔盒里有一把尺子和两支钢笔。 考查就近原则，从there be句型be的选择要遵循就近原则。be后是a ruler，是单数，故be就用单数is。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  you swim, Peter? —Of course, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会游泳吗，彼得？——当然，我会。 考查情态动词辨析，Must必须；May可能，也许 ；Can可以；Should应该。分析句意，答语回答是我能，前面应该是询问你可以吗，用Can,提问。故选C。

questions.prompt: We all like our music teacher—Miss Wang. She  ______  very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们都喜欢我们的音乐老师--王老师。她唱歌很好。 考查时态，sing唱歌。分析句意，此处表示的是经常存在的状态。所以用一般现在时，主语是she,所以谓语动词用单三。sing 的单三是加s。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Tom, Let’s  ______  football after school. —That’s a good idea.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，放学后我们踢球吧。——好主意。 考查祈使句固定句型。plays玩。Let’s do sth.让我们做……吧。let’s后用动词原形。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you like, Mike? —I like blue. My schoolbag is blue and my shoes are blue, too.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你喜欢什么颜色，迈克？——我喜欢蓝色。我的书包是蓝色的，我的鞋子也是蓝色的。 考查名词辨析，What subject什么科目；What colour什么颜色；Which book哪本书；What sports什么运动。根据答语部分“I like blue.”可知问喜欢的颜色。故选B。

questions.prompt: — How are you, Jim? —  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好吗，吉姆？——好，谢谢。根据前句问句，how are you你好吗？回答fine，thank you这是问候语的固定用法，所以选择D答案。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I am a middle school student. Now let me tell you something about our classroom. It's very clean and bright. There are  ______ 11 ______  maps on the back wall. One is a map of China, the other one is a map of the world. There are 40 desks and chairs in our classroom. There is a big desk  ______ 12 ______  our teachers in the front of it. You can see three big and bright  ______ 13 ______  in the wall. Every day, you can see the sun shines through them into the classroom. We  ______ 14 ______  four classes in the morning and two in the afternoon from Monday to Friday. I like my classroom very much. It’s a good place for studying.

questions.prompt: Who climbs, Jim, Peter or Sam?
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆、彼得和萨姆，谁爬得最高？ 考查副词最高级。A. the higher更高，比较级；B. higher更高，比较级；C. high高，原级；D. highest最高，最高级。根据比较范围为三人可知要用最高级，故选D。 【点睛】两者进行比较用比较级，三者或以上进行比较用最高级。

questions.prompt: Many oranges are bigger than yours.
questions.explanation: 句意：许多橘子比你的大得多。 考查修饰比较级的词。A. very非常；B. too太；C. much……得多； D. more更。根据句子可知此处修饰形容词比较级bigger，much可修饰比较级表程度，故选C。 【点睛】常见的修饰比较级的词有much, far, even, a lot, a little等。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to go shopping with me? —I love to.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你想和我去购物吗？——好呀。 考查一般疑问句。A. had助动词have的过去时；B. would表意愿；C. did助动词do的过去时；D. /零冠词。根据一般疑问句怎么提问就怎么回答的原则，问句用would，答句也用would，故选B。

questions.prompt: Whose paper planes are, Lucy or Lily?
questions.explanation: 句意：露西和莉莉，谁的纸飞机更好？ 考查形容词比较级。A. well好地，副词原级；B. best最好，最高级；C. the best最好，最高级；D. better更好，比较级。根据两者在进行比较可知要用比较级，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Are you going to be away for long? —No.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你打算离开很久吗？——不，一两天吧。 考查情景交际。A. Only a day or two只要一两天； B. Three days ago三天前； C. After a week一周后；D. In three days三天后。根据答语说不会离开太久，可知选较短的时间，故选A。

questions.prompt: — How often do you go to the park? — a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去一次公园？——一周一次。 考查情景交际。A. Once一次；B. Ten days十天；C. For six days六天；D. After a month一个月后。上文询问频率，下文则回答频率，once a week表示一周一次，故选A。

questions.prompt: She the boy was a queue jumper.
questions.explanation: 句意：她认为这个男孩是个插队者。 考查动词词义辨析。A. hoped希望；B. talked交谈；C. thought认为；D. spoke讲。根据句意可知她是认为，其他选项不符合常理，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Why did you come here so late? — Sorry. I the bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你为什么来这么晚？——抱歉，我错过了公交车。 考查动词词义辨析。A. took乘坐；B. caught赶上；C. got on登上；D. missed错过。根据上文说来迟了可知后文是没赶上公交车，故选D。

questions.prompt: Your sister went to the park last week,?
questions.explanation: 句意：你姐姐上周去公园了，对吗？ 考查反义疑问句。A. doesn’t she一般现在时，否定；B. did she一般过去时，肯定；C. didn’t she一般过去时，否定；D. was she一般过去时，肯定。根据前文用了一般过去时，可知反义疑问句中的简短疑问句也要用一般过去时，所以排除A；根据前文是肯定可知后文简短疑问句要用否定。故选C。

questions.prompt: People in China like eating moon cakes Mid-autumn Day.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国人在中秋节喜欢吃月饼。 考查时间介词。A. in后接年、月、季节等； B. on后接具体日期；C. at后接具体时刻；D. of……的。根据Mid-autumn Day为具体日期可知其前介词用on，故选B。

questions.prompt: How about shopping this afternoon?
questions.explanation: 句意：今天下午去购物怎么样？ 考查固定搭配。A. go去，原形；B. went去，一般过去时；C. goes去，三单；D. going去，动名词。根据固定搭配how about doing表示做某事如何，用来征询意见可知其后接动名词，故选D。

questions.prompt: I hate dishes every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我讨厌每天洗碗。 考查非谓语动词。A. to wash洗，动词不定式；B. wash洗，原形；C. washing洗，动名词；D. washed洗，一般过去时。根据固定用法hate后常接动名词形式作宾语表示讨厌做某事，故选C。

questions.prompt: — is the meeting going to last? — Half an hour.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个会议要持续多久？——半小时。 考查特殊疑问词。A. What什么；B. How long多久；C. When何时；D. How far多远。根据答语回答的是时长可知上文对时长提问，故选B。

questions.prompt: — it is today! — Yes, Let’s go to the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天天气多好啊！——是的，我们去公园吧。 考查感叹句。A. What a fine date多么好的日期；B. what fine day多好的一天； C. How fine多好；D. How cold多寒冷。根据下文说要去公园可知上文在感叹天气好，所以排除AD。B选项fine前要加不定冠词a，所以B排除。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Happy birthday! —.
questions.explanation: 句意：——生日快乐！——谢谢你，玛丽。 考查情景交际。A. Thank you, Mary谢谢你，玛丽；B. You are welcome不用谢； C. I’m very glad我很高兴；D. You are so kind你真善良。根据常理，别人祝贺你，你应该道谢，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  watch is this? —I think it’s Ricky’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是谁的手表？——我认为它是Ricky的。 考查疑问词辨析。How如何；Whose谁的；What什么；Where在哪里。根据答句“I think it’s Ricky’s.”讲手表是Ricky的，可知此处对所属关系进行提问，问是谁的手表，用whose符合题意。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Is this wallet your mother’s? —No. This is a purple one.  ______  is black.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是你妈妈的钱包吗？——不。这是紫色的。她的是黑色的。 考查名词性物主代词用法。she她，人称代词主格；her她的，人称代词宾格，形容词性物主代词；hers她的（东西），名词性物主代词；his他的，形容词性物主代词。根据回答No.可知，妈妈的钱包不是紫色的，而是黑色的，此句缺少主语，表示妈妈的钱包，可以用名词性物主代词代替，且表示女性的代词hers。故选C。

questions.prompt: At this moment, our cat  ______  a sausage in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在我们的猫正在厨房吃香肠。 考查时态。eats第三人称单数形式；eat动词原形；eating动名词；is eating用于现在进行时。根据时间状语At this moment可知，此句时态是现在进行时，描绘此刻正在进行动作。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  you play tennis? —No, I can’t. But I am good at playing football.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会打网球吗？——不，我不会。但是我擅长踢足球。 考查一般疑问句。do助动词；can可以，情态动词；are系动词；does助动词，第三人称单数形式。根据回答“No, I can’t.”可知，问句是询问能力，用can引导的一般疑问句。故选B。

questions.prompt: There is going to  ______  a film at the cinema this evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：今晚电影院将上映一场电影。 考查there be句型及时态。have ；being现在分词；be动词原形；having现在分词。此句是there be句型，there be句型的一般将来时为there is going to be形式。故选C。

questions.prompt: What do you want to do for your mother  ______  Mother’s Day?
questions.explanation: 句意：在母亲节你想为你的妈妈做什么？ 考查介词辨析。in在较长时间；on在具体某一天；at在某一时刻；for一段时间。此处指母亲节当天，是具体的某一天，用时间介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: I never buy anything on the internet  ______  I can’t see the product.
questions.explanation: 句意：我从不在网上买任何东西，因为我不能看到产品。 考查连词辨析。because因为；and和；而且；so因此；but但是。“I can’t see the product.”是不在网上买东西的原因，因此用because引导的原因状语从句。故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  students  ______  to school every day in the future?
questions.explanation: 句意：在未来学生们每天去学校吗？ 考查一般将来时。A：一般现在时；B：现在进行时；C：错误的表达；D：一般将来时。根据句中时间状语every day in the future可知，时态是一般将来时，故选D。

questions.prompt: ______  the bank is the bookshop.
questions.explanation: 句意：银行的对面是书店。 考查介词辨析。Along沿着，强调沿着街或者路；Opposite在……对面；Across穿过，强调平面穿过，如街道河流等；From来自。根据句意可知，此处表示方位地点，只有Opposite符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Where is Tom? —He  ______  his homework in his room.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆在哪里？——他正在他的房间做他的作业。 考查现在进行时。A：一般现在时的动词三单；B：一般过去时；C：现在进行时；D：一般现在时的动词原形。分析语境可知，此处询问汤姆在干嘛，强调在某个时间点正在发生的动作，所以是现在进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: After  ______  his homework he went out to play basketball with friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：在完成他的作业后，他和朋友出去打篮球了。 考查动名词作宾语。finished过去式/过去分词；finishes动词三单；finishing动名词；finish动词原形。分析句子可知，本句中已有谓语动词went，所以此处使用非谓语动词形式，排除B和D；又因为After是介词，所以其后使用动名词形式作宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: Hurry up, or you  ______ late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则你上学就要迟到了。 考查“祈使句+or+陈述句”用法和一般将来时。are一般现在时；were一般过去时；will be一般将来时；is going to be一般将来时，主语是第三人称或单数。分析句子可知，此处构成“祈使句+or+陈述句”结构，根据句意，此处表示将会迟到，应使用一般将来时，又因为主语是you，故选C。

questions.prompt: Your father is very busy, so he  ______  play football with you this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：你的爸爸非常忙，所以他今天下午不会跟你一起踢足球。 考查一般将来时。doesn't一般现在时的动词三单；don't一般现在时的动词原形；isn't一般现在时；won't一般将来时。根据句意及句中时间状语this afternoon可知，本句时态是一般将来时，否定句应用won't帮助构成。故选D。

questions.prompt: Welcome ______  this short tour of London.
questions.explanation: 句意：欢迎来到这次伦敦短途旅行。 考查介词辨析。to到……；into到……里面；in在……里面；for因为/为了。分析句子可知，此处构成“Welcome to…”短语，翻译为“欢迎来到……”，是固定搭配。故选A。

questions.prompt: It takes me one hour  ______  my house every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我每天花一个小时打扫我的房子。 考查it的固定句型。to clean动词不定式；cleaning动名词；clean动词原形；will clean一般将来时。分析句子可知，此处构成“it takes sb+时间+to do sth”句型，表示“花费某人多长时间去做某事”。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you pay for it? —Over the Internet.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你是怎么付钱的？——通过互联网。 考查特殊疑问句。What什么；How much多少/多少钱；How如何，怎样；When什么时候。分析句子并根据答语“Over the Internet.”可知，此处强调方式，所以用How提问，故选C。

questions.prompt: Please pick me up at the  ______. My plane arrives at 8:00 am.
questions.explanation: 句意：请来机场接我。我的飞机在上午8点到达。 考查名词词义辨析。hotel宾馆；airport机场；museum博物馆；theatre戏院，电影院。根据句意“前来接我”以及飞机降落时间，可知是机场。故选B。

questions.prompt: Lucy is good at  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：露西擅长弹钢琴。 考查动名词作宾语和定冠词的用法。分析句子可知，此处用于“be good at doing sth”结构中，表示“擅长做某事”，排除A和C；又因为play后接西洋乐器，乐器前需加定冠词the。故选B。

questions.prompt: They all choose me  ______  our class monitor.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们都选我作为我们班的班长。 考查介词辨析。as作为；in在……里；with和……一起；on在……上。根据句意可知，此处表示“他们都选我作为我们班的班长”，构成“choose sb as…”短语，翻译为“选择某人作为……”。故选A。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a pig, two ducks and three dogs in the yard.
questions.explanation: 句意：有一只猪，两只鸭子和三只狗在院子里。 考查there be句型及其就近原则。分析句子可知，此处构成“there be”句型，表示“有”，排除A和C；又因为there be需满足“就近原则”，本句中谓语动词取决于a pig，表单数。故选B。 短文语法填空 A We  ______ 21 ______  London and Paris in the coming summer holiday. London is the capital of Britain. There are many museums in this city. Paris is the capital of France. And there are also many famous museums in it. All are beautiful places. So we are looking forward to  ______ 22 ______  them. I think we will enjoy ourselves.

Every country has its own festivals to celebrate different things. Some festivals are more interesting than others because they are unusual—and a lot more fun! Here are just a few unusual festivals from around the world.
Holi, the festival of colours, is in India, Nepal and other parts of the world. Holi celebrates the end of winter and the coming of spring and it lasts for many days. During the festival, people throw coloured powder and water at each other. It’s one of the most colourful festivals in the world.

The only colour during another famous festival is red. “La Tomatina” is in Bunol Spain, in August. People come from all over the world for a big food fight. All over the city, people run through the streets throwing red tomatoes at each other. The streets get very messy but everyone has a good time.

Another strange and cold festival, Quyllur Rit’i, is in Peru in every May or June. People celebrate with music and dancing on top of a glacier ! The festival lasts for three days and, at the end, everyone walks out together carrying torches of fire.

Finally, how about a festival with animals? On the last Sunday of November, people in Lopburi, Thailand, invite some unusual guests to dinner at the Monkey Buffet Festival. Hundreds of monkeys come and they eat a lot of fruit, nuts and vegetables.

One Saturday in January, it was so cold that I didn’t want to go outside to walk the dog. So, I just opened the door and let him out by himself. I watched him to make sure he would comeback. However, another dog passed our house, and our dog ran after him. I hurried to get my coat and rushed outside, but it was too late. Our dog was gone. I walked a few streets but couldn’t find him.
I returned home, feeling worried. My mother was at the door and asked what happened. I told her I let the dog out alone, and now he was lost. She was very angry. Then she made some signs that read, “Lost: A big black dog. Please call us right away.” with our phone number on them. She gave me the signs and told me to put them upon street posts.
My sister and I posted the signs along our street and nearby streets. The whole time, I thought about how cold it was and how cold our dog must be. Later, my sister wanted to go home, so I walked her home and then kept looking for the dog myself. I searched the neighbourhood , calling out his name and looking in all the side streets. I got more and more worried. All I wanted was to stay warm, but now I was very cold — and so was my dog. Finally, I gave up and went home.
When I got back, my mother was smiling. She told me our dog had comeback home by himself. She said I was right that he would comeback, but I was wrong to not walk him. I agreed with her. This was a very difficult morning for everyone.

reading-b.title: Exercise 022
reading-b.content:
My younger brother Tom and I were watching cartoons at home and my mother was out shopping. I left Tom in the living room and went to get something to drink. As I was getting some orange juice, I heard something break. I quickly ran to see what happened. My mother’s favorite vase was on the floor, in pieces.
“What did you do?” I asked.
“I broke it!” Tom answered. “I’m sorry!”
Knowing that he was afraid, and not wanting him to get in trouble, I did what any sister would do. I tried to help him. I quickly ran to get some glue . I didn’t know what time my mother was going to be back, so I tried to hurry. I quickly picked up all of the broken pieces and started to glue them together. It took me an hour to finish the job. Then came the real problem.
I did put the vase back together, but I also glued my hair to it!
“My beautiful hair,” I cried. Seeing that there was no way to get my hair off the vase, I cut it, and I cried again. As I was leaving the bathroom, I heard a key turn in the front door.
“Hey guys, I’m back!”
My mother was back! Tom ran to his room, leaving me all by myself. Before I could say a word, my mother became angry and shouted at me. She decided to ground me because she thought I broke the vase.
While I was lying on my bed, I understood that what I did for Tom was an act of friendship. I knew that even though Tom and I fought a lot, I was still willing to make a sacrifice for him——my hair and my freedom!
Then there was a knock on my door.
“Who is it?” I asked.
Tom walked in and gave me a hug. “Thank you,” he said.
“You’re welcome,” I said. “I guess that’s what a big sister is for, to be a friend when you need one.”

“I’m glad you still want to be my friend,” Amy said.
“Of course, Amy. You’re my best friend and you always will be,” Liz said.
Amy smiled and they hugged.
On the way home, Amy sat with her new bus partner and Liz sat near the front reading a book. The girl beside Liz began to talk to her about the book. Realizing they had a lot in common, the two talked for the rest of the ride.
The year of the 7th grade went on like this. At last, Liz made some new friends who had the same interests as her. And Amy got to know almost everyone else. The pair are still best friends.

The Basketball Team

I was always tall for my age. When I started Grade 7, I was taller than all the other students in the school.
But I was never very fit. I just couldn’t do things in sports, like throwing a baseball. The ball would fall out of my hand onto the ground.
In Grade 8, we got a new coach at our school. He took one look at me and said, “This school needs a basketball team, and you are going to be the star!” I laughed, and my friends laughed even more.
“Amy doesn’t even know what a basketball is!” joked one of my friends. The new coach said, “Don’t worry. I’ll show you what she can do.”
Every day after school, I worked with the new coach. He told me that because I was so tall, my job would be to play centre. A centre is a player who stands under the net and puts rebounds into the net. Centres are always the tallest on the team.
I did push-ups and sit-ups. Most of all, I practised shooting . When I first started, I got zero of ten shots I took. But after a few weeks, I had about five of ten shots landing in the basket.
I still wasn’t very good. But I was so tall that if someone took a shot I was usually the first one to reach the ball after it came down from the net. I became pretty good at putting the ball into the net.
The season came and went. We didn’t do very well, but I learned something about myself that season.
I’m in Grade 9 now and not good enough yet to make it to the high school team. But I think I will be next year.

It was a cold afternoon in winter. My oldest son, Stephen, was at school, and Reed, my husband, at work. My three little ones were sitting around the kitchen table. Tom was making a paper plane, while Sam was working on an oil painting.
But Laura, our only daughter, sat quietly and was lost in her project. Every once in a while, she would ask how to spell the name of someone in our family, and then carefully write the letters one by one. Next, she would add flowers with small items. She finished off each with a sun in the upper right—hand corner. Holding them at eye level, she let out a long sigh of satisfaction.
“What are you doing, Honey?” I asked. She looked quickly at her brother before looking back at me. “It’s a surprise.” she said, covering up her work with her hands.
Next, she put her work into a box. When she had finished, she disappeared up the stairs. Later that evening, I noticed a “mailbox” on the doors to each of our bedrooms. There were little notes saying that she loved all of us. She hadn’t forgotten Sam or baby Paul. There were pages of colored scenes including flowers with happy faces. “He can’t read yet,” she whispered , “But he can look at the pictures.” Each time I received one of my little girl’s gifts, it brightened my heart. I was touched at how carefully she paid attention to what wrong happened to us. When Stephen lost a baseball game, there was a letter telling him she thought he was the best ballplayer in the whole world. After I had a hard day, there was a message thanking me for my efforts.
This same little girl is grown now, but some things about her have never changed. Yesterday I found a love note next to my bedside. “Thanks for always being there for me, Mom,” it read, “I’m glad that we’re the best friends.”
There are angels among us. I know I live with one.

“There’s a number to call to find out more about helping them. Would you like to call it with me?”

I placed second in my school the following year, but more importantly, I realized that I really loved geography and enjoyed the time I spent learning it. But I think I should read more books besides the textbooks, the more, the better. It can open my eyes and improve my language skills. Of course, it also can help me to get good grades. Do you know how to read more and learn more? Here are some tips for you.
Clear your purpose for reading
Before you start reading, ask yourself why you are reading this book. Most people read for two main reasons, pleasure or knowledge. Being clear about your reading purpose can not only help you choose the books you really need to read, but also remind you why reading the book is important to you, so you will keep reading and complete the book faster.
Read only what you are interested in
No matter what you are reading, it is important to enjoy what you read. Your friends may tell you the books they love, but those books might not necessarily be the ones you enjoy.
Give up books that you don’t enjoy
You may have chosen books that you are interested in, and they are right to your purpose. But while you are reading them, there may still be some books that you don’t enjoy reading. Whenever you realize that you aren’t enjoying the book you are reading, give it up. Remember reading shouldn’t be a chore.
Set a reading goal
It is interesting that I read the books borrowed from libraries faster than those I bought. The reason is the books I bought don’t have a due date . I don’t need to return those books. Having a reading goal helps you work out how much reading you need to do in a week or even a day.
Before you read each book, ask yourself when you need to complete this book.

Bella watched as the car drove away. Her eyes started to water. “Hey, what’s wrong?” Mum asked. “Nothing. I don’t want to play any more.” Bella stormed inside and shut the door heavily. How could Jill do that to me? I thought we were friends.
There was a knock on the door. Her mum called outside, “Bella, are you OK?” Bella ignored it and put her pillow over her head. “I’ll be downstairs if you want to talk later. It’s a good choice to calm yourself down first.”
Finally, Bella calmed down and went to talk with her mum. Her mum always had some good ideas to help her.
“What’s going on, Bella?” Mum asked.
“Jill went somewhere with our friends and she didn’t invite me,” Bella said, “Why wouldn’t she ask me? I thought we were friends.”

“How did you feel before the walk?” Jason’s father asked. “Terrible,” Jason said with a frown .

The Big Hike

Tamara opened her eyes and jumped out of bed quickly in the morning. Most days she hated getting up early. But today it was Tamara’s first hike. She put on her new boots and tied the laces.
“Tamara,” her mother called. “Are you ready?” “Yes, I am!” Tamara said excitedly.
Her mother and her older brother James were ready, too.
Tamara’s family got into the car. They drove for two hours. Then, the road climbed high. They were driving into the mountains. Tamara rolled down her window. The air was cool and it smelled like leaves and flowers. Thirty minutes later, Tamara’s mother parked the car. “Are we here? Is this the hike?” asked Tamara.
“Yes,” said James. “See that trail ? That’s where we’ll start hiking.”
Tamara looked at the steep trail. It was long and went into the forest. Tall trees and tiny flowers lined both sides of the trail. They began to walk. Tamara’s mother and her brother talked from time to time. Tamara wanted to talk, but she felt out of breath. After they walked for an hour, Tamara took hold of her mother’s hand. “I’m tired,” she said.
“Come on, Tamara,” said her mother. “You can do it! You’re ten years old. That’s old enough to hike.”
If her mother said she could do it, Tamara knew she could. “If I try my best, I will make it!” She took a deep breath and kept going. Along the way, she tried to look around at the plants to keep her mind off how tired she felt. It was her first time to see the trees with such long leaves.
“Look, Tamara!” her brother called suddenly. The trail ended. They were at a pool next to a waterfall . It was so beautiful that Tamara couldn’t help taking off her boots. She sat on the rock and put her feet into the water. It took away her tiredness. “Congratulations, Tamara!” said her mother. “You just finished your first hike!” Tamara smiled. She decided that she liked hiking.

Later, in the lunchroom, Emily asked Mrs. Jacobs, the lunch-lady, what this meant.
“Well,” said Mrs. Jacobs, “I know that all food has calories, and calories are a way to show energy. But I don’t know how all that energy ends up in our food. I guess you have to ask a farmer!”
Luckily, today, Farmer George came to the park near Emily’s house to sell tomatoes. Farmer George told Emily proudly, “My plants make those calories for you!” “Plants make energy?” Emily asked curiously.
“Well, when the sun hits the leaves, the plant takes in CO2 and water, and mixes them together. The sunshine helps to cook this all up into sugar, and that sugar is then kept in the plant for us to eat. Some plants store more calories than others, but they can all give you energy in the form of sugar.”
Emily nodded, “So, when I eat tomatoes, I’m eating energy from the sun, air and water?” “You got it.”
Emily turned to her dad, “So all we have to do is to eat vegetables, Dad!”
Emily’s dad laughed. “I wish it were that easy, Emily. But still I think that’s probably very good advice.”

Now students’ English handwriting gets worse and worse. That makes their teachers feel worried. Is your English handwriting beautiful? If not, here are four steps that really work!
Use paper with lines
Using paper with lines can keep you writing straight instead of up or down when you write English words or sentences. Those lines on the paper can help you to write words in the right size. Be sure to fill the lined space completely. And make sure those capital letters are written properly.
Slow down
If your writing is hard to read, try slowing down a little. For some kids, going slower makes the handwriting clear. If you write too fast , it’s hard for you to stop where you should, and even worse, you may make more mistakes .
Hold your pencil right
When you hold your pencil the correct way, writing is much easier. Some kids press down really hard when they write. That makes the handwriting not nice. Try to be relaxed and don’t hold the pencil so hard. Let your writing appear nice and clean. If you do so, people will guess you are a student with a good habit.
Draw more pictures
Drawing can improve your handwriting. You need to use the skills to control your pencil better when you are drawing pictures. Even though you have no chance to draw at school, you can practice by yourself at home.
Handwriting is very important. Imagine you are a world-famous movie star or a well-known sports player, what do you do when your fan run up to you? Give them your signatures, of course!

In eastern Africa, a volcano rises more than 19,000 feet into the sky. It’s Mount Kilimanjaro, one of the world’s tallest mountains. Every year, thousands of people try to climb to the top. Fewer than half succeed.
Montannah Kenney of Texas was one of the few who succeeded. She climbed the mountain with her mom last year, when she was just 7! She was one of the youngest climbers ever to get to the top. “It felt great to reach my goal ,” Montannah said.
Her adventure began about two years ago. Montannah found out her mom was planning to climb Kilimanjaro. She asked to go too. “I wanted to see what it was like above the clouds,” she said.
The Kenneys knew it was important to be prepared. They practiced climbing on hills near their home. And they did a study. They found that they had to be ready for all kinds of weather. The bottom of Kilimanjaro is warm, but the top is snowy and cold. The Kenneys also learned that climbers can get altitude sickness , because of climbing very high too quickly. So they planned a route that would help them go slow.
Montannah and her mom started in March, 2018. Guides showed them the way. On the six-day climb, they climbed for nine hours or more each day. And it rained or snowed almost the whole time.
One day, Montannah felt sick to her stomach . She and her mom worried it might be altitude sickness. They thought about turning back. But after resting for a bit, Montannah felt better. She refused to give up. Two days later, she made it to the top of the mountain. “I was finally above the clouds!” she said.

My mother bought the beautiful basket and put it safely in some secret place I couldn’t find. Each week I eagerly counted my growing income. And then, weeks later, I jumped for joy. Oh, happy day! I made it! I finally had the exact amount we’d agreed upon.
Days later, the unthinkable thing happened. A neighbor girl appeared with the exact same basket on her shiny, new bike. The eight-year-old me cried and ran fast back home to tell my mother about this terrible news.
And then came the lesson I’ve taken with me through my life; "Honey, it doesn't matter that the baskets look the same. Your basket is extra-special," Mom said, gently drying my hot tears. "Your basket is special because you got the basket through your hard work.”

Betty thought for a moment and then said, “Okay, we need to put up signs around the neighborhood and call the local newspaper.” Tony also suggested that they call the Animals’ Home. Soon students were busy drawing posters. Two students were making phone calls. Mrs. Smith was surprised to find Betty was so confident and really showed an ability to lead.
Betty, however, was not thinking about being a leader or being shy. Her mind was on finding this lost cat’s home.
The two students making phone calls came back and announced, “The Animals' Home said that a family reported a lost cat named Lucky! They said they’d call the family to come and get him!” The class cheered. Ten minutes later, a woman showed up and said with joy, “Thank you for returning Lucky! He was very ‘lucky’ to have been found by such a caring group of students!”
The class celebrated their success. Mrs. Smith celebrated, too. Betty sat comfortably with her classmates for the first time, laughing and joking. Mrs. Smith believed it was indeed lucky that Betty had found the cat—lucky for both of them!

reading-b.content:
Have you ever wondered why it seems that some people can have enough time to do everything they want, but others can’t? Is it that the first type of people has less to do? No, it’s much more possible that they are practicing good time management skills.
Time management is hard to practice well. But once done, you will manage time much better. With minor tweaks and little efforts, you can do all you need to do in an effective way.
The key to good time management is to understand the difference between the urgent and the important. “Urgent” tasks need your immediate attention, but whether you give that immediate attention may or may not matter. “Important” tasks matter, because not doing them may have serious or even bad results.
For example, answering the phone is urgent. If you don’t do it, you may miss something important. However, it may be a stranger who just wants to sell you a phone you don’t need at all. That’s not important.
Going to the dentist is important. If you don’t, you may get gum disease. But it’s not urgent. If you leave it too long, however, it may become urgent, because you may get a toothache.
Helping to pick up your brother or sister from school is both urgent and important. If you are not there at the right time, they will keep waiting and worry too much. Seeing Wechat moments is neither urgent nor important. So why do you put it first?
Knowing the difference between the urgent and the important is the key to managing time well. Try to put your tasks into their right groups. Remember that your health is important. You should pay enough attention to your health even though there are many urgent things to do.
Although it’s not easy to group your tasks properly, try to be a good time manager so that you can have time to spend with the people you love and on the activities you like. The better you manage your time, the more successful you can be.

It’s there, but it has no weight, no colour, and you can’t smell it. You can’t see it, but it’s working everywhere in our modern world. Don’t try to touch it! It’s dangerous. It has always existed, but humans learned about it only 500 years ago.
What is it? Electricity. It’s powerful and mysterious. Thanks to electricity, you can flick a switchand have light. Watched a good TV show lately? You couldn’t do that without electricity. We cook our food, heat our homes and run our computers using electricity. But what is it, really?
Here is a simple description. Everything in the world is made of atoms . Atoms are small. You can fit millions of them on the head of a pin. In every atom, there are electrons , protons and neutrons . In some atoms, it is possible to move electrons easily from one atom to another. As the electrons move, a current is created. This is electricity.
Don’t worry if you don’t understand it fully. Just remember that electricity is the result of the movement of electrons. As the electrons move, they create a strong electric charge.
There are many ways to generate electricity. A machine called a generator spins rapidly. Water and wind can make a generator spin. So can motors fuelled by oil. As the generator spins, the electrons begin to move. As they move, they create an electric current. Power lines are built from generators to carry this current to places where people can use it. Along your street, power lines bring electricity right to your door. A wire runs into your house. More wires inside your house are attached to the plugs. Plug in your lamp, the electricity lights up the bulb, and you have light!
It takes a lot of energy to make electricity. Oil is one of the main fuels used to power electric generators. Another common fuel is coal. Our planet is running out of these resources, and using them creates a lot of pollution.
In the future, most electricity will be produced using the sun and wind. But for now, be careful about how much electricity you use. Don’t forget to turn off the lights when you leave a room. Every little bit helps.

Do you want to make dinner by yourself? Cooking isn’t something only a few people can do. Everyone—even children—can learn to enjoy. A study shows that people are healthier when they eat home-made food.
Some people think that the kitchen is not a good place for children. They want to keep children safe, and they worry that children will get hurt. There are a lot of sharp and hot things in the kitchen!
But learning to cook may make you safer. When you cook, you learn about what can be dangerous. You find out what to touch and how to touch it. As you learn to cook, you can also learn how to keep yourself safe in the kitchen.
So Much to Learn
People may say that they are too busy and don’t have time to teach children to cook. They worry that it will take longer to cook dinner with children in the kitchen. At first, it may take a little more time to help children learn to cook. But they will get better when they practice more. After some time, they may even help cooking go faster!
You can start by doing easy jobs, such as washing fruits and vegetables. Then you can try making cold foods, such as salads. Later, with the help of an adult , you can start making hot meals.
Cooking also helps with schoolwork. You need to use maths to work out how much money you save when you cook at home. When you read a recipe , you can learn new words. You may not see them in schoolwork.
Be Creative
Part of cooking is learning to make food look good to eat. When food looks good, people think it tastes better. Making food look good is a way of being creative. You can arrange fruits or vegetables by color. Or you can make a pancake with a funny face of berries for eyes and a mouth!
Not everyone will become a cook. But everyone can learn to cook. What other thing teaches so much and tastes so good?

I teach people how to become more confident through lessons and talks. I always start by telling people, “I was not a confident person before.” They don’t believe that. In fact, I had a hard time because I always thought something bad would happen. I’m going to tell you how I became more confident, as well a show you can be.
Firstly, I always compared myself to other people as I grew up. I worried about my appearance because I thought the other children had nicer clothes than me. I tried to dress like them, but I never felt comfortable. After a while, I found that copying them made me unhappy. So stop copying other people, whether it’s wearing the same clothes, having the same hobbies, or doing the same jobs. You need to tell yourself, “I don’t want to be like anyone else; I just want to be me.”
The difficulty with trying to “be me” is that sometimes you don’t know who you are. If you care too much about what other people think, you might not know what’s important to you. That’s why I think you should make a list of the things that are important. I don’t mean lists of what you have, like a nice car or popular shoes, but behavior , such as, “I think it’s important to be kind and helpful.” This will help you know yourself better and understand what behaviour you’re most comfortable with.
Another reason you might not feel confident is that you’re afraid of not achieving your goals . I postponed doing difficult things because I was worried about doing them wrong. I hoped to be more ready before facing them. One day, I knew that if I didn’t face my worries, I’d never become more confident. It won’t be easy, but you need to set goals and hold on to them. Tell yourself, “I’m not going to give up, and it’s going to make me more confident in the future.”
The wonderful thing about becoming more confident is that you’ll feel better about yourself in many ways. You’ll have healthier relationships, you’ll know yourself better, and you’ll learn to do things that you thought were impossible. You’ll still get worried from time to time, but it won’t stop you from achieving your goals.
So just tell yourself, “I’m ready to do this. I’m going to become more confident and manage my life.”

reading-c.title: Exercise 008
reading-c.content:
You read all the time. Sometimes you read just for fun. Other times you read for schoolwork. No matter what you are reading, what you read has meaning. You can connect to what you read.
Making connections is important. It’s giving your brain a place to store what you read. Your brain is like a box. The new information is kept in a safe place. You can think about it later. When you want to use the information, it’s there in your brain. The more connections you make, the better. If you have a lot of connections, your brain can work faster. If you have many ways to think about something, the information will be easier to find.

There are different ways to connect when you read.
●Text-to-self
This is when you realize something you read in a story has happened to you in your own life. Usually, this kind of connection comes with the feelings you felt at that time. It may make you feel happy, afraid, or sad.
●Text-to-text
This is when reading a story reminds you about a story you read before. You may make connections that show how the books share the same writer, have similar events , or are on the same topic. A text-to-text connection happens when you can apply what you’ve read from one text to another.
●Text-to-world
It reminds you of something you have seen happen to someone you know or have seen in the news. You connect what you are reading to real events, other people, and happenings going on in the world. You learn about the world from what you see or hear on TV, movies, magazines, and newspapers. When you can use what you have learnt through these ways to increase your understanding of the text, effective text-to-world connections happen.
All in all, like other reading skills, making connections with the text will help you increase the understanding, build up the confidence and become more interested in reading.

It wouldn’t be a birthday party without the song “Happy Birthday to You.” It is the most well-known song in the English language. People all over the world know it and sing it. But did you ever wonder who owns that song?
The song was written by two school teachers in the US. The first words were “Good morning to all.” It was a nice simple song that the children could sing each day. Later, the words were changed to “Happy birthday to you.” This was in 1893. It wasn’t until 1912 that the song was written down. But no one owned it.
In 1935, a company called Summy decided to try to be the owner of the song. They said that other people, not the two school teachers, wrote it. In 1988, the Summy Company was sold to a music company. The company said that anyone who wanted to sing “Happy Birthday to You” in public had to pay them. In September of 2015, it was decided by law that the song and the words could not be owned by anyone. So now “Happy Birthday to You” is free for anyone to sing, at home or in public.

reading-c.title: Exercise 016
reading-c.content:
Do you play with your phone before bedtime? It may be better to read a book. A US study says that using electronic screens at night can make us sleep badly.
In the evening, our bodies make melatonin . Melatonin makes us feel sleepy and relaxed. It is an important part of our sleep cycle . But the electronic screens stop that cycle from working as usual.
Why? Because phones, computers and TVs make blue light. Blue light stops our bodies from making melatonin. Even just a little bit of blue light can change our sleep cycles. Eight minutes of blue light can keep your brain “working” for another hour, according to the study. Even if you fall asleep, you may have lots of dreams, stopping your brain from resting well.
It’s even worse if you play an exciting game before bedtime. Playing games can make our hearts race, so we have a harder time falling asleep. Then, after we fall asleep, we get less “deep sleep”, so people will be in poor health.
Don’t worry. Here are some tips for you to get a good night’s sleep:
• Do something relaxing every night. Take a warm shower or read a book.
• Sleep in a dark, quiet room that is not too warm or too cold.
• Count sheep. It’s the old trick, and it really works!
• Don’t eat a big meal or have coffee. You’d better drink milk.
• Don’t run around or exercise three hours before going to bed.

3These benefits of napping are the strongest for people who don’t get enough nighttime sleep. A 2014 review of research says when night-time workers, new parents and older people with little nighttime sleep take a nap during night-time work, they feel less sleepy and have better overall performance.
4However, some people may feel tired after napping. That’s because they don’t time their naps right. Then how long is a well-timed short sleep? A 20-minute nap is useful, the psychologist Dautovich says, and 60 to 90 minutes of sleep can be even more helpful. However, when people sleep for more than 20 minutes and less than 60 minutes, they will feel tired easily.
5For another, regular short naps also seem to improve brain health in the long term, Garfield and her colleagues at University College London find. People with regular napping genes have a larger brain volume . All brains lose volume as they age, Garfield says, but taking a nap regularly is able to help slow down your aging for 2. 6 to 6. 5 years.
6Of course, not everyone can nap, Garfield says. And there are other healthy habits that could fill 20 minutes a day, such as going on a walk or going to the gym. But if it can fit in your timetable and you are also willing to try, napping will definitely reward you in many ways.

I came out of my room this morning and found Mom and Dad standing in front of the TV. On the screen, Tony Verrazo, the weatherman said, “Calvin has turned west and is headed for land.”
I didn’t understand what was happening, but suddenly Mom and Dad started rushing around.
“You pick up coconuts, Jason,” Dad said.
“Coconuts?” I was confused. We had coconut trees in the yard , but why pick up coconuts now?
I had no idea what was going on but I wanted to see Calvin, and I went to the beach. There were only two men. One had a camera and the other was talking into a microphone. I recognized him—Tony Verrazo!
“Hi, kid. What’s up?” said Tony, smiling.
“Oh, I’m taking a break from picking up coconuts,” I lied.
“Coconuts,” he said thoughtfully. “I forgot all about them. Stand over here and tell the camera who you are and what you’re doing.”
“Hi,” I took the microphone. “I’m Jason, and I’m picking up coconuts because Calvin is coming.”
“Thanks, kid,” Tony said, “You’d better head home and finish your job!”
I had to do the silly job because Tony made me tell everyone what I was doing.
After I filled up all the bags I could find with coconuts, I went inside. I saw Tony talking on TV, “Hurricane-force winds can make flying coconuts really dangerous! Don’t forget to pick them up! And we want to give credit to the person who came up with the idea.”
There on TV, I was holding the microphone, saying, “Hi, I’m Jason, and I’m picking up Coconuts...”
All day, I thought I had to pick up coconuts just because I was little and had to stay out of everybody’s way. Now I realized what Calvin really was and that what I had done actually mattered.

The keys to keeping a healthy weight are regular exercise and good eating habits. It may sound difficult to try to work them into our lives, but in fact, the best way is by making small changes. Here’s the information you need to make healthy habits easy.
Teens should get 60 minutes or more of physical activity a day. Notice the word “activity”: as long as you’re getting your body moving, any kind of exercise will do. What’s important is that each week you get the right balance of activity, including aerobic, strength building, and stretching exercises. Make exercise a habit by doing some of them every day.

On days when you don’t have football practice or a PE lesson, 60 minutes a day of activity seems like a lot of time for busy students. The good news is that it’s OK to take shorter “exercise breaks” during the day. So get up 15 minutes early and do some stretching. Fast walk for 15 minutes at lunch. Walk or bike home after school.
Eating well doesn’t mean dieting over and over again. In fact, studies have shown that dieting often doesn’t work—and diets may have the reverse effect, with dieters putting on more weight than before they started.
One reason diets don’t work is because they can make people think of foods as “good” or “bad”, but the truth is, everything is OK in moderation . Dieters are also more likely to “give up” some foods; we may end up longing for these foods while our bodies don’t get enough important nutrients . Teens should eat all kinds of food, and there’s nothing wrong with a treat occasionally. A candy bar somehow tastes more special if we treat ourselves from time to time, not every day.
Try to come up with ways to fit exercise and healthy eating into your life in a way that works for you. We’re all different. Your best friend might like gym time better, while you enjoy walks with your dog in the park. Knowing what’s right for you will make staying at a healthy weight a lot easier!

reading-c.title: Exercise 022

Have you noticed any differences since the clocks moved forward by an hour? Maybe you’ve seen new plant life, or felt the days getting lighter and longer. By seeing changes in nature, you can welcome change in your own life too.
What is change
Ekta Hattangady is a doctor. She helps people pay attention to their thoughts and feelings. “Change means that things are becoming something else,” she says. “One example of change is losing baby teeth and getting new teeth as you grow up. Another example of change is the life of a flower. At first it was a seed that received water and sunlight, and grew into a plant with a stem, leaves and flowers. In time the flower will fade—that’s how everything in life changes. Change is a natural part of life.”
Coping when change feels hard
Humans are “beings of habit” and learn to do the same things over and over, like eating breakfast at a certain time and getting ready for school by keeping the same patterns every morning. Sometimes things happen and we have to change our patterns—like moving to a new home or changing schools. These changes can feel uncomfortable and it’s natural to feel sad when things happen that you might not want. However, noticing those feelings of worry, sadness or fear can help you to welcome change and not worry about it more than you need to.
When you experience change, try to notice and pay attention to how you feel in your body and also your thoughts. “Sometimes you might cry; sometimes you might feel sad or lonely,” says Hattangady. Being aware of and accepting what’s happening in your body and mind can help you manage and be less sad. Talk to someone you trust—your friends, your teachers or your parents—about what is going on and how you feel. It can be helpful. Change can be wonderful. Who knows? You may learn new things about yourself, develop skills and make new friends. It also means that sad feelings don’t last. The sun will always rise, flowers will return and there will be new adventures ahead.

reading-c.title: Exercise 027

How Do Animals Spend the Winter?

The weather gets colder, days get shorter and leaves turn color and fall off the trees. Soon, winter is here. Snow covers the ground. People live in warm houses and wear heavy coats outside. Our food comes from shops or supermarkets. But what about animals?
Animals do many different, amazing things to get through the winter. Some of them migrate. This means they travel to other places where the weather is warmer or they can find food.
Birds can fly very long distances. For example, the Arctic tern nestsclose to the North Pole in summer. In autumn, it flies south all the way to Antarctica. Each spring it returns north again. Most migrating birds travel shorter distances. But how do they find their way to the same place each year? Birds seem to use the sun, moon and stars for direction.
How do they know when it is time to leave for the winter? Scientists are still studying this. Many see migration as part of a yearly cycleof changes a bird goes through. The cycle is controlled by changes in the amountof daylight and the weather.

Some animals remain and stay active in winter. They must adapt to the changing weather. Many make changes in their behavior or bodies. To keep warm, animals may grow new, thicker fur in autumn. On snowshoe rabbits, the new fur is white to help them hide in the snow. Food is hard to find in winter. Some animals, like mice, gather extra food in autumn and store it to eat later. Some, like rabbits and deer, spend winter looking for leaves to eat. Animals may find winter shelter in holes in trees or logs, under rocks or leaves, or underground. Some mice even build tunnels through the snow.
Some animals sleep for part or all of the winter. It is a special, very deep sleep called hibernation. The animal’s body temperature drops, and its heartbeat and breathing slow down. It uses very little energy. So it needs little or no food. In autumn, these animals get ready for winter by eating extra food and storing it as body fat. They use this fat for energy while hibernating.

Shyness means feeling nervous or frightened when you’re around other people. Experts have found that more than 80% middle school students feel afraid to be the centre of attention . Some kids are born shy. Some become shy later because of their life experiences.
It’s OK if it takes you a while to feel yourself again when you go to a new place or meet new people. In fact, everybody gets a little shy sometimes. It’s just a case of how much.

Shy people are also good at working with others because they think more for other people. Some great people in history were shy, too.
You see, being shy isn’t all bad. But remember not to let good chances pass by just because of it! If you have to sing a song at a birthday party or practice your spoken English in front of others, just do it! There’s nothing to be afraid of.

“Keep your eyes on your own paper” is one of the rules that Mrs. Archer has taught us. It is a simple rule, but it’s not a rule everybody chooses to follow.
This morning, I had an experience with a “rule breaker ” during an English exam. I felt somebody was watching me a little too closely. I turned my head quickly and saw James who sat right behind me. My eyes caught his and he said in a low voice, “I hope you studied for this test!” I gave him a smile, not sure whether he was joking or not, and returned to my test. This time I leaned a little more closely towards my paper, “I can’t see!” James said.
“What am I going to do?” I thought to myself. Cheating went against my will. I curled my arm around my answers.
“He’s your friend, and what are friends for?”
“You know it’s wrong.”
I tapped the top of my desk, hoping for an easy way out of this matter. No easy answer came. I just knew I had to do what I felt was right, even if it made James mad. So I guarded my paper so that he couldn’t see my answers.
When the exam ended, I stood there for a moment, searching for the right words to say to James. “Sorry, James, but you know me well enough to understand how I feel about cheating,” I said slowly and softly. “But maybe I could help you study before the next test.” “OK, Brian,” he smiled. “It might not be easy, but I’ll give it a try.”
I felt happy that my friendship with James hadn’t been destroyed . Mrs. Archer would be proud.
