Getting kids to exercise or join in any kind of physical activity can be difficult for a lot of parents. But researchers have found that poor motor skills won’t stop kids from being physically fit. In fact, they say kids with poor motor skills are likely to have the same excellent physical fitness.
The researchers checked the motor skills, body fat, and aerobicfitness levels of over 330 kids between the ages of 7 and 11 in the study. To check the aerobic ability, the kids were asked to take a bike riding test and slowly increase the amount of a bicycle workout. As the kids exercised, the researchers measuredtheir V(O) mm, which shows physical fitness based on how well the body uses oxygenduring exercise.
The study showed that the kids’ motor skills didn’t play a role in their performance in the aerobic fitness test. Those with weaker motor skills were just as physically fit as other kids in the study who had stronger motor skills.
The researchers also learned that the kids’ weight didn’t show their physical fitness. These findings match with those from another recent study, which found that kids being active in exercise is more important for their health than their body mass index (BMl). It’s important for kids to understand the importance of exercise, so they can develop healthy habits that last beyond childhood.
“Our study clearly showed that aerobic fitness is not linkedto motor skills when we think about body composition,”Dr. Haapala said. “Also, aerobic fitness was not strongly linked to overweight or obesity. That is to say, the kids’ weight couldn’t be a sign of their physical health.”
The researchers hope that these findings are encouraging for schools and parents—especially for those who have kids with poor motor skills.

reading-d.title: Exercise 071
reading-d.content:
The technology is great. Without it we wouldn’t have been able to put a man on the moon, explore the ocean’s depths or eat microwave sausages. Computers have changed our lives and they have the power to educate and pass on knowledge. But sometimes this power can create more problems than it solves.
Every doctor has had to try their best to calm down patients who’ve come into their surgery waving an Internet print-out, convincedthat they have some rare incurable disease, say, throat cancer. The truth is usually far more ordinary, though: they don’t have throat cancer, and it’s just that their throats are swollen. Being a graduate of the Internet “school” of medicine does not guaranteeaccurate self-health-checks.
One day Mrs. Almond came to my hospital after feeling faint at work. While I took her blood sample and tried to find out what was wrong, she said calmly, “I know what’s wrong; I’ve got throat cancer. I know there’s nothing you doctors can do about it and I’ve just got to wait until the day comes.”
As a matter of routine I ordered a chest X-ray. I looked at it and the blood results an hour later. Something wasn’t right. “Did your local doctor do an X-ray?” I asked. “Oh, I haven’t been to the doctor for years,” she replied. “I read about it on a website and the symptomsfitted, so I knew that’s what I had.”
However, some of her symptoms, like the severe cough and weight loss, didn’t fit with it—but she’d just ignored this.
I looked at the X-ray again, and more tests confirmedit wasn’t the cancer but tuberculosis -something that most certainly did need treating, and could be deadly. She was lucky we caught it when we did.
Mrs. Almond went pale when I explained she would have to be on treatment for the next six months to ensure that she was fully recovered. It was certainly a lesson for her. “I’m so embarrassed,” she said, shaking her head, as I explained that all the people she had come into close contact with would have to be found out and tested. She listed up to about 20, and then I went to my office to type up my notes. Unexpectedly, the computer was not working, so I had to wait until someone from the IT department came to fix it typically. Maybe I should have a microwave sausage while I waited.

Many people complain about their bad memory, especially when they are older. How can we improve our memory?
Many people think that repeating things is the best way to remember them. While this undoubtedly helps short-term memory(remembering a telephone number for a few seconds, for example), psychologistsdoubt whether it can help you remember things for very long. The British psychologist E. C. Stanford seemed to prove this point when he tested himself on five prayersthat he had read aloud every morning for over 25 years. He found that he could remember no more than three words of some of them! More helpful, especially for remembering numbers, is grouping the information. The following numbers would be impossible for most of us to remember: 1492178919931848. But look at them in chunks, and it becomes much easier: 1492 1789 1993 1848.
According to experts, there are many ways of training your memory. Many of them involve forming a mental picture of the things to be memorized. One method, which may be useful in learning foreign languages, is to create a picture in your mind connected to a word you want to remember.
Another method is to invent a story that includes all the things you want to remember. In experiments, people were asked to remember up to 120 words using this skill; when tested afterwards, on average, they were able to recall 90% of them!
However, not all of us are interested in learning long lists of names and numbers just for fun. For those studying a large amount of information, psychologists suggest that the best way to form meaningful connections is to ask yourself lots of questions as you go along. So, for example, if you were reading about a particular disease, you would ask yourself questions like: "Do people get it from water?", "What parts of the body does it influence?" and so on. This is said to be far more effective than time spent "passively" reading and re-reading notes.

We all know that animals are better at some things and we can usually explain why animals can do them better than us. One of the skills which many animals have is homing instinct . These animals such as pigeons, bees, salmons, frogs and cats can find their way home, sometimes making trips of hundreds of kilometers back home. In our daily life, we can make use of an animal’s homing instinct. Pigeons, for examples have been used to carry messages or letters in times of war. Nowadays some people join in the Pigeon Association with the pigeons they have trained because they look on pigeon racing as a hobby.
There are many interesting stories of the homing instinct at work. In the USA a cat travelled 1, 360 kilometers back to its old home after the owners moved, taking nearly a year over the trip. When we lose our kitten, we usually find her again near the house where she was born. We have a pond in the garden where the frogs come back every year. I even heard a dog which was injured by a car managed to take itself to the vet ! There are other wonderful stories about the homing instinct. But how do these animals find their way home? They don’t have satellite navigation with them, they can’t read maps and, as far as we know, they can’t ask each other for directions. It seems that some animals, such as salmons, use their sense of smell to take them back to the place where they were born. Other animals such as birds and bees may use the sun, the stars and the moon to help them find their way. There is a theory that some animals have magnetic cells in their brains which help them to find their way. As far as cats are concerned, nobody really knows how their homing instinct works and I am sure cats are never going to give away their secrets .

reading-d.title: Exercise 087
reading-d.content:
As a middle school student, school was difficult for me. I had a kind of attention problem, which means I couldn’t pay attention to what I was doing. So when everyone else in the class was centering their attention on lessons, I could not.
In my first reading class, Mrs. Smith asked us to read a story and then write on it, all finished in 45 minutes. I put up my hand and said, “Mrs. Smith, you see, the doctor said I have attention problems. I think I can’t finish the task.”
She looked down at me through her glasses, saying, “You are not different from your classmates, young man.” I tried. But I didn’t finish the reading when the bell rang. I had to take it home.

In the quietness of my bedroom, the story suddenly all became clear to me. It was about a blind person, Louis Braille. He lived in a time when the blind couldn’t get much education. But Louis didn’t give up. Instead, he invented a reading system of raised dots. The blind could get much more useful information from books than before.
Wasn’t I the “blind” in my class, being made to learn like the “sighted” students? With thoughts running through my head, I started to get interested in reading and writing. I finished the task in less than 40 minutes. I found that I was not different from others. I just needed a quieter place. If Louis could find his way out of his problem, why should I ever give up?
I didn’t expect anything when I handed in my paper to Mrs. Smith, so it was quite a surprise when it came back to me the next day with an “A” on it. At the bottom of the paper were these words, “See what you can do when you keep trying?”

reading-d.title: Exercise 088

Do you want to live a happy and healthy life? Try laughing for no reason at all. That’s how thousands of people start their day at Laughter Clubs around the world and many doctors now think that having a good laugh may be a very good way to stay healthy.

Dr Madan Kataria started the first Laughter Club in India, in 1995. “Young children laugh about 300 times a day. Adults laugh between 7 and 15 times a day,” says Dr Kataria. “Everyone is good at laughing from the day they were born—it’s the language everyone knows. We want people to feel happy with their lives.” There are now about 500 Laughter Clubs in India and over 1,300 all over the world.
Many doctors are also interested in the advantages of laughter on our health. A 5-year study at the UCLA School of Medicine in California shows that with laughing, people don’t feel so stressful . Laughter is able to make ill people turn out to be healthy.
So, what happens at a Laughter Club? I went to a club near my home to find out. I was very nervous at the beginning of the class, and I didn’t like the idea of laughing with a group of strangers, and I was worried about looking too funny. Our laughter teacher told us to clap our hands and say “ho ho ho, ha ha ha...” when we were looking at each other. In fact, our bodies can’t tell the difference between real and not real laughter. Both of them can help us keep healthy.
Surprisingly, it works! After ten minutes everybody in the room was laughing for real and some people just couldn’t stop! At the end of the class, I was surprised by how happy and comfortable I felt. So when you’re under stress, just start laughing. As Dr Kataria says, “When you laugh, you change and the world changes around you.”

reading-d.title: Exercise 093
reading-d.content:
Food is a majorof every culture. After all, everyone needs to eat! But each country has its own traditions on what people eat and when.
Egypt
Egyptians commonly start the day with a drink, sometimes going with bread. Breakfast can be eaten any time after this but before the day’s main meal. In the past, this main meal was served at around 3:00 p.m. But now people work longer hours and eat when they get home at around 6:00 p.m. Dinner parties are held later, around 9:00 p.m.
Most Egyptian meals include bread or ice, cooked vegetables and beans or meat.
France
France is known for its fine cooking, and its people take food seriously. Most eat three meals a day at fixed times and never snack between meals. Breakfast is a light meal of bread and coffee. They eat lunch at around 1:00 p.m. and a dinner with multiple courses after 8:00 p.m.
The French consider eating a social activity. Eating alone is hard to see, and eating while doing something else is unheard-of. The French take time to enjoy their meals and visitors should do the same.
Brazil
Like the French, Brazilians usually eat a light breakfast. Lunch, the largest meal of the day, usually consists of meat, rice, potatoes, beans and vegetables. Between 6:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m., people enjoy a smaller meal with their families.
Brazilians don’t mind eating a hurried or light meal and sometimes buy food from street carts . But they always finish eating before walking away.
The United States
American’s ancestors came from many countries, so American eating habits differ. Some take time to prepare and eat a hot breakfast. Others take a bagel while rushing out the door or just skip breakfast. For lunch, most Americans eat a sandwich or leftovers. Traditionally, families got together for a large evening meal around 6:00, but now busy schedules force many families to eat in turns. American restaurant servings tend to be huge. But you don’t have to finish them; taking leftovers home is common.

For many centuries people have asked: Why do we dream? What do our dreams mean? Today, science doesn’t have definite answers to these questions, but we do know some things about dream. First, we all dream, often four to five times a night. Second, we don’t usually remember most of our dreams. And finally, when we dream, our brains are very awake.
Thousands of years ago, people began to study dreams. In many cultures, people believed dreams were messages from spirit or gods. Later, the ancient Greeks and Romans had a new idea—Dreams come from a person’s mind. Doctors studied dreams to help sick or worried people.
In the past, some cultures used dreams to predict the future. They thought dreams could help a person choose a husband or wife, guess a baby birthday, or start a business. In some places, this practice is still common.
Today, scientists think dreams are about our thoughts and feelings. Our brains send us messages about our lives. Unluckily, many messages are often strange or confusing. People wake up and think: what did that dream mean?
So, how can you understand the messages in your dreams? Think about the events in the dream. What do they say about your life? For example, one common dream is about flying. reading-d.title: Exercise 102
reading-d.content:
Studies have shown it takes a doctor about 18 seconds to stop a patient after he begins talking.
It was Sunday. I had one last patient to see. I came close to her room in a hurry and stood at the doorway. She was an older woman, sitting at the edge of the bed, trying to put socks on her swollen feet. I spoke quickly to the nurse, saw her chart saying she was in stable condition. I was almost in the clear.
She asked if I could help put on her socks. Instead, I began a long speech that went something like this: “How are you feeling? Your blood sugar and blood pressure were high but they’re better today. The nurse said you can’t wait to see your son who’s visiting you today. It’s nice to have family visit from far away. I’m sure you really look forward to seeing him.”
She stopped me with a serious voice. “Sit down, doctor. This is my story, not your story.”
I was surprised and ashamed. I sat down. I helped her with the socks. She began to tell me that her only son lived around the corner from her, but she had not seen him in five years. She believed that the pressure of this caused greatly to her health problems. After hearing her story and putting on her socks, I asked if there was anything else I could do for her. She shook her head and smiled. All she wanted me to do was to listen.
Listening to someone’s story costs less than expensive diagnostic testing but is key to healing. I often thought of what that woman taught me—the importance of stopping, sitting down and truly listening. And, not long after, unexpectedly, I became the patient, with a diagnosis of sclerosis at age 31. Now, 20 years later, I sit all the time—in a wheelchair.
For as long as I could, I continued to see patients from my chair, but I had to give up my job when my hands were influenced. I still teach medical students and other health care professionals, but now from the view of doctor and patient.
I tell them I believe in the power of listening. I tell them I know firsthand that huge healing takes place within me when someone stops, sits down and listens to my story.

reading-d.title: Exercise 103

There is great excitement and argument over Artificial Intelligence . The argument about whether robots will replace teachers in the classroom is very heated. Some people think this revolution is sure to happen in the next ten years. Others think that the value a good teacher brings, not only to the classroom setting, but in developing a child’s confidence and creativity outside lessons, cannot be easily replaced.
AI is not new for us and is already being used successfully in many fields, such as medicine, finance and so on. So what does this mean for our future? In my view, AI will help kids to think more freely and creatively. Can AI possibly cut down the teaching work in the future, too? Of course. Our teachers are always busy preparing materials for their lessons. Just imagine how happy they would be if they don’t have to copy hundreds of paper, but instead, have this task or others done by machines.
However, most importantly, I do not believe AI will be able to imitate the human mental condition totally, especially empathy and emotional intelligence. What makes learning memorable is shared experience, human interaction, and long-lasting positive relationships. For example, experienced teachers can adapt their interaction with a student if he has suffered a serious loss. But there is no evidence that robots can imitate this adaptability well.
I also believe we need to continue to celebrate our kids’ individuality and their ability not only to make decisions but also make the right decision. These are skills that they can get as they gain more life experience and are given the space to experiment.
To what degree can teachers use AI in their classes? You can have all the data you like with the help of AI, but great teachers will also need to depend on their own gut feeling .

If a friend gives us a big help, it’s a good idea to write them a thank-you note. But how many of us can sit down to do this?
“People don’t seem to walk around giving thanks to people quite often,” Amit Kumar from University of Texas said. Why are people uncertain about sending thank-you notes? And how do people feel when they receiveone?
Kumar and his team asked some students to send a thank-you note to another person by email. Then, they asked both the writer and the recipient how sending or receiving these notes made them feel.
They found that the students didn’t like to write the notes because they had to think too much about them. They worried about what to say and how to say it.
The recipients, however, enjoyed the notes. “When you are a recipient, you can feel the warmth of the note,” Kumar says, “How heartfelt was it? How friendly and warm?”

“The recipients feel quite happy,” Kumar says. “They don’t really feel awkward at all.”
“If people knew that writing a thank-you note could have such a big influence on others, they would do it more often,” Kumar says.
“Simple, small changes in our everyday lives can make a big difference in how we treatother people and how we feel, so start from writing the thank-you note,” he says.

reading-e.title: Exercise 005
reading-e.content:
Art of Coffee
What would you do if you spilledyour coffee on your desk? Many of us would probably immediately begin cleaning up the desk. German artist Stefan Kuhnigk, however, thinks differently. He has used coffee stains to create his world of art.
It all started in 2011. One day, Kuhnigk accidentally spilled his coffee on a piece of paper. Instead of throwing the paper away, he looked at the coffee stain for a while. The stain seemed to look back at him. The artist picked up his pen and started to draw. Half an hour later, his first coffee monster was born.
Since then, Kuhnigk has never put his pen down. Over the last nine years, he has drawn more than 500 monsters. Some of them are lovely. But some have sharp teeth and look evil. Kuhnigk also writes a short story for each of his monsters. Many people like Kuhnigk’s funny creations. They say the monsters and their stories always make them laugh.
So the next time you spill your coffee or something else, don’t immediately clean it up. It’s your chance to be an artist, too!

reading-e.title: Exercise 013
reading-e.content:
Can you remember a time when somebody was kind to you? Maybe a stranger allowed you to go in front of him in a queue. Or perhaps a friend helped you in a much deeper way. There are a million ways to offer kindness.
Why should we be kind?
Being kind is a win-win situation. It brings happiness to both the receiver and the doer of this kind action. Let's imagine you have a workmate who always does a very good job. How about taking a moment to mention this to him? Your workmate will be happy to receive some praise,and you will probably feel good about yourself for having spread a little joy.
What are "random acts of kindness"?
Many organizations encourage people to do kind acts whenever and wherever possible. Their idea is that it doesn't take any plan to be kind,just a little bit of effort. Perhaps the strongest supporters of this idea are the Random Acts of Kindness (RAK)Foundation,who work with schools and companies to teach people kindness skills. They believe that kindness can be taught.
How can I be kind?
The RAK website suggests some ways to show kindness. Generally,they fall into three categories.The first is interpersonal kindness, like donating old clothes to charity or writing a positive online comment about a restaurant. The second is environmental kindness,which could mean recycling or cleaning a local park. The third category is personal kindness,which means treating yourself kindly,such as taking a walk in nature or treating yourself to a big meal. By being kind to yourself,you will be kinder to the world around you.

What is World Kindness Day?
World Kindness Day takes place on 13November. People in many countries celebrate this day by being kind and having lots of fun. One typical event is to use “kindness cards”.You hand a kindness card to somebody when you do a kind act for him. Then it is his turn to pass on the card by doing a kind act for another person.
Being kind has a sort of rippleeffect. This means that one kind action leads to more and more. So don't wait for kindness to find you,go and start a new ripple!

questions.prompt: —Did your brother do anything fun yesterday? —Yes, he went to the zoo with  ______  friend.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你哥哥昨天做什么好玩的事了吗？——是的，他和他的朋友去动物园了。 考查代词辨析。her她的；his他的；your你的；their他们的。根据“he”可知，此空应填his，修饰名词friend，故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  July the 18th, we will travel to the beach to enjoy a day of sea, sand and swimming.
questions.explanation: 句意：7月18日，我们将前往海滩，享受一天的大海、沙滩和游泳。 考查介词。On用于具体的某一天或某一天的上午、下午、晚上；In用于年、月、季节等的前面；At用于具体的时间点前面或黎明、正午、午夜等的前面；To到。根据“July the 18th”可知，是具体的某一天，所以应用On，故选A。

questions.prompt: — I’m really nervous about the talent show. — Don’t worry. You  ______  do it! You’ve prepared well and I believe in you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我对才艺表演感到很紧张。——不要担心。你能做到！你已经准备充分了，我相信你。 考查情态动词。might可能；need需要；can能够；should应该。根据“You’ve prepared well and I believe in you.”可知，此处是在鼓励对方，表示你能做到，表“能力”用can，故选C。

questions.prompt: The Wandering Earth is one of  ______  movies of the year.
questions.explanation: 句意：《流浪地球》是今年最受欢迎的电影之一。 考查形容词最高级句型。根据“one of”可知，此处考查one of + the + 形容词最高级，表示“最……之一”，故选A。

questions.prompt: The sick boy is getting  ______  day by day. His parents stop worrying about him.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个生病的男孩一天天变得更好了。他的父母不再担心他了。 考查形容词比较级用法。well好；better更好；badly差；worse更差。根据句子后面的“stop worrying about him”可知，这个男孩应该是变好了，所以排除C、D选项；根据“day by day”可知，此处应该用比较级形式，表示“一天比一天更好”，所以排除A选项。故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is it from your home to school? — About fifteen minutes’ walk.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从你家到学校有多远？——步行大约十五分钟。 考查特殊疑问句。how long多久；what time什么时间；how far多远；how often多久一次。根据“About fifteen minutes’ walk.”可知，对距离提问用疑问词how far，故选C。

questions.prompt: She always  ______  about the health of her students, trying her best to make them live a happy life.
questions.explanation: 句意：她总是关心学生的健康，尽力让他们过上幸福的生活。 考查时态。根据“She always... about the health of her students”可知，此句应该用一般现在时，主语为第三人称单数，谓语动词用三单。故选A。

questions.prompt: We were wet and hungry because of the heavy rain,  ______  we didn’t give up climbing the hill.
questions.explanation: 句意：因为大暴雨我们又湿又饿，但是我们并没有放弃登山。 考查连词。and和；but但是；so所以；or否则。根据“We were wet and hungry because of the heavy rain,... we didn’t give up climbing the hill.”可知，空格前后构成转折。故选B。

questions.prompt: —How do you like the movie? — ______. It’s really boring.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你觉得这部电影怎么样？——我受不了。它真的很无聊。 考查情景交际。I don’t think so我不这么想；Yes, I’d like to是的，我想去；I like it very much我非常喜欢它；I can’t stand it我不能忍受。根据“It’s really boring.”可知，我受不了这部电影，它太无聊了。故选D。 五、语法填空： 阅读下面短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写1个恰当的单词，在给出的提示词的空白处用括号内所给的词的正确形式填空。 I arrived in Penang in Malaysia this morning with my family. It was  ______ 11 ______  (sun) and hot, so we  ______ 12 ______  (decide) to go to the beach near our hotel. My sister and I tried paragliding. I felt like I was a bird. It was so exciting! For lunch, we had something very special-Malaysian yellow noodles. They were delicious!  ______ 13 ______  the afternoon, we rode bicycles to Georgetown. There are a lot of new buildings now, but many of the old  ______ 14 ______  (building) are still there. In Weld Quay, a really old place in Georgetown, we saw the houses of the Chinese traders from 100 years ago. I wonder  ______ 15 ______  life was like here in the past. I really enjoyed  ______ 16 ______  (walk) around the town. 【答案】11. sunny

questions.prompt: Tony and Peter are good friends. But  ______  have different habits.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼和彼得是好朋友。但他们有不同的习惯。 考查代词辨析。we我们（主格）；he他（主格）；them他/她/它们（宾格）；they他/她/它们（主格）。根据谓语动词“have”可知，此空作主语，用人称代词主格，且使用复数形式。故选D。

questions.prompt: The opening ceremony of the Hangzhou Asian Games was held  ______  September, 2023.
questions.explanation: 句意：杭州亚运会开幕式于2023年9月举行。 考查介词辨析。in在某年某月某季节；on在具体某一天；at在某时刻；to到。空格后是月份，用介词in。故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  he didn’t have much money,  ______  he bought gifts for his friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然他没很多钱，但是他依然给他的朋友们买礼物。 考查连词Although的用法。根据“...he didn’t have much money”可知，此空应该填“虽然，尽管”，Although和but不能在同一个句子中连用，只能选其一，故选A。

questions.prompt: My mom loves reading newspapers and she always shares  ______  with me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈喜欢看报纸，她总是和我分享一些有趣的事情。 考查不定代词及定语后置。nothing没什么事；something某事；interesting有趣的。根据“she always shares... with me.”可知，妈妈总是和我分享一些有趣的事，用something；形容词修饰不定代词，需放在不定代词后面。故选C。

questions.prompt: —How do you go to school every day, by bike or on foot? —By bike. It’s much  ______  than on foot.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你每天是怎么上学的，骑自行车还是步行？——骑自行车。它比步行快得多。 考查形容词比较级。fast快的；faster更快的；fastest最快的；the fastest最快的。分析句子，根据空后“than”，可知空处应填形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: Wangfujing Street is one of  ______  streets in Beijing. Let’s go shopping there.
questions.explanation: 句意：王府井街是北京最著名的街道之一，我们去那里购物吧。 考查形容词最高级。根据“one of”……其中之一可知，比较的对象超过两个，要用最高级形式；并且根据形容词最高级前必须要加定冠词the。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you usually go to the dentist? —Twice a year.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你通常多久去看一次牙医? ——一年两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长，提问时间或距离；how many 多少，问数量的多少；how often多久一次, 问概率；how soon多久以后，提问时间。根据答语中“Twice a year”可知，问的是频率。故选C。

questions.prompt: My dad  ______  the news every evening because he hopes  ______  out what’s going on around the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爸爸每天晚上都看新闻，因为他希望了解世界各地发生的事情。 考查动词时态及不定式。由句中“every evening”可知，第一空应用一般现在时，主语是“My dad”，所以谓语用第三人称单数watches；分析句子结构可知，第二空在句中作宾语，根据“hopes”可知，考查不定式作宾语，构成“hope to do sth.希望做某事”，固定用法，故选D。

questions.prompt: —What did you do last weekend? —We  ______  a picnic in the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你上周末做了什么? ——我们在公园野餐。 考查一般过去时。was having过去进行时；had一般过去时；have had现在完成时；have一般现在时。由问句“What did you do last weekend?”可知，时态为一般过去时。故选B。

questions.prompt: — How do you like your new school? —  ______  My classmates and teachers are nice to me
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认为你的新学校怎么样？——特别棒。同学们和老师们都对我很好。 考查情景交际。No problem.没问题。I don’t mind it.我不在乎；It’s fantastic.特别棒。I can’t stand it.我无法忍受。根据“My classmates and teachers are nice to me.”可知同学和老师都很好，可以推断出我对学校的看法应该很好。故选C。 五、语法填空（共7分，每小题1分） 在未给出提示词的空白处只填写一个单词；在给出提示词的空白处用所给词的适当形式填空。 (A) Some people might ask how this cartoon animal became so popular. One of the  ______ 11 ______  (reason) is that Micky was like a common man, but he always  ______ 12 ______  (try) to face any danger. In his early films, Micky was  ______ 13 ______  (lucky) and had many problems such as  ______ 14 ______  (lose) his house or girlfriend. However, he was always ready to try his best. (B) However, not everyone  ______ 15 ______  (enjoy) watching these shows. Some think that the lives of the performers are made up. For example, some people say they are poor farmers, but  ______ 16 ______  fact, they are just actors. However, if you don’t take these shows seriously, they are fun  ______ 17 ______  (watch). And one great thing about them is that they give people a way to make their dreams come true. 【答案】11. reasons

questions.prompt: Many wild animals are in danger, so we need to protect  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：许多野生动物处于危险之中，所以我们需要保护它们。 考查代词辨析。him他；her她；us我们；them它们。“protect”是动词后面要加代词宾格，本句主语是“Many wild animals”，此处指我们必须保护它们，故选D。

questions.prompt: I usually play the piano  ______  8: 00 o’clock.
questions.explanation: 句意：我通常在8点弹钢琴。 考查介词辨析。on+具体的某一天；for为了；in+年、月、季节等；at+具体时刻。“8:00 o’clock”是具体时刻，应用介词at。故选D。

questions.prompt: ______  is the population of Shanghai?
questions.explanation: 句意：上海的人口是多少？ 考查特殊疑问句。how many多少；how much多少；what什么；how怎样。对人口提问用固定句式：what's the population of...，故选C。

questions.prompt: I think English is  ______  than maths. I can always get higher marks in English.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为英语比数学容易。我英语总是能得到更高的分数。 考查形容词比较级用法。easier更容易的；easy容易的；difficult困难的；more difficult更困难的。根据空后的“than”可知此处为比较级，结合后句“I can always get higher marks in English.”可知英语总是能得到更高的分数，应是觉得英语比数学简单。故选A。

questions.prompt: Lao She is one of  ______  Chinese writers of the twentieth century.
questions.explanation: 句意：老舍是二十世纪最伟大的中国作家之一。 考查最高级。本句是“one of the+最高级+名词复数”句式，故空格处是the greatest。故选D。

questions.prompt: The government wants to  ______  a school for those poor children in the country.
questions.explanation: 句意：政府想为这个乡村的那些贫困儿童建立一所学校。 考查动词短语。set up建立，设立；try on试穿；pick up捡起；turn on打开。根据空格后面的“a school”可知，要填”建立”，其它选项语意不通。故选A。

questions.prompt: Betty practises speaking more often  ______  her Chinese.
questions.explanation: 句意：Betty经常练习口语以提高她的汉语水平。 考查非谓语动词。improve“提高”，根据空前的“Betty practises speaking more often”和空后的“her Chinese”可知，应该是练习口语以提高她的汉语水平，用动词不定式作目的状语，故选B。

questions.prompt: Let’s put the cake in the fridge,  ______  it may go bad tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：让我们把蛋糕放进冰箱，否则它明天可能会坏掉。 考查连词。but但是；or否则；and并且；so所以。根据“ it may go bad tomorrow.”可知，之后给到的是坏的情况。根据语境可知，应用否则。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What’s your plan for the coming holiday? —I  ______  the National Stadium.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你对即将到来的假期有什么计划？——我将参观国家体育场。 考查动词时态。visit是动词原形，是一般现在时；am going to visit是一般将来时；visited是过去式，是一般过去时；visits是第三人称单数形式，是一般现在时。根据“What’s your plan for the coming holiday?”可知是询问计划，回答应表述将要发生的事情，要用一般将来时。故选B。

questions.prompt: My brother  ______  his homework an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥一小时前完成了家庭作业。 考查动词时态。complete完成，动词原形；completes动词第三人称单数形式；completed动词过去式；is completing现在进行时。根据“an hour ago”，可知时态是一般过去时，用动词过去式。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What do you like to do in your free time? —I often  ______  museums with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你空闲时间喜欢做什么？——我经常和朋友一起参观博物馆。 考查动词时态。根据“What do you like to do in your free time?”和“I often...museums with my friends.”可知，句子要用一般现在时，即visit，故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D 四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 When my family moved to Ohio over the summer, I was afraid of going to another new school and knowing no one. I had bright red hair and thick glasses. Besides, I was  ______ 13 ______  and not very popular. Getting on the school bus that first day, I felt like all eyes on me.I could hear the words “She’s fat!” Clearly, the kids on the bus had known each other well. I spent that first bus  ______ 14 ______  in silence (沉默). The following day was even worse. I did not notice that a few boys had tied a rope across the aisle (通道) and then fell down, dropping everything on the bus. When I was uneasily gathering (收集) my things, I could hear the laughter. Finally, I  ______ 15 ______  a seat. Looking out of the window, I held back the tears running out of my eyes. It was then that I went into myself. I began walking everywhere. I would walk through the woods behind our house. I would also walk to a church. I began  ______ 16 ______  the afternoon school bus on purpose (故意), walking home instead. Then  ______ 17 ______, I started losing weight. As I became pleased with myself, I began making  ______ 18 ______. One of my newly-found friends also fought with (与……作斗争) her weight. She lived near my neighborhood so we would meet and walk together. This became a daily activity with talking and laughing along the way — different from the  ______ 19 ______  walks I had taken by myself. Although I would no longer want to experience that time of loneliness and sadness again, I am  ______ 20 ______  I made it through.Whenever I am fighting with any other problem in life, I always remember the saying. This too will pass.

questions.prompt: My brother is only two. He is too young to dress  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的弟弟仅仅两岁。他太小而不能自己穿衣。 考查反身代词。he他，主格；him他，宾格；his他的，形容词性物主代词；himself他自己，反身代词。该句中主语“He”发出的动作反射到自己身上，所以用he的反身代词himself，故选D。

questions.prompt: ______  April 26, 2003, Aron Ralston found himself in a difficult situation when climbing in Utah. A In
questions.explanation: 句意：2003年4月26日，阿隆·拉尔斯顿在犹他州登山时发现自己处境艰难。 考查介词辨析。In在年/月/季节等；On在具体的某一天；Upon在……上面；At在具体时刻。根据“April 26, 2003”可知此处是在具体的某一天。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What would you like, tea or coffee? — ______, thanks. I just prefer a glass of water.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你想要什么，茶还是咖啡？——都不要，谢谢你。我只是更想要一杯水。 考查不定代词。All三者或以上都；Both两者都；Neither两者都不；Either两者中的任何一个。根据“I just prefer a glass of water.”可知，茶和咖啡都不要。故选C。

questions.prompt: —I think I am the shyest in my class. What should I do? —Be more active in class  ______  you can improve your ability to express yourself.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我想我是班上最害羞的。我该怎么办？——在课堂上更加活跃，这样你就可以提高自己的表达能力。 考查连词辨析。or否则；so that以便；although虽然；unless除非。根据“Be more active in class... you can improve your ability to express yourself.”可知在课堂上更加活跃的目的是提高自己的表达能力，故用so that引导目的状语从句，故选B。

questions.prompt: My father was reading a newspaper while my mother  ______  dinner when I came home last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚我回家时，父亲正在看报纸，而母亲正在做饭。 考查时态。根据“My father was reading a newspaper while my mother”可知此处表示两个动作同时进行，故此处用过去进行时was/were doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: When I was young, my parents taught me  ______  older people kindly.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我小的时候，我的父母教我要善待老年人。 考查动词不定式。treats第三人称单数；to treat动词不定式；treated过去式或过去分词；treat动词原形。teach sb to do sth.“教某人做某事”，固定搭配，故选B。

questions.prompt: —I have difficulty  ______  the new word. What should I do? —You can look it up in the dictionary.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我在理解这个生词方面有困难。我应该做什么？——你可以在词典里查找它。 考查非谓语动词。have difficulty (in) doing sth.是固定搭配，意为“在做某事方面有困难”。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What are you going to do this summer vacation? —I  ______  to Universal Beijing Resort as soon as I finish my schoolwork.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个暑假你打算做什么？——我一完成作业就去环球北京度假村。 考查动词时态。根据“as soon as”可知，该句为时间状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tom wants his parents to  ______  a few of his after-school activities. He needs more free time.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆想让他的父母减少他的一些课外活动。他需要更多的空闲时间。 考查动词短语。cut out删去，停止；cut up切碎；cut off切断，中断；cut in插嘴。根据“He needs more free time.”可知，汤姆的空闲时间不够，所以应该停止一些课外活动，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Could you go shopping with me tomorrow? — ______. My father and I will leave for Wuhan early in the morning.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Sorry I am afraid I can’t

questions.explanation: 句意：——你明天和我一起去购物吗？——对不起，我恐怕不能。我和爸爸明天一大早就要动身去武汉。 考查情景交际。I think so我认为是这样；Yes, I hope so是的，我希望如此；I’m afraid so恐怕如此；Sorry, I am afraid I can’t对不起，我恐怕不能。根据下文“My father and I will leave for Wuhan early in the morning.”可知我父亲和我明天要去武汉，不能去购物。故选D。 通读短文，根据句意，选择合适的单词，用所选词的适当形式填空。有一个词是多余的。(共5分，每空1分) spend; leave; kind; sleep; pay; for; Wang Ya, a university student in Kunming received 5,000 yuan after ordering some takeout food for a homeless man. One night, in the heavy rain, Wang saw a homeless man  ______ 11 ______  under a bridge, wearing his summer clothes. Wang felt sorry  ______ 12 ______  him, so he went online and ordered him some food. Wang also  ______ 13 ______  a message for the restaurant. It said “Please make sure that the homeless man gets the food as soon as possible. It’s cold outside and I don’t know if he’s had anything to eat. He has stayed there since noon.” The restaurant owner was so moved that he added some food to the order. The homeless man got the food less than half an hour later. Wang’s story got so popular online that a charitable foundation (慈善基金会) gave him 5,000 yuan for his  ______ 14 ______. But he refused  ______ 15 ______  the money on himself and he gave it to charities. 【答案】11. sleeping

questions.prompt: The music  ______  really nice. I want to listen to it again.
questions.explanation: 句意：这首音乐听起来很好听。我想再听一遍。 考查动词辨析。hears听见；sounds听起来，连系动词，后跟形容词；listens听；watches看。根据“really nice.”可知，音乐听起来不错，系动词+形容词，故选B。

questions.prompt: Tree Planting Day is  ______  March 12th every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：植树节在每年的3月12日。 考查介词的用法。at用于具体的时间点前；in用于年代，月份前；to到；on用于具体的某一天前。根据“March 12th”可知，3月12日是具体的某一天，所以时间介词用on。故选D。

questions.prompt: I am so excited  ______  going to Xinjiang this May.
questions.explanation: 句意：我很兴奋今年五月能去新疆。 考查介词辨析。into进入；in在……里；for了；about有关。be excited about“对……兴奋”，故选D。

questions.prompt: I know it’s  ______  to work out the problem, but I will try  ______  on it.
questions.explanation: 句意：我知道解出这道题很难，但我会努力去做的。 考查词汇辨析。hard困难的，形容词；hard努力地，副词；hardly几乎不，副词。根据“I know it’s...to work out the problem, but I will try...on it.”可知，第一空作is的表语，指“解出这道题很难”，用形容词hard；第二空用副词修饰动词try，指“努力去做”，也用hard。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Have you ever been to Shenzhen  ______? —Yes. I went there two weeks  ______. It is a modern city.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你曾经去过深圳吗？——是的。我两周以前去那里了。它是一个现代城市。 考查副词辨析。yet还，用于否定句和疑问句；just只是；before在以前；ago以前，常用于一段时间+ago。根据“Have you ever been to Shenzhen?”可知，是疑问句，第一空用yet。根据“I went there”可知，时态是一般过去时，ago符合句意，故选C。

questions.prompt: The ice and snow in Harbin are beautiful, so every winter  ______  tourists come here.
questions.explanation: 句意：哈尔滨的冰雪很美，因此每年冬季几百万游客来这里。 考查数词的用法。当million与数词连用时，million不用复数，后面不接of；当million与of连用时，要用millions。故选B。

questions.prompt: It  ______  a lot in summer in Beijing. It is often rainy.
questions.explanation: 句意：北京夏天雨很多。经常下雨。 考查动词时态及主谓一致。根据“It... a lot in summer in Beijing.”可知，此处是描述客观事实，时态用一般现在时，主语It是三单，谓语动词也用三单rains。故选D。

questions.prompt: —We have lived in this city  ______  1980. —So you have lived here  ______  over 30 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——自从1980年以来，我们一直住在这个城市。——所以你们在这里住了超过30年。 考查介词辨析。in+时间段，通常用于一般将来时态；since+时间点，通常用于现在完成时态；for+时间段，通常用于现在完成时态。根据题干可知，两个句子时态都为现在完成时。第一空后1980为时间点，应使用since；第二空后over 30 years为时间段，应使用for。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Tom, why are you playing computer games again? —I  ______  my homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tom，为什么你又玩电脑了？——我已经做完作业了。 考查现在完成时。根据“my homework”可知，作业已经完成了，所以才玩电脑，故选D。

questions.prompt: She couldn’t help  ______  when she heard the bad news.
questions.explanation: 句意：她听到这个坏消息时忍不住哭了起来。 考查非谓语动词。can’t help doing sth“情不自禁做某事”，故选D。

questions.prompt: Jason is good at running. He  ______  run 100 meters in 11 seconds.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰森擅长跑步。他能在11秒内跑完100米。 考查情态动词。must必须；should应该；need需要；can可以。根据“He…run 100 meters in 11 seconds.”可知，此处强调能力，故选D。

questions.prompt: —May I speak to Tom? —Sorry he  ______  America. But he  ______  in two days.

choices.label: A
choices.text: has been to; will come back

choices.label: B
choices.text: has gone to; will come back

questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以跟Tom说话吗？——抱歉，他去了美国。但他在两天之后回来。 考查动词时态。has been to去过某地（已回来）；has gone to去了某地（未回来）。根据“Sorry”可知，他去了美国还没回来，故第一空应填has gone to，排除A选项。根据“in two days”可知，此处应用一般将来时will do的结构，故选B。 二、完形填空（共8分,每小题8分）阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从下面各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择可以填入空白处的最佳选项。 Romain Rolland once said, “There is only one kind of heroism in the world, and that is to still love life after recognizing the truth of life.” Cai Lei, a patient with ALS (渐冻症), perfectly  ______ 13 ______  this sentence. Cai Lei was once the vice president of Jingdong Group, with a  ______ 14 ______  job and a happy family. But who would have thought that at the age of 41, he was diagnosed (诊断) with ALS and could only watch his body “frozen” until he could not breathe. The illness gave him a fatal (致命的) wound but he didn’t want to bow to it. He began to think about  ______ 15 ______  he could do for the people with ALS in the remaining days. After much thought, Cai Lei  ______ 16 ______  an idea: he wants to produce medicine that is good for the treatment of ALS. When Cai Lei told others about this idea, everyone thought he was  ______ 17 ______. You know medicine development takes at least 10 years.  ______ 18 ______, the period from diagnosis to death of patients with ALS is no more than 5 years. Allowing patients at the moment to use medicine is impossible. What’s worse, many people in society still misunderstand him. That misunderstanding is like a  ______ 19 ______, burning Cai Lei’s heart. Although he is heartbroken, he never says anything for himself. He devotes himself to the research and development of the  ______ 20 ______. He believes: “Even if we can’t use this medicine, we should let our future generations use it.”

questions.prompt: My sister loves water sports, and swimming is ______  favorite.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹喜欢水上运动，游泳是她的最爱。 考查代词辨析。her她的；his他的；my我的；your你的。根据“My sister loves water sports”可知，此处指代sister，是女性，使用形容词性物主代词her，故选A。

questions.prompt: Sue will hold her birthday party  ______  5 o’clock this Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：苏将在这个星期六下午5点举行她的生日聚会。 考查时间介词。at后跟具体的钟点/时刻；on后跟具体的某一天；in后跟年、月、季节等时间；for后跟一段时间，表示“长达……”。空后是“5 o’clock”，表示“5点钟”，所以用介词at。故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  many children like to eat junk food, they should really eat more fruit and vegetables.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然很多孩子喜欢吃垃圾食品，但是他们真的应该吃更多的水果和蔬菜。 考查连词辨析。So所以；Although虽然；Because因为；But但是。根据“many children like to eat junk food, they should really eat more fruit and vegetables”可知，前后两句是让步关系，用although引导让步状语从句。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Jenny, could you please buy some drinks and snacks for me? — Sorry, I  ______. I am cleaning the living room.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jenny，你能帮我买些饮料和零食吗？——对不起，我不能。我正在打扫客厅。 考查情态动词。can’t不能；needn’t不需要；mustn’t禁止；shouldn’t不应该。上文“could you please buy some drinks and snacks for me?”表委婉客气的请求，其回答只能用can或can’t；结合下文“I am cleaning the living room.”可知，此处表示拒绝请求，故用can’t。故选A。

questions.prompt: Chongqing is one of  ______  cities in China nowadays.
questions.explanation: 句意：如今，重庆是中国最著名的城市之一。 考查形容词最高级。分析句子结构可知，此处是“one of+the+形容词最高级+可数名词复数”结构，表示“最……之一”，故选D。

questions.prompt: I can’t go out to play until I finish  ______  my homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我要做完作业才能出去玩。 考查非谓语动词。finish doing sth“做完某事”，动名词作宾语，故选D。

questions.prompt: —I  ______  the Great Wall with my friends next week. —Have a good trip.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我下周将和我的朋友们去参观长城。——旅途愉快。 考查一般将来时。根据“next week”可知时态为一般将来时，结构：will do。故选B。

questions.prompt: When the water ran out, he  ______  he would have to do something to save himself.
questions.explanation: 句意：当水用完了，他知道他将必须做一些事情来拯救自己的生命。 考查一般过去时。根据“When the water ran out”可知事情发生在过去，应用一般过去时。故选B。

questions.prompt: When Tom got home, his mother  ______  in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：当汤姆回到家时，他的妈妈正在厨房做饭。 考查动词时态。根据“When Tom got home”可知when引导时间状语从句，从句中got是一般过去时，主句是表示过去某个时间正在做的事情，句子用过去进行时，所以空格处填was cooking。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Jack, I’m bored. Do you want to do something together this afternoon? — ______

choices.label: A
choices.text: I think you can make it.

choices.label: B
choices.text: We are happy you like it.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Don’t forget to take some pictures.

choices.label: D
choices.text: How about watching a movie with me?

questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，我很无聊。今天下午你想要做点什么吗？——和我去看电影怎么样？ 考查情景交际。I think you can make it.我想你能做到的；We are happy you like it.我们很高兴你喜欢它；Don’t forget to take some pictures.不要忘了拍些照片；How about watching a movie with me?和我去看电影怎么样。根据“Do you want to do something together this afternoon?”可知，此处是回答今天下午的打算，选项D符合语境。故选D。 五、语法填空（共6分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，从方框中选择适当的单词并用其正确形式填空。 easy, local, is, way, push, clothes Actually there are some creative  ______ 11 ______  to show kindness. The first way is the kindness you show to others. You can give away old  ______ 12 ______  to those in need or write a positive online review about a book that you like. The second is environmental kindness. You can try recycling. You can also organize a group activity to clean a  ______ 13 ______  park or the beach. The third type is personal kindness, and it’s much  ______ 14 ______  than the first two. It means you should treat yourself kindly. You can take a walk in nature. And stop  ______ 15 ______  yourself too hard. By being kind to yourself, you will surely be kinder to the world around you. The key  ______ 16 ______  that offering kindness makes you happy forever. 【答案】11. ways

questions.prompt: Mr. Wang is coming to our school. I can’t wait to see.
questions.explanation: 句意：王老师要来我们学校了，我迫不及待要看到他。 her她，人称代词宾格；him他，人称代词宾格；it它；them他们，人称代词宾格。根据句意可知，这个空代指的是Mr. Wang，是男性，故应选B。

questions.prompt: Stop  ______  so much junk food. It’s bad for your health.
questions.explanation: 句意：停止吃这么多的垃圾食品。这对你的健康有害。 考查非谓语动词。stop doing sth.停止做某事；stop to do sth.停下来去做某事。根据“It’s bad for your health.”可知，此处表示停止吃垃圾食品，应用stop eating。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Susan.  ______  have you been in China? —For about 10 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，苏珊。你来中国多久了？——大约10年了。 考查how短语辨析。how often多久，对频率提问；how much多少，对不可数名词的数量或对物体价格提问；how long多长，对物体长度或一段时间提问；how many多少，对可数名词数量提问；根据答语“For about 10 years.”可知，问句是在询问持续的时间，应使用how long。故选C。

questions.prompt: It was raining hard when he  ______  home.
questions.explanation: 句意：当他到家时，雨正下得很大。 考查时态。根据“was”可知，时态为一般过去时，动词应用过去式；go home“回家”，为非延续性动词短语，不用于进行时态。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Oh, Jack, your MP4 player looks nice. Is it new? —No. I  ______  it for two years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你的MP4看起来好看，是新的吗？——不是，我买了有两年了。 考查延续性动词。bought买，非延续性动词；had有，延续性动词。现在完成时中，非延续性动词不能与for和since引导的表示一段时间的状语连用，通常是用相应的延续性动词来代替。buy对应的延续性状态词是have。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  you  ______  your homework yet? —Yes. I  ______  it a moment ago.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Have; done; finished C Have; done; have finished

questions.explanation: 句意：——你做完你的家庭作业吗？——是的，我刚刚做成。 考查动词时态。根据题干中的“yet”可知问句用现在完成时，现在完成时的谓语动词结构为have/has done，所以排除A、D选项；由答句中的“a moment ago”可知答句用一般过去时，排除C，故选B。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Never too late That morning Sean checked the email as usual. Then he found an unexpected email in his inbox. Could he realize his dream late? Sean was now nearly 40, alone and poor. He dreamed of being a police officer for a long time and never made it. Was it possibly  ______ 7 ______  this time? When Sean was only a 5-year-old boy, his father’s friend Paul once  ______ 8 ______  the little boy home in his police car. Sean was interested in the car, the lights and the uniform. He decided to be a hero like Paul. However, a high school teacher  ______ 9 ______  his dream. She argued that he had a true gift for writing and should not waste it being a police officer. Sean followed his teacher’s advice and finally he became a  ______ 10 ______  for a newspaper and married. During the years, he changed several jobs but nothing made him really  ______ 11 ______. His heart really wasn’t in the job or marriage. Actually, he had never really given up his childhood dream to become a policeman. His wife could not bear this and left him when Sean was 39 years old. Sean was  ______ 12 ______  to move back to St. Ignace, where his dad lived. “I feel like a failure,” Sean says. He was sad and lost 25 pounds in a few months. When his father encouraged him to search for a new job, the opportunity came. Phoenix was in great need of police officers and one of Sean’s old friends emailed him, “Do you still want to be a police officer?” “Phoenix was a world away — 2,100 miles from St. Ignace,” says Sean. “But here, at least, was one more  ______ 13 ______, I felt reborn.” In order to pass the test to enter the police academy (学院), Sean  ______ 14 ______  began training, setting a daily running rule of a mile and a half. Three weeks later when he arrived in Phoenix, Sean was a man physically and emotionally changed. Finally, Sean passed the written exam and completed the physical test. On Nov.16, 2015, Sean finished his education in the police academy. The following year, Sean got a prize because of his excellent job. “It took me 35 years. But a promise is a promise. How many people can say they achieve their life’s dream?” Sean says. “I made it. It just proves that it’s never too late.”

questions.prompt: My uncle is a doctor. He likes  ______  job very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我叔叔是一名医生。他非常喜欢他的工作。 考查物主代词。my我的；her她的；his他的；your你的。根据主语he可知，人称要保持一致。故选C。

questions.prompt: Six students in our class will celebrate their birthdays  ______  May.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们班有六个学生将在五月庆祝他们的生日。 考查介词的辨析。at在……（用于具体的时刻前面）；on在……之时（用于具体的某一天）；of属于；in在……期间（用在年、月等的前面）根据“May”可知，月份前面用时间介词in。故选D。

questions.prompt: David is American,  ______  he speaks Chinese very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：大卫是美国人，但他的中文说得很好。 考查连词辨析。for因为；but但是；so所以；or或者，否则。根据“David is American,...he speaks Chinese very well.”可知，前后两个句子表示转折，故用but。故选B。

questions.prompt: His voice  ______  as if he has a cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：他的声音听起来好像感冒了。 考查动词辨析。sounds听起来；listens听，强调动作；hears听，强调结果；seems似乎。结合语境和“His voice”可知，此空应填系动词“sounds”，后面接as if引导的表语从句，表示对主语“His voice”所表现的特征、状态或性质作出的反应及判断。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What is your sister doing, Jane? —She  ______  how to make sky lanterns.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你姐姐正在做什么，Jane？——她正在学习如何制作孔明灯。 考查时态。learns学习，一般现在时；will learn将学习，一般将来时；is learning正在学习，现在进行时；learned学习，一般过去时。由问句“What is your sister doing”可知，询问现在正在进行的动作回答也应为现在进行时，故选C。

questions.prompt: Tom and Jerry is so interesting that we  ______  it again the day after tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：《汤姆和杰瑞》如此有趣以至于我们后天会再观看一次。 考查时态。watch观看；will watch一般将来时；have watched现在完成时；are watching现在进行时；watch一般现在时。根据“the day after tomorrow”可知，要用一般将来时。故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  six books since the beginning of this year.
questions.explanation: 句意：今年年初以来，我已经读了六本书。 考查现在完成时。根据“since the beginning of this year.”可知，句子时态是现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: When students prepare for an exam, they may feel  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：当学生准备考试时，他们可能会感到紧张。 考查形容词辨析。proud骄傲的；surprised吃惊的；nervous紧张的；shy害羞的。根据“When students prepare for an exam”可知，准备考试会感到紧张的，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Alice, what does your sister usually do in her free time? — She usually  ______  some books.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爱丽丝，你的妹妹通常在她的空闲时间做什么？——她通常看书。 考查一般现在时。由“usually”可知，句子应用一般现在时。故选A。

questions.prompt: Dan is an artist. He  ______  to draw pictures when he was five years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：丹是一名画家。他五岁就开始画画。 考查时态。根据“when he was five years old”可知，此句为一般过去时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Michael thinks reading paper books is  ______  than reading e-books. A comfortable
questions.explanation: 句意：迈克尔认为读纸质书比看电子书更舒服。 考查形容词比较级的用法。根据“than”可知，句子应用比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What did the coach say? —He encouraged us  ______  no matter how hard it was.
questions.explanation: 句意：——那个教练说的什么呢？——他鼓励我们无论多么困难也不要放弃。 考查非谓语动词。根据“encouraged us”可知，考查encourage sb. to do sth.意思是“鼓励某人做某事”，否定形式为encourage sb. not to do sth.“鼓励某人不要做某事”。根据“no matter how hard it was”可知，此处是指 “无论多么困难也坚持不要放弃”，所以应该用否定形式not to give up。故选D。

questions.prompt: —I’m feeling terrible! I have a high fever. —  ______. You’d better see a doctor at once.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我感觉太很糟糕！我发高烧了。——听到这个消息我很难受。你最好马上去看医生。 考查情景交际。I’m afraid not我恐怕不能；Sorry to hear that听到这个消息我很难受；Sounds great听起来很棒；You are right你是对的。根据“I’m feeling terrible! I have a high fever.”可知，应说听到这个消息我很难受。故选B。 四、完形填空（本题8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Never Give up The day I met Hani she was ashy, 17-year-old Indonesian girl standing alone in the parking lot of the international school, where taught English. She asked if I could help her  ______ 15 ______  her English. I could see that the young girl did all she could, and finally turned to me. “I want to go to a university,” she said with  ______ 16 ______. I was surprised. I agreed to help her as a volunteer. For several months, Hani woke each morning at five and caught the city bus to her public high school. During the ride, she studied for her regular classes and the English homework I gave her. At four o’clock in the afternoon, she arrived at my classroom,  ______ 17 ______  but ready to work. Hani lived in a two-room house with her parents and two brothers. When I met them at their house, I realised they would never be able to  ______ 18 ______  the cost of university. Hani’s warmth was increasing with her language ability, but I was losing heart. One day I received the announcement (通知) from a famous university. After reading the requirements, I told her that there was only a  ______ 19 ______  chance of her getting the scholarship and encouraged her to be more “realistic” about her dream. But she remained determined (坚定的). “Will you send in my name?” she asked. I couldn’t say no to her. I  ______ 20 ______  the application (申请书), with the painful truth about her real life, but a so with my praise of her strong determination. In the weeks that followed, I planned to have her take the Test of English Fluency. The whole test would be a huge project for someone who never touched a computer before. For two weeks, we studied how a computer worked. Soon she received a letter from that famous university. She was  ______ 21 ______. I jumped around the room excitedly. Hani stood by, smiling. From this experience, I learned something from Hani: It is not wisdom alone that brings success, but also the drive to succeed, the commitment to work hard and the  ______ 22 ______  to believe in yourself.

questions.prompt: —How was your vacation, Sue? — ______  was wonderful.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Sue，你的假期过得怎么样？——太棒了。 考查代词。They他们；It它；She她；He他。根据“How was your vacation,”可知，此处回答假期的情况，vacation是单数名词，因此用代词it代指，故选B。

questions.prompt: Our school talent show is planned to take place  ______  Monday evening. Welcome to join us.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校的才艺表演计划在星期一晚上举行。欢迎加入我们。 考查时间介词辨析。by到……为止；at后接具体时刻；on后接具体一天；in后接某年某月某季节。“Monday evening”是具体的一天，应填on，故选C。

questions.prompt: Learning is a lifelong journey because it brings every day.
questions.explanation: 句意“学习是一生的旅程，因为它每天带来一些新的东西”。something与anything为复合不定代词，当形容词修饰复合不定代词时，形容词后置，排除A和D；something用于肯定句中译为“一些事情”，用于疑问句中，表示建议，并希望得到对方肯定回答，译为“一些事情”；anything用于肯定句中译为“任何事情”，用于疑问句和否定句中译为“一些事情”。本句话为肯定句，且译为“一些新的东西”，故选B。

questions.prompt: This room is  ______  than that one, but it’s more comfortable.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个房间比那个房间小，但更舒适。 考查形容词的比较级。根据“than”可知前用形容词的比较级作表语。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you have P.E.? —Four times a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久上一次体育课？——一周四次 考查特殊疑问词。how long多长时间；how often多久一次；how much多少钱；how far多远。根据“Four times a week”可知此处是对频率进行询问，用how often。故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  the twins look the same, they are really different from each other.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然这对双胞胎长得一样，但他们真的很不一样。 考查连词。because因为；but但是；although虽然；so所以。根据“the twins look the same, they are really different from each other”可知前后两句是让步关系，此处用although引导让步状语从句。故选C。

questions.prompt: Many Beijingers  ______  their National Holiday in the city parks and museums last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年，许多北京人在城市公园和博物馆度过了他们的国庆假期。 考查时态。根据“last year”可知用一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式spent。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Which season do you think is  ______  in Beijing, Fang Fang? —Autumn, I guess.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认为在北京哪一个季节是最美丽的，芳芳？——秋季，我认为。 考查形容词最高级。根据“Which season”可知是四个季节相比较，所以应用形容词最高级，而形容词最高级前面必须加定冠词the，故选D。

questions.prompt: Tony’s parents are always busy, so he often  ______  with housework in his free time.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼的父母总是很忙，所以他经常在空闲时间帮忙做家务。 考查时态。根据“often”可知句子用一般现在时，主语是he，谓语动词用三单。故选B。

questions.prompt: My parents always tell me  ______  more vegetables and fruit every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父母总是告诉我每天要多吃蔬菜和水果。 考查非谓语动词。tell sb to do sth“告诉某人做某事”，使用动词不定式作宾语补足语，故选C。 五、完形填空。（共14分，每小题1分） A 短文填空。阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给出提示词的空白处填写一个适当的单词，在给提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 All these shows have one thing  ______ 11 ______  common: they try to look for the best singers, the most talented dancers, the most exciting magicians,  ______ 12 ______  (funny) actors and so on. All kinds of people join these shows. But who can play the piano the best or sing the most beautifully? That’s up to you to decide. When people watch the show, they usually play a role in deciding the winner. And the winner always  ______ 13 ______  (get) a very good prize. However, not everybody enjoys  ______ 14 ______  (watch) these shows. Some think that the lives of the performers are made up. For example, some people say they are poor farmers,  ______ 15 ______  in fact they are just actors. However, if you don’t take these shows too  ______ 16 ______  (serious), they are fun to watch. And one great thing about them is that they give people a way to make their dreams come true. 【答案】11 in 12. the funniest

questions.prompt: My brother loves ball games and basketball is  ______  favorite.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥喜欢球类运动，篮球是他的最爱。 考查代词辨析。her她的；his他的；my我的；your你的。根据“My brother loves ball games”可知，此处指代brother，是男性，使用形容词性物主代词his，故选B。

questions.prompt: Animal World begins  ______  8:30 p.m. every day on CCTV 1. It’s a great TV program.
questions.explanation: 句意：《动物世界》每天晚上八点半在中央电视台一套开始播出。它是一档很好的节目。 考查介词辨析。in在……里面；on在……上面；at在某个时间；to到。根据“8:30 p.m. every day ”可知，此处应使用“在某个时间”的介词at。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mum,  ______  I finish my homework first? —Yes, you must.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我必须先完成作业吗？——是的，你必须这样做。 考查情态动词。must必须；should应该；can能；may可能。根据“I finish my homework first?”以及“Yes, you must.”可知此处是询问是不是必须要先完成作业。故选A。

questions.prompt: Anezka Indrackova was  ______  athlete in Beijing Winter Olympic Games.
questions.explanation: 句意：阿内兹卡·因德拉茨科娃是北京冬奥会上最年轻的运动员。 考查形容词最高级。根据“in Beijing Winter Olympic Games.”可知，设空处是在冬奥会中所有运动员里进行比较，因此是最高级the youngest。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______ was Janek Mela when he got to the North Pole? —He was only 15 years old then.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Janek Mela到达北极的时候几岁？——当时他只有15岁。 考查特殊疑问句。How old年纪多大；How long多久，多长；How far多远；How many多少。根据“He was only 15 years old then.”可知询问年龄用how old提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: Cathy was ill yesterday  ______  she didn’t come to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：凯茜昨天生病了，所以她没来上学。 考查连词辨析。because因为；or或；but但是；so所以。分析题干可知，后句是前句的结果，空格处意为“所以”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —How did you spend the Mid-Autumn Festival last month Adam? — I  ______  moon cakes and watched the full moon with my family.
questions.explanation: 句意：——亚当，上个月你是怎么过中秋节的？ ——我和家人一起吃月饼、赏月。 考查一般过去时。根据“How did you spend the Mid-Autumn Festival last month, Adam?”和“watched the full moon with my family.”可知，此处是指上个月吃月饼、赏月，动作发生在过去，时态为一般过去时，谓语动词eat应用过去式ate。故选B。

questions.prompt: The weatherman says it  ______  tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：气象员说明天早上会下雨。 考查谓语动词时态。rains下雨，现在时；rained，过去时；was raining，过去进行时；will rain，一般将来时。主句为一般现在时，宾语从句遵循“主现从不限”原则，由“tomorrow morning”可知，从句应使用一般将来时，其结构为will+动词原形。故选D。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分) 阅读下面的短文。掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Once, Mr. Kafka was walking through a park. He saw a young girl crying. She lost her favorite doll. It was the prize she won in a game. He helped her look for the doll almost everywhere in the park, but they couldn’t find it. Seeing the girl’s  ______ 9 ______  eyes, Kafka thought of a good idea, so he asked her to meet him there the next day and they would look for it again. And the story didn’t  ______ 10 ______  until the end of Kafka’s life. The next day, when they found that the doll couldn’t appear (出现), Kafka gave the girl a letter from the “doll” that said, “I wanted to travel the world. I’ll write to you about my  ______ 11 ______  around the world. It must be wonderful. Please do not cry or wait for me.” Later, Kafka read the letters of the doll’s exciting stories about its travel and it made the girl  ______ 12 ______. One day, Kafka read her a new letter that the “doll” said it would return to their home! And the girl was very happy to  ______ 13 ______  that. Then, he gave her a new doll that he bought. “Your doll is back,” said Kafka. “But this one does not look like mine at all,” she replied. Kafka  ______ 14 ______  her another letter and it said, “I changed a lot because of my trips.” The girl accepted (接受) the new doll and took it home  ______ 15 ______. A year later, Kafka died. The girl kept the doll carefully. After many years, the grown-up girl found a letter hidden (隐藏) inside the  ______ 16 ______. The tiny letter, written by Kafka, said, “Everything you love is very possible to be lost, but in the end, love will return in a different way.”

questions.prompt: Jim is my brother, and I like playing football with  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆是我的弟弟，我喜欢和他一起踢足球。 考查代词辨析。him他；her她；me我；you你、你们。根据“Jim is my brother.”可知，此处指的是“我”喜欢和吉姆一起踢足球，所以这里应用人称代词宾格him指代Jim，在句中作介词with的宾语。故选A。

questions.prompt: We will have a big family dinner  ______  Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们将在周六有一次家庭聚餐。 考查时间介词辨析。in后面加年或月或季节；on后面加星期或具体日期；at后面加具体时间点；to后面加时间点，意为“差”。根据Saturday周六，可知介词选on。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Mum,  ______  I get up before 7: 00 on weekends? —Yes, you must. It’s a good habit to get up early every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，周末我必须七点以前起床吗？ ——是的，你必须。每天早起是个好习惯。 考查情态动词。must必须；should应该；may可以；can能。根据答语“Yes, you must.”可知，问句也应用must。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Which do you like  ______  jiaozi or zongzi? —Jiaozi.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你更喜欢饺子还是粽子？——饺子。 考查比较级。well好；better更好；best最好；the best最好。根据“ jiaozi or zongzi?”可知，两者比较，使用比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  will Jason stay in China? —For one week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——詹森将在中国呆多久？ ——一个星期。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少，询问价格或不可数名词数量；How often多久一次，是对频率进行的提问；How long多长，是对长度或一段时间的提问；How soon多久以后，常对动作还有多久发生进行提问，一般用于将来时，回答用“in+时间段”。根据答语“For one week.”可知，此处指的是一段时间，疑问词应用How long。故选C。

questions.prompt: It is difficult to learn math well  ______  they don’t give up.
questions.explanation: 句意：数学很难学好，但他们不放弃。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；or或者，否则；so因此，所以。根据语境，可知前后文是转折关系，即数学很难学好，但他们不放弃，因此用连词but，表示转折。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What is your mum doing? —She  ______  a delicious pizza now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妈妈在做什么？——她现在正在做一个美味的披萨。 考查动词的时态。根据“now”可知，句子应用现在进行时，结构为am/is/are doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: The students  ______  to the park to plant trees tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：学生们明天将去公园种树。 考查动词时态。结合“tomorrow”可知应用一般将来时，结构为will+动词原形。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  my homework when Tom called me last night.

questions.explanation: 句意：自然公园将很大，将会有更多的竹子来喂养熊猫。 考查动词时态。根据“The nature parks will be big”及语境可知，事情还未发生，时态用一般将来时（will do），故选C。

questions.prompt: My brother  ______  a model plane while I was sweeping the floor.
questions.explanation: 句意：我在扫地的时候，我哥哥在做飞机模型。 考查动词时态。根据“while I was sweeping the floor”可知，while引导时间状语从句，且主从句的动作同时进行，都可以延续，用过去进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: In the West, people often  ______  flowers when they visit someone.
questions.explanation: 句意：在西方，人们拜访别人时经常带花。 考查动词时态。根据“often”可知，该句陈述经常性的动作，且句中没有表示过去的词，故用一般现在时。故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you think of your school trip last week, Chris? —Oh, wonderful! We had a great time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你觉得上周的学校旅行怎么样，Chris？ ——哦，太棒了！我们玩得很开心。 考查疑问词辨析。Why为什么；What什么；When什么时候；Where哪里。根据wonderful可知，设空处询问对学校旅行的看法，“what do you think of...”意为“你觉得……怎么样”，选项B符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: We should work hard  ______  people using plastic (塑料的) bags.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们应该努力工作阻止人们使用塑料的袋子。 考查非谓语动词。根据“We should work hard... people using plastic (塑料的) bags”可知，此处是表示目的，应用不定式作目的状语。故选D。 选择方框中恰当词语填空，并将该词语的字母标号涂在答题卡的相应位置上。 A. keep clear of B. make mistakes C. thinking about D. is far from E. pay attention

questions.prompt: Betty isn’t confident. She doesn’t always feel sure of  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂缺乏自信。她总是对自己缺乏信心。 考查反身代词。she她；her她/她的；herself她自己；hers她的。根据“She doesn’t always feel sure of…”可知，她总是对她自己缺乏信心。故选C。

questions.prompt: Fill out our form  ______  come to learn English in Los Angeles.
questions.explanation: 句意：填写我们的表格，来洛杉矶学习英语。 考查连词词义辨析。and和，表示顺承关系；or或者，否则，表示选择关系；but但是，表示转折关系；in在……里面。“Fill out our form”和“come to learn English”构成顺承关系，故选A。

questions.prompt: Anna’s birthday is coming. I’m going to buy a gift  ______  her.
questions.explanation: 句意：Anna的生日快到了。我准备给她买一份礼物。 考查介词。to到；of……的；for为了；with和。根据“buy a gift...her.”可知，此处表达“为某人买某物”，即“buy sth. for sb.”，此处用介词for。故选C。

questions.prompt: I know it’s  ______  to work out the problem, but I will try  ______  on it.
questions.explanation: 句意：我知道解出这道题很难，但我会努力去做的。 考查词汇辨析。hard困难的，形容词；hard努力地，副词；hardly几乎不，副词。根据“I know it’s...to work out the problem, but I will try...on it.”可知，第一空作is的表语，指“解出这道题很难”，用形容词hard；第二空用副词修饰动词try，指“努力去做”，也用hard。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Jack,  ______  you swim? —Yes. I often go swimming with my father in summer.
questions.explanation: 句意：——-杰克，你会游泳吗？——是的。夏天我经常和爸爸一起去游泳。 考查情态动词词义辨析。must必须；need需要；can能够；may可能。根据答语“Yes. I often go swimming with my father in summer.”可知，此句是询问对方是否会游泳。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you play tennis? — Twice a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jim，你多久打一次网球？——一周两次。 考查特殊疑问词。How long多久；How many多少，提问可数名词数量；How soon多久以后；How often多久一次，提问频率。根据答句“Twice a week.”可知，是对频率提问。故选D。

questions.prompt: —May I speak to Tom? —Sorry, he  ______  America. But he  ______  in two days.

choices.label: A
choices.text: has been to; will come back

choices.label: B
choices.text: has gone to; will come back

questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以跟Tom说话吗？——抱歉，他去了美国。但他在两天之后回来。 考查动词时态。has been to去过某地（已回来）；has gone to去了某地（未回来）。根据“Sorry”可知，他去了美国还没回来，故第一空应填has gone to，排除A选项。根据“in two days”可知，此处应用一般将来时will do的结构，故选B。

questions.prompt: When the telephone rang, I  ______  cookies in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：电话铃响时，我正在厨房做饼干。 考查过去进行时。根据“When the telephone rang, I...cookies in the kitchen”可知，本句是when引导的时间状语从句，从句用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时，表达“过去某个时间正在发生的动作”。故选B。

questions.prompt: Slow down! You  ______  too fast.
questions.explanation: 句意：慢下来！你开得太快了。 考查时态。根据“Slow down!”可知，阐述正在发生的事情，用现在进行时，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to see the film YOLO with me? —Sorry, I  ______  it twice.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你想和我一起去看电影《YOLO》吗？——对不起，我已经看了两遍了。 考查动词的时态。根据“twice”可知，此句是说已经看过两次了，应用现在完成时，其构成为“has/have done”，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______  an English test? —Next Monday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道我们将在什么时候进行英语考试吗？——下周一。 考查宾语从句。根据句子结构可知是宾语从句，应用陈述句语序，排除A和C；结合答语“Next Monday.”可知，宾语从句的时态用一般将来时（will do）。故选B。 二、完形填空 （共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从下面各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择可以填入空白处的最佳选项。 Reports say that till early June, stories, photographs and videos of the ongoing Cun-Chao in Rongjiang County and Cun-BA in neighboring Taijiang County had attracted more than 3 billion views. Dressed in their traditional festive  ______ 18 ______, they invite other visitors to share the food and drinks, and  ______ 19 ______  them in singing and dancing before and after the games. questions.prompt: Mr. Wang in a friendly teacher, we all like  ______  very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：王先生在一个友好的老师。我们都很喜欢他。 考查代词辨析。her她，宾格或她的，形容词性物主代词；him他，宾格；them他们，宾格；us我们，宾格。根据“Mr. Wang”可知王先生是一位男老师，所以用人称代词单数形式him，作动词like的宾语，故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s very cold outside. Put on warm clothes,  ______  you may get sick.
questions.explanation: 句意：外面很冷。穿上暖和的衣服，否则你可能会生病。 考查连词词义辨析。or否则；so因此；and和；but但是。根据“Put on warm clothes”可知不穿暖和的衣服可能会生病，空格处意为“否则”，表示否定的条件，or符合语境，故选A。

questions.prompt: Usually I make supper for my family  ______  Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：通常我在星期六为家人做晚餐。 考查介词辨析。at其后加时刻；in其后加早中晚，月份，季节，年份等；to到；on其后加星期或具体的某天。 空后是“Saturday”，用时间介词on，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you help in the Children’s House, Betty? —Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——贝蒂，你多久在儿童之家帮忙一次？——每月两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How far多远（提问距离）；How long多长时间（提问时长）；How often多久一次（提问频率）；How soon多久以后（提问时长）。根据答语“Twice a month.”可知，问句提问频率，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Mum, can I play with my dog for a while? — Sorry, you  ______. Dad took it to your Grandpa’s farm.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我能和我的狗玩一会儿吗？——对不起，你不能。爸爸把它带到你爷爷的农场去了。 考查can引导的一般疑问句的否定回答。needn’t不必；can’t不能；mustn’t禁止；wouldn’t不会的。根据“Sorry”可知，此处是否定回答，结合“can I play with my dog for a while?”可知，此处应用can’t作否定回答。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tina  ______  a walk with her grandmother after supper every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：蒂娜每天晚饭后都和奶奶一起散步。 考查动词形式。have a walk“散步”，时态用一般现在时描述经常发生的事，主语是Tina，谓语动词用三单形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: —What was your little sister doing at nine last night? —She  ______  a movie in the cinema with her friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨晚九点你的妹妹在干什么？——她正和她的朋友们在电影院看电影。 考查动词的时态。根据“What was your little sister doing at nine last night”可知，此处在询问过去某个时间点正在发生的事情，故回答时也应用过去进行时，即“was/were+现在分词”的结构。故选D。

questions.prompt: The little girl  ______  trees in the West Hill with her parents tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个小女孩明天将和她的父母一起在西山种树。 考查一般将来时。根据“tomorrow”可知，动作发生在将来，应用一般将来时，结构是：will+动词原形，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Alice, what’s your brother doing? —He  ______  the guitar now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Alice，你哥哥在干什么？——他现在正在弹吉他。 考查现在进行时。根据“what’s your brother doing?”可知，问句提问正在做什么事，应用现在进行时，结构是：am/is/are+动词-ing形式，主语He表示单数，be动词用is，play用动词-ing形式playing。故选C。

questions.prompt: Janek Mela finally  ______  at the South Pole on December 31st, 2004.
questions.explanation: 句意：Janek Mela终于在2004年12月31日抵达南极。 考查一般过去时。根据“December 31st, 2004”可知，事情发生在过去，应用一般过去时，动词要用过去式，故选A。

questions.prompt: Tom is  ______  than any other student in our class.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我们班汤姆比任何其他男孩都高。tall高的，是原级；taller更高的，是比较级；the tallest最高的，是最高级。根据“than any other student”可知此处用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: Zhong Nanshan is one of  ______  scientists in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：钟南山是中国最著名的科学家之一。 考查最高级。“one of+形容词的最高级+复数名词”意为“最……之一”，famous的最高级由most构成，形容词最高级与定冠词the连用，故选D。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 True Friendship As the smallest and thinnest player in my ice hockey team, I was nicknamed (起绰号) by my team leader. The first time I heard other players call the  ______ 13 ______, I didn’t like it at all. I knew they wanted to make friends with me, but inside I was  ______ 14 ______. I knew that any of them could get my puck  ______ 16 ______. In the middle of the game, I was skating with the puck and I  ______ 17 ______  it to Eric. They had never seen someone so small stand up so bravely in front of such a big player. Although I might be small, I have strengths.

questions.prompt: The house itself is beautiful  ______  the decorations are rather old.
questions.explanation: 句意：这房子本身很漂亮，但装饰有些太旧了。 考查连词。or或者；so所以；for因为；but但是；根据“The house itself is beautiful”可知，房子很漂亮；根据“decorations are rather old”可知，装饰太久了，前后为转折关系。故选D。

questions.prompt: I improve my English  ______  listening to English songs. It’s very useful.
questions.explanation: 句意：我通过听英文歌来提高我的英语。它非常有用。 考查介词。by通过；on在……上面；with有；for为了。by doing sth表示“通过做某事”，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  will the Pairs 2024 Olympic Games last? — For 17 days.
questions.explanation: 句意：——2024年巴黎奥运会将持续多久？ ——17天。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少；How often多久一次；How long多久；How far多远。根据答语“”可知此处询问2024年巴黎奥运会将持续多久。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Mom, must I clean the room now? — No, you  ______. You can do it after 5 p.m.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我现在必须打扫房间吗？——不，你不需要。你可以在下午5点以后做。 考查一般疑问句的回答。must开头的一般疑问句，否定回答用needn’t或don’t have to。故选A。

questions.prompt: Jim studies better than Tom, but Tom is  ______  than Jim.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆比汤姆学习好，但汤姆比吉姆更友好。 考查形容词的比较级。A. friendly形容词原级；B. more friendly形容词比较级；C. most friendly形容词最高级；D. the most friendly形容词最高级。根据句中than可知，此处应用形容词比较级。故选B。 【点睛】错因分析： ①考生没有注意到比较级标志词than； ②考生没有掌握形容词比较级的用法及构成。

questions.prompt: I  ______  the table tennis match on TV at seven last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚七点我正在看电视上的乒乓球比赛。 考查时态。watch观看。根据“at seven last night”可知，在过去某时，用过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: You  ______  if you do one thing at a time and stick to your plan.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你一次只做一件事，坚持自己的计划，你就会成功。 考查时态。if引导的条件状语从句，需满足“主将从现”原则，从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时，故选C。

questions.prompt: My father  ______  for a walk every day, which helps him keep fit.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲每天散步，这有助于他保持健康。 考查一般现在时。由“every day”可知，句子为一般现在时，谓语动词应用动词原形或第三人称单数。故选B。

questions.prompt: Lang Lang  ______  to play the piano when he was only three years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：郎朗在他只有3岁的时候就开始弹钢琴了。 考查一般过去时。A. begins表一般现在时；B. began表一般过去时；C. will begin表一般将来时；D. is beginning表现在进行时。根据句中when he was only three years old可知，句子应用一般过去时。故选B。 【点睛】错因分析： ①考生忽视了题干中的when he was only three years old，从而对时态判断错误； ②考生未能掌握一般过去时的构成。

questions.prompt: We  ______  good friends since we met in 2000.
questions.explanation: 句意：自2000 年相识以来，我们一直都是好朋友。 考查现在完成时。are表一般现在时；were表一般过去时；will be表一般将来时；have been表现在完成时。根据“since we met in 2000”可知，时态现在完成时。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Peter, could you tell me  ______  next Friday? —By plane.

One of the diners asked, “What about our meals?” “Don’t worry, sir,” replied the manager. “Fortunately, we use gas in our kitchen, not electricity, so the chef can continue cooking all your meals.” My father said to me, “Let’s go out to the street and take a look.” He and I went out of the front door and looked up and down the street. questions.prompt: My sister is good at basketball.  ______  can jump higher than me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姐姐擅长篮球。她能跳得比我高。 考查人称代词词义辨析。He他；We我们；It它；She她。根据“My sister”可知，空格处应用She指代My sister，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Hurry up, Dad! Let’s go across the street quickly. —No, Peter, you  ______. The traffic lights are red.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爸爸，快一点！我们快点过马路吧。——不，Peter，你不能。交通灯是红色的。 考查情态动词。mustn’t不能；wouldn’t不会；needn’t不必；don’t have to没必要。根据“The traffic lights are red.”可知，交通灯是红色时，行人禁止过马路，mustn’t表示禁止，故选A。

questions.prompt: —What did you do last night? —I  ______  an exciting football game at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你昨晚做了什么？——我在家里看了一场激动人心的足球赛。 考查动词时态。根据“What did you do last night?”可知，时态为一般过去时，所以空处应用动词过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: Ng Cheuk Yan is one of  ______  athletes at the 4th Asian Para Games in Hangzhou.
questions.explanation: 句意：吴卓人是在杭州举行的第四届亚洲残疾人运动会上最年轻的运动员之一。 考查形容词最高级。分析题干可知，本题考查“one of the+形容词最高级+可数名词复数形式”结构，表示“最……的……之一”，结合选项，空格处应填the youngest，表示最年轻的运动员之一，故选D。

questions.prompt: When the teacher came into the classroom, I  ______  the class project with my team.
questions.explanation: 句意：当老师走进教室时，我和我的团队正在讨论班级项目。 考查动词时态。本句是when引导的时间状语从句，从句用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时（was/were doing），表示“从句动作发生时，主句动作正在进行”，故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  the bones are very light they are strong enough to support our bodies.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然骨头很轻，但它们足够强壮，足以支撑我们的身体。 考查连词词义辨析。Although虽然；Because因为；If如果；When当……时候。根据“the bones are very light”及“they are strong enough to support our bodies”的句意可知，此处为转折让步的关系。故选A。 二、用所给词的适当形式填空（每题1分，共3分） 阅读下面的短文，用括号中所给单词的正确形式填入空白处，补全文章。 For teenagers, podcasts (播客) are perfect for making their brains busy while they’re doing housework around the house, exercising or even  ______ 7 ______  (walk) to school. Sugar Calling is the podcast for teenagers who like writing. For each program, the host interviews a best-selling writer for advice on how to write stories. The successful writer  ______ 8 ______  (share) experiences and knowledge in making good stories to encourage young writers. The program hopes that more teenagers will be  ______ 9 ______  (interest) in writing. 【答案】7. walking

questions.prompt: Pandas are in danger and we should protect  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：熊猫正处于危险中，我们应该保护它们。 考查人称代词宾格。it它；them他/它们；her她；him他。分析题干，空处缺少宾语，根据“Pandas”可知，这里的代词需用复数，故选B。

questions.prompt: Shenzhen is  ______  the south of China.
questions.explanation: 句意：深圳在中国的南方。 考查方位介词辨析。in表示范围之内的某方位；at表示在某个小地方；on表示与某方位是毗邻关系；to表示范围之外的某方位。深圳属于中国，是在中国的内部某个地方，in符合题意，故选A。

questions.prompt: This week’s football match is  ______  than last week’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：这周的足球比赛比上周的更加令人激动。 考查形容词比较级。than用于形容词的比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing at 5 p. m. yesterday? —I  ______  the classroom at that time
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天下午5点你在做什么？——我那时正在打扫教室。 考查过去进行时。根据“at 5 p. m. yesterday”可确定此题为过去进行时态。故选D。

questions.prompt: My mother allows me  ______  TV for half an hour after finishing my homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈允许我做完作业后看半小时电视。 考查非谓语动词。allow sb. to do sth.“允许某人做某事”，动词watch要用不定式to watch。故选D。

questions.prompt: Please don’t make any noise. The students  ______  an important test now.
questions.explanation: 句意：请不要制造噪音。学生们正在进行一场重要的考试。 考查现在进行时。根据“now”可知，时态是现在进行时，其结构是：am/is/are+动词-ing形式，主语The students表示复数，be动词要用are，have用动词-ing形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: We will have a great time playing snowballs if it  ______  tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天下雪，我们打雪球会玩得很开心。 考查条件状语从句中的主将从现。分析句子结构可知，本句含if引导的条件状语从句，应遵循主将从现原则，从句用一般现在时表将来。从句主语是it，动词用第三人称单数形式。故选C。

questions.prompt: My brother  ______  exercise every day and he likes sports very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥每天锻炼，他非常喜欢运动 考查动词时态。根据“every day”可知，本句是一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数，动词用三单形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: According to some scientists, people  ______  to be 200 years old in the future.
questions.explanation: 句意：根据一些科学家的说法，将来人们会活到200岁。 考查动词时态。根据“in the future”可知，句子用一般将来时，结构为will do，故选C。

questions.prompt: Be careful, because parts of a building  ______  fall on you during an earthquake.
questions.explanation: 句意：小心，因为地震时建筑物的一部分可能会掉到你身上。 考查情态动词。may可能；should应该；must一定；need需要。根据“Be careful, because parts of a building... fall on you during an earthquake.”可知，此处指地震时建筑物的一部分可能会砸到人的身上，may符合语境。故选A。 二 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Secret Power It was Peter’s first day of preschool. His mother, Linda, was worried about how he would adjust (适应). During the day, Linda  ______ 12 ______  herself busy with work, but she couldn’t help thinking about how Peter was doing. But as she came back to pick her son up in the afternoon, she was  ______ 13 ______  to see that Peter was laughing and playing with a group of kids. When Peter saw his mother, he ran up to her and hugged her, “Mom  ______ 14 ______  so many new friends! And we got to do all sorts of fun things. We painted, sang songs and played games. ” As they walked back to the car, Linda asked Peter, “So, I can’t wait to see my new  ______ 15 ______  again and learn more new things. ” Linda was more than happy to see her son having such a great time on his first day at preschool. But the real twist (转折) came when Peter told her that he had“secret power”. “What is your secret power?” Linda asked. “I used it to make anyone I met relaxed and  ______ 16 ______, and want to be friends with me. ” Peter said.
