questions.prompt: Betty is my best friend.  ______  is pretty and has long fair hair.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂是我最好的朋友，她非常漂亮，有着长长的金色头发。 考查代词。He他；She她；It它；They他们。主语Betty是一位女生，单数，故选B。

questions.prompt: Beihai Park is so quiet that people can hardly believe it’s  ______  the city center.
questions.explanation: 句意：北海公园静谧得让人不敢相信它就在市中心。 考查介词辨析。on在……边/端，侧重与另一个物体表面相接触；to在……面，表示一个地方在另一个地方的范围之外；in在……里面，表示在范围之内；of属于……的。根据“...the city center.”可知，此处是指在市中心，用介词in。故选C。

questions.prompt: The flowers  ______  very sweet. Let’s go for a walk in the garden.
questions.explanation: 句意：这些花闻起来很香。我们去花园里散散步吧。 考查动词辨析。smell闻起来；look看起来；feel感觉；taste尝起来。根据“The flowers...very sweet. Let’s go for a walk in the garden.”可知，花闻起来很香。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you tidy your own room? —Twice a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久整理一次你自己的房间？——一周两次。 考查疑问词组。How often多久一次；How soon多久以后；How much多少（钱）；How long多久。根据“Twice a week.”可知询问频率，用How often提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: We  ______  football for a year and we all feel very fit.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们踢足球已经一年了，我们都感觉很健康。 考查动词时态。were playing过去进行时；played一般过去时；have played现在完成时；are playing现在进行时。根据“for a year”可知，此处为现在完成时，其结构为have/has+过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: You’d better get up early,  ______  you’ll be late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：你最好早点起床，否则你会上学迟到。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；so所以；or否则。根据“You’d better get up early, …you’ll be late for school.”可知，前后两句为选择关系，此处描述的是“你最好早点起床，否则你会上学迟到”，应该用or。故选D。

questions.prompt: Daming thinks Superman is  ______  than Spider Man.
questions.explanation: 句意：大明认为超人比蜘蛛侠更强。 考查比较级的用法。strong强壮的，形容词原级；stronger更强壮的，形容词比较级；strongest最强壮的，前面通常加the；the strongest最强壮的，形容词最高级。空后有比较级的标志词than，可知空处要用比较级，stronger符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: My mother  ______  in the kitchen when I got home yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚我到家时，我妈妈正在厨房做饭。 考查过去进行时。根据“My mother…in the kitchen when I got home yesterday evening.”可知，此处描述的是过去的某一时刻正在发生的动作，应该用过去进行时，谓语动词构成是was/were doing，主语是My mother，be动词用was，cook用现在分词形式cooking。故选D。

questions.prompt: Mary  ______  us if she comes to Beijing next month.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果玛丽下个月来北京，她就会来看我们。 考查一般将来时。根据“Mary...us if she comes to Beijing next month.”可知，此处是if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”，从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时“will do”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tony often  ______  cartoon films in his free time.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼经常在空闲时间看卡通电影。 考查动词的时态。watches观看，动词三单；watched动词过去式；is watching现在进行时；will watch一般将来时。根据often可知，句子的时态为一般现在时，主语Tony为第三人称单数，此处用动词三单。故选A。

questions.prompt: David is a tennis player. He to play tennis when he was six years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：戴维是个网球运动员，六岁时就开始打网球了。从when he was six years old判断句子时态用一般过去时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Jenny, could you tell me  ______  the T-shirt? It’s beautiful. —OK. Thanks. I bought it in a shop on the Internet.

questions.prompt: My best friend is Alice.  ______  is a quiet girl with long hair.
questions.explanation: 句意：我最好的朋友是Alice。她是一位文静的长发女孩。 考查代词用法。She她，为主格；Her她，她的；He他，为主格；Him他，为宾格。根据“...is a quiet girl with long hair.”可知，缺主语，Alice为女性名字，需代词She代替。故选A。

questions.prompt: — What’s the weather like in Beijing  ______  October? — It is great, neither too hot nor too cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：——北京十月的天气怎么样？——它很棒，既不太热也不太冷。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体的时刻前面；on用于具体的某一天或具体某一天的上午、下午或晚上；in用在年、月、上下午的前面；with和、带有。根据“October”可知，在某月用介词in。故选C。

questions.prompt: My parents are very understanding,  ______  I am thankful to them.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父母非常理解我，因此我很感谢他们。 考查连词用法。or或者，否则；but但是；for因为；so因此。根据空前后关系可知，前因后果，需连词so来连接两个句子。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  eggs do we need to make a cake? —Three.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们需要多少个鸡蛋做蛋糕？——三个鸡蛋。 考查特殊疑问词组。How long多久，多长；How many多少；How often多久一次；How much多少。根据问句中“eggs”及答句可知，空处指对数量提问，需用how many+可数名词复数，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Mom,  ______  I watch the baseball game for a while? —Of course you can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我可以看一会儿棒球赛吗？——当然可以。 考查情态动词辨析。can能够，可以；must必须；should应该；need需要。根据“Of course you can”可知，一般疑问句用can开头，故选A。

questions.prompt: Beijing Olympic Tower is one of  ______  towers in the city.
questions.explanation: 句意：北京奥林匹克塔是这个城市最高的塔之一。 考查最高级。“one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数”表示“最……之一”，故选D。

questions.prompt: Our foreign teacher Kelly  ______  back to the US last month.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们外教Kelly上个月返回到美国。 考查动词时态。根据“last month”可知，时态为一般过去时，且为肯定句，谓语动词需用过去式，go的过去式为went。故选B。

questions.prompt: If I travel to Kunming next week, I  ______  you a postcard.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果下周去昆明旅游，我将给你寄一张明信片。 考查一般将来时。send寄，动词原形；sent动词过去式；will send一般将来时；have sent现在完成时。根据“next week”可知，用一般将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Lily plans  ______  for the final exam so she can’t go out with us tonight.
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉打算准备期末考试，所以她今晚不能和我们出去了。 考查非谓语。plan to do sth“计划做某事”，动词不定式作宾语，故选C。

questions.prompt: My sister loves music very much and  ______  dream is to be a singer.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹非常喜欢音乐，她的梦想是成为一名歌手。 考查代词辨析。she她；he他；her她，她的；his他的。根据“My sister loves music very much”以及“dream is to be a singer.”可知，此处使用形容词性物主代词修饰其后名词，主语“my sister”是女性，所以用her。故选C。

questions.prompt: I usually help to clean up the city parks  ______  Sundays.
questions.explanation: 句意：星期天我通常帮助打扫城市公园。 考查介词辨析。on在具体某天；in接年/月/季节；at接具体某时刻；for接一段时间。根据“Sundays”可知，考查固定短语on Sundays“在星期天”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Qomolangma is 8,848.86 meters high,  ______  it is very dangerous to climb.
questions.explanation: 句意：珠穆朗玛峰高8848.86米，所以攀登它是非常危险的。 考查连词辨析。so所以；for因为；but但是；or或者。根据“Qomolangma is 8,848.86 meters high”以及“it is very dangerous to climb.”可知，应该说珠穆朗玛峰高8848.86米，“所以”攀登它是非常危险的，其他选项不符合语境。故选A。

questions.prompt: Yu Gong Moves the Mountains is one of  ______  stories in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：《愚公移山》是中国最著名的故事之一。 考查最高级。one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数，表示“最……的……之一”，故选D。

questions.prompt: My mum asked me  ______  the dog after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈叫我放学后去遛狗。 考查非谓语动词。根据“My mum asked me”可知，考查ask sb to do sth“要求某人做某事”，因此设空处填不定式。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tom is a science lover. He often  ______  at the National Science Museum on the weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆是一个科学爱好者。他经常周末在国家科学博物馆做志愿者。 考查动词时态。根据“He often”可知，该句描述经常性的动作，为一般现在时，主语是“He”，动词填三单形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  to the new amusement park with my friends next month.
questions.explanation: 句意：下个月我和我的朋友们将去新主题公园。 考查一般将来时。由“next month”可知，事情还未发生，应用一般将来时will do。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing when it started to rain yesterday? —I  ______  the piano at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天开始下雨的时候你正在做什么？——我在家里弹钢琴。 考查动词时态。根据“What were you doing when it started to rain yesterday?”可知，设空处是问昨天开始下雨的时候正在进行的动作，因此为过去进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Jim  ______  the Summer Palace twice since he came to Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从吉姆来到北京，他已经参观了颐和园两次。 考查动词时态。根据“the Summer Palace twice since he came to Beijing.”可知，该句是含有since的现在完成时，其结构为“have/has+done”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______? —Yes. It teaches children about endangered animals.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道这个程序是做什么的吗？——知道。它教孩子们有关濒危动物的知识。 考查宾语从句。know是动词，此处是宾语从句。宾语从句是陈述语序，即“连接词+主语+谓语动词（+其他）”，故A与C选项错误。根据“It teaches...”可知应是一般现在时。故选B。 五、选词填空(共6分，每题1分) 阅读下面的短文，从方框中选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空。 normal fight use keep animal unless The Monkey King is not just any  ______ 11 ______  monkey. In fact, sometimes he doesn’t look like a monkey! This is because he can make 72 changes to his shape and size, turning himself into different  ______ 12 ______  and objects. But  ______ 13 ______  he can hide his tail, he cannot turn himself into a man. To fight bad people, the Monkey King  ______ 14 ______  a magic stick. Sometimes he can make the stick so small that he can  ______ 15 ______  it in his ear. At other times, he is able to make it big and long. The Monkey King has excited the children of China for many years. questions.prompt: This book is for Mary. Please pass it to  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这本书是给玛丽的。请把它递给她。 考查代词辨析。her她；them它们；him他；it它。空处指代Mary，应用her，故选A。

questions.prompt: The 19th Asian Games opened  ______  September 23rd in Hangzhou.
questions.explanation: 句意：第19届亚运会于9月23日在杭州开幕。 考查时间介词。in后接年/月/季节；to到；at后接时刻；on后接具体的某一天。根据“September 23rd”可知，这是具体的一天，应该用时间介词on。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me,  ______  are the apples? —Twelve yuan a kilo.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，这些苹果多少钱？——一公斤12元。 考查特殊疑问句。how many多少；how old多大年龄；how long多长时间；how much多少钱。根据答语“Twelve yuan a kilo.”可知，上句询问价钱。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  in Haikou five years ago, but now I live in Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：五年前我住在海口，但是现在我住在北京。 考查动词的时态。根据时间状语“five years ago”可知，句子是一般过去时，故动词用其过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  we finish this task today? —No, you don’t have to. You can finish it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们今天必须要完成任务吗？——不，你们不必。你们可以明天完成它。 考查情态动词。must必须；may可以；can能够；shall将。根据“No, you don’t have to. ”可知，这是must引导的一般疑问句，否定回答应用needn’t或don’t have to，表示“不必”，故选A。

questions.prompt: The new supermarket in our town is much  ______  than the old one.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们镇上新开的超市比旧的大得多。 考查比较级。big大的；bigger更大的；biggest最大的；the biggest最大的。根据“than”可知，此处应用比较级bigger，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What is your brother doing? —He  ______  a poster about traditional Chinese festivals.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的哥哥在做什么？——他正在制作关于中国传统节日的海报。 考查现在进行时。根据“What is your brother doing?”可知，此处应用现在进行时，对应的结构是be doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Where did you go last Saturday? — I  ______  to Shougang Park with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你上周六去了哪里？——我和朋友一起去了首钢公园。 考查时态。go一般现在时；went一般过去时；will go一般将来时；am going现在进行时。根据“Where did you go last Saturday”可知，上周六发生的事请用一般过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: George is 1.9 meters tall. He is  ______  in our class.
questions.explanation: 句意：乔治身高1.9米。他是我们班里最高的。 考查最高级的用法。根据“He is…in our class.”可知，他是班里最高的学生，形容词的最高级之前要加定冠词the。故选D。

questions.prompt: Lisa  ______  to school when she saw the accident yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天早上当Lisa步行去学校的时候看到了这个事故。 考查时态。walked一般过去时；is walking现在进行时；was walking过去进行时；has walked现在完成时。根据“when she saw the accident yesterday morning”可知，主句的时态应为过去进行时，表示过去正在进行的动作，故选C。

questions.prompt: We  ______  cooking lessons next term. How exciting it is!
questions.explanation: 句意：下学期我们将上烹饪课多么令人兴奋！ 考查时态。have一般现在时；had一般过去时；will have一般将来时；were having过去进行时。根据时间状语“next term” 可知，本句一般将来时态，其构成为“主语+wil+动词原形+其它”。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 “Hey, Ben, let’s go riding to the park,” called Dion. He and Thomas were on their bikes and wanted Ben to come along. Ben shook his head  ______ 13 ______. All of his friends had bicycles. He did not. Ben wished he had one so he could go riding with his friends. He used to have a tricycle (三轮车) when he was small, but he was much too big for that now. If he took it, he would not have to wait until his birthday. He could  ______ 18 ______  with his friends. That would make him happy. He wanted to take the bike. What should he do? Ben thought about it. This was not his bike. It belonged to somebody else. That kid would be very sad to  ______ 19 ______  the bike, Ben thought. He knew he would be sad if a kid took a bike from him. This was a bad idea. Ben turned away from the bike. He decided to wait until his birthday. As he walked home, still without a bicycle, Ben felt  ______ 20 ______.

questions.prompt: Sam is my best friend.  ______  last name is Johnson.
questions.explanation: 句意：Sam是我最好的朋友。他姓Johnson。 考查代词用法。He他，主格；His他的，形容词性物主代词；Him他，宾格；Their他们的，形容词性物主代词。根据“Sam is my best friend.”可知，此处是指Sam的姓是Johnson，修饰名词last name，用形容词性物主代词his。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Daming, where is Beijing Capital International Airport? — It is  ______  the northeast of Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：——大明，北京首都国际机场在哪里？——它在北京的东北部。 考查介词辨析。in在……里面；on在……上面；at在；behind在……后面。根据“Beijing Capital International Airport”位于“Beijing”内部，应用介词in。故选A。

questions.prompt: Traveling by train is  ______  than by plane and you can see the beautiful world through the window.
questions.explanation: 句意：乘火车旅行比乘飞机更放松，你可以透过窗户看到美丽的世界。 考查比较级。根据“than”可知，需要使用比较级。故选D。

questions.prompt: Please listen  ______  so that you can write down all the information.
questions.explanation: 句意：请仔细听以便记下所有的信息。 考查形容词和副词词义辨析。careful仔细的，形容词；careless粗心的，形容词；carefully仔细地，副词；carelessly粗心地，副词。根据“so that you can write down all the information.”可知，空处应表达仔细地听，修饰动词listen用副词形式。故选C。

questions.prompt: Last autumn was  ______  one in the past ten years, so many birds left later than usual for their trip south.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年秋天是近十年来最温暖的一个秋天，所以许多鸟儿比往常晚出发去南方旅行。 考查形容词最高级。根据“in the past ten years”可知该句应使用最高级，warm的最高级为“the warmest”。故选D。

questions.prompt: My family decided  ______  to the countryside for some peace and quiet last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年，我们家决定搬到乡下去，过些清净的日子。 考查非谓语动词。根据“decided”可知设空处后填不定式作宾语，decide to do“决定做某事”。故选A。

questions.prompt: When I  ______  home this morning, the wind was really strong.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天早上我离开家的时候，风真的很大。 考查动词时态。根据“this morning, the wind was really strong.”可知该句是一般过去时，谓语动词应使用动词过去式，leave的过去式是left。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Dad, must I clean my room now? — No, you  ______. You can do it later.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爸爸，我现在必须打扫我的房间吗？——不，你不需要。你可以等下再做。 考查情态动词。can’t不能；mustn’t不准；shouldn’t不应该；needn’t不需要。根据“You can do it later.”可知说的是“不需要”现在打扫。故选D。

questions.prompt: Betty is only six,  ______  she can sing one hundred Chinese songs.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然Betty只有六岁，但是她能唱一百首中文歌曲。 考查连词。so因此；but但是；although虽然；because因为。分析句子可知，前后存在转折关系，用but。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing at eight this morning? You didn’t answer my phone. —I’m sorry. I  ______  my cat then.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天早上八点你在做什么？你没接我电话。——我很抱歉。那时我正在喂我的猫。 考查动词时态。根据“What were you doing at eight this morning?”可知，问的是过去某个时间段正在进行的动作，结合“then”应说那时我正在做什么，因此答句设空处谓语应该使用过去进行时。故选A。 四、完形填空（共12分，每小题1分） （一） 根据短文内容，从方框中选出恰当的词。 A. sure B. teach C. surprise D. help Chongyang Festival is meaningful for the elderly in Chinese culture, so it is a time for us to show thanks and love for our grandparents. questions.prompt: Mrs. Smith has two kids and she often plays tennis with  ______  on Sundays.

questions.explanation: 句意：寒假期间，我们全家乘飞机去海南旅游。 考查介词辨析。in在……内；on在……之上；by通过；to到。by plane“乘飞机”，是固定搭配。故选C。

questions.prompt: Betty and Lily  ______  friends since they were 13 years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂和莉莉从 13 岁起就是朋友。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语“since they were 13 years old”可知，时态为现在完成时，表示过去发生的动作，持续到现在。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Dad, this black shirt  ______  very soft. Would you like to try it on? — No, thanks. I prefer light colors.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爸爸，这件黑衬衫摸起来很柔软。您想试穿一下吗？——不了，谢谢。我喜欢浅色的。 考查动词辨析。tastes尝起来；sounds听起来；smells闻起来；feels感觉到。空格后为“soft”，表达的是触感，故应用动词feels，即摸起来很柔软。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Tim, you need to go now,  ______  you will be late for class. —OK, mom. I’m leaving now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tim，你现在就得走了，否则你上课会迟到。——好的，妈妈。我现在就走。 考查并列连词辨析。or否则，不然；but但是；and并且；so因此。根据“you need to go now”和“you will be late for class”可知，现在就得走，不然就会迟到，用or表示 “否则，不然”。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you cook for your family? — About twice a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久为家人做一次饭？——大约一周两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多久、多长；How much多少钱，询问价格；How often多久一次，询问频率；How many多少，询问数量。根据答语“About twice a week”可知，题干是询问频率。故选C。

questions.prompt: I refuse  ______  all the fried food because I want to keep fit.
questions.explanation: 句意：我拒绝吃所有的油炸食品，因为我想保持健康。 本题考查动词不定式。eat 动词原形； to eat动词不定式； eating 现在分词或动名词；ate 过去式。refuse to do sth.表示 “拒绝做某事”。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Sam, you  ______  the table yet. It’s all messy! —Sorry, I’ll do it immediately.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Sam，你还没有收拾桌子。它乱七八糟的！——抱歉。我会立即收拾。 考查现在完成时。根据yet可知，此处表示对现在造成的影响，应用现在完成时。故选A。

questions.prompt: It  ______  the writer several months to finish the book Red Star Over China in the 1930s.
questions.explanation: 句意：1930年代，作者花了几个月的时间完成了《红星照耀中国》一书。 考查时态。takes一般现在时；will take一般将来时；has taken现在完成时；took一般过去式。根据“It…the writer several months to finish the book Red Star Over China in the 1930s.”句中时间状语in the 1930s可知，句子时态为一般过去时，take过去式为took。故选D。

questions.prompt: It’s Grandma’s birthday next week. We’re going to make a cake for  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：下周是奶奶的生日。我们会为她举办一个派对。 考查代词辨析。him他，主格；her她，她的，宾格或形容词性物主代词；himself他自己，反身代词；herself她自己，反身代词。根据“It’s Grandma’s birthday is next week.”可知此处指的是为奶奶举办派对，设空处位于介词for后，用代词宾格her指代奶奶，故选B。

questions.prompt: Jannek Mela arrived at the South Pole  ______  December, 2004.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jannek Mela在2004年12月到达南极。 考查介词辨析。on后接具体某一天；at后接具体的时刻；to到；in后接年/月/季节等泛指的时间。December是月份，其前用介词in。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mr. Green,  ______  I hand in my homework today? —No, you needn’t. You can give it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——格林先生，我今天必须交作业吗？——不，你不必。你可以明天交。 考查情态动词辨析。can可以；should应该；must必须；may可能。根据答语“No, you needn’t.”可知，一般疑问句用“must”开头。故选C。

questions.prompt: —David, which event is for you, sit-ups, push-ups or high jump? —I think high jump is  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——大卫，仰卧起坐、俯卧撑和跳高哪个项目适合你？——我认为跳高是最难的。 考查形容词最高级。由“sit-ups, push-ups or high jump”可知，跳高是三个项目中最难的一个，应用最高级，形容词最高级之前需加the。故选D。

questions.prompt: ______  it snowed heavily yesterday, we enjoyed ourselves.
questions.explanation: 句意：尽管昨天雪下得很大，我们还是玩得很愉快。 考查although引导的让步状语从句。although尽管；so因此；but但是；when当……时。根据“...it snowed heavily yesterday, we enjoyed ourselves.”可知，前后两句构成让步关系，此处应用although引导让步状语从句。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  shall we meet for the picnic, Tom? —At the bus station near our school.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，我们在哪里见面野餐？——在我们学校附近的公共汽车站。 考查特殊疑问句。Where哪里；How如何；When什么时候；Why为什么。根据“At the bus station near our school.”可知，问句是问地点，用where提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Peter, what’s your brother doing? —He  ______  the piano.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Peter，你哥哥正在做什么？——他正在弹钢琴。 考查动词时态。根据“what’s your brother doing?”可知，句子时态用现在进行时am/is/are doing，主语是三单，be用is。故选D。

questions.prompt: Jenny likes reading. She  ______  picture books with her mum every evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：珍妮喜欢读书。她每天晚上和妈妈一起读图画书。 考查一般现在时。由“every evening”可知，句子应用一般现在时，She作主语，谓语应用第三人称单数形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What did you do last Sunday, Tina? —I  ______  the Great Wall with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tina，上星期天你做了什么？——我和朋友们游览了长城。 考查一般过去时。根据“last Sunday”可知谈论过去的事情，故用一般过去时。visit的过去式为visited，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing at three o’clock yesterday afternoon, Mike? —I  ______  my cousin with his homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克，昨天下午三点钟你在做什么？——我在帮我表弟做作业。 考查过去进行时。由“What were you doing at three o’clock yesterday afternoon”可知，此处指昨天下午三点钟正在做的事情，应用过去进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What will you do during the coming winter holiday? —We  ______  volunteer work in our community.
questions.explanation: 句意：——在即将到来的寒假里你们将做什么？——我们将在我们的社区做志愿者工作。 考查一般将来时。根据“the coming winter holiday”可知寒假还没有到来，所以做志愿者工作是发生在将来，应用一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Our class won the basketball game yesterday. —Wow.  ______!
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们班昨天赢得了篮球比赛。——哇。好兴奋啊! 考查情景交际。How exciting好兴奋啊；What a shame真遗憾；I can’t stand it我受不了；How funny真有趣。由“Our class won the basketball game yesterday”可知，赢得比赛应该感到兴奋。故选A。 二、完形填空(每题1分，共8分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 More than I had dreamed of From the age of eight, I had dreamed of becoming a member of the Students Union. I had always admired (钦佩) my school leaders for taking responsibility for all of us. I dreamed of being a  ______ 13 ______, too. Years flew by, and soon I was able to take part in the elections,  ______ 14 ______  I would win. But the first time I stood, almost no one voted (投票) for me. I decided that I had been stupid to think I had a chance. I was a common student. My schoolmates across the school hardly knew me. I just did not have what it took to win a school election. I was so  ______ 15 ______. As I cried in my room that evening, I suddenly took a deep breath and decided I wouldn’t stop dreaming. I decided that I would  ______ 16 ______  for election again in my final year at school—and I would win. I recognized that my competitors had a lot of things in their favor. What were the points that would  ______ 17 ______  in my favor? I had good grades, and I was friendly and helpful. And my biggest strength was the faith (忠诚) I had in myself. I would not allow my common appearance (外貌) to hold me back from putting my best foot forward. That evening, I began making my election plans a whole year in advance (提前). I realized that students would have to get to know me and found that I had the ability to help them. I loved making friends and I liked being helpful, so I decided that perhaps I could use these qualities to my advantage (优势). In order to learn how to give a great election  ______ 18 ______, I also took a course to improve public speaking skills. The day after the election, our headteacher announced (宣布) I had won the second highest number of votes. The students cheered. The joy on the faces of all my friends showed me that my success was also theirs.  ______ 19 ______, I realized that I had got much more than I had dreamed of. I had made many new friends and had helped people along the way. I had won the election and love of my schoolmates and they knew me as somebody who would stand by them. I was able to put a smile on their faces and  ______ 20 ______  up their day.

questions.prompt: Mary likes comedies.  ______ thinks they are fun. A He
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽喜欢喜剧。她认为它们很有趣。 考查代词辨析。He他；She她；It它；They他们。根据“Mary”可知，Mary是女生名字，用she代替作主语，故选B。

questions.prompt: The cartoon Nezha I am the destiny came out in mainland China  ______  July 26, 2019.
questions.explanation: 句意：2019年7月26日，动画片《哪吒之魔童降世》在中国大陆上映。 考查介词辨析。on用于具体一天；in用于季节、年和月等；at用于点钟；from来自。根据“July 26, 2019”可知，具体一天用on，故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  are you going to be a pianist in the future? — I’m going to practice playing the piano every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你将来打算怎样成为一名钢琴家？——我打算每天练习弹钢琴。 考查特殊疑问句。how如何；what什么；where哪里；when什么时候。根据“ I’m going to practice playing the piano every day.”可知，询问如何成为一名钢琴家，故选A。

questions.prompt: Mickey was just like a common man,  ______  he tried his best to face any danger.
questions.explanation: 句意：米奇就像一个普通人，但他尽了最大的努力去面对任何危险。 考查连词辨析。because因为；so所以；and和；but但是。根据前后两句话可知，句子前后是转折关系，故选D。

questions.prompt: They practiced hard and expected  ______  the soccer game.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们努力练习，期望赢得足球比赛。 考查非谓语动词。expect to do sth“期望做某事”，因此空处填不定式。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Why do you enjoy  ______  the newspapers? — Because I hope to find out what’s going on around the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你为什么喜欢读报纸？——因为我想要弄清世界各地正在发生的事。 考查非谓语动词。enjoy doing sth“喜欢做某事”，因此空处填动名词。故选D。

questions.prompt: Peter likes watching TV shows. He always  ______  talk shows at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：Peter喜欢看电视节目。他总是在家看脱口秀。 考查动词时态。根据“always”可知，时态是一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数，动词填三单形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: New Year is coming soon. We  ______  a New Year’s party next month.
questions.explanation: 句意：新年快到了。下个月我们将举行一个新年晚会。 考查一般将来时。根据“next month”可知，句子时态是一般将来时，用be going to do结构，故选A。

questions.prompt: — What do you think of the movie Coco? —  ______. It is so wonderful.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你觉得电影《寻梦环游记》怎么样？——我很喜欢。它是如此美妙。 考查情景交际。I can’t stand it我无法忍受；I don’t mind it我不介意；I really love it我很喜欢；I hate it我讨厌它。根据“It is so wonderful”可知，电影很精彩，因此很喜欢，故选C。 五、选词填空。（共5分,每小题1分） 阅读下列短文，掌握其大意，从方框中选择适当的词，并用其适当形式填空。每词限用一次。 little enjoy robot bad difference I think our life will be very  ______ 10 ______  in 50 years. First, there will be a lot of  ______ 11 ______  everywhere. People won’t have to work long hours and do housework. So people will have more free time and they will be able to  ______ 12 ______  the things they like. Besides, I believe that everyone will have a chance to go to the moon for a holiday. It is much easier to get to space stations. Unluckily, the environment will become  ______ 13 ______  than now. There will be  ______ 14 ______  fresh water because there will be more pollution in the sea. 【答案】10. different

questions.prompt: My parents want  ______  to do the housework every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父母想要我每天做家务。 考查代词辨析。me我，人称代词宾格；I我，人称代词主格；my我的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词。want sb to do sth表示“想要某人做某事”，want为动词，后接人称代词宾格。故选A。

questions.prompt: My best friend is good  ______  singing, but I do well  ______  dancing.
questions.explanation: 句意：我最好的朋友擅长唱歌，但我跳舞跳得好。 考查介词辨析。in在……方面；at在。be good at doing sth“擅长做某事”，do well in (doing) sth“在……做得好”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Although my grandfather is old,  ______  he looks very strong and healthy.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然我的爷爷老了，他看起来很强壮和健康。 考查连词。and而且；so所以；but但是。although引导的让步状语从句，可与yet连用，不可以与其他连词连用，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the supermarket? —Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去一次超市？——一周一次。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多久，多长，对时间段或者长度提问；How far多远，对距离提问；How often多长时间一次，对频度提问；What time什么时候，对时间点提问。根据“Once a week”可知，在对频度提问，故应用How often。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What do you think of the movie? —It’s great! The only pity is that I  ______  the beginning of it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你觉得电影怎么样？——非常好。唯一的遗憾是我错过了电影的开头。 考查动词时态。根据语境可知电影已看完，“错过了电影开头”是说话者在陈述过去事实，应使用一般过去时，故选A。

questions.prompt: Which country is  ______, Australia or Canada?
questions.explanation: 句意：澳大利亚和加拿大哪个国家更大？ 考查形容词比较级。根据“Australia or Canada”可知两者之间的比较，应用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: The talk show made all of us  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：脱口秀让我们大家都笑了。 考查非谓语动词。laugh是动词，意为“笑”。make sb. do sth.的意思是“让某人做某事”，故选A。

questions.prompt: The snake is one of  ______  in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：蛇是世界上最危险的动物之一。 考查形容词最高级。“one of +形容词最高级+可数名词复数”意为“最……之一”，固定句式。故选C。 五、选词填空（共4分, 每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，从方框中选择适当的单词并用其正确形式填空，其中有两项为多余选项。 different, use, friendly, make, stone, buy You may think there is nothing but sand in the desert of the world, but it is no true. In the desert we can find  ______ 9 ______. We can see hills, too. There is a little rain in the desert, but it is not enough for most plants. The animals are  ______ 10 ______  to the desert people in many ways. The desert people eat the meat and drink the milk of the animals. They use their skins to  ______ 11 ______  shoes, water bags and even tents. They use the camels for carrying things. The people of the desert have to keep moving from one place to another. They must always look for grass or desert plants for their animals. They usually live in the tents. When there is no more food for their animals, they take down their tents, put them on the camels and move to another place. The desert people are very  ______ 12 ______. They always help the people in trouble and give them food and water. 【答案】9. stones

questions.prompt: Shanghai is a modern city  ______  the east of China.
questions.explanation: 句意：上海是中国东部的一座现代化城市。 考查介词辨析。in the+方位名词，指的是小范围在一个大范围的里面，表示在某范围之内，强调两者的包含关系；on the+方位名词，指的是一个范围紧挨着另一个范围，表示“两地接壤”，强调两者为相邻关系；to the+方位名词，指的是一个范围和另一个范围之间隔段距离，表示“在某范围之外”，强调两者是远离关系；off离开。根据题干可知，上海是中国东部的一个城市。表示在某范围之内，要用介词in。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  does your father go to work? —He rides his bike. He thinks it’s a good way to take exercise.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你父亲是怎么上班的？——他骑自行车。他认为这是锻炼身体的好方法。 考查特殊疑问句。what什么；how如何；where哪里；when什么时候。根据“He rides his bike”可知此处询问交通方式，疑问词用how。故选B。

questions.prompt: It is really hot these days. Why not  ______  to the swimming pool this weekend?
questions.explanation: 句意：这些天真的很热。为什么这周末不去游泳池？ 考查动词时态。goes去，动词三单形式；go动词原形；going动名词；to go不定式。why not+do sth.“为什么不做某事”，固定搭配。故选B。

questions.prompt: You can  ______  new words in the dictionary when you don’t know their meanings.
questions.explanation: 句意：当你不知道生词的意思时，你可以在字典里查单词。 考查动词短语辨析。look up查找；look at查看；look in拜访；look like看起来像。根据“when you don’t know their meanings”可知，此处是“你可以在字典里查找生词”。故选A。

questions.prompt: The first question is easy, but the second one is much  ______  than the first one.
questions.explanation: 句意：第一个问题很容易，但是第二个问题比第一个问题容易得多。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知，句子用比较级，形容词easy的比较级形式为easier。故选B。

questions.prompt: I think skiing is  ______  than running.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为滑雪比跑步更令人兴奋。exciting令人兴奋的；more exciting更令人兴奋的；most exciting最令人兴奋的；the most exciting最令人兴奋的。根据句意和句中的than可知，这里表示滑雪和跑步两者相比，应用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Which is  ______  way to travel, by bus, by train or by plane? —I think it’s by train.
questions.explanation: 句意：——乘公共汽车、火车还是飞机，哪一种旅行方式最舒适？——我想是坐火车。 考查形容词最高级。根据“by bus, by train or by plane”可知三者比较，用形容词最高级，the most comfortable“最舒适的”。故选D。

questions.prompt: All the boys in my class like football  ______  Tony. He likes volleyball.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们班上所有男孩都喜欢足球除了托尼。他喜欢排球。 考查介词辨析。from“从……”；for“为了”；except“除了”；with“带有”。根据“He likes volleyball”他喜欢排球，可知，此处表达的是“除了托尼，我班上所有的男孩都喜欢足球”。故选C。

questions.prompt: My brother  ______  his homework on time every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥每天按时完成作业。 考查一般现在时。complete“完成”，动词原形，用于一般现在时；completes，动词的单三形式，用于一般现在时，且主语为第三人称单数；completed，动词过去式，用于一般过去时；will complete，用于一般将来时。根据句子中的时间状语every day“每天”，可知本句时态时一般现在时。且主语my brother为第三人称单数，动词要用单三形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Your watch looks very nice! —Thank you! I  ______  it when I was on vacation last week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的表看起来非常好看。——谢谢！上个星期当我度假的时候买的。 考查一般过去时。根据“last week”可知时态为一般过去时，谓语动词应用其过去式，故选C。

questions.prompt: —In the future, who  ______  more heavy work for us? —Robots.
questions.explanation: 句意：——将来，谁会为我们做更繁重的工作呢？——机器人。 考查一般将来时。does做，第三人称单数形式；did做，一般过去时；do做，动词原形；will do将会做，一般将来时。根据句中的时间状语“In the future”可知，时态为一般将来时，用will +动词原形。故选D。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I forgot the name of the old lady, who was a customer (顾客) on my newspaper route when I was twelve. Yet she taught me a  ______ 13 ______  that I shall never forget. On a winter afternoon, a friend and I were throwing stones onto the roof of the old lady’s house near her garden. I found a perfectly smooth (光滑的) rock and threw it. The stone was too  ______ 14 ______, however, so it slipped (滑) from my hand as I let it go and headed straight for a small window on the lady’s door. At the  ______ 15 ______  of broken glass, we knew we were in trouble. We ran faster than any of our stones flew off her roof. I was too  ______ 16 ______  of getting caught that first night to be concerned about the old lady with the broken window in winter. However, a few days later, when I was sure that I hadn’t been discovered I started to feel guilty (内疚的). She still greeted me with a smile each day when I gave her the newspaper, but I was no longer able to act comfortably when seeing her. I decided that I would  ______ 17 ______  my paper delivery (送) money, and in three weeks I had the seven dollars that I thought would cover the cost of her window. I put the money in an envelope with a  ______ 18 ______  saying that I was sorry for breaking her window and hoped that the seven dollars would cover the cost of repairing it. The next day, I  ______ 19 ______  the old lady her paper. She thanked me for the paper and gave me a bag of biscuits she had made herself. I thanked her and ate the biscuits as I continued my route. After several biscuits, I  ______ 20 ______  an envelope and pulled it out of the bag. When I opened the envelope, I was shocked. Inside were the seven dollars and a short note that said, “I’m proud of you.”

questions.prompt: — Where did Mr. Smith go last week? —  ______  went to Tian'anmen Square with some friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——史密斯先生上周去了哪里？——他和一些朋友去了天安门。 考查代词。she她，主格；her她；宾格；he他，主格；his他的。句子缺主语，根据“Mr. Smith”可知是男士，用人称代词的主格“he”。故选C。

questions.prompt: I heard you went skating  ______  Friday evening. Did you have a good time?
questions.explanation: 句意：我听说你星期五晚上去滑冰了。你玩得开心吗？ 考查介词。on用于具体的某一天或具体某一天的上/下午/晚上；of……的；at用于具体的钟点前；in用于年/月/季节/泛指的上/下午/晚上前；空格修饰的是“Friday evening”，是具体的一天的晚上，所以用介词on，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  does your sister play sports? —About three times a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你姐姐多久做一次运动？——大约一周三次。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少；How much多少钱；How often多久一次；How long多长时间。根据“About three times a week.”可知，对频率提问应用How often。故选C。

questions.prompt: Is there  ______  in today’s newspaper?
questions.explanation: 句意：在今天的报纸里有什么有趣的事情吗？ 考查复合不定代词以及形容词的位置。形容词修饰复合不定代词时，要放在复合不定代词的后面，排除A和B选项。something某事，常用于肯定句；anything任何事，用于疑问句和否定句。此句是疑问句，应用anything，故选D。

questions.prompt: The Yangtze River is  ______  than the Yellow River.
questions.explanation: 句意：长江比黄河长。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知，此处要用形容词的是比较级，是两者之间的比较，故选B。

questions.prompt: Jack goes running every day,  ______  he is quite healthy.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jack每天去跑步，所以他相当健康。 考查连词辨析。or或者；so所以；but但是；until直到。句中“he is quite healthy.”是“Jack goes running every day”的结果，表示因果关系，用“so”。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What do you think of your best friend? —She is  ______. She always has a smile on the face. I like her.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认为你最好的朋友怎么样？——她非常好。她脸上总有笑容。我喜欢她。 考查形容词辨析。fantastic极好的；bored感到无聊的；slow慢的；boring无聊的。根据“She always has a smile on the face. I like her.”可知此处应该是表示好的词。故选A。

questions.prompt: Their parents make the little girl  ______  the room every Sunday. A cleans
questions.explanation: 句意：他们的父母让小女孩每个星期天打扫房间。 考查非谓语动词。make sb do sth“使某人做某事”，省略to的动词不定式作宾补，故选B。

questions.prompt: I have to call a taxi because the box was much  ______  than I thought.
questions.explanation: 句意：我得叫辆出租车，因为这个箱子比我想象的要重得多。 考查形容词比较级。much修饰形容词比较级，结合“than”可知此处用比较级heavier。故选B。

questions.prompt: Peter enjoys  ______  jokes and often makes us laugh.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得喜欢讲笑话，经常逗我们笑。 考查非谓语动词。enjoy doing sth“喜欢做某事”，动名词作宾语，故选C。

questions.prompt: I think it’s important for students  ______  the rules.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为学生遵守规则是很重要的。 考查动词不定式作主语。根据“it is adj. to do sth”可知，动词不定式作真正的主语，故选A。

questions.prompt: Beijing, the capital of China, is one of  ______  cities in the world.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：根据one of后面往往跟最高级，表示“最…之一”，故本题应用the biggest。本句的意思是“北京，中国的首都，是世界上最大的城市之一。”所以本题选A。 考点：本题考查最高级 点评：本题实际上考查的是一个固定句型：one of +形容词的最高级+名词复数，表示“最…中的一个”。应该注意其中固定用法。

questions.prompt: — What do you think of the shows? —  ______  They are too boring.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你觉得这些节目怎么样？——我无法忍受它们。它们太无聊了。 考查情景交际。Pretty good相当不错；I don’t mind them我不介意它们；I can’t stand them我无法忍受它们；I love them我喜欢它们。根据“They are too boring”可知，太无聊了，说明无法忍受这些节目，故选C。 五、选词填空（共4分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，从方框中选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空，其中有两项为多余选项。 good, clever, time, rich, is, become Spring Festival is the most important festival in China. It usually  ______ 15 ______  on the first day of the first month in the Chinese calendar. It is a  ______ 16 ______  for family members to enjoy being together. The most popular food for the festival is dumplings. Just as an old saying goes, “Nothing tastes  ______ 17 ______  than dumplings.” Also, many people believe eating dumplings will make them  ______ 18 ______, because the food looks like “yuanbao”. People usually put a coin or a candy inside a dumpling. They believe that the person will be lucky in the new year when he/she gets the dumpling. 【答案】15. is 16. time

questions.prompt: John usually does outdoor activities  ______  Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：约翰通常在星期天做户外活动。 考查介词辨析。of……的；in在某年某月；at在某时刻；on在某一天。空格后是具体某一天，用介词on。故选D。

questions.prompt: Learning is a lifelong journey because it brings every day.
questions.explanation: 句意“学习是一生的旅程，因为它每天带来一些新的东西”。something与anything为复合不定代词，当形容词修饰复合不定代词时，形容词后置，排除A和D；something用于肯定句中译为“一些事情”，用于疑问句中，表示建议，并希望得到对方肯定回答，译为“一些事情”；anything用于肯定句中译为“任何事情”，用于疑问句和否定句中译为“一些事情”。本句话为肯定句，且译为“一些新的东西”，故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  the twins look the same, they are really different from each other.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然这对双胞胎长得一样，但他们真的很不一样。 考查连词。because因为；but但是；although虽然；so所以。根据“the twins look the same, they are really different from each other”可知前后两句是让步关系，此处用although引导让步状语从句。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you have P.E.? —Four times a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久上一次体育课？——一周四次。 考查特殊疑问词。how long多长时间；how often多久一次；how much多少钱；how far多远。根据“Four times a week”可知此处是对频率进行询问，用how often。故选B。

questions.prompt: This room is  ______  than that one, but it’s more comfortable.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个房间比那个房间小，但更舒适。 考查形容词的比较级。根据“than”可知前用形容词的比较级作表语。故选A。

questions.prompt: Who is  ______, Tom, Steve or Dennis?
questions.explanation: 句意：谁最受欢迎，汤姆，史蒂夫还是丹尼斯？ 考查形容词的最高级。根据“Tom, Steve or Dennis”可知是在三者之中作比较，用形容词的最高级，且最高级前加定冠词the。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tony’s parents are always busy, so he often  ______  with housework in his free time.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼的父母总是很忙，所以他经常在空闲时间帮忙做家务。 考查时态。根据“often”可知句子用一般现在时，主语是he，谓语动词用三单。故选B。

questions.prompt: —How was your National Day holiday? —Pretty good! We  ______  a talent show and really enjoyed it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的国庆假期怎么样？——非常好！我们看了一场才艺表演，真的很享受。 考查时态。根据“and really enjoyed it”可知描述过去的动作，用一般过去时，动词用过去式。故选C。 五、完成句子（共4分,每小题1分）根据中文提示,补全句子。

questions.prompt: —What a nice model plane! —Thank you. I made it by  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——多漂亮的飞机模型啊！——谢谢你。我自己制作的。 考查代词辨析。me我，人称代词宾格；my我的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词；myself我自己，反身代词。根据“I made it by...”可知我自己做的，by oneself“独自，单独”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Linda is good  ______  English but I do well  ______  math.
questions.explanation: 句意：Linda擅长英语，但是我擅长数学。 考查介词辨析。at在；in在……里；with带有。根据“Linda is good … English”可知，第一空表示擅长英语，be good at“擅长”；“do well in”擅长。所以第一空填at，第二空填in，故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  he is young, he can work out this difficult physics problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然他很年轻，但他能解出这道难物理题。 考查连词辨析。still仍然；since自从；though尽管；because因为。“he is young”与“he can work out this difficult physics problem”是让步关系，用though引导让步状语从句，故选C。

questions.prompt: Tom is a/an  ______  boy. He can play the guitar upside down.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆是一个有创造力的男孩。他可以倒着弹吉他。 考查词汇辨析。talents天赋，才能；creative有创造力的；outgoing外向的；helpful有帮助的。根据“He can play the guitar upside down.”可知能倒着弹吉他，是有创造力的。故选B。

questions.prompt: China is one of  ______  in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国是世界上最大的国家之一。 考查形容词最高级。“one of the+形容词最高级+可数名词复数”意为“最……的……之一”，是固定用法。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______ does your mother go to the gym? —Almost once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妈妈多久去一次健身房？——几乎一周一次。 考查特殊疑问句。how much多少；how long多久；how soon多久以后；how often多久一次。根据答语“Almost once a week”可知，对频率提问用how often，故选D。

questions.prompt: My best friend always helps to  ______  the best in me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我最好的朋友总是帮助我发挥出最好的一面。 考查动词短语辨析。bring up养育，抚养；bring out使显示；bring about导致，引起；bring together使相合。根据“My best friend always helps to...the best in me.”可知，此处是“bring out the best in”短语，意为“使……发挥出最好的一面”。故选B。

questions.prompt: I’ve just returned from my trip to London. I  ______  many interesting places there.
questions.explanation: 句意：我刚从伦敦旅行回来。我在那里参观了许多有趣的地方。 考查时态辨析。根据“I’ve just returned from my trip to London.”可知在伦敦游玩是过去发生的事情，用一般过去时，此处用动词过去式visited。故选C。

questions.prompt: I plan  ______  a soap opera tonight.
questions.explanation: 句意：我计划今晚看一部肥皂剧。 考查非谓语动词。plan to do sth.“计划做某事”，此处用动词不定式作宾语。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What do you want to have for dinner? — ______. I’m OK with whatever you cook.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你晚餐想吃什么？——由你决定。你做什么我都可以。 考查情景交际。No problem没问题；It’s up to you由你决定；I can’t stand it我不能忍受它；Help yourself请自便。根据“I’m OK with whatever you cook.”可知对方做什么都可以，由对方来决定。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tom gets up  ______  in his family.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆是他们家起床最快的。 考查副词最高级。quick快的，形容词；quickly快地，副词；the quickest最快的；the most quickly最快地。根据“gets up”可知用副词修饰动词，结合“in his family”可知用副词最高级。故选D。

questions.prompt: I knocked on the door but answered.
questions.explanation: 句意：我敲了门，但没有人回应。 考查不定代词。somebody某人；nobody没有人；anybody任何人；everybody每个人，人人。结合连词but前后表示转折关系，故选B。

questions.prompt: The town  ______  a lot of pollution in the past but it is not a problem any more.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个城镇过去有很多污染，但这已经不是问题了。 考查时态。根据“in the past”可知，时态为一般过去时，动词要用过去式；have的过去式为had。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Lily, could you tell me ______ last night? —Oh, I went to the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Lily，你能告诉我昨晚去哪里了么？——嗯，我去了图书馆。 考查宾语从句时态和语序辨析。宾语从句用陈述语序：引导词+主语+谓语，排除BD；last night是过去时间，宾语从句中主句用一般过去式，从句如果不是客观事实或者真理，也要用一般过去式。故选A。 五、语法填空（共4分，每小题1分） 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写一个适当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 Everyone is good at something, but some people are truly talented. It’s always interesting to watch other people show their  ______ 15 ______  (talent). Talent shows are getting more and more popular. First, there were shows like American Idol and America’s Got Talent. Now, there are similar shows around the world, such as China’s Got Talent. All these shows have one thing in  ______ 16 ______: They try to look for the best singers, the most talented dancers, the most exciting magicians, the  ______ 17 ______  (funny) actors and so on. All kinds of people join these shows. But who can play the piano the best or sing the most beautifully? That’s up to you to decide. When people watch the show, they usually play a role in deciding the winner. And the winner always gets a very good  ______ 18 ______. 【答案】15. talents

questions.prompt: Kunming is the beautiful capital of Yunnan Province, located  ______  the southwest of China.
questions.explanation: 句意：昆明是云南省美丽的省会，位于中国西南部。 考查方位介词。in在范围内；on在范围外，接壤；of……的一部分；to在范围外，不接壤。根据“located…the southwest of China.”可知，昆明在中国范围内，用介词in。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Have you seen  ______  umbrella here? —You mean  ______  purple one? It was here just now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你在这儿见过一把伞吗？——你是说紫色的吗？刚才它还在这儿。 考查冠词用法。根据“Have you seen…umbrella here?”可知，第一空表泛指，应该用不定冠词，umbrella以元音音素开头，不定冠词应该用an；又根据“purple one”可知，此处特指紫色的伞，故第二空应该用定冠词the。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Can I help you, sir? — Yes, please. The coat I bought last week is too big for me, so I’d like to change it for a  ______  one.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我能帮你吗，先生？——是的，请。我上周买的那件外套对我来说太大了，所以我想换件小一点的。 考查形容词比较级。small小的；larger更大的；bigger更大的；smaller更小的。根据“The coat I bought last week is too big for me”可知买的外套太大了，想换一个更小的，暗含比较之意，应用smaller，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Your handwriting is beautiful. —Thank you, I write ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的字写得很漂亮。——谢谢你，我写得比以前更仔细了。 考查副词比较级辨析。careful细心的，形容词，more careful是其比较级；carefully细心地，副词，more carefully是其比较级。write写，动词需用副词修饰，可排除前两项。than比，用于比较；根据句意结构，可知本句需用比较级，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Which season do you like  ______? — Winter. I like making a snowman.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你最喜欢哪个季节？——冬季。我喜欢堆雪人。 考查副词最高级。根据“Which season do you like”可知，表示三者以上的比较要用最高级，最高级前要加the，故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  exercise you take,  ______  you will be.
questions.explanation: 句意：你做锻炼越多，你就会越健康。 考查比较级。结合选项可知，此处是“the+比较级…the+比较级”表示“越……就越……”，第一个空是much的比较级more；第二个空是healthy的比较级healthier。故选A。

questions.prompt: —This bike is  ______  than any other one in our shop. —Great. I’ll take it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这辆自行车比我们店里的任何一辆都要新。——太好了。我买了。 考查形容词的比较级。根据“than”可知，此空应该填一个比较级，new的比较级是newer，much修饰形容词的比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Greg, you are so talented in speaking Chinese. Can you also write in Chinese? —Yes, I can, but my writing is  ______  my speaking.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Greg，你说中文很有天赋。你也能用中文写作吗？——是的，我可以，但我的写作不如我的口语好。 考查形容词和副词辨析以及形容词原级。根据“Yes, I can, but my writing is...my speaking.”可知会用中文写作，但是写作不如口语好，用结构not as...as“不如……”，此处作be动词的表语用形容词good。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the population of Shanghai? —Over 20 million.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上海人口是多少？——超过2000万。 考查特殊疑问词。How怎样； How many多少；What什么；How much多少钱。本句中询问人口的多少用固定句型what is the population of...“……的人口是多少”。故选C。

questions.prompt: —I tried to take a deep breath, but I just can’t stop  ______  so nervous! —What about  ______  of something cute like a puppy?
questions.explanation: 句意：——我试着深吸一口气，但是我就是不能停止紧张！——想想像小狗这样可爱的东西怎么样？ 考查动名词的用法。can’t stop doing sth.“不能停止做某事”，动名词作宾语。what about doing sth.“做某事怎么样”，用来表建议。故选A。

questions.prompt: We have a lot  ______  for our English report about the world population.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们有很多事情要为关于世界人口的英语报告做准备。 考查非谓语动词。根据“have a lot...for...”可知是有很多事情要准备，故此处用动词不定式作定语。故选C。

questions.prompt: —I advise you  ______  some cartoons. Those funny stories always make me  ______. —Thank you, but I’m afraid those are a little childish for me.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我建议你看一些动画片。那些有趣的故事总是让我发笑。——谢谢，但我恐怕这些对我来说有点幼稚。 考查非谓语动词。advise sb. to do sth.“建议某人做某事”，动词不定式作宾语补足语；make sb. do sth.“让某人做某事”，省略不定式符号to的动词不定式作宾语补足语。故选B。 四、完形填空。（共 8 分, 每小题 1 分） 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Right from childhood, my brothers began to play rugby (橄榄球) with me. They all  ______ 13 ______  me to become rugby player some day. My mom  ______ 14 ______, and she pushed me into skating though I always had a strong hope for rugby. Finally we reached an agreement that I became the referee (裁判) of rugby. At that time, I didn’t realize that I was beginning an activity that would influence my character. At first I only worked with my brothers. Everyone was  ______ 15 ______  and we got along quite well with each other. I soon realized that I needed to work with other people, and that’s when my experience changed. As I began to work with more coaches (教练) who acted in unpleasant ways, all I wanted to do was to get through each game and then be able to leave  ______ 16 ______  getting into trouble. Although as a referee I tried my best in every match, they sometimes shouted at me. That made me feel  ______ 17 ______, but I decided not to let them drive me away. I decided to stand up for myself. I never answered rudely to the coaches, but I did not let them break my confidence anymore. There were still a few situations that made me frightened. Once I called a penalty (判罚) and the team ended up  ______ 18 ______. I knew I had made the right  ______ 19 ______, even though I was scared when I saw that team’s fans waiting for me at my room. I stood my ground and overcame (克服) my fears. I’ve been a referee for six years, but I still can’t say it’s easy. Every game hands me something new and I  ______ 20 ______  know what I will face. Now I’m always prepared to face the unexpected. These are the little lessons that I’m grateful to have learned as a woman referee.

questions.prompt: —Did everyone have a good time? —Oh, yes.  ______  was excellent. We love it so much.
questions.explanation: 句意：——每个人都玩得愉快吗？——是的。一切都很好。我们都很喜欢。 考查不定代词辨析。Something某事，用于肯定句；Nothing没有什么；Anything任何事情，用于否定句和疑问句；Everything一切。根据“yes”可知，应该是表示肯定，且该句为陈述句，故可排除B和C。又根据“We love it so much.”可知，应该是一切都很好。故选D。

questions.prompt: We think the best way to relax is  ______  exercise.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们认为最好的放松方式是通过锻炼。 考查介词辨析。in在……里面；for为了；through通过；on在……上面。根据“the best way to relax is...exercise.”可知通过锻炼是最好的放松方式，故选C。

questions.prompt: —You watched the fashion show last night, didn’t you? —Yes, I missed the beginning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨晚你看了时装表演， 不是吗? ——是的， 但是我错过了开头。 考查连词。so所以，表结果；and和，表并列；but但是，表转折；then然后。根据句意，此处表转折，故选C。

questions.prompt: Anna is much  ______  than her brother.
questions.explanation: 句意：安娜比她的哥哥更有趣。 考查形容词比较级。funny“有趣的”，形容词原形；funnier“更有趣的”，形容词比较级；funniest“最有趣的”，形容词最高级；the funniest“最有趣的”，the+最高级。much修饰形容词比较级，than与比较级连用，故设空处应填形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Does Tara work as  ______  as Tina? — Yes, she does.
questions.explanation: 句意：——塔拉和蒂娜工作一样努力吗？——是的，她是。 考查副词原级。hardly几乎不；hard努力。as+形容词/副词原级+as“和……一样……”，修饰动词work用副词hard。故选B。

questions.prompt: Xi’an is one of capital in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：南京是中国最古老首都城市之一。 考查形容词。one of之一，后接形容词最高级和名词复数，故答案选D。

questions.prompt: John  ______ takes the bus to school because he enjoys walking there.
questions.explanation: 句意：John几乎从不坐公交车去学校，因为他喜欢走着去那里。 考查频率副词。always“总是”；usually“通常”；often“经常”；hardly never“从不”，表示否定。根据“because he enjoys walking there”因为他喜欢走着去那里，可知John几乎不坐公交车。故选D。

questions.prompt: My brother  ______  a song in the school show last week.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥上周在学校演出中唱了一首歌。 考查动词时态。根据“last week”可知本句是一般过去时，动词用过去式。故选C。

questions.prompt: What she said made everyone  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：她的话让每个人都觉得很舒服。 考查非谓语动词以及形容词作表语的用法。make sb do sth“让某人做某事”，动词不定式作宾补。feel是感官动词，后接形容词comfortable作表语，故选C。 五、选词填空。（共 5 分,每小题 1 分） 阅读下列短文,掌握其大意,从方框中选择适当的词,并用其适当形式填空。每词限用一次。 begin do get something surprise I’m Sally. I was a shy girl. But this term, I decided  ______ 10 ______  a brave thing. In this term, we had a new subject to learn—physics. When our teacher asked someone to be the physics monitor, I put up my hand and  ______ 11 ______  the role. But it was not as easy as I thought. At the  ______ 12 ______, I was a little worried because I found that many students did not hand in their homework. I shouted at the students. It made them angry. I began to lose some of my friends. Then I found that, I should talk to my classmates in a kind way and not get so angry. After this, I changed the way to speak. “Excuse me. Could you please finish your homework?” I said. Besides, I also tried to be helpful. “Is there  ______ 13 ______  I can do to help?” I often asked. Later, I was  ______ 14 ______  that many students started to understand me and finished their homework quickly. I found the best way to do this job is to talk with my classmates in a friendly way. Now, I am getting better and better with my classmates. This job makes me feel like I am growing up like a little tree day by day. 【答案】10. to do

questions.prompt: Miss Fang is  ______  English teacher.  ______  is a good teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：王小姐是我的英语老师，她是名好老师。 前句修饰名词English teacher可知填形容词性物主代词；后句在句子中做主语，可知填人称代词主格，Miss Fang是女老师，可知填She，故选D。

questions.prompt: Don’t forget  ______  the windows before you leave.
questions.explanation: 句意：离开前别忘了关上窗户。 考查不定式。forget to do sth“忘记去做某事”；forget doing sth“忘记做过某事”。此处指离开前别忘了关上窗户，使用不定式。故选A。

questions.prompt: I’m going to take him to some famous hutongs  ______  he can learn more about China.
questions.explanation: 句意：我要带他去一些著名的胡同，以便他能更多地了解中国。 考查连词辨析。but但是；as if似乎；so that为了；or否则。根据句意和上下文可知，后句“他能更多地了解中国”是前句“我要带他去一些著名的胡同”的目的，所以要用表示目的连词词组“so that”来引导目的状语从句。故选C。

questions.prompt: I spend two hours ______ basketball every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我每天花两个小时练习打篮球。 考查动名词。spend+时间+（in）doing sth“花费时间做某事”，是固定搭配，因此填动名词practicing；practice doing sth“练习做某事”，因此填动名词playing。故选D。

questions.prompt: My brother always goes to the library  ______  Saturday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的弟弟在周六早上总是去图书馆。 考查介词辨析。on在具体某一天；in在较长一段时间；at在某处；to到。根据“Saturday morning”可知此处指具体某一天。故选A。

questions.prompt: It is really hot these days. Why not  ______  to the swimming pool this weekend?
questions.explanation: 句意：这些天真的很热。为什么这周末不去游泳池？ 考查动词时态。goes去，动词的三单形式；go动词原形；going动名词；to go不定式。why not+do sth.“为什么不做某事”，固定搭配。故选B。

questions.prompt: One of my classmates  ______  football games every Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的一个同学每个星期六都看足球比赛。 考查动词时态。根据句意和时间状语“every Saturday”可知，一般现在时；主语“One of my classmates”是第三人称单数，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式。故选C。

questions.prompt: He  ______  me phone number, but I can’t remember it now.
questions.explanation: 句意：他告诉了我电话号码，但我现在不记得了。 考查动词时态。根据后句句意“但我现在不记得了”可知，他以前告诉过我电话号码，是一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Which is  ______  way to travel, by bus, by train or by plane? —I think it’s by train.
questions.explanation: 句意：——乘公共汽车、火车还是飞机，哪一种旅行方式最舒适？——我想是坐火车。 考查形容词最高级。根据“by bus, by train or by plane”可知三者比较，用形容词最高级，the most comfortable“最舒适的”。故选D。

questions.prompt: My grandparents look after my younger sister every day  ______  Saturday and Sunday, because they visit their friends on weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：除了星期六和星期天，我的祖父母每天都照顾我的妹妹，因为他们在周末拜访他们的朋友。 考查介词辨析。except除……之外（不包括在内）；besides除……之外（包括在内）；beside在……旁边；for为了。根据“because they visit their friends on weekends”可知，此处是指是除了周六和周日，不包括在内的，故选A。

questions.prompt: The teacher is glad to see that Tony is  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师很高兴看到托尼比以前细心了。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than before”可知，此处需用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: Hurry up! The class  ______  in 5 minutes.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点！5分钟后就开始上课了。 考查一般将来时。根据句意和时间状语“in 5 minutes”可知表述将来的事情，要用一般将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —I can’t find Sarah. Where is she? —She ______ for the coming football match on the playground.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我找不到莎拉。她在哪儿？——她正在操场上为即将到来的足球比赛进行训练。 考查动词时态。trains是第三人称单数形式，是一般现在时；will train是一般将来时；is training是现在进行时；trained是动词的过去式，是一般过去时。根据前句句意“我找不到莎拉。她在哪儿”可知，询问莎拉现在在哪里，在做什么事情，要用现在进行时。故选C。 二、完型填空。（20分） “I don’t want to go, Miss White. I’m frightened（害怕的）, very frightened,” Monica told her teacher. Monica was a very  ______ 15 ______  girl. She always sat at the back of the classroom,  ______ 16 ______  or taking notes. Every Monday morning, there would be a special show in her class and one student would be chosen to make a speech about his or her dream. Miss White hoped that Monica could have a try the next week. But she refused. “I know that it seems  ______ 17 ______  for you, but it will help you build up your confidence,” said Miss White. Monica was lost in thought. The next day, Monica came to Miss White’s office. Miss White was  ______ 18 ______  that she would take the chance. Miss White red-pencilled her manuscript（手稿）of the speech, corrected her pronunciation and even helped with her body language. She advised Monica to practise, to imagine that she was speaking confidently in front of her class. For a whole week, Monica practised speaking in front of her imaginary friends and teacher. Behind the locked door of her bedroom, she told them about her  ______ 19 ______. Finally, Monday arrived.  ______ 20 ______  Monica was called upon to give her speech, she  ______ 21 ______  and walked to the front of the class without any notes, in a show of confidence. Monica’s successful performance brought everyone a great  ______ 22 ______.The whole class clapped（鼓掌）for a full minute when she completed her speech. Miss White  ______ 23 ______. She had known that Monica would make it when she bravely took her first step to overcome（克服）her fear of speaking in public. From that day, Monica’s life changed for the better. At the age of 23, she became a newsreader. People who see her on television now will find it hard to  ______ 24 ______  that she was once a shy girl who refused to speak up in class.

questions.prompt: —How was your vacation, Sue? — ______  was wonderful.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Sue，你的假期过得怎么样？——太棒了。 考查代词。They他们；It它；She她；He他。根据“How was your vacation,”可知，此处回答假期的情况，vacation是单数名词，因此用代词it代指，故选B。

questions.prompt: Our school talent show is planned to take place  ______  Monday evening. Welcome to join us.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校的才艺表演计划在星期一晚上举行。欢迎加入我们。 考查时间介词辨析。by到……为止；at后接具体时刻；on后接具体一天；in后接某年某月某季节。“Monday evening”是具体的一天，应填on，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you work out in the gym, Jane? —Every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：——简，你多久在健身房锻炼一次？——每天。 考查特殊疑问词。how much多少钱；how long多长时间；how often多久一次；how far多远。根据“Every day”可知此处询问频次，用疑问词how often。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What’s the population of Shenzhen? —It’s over ten million, I think. That’s  ______  than the population of many other cities in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：——深圳的人口是多少？——我想已经超过一千万了。这比中国许多其他城市的人口都要多。 考查形容词比较级。根据than可知，此处应填比较级larger，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Which season do you think is  ______  in Beijing, Fang Fang? —Autumn, I guess. A beautiful
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认为在北京哪一个季节是最美丽的，芳芳？——秋季，我认为。 考查形容词最高级。根据“Which season”可知是四个季节相比较，所以应用形容词最高级，而形容词最高级前面必须加定冠词the，故选D。

questions.prompt: Our teachers always tell us to believe that  ______  is difficult as long as we keep trying hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的老师总是告诉我们要相信，只要我们不断努力，没有什么是困难的。 考查代词。nothing没什么；something某物；anything任何事；everything一切。根据“as long as we keep trying hard”可知，在我们不断努力的条件下，没有什么是困难的，故选A。

questions.prompt: Although Tom doesn’t like vegetables, he  ______  them every day because they’re good for his health.
questions.explanation: 句意：尽管Tom不喜欢蔬菜，他每天还是吃，因为它们对健康好。 考查时态。根据“every day”可知此处指经常的事，用一般现在时。故选A。

questions.prompt: The match last Sunday was so boring because no one  ______  at all.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周日的比赛很无聊，因为没有人进球。 考查时态辨析。根据“last Sunday”可知用一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式scored。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where is your brother, Mark? —He  ______  China’s Got Talent on TV in the living-room.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Mark，你哥哥在哪里？——他正在客厅里看电视《中国达人秀》。 考查时态。根据“Where is...”可知他现在正在看电视，用现在进行时am/is/are doing。故选D。 五、课文填空（共4分，每空1分） 阅读下面的短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处，仅填写一个恰当的单词；在给出提示词的空白处，用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 Everyone is good at something, but some people are truly talented. It’s always interesting to watch other people  ______ 10 ______  (show) their talents. Talent shows are getting more and more popular. First, there were shows like American Idol and America’s Got Talent. Now, there are similar shows around the world, such as China’s Got Talent. All these shows have one thing in  ______ 11 ______: They try to look for the best singers, the most talented dancers, the most exciting magicians,  ______ 12 ______  (fun) actors and so on. All kinds of people join these shows. But who can play the piano the best or sing the most beautifully? That’s up to you  ______ 13 ______  (decide). When people watch the show, they usually play a role in deciding the winner. And the winner always gets a very good prize. 【答案】10. show

questions.prompt: —Is Mo Yan  ______  best writer in China? —It’s hard to say But he is really  ______  very good writer.
questions.explanation: 句意： ——莫言是中国最好的作家吗？——这很难说。但他真的是一个很好的作家。 考查冠词用法。形容词最高级best前加定冠词the；第二空泛指“一个非常好的作家”，且very以辅音音素开头，故第二空用不定冠词a。故选B。

questions.prompt: Mary’s birthday is coming. We’ve decided to make a cake for  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽的生日快到了。我们决定为她做一个蛋糕。 考查代词辨析。him他；her她；you你/你们；them他们。根据“Mary’s birthday is coming.”可知，此处指Mary，女性，故选B。

questions.prompt: Space Day of China falls  ______  April 24th every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年的4月24日是中国的“航天日”。 考查介词辨析。on用在星期或具体时间前；by到……为止；at其后加点钟等；in其后加早中晚/月份/年份等。根据“April 24th”可知，此处加具体的时间，故选A。

questions.prompt: The teacher is glad to see that Tony is  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师很高兴看到托尼比以前细心了。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than before”可知，此处需用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: We have a lovely room. It’s one of in the hotel.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们有一个漂亮的房间。这是宾馆最好的房间之一。 考查形容词最高级。固定搭配：one+of+the+形容词最高级，表示“最……之一”，故选D。

questions.prompt: Please speak louder  ______  everybody can hear you clearly.
questions.explanation: 句意：请大声一点，这样大家都能听清楚。 考查连词辨析。if如果；so that以便；because因为；though尽管。根据“Please speak louder…everybody can hear you clearly.”可知，大声一些的目的是让大家听清楚，应该用so that引导目的状语从句。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Peter, what are you doing? —Oh, I  ______  a report about national heroes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，你在干什么？——哦，我在写一篇关于民族英雄的报告。 考查动词时态。根据“Peter, what are you doing?”可知句子是现在进行时，其结构为am/is/are doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: My parents and I  ______  trees last Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周日，我和父母植树。 考查时态。根据“last Sunday”可知句子用一般过去时，动词用过去式。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Lily, what do you usually do after school? —I  ______  exercise with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——莉莉，放学后你通常做什么？——我和我的朋友一起锻炼。 考查一般现在时。根据“what do you usually do after school”可知，时态是一般现在时，主语是I，动词用原形，故选A。

questions.prompt: My grandfather wants  ______  around the world because he enjoys  ______  new places.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爷爷想环游世界，因为他喜欢看新地方。 考查非谓语动词。第一空，根据“want to do sth.：想要做某事”可知，应填to travel，是动词不定式结构，故排除A和D；第二空，根据“enjoy doing sth.：喜欢做某事”，应填seeing，是动词的v-ing形式，故排除B，故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  does it take to fly from Beijing to Shanghai? — About two and a half hours.
questions.explanation: ——从北京飞上海要多长时间? ——大约两个半小时。 考查特殊疑问词。How soon多久以后，提问“in+一段时间”；How often问频率，指多长时间一次；How much问价钱或不可数名词的数量；How long多长时间，提问一段时间。根据答语“About two and a half hours.”可知，表示一段时间，应用how long进行提问，表示多长时间，故选D。 五、完形填空（共 8 分，每小题 1 分） The Phone Call It was getting dark. Paul looked out of the window and signed (叹气). Dad said he could come home by 5:30, but it was almost 7:00. Even if Dad came back, it wouldn’t be much fun playing  ______ 12 ______  in the dark. Paul walked into his room and threw his baseball into the corner. He tried to do some homework, but he couldn’t. The phone rang at about 8:00. It was Dad: “Paul, I’m sorry, but I can’t play baseball with you tonight. I have to finish my work at the office. Maybe we can play this weekend. Oh no. How about next weekend?” Paul couldn’t understand why Dad was so  ______ 13 ______. He threw himself on the sofa and soon fell asleep. His book was still opened to the first page. The next day at school, Paul didn’t hand in his homework and he  ______ 14 ______  a test. Mrs. Green, his teacher, asked him to stay after school. “Paul, you didn’t do your homework. You didn’t pass the test and only got a D. This isn’t like you. What’s wrong?” Paul just sat there  ______ 15 ______. “Paul, if you don’t want to talk, I will. I know that something’s worrying with you, but you have to get it out. You need to tell someone.” As Paul walked home, he thought of what Mrs. Green said. Maybe he didn’t do his homework because he wanted to get his dad’s attention (注意). He knew Mrs. Green was right. He decided to take her advice. When Paul got home, he  ______ 16 ______  his dad. But there was no answer. Then it went to voicemail (语音信箱). Paul began talking: “Dad, I can’t play with you next weekend. I’ve got lots of problems with my homework. Also, I really don’t want to spend another day looking out of the window and waiting. Whenever you  ______ 17 ______  our plans, Dad, it hurts me. It’s not too late to rebuild our relationship, but we have to start small. Maybe you can help me with my  ______ 18 ______  sometime. Dad, I love you.” As Paul ended the call, he felt relaxed. He didn’t know whether his dad would feel different, but it didn’t matter. He himself  ______ 19 ______  his mood. He expressed his feelings to the right person. He had a clear head when he was doing his homework that evening.

questions.prompt: The woman teacher is kind, but I’m afraid to speak to  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：那位女老师很和蔼，但我不敢和她说话。 考查代词辨析。it它；her她；him他；us我们。根据“The woman teacher is kind, but I’m afraid to speak to...”可知此空是代指女老师，应用her，故选B。

questions.prompt: Thank you for buying a beautiful toy  ______  my son.
questions.explanation: 句意：谢谢你给我儿子买了一个漂亮的玩具。 考查介词辨析。to到；in在……里面；for为；at在。buy sth for sb“为某人买某物”，固定搭配。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What is the best way to travel around the city? — ______  bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：——游览这个城市最好的方式是什么？——乘坐公共汽车。 考查介词辨析。By乘坐；On在……上面；At在；In在……里面。根据“... bus.”可知用“by+交通工具”表示乘坐某种交通工具。故选A。

questions.prompt: He learns English  ______  of all my classmates.
questions.explanation: 句意：他的英语在我们班里最好。 考查副词的最高级。根据空后的“of all my classmates”可知比较范围是在三者以上，所以用最高级。最高级前要加the，故选C。

questions.prompt: It is difficult to practice in winter  ______  the weather is so cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：冬天很难练习，因为天气很冷。 考查连词。so所以，表示因果的并列连词；and和，并列连词；or或者，选择连词；because因为，引导原因状语从句。分析空前后两个句子可知，本题为原因状语从句，故选D。

questions.prompt: This year we hope to play  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：今年我们希望比以前打得更好。 考查比较级。good好的；well好地；better更好；the best最好。根据“than”可知两者之间的比较应用比较级better，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Jack,  ______  you understand the words of the opera? —Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你能听懂这部歌剧的歌词吗？——是的，我能。 考查情态动词。can能；must必须；need需要；may可能。根据“Yes, I can.”可知，问的是能不能，该一般疑问句以can开头，故选A。

questions.prompt: Listening is  ______  than speaking in language learning.
questions.explanation: 句意：在语言学习中，听比说更难。 考查比较级。than前用比较级，difficult的比较级是more difficult。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the population of Shenzhen? —It’s over ten million.
questions.explanation: 句意：——深圳的人口是多少？——超过一千万。 考查特殊疑问句。how much多少钱；how many多少，对可数名词复数提问；what什么；how如何。根据“It’s over ten million”可知对人口的多少进行询问时，疑问词用what，即what is the population of...“……的人口是多少”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Most of my classmates  ______  the subway every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的大多数同学每天都坐地铁。 考查时态。根据“every day”可知句子用一般现在时，主语是名词复数，谓语动词用原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: Look! The boys  ______  hard on the playground.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！男孩们正在操场上刻苦训练。 考查动词时态。根据“Look!”可知，时态用现在进行时，谓语结构是am/is/are+doing。故选A。

questions.prompt: We  ______  to Lao She Teahouse to see the Beijing Opera next weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：下周末我们将去老舍茶馆看京剧。 考查时态。根据“next weekend”可知句子用一般将来时will do。故选B。

questions.prompt: Last year we  ______  to the other team in the final match.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年我们在决赛中输给了另一队。 考查时态。根据“Last year”可知句子用一般过去时，动词用过去式。故选C。 四、完形填空：（每小题1.5分，515分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 GE Money has recently done a study. It shows that women spend over 8 years of their life shopping. According to the study, women  ______ 14 ______  about 400 hours each year shopping. Almost a quarter of that time is spent doing  ______ 15 ______  for food. Luckily, Million Looks magazine says that shopping can be a good thing, and it gives some interesting  ______ 16 ______  about women and shopping. The magazine says that women who shop for more than 17 hours a week are thinner and  ______ 17 ______  than those who spend less time shopping. The magazine also says that women who shop more often look much younger than those who dislike shopping. Finally, they say that most  ______ 18 ______  who enjoy shopping are much  ______ 19 ______. We cannot be sure if these things are true, but that shopping is big business is really  ______ 20 ______. There are now about 50,000 shopping malls in the United States alone, and each person spends about $75 each time they  ______ 21 ______  a mall. The shopping malls also try their best to encourage people to spend as much as possible, and stay in the mall as  ______ 22 ______  as possible. There are escalators (电扶梯) in malls, so people use them to pass many different stores. You may have also noticed that places to sit in malls are  ______ 23 ______  to find. This is because people can’t spend money when they are sitting down!

questions.prompt: This room is ours and that one is  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个房间是我们的，那个是他们的。 考查代词辨析。they他们；them他们；theirs他们的；their他们的。此处在句中作表语，表示“他们的房间”，用theirs代替their room。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mike does his exercises  ______  seven in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：迈克在晚上七点做运动。 考查介词辨析。on其后加星期或具体的时间；in其后加早中晚/月份/季节/年份等；by到……为止；at其后加点钟。“seven”是点钟，用介词at。故选D。

questions.prompt: We didn’t go shopping  ______  the strong wind.
questions.explanation: 句意：因为大风我们没有去购物。 考查短语词义辨析。in order to为了；as a result结果；because of因为；so that以至于。根据“the strong wind”和“We didn’t go shopping”可知二者是因果关系，前果后因，用because of。故选C。

questions.prompt: The movie is quite boring. There isn't  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这部电影非常无聊。没有什么有趣的东西。 考查不定代词和定语后置。something某事，常用于肯定句中；anything任何事，常用于否定句或疑问句中；interesting有趣的，是一个形容词，修饰不定代词，应放在不定代词后面，可先排除A和B；这是一个否定句，应用anything，故选D。

questions.prompt: My mother told me  ______  TV too much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈告诉我不能看太多电视。 考查动词不定式的否定。tell sb to do sth“告诉某人做某事”，watch TV“看电视”，对动词不定式进行否定，直接在不定式前面加not，故选A。

questions.prompt: What  ______  you  ______  at this time yesterday?
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天这个时间你正在做什么？ 考查过去进行时。根据“at this time yesterday”可知时态应为过去进行时，其谓语结构为“was/were+doing”，故选B。

questions.prompt: I like studying English but I forget new vocabulary  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢学英语，但是我很快就会忘记新单词。 考查词义辨析和副词修饰动词。quick快的；quickly快地；good好的；well好地。此处在句中修饰动词，用副词形式，结合“I like studying English but I forget new vocabulary...”可知，是很快忘记新单词。故选B。

questions.prompt: Do you enjoy  ______  to rock music?
questions.explanation: 句意：你喜欢听摇滚音乐吗？ 考查非谓语。enjoy doing sth.“喜欢做某事”，此处用动名词作宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: Kate always does her homework  ______  than Peter.
questions.explanation: 句意：凯特做作业总是比彼得更仔细。 考查副词的比较级。此处在句中修饰动词，用副词形式，根据“than”可知，用副词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: They like spring best because it never gets too hot  ______  too cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们最喜欢春天，因为春天不冷也不热。 考查并列连词辨析。and和；so所以；or或者、也不；but但是。根据“because it never gets too hot...too cold”可知，此处表示“不冷也不热”，否定句中用or代替and。故选C。

questions.prompt: It  ______  me about ten minutes to walk to school every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：每天我大约花费十分钟走路去学校。 考查动词辨析。四个选项都有“花费”的含义，spend主语通常为人；cost主语为物；pay主语为人；take主语通常为it，构成句型“It takes sb 时间 to do sth”，表示“花费某人多长时间做某事”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Oh, we missed the last bus to the museum. — ______  We can go there by taxi and it’s faster.
questions.explanation: 句意：——哦，我们错过了去博物馆的末班车。——没关系。我们可以乘出租车去那里，而且速度更快。 考查情景交际。Never mind没关系；I’m not sure about it关于这个我不确定；Bad luck真倒霉；That’s too bad太糟了；根据“Oh, we missed the last bus to the museum.”以及“We can go there by taxi and it’s faster.”可知，此处是安慰对方，表示“没关系”，故选A。

questions.prompt: — did you go last Sunday? — I went to the Science Museum.
questions.explanation: 本题考查：特殊疑问句。选项分析：A. Where 在哪里。B. When什么时候，何时。C. How如何；多少；多么。D. Why为什么。依据答语I went to the Science Museum.我去了科学博物馆。答语是指地点的词。综合分析前后句， 可知此处填Where最合适，完整句意为：Where did you go last Sunday? I went to the Science Museum.上星期天你去哪儿了?我去了科学博物馆。正确答案为：A

questions.prompt: Stop  ______  so much noise！Father is working at the desk.
questions.explanation: 句意：别那么吵闹了！爸爸在办公桌上工作。短语stop to do sth.：停下来（正做的一件事去）做另一件事（指两件事）；stop doing sth.：停止正在做的事，指一件事。结合句意和语境可知选B。

questions.prompt: — Hi, Tony, I don’t know how to make a model spaceship. Can you help me? — ______!
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，Tony，我不知道怎么制作模型宇宙飞船。你能帮助我吗？——当然，没问题。 考查情景交际。Good luck祝你好运；Sure, no problem当然，没问题；You’re welcome 不客气；Thanks谢谢。根据“Can you help me?”可知对方提出请求，用“Sure, no problem”回复，表示愿意提供帮助。故选B。 四、完形填空（共 10 分，每小题 1 分） 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从方框中选出最佳词语填入短文空白处，每个词只使用一次。 except, teeth, best, smaller Animals are people’s friends. But many wild animals are facing the danger of dying out, because the environment that they are living changed greatly. For example, their living area has become  ______ 16 ______  than before because of pollution. They have no places to live in  ______ 17 ______  the zoo. And many wild animals now can’t find enough food to eat. At the same time, man is killing animals just for their fur,  ______ 18 ______  and meat. People should know how serious the situation is and try our  ______ 19 ______  to protect the animals. First, we should set up some nature reserves. Second, we should do something to make our world cleaner. Remember: The death of the animals will bring a disaster to human beings. 【答案】16. smaller

questions.prompt: He became internationally famous  ______  his novels.
questions.explanation: 句意：他因小说而蜚声国际。考查介词辨析题。be famous for因…而著名，固定短语；根据句意语境，可知选B。

questions.prompt: We must speak English ______  possible after class.
questions.explanation: 句意：课后我们必须尽可能多说英语。as…as之间跟形容词或副词的原级，more是many/much的比较级，首先排除D答案；as soon as possible尽可能快地，是从时间的角度来表达的，也不符合题意；many修饰可数名词，much修饰不可数名词，English是不可数名词，需要由much来修饰，故答案为C。

questions.prompt: As a student, it's important  ______  late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：作为一名学生，上学不迟到是重要的。don’t be不要；not be不；not to be动词不定式否定形式；can’t be不能。这句话中使用了句型It is +形容词+to do sth.“做某事是…的”，根据句意可知，这里是否定的形式，故应选C。

questions.prompt: —Who does homework, Tom, Jack or Bill? —Bill.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，杰克和比尔，谁做作业最认真？ ——比尔。 考查形容词与副词辨析。根据后面的三个人可知此空应用最高级形式，排除A、B两项；又根据动词does可知应用副词修饰。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  will Linda stay in the countryside with her grandparents? —Maybe two weeks.
questions.explanation: 句意：——琳达和她的祖父母将要待在乡下多长时间？——也许两周的时间。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长时间；How old多大年龄； How much多少（钱）；How far多远。根据“Maybe two weeks.”可知，对时间段提问，用how long。故选A。

questions.prompt: In our city, it's  ______  in July, but it is even  ______  in August.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我们的城市，七月很热，但八月更热。考查形容词和比较级辨析题。but表转折，句子前后是转折关系；前一空缺表语形容词，后一句和前面进行对比，even更加/甚至，修饰比较级，空格处需填比较级。根据句意语境，可知选A。

questions.prompt: We didn't do morning exercises  ______  the rain.
questions.explanation: 句意：由于下雨，我们没有做早操。 A. 因为；B.因为，由于；C.结果；D.即使。根据because 因为，后接句子；because of 因为，由于，后接名词或名词短语。根据空后the rain是名词，此空应填because of，故选B。

questions.prompt: It is one of  ______  shopping centres in my city.
questions.explanation: 句意：它是我们城市最大的购物中心之一。 考查形容词最高级。“one of the+形容词最高级+可数名词复数”表示“最……的……之一”。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Tom offered  ______  a birthday cake for Jim, and it was delicious. — Great! It was very nice of him to do it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆提出给吉姆做一个生日蛋糕，蛋糕很好吃。——棒极了！ 考查非谓语动词。offer to do sth.意为“主动提议做某事”，动词不定式作宾语，故选A。

questions.prompt: The funny look made Lucy  ______  all the time.
questions.explanation: 句意：那滑稽表情使露西一直笑个不停。 A. laugh动词原形；B. laughing现在分词或动名词；C. to laugh动词不定式；D. laughed过去式或过去分词。根据make sb. do sth.表示“使某人做某事”后跟省略的不定式，此空应填laugh，故排除B、C、D，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Let’s go out for a picnic on Sunday. — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——让我们星期天出去野餐吧。——好主意。 考查情景交际。Good idea好主意；Here you are给你；Nice to meet you见到你很高兴；Don’t worry别担心。根据“Let’s go out for a picnic on Sunday.”可知对这个建议作出评价，用“好主意”符合语境。故选A。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Last summer I spent two weeks in Singapore with my mother and my sister. Before this trip, I heard that Singapore is one of the most beautiful and cleanest countries in Asia. I hoped that I would have an unforgettable time there. In fact, the trip was  ______ 13 ______  than I had expected. Many places in Singapore attracted us. First, we visited Singapore Zoo and Jurong Bird Park.  ______ 14 ______  the places are very large and many animals live there. So we had to  ______ 15 ______  a whole day seeing all of the animals. However, the most interesting event was the Bird Show in Jurong Bird Park. We enjoyed the performances of the birds. The workers had trained the birds carefully and patiently for long  ______ 16 ______  they could dance, sing and even play basketball. At the end of the show, they sent the visitors a message that raises people’s awareness (意识) of protecting birds. I think it is a very helpful and practical (实际的)  ______ 17 ______  of educating people to protect nature. Second, after spending a week in relaxing and visiting some tourist spots in Singapore, my sister and I  ______ 18 ______  to attend a short-term English course because English is the official language in Singapore and we thought we would  ______ 19 ______  our English quickly. English was the only common language in this class, so all students there had to speak English during the lessons. The trip in Singapore was truly a nice  ______ 20 ______  in my life. During the trip, I learned much about other countries’ lives, other people’s thoughts and I improved my English. Besides, I have made some new friends who I am still keeping in touch with and I hope that I will meet them again someday in China and tell them more about our country.

questions.prompt: Jim has a sister. He likes playing games with  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆有一个妹妹。他喜欢和她一起做游戏。 考查人称代词的用法。me我（第一人称宾格的形式）；you 你（第二人称的宾格形式）；her她(第三人称宾格，表示女子时用)；him他（第三人称宾格，表示男子时用）。结合句意，吉姆和他的妹妹一起做游戏，他的妹妹是女孩，因此用her在此处作宾语。故选 C。

questions.prompt: I watched the Super Brain  ______  March 28th.
questions.explanation: 句意：我在3月28日观看了《最强大脑》。 考查介词辨析。in在某年某月等；on在具体某一天；at在某一时刻；to到。空格后是具体某一天用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the cinema? —About once a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去一次电影院？——大约一个月一次。 考查特殊疑问句。how long多长时间；how much多少钱；how often多久一次；how far多远。根据“About once a month”可知此处询问频率，疑问词用how often。故选C。

questions.prompt: Judy enjoys running. She even runs  ______  than the boys in her class.
questions.explanation: 句意：朱迪喜欢跑步。她甚至比班上的男孩跑得更快。 考查比较级。根据“than”可知此处用副词的比较级faster“更快”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Sue  ______  to Penang with her parents last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：苏去年和她的父母去槟城旅游。 考查时态。根据“last year”可知，时态是一般过去时，动词用过去式。故选A。

questions.prompt: — I missed the beginning of The Voice of China yesterday evening. —! But you can watch the re-play tonight.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天晚上，我错过了《中国好声音》的开幕式。——太遗憾了！但是今晚你可以看重播。 考查情景对话。A. Hurry up 快点； B. What a pity 太遗憾；C. Try your best 尽你最大努力；D. I don’ t think so我不这样认为。 根据I missed the beginning of The Voice of China yesterday evening.可知此处错过了一个好节目，因此是一件遗憾的事。故选B。 五、语法填空（共4 题，每小题1 分，共4 分） 请用方框里所给词的适当形式填空。 stay person have good Chelsea Fearce is seventeen years old. There are five  ______ 7 ______  in her family. They are poor and they live in a shelter (收容所). “Getting a shower food and clean clothes was not easy for me,” Fearce said. “I’m worried about my family and my home life. I know I have to become much stronger, so I study hard.” When she was in high school, Fearce often  ______ 8 ______  up late. She wanted to live a  ______ 9 ______  life than before. She just told herself to keep working. Fearce overcame (克服) all the problems. She got high grades and she became a college student. “Never give up! Do what you truly have to do right now so that you can have a future that you really need  ______ 10 ______.” Fearce told everyone. 【答案】7. persons

questions.prompt: Look! That old man is crossing the road. Let’s go and help  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！那个老人在过马路，让我们去帮助他吧。me我，人称代词宾格；him他；her她；them他们。这几个选项中都是人称代词的宾格形式。根据句意可知，这个代词指代的是that old man，故应选B。

questions.prompt: In order to keep cool, many people go swimming  ______  summer．
questions.explanation: 句意：为了保持凉爽，在夏天很多人去游泳。in泛指在上午、下午或晚上；在季节、月份、年代前；at在具体时刻；on在具体某一天、星期；to到…。空后的summer是夏天，故应选A。

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  you’ll be late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则你上学就迟到了。 考查并列连词辨析。and又，和，表示并列关系；but但是，表示转折关系；so因此，表因果关系；or否则，表相反假设，用于警告或忠告。句型“祈使句+or+陈述句”表示以陈述句为条件下的相反假设，意为“否则，要不然”，所以用连词or。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______ you come to my birthday party this Friday evening? —Sure. It must be a lot of fun.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个星期五晚上你能来参加我的生日聚会吗？——当然。那一定很有趣。 考查情态动词。Can能够；Need需要；Must必须；Should应该。根据“you come to my birthday party this Friday evening?”可知，此处是询问对方是否能来参加派对，因此用Can。故选A。

questions.prompt: — do you like better, carrots or potatoes? —Carrots. They are good for my eyes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你比较喜欢哪一个，胡萝卜还是西红柿？——胡萝卜，它们对我的眼睛有好处。A. Why为什么； B. Which 哪一个； C. Who 谁； D. Whose谁的；根据carrots or potatoes胡萝卜还是西红柿，可知是选择哪一个；故选B

questions.prompt: I think skiing is  ______  than running.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为滑雪比跑步更令人兴奋。exciting令人兴奋的；more exciting更令人兴奋的；most exciting最令人兴奋的；the most exciting最令人兴奋的。根据句意和句中的than可知，这里表示滑雪和跑步两者相比，应用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: The North Star is one of  ______  stars in the night sky.
questions.explanation: 句意：北极星是夜空中最亮的星星之一。A. bright 明亮的； B. brighter 比较亮； C. brightest 最亮的； D. the brightest最亮的；根据one of ---之一，后面通常用形容词或副词最高级，这里是形容词最高级修饰名词 stars ，形容词最高级前要加冠词the；故选D 点睛：形容词原级的用法 1.说明人或事物的自身特征、性质或状态时，用形容词原级。通常用as---as结构； 2.表示A与B在某一程度相同或不同时，用原级。比较级的用法 1.常用于比较级+than的结构；2.形容词常用much /a little /even等来修饰，例如：much bigger；3.表示两者之间进行选择时“Which is +形容词比较级，A or B?”；4. the +比较级，the+比较级 越---就越---。形容词最高级用法 1.表示三者或三者以上进行比较时用最高级；2.用于“one of the +最高级”。最高级前常加冠词the 。

questions.prompt: It’s difficult for Betty  ______  the words of the Beijing Opera.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂很难听懂京剧的歌词。 考查It固定句型。此处是固定句型，It is+形容词+for sb to do sth“做某事对某人来说是……的”，因此这里填不定式。故选C。

questions.prompt: —My grandma enjoys  ______  at that photo on the wall. —I can understand. It helps her to remember her childhood.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我奶奶喜欢看墙上的照片。——我能理解。这有助于她回忆起她的童年。 考查非谓语动词。此处是固定词组，enjoy doing sth“喜欢做某事”，动名词作宾语。故选B。

questions.prompt: The teacher offered  ______  me with my English.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师主动提出帮助我学英语。 考查非谓语动词。offer to do sth“主动提出做某事”，为固定短语，故选D。

questions.prompt: They  ______  their holiday in Paris last summer.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年夏天他们在巴黎度假。 考查动词时态。根据“last summer”可知，本题是一般过去时态，因此动词填过去式。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What a fine day! What about going for a picnic? — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——多好的天气啊！去野餐怎么样？——这是个好主意。 考情情景交际。You’re welcome不客气；Thank you very much非常感谢；That’s a good idea这是个好主意；It doesn’t matter没关系。根据“What about going for a picnic?”可知，此处表示建议，赞同对方的建议用That’s a good idea。故选C。 二、完形填空（共 8 分，每小题 1 分） 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I stood there listening to my father shout at top of his voice.
