questions.prompt: Lucy’s birthday is coming. Let’s make a cake for  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：露西的生日快到了。让我们为她做一个蛋糕吧。 考查代词辨析。she她，主格；her她，宾格；us我们；hers她的，名词性物主代词。根据“Let’s make a cake for…”可知，介词for后用人称单词的宾格，此处指“为了露西做一个蛋糕”，人称代词的宾格her符合题意。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tree Planting Day of China falls  ______  March 12th every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年的3月12日是中国的植树节。 考查介词辨析。in后接年/月/季节；to到；of……的；on后接具体的某一天。根据“March 12th”为具体的一天可知，时间介词on符合题意。故选D。

questions.prompt: — I tried several ways to work out the math problem, but  ______  of them worked. — Never give up. I believe you’ll make it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我尝试了几种方法来解这道数学题，但没有一种有效。——永不放弃。我相信你会成功的。 考查不定代词辨析。all所有的；each每个，各自的；none没有一点没有（三者或三者以上）；neither两者都不。根据“I tried several ways to work out the math problem”和空格前的but可知，此处应该是指“没有一种有效”，几种方法都无效，用none。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mum is glad to see that Jim is  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：妈妈很高兴看到吉姆比以前更加细心了。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than before”可知，此处需用比较级；又根据“Jim is…”可知，空格的部分，在句中作表语，所以应该填入形容词的比较级形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: — What does your friend look like? — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的朋友长什么样？——她又高又瘦。 考查情景交际。She’s quite well她身体相当好；She is really kind她真的很善良；She is tall and thin她又高又瘦；She likes wearing a skirt她喜欢穿裙子。根据问句“What does your friend look like?”可知，询问长相，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mum, flowers for you. Happy Mother’s Day! —Thanks, my son. They  ______  so sweet.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，给您的花。母亲节快乐！——谢谢，我的儿子。它们闻起来好香。 考查动词辨析。get得到；sound听起来；smell闻起来；taste尝起来。根据“They... so sweet.”可知，花应该是闻起来香，故选C。

questions.prompt: I find  ______  necessary to learn about the customs of a country before you go there.
questions.explanation: 句意：在你去一个国家之前，我觉得有必要了解那里的风俗习惯。 考查it的用法。sb. find it+形容词+to do sth.“某人发现去做某事是……”，it是形式宾语，不定式为真正的宾语。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Peter, what are you doing? —Oh, I  ______  a report about national heroes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，你在干什么？——哦，我在写一篇关于国家英雄的报道。 考查现在进行时。根据“what are you doing”可知，此处强调动作正在发生，使用现在进行时，故选B。

questions.prompt: Don’t lose heart. If you keep working hard, you  ______  some day.
questions.explanation: 句意：不要灰心。如果你继续努力，将来某一天你会成功的。 考查if引导的条件状语从句。if表示“如果”时遵循“主将从现”原则，即主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时；空格处于主句位置，故用一般将来时。故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  about my brother when my telephone rang. It was him!
questions.explanation: 句意：当我的电话铃响的时候，我正在想我的哥哥。是他！ 考查动词的时态。根据“I…about my brother when my telephone rang.”可知，when引导的时间状语从句为一般过去时，主句在描述过去某一时刻正在发生的事情，用过去进行时was/were doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where is your father? — He is not at home. He  ______  Shanghai.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你父亲在哪里？ ——他不在家。他已经去上海了。 考查动词的时态。has been to，去过某地（已回来）；has gone to去了某地（未回来，仍在某地）；went to去了某地，指去的动作；will go to打算去某地。根据“He is not at home.”和语境可知，他去上海还没回来。故选B。

questions.prompt: Susan  ______  a lot about Chinese culture since she came to study in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从来中国留学以来，苏珊对中国文化有了很多了解。 考查动词时态。is learning正在学习，现在进行时；learns学习，三单形式；has learned已经学习，现在完成时；learned学习，过去式。根据“since she came to study in China.”可知，此处要用现在完成时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Miss Brown has helped me a lot,  ______  I’m quite thankful to her.
questions.explanation: 句意：布朗小姐帮了我很多，所以我很感谢她。 考查连词辨析。since自从；but但是；or或；so因此。根据“Miss Brown has helped me a lot”可知，前句是后句的原因，表示因此我很感谢她。故选D。

questions.prompt: They walked because they couldn’t afford  ______  a taxi.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们走路是因为他们付不起出租车费。 考查动词不定式作宾语。根据“afford”可知，此处是afford to do sth.，所以使用动词不定式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Your watch is so cool! When did you get it? — On my 12th birthday. I  ______  it for two years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的手表太酷了！你什么时候买的？——在我12岁生日的时候。 我买了2年了。 考查现在完成时。根据“for two years”可知，此处应用现在完成时，buy是短暂性动词，此处需要延续性动词代替，故应用have had。故选B。

questions.prompt: I think the machine is too big．It too much space．
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为这台机器太大。它占据太多的空间。tidy up清理；get up起床；take up占据；make up编造。结合句意可知，答案为C。 II.从下面各题所给的两个选项中, 选择可以填入空白处的最佳选项, 把文段补全完整。 A Among all kinds of interesting sports, I like swimming best. I  ______ 17 ______  for 8 years since I learned it when I was a kid. Now I swim every weekend. Swimming can strengthen our body, so it can improve our health. questions.prompt: —Excuse me, are these  ______  umbrellas? —Yes. Thank you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，这些是你的雨伞吗？——是的。谢谢你。 考查代词词义辨析。you 你（们），人称代词；yourself你自己，反身代词；yours你（们）的，名词性物主代词；your你（们）的，形容词性物主代词。根据空后的“umbrellas”可知，此处应用形容词性物主代词。故选D。

questions.prompt: The bread tastes  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：面包尝起来很好。 考查形容词作表语。to be well动词不定式；to be good动词不定式；well好，副词；good好的，形容词。根据“tastes”可知，tastes为感官系动词，其后需填形容词，作表语，good“好的”，形容词，符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: We should do some sports every day ______  it is good for our health.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们应该每天做一些运动，因为这对我们的健康有益。 考查连词辨析。so 因此，并列连词，后面表示结果；although虽然，但是，即使，前后是转折关系，表示让步条件，引导让步状语从句；because因为，前后是因果关系，表示原因，引导原因状语从句；but但是，并列连词，表示转折关系。根据句意，可知前后是因果关系，后面的句子表示原因，可知填because。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mary, could you help me? —Wait a moment, I  ______  in the kitchen.

questions.explanation: 句意：——露西，你叔叔是老师吗？ ——是的，他教了将近20年的历史了。考查现在完成时。根据for nearly 20 years可知，这是一个表示一段时间的时间状语，通常用于现在完成时，而且动词应该用延续性动词，现在完成时态结构为have/has+动词的过去分词。故选B。 【点睛】本题主要考查现在完成时。用法：表示过去发生或完成的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，还表示过去发生动作一直持续到现在。其结构是have/has+及物动词的过去分词。此题注意短暂性动词和延续性动词的区别。

questions.prompt: As a doctor, you should be patient  ______  all the patients.
questions.explanation: 句意：作为医生，你应该对所有的病人有耐心。 考查介词辨析。in在……里；with和；on在……上；of……的。be patient with对……有耐心。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Dad, I was the first to reach the top of the hill. —Good job, Mary. I’m  ______  of you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爸爸， 我是第一个到达山顶的。——做得好， 玛丽。我为你骄傲。 考查形容词短语。be afraid of害怕……；be proud of以……为骄傲；be tired of厌烦……；be careful of小心。根据“ I was the first to reach the top of the hill.”和“Good job”可知，“我”是第一个到达山顶的，所以父亲是感到骄傲的。故选B。

questions.prompt: We should  ______ good eating habits.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们应该养成良好的饮食习惯。grow“栽培，种植”；develop“发展，养成”；increase“增加，增大，提高”；find“找到；发现”。develop habits养成习惯，故选B。

questions.prompt: The government wants to  ______ a school for the poor children.
questions.explanation: 句意：政府想为贫穷的孩子们建立一所学校。put off“推迟”；set up“建立”；call in“来访”；look after“照顾”；根据宾语a school可知此处表示建立一所学校，故选B。

questions.prompt: The house is so expensive that I can’t  ______  it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这房子太贵了，我买不起。 考查及物动词。afford及物动词，意为“买得起；能做；承担得起”，后面接名词、代词或动词不定式作宾语，it是代词，空前是情态动词，动词用原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: Each year quite a lot of food  ______  around the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年全世界有相当多的食物被浪费。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“Each year quite a lot of food...around the world.”可知，each year“每年”，句子应是一般现在时，且主语food和动词waste“浪费”之间存在被动关系，句子应用一般现在时的被动语态，谓语结构是am/is/are done。故选B。

questions.prompt: Mum, I’m hungry now  ______  I didn’t have breakfast this morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：妈妈，我现在饿了因为今天早晨我没有吃早饭。 考查连词的用法。because 因为，后加句子；because of 因为，介词短语，后加名词或者名词短语；and 并且；but但是。两句之间是因果关系，后加的是句子，故选A。

questions.prompt: The sick man  ______  to hospital by the policeman an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：那个病人一小时前被警察送进了医院。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。根据“by the policeman an hour ago”可知，时态为一般过去时，主语和谓语动词之间是被动关系，所以使用一般过去时的被动语态（was/were done），故选B。

questions.prompt: —Jim, you play the guitar very well. Who taught you? —No one, I just taught  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——吉姆，你吉他弹得很好。谁教你的？——没人。我只是自学的。 考查反身代词词义辨析。yourself你自己；himself他自己；herself她自己；myself我自己。根据主语“I，我”可知，与之对应的反身代词是“myself，我自己”。故选D。

questions.prompt: We have a history class  ______  Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：周五下午我们有历史课。 考查介词辨析。to到；at在，用于具体某时刻前；in在，用于月份、季节、年份前；on在，用于具体某一天的上午、下午或晚上前。此处指 “周五下午” ，是具体某一天的下午，应用介词on。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  you give me a hand? I can't move the box by myself. —No problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能帮我一下吗？我自己搬不动这个箱子。——没问题。 本题考查情态动词。could能，should应该，must必须，need需要。根据I can't move the box by myself可知，我自己搬不动这个箱子，因此请求别人帮助，Could you do sth？你能做某事吗？表示委婉地请求。故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  does the museum open at the weekends? —At 9:00 am. A How
questions.explanation: 句意：——博物馆周末什么时候开门？——在9点。 考查特殊疑问句。how如何；where哪里；why为什么；when什么时候。根据“At 9:00 am”可知上文询问时间，疑问词用when。故选D。

questions.prompt: ______  it’s very difficult, remember not to give up until the last minute.
questions.explanation: 句意：尽管很困难，但要记得不到最后一刻不要放弃。 考查让步状语从句。Until直到；Unless除非；Although尽管；Since自从。根据“... it’s very difficult, remember not to give up” 可知，指的是尽管困难，但不要放弃。此句是although引导的让步状语从句。故选C。

questions.prompt: After taking football lessons, Tom is much  ______  than last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：上了足球课后，汤姆比去年强壮多了。 考查形容词比较级。根据“much...than last year”可知，此处应用比较级，表示汤姆比去年更强壮了。故选B。

questions.prompt: Harry invited me ______  with him when his parents were out of town.
questions.explanation: 句意：Harry 邀请我在他爸妈不在镇上的时候去陪他待着。本题考查动词的时态。A. stay 原型； B. staved过去式； C. staying 现在分词； D. to stay动词不定式。 Invite sb to do sth邀请某人做某事，故选D to stay。

questions.prompt: —Tina, what do you usually do at weekends? —I usually  ______  swimming with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——蒂娜，你周末通常做什么？——我通常和父母一起去游泳。 考查动词时态。 go动词原形；goes动词第三人称单数形式；going动名词；went动词过去式。根据“usually”可知时态是一般现在时，主语“I”后接动词原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: Look! Some children  ______  kites on the playground.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！一些孩子正在操场上放风筝。 考查动词时态。根据“Look!”可知，动作正在进行，应用现在进行时，其结构为：be+动词的现在分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Tina, how was your weekend? — Great! We  ______  a picnic in the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——蒂娜，你周末过得怎么样？——非常好。我们在公园里野餐。 考查时态。根据“was”可知动作发生在过去，用一般过去时，动词用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: If you want to visit the Palace Museum tomorrow, I  ______  tickets for you.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你明天想参观故宫博物院，我会为你订票。 考查时态。根据if引导条件状语从句“主将从现”的原则，从句“If you want to visit the Palace Museum tomorrow,”是一般现在时，可知主句用一般将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  a sweet dream when my friend called me this morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天早上我朋友给我打电话时，我正在做一个美梦。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语从句“when my friend called me this morning.”的语境可知，空处表示一个过去的动作正在进行，故应用过去进行时，构成形式为：was/were doing；主语是第一人称单数形式，故助动词应用was，have的过去分词是having。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 When I was a little girl, my father loved to play catch with me. I wasn’t very good at it, but he would encourage (鼓励)  ______ 13 ______  telling me “keep your eye on the ball” as I would not be able to catch even the easiest of throws. As I got older, we didn’t play catch as much. If I had a problem, I would go to my father to ask for his  ______ 14 ______. He would try to joke with me and say “keep your eye on the ball”. We would both  ______ 15 ______  because usually that suggestion did not apply to (适用于) the problem, but he would  ______ 16 ______  to make me smile. My father became ill in 1995 when I was 23. As he suffered from a stroke (中风), he could not  ______ 17 ______. There weren’t any more conversations. He could only mouth words, which were sometimes hard to understand. After a while, I seemed to be pretty good at reading his lips (嘴唇), even better than the nurses who were  ______ 18 ______  him. During our last  ______ 19 ______, I was telling him about a problem I was having with my work. Once again, I could read his lips: “Keep your eye on the ball.” We both smiled. That was the  ______ 20 ______  time I saw my father before he passed away. Since then, “keep your eye on the ball” has become a way for me to get rid of stress.

questions.prompt: My brother and I like museums.  ______  often visit them on weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥和我喜欢博物馆。我们经常在周末去参观。 考查代词辨析。I我；We我们；They它们；You你们。根据“My brother and I like museums”和“visit”可知，空处指“我和我哥哥”，所以用we指代。故选B。

questions.prompt: Mike is thirteen years old. He was born  ______  2009.
questions.explanation: 句意：Mike13岁。他出生于2009年。 考查时间介词辨析。in用于年、月和季节之前；on用于具体的某一天和星期几之前；of属于……的；at用于具体的某一时刻之前。“2009”是年份，所以此空应填in，故选A。

questions.prompt: You’d better get up early, you will miss the first class.
questions.explanation: 句意：你最好早起，否则你将会错过第一班车。 考查连词的用法。A.so因此；B.and而且；C.or否则； D.but但是。依据句意可知，答案为C。

questions.prompt: —Listen! Who is singing in the next room? —Lily. She sings much  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：——听！谁在隔壁房间唱歌？——莉莉。她唱得比以前好多了。 考查副词的比较级。than是比较级的标志，前面应用well的比较级better。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What a nice shirt!  ______  is it? —It’s 200 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——多漂亮的衬衫啊！它多少钱？——200元。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长，多久，对长度或一段时间提问；How old多大，对年龄提问；How many多少，对可数名词数量提问；How much多少，多少钱，对不可数名词数量或价格提问。根据”It’s 200 yuan”可知，是对价格进行提问，因此疑问词应用How much。故选D。

questions.prompt: Simon and Sally  ______  a tennis match the day after tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：后天西蒙和萨利将有一场网球比赛。 考查时态辨析。根据“the day after tomorrow”可知是将来时间，用一般将来时，其结构为will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Where is Jack? —He is in his bedroom. He  ______  with his friend on the phone now. A talked
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克在哪儿？——他在他的卧室里。他现在正在和朋友打电话。 考查现在进行时。根据语境和标志词“now”，可知杰克正在卧室里和他的朋友打电话，句子用现在进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: —What did Lucy do yesterday afternoon? —She  ______  her parents do the housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：——露西昨天下午做什么了？——她帮助她的父母做家务。 考查一般过去时。helps一般现在时，第三人称单数形式；is helping现在进行时；helped一般过去时；will help一般将来时。根据上文问句“What did Lucy do yesterday afternoon?”，可知问昨天下午的事情，因此答语应用一般过去时。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 “Where is Trevor?” asked Dad. Trevor was my brother. He was older and bigger than I was but acted much younger. “I don’t know.” I answered. I was busy choosing the perfect  ______ 9 ______  for Dad’s birthday. This year Dad wanted something that couldn’t be bought at a shop. “Daddy! There is a dragon toy!” Trevor came back with a box in his hand. But when he  ______ 10 ______  it, there was only candy in it! He cried loudly. I came to him and read the words “dragon candy” on the cover（封面）of the box. But in fact, my big brother had trouble  ______ 11 ______. What Trevor said took away my worry about Dad’s gift. I came up with an idea, but when  ______ 12 ______  my idea with Trevor, he shook his head. “Let’s make a deal（交易）, ” I said, “We’ll try only for ten days.” When he heard this, he agreed. The first day was the most  ______ 13 ______. Trevor didn’t want to read anything. Then I began to ask him how he felt about not finding a dragon in the box. He slowly opened his mouth. That was a start! Each day after that, Trevor told more of his dragon story, and I wrote it down. We  ______ 14 ______  reading aloud in my room so many times that he got ready for the performance（表演）at last. On Dad’s birthday, Trevor asked Dad and me to sit on the sofa. He stood before us with confidence（自信心）. I sat closer to Dad and said, “This is a surprise from both of us!” “Wow!” Dad already sounded  ______ 15 ______. “My Dragon Friend. Written by Trevor Johnson.” I could hear how  ______ 16 ______  he read. After he finished it, Trevor began to laugh when we couldn’t stop clapping hands（拍手）. Dad took off his glasses and dried them on his shirt. “That is the best birthday gift ever!” Dad said. I knew, in Trevor’s world, that was more than just a start.

questions.prompt: — Tony looks tired. What is the matter with  ______? — He hurt his knee yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼看起来很累。他怎么了？——他昨天伤了膝盖。 考查代词辨析。him他；her她；us我们；them他们。根据“Tony looks tired”和“He hurt his knee yesterday”可知，是在询问Tony怎么了，托尼是男性，故应用him。故选A。

questions.prompt: Shenzhou-13 returned to the Earth  ______  April 16th, 2022 after a 180-day stay in space.
questions.explanation: 句意：神舟13号在太空里面待了180天后，于2022年4月16号返回地球了。 考查介词辨析。in后跟某年某月某季节；on后跟具体的时间；at在；to到。空后是具体的时间，所以用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: Don’t go to bed too late,  ______  you may have a headache.
questions.explanation: 句意：不要上床睡觉太晚了，否则你可能会头疼。 考查连词辨析。or否则；and和；but但是；so所以。根据“Don’t go to bed too late…you may have a headache.”可知，此处是让不要睡太晚，否则会头疼。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Happy birthday! Here’s your gift. —Oh, thank you! What a beautiful scarf! It  ______  soft.
questions.explanation: 句意：——生日快乐！这是你的礼物。——谢谢你！多么漂亮的围巾呀！它摸起来很软。 考查感官动词辨析。sounds听起来；feels摸起来；smells闻起来；tastes尝起来。根据“What a beautiful scarf!”可知，围巾应是摸起来软。故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  you travel,  ______  your life experience will be.
questions.explanation: 句意：你旅行得越多，你生活经历就越丰富。 考查比较级。the+比较级，the+比较级表示“越……越……”，又根据“…you travel…your life experience will be.”可知，旅行越多，经历会越丰富。故选A。

questions.prompt: Putting out forest fire is regarded as one of  ______  problems in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：扑灭森林大火被认为是世界上最困难的问题之一。 考查最高级用法。one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数表示“最……的之一”，固定用法。故选D。

questions.prompt: I have a dog, and my grandma always  ______  care of her for me on schooldays.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有一只狗，我奶奶在我上学的时候总是帮我照顾她。 考查动词时态。根据“always”及“on schooldays”可知，此处指经常性的动作，故为一般现在时，主语my grandma是第三人称单数，谓语动词用其单三形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Mr. Black, do you spend reading every day? — For about half an hour.
questions.explanation: 句意：——布莱克先生，你每天花多长时间看书？——大约半小时。 本题考查特殊疑问词。how far 多远，询问距离长短；how much多少钱，询问价格；how long多长，询问时间长短，物体长短；how often多久 (一次)，询问频率。根据答中“About half an hour” 可知问句是在问的时间长短（时间段）。故选 C。

questions.prompt: My uncle’s new book  ______  out next month. I can’t wait to see it.
questions.explanation: 句意：我叔叔的新书下个月就要出版了。我迫不及待要看了。 考查一般将来时。根据“next month”可知，句子用一般将来时，结构是will do。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can I speak to Mr. King, please? —Sorry, he  ______  to the post office and will be back later.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我能跟King先生说话吗？——对不起，他去邮局了，一会儿回来。 考查动词时态。根据“he…to the post office and will be back later.”可知，此处表示去邮局还没回来，应用现在完成时。has been to去了某地，已经回来了；has gone to去了某地，还未回来。此处是还未回来，所以用has gone to。故选C。

questions.prompt: Our English teacher often encourages us  ______  English aloud in class.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的英语老师经常鼓励我们在课堂上大声说英语。 考查非谓语动词。根据“encourages us”可知，考查encourage sb to do“鼓励某人做某事”，因此设空处填不定式。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  many new friends since I became a middle school student.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我成为一名中学生以来，我已经交了许多新朋友。 考查现在完成时。since常与现在完成时连用，根据“since I became a middle school student”可知，时态是现在完成时。故选D。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分）阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A. B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 A Special Day It was a sunny day yesterday. After a whole day’s work in my office, I walked home. On the busy street, I saw a young man selling some small  ______ 13 ______  around the corner. Usually, I would  ______ 14 ______  past such sellers and never buy anything. But when I noticed he was blind, I decided to stand there for some time. I wanted to see how he sold his toys. Soon, a little girl came with her mother and wanted a toy that could make a noise. Kids like such toys because the noise sounded really  ______ 15 ______. The toy was 18 yuan. The mother took out a 20-yuan note. She told the young man how much she was giving him and wanted the  ______ 16 ______  back. I couldn’t help  ______ 17 ______  what he was going to do next. He told the mother to put the money in his bag and get 2 yuan back herself. Then she did so. What the young man did  ______ 18 ______  me. He chose to trust people even if he couldn’t see. He let me know believing in people is a beautiful thing. I was so  ______ 19 ______  that I made a decision to buy a toy although I didn’t need it at all. I put my 20 yuan in his bag, and just walked away  ______ 20 ______  without saying anything. The young man was a good example to us all. On my way home, I kept thinking that the world would be a better place if we all could learn to trust people more, just like the young blind street seller.

questions.prompt: As a great mother, Sara didn’t earn much, but  ______  adopted twelve deaf children.
questions.explanation: 句意：作为一个伟大的妈妈，Sara没有挣到许多钱，但是她却收养了12个耳聋的孩子。 考查代词辨析。she她；he他；we我们；they他们。根据“As a great mother, Sara didn’t earn much”可知这里指的是Sara，应用she指代，故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  December, the team started the expedition to the South Pole.
questions.explanation: 句意：在十二月，这个团队开始了南极探险。 考查介词辨析。on作时间介词时，用在具体的某一天前；in作时间介词时，用在月、年、季节前；at作时间介词时，用在具体的点刻前；from从。根据“December”可知为月份，故选B。

questions.prompt: I don’t like sports programmes,  ______  I like nature shows.
questions.explanation: J句意：我不喜欢体育节目，但我喜欢自然节目。 考查连词辨析。or或者；but但是；and和；so所以。根据句意可知，我不喜欢体育节目，但我喜欢自然节目，前后句为转折关系，应用连词but。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Where is Mrs. Wang? —She is in the hall. She  ______  a speech on Chinese culture.
questions.explanation: 句意：——王夫人在哪里？——她在大厅里。她正在做一个关于中国文化的演讲。 考查现在进行时。根据“Where is Mrs. Wang?”和“She is in the hall. She...a speech on Chinese culture.”可知，王夫人正在大厅里做演讲，时态应用现在进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Traveling abroad is much than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：出国旅行比以前更容易。 考查形容词的比较级。根据题意和空格后的“than before”可知是现在和之前的比较，用形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: —When did you come to Beijing? —I  ______  to Beijing in 2008.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你什么时候来北京的？——我2008年来的北京。 考查一般过去时。根据“in 2008”可知，时态是一般过去时，动词使用过去式came。故选D。

questions.prompt: My mother always  ______  about my bedroom because I don’t like cleaning it.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈总是抱怨我的房间，因为我不喜欢打扫它。 考查一般现在时。complain抱怨。根据“My mother always...about my bedroom because I don’t like cleaning it.”可知，时态应用一般现在时，主语“My mother”是第三人称单数，谓语动词应用三单形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Mum, must I wash the dishes right now? —No, you  ______. You can have a rest first.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我必须立刻洗餐具吗？——不，你不必。你可以先休息一会。 考查must打头的一般疑问句的回答。must打头的一般疑问句的回答为否定时，用need’t或don’t have to，表示“不必”，故选A。

questions.prompt: Of all the seasons in the year, winter is  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：在一年的所有季节中，冬天是最寒冷的。 考查形容词最高级。the coldest最寒冷的，the+形容词最高级；coldest最寒冷的，形容词最高级；colder比较寒冷的，形容词比较级；cold寒冷的，原级。根据“Of all the seasons in the year”可知，应用the+形容词最高级，表示在一年的所有季节中，冬天是最寒冷的。故选A。

questions.prompt: He is very  ______  because he watched an  ______  basketball match last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：他是非常激动的因为他昨晚看了一场令人激动的篮球比赛。 考查形容词辨析。exciting令人激动的，通常修饰“物”；excited“感到激动的”，通常修饰“人”。根据“He is very...”和“basketball match”可知第一空修饰“人”，应填excited，第二空修饰“物”，应填exciting。故选C。

questions.prompt: After the earthquake, Mr. Lin decided  ______  the lead and help us get out safely.
questions.explanation: 句意：地震之后，林先生决定带头并帮助我们安全地出去。 考查非谓语。decide“决定”，后跟动词不定式，作其宾语，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Which coat is  ______  on me, the blue one or the black one? —The blue one.
questions.explanation: 句意：——哪件外套穿在我身上更好看些，是那件蓝色的还是那件黑色的？ ——那件蓝色的。 考查形容词比较级。因为后面有the blue one or the black one表示两者进行比较，应用比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: In our Maths Club, we often  ______  ways to solve problems together.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我们的数学俱乐部，我们总是一起讨论解决问题的方法。 考查一般现在时。根据时间状语“often”和句意可知，时态应用一般现在时，主语“we”是第一人称复数，谓语动词用动词原形。故选C。

questions.prompt: My parents asked me  ______  my sister with her schoolwork.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父母要求我在妹妹的学业上帮助她。 考查非谓语动词。ask sb. to do sth.“要求某人做某事”，不定式做宾语补足语。故选C。 二 完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择能填入相应空白处的最佳选项。 New Kid in School Jayden watched the kids on the school playground. Some were running and playing games, while others were kicking a dirty old football. It was his third day at his new school, and he  ______ 15 ______  someone would ask him to play. But no one did. Jayden missed his old  ______ 16 ______  “Why did we have to move?” he said to himself quietly. “I don’t have any friends here. Back home, I had Shawn and Jorge and Nora.” When he reached his house, it was  ______ 17 ______. Then he noticed a note. It read, “Barry and I are across the street at our neighbor’s house. Come on over.” In the neighbor’s backyard, Jayden saw his mother and a woman drinking tea and chatting. questions.explanation: 句意：我们渴了。你能给我们一些果汁吗？ 考查代词辨析。him他；her她；us我们；them他们。根据前面的主语We，可知此处指的是“给我们一些果汁”，give是动词，后接人称代词宾格us。故选C。

questions.prompt: Although she is eighty-five, she  ______  still read without glasses.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然她八十五岁了，但她仍然能不戴眼镜看书。 考查情态动词。could可以，能，常用于表示请求的语境；might可能；must必须；can能。根据“Although she is eighty-five”可知，此处指的是“能看见”，应用can，故选D。

questions.prompt: I am a  ______  volleyball player than Mia.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的排球打得比米娅好。 考查比较级。good好的；better比较级；best最高级。根据句子中的than可知空格处需使用形容词比较级形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the theatre? —Once a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去看一次戏？——一个月一次。 考查特殊疑问词。How often多久一次；How much多少；How long多长时间；How soon多久。根据“Once a month.”可知此处问的是频率，故选A。

questions.prompt: I fell off my bicycle,  ______  I didn’t get hurt.
questions.explanation: 句意：我从自行车上摔了下来，但是没有受伤。 考查连词。so所以；or或者；but但是；for为了。根据“I fell off my bicycle,…I didn’t get hurt.”可知，前后两句存在转折关系，用but连接，故选C。

questions.prompt: Lily  ______  to the beach with Mr Green last summer.
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉去年夏天和格林先生去了海滩。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语“last summer”可知句子时态应是一般过去时，动词应用过去式，go的过去式是went。故选A。

questions.prompt: We’ve booked our hotel in Shanghai. We  ______  the holidays there next month.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们已经预定了上海的旅馆。下个月我们将在那里度假。 考查一般将来时。spend度过，动词原形；spent度过，过去式；have spent度过，现在完成时；will spend度过，一般将来时。根据时间状语“next month”可知，该句时态为一般将来时，其结构为“will do”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Hurry up! Everybody  ______  for you.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点儿！大家都在等你。 考查动词时态。根据“Hurry up!”可知，时态为现在进行时，其构成：主语+be+动词ing，Everybody作主语时，be动词用is，故选C。

questions.prompt: Grandpa found some old coins while he  ______  in the garden.
questions.explanation: 句意：爷爷在花园里干活时发现了一些旧硬币。 考查过去进行时。结合语境可知，该句为while引导的时间状语从句，表示主句动作发生时，从句的动作也正在进行之中，意为“当……时”。又因主句的动作发生在过去，从句应用过去进行时，其结构为“was/were doing”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______  yesterday? —A new dictionary.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道安昨天买了什么吗？——一本新字典。 考查宾语从句及时态。分析句子结构并结合选项可知，空处所在句为宾语从句，从句应用陈述语序；根据空后的“yesterday”可知，从句时态为一般过去时。故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 It was a very important day for Ryan—he was about to make his first public speech. questions.prompt: —In the future, people will have robots in  ______  homes. —That will be a better world.
questions.explanation: 句意：——在未来，人们将在家里有机器人。——这将是一个更好的世界。 考查形容词性物主代词。they他们，主格；them他们，宾格；their他们的，形容词性物主代词；themselves他们自己。根据“In the future, people will have robots in...homes.”可知在他们的家里有机器人，名词home前用形容词性物主代词修饰。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where are you going to work, Alice? —I am going to work  ______  Shanghai.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爱丽丝，你要去哪里工作？——我要去上海工作。 考查介词辨析。to朝，向；at在，后常接小地方；in在……内，后常接大地点；on在……上。根据“I am going to work”和“Shanghai”可知，此处为我要去上海工作，根据“Shanghai”可知，其为城市，是大地点，故应用in。故选C。

questions.prompt: I am very shy,  ______  my best friend is outgoing. We are quite different.
questions.explanation: 句意：我很害羞，但是我最好的朋友很外向。我们非常不同。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；or或者；so因此。根据“I am very shy,...my best friend is outgoing. ”可知前后有转折关系，用but连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  you come to my birthday party, Jeff? —I’m sorry, I can’t. I have to look after my brother.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jeff，你能来我的生日派对吗？——不好意思，我去不了。我必须照顾我的弟弟。 考查情态动词。should应该；may可以；must必须；can能够。may通常询问请求，此处指询问某事的可能性，用can。故选D。

questions.prompt: Beijing is one of  ______  cities in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：北京是世界上最大的城市之一。 考查形容词的最高级。根据“Beijing is one of... citiesin the world.”可知，本句为“one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数”表示“最……之一”，因此空处用形容词最高级，且形容词最高级前需加定冠词the。故选D。

questions.prompt: Mary expects  ______  to a movie this weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽期待这个周末去看电影。 考查动词不定式。根据“expect to do sth”表示“期待做某事”为固定搭配，动词不定式作宾语。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What are you doing, Andy? —I  ______  a banana milk shake.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Andy，你在做什么？——我在做香蕉奶昔。 考查时态。根据“What are you doing, Andy?”可知询问说话时，正在做的事，用现在进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What did you do yesterday? —I  ______  some food and drinks for the coming party.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你昨天做了什么？——我为即将到来的聚会买了一些食物和饮料。 考查动词时态。根据“What did you do yesterday?”可知时态为一般过去时，故答语的时态也为一般过去时，句中谓语动词使用过去式，动词buy的过去式为bought。故选B。

questions.prompt: If it  ______  tomorrow, we’ll stay at home and prepare for the exams.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天下雨，我们会待在家，准备考试。 考查时态。if引导的时间状语从句，遵循主将从现原则，从句用一般现在时，rain为动词，主语是it，谓语动词用三单形式。故选C。

questions.prompt: —There  ______  a football match next Sunday, Tom. —Really? I will go to watch it.
questions.explanation: 句意：Tom，下周日会有一场足球比赛。——真的吗？我要去看。 考查时态和There be句型。根据“next Sunday”可知此句是一般将来时，某地有某物用There be句型，将来时为There is/are going to be或者There will be。主语是单数，be动词用is。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What do you think of the TV play? — ______. It’s boring.

questions.prompt: —Where is Joe? —He  ______  TV in the living room now.

questions.prompt: The Greens don’t live here any longer. They  ______  to Beijing last month.

questions.prompt: The government  ______  a new hospital in our town next year.

questions.prompt: —What were you doing when the teacher went into the classroom? —I  ______  the blackboard.

questions.prompt: My parents  ______ trees and flowers in front of the house since we moved to Daxing.

You’re good,” the lunch lady said as she pointed to the direction the boy had gone. But I could not find him, I missed the chance to  ______ 17 ______  him. He was nameless to me. A month later, on my way home, I saw an elderly woman struggling (费力) with heavy bags. I suddenly thought of the nameless boy who  ______ 19 ______  me lunch. “Excuse me, madam, do you need help?” I’ll never forget her  ______ 20 ______  as I rushed forward to lend her a hand. It’s the very prize for my act of kindness.

questions.prompt: Tom is my best friend. I often practise tennis with  ______  after school. A me
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆是我最好的朋友。放学后我经常和他一起练习网球。 考查人称代词用法。me我；her她；him他；it它。根据“Tom is my best friend.”可知，此处是说放学后和汤姆一起去打网球，with是介词，后接人称代词宾格，Tom是男生名字。故选C。

questions.prompt: —When is your birthday? —It’s  ______  8th April.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的生日是什么时候？——在四月八号。 考查时间介词。in在某年某月；on在某一天；at在；of……的。根据“8th April”可知，这是一个具体日期，即某一天，某一天之前的介词应用on。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Sam,  ______  I join you in the community service? —Of course you can.

questions.prompt: Wash your hands before meals,  ______  you may get ill.
questions.explanation: 句意：饭前要洗手，否则你会生病的。 考查连词辨析。so所以；or否则；and和；but但是。本句是“祈使句+and/or+陈述句”结构；根据语境可知，“饭前不洗手”是“可能生病”的条件，需用or表示“否则”，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the school library? — Twice a week. I love reading there.

questions.prompt: Deng Yaping is one of  ______  table tennis players in China. A good
questions.explanation: 句意：邓亚萍是中国最好的乒乓球运动员之一。 考查最高级。good好，形容词原级；better更好的，形容词比较级；best最好的；the best最好的，形容词最高级。此处是“one of+最高级+可数名词复数”用法，意为“最……之一”，形容词最高级前需要加the。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Bill, what do you often do after dinner? —I often  ______  my parents do some housework.

questions.prompt: —Peter, what were you doing at eight last night? —I  ______  my homework at home.

questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆八月份要来北京学汉语。 考查介词辨析。on用于具体的某一天或者具体某一天的上/下午/晚上；at用于具体的钟点前；in用于年/月/季节或泛指的某一天的上午、下午和晚上前；to朝，向。根据空后“August”可知，此处是指月份，应用介词in。故选C。

questions.prompt: I’d like to go with you,  ______  I’m afraid I have no time.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想和你一起去，但是我恐怕我没有时间。 考查连词词义辨析。but但是；and而且；so所以，因此；or或者，否则。根据“I’m afraid I have no time”可知，表示转折关系，指虽然我愿意和你去，但是我恐怕我没有时间。故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you go to the library? — Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：—你多久去一次图书馆？—一周一次。 考查特殊疑问句和情景交际。A.How often多久一次，询问频度； B. How far多远，询问距离； C. How much多少，询问不可数名词数量；D. How long多长，询问时间和物体的长度。根据回答“一周一次”可知询问频率，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  you play tennis? —No, I can’t. But I’m good at football.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会打网球吗？——不，我不会。但是我擅长足球。 考查情态动词。Can能够，可以；Could过去能够；May可以，可能；Must一定，必须。根据答句“No, I can’t. But I’m good at football.”可知问句应是用can提问，表示“能够”，故选A。

questions.prompt: The cartoon film is so funny that I can’t help  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这部卡通电影太有趣了，我忍不住笑了。 考查非谓语动词。can’t help doing“忍不住做”，是固定搭配，空格处应用动名词作宾语，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where is Zhang Ming? —Oh, he his mother clean the house now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——张明在哪里？ ——哦，他现在帮他妈妈打扫房子了。 考查现在进行时。根据“now”可知，此处是指张明正在帮助妈妈打扫房间，句子时态应用现在进行时态，其结构是be doing；主语为he，be动词用is，help的现在分词为helping。故选D。

questions.prompt: Mr. Green often  ______  newspapers after breakfast every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：格林先生经常每天早饭后看报纸。 考查时态。由“every day”可知，时态是一般现在时，主语是Mr. Green，用动词第三人称单数形式，故选C。

questions.prompt: Lisa and Sally are good friends. They each other since 2020.
questions.explanation: 句意：Lisa和Sally是好朋友。 她们从2020年就已经认识。 考查动词时态。根据“since 2020.”可知，强调的是过去发生的动作一直持续到现在，故确定为现在完成时态，其结构为have/has+过去分词，主语是复数，助动词用have。故选D。

questions.prompt: —What did you do yesterday afternoon? —I  ______  some food and drink for the coming party.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你昨天下午做了什么？——我为即将到来的聚会买了一些食物和饮料。 考查时态。根据“What did you do yesterday afternoon”可知时态为一般过去时态，故答语的时态也为一般过去时，空格处为本句谓语动词，故用动词buy的过去式bought。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Peter, can you tell me? —Next Friday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，彼得，你能告诉我会议什么时候开始吗？ ——下个星期五。 考查宾语从句。分析句子结构可知，空处为宾语从句，应用陈述句语序，排除B和D；根据答语“Next Friday.”可知，从句应用一般将来时，排除A。故选C。 完形填空 （8分） Years ago, we were asked to create a newspaper in groups about world culture in our history class. We first wrote the names of three friends we  ______ 13 ______  in our group. Unluckily, Mrs. Bartlett, our teacher, didn’t put me in the group with any of my friends. Instead, I was with Mauro, who never spoke English, Juliette, who always wore thick glasses and Rachel, who wore strange clothes. I had never  ______ 14 ______  to them. Oh, how badly I wanted to be with my friends! I was so sad that I walked up to Mrs. Bartlett. “I know what you want, Karina,” she gently patted me on my shoulder, “but your group needs a  ______ 15 ______. I need you to help them get a passing grade on this project. Only you can make it.” I was pretty surprised. “Will you  ______ 16 ______  them?” she asked. “Yes,” I answered. I couldn’t believe it came out of my mouth, but it did. I bravely walked to my group and started our project. We had different tasks according to our interests. Little by little, I felt myself enjoying their  ______ 17 ______. I found out Mauro was fighting with English. Behind Juliette’s thick glasses were her shining eyes. Rachel was good at painting and always had new ideas. She did things so  ______ 18 ______  that she wanted to be a fashion designer (时装设计师). I realized that they were not strange; they were just people that no one  ______ 19 ______  enough for—except Mrs.Bartlett. Her thoughtfulness brought out the best in the four of us. I learned something that week. I was given a chance to see other people in a new light. I learned that inner (内在的) beauty was more  ______ 20 ______  than appearance. Mrs. Bartlett gave us an A on that project, but we thought we should have handed it right back, for she was the one who should truly have it.

questions.prompt: Amy is my sister.  ______  can sing very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米是我的姐姐。她唱得很好。 考查人称代词辨析。I我；You你/你们；She她；It它。根据“Amy is my sister”可知，此处代词she代指我的姐姐艾米。故选C。

questions.prompt: I usually start practising playing the piano  ______  8:00 pm.
questions.explanation: 句意：我通常在晚上八点开始练习弹钢琴。 考查介词用法。on用于具体某一天；for后跟时间段；in用于周，月，季节，年等较长的时间；at用于时刻前；此句“8:00 pm”表示时刻，所以前用at。故选D。

questions.prompt: To win the football match, our team is training  ______  than usual.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了赢得足球比赛，我们的队伍正在比平常训练得更刻苦。 考查比较级。设空处后面的than是比较级标志。故选B。

questions.prompt: Speak  ______  in class, and don’t be afraid of making mistakes.
questions.explanation: 句意：在课堂上自信地说，不要害怕犯错误。 考查副词的用法。根据“Speak... in class”可知，此处用副词修饰动词speak，本句中不含有比较的情形，因此不用最高级。故选C。

questions.prompt: Lingling offered  ______  Betty to Lao She Teahouse.
questions.explanation: 句意：Lingling提议带Betty去老舍茶馆。 考查非谓语动词。offer to do sth.“提议做某事”，是固定搭配，空格处应填动词不定式，故选B。

questions.prompt: While I  ______  in my room, I heard a loud noise outside.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我正在屋里画画的时候，我听到外面一声巨响。 考查时态。paint画画，一般现在时；am painting画画，现在进行时；was painting画画，过去进行时；will paint画画，一般将来时。这是while引导的时间状语从句，表示当一个动作正在发生时，另一个动作发生了。此句主句是一般过去时，所以从句用过去进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What’s wrong, Eric? —I  ______  my left foot yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——怎么了，Eric？——我昨天伤到了右脚。 考查时态。根据“yesterday”可知用一般过去时。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What’s your plan for the coming holiday? —I  ______  the National Stadium.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你假期的计划是什么? ——我要去参观国家体育场。 考查时态。visit参观，一般现在时；am going to visit一般将来时； visited一般过去时；was visiting过去进行时。根据问句“What’s your plan for the coming holiday?”可知，要用将来时表示计划做某事。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Who is knocking on the door? Is it your brother? —It  ______  be him, Mom. He’s still at work.
questions.explanation: 句意：——谁在敲门？是你的哥哥吗？——不可能是他，妈妈。他还在上班。 考查情态动词表推测。can’t不可能；can能，可以；must必须；mustn’t不许。根据“He’s still at work.”可知，此处表示不可能是他。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Jack, I’m bored. Do you want to do something together this afternoon? — ______

choices.label: A
choices.text: I think you can make it.

choices.label: B
choices.text: We are happy you like it.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Don’t forget to take some pictures.

choices.label: D
choices.text: How about watching a movie with me?

questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，我很无聊。今天下午你想要做点什么吗？——和我去看电影怎么样？ 考查情景交际。I think you can make it.我想你能做到的；We are happy you like it.我们很高兴你喜欢它；Don’t forget to take some pictures.不要忘了拍些照片；How about watching a movie with me?和我去看电影怎么样。根据“Do you want to do something together this afternoon?”可知，此处是回答今天下午的打算，选项D符合语境。故选D。 四、完形填空（共10分，每小题1分） （一） 根据短文内容，从方框中选出恰当的词填写在答题卡的相应位置上。 protect space problem heavily Our world is facing many problems. One of the biggest is increasing population. Every year, more babies are born and people also live longer. The growing population means the growing need for  ______ 23 ______, food and clean water. People also need better bus and train services. The large population brings another huge  ______ 24 ______  for the world: pollution. There is so much traffic on the roads that in some cities the air is  ______ 25 ______  polluted. People also produce more rubbish. In many areas, the rivers are seriously polluted and people have to walk a long way to get clean water. We must work harder to  ______ 26 ______  our world against pollution. 【答案】23. space

questions.prompt: My father is an excellent teacher and his students like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲是一位优秀的老师，他的学生都喜欢他。 考查代词辨析。her她，宾格代词；him他，宾格代词；she她，主格代词；he他，主格代词。动词like后跟宾格代词，排除C/D；由My father可知，用宾格代词him。故选B。

questions.prompt: You can stay with an American family  ______  stay in a hotel during your visit.
questions.explanation: 句意：访问期间，您可以与美国家庭住在一起，也可以住在酒店。 考查连词。or或者，表示选择关系；because因为，表示因果关系；so所以，表示因果关系；but但是，表示转折关系。根据“You can stay with an American family... stay in a hotel during your visit.”可知，前后句之间表达的是选择关系，因此应用or来连接，故选A。

questions.prompt: The music  ______  so exciting that people can’t help dancing to it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这音乐听起来如此激动人心，人们情不自禁地跟着它跳舞。 考查动词辨析。looks看起来；smells闻起来；tastes尝起来；sounds听起来。根据“The music”可知，此处指音乐听起来如此激动人心。故选D。

questions.prompt: While I was reading, my mum  ______  in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我读书的时候，我妈妈正在厨房做饭。 考查时态。while表示某个动作进行的同时另一个动作也在进行之中，这时主从句都用进行态。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  can I keep the book, sir? —For two weeks.
questions.explanation: 句意：——先生，这本书我可以借多久？——两周。 考查疑问词辨析。How soon多久以后 ；How often多久一次；How long多长时间；How much多少。根据“For two weeks.”可知，此处是在询问多长时间。故选C。

questions.prompt: My sister  ______  cartoons after she finishes her homework every evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹每天晚上做完作业后都会看动画片。 考查时态。根据“every evening”可知，句子是一般现在时，且句子主语“My sister”为第三人称单数，谓语动词也应用第三人称单数。故选D。

questions.prompt: David  ______  some new friends at the summer camp last July.
questions.explanation: 句意：大卫去年七月在夏令营交了一些新朋友。 考查时态。根据“last July”可知，句子是一般过去时，动词应用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: Peter  ______  much exercise since he joined the club.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从彼得加入俱乐部以来，他做了很多运动。 考查时态。根据“since he joined the club”可知此处应用现在完成时，动词应为have/has done结构，且主语“Peter”为第三人称单数，所以助动词应用has。故选B。

questions.prompt: Please keep quiet! Dad  ______  an online meeting now.
questions.explanation: 句意：请保持安静！爸爸正在开在线会议。 考查时态。根据“now”可知，句子是现在进行时，谓语动词应用be doing结构，句子主语“Dad”是第三人称单数，所以be动词应用is。故选C。

questions.prompt: I know the old man. He is very kind and we all like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认识那个老人。他很善良，我们都喜欢他。 考查代词辨析。them他们，人称代词宾格；her她，她的，人称代词宾格或形容词性物主代词；it它，人称代词主格或宾格；him他，人称代词宾格。根据“I know the old man. He is very kind and we all like”可知，这位老人很善良，故我们是都很喜欢他，此处应用人称代词宾格作宾语，由“He”可知，是男性。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Tom, what do you usually do  ______  New Year’s Eve? —We usually do some shopping.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你通常在除夕干什么？——我们通常购物。 考查介词辨析。to到；at用于具体的某一时刻之前；in用于年、月或季节之前；on用于星期或具体的某一天之前。根据“New Year’s Eve”可知，是具体的某一天，故其前介词应用on。故选D。

questions.prompt: 一Miss Wang,  ______  I read the story book? 一Yes, you can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——王老师，我可以读故事书吗？ ——是的，你可以。 考查情态动词。must必须；can可以，能够；need需要；should应该。从答句“Yes, you can.”可知，问句是由can引导的一般疑问句。故选B。

questions.prompt: The play was very long. It didn’t end  ______  it was 9: 30 in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：这出戏很长直到晚上九点半才结束。 考查连词辨析。if如果；unless除非；until直到；because因为。根据“The play was very long.”可知，这出戏很长，所以结束时间很晚，直到晚上九点半才结束，此处not…until“直到……才”，故选C。

questions.prompt: Grace is  ______  than before. She can finish her homework very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：格蕾丝比以前更认真了。她能很好地完成作业。 考查形容词比较级。careful认真的，形容词原级；more careful比较级；most careful最高级；the most careful最高级。根据“than before”可知空格处应用形容词比较级more careful，故选B。

questions.prompt: The workers have already worked for two hours. They must be tired  ______  they need to take a break.
questions.explanation: 句意：工人们已经工作了两个小时。他们一定是累了，所以需要休息一下。 考查连词。so因此；for因为；but但是；or或者。根据“They must be tired”可知设空句的前后句之间是因果关系，表示“他们一定是累了，所以需要休息一下。”因此应用并列连词so。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Where did you buy the bag? —I  ______  it in the new shopping center near my home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你在哪里买的这个包？——我在我家附近的新购物中心买的。 考查一般过去时。buy买，动词原形；bought买，动词过去式；will buy买，一般将来时；have bought买，现在完成时。根据上文“Where did you buy the bag?”可知，句子时态用一般过去时，因此此处用动词过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Susan, what are you doing? —Oh, I  ______  to an English song.
questions.explanation: 句意：——苏珊，你在干什么？ ——哦，我在听一首英文歌。 考查时态。listen一般现在时态；listened一般过去时态；am listening现在进行时态；was listening过去进行时态；问句“Susan, what are you doing?”的时态为现在进行时态，故答语时态为现在进行时态，其构成是：am/is/are+doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: If you study hard, you  ______  your goals in the future.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你努力学习，你就会在未来实现你的目标。 考查时态。根据“If you study hard”可知，此句是if引导的条件状语从句，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时，空处所在的句子为主句，用一般将来时will do。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  Chinese in this school since I came to Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我来到北京，我就在这所学校学习中文。 考查动词时态。根据“since I came to Beijing”可知，本句时态为现在完成时。故选D。

questions.prompt: Professor Smith  ______  to help the students solve the problems every term.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯教授每个学期都受邀帮助学生解决问题。 考查时态和语态。根据“Professor Smith...to help the students solve the problems every term.”可知，主语Professor Smith与invite之间是被动关系，应用被动语态，结构为is/was+动词过去分词，根据every term可知，时态为一般现在时，be动词用is，invite的过去分词为invited。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Tony, can you tell me  ______  last weekend? —Sure.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼，你能告诉我你上周末在网上做了什么吗？——当然。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句需要用陈述句语序，因此排除A、C选项；再由last weekend可知句子时态用一般过去时，排除B选项。故选D。 二、完形填空。（8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 My Work Experience in a Nursing Home A few weeks ago, I had my first work experience in a nursing home. I worked alongside the manager and helped her carry out different games and  ______ 13 ______  with the residents (居民，住户). When I arrived, my first work was to  ______ 14 ______  their names and faces by going in and talking to some of the residents. Although most of them did not communicate easily, it was obvious (明显的) which patients were beginning to show signs of dementia (痴呆). First on the list of activities was indoor boules (滚球). It was surprising how such a simple activity could show so clearly how the different afflictions (折磨，痛苦) that were so common in old age could affect a person’s ability to  ______ 15 ______  simple tasks, such as roll a ball as close as possible to another ball in the middle of the room. What  ______ 16 ______  me most was that the overall winner was a long term stroke victim (中风患者), who was paralyzed (瘫痪的) down the left hand side of her body. I sat down with the winner and she told me about her grandchildren and the games they played with her when they came to visit. She also praised the home for the  ______ 17 ______  she was receiving. I noticed, as she was talking although she was paralyzed down one side, her  ______ 18 ______  was good, and the words she said indicated (表明，显示) that she was recovering from a stroke, but her cognitive (认知的) ability was good. After finishing my work, I headed home. I was still thinking everything I had just experienced and how I might be asked to  ______ 19 ______  next week. I realize that the most helpful thing I can do for the benefit of the residents is just to  ______ 20 ______  to them. Yes, I’m sure that staying there for a long time, they must become lonely.

questions.prompt: I have many friends and I often use WeChat to communicate with  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有很多朋友，我经常用微信与他们交流。 考查代词辨析。me我；you你；us我们；them他们。根据“I have many friends and I often use WeChat to communicate with...”可知此处指和朋友们交流，用代词them指代。故选D。

questions.prompt: People often eat twelve grapes  ______  midnight of New Year’s Eve in Spain.
questions.explanation: 句意：在西班牙，人们经常在除夕午夜吃十二颗葡萄。 考查介词辨析。at在；on在某一天；in在某年某月某季节；to到。at midnight“在午夜”，固定用法。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  I take photos here? —Sorry, you can’t. It’s not allowed in the museum.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以这里拍照吗？——对不起，你不能。博物馆不允许拍照。 考查动词辨析。Must必须；Need需要；Can可以；Will将会。根据答语“Sorry, you can’t”可知，用can提问，用can/can’t回答。故选C。

questions.prompt: Lily thinks swimming is  ______  than running and I agree with her.
questions.explanation: 句意：Lily认为游泳比跑步难，我同意她的看法。 考查形容词的比较级。根据“than”可知此处应用比较级形式，harder符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  did China send Shenzhou-16? —On May 30, 2023.
questions.explanation: 句意：——中国是什么时候发射神舟十六号的？——2023年5月30日。 考查特殊疑问句。what什么；when什么时候；where哪里；who谁。根据“On May 30, 2023.”可知此处应询问时间，疑问词用when。故选B。

questions.prompt: My mum and I argue a lot,  ______  I know she loves me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我和妈妈经常吵架，但我知道她爱我。 考查连词辨析。or或者；so所以；for因为；but但是。前后两句是转折关系，用but连接。故选D。

questions.prompt: I used to eat sweet zongzi, but now I  ______  the salty ones.
questions.explanation: 句意：我过去常常吃甜粽子，但现在我更喜欢咸的。 考查一般现在时。根据“now”可知句子应用一般现在时，主语I，谓语用动词原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: Now you have a great influence on me and I believe I  ______  in the future.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在你对我有很大的影响，我相信我将来会成功的。 考查时态。根据“in the future”可知句子用一般将来时will do。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  about my grandpa when my phone rang. It was him!
questions.explanation: 句意：当我的电话铃响的时候，我正在想爷爷。是他！ 考查时态。根据“when my phone rang”可知是当电话响的时候正在想爷爷，故主句用过去进行时was/were doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: The police  ______  their best to find the evidence last month.
questions.explanation: 句意：警方上个月尽力寻找证据。 考查时态。根据“last month”可知句子用一般过去时，动词用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tony  ______  to write “福” (meaning “good luck”) since three year ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼从三年前就学会了写“福”（意思是“好运”）。 考查时态。根据“since three years ago”可知句子用现在完成时have/has done。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______  the skycar? —Yes, I do. To solve the traffic problems.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道吉罗为什么发明了飞车吗？——是的，我知道。为了解决交通问题。 考查宾语从句。句子是宾语从句，用陈述语序，排除AC；根据“To solve the traffic problems”可知此处询问原因，用why引导宾语从句。故选D。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Mystery of the Library Ghost The library at Jefferson Middle School was a quiet and peaceful place, perfect for studying and reading. But there were rumors (谣言) that a ghost was in the  ______ 13 ______, scaring students and making strange noises at night. One day, a group of friends decided to explore the mystery of the library ghost. They started by looking around the library, searching for any clues that might help them  ______ 14 ______  the mystery. They found nothing at first, until they saw a small door hidden behind one of the bookshelves. They decided to open the door and see where it led. To their surprise, the door opened up into a small closet (壁橱). Inside, they found an old book with  ______ 15 ______  writing on its cover and they were interested. As they opened the book, they heard a strange noise coming from the shadows (阴影). Suddenly, a ghost appeared, walking in a sheet and  ______ 16 ______  the friends. But as the ghost took off the sheet, they realized that it was just the school librarian, Mrs. Johnson, playing a prank (恶作剧) on them. She explained that she had been dressing up as a ghost to keep the students interested in mysteries, but promised to  ______ 17 ______  the pranks from then on. As the friends walked back to their table, they realized that the mystery of the library ghost had been  ______ 18 ______  solved. But they also knew that they had made a new friend in the library and shared their  ______ 19 ______  of mysteries and reading. From then on, they spent their afternoons at the library, reading books and sharing stories with Mrs. Johnson. And while they might not have solved any more mysteries that year, they knew that they had found something even more important —a  ______ 20 ______  of community and a love of learning. So, the next time you’re in the library and think you hear a ghostly noise, remember this story and know that it might just be a librarian playing a harmless prank.

questions.prompt: —Where did you get this lantern? —I made it by  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你在哪里得到这个灯笼的？ ——我自己独自制作的。 考查反身代词。itself它自己；himself他自己；myself我自己；yourself你自己。根据“I made it by...”可知，本句的主语是“我”，动作的发出者也是“我”，应使用myself。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Julie, have you bought any fruit  ______  the picnic? — Yes. I have bought some strawberries.
questions.explanation: 句意：——朱莉，你为野餐买水果了吗? ——是的。我买了一些草莓。 考查介词辨析。to到；for为了；at在；from来自。根据“bought any fruit…the picnic”可知此处表示为野餐买水果，应用“for”。故选B。

questions.prompt: Don’t lose heart. If you keep working hard, you  ______  some day.
questions.explanation: 句意：不要灰心。如果你继续努力，将来某一天你会成功的。 考查if引导的条件状语从句。if表示“如果”时遵循“主将从现”原则，即主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时；空格处于主句位置，故用一般将来时。故选A。

questions.prompt: Anne is one of  ______  students in my class. She learns everything quickly.
questions.explanation: 句意：安妮是班上最聪明的学生之一。她学所有东西都学得很快。 考查形容词最高级。clever聪明的；cleverer更聪明的；cleverest最聪明的（形容词最高级前通常加the）；the cleverest最聪明的。根据“Anne is one of...students in my class.”可知，此处可用“one of the+形容词最高级+可数名词复数”，表示“最……的……之一”，空处应是the cleverest。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mom, where is Dad? —Look! He  ______  your bike outside.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，爸爸在哪里？——看！他正在外面修理你的自行车。 考查现在进行时。根据“where is Dad?”可知，是在问爸爸现在的情况，根据“Look!”可知，时态应为现在进行时，结构为be+动词现在分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mr. Zhang  ______  for our community as a volunteer for nearly ten years.
questions.explanation: 句意：张先生作为志愿者在我们社区工作了近十年。 考查现在完成时。根据“for nearly ten years”可知句子应用现在完成时，其谓语结构为：have/has+过去分词。故选D。

questions.prompt: We should do everything to protect the earth,  ______  we will lose our home.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们应该尽一切努力保护地球，否则我们会失去我们家园。 考查连词辨析。but但是；for因为；or否则；so因此。根据“We should do everything to protect the earth...we will lose our home.”可知，后句表示一种否定的条件，连词or“否则”符合语境。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Lily, what do you usually do after school? —I  ______  exercise with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——莉莉，放学后你通常做什么？——我和我的朋友一起锻炼。 考查一般现在时。根据“what do you usually do after school”可知，时态是一般现在时，主语是I，动词用原形，故选A。

questions.prompt: —You dance so well, Susan. —Thanks. I  ______  Chinese dance since I was 5 years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你舞跳得真好，苏珊。 ——谢谢。我从5岁开始学中国舞。 考查动词的时态。根据“since I was 5 years old”可知主句要用现在完成时。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Jane, I called you last night but nobody answered. —Oh, my parents and I  ______  a walk in the park at that time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jane，我昨晚给你打电话，但没有人接。 ——哦，我和父母那时正在公园里散步。 考查动词的时态。根据时间状语“at that time”可知句子应用过去进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What did you do for your class project? —We  ______  a music video.
questions.explanation: 句意： ——你课堂项目做的什么？——我们制作了一个音乐视频。 考查动词时态。根据问句“What did you do for your class project”的时态可知空格处应使用一般过去时，谓语用动词的过去式表示。 故选B。

questions.prompt: —What lovely flowers! Could you tell me  ______? —From the Flower Market.
questions.explanation: 句意：——多么可爱的花啊！你能告诉我你在哪里买的吗？——从花卉市场。 考查宾语从句。分析句子可知，空格处是宾语从句，应为陈述语序，故排除A、D两项。结合“From the Flower Market.”可知，此处询问地点，故用where引导宾语从句。故选B。 二、完形填空。 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I used to be the shyest person in the world. I hid behind my elder sister whenever I had to speak to a stranger. When asked to speak in class, I could hardly  ______ 13 ______, much less speak. Even among the few friends I had, my low, timid (怯怯的) voice earned me jokes—about being a girl. Then in the seventh grade, my sister suggested I  ______ 14 ______  voice lessons. After considering it for a short time, I did. I began a series of vocal exercises. After exercising a lot, I felt  ______ 15 ______  in my voice. A few months later I was asked to sing for some retired people, I thought I would do better than before because of the voice lessons. I opened my mouth and—nothing. I couldn’t remember the  ______ 16 ______! My face turned hot. The kind pianist whispered a prompt (提示), and I remembered just enough to keep singing. Then the thought hit me: I’ve already embarrassed (尴尬) myself enough. There’s really nothing else to  ______ 17 ______. So in my second song, I just relaxed and felt the  ______ 18 ______  of the song lift (振奋) me. And I did much better. After that, I started singing to myself as  ______ 19 ______  as I could in my own room. That’s something I would never have done before. One classmate even said that I should be in the school’s talent show. I am not a shy person any more. Singing has made me more outgoing (外向的). Today, I can also stand in front of the whole class and give a big  ______ 20 ______. I am proud of myself.

questions.prompt: Look! An old lady is crossing the road. Let’s go and help  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！一位老奶奶正在过马路。我们去帮她吧。 考查人称代词。me我；him他；her她；them他们。根据“help...”可知，指的是帮助这位老奶奶，后面接宾格“她”，her。故选C。

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  you’ll be late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则你上学就迟到了。 考查并列连词辨析。and又，和，表示并列关系；but但是，表示转折关系；so因此，表因果关系；or否则，表相反假设，用于警告或忠告。句型“祈使句+or+陈述句”表示以陈述句为条件下的相反假设，意为“否则，要不然”，所以用连词or。故选D。

questions.prompt: I think math is  ______ than English.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为数学比英语难。 考查形容词比较级。hard难的，形容词原级；harder更难的，形容词比较级；hardest最难的，形容词最高级；the hardest最难的，形容词最高级。根据“than”可知，指的是数学比英语难，用形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: Listen! Some of the students  ______  in the classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：听！一些学生正在教室里读书。 考查动词时态。根据“Listen!”可知，学生正在读书，是现在进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Every year many foreigners  ______  to China to learn Chinese.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年许多外国人来中国学习汉语。根据Every year可知用一般现在时态；故选A

questions.prompt: —Where did Bob go last night? —He  ______  to the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：——鲍勃昨晚去了哪里？——他去了图书馆 考查动词时态。go去，动词原形；goes去，动词三单；went去，动词过去式；will go去，一般将来时。根据“Where did Bob go last night?”为一般过去时，所以答语也应为一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式，故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  a picnic with my brother next Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：下星期六我将和我哥哥去野餐。 考查一般将来时。根据“next Saturday”可知，指的是下周六去野餐，时态是一般将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you go home every day? —At 8 p.m.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你每天什么时候回家？——晚上8点。 考查特殊疑问句。When什么时候；What什么；Why为什么；Where在哪里。根据“At 8 p.m.”可知，此处询问时间，用when来提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: The students like  ______  the farmers with their work.
questions.explanation: 句意：学生们喜欢帮助农民干活。 考查非谓语。根据“like...the farmers”可知，是喜欢帮助农民，like doing sth.“喜欢做某事”，动名词helping作宾语。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you drive a car, Bill? —No, I  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Bill，你会开车吗？——不，我不能。 考查情态动词辨析。can’t不能，不会（表示能力）；shouldn’t不应该；mustn’t禁止；needn’t不必，没必要。根据“Can you drive a car”可知，在询问对方是否会开车，指的是能力，其否定回答为can’t。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Must I have supper now, Mom? —No, you  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我现在必须吃晚饭吗，妈妈？——不，你不必。 考查情态动词辨析。mustn’t禁止；can’t不能；needn’t不必，没必要；shouldn’t不应该。根据“Must I have supper now”可知，是在问妈妈必须吃晚饭吗，以must开头的一般疑问句，否定回答用needn’t 。故选C。 二、完形填空(8*1) 阅读下面的短文，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 New York, Tokyo, Paris and  ______ 13 ______  cities are  ______ 14 ______  places to live in. There are  ______ 15 ______  interesting things to see and to do. You can go to  ______ 16 ______  kinds of museums, cinemas and parks. You can also go  ______ 17 ______, to buy things from all over the world. But there are  ______ 18 ______  problems in big cities, too. The cost of living is high. Every year many new visitors get to the cities to find  ______ 19 ______, to study at good schools and receive good medical care. Also too many people in a small space make it hard to keep the cities safe and  ______ 20 ______.

questions.prompt: I’m going to play basketball, would you like to go with  ______?
questions.explanation: 句意：我要去打篮球，你愿意和我一起去吗？ 考查代词辨析。I我，人称代词主格； me我，人称代词宾格；he他，人称代词主格；him他，人称代词宾格。根据“I’m going to play basketball”和“with”可知，空格处要用第一人称的人称代词宾格形式me，邀请对方加入自己。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  does he play soccer? —Three times a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——他多久踢一次足球？——一周三次。 考查特殊疑问词。How long多久，多长，对时间段或长度提问；How soon多久，多快；How far多远，对距离提问；How often多久一次，对频率提问。根据答语“Three times a week”可知，是在对频率提问。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Does David like to exercise? —Yes. He can do many sports,  ______ soccer, basketball and tennis.
questions.explanation: 句意：——大卫喜欢锻炼吗？——是的。他会很多运动项目。例如足球，篮球和网球。 考查短语辨析。because of因为； such as例如；as for关于，至于；as well也；结合“soccer, basketball and tennis”可知，此处是举例，例如是such as。故选B。

questions.prompt: I went to the Great Wall last week and  ______  lots of visitors there.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周我去了长城，在那里遇到了很多游客。 考查一般过去时。met是过去式；meet是动词原形；will meet是一般将来时；have met是现在完成时。根据“I went to the Great Wall last week”的时态可知空格上也使用一般过去时。故选A。

questions.prompt: Town Cinema is  ______  than most cinemas, but Movie World is  ______  in the town.
questions.explanation: 句意：镇电影院比大多数电影院都贵，但电影世界是镇上最贵的。 考查形容词比较级和最高级。more expensive更贵的； expensive贵的；the most expensive最贵的；expensivest形式错误。由”than”可知，第一空应形容词使用比较级；根据比较范围”in the town”可知，第二空应使用形容词最高级，最高级前常使用定冠词the。故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s important  ______  us  ______  every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：每天锻炼对我们来说很重要。 考查it固定句式。分析句子可知，此处是结构“It is+形容词+for sb. to do sth.”，意为“对某人来说，做某事是……”，It是形式主语，不定式to exercise是真正主语。故选A。 五、语法填空（共 6 分, 每小题 1 分） 阅读短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填1个适当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 What a difference a day makes! My father and I decided to go to Penang Hill today. We wanted to walk up to the top but then it started raining a little  ______ 7 ______  we decided to take the train. We waited over an hour for the train because there  ______ 8 ______  (be) too many people. When we  ______ 9 ______  (get) to the top, it was raining really  ______ 10 ______  (hard). We did not have  ______ 11 ______  (a) umbrella so we were wet and cold. It was terrible! And because of the bad weather, we couldn’t see  ______ 12 ______  (something) below. My father didn’t bring enough money. So we only had one bowl of rice and some fish. The food tasted great because I was so hungry! 【答案】7. so 8. were

questions.prompt: —What’s the news today? —There isn’t  ______  in today’s newspaper.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能把报纸递给我吗？——今天报纸上没有什么特别之处。 考查形容词作后置定语。something special一些特别的东西，用于肯定句；anything special一些特别的东西，用于否定句和疑问句；根据语境理解及句子结构分析可知，句子是一个否定句，所以应该选用anything的结构，而英语中形容词修饰不定代词时，要放在不定代词后面，故选B。

questions.prompt: —How many hours do you exercise every week? —Oh, I don’t like sports. I  ______  do exercise at all.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你每周锻炼多少小时？——哦，我不喜欢运动。我从来不锻炼。 考查副词辨析。always总是；often经常；usually通常；never从不。根据“Oh, I don’t like sports.”可知，不喜欢运动，所以从不锻炼。故选D。

questions.prompt: I am sorry you didn’t catch the train. It  ______  ten minutes ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：很遗憾你没赶上火车。它十分钟前就开走了。 考查动词时态。根据“ten minutes ago”可知，时态是一般过去时，谓语动词用其过去式。故选A。

questions.prompt: The T-shirt looks wonderful,  ______  it’s too big for me.
questions.explanation: 句意：这件T恤看起来很棒，但对我来说太大了。 考查连词辨析。so因此；and和；or或者；but但是。上文“看起来很棒”和下文“对我来说太大了”之间是转折关系，所以用but连接。故选D。

questions.prompt: This movie is much  ______  than that one.
questions.explanation: 句意：这部电影比那部有趣得多。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知，此句是两者之间比较，interesting的比较级是more interesting，much修饰比较级且位于比较级前。interesting修饰物；interested修饰人。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What do you think of talk show? — ______. They are too boring.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I want to be one of them

questions.explanation: 句意：——你认为脱口秀怎么样？——我无法忍受。它们太无聊了。 考查情景交际。I don’t mind them我不介意它们；I can’t stand them我受不了它们；I love watching them我喜欢观看；I want to be one of them我希望成为他们中之一。根据“They are too boring.”可知，“我”受不了脱口秀。故选B。

questions.prompt: The teacher told us  ______  English every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师告诉我们每天读英语。 考查动词不定式。tell sb to do sth“告诉某人做某事”，空格处动词不定式作宾语补足语。故选D。

questions.prompt: The Yellow River is the second  ______  river in our country.
questions.explanation: 句意：黄河是我国的第二长河。 考查形容词最高级。英语中在表示“第几……”时，一般是在该形容词的最高级前加序数词。所以在long的最高级longest前加序数词second，故选C。 五、语法填空（共6分, 每小题2分） 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填一个适当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 All these shows have one thing in common: They try to look  ______ 9 ______  the best singers, the most talented dancers, the most exciting magicians, the  ______ 10 ______  (funny) actor and so on. All kinds of people join these shows. But who can play the piano the best or sing the most beautifully? That’s up to you  ______ 11 ______  (decide). When people watch the show, they usually play a role in deciding the winter. 【答案】9. for 10. funniest

questions.prompt: Shhh! Please don’t talk so loud. Mum  ______  your grandma.
questions.explanation: 句意：嘘！请不要这么大声说话。妈妈正在给你奶奶打电话。 考查现在进行时。根据“Shhh! Please don’t talk so loud.”可知，此处强调动作正在发生，时态是现在进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Sorry, I can’t meet you this afternoon. I  ______  out with some friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：对不起，今天下午我不能见你了。我将和一些朋友出去。 考查一般将来时。根据时间状语“this afternoon”可知，时态是一般将来时，故选B。

questions.prompt: My father’s hometown is Jilin. It is  ______  the northeast of China.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲的家乡是吉林。它在中国的东北部。 考查介词辨析。in在……内；on接壤；to相隔；at在。根据“My father’s hometown is Jilin. It is...the northeast of China.”可知，吉林在中国内部，故选A。

questions.prompt: — You look pale, are you OK? — No, my knees hurt. A boy  ______  me down just now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你看起来脸色苍白。你还好吗？——不好，我膝盖疼。刚才一个男孩把我撞倒了。 考查动词时态。根据“just now”可知，时态一般过去时，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Wow, what a heavy snow! — You need to be  ______  when you are driving on icy roads than on dry roads.
questions.explanation: 句意：——哇，好大的雪啊！——当你在结冰的道路上驾驶时，你需要比在干燥的道路上更小心。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知，此处应使用形容词比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: China is developing  ______  of all the countries in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国是世界上发展最快的国家。 考查副词最高级。faster更快，比较级；fast快速地，原级； fastest最快地，最高级； the most fastest此格式错误。根据“of all the countries in the world”和“is developing”可知，需要一个副词的最高级形式，结合选项，fastest符合句意。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the population of Beijing? —It has a population of more than twenty two million.
questions.explanation: 句意：——北京的人口有多少？——它有超过2200万的人口。 考查特殊疑问句。which哪一个；how many多少；what什么；how much多少。根据“is the population of Beijing”可知，此处用询问人口的固定句式：what’s the population of…，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Excuse me, we don’t allow strangers  ______  this place. — Sorry, I didn’t see the sign.
questions.explanation: 句意：—— 对不起，我们不允许陌生人进入这个地方。—— 对不起，我没看到标志。 考查固定搭配。根据“allow sb. to do sth.”可知，此空需要一个动词不定式，结合选项，to enter符合句意。故选A。

questions.prompt: Betty’s home is close to her school,  ______  she walks to school every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂的家离学校很近，所以她每天步行去学校。 考查连词辨析。but但是；because因为；or或者；so所以。前后两句构成因果关系，前因后果，故选D。

questions.prompt: The  ______  we trained, the better chance we will have to win in the final.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们训练得越认真，我们在决赛中获胜的机会就越大。 考查“the+比较级，the+比较级”结构。more careful更认真的；more harder形式错误；more carefully更认真地；more hardly形式错误。本句是“the+比较级，the+比较级”结构，此处在句中修饰动词，用副词，故选C。 二、 完形填空 阅读短文，根据短文内容，从短文后各题所给的四个选项中选择最佳选项。（1.5*10=15） Golden Dreams Brad  ______ 11 ______  again. He got up and walked away from the track(跑道). He felt too sad to start again. Later that night Brad sat on his bed, thinking  ______ 12 ______  he was going to win the race. The sports meeting day was only about a month away. Dad said, “Lots of people trip over(被……绊倒)their own two feet, so do I. I think you get it from me. Your mother spent a long time teaching me how to dance.”  ______ 13 ______  that did not make Brad feel any better. Brad wanted to win a race - just one race. But how could he do that? He did not know. Then he thought of something Dad always said: “Start small but think big. Brad had no difficulty thinking big. He really wanted to win a gold medal. But what did Dad  ______ 14 ______  about starting small? Brad asked his mother for  ______ 15 ______. She told Brad the process that she had taught his father to dance. She said they  ______ 16 ______  with little steps and they repeated many times. Finally, Brad’s father became a good dancer! The next morning Brad was ready to start small, one step at a time. He went to school and walked the track before class started. For the first week he walked slowly. For the second week he walked  ______ 17 ______. For the third week he ran slowly. For the last week he ran as fast as he could. He wasn’t running - he was like  ______ 18 ______! On the sports meeting day, the race began. Brad took off as if he had wings on his feet. When the race was over, he had  ______ 19 ______  in second place and won the silver medal. Brad  ______ 20 ______  held up the medal and said, “Next year this will be gold!”

questions.prompt: My aunt is a doctor at a children’s hospital.  ______  always works very hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姑妈是一家儿童医院的医生。她总是工作很努力。 考查人称代词。She她；He他；We我们；They他们。根据“My aunt…”可知，此处指代上文中提到的“aunt”，故用She指代。故选A。

questions.prompt: Shenzhou-12 returned to the Earth  ______  September 17th after a 90-day stay in space.
questions.explanation: 句意：在太空停留90天后，神舟12号于9月17日返回地球。 考查时间介词辨析。in后加世纪、年、季节、月或者早晨、下午和晚上；on后接具体到某一天的时间或具体某一天的早晨、下午和晚上；at后接钟点或中午、夜间；to到、朝。根据“September 17th”可知指的是具体的某一天，因此用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you exercise, Jack? —I exercise every day. I like to play badminton.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久锻炼一次，杰克？——我每天锻炼。我喜欢打羽毛球。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少，询问数量或价格；How many多少，询问数量；How long多久，询问时间；How often多久一次，询问频率。答语“every day”表频率，故用How often提问。故选D。

questions.prompt: Nick can’t stand soap operas,  ______  they’re meaningless.
questions.explanation: 句意：尼克受不了肥皂剧，因为它们毫无意义。 考查连词辨析。though尽管；but但是；because因为；so因此。上文“尼克受不了肥皂剧”和下文“它们毫无意义”之间是因果关系，后者表原因，故用because连接。故选C。

questions.prompt: Tina jumped  ______  than anyone else in the sports meeting last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：蒂娜在去年的运动会上跳得比其他任何人都高。 考查比较级。根据“than”可知，此处应用比较级higher。故选B。

questions.prompt: I have a dog, and my grandma always  ______  care of her for me on schooldays.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有一只狗，我奶奶在我上学的时候总是帮我照顾她。 考查动词时态。根据“always”及“on schooldays”可知，此处指经常性的动作，故为一般现在时，主语my grandma是第三人称单数，谓语动词用其单三形式。故选A。
