questions.explanation: 句意：——朱莉，你能告诉我你在哪里买的漂亮帽子吗？——哦，我去年夏天在海南买的。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句应用陈述语序，故排除A、C两项。根据“last summer”可知，时态是一般过去时，故排除D选项。故选B。 四、语法填空（每小题1分，共4分） 阅读下面的短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处，仅填写一个恰当的单词：在给出提示词的空白处，用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 When people say “culture”, we think of art and history. But one very famous symbol in American culture is a cartoon. We all know and love the black mouse  ______ 8 ______  two large round ears—Mickey Mouse. Over 80 years ago, he first  ______ 9 ______  (appear) in the cartoon, Steamboat Willie. When this cartoon first came out in New York in 1928, it was the first cartoon with sound and music. The man behind Mickey was Walt Disney. He became very rich and  ______ 10 ______  (success). In the 1930s, he made 87 cartoons with Mickey. In 1978, Mickey became the first cartoon character  ______ 11 ______  (have) a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. 【答案】8. with

questions.prompt: Mr. Smith likes running.  ______  runs a marathon every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯先生喜欢跑步。他每年都跑马拉松。 考查代词辨析。His他的，形容词性物主代词或者名词性物主代词；He他，主格；Her她的，形容词性物主代词；She她，主格。根据空后谓语动词“runs”可知，句子缺少主语，因此要使用代词主格；“Mr. Smith”是男性，因此是He。故选B。

questions.prompt: —How are you in a new school? —I’m fine, Mom. I am doing very well and there is  ______  to worry about.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你在新学校过得怎么样？——我很好，妈妈。我做得很好，没有什么好担心的。 考查不定代词。something某些事，常用在肯定句中；anything任何事，常用在疑问句和否定句中；everything每件事；nothing没有什么事。根据“I am doing very well”可知，我做得很好，没什么可担心的，因此是nothing。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you have a sports meeting? —Twice a year.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你们多久开一次运动会？——一年两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多久，对时间进行提问；How often多久一次，对频率进行提问；How many多少，对可数名词进行提问；How much多少，对不可数名词进行提问。根据“Twice a year.”可知，上文是对频率进行提问，故选B。

questions.prompt: If you want  ______  what is happening around the world, watch the news every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你想知道世界上正在发生什么，每天看新闻。 考查不定式。根据“want”可知，此处是固定词组，want to do sth“想要做某事”，不定式作宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: We are proud that Beijing is one of  ______  cities in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们为北京是世界上最繁忙的城市之一而感到自豪。 考查形容词最高级。根据“Beijing is one of... cities in the world”可知，此处是固定用法，“one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数”意为“最……之一”，因此是the busiest。故选D。

questions.prompt: I wonder  ______  in the past.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想知道过去这里的生活是什么样的。 考查宾语从句时态和语序。本题动词“wonder”后跟宾语从句，因此从句为陈述句语序，故排除A、B；又根据“in the past”可知，时态为一般过去时，排除D。故选C。 五、语法填空 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写1个适当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空。 A It is good to relax by using the Internet or  ______ 7 ______  (watch) game shows, but we think the best way to relax is through exercise. It is healthy for the mind and the body. Exercise such as playing sports  ______ 8 ______  (be) fun, and you can spend time with your friends and family as you play together. And remember, “Old habits die hard.” So start exercising  ______ 9 ______  it’s too late! B However, not everybody enjoys watching these shows. Some think that the  ______ 10 ______  (life) of the performers are made up. For example, some people say they are poor farmers, but in fact they are just actors. However, if you don’t take these shows too  ______ 11 ______  (serious), they are fun to watch. And one great thing about them is that they give people a way to make their dreams  ______ 12 ______  (come) true. On November 18, 1978, Mickey  ______ 13 ______  (become) the first cartoon character to have a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. Today’s cartoons are usually not as simple  ______ 14 ______  little Mickey Mouse, but everyone still knows and loves him. Who has a pair of ears  ______ 15 ______  (famous) than Mickey’s? 【答案】7. watching 8. is

questions.prompt: My elder brother and I like football.  ______  play it together once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥和我喜欢足球。我们每周一起踢一次。 考查代词辨析。I我；They他们；We我们；You你，你们。根据“My elder brother and I like football....play it together once a week.”可知，此处指“My elder brother and I”二人，“我们”符合语境。故选C。

questions.prompt: Happy birthday, Mrs. Zhang. Here’s a birthday card  ______  you.
questions.explanation: 句意：张太太，生日快乐。这是给你的生日卡片。 考查介词辨析。for给；in在里面；with带有；from从。根据“Here’s a birthday card … you”可知，此处指给你的生日卡片，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  you please close the door? It’s too cold in the classroom. —Sorry, I’ll close the door now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能把门关上吗？教室里太冷了。——对不起，我现在就关门。 考查动词辨析。Could可以；Must必须；Should应该；Need需要。根据“...you please close the door? It’s too cold in the classroom.”可知，此处表示委婉请求，问对方是否可以关门，故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  my mother is busy,  ______  she often helps me with my study.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然我妈妈很忙，但她经常帮助我学习。 考查连词。Although虽然，尽管；but但是。在英语中Although和but不能搭配使用，只能用其中一个。结合语境可知，“my mother is busy”表让步，故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  some washing when you called me.
questions.explanation: 句意：你打电话给我时，我正在洗衣服。 考查过去进行时。根据“I...some washing when you called me.”可知，强调在过去打电话的时刻正在发生的动作，用过去进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: If you want to make friends, you have to  ______  well with others.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你想交朋友，你必须和别人相处得很好。 考查动词短语辨析。go on继续；get on with与……友好相处；go up增长；get up起床。根据“If you want to make friends, you have to …well with others”可知，如果想与别人交朋友，就要和别人相处得好，故选B。 五、语法填空（每题1分，共6分） 阅读短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写1个适当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空。 A Thanks to Mr. Wang and the passengers, the man was saved by the doctors in time. “It’s sad that many people don’t want to help  ______ 7 ______  (other) because they don’t want  ______ 8 ______  (some) trouble,” says one passenger. But the driver didn’t think about  ______ 9 ______  (him). He only thought about saving a life. 【答案】7. others

questions.prompt: You could ask the hospital to let you visit the kids and cheer  ______  up.
questions.explanation: 句意：你可以请求医院让你去看望孩子们，让他们高兴起来。 考查代词辨析。you你；him他；them他们；her她。此处代指kids作为动词短语cheer up的宾语，应用代词them。故选C。

questions.prompt: Susan went to college  ______  September 1, 2020 and began her new life.
questions.explanation: 句意：苏珊于2020年9月1日上大学，开始了她的新生活。 考查介词辨析。in后加某年某月某季节；on后加具体的某一天；at后加具体的时刻；for后加一段时间。根据“September 1”可知是具体到了9月1日，应用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: We should do sports every day  ______  it is good for our health.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们应该每天做运动，因为这对我们的健康有益。 考查原因状语从句。so因此；although虽然；because因为；but但是。根据语境可知，前后是因果关系，后面的句子表示原因，应用because。故选C。

questions.prompt: — What can you do for the sick kids in the hospital? — Well, I  ______  tell funny stories and jokes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能为医院里生病的孩子做些什么？——嗯，我会讲有趣的故事和笑话。 考查情态动词。need需要；can能；should应该；must必须。根据“What can you do for the sick kids in the hospital?”可知，此处是说明自己会做什么，应用can。故选B。

questions.prompt: The rainstorm yesterday is  ______  one of the year. A heavy
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天的暴风雨是一年中最大的一次。 考查最高级。根据“of the year.”可知，此处是在整个一年中进行比较，应用最高级，形容词最高级前面要加the。故选D。

questions.prompt: I can’t go out to play until I finish  ______  my homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我要做完作业才能出去玩。 考查非谓语动词。finish doing sth“做完某事”，动名词作宾语，故选D。

questions.prompt: —I  ______  the Great Wall next week. —Have a good trip.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我下周要去参观长城。——祝你旅途愉快！ 考查动词时态。根据句中的时间状语“next week”可知，句子时态应用一般将来时态，其结构为will+动词原形，故选B。

questions.prompt: He  ______  his temperature and found he had a fever.
questions.explanation: 句意：他量了量体温，发现自己发烧了。 考查动词时态。根据found可知，此句是一般过去时，动词用过去式，故选B。

questions.prompt: When Tom got home, his mother  ______  in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：当汤姆回到家时，他的妈妈正在厨房做饭。 考查动词时态。根据“When Tom got home”可知when引导时间状语从句，从句中got是一般过去时，主句是表示过去某个时间正在做的事情，句子用过去进行时，所以空格处填was cooking。故选D。

questions.prompt: You should explain  ______  you were so late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：你应该解释一下为什么上学迟到这么久。 考查宾语从句。why为什么；what什么；when什么时候；who谁。根据“explain...you were so late for school.”可知，是解释上学迟到这么久的原因，应用why引导宾语从句。故选A。 五、短文填空(共9分，每小题1分) A 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空，仅填写一个适当的单词。 More recently, most Americans remember what they were doing  ______ 11 ______  the World Trade Center in New York was taken down by terrorists. Even the date—September 11, 2001—has  ______ 12 ______  (mean) to most Americans. This was a day Kate Smith will never forget. She remembers  ______ 13 ______  (work) in her office near the two towers. “My friend shouted that a plane just hit the World Trade Center! I didn’t believe him at first, but then I looked out of the window and  ______ 14 ______  (realize) that it was true. I was so scared that I could hardly think  ______ 15 ______  (clear) after that.” 【答案】11. when

questions.prompt: Jenny hurt  ______  when she climbed the mountain.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jenny在爬山的时候伤到了她自己。 考查反身代词。myself我自己；yourself你自己；herself她自己；himself他自己。根据“when she climbed the mountain”可知是伤到了她自己，用herself。故选C。

questions.prompt: Many people in America now can remember what happened  ______  April 4, 1968.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在许多美国人都能记得1968年4月4日发生的事情。 考查时间介词。in后接年、月等；on后接具体日期；at后接具体时刻等；for后接时间段。根据“April 4, 1968”可知此处表示在1986年4月4日，用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  you please fold your clothes? —Yes, sure.
questions.explanation: 句意：——请叠一下衣服好吗？——好的。 考查情态动词辨析。Must必须；Need需要；Could可以，能；Should应该。根据“... you please fold your clothes?”可知，此处是请求对方叠衣服，应用Could表示委婉语气。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  in the library when the rainstorm came.
questions.explanation: 句意：当暴风雨来临的时候，我正在图书馆读书。 考查时态。when引导的时间状语从句，表示当某事发生时，另一件事正在进行，根据“when the rainstorm came”可知从句用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时，其结构为was/were doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: We can’t  ______  making a plan to help clean up the school hall.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们不能推迟制定帮助清理学校礼堂的计划。 考查动词短语。put off推迟；cut off切断；take off起飞；fall off跌落。根据“We can’t... making a plan to help clean up the school hall.”可知制定打扫学校礼堂的计划不能推迟。故选A。

questions.prompt: My grandma bought a smart phone  ______  the online shopping.
questions.explanation: 句意：我奶奶买了一部智能手机来享受网上购物。 考查非谓语动词。根据“bought a smart phone... the online shopping”可知享受网上购物是买智能手机的目的，用动词不定式to enjoy作目的状语。故选D。 五、语法填空（每题1分，共6分） 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空。在给出提示词空白处用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空。 I felt butterflies in my stomach when I started calligraphy (书法) class ten years ago. At that time, I didn’t know that I had just made one of  ______ 7 ______  (good) choices in my life. I went into the classroom, sat down and listened to the teacher introducing the skills of the calligraphy. Then it was time for me  ______ 8 ______  (try). I took up the brush, using the correct way to write “one”  ______ 9 ______  (careful) in Chinese. All of a sudden, calligraphy became so fascinating that I began to accept calligraphy as a part of my life. After nearly five years of practicing, I started to write some well-known  ______ 10 ______  (poem). Calligraphy seemed like a bridge which connected me with writers from old times. Stroke (笔画) by stroke, word by word, I could sense their feelings and learned to enjoy my daily life. Now, calligraphy is not only a hobby, but also a way to take  ______ 11 ______  (I) out of the worries of life. Holding the pen, I can write for a whole day. Calligraphy is so  ______ 12 ______  (help) that it can balance my busy school life successfully. How amazing! 【答案】7. the best

questions.prompt: —How did you learn French? —I learned it by  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你是怎么学法语的？——我自己学的。 考查反身代词。I我，人称代词主格；me我，人称代词宾格；myself我自己；my我的。根据“I learned it by...”可知是指自学，应用反身代词。故选C。

questions.prompt: If you don’t know the way to the park, you  ______  ask a policeman for help.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你不知道去公园的路，你应该向警察寻求帮助。 考查情态动词。must必须；should应该；mustn’t不许，禁止；shouldn’t不应该。根据“If you don’t know the way to the park, you... ask a policeman for help.”可知，不知道去公园的路，应该找警察帮忙，用should表示建议。故选B。

questions.prompt: Mr. Black is used to  ______  up early. He reads books in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：布莱克先生习惯早起。他早上看书。 考查非谓语动词。be used to doing sth“习惯做某事”，为固定短语，此处是指布莱克先生习惯早起。故选C。

questions.prompt: Could you please  ______  some money to the poor girl? She’ll return it soon.
questions.explanation: 句意：你能借给这个可怜的女孩一些钱吗？她很快就会还的。 考查动词辨析。borrow借来；lend借出。根据“She’ll return it soon.”可知，此处指借给女孩一些钱，could是情态动词，后跟动词原形，故选C。

questions.prompt: They should eat more vegetables  ______  they can be healthier.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们应该多吃蔬菜，这样他们就可以更健康。 考查连词辨析。until直到；so that以便；although尽管；while当……时候。根据“They should eat more vegetables...they can be healthier.”可知多吃蔬菜是为了更健康。应用so that引导目的状语从句。故选B。

questions.prompt: We were walking down the street when the earthquake  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：地震发生时我们正走在街上。 考查动词时态。分析题干可知，本句是含有when的时间状语从句，主句用过去进行时，此时从句应该用一般过去时，表示地震已发生，应用happened。故选B。

questions.prompt: We will go camping if it  ______  tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天不下雨，我们就去露营。 考查动词时态。if作为连词，引导条件状语从句。在复合句中如果主句用一般将来时，则if引导的状语从句用一般现在时。rain“下雨”，动词，因此用助动词doesn’t构成否定句，后用动词原形。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Are your father and mother teachers? —No,  ______. My father is a doctor and my mother is an office worker.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的父母是老师吗？——不。都不是。我父亲是一名医生，我母亲是一名上班族。 考查代词辨析。both两者都；either二者之一；none三者及以上都不；neither两者都不。根据“My father is a doctor and my mother is an office worker.”可知，父母二人都不是老师，故选D。

questions.prompt: ______  ask your parents for help?
questions.explanation: 句意：你为什么不向你父母求助呢？ 考查特殊疑问句。Why not do sth“为什么不做某事”；Why don’t you do sth“你为什么不做某事”；How about doing sth“做某事怎么样”；What about doing sth“做某事怎么样”。分析题干可知，空后是动词原形，排除CD选项。同时空后没有人称代词，所以B选项符合。故选B。

questions.prompt: Teachers encourage their students to  ______  the problems and in this way, students can enjoy success.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师鼓励他们的学生解决问题，这样，学生就能享受成功。 考查动词短语。give up放弃；work out算出，解决；look through浏览；put off推迟。根据“Teachers encourage their students to...the problems”可知，此处指的是“学生们自己解决问题”，故选B。 五、短文填空。(每题1分，共7分) 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写一个适当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 My problem is that I can’t get  ______ 11 ______  with my family. Relations between my parents have become difficult. They fight a lot, and I really don’t like it. It’s the only  ______ 12 ______  (communicate) they have. I don’t know  ______ 13 ______  I should say anything to them about this. When they argue, it’s like a big, black cloud  ______ 14 ______  (hang) over our home. Also, my  ______ 15 ______  (old) brother is not very nice to me. He always  ______ 16 ______  (refuse) to let me watch my favorite TV show. Instead he watches whatever he wants  ______ 17 ______  late at night. I don’t think this is fair. At home I always feel lonely and nervous. Is that normal? What can I do? 【答案】11. on 12. communication 13 if##whether

questions.prompt: These apples taste ．
questions.explanation: 句意：这些苹果尝起来好。taste表示“尝起来”时，是系动词，后面接形容词作表语。Well作形容词是身体好；D. good是形容词，意思是“好的”。根据题意，故选D。 点睛：表示存在或具有某种特征或状态.这类连系动词强调"存在".常见的有:be(是),look(看起来),feel(摸上去),seem(似乎是),appear(似乎、显得),prove(证明是),smell(闻起来),taste(尝起来),sound(听起来)等，他们后面都是加形容词。

questions.prompt: Mary dreamed  ______  being a teacher when she was young.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽年轻时梦想成为一名教师。 考查介词辨析。of……的；from从；on在……上面；in在……里面。dream of“梦想”，固定用法。故选A。

questions.prompt: I think it isn’t kind of you to  ______  stories about him.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为你编造他的故事是不厚道的。 考查动词短语。look up查阅；pick up捡起；make up编造；turn up出现。根据“it isn’t kind of you to...stories ”可知，不厚道应是因为编造故事，故选C。

questions.prompt: He couldn’t help  ______  about what would happen.
questions.explanation: 句意：他不禁想到会发生什么事。 考查非谓语动词。can’t/couldn’t help doing sth“禁不住做某事”，固定短语，所以空处用动名词作宾语，故选D。

questions.prompt: Ms. Liu made her students  ______  English magazines every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：刘老师让她的学生每天阅读英语杂志。 考查非谓语动词。make sb. do sth.“让某人做某事”，固定用法。故选B。

questions.prompt: She encouraged us  ______  about our experiences at the camp.
questions.explanation: 句意：她鼓励我们写下我们在营地的经历。 考查非谓语动词。encourage sb to do sth“鼓励某人做某事”，固定短语，所以空处用动词不定式，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Look at my new smart phone. —Wow, it’s so cool! When and where  ______  you  ______  it?
questions.explanation: 句意：——看看我的新智能手机。——它太酷了，你什么时候在哪里买的？ 考查时态。问什么时候买的用过去时态，疑问句中，助动词did提前，动词用原形。故选C

questions.prompt: She  ______  the room when I went to see her.
questions.explanation: 句意：我去看她时，她正在打扫房间。 考查动词时态。根据“when I went to see her”可知，此处强调从句动作发生时，主句动作正在进行，从句是一般过去时，所以主句用过去进行时（was/were doing），故选B。

questions.prompt: I have already watched Spider-man,  ______  I do not want to watch it again.
questions.explanation: 句意：我已经看过《蜘蛛侠》了，所以我不想再看了。 考查连词辨析。but但是；so因此；or否则；because因为。“I have already watched Spider-man”是不想再看的原因，前因后果，用so连接表因果关系的并列句。故选B。

questions.prompt: —I hear your father  ______  to Japan once. —Yes. He went there last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我听说你父亲去过一次日本。——是的。他去年去的。 考查动词时态和动词辨析。has been to曾经去过；has gone to去了；went去，过去式；goes去，三单形式。根据“once”和“Yes. He went there last year.”可知，是指去过日本一次，用现在完成时，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  you  ______  your homework yet? —Yes, I’ve just finished it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你完成你的家庭作业了吗？——是的，我已经完成了。 考查动词时态。根据“yet”和答句“Yes, I’ve just finished it.”可知，问句用现在完成时态（have/has done）。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Is it going to rain this afternoon? — ______. I want to go swimming with my classmates.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天下午会下雨吗？——我希望不会。我想和我的同学去游泳。 考查情景交际。I think so我也这么想；All right好吧；I hope not我希望不会；I hope so我希望如此。根据“I want to go swimming with my classmates.”可知，想和同学去游泳，所以应是不希望下午下雨，故选C。 （二） A 阅读短文，从括号内A、B两个选项中选择一个正确答案。 Most animals communicate by smell. Dogs are famous  ______ 13 ______  (A. for; B. of) this. They can find missing people by using their wonderful sense（感官） of smell. Mice have an excellent sense of smell, too. Scientists  ______ 14 ______  (A. trained; B. have trained) them to find landmines（地雷）since a long time ago. It is found that even ants use smell. They use smell to tell other ants where the food is. 【答案】13. A 14. B 【解析】 【导语】本文介绍了大多数动物通过嗅觉交流。 【13题详解】 句意：狗因这一点而出名。for给，对，为了，（表示结果）因为，由于；of属于（某人或某物）的，……的一部分，……的（表示某物的特征或品质）。根据后一句“They can find missing people by using their wonderful sense（感官）of smell.”可知，它们可以通过嗅觉找到失踪的人。此处“它们”指的是“狗”。所以狗因嗅觉而出名。表达“因……而出名”用短语be famous for。故选A。 【14题详解】 句意：自从很久以前，科学家就训练他们寻找地雷。根据“since a long time ago自从很久以前”可知，本句时态为现在完成时。现在完成时的句型基本结构：主语+have/has+动词的过去分词。故选B。 B 阅读短文，从括号内A、B两个选项中选择一个正确答案。 Costa Rica is one of the best  ______ 15 ______  (A place; B places) for travellers. There are rain forests to explore (探索), volcanoes (火山) to climb, and a few most wonderful beaches on the earth. It’s  ______ 16 ______  (A interesting; B interested) to take a ride through the jungle (丛林) and try rowing on the rivers. 【答案】15. B 16. A 【解析】 【导语】本文主要介绍了哥斯达黎加可供旅行的地方。 【15题详解】 句意：哥斯达黎加是旅行者最好的地方之一。“one of the+形容词最高级+可数名词复数”表示“最……的……之一”，此处用复数形式places。故选B。 【16题详解】 句意：骑马穿过丛林，在河流上划船是很有趣的。interesting有趣的；interested感兴趣的。句中it是形式主语，真正的主语是动词不定式“to take a ride through the jungle and try rowing on the rivers”，此处表示做这些事情是有趣的，用interesting。故选A。 四、完形填空（共10分，每小题1分） 从下面各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择可以填入空白处的最佳选项。 When I was just a few months old, my parents realized that I might have a hearing problem because I couldn’t even hear loud noises. They  ______ 17 ______  all sorts of methods (方法). Sadly, I couldn’t hear a thing. The doctor advised my parents to put me in a  ______ 18 ______  school so I could learn to communicate. But they found it a little hard to take. They wanted me to be able to  ______ 19 ______  a normal life. So first my parents sent me to private speech  ______ 20 ______  where I learned to read lips (唇) and pronounce words. Next my parents decided to send me to a normal primary school. In order for that to  ______ 21 ______, they managed to make the headmaster to accept me. At school, I sat at the  ______ 22 ______  of class and paid attention to the teacher, which wasn’t always easy, especially when she had her back to the class in order to write on the board. But I tried on and did a lot of work after school. My parents’ effort paid off and I left primary school with good enough  ______ 23 ______  to get into a number of Singapore’s top middle schools. Also my parents went to several schools to explain my needs.  ______ 24 ______, a school in my neighborhood accepted me. I worked very hard and did well enough to go to one of the top junior colleges. Since then I have achieved (取得) many things inside and outside school. None of these would have been  ______ 25 ______  without one of the most important lessons from my parents. If you  ______ 26 ______  yourself and work hard, you can win great results.

questions.prompt: Mr. Smith has got a stomach ache and  ______  head hurts.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯先生胃痛，头也疼。 考查代词辨析。her她的；his他的；their他们的；your你的。根据“Mr. Smith”可知，男性，应用his表示“他的”，故选B。

questions.prompt: China sent Tianwen-1 spaceship into space ______  July 23rd, 2020.
questions.explanation: 句意：2020年7月23日，中国将“天问一号”探测器送入太空。 考查介词。on用于指具体某一天；by通常接时间名词，常用于完成时；at用于指某一特定的时刻；in用于指某个较长的时间（年、月、季节）。空格后“July 23rd, 2020”为具体的一天，故应用介词on。故选A。

questions.prompt: Tony has entered a lot of competitions,  ______  he hasn’t won any prizes.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼参加了很多比赛，但他没有赢得任何奖品。 考查连词辨析。so因此；for因为；but但是；or或者。“Tony has entered a lot of competitions”与“he hasn’t won any prizes”是转折关系，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Sam,  ______  you help me make an apple pie? —No problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Sam，你可以帮助我做一个苹果派吗？——没问题。 考查情态动词辨析。can可以；must必须；should应该；need必须。根据答语“No problem”可知，此处是表示请求允许，用can符合语境，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  has Spiderman been popular? —For sixty years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——蜘蛛侠流行多久了？——六年了。 考查特殊疑问句。how much多少；how often多久一次；how long多久；how soon多久以后。根据“For sixty years”可知，对时间段提问用how long引导特殊疑问句，故选C。

questions.prompt: Cairo is one of  ______  cities in Egypt.
questions.explanation: 句意：开罗是埃及最繁华的城市之一。 考查形容词最高级。one of the+形容词最高级+复数名词，表示“最……之一”，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Mum, the pizza  ______  so delicious. I can’t wait to try some. — All right, sweetie. Just wait a second.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，披萨闻起来真香。我迫不及待想尝尝。 ——好吧，亲爱的。等一下。 考查感官动词。sounds听起来；smells闻到；feels感觉到；hears听到。根据句中“pizza”可知，披萨的美味可以通过闻和吃体验出来，但是根据下文“I can’t wait to try some”可知，还没有能品尝，故指的是“闻到”。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Have you finished your project? —Not yet. I  ______  on it now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的项目完成了吗？——还没有。我现在还在做着呢。 考查动词时态。根据“Not yet. I …on it now.”可知，还没有做完，目前正在做，使用现在进行时，结构为be doing，副词位于be动词之后。故选D。

questions.prompt: Sara  ______  many places since she came to Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从萨拉来到北京，她已经参观了许多地方。 考查动词时态。since+一般过去时的从句，主句用现在完成时have/has done结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: Mike and Claire are very excited because they  ______  to the US in a few days.
questions.explanation: 句意：迈克和克莱尔非常激动，因为他们几天后将搬回美国。 考查时态。根据句中时间状语“in a few days”可知，句子应用一般将来时will do，意为“过几天将……”，故选D。

questions.prompt: The geography teacher told us the earth  ______  around the sun.
questions.explanation: 句意：地理老师告诉我们地球绕着太阳转。 考查动词时态。此处是宾语从句，从句“地球绕着太阳转”是客观事实，仍用一般现在时，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to go to watch a cartoon with me? —I’d love to, but I  ______  my English homework yet.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你愿意和我一起去看卡通片吗？ ——我很想去，但我还没有完成英语作业。 考查句子时态。根据句中“yet”提示，yet为现在完成时态的标志词。该句应用现在完成时，即“haven’t +过去分词”形式。故选C。 二、完形填空（共 10 分，每小题 1 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I had been playing hockey (冰球) for about 10 years. I was always the one sitting at the end of the bench, and seldom got into a game. I went to all the practices and showed up even when it was so cold that your “breath froze” and when the other players had decided to stay home. I felt I had  ______ 13 ______  enough and thought of quitting. I finally decided to break the news to my mom that I was leaving the team. questions.prompt: Good hobbies can help children enjoy themselves in life, and also help them  ______.

questions.prompt: —Why are you still here? It’s almost eight o’clock. —Because I  ______  my work. Don’t worry. It’s almost done.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你怎么还在这里？快八点了。——因为我还没有完成我的工作。别担心。差不多完成了。 考查现在完成时。根据“Why are you still here?”可知，强调对现在的影响，用现在完成时，故选C。

questions.prompt: — What did the man say? — He told us  ______  any further. There is danger ahead.
questions.explanation: 句意：——那人说了什么？——他告诉我们不要再往前走了。前方有危险。 考查动词不定式的否定形式。tell sb. not to do sth.“告诉某人不干某事”，是动词不定式的否定形式。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Where’s Mary? —She  ______  to Hubei.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玛丽在哪？——她已经去了湖北。 考查谓语动词时态。根据“Where’s Mary?”可知询问玛丽在哪，也即现在玛丽不在此地，因此应用现在完成时表示过去的动作对现在的影响，have been to表示“去过某地，人已回来”，不符合题意；have gone to“表示去了某地没回来”，符合题意。故选B。

questions.prompt: Miss Lin ______  a lot of work for the poor area since 2010.
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词时态。结合since 2010可知要用现在完成时。故答案为C。

questions.prompt: The writer’s first book  ______  in 2019, and then he became popular.
questions.explanation: 句意：作者的第一本书在2019年出版的，然后他变得很受欢迎。 考查动词短语。came up发生，上来；came over过来，克服；came out出版；came on加油。根据“The writer’s first book”可知，指的是书出版。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  your father ever  ______  to Tibet? —Yes. He  ______  there last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的父亲曾经去过西藏吗？——是的。他去年去了那里。 考查动词时态。根据“ever”可知，问句用现在完成时，排除CD选项；由“last year”可知，此处用一般过去时，排除A选项。故选B。

questions.prompt: Mr. Fan  ______  this watch in 2012. He  ______  it for 10 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：范先生在2012年买的这块手表。他拥有它10年了。 考查时态。bought“买”；has“拥有”。根据“in 2012”可知，第一空用一般过去时；根据“for 10 years”可知，第二空用现在完成时，故选A。 四、完形填空（本题 10 分，每小题 1 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 There’s No “I” in Team I love hockey (冰球). I mean I r-e-a-l-l-y love hockey. I love the feeling when I  ______ 15 ______  in and out of players on the ice. I love taking the risk to score even if I miss. They handed out five prizes but none of them was for me. I was so disappointed. It took everything within me not to cry. I tried really hard to  ______ 17 ______  and be happy for my teammates who did get one. When we got home, I had a long talk with my mom and told her how I felt before bed. I fell asleep with a crying headache. When I woke up in the morning there was a card waiting for me on the kitchen table. He told me that he liked that I could play defensively (防守) and set up plays. When I thought about what he said later on, I realized that he was  ______ 21 ______. In that moment, I knew why I hadn’t won a prize, but more than that, I realized that there is no “I” in team. I’m so happy that I learned that  ______ 24 ______.

questions.prompt: My parents and I watch CCTV news  ______  7 p.m. every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我和父母每天晚上7点看央视新闻。 考查介词辨析。at后接具体的时刻；on后接具体的某一天；in后接年、月、季节等；to到。空后“7 p.m.”是具体的时刻，此空应填at。故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  high school students enter colleges in China every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国每年有数百万高中生进入大学。 考查基数词。Ten million一千万；Millions of数百万；Ten hundred常用“one thousand”来表示“一千”；Hundreds of好几百。根据常识可知，每年进入大学的高中生应有数百万。故选B。

questions.prompt: Emily has a sweet tooth,  ______  she’s never got a toothache.
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米丽喜欢吃甜食，但她从来没有牙痛过。 考查连词辨析。and和；so因此；but但是；or或者。“Emily has a sweet tooth”与“she’s never got a toothache”是转折关系，故选C。

questions.prompt: —I think Monkey King is one of  ______  cartoons I have ever watched! —Yes. It’s also my favourite.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我认为《美猴王》是我看过的最幽默的动画片之一！——是的。这也是我的最爱。 考查最高级。根据“one of”可知此处是“one of+the+形容词最高级+复数名词”结构，意为“最……之一”。形容词最高级前加the。故选D。

questions.prompt: Adele is an excellent singer. Her voice  ______  beautiful.
questions.explanation: 句意：阿黛尔是一位出色的歌手。她的声音听起来很美。 考查动词辨析。looks看起来；smells闻起来；tastes尝起来；sounds听起来。根据“Her voice… beautiful”可知，声音听起来很美，故选D。

questions.prompt: —May I speak to John? —Sorry, he  ______  Guangzhou. But he will be back tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以和约翰讲话吗？——对不起，他去广州了。但是他明天会回来。 考查现在完成时。have/has been to去过某地（已经回来）；have/has gone to去了某地（还没回来）。根据“But he will be back tomorrow.”可知，约翰去广州了，还没回来，并且主语“he”为第三人称单数，此处应用has gone to。故选B。

questions.prompt: Too Cool To Kill is a funny film. I  ______  it twice.
questions.explanation: 句意：《这个杀手不太冷静》是一部有趣的电影。我已经看过两次了。 考查现在完成时。根据“twice”可知，表示次数的词作时间状语，常用于现在完成时，结构为have/has done。故选D。

questions.prompt: David has worked in this company since he  ______  to Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：大卫自从来北京就一直在这家公司工作。 考查动词时态。since引导的时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时，从句用一般过去时，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  you  ______  the yoga club yet? —No, I haven’t. I prefer to play tennis.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你加入瑜伽俱乐部了吗？——不，我没有。我更喜欢打网球。 考查现在完成时的一般疑问句。根据“No, I haven’t.”可知，此一般疑问句用have提问，后接过去分词joined构成现在完成时。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  the dress for a year. It is not a new one.
questions.explanation: 句意：这件衣服我买了一年了。它不是新的。 考查现在完成时。根据“for a year”可知，此句应用现在完成时，排除A和C；bought“买”是非延续性动词，不能和表示一段时间的状语连用。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Amy, you look pale and tired. What’s wrong? —I  ______  well last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：——艾米，你看起来脸色苍白而且很疲惫。怎么了？ ——我昨晚没睡好。 考查动词的时态。根据“last night”可知，此处时态为一般过去时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —I’ve entered a writing competition. But I am not good at  ______  a story. Could you help me? —No problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我参加了一个写作比赛。但我不擅长编故事。你能帮我一下吗？——没问题。 考查动词短语辨析。set up设立；make up编造；put up张贴；take up占据。根据“But I am not good at…a story”可知，不擅长编故事，故选B。 从下面各题所给的A、B两个选项中选出可以填入短文空白处的最佳选项。（共4分，每小题1分） A Last month my family and I travelled to Egypt. We went to the Great Pyramids. They were built for the kings of ancient Egypt. After a king was  ______ 13 ______, people put him inside a pyramid. They believed that their king would live a new life in a pyramid. They put many of the king’s things in the pyramid, because they thought the king would need them in his new life. We tried to read the ancient language of Egypt. The language is made up of some small pictures.  ______ 14 ______  of us could understand these pictures until a tour guide told us the meaning.

questions.prompt: Mr. Jackson is a popular writer, and we all like reading  ______  books.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克逊先生是个受欢迎的作家，我们都喜欢读他的书。 考查物主代词。his他的；her她的；their他们的；your你/你们的。根据空后有名词books，可知需要填形容词性物主代词；又根据前一句Mr. Jackson is a popular writer，可知此处是指“喜欢读他的书”，故选A。

questions.prompt: The restaurant is very popular now,  ______ I don't like the food there.
questions.explanation: 句意：这家餐馆现在很受欢迎，但我不喜欢那里的食物。 考查连词。and和；but但是；or否则；so所以；分析句子“The restaurant is very popular now,  ______ I don't like the food there”这家餐馆现在很受欢迎， ______ 我不喜欢那里的食物，所以这两句话是转折关系，故选B。

questions.prompt: —When is the sports meeting, Kate? — ______  September 30th. A At
questions.explanation: 句意：——运动会在什么时候，凯特？——在9月30日。 考查时间介词。At后接具体时刻等；In后接年、月等；On后接具体日期等；To到。根据“September 30th.”可知此处表示在9月30日，用介词On。故选C。

questions.prompt: The cheese cake  ______  so good that I can’t wait to eat it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这块奶酪蛋糕闻起来很好所以我迫不及待要吃了它。选项A“尝起来”，选项B“摸起来”，选项C“听起来”，选项D“闻起来”。“so…that”是“如此…以至于”，这里说蛋糕闻起来很香以至于我迫不及待要吃，说明一开始并没有吃，只是闻了闻。故选D。 点睛：本题是感官类系动词的考察，但只要对这类词的意义有着清晰的认识也能轻松破解。本题的关键在“so …that”，既然是“以至于…”就说明前面的动作貌似对后面的“吃”产生了影响，所以前面没吃，不选taste（尝起来），选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you visit your grandparents, Tom? —Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去看一次你的祖父母，汤姆？——一个月两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How often多久一次；How much多少钱；How long多长；How old多大年龄。根据答语“Twice a month.”可知，此处对频率进行提问，故选A。

questions.prompt: --- I hand in the report today? --- No, you needn’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：---我今天必须交报告吗？----不，你不必。考查情态动词。A. Can能；B. Must必须； C. Shall将，一般用于第一人称；D. Could能，可以。Must开头的一般疑问句（Must I/she/he….？），它的肯定回答是Yes， you/she/he…must.否定回答是No, you/she/he...needn’t. must开头的一般疑问句不用No,…mustn’t回答，mustn’t意思是禁止做某事。结合句意和语境可知选B。

questions.prompt: —What’s that noise, Sam? —My little brother  ______  with his toy car now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——萨姆，那是什么声音？——我的弟弟现在正在玩他的玩具汽车。 考查现在进行时。play玩。will play一般将来时；is playing现在进行时；plays动词的第三人称单数形式；played动词的过去式。根据问句“What’s that noise, Sam?”可知提到的声响是现有的，结合答句中“now”可知是说现在正在进行的动作，用现在进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —How do you usually go to school? —I  ______  to school on foot every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你通常怎么去上学？——我每天步行去上学。 考查动词时态辨析。every day“每天”是一般现在时的标志，可知用一般现在时，故选A。

questions.prompt: My mother  ______  some washing when the telephone rang last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚电话铃响时，我妈妈正在洗衣服。 考查动词时态。根据“when the telephone rang last night”可知，此处是when引导的时间状语从句，从句是一般过去时态，主句用过去进行时，其结构是：was/were doing，主语是单数，be动词用was，故选D。

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we  ______  at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。 考查动词的时态。“if”引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”的原则。主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时态表示将来。根据“If it rains”可知从句部分是一般现在时，主句表达“待在家里”用“will stay”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Lily is my classmate. We each other since she came to our school.
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉是我的同班同学。自从她来到我们学校，我们就认识了。考查动词时态。Since自从…以来，后跟过去的时间点，或一般过去式的从句，主句用现在完成时。结合句意和语境可知选C。

questions.prompt: —May I speak to Tom? —Sorry, he  ______  America. But he will come back in two days.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以和汤姆说话吗？——对不起，他去了美国。但他两天后就会回来。 考查现在完成时。have/has been to去过（已回来）；have/has gone to去了（还未回来）。根据“But he will come back in two days”可知他两天后才回来，说明此时还未回来，用have/has gone to；主语是he，助动词用has。故选D。 从下面各题所给的A、B两个选项中选出可以填入短文空白处填入最佳选项。（共4分，每小题1分） A Shyness Scientists once did a study on two-month-old babies. They  ______ 13 ______  that of every five babies, one was very active. This kind of baby liked to make noise. And one of every five babies was always quiet. These babies might be shy when they grew up. People who are outgoing are sometimes more  ______ 14 ______. Shy people may feel that they have a disadvantage. But shyness can be an advantage. Shy people are often very good at listening. This can also make them successful.

questions.prompt: Our football team won the game! I feel very  ______  because of the exciting news.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的足球队赢了比赛！因为这个激动人心的消息，我感到非常高兴。 考查词义辨析。happy高兴的，形容词；happily高兴地，副词；nervous神经紧张的，形容词；nervously焦急地，副词。根据“Our football team won the game!”可知，这是一个好消息，因此是感到高兴，feel后跟形容词作表语，因此是happy。故选A。

questions.prompt: People in China have moon cakes  ______  Mid-autumn Day.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国人在中秋节吃月饼。 考查时间介词辨析。in后接某年某月某季节；on后接具体一天；at后接具体时刻；of……的。“Mid-autumn Day”是具体的一天，故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s raining outside, you’d better take your umbrella.
questions.explanation: 句意：外面正在下雨，因此你最好带上你的雨伞。 考查连词辨析。but但是；for为了；or或者；so因此。“you’d better take your umbrella.”是“It’s raining outside”的结果，因此用so连接。故选D。

questions.prompt: Zhong Nanshan is one of  ______  people during the outbreak of covid-19.
questions.explanation: 句意：钟南山是新冠肺炎疫情期间最伟大的人物之一。 考查最高级。这里是固定用法：one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数表示“最……之一”，因此这里填the greatest。故选D。

questions.prompt: He couldn’t help angry when he heard that news．
questions.explanation: 句意：听到那个消息，他禁不住生起气来。can’t help doing sth.情不自禁地做某事。结合句意可知，答案为C。

questions.prompt: — ______  have you studied in this school? —For nearly two years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你在这所学校学习多久了？——快两年了。 考查特殊疑问句。How often多长时间一次；How far多远；How much多少钱；how long多久，一般对时间段提问。根据回答“For nearly three years.”可知，是for加时间段，所以应该用how long提问。故选D。

questions.prompt: My grandmother often  ______  about her childhood with me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我祖母经常和我谈论她的童年。 考查动词时态。根据“often”可知，本题是一般现在时，主语“My grandmother”是第三人称单数，因此动词填三单talks。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing when I called you at 4:00 yesterday afternoon? —Oh, sorry. I  ______  a piano lesson at that time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天下午4点我打电话给你的时候你在干什么？——哦，抱歉。那时我正在上钢琴课。 考查过去进行时。根据“at 4:00 yesterday afternoon”可知，此处强调在过去的某个时间点正在发生的动作，故选B。

questions.prompt: In the 1960s, my father  ______  in a small house with his two brothers.
questions.explanation: 句意：在20世纪60年代，我的父亲和他的两个兄弟住在一个小房子里。 考查动词时态。根据“In the 1960s”可知，此句用一般过去时，动词用过去式，故选D。

questions.prompt: —What will you do this weekend? —I  ______  some friends to my home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个周末你要做什么？——我将邀请一些朋友到我家来。 考查动词时态。根据“What will you do this weekend?”可知，问句是一般将来时，因此回答也用一般将来时，结构是“will+动词原形”。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Your English is very beautiful! — Thank you. I  ______  English since I was a little boy.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的英语真好！——谢谢。我从小就学英语。 考查动词时态。根据“since”可知，此句是现在完成时态，结构为“have/has done”；主语是“I”，因此助动词是have。故选A。

questions.prompt: Today is Mother’s Day. Wang Fang  ______  a letter to her mother now.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天是母亲节。王芳现在正在给她妈妈写信。 考查动词时态。根据“now”可知，本句是现在进行时，结构是“be doing”；主语“Wang Fang”是单数，因此be动词是is，write现在分词是writing。故选C。 二、 完形填空 （共 16 分，每小题 1 分） 通读下面两篇短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A, B, C, D 四个选项中，选择能填入相应空白处的最佳选项。 A This Old Chair “I was thinking of our spring house cleaning.” John’s mom suggested. “Tomorrow, John, you have no school. Suddenly John’s mom pointed to the Grandpa’s  ______ 13 ______  and shouted, “That old chair has got to go. We will buy Grandpa a new one.” It was  ______ 14 ______. John had to agree. The chair was unsightly(不美观的). It was too old. “John, let’s take the chair outside.” Mom said. As they were trying to  ______ 15 ______  the chair, Grandpa came in. He blocked their way. “Oh, no! You can’t take my chair.” “Grandpa, we’ll buy you a new one.” John’s mom said. “No, I don’t want a new one.” Grandpa tried to push his chair back into place. John’s mom gave up and left the room. Grandpa sat into his chair and closed his eyes. “Grandpa, why don’t you let us throw away the chair?” John asked. “It’s so old.” “You don’t  ______ 16 ______, John. I sat in this chair with your grandma when I asked her to marry me. It was so long ago, but when I sit in this chair and close my eyes I  ______ 17 ______ she is near.” It’s amazing(令人惊奇的), John thought, how Grandpa could  ______ 18 ______  things from the past. In the present, he forgot almost everything. “And the night your father was born, I sat in this chair. When they placed the tiny baby into my arms, I was never happier.” A smile now flashed(闪现) across his old face. “I think I’m going to understand.” John said  ______ 19 ______. “Many years later,” Grandpa’s voice broke, “I sat in this chair when the doctor called and told me your grandma was ill. I was lost without her but the chair gave me comfort and warmth.” “I’m sorry, Grandpa.” John looked at Grandpa and said, “This is not just any old chair. You’ve gone through a lot together.” That night, John told his mom this chair was like Grandpa’s  ______ 20 ______. They realized how much the chair meant to Grandpa. When they looked at the chair the next day, they found the room would be very dull(单调的) without this old chair.

questions.prompt: My brother is a tour guide.  ______  loves travelling.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥是导游，他喜欢旅行。 考查人称代词词义辨析。we我们；she她；he他；they他们。根据第一句主语“My brother我的哥哥”以及谓语动词是第三人称单数形式loves，可以推测此处的代词是he。故选C。

questions.prompt: I want to be a doctor  ______  the future. I would like to help people a lot.
questions.explanation: 句意：我将来想成为一名医生。我很想帮助别人。 考查介词辨析。to朝向；at在；on在……上；in在……里面。根据“the future”可知，in the future“在将来”，固定短语。故选D。

questions.prompt: I’d like to go boating with you,  ______  I’m too busy today.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想和你去划船，但我今天太忙了。 考查连词。but 但是；and 和；so因此；or或者；根据句意及语境可知，此处两句表达的是转折关系，所以应该用表转折关系的连词，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______ do you always keep learning new things? —Because I want to develop some new skills.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你为什么总是在学习新东西？——因为我想发展一些新技能。 考查特殊疑问句。Where在哪里；Why为什么；When什么时候；How怎么。根据Because“因为”可知，对原因提问用Why。故选B。

questions.prompt: Now mobile phones are very popular and they are much  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在手机非常流行，而且比之前便宜很多。 考查形容词的比较级。根据语境和“much…than before”可知，与之前作比较，是两者之间，用比较级形式，即cheaper。故选B。

questions.prompt: Don’t play games here. The teachers  ______  a meeting now.
questions.explanation: 句意：不要在这里玩游戏。老师们现在正在开会。 考查现在进行时。根据“Don’t play games here”和“now”可知，句子为现在进行时，表示现在正在发生的事情，应用“am/is/are+doing”的结构。故选C。

questions.prompt: —I called you at eight last night. But there was no answer. —Oh, I  ______  a table tennis game on TV at that time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我昨晚八点打电话给你。但没有人回答。——哦，那时我正在电视上看乒乓球比赛。 考查动词时态。根据“at that time”可知，上文询问昨晚八点在做什么，答句应用过去进行时“was/were doing”，表示过去的某个时间点正在做什么。故选D。

questions.prompt: My friend Xiao Ming is in America now and he ______  back next week.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的朋友小明现在在美国并且将要在下周回来。 考查一般将来时。will come是come将来时；comes是come的第三人称单数形式；has come是come的现在完成时；came是come的过去式。根据时间状语“next week”可知，空格处要填一般将来时。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Kate. You look tired. What’s the matter? —I  ______  up late last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，凯特。你看起来很累。怎么了？——我昨晚熬夜了。 考查一般过去时。根据“last night”判断，时态为一般过去时，故动词要用过去式；stay up late“熬夜”。故选D。

questions.prompt: ——Lucy, is your uncle a teacher? ——Yes,he is.He history for nearly 20 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——露西，你叔叔是老师吗？ ——是的，他教了将近20年的历史了。考查现在完成时。根据for nearly 20 years可知，这是一个表示一段时间的时间状语，通常用于现在完成时，而且动词应该用延续性动词，现在完成时态结构为have/has+动词的过去分词。故选B。 【点睛】本题主要考查现在完成时。用法：表示过去发生或完成的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，还表示过去发生动作一直持续到现在。其结构是have/has+及物动词的过去分词。此题注意短暂性动词和延续性动词的区别。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______? —At 9:00 tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道会议什么时候开始吗？——明天早上9点钟。 考查宾语从句。根据“Do you know...”和所给选项判断，题干是含有宾语从句的复合句；宾语从句要用陈述句语序，排除BD选项；再根据答语“At 9:00 tomorrow morning.”可知，从句时态要用一般将来时，排除C选项。故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 From the time I was a child in New Jersey, I loved spending weekends with my grandparents. I felt  ______ 13 ______  in Granny’s small kitchen. We always had peaceful conversations, and Granny always seemed to have some wisdom (智慧) with every dish she prepared. I remember one Saturday morning. I was about 11 years old. After breakfast I asked Granny, “What kind of  ______ 14 ______  are you making today?” “Vegetable beef,” she answered, “and you can help by cutting some carrots.” As I slowly cut the carrots. I said,“I’ve got to give a  ______ 15 ______  next week and I’m scared. I don’t like standing in front of everybody. What if I forget what I’m going to say? Or what if somebody laughs?” “And what if you do just fine?” Granny asked. “Have you  ______ 16 ______  notes?” “Well, no. That would be a lot of work.” “Hard work never hurts anyone,” Granny said, “you could try practicing in front of a mirror (镜子). It’s easy to find how well you are practicing.” I pushed the pieces of carrots to the side of the cutting board and then complained about schoolwork, friends and family. Granny took it all in, listening  ______ 17 ______  while I talked about so many pieces of grief (伤事) in my life. “Nancy,” she said, “there’s nothing wrong with a little trouble in your life. Well, you know, a lot of people don’t make homemade soup these days. They say it’s too much trouble. But I don’t  ______ 18 ______  such a little trouble. It adds flavor (滋味) to my soup—and to my life. My soup will be pretty bland (平淡的) without the vegetables, and so will my life be if it doesn’t have the little ups and downs.” She smiled and then started washing the dishes. While I helped Granny clean up, I thought about what she had said. I still had a few days to practice my report. That Saturday, Granny gave me food for thought as well as a bowl of her homemade soup. As I  ______ 19 ______  the meal with my grandparents, my problems didn’t seem so big any more. Maybe I could  ______ 20 ______  a little trouble into something as special as Granny’s homemade soup. I would have to work on them. Granny had said hard work paid off.

questions.prompt: Mike is my new friend. I often play football with  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：迈克是我的新朋友。我经常和他踢足球。 考查代词辨析。her她(宾格)、她的(形容词性物主代词)；him他(宾格)；me我(宾格)；you你(宾格)。根据“Mike is my new friend”可知此处应填一个代词指代“Mike”，是男性，用him。故填B。

questions.prompt: I hope the interview  ______  Sunday will be successful.
questions.explanation: 句意：我希望周日的面试会成功。 考查介词辨析。on其后加星期或具体某一天的时间；in其后加早晨、下午、晚上，季节，月份，年份等；at其后加点钟；of表示所属。根据“Sunday”可知，应用on。故选A。

questions.prompt: You can’t use mobile phones too much,  ______  they are very convenient.
questions.explanation: 句意：你不能太多地使用手机，尽管他们是非常方便的。 考查连词辨析。or或者；although尽管；so所以；because因为。根据“You can’t use mobile phones too much”和“they are very convenient.”是转折关系可知应用although，引导让步状语从句，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  did you go picnic last Sunday? —By bike.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上周日你如何去野餐？——骑自行车。 考查特殊疑问句。when何时；where哪里；why为什么；how怎样。根据答语“By bike”可知，询问出行方式，用疑问词how提问，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Must I go to the office every day in the future? —No, you  ______. You can work at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——以后我必须每天都去办公室吗？——不，你不必。你可以在家工作。 考查情态动词。can’t不能；mustn’t禁止；needn’t不需要；shouldn’t不应该。must开头的一般疑问句否定回答应用needn’t/don’t have to。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mid-autumn Festival is one of  ______  festivals in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：中秋节是中国最重要的节日之一。 考查形容词最高级。固定句型one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数“……中最……之一”，形容词最高级前要加the，所以此处用the most important“最重要的”。故选D。

questions.prompt: My dog  ______  its tail to show happiness every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的狗每天摇尾巴表达快乐。 考查动词时态。wag“摇摆”，动词，作谓语，根据“every day”可知，时态用一般现在时，主语是“My dog”，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式wags。故选B。

questions.prompt: —David, hurry up! We  ______  for you. —Just one minute.
questions.explanation: 句意：——戴维，快点。我们正在等你。——稍等片刻。 考查现在进行时。根据“David, hurry up!”可知是我们正在等你，你快点，应用现在进行时，其谓语结构为“be+动词现在分词”，故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  games online when Frank called me last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚弗兰克给我打电话时，我正在网上玩游戏。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语从句“when Frank called me last night.”语境可知，空处表示在过去的某一时刻正在进行的动作，故应用过去进行时，构成形式为：was/were doing，主语“I”是第一人称单数形式，故助动词应用was，play的现在分词是playing。故选D。

questions.prompt: To celebrate Thanksgiving, my mum  ______  a lot of delicious food yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了庆祝感恩节，我妈妈昨天准备了很多美味的食物。 考查动词时态。根据“yesterday”可知，时态是一般过去时，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______? —At 8:00 tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道会议什么时候开始吗？——明天上午八点。 考查宾语从句。know后缺少宾语，用宾语从句，宾语从句用陈述语序，排除BD；“主现从不限”，再由“At 8:00 tomorrow morning.”可知对将来时间提问，用一般将来时，排除C。故选A。 二、完形填空 （共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A New Way of Speaking It was Raj’s first day of school in a new country, and he was  ______ 13 ______. His family just moved to the United States from India. The teacher, Mr. Washington came out of his office. He reached out his hand. Raj shook it as his father showed him. “Welcome!” Mr. Washington said. His first handshake in the United States was a success. His mother told Mr. Washington that he earned high marks in English. Mr. Washington smiled and said, “I can tell that he is the apple of your eye.” Raj  ______ 14 ______  what Mr. Washington meant. He has seen no apples in his mother’s eyes. “You are wonderful like a juicy, sweet apple!” his mother said to him. Raj felt a smile  ______ 15 ______  slowly across his face. “Sandeep, come here, please,” Mr. Washington said. A boy with a big smile walked over. “Raj, this is Sandeep. He will help you during the school day.” “Namaste,” Sandeep said. Then he placed his hands together. The  ______ 16 ______  felt like a little bit of home. “It is nice to meet another person from India.” Next, Mr. Washington  ______ 17 ______  Raj in the class. The students smiled and called out, “Hello, Raj!” Raj was suddenly nervous again. The morning passed quickly. A bell sounded loudly. “It’s time for lunch!” Sandeep said. “The early bird gets the worm(蠕虫)!” Mr. Washington said. “Are there other things to eat?” Raj asked Sandeep. “I don’t think I would like worms.” “It’s an idiom—a saying,” Sandeep explained. “He means that the first to arrive get the best  ______ 18 ______  of food.” This new way of speaking English puzzled Raj. Then they went to the lunchroom. As they walked to the table, a boy dropped his milk on the floor. The milk flowed(流动) like a white river. Raj began to laugh  ______ 19 ______. “What’s so funny?” the boy asked. “You poured(倒出) away rivers of milk!” Raj said. “That makes no  ______ 20 ______,” the boy said. “This is an Indian way of saying you are very giving,” Raj explained. “It’s an idiom.” “Oh,” the boy said. “I guess that is pretty funny!” “I’m Raj,” he said, suddenly feeling better. “Mike,” the boy said. They shook hands.

questions.prompt: Look! That old man is crossing the road. Let’s go and help  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！那个老人在过马路，让我们去帮助他吧。me我，人称代词宾格；him他；her她；them他们。这几个选项中都是人称代词的宾格形式。根据句意可知，这个代词指代的是that old man，故应选B。

questions.prompt: In order to keep cool, many people go swimming  ______  summer．
questions.explanation: 句意：为了保持凉爽，在夏天很多人去游泳。in泛指在上午、下午或晚上；在季节、月份、年代前；at在具体时刻；on在具体某一天、星期；to到…。空后的summer是夏天，故应选A。

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  you will be late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则你上学就迟到了。 考查并列连词辨析。and又，和，表示并列关系；but但是，表示转折关系；or否则，表相反假设，用于警告或忠告；so因此，表因果关系；句型“祈使句+or+陈述句”表示以陈述句为条件下的相反假设，意为“否则，要不然”，所以，用连词or。故选C。

questions.prompt: I think skiing is  ______  than running.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为滑雪比跑步更令人兴奋。exciting令人兴奋的；more exciting更令人兴奋的；most exciting最令人兴奋的；the most exciting最令人兴奋的。根据句意和句中的than可知，这里表示滑雪和跑步两者相比，应用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: They went to  ______  Great Wall yesterday and had  ______  good time.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们昨天去了长城，玩得很开心。 考查冠词辨析。the定冠词，表示特指；a不定冠词，常用在辅音音素开头的单词前；an不定冠词，常用在元音音素开头的单词前。第一空根据“Great Wall”可知，这是专有名词，the Great Wall“长城”；第二空“have a good time”是固定搭配，意为“玩得开心，过得愉快”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Every year many foreigners  ______  to China to learn Chinese.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年许多外国人来中国学习汉语。根据Every year可知用一般现在时态；故选A

questions.prompt: He  ______  in the library when the rainstorm came yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天暴风雨来的时候，他正在图书馆睡觉。 考查动词时态。when引导时间状语从句，从句“came”是一般过去时，所以主句用过去的某个时态；句意表示“当暴风雨来的时候，他正在图书馆睡觉”，表示过去的某个时刻正在做的事情，所以空格处用过去进行时was sleeping。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  a picnic with my brother last Sunday. It was great.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周日我和我的哥哥一起去野餐了，非常棒。have有，动词原形；had是have的过去式；will have将会有，一般将来时态；am having现在进行时态。have a picnic去野餐，是一个固定短语。根据句中的时间状语last Sunday可知，这里说的是过去的事情，应用一般过去时态，故选B。

questions.prompt: —I’m Daisy, not Jessie. —Sorry, I have difficulty  ______  people’s names.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我是黛西，不是杰西。——对不起，我记不住别人的名字。 考查非谓语动词。根据“have difficulty”可知，此处是固定搭配，have difficulty (in) doing sth意为“做某事有困难”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Our government is trying to  ______  ways to solve the smog (雾霾) problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的政府正在想办法解决雾霾问题。 考查动词词组辨析。catch up with赶上；put up with容忍；come up with提出，想出；get on with继续做某事/与……相处。根据“ways to solve the smog (雾霾) problem.”可知，是想办法来解决问题。故选C。

questions.prompt: The students decided  ______  for a volunteer after-school reading program.
questions.explanation: 句意：学生们决定参加课外阅读节目的志愿者选拔。 考查不定式。根据“decided”可知，decide to do sth.“决定做某事”，因此这里填不定式；try out for“参加选拔”。故选C。 五、完形填空（共8分, 每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 When I was small, my mum used to give the family something special for meals—she would make breakfast food for dinner. I still remember one night my mum  ______ 13 ______  some bread in front of my dad, something very burnt（烤糊）. I waited to see if anybody noticed. To my surprise, he smiled at my mum and then turned to ask me how my day at school had been. I  ______ 14 ______  what I told him that night. But I do remember watching him put some butter on that bread. He  ______ 15 ______  as usual, every single bite. After dinner, my mum said sorry to my dad for burning the bread. And I never forget what he said, “I love burnt bread, dear. It doesn’t  ______ 16 ______  at all.” Later that night, I went to kiss Dad good night. I asked him if he really liked his bread burnt. He held me in arms and  ______ 17 ______  “Your mum worked very hard all day. She’s really tired. And you see a bit of burnt food never hurt anyone!” Now I know life is not perfect. Nobody is perfect, either. As for me, I often forget birthdays or some other special days. But I’ve learned something  ______ 18 ______  over these years. What we really need is the understanding of each other, whether between a husband and wife, a parent and  ______ 19 ______  or just between two friends. This is the key to a happy life. So, don’t get angry if the bread gets burnt. Remember, burnt bread never hurt anyone. Be kind to those around you and a happier life will surely come  ______ 20 ______  to you.

questions.prompt: Miss Wang is  ______  English teacher. We all like her very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：王老师是我们的英语老师。我们都很喜欢她。 考查代词辨析。our我们的，形容词性物主代词；we我们，人称代词主格；us我们，人称代词宾格；ours我们的，名词性物主代词。这里作定语修饰名词teacher，用形容词性物主代词our。故选A。

questions.prompt: We often go camping  ______  spring because it is the best season in Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们经常在春天去露营，因为这是北京最好的季节。 考查介词辨析。of属于……的；in用于年、月和季节之前；on用于具体的某一天和星期几之前；at用于具体的某一时刻之前。spring是季节，介词应用in。故选B。

questions.prompt: Get up early, ______ you’ll be late for school. A so
questions.explanation: 句意：早点起床，否则你会上学迟到。考查祈使句+and/or+陈述句，祈使句相当于条件状语从句，后面陈述句表示的结果。（1）“祈使句，+and + 陈述句”该句型表示如果做到了祈使句表示的事情，就会有后面句子表示的结果。（2）祈使句，+ or + 陈述句该句型表示如果不做到祈使句表示的事情，就会有后面句子表示的结果。根据句意及语境此题应选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  pencil-box is this? —I think it’s Tom’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是谁的铅笔盒？——我想是汤姆的。 考查特殊疑问句。Who谁；Which哪个；What什么；Whose谁的。根据“I think it’s Tom’s.”可知，问是谁的，故选D。

questions.prompt: I jumped than Bill in the sports meet last year
questions.explanation: 句意：上年的运动会我跳的比比尔高。 考查副词的比较级。连词than常用在比较级的句子中，只有B是比较级，故答案选B。

questions.prompt: —Jack,  ______  you play the guitar? —Yes I can. I began to play it when I was 7 years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jack，你会弹吉他吗？——是的，我会。我7岁的时候就开始弹了。 考查情态动词辨析。can会；may可以；need需要；must必须。根据“Yes, I can”可知，此处是can引导的一般疑问句，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Mum, where is Dad? —He  ______  with uncle Li in the garden now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，爸爸在哪里？——他现在正在花园里和李叔叔谈话。 考查现在进行时。根据提问“你爸爸在哪里”以及时间状语now“现在”可知，此处动作正在发生，用现在进行时，结构为：am/is/are+doing。主语是he“他”，为第三人称单数，be动词用is。故选D。

questions.prompt: My grandparents ______  in that city since 2008.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：我的祖父母从2008年就生活在那个城市里。A.will live 是一般将来时； B.live 是一般现在时； C.have lived现在完成时； D.were living 过去进行时。since是现在外出时的标志词，现在完成时态：have/has+ 动词的过去分词。故选C。 【考点定位】：考查现在完成时的用法。

questions.prompt: I think skiing is  ______  event in the Winter Olympics.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为滑雪是冬奥会上最激动人心的项目。 考查形容词最高级用法。exciting激动人心的；the most exciting最激动人心的；more exciting更激动人心的；most exciting前面要加the。根据“in the Winter Olympics”可知，此处是三者以上比较，用最高级the most exciting。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing at 8:00 yesterday evening? —I  ______  TV with my parents at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天晚上8点你在干什么？——我和父母在家里看电视。 考查过去进行时。根据“at 8:00 yesterday evening”可知，在过去的某个时间点，动作正在发生，时态是过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: —How long has your sister studied in this college? —She  ______  here for 3 years and she will graduate from this college next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你姐姐在这所大学学习多久了？——她已经在这里学习三年了，明年她将从这所大学毕业。 考查现在完成时。根据时间状语“for 3 years”可知，该句应用现在完成时，其谓语结构为：have/has +过去分词。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Tony, do you know ______? Mrs. Black is looking for him. — Maybe he is in the lab.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼，你知道杰克在哪儿吗？布莱克太太在找他。——也许他在实验室。 考查宾语从句。分析句子结构可知，该句是宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，故排除A、B选项；根据“Maybe he is in the lab.”可知，从句的时态为一般现在时，故排除D选项。故选C。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Jump Around “Whee!” I could hear kids cheering all around me. It was Nicky’s birthday party and we were all having fun in the bounce(弹跳) house. We were jumping up as high as we could, and falling down to let the soft ground catch us. I loved  ______ 13 ______  in bounce houses! I wish I could have one in my backyard. I looked up the  ______ 14 ______  of a bounce house and found it was too expensive for me. Maybe if all of my friends and I put our money together, we could buy it! I found them playing outside and asked. Jake said, “That would be great!” “Yeah, I’m in,” replied Kate. “Good idea!” said Janie. The next day, we all put our money together and found out we had enough! I talked to my parents about my idea. “That would be a lot of fun for you and your friends. We have space in our backyard, but there are some things that I don’t think you’ve considered(考虑)  ______ 15 ______. We would have to use our electricity to blow it up every time. That would cost more money, and it would cost money to  ______ 16 ______  it if it ever got a hole(洞) in it or anything. Are you going to pay for the electricity and repairs(修理费) yourself?” Dad asked. “You’re right. I didn’t think about that…” I replied. “Maybe something besides a bounce house would  ______ 17 ______  better. What about a big trampoline(蹦床)?” Mom suggested. “That’s a great idea! We can buy a trampoline!” I said excitedly. “Great! Before we allow all your friends to use a trampoline, we need to make sure everyone will be  ______ 18 ______. We need to buy safety equipment(设备) for the trampoline, and we need to make some rules. Does that make sense?” Dad asked. “Yes,” I said. “I’ll talk to my friends tomorrow to make sure we all agree on the  ______ 19 ______.” “Perfect!” The next day, we all sat down and came up with rules. We decided that we should not push each other, we should not jump off the trampoline, and we should not land on our heads or necks. Our parents all looked over the rules, and wrote one more: we should have an adult to be outside with us. That seemed fair(公平的) to us, so we  ______ 20 ______  our money together and got a trampoline!

questions.prompt: Mr. Jackson is a popular writer, and we all like reading  ______  books.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克逊先生是个受欢迎的作家，我们都喜欢读他的书。 考查物主代词。his他的；her她的；their他们的；your你/你们的。根据空后有名词books，可知需要填形容词性物主代词；又根据前一句Mr. Jackson is a popular writer，可知此处是指“喜欢读他的书”，故选A。

questions.prompt: We have a big family dinner  ______  Chinese New Year’s Eve.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们在除夕夜吃了一顿丰盛的家庭晚餐。 考查介词辨析。at表示具体的时刻；on表示具体某一天的上午、下午或晚上；in泛指上午、下午或晚上；for表示做某事做了多久。根据“Chinese New Year’s Eve”可知此处表示的是“除夕夜”，是具体某一天晚上，用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  have you been in Beijing? —I’ve been here for ten years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你来北京多久了？——我在这里已经十年了。 考查特殊疑问词。How much多少钱，提问价格；How far多远，提问距离；How often多久一次，提问频率；How long多长时间，提问时间。根据答语“I’ve been here for ten years.”可知，问句应为提问时间，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you speak Japanese? —No, I  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会说日语吗？——不，我不会。 考查情态动词辨析。mustn’t禁止；shouldn’t不应该；can’t不会；needn’t不需要。一般疑问句用can提问，否定回答用can’t。故选C。

questions.prompt: The restaurant is very popular now,  ______ I don't like the food there.
questions.explanation: 句意：这家餐馆现在很受欢迎，但我不喜欢那里的食物。 考查连词。and和；but但是；or否则；so所以；分析句子“The restaurant is very popular now,  ______ I don't like the food there”这家餐馆现在很受欢迎， ______ 我不喜欢那里的食物，所以这两句话是转折关系，故选B。

questions.prompt: Keep quiet, please. The baby ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：请保持安静。婴儿在睡觉。 考查动词时态。根据“Keep quiet”可知，婴儿正在睡觉，所以需要保持安静，用现在进行时表示正在进行的动作，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Which do you like  ______, tea or coffee? —A cup of coffee, please.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你更喜欢哪一个，茶还是咖啡？——请给我一杯咖啡。 考查副词的比较级。good“好的”，形容词；best“最好的”，为good/well的最高级；well“好”，副词；better“更好的”，为good/well的比较级。根据语境可知，“Which+...+副词比较级, A or B?”表示两者中“哪个更……？”，better“更好”，副词比较级。故选D。

questions.prompt: The students  ______  a picnic tomorrow afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：学生们明天下午将野餐。 考查动词时态。根据“tomorrow afternoon”可知，时态应该使用一般将来时，结构为will do。故选B。

questions.prompt: —I didn’t see you yesterday. Where did you go? —I  ______  to the zoo with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我昨天没见到你你去哪儿了？——我和父母一起去了动物园。 考查动词时态。根据“yesterday”可知，说话人和父母一起去动物园是发生在昨天，句子应用一般过去时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Lucy is my friend. She  ______  in this school since she came here.
questions.explanation: 句意：露西是我的朋友。她来这里后一直在这所学校学习。 考查动词时态。根据“since she came here.”可知，since引导的时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Judy, could you tell me  ______  the schoolbag? —Oh, yes. I bought it in a store on the Internet.
questions.explanation: 句意：——朱迪，你能告诉我你在哪里买的书包吗？——哦，好的。我在网上商店买的。 考查宾语从句。本题动词tell后跟宾语从句，宾语从句应用陈述句语序，所以可以排除AB两个选项。根据“I bought it in a store on the Internet”可知，本句时态为一般过去时。故选D。 二、完形填空（共8分,每小题1分） I Broke It I stare at the broken vase on the floor. It was Mom’s favorite. Now it’s in a million pieces. It was silly to play  ______ 13 ______  inside with Mom away. I wasn’t thinking about that, though. Saturday is my team’s final match. I just wanted to practice a little more. Now I’m in  ______ 14 ______! Rusty thinks I am playing—not  ______ 15 ______  up the vase. He jumps up and down barking happily. This gives me an  ______ 16 ______. Mum comes back. Rusty jumps up to greet Mom, his tail wagging. “I’m sorry, Mom, but Rusty  ______ 17 ______  your vase,” I lie, looking at my feet. “Rusty, you bad boy!” she scolds. Rusty whines. A sick feeling rises in my heart. “You go outside,” says Mom. Rusty hangs his head in shame. “Go to your doghouse, Rusty,” I say, holding the door open. Rusty slumps to his doghouse looking sad. I close the door and try to think about something else. Then it begins to rain hard. I can’t help but  ______ 18 ______  out the window. Rusty shivers in his doghouse. That sick feeling in my heart grows. Rusty peeks (偷看) out. Rain falls down his nose as if he is crying. What have I done? I ask myself. Rusty is in trouble because of my lie. “Mom, I have something to tell you.” I say. “I was playing soccer in the house and I broke the vase.” I  ______ 19 ______  explain. “Blaming Rusty for your mistake was wrong,” Mom says. “Thank you for being  ______ 20 ______,” she adds. “Let Rusty back inside now,” she says. I open the door and Rusty runs back in. He jumps up and gives me a big lick. Suddenly, my heart feels warm.

questions.prompt: This isn’t my dictionary.  ______  is over there, on the desk.
questions.explanation: 句意：这不是我的字典。我的在那边，在桌子上。 考查代词辨析。His他的；Mine我的；Hers她的；Yours你的/你们的。根据“This isn’t my dictionary.”可知，此处表示“我的”，故选B。

questions.prompt: You’ve got a report tomorrow,  ______  you’d better prepare for it tonight.
questions.explanation: 句意：你明天有个报告，因此你最好今晚准备一下。 考查并列连词的辨析。or或者，表选择关系；so所以，表因果关系中的结果；but但是，表转折关系；for因为，表原因。根据“You’ve got a report tomorrow,…you’d better prepare for it tonight.”可知，你明天有个报告，你最好今晚准备一下，前后两句是因果关系，为前因后果，所以空处用so连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: Peter! The ice is too thin. It is dangerous. You  ______  keep out.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得！冰太薄了。这很危险。你必须留在外面。 考查情态动词辨析。could能；must必须；may可以；might可能。根据“The ice is too thin. It is dangerous.”可知，很危险所以必须留在外面。故选B。

questions.prompt: Yuan Longping is one of  ______  scientists in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：袁隆平是世界上最伟大的科学家之一。 考查形容词最高级。“one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数”表示“最……之一”，故此处要用great的最高级greatest；形容词最高级前的定冠词the不能省略。故选D。

questions.prompt: Betty often  ______  a walk with her parents after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：放学后贝蒂经常和她的父母散步。 考查动词的时态。由often可知时态是一般现在时, 主语Betty接动词第三人称单数形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: My mum  ______  on the computer when Grandma called her last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚奶奶给我妈妈打电话时，她正在电脑上工作。 考查动词时态。根据“My mum…on the computer when Grandma called her last night.”可知，空处表示在过去的某一时刻正在进行的动作，应用过去进行时，构成形式为：was/were doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What is your sister doing right now, Tony? —She  ______  her homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼，你姐姐现在在做什么？ ——她正在检查她的家庭作业。 考查动词时态。根据“What is your sister doing right now”可知，问句的时态是现在进行时，答语也应用此时态，其谓语动词构成形式为：be doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: The town  ______  a lot of pollution in the past but it is not a problem any more.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个城镇过去有很多污染，但这已经不是问题了。 考查时态。根据“in the past”可知，时态为一般过去时，动词要用过去式；have的过去式为had。故选D。 二、完形填空（每小题1分, 共8分） 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Building a Class Project (项目) David sat alone on the school bus home. He didn’t want to talk to his friends. They were all talking about their class projects for the weekend. They were  ______ 9 ______  but David wasn’t. How could they understand his feelings when their parents would be them? Nobody would  ______ 10 ______  David. His mum worked all the time and his dad never wanted to do anything with him. “How was school today?” Grandpa asked when David got home. “It was okay, I guess.” “You don’t sound like that.” David told Grandpa about the  ______ 11 ______. Each student needed to ask a grown-up for help, and together they would build something. The students needed to make a report to explain how their projects had gone. “That sounds nice,” Grandpa said “Why does it make you  ______ 12 ______?” David felt his sadness rising inside him. “I don’t have anyone to help me.” Grandpa raised his eyebrows. “Who am I?” he asked. “You’d build a project with me, Grandpa?” David said in surprise. “Sure, I would,” Grandpa said  ______ 13 ______. David’s heart seemed so light that he thought it would fly away. Maybe this project wouldn’t be so bad. They sat at the table and made a list of ideas. Finally, they  ______ 14 ______  to build a robot from old boxes. Two hours later, the robot was finished. The table was untidy, but David couldn’t stop  ______ 15 ______. “I think it’s the best robot I have ever built. Now I’ll write my report.” David said. He turned towards his room, but he stopped. He ran to Grandpa and hugged him. “Thank you for helping me, Grandpa. I had a lot of  ______ 16 ______.” Grandpa patted his shoulders. “Me, too. Now, go and write your report. Maybe next time we can make a rocket.” David smiled. He couldn’t wait any more.

questions.prompt: My English teacher Miss Wang is very kind. We all like  ______  a lot.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的英语老师王老师很和蔼。我们都很喜欢她。 考查代词辨析。him他；her她；you你；them他们。根据“Miss Wang”是女性，可知用her指代。故选B。

questions.prompt: The three Shenzhou-13 astronauts returned to Earth safely  ______  April 16, 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：2022年4月16日，神舟十三号的三名宇航员安全返回地球。 考查介词辨析。on后接具体某一天等；in后接年、月、季节等；at后接具体时刻等；to离，差。根据“April 16, 2022”可知此处表示在具体的2022年4月16日这一天，用介词on。故选A。

questions.prompt: Do enough exercise every day,  ______  you will be stronger.
questions.explanation: 句意：每天做足够的运动，你会更强壮。 考查连词辨析。but但是；or否则；and和；for因为。“每天做足够的运动”与“你会更强壮”之间是顺承关系，此处用“祈使句+and+陈述句”结构。故选C。

questions.prompt: The boys in our class trained hard and  ______  the football match last Wednesday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们班的男生刻苦训练，赢得了上周三的足球赛。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语“last Wednesday”可知，时态是一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Tony, be quiet, please. Your father  ______  an online meeting in the study. —No problem, Mum.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼，请安静。你父亲正在书房里开网络会议。——没问题，妈妈。 考查时态。根据“Tony, be quiet, please.”可知说话时正在开网络会议，用现在进行时，其结构为am/is/are doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: The old man  ______  his dog for a walk after dinner every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：这位老人每天晚饭后带他的狗散步。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语“every day”可知，本句是一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数，故空格处是动词的单三形式takes。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Sara, do you know ______  the Science Museum? —Next Monday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——萨拉，你知道我们什么时候去参观科学博物馆吗？——下周一早上。 考查宾语从句。根据答语“Next Monday morning.”可知，时态是一般将来时，故排除A、B两项；宾语从句应为陈述句语序，故排除D选项。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 从每题给出的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Caring for Rio My brother Sam and I wanted a pet. “You are both in school, and I am at work all day. Pets like cats and dogs need lots of attention,” Mum suggested we think of other kinds of pets. We decided on a  ______ 9 ______. The next weekend, we saw a small parrot at a pet shop. His name was Rio, and he knew how to talk. When he said “Hello there,” Sam and I knew Rio was a perfect  ______ 10 ______  for us. Mum agreed we could take Rio home if we  ______ 11 ______  to take good care of him. As soon as we got home, Mum showed us how to line (铺) the bottom of Rio’s cage with newspaper. “You have to change the paper every other day,” she told us. “Rio should always have a  ______ 12 ______  cage. You also have to give him fresh food and water every day.” Rio was a very smart bird. We soon taught him to say our names. Sam and I made a  ______ 13 ______. We each would care for Rio three days a week, and we would work together on Sundays. Later I got busy with football practice and visits with friends. Sometimes I  ______ 14 ______  to change the newspaper. Sam noticed and began to do my job. Soon Sam was caring for Rio seven days a week. I thought it was  ______ 15 ______  until one day Sam and I came home and Rio said, “Hello, Sam. I love you, Sam.” “Hey Rio, what about me?” I asked. I tried to get him to say hello to me, but he just looked at me. “Maybe he does not like me any more,” I said to Mum. “Maybe he knows Sam is taking care of him, and you are not,” Mum said. That night I  ______ 16 ______  changed clean newspaper for Rio and gave him some food. The very next day I asked Sam if I could care for Rio for the next three weeks.

questions.prompt: This is my sister.  ______  name is Grace.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我的妹妹。她的名字叫Grace。 考查物主代词。My我的； Its它的； Her她的； His他的。根据前面的my sister可知是女性。故选C。

questions.prompt: Cambridge is a beautiful city  ______  the east of England.
questions.explanation: 句意：剑桥是英国东部一个美丽的城市。 考查介词词义辨析。on在……端/边，表示方位，即一个地方在另一个地方的某一端或某一边，两个地方只是相邻或接壤，却互不管辖；at在(某地)，在……里，在……上，在……旁，接近……，靠近(某处)，表示方位；in 在……之内，表示方位，即一个小地方处在一个大地方的范围(疆域)之内；to在……面，表示方位，即一个地方在另一个地方的范围之外，互不管辖。尤其当两个地方相隔较远，且有湖泊、大海等区域相隔时，通常用 to。剑桥属于英国范围内的城市。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  did you travel to Shanghai? — By train.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你是怎么去上海的？——乘火车。 考查特殊疑问句。What什么；How怎样；Why为什么；When什么时候。答语“By train.”表方式，故用How提问。故选B。

questions.prompt: Bring a coat  ______  it will soon become cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：带件外套，因为很快就会变冷。 考查连词辨析。because因为；so因此；but但是；and和。上文“带件外套”和下文“很快会变冷”之间是因果关系，下文表原因，故用because连接。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Must I bring the dictionary to school? —No, you  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我必须把字典带到学校吗？——不，你不必。 考查Must引导的一般疑问句。can’t不能；needn’t不必；shouldn’t不应该；mustn’t表禁止。Must引导的一般疑问句，否定回答是No, you needn’t或you don’t have to。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tony is  ______  of the three boys. He can carry this big box.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼是三个男孩中最强壮的。他能提这个大箱子。 考查形容词最高级。strong强壮的；stronger比较强壮的；strongest最强壮的； the strongest最强壮的。形容词最高级用于三者及以上，且前需要加the。根据“of the three boys”可知，此处应用最高级。故选D。

questions.prompt: Football is  ______  than basketball in many countries.
questions.explanation: 句意：在许多国家，足球比篮球更受欢迎。 考查比较级。popular受欢迎的，原级；more popular更受欢迎的，比较级；most popular最受欢迎的，最高级；the most popular最受欢迎的，the+最高级。根据“than”可知，此处是比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: Betty usually  ______  housework to help her mother, but her elder brother doesn’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：Betty通常做家务来帮助妈妈，但她的哥哥不做。 考查时态。根据usually可知“通常”是频度副词，是一般现在时态的标志；主语Betty是第三人称单数，故填does。故选A。

questions.prompt: — What were you doing at 3 o’clock yesterday afternoon? — We  ______  a tea party.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天下午3点你在做什么？——我们正在举行茶会。 考查时态。根据“at 3 o’clock yesterday afternoon”可知“昨天下午3点”是过去的具体时间点，是过去进行时的标志。故选D。

questions.prompt: My father and I  ______  a table tennis game on TV last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲和我昨晚在电视上看了一场乒乓球比赛。 考查动词时态。根据“last night”可知，时态是一般过去时，谓语动词用其过去式。故选A。

questions.prompt: If you want to visit Beijing Winter Olympic Park, I  ______  a ticket for you tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你想参观北京冬奥公园，我明天会给你订一张票。 考查动词时态。根据“tomorrow”可知，时态是一般将来时，结构是will do。故选D。

questions.prompt: My parents asked me  ______  my sister with her schoolwork.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父母要求我在妹妹的学业上帮助她。 考查非谓语动词。ask sb. to do sth.“要求某人做某事”，不定式做宾语补足语。故选C。 二、完形填空（共 8 分，每小题 1 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Sand and Stone Two friends, Ahmad and Ismail, were walking across the desert. The journey was long, and they were very tired from walking in the hot, hot sun. Ismail wanted to  ______ 13 ______, but Ahmad was not ready for it. “We have a long way to go,” he said, “We must walk a few more kilometres before we can stop.” They began to argue (争吵). Ahmad became so angry that he hit Ismail. Ismail fell to his knees in the sand. He was  ______ 14 ______  and angry. With his finger, he wrote in the  ______ 15 ______, “Here, my friend hit me.” The friends went on their journey across the desert. Not a word was spoken between them. After a long time, they came to an oasis (绿洲) with palm trees and a pool of water. Excited, Ismail ran toward the cool water. But, as he came near the water, he  ______ 16 ______  that he couldn’t run any more. The sand was wet. He was pulled down into it, and he couldn’t climb out. He sank (下沉) further and further into the sand, and he became very  ______ 17 ______. He shouted to Ahmad, “Help me! Help me！”Ahmad ran forward and reached across the dangerous sand. He took his friend’s arm and pulled him to safety. Then Ismail took out his  ______ 18 ______  and on a stone near them, he carved (刻下) these words: “Here, my friend helped me.” “But why,” said Ahmad, “did you write in the sand when I hit you? But when I helped you, you carved the words in the stone?” “Ah,” said Ismail, “When you hit me, I wrote it in the sand because soon the  ______ 19 ______  will blow the words away and I won’t remember it any more. But when you helped me, I carved the words in the stone because I’ll never  ______ 20 ______  that.”

questions.prompt: Our school is going to have a sports meeting tomorrow.  ______  is ready now.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校明天要开运动会。一切都准备好了。 考查代词辨析。Something某件事情；Everything每件事情；Anything任何事情；Nothing没有事情。根据前句“Our school is going to have a sports meeting tomorrow.”语境可知，应是一切准备就绪。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  honey do we need, Jane? —About one spoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们需要多少蜂蜜，简？——大约一勺。 考查特殊疑问词辨析。How many多少，对可数名词复数的数量提问；How often多久一次，对频率提问；How far多远，对距离提问；How much多少，对不可数名词的量提问。根据honey“蜂蜜”，是不可数名词可知应用How much提问，故选D。

questions.prompt: Jim is at a bus stop. He is going to take a bus ______  school.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jim在公交站。他要坐公交车去学校。 考查介词辨析。on在……上面；in在……里面；to去；at在。to表示“朝……方向，向……方向”，指朝着目的地的方向，to后跟表示目的地的名词。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Is Tom ______  than Peter? —Yes, he is.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆比彼得更外向吗? ——是的，他是。 考查形容词比较级。根据than“比”可知是汤姆和彼得二者作比较，应用outgoing的比较级形式。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Does Tara often get up as  ______  as Tina? —No, she doesn’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tara经常和Tina起床一样早吗？——不，Tara没有Tina起床早。 考查副词原级。as... as “和……一样……”，中间用副词early的原级。故选A。

questions.prompt: Which is  ______  season in Beijing? I think it’s spring.
questions.explanation: 句意：在北京最好的季节是什么？我认为是春天。good形容词，好的；well副词，好；best最高级，最好；the best最好，形容词最高级前加定冠词the。本句是在一个范围内进行比较，所以形容词good使用最高级形式best。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  you play tennis, Mary? —No, I can’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Mary，你会打网球吗？——不，我不会。 考查情态动词。Can会，能够；May可能；Must必须；Should应该。根据“No, I can’t.”可知此处是Can开头的一般疑问句。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Where did you go on vacation last summer, Jack? —I  ______  to the mountains.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你去年夏天去哪儿度假了，杰克？——我去了山里。 考查时态。根据“last summer”可知要回答过去做了什么，用一般过去时，此处用过去式went。故选B。

questions.prompt: Keep quiet, everyone! The students  ______  a lesson in the classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：大家保持安静！学生们正在教室上课。 考查时态。根据“Keep quiet, everyone!”可知现在正在上课，用现在进行时，其结构为am/is/are doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Do you plan  ______  for a party this weekend? —Yes, we do.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你计划准备这个周末的聚会吗？——是的，我们计划了。 考查非谓语动词。结合语境和空前“plan”可知问句用“plan to do sth计划做某事”，所以这里用动词不定式作宾语。故选A。

questions.prompt: If I have time, I  ______  my parents with the housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果我有时间，我会帮父母做家务。 考查主将从现。此句是if引导的条件状语从句，空处所在句为主句，遵循“主将从现”的时态原则，因此这里用一般将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to go shopping with me? — ______
questions.explanation: 句意：——你愿意和我一起去购物吗？——当然，我乐意去。 考查情景交际。No, I don’t think so不，我不这么认为；OK, I’ll take them好的，我要买下它们；Sorry, I don’t抱歉，我不会；Sure, I’d love to当然，我乐意去。根据“Would you like to go shopping with me”可知，对于对方的邀请应表示同意或拒绝，D选项符合语境，故选D。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Great Friendship Mark and Jarryd are good friends from Sydney.  ______ 13 ______  of them enjoy playing Australian football. A few years ago, when Mark was nine, he had a brain cancer（脑癌）. It made the boy lose his  ______ 14 ______  and part of his hearing. As a result, Mark couldn’t play football any more. However, Jarryd still shared his love of Australian football with Mark. And they still  ______ 15 ______  about the Sydney Swans, the team they like best, together. One day I took my seat at Sydney Cricket Ground to  ______ 16 ______  the Swans. The old stadium（体育馆）was crowded with football fans. Shortly into the second quarter（局）, I heard some great commentary（现场解说）from a  ______ 17 ______. This was Jarryd. He was sitting next to Mark. Although Mark couldn’t see any more, he still loved the Swans very much. Usually, he went to the stadium and  ______ 18 ______  to the commentary on the radio. However, in the second quarter of that match, the radio broke down. Just at that time I  ______ 19 ______  watched the Swans and the team’s star player, Buddy. Instead, the voice between Jarryd and Mark came to my ears. “What’s happening now,” Mark asked. “Don’t worry, Mark（进球）! Buddy is on fire!” Mark listened carefully. He was  ______ 20 ______  in the magic of Australian football brought to life by his friend. Here, Jarryd and Mark moved me deeply with their great friendship.

questions.prompt: — George, the bike looks cool. Is it  ______? — Yes. My mother bought it for my birthday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——乔治，这辆自行车看起来很酷。它是你的吗？——是的。我妈妈给我买的生日礼物。 考查名词性物主代词。his他的；yours你的；hers她的；ours我们的。分析语境可知，此处询问乔治，表示“它是你的吗？”的含义，故选B。

questions.prompt: I often go on holiday with my parents  ______  summer.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常在夏天和我的父母去度假。 考查介词辨析。on后常接星期或具体的时间；at后常接时刻；in后常接早中晚，季节，年份等；of……的。“summer”是季节，用介词in。故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  I got home, my sister was doing her homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我到家的时候，我的妹妹正在做回家作业。 考查连词。Though尽管； Because因为；If如果；When当……时候。根据“I got home, my sister was doing her homework”可知，当我到家的时候，妹妹正在做作业，此处表示时间，应用连词When引导时间状语从句。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Excuse me, sir.  ______  is it from here to No.6 Middle School? — It’s about 10 minutes’ walk.
questions.explanation: 句意：——对不起，先生。从这里到第六中学有多远?——步行约10分钟。考查疑问词辨析题。A. How soon多快，指多久以后，表速度；B. How far多远，表距离；C. How much多少，表数量，修饰不可数名词/表价格；D. How often多久一次，表频率。根据答语It’s about 10 minutes’ walk.，可知问的是距离，故选B。 【点睛】这几个以how引起的副词短语是英语考试中的基础题型，是必考内容。答题前首先要理解每个选项的基本含义及用法，并注意交叉含义间的区别，然后根据问答语之间的逻辑关系，以及该疑问词在句子中承担的句子成分选择正确答案。

questions.prompt: — Which sport do you think is  ______, swimming or skating? — Skating.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认为游泳和滑冰哪个运动更有趣？——滑冰。 考查形容词比较级。interesting形容词原级；more interesting形容词比较级；most interesting形容词最高级；the most interesting是the加形容词最高级。根据后文“swimming or skating”可知，是两者之间比较，所以需用形容词比较级形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: Linda is a tennis player. She  ______  to play tennis when she was five years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：琳达是个网球运动员。她五岁时开始打网球。 考查一般过去时。结合语境和“when she was five years old”可知，此处表示发生在过去的事，应用一般过去时，故应用began。故选C。

questions.prompt: Dad  ______  young kids how to play football every Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爸爸每个星期六教小孩子踢足球。 考查一般现在时。结合语境和“every Saturday”可知，该句是一般现在时，由于主语“Dad”是第三人称单数形式，故谓语也应用动词的三单形式，teach的三单形式是teaches。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Henry. I called you last night, but you didn’t answer. —Sorry. I  ______  TV at that time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，亨利。我昨晚打电话给你，但你没接。——对不起。我那时正在看电视。 考查过去进行时。结合语境和“at that time”可知，这里表达的是“那时正在做某事”，英语中要用过去进行时，结构是“was/were doing”形式，由于句子主语是“I”，所以要用was。故选D。 二、完形填空(共8分，每小题1分) 阅读下面的短文，根据其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、口四个选项中选出最佳选项。 On a snowy evening, a rich woman was standing by the road. She was very worried. Her  ______ 9 ______  had broken down. Just then a poor man named Robert came. He was on his way back home from work as usual. The woman wondered, “Is the man going to  ______ 10 ______  me? He looks very cold and hungry.” But to her surprise, he  ______ 11 ______  and said with a smile, “Can I help you, madam?” After forty minutes, the car was at last fixed (修理) by Robert. The woman wanted to pay him. “No, that’s nothing, madam,” he said. “I was just helping someone in  ______ 12 ______. If you really want to pay me back, I hope whenever you see someone in need, you should give him a hand.” A few minutes later, the woman saw a shabby (破旧的) house by the road. She  ______ 13 ______  Robert’s words, so she stopped. The hostess (女主人) was very happy to see her,  ______ 14 ______  asked her in and went to the kitchen to make tea for her. The woman could see that was a poor family and that they needed help. When the hostess was making tea in the kitchen, the woman  ______ 15 ______  500 dollars on a table and went away quietly. Robert came home later than before, thinking how  ______ 16 ______  their life was. His wife was pregnant (怀孕) and the baby was to be born the next month, but there was not enough money. His wife went up to him, gave him a kiss and said softly, “Don’t worry, dear! Everything is going to be all right. A stranger has helped us out.” Let’s always be ready to help others because helping others is helping ourselves.

questions.prompt: My sister likes many subjects at school.  ______  favorite one is art.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姐姐在学校喜欢很多科目。她最喜欢的是美术。 考查代词辨析。My我的；Your你的；Her她的；His他的。根据“My sister likes many subjects at school.”可知，空处是指姐姐最喜欢的科目，用her指代“我姐姐的”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Beihai Park is so quiet that people can hardly believe it’s  ______  the city center.
questions.explanation: 句意：北海公园静谧得让人不敢相信它就在市中心。 考查介词辨析。on在……边/端，侧重与另一个物体表面相接触；to在……面，表示一个地方在另一个地方的范围之外；in在……里面，表示在范围之内；of属于……的。根据“...the city center.”可知，此处是指在市中心，用介词in。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  have you collected stamps? —For about three years.
