questions.explanation: 句意：——你集邮多久了？——大约三年。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长时间；How many多少；How much多少；How often多久一次。根据“For about three years.”可知，是对一段时间进行提问，用How long 。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Lily,  ______  you help me with my homework after school? — Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——莉莉，放学后你能在家庭作业上帮助我吗？——我可以。 考查动词辨析。must必须；should应该；need需要；can能够。根据“Yes, I can.”可知，此处是can引导的一般疑问句。故选D。

questions.prompt: My father didn’t play basketball with me yesterday  ______  he was very busy.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲昨天没有和我一起打篮球，因为他很忙。 考查连词辨析。but但是；because因为；although尽管；so因此。根据“My father didn’t play basketball with me yesterday...he was very busy.”可知，句子前后是因果关系，前果后因，用because连接句子。故选B。

questions.prompt: Poyang Lake is  ______  freshwater lake in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：鄱阳湖是中国最大的淡水湖。 考查形容词最高级。根据“ in China.”可知此处是在整个中国里进行比较，应用形容词最高级，故选D。

questions.prompt: —You  ______  pale. Are you feeling all right? —I’m OK. Don’t worry.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你看起来脸色苍白。你感觉还好吗？——我很好。别担心。 考查系动词辨析。look看起来；taste尝起来；smell闻起来；sound听起来。根据下文“I’m OK. Don’t worry.”可知，此处是“你看起来脸色苍白”，故选A。

questions.prompt: Betty always  ______  out to take a walk with her friends on weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂周末总是和她的朋友出去散步。 考查动词时态。根据“always”以及“on weekends”可知，本句时态为一般现在时。故选A。

questions.prompt: My mother  ______  in the kitchen when I got home yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天晚上我回到家时，我妈妈正在厨房做饭。 考查动词时态。根据“when I got home yesterday evening.”可知，此处是指我到家的时候，妈妈正坐在做饭。表示过去正在进行的动作，用过去进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: Zhang Guimei  ______  as a teacher in Yunnan Province since 1990.
questions.explanation: 句意：张桂梅自1990年起在云南省任教。 考查动词时态。根据“since 1990”可知，本句时态为现在完成时，故选B。

questions.prompt: The government  ______  a new road near our school next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：明年政府将我们学校附近修建一条新道路。 考查动词时态。根据“next year”可知，本句时态是一般将来时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Jenny, could you tell me  ______  the T-shirt? It’s beautiful. —OK. Thanks. I bought it in a shop on the Internet.
questions.explanation: 句意：——珍妮，你能告诉我你在哪里买的T恤吗？ 它很漂亮。——好的。 谢谢。 我在网上的一家商店买的。 考查宾语从句。根据“could you tell me...”可知，此处是宾语从句，需用陈述语序，可排除B、D选项；再根据“I bought it in a shop on the Internet.”可知，买衬衫这件事发生在过去，需用一般过去时。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Never Stop Trying Martha was born in a poor family in the countryside in Africa, and people need to pay much money for school. As a result, it was never  ______ 13 ______  for her to have a life that she wanted. However, at the age of 14, she  ______ 14 ______  to get an education(教育). Martha believed that if she held her head high and had enough training, she would achieve the goal (实现目标) that other people only dreamed of. At the age of 15, she started looking for ways to make money for her education. Her father left his family, leaving his children with no other choices but to  ______ 15 ______  out of school. Martha was ready to show the world that she would not be broken and nothing was going to stop her from being a respected(受人尊敬的) member of society. She found a way of  ______ 16 ______  a hair product but there wasn’t much money she made.  ______ 17 ______, the little money she had would go a long way. At the age of 16, Martha managed to put herself through high school. After high school, her uncle put her through college where she studied science for 2 years. At 22, she graduated and worked for the Red Cross and her life changed for the  ______ 18 ______. A few years later, one of the best companies in her country heard about her ability(能力) and graduate hard work and asked her to work for them. Today, Martha is one of the most  ______ 19 ______  women in her family. Martha has also changed the lives of her family members just as she planned. She never gave up and today she is able to walk with her  ______ 20 ______  high and she is telling you that with an education and a clear goal, you can achieve anything.

questions.prompt: My brother and I like museums.  ______  often visit them on weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥和我喜欢博物馆。我们经常在周末去参观。 考查代词辨析。I我；We我们；They它们；You你们。根据“My brother and I like museums”和“visit”可知，空处指“我和我哥哥”，所以用we指代。故选B。

questions.prompt: The first Chinese team reached the top of Qomolangma  ______  1960.
questions.explanation: 句意：1960年，第一支中国团队登顶喜马拉雅山。 考查介词。on在……时候（后接具体日期）；at在；in在……时候（后接抽象时间）；to去。根据“1960”可知，此处应用介词in，表示“在1960年”。故选C。

questions.prompt: The Yangtze River is almost as  ______  as the Amazon River.
questions.explanation: 句意：长江几乎和亚马逊河一样长。 考查原级比较。as...as“和……一样”，中间加形容词或副词的原级，long“长的”，是形容词，此处是指“两条河几乎一样长”，故选B。

questions.prompt: The cute dog caught my eyes  ______  I walked into the pet store.
questions.explanation: 句意：我一走进宠物店，那只可爱的狗就吸引了我的注意。 考查连词辨析。as soon as一……就；ever since从那时起；although虽然；unless除非。根据句意可知，“I walked into the pet store”是“The cute dog caught my eyes”的时间状语，表示一走进去，就被吸引住了，故选A。

questions.prompt: Our class  ______  in an old people’s home next summer vacation.
questions.explanation: 句意：明年暑假，我们班要去敬老院参加志愿工作。 考查动词时态。根据“next summer vacation”可知，此处应用一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  my mom do the dishes when Jimmy called in at eight last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚八点Jimmy来访时，我正在帮妈妈洗碗。 考查过去进行时。根据“when Jimmy called in at eight last night.”可知描述的是昨晚八点正在发生的动作，因此句子应用过去进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: My grandpa  ______  in this neighborhood since he was ten years old. He knows everyone here.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从他十岁起，我的爷爷就住在这个社区。他认识这里的每个人。 考查现在完成时。根据“since he was ten years old”可知该句应用现在完成时。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  you explain to me how to do this math problem, Tom? —Sure, no problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你能给我解释一下怎么做这道数学题吗？——当然没问题。 考查情态动词。must必须；could（礼貌地请求别人做事）能，能否；should应该；may可以（征求同意或表示允许），常与第一人称I连用。根据“you explain to me how to do this math problem, Tom”可知，此处是礼貌地请求别人帮忙，应用委婉语气，主语是you，所以用could。故选B。 五、语法填空（每题1分, 共4分） 阅读下列短文, 根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写1个适当的单词, 在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 Scientists say there are now  ______ 24 ______  (few) than 2, 000 pandas living in the forests. Another 300 or so live in zoos or research centers in China and other  ______ 25 ______  (country). Pandas don’t have many babies and the babies often die from illnesses. Adult pandas spend over 12 hours a day  ______ 26 ______  (eat) about 10 kilos of bamboo. However, the bamboo forests are getting smaller because of human activities. Luckily, Chinese people are trying their best  ______ 27 ______  (save) pandas. Let’s just hope things will get better soon. 【答案】24. fewer

questions.prompt: Many people think that doing sports can help  ______  keep fit.
questions.explanation: 句意：许多人认为做运动可以帮助他们保持健康。 考查代词辨析。they他们，主格；them他们，宾格；their他们的，形容词性物主代词；theirs他们的，名词性物主代词。help sb do sth“帮助某人做某事”，动词help后用宾格them“他们”。故选B。

questions.prompt: Janek and the team got to the pole  ______  April 24th, 2004.
questions.explanation: 句意：雅内克和探险队于2004年4月24日到达了极点。 考查时间介词的用法。in后接某年某月某季节；at后接具体时刻；of……的；on后接具体一天。根据“April 24th, 2004”可知，此处是具体的一天，应填介词on，故选D。

questions.prompt: I like playing ping-pong,  ______  I’m not very good at it.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢打乒乓球，但是我不是很擅长。 but但是，表转折关系；and和，表并列关系；so所以，表因果关系；or或者，表选择关系。根据空格前的“like playing ping-pong”和空格后的“not very good at it”可知这两句是转折关系。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Excuse me,  ______  I have the seat next to the window? — Yes of course.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，我可以坐靠窗的座位吗？——是的，当然可以。 考查情态动词。must必须；should应该；need需要；may可以。根据“...I have the seat next to the window?”及“Yes, of course.”可知，此处表示委婉的请求，应用情态动词may。故选D。

questions.prompt: Sandy is only 12 years old.She is  ______  on the team.
questions.explanation: 句意：桑迪只有12岁。她是队里最年轻的。 考查形容词最高级用法。首先题目中已经给定范围是“on the team”，再根据“Sandy is only 12 years old”可知，她只有12岁，是在给定的范围内比较要用形容词最高级，形容词最高级前要加定冠词the。故选D。

questions.prompt: ---- do you go shopping? ----Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：-你多久购物一次？-一周一次。A.多长；B.多少；C.多久一次；D.多久以后，通过答句可以知道是在提问频率，用how often，故选C。 【点睛】How often, how long, how far与 how soon的区别：1、How often有“多久一次”的意思，是就做某事的频率提问。针对How often的回答一般是 ：Twice a year, Three times a week。e.g. —How often do you watch TV?—Three times a week. 2、How long表示 “时间多久或物体多长”， 表示时间侧重指 “一段时间”。针对 “How long” 的回答一般是时间段，如 “for three days”, “three years”。e.g. —How long were you away last year? —About two weeks. 3、How far 是提问“路程有多远”，询问距离的。e.g How far is it from his house? 距离他家有多远？ 4、How soon表示 “多久之后”，主要用来对表示将来的一段时间提问。How soon的回答一般是：“ in + 时间段”，如 “ in two days” “in five years”。 e.g. —How soon will you be ready? —I’ll be ready in five minutes.

questions.prompt: ______  we can get Vitamin D from food, we can also get it from the sun.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然我们可以从食物中获得维生素D，但我们也可以从太阳中获得。 考查从属连词的词义辨析。Although虽然；For因为；Because因为；If如果。根据“we can get Vitamin D from food”和“we can also get it from the sun.”可知，空格前后是让步关系，因此可用Although引导让步状语从句。故选A。

questions.prompt: — How was your weekend, Jack? — Good. I  ______  lots of new games with my sister.
questions.explanation: 句意：——周末过得怎么样，杰克？——很好。我和妹妹玩了很多新游戏。 考查一般过去时。根据“How was your weeken”可知，时态是一般过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: My aunt and uncle  ______  in the yard when their dog became really noisy.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们的狗叫得很大声时，我姑姑和姑父正在院子里工作。 考查过去进行时。根据“when their dog became really noisy”可知，空格处表示在过去某一时刻(狗叫得很大声时)姑姑和姑父正在进行的动作，应用过去进行时：was/were doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: It’s rainy and cloudy today. Dad and I  ______  the art museum tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天阴雨连绵。爸爸将和我明天去参观艺术博物馆。 考查一般将来时。visit参观；动词原形；visited参观，动词的过去式；will visit将参观；are visiting正在参观。根据“tomorrow”可知，本句的时态是一般将来时，其谓语结构是will+动词原形。故选C。

questions.prompt: Tom, where is your mum? Oh, she  ______  in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你妈妈在哪里？——哦，她正在厨房做饭。 根据where is your mum?可知此处询问你妈妈现在正在哪里，故用现在进行时be doing，故选C。

questions.prompt: Mr. Jiang  ______  children to swim every weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：每个周末蒋老师都教孩子们游泳。 考查一般现在时。is teaching教，用于现在进行时；teaches教，用于一般现在时；taught教，用于一般过去时；will teach将要教，用于一般将来时。根据时间状语“every weekend”可知，本句需用一般现在时。故选B。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 Tom loved cars more than anything else. This spring he thought of building a model car to enter for a competition. So he asked his dad for  ______ 13 ______. “Well,” Dad said. “How about this: you do some research first and then come back to me with a design (设计).” A week later, Tom brought his notes and drawings to Dad. Dad looked over his work, thinking. “Well, that’s interesting,” he said. “Try to  ______ 14 ______  it as you’ve designed.” Over three weekends of hard work, Tom turned his design into a real model car and  ______ 15 ______  it light blue. Dad asked Tom to take it for a test drive. Tom agreed. After a while, Tom came back to Dad. “Well,” he said. “Now I know  ______ 16 ______  you wanted me to have a test drive. When I drove fast, there was a problem with it.” “Very good!” Dad said. “So, why didn’t you tell me about that  ______ 17 ______  in the first place?” Sally asked. Dad laughed. “Where’s the fun in that? If you give a man a fish, he’ll eat for a day. But if you  ______ 18 ______ a man to fish, he’ll eat for a lifetime.” Tom said, “I see. Anyway, designing is half the fun!” Dad smiled. “Good. Sometimes, learning happens during the process.We learn how to do something right by doing it a few times first and making  ______ 19 ______  along the way.” That encouraged Tom and he worked even harder. The competition doesn’t seem as  ______ 20 ______. He had already learned a lot by building something better than ever before.

questions.prompt: ______  people all over the world will watch the 2022 Winter Olympics online.
questions.explanation: 句意：全世界数百万人将在线观看2022年冬奥会。 考查million的用法。million“百万”，当million前有数词时，用单数，和of连用时，用复数，故选D。

questions.prompt: It’s cloudy outside. It  ______  rain, so you’d better bring an umbrella with you.
questions.explanation: 句意：外面多云。可能会下雨，所以你最好带把伞。 考查情态动词。can能；may可能；should应该；need需要，根据“It’s cloudy outside”和“so you’d better bring an umbrella with you”可知，应该是可能会下雨，用may，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Jack, what do you think of our after-school clubs? — The AI Club is  ______  than the Chess Club.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你觉得我们的课后俱乐部怎么样？——AI俱乐部比国际象棋俱乐部更令人愉快。 考查形容词比较级。通过“than”可知，此处是在将国际象棋俱乐部和AI俱乐部进行对比，空格出应用比较级。enjoyable“令人愉快的”，形容词，比较级为“more enjoyable”，表示“更令人愉快的”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Betty practises speaking more often  ______  her Chinese.
questions.explanation: 句意：Betty经常练习口语以提高她的汉语水平。 考查非谓语动词。improve“提高”，根据空前的“Betty practises speaking more often”和空后的“her Chinese”可知，应该是练习口语以提高她的汉语水平，用动词不定式作目的状语，故选B。

questions.prompt: Of all the children, Amy listens to the story Tom Sawyer  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：在所有的孩子中，艾米最认真地听《汤姆索亚历险记》的故事。 考查形容词最高级。根据“Of all the children”可知，表示在所有孩子范围内比较，应用形容词或副词的最高级，carefullly”小心地“，副词，其最高级形式为“most carefully”，副词最高级前面的the可以省略。故选C。

questions.prompt: Peter  ______  on the players at the stadium at eight o’clock yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得昨天晚上八点钟在体育场为运动员加油。 考查过去进行时。cheer加油，欢呼。根据题干中的“at eight o’clock yesterday evening”以及句意可知，句子为过去进行时。过去进行时结构为“was/were + doing”。题干主语为“Peter”，所以be动词为was。故选A。 （二）根据短文内容，从各题所给的 A、B 两个选项中选出正确选项。 A Travelling can be either cheap or costly. It often depends on how far you want to travel and the choice of transport (交通工具). Riding a bicycle is  ______ 7 ______  than driving a car, because it will not cost anything as you power it by your legs. However, the use of a bicycle can be hard work and can take a lot of time to travel long distances (距离). Cars and motorcycles are faster ways of transport,  ______ 8 ______  they are more expensive to use as they need a lot of gas (汽油) to work.

questions.prompt: — Tim, have you ever heard the song Together for a Shared Future? — Yes, it  ______  beautiful.
questions.explanation: 句意：——蒂姆，你听过《一起向未来》这首歌吗？ ——是的，听起来很美。 考查系动词。smells闻起来；sounds听起来；feels摸起来；looks看起来。根据“have you ever heard the song Together for a Shared Future?”可知，《一起向未来》是一首歌曲，应该是听起来很美。故选B。

questions.prompt: So far China  ______  nine manned spaceships into space.
questions.explanation: 句意：到目前为止，中国已经向太空发射了九艘载人飞船。 考查现在完成时。由提示词So far 可知，这里用现在完成时，其结构是：助动词have/has+动词的过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: Su Yiming  ______  snowboarding since he was four years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：苏翊鸣从四岁开始练习单板滑雪。 考查动词时态。根据“since he was four years old.”可知句子是现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: When my aunt was young, she  ______  of being a presenter.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我姑姑年轻的时候，她梦想成为一名主持人。 考查时态。根据“When my aunt was young”可知，时态是一般过去时，动词使用过去式。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Emma,  ______  have you been in Beijing? —For about two years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——艾玛，你在北京多长时间了？——大概两年了。 考查疑问词how far多远，对距离提问；how often多久一次，对频率提问；how long多长时间，对时间段提问；how soon多久，对将要用多长时间提问。根据“For about two years.”可知此处对时间段提问，故用疑问词how long。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Could you please tell me  ______? — Next Friday.

choices.label: A
choices.text: when we visit the Science Museum

choices.label: B
choices.text: when do we visit the Science Museum

choices.label: C
choices.text: when will we visit the Science Museum

choices.label: D
choices.text: when we will visit the Science Museum

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我我们什么时候参观科学博物馆吗？——下周五。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句用陈述语序，排除B和C；根据答语“Next Friday.”可知，问句从句用一般将来时。故选D。 （二）根据短文内容，从各题所给的 A、B 两个选项中选出正确选项。 A My name’s Albert and I’m a lifeguard (救生员). I’ve worked here for 4 years  ______ 19 ______  I really love my job. I have saved some lives. It’s nice to know that my job is important to keep people safe while they’re resting and having fun at the beach. I also like to know that my advice is useful to them. I  ______ 20 ______  from Tuesday to Saturday, from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm and rest two Sundays a month. My friends think I should take a time off and go out during the weekend, but I can’t imagine doing anything else.

questions.prompt: Lily has a little brother. She wants to buy a birthday gift for  ______  today. A her
questions.explanation: 句意：Lily有一个小弟弟。今天她想要给他买一个生日礼物。 考查人称代词宾格。her她；him他；you你；them他们，根据“Lily has a little brother”可知，应该是给他买一个生日礼物，故选B。

questions.prompt: My father gets up  ______  6:00 every day, then he prepares breakfast in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的爸爸每天六点起床，然后他在厨房准备早餐。 考查介词辨析。at在，后接时间点；in在，后接月份，年份；on在，后接具体的某一天；to朝。根据空后的时间点“6:00”可知，此空应该用介词at。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Did you have a nice weekend, Lucy? —Yes. I ______  back to my hometown to visit my grandparents. We had a good time together.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Lucy，你周末过得愉快吗？——是的。我回到故乡去拜访我的祖父母。我们一起度过了一段美好的时光。 考查时态。根据“Did you have a nice weekend, Lucy?”可知，时态为一般过去时。go back“回去”，故此空应该用go的过去式went。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Mike,  ______  you swim? —No, I can’t. But my brother will teach me to swim this summer holiday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Mike，你会游泳吗？——不，我不会。但我的哥哥这个暑假会教我游泳的。 考查情态动词词义辨析。should应该；must必须；can能，会；need需要。根据答语“No, I can’t. ”可知，此处问的是你会游泳吗？应使用can引导一般疑问句，故选C。

questions.prompt: Jack is good at basketball. He is  ______  basketball player in his school.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jack很擅长打篮球。他是他的学校里最好的篮球运动员。 考查形容词的最高级。根据“in his school”可知，此处指的是他是他的学校里最好的篮球运动员，应使用形容词的最高级修饰名词basketball player ，作定语，形容词的最高级前要使用定冠词the，故选D。

questions.prompt: My uncle is in a volunteer group. He  ______  some young children to read books every weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：我叔叔参加了一个志愿者小组。他每个周末教一些小孩子读书。 考查动词第三人称单数。teach“教”，根据“every weekend”可知，时态是一般现在时，主语“he”是第三人称单数，所以空缺处用第三人称单数，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you play tennis? —Twice a week. I go to the gym to play tennis with my sister.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久打一次网球？——一周两次。我和姐姐去体育馆打网球。 考查特殊疑问句。How many许多，修饰可数名词复数；How often多久一次；How long多长时间；How much多少，修饰不可数名词，根据答句的“Twice a week”可知，应该问的是频率，用how often，故选B。

questions.prompt: You should keep your hands clean  ______  it helps you stay healthy. A when
questions.explanation: 句意：你应该保持双手清洁因为这样能帮助你保持健康。 考查连词词义辨析。when当……时；although尽管；because因为；but但是。保持双手清洁的原因是这样能帮助你保持健康。故选because，用来引导原因状语从句。故选C。

questions.prompt: We can get vitamin D from food  ______  we can also get it from the sun.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们可以从食物中获取维生素D，但我们也可以从太阳中获取。 考查连词辨析。but但是；so所以；if如果；because因为，根据“We can get vitamin D from food”和“we can also get it from the sun”可知，空缺处应该用连词but表转折，表示“但我们也可以从太阳中获取”，故选A。

questions.prompt: Peter  ______  with his brother on the phone at 9:00 last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天晚上九点钟皮特正在和他的弟弟打电话。 考查时态。根据句意“昨天晚上九点皮特正在和他的弟弟打电话”可知描述的是在昨晚那个时间点皮特正在做什么。应选过去进行时。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Carrie, what are you going to do this weekend? —I  ______  some cleaning for our community.
questions.explanation: 句意：——卡丽，这周末你打算去做什么？——我打算为我们的社区打扫卫生。 考查时态。根据“what are you going to do this weekend”可知询问者在问卡丽周末打算做什么，应用一般将来时。回答句也应用一般将来时来回答。“be going to do sth.”意为“计划、将要做某事”，也是一般将来时态的一种。故选C。

questions.prompt: She  ______  model ship when her brother came in.
questions.explanation: 句意：她哥哥进来时，她正在做船模。 考查过去进行时。make“制作”，根据“when her brother came in”可知，空缺处强调的是过去的某一时刻正在进行的动作，用过去进行时，故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从每文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 The Best Vacation Ever Winter holiday was fast coming. All Scott wanted to do was going  ______ 13 ______. But Scott’s parents had different plans. They had booked a weeklong tropical cruise (热带乘船游览). Scott didn’t like warm weather and asked if he could just stay at his best friend’s house so he could snowboard every day with his friends at the local mountain. His parents didn’t want to hear anything of it. He kept  ______ 14 ______  to his parents about it, but they would not change their minds. Family time was important to them and they should spend winter break together. The week of the cruise arrived, and Scott still complained as he and his family left their house to head south. Scott’s dad told him that he would only make the vacation  ______ 15 ______  if he didn’t change his attitude (态度) and open his mind to a new experience. Scott still couldn’t stop thinking about all of the  ______ 16 ______  he was leaving behind. When they got on the ship, Scott found a surfing pool. He asked his parents if he could try surfing. They said, “Of course.” Much to Scott’s surprise, they wanted to try surfing too. When Scott and his parents had their swim suits on, they headed back to the surfing pool. Scott’s dad went first and only  ______ 17 ______  about five seconds before he fell off. His mom made it longer than his dad did. When it was Scott’s turn, he was excited and a little  ______ 18 ______. He carefully jumped on the board and stood just like he was standing on his snowboard. Then the waves (海浪)started. It felt similar (相似的) to snowboarding but different at the same time. On his first ride, Scott rode for almost 30 seconds before falling off. He was hooked(入迷) though. Many people tried surfing the first day of the cruise, but only eight people really  ______ 19 ______  to it. Scott got to know these people quite well. By the time the weeklong cruise was over, Scott had some new friends, a new  ______ 20 ______, and great memories. He told his parents it was his best vacation ever.

questions.prompt: Tom and Mike are good friends.  ______  often help each others.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：凯特和爱丽丝好朋友，她们经常互相帮助。根据句意此空应用人称代词，又因此空在句中作主语，所以用主格they，因此选A。 考点：考查代词的用法

questions.prompt: —What did Mr Lin do after that? —He divided the people  ______  five groups.
questions.explanation: 句意：——林先生在那之后做了什么？——他把人们分成五组。 考查介词辨析。into进入；for为了；with和；on在……上面。固定短语divide...into把……分成……。故选A。

questions.prompt: I jumped  ______  than Bill in the sports meeting last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：在去年的运动会上，我跳得比比尔高。 考查比较级。high高地，副词原级；higher更高地，副词比较级；highest最高地，副词最高级； the highest最高地，副词最高级。根据“than Bill”可知，此空需要比较级，结合选项，B符合句意。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Why are bones so important? — ______  they help us move freely.
questions.explanation: 句意：——为什么骨头如此重要？——因为它们帮助我们自由行动。 考查连词辨析。And和；But但是；So所以；Because因为。根据“Why ”可知回答why引导的特殊疑问句，应用because，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  won the first gold medal for China at Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games? —Yang Qian. She’s from Zhejiang.
questions.explanation: 句意：——谁在2020年东京奥运会上为中国赢得了第一枚金牌？——杨倩。她来自浙江。 考查特殊疑问句。When什么时候；What什么；Who谁；Where哪里。答语“Yang Qian.”指人，应用Who引导特殊疑问句。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  I borrow your pen, please? —Sure. Here you are.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以借你的钢笔吗？——当然。给你。 考查情态动词。can能，可以；must必须；need需要；should应该。根据“...I borrow your pencil, please?”可知，这里是向对方借东西，应询问“可不可以”，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Tina, what did you do in your last Chinese class? —We ______  interesting TV programmes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——蒂娜，你们上一节语文课做了什么？——我们看了有趣的电视节目。 考查动词时态。根据“in your last Chinese class”可知，此处询问过去发生的事情，应为一般过去时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What do you often do at weekends? —I often  ______  my grandparents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你周末经常做什么？——我经常拜访我的祖父母。 考查动词时态。根据“What do you often do at weekends?”可知，是一般现在时，答语也应用一般现在时，主语是I，动词用原形。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing last Saturday when I phoned? — I  ______  the piano.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上周六我打电话时你在干什么？ ——我在弹钢琴。 考查动词时态。根据“What were you doing last Saturday when I phoned?”可知，这里是问过去某一时刻正在发生的事情，因此用过去进行时，其结构是：was/were+动词的现在分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Who is  ______  runner in our class? —I think Li Ming is.
questions.explanation: 句意：——谁是我们班跑得最快的人？——我认为是李明。 考查形容词的最高级。fast快的；faster更快的；fastest最快的；the fastest最快的。根据“in our class”可知此处指三者以上的比较应用最高级形式，且最高级前应加定冠词the。故选D。

questions.prompt: —What will you do during the coming winter holiday? —I  ______  volunteer work in our community.
questions.explanation: 句意：——在即将到来的寒假里你将做什么？——我将在我们的社区做志愿者工作。 考查动词时态。根据“the coming winter holiday”可知寒假还没有到来，所以做志愿者工作是发生在将来，应用一般将来时，故选C。

questions.prompt: —I kicked the ball and made a goal. — ______
questions.explanation: 句意：——我踢了球，进了一个球。——多么令人兴奋啊！ 考查情景交际。How exciting!多么令人兴奋；What a shame!真可惜；Can you believe that?你能相信吗；I can’t stand it.我忍受不了了。上文“I kicked the ball and made a goal.”表示自己进了球，则“多么令人兴奋”作为答语符合语境。故选A。 二、完形填空(共8分,每小题1分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 “Everybody, it’s time for our group project. Let’s get to work!” says Ms White. Amy is the leader of one group. She is not looking forward to working with her group because a boy named Ray is always absent (缺席) from the group meetings. He doesn’t follow the rules, and he refuses (拒绝) to do any work. This  ______ 13 ______  the whole group down. Amy considers telling Ms White about these problems, but she doesn’t want to get Ray in trouble. Instead, she decides to talk to him and find out what the  ______ 14 ______  is. She says, “Everyone is working hard on our  ______ 15 ______. But so far, you haven’t done anything. Is there something wrong?” Ray thinks  ______ 16 ______  for a few seconds, and finally says, “It’s not that I don’t want to be in the  ______ 17 ______. Sometimes, I don’t really understand the things we’re learning. I know it’s not fair (公平的), but I don’t want to say something stupid,  ______ 18 ______  I do nothing. Now Amy understands. Ray isn’t lazy—he just needs help! “From now on,” she says, “I will try my best to  ______ 19 ______  you to feel more confident (自信的). Then you can do your share, and it will be fair for everyone.”“Thank you! I’ll try hard to do my part.” says Ray. Amy feels happy. She  ______ 20 ______  that talking about problems is better than keeping them as secrets.

questions.prompt: Miss Wu teaches ______ English And we like her class very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：吴老师教我们英语。我们非常喜欢她的课。 考查人称代词宾格。ours我们的，名词性物主代词；we我们，主格；us我们，宾格；our我们的，形容词性物主代词，根据所给空前面的动词teach是动词，后面接人称代词的宾格，故选C。

questions.prompt: How about ______ carefully in class? It will help you a lot.
questions.explanation: 句意：上课认真听怎么样？这对你有很大帮助。 考查非谓语。how about doing sth.“做某事怎么样”，此处动名词作宾语。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______ did you play basketball last weekend? —In the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上周末你在哪里打篮球？——在公园里。 考查特殊疑问句。Where哪里；When何时；Why为什么；How怎样。根据“In the park.”可知是地点。故选A。

questions.prompt: The picture is  ______  than that one.
questions.explanation: 句意：这幅画比那幅画更美。 考查比较级。根据句中的“than”可知，句中应用比较级，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______ is the population of this city? —Seven million.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个城市有多少人口？——七百万。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少，后面接可数名词复数；How much多少，修饰不可数名词；What多少，什么；How怎样，根据答句Seven million可知，问句是询问这个城市的人口是多少，用句型What is the population of this city？故选C。

questions.prompt: Heilongjiang is  ______  the north of China.
questions.explanation: 句意：黑龙江在中国北部。 本题考查地点介词。A. in 在，表示“在范围内”；B. on 在，表示“接壤”；C. to 位于，表示“范围外”；D. for 为了。根据黑龙江在中国内部，故选A。

questions.prompt: The Smiths ______ to the city two years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯一家人在两年前搬去了城里。 考查时态。move搬，移动；动词原形； are moving 现在进行时；will move一般将来时； moved过去式/过去分词形式。根据“two years ago”可知“两年前”是一般过去时态。故选D。

questions.prompt: The ruler is as ______ as that one. I will buy one of them.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个尺子和那个一样长。我要买它们中的一个。 考查as……as句型。younger比较年轻的；young年轻的；longer比较长的；long长的，根据as……as意为“和……一样”，中间用形容词原形，排除A和C，由于是尺子，所以应该是这个尺子和那个一样长，排除B，故选D。

questions.prompt: The new building in the city is about ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这座新楼大约150米高。 考查数词。150 metres high 150米高；150-metre-high 150米高的；150-metres high 错误结构；150 metre high错误结构。这里表达的是“建筑物有150米高”，英语中表达“物体有多高”的结构是“基数词+meter(s) high”，所以只有A选项符合，而B选项用时，后面必须有被修饰的单数名词，故选A。

questions.prompt: About ______ people visit the museum every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年大约有七百万人参观博物馆。 考查数词。million百万，数词+million意为“几百万”；million和of连用时，用millions，排除B和C，seven million of后面要加范围以及所给空前面的about可知，应该是七百万人，排除D，故选A。

questions.prompt: We know that she enjoys  ______  books very much.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：我们知道她非常喜欢读书。此题考查固定短语enjoy doing sth喜欢做某事。根据句意，应选C。

questions.prompt: Lucy thinks Chinese is ______ than English.
questions.explanation: 句意：Lucy认为汉语比英语困难。 考查形容词比较级。difficult困难的，形容词，其比较级为more difficult 。根据than可知是形容词比较级的标志，故选C。 五、完形填空 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从方框中选择最佳词，并用其正确形式填入短文空白处。 A when want buy kind Venice is a great city in Italy. It is a Water City. You can’t see any cars or taxis there. When you  ______ 13 ______  to go to a far place, you can take a boat. There are many rivers around the city and there are many  ______ 14 ______  of boats. The best way to visit Venice is walking.  ______ 15 ______  you are tired, you can buy some ice cream. The ice cream in Venice is good to eat. Venice is a good place for kids to have fun. You can let your kids give food to pigeons on San Marco Square. They are all white and beautiful. Or you can also take a water-bus to some nice places. Guggenheim Museum is near San Marco. It is a good place for kids to go, too. There kids can learn a lot. Don’t wait! Go to Venice to have a good time soon. 【答案】13. want

questions.prompt: — Where did Mr. Smith go last week? —  ______  went to Tian'anmen Square with some friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——史密斯先生上周去了哪里？——他和一些朋友去了天安门。 考查代词。she她，主格；her她；宾格；he他，主格；his他的。句子缺主语，根据“Mr. Smith”可知是男士，用人称代词的主格“he”。故选C。

questions.prompt: I heard you went skating  ______  Friday evening. Did you have a good time?
questions.explanation: 句意：我听说你星期五晚上去滑冰了。你玩得开心吗？ 考查介词。on用于具体的某一天或具体某一天的上/下午/晚上；of……的；at用于具体的钟点前；in用于年/月/季节/泛指的上/下午/晚上前；空格修饰的是“Friday evening”，是具体的一天的晚上，所以用介词on，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you exercise? —I love running. I do that about three times a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久锻炼一次？——我喜欢跑步。我大约一周做三次锻炼。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少；提问可数名词数量的多少；How much多少，提问不可数名词数量；How often多久，经常，提问频度；How long多长，答语：for+一段时间。根据下文“I do that about three times a week.”可知，此处是提问频度，故选C。

questions.prompt: The movie is quite boring. There isn't  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这部电影非常无聊。没有什么有趣的东西。 考查不定代词和定语后置。something某事，常用于肯定句中；anything任何事，常用于否定句或疑问句中；interesting有趣的，是一个形容词，修饰不定代词，应放在不定代词后面，可先排除A和B；这是一个否定句，应用anything，故选D。

questions.prompt: The Yangtze River is  ______  than the Yellow River.
questions.explanation: 句意：长江比黄河长。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知，此处要用形容词的是比较级，是两者之间的比较，故选B。

questions.prompt: She never  ______  up late because she knows it's bad for her health.
questions.explanation: 句意：她从不熬夜，因为她知道这对她的健康不好。 考查动词时态，stay up“熬夜”，观察句子，这里缺少的是谓语部分，排除选项D。根据never“绝不”一词，可知时态用一般现在时，主语为she，谓语动词应该用三单形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: Lucy went shopping yesterday and  ______  a gift for her mother.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天Lucy去购物了，给她的妈妈买了一个礼物。 考查动词时态。buy买，是一个动词。根据句中的时间状语“yesterday”可知，这句话说的是过去发生的事情，应用一般过去时态，buy的过去式是bought。故选C。

questions.prompt: Larry is funny and outgoing. He always makes his friends  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：拉里既风趣又外向。他总是让他的朋友们笑。 考查make sb. do sth.句式。laugh笑；laughs第三人称单数形式；laughing动名词/现在分词；to laugh动词不定式；make sb. do sth.意为“使某人做某事”，固定短语。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What a great day! Let's go to the park. — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——多么美好的一天!我们去公园吧。——听起来是个好主意。 考查情境交际，Don't worry不要担心；Thanks for your help谢谢你的帮助；You are welcome 不用谢；Sounds like a good idea听起来是个好主意。根据“Let's go to the park.”我们去公园吧，可知答案，故选D。 五、完形填空 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Who Did Jeffery's Homework? Jeffery loves outdoor games like hockey and basketball. He is a good sports player but he is not interested in studies. He never does homework. "Too boring," he says. His teachers tell him," Jeffery! Do your homework, or you can't learn a thing. "But what can he do? He  ______ 10 ______  homework. One day, he found his cat playing with a little doll and he took it away. When he looked at it closely, he found that it wasn't a doll at all but a man of the smallest size. It was a little elf（精灵）! The elf shouted, "Save me! Don't give me back to the cat. You can make a  ______ 11 ______  if you save me. " ""How  ______ 12 ______  I am!" Jeffery thought. Here was the answer to all of his problems. So he said, "Please do all my homework till the end of this term and make sure I can get A's. If you make my wish come true, I'll let you go then." The little elf agreed. And true to his word, the little elf began to do Jeffery's homework. But there was one problem — the elf didn't always know how to do the homework and needed  ______ 13 ______. When doing reading, the elf asked Jeffery to  ______ 14 ______  new words in the dictionary. When doing history, the elf needed Jeffery to go to the  ______ 15 ______  to borrow books and read to him. Jeffery was working harder than ever! He stayed up late at night and got up early in the morning. That little elf was driving him crazy! He never felt so  ______ 16 ______. Finally the last day of school arrived and the elf was free to go. As for homework, Jeffery didn't hate to do it anymore. He got his A's. His classmates and teachers were all surprised. They  ______ 17 ______  what had happened to Jeffery. Do you know who really helped Jeffery?

questions.prompt: —Helen, long time no see. I’ve heard that  ______  went to Wuhan last summer vacation. —Yes, I had a very great time there.
questions.explanation: 句意：——海伦，好久不见了。我听说你去年暑假去了武汉。——是的，我在那里过得很愉快。 考查代词辨析。she她；I我；you你；they他/她/它们。根据题干可知空处作宾语从句的主语, 由“I had a very great time there”可知这里用you。故选C。

questions.prompt: No news is good news. ______  wants to be bothered by endless phone calls.
questions.explanation: 句意：没有消息就是好消息。没有人希望被无休止的电话打扰。 考查复合不定代词。anyone任何人；nobody没有人；someone某人；none没有一个, 可指人, 也可指物，一般不单独作主语, 而是和“of”连用。根据“No news”可知表达没有人希望被无休止的电话打扰用表达否定意义的不定代词“nobody”。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you get a review of what you learn in class？ —Every weekend. Regular reviews are very important for studies.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多长时间复习一次你上课所学的内容？——每个周末。有规律的复习对学习很重要。 考查特殊疑问句。how often多久一次；how long多长时间，多久；how soon多久以后；how many多少。根据“Every weekend”可知,此处询问你多久复习一次课上学习的内容,询问频率,疑问词用“How often”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Why not ______ some time with your grandparents on holidays? They really need to be cared about and companioned.
questions.explanation: 句意：为什么假期不花一些时间和你的爷爷奶奶在一起？他们真的需要被关心和陪伴。 考查动词。take花费，主语为“it”，用“it takes sb.时间to do”的结构；cost花费，主语为物，用“sth. cost sb.钱”的结构；pay花费，主语为人，用“sb. pay 钱for sth.”的结构；spend花费，主语为人，用“sb. spend钱/时间 with sb.”的结构。“some time”表达“时间”，“why not”用于提建议，相当于“why don’t you”判断句子主语为人，句子表达“花一些时间和爷爷奶奶一起”用动词“spend”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Jason is excellent in sports. He runs  ______  in our class.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰森擅长运动。他在我们班跑得最快。 考查副词最高级。根据“in our class”可知，此句应该表示他在我们班跑得最快。用最高级the fastest。故选C。

questions.prompt: If you want to live a healthy life, you’d better eat  ______ vegetables and  ______  junk food.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你想过健康的生活，你最好多吃蔬菜，少吃垃圾食品。 考查形容词比较级。more更多的；much许多；many许多；less较少的；little没有多少。根据“If you want to live a healthy life, you’d better eat…vegetables and … junk food”可知，两个空都有比较之意，保持健康就要多吃蔬菜，少吃垃圾食品，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Where did you go this summer vacation, Peter？ — I  ______  to Vietnam with my family.It was an adventurous trip.
questions.explanation: 句意：——皮特，这个暑假你去了哪里？——我和家人一起去了越南，是一个冒险之旅。 考查动词及动词的时态。go去；went是“go”的过去式；do做；did 是“do”的过去式。根据“Where did you go this summer vacation”可知，问句是询问对方去哪儿了, 是一般过去时, 答语中用动词的过去式“went”。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Can you tell me  ______? —She sometimes goes shopping.

choices.label: A
choices.text: what does she do on weekends

choices.label: C
choices.text: what did she do on weekends

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我她周末干什么吗？——她有时去购物。 考查宾语从句。根据“宾语从句要用陈述句语序”的原则可知，排除A/C选项；结合“Can you tell me”及“She sometimes goes shopping.”可知，从句应用一般现在时，故选B。

questions.prompt: This latest style i-watch is ______.I can afford it if I save up a week’s pocket money.
questions.explanation: 句意：最新款的电话手表不贵，如果我攒一个星期的零花钱就可以买得起它。 考查形容词。inexperienced缺乏认识（或经验）的； inconvenient不方便的； incomplete不完整的；inexpensive便宜的，不贵的。 根据“I can afford it if l save up a week’s pocket money”可知如果我攒一个星期的零花钱就可以买得起可知表达最新款的电话手表是便宜的。用形容词“inexpensive”作表语。故选D。

questions.prompt: What matters most in your mind? Money,  ______  or friendship?
questions.explanation: 句意：你心目中最重要的是什么？金钱、健康还是友谊？ 考查名词辨析。health健康，名词；wealthy富有的，形容词；wealth财富，名词；healthy健康的，形容词。money，friendship为名词，or表示选择，据此判断空格处用名词，排除选项B和D；money的含义为钱，据此判断空格处不能再用wealth。故选A。 二、选词填空（本大题共1小题, 每小题6分, 共6分） I grew to be a tall girl but I tried to be as ordinary as possible. At school, I always chose a seat in the back of the room, and never  ______ 11 ______  my hand in class. When I was 16, I went to my new school. And I liked the English teacher. In my last year in high school, however, we were told that we were going to have a new English teacher, Oliver Bascom. Oliver Bascom! My girlfriends and I laughed as we  ______ 12 ______  the short and bald man. The situation was not funny, because this man would teach us for the whole year. After we opened the door, there in front of the blackboard, we saw a young and handsome man! What followed was pandemonium (喧闹) seventeen-year-old girls  ______ 13 ______  to get to seats in the front of the room. And I managed to get a front and center desk. I really wanted to make a good impression on my new teacher, but I usually kept quiet. The day that directions were given for our first major writing assignment, I arrived late to class. A friend later gave me the guidelines and I thought I understood them. I worked the whole weekend on the essay and waited  ______ 14 ______  for Mr. Bascom’s evaluation. After three days, he arrived in class holding the corrected papers. “I’ve chosen the ten best essays for class discussion,” he said. Twenty minutes later, my  ______ 15 ______  sank when he got to the last essay, and I didn’t hear my name. “These are all great essays,” Mr. Bascom continued. “However, I am now going to read you the most successful of all …” We were all surprised as I was the author of this  ______ 16 ______  work. A different girl walked out of the classroom that day. I knew that I had a new set of standards to live up to and that anything was possible in the future. Finally, I raised my head.

questions.prompt: Jim has a sister. He likes playing games with  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆有一个妹妹。他喜欢和她一起做游戏。 考查人称代词的用法。me我（第一人称宾格的形式）；you 你（第二人称的宾格形式）；her她(第三人称宾格，表示女子时用)；him他（第三人称宾格，表示男子时用）。结合句意，吉姆和他的妹妹一起做游戏，他的妹妹是女孩，因此用her在此处作宾语。故选 C。

questions.prompt: Put on your coat,  ______  you may catch a cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：穿上你的大衣，否则，你可能会感冒。 考查连词的用法。and 和；so因此；but但是；or否则。根据句意可知，此处指穿上衣服，否则会感冒。故选D。

questions.prompt: The beach is not as  ______  as it used to be. Let’s collect the rubbish.
questions.explanation: 句意：这片海滩不如以前干净了。让我们去捡垃圾吧。 考查固定句型。not as…as… 不如……一样，中间接形容词或副词的原级。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you visit your grandparents, Mike? —Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克，你多久去看望一次你的祖父母？——一个星期一次。 考查特殊疑问句。How soon多久；How long多长时间；How often多久一次；How far多远。根据答语“Once a week.”可知，问的是频率，故选C。

questions.prompt: I watched the Super Brain  ______  March 28th.
questions.explanation: 句意：3月28日我看了《最强大脑》。 考查介词辨析。in后接年、月、季节等；at后接具体钟表时刻；on后接具体某一天等；to朝，向。根据“March 28th”可知表示在3月28日，用介词on符合语境。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mary likes tennis and she thinks it’s  ______  of all sports.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽喜欢网球，她认为网球是所有运动中最有趣的。 考查形容词最高级。根据“of all sports”可知比较范围在三者以上，用形容词的最高级，最高级前要加the。故选D。

questions.prompt: My little brother  ______  speak English because he is only six months old.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的小弟弟不会说英语因为他仅仅六个月大。 考查情态动词。can’t不会， 不可能；mustn’t禁止；shouldn’t不应该；needn’t不必。根据“ he is only six months old”可知，弟弟只有六个月大，所以应该是不会说英语。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Which season do you like  ______ ，winter or summer? —Summer
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：---冬季和夏季，你更喜欢哪个季节？---夏季。此题考查副词比较级。根据句意，应选B。 考点：考查副词比较级。

questions.prompt: —Thanks a lot. — ______.
questions.explanation: 句意: ——非常感谢。——不客气。 考查情景交际。That’s all right不客气；All right好, 顺利；That’s right那是对的；You are right你是对的。根据“Thanks a lot”可知对方表示感谢, 应该回答“不客气”，用句子“That’s all right”。故选A。

questions.prompt: The twins can speak only  ______  French.
questions.explanation: 句意：这对双胞胎只会说一点法语。 考查词义辨析。few几乎没有，修饰可数名词；a few有一点，修饰可数名词；little几乎没有，修饰不可数名词；a little一点，修饰不可数名词。此处修饰不可数名词French，排除A、B；根据“only”可知，此处强调肯定含义，会说一点。故选D。

questions.prompt: Do you need  ______  tea?
questions.explanation: 句意：你需要再来点茶吗？ 考查一般疑问句和形容词比较级。此句是提出请求，需要用some，排除BC。此处表达出”更多点，再来点”的含义，所以要用形容词的比较级more。故选A。

questions.prompt: You’d better  ______  football on the road.
questions.explanation: 句意：你最好不要在路上踢足球。 考查情态动词。had better最好，是情态动词，后接动词原形。you’d better not do sth表示 “你最好不要做某事”。故选B。

questions.prompt: Loud music and red chairs in the restaurant make people  ______  fast.
questions.explanation: 句意：在餐馆里吵闹的音乐和红色的椅子让人们吃得快。 考查非谓语动词。make后用省略to的动词不定式作宾补，make sb. do sth.表示“让某人做某事”，所以此处使用eat。 故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  large the room is!
questions.explanation: 句意：这房间多大啊！ 考查感叹句。本句强调的中心词是形容词large，用“How+形容词+主语+谓语！”表示，故选C。

questions.prompt: They will have a trip to the Summer Palace if it  ______  next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果下周日不下雨, 他们将去颐和园旅行。 考查动词的时态。if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，根据“They will have a trip to the Summer Palace ”可知，主句时态为一般将来时，所以从句使用一般现在时，从句主语是it，变为否定句时，借助助动词does。故选C。

questions.prompt: My brother decides  ______  to England to study English next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥决定明年去英国学习英语。 考查非谓语动词。结合语境和空前“decides”可知，本句用短语“decide to do sth决定做某事”，所以这里用动词不定式作宾语。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Where is Mr. Smith? —He  ______  a meeting at the office now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Smith先生在哪里？——他现在正在办公室里开会。 考查动词时态。is having现在进行时，正在做某事；had是have的过去式；has是have的第三人称单数形式；will have一般将来时。根据对话的情景可知，这里问的是Smith现在在哪里，“开会”这个动作是此刻正在进行的，应用现在进行时。故选A。

questions.prompt: When I opened the fridge, there  ______  only a bottle of milk and some eggs.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我打开冰箱时，只有一瓶牛奶和一些鸡蛋。 考查时态。根据句中的 opened可知，此句时态是一般过去时。there be句型遵循就近原则，be动词与a bottle of milk一致，因此用was。故选C。

questions.prompt: Jennifer often  ______  some housework after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jennifer 放学后经常做一些家务。 考查动词的时态。结合语境和空前often可知本句用一般现在时，陈述经常发生的事情，主语Jennifer是第三人称单数，所以动词要用第三人称单数形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: My parents always tell me  ______  more vegetables and fruit.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：我的父母经常告诉我多吃蔬菜和水果。Tell后面一般接带to的动词不定式做宾语补足语，表示具体的将要进行的动作，故选D。 考点：考查非谓语动词 二、完形填空（共10分, 每小题4分） 根据短文内容, 从方框中选出恰当的词填写在答题卡的相应位置上。 make, brings, place, goal, enoughIn Chile（智利）, it is difficult for small schools in villages to teach science because they don’t have  ______ 21 ______  teachers or equipment. This is where the Science Bus Project can help. The bus  ______ 22 ______  special science teachers, new ideas and equipment to these schools. Sometimes the children go inside the bus for their lessons or clubs. Sometimes the teachers even bring the equipment inside the classroom. The  ______ 23 ______  of the Science Bus Project is to bring science to children all over Chile. Since 2012, the bus has visited lots of schools in Chile, and hundreds of teachers have learned how to  ______ 24 ______  their science classes fun and exciting. 【答案】21. enough

questions.prompt: Mr. Bean enjoys  ______  jokes and often hopes  ______  us more pleasure.
questions.explanation: 句意：憨豆先生喜欢开玩笑，经常希望能给我们带来更多的快乐。 考查非谓语动词。enjoy doing sth喜欢做某事，因此第一空用动名词telling作宾语；hope to do sth希望做某事，因此用动词不定式to bring作宾语，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Did you ______  last week? —Yes. I went to Beijing with my family.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你上周去有趣的地方了吗？——是的，我和我的家人去了北京。 考查anywhere及形容词。go后跟名词时要加介词to，这里go后不用介词。疑问句中用anywhere而不是somewhere，同时anywhere的修饰语后置。故选B。

questions.prompt: He can’t go to work today  ______  his illness（病）.
questions.explanation: 句意：他今天因为生病无法去上班。 考查介词。because因为，是连词,后跟句子；because of因为，是介词短语，后跟名词，动名词或代词；but但是，是连词；and而且，是连词。结合句意，逗号前表示结果，逗号后是原因，空格后是名词his illness，所以用介词短语because of，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go camping in the country? —Once a year.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去乡下野营一次？——一年一次。 考查特殊疑问词。How often 多久一次，询问频率；How long 多长（时间），询问长短或时间；How soon 多久，询问时间；How much 多少钱，询问价格。根据回答“Once a year.”可知，对方询问的是野营的频率，故选A。

questions.prompt: Eating fruit and vegetables is good  ______  our health.
questions.explanation: 句意：吃水果和蔬菜对我们的身体有好处。 考查介词辨析。be good at擅长某事；be good in在……中表现出色；be good under无此搭配；be good for对……有好处。根据“Eating fruit and vegetables”及“our health”，可知，吃水果和蔬菜对身体有好处，故选D。

questions.prompt: ______  he tried his best,  ______  he didn’t win the competition.
questions.explanation: 句意：尽管他尽了自己最大的努力，他还是没有赢得比赛。 考查连词词义辨析。though 尽管，表让步，不和but连用；but 但是，表转折。因为though不和but连用，排除B和C；“he tried his best”和“he didn’t win the competition”之间是让步关系，故选A。

questions.prompt: The mother makes the little girl  ______  the room every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：妈妈让小女孩每天打扫房间。 考查使役动词的用法。句中“make”是使役动词，其搭配是“make sb do sth”，表示“让某人做某事”，故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  is unhealthy for us to go to school without eating breakfast in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：早上不吃早饭上学对我们是不健康的。 考查代词词义辨析。That 那个，指示代词；This 这个，指示代词；It 它，人称代词；Which 哪一个，疑问代词。由于句子是陈述句，排除D；“It's+adj.+for sb+to do sth”是固定句型，表示“对某人来说做某事是……的”，其中“It”作形式主语，真正主语是动词不定式，故选C。

questions.prompt: My mother says my sister is similar  ______  me, but I think she is different  ______  me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈说我妹妹与我相似，但我认为她与我不同。 考查介词辨析。to给；from从；with和；as作为，根据固定搭配be similar to“和……相似”；be different from“不同于……”可知，应该是我妈妈说我妹妹与我相似，但我认为她与我不同，故选A。

questions.prompt: Tony is of the three boys, but he is the tallest.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼是这三个男孩中最小的，但他是最高的。考查最高级。A. 年轻的；B. 更年轻的；C. 最年轻的，通常加the；D. 最年轻的。结合语境“托尼是这三个男孩中最小的，但他是最高的。”。of the three boys是三者以上的比较，可知，用最高级the youngest最年轻的，最小的。故选D。 二． 根据汉语意思完成句子，没空一词.

questions.prompt: I sometimes help my mom with her housework ______  Saturdays.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：在表示时间时，at表示在时间的一点；on 表示在具体某一天； in表示在一个时间范围，或者接一段时间，表示多久之后；to表示差几分到几点。句意：在周六，我有时帮助我的母亲做家务。根据下文Saturdays，可知本句中表示在具体某一天，故用介词on。选C。 考点：考查介词辨析

questions.prompt: －Have you tried the pizza? －Yes, It  ______  delicious.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你尝过比萨了吗？——是的。它尝起来很美味。 考查动词辨析。looks看起来；tastes尝起来；feels感觉；sounds听起来。由“tried the pizza”可知，是吃过比萨了，所以是尝起来很好吃，故选B。

questions.prompt: My uncle likes books,  ______  he doesn't have much time to read.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的叔叔喜欢书，但他没太多时间读。 考查连词。for因为；or否则；but但是；so因此；空格前后两句之间表达的是转折关系，所以应该用表转折关系的连词but连接，故选C。

questions.prompt: My friend Sally  ______  to another city last year. I really miss her.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的朋友萨利去年搬到了另一个城市。我真的很想她。 本题主要考查时态。根据句中的标志词“last year”可知该题考查的是一般过去时。A. moves 一般现在时； B. moved 一般过去时；C. was moving 过去进行时；D. has moved 现在完成时；故选B。

questions.prompt: —Have you ever  ______  to Haikou? —Yes, I  ______  there with my family last August.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你曾经去过海口吗？——是的，去年八月份我和我的家人一起去的。 考查动词时态。gone是go的过去分词；been是be的过去分词；went是go的过去式。have been to意为“去过某地（已回）”；have gone to意为“去了某地（未回）”。根据答语“I…there with my family last August”可知，这里问“去过……”，应用have been to；第二句话中“last August”过去的时间，应用一般过去时态。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What do you often do at weekends? —I often  ______  my grandparents.
questions.explanation: 句意：你经常在周末做什么？——我经常去看我的爷爷奶奶。 考查句子时态。A. visit 一般现在时；B. visited 一般过去时；C. have visited现在完成时；D. will visit一般将来时。结合语境可知下文often可知是经常性动作，故用一般现在时态。选A。

questions.prompt: －Paul, what were you doing at nine yesterday evening? －I  ______  a movie in the cinema with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——保罗，你昨晚九点在做什么？ ——我和我的朋友当时正在电影院看电影。 本题主要考查时态。由句中时间状语“at nine yesterday evening”可知，问句提问“过去的时间点在做什么”。故用过去进行时“were/was+doing”。A. was watching 过去进行时；B. watch 动词原形；C. watched 一般过去时；D. will watch 一般将来时。故选A。

questions.prompt: The spaceship  ______  back some pictures since it reached Mars.
questions.explanation: 句意：这艘飞船自从它到达火星已经发送回来一些照片。 考查时态。send发送，sends第三人称单数；has sent现在完成时，第三人称单数；have sent现在完成时；sent一般过去时。由“since”确定为现在完成时，主语为the spaceship为名词单数，故选B。 【点睛】本题主要注意since的用法，since加时间状语或时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时。时间状语为过去的时间，时间状语从句中用一般过去时。

questions.prompt: — Mum, where is Dad? — He  ______  a newspaper in the bedroom now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，爸爸在哪儿？——他现在正在卧室里看报纸。根据答语中的时间状语now和问句中“爸爸在哪儿”判断，答语要用现在进行时，故答案选D。

questions.prompt: —What do you think of the movie The Wandering Earth? —I  ______  it yet.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认电影《流浪地球》怎样？——我还没看呢。 考查时态。由“yet”确定为现在完成时的否定，故选D。

questions.prompt: Taron ______  a cold yesterday, so he had to go to see a doctor.
questions.explanation: 句意：塔伦昨天感冒了，所以他不得不去看医生。 考查动词时态辨析。has caught 现在完成时；is catching 现在进行时；catches 一般现在时的三单形式；caught 一般过去时。根据句中时间状语yesterday，表示过去发生的动作，用一般过去时，所以空格处填caught。故选D。 二. 完形填空（共8分, 每小题8分） 通读下面短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A, B, C, D四个选项中, 选择能填入相应空白处的最佳选项, 将其字母代号写在提前括号内。 When I was small, my mum used to give the family something special for meals—she would make breakfast food for dinner. I still remember one night my mum  ______ 13 ______  some bread in front of my dad, something very burnt（烤糊的）. I waited to see if anybody noticed. To my surprise, he smiled at my mum and then turned to ask me how my day at school had been. I  ______ 14 ______  what I told him that night. But I do remember watching him put some butter on that bread. He  ______ 15 ______  as usual, every single bite. After dinner, my mum said sorry to my dad for burning the bread. And I never forget what he said, “I love burnt bread, dear. It doesn’t  ______ 16 ______  at all.” Later that night, I went to kiss Dad good night. I asked him if he really liked his bread burnt. He held me in arms and  ______ 17 ______  “Your mum worked very hard all day. She’s really tired. And you see a bit of burnt food never hurt anyone!” Now I know life is not perfect. Nobody is perfect, either. As for me, I often forget birthdays or some other special days. But I’ve learned something  ______ 18 ______  over these years. What we really need is the understanding of each other, whether between a husband and wife, a parent and  ______ 19 ______  or just between two friends. This is the key to a happy life. So, don’t get angry if the bread gets burnt. Remember, burnt bread never hurt anyone. Be kind to those around you and a happier life will surely come  ______ 20 ______  to you.

questions.prompt: My father is a worker.  ______  is very kind.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父亲是一个工人，他非常友好。 考查代词。he他，主格；she她，主格；his他的；her她的。句子缺主语，用人称代词的主格，根据“My father”可知是一位男士，用he。故选A。

questions.prompt: More and more young people go skating winter.
— ______  do you visit your grandparents, Tom? —Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你多久去看一次你的祖父母？——一个月两次。 考查疑问词辨析。How much多少（钱），提问不可数名词的量或物品的价格；How often多久一次，提问频度；How long多久，对时间段进行提问；How soon多久以后，对“in+时间段”进行提问。根据答句“Twice a month.”表示的是频率，可知要用How often提问。故选B。

questions.prompt: Many people like pandas they are cute.
questions.explanation: 句意：很多人喜欢熊猫，因为它们很可爱。考查从属连词的辨析。选项A意为：虽然；选项B意为：如果；选项C意为：当……时候；选项D意为：因为。结合句意：很多人喜欢熊猫，因为它们很可爱。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tony is of the three boys, but he is the tallest.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼是这三个男孩中最小的，但他是最高的。考查最高级。A. 年轻的；B. 更年轻的；C. 最年轻的，通常加the；D. 最年轻的。结合语境“托尼是这三个男孩中最小的，但他是最高的。”。of the three boys是三者以上的比较，可知，用最高级the youngest最年轻的，最小的。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Which do you think is  ______, English or maths? — Maths, of course.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认为哪科比较难，英语还是数学？——当然是数学。 考查形容词比较级。difficult困难的，根据“English or maths”可知，是两者比较，用形容词比较级，difficult的比较级形式是more difficult，故选B。

questions.prompt: You ______  cross the road on a red light.
questions.explanation: 句意：你禁止在红灯时过马路。 考查情态动词。must必须；mustn’t禁止；have to必须；don’t have to不必。根据“on a red light”可知，此处是禁止穿过马路。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Tom, what’s your dad doing? — He  ______  his car.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你爸爸正在做什么？——他正在洗车。 考查现在进行时。clean his car洗车，根据“what’s your dad doing?”可知，答句用现在进行时，表正在进行的动作，故选C。

questions.prompt: Bill likes reading He  ______  picture books with his dad every evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：比尔喜欢读书。他每天晚上和爸爸一起看图画书。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语every evening可知，是一般现在时态，主语是he是第三人称单数，谓语动词变第三人称单数。read是动词，读，看。此处变第三人称单数，故选A。

questions.prompt: If you want to visit the Palace Museum, I  ______  tickets for you tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你想参观故宫博物院，我明天就给你订票。 考查一般将来时。book预定，根据“tomorrow”和if引导的条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”原则可知，时态用一般将来时，构成：主语+will+动词原形，故选A。

questions.prompt: — What did you do last weekend? — I  ______  my grandparents with my mum.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上周末你做了什么？——我和我妈妈去拜访了我的祖父母。 考查一般过去时。visit拜访，根据“last weekend”可知，答句时态用一般过去时，故选C。

questions.prompt: I like doing research, but I hate  ______  models.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢做研究，但我讨厌做模型。 考查非谓语动词。make制作，根据固定搭配hate doing sth“讨厌做某事”可知，应该用动名词作宾语，故选C。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Father Gives All for Daughter One day, an 11-year-old girl asked her dad, “What are you going to get me for my15th birthday?” The father answered, “Don’t worry about that. You still have plenty of time.” But on a day after her 14th birthday, she was seriously ill and her parents took her to the  ______ 13 ______. The family learned that the girl had a serious heart disease and that she might die. At night, she asked her dad, “Daddy, have they told you I’m going to  ______ 14 ______?” The father answered, “No, you will live as  ______ 15 ______  as anyone else.” She was surprised “How can you be sure?” He  ______ 16 ______  to her and said, “I just know it.” When the girl was 15, she had a heart transplant(移植手术). After recovering, she came home to find a letter on her bed and it said, “My dearest daughter, if you are  ______ 17 ______  this, it means that everything went as I told you it would. One day you asked me what I would  ______ 18 ______  you for your 15th birthday. I wasn’t sure then. But now you know that my  ______ 19 ______  to you is my heart.” Parents often make great sacrifices(牺性) to make their children happy. Keep this in mind when you feel angry toward your parents. They’re just doing what they think is  ______ 20 ______  for you.

questions.prompt: The strong earthquake happened  ______  May 12th, 2008.
questions.explanation: 句意：这次强震发生在2008年5月12日。 考查介词辨析。on用于具体的某一天或星期几之前；at用于具体的某一时刻之前；in用于年、月、季节之前；to到。2008年5月12日是具体的某一天，应用介词on。故选A。

questions.prompt: This is the  ______  TV programme I have watched. I don't like it at all.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我看过的最无聊的电视节目。我一点也不喜欢它。 考查形容词辨析和最高级。more boring比较无聊的；most boring最无聊的；more exciting比较激动人心的；most exciting最激动人心的。根据“I don't like it at all.”可知，节目很无聊，故排除C、D；根据比较范围 I have watched判断，形容词用最高级，故选B。

questions.prompt: He decided  ______ the lead and help all of us get out safely.
questions.explanation: 句意：他决定带头帮助我们所有人安全离开。 考查动词的用法。根据固定用法“decide to do sth.”决定做某事，故选A。

questions.prompt: Our tour guide asked us  ______  with him to the North Pole.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的向导要求我们和他一起去北极。 考查动词的用法。根据固定搭配“ask sb. to do sth.”要求或叫某人做某事。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Mum, must I finish the housework right now? — No, you  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我现在必须做完家务吗？——不，你不需要。 考查情态动词辨析。needn’t不必；wouldn't不会；mustn't禁止；can't不能。问句为must引导的一般疑问句，否定回答应用needn’t，表示不必。故填A。

questions.prompt: He is very  ______  because he watched an  ______  basketball match.
questions.explanation: 句意：他很兴奋，因为他看了一场激动人心的篮球比赛。 考查形容词词义辨析。exciting令人激动的，修饰物；excited兴奋的，修饰人。第一空修饰主语“He”，应用excited；第二空修饰名词“basketball”，应用exciting，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Are you a soccer player in your school? — Yes, I  ______  the team two years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你是你们学校的足球运动员吗？——是的，我两年前加入球队的。 考查一般过去时。was joining过去进行时；was joined一般过去时的被动语态；joined一般过去时；join一般现在时。根据时间状语“two years ago”可知，本句时态是一般过去时，应使用过去式，故选C。

questions.prompt: Clothes and shoes are much  ______ than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：衣服和鞋子比以前便宜多了。 考查形容词比较级。cheap形容词，原级；cheaper更便宜的，比较级；cheapest最便宜的，最高级；the cheapest最便宜的，最高级，形容词的最高级前常用定冠词the。根据“much”和“than”可知，此处用形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: — I'm very tired now. — How about  ______  a rest?
questions.explanation: 句意：我现在很累。——休息一下怎么样？ 考查固定结构。how about doing sth.?做某事怎么样，用于提建议；about是介词，后接代词或动名词短语。结合选项，故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  fast the boy swam!
questions.explanation: 句意：这男孩游得多快啊！ 考查感叹句。构成感叹句的结构：“What+形容词+名词+主语+谓语+其它”和“How+形容词/副词+主语+谓语+其它”；根据句末的感叹号可知，本题考查感叹句；句子的主语是the boy，谓语是swam，主语前fast是副词，符合how引导的感叹句结构：How+副词+主语+谓语+其它。故选A。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 On my way home I knocked into a stranger as he passed by. "Oh, I'm terribly sorry," I said. "That's all right. Please excuse me too. I didn't even notice you. I wish I didn't hurt you. " We were very  ______ 11 ______. We said goodbye and went on our way. But at home we often treated our loved ones in a different way. Later that day, while I was cooking the evening meal, my daughter stood beside me very quietly. When I turned, I nearly  ______ 12 ______  her over. "Move out of the way," I shouted. She walked away, tears (眼泪)in her eyes. While I went to my bed, I realized (意识到) how  ______ 13 ______  I'd spoken. So I decided to get up to say sorry to my daughter. On the way to her bedroom, to my surprise, I found some  ______ 14 ______  by the door of the kitchen. At that time my tears began to fall. I quietly went and got down on my knees by her  ______ 15 ______. She woke up when I kissed her. Then I asked, "Did you pick these flowers for me?" She smiled and said: "I found them out by the tree. I picked them  ______ 16 ______  they're pretty like you. I knew you'd like them. I stood quietly in order to give you a  ______ 17 ______ " I replied, "Oh dear, I'm really sorry for the way I acted today. I shouldn't have shouted at you." I suddenly realized what a clever way it is to explain the word  ______ 18 ______  like this: (F)ather (A))nd (M)other, (D)o (L)ove (Y)ou!

questions.prompt: This is my brother.  ______  name is Bob.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我兄弟。他的名字是鲍勃。 考查代词的用法。She她，人称代词主格；Her她的，形容词性物主代词；He他，人称代词主格；His他的，形容词性物主代词。根据第一句可知“Bob”是男性，排除A和B，而且这里需要形容词性物主代词作定语，修饰空后的名词“name”，所以用“his他的 ”。故选D。

questions.prompt: In Alaska, the days are long and warm  ______  summer.
questions.explanation: 句意：阿拉斯加，夏天白天漫长而温暖。 考查介词辨析。at后面接具体的时刻；in用于年、月、季节或泛指一天的上午、下午、晚上等；on后面接具体的某一天或某一天的早、中、晚前；to到，根据所给空后面的“summer”是季节，所以用介词in，故选B。

questions.prompt: It will soon become cold,  ______  bring a coat.
questions.explanation: 句意：天很快就冷了，所以带上一件外套。 考查连词。so所以，表因果；or或者，否则；but但是；because因为表原因；分析句子可知，空前空后在句意上是因果关系，前半句是因，后半句是果，故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  did the earthquake last? — For two minutes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——地震持续了多久？——2分钟。 考查特殊疑问句。How often多久一次，提问频率；How long多长时间；How many多少，提问数量，修饰可数名词；How much多少，提问数量，修饰不可数名词；多少钱，提问价格。根据下面的回答“For two minutes”，可知是对时间段提问，故选B。

questions.prompt: The teacher asks us  ______  English loudly in class, so that everyone can hear.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师让我们在课堂上大声读英语，目的是每个人都能听见。Ato speak动词不定式； Bspeaks单三形式； Cspeaking现在分词或动名词形式； Dspeak动词原形。根据ask sb to do sth要求某人做某事，不定式做宾补；故选A

questions.prompt: With your help, I do my homework  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：在你的帮助下，我做作业比以前仔细多了。 考查副词比较级。根据句中的“than”可知，句子要用比较级形式，且空格修饰的是动词do，应用副词的比较级，故选C。

questions.prompt: You  ______  wait when the traffic lights are red.
questions.explanation: 句意：当交通灯是红色时，你必须等待。 考查情态动词辨析。may可以，可能；could可能，表示请求许可或推测可能；might可能；must必须。根据“when the traffic lights are red”及结合常识，可知红灯时必须等待，这是交通规则。故选D。

questions.prompt: On our way back home yesterday, we  ______  to have lunch in a restaurant.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天在我们回家的路上，我们停下来在一家餐馆吃午饭。 考查动词时态。根据“yesterday”可知，句子要用一般过去时，动词用过去式，故选A。

questions.prompt: — What are you doing? — I  ______  some notes for a report.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你在做什么？——我正在为一份报告准备笔记。 考查现在进行时。结合语境和问句可知，答句用现在进行时表示现在正在做的动作。故选C。

questions.prompt: There  ______  many small parks around Beijing next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：明年北京周围将会有许多小公园。 考查时态。is是，be动词三单形式；are是，be动词复数形式；will be将是，将来时结构；were是，be动词复数形式的过去式；根据句中的时间“next year”可知，句子应用一般将来时，there be结构的将来时结构是there will be，故选C。

questions.prompt: — What do you often do on weekends? — I  ______  to the theatre to see the Beijing Opera with my grandpa.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你周末经常做什么？——我和爷爷一起去剧院看京剧。 考查动词时态。根据问句可知，问的是周末经常性的动作，句子是一般现在时，回答也用一般现在时作答，主语是I所以动词应该用原形。故选B。

questions.prompt: They  ______  a party in the garden at five yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天下午五点他们正在花园里举行晚会。 考查时态。根据“at five yesterday afternoon”可知是过去某个时间点正在发生的动作，可推测出是过去进行时，故选D。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Jessica loves playing soccer Jessica loved playing soccer. She often played with her older twin brothers, Jason and Jamal. “Jessica is a good soccer player,” said Jason. “But she is too small.” added Jamal. The twins played for the school soccer team — the Dragons. They would play  ______ 13 ______  another team called Sharks the next week. On the morning of the big game, the twins were very excited. However, when they arrived at the soccer field, they heard the  ______ 14 ______  news. Four of their players had chicken pox(水痘) and they only had ten players. If they didn’t have eleven players, they couldn’t play and the Sharks would  ______ 15 ______  the match. “I’ll play for you,” said a little voice. It was Jessica. Everyone laughed because she was a girl and she was so small. “It doesn’t matter. With  ______ 16 ______  players, we’ll be able to play the game,” said Coach. Coach told Jessica not to move from the center circle. She was not to kick the ball. The teams lined up, ready to play. The boys on the Sharks team pointed at Jessica. They  ______ 17 ______  at her because her shirt was big. It reached her knees. The Sharks were a very good team. At half time, the score was Sharks: 2, Dragons: 1. Jessica had not touched the ball. In the second half, the Dragons were determined(决定) to try  ______ 18 ______. With five minutes to play, Jason kicked the ball and passed it to Jamal. Jamal hit the ball hard and scored a goal to make the score Sharks: 2, Dragons: 2. There were only two minutes left. Jessica decided it was time to  ______ 19 ______. She left the center circle. Nobody noticed her moving toward the goal. Suddenly, Jessica kicked the ball as hard as she could. Her kick was so powerful that she scored the winning goal. “You are a  ______ 20 ______  soccer player!” said Jamal.
