questions.explanation: 句意：北京是个漂亮的城市是因为每年春天人们种越来越多的树。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。A一般过去时；B一般现在时的被动语态；C一般将来时的被动语态；D一般现在时。这里more and more trees做主语，树是被种，自己不会种上 去。故用被动式，every spring.一般现在时标志。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Could you tell me  ______  yesterday? —Because my bike was broken on my way here.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你昨天为什么迟到吗？——因为我的自行车在来的路上坏了。 考查宾语从句。英语宾语从句中一般用陈述语序，可知排除B和D。根据宾语从句时间状语yesterday，可知宾语从句时态是一般过去时态。故选A。 完形填空 We could all say that we have bad days as we go through life, but what does it take to have a rally good day? I remember a day recently when I had to go to the hospital for special  ______ 11 ______  because I wasn't feeling well and my doctor sent me to a specialist to try and find the cause of my illness As I  ______ 12 ______  to the hospital, I was feeling sad and certainly wasn't on top of my game. As I got to the hospital, I began my  ______ 13 ______  for a parking lot. I finally found one not too far from the entrance to the hospital. As I got out and brought my change out of my pocket, I noticed a man looking a little  ______ 14 ______  standing in front of a parking meter（停车记时收费表）two cars away. He seemed to be searching his pockets for what I supposed were  ______ 15 ______  for the meter. Although I  ______ 16 ______  didn't feel that great, I thought that I should at least go over to him and find out if I could  ______ 17 ______  him. As I stood beside him, he turned to me, looking anxious. I asked him if he had a problem I could help with. He said that he had no changes at all because he was only thinking about visiting his sick wife when he left his house. I reached into my pocket and  ______ 18 ______  out two dollars and gave it to him without saying a word. And, without waiting for a reply, I turned on my heel and said to him as I was walking away: “Have a good day.” The funny thing was that I felt a lot brighter. A small smile came to my face, and I seemed to walk just a little quicker. I was walking away when he called out: “Thank you so much.” You know, I didn't even  ______ 19 ______  him to say anything. He didn't have to say a word to me. It was simply enough to know that I had helped someone else who needed a  ______ 20 ______. That's all it took to bring a smile to my face as I went on toward completing my own business. You know, it doesn't take much to help someone else.

questions.explanation: 句意：——你觉得这个游戏节目怎么样?——我喜爱它。 考查情景交际。Yes, I’d love to是的，我很乐意；I think so我也这么认为；I love it我喜爱它；That’s nothing不要紧；根据上一句是问游戏咋样，所以此处用“I love it”，故选C。

questions.prompt: ---Dad. Could I have an MP5 like this? ---Certainly. We can buy  ______  one, but as good as this one.
—My cousin plays sports, eats healthy food and sleeps well every day. —I think he has a good  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的表弟每天运动，吃健康的食物，睡得好。——我认为他的生活方式很好。 考查名词。hobby爱好；sport运动；lifestyle生活方式；activity活动；根据上一句是“plays sports, eats healthy food and sleeps well every day”可知是生活方式好，故选C。

choices.label: A

questions.prompt: Could you please pass  ______  the ball? Thank you!
questions.explanation: 句意：你能把球传给我吗？谢谢您！ A. I我，主格；B. me我，宾格；C. my我的，形容词性物主代词；D. mine我的，名词性物主代词。根据题意动词pass应该接代词的宾格形式，只有C符合要求，故选B。

questions.prompt: ---How old is your little sister? ---She is just five months old. She was born August last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：---你妹妹多大了？---她只有五个月。她出生在去年八月。考查介词。在较长的时间段用介词in，例如, in August（在八月），in 1989（在1989年）；因此选A项 点睛：时间介词用法：在较长的时间里用介词in，例如，in 1986；在具体的某一天或某一天的上午、下午或晚上用介词on，例如，on Sunday，on a morning of January；在时间点或较短的时间段用介词at，例如，at 3:30,at this moment；for+时间段，表示做某事做了多长时间，例如，He slept for 8 hours yesterday。

questions.prompt: —  ______  does it take you to go to school? —It takes me about 10 minutes to walk to school. I live quite near the school.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你上学要多长时间？——步行去学校大约要10分钟。我住在学校附近。 本题主要考查 it 作形式主语的常用句型。根据“It + take（sb.）+ 时间（金钱）+ 动词不定式”，意为“做某事花费某人多少时间（或金钱）”。B项是对距离提问，C项是对时间点提问，D项是对事物提问，意为“什么”，均不符合题意。对“一段时间”提问时要用 How long。故选A。

questions.prompt: Judy enjoys running. She even runs than the boys in her class.
questions.explanation: 句意：朱蒂喜欢跑步。她甚至比班上的男孩跑得快。考查副词的比较级。根据句意及关键词than，可知应使用比较级，选B项。

questions.prompt: What a lovely rose! It's one of  ______  in the bouquet (花束).
questions.explanation: 句意：多可爱的玫瑰啊！这是花束中最漂亮的一个。 本题考查形容词最高级多音节词前加most构成。根据固定结构：one of the + 形容词最高级 + 名词复数 + 表示范围的短语或从句，可知，此空应填the most beautiful，故选D。

questions.prompt: Listening is just as  ______  as speaking in language learning.
questions.explanation: 句意：在语言学习中，听和说同样重要。 考查同级比较。as……as，和……一样，用于同级比较，前一个as后面接形容词或者副词原形，故选A。

questions.prompt: He just came back from the UK and he for the newspaper next month.
questions.explanation: 句意：---他刚从英国回来，下个月就要为报社工作了。考查动词时态。根据句中的提示词next month，可知应使用一般将来时，因此选D项。

questions.prompt: My grandfather wants  ______  around the world because he enjoys ______  places.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爷爷想环游世界，因为他喜欢看新地方。 本题考查动词want和enjoy的用法。第一空，根据“want to do sth.：想要做某事”可知，应填to travel，是动词不定式结构，故排除A和D；第二空，根据“enjoy doing sth.：喜欢做某事”，应填seeing，是动词的v-ing形式，故排除B，故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  playing a few games and dancing?
questions.explanation: 句意：玩几个游戏跳舞怎么样？ A. Why not为什么不，后面跟动词原形；B. Would you like你想要……吗？后面跟动词不定式；C. How about怎么样，如何，后面跟动名词；D. Shall we (同I和we连用，表示将来)将要，将会，后面跟动词原形。根据how about + doing sth，可知，此空应填How about，故选C。

questions.prompt: Lingling ______  much money on clothes.
questions.explanation: 句意：玲玲花很多的钱买衣服。 本题考查动词的辨析。A.cost的主语是物或某种活动，sth．costs （sb．） +金钱，某物花了（某人）多少钱；B.spend的主语必须是人，spend time /money on sth．在……上花费时间（金钱）；C.take后面常跟双宾语，It takes sb．+时间+to do sth．做某事花了某人多少时间；D.pay money for sth．付钱买…。由介词on可知，此空要用spends，故选B。

questions.prompt: The funny look made Lucy  ______  all the time.
questions.explanation: 句意：那滑稽的表情使露西一直笑个不停。 A. laugh动词原形；B. laughing现在分词或动名词；C. to laugh动词不定式；D. laughed过去式或过去分词。根据make sb. do sth.表示“使某人做某事”后跟省略的不定式，此空应填laugh，故排除B、C、D，故选A。

questions.prompt: We didn't do morning exercises  ______  the rain.
questions.explanation: 句意：由于下雨，我们没有做早操。 A. 因为；B.因为，由于；C.结果；D.即使。根据because 因为，后接句子；because of 因为，由于，后接名词或名词短语。根据空后the rain是名词，此空应填because of，故选B。 短文语法填空。 A If you are invited to an  ______ 13 ______  (A. American; B. America) home, you can bring a small gift. Flowers or candy are good gifts. You might have to take your shoes off at the door. When it's time for dinner, the hostess will tell you where  ______ 14 ______  (A. to sit; B. sit) at the table. Take some of everything. At the end of the meal, guests can offer to clear the table and help with the dishes. 【答案】13. A 14. A 【解析】 【分析】文章大意：如果你被邀请到一个美国家庭，你可以带一个小礼物。你可能得在门口脱鞋。晚餐时间到了，女主人会告诉你在桌边的位置。用餐结束时，客人可以主动提出清理桌子和帮忙洗碗。 【13题详解】 句意：如果你被邀请到一个美国的家庭，你可以带一个小礼物。 根据空前不定冠词an和空后home可知，此空应填形容词，此空应填American美国，故选A。 【14题详解】 句意：晚餐时间到了，女主人会告诉你在桌边的位置。 根据空前the hostess will tell you where可知，考查疑问副词where与动词不定式连用，故选A。 B Summer is over. It's time for school. Some students are ______ 15 ______  (A. excited; B. exciting). Others are nervous. Young students go to elementary school. They learn many ______ 16 ______  (A. subject; B. subjects). They usually stay in one classroom and have one teacher. 【答案】15. A 16. B 【解析】 【分析】文章大意：夏天结束了。该上学了。一些学生很兴奋,其他人很紧张。他们学了许多科目。他们通常待在一个教室里，有一个老师。 【15题详解】 句意：一些学生很兴奋。 根据空前are可知，此空应填形容词作表语，由形容词excited修饰人，形容词exciting修饰物，根据主语Some students可知，此空应填excited，故选A。 【16题详解】 句意：他们学了许多科目。 根据空前many可知，此空应填可数名词的复数形式，应填subjects，故选B。 根据上下文内容选择最佳答案，使文章完整。 Joe was driving home on a country road one winter evening. He spent several months looking for a new  ______ 17 ______  since the factory he had worked in is closed. It was a lonely road. Not many people had a reason to be on it unless they were leaving. He almost didn't see a small car  ______ 18 ______  at the side of the road. He thought the driver might need help, so he pulled up in front of the car and got out. An old lady was in the car. At first she was worried. “He didn't look  ______ 19 ______. He looked poor and hungry,” she thought. He could see that she was  ______ 20 ______. He said, “I'm here to help you, Madam.” All the lady had was a flat tire(瘪的轮胎). While Joe was  ______ 21 ______, the lady opened the window and began to talk to him. She told him that she couldn't  ______ 22 ______  him enough for helping her in such a situation. Soon Joe Was able to change the tire. She asked how much she owed(欠)him. Joe never thought about money. He told her that if she really wanted to pay him back, the next time she saw someone who needed help, she could  ______ 23 ______  that person the help. A few miles down the road, the old lady saw a small restaurant She decided to eat something and  ______ 24 ______  herself up before she finished her trip home. The waitress looked young and poor. After she finished her meal, she handed a 100-dollar bill to her. When the waitress went to get her change, the lady left without being  ______ 25 ______. The waitress then found some words on a piece of paper, “You don't owe me a thing. Someone once helped me, the way I'm helping you. If you really want to pay me back, here’s what you  ______ 26 ______. Don’t let the chain (链) of love end with you.”

questions.prompt: ---What do you know about kite surfing? ----It is  ______  exciting water sport.

I bought  ______  for my mother on Mother's Day this year.
The Great Wall is famous, so every year  ______ people come to visit it.
questions.explanation: 句意：长城很出名，所以每年有数百万的人来参观。 考查数词用法。此处表示的是概数， millions of 表示“数百万的”。A,B,D选项表述错误。故选C。 【点睛】million与millions of的区别 million：百万；millions of：成百上千万，上百万计。 当有具体的数词修饰million时，million用单数，这表示具体的数字“几百万”，比如 ：five million workers 五百万工人 当million后面跟有介词of时，必须加上s，前面不能有具体数字，of后面跟复数名词。此时表示的是概数， millions of 表示“数百万的”。如：millions of workers hundred,thousand的用法也是如此。

questions.prompt: You’ll have to  ______ the ticket early if you want to see that football match. A park
questions.explanation: 句意：你要想看那场足球比赛的话，就得早点儿订票。 考查动词辨析。A. park停放车；B. book预定；C. show展示；D. offer提供，根据early“早早地”，可知是早点儿预定票，故选B。

questions.prompt: （2016﹒山东青岛）The talent show is  ______  the game show. I like both.
Most people are  ______ building a paper factory near here. They are worried the river will get polluted.
questions.explanation: 句意：大多数人反对在这附近建纸厂。他们担心河流将会受到污染。 考查介词用法。A. for为了；B. with和，用；C. against反对；D. except除…之外，be against doing表示“反对、不赞成做某事” 由后句语境得知, 是反对建纸厂。故选C。

questions.prompt: You’d better travel around Nanjing with a local tour guide  ______ you want to know more about its culture.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你想更多地了解它的文化，你最好由当地的导游带着在南京旅游。 考查连词辨析。A. but但是；B. until直到；C. while然而；D. if如果，分析前后两句的逻辑关系， 根据句意，可知“由当地的导游带着在南京旅游”是“更多地了解它的文化”的“条件”。故选D。

questions.prompt: --Could you tell me some information about the hotels in your city? --Why not  ______  on the Internet?
—Why not  ______ for a walk after supper? —That’s a good idea.
questions.explanation: 句意：——晚饭后去散散步吧？——这是个好主意。 A.go去，动词原形； B.to go去，动词不定式； C.going 去，动名词或现在分词形式；D.goes去，单数第三人称形式。本题考查固定句式。Why not+动词原形，意为“为什么不……”, 表示向对方提建议。故选A。 完形填空 Modern life is impossible without travelling. The fastest  ______ 11 ______  of travelling is by air. With a modern airliner(客机) you can travel in one day to several places. It  ______ 12 ______ a month or more to get there a hundred years ago. Travelling by train is slower than by air, but it has  ______ 13 ______  advantages(优点). You can see the country you’re travelling through. Modern trains have comfortable seats and dining cars. They make even the longest journey  ______ 14 ______. Some people prefer to travel by water when  ______ 15 ______. There are large ships and river boats. You can visit many other countries and different places. Travelling by water is  ______ 16 ______  pleasant way to spend a holiday. Many people like travelling by car. You can make your own  ______ 17 ______. You can travel three or four hundred miles or only fifty or one hundred miles a day, just as you like. You can stop somewhere  ______ 18 ______. You can stop at a good restaurant where you can  ______ 19 ______  a good meal, or at a hotel to spend the night. That’s  ______ 20 ______  travelling by car is popular for pleasant trips. Taking a train or a plane is OK when people are travelling on business.

questions.prompt: I have a big family. There are eight people in  ______ family.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有一个大家庭。我家有八口人。 考查形容词性物主代词。my我的，形容词性物主代词；I我，人称代词主格；me我，人称代词宾格；mine我的，名词性物主代词。此处修饰其后名词family，可知要用形容词性物主代词，故选A。 【点睛】形容词性物主代词和名词性物主代词都可翻译成“某人的”，但是两者用法不同。形容词性物主代词看作形容词，作定语修饰其后名词；名词性物主代词看作名词，作主语、宾语或表语，其后无需再接名词。两者可构成一个等式：形容词性物主代词+名词=名词性物主代词。

questions.prompt: I always come to school ______  bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：我总是乘公交车来学校。 考查介词辨析。on在……上；by凭借，乘坐；of……的；in在……里。此处表示乘坐某种交通工具，根据固定用法，by后直接接交通工具表示“乘坐、使用某种交通工具”，故选B。

questions.prompt: —These apples are really tasty.  ______  did you buy them? —In the store around the corner.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些苹果很好吃。你在哪里买的？——在角落处的那家店。 考查特殊疑问词。How怎样；Why为何；When何时；Where何处。根据下文回答的是地点，可知此处是询问地点，应该用where，故选D。

questions.prompt: I'd like to play basketball with you,  ______  I have homework to do.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想和你打篮球，但是我有作业要做。 考查并列连词。for因为；so所以；but但是；or或者。根据前后两句的逻辑，可知此处表示转折，应该用but，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Lucy,  ______  you tell me how to improve my English? —Why don't you read more English stories?
questions.explanation: 句意：——露西，你能告诉我怎么提高我的英语吗？——你为什么不多读些英语故事呢？ 考查情态动词。can能；must必须；should应该；need需要。根据句意，可知此处表请求，应该用can，故选A。

questions.prompt: My brother loves making model planes. He is ______  in science than art.
questions.explanation: 句意：我弟弟喜欢做模型飞机。他对科学比美术更感兴趣。 考查形容词比较级。interested感兴趣的，形容词原级；more interested更感兴趣的，形容词比较级；most interested最感兴趣的，形容词最高级。根据其后than，可知此处要用比较级，故选C。

questions.prompt: The opera is very difficult. I hope  ______  more next time.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个戏剧很难。我希望下次能理解更多。 考查非谓语动词。understand动词原形；understanding动名词；to understand动词不定式；understood动词过去分词。根据固定用法，hope后接动词不定式作宾语，意为“希望做某事”，故选C。 【点睛】hope既有名词词性，意为“希望”，又有动词词性，意为“希望”，其作动词时，常见用法如下：①后接动词不定式作宾语，即hope to do sth.，意为“希望做某事”；②后接宾语从句，通常可省略宾语从句的引导词that，注意此时其后要接完整的句子，不存在hope sb. to do sth.的用法。

questions.prompt: I  ______  to my grandparents’ home every weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：我每个周末都去祖父母家。 考查动词时态。go一般现在时；went一般过去时；was going过去进行时；will go一般将来时。根据频率副词every weekend，可知用一般现在时，故选A。

questions.prompt: Shhh! Please don't talk so loud. Mum  ______  your grandma.
questions.explanation: 句意：嘘，请别讲话那么大声。妈妈正在给你外婆打电话呢。 考查动词时态。calls一般现在时；called一般过去时；was calling过去进行时；is calling现在进行时。根据语境，可知此处要用现在进行时，故选D。 【点睛】解答动词的时态类试题时，考生可参考以下3种方法来判断用哪种时态： （1）根据时间状语确定时态 特定的时间状语往往标志着特定的时态，句中已经给出了明显的时间状语。考生只要牢记这些时间标志词所对应的时态，在答题时就会变得游刃有余。如： ①一般现在时，熟记明显的时间标志词，如often, usually, every系列等。 ②一般过去时的时间标志词有just now, yesterday, in the past, last系列等。 ③一般将来时的时间标志词有tomorrow, the day after tomorrow, next系列等。 ④现在进行时的时间标志词有now, at the moment等。 ⑤过去进行时的时间标志词有at that time等。 ④现在完成时时间标志词有already, since, for, so far, recently等。 (2)利用上下文语境判断时态 动词的时态是由上下文的语境来决定的，这就要求考生一方面要熟记各种时态的适用范围，另一方面要注意上下文想表达的语境。因此，如果一个英语句子中既没有出现时间状语，也没有可供判断时态的上下文，那么就应当把这个句子翻译成中文，根据中文意思来判断这个句子该用何种时态。 (3)根据上下文已有的时态信息确定时态 有些试题虽然看起来没有时间状语，但是上下句的动作存在着明显的时间顺序，因此可根据上下文已有的时态来判断空格处所要选用的时态。

questions.prompt: Sorry, I can't meet you this afternoon. I  ______  out with some friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：抱歉，我今天下午不能见你。我要和一些朋友出去。 考查动词时态。go一般现时；will go一般将来时；was going过去进行时；went一般过去时。根据时间状语this afternoon，可知要用一般将来时，故选B。

questions.prompt: Last Sunday my brother  ______  to the football game.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周日，我哥哥去参加足球比赛了。 考查动词时态。go一般现在时；goes一般现在时；went一般过去时；will go一般将来时。根据时间状语Last Sunday，可知用一般过去时，故选C。

questions.prompt: My sister ______  her room when Susie rang and asked her out.
questions.explanation: 句意：当苏西打电话叫我姐姐出去时，她正在打扫房间。 考查动词时态。is tidying现在进行时；was tidying过去进行时；tidies一般现在时；tidied一般过去时。根据从句when Susie rang and asked her out用一般过去时，此处表示我姐姐当时正在做什么，可知此处用过去进行时，故选B。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 On a cold morning in Austria, 16-year-old skier Ann Thompson was about to make her last practice run. As she went down the  ______ 13 ______ on her skis, Thompson had a terrible accident. She fell and badly hurt her spinal cord (脊髓). As a result, Thompson could no longer walk. “The accident didn't ______ 14 ______ anything.” Thompson said. “I' m the same person I was before.” After her accident，Thompson ______ 15 ______ the Cruisers, a program for wheelchair athletes (运动员) in Connecticut, Thompson’s home state. “We brought her down to see what was happening,” said Don Chaffee, a Cruiser official. “At first, she said, ‘I can't do that.’ Then she realized, ‘I can do that. I'm going to do that.’” Just over a year after her accident, Thompson was a good wheelchair athlete. Her ______ 16 ______  was track and field (田径). Thompson also played basketball in her college. It wasn't ______ 17 ______ for her. She had never played basketball before her accident. Now she was learning the sport in a wheelchair. She tried out for the, U. S. Paralympic women’ s basketball team, and she ______ 18 ______ it. Thompson is a role model for millions of people. She wanted to tell kids through her story. “Try,” she said. “Really try. If you want to do something, try your best to do it. If you really want to do something, you can find a ______ 19 ______ to do it.” Kids who watch her practice see that anything is possible. “They see this lady in her wheelchair going around and  ______ 20 ______ life, ” said Chaffee. “And they say, ‘Hey, I can make it, too. ”

questions.prompt: My sister is very nice and kind. We all like  ______  very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的妹妹非常漂亮，而且善良。我们都非常喜欢她。her她，宾格形式；him他，宾格形式；you你，主格形式或宾格形式；them他们，是宾格形式。此处代指my sister，作为动词like的宾语，故用代词her，故选A。

questions.prompt: Lily often visits her grandma  ______  Sundays．
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉经常在星期天看望她的奶奶。 考查时间介词。at+钟点，表示在几点钟；in+年/月/季节，表示在某年或某月或某季节；on+具体日期，表示在具体某一天；分钟+to+整点，表示差几分钟到某个整点；而Sundays是指“周日”，表达“在周日”是on Sundays，要用介词on，故选C。

questions.prompt: Mr. Liu was old,  ______  he kept working.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然刘先生年纪大了，但他继续工作。 考查连词。and和、又；but但是；so因此；or或者。根据句意可知，“刘先生年纪大了”和“他继续工作”是转折关系，故选B。

questions.prompt: Diwang Tower is ______ than many other buildings in Shenzhen．
questions.explanation: 句意：在深圳，帝王塔比许多其他建筑都高。 考查比较级的用法。由句中“than（比）”可知，此句是用帝王塔和其他建筑相比较，应用比较级。tall的比较级为taller，故选B。

questions.prompt: In China， you ______  only use red paper for hongbao because red means luck．
questions.explanation: 句意：在中国，红包必须只能用红纸，因为红色代表幸运。 考查情态动词辨析。must必须，一定；need需要，need to do sth需要做某事；might是may的过去式，意为“可能，可以”；could是can的过去式，意为“能，可能”。根据中国传统，在中国红包必须用红纸，故选A。

questions.prompt: —What did you do last Saturday，Mary？ —I  ______  my mum clean the house．
questions.explanation: 句意：——Mary，你上周六做什么了？——我帮助妈妈打扫房间了。 考查一般过去时。根据时间词last Saturday可知时态为一般过去时，故动词help用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Where's your dad, Peter? —He ______  in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你爸爸在哪，彼得？——他正在厨房做饭。 考查时态。根据语境可知，对话发生的时刻，彼得的父亲“正在做饭”，动词需用现在进行时，结构是“be+doing”，故选D。

questions.prompt: We ______  a school trip next Monday.
questions.explanation: 句意：下星期一我们学校要去旅行。 考查时态。根据句中的时间“next Monday”可知，动作还没有发生，所以应该用将来时，结构是“will+动词原形”，故选D。

questions.prompt: David ______  Chinese when Alice came into the classroom．
questions.explanation: 句意：当爱丽丝走进教室时，戴维正在学语文。 考查时态。根据“when Alice came into the classroom”可知，从句是一般过去时态，从句的动作发生时，主句的动作也在发生，learn是延续性动词，所以主句用过去进行时态。故选C。

questions.prompt: Betty ______  to school by bike every day．
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂每天骑自行车上学。 考查动词时态。goes第三人称单数；is going现在进行时表将来；will go一般将来时；was going过去进行时表将来。根据时间状语every day可知，这里用一般现在时，主语是单数，谓语动词变第三人称单数。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you read English storybooks every day, Linda? — At 7: 00 pm.
questions.explanation: 句意：----琳达，你每天什么时候读英语故事书？-----晚上7点。考查特殊疑问句。A. When什么时候，询问时间；B. Why为什么，询问时间；C. How怎样，如何，询问方式方法；D. Where在哪里，哪儿，询问地点。根据回答“At 7: 00 pm.（-晚上7点）”可知询问时间，询问时间用when；结合句意可知填When；选A。

questions.prompt: I hope ______  the Beijing Opera with my friend．
questions.explanation: 句意：我希望能和我的朋友一起看京剧。 考查非谓语动词。seeing看见，动名词；see看见，原形；saw看见，过去式；to see看见，动词不定式。短语hope to do sth.希望做某事，用动词不定式作宾语，故选D。 二、选择方框中恰当的词语填空，并将该词语的字母标号涂在答题卡的相应位置上． A. is famous for B. is interested in C. is looking after D. write down E. think about

questions.prompt: Alice’ s parents gave a nice toy dog on her birthday.
questions.explanation: 句意：爱丽丝的父母在她过生日的时候送给了她一只漂亮的玩具狗。 考查人称代词辨析。they他们；them他们；she她；her她。根据句中gave是动词，所以此处使用人称代词宾格形式；Alice是女性，所以此处用人称代词宾格her符合题意。故选D。

questions.prompt: Eric can play guitar and he can play soccer, too.
questions.explanation: 句意：埃里克会弹钢琴，也会踢足球。 考查冠词的使用。the是定冠词，表示“特指”，或者放在乐器前面；根据句中guitar是乐器，可知此处是play the guitar；句中soccer是球类运动，所以此处是play soccer，中间不需要冠词。故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  Sunday morning I went to the library with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：在星期日早上，我和我的朋友们去了图书馆。 考查介词辨析。in在……里；on在……上；at在……时候；to到……。根据Sunday morning是具体某一天的早上，所以此处应使用介词on。故选B。 【点睛】本题考查的是介词辨析，in、on、at可以作为时间介词，但是用法不同。in用在世纪、年份、月份、季节以及一天中的早、中、晚的前面；on用在星期、日期、特定的节日（一天）以及某一天的早、中、晚的前面；at用在某一时刻、年龄以及特定节日（不止一天）的前面。本题中Sunday morning是具体的某一天的早上，所以用介词on符合题意。

questions.prompt: There  ______  a lot of people in the museum yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天，在博物馆有许多人。 考查一般过去时。is和are都是be动词，was是is的过去式，were是are的过去式；根据句中a lot of people是复数，根据yesterday可知，句中时态为一般过去时，所以此处应使用be动词were。故选D。

questions.prompt: Jack often TV in the evenings. But now he is an English book.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克经常在晚上看电视，但是现在他正在读英语书。 考查一般现在时和现在进行时。watch是动词，表示“观看”，watch TV看电视；read是动词，表示“阅读”，read an English book读英语书；根据句中Jack是第三人称单数形式以及句中的often可知，此处时态是一般现在时，所以第一空应使用动词第三人称单数形式watches；根据句中now可知，句中时态为现在进行时，所以第二空使用reading。故选B。

questions.prompt: The story is  ______  and all of us are  ______  in it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个故事很有趣，我们所有人都对它感兴趣。 考查形容词用法。interest兴趣；interesting有趣的；interested感兴趣的。故事是有趣的，第一空用interesting在句中作表语；be interested in对……感兴趣，固定搭配。故选D。

questions.prompt: － ______  you feel scared when you saw the big snake? －No, I didn’t feel scared at all.
questions.explanation: 句意：——当你看到那条大蛇的时候你感到害怕吗？——不，我一点也不害怕。 考查一般疑问句。do是助动词，其过去式是did；was和were是be动词；根据句中saw可知，句中的时态是一般过去时；根据句中feel是实义动词，且you是主语，所以此处变为一般疑问句时需要借助助动词did。故选B。

questions.prompt: －What does he look like? －.

questions.prompt: －Would you like some orange juice? － ______. I’m very thirsty.

questions.prompt: － is it from your home to school? －It’s ten minutes’ walk.

questions.prompt: The North Star is one of  ______  stars in the night sky.

questions.explanation: ——你曾和你的朋友们有过任何问题吗？——是的，但是我们和好了。 考查时态。A.一般过去时；B.现在完成时；C.一般将来时；D.一般现在时。根据问句中的ever可知，ever常用于现在完成时中，B项符合题意。故选B。

questions.prompt: I haven't heard from Mr. Smith  ______  he moved to Shanghai.
questions.explanation: 自从史密斯先生搬去上海，我就没有收到过他的来信了。 考查连词。since自从，连词；for介词，与一段时间连用；in在，介词；so所以，连词。空前空后是两个独立的句子，应用连词连接，排除C项；根据“I haven't heard from Mr. Smith”可知，现在完成时用常与“since+句子”连用，表示从过去某一时间点到现在为止。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Could you tell me  ______? —Because the scenery attracts me.

choices.label: A
choices.text: why do you go to Tibet

choices.label: B
choices.text: when are you going to Tibet

choices.label: C
choices.text: why you are going to Tibet

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你为什么要去西藏吗？——因为风景吸引我。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句用陈述语序，排除A和B；根据答语Because the scenery attracts me因为风景吸引我，可知问why为什么；故选C。 四、完形填空 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Changing Makes You More Confident I used to hate being called upon in class mainly because I didn't like attention drawn to myself. And unless otherwise assigned (指定) a seat by the teacher, I always  ______ 13 ______  to sit at the back of the classroom. All this changed after I joined a sports team. It began when a teacher suggested I try out for the basketball team. At first I thought it was a  ______ 14 ______  idea because I didn't have a good sense of balance, nor did I have the  ______ 15 ______  to keep pace with the others on the team and they would laugh at me. But for the teacher who kept insisting on my "going for it", I wouldn't have decided to give it a try. When I first started  ______ 16 ______  the practice sessions, I didn't even know the rules of the game, much less what I was doing. Sometimes I'd get confused and take a shot at the wrong  ______ 17 ______  —which made me feel really stupid. Fortunately, I wasn't the only one "new" at the game, so I decided to focus on learning the game, do my best at each practice session, and not be too hard on myself for the things I didn't know "just yet". I practiced and practiced. Soon I knew the  ______ 18 ______  and the "moves". Being part of a team was fun and motivating (激励, 动力). With time, I learned how to play and made friends in the process — friends who respected my efforts to work hard and be a team player. I never had so much fun! With my improved self-confidence comes more  ______ 19 ______  from teachers and classmates. I have gone from "  ______ 20 ______  " in the back of the classroom and not wanting to call attention to myself, to raising my hand— even when I sometimes wasn't 100 percent sure I had the right answer. Now I have more self-confidence in myself.

questions.prompt: Alice looks sad. Let's cheer  ______  up.
questions.explanation: 句意：Alice看起来很伤心，我们让她振作起来吧。 考查代词的用法。hers她的，名词性物主代词；her她的或她，宾格形式，形容词性物主代词；herself她自己，反身代词；she她，主格。动词短语中间用宾格。故选B。

questions.prompt: He must be out,  ______  he will come to answer the door.
questions.explanation: 句意：他一定是出去了，否则他会来开门的。 考查连词。and和；yet然而；but但是；or否则，要不然。根据“He must be out,  ______  he will come to answer the door.”他一定是出去了， ______  他会来开门的。可知，应该选择or否则，要不然。符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mum, I have a cold. —You  ______  go to a doctor. I’ll take you to hospital.
questions.explanation: 本题考查情态动词的用法。结合本题语境可知，你“应该”去看医生，故should符合题意。

questions.prompt: I was  ______  busy at that time  ______  I couldn't answer my friend's telephone.
questions.explanation: 句意：那时候我太忙了，连朋友的电话都没接。 考查结果状语从句。too; to太……不……，用于“too+形容词、副词+不定式”；enough; to “足够……做某事，用于“形容词、副词+ enough+ to do sth”；such; that“这么……以致……”，such+名词+ that从句；so; that如此……以至于……，so+形容词、副词+that从句；从文字的表层意思推断空格指太忙了，连朋友的电话都没接；空格2后是从句，所以排除A、B；空格1在形容词前，所以排除C；故选D。

questions.prompt: She decided  ______  for a volunteer after-school reading program.
questions.explanation: 句意：她决定参加课后阅读节目的志愿者选拔。 考查动词不定式做宾语。trying out动词短语ing形式；try out动词短语原形；to try out动词短语不定式；tried out动词短语过去式。决定做某事，decide to do sth.，动词不定式做宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Dad, could I go to a movie? — ______. But don't stay out late.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爸爸，我能去看电影么？——可以，你可以去，但是不要在外面呆太晚了。 考查情景交际用语。Yes, you could是的，你可以；Yes, you can是的，你可以；No, you can't不，你不可以；No, you couldn't不，你不可以。根据答句，但是不要在外面呆太晚，可知是同意，故排除CD；could用于表示准许时，要用can回答。故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  talk with them about your problems?
questions.explanation: 句意：为什么不和你父母说你的问题呢？ 考查情景交际用语，四个选项都可用于提出建议。Would you like项表示想要，后常跟to；Why don't表示为什么不，后跟you，与D项含义一样；Why not后直接跟动词原形；How about表示……怎么样，相当于what about，后跟动名词。题中划线处后talk是动词原形，故选D。

questions.prompt: Helen is one of  ______  girls in the talent show. I enjoy watching her dancing.
questions.explanation: 句意：海伦是选秀节目中最受欢迎的女孩之一。我喜欢看她跳舞。 考查形容词的最高级。选项A为原级；选项B为比较级；选项C为最高级；选项D为最高级。此题是：one of+形容词的最高级+可数名词的复数形式，表示：“其中之一最……”；形容的最高级前不能省略定冠词the。故选D。

questions.prompt: It  ______  heavily when my sister and I got to the museum.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我和妹妹到达博物馆时，正好下大雨了。 考查动词的时态。rained下雨过去式；was raining下雨，过去进行时；is raining下雨，现在进行时；rains下雨，一般现在时。根据句意，当我和妹妹到达博物馆时，动词got是过去式，表示到达博物馆时正在进行的动作，用过去进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: We will be lost  ______  I drop white stones on the way.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果我没有沿路丢白色石头，我们会迷路的。 考查连词词义辨析。until直到……才；unless除非，如果不；if如果；although虽然。根据句意表示如果我没有沿路丢白色石头，我们会迷路的，可知是除非，如果不的意思。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to go to the amusement park with me? —I'd love to, but I  ______  there many times before.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你愿意和我一起去游乐园吗？——我愿意去，但是我以前已经去过很多次了。 考查现在完成时。have been there表示曾经去过那里，人已经回来；go/went to there是错误选项；have gone there表示某人去了某地，还没有回来；will go there将要去那里。由many times可知，题干表示“我已经去过那里很多次了”。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What's the best food you have had in Beijing, Alex? —Roast duck! I  ______  to a famous restaurant to have it last week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你在北京吃过的最好的食物是什么，亚历克斯——烤鸭！我上周去了一家著名的餐馆吃烤鸭。 考查时态。have gone现在完成时；go一般现在时、原形；will go一般将来时；went一般过去时；根据时间状语last week判断句子是一般过去时，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Does Mr. Smith know Shanghai very well? —Of course. He  ______  there since he came to China in 1980.
questions.explanation: 句意：——史密斯先生很了解上海吗？——当然。自从他1980年来中国就一直住在那里。 考查现在完成时。has lived现在完成时；was living过去进行时；lived一般过去时；lives一般现在时、单三；根据时间状语“since he came to China in 1980.”判断句子是现在完成时；故选A。

questions.prompt: Unless you  ______  you will realize your dream one day.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你不放弃，你有一天会实现你的梦想。 考查动词短语词义辨析。stay up熬夜；hurry up快点；give up放弃；put up挂起，张贴。结合语境理解，如果你不放弃，你有一天会实现你的梦想，可知是“放弃”的意思。故选C。

questions.prompt: Nobody knows  ______  yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：没有人知道昨天事故是如何发生的。 根据yesterday可知此处用一般过去时，故排除BC两项。作为动词knows的宾语从句，故用陈述语序：疑问词+主语+谓语+宾语，故选A。 二、完形填空 A 阅读下面的短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写1个适当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 Aron Ralston, an American man who is interested in mountain climbing, is used to taking risks. However, on April 26, 2003, he found himself in a very dangerous situation when climbing in Utah. His arm was caught under such a heavy rock that he couldn't  ______ 16 ______ his arm. He stayed there for 5 days to wait for help before his water ran out. Later, he decided to save his own life by ______ 17 ______ (cut) off half his right arm. In order not ______ 18 ______ (lose) too much blood, he even bandaged himself with his left arm. After that experience, he wrote a book called Between a Rock and a Hard Place to tell of the ______ 19 ______ (important) of making good decisions, and being in control of one's life. His love for mountain climbing is so ______ 20 ______ that he kept on climbing mountains even after this experience. 【答案】16. free 17. cutting 18. to lose 19. importance 20. great 【解析】 本文介绍了登山运动员阿伦·罗尔斯。在2003年4月，阿伦在犹他州的峡谷探险时遇到意外，右臂被夹在石缝中无法动弹，他只好借由身体的力量靠在峡谷岩壁上，这样支撑了5天之后，他的水耗尽了。最后他不得不用小刀割断自己的手臂，并且成功的拯救了自己。 【16题详解】 句意：他的右臂被一块很重的石头压住了，他无法把胳膊抽出来。 根据“His arm was caught under such a heavy rock”他的胳膊被一块很重的石头压住了。可知，他是无法把胳膊抽出来。也就是右臂被夹在石缝中无法动弹。故填free。 【17题详解】 句意：后来，他决定砍掉右臂的一半来挽救自己的生命。 句中的by是介词，后跟动名词做宾语。故填cutting。 【18题详解】 句意：为了不失血过多，他甚至用左臂包扎自己。 此处是in order not to do sth.为了不做某事。故填to lose。 【19题详解】 句意：在那次经历之后，他写了一本名为《生死两难》的书，书中讲述了做出正确决定和掌控自己生活的重要性。 分析句子结构可知，在the与of之间应该填一个名词，important的名词为importance。故答案为importance。 【20题详解】 句意：他对爬山的热爱是如此之深，以至于在经历了这段经历之后，他还是继续爬山。 根据“he kept on climbing mountains even after this experience.”他还是继续爬山。可知，他对爬山的热爱是如此之深。故填great。 B 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A, B,C,D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 In November 1979, pupils in England were able to watch a new TV program called Monkey. Most of them were hearing this story for the first time. However, this story is not  ______ 21 ______  to Chinese children. The Monkey King or Sun Wukong is the main character in the traditional Chinese book Journey to the West. The Monkey King is not just any normal monkey. In fact, he sometimes does not even look like a monkey! This is because he can make 72 ______ 22 ______ to his shape and size, turning himself into different animals and objects. But unless he can hide his tail, he cannot turn himself into a man. To fight bad people, the Monkey King uses a ______ 23 ______  stick. Sometimes he can make the stick so small that he can keep it in his ear. At other times, he is able to make it big and long. The Monkey King has ______ 24 ______  the children of China for many years. And as soon as the TV program came out more than 30 years ago, western children became interested in reading this story because the clever Monkey King keeps fighting to help the weak and never gives up.

questions.prompt: Uncle Wang is coming to our house. I can't wait to see  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：王叔叔要来我们家了。我迫不及待地想见到他。 考查人称代词。him他，人称代词宾格；her她（的），人称代词宾格或形容词性物主代词；it它，人称代词主格或宾格；them他（它，她）们，人称代词宾格。动词see后接人称代词宾格，根据题干中“Uncle Wang is coming to our house.”可知是迫不及待想见王叔叔，用him指代Uncle Wang。故选A。

questions.prompt: Qian Xuesen, the famous scientist, was born  ______  December, 1911.
questions.explanation: 句意：著名科学家钱学森生于1911年12月。 考查时间介词。on后接具体的某一天；at后接具体钟表时刻；in后接年、月、季节或一天的上午、下午、晚上等；over多于。根据空后“December, 1911”可知此处指在1911年12月，月份前用介词in。故选C。

questions.prompt: Sam  ______ his mum clean the house every weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：每个周末塞姆帮助他妈妈打扫房子。 考查时态。helped一般过去时态；helps一般现时态（主语单三）；will help一般将来时态；is helping现在进行时态；every weekend可知用一般现在时态，主语Sam单三，谓语动词用单数形式；故选B。

questions.prompt: Mr. Ball is 62. He just got a new computer  ______  he isn't sure how to use it.
questions.explanation: 句意：鲍尔先生今年62岁。他刚买了一台新电脑，但不知道怎么用。 考查连词。or或者；for因为；so所以；but但是；根据句意理解可知，He just got a new computer 与he isn’t sure how to use it.前后两句表达的是转折关系，表示“但是”，所以这里应该用but连接，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Which do you like ______, swimming or skating? —Swimming.
questions.explanation: 句意：你更喜欢哪一个，游泳还是滑冰？——游泳。 考查副词比较级辨析。good好的，形容词原级；better更好，形容词或副词比较级；best最好，形容词或副词最高级；the best最好，形容词或副词最高级。swimming or skating是在游泳和滑冰两者间比较，且空格处修饰动词like，所以空格处填副词比较级better。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  you sing an English song? —Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能唱一支英文歌曲吗？——是的，我能。 考查情态动词。Can能，能够；May 可以；Must必须，一定； Need需要。Can多表示自身拥有的某种能力，有关can的一般疑问句，一般还是用can来进行回应，故选A。

questions.prompt: —— do you usually go to school, Mary? ——By bike.
questions.explanation: 句意：--玛丽，你通常怎么上学？ --骑自行车。考查疑问词。A. 什么时候；B. 怎么；C. 哪里；D. 为什么。结合语境“玛丽，你通常怎么上学？骑自行车。”。可知，对乘坐某种交通工具提问，用疑问词how提问。故选B。 【点睛】疑问词通常用来构成疑问句，要根据回答的具体内容进行选择，注意一些固定搭配，分清疑问词的用法。

questions.prompt: —Where did you go last weekend? —I  ______  to the Beijing Expo Park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上周末你去哪儿了？ ——我去了北京世博园。 考查时态。选项A为一般现在时；选项B为一般过去时；选项C为现在进行时；选项D为现在完成时。由last weekend可知，此题应该用一般过去时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What is your father doing, Mike? —He  ______  in the garden.
questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克，你的父亲正在做什么？——他正在花园里浇水。 考查动词时态辨析。waters一般现在时；watered一般过去时；is watering现在进行时；has watered现在完成时。根据问句What is your father doing中用的是现在进行时结构，所以答语也用现在进行时be doing结构，主语he是第三人称，所以空格处填is watering。故选C。

questions.prompt: Steve  ______  us if he comes to Beijing next month.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果史蒂夫下个月来北京，他将来拜访我们。 考查一般将来时。visit拜访。visits动词的第三人称单数形式；visited动词的过去式；has visited现在完成时；will visit一般将来时。根据题干中“if he comes to Beijing next month”可知if引导的条件状语从句，从句用一般现在时，主句要用一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: My aunt is a worker. She  ______  in this factory for 20 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姑姑是个工人。她在这家工厂已经工作了20年。 考查时态。选项A为一般现在时的单三形式；选项B为一般过去时；选项C为现在进行时；选项D为现在完成时。由for 20 years可知，此题应该用现在完成时。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you tell me to London? —Sure.Next month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我什么时候去伦敦旅行好吗？——当然可以，下个月。 考查宾语从句。由回答中的next month可知用一般将来时态，宾语从句用陈述句语序。故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Valuable Gifts When my mother told my father she was pregnant (怀孕), the first thing he did was to buy a TV. It was 1957 and TVs were new technology. He thought that with a baby, they would go out less and he would need to find entertainment at home. That was the first  ______ 13 ______  he gave me. But when I think of other gifts my father has given me, the first would be a love of  ______ 14 ______. He is always found reading in our study. He has been totally deaf in one ear since he was two, so we rarely listened to music. In my childhood, storybooks were king, not songs. The second is  ______ 15 ______  all. He treats everyone the same—CEO or cleaner, child or adult. Even when I was little, the conversation around the dinner table was noisy but adult-level. He always said my age didn't matter. If I voiced an opinion, I had to argue the case and give evidence (证据). The greatest gift to me, however, was that he took interest in my  ______ 16 ______  and never my looks. Most successful women had fathers who ______ 17 ______  their intelligence. My father said that my mother was the most intelligent person he had ever met. He still says that. They met at a dance in the early 50s when she was a teacher. Wanting to show off, he told her she reminded him of Jane Austen's Emma, then misquoted (错误地引用) the book. My mother  ______ 18 ______  corrected him and he was in love from that moment. Over the years, my father taught me never to stand  ______ 19 ______  and never to accept the way things are; I should find for change. I will continue to follow his  ______ 20 ______.

questions.prompt: Miss Smith is very kind. We all like  ______.（2017 北京中考）
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯老师非常好心。我们都喜欢她。 考查代词的用法。A. it 它；B. her 她；C. him 他；D. Them他们，根据句意及题干分析此空作like的宾语，所以用宾格，Miss Smith是女性，所以用her，故选B。

questions.prompt: The pop singer will have a concert  ______  Shanghai next week.
questions.explanation: 句意：这位流行歌手下周将在上海举行音乐会。 in在……内；at在 (某处) ；of关于(某人)；to向，朝。Shanghai上海，地名，表示地点，在地点前用介词in。故选A。

questions.prompt: -- ______ do you go to school every day? --By bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你每天怎么去上学。 ——乘公共汽车。 Who什么人，就人名提问；What什么，就事物提问；How怎样，就方式提问；Where哪里，就地点提问。由答语：by bus. 乘公共汽车。可知，本题是就方式提问，因此应该用how来提问。故选C。

questions.prompt: -- ______  I borrow your pen, please? --Sure, Here you are.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我能借一下你的钢笔吗？ ——当然，给你。 Must必须；Should应该；Need需要；Can能，能够。本题主要考查情态动词的用法。根据语境可知，前文要表达的是：我能借一下你的钢笔吗？ 综合各个选项，只有“can”能表达“能够”的意思。因此选项D是正确的。对于其他选项，选项A中的must表示“必须”，通常是虚拟语气；选项B中的should是“应该”的意思；选项C中的need是“需要”的意思。均不符合本题的语境和用法，所以都不选。

questions.prompt: I like playing basketball ______ my brother doesn't like it.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢打篮球，但我哥哥不喜欢。 but但是，表示转折；and和，表示并列；or或者，表示选择；so因此，表示因果。结合本题的语境：我喜欢打篮球，与我的哥哥不喜欢，之间存在着转折关系，因此用but连接。故选A。

questions.prompt: I can run  ______ than Peter in the sports meet this year.
questions.explanation: 句意：在今年的运动会上我跑得比彼得快。 选项A是原级；选项B是比较级；选项C是最高级；选项D是最高级。由句中的比较连词than可知，本题应该用比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: I was very happy yesterday. My father ______ me a gift for my birthday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我很高兴。我父亲给我买了一份生日礼物。 选项A是动词原形；选项B是一般将来时；选项C是过去式；选项D是三单。由时间状语yesterday可知，本题应该用一般过去时，故选C。

questions.prompt: -- Which is ______ season in Beijing? --I think it is autumn.
questions.explanation: 句意：——北京哪个季节最好？ ——我想是秋天。 选项A是原级；选项B是比较级；选项C是最高级；选项D是最高级。我们知道一年有四个季节，结合答语中的autumn，可以推断应该用最高级，排除A/B；而在最高级前应该加the。故选D。

questions.prompt: --What were you doing this time yesterday? --I ______ lunch at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天这个时候你在做什么？ ——我在家吃午饭。 选项A是现在进行时；选项B是过去进行时；选项C是一般现在时；选项D是一般过去时。由问句What were you doing this time yesterday?的时态是过去进行时，可以得知下文的答语也应该用过去进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: He  ______  football with his friends every weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：他每个周末都和朋友们踢足球。 选项A是一般现在时；选项B是现在进行时；选项C是一般过去时；选项D是一般将来时。由句子中的时间状语every weekend可知，该题的时态应该用一般现在时。故选A。

questions.prompt: --Mark, are you listening to music? --No, I ______ my mother wash clothes now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——马克，你在听音乐吗？ ——不，我现在正在帮妈妈洗衣服。 选项A是一般过去时；选项B是一般将来时；选项C是现在进行时；选项D是一般现在时。由问句Mark, are you listening to music?和答语中now可知，该题的时态应该用现在进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______ volunteer work with my classmates next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：下星期天我将和我的同学一起做义工。 选项A是一般现在时；选项B是过去进行时；选项C是一般过去时；选项D是一般将来时。由句中的时间状语next Sunday可知，该题的时态应该用一般将来时。故选D。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所绘的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 On my first day of the seventh grade. I noticed one little girl called Amy on the school bus. “Don’t talk to her,” Lauren said, who sat beside me. “Or they will make fun of you.” Amy had many physical(身体的) differences - lots of  ______ 13 ______ for other kids to make fun of her. Her eyes weren’t straight. Her glasses were an inch thick. And she had really ugly teeth. Every day as we drove to and from school, kids would shout insults (侮辱) at Amy. “God, what a (n)  ______ 14 ______  face! Stop looking at me!” “Mr. Rolland (the driver)! Amy took off her  ______ 15 ______  and now her eyes are frightening me!” For a while I shouted my share of insults, just so I’d would fit in, I didn’t want them to treat me the same way they treated Amy. But while I was insulting her, my heart  ______ 16 ______  for the girl. I could see that the insults were making her look uglier, because she was so ashamed and alone. Then I wanted to stand up for her. I just didn’t know how to  ______ 17 ______  my schoolmates until the night of our class roller-skating party. Our whole class was there, including(包括) Amy. Amy didn’t know how to skate, but I could see how much she wanted to have fun like the rest of us. So I skated over to her and took her by the hand; we began the journey together around the skating rink (溜冰场). She just smiled, and sometimes she would laugh ______ 18 ______. On the school bus the next morning there was much news about Amy and me ______ 19 ______ together, but nobody insulted her or me. And they didn’t do that for the rest of the year. After graduation, I never heard from Amy again. However, I never forget her and I’ve always ______ 20 ______ if I changed her life for the better. But I know for sure she changed my life. After becoming her friend, I no longer tried to impress (给……留下印象) people by trying to act like them. I became myself.

questions.explanation: 句意：——玛丽，你能告诉我布朗先生什么时候回来吗？——当然，下周回来。 根据宾语从句用陈述句语序，排除A和C；根据next week可知用将来时态；故选B。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 A Musical Astronaut Brenda Bongos was a happy, artistic girl. She had one big dream—to play the drums in a band. But one big problem lay in her way. To be good enough to play in a band, Brenda had to  ______ 13 ______ a lot, but she lived next-door to a lot of old people. Many of them were sick. She knew that the sound of beating drums would really make them  ______ 14 ______. So, she had tried playing in the strangest places: a basement(地下室), a kitchen, and even in a shower. However, there was always someone it would annoy(打扰). To practice as much as she could, Brenda spent most of her time playing on books and boxes, and looking for new places to practice. One day, while watching a science documentary on TV, she  ______ 15 ______  that sound cannot travel in space, because there's no air. At that moment, Brenda Bongos decided to become a sort of musical astronaut. With the help of a lot of time, books and work, Brenda  ______ 16 ______  a space bubble. This was a big glass ball connected to a machine which sucked out(吸出)all the air inside. Only a set of drums and a chair would be  ______ 17 ______  inside the bubble. Brenda also made herself a space suit. She put on the suit, entered the bubble, turned on the  ______ 18 ______, and played those drums like a wild child. Soon Brenda Bongos became very famous. Many people came to see her play in her space bubble. Then she came out of the bubble and started giving concerts. As her fame(名气)spread ______ 19 ______, the government suggested that she should be part of a special space journey. Finally, Brenda was a real musical astronaut, and had gone far beyond her first dream of playing drums in a band. Years later, when asked how she had achieved all this, she thought for a moment, and said: "If those old people next-door hadn't mattered so much to me, I wouldn't have found a(an) ______ 20 ______, and none of this would have ever happened. "In the face of difficulties, Brenda showed her kindness, she worked hard and never stopped trying.

questions.prompt: We won't wait for you  ______  you can't get there on time.
——He got an A in last week's math test. ——It is  ______! His math is always the worst.
questions.explanation: 句意：——在上周数学测验中，他得了个A。——那是不可能的，他的数学通常最糟糕。根据His math is always the worst可知得A不可能；A.possible可能的；B.simple简单的;C.impossible不可能的；D. bored无聊的；根据句意故选C。

questions.prompt: After two hours' drive, the driver decided  ______  and have a rest.
questions.explanation: 句意：开了两个小时的车，司机决定停下来休息一下。 A 动词原形 B 动词不定式 C 动词现在分词 D 动词过去式。考查句型decide to do sth决定做某事，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Alice didn't go to the party  ______ her illness. —I'm sorry to hear that.
questions.explanation: ——因为爱丽丝病了所以她没去参加派对。——听说那样很抱歉。 本题考查介词短语because of的用法。because 因为；but但是； so所以； because of因为。根据语境，“爱丽丝病了”与“她没去参加派对”之间存在因果关系，所以排除but；“她病了”是原因，所以排除so；because与because of的区别是because后接句子，而because of后接名词，“her illness”“她的疾病”是名词短语，所以用because of。故选D。 【点睛】because和becauseof的区别：从词性上看because 是连词，其后接句子；because of 是复合介词，其后接名词、代词、动名词、what 从句等。如：I didn’t buy it because it was too expensive. 我没有买是因为它太贵了。2、从用法上看because 所引导的从句除用作原因状语外，还可用作表语。而复合介词 because of 所引导的介词短语通常用作状语而不用作表语。如：It is because he loves you. 是因为他爱你。He was absent because of the rain.他因雨缺席。

questions.prompt: The book is  ______  for us to read and it's also fun.
questions.explanation: 句意：这本书读起来很容易，也很有趣。 从后句it's also fun判断这里说的应该是书简单易读，这里用easy，enough 修饰形容词，应该位于之后， 故选D。

questions.prompt: (2018·山东临沂) Could you please speak a little louder? I  ______  hear you very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：请你说大点声好吗？我不能很好地听到你说的话。考查情态动词辨析。can't不能，表示不能够；mustn't不许，表禁止；shouldn’t不应该，表劝诫；needn’t无需，表示没必要。本句表示“不能够”，根据句意语境，可知BCD三项意思都与句意不合，故选A。

questions.prompt: The more careful you are, the  ______  mistakes you will make.
questions.explanation: 句意：你越认真，你犯的错误就会越少。A. fewer更少；修饰可数名词复数；B. fewest最少；修饰可数名词复数；C. less更少，修饰不可数名词；D. least最少，修饰不可数名词；这里是the+比较级……；the+比较级……，表示越……就越……。mistakes是可数名词的复数，这里用fewer来修饰，根据题意，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Does your mother have a hobby? —No,  ______  you call going shopping a hobby.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的母亲有爱好吗？——没有，除非你把购物也当作爱好。unless除非；because因为；although虽然；if如果。答句句意：除非你把购物也当作爱好。这里是说除非的意思。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Can you hang out with me tonight? — ______, but I am not available.
questions.explanation: 句意：--你今晚能和我一起玩吗？--我想，但是我没有空。 A我想，B当然，C好，D劳驾；根据前句"你今晚能和我一起玩吗"和后句"但是我没有空"可知，要用"我想"回答，其它选项语意不通，故选A。

questions.prompt: If he  ______  here, I'll call you at once.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果他到这儿了，我会立刻给你打电话。 本题考查句子时态，在条件状语从句中，如果主句是一般将来时，从句用一般现在时替代一般将来时；即所谓的主将从现。根据句意，本句是条件状语从句；主句“I'll call you at once.”是一般将来时态，所以从句用一般现在时态。arrive到达，三单形式为arrives。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you take a shower? —Every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久洗一次澡？——每天都洗。 本题考查特殊疑问词。How many多少；How much多少；How old多大； How often多久一次。根据题干答语，‘Every day”“每天”是做事的频率；How many与how much是用数字或量词、多少钱来回答，排除A,B；how old是用某人多大岁数来回答，排除C；how often多久一次，是用频率作答，故选D。

questions.prompt: My cousin has a good  ______. He never plays games if he doesn’t do his homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的堂兄弟有一个好的习惯。如果不做家庭作业，他从不玩游戏。 本题考查名词辨析。habit习惯；result结果；friend朋友；time时间。依据题干，“He never plays games if he doesn’t do his homework.” “如果不做家庭作业，他从不玩游戏”，结合横线前面的单词“good”，这显然不是一个好的结果，也不是一个好的朋友，更不是一个好的时间；是一个好的习惯，符合题意。故选A。

questions.prompt: .It is very dangerous for you  ______  soccer in the street.
questions.explanation: 句意：对你来说在街上踢足球是危险的。 在英语句子结构 It’s + adj. +for sb to do sth. 译作“(某人)做某事是……的”。It 是形式主语，不定式结构是真正主语，for后面的sb是不定式的逻辑主语；本题考查这一结构，to play做句子的真正主语。故选B。

questions.prompt: This bed is too hard. I feel very  ______ in it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这张床太硬了，在上面我感觉不舒服。 本题考查形容词辨析。warm暖和的； interesting有趣的；comfortable舒服的；uncomfortable不舒服的。根据题干“This bed is too hard. ” 这张床太硬了，可知，我的感觉应该是不好，而A,B,C都是积极的、好的形容词，所以应该是uncomfortable不舒服的，故选D。

questions.prompt: I need  ______ bananas to make fruit salad. Could you please buy some?
questions.explanation: 本题的含义是我需要几个香蕉做水果沙拉，你能给我买一些吗？a few表示“几个”的意思，修饰可数名词的复数；few表示否定“几乎没有”，修饰可数名词复数；a little有一些，修饰不可数名词；little几乎没有，修饰不可数名词；本题中的bananas是可数名词的复数，根据句意可知要一些；故选B。 完形填空 “Problems and worries are normal (正常) in life,” says Laura. “But I think talking to someone helps a lot. If we don't talk to someone, we'll certainly feel  ______ 16 ______. ” Laura once lost her  ______ 17 ______, and worried for days. She was afraid to tell her parents about it. She even walked three miles to school each day because she didn't have any money. She just kept  ______ 18 ______  of the problem again and again in her mind. “If I tell my parents, they'll be angry!” But in the end, she talked to her parents and they were really  ______ 19 ______. Her dad said that he  ______ 20 ______  made careless mistakes himself. They got her a new wallet and asked her to be more careful. “I will always remember to  ______ 21 ______  my problems in the future!” Laura says. Robert Hunt advises students about common  ______ 22 ______. He feels the same way as Laura. “It is best not to avoid our problems. We should always try to solve them. ” He thinks that you can first find someone to talk to. This person doesn't need to be an expert like himself. Students often forget that their parents have more  ______ 23 ______  than them, and are always there to  ______ 24 ______  them. In English, we say that sharing a problem is like cutting it in half. So you're halfway to solving a problem if you talk to  ______ 25 ______  about it.

questions.prompt: Pandas are in danger and we should protect  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：熊猫正处于危险中，我们应该保护它们。 考查人称代词宾格。it它；them他/它们；her她；him他。分析题干，空处缺少宾语，根据“Pandas”可知，这里代词需用复数，故选B。

questions.prompt: Shenzhen is  ______  the south of China.
questions.explanation: 句意：深圳在中国的南方。 考查方位介词辨析。in表示范围之内的某方位；at表示在某个小地方；on表示与某方位是毗邻关系；to表示范围之外的某方位。深圳属于中国，是在中国的内部某个地方，in符合题意，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______ is the population of New York, the biggest city of America? —About 8.5 million.
questions.explanation: 句意：——美国最大的城市纽约的人口是多少？——约850万人。 考查特殊疑问句和疑问词辨析。Where在哪里，对地点进行提问；When什么时候，对时间进行提问；Who谁，对人进行提问；What多少。根据回答“About 8.5 million”可知对人口多少进行提问，故选D。

questions.prompt: In England, we  ______  say Mr. or Mrs. when we meet someone for the first time.
questions.explanation: 句意：在英格兰，当你第一次遇到某人时，你一定要称呼先生或夫人。 考查情态动词。can能、能够；must必须、一定；need需要；might可能、也许。根据题干，结合常识，可知在英格兰，当你第一次遇到某人时，你一定要称呼先生或夫人。此处是表示“一定”的意思，用must，故答案选B。

questions.prompt: I often watch English movies  ______  it can help me improve my English.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常看英语电影，因为它能帮助我提高英语水平。 考查连词。so 所以，表示结果，并列连词；but但是，表转折，并列连词；because因为，表示原因，从属连词；or或者，表选择，并列连词。根据句意前后两句表示因果关系，后一句表示原因，所以用because引导原因状语从句，故选C。

questions.prompt: Riding a bike is  ______  than driving a car and it is good for our health.
questions.explanation: 句意：骑自行车比开车便宜，并且它对我们的健康有好处。 考查形容词比较级。根据句中than可知横线处应该用形容词的比较级形式，cheap的比较级为cheaper，故选B。

questions.prompt: Many people enjoy jogging. It is one of  ______  sports in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：许多人喜欢慢跑，它是世界上最受欢迎的运动之一。 考查形容词的最高级。A项为形容词的原级；B项为形容词的比较级；C项为错误选项；D项为形容词的最高级。根据one of可知，应该使用形容词的最高级；形容词的最高级之前要加定冠词the。故选D。

questions.prompt: Lu Xun  ______  to help the Chinese people, so he decided to be a doctor in 1904.
questions.explanation: 句意：鲁迅希望帮助中国人民，所以在1904年他决定当一名医生。 考查时态。hopes希望，动词三单；hoped希望，过去式；will hope希望，一般将来时；is hoping希望，现在进行时；根据句意理解及后句的动词可知，后句用的是过去时，所以这里也用过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Mum, what's dad doing? —He  ______  a football match on TV now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，爸爸在干什么？——他正在电视上看足球比赛。 考查时态。watches观看，动词三单；watched观看，过去式；is watching观看，现在进行时；will watch观看，一般将来时；根据句意理解可知，问句用的是现在进行时，所以回答也用现在进行时，表达的是正在进行的动作，故选C。

questions.prompt: China  ______  the 24th Winter Olympics in 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国将要在2022年举办第24届冬奥会。 考查一般将来时。A：一般现在时；B：一般过去时；C：现在进行时；D：一般将来时。根据句中时间状语in 2022可知，时间表将来，应使用一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  to cross the road when the accident happened.
questions.explanation: 句意：事故发生时，我正等着过马路。 考查动词时态。wait等待，动词原形；will wait一般将来时；was waiting过去进行时；are waiting现在进行时。根据题干可知，本句是when引导的时间状语从句，表示一个动作进行时，另一个动作也正在进行，所以此处应用进行时态，再由happened为一般过去时，可知这里应用过去进行时态，故答案选C。 二、完形填空 通读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The power of attitude (态度)! "Look, it's Baldy (秃头)!" A boy shouted to me on the playground. Although I was often insulted (侮辱) because of the scars (伤疤) on my head, it was  ______ 13 ______  to hear. When I was just 20 months old. I had an accident—a bowl full of hot oil fell on my head. My parents sent me to hospital at once and I had to  ______ 14 ______  there for weeks while the doctors tried their best to save my life. "It is very lucky for your daughter to be alive， "they told Mum and Dad. "But she'll be left with scars on her head, and of course her hair won't grow there." As a child, I  ______ 15 ______  much about my scars, so I always wore a scarf to cover them up when I left home. If I didn't, people would call me terrible names like Baldy. One day, I took part in a children's bums (烫伤) camp. There I made a friend, a 14-year-old girl, Mary. Her burns are a lot more serious than mine. But she is so strong that she  ______ 16 ______  shows any sadness. "You shouldn't listen to what people talk about what you look like because we're not  ______ 17 ______  from anyone else." She told me sincerely (真诚地). "You don't need to wear a scarf because you look great too without it." So later, at my 13th birthday party, I took off my  ______ 18 ______  and showed off my scars. It felt amazing not having to  ______ 19 ______  away behind my scarf. Now I am  ______ 20 ______  of what I look like and much happier because I know it is your attitude that tells who you truly are.

questions.prompt: Mo Yan kept on writing and at last  ______  won the Nobel prize.
questions.explanation: 句意：莫言坚持写作，最终他赢得了诺贝尔奖。 考查人称代词词义辨析。he他，人称代词主格；she她，人称代词主格；his他的，形容词性物主代词；her她的，形容词性物主代词。根据文学常识可知莫言是一位男作家，且题干“and”连接的句子，后句缺少主语，故选A。

questions.prompt: Einstein, the famous scientist, was born March, 1879.
questions.explanation: 句意：爱迪生，著名的科学家出生在1879年3月。 在某年、某月用介词in，在某一时刻用介词at，在具体的某一天用介词on，根据句意，故选C。

questions.prompt: My father did not come back home  ______  he finished his work.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲直到做完工作才回家。 考查连词。although虽然；until直到……；if如果；as当……时；根据句意理解可知，这里表达的是“没有回家直到做完工作”，在这里构成not…until的结构，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you hang out with friends? —Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久和朋友出去玩一次？——一周一次。 考查副词词义辨析。How many……多少，询问数量；How much…….多少钱，询问价格；How long多长时间，询问时间多久或物体多长；How often多久一次，询问频率。根据答语“Once a week.”一周一次，可知问句是询问做某件事情的频率。故选D。

questions.prompt: It's  ______ to have happy children than to have successful children.
questions.explanation: 句意：有一个快乐的孩子比有一个成功的孩子更重要。 考查比较级。important重要的；more important更重要的；most important最重要的，缺少the；the most important最重要的；根据句意理解及句中的than可知，这里应该用比较级的形式，表示两者之间的比较，important的比较级需要加more，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Could you help me carry the bag? —Sorry, I  ______. I have to go to the teachers' office now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能帮我提一下包吗？——对不起，我不能。我现在得去教师办公室。 考查情态动词。can't 不能，表现在的能力；couldn't不能，表过去的能力；mustn't不许，表禁止；won't不要，表将来发生的动作；根据“I have to go to the teachers' office now” 我现在得去教师办公室，推断空格指不能帮对方提包；故选A。

questions.prompt: We won't give up because we don't want  ______  the teachers down.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们不会放弃因为我们不想让老师失望。 考查不定式。let原形；letting动名词、现在分词；to let不定式；lets一般现在时的第三人称单数形式；want to do sth想要做某事，由此判断空格填不定式；故选C。

questions.prompt: She  ______  her dog for a walk after dinner every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：她每天晚饭后带着她的狗散步。 考查时态。is taken被带，一般现在时被动语态；taking带，现在分词或动名词；takes带，动词三单；took带，过去式；根据句意理解及句中的every day可知，此题的时态为一般现在时，且主语与动词之间是主动关系，故选C。

questions.prompt: —How was your weekend? —Wonderful! I  ______  a great time with my friends in the water park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你周末过得怎么样？——太棒了！我和朋友们在水上公园玩得很开心。 考查时态。had有，过去式；have有，动词原形；will have有，一般将来时结构；am having有，现在进行时；根据句意理解及前句How was your weekend?可知，这里表达的是过去的事情，所以这里应该用had，故选A。

questions.prompt: They  ______  basketball when the sandstorm came.
questions.explanation: 句意：沙尘暴来临时，他们正在打篮球。 考查时态。play玩，一般现在时态；played玩，一般过去时态；are playing玩，现在进行时态；were playing玩，过去进行时态；根据句意理解及后句when the sandstorm came可知，这里表达的是当某个动作发生时，另一个动作正在进行，这是过去进行时的用法，所以应该用过去进行时态；故选D。

questions.prompt: —Is your father at home? —No, he  ______  Shanghai.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你父亲在家吗？——不，他去上海了。 本题考查时态。has gone to是现在完成时，表示去了还没有回来；has been to是现在完成时，表示去过，现在回来了；will go to是一般将来时；goes to是一般现在时。根据No可知，他现在不在家，因此表示去上海了，还没有回来，故选A。

questions.prompt: —I’m going to Tibet for vacation. — ______.
questions.explanation: ——我要去西藏度假了。——祝你玩得开心。 考查交际用语。You’re welcome不客气；I’d love to我想去；Have a good time.玩的开心；I’m sorry to hear that听到这很抱歉。当得知某人要去旅游时，要以“Have a good time．”表达祝福。故选C。 四、根据课文原文填空。 A 阅读下面的短文，根据课文内容填空。在未给出提示词的空白处仅填写一个适当的单词。在给出提示词的空白处，用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 In November 1979, pupils in England were able to watch a new TV program called monkey. Most of them were hearing this story for the first time. However, this story is not new to Chinese children. The monkey king or Sun Wukong is a main character in the traditional Chinese  ______ 13 ______  Journey to the West. The monkey king is not just any normal monkey, in fact, he sometimes does not even look like a monkey. This is because he can make 72  ______ 14 ______  to his shape and size, turning himself into different animals and objects. But unless he can hide his tail, he cannot turn himself into a man. To fight bad people, the monkey king uses the magic stick. Sometimes he can make the stick so  ______ 15 ______  that he can keep it in his ear. At other times. He is able to make it big and long. The monkey king has excited the children of China for many years. And as soon as the TV program came out more than 30 years ago. Western children became interested in reading this story because the clever monkey king keeps  ______ 16 ______  (fight) to help the weak and never gives up. 【答案】13. book 14. changes 15. small 16. fighting 【解析】 文章介绍了《西游记》中的主要角色——美猴王。介绍了美猴王的外观以及他一直努力帮助弱者，从不放弃的精神。 【13题详解】 句意：美猴王是中国的传统书籍《西游记》中的一个主角。 根据文学常识，可知《西游记》是中国的传统书籍，且这是一本书，用可数名词单数，故填book。 【14题详解】 句意：这是因为他能变72种形状和大小。 根据turning himself into different animals and objects把他自己变成不同的动物和物体，可知是change变化，72种变化，所以用复数；故填changes。 【15题详解】 句意：有时他能把金箍棒变得如此的小以至于能放在耳朵里。 根据 he can keep it in his ear能放在耳朵里，可知是small小的；故填small。 【16题详解】 句意：因为这个聪明的美猴王坚持斗争保护弱者，从不放弃。 根据keep doing sth.坚持做某事；故填fighting。 B 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的ABCD四个选项中选择最佳选项。 When I first arrived on this island, I had  ______ 17 ______. But I've found the ship and made a small boat. I've brought back many things I can use—food and drink, tools, knives and guns. Although I have lost everything, I have not lost my life. So I will not give up and I will wait for another ship. I have already cut down trees and built a house. I go out with my gun almost every day to kill animals and birds for food. I am even learning to grow fruit and vegetables. A few weeks ago, I found the  ______ 18 ______  of another man's feet on the sand. Who else is on my  ______ 19 ______? How long have they been here? Not long after that, I saw some cannibals trying to kill two men from a broken ship. One of them died, but the other ran towards my house. I helped him kill the cannibals. This man now lives with me and helps me. I named him Friday. Because that was the day I met him. He is smart and I have already  ______ 20 ______  him some English.

questions.prompt: Tom and Jerry went to the zoo.  ______ wanted to see the new-born baby panda.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆和杰瑞去了动物园。他们想看看刚出生的熊猫宝宝。 考查代词。They主格，；Them宾格；Their形容词性物主代词；Theirs名词性物主代词；分析句子“  ______ wanted to see the new-born baby panda” ______ 想看看刚出生的熊猫宝宝，此处缺主语，故选A。

questions.prompt: The little children often play  ______ the playground after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：孩子们放学后经常在操场上玩。 with和；on在……上面；for为了；above在……上；根据on the playground表示“在操场上”，所以此处用“on”，故选B。

questions.prompt: The restaurant is very popular now,  ______ I don't like the food there.
questions.explanation: 句意：这家餐馆现在很受欢迎，但我不喜欢那里的食物。 考查连词。and和；but但是；or否则；so所以；分析句子“The restaurant is very popular now,  ______ I don't like the food there”这家餐馆现在很受欢迎， ______ 我不喜欢那里的食物，所以这两句话是转折关系，故选B。

questions.prompt: You  ______ follow the traffic rules, or you will be in danger.
questions.explanation: 句意：你必须遵守交通规则，否则会有危险。 考查情态动词。can能；may可以；must必须；might可以；根据“follow the traffic rules”遵守交通规则，所以此处是法律法规，用must表示“必须”，故选C。

questions.prompt: The supermarket is probably  ______ place in town every Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：超市可能是每个星期六下午镇上最热闹的地方。 考查最高级。busy形容词原级；busier比较级；the busiest最高级；根据“ in town”所以此处应该用最高级the busiest，表示“最热闹的”，故选C。

questions.prompt: —It snowed  ______ in Beijing yesterday. —Wow! You could make a snowman.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天北京下了大雪。——哇！你可以堆雪人了。 考查副词。heavy形容词；heavily副词；heavier形容词比较级；more heavily副词比较级；根据“It snowed ”，所以此处缺副词修饰动词，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing at eight o'clock last night? —I  ______. I had a headache.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨晚八点你在干什么?——我正在睡觉。我头痛。 考查时态。sleep一般现在时；slept一般过去时；am sleeping现在进行时；was sleeping过去进行时；根据“at eight o'clock last night”昨晚八点，所以此处用过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: You need to be  ______ when you are driving on icy roads than on dry roads.
questions.explanation: 句意：当你在结冰的道路上开车时，要比在干燥的道路上开车时更加小心。 考查比较级。careful原级；more careful比较级；the most careful最高级；根据“when you are driving on icy roads than on dry roads”所以此处用比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______ do you water your plants? —Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久给植物浇一次水?——一个月两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少（可数名词）；How much多少（不可数名词）；How long多久；How often多久一次；根据“Twice a month”一个月两次，所以此处用How often，故选D。

questions.prompt: Lisa's parents always encourage her  ______ more friends at school.
questions.explanation: 句意：丽莎的父母总是鼓励她在学校交更多的朋友。 make动词原形；to make动词不定式；made一般过去时；making动名词，现在分词；根据encourage sb to do sth表示“鼓励某人做某事”，所以此处缺动词不定式，故选B。

questions.prompt: I finished reading the book while I  ______ to see a doctor.
questions.explanation: 句意：我在等医生的时候读完了这本书。 考查过去进行时。am waiting现在进行时；will wait一般将来时；was waiting过去进行时；wait一般现在时；根据while+sb+be doing表示“当某人做……时”；所以此处缺过去进行时，故选C。

questions.prompt: —How did Peter improve his English so fast? —He  ______  from his mistakes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得英语怎么提高得这么快?——他从错误中吸取教训。 考查时态。learned一般过去时；is learning现在进行时；；will learn一般将来时；learn一般现在时；根据“How did Peter…”所以此处也是一般过去时，故选A。 【点睛】1、while用作连词时，表示“在……(过程)中，在……期间”。

questions.prompt: — Alice, is this your dictionary? — Let me see. Oh, no.  ______  is in my schoolbag.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爱丽丝，这是你的字典吗？ ——让我看看。哦，不是。我的字典在书包里。 考查代词。A. Myself我自己，反身代词；B. Me我，人称代词宾格；C. My我的，形容词性物主代词；D. Mine我的，名词性物主代词。根据句子结构，句子缺主语，且根据问句is this your dictionary提示，空格处应填入意为“我的字典”的主语，名词性物主代词mine等于my dictionary，可作主语，故选D。

questions.prompt: The Dragon Boat Festival is coming. It comes  ______  June 25 this year.
questions.explanation: 句意：端午节快到了。今年（的端午节）是6月25日。 考查介词。A. in用于指早午晚、年、月、季节、一段时间后；B. on用于指具体某一天，如星期几，节日以及具体某一天的早中晚；C. at用于指某一特定的时刻；D. for用于指时间的长度。根据空格后June 25提示，后接具体某一天应用介词on，故选B。

questions.prompt: I like cartoons,  ______  I didn’t go to watch The Adventures of Tintin last week because of the test.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢卡通片，但上星期因为考试没去看《丁丁历险记》。 考查连词。A. so因此，表因果关系；B. and和，表并列关系；C. but但是，表转折关系；D. or或者，表选择关系。根据前后句意可知，“喜欢卡通片”和“上星期因为考试没去看《丁丁历险记》”之间为转折关系，故应用表转折的连词but，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Who runs fastest in your class? — Tom does. He always runs  ______  than any other student.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你们班谁跑得最快？ ——汤姆。他总是比其他同学跑得都快。 考查副词比较级。A. fast快速地，副词原级；B. faster更快地，副词比较级；C. fastest最快地，副词最高级；D. the fastest最快地，副词最高级。根据than any other student提示，than是比较级的标志，表示Tom与其他学生两者进行比较，故空格处应填入副词的比较级形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: Jimmy is a kind boy. He  ______  others fix up the bikes for five years.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉米是个好孩子。他已经帮别人修理自行车五年了。 考查现在完成时。A. helps表一般现在时；B. will help表一般将来时；C. helped表一般过去时；D. has helped表现在完成时。根据句中for five years提示，持续某一个状态，句子要用现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Our teacher often tells us  ______  our own cloth bags when shopping.
questions.explanation: 考察非谓语动词。Tell后面接带to不定式做补足语，表示具体的将要进行的动作，故选C。固定结构tell sb to do sth表示告诉某人做某事。

questions.prompt: If Tony  ______  to the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, Bob will join him.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果托尼要去看2022年冬奥会，鲍勃将和他一起去。 考查if引导条件状语从句的“主将从现”。根据英语语法，由if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，即主句是一般将来时，从句要用一般现在时。故空格处所在从句应用一般现在时，且主语Tony表第三人称单数，故动词应用第三人称单数形式goes，故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  Mr. Smith since he moved to Shanghai.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从史密斯先生搬到上海以来，我一直没有收到他的信。 考查现在完成时。根据“since he moved to Shanghai”可知，此处为现在完成时，因主语是I，故用助动词have not+过去分词，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Tina, have you tried mom’s cookies? — Yes. They  ______  perfect!
questions.explanation: 句意：——蒂娜，你尝过妈妈做的饼干吗？ ——是的。它们味道好极了！ 考查感官动词。A. tastes品尝，动词第三人称单数形式；B. taste品尝；C. smell闻到；D. look看。根据tried mom’s cookies提示，问的是品尝了妈妈做的饼干吗，故空格处应填入意为“品尝”的感官动词，C、D选项可排除。句子主语They表第三人称复数，故应用动词原形taste，故选B。

questions.prompt: China's Chang'e-4 ______ on the far side of the moon on Jan 3. 2019.
questions.explanation: 句意：2019年1月3日，中国的嫦娥四号卫星在月球的背面着陆了。 考查动词时态。lands着陆，动词的第三人称单数形式；landed过去式或过去分词形式；will land一般将来时；has landed现在完成时。根据句意和句中的时间状语on Jan 3. 2019可知，这是一个过去的时间，这句话应用一般过去时态。故选B。

questions.prompt: — I called you at ten o’clock yesterday morning, but nobody answered the phone. — Oh, I  ______  a basketball match with my friends at the stadium.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我昨天早上十点给你打电话，但没人接。 ——哦，我和朋友们在体育馆看篮球赛。 考查过去进行时。A. watched表一般过去时；B. watch动词原形；C. am watching表现在进行时；D. was watching表过去进行时。根据at ten o’clock yesterday morning提示，可知空格处应用过去进行时，表示过去某一时刻正在发生的动作，D选项符合句子结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Have you seen David recently? —Yes, yesterday I met David in the supermarket and he  ______  pretty happy.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你最近见过大卫吗？——是的，我昨天在超市见到了大卫，他看起来非常开心。 考查感官动词辨析。looked看起来；smelled闻起来；felt感觉；sounded听起来。根据句中met可知，此处是“见到了大卫，他看起来很开心”。故选A。 二、完形填空 To Test Your Wings "We have to let him try it, Lila," I said to my wife. reading-a.title: Exercise 003
reading-a.content:
A
You’re never too young to start being charitable. It doesn’t have to be a grand gesture, just something as simple as a lemonade stand.
But sometimes even the smallest gestures can end up becoming a rather big deal. And one perfect example of this, is a neighborhood lemonade stand in Peoria, Illinois, which really took off.
It started out when a group of neighborhood kids in the Knolls neighborhood got together in order to participate in a fundraiser to help raise money for the St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital. The children got busy selling lemonade and other treats all throughout the weekend, and their hard work paid off. In total, they were able to make more than $3,500 for the good cause.
But this charitable lemonade stand isn’t in its first year. In fact, it has been several years in the making, all because of one mom’s actions. Suzanne Miller has been participating in charity races for the hospital for years, and because of her actions, her kids wanted to join in her fundraising. Hence the lemonade stand was started.
As Miller shared with the reporter, “The first year we did it we raised $220, and we thought that was amazing. Each year, it got bigger and bigger.”
But it’s not just the profits that have increased over the years, so have the volunteers. This year, Miller’s kids were joined by her neighbor Leslie Rothan’s three kids in running the lemonade stand.
Miller posted to Facebook, “The Lemonade Stand that our neighbors hosted this weekend raised $3,515 and donated it to the hospital. I can’t find the words to tell you how I feel. It’s absolutely incredible to celebrate this way.
Leslie Rothan added, “As a parent, it really makes you filled with joy. It was their idea, and obviously we wanted to support and encourage them to be as successful as possible, but it really helped them to realize what they were doing and how that money could really help save children.

How to keep fit
Running
Running will help you lose weight faster than any other activity. It also strengthens your heart, lungs, and leg muscles . But it can hurt your joints . If you feel ache in your knees , you need to stop and choose a different activity.
Walking
Walking puts less stress on the body than running. But you need to get your heart beating faster to see results. This means you’ll need to walk fast. Walking can also help you lose weight.
Swimming
Swimming is a great way to strengthen different parts of your body. It is also a good way to help lose weight. The water in a swimming pool is cooler than our body temperature. The body naturally protects itself from the cold by burning fat.
Cycling
Riding a bicycle will help you lose weight and work leg muscles. But be careful! If you live in the city, you should stay on bike path and away from traffic.

Simone let the door slam behind her as she walked into the house. Her backpack came off her shoulders and onto the floor.
“What’s wrong, little sis?” Thomas asked.
“Everything,” Simone said, “I can’t do anything right.”
Thomas turned to Simone. “Now I know that’s not true. You just got second place at the school history fair, and Mom and Dad didn’t even help you with your project. I’d say that was doing something right.”
“Yeah second place. That’s me. Second best to Sheri in everything.” Simone crossed her arms.
“What happened?” Thomas asked.
Simone took a deep breath and said, “I tried out for the school play, and Sheri got the lead.”
Thomas nodded. “She has been taking acting lessons for the past two summers.”
Simone put her arms down. “I know, and I’m happy for her, but I practiced every night for that part. I wanted it so much.”
“What part did you get?” Thomas asked.
“The second best part, of course. When is it going to be my turn to be the best at something?”
Thomas touched Simone’s hair. “You’re the best little sister I have.”
“I’m your only sister,” Simone said.
The doorbell rang, and Thomas got up to answer it.
“Hi, Sheri. Congratulations on getting the lead in the play.”
“Thanks,” Sheri said, but she didn’t look happy. She walked into the living room and sat down next to Simone. “I have to tell you something. I saw your audition . You’re a natural actress, Simone. I was worried you were going to get the lead, and now I feel bad for hoping you wouldn’t get the part. I wish I were as good a friend as you are.”
“Looks like you’re the best at something after all,” Thomas said to Simone.
Simone smiled. “I’m glad we got the two main parts, Sheri. That means we get to practice our lines together. It’s going to be so much fun.”

Don’t you think robots are a part of your life? In factories, robots put together everything from toys to cars. Some homes have robots that sweep floors or mow the lawn . And more robots are soon to come.

Like a Human
Robots don’t expect any thanks for all the work they do for us. After all, they don’t have feelings. But that may be changing with Nexi, a robot created by scientists at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Nexi can move its face to show anger, happiness or sadness. It can also raise its eyebrows to show surprise.

Household Helpers
How would you like a robot to help clean up your toys, or one that plays hide-and-seek with you? Nao can be programmed to do both those activities, and more. A two-foot-tall robot, Nao was designed by a company in France to be a helper and companion . It can talk, walk and even remember faces, voices and places.

Robots at Work
Need a lift out of bed? RIBA, short for “Robot for Interactive Body Assistance”, will lend its helpful arms! Some patients at hospitals and nursing homes have a hard time getting in and out of bed. RIBA can gently lift a patient out of bed and help him or her into a wheelchair .

Water Bots
Robots that work in water—and look like sea creatures —are making news lately. One of them is a robotic fish. Researchers built the robotic fish to swim in water to find out pollution. There’s even a robotic penguin called the AP, which can move in water in all directions.

When you travel, festivals are one of the most amazing experiences. They’re fun and a good way to learn about the place you’re visiting. Here are some of the amazing festivals in the world.

Songkran, a time to wish for good luck, is on some of the hottest days in April in Thailand, and people celebrate it by throwing water on each other, using water guns, and buckets. Elephants can also be seen walking around and splashing off water at people!

The Carnival in Rio de Janeiro is a world famous festival in late February or early March every year and the biggest carnival in the world. The first festival of Rio dates back to 1823. We can see people with colorful clothes and masks on the street.

La Tomatina is a fun festival held on the last Wednesday in August in Spain every year. People throw tomatoes at each other. People first started celebrating it in 1945. From then on, La Tomatina has become one event that gets you dancing, and having great fun.

The Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta is the largest hot air balloon festival in the world. This 9-day event is held in Albuquerque, New Mexico, USA during early October. People can see around 750 balloons.

When my son, Mark, was in the third grade, he saved all his pocket money for over three months to buy holiday presents. The third Saturday in December Mark said he had made his list and had twenty dollars in his pocket.

Finally he came to the checkout counter and reached into his pocket for his money. It was not there! There was a hole in his pocket, but no money. A woman came up to Mark and took him in her arms. “You would help me a lot if you let me pay for you,” said the woman. “It would be the most wonderful gift you could give me. I only ask that one day you will pass it on. When you grow up, I would like you to find someone you can help. When you help others, I know you will feel as good about it as I do now.”
Mark took the money, dried his tears and ran back to the checkout counter as fast as he could. That year we all enjoyed our gifts almost as much as Mark enjoyed giving them to us.
I would like to say “thank you” to that very kind woman, and tell her that four years later, Mark went house to house collecting blankets and clothes for the homeless people in the fire. And I want to promise her that Mark will never forget to keep passing it on.

I always wanted to be an only child, so I wouldn’t worry about someone taking the remote during a “big game”. However, I had an older sister, Christie.
I started playing basketball when I was eight. My dad was the coach of my team, and my mom kept score. So, my sister, who wasn’t old enough to stay at home alone, had to come to all of my games. She looked like she didn’t want to be there, but she cheered with the crowd anyway.
On the way home from the games, my parents and I talked about everything I did on the court . My sister sat in the backseat with me in silence. She didn’t really understand what was going on in the games. But most nights, she came into my room and said, “Good night, Brad. Good game.” I would smile and thank her. When I was in high school, Christie didn’t have to come to my games anymore. But she still came every week, cheering me on. I remember the last game of the season. My sister came with a large group of her friends. Printed on her shirt, in big, bright red letters, were the words “BRAD’S SISTER”. Suddenly, I was embarrassed . I felt embarrassed, not because she was there but because I’d never thanked her for helping me before.
My sister left for college a few months after that last game, and I am an only child now. But now that she’s gone, I miss having someone to fight with for the remote a lot.
I went to visit her at college for a weekend, and as I stood outside her dorm , waiting for her to come out, a friend of hers walked past me and questioned, “Hey, aren’t you Christie’s brother?” I said proudly, “Yeah, I am. I’m Christie’s brother.”

reading-a.title: Exercise 105
reading-a.content:
All countries around the world have their ways to celebrate the coming year. Here are some unusual new year traditions around the world that you must know.

In Canada, they have an unusual new year tradition known as the Polar Bear Swim. Peter Pantages started this event in 1920 in Vancouver when his friends jumped in the freezing waters of the English Bay. Now, it is held in many places. But why do they do that? Many participants say that it starts off their year right since the icy water clears their heads—a cleansing for the mind and soul.

At midnight, people go to the streets and dance to drum beats to welcome the New Year. The London Eye stands in bright colors for the fireworks show at midnight. For hours before the clock strikes 12, people come together to watch shows. The London Eye is lit up each year for New Year’s celebrations.

On New Year’s Eve in Venice, Italy, the most popular celebrations are setting off fireworks in the street and the fireworks displays are great ways to send off the old year and welcome the new one. As the clock strikes midnight, the boat paradebegins. People often enjoy a glass of wine on the boat to celebrate the New Year.

In Thailand, they have the January New Year’s celebration by exchanging gifts with friends and family members. Then they get together to enjoy a traditional New Year’s Eve rice cake. Thai people also celebrate Songkran, or the Thai New Year in April. The first day in Bangkok, people often have a big water fight because they believe that water washes away bad luck. So throwing water is a sign of well—wishing and respect.

reading-a.content:

Self-Respect Building Activities for Teens
During the teen years, kids often face a lot of challenges in life. Luckily, there are some self-respect building activities for kids who have low self-respect.
Making Lists

To begin with, the teens should make a list of at least five things they like about themselves. This list can include things like their pretty smiles, or more important things like getting good grades. Each day they continue to make a new list in order to get the lists updated . The teens can turn to them when feeing sad.
Superhero Capes

The superhero cape activity requires a large group of teens who know each other well. Give each teen a large piece of paper to make a cape. The teen’s name should be put across his or her chest. The teen’s then walk around and write at least one positive thing on others’ capes. Finally, the teens view their own capes to see what others have written.
Self-Respect Collage

In this activity, the teens just read through magazines and cut out words or pictures that best describe their lives. These cuts might include words about their personalities, pictures of activities they enjoy doing, foods they like or jobs they long for. All the magazine cuts should be placed into a collage.
Self-Respect Calendar

A self-respect calendar can help deal with stress. Give each teen a blank calendar at the beginning of the month. The teens then write down things they enjoy doing for each day. Activities might include playing a basketball game with friends, having a milkshake or reading one’s favorite book.

Exercise also helps the blood to move around inside the body. This is very important. Our blood takes food to all parts of our body. The head also needs blood. Exercise helps us to think better!

A cup of coffee is a good way for many people to start their day. It can also pass on kindness.
Manyang Kher used to be a Sudanese child refugee. When he was three years old, his village was burnt in the war. He was separated from his parents and never saw them again. He became one of the 20,000 young Sudanese who had to leave their home for Ethiopia’s Gambella area. He lived there as a refugee for 13 years.
When he was 16, Kher went to the United States. While he was in college, he started a program to help the refugees. Now, he owns a coffee company called 734, which is a part of his program. The company has helped more than 200,000 refugees living in the Gambella area till now. Kher said, “I know the difficulties and pains they face every day. You see kids die from hunger. You see kids dying of illnesses. You see kids running away from the refugee camp to find a place to be home, but die on the way.”
Eighty percent of the money made by the coffee company is used to send more of the children to school. And, as Kher explains, the money helps refugees to help themselves. For example, a cup of 734 coffee can also buy one fishing net for a refugee. They can fish for themselves.
Kher sells the coffee online and to coffee stores. Megan Murphy owns a coffee store in Washington, D.C. She serves 734 coffee in her store and people love it. The coffee tastes delicious, so it’s a win-win on both sides.
