Sometimes, they went out for a walk or played in the backyard. Other days, they stayed inside the house to read or watch their favorite show on TV. Today, Sara was planning to help her sister make a castle out of pillows, chairs and blankets. With a smile, Sara considered how much she  ______ 19 ______  being a big sister. As Sara gathered blankets, pillows and snacks to eat in their castle, her sister shouted happily. Then an  ______ 20 ______  came to Sara—she was an expert at something! Sara smiled as she knew that she also had a wonderful report. She believed she would hand in an excellent assignment next week.

questions.prompt: Our parents help and support us a lot, so we should be thankful to  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的父母帮助和支持我们很多，所以我们应该感谢他们。 考查代词词义辨析。him他；her她；you你；them他们。根据“Our parents help and support us a lot”可知，此处指感谢我们的父母，所以应用them。故选D。

questions.prompt: My best friend Tina will arrive in Beijing  ______  8 o’clock this Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我最好的朋友蒂娜将于本周六8点到达北京。 考查介词词义辨析。in在，表示在较长的时间里，如周/月份/季节/年份/世纪等；on在，表示在具体的某一天或某一天的上午或下午；at在，表示在某个具体的时刻；to到。根据空后的“8 o’clock”可知，此处表示在某个具体的时刻，应用at。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mum,  ______  I clean my bedroom at once? —No, you needn’t. You can do it after you finish your homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我必须马上打扫卧室吗？——不，你不必。你可以在完成家庭作业后再做。 考查情态动词。must必须；need需要；can可以；should应该。根据“No, you needn’t”可知此处询问是不是必须马上打扫卧室。故选A。

questions.prompt: —This movie is quite interesting. —Yes, but the movie I watched last week was  ______  than this one.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这部电影很有趣。——是的，但是我上周看的电影比这部更有趣。 考查比较级。根据“than”可知此处用形容词的比较级more interesting。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the pencil case? —It’s about 20 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个铅笔盒多少钱？——大约20元。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长时间，问一段时间；How often多久一次，提问频率；How soon多久以后，对“in+时间段”进行提问；How much多少钱，对价格提问。根据答语“It’s about 20 yuan.”可知，此处提问价格。故选D。

questions.prompt: Mrs. Zhang is over sixty,  ______  she works as hard as others.
questions.explanation: 句意：张太太已经六十多岁了，但她和其他人一样努力工作。 考查连词辨析。or或者；but但是；so所以；for因为。前后两句是转折关系，用but连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: My sister  ______  when I got home.
questions.explanation: 句意：我回到家时，我姐姐正在画画。 考查动词时态。根据“when I got home”可知，此处指过去某一时刻正在进行动作，应用过去进行时“was/were doing”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Amy  ______  Chinese for 6 years, so she can speak Chinese very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：Amy已经学了6年中文了，所以她能说中文说得很好。 考查时态。根据“for 6 years”可知句子用现在完成时，结构：have/has done。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mike, we  ______  to the Palace Museum tomorrow. Would you like to join us? —Yes. Of course!
questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克，我们明天要去故宫博物院。你愿意加入我们吗？——是的。当然！ 考查时态。根据“tomorrow”可知，此处指将来发生的事情，应用一般将来时。故选A。

questions.prompt: Earth Day  ______  in 1970 for the first time.
questions.explanation: 句意：1970年首次庆祝了地球日。 考查被动语态。根据“in 1970”可知，句子时态为一般过去时，分析句子结构可知，句子主语与谓语之间为逻辑上的动宾关系，指的是地球日被庆祝，应用一般过去时的被动语态。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Peter, could you tell me  ______  in the Science Club yesterday? —Well, we did some experiments together.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，你能告诉我你昨天在科学俱乐部做了什么吗？——我们一起做了一些实验。 考查宾语从句。根据“could you tell me...in the Science Club yesterday”和选项可知，空格处为宾语从句，从句应用陈述语序，故排除选项B和D。结合语境可知，从句时态遵循“主现从不限”的原则，由“yesterday”可知，从句时态为一般过去时，故谓语动词用过去式。故选C。 二、完形填空(每题1分，共8分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Magic of a Book One day when I was 11, my mother gave me an order: I was lo walk to the public library, and borrow at least one book for the summer. This was one more weapon for her to defeat (战胜) my strange problem—inability to  ______ 13 ______. In the library, I found my way into the “Children’s Room”. I sat down on the floor and pulled a few books off the  ______ 14 ______  at random (随机的). The cover of a book caught my eye. It presented a picture of a beagle. I had recently had a beagle, the first and only animal companion I ever had as a child. He was my secret sharer, but one morning, he was gone. I never forgot my beagle. There on the book’s cover was a beagle which looked the same to my dog. I ran my fingers over the  ______ 15 ______  of the dog on the cover. My eyes run across the title, Amos, the Beagle with a Plan. Unknowingly, I had read the title without  ______ 16 ______  the book. I borrowed it from the library for the summer. Under the shade of a bush, I started to read about Amos. I read it with difficulty. Though pages were turned  ______ 17 ______, I got the main idea of the story about a dog who, like mine, had been separated from his family and who finally found his way back home. That dog was my dog, and I was the little boy in the book. At the end of the story, my mind continued the final scene of reunion, on and on, until my own  ______ 18 ______  dog and I were, in my mind, running together. My mother’s call made me  ______ 19 ______  to the real world. I suddenly realized something: I had read a book, and I had loved reading that book. Everyone knew I could not read. But I had read it. Books could be incredibly wonderful and I was going to read them. I never told my mother about my “miraculous” (奇迹般的) experience that summer, but she saw a slow but noticeable  ______ 20 ______  in my classroom performance during the next year.

questions.prompt: Mike is my good friend. He often helps  ______  with my English.
questions.explanation: 句意：麦克是我的好朋友。他经常帮助我学习英语。 考查代词辨析。I我，人称代词主格；me我，人称代词宾格；my我的；mine我的。根据“help...with my English”可知，help sb. with sth.“在某方面帮助某人”，help是动词，后接人称代词宾格。故选B。

questions.prompt: My father was born  ______  1964.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的爸爸出生于1964年。 考查介词辨析。in常用于早上、下午、晚上、四季、月份、年份等前；on常用于星期、具体日期、某一天早上、下午和晚上等前；at用于具体时刻前；to是到……时间。根据句意我的爸爸出生于1964年，其中年份应用介词in。故选A。

questions.prompt: I can look after myself,  ______  it won’t be easy for me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我能照顾我自己，尽管这对我来说不容易。 考查连词辨析。because因为；or或者；so所以；although尽管。根据“I can look after myself...it won’t be easy for me.”可知，设空处前后表述内容构成让步转折关系，although引导让步状语从句。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you play basketball? —Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久打一次篮球？——每周一次。 考查疑问词组。how much多少钱；how long多久，对一段时间或长度提问；how often多久一次，对频率提问；how far多远，对距离提问。根据“Once a week.”可知，对频率提问用疑问词组how often。故选C。

questions.prompt: Bill does sports every day. He is one of  ______  boys in my class.
questions.explanation: 句意：比尔每天都做运动。他是我班上最强壮的男孩之一。 考查形容词最高级。固定句式one of+the+形容词最高级+名词复数“最……之一”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you ride a bike? —No, I  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会骑自行车吗？——不，我不会。 考查情态动词。may not可能不；mustn’t禁止；needn’t不需要；can’t不能。根据“Can you ride a bike?”可知此处是表示一种能力，表示不会，应用can’t。故选D。

questions.prompt: Mike and I  ______  football yesterday. We had a good time.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我和Mike踢足球了。我们玩得很开心。 考查时态。play玩，一般现在时；will play玩，一般将来时；played玩，一般过去时；are playing玩，现在进行时。根据时间状语yesterday（昨天）可知，本句为一般过去时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Where's Tom? His mother  ______  him now.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：汤姆在哪里？他的妈妈现在正在找他。根据句意及时间状语now可知此题应用现在进行时态，故选A。

questions.prompt: My uncle is a song writer. He  ______  more than twenty songs since 2018.
questions.explanation: 句意：我叔叔是一名词曲作者。自2018年以来，他已经写了超过20首歌。 考查时态。writes写，一般现在时；wrote写，一般过去时；has written写，现在完成时；will write写，一般将来时。根据时间状语since 2018（自从2018年）可知，本句应该使用现在完成时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing at this time yesterday? —I  ______  in the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天这个时候你在干什么？——我在公园散步。 考查过去进行时。根据时间状语“at this time yesterday”可知，过去的某个具体时间点，本句应该用过去进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: If you listen carefully in class, you  ______  what to do.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你上课认真听了，你就会明白该做什么。 考查时态。understand知道，一般现在时；understood知道，一般过去时；will understand知道，一般将来时；have understood知道，现在完成时。分析句子可知，本句是“if引导的条件状语从句+主句”的结构，if引导的条件状语从句，谓语动词时态遵循“主将从现”的原则，故从句用将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______  tomorrow? —At 9 o’clock in the morning.

choices.label: B
choices.text: when Mary will come C how will Mary come

questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道玛丽明天什么时候来吗？——早上9点。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句中用陈述语序，选项A和C都是疑问语序，故排除；由At 9 o’clock in the morning.（早上9点。）可知问的是时间，用when引导宾语从句，排除D。故选B。 二 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Special Needs Bring Special Joy On September 9, 1995, I was told that I had a new baby sister. A few days later my dad told me that hospital tests didn’t turn out well. My sister had  ______ 13 ______  problems. We made several trips to a well-known hearing center, but the  ______ 14 ______  didn’t work, so my family began learning sign language. I should correct myself when I say “my family”, because I didn’t want to sit down every night and learn sign after sign. I did my own things. My parents spent hours with my sister  ______ 15 ______  her and themselves by playing sign language games. Years passed. The summer before ninth grade, as my parents had to work, it was up to me to take care of my sister. This meant getting her to summer school in the morning, cooking for her and playing with her. One day my mother asked me to sign something, and I failed. My mom was almost in tears（眼泪）. She was so  ______ 16 ______  that I didn’t care enough about my sister. This  ______ 17 ______  me, realizing how selfish（自私的）I had been. I needed to talk to her. But I couldn’t even sign  ______ 18 ______  phrases like: “Where are you going?” “What time will you be home?” “What do you want to eat?” and other questions I wanted to ask but didn’t know how. My family and I started attending sign language classes at my sister’s school. We sat down as a family watching sign language movies and playing sign language games. Today I can  ______ 19 ______  very well with my sister. It brings a smile to my face when my sister signs something to me about one of my friends, and they can’t understand. I realized it was no fun not knowing what my family was saying. So if you have a family member with special needs, don’t put him or her aside. This person should be the first thing on your mind. With me, signing now comes before school, friends and sports, because it is the  ______ 20 ______  of my family.

questions.prompt: I have a sister and ______  name is Mary.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有一个妹妹，她的名字是Mary。 考查形容词性物主代词辨析。his他的；her她的；my我的；their他/她/它们的。结合句意可知，此空表示“妹妹的名字”，用表示女性的“她的”，并且为单数形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: World Environment Day falls  ______  June 5th every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年的6月5日是世界环境日。 考查时间介词。to到；of……的；in后接年、月、季节等；on后接具体某一天。根据“June 5th”可知此处指在6月5日这一天，用介词on。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you usually have a haircut, Jim? — Every three weeks. My hair grows so fast.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jim,你通常多久理发一次？——三周一次。我的头发长得很快。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少钱：How many多少个；How long多长时间；How often多久一次。根据“Every three weeks.”可知问句是对频率的提问，用How often引导的特殊疑问句。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Linda,  ______  you take care of your little sister this afternoon? — Sure, Mom!
questions.explanation: 句意：——Linda，今天下午你能照顾一下你的妹妹吗？——当然，妈妈。 考查情态动词用法。must必须；need需要；can可以；能够；should应该。结合句意可知，问句表示委婉地提出想法或请求，用can引导的一般疑问句。故选C。 【点睛】“can”的用法： 表示“能；会”，指脑力或体力方面的“能力”。例如: I can speak English. 表示“可能”,常用于否定句或疑问句中,指某种可能性。例如: Han Mei can’t be in the classroom. 也可以表示客观上的可能性。例如：Teachers can make mistakes. 表示“可以”，常用于口语中，指许可或请求做某事。例如: Can I have a cup of tea, please? 表示“怀疑”，在表达此意思时，只能用于一般疑问句中，带有感情色彩。

questions.prompt: I did well in the sports meeting this term ______  I trained hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：由于我训练努力，我在这学期的运动会上表现出色。 考查连词辨析。because因为；由于；so因此；when当……时；if如果；是否。结合句意可知“ I trained hard.”是表现出色的原因，因此此句是because引导的原因状语从句。故选A。

questions.prompt: Supercomputers are thousands of times ______  than ordinary computers.
questions.explanation: 句意：超级电脑比普通电脑快上千倍。 考查形容词比较级。fast快的，形容词原级；faster形容词比较级；fastest副词最高级；the fastest形容词或副词最高级。than是形容词比较级的标志，因此此空为形容词的比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: Since 2008, China ______  a powerful high-speed railway network.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从2008年，中国已经发展了一个强大的高速铁路网。 考查现在完成时，develop发展，动词原形；developed过去式；has developed现在完成时；will develop一般将来时。根据时间状语“Since 2008”可知，此句用现在完成时表达某一动作或状态从过去开始，一直延续至今。故选C。 【点睛】现在完成时的用法：

questions.prompt: — Has Grandma arrived? — Not yet. She will give us a call as soon as she ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——奶奶已经到了吗？——还没有。她一到就会给我们打电话。 考查时间状语从句。lands到达；着陆，第三人称单数形式；landed过去式；will land一般将来时；was landing过去进行时。此句是as soon as引导的时间状语从句，遵循主将从现的原则，主句一般将来时，从句用一般现在时。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Do you have any plans for the coming weekend? — Yes I ______  Peking University with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——马上到来的周末你有任何计划吗？——是的。我将跟我的朋友去参观北京大学。 考查一般将来时。visit参观，动词原形；will visit一般将来时；have visited现在完成时；was visiting过去进行时。根据问句中“the coming weekend”可知是询问将来的事，因此用一般将来时。故选B。

questions.prompt: I ______  a sweet dream when the alarm clock rang this morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天早晨闹钟响的时候我正在做美梦。 考查过去进行时。have有，动词原形；had过去式；am having现在进行时；was having过去进行时。结合句意可知，此句是when引导的时间状语从句，表达闹钟响的时候，正在进行的动作，因此主句用过去进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer  ______  by Mark Twain in the nineteenth century.
questions.explanation: 句意：《汤姆·索亚历险记》是马克·吐温在19世纪写的。 考查时态和语态。分析句子结构，空处是谓语动词，本句主语The Adventures of Tom Sawyer和谓语之间是被动关系，此处应用被动语态。根据时间状语“in the nineteenth century”可知本句是一般过去时，此处应用一般过去时的被动语态，即was done。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Do you know ______? — At 9 o'clock tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：你知道会议什么时候开始吗？——明天上午九点。 考查宾语从句。问句是一个宾语从句，宾语从句中从句语序应该为陈述句语序，因排除A和B；根据回答“At 9 o'clock tomorrow morning.”可知询问的应该是将来的事，用一般将来时。故选C。 二、完形填空。（每题1分，共8分） My Understanding of Money I used to walk around the store with my parents constantly begging for something. I remember the sight of all the colorful bags of chips and candy that I asked my parents to buy for me. I cannot remember a time when I didn't beg for something at the store. When I was about twelve years old, my dad always  ______ 13 ______ my begging and told me with a frustrated(使人挫败的)face, "You can waste all the money as you want when you have a job." I listened, but I never really heard the  ______ 14 ______ he was trying to get across to me. Since I wanted so many things and my parents were not going to buy them for me, I decided to make money as a  ______ 15 ______ myself. I remember the feeling of getting new money in my pocket, then throwing it out within the next week. A few years later, I was a freshman in high school and did not feel like looking for a new job. One day, I saw people handing out flyers（传单）at school. I wasn't ______ 16 ______ at first because I thought I was fine making money by babysitting. But once I ______ 17 ______ thought about the money I could make, I applied to work as a lifeguard advertised on the flyer. After a few months' training, I could finally start the job. But the more money I made, the less I wanted to spend. As the work and pay increased, so did my responsibility with money. Instead of  ______ 18 ______ my money on useless things, I started saving up. I finally realized that money meant so much more to me because I was the one ______ 19 ______ for it. Now, I have 5,000 dollars in my bank account, and I limit myself to what I buy. My life has permanently(持久地)been influenced because I know the  ______ 20 ______ of money. It is more than what I can spend.

questions.prompt: Tony is my brother.  ______  hobby is skating.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼是我的兄弟。他的爱好是滑冰。 考查代词辨析。my我的；your你的，你们的；her她的；his他的。根据“Tony is my brother.”可知，托尼是第三人称，且是男性，应用his指代。故选D。

questions.prompt: New Year’s Day usually falls  ______  January 1st. It is the start of a new year.
questions.explanation: 句意：元旦通常在1月1日。这是新的一年的开始。 考查介词辨析。on用于节日，星期几，具体的某一天或某一天的上午、下午或晚上前；in强调时间段，用于年，月，周，季节，早晨（上午），下午或晚上等名词前；at用于具体时刻之前；of……的。根据“January 1st”可知，1月1日，为具体的一天，其前面需用介词on修饰。故选A。

questions.prompt: Tim is honest and likes to help others,  ______  we all enjoy being with him.
questions.explanation: 句意：蒂姆很诚实，喜欢帮助别人，所以我们都喜欢和他在一起。 考查连词辨析。but但是；or或者；so所以；though虽然，尽管。分析“Tim is honest and likes to help others,...we all enjoy being with him.”可知，前后两句是因果关系，后句表示结果，应用连词so。故选C。

questions.prompt: Lucy speaks Chinese much  ______  than before because of her hard work.
questions.explanation: 句意：由于露西的努力，她的中文说得比以前好多了。 考查比较级。than前用比较级形式，此处修饰动词speaks是副词well，其比较级为better。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Jack,  ______  you finish the housework in ten minutes? —Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你能在十分钟内做完家务吗？——是的，我能。 考查情态动词。need需要；can能；must必须；should应该。根据答语“Yes, I can.”可知一般疑问句应用can开头。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  was Frank when he invented popsicles? —At the age of 11.
questions.explanation: 句意：——弗兰克发明冰棒的时候多大了？——11岁。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长时间；How often多久一次；How old多大；How much多少。根据“At the age of 11.”可知，此句询问发明冰棒时的年龄，应用how old。故选C。

questions.prompt: My mother  ______  English for nearly 20 years. She likes her job.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈教英语将近20年了。她喜欢她的工作。 考查时态。根据“for nearly 20 years”可知，此句为现在完成时，谓语结构为have/has done。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  to the theme park with my friends last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年我和朋友们去了主题公园。 考查时态。根据“last year”可知，句子时态用一般过去时，谓语动词go用过去式went。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing at seven yesterday evening, Lucy? —I  ______  my brother with his English.
questions.explanation: 句意：——露西，昨天晚上7点你在做什么？——我在帮我弟弟学英语。 考查时态。根据“at seven yesterday evening”可知，此句应用过去进行时回答，谓语结构为was/were doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: If it  ______  sunny tomorrow, we’ll go to a park to have a picnic.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天天气晴朗，我们就去公园野餐。 考查时态。分析句子可知，if引导的是条件状语从句，根据“we’ll go”可知，主句为一般将来时，从句用一般现在时表将来。故选A。

questions.prompt: The second spacewalk by China’s Shenzhou-14 astronauts  ______  on September 17th, 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国神舟十四号宇航员的第二次太空行走于2022年9月17日完成。 考查被动语态。主语The second spacewalk和动词complete之间是被动关系，结合“September 17th, 2022.”可知应用一般过去时的被动语态：was/were done。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me  ______? —Last Friday.

choices.label: A
choices.text: when we held the sports meeting

choices.label: B
choices.text: when did we hold the sports meeting

choices.label: C
choices.text: where we held the sports meeting

choices.label: D
choices.text: where did we hold the sports meeting

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我我们什么时候举行的运动会吗？——上周五。 考查宾语从句。分析句子结构可知，此处是宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，排除B和D选项。结合答语“Last Friday.”可知，询问时间用when引导宾语从句，故选A。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A Good-luck Dumpling When I was in my middle age, something terrible happened to me. As I was away from home for almost a year, my wife and children were very worried. And my 80-year-old mother nearly broken down (崩溃). On the eve of the Spring Festival, I was finally allowed to return home. Mother looked at me, her eyes filled with  ______ 13 ______. But soon she said, “Let’s start making dumplings for the Festival.” And then an idea  ______ 14 ______  her, “Let’s put in a coin and make a good-luck dumpling. Whoever eats it will be blessed (有福的).” While making the good-luck dumpling, my mother secretly made a(n)  ______ 15 ______  on it. She pretended nothing had happened, but the trick didn’t escape my eyes. After Mother boiled the dumplings all by herself, she put the good-luck dumpling on top of the others in a bowl on purpose and pushed the bowl to me. Feeling loved, I looked at her in  ______ 16 ______  eyes. I had thought it would give her a lovely surprise if she ate the good-luck dumpling. So, when she went to the kitchen, I put the dumpling into her bowl. Obviously, when Mother returned, she didn’t  ______ 17 ______  it and went on eating with her eyes on me all the time. “Ouch!” suddenly she cried out. The coin had hurt her teeth. “Oh, Granny is blessed”, my wife  ______ 18 ______. “I...how come?” Mother was  ______ 19 ______. Just at that moment, the coin fell out of her mouth. So I joined my wife and children, “Granny is blessed! Mother is blessed!” Mother burst into laughter, and then tears, as my wife and I  ______ 20 ______  with her all her sadness and joy.

questions.prompt: Lily enjoys singing and  ______  favorite subject is music.
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉喜欢唱歌，她最喜欢的科目是音乐。 考查物主代词。his他的；her她的；your你（们）的；their他们的。句子主语为“Lily”，女性单数人称，故空格处应用物主代词her，故选B。

questions.prompt: The best time to visit Beijing is  ______  October.
questions.explanation: 句意：游览北京的最佳时间是十月。 考查介词辨析。at后接具体的时间点；on后接具体的某一天；in后接年、月等较长的一段时间；to到某处。空格后为月份“October”，故应用介词in。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Which sport do you like  ______, swimming or skating? —Swimming.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你更喜欢哪一项运动，游泳还是滑冰？——游泳。 考查比较级用法。well好地，better更好；best最好，the best最好。根据“swimming or skating”可知，是两种事物的比较，需用比较级。副词well修饰动词like，其比较级是better。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Must I study medicine and be a doctor like you, Dad? —No, you  ______, son. You’re free to make your own decision.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爸爸，我必须学医并且像你一样当医生吗？——不，你不必。儿子。你可以自由地作出自己的决定。 考查情态动词辨析。needn’t不必；mustn’t不准，不允许，禁止；can’t 不能，不可能；shouldn’t不应该。must提问的一般疑问句，用Yes, sb must./No, sb needn’t/don’t have to回答。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Lucy, what are you doing? —I  ______  a model ship.
questions.explanation: 句意：——露西，你在干什么？——我正在制作一个轮船模型。 考查现在进行时。根据“what are you doing?”可知句子应用现在进行时来回答，其谓语结构为：am/is/are+现在分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: The Shenzhou-15 astronauts  ______  to Earth safely on June 4, 2023.
questions.explanation: 句意：神舟15号宇航员于2023年6月4日安全返回地球 考查时态。根据“on June 4, 2023”可知是过去发生的事情，用一般过去时，谓语用过去式returned。故选B。

questions.prompt: If you go to the concert with us tomorrow, you  ______  a great time there.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你明天和我们一起去听音乐会，你会玩得很开心的。 考查时态。if引导的条件状语从句遵循主将从现原则，主句用一般将来时，其结构为will do。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where is Zhang Ming? —Oh, he  ______  to Shanghai and he will be back tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——张明在哪里？——哦，他去上海了，明天就回来。 考查has/have gone to与has/have been to的区别。has gone to去了某地还没有回来；has been to去过某地，已经回来了。根据“...he’ll be back tomorrow”可知，他去了上海，还没回来，所以句子时态应用现在完成时，用has gone to，符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: — How do you like your new school, Kate? — It’s very clean and beautiful  ______  it is a bit small.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你喜欢你的新学校吗，凯特？——虽然它有点小，但它非常干净漂亮。 考查连词辨析。if如果；since自从；so因此；although虽然。空格前为“它很干净和漂亮”，空格后为“它很小”，此处应用although引导让步状语从句。故选D。

questions.prompt: I was reading story books  ______  my mum was cooking dinner.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我的妈妈正在做晚饭时，我正在读故事书。 考查状语从句。until直到；after在……之后；while当……时；before在……之前。根据句中“was reading”和“was cooking”可知主句和从句都是过去进行时，需用while引导时间状语从句，表示两个动作同时正在进行。故选C。

questions.prompt: — I hope you’ll enjoy your trip, dear! — Thank you, mum. I’ll give you a call  ______  I get there.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我希望你旅行愉快，亲爱的！——谢谢，妈妈。我一到那里就给你打电话。 考查连词辨析。until直到；as soon as一……就……；since自从；so that以至于。根据前后句意可知，此处指的是一到那里就给你打电话。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me  ______? —Last Friday.

choices.label: A
choices.text: when did you visit the National Museum of China

choices.label: B
choices.text: when you visited the National Museum of China

choices.label: C
choices.text: why did you visit the National Museum of China

choices.label: D
choices.text: why you visited the National Museum of China

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你什么时候去参观的中国国家博物馆的吗？——上个星期五。 考查宾语从句。根据“Last Friday”可知，询问时间应用when提问，排除C和D；又因宾语从句的语序需用陈述语序，排除A。故选B。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Gus White was driving home from work when he noticed a pair of dogs in the flash of his headlights. It was snowing so hard. What were they doing out here, when it was too  ______ 13 ______  for dogs to go outside? Gus parked his truck and approached（靠近，接近）the animals. He  ______ 14 ______  his hands to them, which made no effort to escape（逃脱）. He placed the dogs on the passenger seat and they were snuggle （依偎） together there. Gus took a picture of the pair and  ______ 15 ______  it to his wife, Katie White. Then he called the number from the dogs’ ID tags. A man answered. “I gave those dogs away,” the man said. “Well, do you want them back?” “No.” The man hung up. These dogs were  ______ 16 ______  in this world. Gus looked over at them, their large eyes begging（祈求）. He called Katie. “Bring them home”, she said. The Whites prepared a bed for the dogs, also setting out food and water. As a boy, Gus had dreamed of owning dogs but  ______ 17 ______  this pair was out of the question—the Whites already had a family dog. The next day, they took the dogs to a shelter（收养所） to drop them off—on one condition. “I’m not signing the dogs over to you if you’re going to  ______ 18 ______  them,” Katie said. The shelter workers promised her they’d keep the couple together. In the days following, Katie phoned the shelter  ______ 19 ______  to check up on Pepper and Cooper. Soon, the dogs were adopted （领养）, as a pair, to a loving family. It’s a simple story but it speaks to the best of our  ______ 20 ______.

questions.prompt: — Hello, John. Do you know the young lady? — Oh, yes.  ______  is my teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，约翰。你认识这位年轻的女士吗？——哦，是的。她是我的老师。 考查代词的用法。He他，主格人称代词；She她，主格人称代词；His他的，形容词性物主代词或者名词性物主代词；Her她，宾格人称代词；她的，形容词性物主代词。根据“... is my teacher.”可知，是位于主语的位置，又由“Do you know the young lady?”中的the young lady可知，要用第三人称单数女性的她的主格人称代词作为该句主语。故选B。

questions.prompt: I like reading. I often go to the library  ______  Saturday mornings.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢阅读，我经常在周六早晨去图书馆。 考查时间介词。to到；in在……里面；at在；on在……上面。“在早晨”in the morning；在具体某天的早晨用介词on，此处为on Saturday mornings，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Your new bike looks fantastic.  ______  is it? —It is 2,600 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的新自行车看起来棒极了。多少钱？——2600元。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少，对可数名词数量提问；How often多久一次，询问频率；How much多少，对不可数名词数量或价格进行提问；How long多长，对长度或一段时间的提问。根据“It is 2,600 yuan.”可知，上文是对价格进行的提问，所以特殊疑问词用how much“多少钱”，故选C。

questions.prompt: The Chinese women’s basketball team met many difficulties,  ______  they never gave up.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国女篮遇到了许多困难，但她们从未放弃 考查连词辨析。and并且；so所以；but但是；because因为。根据“met many difficulties”和“they never gave up”可知，前后句为转折关系，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mum,  ______  I finish my homework now？ —No, you needn’t. You may have dinner first.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我现在必须完成作业吗？——不，你不必。你可以先吃晚饭。考查情态动词。A. can能、能够；B. must必须；C. might 可能、也许；D. could能。根据答语No, you needn’t. You may have dinner first.可知B选项符合题意，以must提问一般疑问句，肯定回答用must（必须），否定回答用needn’t或 don’t/doesn’t have to （不必）。故答案选B。

questions.prompt: —Which book by Mark Twain do you think is  ______, The Adventures of Tom Sawyer or The Million Pound Note? —I think it’s The Million Pound Note.
questions.explanation: 句意：——马克·吐温的哪本书你觉得最有趣，《汤姆·索亚历险记》还是《百万英镑》？——我认为是《百万英镑》。 考查比较级。interesting有趣的，原级；more interesting更有趣的，比较级；most interesting非常有趣的；the most interesting最有趣的，最高级。根据“The Adventures of Tom Sawyer or The Million Pound Note”可知是两者比较，用比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: My brother  ______  his bike to school every day. It’s good for health.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥每天骑自行车上学。它对健康有益。 考查时态。根据“every day”可知句子用一般现在时，主语是My brother，谓语动词用单三。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Jack, what were you doing at seven last night? —I  ______  the Internet to search for some information for the report next week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，昨晚7点你在干什么？——我正在上网为下周的报告寻找一些资料。 考查时态。根据“Jack, what were you doing at seven last night?”是问过去某一刻正在做什么可知，时态用过去进行时，结构为was/were doing；主语为“I”，应用was。故选D。

questions.prompt: My uncle  ______  to a new city abroad ten years ago as required by his job.
questions.explanation: 句意：由于工作的需要，我叔叔十年前搬到了国外一个新的城市。 考查时态。根据“ten years ago”可知，时态为一般过去时，动词应用过去式。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Let’s go to see the movie Chosin Lake. —I’d love to but I  ______  it twice. It’s a wonderful movie.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们去看电影《长津湖》吧。——我很想去，但我已经看过两次了。这是一部精彩的电影。 考查时态。根据“It’s a wonderful movie.”可知，我已经看过两次了，现在不想去看了；时态应用现在完成时，表示过去发生的动作对现在的影响。故选B。

questions.prompt: A book show  ______  in our city next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：明年我们市将举办一场书展。 考查被动语态。根据“next year”可知是将来时；A book show与谓语hold之间是被动关系，即将来时态的被动语态，结构为will be done。故选D。

questions.prompt: — I want to improve my English. Can you tell me  ______? — Certainly, it’s my pleasure to share with you all.

choices.label: A
choices.text: what your secret of learning English was

choices.label: B
choices.text: how is your secret of learning English

choices.label: C
choices.text: what your secret of learning English is

choices.label: D
choices.text: how was your secret of learning English

questions.explanation: 句意：——我想提高我的英语水平。你能告诉我你学习英语的秘诀是什么吗？——当然，能和大家分享是我的荣幸。 考查宾语从句。根据英语语法，宾语从句应用陈述句语序，B、D选项可排除。句子主句为一般现在时，从句时态不受限，根据语境可知，此处是在对一般事实“学习英语的秘诀”进行提问，故从句应用一般现在时。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题 1 分，共 8 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 In the eighth grade, my classmates gave me a nickname “Dictionary”. It all started the day a national spelling competition was held. After hearing this news, I made an important decision to join it. In order to win, I opened my dictionary and started learning how to spell every word in English. To memorize the most words as possible, I tried every possible ways and began reading day and night so that I could remember them more  ______ 13 ______. During the competition, I misspelled one word. The pain of this failure was so great that I still  ______ 14 ______  the word “graffiti” today while not succeeding in something that I put in so much effort also reminded me to study harder. Later, my school was participating in a French dictation competition hosted by a nonprofit(非盈利) organization that gives kids in poor areas a  ______ 15 ______  to get an education, which is a good chance for them to change their life. The fact that French isn’t my first language has only made me put more energy into it. I  ______ 16 ______  the books even harder, I spent all my free time studying. In the competition, I scored the highest in my school! I felt so proud. That joy was  ______ 17 ______  because I knew my victory was also helping children learn to read and write. In the final, I took the fifth place. Although it wasn’t what I had dreamed of, it was quite  ______ 18 ______! And I was not upset because of this result. Instead, I was proud of myself. Besides the award, I got  ______ 19 ______  that I’d use for the rest of my life, such as persistence(坚持不懈) and critical thinking. So, no matter what I would be in the future, I believe I could do well in that. In fact, I was pleased that I had experienced a lot from the language competitions. Moreover, I found that whether we are making changes for ourselves or for others, we never know what can be the catalyst(催化剂) of a brilliant future. Sometimes, that catalyst can be as  ______ 20 ______  as a book. It could be a moment of inspiration that can change the course of our lives.

questions.prompt: Yao Ming was higher than  ______  classmates from an early age.
questions.explanation: 句意：姚明从早年时，就比他的同学高。 考查代词辨析。your你的，你们的；her她，她的；their他们的；his他的。根据句中“classmates”一词可知，需用形容词性物主代词来修饰，再根据“than”可知，他是跟他的同学比身高的。故需用he的形容词性物主代词his。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tom likes watching TV  ______  8: 00 pm every evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆喜欢每天晚上8点看电视。 考查介词辨析。in在……里面，常用于年、月或季节前；on在……上，常用于具体的某一天前；at在……时刻，常用于具体的时间点前；during在……期间。根据“Tom likes watching TV…8: 00 pm every evening.”可知，此处指的是在晚上8点，应用介词at。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  you tell me the difference between the twins? — Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我这对双胞胎的区别吗？——是的，我能。 考查情态动词词义辨析。Need需要；Can能；Should应该；Must一定。根据答语“Yes, I can.”可知，此处用Can提问，表示“你能……吗”。故选B。

questions.prompt: This book is  ______  book I have ever read.
questions.explanation: 句意：这本书是我读过的最好的书。 考查形容词最高级。根据“...I’ve ever read”可知，此处表示比较的范围，所以用最高级，good表示“好的”，其最高级是best，形容词的比较级需要用定冠词the修饰。故选D。

questions.prompt: —  ______  does Dick go to the Book Club? — Twice a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——迪克多久去一次读书俱乐部？——一周两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How often多久一次；How long多长时间；How many多少；How much多少。根据“Twice a week.”可知问的是频率，故选A。

questions.prompt: The Chinese women’s basketball team met many difficulties,  ______  they never gave up.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国女篮遇到了很多困难，但她们从未放弃。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；so所以；because因为。根据“they never gave up.”可知，这里表示转折，用but连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Where is Jenny? — She  ______  a poster for the community in her study.
questions.explanation: 句意：——珍妮在哪里？——她正在书房里为社区制作海报。 考查现在进行时。根据问句“Where is Jenny?”可知，此处询问珍妮在哪里，答句应为表示“此时此刻的动作”，此处应用现在进行时回答表示，现在进行时的结构是be doing，本句的主语是She，所以用is making表示“正在制作”。故选B。

questions.prompt: If you read English every morning, your speaking  ______  one day.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你每天早上读英语，你的口语总有一天会提高。 考查动词的时态。此处是由If引导的条件状语从句，当表示将来发生的事情时，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时，根据one day可知，此处表示“总有一天”，本句表示将来发生的事情；improve表示“提高”，其将来时态是will improve。故选A。

questions.prompt: Hank  ______  in the kitchen when his sister came back home.
questions.explanation: 句意：汉克妹妹回家时，他正在厨房做饭。 考查动词时态。根据“when his sister came back home.”可知描述的是在过去的某个时间点正在发生的动作，用过去进行时，结构为was/were doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  this beautiful gold watch for over 25 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：我拥有这只漂亮的金表已经超过25年了。 考查动词时态。根据“for over 25 years.”可知，for+时间段用于现在完成时：have/has done。故选C。

questions.prompt: The Beijing National Stadium—Bird’s Nest  ______  in June, 2008.
questions.explanation: 句意：北京国家体育场——鸟巢于2008年6月建成。 考查被动语态。主语和动词build之间是被动关系，结合“June, 2008”可知应用一般过去时的被动语态，故选A。

questions.prompt: My uncle remembered  ______.

choices.label: B

questions.explanation: 句意：我叔叔记得我们搬到城里的时候。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句用陈述语序，排除选项B、D；又因为“My uncle remembered...”可知，主句为一般过去时，从句也需为相应的过去时态，故选A。 二、完形填空（每题 1 分，共 8 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Empty Pot (盆) Long ago, the King of China announced a contest to find the next ruler of the land. He was getting old and had no sons to take over the throne (王位). One thing about the King is that he loved to grow plants. So he announced that any boy who wanted to be king would have to come to the palace and  ______ 13 ______  a royal (皇室的) seed. In six months, the boy who grew the best ______ 14 ______  would be the one to win the contest. He would be the next to sit on the throne. On the big day, huge crowds of boys came to the palace. Jun was one of those boys, he was quiet and good at growing things. Each boy took home his royal seed, held tightly in his hand. Over the next few days, Jun watered his pot every day. All over the country, boys were doing the same thing. Each one looked with ______ 15 ______  at his own pot. Chen was the first boy to announce that a green leaf was coming up. Han was the next one to say a little green plant was coming up in his pot. Then it was Wang. Jun did not know why there was empty in his pot. He had much experience in growing, none of the other boys could grow plants as  ______ 16 ______  as he! But still, Jun’s seed did not grow. Six months passed. The day came when all the boys needed to bring their plants to the palace to be judged. “What will I do?” cried Jun to his mother and father as he looked out the window. “My pot is empty! My seed did not grow!” “Bring the King your pot, the way it is.” said his father. “That’s right.” said Jun’s mother. “You did the best you could.” Then Jun carried his empty pot on the road to the palace. At the palace, all the boys lined up. Holding their big, strong plants in front of them, they  ______ 17 ______  to be judged. The King looked at each plant with a blank look on his face. When he came to Jun, he frowned (皱眉) and said, “What is this? You brought me an empty pot?” It was all Jun could do to keep from crying. “I tried my best. I planted your seed in the best soil I could find. I kept it wet and watched it every day. When the seed did not  ______ 18 ______, I moved it to new soil, and I even moved it a third time. But it just didn’t grow!” Jun hung his head. “I’m sorry.” “Hmm,” said the King. Turning so everyone could hear he shouted, “I do not know where all these other boys got their seeds. There is no  ______ 19 ______  anything could grow from the seeds we passed out for the contest. And that is because all those seeds had been  ______ 20 ______! No plant could grow from them!” So anyone who showed me his beautiful plant must be a liar. Only this man told me the truth. Do remember honesty is the best policy.” And he smiled at Jun.

questions.prompt: Mr. Black is a good teacher and we all like ______  classes very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：布莱克先生是一位好老师，我们都非常喜欢他的课。 考查代词辨析。his他的；her她的；their他们的；its它的。根据“Mr. Black”可知，是指布莱克先生的课，应用his，故选A。

questions.prompt: It is the best time to visit Beijing  ______  autumn.
questions.explanation: 句意：秋天是游览北京的最佳时间。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体时刻前；to到；in用于年，月，周，季节，早晨（上午），下午或晚上等名词前；on用于节日，星期几，具体的某一天或某一天的上午，下午或晚上前。根据“autumn”可知，秋天，为季节，其前需用介词in修饰。故选C。

questions.prompt: Science is useful,  ______  I will try my best to learn it well.
questions.explanation: 句意：科学是有用的，所以我会尽力把它学好。 考查连词辨析。but但是；for因为；so所以；or否则。根据“I will try my best to learn it well.”可知，科学是有用的，所以我会尽力把它学好。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me, can I park my car here? —Sorry, you  ______. This is no parking area.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，我可以把车停在这里吗？——对不起，你不能。这不是停车区。 考查情态动词。can可以；can’t不可以；must必须；needn’t不必。根据“can I park my car here”和“Sorry,... This is no parking area.”可知不可以把车停这里，用can’t。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  students are there in your class? —There are thirty-six.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你班里有多少名学生？——有三十六名。 考查特殊疑问句。how far多远；how many多少，询问可数名词的数量；how long多长时间；how much多少，询问不可数名词的数量。根据“There are thirty-six”可知此处询问可数名词复数students的数量用how many。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Which subject is  ______, English, science or geography? —Science.
questions.explanation: 句意：——英语、科学和地理，哪个科目最有趣？——科学。 考查形容词最高级的用法。根据“Which subject is..., English, science or geography?”可知，是对英语，科学和地理三个科目进行比较，且句子是特殊疑问句，用“which+...+the+形容词最高级, A, B or C?”的结构，空处需填“the+形容词最高级”，the most interesting符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mike, where is your sister? —She  ______  books in her home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克，你妹妹在哪儿？——她正在家里看书。 考查现在进行时。根据“where is your sister?”及答语“books in her home.”可知，对话的时候妹妹正在家里看书，时态要用现在进行时am/is/are doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: The earthquake  ______  on the night of September, 2023.
questions.explanation: 句意：地震发生在2023年9月的晚上。 考查时态。根据“on the night of September, 2023”可知动作发生在过去，用一般过去时，动词用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: The famous singer  ______  a song at the party tomorrow evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：这位著名歌唱家将在明晚的晚会上演唱一首歌。 考查一般将来时。根据“tomorrow evening”可知，此处表示一般将来时，其形式是will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What an old building! I think it has a long history. —Yes, it  ______  here for almost five hundred years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——多么古老的建筑啊！我认为它有着悠久的历史。——是的，它在这里已经有将近五百年的历史了。 考查时态。根据“for almost five hundred years”可知句子用现在完成时，表示从过去持续到现在，可能将持续下去，谓语结构是have/has done。故选D。

questions.prompt: English is important because it  ______  all over the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：英语很重要，因为全世界都在用英语。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语it和谓语use之间是被动关系，根据语境可知，句子用一般现在时，故用一般现在时的被动语态am/is/are done。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Lucy, can you tell me  ______  the dictionary? —Sure. I bought it in the bookstore near my home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——露西，你能告诉我你在哪里买的字典吗？——当然。我在我家附近的书店买的。 考查宾语从句。根据“Lucy, can you tell me...the dictionary?”可知，“...the dictionary”作宾语从句，要用陈述语序，排除C和D（均为疑问句语序）；因主句为一般现在时，遵循“主现从不限”原则，此处的从句是询问对方这本字典在哪里买的，事情发生在过去，从句时态用一般过去时，动词用过去式bought。故选B。 二、完形填空(每题1分,共8分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Catching Tree Linda looked up at the tree. It was the biggest tree in town. It was so big that it caught things that people lost. If something was floated away or blew away, it was usually  ______ 13 ______  in the tree. The branches were not close to the  ______ 15 ______. They were high up. She needed a ladder to start climbing up the tree. She began to climb. In the lowest branches, she found bird nests. Squirrels chattered at her and ran the other way. She went higher. She found an old baseball. Then there was a kite that was not hers. She found someone’s cat, but it ran away from her. She went higher still. A newspaper was caught in one of the branches. Then a balloon was trapped(困住) in the leaves. There were more birds, too. She went even higher. More birds’ nests and squirrels  ______ 16 ______  her. She found a paper airplane. Then there was an old shoe. Next she found a lady’s hat caught in some twigs(小细枝). She went even higher to the top. At last, she found her kite. She  ______ 17 ______  it and ted it to her arm. She found other things, too. There was a toy rocket, another newspaper, and a tennis racket. There were other things, too. Before she went down, she took all the things that belonged to(属于) people from the tree. She  ______ 18 ______  the animals alone. They belonged in the tree. By the time she reached the ground again, the area around the tree was covered with things she had taken down  ______ 19 ______. questions.prompt: My brother studies at an art school.  ______  can draw beautiful pictures.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥在艺术学校学习。他能画很美的画。 考查代词辨析。She她；He他；It它；They他们。根据“My brother”可知，我哥哥是位男性。故选B。

questions.prompt: The Double Ninth Festival is  ______  October 11 this year.
questions.explanation: 句意：今年的重阳节是10月11日。 考查介词辨析。on后跟具体的某一天；in后跟某年某月某季节；at后跟具体时刻；to到。根据“October”可知，月份前用介词in。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Mom, I’ll prepare breakfast by myself tomorrow. You  ______  get up early. —Thanks, Emma. That’s so nice of you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我明天自己准备早餐。你不必起得早。——谢谢，Emma。你真好。 考查情态动词。can’t不可能；mustn’t不许；needn’t不需要；may not未必。根据“Mom, I’ll prepare breakfast by myself tomorrow.”可知，Emma自己准备早餐，妈妈不需要早起。故选C。

questions.prompt: After winning the singing competition, Bob became  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：在赢得歌唱比赛后，鲍勃变得比以前更自信了。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than before”可知，此处应用形容词比较级，与以前的鲍勃相比较。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go swimming? —Every weekend in the summer months.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去游泳一次？——夏季的每个周末。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多久，对一段时间进行提问；How soon多久以后，在将来时中对将来的时间提问；How much多少，对不可数名词的数量或对价格进行提问；How often多长时间一次，对频率进行询问。根据答语“Every weekend in the summer months.”可知，此处对频率进行询问。故选D。

questions.prompt: I knew Sara could help me,  ______  I asked her for help.
questions.explanation: 句意：我知道萨拉能帮助我，所以我向她求助。 考查连词辨析。or或者；for因为；so因此；but但是。“I knew Sara could help me”与“I asked her for help”是因果关系，遵循“前因后果”，此空应填so，故选C。

questions.prompt: Look! Those kids  ______  in the playground, laughing loudly.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！那些孩子在操场上奔跑，大声笑着。 考查动词时态。根据“Look!”可知，此处表示现在进行的动作，应用现在进行时。故选A。

questions.prompt: We  ______  the new museum if we have time tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果我们明天有时间，我们会去参观新的博物馆。 考查主将从现的用法。分析题干可知，本句包含if引导的条件状语从句，根据“if we have time tomorrow”可知，从句时态是一般现在时，则主句时态是一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: My dad  ______  blood three times at the blood center since two years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：从两年前开始，我爸爸已经在血液中心献血三次了。 考查时态。根据“since two years ago”可知句子用现在完成时have/has done。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  a present for my grandpa in the shop when my friend saw me.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我的朋友看到我时，我正在商店里为爷爷挑选礼物。 考查动词时态。根据“when my friend saw me”可知，此处应用过去进行时，表示过去在某一时间段或某一段时间内正在发生或进行动作。故选B。

questions.prompt: In our school, lunch  ______  from 11:30 am to 12:30 pm this term.
questions.explanation: 句意： 在我们学校，午餐供应时间从上午11:30到下午12:30。 考查被动语态。句子陈述的是一般性情况，时态用一般现在时，且主语lunch和谓语动词serve之间是被动关系，因此要用被动语态； 一般现在时的被动语态结构为“am/is/are+动词的过去分词”，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Jack, can you tell me  ______  at the school sports meeting? —Sure. I took part in the 100-metre race.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jack，你能告诉我你在校运动会做什么了吗？——当然。我参加了100米跑。 考查宾语从句。根据“can you tell me”可知此句是宾语从句，从句是陈述句语序，排除C和D，主句一般现在时，主现从不限，根据“I took part in the 100-metre race.”可知询问过去的事，用一般过去时。故选A。 二、完形填空 (每题1分, 共8分) 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 “Lucy, your routine (动作) looks great.” Mia greeted Lucy with a hug after the practice. “But it might help if you...” “Look, Mia,” Lucy interrupted, unable to hide her feelings. “I know what’s best for my routine. I’ve spent months  ______ 13 ______  it and I can find out what needs to be fixed myself.” “I’m sorry, Lucy. I know you’re great at gymnastics, but I just thought... never mind. I’ll give you some  ______ 14 ______.” With that, Mia left. Lucy realized she had driven her friend away, but she  ______ 15 ______  to let her feelings distract (使分心) her. She told herself that it would be easier to focus without continuous judgment. The competition was two days away. “Lucy! Watch that somersault (空翻)!” Coach Jen shouted as Lucy practiced. Lucy saw the empty seat beside Coach Jen and tried to push away the  ______ 16 ______  she felt from her friend’s absence. Coach Jen went up to Lucy after practice. “Lucy, you seem off your game, and you need to get it together. I’d hate to see all your efforts go to waste.” Coach Jen walked off with a look of disappointment. Mia always nitpicked (挑剔) her performance, but she always had something supportive to say as well. Lucy missed the  ______ 17 ______  Mia gave her when she was doubting herself — like now. Finally, the day of the competition came, Although Lucy knew the routine by heart, she still felt  ______ 18 ______. She stood there with a worried face. “You’re going to be great!” Lucy suddenly heard. She turned and saw Mia walking towards her. Lucy stood with her mouth open. “I really didn’t think you were going to show up. I’m sorry — you were just trying to  ______ 19 ______  me, but I didn’t want to take the time to listen to what you had to say.” Mia hugged Lucy. “I know you needed your space, but there’s no way I was going to miss your competition — you’re my best friend! I’ll always  ______ 20 ______  you.” Her friend’s words made Lucy feel better. When a judge called her name, she walked to the gymnastic floor with her head held high.

questions.prompt: Tina is a five-year-old girl.  ______  can draw very beautiful pictures.
questions.explanation: 句意：蒂娜是一个五岁的女孩。她能画出非常漂亮的画。 考查代词辨析。She她；He他；It它；They他们。根据“Tina is a five-year-old girl.”可知，空格处应填一人称代词主格代替Tina。故选A。

questions.prompt: The students are having a Chinese lesson  ______  the classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：学生们正在教室里上语文课。 考查介词辨析。on在……上面；at在某处或某一时刻；in在……里面；to到……去。根据“having a Chinese lesson”可知，此处指“在教室里上课”。故选C。

questions.prompt: It’s very late,  ______  Miss White is still working at the office.
questions.explanation: 句意：很晚了，但怀特小姐还在办公室工作。 考查连词辨析。and和；or或者；so因此；but但是。根据“It’s very late”和“Miss White is still working at the office”可知前后表转折，虽然已经很晚了，但她仍然在工作，but符合题意。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Must I clean my room right now? —No, you  ______. You can clean it after dinner.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我必须立刻打扫房间吗？——不，你不必。你可以晚饭后打扫它。 考查情态动词。shouldn’t不该；wouldn’t不会；mustn’t禁止；needn’t不需要。根据“You can clean it after dinner.”可知是指你不需要现在打扫，你可以晚饭后打扫它。故选D。

questions.prompt: This new school is  ______  than ours.
questions.explanation: 句意：这所新学校比我们的大。 考查形容词比较级。根据than可知，此处应用形容词large“大的”的比较级形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the book? —It’s $22. 95. A How old

questions.prompt: —Where were you last Saturday? —I  ______  in the Capital Museum.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上星期六你在哪里？——我在首都博物馆。 考查动词的时态。根据“last Saturday”可知考查的是动词的过去时，系动词be的过去式是was或were，因主语是I故用was。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  Mr. Smith at the airport tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：明天上午我将去机场接史密斯先生。 考查动词时态。根据“tomorrow morning”可知，句子是一般将来时，故选A。

questions.prompt: David  ______  his grandparents every week.
questions.explanation: 句意：大卫每周都去看望他的祖父母。 考查动词时态。根据“every week”可知是指经常发生的动作，时态用一般现在时，主语David是第三人称单数，谓语动词用三单形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: My brother  ______  a model plane and I am watering the flowers now.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在，我哥哥正在做飞机模型，我正在浇花。 考查时态。made制作，过去式；will make一般将来时；is making正在进行时；has made现在完成时。根据now可知，句子时态为现在进行时，结构为be动词+动词现在分词，主语是My brother，第三人称单数形式，be动词用is，make的现在分词是making。故选C。

questions.prompt: Today, smart phones are really helpful. They  ______ everywhere.
questions.explanation: 句意：如今，智能手机真的很有用，到处都用智能手机。 考查被动语态。根据“Today, smart phones are really helpful.”可知，本句时态为一般现在时，主语they和谓语动词use“使用”之间是被动关系，应用一般现在时的被动语态。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Can you tell me  ______  the book, Tony? —Yes. I bought the book in Xinhua Bookstore.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你在哪里买的这本书吗，托尼？ ——可以。我在新华书店买了这本书。 考查宾语从句。根据“I bought the book in Xinhua Bookstore.”可知，回答者去新华书店买书这一动作已经发生，应用一般过去时，排除C、D选项。根据英语语法，宾语从句应用陈述语序，故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 The Family Cookbook "Can I take your order? "Night after night, I had to repeat this sentence as I waited tables in my family's restaurant. My father was a famous chef and the restaurant was always crowded, so I was always  ______ 13 ______. As the graduation（毕业） day drew near, my father and I started looking at new cars. It was the first time that I remembered my father spending time with me outside the restaurant. The week before graduation we found the perfect car. I was sure that my father would buy it for me. On the night of graduation, my father handed me a gift—wrapped book. It was my father's old cookbook. I was so angry that I threw the cookbook down and  ______ 16 ______  out of the house. I could not believe that with all of his  ______ 17 ______  and all of the time that I had spent working in the restaurant, all I would get was that old cookbook. Plus, he knew I hated cooking! I soon moved away and after many years became successful in my own business. Although I often saw my father during the vacation, we never talked about the graduation  ______ 18 ______. Then one day, I got a call that my father was in hospital. I went to see him because I was very  ______ 19 ______  and wanted to make sure he would be OK. That night at my parents' home, I found the cookbook that he had given me years ago. I carefully opened the cookbook and went through the pages. Midway through them, I found something that made my eyes fill with tears. It was a  ______ 20 ______, dated the of my graduation, made out in the exact amount of money needed for the car we picked out all those years ago.

questions.prompt: My grandparents are coming home from Hainan. We will meet  ______  at the airport.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的祖父母要从海南回家了。我们将在机场接他们。 考查代词辨析。it它；her她；him他；them他们。根据“My grandparents”可知，代词应用them。故选D。

questions.prompt: There are many club s in our school. My favorite music club is  ______  Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校有很多俱乐部。我最喜欢的音乐俱乐部是星期五下午。 考查介词辨析。on用于表示确定的时间，具体某天或具体某一天的上午下午晚上或一般节日等；in用于表示世纪、年、月、季节，在上午/下午/晚上/白天等；at表示在具体的时间点，常用于表示钟点、夜里、中午、拂晓等的词组中；of属于……的。根据“Friday afternoon.”可知，这里用介词on。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Mr. Li, can I join the football team? — Of course, you  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——李先生我可以参加足球队吗？——当然，你可以。 考查情态动词辨析。can可以；need需要；must必须；would将要，表示可能性。根据“can I join the football team”可知此处应用can回答，故选A。

questions.prompt: —How are you feeling, Jane? —Much  ______. Thanks for your help.
questions.explanation: 句意：——简，你感觉怎么样？————好多了。谢谢你的帮助。 考查形容词比较级。much修饰形容词比较级，表示“好多了”，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  are you going to have the school meeting, Andrew? —Online.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你打算在哪里开学校会议，安德鲁？——线上。 考查疑问词。where哪里；who谁；what什么；when什么时候。根据答语online可知，此处问的是地点，表示在“哪里”开会。故选A。

questions.prompt: My sister enjoys watching movies,  ______  she doesn’t like watching them alone.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹喜欢看电影，但她不喜欢一个人看。 考查并列连词。or或者；so所以；but但是；for因为。根据“she doesn’t like watching them alone”可知，前后句为转折关系，应用并列连词but“但是”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Many foreigners  ______  Shougang Park yesterday and they felt really excited.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天许多外国人参观了首钢公园，他们感到非常兴奋。 考查动词时态。根据yesterday可知，时态用一般过去时，所以空处用visit的过去式visited，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Where are you now, Betty? —I’m in Lao She Teahouse and I  ______  Beijing Opera.
questions.explanation: 句意：——贝蒂，你现在在哪里？——我在老舍茶馆看京剧。 考查动词时态。根据“Where are you now”可知，是介绍现在正在做的事情，所以应用现在进行时，故选C。

questions.prompt: We  ______  some cleaning for the old men in our community tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：明天我们将会为我们社区里的老人做清洁。 考查一般将来时。根据时间状语“tomorrow”可知，句子描述将来的事情，应用一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: Jima  ______  a lot from the social work since he joined the projects at school.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从参加学校的项目以来，Jima从社会工作中学到了很多。 考查现在完成时。根据时间状语 “since he joined the projects...”可知，该句为现在完成时，结构为“have/has+done”，主语为Jima，助动词用has，故选C。

questions.prompt: Many homeless dogs  ______  after well by Miss Wang every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：许多无家可归的狗每天都被王小姐照顾得很好。 考查动词时态和语态。look after“照顾”，主语homeless dogs和动词look after之间是动宾关系，所以用被动语态，结合every day可知，此处应用一般现在时的被动语态，主语是复数，所以be动词用are，look变为过去分词looked。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______, Mary? —Yes. Perhaps in a few months.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玛丽，你知道宇宙飞船什么时候回来吗？——知道。也许几个月后。 考查宾语从句。根据“Do you know”可知，空格处为宾语从句，此时从句应用陈述句语序，故排除选项B和D。根据“Perhaps in a few months”可知，引导词应用when。故选C。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Lisa, Michael, and Emma were good friends. They were reading the script (剧本), when their drama teacher, Mrs. Anderson, called out the  ______ 13 ______  of the students with acting parts, they did not hear their names called. They were asked to be the set designers, whose job was to  ______ 14 ______  the decorations on the stage. Lisa was unhappy because she performed well at the tryout. But she had an idea “If the girl who got the starring part (主演) gets sick or something, I’ll have the chance. So I’d better know the  ______ 15 ______  perfectly. ” For the next month the set-design team met after school every day. Emma and Michael cut, fixed and painted, while Lisa sat in the corner, learning the lines of the starring part. She could see that the sets were going  ______ 16 ______, but she did not think it mattered. That evening, when the teacher saw the sets before rehearsal (排练), she was  ______ 17 ______  because the rainbow had not been painted. So the actors had to rehearse without the sets. As Lisa watched the play rehearsal with no sets, she  ______ 18 ______  she was ruining (毁坏) it although she had imagined stepping in at the last minute to save it. Lisa decided that if she could not act, she could help tell the story with excellent sets. The set design team worked every afternoon and evening to get the sets  ______ 19 ______  and looking wonderful. At the end of the play on opening night, their teacher had the set-design team come out to take a bow (鞠躬). The audience clapped for the set designers just as loudly as it had for the actors. It seemed that the sets were also stars of the show! From this experience, Lisa came to understand that whether she played a part or worked as the set designer, she could achieve her  ______ 20 ______.

questions.prompt: Mary is a popular singer, and we all like ______  songs.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽是一位受欢迎的歌手，我们都喜欢她的歌。 考查形容词性物主代词。his他的；her她的；your你的，你们的；their他们的，她们的，它们的。根据上文“Mary is a popular singer”可知，Mary是女名，表示“她的”用her。故选B。

questions.prompt: The Smiths arrived  ______  Shanghai on a cold winter morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯一家在一个寒冷的冬日早上到达上海。 考查介词辨析。in在……里面；on在……上面；at在；to到。Shanghai“上海”是一个大城市，应用动词短语arrive in表示到达。故选A。

questions.prompt: John had a bad cold yesterday,  ______  he didn’t go to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jack昨天感冒了，因此他没有去上学。 考查连词辨析。for因为；so因此；but但是；or或者。空格前后两句为因果关系，前因后果，应用表示因果关系的并列连词so来连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Anna,  ______  is our English teacher? —On the playground.
questions.explanation: 句意：——安娜，我们的英语老师在哪儿？——在操场上。 考查特殊疑问词辨析。where哪里；why为什么；what什么；who谁。根据回答可知是在提问地点，用where。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Look! Tom’s name is on the cover of this book. —Right, I’m sure it  ______  be Tom’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——看！汤姆的名字在这本书的封面上。——没错，我很确定它一定是汤姆的。 考查动词辨析。can可以；need需要；must肯定；may可能。根据“Tom’s name is on the cover of this book”和“Right, I’m sure”可知是非常有把握的推测，应用情态动词must表示。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Jack, what do you think of the robot? —I think it’s one of  ______  inventions. A interesting
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你觉得机器人怎么样？——我觉得它是最有趣的发明之一。 考查形容词的最高级。根据“one of”可知此处应用“one of the+形容词最高级+复数名词”表示“最……的……之一”。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  for the dinner when Peter knocked at the door last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚彼得敲门时，我正在准备晚饭。 考查动词时态。prepare准备，一般现在时；prepared准备，一般过去时；was preparing正在准备，过去进行时；am preparing正在准备，现在进行时。根据“when Peter knocked at the door last night”和语境可知，此处应用过去进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: If it doesn’t rain tomorrow, we  ______  bird-watching in Niantan Park.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天不下雨，我们将去念坛公园观鸟。 考查条件状语从句时态。句子是if引导的条件状语从句，从句是一般现在时，主句应用一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: Ever since Mrs. Brown came to Beijing, she  ______  in this community.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从布朗太太到北京以来，她就一直在这个社区生活。 考查现在完成时。根据“Ever since”可知句子应用现在完成时，其谓语结构为：have/has+过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: This email  ______  by our English teacher five days ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：这封电子邮件是我们的英语老师五天前写的。 考查动词。write写，原形；wrote过去式；is written一般现在时的被动语态；was written一般过去时的被动语态。主语This email与动词write之间存在被动关系，用be done的结构，时间状语是five days ago，因此用一般过去时的被动语态，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______? —Next Friday morning.

choices.label: A
choices.text: When will Mr. Green come back

choices.label: B
choices.text: When Mr. Green will come back

choices.label: C
choices.text: When did Mr. Green come back

questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道格林先生什么时候回来吗？——下周五早上。 考查宾语从句。分析句子结构可知，此处为宾语从句，必须用陈述句的语序，排除A、C；再由“Next Friday morning.”可知，时态为一般将来时。故选B。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Girl No One Talked to Last year there was a girl at our school who hardly anyone talked to. I think it was because she seldom showered, and she kind of smelled bad. Her name was Cindy Lindburg. I didn’t know exactly where she  ______ 13 ______, but it must have been somewhere in the neighborhood because we always got on the school bus at the same bus stop. One day, I was walking up to the bus stop and I saw Carl making fun of her. I couldn’t hear what he was saying, but I saw how sad it made Cindy. As soon as I got close enough, I glared (怒视) at Carl to make him  ______ 14 ______  laughing. But it didn’t work. So I walked over and stood closer to Cindy to make sure she wouldn’t feel quite so bad. It was just one of those times when you just knew someone needed someone to be a friend. I didn’t think she’d say anything, but she did. Her eyes peeked up from staring at the ground and whispered (低声说), “Hi.” “Hi,” I said. Then as  ______ 15 ______  as I could, I said, “Don’t pay any attention to Carl! His parents have been unsuccessful in teaching him some manners.” Some of the kids around us laughed after they heard what I had said. By now everyone there was talking with a friend. Quietly, and with a serious look on her face, Cindy said, “I don’t know why everyone  ______ 16 ______  me.” I was surprised at her words. “No one hates you,” I told her. “Then why don’t I have any friends?” she asked. I thought for a moment. “Well” I began, wondering if I could tell her that maybe it was because she smelled so  ______ 17 ______, “I think you’re smart, and you dress okay, and…” “So then, what is it?” she asked. “Maybe it’s because you…” I paused because I almost said “stink” (发出臭味) but instead, “don’t smell so good.” She looked up,  ______ 18 ______  my face as if checking to see if I was making fun of her or being mean. I guess she decided I wasn’t. She nodded. I added, “I think you’d probably make more friends if you took more  ______ 19 ______.” She looked away. I worried that I might have gone too far. Turning back to face me, Cindy took a deep breath and said, “Thank you.” I was so relieved, and the next moment the bus arrived, and all the kids started getting on. “If I save a seat for you on the bus tomorrow,” she asked, “will you sit with me?” “Sure,” I said. I’m happy to report that Cindy did take more baths from that day on. And it wasn’t too long before she started to make  ______ 20 ______  at school. I was one of them.

questions.prompt: My brother is only six, but  ______  can already help with some housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我弟弟只有六岁，但他已经能帮忙做一些家务了。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；it它；they他们。根据“My brother”可知，空处指代弟弟，应用he。故选A。

questions.prompt: We have PE class  ______  three o’clock every afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们每天下午三点钟都上体育课。 考查时间介词。on其后加星期或日期；to到；in其后加早中晚，月份，季节，年份等；at其后加时间点。“three o’clock”是时间点，用时间介词at。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Sam,  ______  I join you in the community service? —Of course you can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Sam，我能加入你的社区服务吗？——你当然可以。 考查动词辨析。can可以；must必须；should应该；need需要。根据“Of course you can.”可知，此处请求对方允许，用can，故选A。

questions.prompt: After taking tennis classes, my sister is much  ______  than last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：上完网球课后，我妹妹比去年强壮多了。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知，此处应使用形容词比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you tidy your own room? —Twice a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久整理一次你自己的房间？——一周两次。 考查疑问词组。How often多久一次；How soon多久以后；How much多少（钱）；How long多久。根据“Twice a week.”可知询问频率，用How often提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: Wash your hands before meals,  ______  you may get ill.
questions.explanation: 句意：饭前洗手，否则你可能会生病的。 本题考查连词。and而且，but但是，or否则，so所以。结合句意，“饭前不洗手”是“你可能会生病”的条件，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Lucy, what are you doing? —I  ______  a model ship.
questions.explanation: 句意：——露西，你在干什么？——我正在制作一个轮船模型。 考查现在进行时。根据“what are you doing?”可知句子应用现在进行时来回答，其谓语结构为：am/is/are+现在分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: If you go to the concert with us, you  ______  a good time there.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你和我们去音乐会，你会在那儿玩得很开心。 考查if引导的条件状语从句。该句式的语法规则主将从现，即if引导的从句为一般现在时，主语为一般将来时，即will do。故选B。

questions.prompt: The Shenzhou-15 astronauts  ______  to Earth safely on June 4, 2023. A return
questions.explanation: 句意：神舟15号宇航员于2023年6月4日安全返回地球。 考查时态。根据“on June 4, 2023”可知是过去发生的事情，用一般过去时，谓语用过去式returned。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  many friends since I came to this school.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我来到这所学校我已经结交了很多朋友。 考查现在完成时的谓语形式。make一般现在时；make一般过去时；will make一般将来时；have made现在完成时。根据“since”可知主句时态是现在完成时，所以选have made。故选D。

questions.prompt: Today, many winter Olympic sports  ______  even by children.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天，许多冬季奥运会项目甚至受到孩子们的喜爱。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“Today”可知，是一般现在时，根据“by children”可知，表被动，所以用一般现在时的被动语态。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Do you know  ______? —At 9:00 tomorrow morning.

choices.label: B
choices.text: when did the video meeting begin

choices.label: C
choices.text: when the video meeting will begin

questions.explanation: ——句意：你知道视频会议什么时候开始吗?——明天上午九点。 考查宾语从句。问句是一个含宾语从句的复合句，宾语从句中从句语序应该为陈述句语序，因此排除B和D；根据答语“At 9 o'clock tomorrow morning.”可知询问的应该是将来的事，用一般将来时，选项A是一般过去时，故选C。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 “Do you have your costume (装扮) for the Harvest Fest (丰收节) competition?” Meg asked. “I have one—Magnifico, my favourite hero,” said Jordan, sitting in his wheelchair (轮椅). “But it’s boring.” Meg shrugged. “You love Magnifico. What’s the matter?” “Danny and Alex are going as Magnifico, too.” Jordan shook his head. “It’s  ______ 13 ______  for me to win.” Meg said, “Maybe you should go as something different.” “The competition is Friday night. It’s too late to change costumes,” Jordan sighed. Back at home, Jordan was quiet, thinking about Meg’s words  ______ 14 ______. When he pulled into Mom’s home office, he saw papers and books everywhere. “What are all these?” he asked. “I’m cleaning out my old desk. The new one is arriving tomorrow.” She smiled at Jordan. “What’s on your mind?” Jordan explained the costume situation. “I really want to be the  ______ 15 ______.” “We have lots of old clothes and costumes. Why not take a look?” Mom  ______ 16 ______. “OK.” Jordan found large sunglasses and a long black wig, but nothing was useful. The next day, Meg found him. “Any new idea?” “I  ______ 17 ______  some old clothes.” He shrugged. “Nothing.” “Jordan you have to think outside the box,” said Meg. “See what you have around your house. There’s hidden potential (潜能) in everyday items. My candy-bar costume is made from recycled aluminum foil.” When Jordan got home, he found Mom putting her new desk together. On top of the desk was a large box. Suddenly, he  ______ 18 ______  what Meg said—think outside the box. “What do you think?” Mom asked, pointing to her desk. Jordan’s eyes fell on the  ______ 19 ______. He smiled. “It’s perfect!” On Friday night, Jordan was fully prepared for the competition. When Danny and Alex saw Jordan, they couldn’t believe his costume. “The Magnifico Mobile?” Danny’s eyes lit up. “The wheels of your wheelchair are perfect for its back wheels.” He wondered how Jordan made it. Jordan beamed. “Thanks! I got the idea from a box.” It was time to announce the result. “The winner is…Jordan Eastman!” Everyone clapped. “See?” Meg said. “You just needed to be  ______ 20 ______!” “Yeah, think outside the box!” Jordan smiled.

questions.prompt: My brother likes basketball very much. Yao Ming is  ______  favourite basketball star.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥非常喜欢篮球。姚明是他最喜欢的篮球明星。 考查代词辨析。my我的；her她、她的；his他的；their他们的。根据题干中“My brother”（我的哥哥），可知是男性， “favourite basketball star”（最喜欢的篮球明星）为名词词组，前面需要用形容词性物主代词。故选C。

questions.prompt: China’s Shenzhou-16 astronauts completed their tasks very well and returned to Earth safely  ______  October 31, 2023.
questions.explanation: 句意：2023年10月31日，中国神舟16号航天员圆满完成任务，安全返回地球。 考查时间介词。at后接钟点；in后加没有具体到某一天的时间（世纪、年、季节、月）或者早晨、下午和晚上；on后接具体到某一天的时间或具体某一天的早晨、下午和晚上；to到。根据“October 31, 2023”可知，表示具体某一天要介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mr. Smith,  ______  is the new bridge? —Oh, let me see! It’s about 800 metres.
questions.explanation: 句意：——史密斯先生，新桥有多长？ ——哦，让我看看！大约800米。 考查特殊疑问句。how old多大，对年龄提问；how long多长/多久，对长度或一段时间提问；how much多少，对价格或不可数名词的数量提问；how often多久一次，对频率提问。根据答语“It’s about 800 metres.”可知，此处是询问新桥的长度，应用how long。故选B。

questions.prompt: Taxi Apps (打车软件) can help us travel around more easily,  ______  more and more people like using them. A or
questions.explanation: 句意：打车软件能帮助我们更容易地去旅行，所以越来越多的人喜欢使用它们。 考查连词辨析。or或者；so所以；for为了；but但是。根据“Taxi Apps can help us travel around more easily”和“more and more people like using them”可知，句子前后是因果关系。故选B。

questions.prompt: — What do you think of the film you saw yesterday? — Oh! It’s one of  ______  films I’ve ever seen.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认为你昨天看的电影怎么样？——哦！ 这是我看过的最有趣的电影之一。 考查形容词最高级。题中将“昨天我看的电影”和“我看过的所有电影”进行了对比，是三者或三者以上的比较，所以要用形容词最高级；表示“最……”这个概念，结构是“one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数”，interesting的最高级形式是most interesting，且最高级前要加the，所以是the most interesting。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Must I finish the job this Friday? —No, you  ______. You can finish it next Monday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我必须在这个星期五完成这项工作吗？——不，你不必。你可以在下周一完成。 考查情态动词。can’t不能；shouldn’t不应该；needn’t不必；mustn’t禁止。根据“Must I...”可知其否定回答为No, you needn’t。故选C。

questions.prompt: —You look so happy. What happened? —I  ______  an A in my English exam yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你看起来很开心。发生了什么？——我昨天英语考试得了A。 考查动词时态。根据yesterday“昨天”可知句子时态为一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式got。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Peter, what were you doing at this time last night? —I  ______  my mother prepare the dinner at that time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，昨天晚上这个时间你在干什么？ ——我那时正在帮助母亲准备晚餐。 考查过去进行时。help动词原形；will help一般将来时；was helping过去进行时；am helping现在进行时。根据句子中的“at that time”（那时）可知空格处使用过去进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: We  ______  a gardening class next week and we’ll learn how to beautify our school.
questions.explanation: 句意：下周我们将上园艺课，我们将学习如何美化我们的学校。 考查动词时态。根据句中的时间状语“next week”可知，时态是一般将来时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Is your sister a teacher Mary? —Yes, she  ______  in Beijing Academy since 2013.
questions.explanation: 句意：———玛丽，你的妹妹是老师吗？——是的，她自从2013年以来就在北京中学工作了。 考查动词时态。根据“since 2013”可知，本句是现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Nowadays, the program China in the Classics on CCTV becomes popular and it  ______  by more and more people.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在，中央电视台的中国经典节目很受欢迎，被越来越多的人观看。 考查被动语态。watches一般现在时的第三人称单数形式；watched一般过去时；was watched一般过去时的被动语态；is watched一般现在时的被动语态。根据Nowadays可知句子时态用一般现在时，主语it和谓语动词watch之间是被动关系，所以要用被动语态；一般现在时的被动语态结构为：am/is/are+动词的过去分词。故选D。

questions.prompt: Bing Xin is a popular woman writer in China. Many children like reading  ______  books.
questions.explanation: 句意：冰心是中国一位受欢迎的女作家。许多孩子喜欢读她的书。 考查代词辨析。her她；his他的；my我的；your你的，你们的。根据“a popular woman writer”可知，指的是她的书，形容词性物主代词用her。故选A。

questions.prompt: People often celebrate New Year  ______  December 31st every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：人们通常在每年的12月31日庆祝新年。 考查时间介词。at在，用于时刻前；on用于具体某一天前；in用在年月季节等较长一段时间前；of……的。根据“December 31st”是具体某一天可知，应用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  will Shenzhou XVⅡspaceship stay in space, Tom? —For about six months.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，神舟十五号二号宇宙飞船将在太空停留多久？——大约六个月。 考查特殊疑问词。how many多少；how often多久一次；how long多长时间；how much多少钱。根据“For about six months.”可知，此处提问一段时间，应使用how long。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mike is interested in trying new ideas,  ______  he has invented many things.
questions.explanation: 句意：迈克对尝试新的想法感兴趣，而且他已经发明了很多东西。 考查连词词义辨析。and而且，表示并列；but但是，表示转折；or或者，表示选择；unless除非，引导条件状语从句。根据句意，前半句是“迈克对尝试新的想法感兴趣”，后半句“他已经发明了很多东西”，前后两句是并列关系，所以用and连接。故选A。

questions.prompt: A good learner always  ______  clear goals and keeps learning.
questions.explanation: 句意：一个好的学习者总是有明确的目标并不断学习。 考查时态。由“always”可知，时态为一般现在时，主语“A good learner”为第三人称单数，谓语也应用第三人称单数形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing when I called you at 20:00 yesterday? —I  ______  a difficult English puzzle.
questions.explanation: 句意：——当我昨天20：00给你打电话时，你正在做什么？——我正在解决一道困难的英语谜题。 考查过去进行时。solve解决，原形；solved过去式；am solving现在进行时；was solving过去进行时。根据“What were you doing”可知应该使用过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: You  ______  your friends better if you can stand in their shoes.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你能站在朋友的立场上，你就能更好地理解他们。 考查动词时态。if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，主句用一般将来时：will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: Zhang Guimei  ______  many girls from poor areas for over 40 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：40多年来，张桂梅帮助了许多贫困地区的女孩。 考查现在完成时。helps帮助，三单形式；helped过去式；will help将来时；has helped现在完成时。根据“for over 40 years”可知，for后跟一段时间，使用现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: A kid  ______  some of his own stories with his classmates now.
questions.explanation: 句意：一个孩子正在和他的同学分享他自己的故事。 考查时态。根据“now”可知，时态为现在进行时，结构为be doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: Astronauts  ______  to the walls in space so that they don’t float around when sleeping.
questions.explanation: 句意：宇航员在太空中被绑在墙上，这样他们睡觉时就不会到处漂浮。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语“Astronauts”和谓语“tie”之间为逻辑上的动宾关系，应用被动语态；根据“they don’t float around”可知，时态为一般现在时，因此用一般现在时的被动语态，主语是复数，系动词用are。故选C。

questions.prompt: My mother is very kind.  ______  is always ready to help others.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈很善良。她总是乐于助人。 考查人称代词。She她；He他；I我；You你。根据“My mother is very kind.”可知，这里用人称代词She。故选A。

questions.prompt: Many tourists go to Tian’anmen Square  ______  1st October to celebrate our National Day.
questions.explanation: 句意：十月一日许多游客去天安门广场庆祝国庆节。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体的钟点前；in用于年、月、季节等泛指的时间前；on用于具体的某一天前，或具体某一天的上/下午/晚上前；to朝，向。根据“1st October”可知，是具体的某一天，用介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Must I return the book before Friday, Miss Li? —No, you  ______. You can keep it for three weeks.

questions.prompt: The new gym is much  ______  than the old one.
questions.explanation: 句意：新体育馆比旧体育馆大得多。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”以及“is much”可知考查形容词比较级。larger“更大的”符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you have the basketball training? —Twice a week.

questions.prompt: Running is a good way to keep healthy,  ______  many people love it.
questions.explanation: 句意：跑步是保持健康的好方法，所以很多人都喜欢它。 考查连词辨析。or或；but但是；because因为；so所以。空前是空后“人们喜欢跑步”的原因，前后之间是因果关系，属于前因后果，所以用so连接结果。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Be quiet! Your father  ______  an online meeting now. —OK, mum.
questions.explanation: 句意：——安静点！你父亲现在正在参加一个在线会议。——好的，妈妈。 考查动词时态。根据“now”可知时态用现在进行时，主语是三单，结构应用“is doing”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —How was your weekend? —Great! I  ______  the National Museum with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——周末过得怎么样？——很好！我和朋友参观了国家博物馆。 考查动词的时态。根据“How was your weekend?”可知，时态为一般过去时，所以谓语动词要用过去分词形式，结合选项visit的过去式是visited。故选B。

questions.prompt: We  ______  football if it doesn’t snow tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天不下雪，我们就踢足球。 考查条件状语从句。根据“if it doesn’t snow tomorrow.”可知该句是if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，主句应用一般将来时“will do”，故选A。

questions.prompt: John  ______  Chinese since he came to live in China. He is good at it now.
questions.explanation: 句意：约翰自从来到中国生活以来就一直在学中文。他现在很擅长。 考查现在完成时。learns一般现在时；was learning过去进行时；has learned现在完成时；will learn一般将来时。根据“since he came to live in China.”可知，用现在完成时，结构为：has/have done。故选C。

questions.prompt: These great books  ______  by people all over the world today.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天，全世界的人都在阅读这些伟大的书籍。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“today”可知该句是一般现在时，主语是“books”与“read”之间存在被动关系，因此用一般现在时的被动语态“am/is/are+动词过去分词”，主语为复数，be动词用are，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Bob,  ______  you hand in your report before Friday? —OK. No problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：——鲍勃，你能在星期五之前交报告吗？——好啊，没问题。 考查词义辨析。can能，可以；need需要；must必须；should应该；应当。根据回答“OK. No problem.”可知表示向别人征求意见，应用can，“can you…?”表示委婉地邀请或向别人征求意见等。故选A。

questions.prompt: Tea is one of  ______  drinks in the world. Drinking tea can bring many health benefits.

questions.prompt: Jimmy  ______  a book when his mom came home last night.

questions.prompt: My grandfather  ______  a healthy life. He takes a walk in the park every day.

questions.prompt: Alice  ______  a lot about Chinese customs since she joined the culture club.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从加入文化俱乐部以来，爱丽丝学到了很多关于中国风俗的知识。 考查现在完成时。根据“since she joined the culture club”可知，句子时态应用现在完成时，其结构是have/has done，句子主语Alice为第三人称单数，助动词用has，动词learn“学会”的过去分词为learned。故选C。

questions.prompt: As technology develops rapidly, more and more AI tools  ______  in the future.
questions.explanation: 句意：随着科技的快速发展，未来越来越多的人工智能工具将会被发明。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。根据“in the future”可知句子应用一般将来时，主语AI tools与动词invent存在逻辑上的被动关系，谓语应用一般将来时的被动语态，即will be+过去分词。故选D。
