questions.prompt: Mr. Smith is a great teacher. We all like ______  lessons.
questions.explanation: 句意：Smith先生是一个极好的老师。我们都喜欢他的课。 考查代词词义辨析。his他的；her她的；your你的，你们的；their他们的。lesson“课程”前面缺形容词性物主代词修饰，Mr. Smith指的是男性，所以填his。故选A。

questions.prompt: Betty loves reading very much. There are lots of books  ______  her book shelves.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂非常喜欢阅读。她的书架上有很多书。 考查介词辨析。at在，后接小地方；on在……上面；from从；between在……之间。根据“There are lots of books... her book shelves.”可知，此处是指书在书架上面，故选B。

questions.prompt: Tim likes to help others,  ______  we all enjoy being with him.
questions.explanation: 句意：Tim喜欢帮助别人，所以我们都喜欢和他在一起。 考查连词辨析。because因为；but但是；or或者；so因此。根据“Tim likes to help others,... we all enjoy being with him.”可知，前后句为因果关系，此处表示结果，应用so。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Jack,  ______  you finish the housework in ten minutes? —Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你能在十分钟内做完家务吗？——是的，我能。 考查情态动词need需要；can能；must必须；should应该。根据答语“Yes, I can.”可知一般疑问句应用can开头。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you have lunch at school every day? —At 12 o’clock.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你每天在学校什么时候吃午饭？——12点。 考查疑问词辨析。how如何；where在哪里；why为什么；when什么时候。根据“At 12 o’clock”可知，空处是对时间进行提问，所以用when，故选D。

questions.prompt: My father likes sports. He often  ______  in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爸爸喜欢运动。他经常在早上跑步。 考查一般现在时。根据“often”可知是频率副词，可推测出是用一般现在时，结合主语是“He”，可知用“runs”，故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s getting cold. Everyone needs to wear warm clothes  ______  winter.
questions.explanation: 句意：天气越来越冷了。冬天每个人都需要穿暖和的衣服。 考查介词辨析。at后接具体时刻；on后接具体某一天；in后接年/月/季节等；of……的。根据“winter”可知，冬天是季节，应用介词in，故选C。

questions.prompt: My grandpa is old but  ______  thinks he is young.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爷爷老了，但他认为自己很年轻。 考查代词辨析。she她；you你；it它；he他。根据“My grandpa is old but... thinks he is young.”可知，此处是“他”认为自己很年轻，用he。故选D。

questions.prompt: There  ______  two little lakes and a playground in the park near Liu Yin’s home.
questions.explanation: 句意：刘银家附近的公园里有两个小湖泊和一个操场。 考查主谓一致。there be句型表示某地存在某物，谓语动词遵从就近原则。因为空格后“two little lakes”是复数，因此这里be动词用are。故选C。

questions.prompt: There is  ______  old TV in my grandpa’s room.
questions.explanation: 句意：有一个旧的电视机在我的祖父的房间里。 考查冠词。an/a一个；the这个。根据There is...old TV“有一个旧的电视机”，可知这里表示泛指，因为old是以元音音素开头的单词，因此要用不定冠词an修饰。故选A。

questions.prompt: My mom  ______  a pet dog. It’s very cute.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈有一只宠物狗。它很可爱。 考查一般现在时。根据“It’s very cute.”可知，句子用一般现在时，主语“My mom”是第三人称单数，谓语动词应用三单形式，空处应是has。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______ is your sister? —She is fourteen years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妹妹多大了？——她十四岁了。 考查特殊疑问词。How often多久一次（提问频度）；How much多少，多少钱（提问不可数名词数量，或提问价格）；How tall多高（提问身高）；How old多大（提问年龄）。根据答语“She is fourteen years old.”可知问的是年龄。故选D。 （二）完形填空。 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Dad says things will get better. He says I will love living in the city just like I love to climb trees and play basketball. I look out of the window of our  ______ 18 ______  house. “I miss my friends,” I say, “I miss Michigan. I  ______ 19 ______  the trees.” “Los Angeles isn’t a bad place,” Dad says. Then he tells me about a park near our  ______ 20 ______. “You can play basketball there. Go and have fun!” When I get there, I see  ______ 21 ______  boys playing basketball. They are playing one-on-one (一对一). Two of them are taller than me, but one is about my size. I can tell that the short boy knows how to play. But the other boys are too tall for him. One-on-one isn’t his game. He  ______ 22 ______  someone’s help. I just go down to the other  ______ 23 ______  “Hey!” I stop and turn around. The short boy asks “Will you  ______ 24 ______  us?” “Sounds good.” “Come on. I’m Louie.” “Sonny.” We walk over. Louie says to the other boys, “How about a little two-on-two?” “Small against (对抗) tall,” I say. They agree. Then the game starts. It’s a/an  ______ 25 ______  game—up by two, down by two, back and forth (来来回回). Louie and I lose in the end,  ______ 26 ______  we are really proud of ourselves for playing a good game. Then I know all three of them study in Franklin School, just like me. And they have a basketball team. “Louie is the only good guard (后卫) we have.” “Not anymore,” I say. “Yeah.” Then we all laugh. “Coming back tomorrow?” “Yeah.” The sun is going down behind pink and orange clouds. “Los Angeles is not a  ______ 27 ______  place.” I think I get it.

questions.prompt: My brother likes reading and  ______  favorite book is Journey to the West.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥喜欢读书，他最喜欢的书是《西游记》。 考查代词辨析。her她的；his他的；its它的；their他们的。根据并列句子主语“My brother”可知，此处指的是“他最喜欢的书”，应用形容词性物主代词his，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Welcome to our school, John! Are you American? —No. I’m  ______  England.
questions.explanation: 句意：——欢迎来到我们学校，约翰！你是美国人吗？——不是。我来自英国。 考查介词辨析。from从……；in在……里；to到；with和。根据“Are you American?”可知询问的是来自哪里。根据“I’m…England”可知，这里是“be from+国家”的结构，用介词from。故选A。

questions.prompt: My phone bill is high  ______  I have lots of friends and we like to talk on the phone.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的电话话费很高，因为我有许多朋友，而且我们喜欢在电话上聊天。 考查连词辨析。or或者；so所以；but但是；because因为。根据“I have lots of friends and we like to talk on the phone”可知，因为我有许多朋友，我们喜欢在电话上聊天，所以我的电话费很高，所以用because引导原因状语从句。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me, Miss Green. Must I hand in my homework tomorrow？ —No, you  ______. You can give it to me next Monday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，格林小姐。我明天必须交作业吗？——不，你不必。你可以在下个周一给我。 考查情态动词。needn’t不必；wouldn’t将不；couldn’t不能；mustn’t禁止。根据“Must I...”可知其否定回答为No, you needn’t。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  does it take to go to Shanghai from Beijing by train？ —About 5 hours.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从北京乘火车去上海需要多长时间？——大约5小时。 考查特殊疑问词。How many多少,询问可数名词数量；How much多少，询问价格或者不可数名词数量；How often多久一次，询问频率；How long多长时间，询问时长。根据答语“About 5 hours.”表示时长可知，应用how long进行提问。故选D。

questions.prompt: Sound travels  ______  in water than in air.
questions.explanation: 句意：声音在水中比在空气中传播得快。 考查形副三级辨析。fast快地（原级）；faster更快地（比较级）；(the) fastest最快地（最高级）。根据句中“than”，可知空处应填副词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: If you don’t leave now, you  ______  late for the movie.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你现在不走，你看电影就要迟到了。 考查动词时态。根据“If you don’t leave now, you... late for the movie.”可知，本句是if引导的条件状语从句，根据“主将从现”原则，主句用一般将来时will do。故选C。

questions.prompt: Tianhui-5 satellite  ______  into space in November, 2023.
questions.explanation: 句意：天绘五号卫星于2023年11月发射升空。 考查被动语态。主语“Tianhui-5 satellite”和谓语动词send“发射”之间是被动关系。根据“in November, 2023”可知，应用一般过去时的被动语态：was/were +done，主语是第三人称单数，send的过去分词是sent。故选A。

questions.prompt: The volunteers  ______  the roads in the community now.
questions.explanation: 句意：志愿者们正在社区里清扫道路。 考查现在进行时。cleaned清扫，一般过去时；are cleaning正在清扫，现在进行时；will clean将要清扫，一般将来时；have cleaned已经清扫了，现在完成时。根据句尾时间状语“now”可知，此处应用现在进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  with my sister when mum came home.
questions.explanation: 句意：妈妈回家时，我正在和妹妹一起玩。 考查时态辨析。根据“when mum came home”，可知是when引导的时间状语从句，从句时态为一般过去时；结合选项，主句应用过去进行时，表示“过去某一时刻正在发生的动作”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Jack  ______  a lot of Chinese traditions since he began to live in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从杰克在中国生活以来，他学到了很多中国传统。 考查动词时态。根据“since he began to live in China”可知，时态应用现在完成时，结构为“have/has done”，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me  ______  tomorrow? —Chinese, maths and English.
questions.explanation: 句意：——可以请你告诉我明天我们有什么课吗？——语文，数学和英语。 考查宾语从句。此句是宾语从句，从句为陈述语序，排除选项A和C。根据答语“Chinese, maths and English.”可知，此处询问上什么课，排除选项D。故选B。 二 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A Lesson for Life One morning, Sanggat, an eight-year-old student of mine, knocked on my door. He was here to help me sweep my room. He noticed some thick books on my table. Curiously he asked, “Sir, what books are these?” I told him that those were books I needed to  ______ 13 ______  for an important exam so that I might go to university someday. He frowned (皱眉) because in this poor area even a bicycle was unheard of. I tried to explain “university” to him. He was  ______ 14 ______, “But, sir, you are a teacher. Why study?” So we sat down and I told him all about this thing called “education” and gave him a talk about his chances of becoming some one great in the future. He took one of my  ______ 15 ______, “Now, the words are so tiny and there are millions of them. How can you possibly finish reading it?” I explained to him the importance of learning to read well and that teachers like me, were specially sent to teach children like him so that they could read great books someday. When the other students  ______ 16 ______  that Sanggat always volunteered to sweep my room, they wanted to do the same. Soon it became an almost daily job. I realized an important lesson of my own teachers must watch out for every opportunity we have to help the young ones realize self achievements.  ______ 20 ______  actions sometimes can have far reaching effects on them and life may never be the same again.

questions.prompt: —What’s your hobby? — ______  hobby is listening to music.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的爱好是什么？——我的爱好是听音乐。 考查形容词性物主代词。his他的；my我的；her她的；their他们的。在英语提问中，your“你的”对应的回答应该是my“我的”。故选B。

questions.prompt: Jack often does some cooking for his family  ______  Saturdays.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克经常在星期六为他的家人做饭。 考查介词辨析。in用于表示世纪、年、月、季节，在上午/下午/晚上/白天等；at其后加时间点；to到；on用于表示确定的时间，具体某天或具体某一天的上午下午晚上或一般节日等。“Saturdays”确定到每个周六，应用on。故选D。

questions.prompt: I like the Spring Festival best  ______  my whole family can get together.
questions.explanation: 句意：我最喜欢春节，因为我们全家可以团聚在一起。 考查连词辨析。because因为，表示因果关系；but但是，表示转折关系；although尽管，虽然，引导让步状语从句；or否则。根据原句句意可知，全家团聚是我喜欢春节的原因。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Mr. Brown,  ______  we hand in the book report by Friday? —No, you needn’t. Next Monday is also OK.
questions.explanation: 句意：——布朗先生，我们必须在星期五之前交读书报告吗？——不，你们不必。下周一也可以。 考查情态动词的用法。can可以；would将会；must必须；might可能。根据“No, you needn’t. Next Monday is also OK.”可知，问句是问必须在周五前提交读书报告吗。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What did you think of the science museum? —Perfect. It was  ______  than I expected.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你觉得这家科学博物馆怎么样？——特别好。它比我想象的更有趣。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知本题应该用形容词比较级形式；interesting是多音节形容词，其比较级是在词前加more。故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you go to the dance club? —Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去一次舞会俱乐部？——一个月两次。 考查特殊疑问。How much多少，多少钱；How far多远；How long多长时间；How often多久一次。根据“Twice a month.”可知，问句是对频率提问，需用How often。故选D。

questions.prompt: We  ______  football on the playground when it started to rain.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们正在操场上踢足球时，天开始下雨了。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语从句“when it started to rain”可知，主句时态应用过去时进行时“was/were doing”。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to watch the movie with me? —Sorry. I  ______  it twice, but I do think it’s very interesting.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你愿意和我一起观看电影吗？——抱歉啊，我已经看过两次，但我确实认为它非常有趣。 考查动词时态。根据答句中“... it twice, but I do think it’s very interesting.”可知，我已经看过两次，需用现在完成时，其结构是“have/has+动词原形”。主语为I，助动词用have。故选C。

questions.prompt: Yuan Longping  ______  to help people grow more rice when he was young.
questions.explanation: 句意：袁隆平年轻时就决定帮助人们多种植水稻。 考查谓语动词的时态。根据“when he was young”可知，表示过去发生的动作或状态应用一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式。故选D。

questions.prompt: Please be quiet. Dad  ______  in his study.
questions.explanation: 句意：请保持安静。爸爸正在书房里工作。 考查时态。根据“Please be quiet.”可知，请保持安静，说明爸爸此刻正在书房工作，时态为现在进行时，结构为am/is/are doing。故选A。

questions.prompt: A course on traditional Chinese culture  ______  in our school next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：明年我们学校将开设一门关于中国传统文化的课程。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。本句主语是动作的承受者，结合时间状语“next year”可知，用一般将来时的被动语态。故选C。

The kids at her school were asked to invent something useful, make a model, and show how it worked. “The competition is really going to be cool,” she told her mother. “The only  ______ 13 ______  is, I want to help someone solve a real problem, but I can’t think of anything good.” “I’m sure you’ll do fine,” said her mother. “Oh, no! Mom, Kerry just crawled (爬) through the plans for my invention, and her leg brace messed them up!” Jessica shouted. “You know you can’t spread out your  ______ 14 ______  on the floor when she’s around,” said her mother. “Just be thankful she can crawl at all.” Kerry, Jessica’s sister, had heart trouble. She wasn’t really able to use the left side of her body. Still, she learned to crawl and her  ______ 15 ______  leg didn’t stop her from being a naughty little sister. Just then, Kerry plopped (倒下) herself down on the floor and started  ______ 16 ______. She pulled at the brace on her leg. Her sock had fallen down again and the brace was hurting her leg. Mom quickly ran to her. “I don’t know what we’re going to do,” said Mom, holding up the baby in her arms. “Look at her leg.” “That’s it!” Jessica said  ______ 17 ______. “I know what I’m going to do!” She rushed upstairs, collected a few things from her mother’s room and something from her sister’s room, and then  ______ 18 ______  herself in her room to work uninterrupted. Two hours later, she showed her invention—a special sock for Kerry. Jessica held it up and pointed. “See, it has these Velcro straps (粘扣带) on the top that hook (勾住) around the top of her leg brace and then stick to her sock. Now, the sock won’t fall down and Kerry’s leg is  ______ 19 ______.” “What a wonderful idea! Let’s try it,” said Mom. Kerry smiled as her mother put the new sock on under her brace. Jessica’s invention won first prize at her school. “What an honor!” Everyone said to her. She felt proud, but what really made her feel  ______ 20 ______  inside was when Kerry looked up at her with a smile. That’s when she knew she’d won something truly important-a special place in her little sister’s heart.

questions.prompt: Mrs. Smith is an art teacher.  ______  gives lessons at an international school.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯夫人是一位美术老师。她在一所国际学校上课。 考查人称代词。He他（主格）；She她（主格）；Him他（宾格）；Her她（宾格）。分析题干可知，空格处是人称代词用于指代前一句的Mrs. Smith“史密斯夫人”，且空格处在句中作主语，应用人称代词的主格，故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s a good idea to visit Beijing  ______  autumn.
questions.explanation: 句意：秋天去北京旅游是个好主意。 考查介词的用法。in在……里面；on在……上面；at在；to到。in+表示季节的名词表示“在某个季节”，空后的autumn“秋天”是表示季节的名词，故选A。

questions.prompt: My little brother is only 6 this year,  ______  he can look after himself.
questions.explanation: 句意：我弟弟今年只有6岁，但他能照顾好自己。 考查连词辨析。because因为；and并且，和；so所以；but但是。根据“My little brother is only 6 this year...he can look after himself.”可知，空处前后表转折关系。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mum, must I go home now? —No, you  ______. You can go home at six.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我现在必须回家吗？——不，你不必。你可以六点回家。 考查情态动词辨析。mustn’t绝不；can’t不能；needn’t不必；shouldn’t不应该。根据“You can go home at six.”可知，答语表达的是“现在不需要回家”。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you play sports, Mike? —Three times a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克，你多久运动一次？——每周三次。 考查由how构成的疑问词组。How old几岁（提问年龄）；How much多少钱，多少（提问不可数名词的数量）；How many多少（提问可数名词的数量）；How often多久一次（提问频率）。根据答语“Three times a week.”可知，问句提问频率，故选D。

questions.prompt: It is much  ______  today than it was yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天比昨天冷得多。 考查形容词比较级。cold寒冷的（原级）；colder比较级；coldest最高级，前面要加the；the coldest最高级。根据“It is much...today than it was yesterday.”可知，是把今天的天气和昨天的天气两者进行比较，用形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: Be quiet, please. The baby  ______  in the room now.
questions.explanation: 句意：请安静。婴儿正在房间里睡觉。 考查动词时态。根据now可知，此句是现在进行时be doing的结构，故选A。

questions.prompt: Mr. King  ______  a horse when his son came back home last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚儿子回家时，金先生正在画一匹马。 考查动词时态。根据“when his son came back home last night.”可知，此处是由when引导的时间状语从句，表示“当……时”，主句时态应用过去进行时“was/were doing”，故选C。

questions.prompt: We  ______  to the zoo if the weather is fine tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天天气好，我们就去动物园。 考查动词时态。if引导的条件句，结合“tomorrow”可知，遵循主将从现的原则，主句要用一般将来时。故选A。

questions.prompt: Beijing Opera  ______  to foreign people many years ago. A introduced
questions.explanation: 句意：京剧是许多年前传入外国的。 考查被动语态。主语Beijing Opera与动词introduce之间是被动关系，结合“many years ago”可知，此处用一般过去时的被动语态：was/were done。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me  ______  last Friday? —The National Museum of China.
questions.explanation: 句意 ：——能请你告诉我上周五你到哪里参观吗？——中国国家博物馆。 考查宾语从句。分析“Could you please tell me...last Friday?”可知，空格处是宾语从句，从句应采用陈述语序，根据“last Friday”可知，时态是一般过去时，故选B。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Yard Work It seemed that the work would never end for Steven. He was helping his brother and father in the yard. Each weekend, there was something to do. He did not know why they couldn’t just sit inside and watch  ______ 13 ______  like all the other kids. With a sigh (叹气), he pulled his rake a little harder and  ______ 14 ______, hoping he might still get done in time for the last round of cartoons. After all, they’d already done so much. First, his older brother, Karl, had started cutting the grass with the lawnmower. Dad had used the weedeater to trim (修剪) up around the house. He had used the blower to clean the driveway and the sidewalks. He couldn’t  ______ 15 ______  much, because he had the easier jobs. Then, they’d had to do some more things. Karl had pulled weeds in the garden beds, while dad had sprayed (喷药) along the edges of the house. Steven had to push the spreader, which threw grass fertilizer (肥料) everywhere. He marched up and down (踱来踱去) the hills and through the front lot. He probably had the harder  ______ 16 ______  this time, but he didn’t like pulling weeds, and dad didn’t let him play much with the sprayer. Finally, dad got out the hedge clippers. Dad was making the bushes into nice shapes, while Karl and he both got out rakes. There were a few leaves here and there. They  ______ 17 ______  all of the things into four or five piles, and then got a wheelbarrow. Dad was done then, so he pushed the wheelbarrow and  ______ 18 ______  them dump (扔掉) the yard waste together. It was done! Yard work was done for a week. It was a lot of hard work, and that didn’t even  ______ 19 ______  cleaning up the tools, and the other jobs that came with keeping the yard clean. Dad didn’t much like spending money on having someone else do the yard work when he had three sets of hands that knew how and could do it. Steven  ______ 20 ______  it was important to work hard and save money, even if he missed some cartoons.

questions.prompt: Mother Teresa spent  ______  life caring for the poor in many countries.
questions.explanation: 句意：特蕾莎修女一生都在照顾许多国家的穷人。 考查代词辨析。his他的；her她/她的；your你的/你们的；our我们的。根据“Mother Teresa spent”可知是“她的”一生都在照顾许多国家的穷人。故选B。

questions.prompt: The class planned to hold a birthday party for their teacher  ______  January 15th.
questions.explanation: 句意：同学们计划在1月15日为老师举办一个生日聚会。 考查词义辨析。on 在（某一天），用在星期、具体日期等名词前；by在……之前；at在(某时间或时刻)，用在几点、很短的时间段名词前；in在（一段时间）之内，过……之久。根据空格后“January 15th”是具体的日期，可知用介词on。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do people like to learn about space? —Because they like exploring the unknown world.
questions.explanation: 句意：——为什么人们喜欢学习太空知识？——因为他们喜欢探索未知的世界。 考查特殊疑问句。How怎样；When什么时候；Why为什么；Where在哪里。根据“Because they like exploring the unknown world.”可知，问句是问原因，用why提问。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Sam,  ______  you tell Chinese stories in English? — Of course I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——萨姆，你能用英语讲中国故事吗？ ——我当然可以。 考查情态动词can能；must必须；should应该；need需要。根据“Of course I can.”可知，此处表示能力，用情态动词can。故选A。

questions.prompt: I like English classes,  ______  I’m shy about talking in the class discussion.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢英语课，但是我不好意思在课堂讨论中发言。 考查连词词义辨析。but但是；for因为；and和，又；or或者，否则。前句“I like English classes”和后句“I’m shy about talking in the class discussion”构成转折，故选A。

questions.prompt: This term, I improved a lot, and I promise to work  ______  next term.
questions.explanation: 句意：这学期，我进步了很多，我保证下学期更努力学习。 考查比较级。hard原级；harder比较级；hardest最高级；the hardest最高级。根据语境是下学期和这学期比较，所以是比较级harder。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Tom, where is your dad now? — Oh, he  ______  in the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你的爸爸现在在哪里？——哦，他正在公园里跑步。 考查现在进行时。根据“where is your dad now”可知时态为现在进行时，其结构为am/is/are+动词的现在分词。故选B。

questions.prompt: To help save the planet, our family  ______  everything since last month.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了帮助拯救地球，我们家从上个月开始回收所有的东西。 考查现在完成时。根据“since last month”可知，句子时态为现在完成时，其结构为have/has done，主语our family为第三人称单数，助动词用has，recycle“回收利用”的过去分词为recycled。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  everything by myself every day and I don’t depend on my parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：我每天什么事都自己做，不依靠父母。 考查动词时态。根据“every day”可知，时态用一般现在时，主语是I，谓语动词用原形do。故选A。

questions.prompt: Daming  ______  in the community when I met him for the first time.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我第一次见到大明时，他在社区正帮忙。 考查过去进行时。helps一般现在时；was helping过去进行时；has helped现在完成时；will help一般将来时。根据“when I met him for the first time”可知，过去时间里当一件事情发生时另一件事正在发生，应用过去进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: An important part of the Great Wall  ______  in Jiayuguan in the Ming Dynasty.
questions.explanation: 句意：明代在嘉峪关修建了长城的重要组成部分。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。分析句子结构可知，主语An important part与动词build是动宾关系，应用被动语态；根据“in the Ming Dynasty”可知，事情发生在过去，所以此处为一般过去时的被动语态，其结构是was/were done，主语An important part为第三人称单数，be动词用was，build“建造”的过去分词为built。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Could you please tell me  ______? — It was launched in 1999.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我神舟一号什么时候发射的？——它是在1999年发射的。 考查宾语从句。根据“It was launched in 1999”可知，时态为一般过去时，排除CD；由于宾语从句的语序为陈述句语序，所以排除A。故选B。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 There is nothing more wonderful than the smell of the Adirondack air! Every summer, my father would plan a  ______ 13 ______  to one of those wonderful lakes which are among the forests of the Adirondack Mountains. One trip that I will never  ______ 14 ______  was a visit to a lake at the foot of the mountains. After arriving at the lake, we emptied the car full of picnic things, carrying them through a wooded path to the picnic place. Then my dad, my sister and I  ______ 15 ______  ran into the water. Dad let us dive (跳水) from his knee, throwing us up in the air and turning us over like thick pancakes on a grill (烤架). This amazing game went on and on as we shouted out “More! More!”. When we were finally tired of our games, my dad stopped to watch my  ______ 16 ______. She loved artistic swimming and started practising skills that her team used in competition. My father paid all his attention to her. I was  ______ 17 ______  that no one watched or played with me. I decided to swim by myself in deeper water. The waves were getting stronger, but I didn’t  ______ 18 ______. I just wanted to do what my sister could do so that I could catch dad’s attention. As I tried to dive, a huge wave hit me. I tried to stand up but  ______ 19 ______. I thought I was dying. Suddenly, I felt a strong catch on my arm. It was my dad! He hugged me tightly and carried me back to a place where I could stand. He gave me a warm hug and a big smile because he knew I was all right. He was watching me all the time! He had never taken his eyes off me. He had  ______ 20 ______  me! Being told by someone that you are loved is great, but experiencing that love is even better.

questions.prompt: Tu Youyou and Yuan Longping set good examples to young people. Everyone should be proud of  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：屠呦呦和袁隆平为年轻人树立了很好的榜样。每个人都应该为他们感到骄傲。 考查代词辨析。us我们；you你（们）；them他们；him他。根据“Tu Youyou and Yuan Longping”可知，是两个人，应该用them指代。介词of后接人称代词的宾格。故选C。

questions.prompt: —When is your birthday, Sally? —My birthday is  ______  July 3rd.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的生日是什么时候，萨利？——我的生日是7月3日。 考查时间介词。in后跟某年某月某季节；on后跟具体的某一天；at接某个时刻；to（距整点）差。根据“July 3rd”可知这是具体的某一天。故选B。

questions.prompt: I read English newspapers every day  ______  my English.
questions.explanation: 句意：我每天读英文报纸来提高我的英语水平。 考查非谓语动词。improve“提高”。设空处缺状语，用不定式to improve作目的状语。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Who ran  ______  in the sports meeting, Tom or Sam? —Tom did, I think.
questions.explanation: 句意：——谁在运动会上跑得更快，汤姆还是萨姆？——我认为是汤姆。 考查副词比较级。fast快，副词。根据“Tom or Sam”可知是这两者之间进行比较，用副词比较级faster。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Jack,  ______  you finish your homework in ten minutes? —Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你能在十分钟内完成作业吗？——是的，我能。 考查情态动词。must必须；should应该；need需要；can能。根据“Yes, I can.”可知问的是“能”在十分钟内完成作业。故选D。

questions.prompt: Matthew was a quiet man  ______  didn’t speak much, especially to strangers.
questions.explanation: 句意：马修是个安静的人，不爱说话，尤其是对陌生人。 考查定语从句。who先行词是人，在从句中作主语；which先行词是物，在从句中作主语；when在从句中作时间状语；where在从句中作地点状语。该句先行词是“quiet man”，指的人，在从句中作主语。故选A。

questions.prompt: I think Leonardo da Vinci was a great inventor  ______  he was a pioneer in many areas.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为列奥纳多·达·芬奇是一位伟大的发明家，因为他在许多领域都是先驱。 考查连词辨析。because因为；or或；if如果；but但是。根据“he was a pioneer in many areas”可知后文解释的是原因。故选A。

questions.prompt: Lord of the Flies  ______  in 1954. Although it was not a great success at first, it became popular later.
questions.explanation: 句意：《蝇王》于1954年出版发行。虽然一开始并没有取得很大成功，但后来却流行起来。 考查被动语态。Lord of the Flies与选项核心动词publish之间是被动关系，根据“in 1954”可知，时态为一般过去时，需用一般过去时的被动语态，其结构为was/were+动词的过去分词。主语为单数，需用was。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tim loves travelling and he  ______  to many countries since 2020.
questions.explanation: 句意：Tim喜欢旅行，自2020年以来，他已经去过很多国家。 考查动词时态。根据“since 2020”可知，句子时态为现在完成时have/has done，主语是he，助动词用has。故选D。

questions.prompt: — What body language do your parents often use? — My mum often hugs me. Hugging  ______  to show love.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的父母经常使用什么肢体语言？——我妈妈经常拥抱我。拥抱用以表达爱意。 考查被动语态。Hugging与选项核心动词use之间是被动关系，需用被动语态，因陈述的是一般事实，需用一般现在时的被动语态，其结构为be+动词的过去分词，主语为动名词Hugging，be动词用is。故选B。

But there are also “everyday” heroes—they may not be well-known but they do what they can to help  ______ 13 ______  people’s lives as well. As his family was not rich, he learned from a young age the importance of  ______ 14 ______  the waste of food. Using an app developed by Lee’s team,  ______ 17 ______  report how much leftover food they have each day. Then volunteers are sent to fetch it. questions.prompt: Mr. Li is a great history teacher.  ______  knowledge of the subject is excellent.

questions.prompt: The city library opens ______  eight thirty every day.

questions.prompt: — Dad, help me please. I  ______  lift the box up. — No problem, I’m coming.

questions.prompt: Anne is one of  ______  students in my class. She learns everything quickly.

questions.prompt: — Jack,  ______  was the last sports meeting held? — At the National Stadium.

questions.prompt: I practiced swimming for an hour,  ______  I am tired now.

questions.prompt: Frank fell over when he  ______  down the steps.
questions.explanation: 句意：弗兰克跑下台阶时摔倒了。 考查动词时态。根据“Frank fell over when he... down the steps.”可知，主句的时态为一般过去时，从句也应用过去的某一时态，结合语境可知，空处是指过去的某一时刻正发生的动作，应用过去进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Sam  ______  playing the guitar but his brother doesn’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：山姆喜欢弹吉他但是他的弟弟不喜欢。 考查动词时态辨析。根据“his brother doesn’t.”可知，应用一般现在时。故选D。

questions.prompt: Ever since I was a kid, I  ______  to be a doctor.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我是一个孩子的时候，我就想成为一名医生。 考查动词时态辨析。根据“Ever since I was a kid”可知，主句应用现在完成时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Some students in our school  ______  some trees in the park last Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周日，我们学校的一些学生在公园里种了一些树。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语“last Sunday”可知，该句为一般过去时，故选A。

questions.prompt: More small street gardens  ______  in the future all over Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：未来，北京将建造更多的小街花园。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。根据时间状语in the future可知，此句时态为一般将来时，由句意可知，主语More small street gardens和谓语动词“build”是被动关系，用被动语态。即此句是一般将来时的被动语态。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Lucy is at the door. Do you know  ______? —Sorry, I don’t know.
questions.explanation: 句意：——露西在门口。你知道她正在等谁吗？——对不起，我不知道。 考查宾语从句。分析句子可知，此处是宾语从句，从句语序为陈述语序，排除C和D；根据“Do you know”可知，主句使用一般现在时，从句可根据具体情况选择任何时态，根据“Lucy is at the door.”可推知露西正在等待某人，故应用现在进行时（be doing）。故选B。 二、完形填空(每题1分,共8分) 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A. A used bike wasn’t exactly new, but it would probably be better than his old one. The next morning, Henry walked to school. He didn’t  ______ 17 ______  because his dad always kept his promises. He knew he would have a new used bike very soon. When Henry came back from school, he asked, “Mom, any news from Dad on my new bike yet?” “Well,” answered Mom. “Looks like you won’t need a new bike. David’s mother called today and said David had  ______ 18 ______  taken your bike home yesterday instead of his.” “Okay,” said Henry, trying to hide his  ______ 19 ______. questions.prompt: This bag is  ______. My aunt bought it for me last Sunday.

questions.prompt: — Dad, what shall we do  ______  Grandma’s birthday? — How about making a cake?
questions.explanation: 句意：——爸爸，我们为奶奶的生日做什么呢？——做个蛋糕怎么样？ 考查介词辨析。for为了；of……的；in在……里；to到。根据“ Grandma’s birthday”可知，为奶奶的生日做什么，故选A。

questions.prompt: —George, stop! You  ______  touch my computer. I’m working. —Sorry, Mom!
questions.explanation: 句意：——乔治，住手！你不准触摸我的电脑！我在工作。——对不起，妈妈！ 考查词义辨析。couldn’t不能；needn’t不必；mustn’t不准；wouldn’t不会。根据“I’m working.”以及下句乔治的道歉，可知妈妈不允许乔治触碰她的电脑，mustn’t表示强烈的禁止语气。故选C。

questions.prompt: Amy loves music very much and she sings  ______  than me.
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米非常喜欢音乐，她唱得比我好听。 考查副词比较级。根据“than”可知，此处应使用副词比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Jack,  ______  do you go running? — Every morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你多久去跑步一次？——每天早上。 考查疑问词辨析。how long多久；how much多少钱；how often多久一次；how soon还要多久。根据回答“Every morning.”可知询问的是频率。故选C。

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  you will miss the train.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则你会赶不上火车的。 考查并列连词。but但是；or否则；so所以；and和；根据“you will miss the train”可知此处用“or”，故选B。

questions.prompt: While I  ______  home yesterday afternoon it began to rain.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我昨天下午走路回家时，天开始下雨了。 考查过去进行时。根据“yesterday afternoon”可知时态是过去时，while后接进行时，故空处用过去进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Our football team started last year. We  ______  football for a year now.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们足球队去年组建的。到现在为止我们已经踢了一年足球了。 考查现在完成时。根据“for a year now”for+时间段可知是现在完成时。句型结构是主语+have/has done。故选B。

questions.prompt: Linda is excited about the coming weekend because she  ______  several old friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：琳达对即将到来的周末很兴奋，因为她打算去见几个老朋友。 考查一般将来时。sees看见，三单；saw看见，一般过去式；has seen已经见了，现在完成时；is going to see打算去见。根据“Linda is excited about the coming weekend because she”可知即将到来的周末表将来。见一些老朋友是将来打算好的事情。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Henry, where is your brother? — He  ______  my bike in the garden.
questions.explanation: 句意：——海瑞，你的弟弟去哪了？——他正在花园修我的自行车。 考查现在进行时。根据“Henry, where is your brother”可知此刻弟弟不在，结合下文说明他应该正在修理自行车。现在进行时的句型结构是主语+be+动词ing。主语是“he”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Trees and flowers  ______  on the hills every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年山上都种上树和花。 考查时态和语态。主语“Trees and flowers”与动词plant之间是动宾关系，结合“every year”可知用一般现在时的被动语态，其结构为am/is/are done。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Lucy, do you know  ______? — At eight this morning.

questions.explanation: 句意：——露西，你知道唐尼什么时候动身去上海吗？——今天早上八点。 考查宾语从句。根据答语“At eight this morning”可知在问离开的时间，应该是什么时候。用when引导宾语从句。宾语从句要用陈述句语序。故选D。 二、完形填空(每题1分, 共8分) 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Dylan was always told dancing was a girl’s sport and he shouldn’t dance, but his dream was to be a dance star. He was hoping to learn some dancing skills secretly. He loved Saturdays because his parents were out and he could dance all day. He nearly had a heart attack(发作) when someone knocked on his door one day. “Just a minute!” he called. “Dylan, it’s me, you’re safe. I need your  ______ 14 ______,” Emily said. “Can I? How long have you known that?” “Since you started watching me on the weekends. It’s why I wanted lessons. En Pointe auditions (选拔赛) are next month, but Mrs. Gail doesn’t think I’m ready. Can you dance with me for the audition? None of the boys in my class wanted to dance with me,” Emily said. “We’ll show Mrs Gail and those boys that they have been  ______ 15 ______.” Then they practiced all that day. At dinner, Emily and Dylan smiled across the table. Their parents looked at them  ______ 16 ______, but were too tired to ask about their secret. They practiced four nights a week and on Saturdays. Dylan enjoyed himself and Emily improved quickly. A month later, their parents attended the audition. Dylan and Emily started. They moved with grace(优雅), smiling with pride. From the deep concentration (专注) of the crowd, Dylan was sure they  ______ 17 ______  their expectations. “Emily, I had my  ______ 18 ______, but no longer after watching you dance. Welcome to Pointe class!” Mrs. Gail said. Dylan hung back after giving Emily a congratulatory hug; he wasn’t quite ready to  ______ 19 ______  his parents just yet. When he saw his dad coming toward him, he took a deep breath. “Well done, Son. You really looked like you belonged out there. You don’t have to hide your dancing from us.  ______ 20 ______  your dreams.” Dylan hugged his dad. He knew it would be hard, but he wouldn’t give up.

questions.prompt: I have a little sister. I like to play with  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有一个小妹妹。我喜欢和她一起玩。 考查宾格代词。her她；him他；you你；them他们。根据“I have a little sister.”可知，这里是喜欢和她一起玩。故选A。

questions.prompt: More and more people in China like to eat Qingtuan  ______  spring.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国越来越多的人在春天喜欢吃青团。 考查介词辨析。on在……时候，后接天；to朝着……；at在……时候，后接具体的时间点；in在……时候，后接年、月、季节以及宽泛的早中晚。根据空后可知，spring是季节，故用in。故选D。

questions.prompt: I don’t like sports,  ______  I still go to football practice to stay healthy.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不喜欢运动，但是我仍然去足球训练以保持健康。 考查并列连词辨析。so因此；for为了；or或者，否则；but但是。根据“I don’t like sports...I still go to football practice to stay healthy”可知我不喜欢运动，我仍然去足球训练以保持健康，前后是转折关系，应用but。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Hurry up, Mum! Let’s go across the road quickly. —No, Henry, you  ______. The traffic lights are red.
questions.explanation: 句意：——快点，妈妈！我们快点过马路吧。——不，亨利，你不能。交通灯是红色的。 考查情态动词。may not可能不；shouldn’t不应该；mustn’t禁止；needn’t不必。根据“The traffic lights are red.”可知，此处表示禁止过马路。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Which T-shirt is  ______, the red one or the yellow one? —The red one. It goes well with your jeans.
questions.explanation: 句意：——哪件T恤更好，是红色的还是黄色的？——红色的。这和你的牛仔裤很适合搭配。 考查形容词比较级。good好的，容词词；better更好的,比较级；best最好的，最高级；the best最好的，最高级前，常使用定冠词the。相据后文“the red one or the yellow one”红色的还是黄色的，可知，此处是二者相比较进行选择，应使用比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Dad,  ______  is my basketball? —Under your bed. You should put away your things.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爸爸，我的篮球在哪里？——在你的床底下。你应该收起你的东西。 考查特殊疑问词。when什么时候；where在哪里；how怎样；why为什么。根据“Under your bed.”可知在你的床底下，因此是询问在哪里，应用where。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Betty! Mrs. Li called and  ______  us to her new house just now. —Great, I will go.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，贝蒂！李太太刚才打电话邀请我们去她的新房子。 ——太好了，我会去的。 考查一般过去时。根据句子中的just now可知，句子时态是一般过去时，谓语用动词过去式表示。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Why don’t you leave the library, Tom? —I  ______  my report yet. I need to search for some information.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你为什么不离开图书馆？——我还没有完成我的报告。我需要找一些信息。 考查现在完成时。根据“I need to search for some information.”可知，报告还没有完成，因此应使用现在完成时，其构成是have/has+过去分词，主语I是第一人称，助动词用have，其否定形式在助动词后面加not，finish的过去分词为finished。故选D。

questions.prompt: My mum always  ______  me to stick to my dream when I want to give up.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我想放弃时，妈妈总是鼓励我坚持自己的梦想。 考查谓语动词时态。句子是when引导的时间状语从句，从句时态是一般现在时，主句根据always可知应用一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数，谓语动词需要三单式。故选C。

questions.prompt: —We don’t have enough yogurt in the fridge, Tim. —I  ______  some in the supermarket soon.
questions.explanation: 句意：——蒂姆，我们冰箱里的酸奶不够了。 ——我马上去超市买一些。 考查一般将来时。根据soon可知，用一般将来时will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Wow, 2023 Friendship Forest Tree Planting Activity was a great success! —Yes. I knew many trees  ______  for a better environment.
questions.explanation: 句意：——哇，2023年友谊森林植树活动非常成功！——是的。我知道为了更好的环境种了很多树。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。knew后是宾语从句，主句是一般过去时，从句需用相应的过去时态。从句主语trees和谓语动词plant之间是动宾关系，树被种植，需用被动语态be+done。主语是复数trees，用一般过去时的被动语态were planted。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Sally, could you tell me  ______? —Next Friday.

questions.explanation: 句意：——莎莉，你能告诉我我们什么时候会有一个毕业生聚会吗？——下周五。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句的语序应为陈述语序，选项B和D为疑问语序，应排除；主句中could表示委婉语气，表示礼貌而非时态，根据“Next Friday.”可知还没有聚会，应用一般将来时。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Never Give up The day I met Hani, she was a shy, 17-year-old Indonesian girl standing alone in the parking lot of the international school, where I taught English. Hani’s warmth was increasing with her language ability, but I was losing heart. One day I received the announcement (通知) from a famous university. After reading the requirements, I told her that there was only a  ______ 17 ______  chance of her getting the scholarship (奖学金) and encouraged her to be more “realistic” about her dream. But she remained determined (坚定的). “Will you send in my name?” she asked. I couldn’t say no to her. I  ______ 18 ______  the application (申请书), with the painful truth about her real life, but also with my praise of her strong determination. In the weeks that followed, I planned to have her take the Test of English Fluency (流利性). The whole test would be a huge project for someone who had never touched a computer before. For two weeks, we studied how a computer works. Soon she received a letter from that famous university. She was  ______ 19 ______. I jumped around the room excitedly. Hani stood by, smiling. I realised that I had learned something Hani had known from the beginning: It is not wisdom alone that brings success, but also the drive to succeed, the commitment to work hard and the  ______ 20 ______  to believe in yourself.

questions.prompt: My brother shared  ______  coming holiday plan happily yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥昨天开心地分享他接下来的假期计划。 考查代词辨析。his他的；her她的；my我的；their他们的。根据“My brother shared”可知此处指哥哥分享自己的计划，用表示男性的形容词性物主代词his指代。故选A。

questions.prompt: I often go to Capital Library of China  ______  Saturday mornings.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常在星期六早上去中国首都图书馆。 考查介词辨析。to用于指两个时间点之间的时间；in用于指某个较长的时间（年、月、季节）；at用于指某一特定的时刻；on用于指具体某一天，如星期几的早、中、晚。空格后为“Saturday mornings”，故应搭配介词on。故选D。

questions.prompt: There are only 24 days until the final exam,  ______  we’d better study harder.
questions.explanation: 句意：离期末考试只有24天了，所以我们最好更加努力地学习 考查连词辨析。or或者；for由于；so所以；but但是，根据句意，可知前后为“因果关系”，努力学习就是因为距离期末考试只有24天了，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Lily,  ______  I use your computer? Mine doesn’t work. — Of course, here you are.

questions.prompt: —Mum, I broke my dad’s glasses. What should I do? —Tell him the truth, or he will be even  ______  with you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我打碎了我爸爸的眼镜。我该怎么办？——告诉他真相，否则他会更生你的气。 考查比较级。根据“Tell him the truth, or he will be even...with you.”可知，如果不告诉爸爸真相的话，爸爸会更生气，even后加形容词比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is it from your home to the subway station? — Quite near. It’s about 5 minutes’ walk.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从你家到地铁站有多远？——很近。步行大约5分钟。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长时间，问一段时间；How often多久一次，提问频率；How far多远，提问两地之间的距离；How many多少，对复数名词数量提问。根据下文“It’s about 5 minutes’ walk”可知，此处是在对距离进行提问，故选C。

questions.prompt: The children  ______  the house when their mother came home from work.
questions.explanation: 句意：妈妈下班回家时，孩子们正在打扫房子。 考查动词时态。根据when以及came可知，从句用一般过去时，主句表示过去某个时刻正在发生的事情，用过去进行时was/were doing的结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Grandma, do you like your new smart phone? —Of course. I  ______  how to download music since I had it.

questions.prompt: —Alice, please turn down the TV. I  ______  a meeting online. —Oh, sorry, Dad.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爱丽丝，请把电视的声音关小点。我正在网上开会。——哦，对不起，爸爸。 考查动词时态。根据“please turn down the TV”可说明爸爸现在正在网上开会，所以让爱丽丝把电视声音关小点，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Tom, I want to see a movie this Sunday. Let’s go together. —Ok. I  ______  with you if I am free.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，这个星期天我想去看电影。我们一起去吧。——好的。如果我有空，我就和你一起去。 考查动词时态。if引导的条件状语从句，主句用一般将来时：will do，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Daming, where are Betty and Tony? —They  ______  to hang flags in the hall by the head teacher.
questions.explanation: ——大明，贝蒂和托尼在哪里？——他们被班主任要求在大厅里悬挂旗帜。 考查时态与被动语态。分析句子可知，答语中的“They”指的就是问句里的“Betty and Tony”；由“by the head teacher”，可知主语“They”与谓语动词是被动关系，所以要使用被动语态；根据对话情景，他们悬挂旗帜的动作不可能发生在将来，所以要用“一般过去时的被动语态”，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Jim, do you know  ______? — Yes, Grandpa. Let me get it for you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——吉姆，你知道报纸在哪里吗？——是的，爷爷。让我帮你拿。 考查宾语从句。句子为宾语从句，故应用陈述句语序，C、D选项可排除。根据下文“Let me get it for you”可知，此处是在问报纸在哪儿，故选A。 二、 完形填空(每题1分, 共8分) 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 When I was about 12 years old, my friends and I decided that we wanted a pet mouse. The pet shop wouldn’t sell us one unless we had a  ______ 13 ______  from a parent, so, having the neatest handwriting, I forged (伪造) one. During the following days I nearly forgot about it, but I suddenly got a  ______ 16 ______  from him one day. “How lovely it is to hear from you, “he said, and went on to tell me all about his life in his letter. He’d love to hear about what subjects at school I enjoyed. And so we started a correspondence (通信) that went on for several years. He turned out to be the most attractive man. Then out of the blue, he  ______ 17 ______. My mum heard of the bad news and was sad as they had not really spoken for years. I went upstairs and took out a box of letters, the last one being from just a few days before he had passed. My mum  ______ 18 ______  herself reading them and knowing that although she hadn’t been in touch, I had grown  ______ 19 ______  to him by writing to him. In fact, I then became friends with his wife, who I also wrote to for many years. I often think about how an act of childhood led to such rich  ______ 20 ______  that lasted for many years. It encouraged me to write to lots of other people in fact, and it’s something I keep up with to this day. So, I’d encourage you to put pen to paper and see where it leads.

questions.prompt: —Excuse me. Can you tell  ______  where the post office is? —Sure. Walk ahead, turn left and you will see it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰了，你能告诉我邮电局在哪里吗？——当然。向前走，然后左拐，你就会看到它。 考查代词辨析。I我，主格；me我，宾格；my我的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词。根据“Can you tell…where the post office is?”可知，此处表示“你能告诉我邮局在哪里吗？”，动词tell后面接宾语，因此空白处应用宾格代词。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What do you usually do  ______  the evening? —I watch the CCTV news, and do some revision work.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你晚上通常做什么？——我看中央电视台的新闻，做一些修改工作。 考查介词辨析。for为了；on在……上；at在；in在……里。根据“the evening”可知考查介词短语in the evening，意为“在晚上”，in符合句子意思，故选D。

questions.prompt: He is as  ______  as his father this year.
questions.explanation: 句意：今年，他和他的父亲一样强壮。根据“as…as”可知，as+形容词原级+as表示“和……一样”，因此填形容词strong的原级，故选A。

questions.prompt: With the help of my teachers, I ______  much progress since last term.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我老师的帮助下，自从上学期开始，我已经取得了很多进步。 考查时态。根据“since last term.”可知句子用现在完成时，其结构是have/has+done。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Xiao Ming.  ______  you recite the dialogue? —I think I can. Let me try.
questions.explanation: 句意：——小明。你能把这段对话背下来吗？——我想我能。让我试试。 考查情态动词。Do助动词；May可能；Must必须；Can能够。根据“I think I can. Let me try.”可知，此处是指能够背诵这段对话吗，用can表示。故选D。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is it from your home to the summer school? —It’s about 20 kilometers.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从你家到夏令营学校有多远？——大约20公里。 考查特殊疑问句。how long多长；how soon多久之后；how far多远；how much多少。根据“It’s about 20 kilometers.”可知，此处提问距离。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Listen! What’s the noise over the store? —Well, people  ______  for its delicious homemade food.
questions.explanation: 句意：——听！那边商店有什么声音？——嗯，人们为它美味的自制食物在排队。 考查动词时态。根据“Listen”可知，此句用现在进行时，结构为be+doing，故选A。

questions.prompt: This summer, many people  ______  their money to help the homeless in the flooded areas.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个夏天，很多人捐赠钱来帮助洪水灾区无家可归的人。 考查动词短语辨析。gave up放弃；gave away捐赠；gave in屈服，让步；gave off发出。根据“to help the homeless in the flooded areas.”可知，应是通过捐赠钱来帮助无家可归的人。故选B。

questions.prompt: My sister and I like sports.  ______  often go swimming after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姐姐和我喜欢运动。放学后我们经常去游泳。 考查代词辨析。I我；you你/你们；we我们；they他们/她们/它们。根据“My sister and I”可知，此处指“我和姐姐”，故用we表“我们”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mr. Smith and his wife went to London  ______  plane yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯先生和他的妻子昨天乘飞机去了伦敦。 考查介词辨析。by乘坐；in在……中；on在……上；at在。by+交通方式，表示“乘坐某种交通方式”，故选A。

questions.prompt: We must work together as a team,  ______  we won’t finish the task.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们必须作为一个团队一起工作，否则我们不会完成任务。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；or否则；so因此。分析“We must work together as a team…we won’t finish the task.”可知，此处用来说明转折的结果，“否则”符合语境，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the population of China? —About 1.37 billion.
questions.explanation: 句意：——中国的人口有多少？——大约13.7亿。 考查特殊疑问句。How many“多少”，询问可数名词的数量；How much“多少”，询问不可数名词的数量；What“什么”；How“怎样，如何”。根据答语“About 1.37 billion”可以判断问句是询问中国的人口是多少，询问人口多少应用What来提问，population看作单数，系动词用is， What is the population of…?“……的人口是多少？”， 是询问人口的固定句型。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  you drive a car? —No, I can’t. I can ride a bike.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会开车吗？——不，我不会。我会骑自行车。 考查情态动词。Must必须；Can能，会；Should应该；Need需要；根据回答“No, I can’t. I can ride a bike.”可知，此处问的是“能/会”，应用can，故选B。

questions.prompt: Emma is seven years old. She is three years  ______  than David.
questions.explanation: 句意：艾玛七岁了。她比大卫小三岁。 考查形容词比较级。young形容词原级；younger形容词比较级；youngest形容词最高级；the youngest形容词最高级。根据后文的than，可知是两者比较，用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: If it  ______  sunny tomorrow, we will go climbing.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天天气晴朗，我们就去爬山。 考查动词时态，观察句子这是一个if引导的条件状语从句，遵循主将从现原则，即主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时，故选A。

questions.prompt: They will have a party tomorrow, and now they  ______  for it.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们明天会有个派对，现在他们正在准备。 考查动词时态。prepare，动词，意为“准备”，prepare for...表示“为……做准备”，固定搭配；根据时间状语“now”可知，句子时态为现在进行时，其构成为：am/is/are+动词的现在分词；主语they是第三人称复数，be动词用are；prepare的现在分词是preparing。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where does your brother Mike live? — In London. He  ______  there since he was born.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你弟弟迈克住在哪里？——伦敦。他从出生起就住在那里。 考查动词时态。根据空后从句“since he was born.”可知，空处的动词应用现在完成时，构成形式为：have/has done；主语是第三人称单数形式，故助动词应用has，live的过去分词是lived。故选B。

questions.prompt: Many people  ______  the Forbidden City for many times, but they still want to go and enjoy literature and art there.
questions.explanation: 句意：很多人已经去过故宫很多次了，但他们仍然想去那里欣赏文学和艺术。 考查现完成时。go to去，一般现在时；went to去，一般过去时；have been to去过，现在完成时；will go to将要去，一般将来时。根据“for many times”可知，此句用现在完成时，此处表示去过故宫很多次了，对故宫已有所了解。故选C。

questions.prompt: Look at the new park. It  ______  by the workers last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：看这个新公园。它是工人们去年建造的。 考查时态和语态。根据“last year”可知，句子时态用一般过去时；主语“It”指代“the new park”，它与谓语动词“build建造”构成被动关系。因此用一般过去时的被动语态：was/were+done。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Can you tell me  ______  in the Science Museum? — Sure. I will fill a bag with sand.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你要在科学博物馆做什么吗？——当然，我将用沙子填满一个袋子。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句需要用陈述句语序，据此可排除BC。结合答语“I will fill a bag with sand”为一般将来时，可知询问在科学博物馆做什么也为一般将来时，故选D。 三、完形填空。（共 8 分, 每小题 1 分） 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Our teacher asked us what our favorite animal was, and I said, “Fried chicken” She said I wasn’t funny, but she wasn’t  ______ 13 ______, because everyone else laughed. My parents told me to always be truthful and I am. Fried chicken is my favorite animal. I told my dad what happened, and he said my teacher was probably a(n)  ______ 14 ______  of PETA（善待动物组织）. questions.prompt: My mum likes sports and  ______  is good at playing volleyball very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈喜欢运动，她非常擅长打排球。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；it它；they他们。此处指代My mum，女性，使用she，故选B。

questions.prompt: I have Science Club  ______  four o’clock every Thursday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我每周四四点钟有科学俱乐部。 考查介词辨析。at在……时刻：in后跟年/月/季节等；on在具体某一天；to朝着。根据“four o’clock”可知，在4点钟使用介词at，故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  I borrow some books here? — Sorry, you can’t. It’s not allowed in the reading room of the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以在这儿借几本书吗？——抱歉，你不能。图书馆的阅览室是不允许借书的。 考查动词辨析。Will将会；Must必须；Can可以；Need需要。根据“Sorry, you can’t.”可知，此处应用can提问，故选C。

questions.prompt: I was late for school  ______  I missed the bus this morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我上学迟到了，因为我今天早上没赶上公共汽车。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；or或者；because因为，根据句意，可知“迟到”是因为“没赶上公交车”，两者为因果关系，故选D。

questions.prompt: The river in my hometown is  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：我家乡的河比以前更干净了。 考查形容词比较级。根据原句中“than”可知，此处应用比较级形式，clean的比较级是cleaner，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  would you like to be in the future? —An astronaut. And my favourite books are about space.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你未来想成为什么？——宇航员。我最喜欢的书是关于太空的。 考查特殊疑问句。How如何；Where哪里；When何时；What什么。根据“An astronaut”可知，是询问未来想成为什么，使用疑问代词what，故选D。

questions.prompt: Mr. Wang  ______  a speech about ChatGPT in the meeting hall now.
questions.explanation: 句意：王先生现在正在会议厅发表关于ChatGPT的演讲。 考查时态。根据“now”可知，句子用现在进行时，结构是“am/is/are+doing”，故选B。

questions.prompt: If you have a clear learning plan, you  ______  the progress easier.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你有明确的学习计划，你会更容易知道进展。 考查动词的时态。根据“If you have a clear learning plan”可知原句是if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，因此主句要用将来时，故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  in the kitchen when a car stopped in front of the window.
questions.explanation: 句意：我正在厨房做饭，这时一辆汽车停在窗前。 考查动词的时态。根据“I…in the kitchen when a car stopped in front of the window.”可知，when引导的从句部分是一般过去时，主句部分也应该是过去的时态，表示某个时间点正在发生的事，应用过去进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: My family  ______  towards a greener life for several years.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的家人已经朝着更环保的生活方式努力了好几年。 考查动词时态。根据“for several years”可知，这是一个从过去延续到现在的动作。因此，应该使用现在完成时态，所以正确的答案是“have worked”，故选D。

questions.prompt: Many winter clothes  ______  to poor areas by volunteers every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：志愿者每年都会把许多冬衣送到贫困地区。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“every year”可知原句是一般现在时，主语Many winter clothes与谓语动词send是逻辑上的被动关系，空格处应用are sent。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mrs. Smith is very friendly. We all like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯夫人非常友好。我们都喜欢她。 考查代词辨析。it它；her她；him他；them他们。根据“Mrs. Smith is very friendly.”可知，史密斯夫人为女性，宾格应使用her。故选B。

questions.prompt: I usually visit my grandparents  ______  Saturdays.
questions.explanation: 句意：我通常在周六拜访我的祖父母。 考查介词短语。at在（某个时间时刻）；in加年、月、季节；on加具体某一天；to表方向。on Saturdays“在每周六”，固定短语。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  you give me a hand? I can’t open this bottle. — No problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能帮我一下吗？我打不开这个瓶子。——没问题。 考查情态动词。Should应该；Must必须；Could能；Need需要。此处表示请求，所以应用Could表达一种委婉语气。故选C。

questions.prompt: Have breakfast every morning  ______  you’ll get ill.
questions.explanation: 句意：每天早上吃早饭，否则你会生病的。 考查连词辨析。and和，并列连词；or或者，选择连词；but但是，转折连词；because因为。根据“Have breakfast every morning...you’ll get ill.”可知，本句为“祈使句+or+陈述句”句型，此处表示每天早上吃早饭，否则你会生病的。故选B。

questions.prompt: The Palace Museum is one of  ______  museums in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：故宫博物院是世界上最著名的博物馆之一。 考查形容词最高级。“one of+the+形容词最高级+可数名词复数”表示“最……之一”，此处表示最著名的博物馆之一。故选D。

questions.prompt: —  ______ did you turn off the radio? — Because the baby is sleeping.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你为什么关掉收音机？——因为婴儿在睡觉。 考查特殊疑问词。Why为什么；Where什么地点；When什么时间；How怎么样。根据“Because the baby is sleeping.”可知，此处询问原因，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Hello, can I speak to Mary? — Sorry, she  ______  a meeting next door.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，我可以和玛丽讲话吗？——对不起，她正在隔壁开会。 考查现在进行时。根据“Sorry”可知，她正在隔壁开会，要用现在进行时，其结构为be doing。主语he后接be动词is。故选B。

questions.prompt: If you read a lot today, you  ______  in the future.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你今天读了很多书，你将来就会成功。 考查一般将来时。本句为条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时；将来时的构成为：will/be going to+do。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Mike, what were you doing at eight last night? — I  ______  my mother with housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克，你昨晚八点在干什么？——我在帮妈妈做家务。 考查时态。根据“what were you doing at eight last night?”可知，句子时态为过去进行时（was/were doing）。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Tom, let’s go to see the Full River Red tonight! — I  ______  it already. I went with my father yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，今晚我们去看《满江红》吧！——我已经看过了。我昨天和我爸爸一起去了。 考查现在完成时。根据“already”可知，本句为现在完成时，其构成为：have/has+done，故选D。

questions.prompt: To protect the environment, many trees  ______  in China every year.

questions.prompt: My brother and I like painting.  ______  often have painting classes on weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥和我喜欢画画。我们经常在周末上绘画课。 考查代词辨析。I我；He他；We我们；They他们。根据“... often have painting classes on weekends.”可知主语是复数，此空指代“My brother and I”，用we代替。故选C。

questions.prompt: Our school usually celebrates its Art Festival  ______  May every year.

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我去年寒假你去了哪里了吗？——当然。我去了哈尔滨。 考查宾语从句语序及时态。分析句子成分可知，该句为宾语从句，要用陈述语序，选项AC是疑问语序，排除选项AC；根据时间状语“last summer vacation”和“I went to Shanghai.”可知，宾语从句用一般过去时，排除D选项。故选B。 二、完形填空。（共8分, 每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项 中, 选择最佳选项。 The Day Everything Changed I entered the class nervously, not knowing what to expect. Ms. Williams is known for being hard. As I took my seat, I noticed a girl sitting by the window. She had sandy blond hair pulled into a ponytail（马尾辫）and wore oversized glasses. I’d seen her before but didn’t know her name. Throughout the class, she didn’t speak or look up from her notebook. At break, she went to the library  ______ 13 ______  I wondered what made her so shy and quiet. Later that week, I was partnered with her for an assignment. Then I knew her name was Lucy. During the project, I realized Lucy was kind and smart. I smiled at her and tried to include her in the conversation. She gave a small  ______ 14 ______  in return. Over the next few months, Lucy and I became close friends. I invited her to sit with me at lunch and join after-school activities with us. Slowly, Lucy began to open up. She  ______ 15 ______  about herself, and told me that she loved to read and watch old movies. I was relieved（宽慰的）to see the shy, hesitant expression leave her face. One day Lucy told me a secret. She’d been bullied（欺凌）for a long time at her former school. The rude treatment had hurt her much, so that she became quiet, and had been fearful of  ______ 16 ______  with people since. As she spoke, tears filled her eyes. I felt sad that such a lovely girl had been caused so much pain. I told Lucy she shouldn’t have been treated that way and I was  ______ 17 ______  to have her as a friend. A smile  ______ 18 ______  across Lucy’s face, and she hugged me. At that moment, something changed slightly inside me. I realized Lucy’s friendship had given me a gift — the ability to see through the  ______ 19 ______  of people into who they truly are. Her quiet kindness and sensitivity had changed me for the better. From that day on, Lucy and I were inseparable（不可分的）. Her friendship taught me the importance of opening one’s heart and  ______ 20 ______  out to others. The day I met Lucy, everything changed — for the better.

questions.prompt: Although my sister is six,  ______  can play the piano very well.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然我妹妹六岁，但她弹钢琴能弹得很好。 考查代词辨析。she她；he他；we我们；they他们。根据“Although my sister is six”可知，用she指代“我妹妹”，作主语。故选A。

questions.prompt: We have English class  ______  eight o’clock every Monday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们每周一早上八点上英语课。 考查介词辨析。to朝着，到；on在……时，后接星期几或某一特定的日期；at在，后接时间点；in后接时间段，如一般意义的上午、下午或晚上以及月或年等较长的时间。句中“eight o’clock”是时间点，用at，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  I use your bike? —Sure, here is the key.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我能用一下你的自行车吗？——当然，这是钥匙。 考查情态动词。must“必须”；need“需要”；can“可以”；will“愿意”。根据“Sure, here is the key.”可知，问句在问是否可以用自行车。故选C。

questions.prompt: Tim always plays table tennis, so he looks  ______  than he really is.
questions.explanation: 句意：蒂姆总是打乒乓球，所以他看起来比实际年龄年轻。 考查形容词比较级。young年轻的，形容词原级；younger更年轻的，形容词比较级；youngest最年轻的，形容词最高级。根据“than”可知应用比较级，younger符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  will the film Full River Red last? — For about three hours.
questions.explanation: 句意：——电影《满江红》会持续多长时间？——大约三个小时。 考查特殊疑问。How long多长时间；How often多久一次；How much多少；How soon多久之后。根据“For about three hours.”可知大约三个小时，回答了时长，应用how long提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: My mother often helps me a lot,  ______  I’m thankful to her.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的母亲经常给我很多帮助，所以我很感激她。 考查并列连词辨析。or或者，否则；but但是；for为了；so所以。根据“My mother often helps me a lot,”可知我的母亲经常帮助我很多，所以我会很感激，应用so表示结果。故选D。

questions.prompt: New media, like WeChat,  ______  the ways of communication now.
questions.explanation: 句意：像微信这样的新媒体正在改变人们的沟通方式。 考查时态。根据“now”可知此处表示它们正在改变人们的沟通方式，用现在进行时am/is/are doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: We  ______  the exam as long as we keep trying and never give up.
questions.explanation: 句意：只要我们继续努力，永不放弃，我们就会通过考试。 考查时态。句中“as long as”意为“只要”，引导条件状语从句，主句应用一般将来时，其构成为“will do”，故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  clothes when my phone rang yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天晚上，当我的电话响起时，我正在洗衣服。 考查谓语动词时态。根据“when my phone rang yesterday evening”可知，当我的电话响起时，我正在洗衣服，因此用过去进行时（was/were doing），表示过去某一动作发生时候，另一动作正在发生。故选B。

questions.prompt: Mark  ______  a lot about Chinese paper cutting since he studied in our school.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从马克在我们学校学习以来，他学到了很多关于中国剪纸的知识。 考查谓语动词时态。根据“since he studied in our school.”可知，自从在我们学校学习以来，学到很多知识，因此用现在完成时（have/has done）。故选C。

questions.prompt: Beijing Daxing International Airport  ______  four years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：北京大兴国际机场于四年前建成。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。根据“four years ago”可知，时态是一般过去时，主语“Beijing Daxing International Airport”和动词“complete”是动宾关系，应用一般过去时的被动语态（was/were done）。故选D。

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我我们什么时候参观世博园吗？——下周四上午。 考查宾语从句。根据“Could you please tell me...”可知，本句为宾语从句，宾语从句用陈述语序，故排除选项B和C。有根据答语“Next Thursday morning.”可知，此处询问时间，故用when引导的宾语从句。故选A。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Story of the Carrot and the Ring Have you ever lost something that was precious to you, and thought you’d never see it again? That’s what happened to Mary Grams. Mary had worn her engagement ring for more than half a century when she  ______ 13 ______  lost it. She was working in her garden on the family farm one day, pulling out a plant. And that was probably when the ring came off her finger. When she discovered it was missing, she searched everywhere for it for days, before finally  ______ 14 ______  up. Mary realized she probably wasn’t going to  ______ 15 ______  the ring again. So she decided not to tell anyone about what had happened, apart from her son. Instead, she thought she would replace it with a much cheaper ring from a jeweller’s. Luckily, she managed to buy another one that  ______ 16 ______  just like it. In fact, it was so similar that no one else in her family even knew her original ring was missing. But the story has a happy ending Mary eventually got her engagement ring back —13 years after it was lost! One day Mary’s daughter-in-law Colleen was working in the same  ______ 17 ______  where Mary had been all those years ago. She was digging up vegetables there when she discovered the ring. But this time it was a bit  ______ 18 ______  —because there was a carrot growing right through the middle of it! As soon as Colleen saw the ring, she knew immediately who the  ______ 19 ______  was. The farm had been in the family for over 100 years. And only two women had lived there in all that time. So when Colleen discovered the story of the lost ring, it became clear there was only one person it could possibly have belonged to, and the ring was returned to Mary. Mary decided to remove her ring from the carrot and  ______ 20 ______  it again. So she carefully cut the carrot in half. Then the ring was washed, and Mary put it back on her finger—and it still fitted perfectly!

questions.prompt: Mr. Smith has two sons. He often plays football with  ______  at weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯先生有两个儿子。他经常在周末和他们一起踢足球。 考查代词辨析。him他；her她；you你（们）；them他们。根据上文“Mr. Smith has two sons”可知，此处应用人称代词them指代上文提到的两个儿子。故选D。

questions.prompt: To make our school more beautiful, we decided to plant more trees  ______  spring.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了让我们的学校更加美丽，我们决定在春天种植更多树木。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体的时刻前面；to到；in用在季节、年、月、上下午的前面；on用于具体的某一天或具体某一天的上午、下午或晚上。根据“spring”可知，此处应用介词短语in spring，表示“在春天”。故选C。

questions.prompt: There is something wrong with Jack’s leg,  ______  he doesn’t give up his football dream.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克的腿有问题，但是他没有放弃他的足球梦。 考查连词辨析。and和，表示并列关系；but但是，表示转折关系；or或者，表达选择关系；so所以，表达因果关系。根据“he doesn’t give up his football dream.”可知，虽然杰克腿有问题，但是并未放弃梦想，这是转折关系。故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  you skate, Tom? — Yes, I can. My favourite winter sport is skating.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你会滑冰吗？——是的，我会。我最喜欢的冬季运动就是滑冰。 考查情态动词辨析。can“能、会”；must“必须”；should“应该”；need“需要”。根据答语“Yes, I can”可知此处是由can引导的一般疑问句。故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you go to the library, Jim? — Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去一次图书馆，吉姆？——一周一次。 考查疑问词辨析。How much多少钱；How long多长时间；How often多久一次；How soon多久以后。根据“Once a week”可知，此处对频率提问，因此用疑问词how often，故选C。

questions.prompt: Michael thinks reading paper books is  ______  than reading e-books.
questions.explanation: 句意：迈克尔认为读纸质书比看电子书更舒服。 考查形容词比较级的用法。根据“than”可知，句子应用比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: Jane came to Beijing in 2020. She  ______  here for three years.
questions.explanation: 句意：简2020年来到北京。她住在那里已经三年了。 考查动词时态辨析。根据“for three years”可知，应用现在完成时，结构为“have/has+动词现在分词”，主语为She，助动词用has，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Alice, what does your sister usually do in her free time? — She usually  ______  some books.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爱丽丝，你的妹妹通常在她的空闲时间做什么？——她通常看书。 考查一般现在时。由“usually”可知，句子应用一般现在时。故选A。

questions.prompt: Dan is an artist. He  ______  to draw pictures at the age of five.
questions.explanation: 句意：丹是一名画家。他五岁就开始画画。 考查动词时态辨析。根据“at the age of five.”可知，这是过去的时间状语，故用一般过去时。故选D。

questions.prompt: Susan  ______  with her cousin online when her father got home last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：当爸爸昨晚回来时，苏珊正在网上和她的表姐聊天。 考查过去进行时。was chatting过去进行时；is chatting现在进行时；chats一般现在时；will chat一般将来时。根据后文“when her father got home last night”可知当爸爸到家时，她应是正在做某事，时间是在过去，所以是过去进行时。故选A。

questions.prompt: The 19th Asian Games  ______  in Hangzhou in September, 2023.
questions.explanation: 句意：第十九届亚运会将于2023年9月在杭州举行。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。由“in September, 2023”可知，句子应用一般将来时；又因“The 19th Asian Games”是主语，为物，自己不能主动举行，需用被动，一般将来时被动语态结构：will be+动词过去分词。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Tony, could you tell me  ______  so many words last term? — Sure. By reading English as much as possible.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tony，你能告诉我你上学期是怎么学会这么多单词的吗？——当然。通过尽可能多地阅读英语。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句要用陈述语序，排除A与C；根据“By reading English as much as possible.” 可知在问学习的方式，要用how提问。故选B。 二、 完形填空(共 8 分，每小题 1 分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Laura couldn’t wait to hear Mrs. Perkins’s big announcement (公布). The person elected will help me pass out papers, and hand out materials. He or she will also get to decide on the theme for the class project that month.” Laura could hardly sit still. It was a contest! She had to win. Mrs. Perkins held up a gold star badge. “The class leader will wear this badge during school hours.” Laura’s eyes widened. A shiny gold badge! Everyone would know she was a  ______ 14 ______  if she was wearing that badge. “This is a lot of responsibility,” Mrs. Perkins said. “So I only want students to nominate (提名) themselves if they  ______ 15 ______  feel they are up to the task.” Laura was hardly listening anymore. She was  ______ 16 ______  herself wearing the gold badge. Hearing the sound of chalk writing on the blackboard, Laura turned to see Mrs. Perkins writing a list of  ______ 17 ______. “Does anyone else wish to be nominated for class leader this month?” Mrs. Perkins asked. Laura’s hand shot up in the air. “I want to be nominated!” Mrs. Perkins  ______ 18 ______  Laura to the list. Laura scanned the names. Melissa was on it, too. Laura looked at her best friend sitting next to her. “Good luck!” Melissa said. “I would love to choose the theme for the class project. I have a great idea for it.” Laura suddenly felt  ______ 19 ______. Melissa didn’t just want to win, she wanted to help the class. “Would anyone like to tell the class why they should be this month’s class leader?” Mrs. Perkins askd. Laura raised her hand. “I think everyone should vote for Melissa. She has a great idea for the class project, and she always helps Mrs. Perkins pass out papers. She’ll make a great class leader.” Everyone  ______ 20 ______. “Thanks,” Melissa said. “But I thought you wanted to be the class leader.” Laura shrugged(耸肩).“There’s always next month.”

questions.prompt: My sister is only six years old, but  ______  can take good care of herself.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的妹妹只有六岁，但是她能很好地照顾自己。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；it它；they他们。根据“My sister”和“herself”可知，应是说“我妹妹”能照顾自己，是女孩，所以用she，故选B。

questions.prompt: Usually I help my parents with some housework  ______  Sundays.
questions.explanation: 句意：我通常在星期天帮父母做一些家务。 考查时间介词。at后跟具体时刻；on后跟具体的日期和星期；to后跟时刻，表示离下一个时刻差几分钟；in后跟年、月、季节和在上下午和晚上。根据Sundays可知要用on，故选B。

questions.prompt: Both my brother and I like films,  ______  we often go to the cinema.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥和我都喜欢电影，所以我们经常去电影院。 考查连词辨析。so所以；but但是；for由于；or或者。根据句意可知，空后“经常去电影院”是空前“喜欢看电影”的结果，属于前因后果，所以用so连接。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me, must I return all the books in a week? —No, you  ______. You can keep them for two weeks.
questions.explanation: 句意：——对不起，我必须在一周内归还所有的书吗？——不，你不需要。你可以借两个星期。 考查一般疑问句。needn’t不需要；wouldn’t不会；shouldn’t不应该；can’t不能。根据“must I return all the books in a week?”可知，“Must...?”开头的一般疑问句，否定回答用“No, sb needn’t/don’t have to.”。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Jim,  ______  does your father usually go to work? —By bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：——吉姆，你爸爸通常是怎么上班的？——乘公共汽车。 考查疑问副词辨析。when什么时候；why为什么；how怎样；where在哪里。根据答语“By bus.乘公共汽车。”可知，是在问爸爸如何去上班的。故选C。

questions.prompt: Li Shizhen was one of  ______  doctors in Chinese history.
questions.explanation: 句意：李时珍是中国历史上最著名的医生之一。 考查形容词最高级。famous著名的；more famous更著名的；most famous最著名的；the most famous最著名的。根据“one of…doctors in Chinese history”可知空处应用最高级，结构为“one of the+最高级+名词复数”。故选D。

questions.prompt: If you go by subway, you  ______  at the Summer Palace in half an hour.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你坐地铁，半小时后你就会到达颐和园。 考查时态。句子是if引导条件状语从句，遵循主将从现，主句用一般将来时will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: Mr. Green  ______  for his lessons when I went into his office.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我走进格林先生先生的办公室时，他正在备课。 考查时态。根据“when I went into his office”可知走进办公室时，格林先生正在备课，用过去进行时was/were doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: My classmates and I  ______  a lot of volunteer work since last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：从去年开始，我和同学们做了很多志愿者工作。 考查时态。根据“since last year”可知句子用现在完成时have/has done。故选C。

questions.prompt: The sports meeting  ______  in our school last month. Our class won the first prize.
questions.explanation: 句意：运动会上个月在我们学校举行。我们班得了一等奖。 考查被动语态。主语The sports meeting和谓语hold之间是被动关系，根据“last month”可知此处用一般过去时的被动语态was/were done。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mary, do you know  ______  the English competition? —Yes, I do. Next Wednesday.

He is my friend.” His mother said, “When people  ______ 15 ______  Arun, you don’t like it. When he loses, you feel happy. You keep seeing negative qualities in him and feel a sense of dislike towards him. Do you feel all of this?” Karan was shocked by what he heard and thought it was true. His mother continued, “I have a great solution for you to deal with jealousy. Instead of being jealous, you should focus your  ______ 16 ______  on appreciating (欣赏) the positive qualities in Arun.” Just listening to this, Karan replied, “Positives qualities? In Arun? I cannot find even a single positive quality in him.” His mother asked, “You can’t or you don’t want to find it?” Karan looked down  ______ 17 ______. His mother said, “OK. Tell me when you start preparing for an exam.” Karan replied, “A week before.” His mother asked, “And Arun?” Karan thought and said, “He studies daily. He lists all the schoolwork that he has to do and when he should do each thing. He always  ______ 18 ______  his timetable.” His mother said, “This shows that he has good management skills and he is hardworking.” Karan nodded. He felt inspired (受到启发的). From that day, he began to  ______ 19 ______  Arun’s good qualities. Very soon, he also became hardworking like Arun. In the following exam, Arun again stood first while Karan came second. But this time Karan was not jealous at all. He was happy to see his own  ______ 20 ______. questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉和她的同学昨天去进行了学校旅行。 考查一般过去时态。went过去时态；will go一般将来时；go一般现在时；have gone现在完成时。根据“yesterday”可知，时态为一般过去时。故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  six books since the beginning of this year.
questions.explanation: 句意：今年年初以来，我已经读了六本书。 考查现在完成时。根据“since the beginning of this year.”可知，句子时态是现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: If the number of sharks drops too low, it  ______  danger to all ocean life.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果鲨鱼的数量下降过低，它会给所有的海洋生物带来危险。 考查动词的时态。根据“If the number of sharks drops too low”可知，此处是if引导的条件从句，句子时态应遵循“主将从现”原则。故主句时态用一般将来时，故选B。

questions.prompt: Today, teenagers  ______  to help around in their neighborhood.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天，青少年被鼓励在他们的社区帮忙。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“today”可知，句子时态是一般现在时，且teenagers与encourage是被动关系，应用be+过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: This is Mary’s English book.  ______  is at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是玛丽的英语书。我的在家。 考查名词性物主代词。I我（人称代词主格）；My我的（形容词性物主代词）；Me我（人称代词宾格）；Mine我的（名词性物主代词）。根据句意，可知此空要表达的意思是“我的”，且作主语，需要使用名词性物主代词，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  was your trip to Yunnan, Tom? —It was wonderful.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你的云南之旅怎么样？——精彩绝伦。 考查特殊疑问句。How怎样；What什么；When什么时候；Where在哪里。根据答句“It was wonderful.”可知，询问的是旅游的感觉，应用how来提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: —John,  ______  you please take out the trash? —OK, Mum. I’ll do it right away.
questions.explanation: 句意：——约翰，你能把垃圾倒掉吗？——好的，妈妈。我马上去做。 考查情态动词辨析。must必须；should应该；could可以；need需要。Could you please...? 用来表示“请求别人做某事”，是一种委婉地表达请求的问句。故选C。

questions.prompt: Read these books,  ______  you’ll get to know more about Chinese tea culture.
questions.explanation: 句意：读这些书，你就会对中国茶文化有更多的了解。 考查连词辨析。though虽然；unless除非；and和；but但是。此句是“祈使句+and+陈述句”结构，其中的陈述句表示将来意义。故选C。

questions.prompt: Linda is  ______  in art than her sister Lily.
questions.explanation: 句意：琳达在艺术方面比她妹妹莉莉更有创造力。 考查比较级。根据“than”可知本句是比较级结构，应用more creative，故选B。

questions.prompt: We  ______  a survey about students’ reading habits last weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周末我们做了一项关于学生阅读习惯的调查。 考查一般过去时。由 last weekend可知，这里的时态为一般过去时。故选B。

questions.prompt: Millions of tourists  ______  the Great Wall every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年有数以百万计的游客游览长城。 考查一般现在时。由every year可知，这里的时态为一般现在时，主语Millions of tourists 是复数，因此谓语用动词原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  a video call with Grandma when Dad arrived home.
questions.explanation: 句意：爸爸到家时，我正在和奶奶视频通话。 考查动词时态。本句是when 引导的时间状语从句，根据句意可知，arrived home这个动作发生的时候，另一个动作have a video call正在进行，需用过去进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: Time flies. Mr. Smith  ______  English in our school for three years. We all enjoy his classes.
questions.explanation: 句意：时光飞逝。史密斯先生在我们学校教英语已经三年了。我们都喜欢他的课。 考查现在完成时。由“for three years”可知，这里用现在完成时，其结构是：助动词have/has+动词的过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: The graduation party  ______  in the school hall next month.
questions.explanation: 句意： 毕业晚会将于下个月在学校礼堂举行。 考查被动语态。分析句子可知，主语和动词之间是被动关系，结合“next month”可知，应用一般将来时的被动语态，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Mom’s birthday is coming. Do you have any plans? —Sure. I’ll give  ______  a big surprise.

questions.prompt: —It’ll be sunny tomorrow. Why don’t we go for a trip  ______  bike? —Good idea!

questions.prompt: Judy really has a gift for Chinese,  ______  she still works hard on it.
questions.explanation: 句意：朱迪确实有中文天赋，但她仍然为此努力。 考查连词辨析。so所以；because因为；but但是；or或者。根据“Judy really has a gift for Chinese”可知朱迪确实有中文天赋，前后是转折关系，应用but。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is Beijing Daxing International Airport from here? —It’s quite near, about 3 kilometers.
questions.explanation: 句意：——北京大兴国际机场离这里有多远？——它很近，大约3公里。 考查特殊疑问句。How far多远；How often多久一次；How much多少；How soon多久以后。根据句中“Beijing Daxing International Airport from here”可知，此处是在问两地的距离，对距离进行提问应用How far。故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  see the words on the blackboard clearly. I need to move closer.
questions.explanation: 句意：我看不清黑板上的单词。我需要靠近一点。 考查情态动词。needn’t不需要；shouldn’t不应该；mustn’t一定不能；can’t不能。根据“I need to move closer.”可知，这里是我看不清黑板上的单词。故选D。

questions.prompt: John  ______  the word game every time we play.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们每次玩文字游戏，约翰都会赢。 考查一般现在时。由“every time”可知，这里应该用一般现在时，主语John是三单，因此谓语用三单形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: Gary is  ______  singer in our class. No one else sings so well.
questions.explanation: 句意：Gary是我们班最好的歌手。没有人唱得这么好。 考查形容词最高级。good好的；better更好；best最好；the best最好。根据“No one else sings so well.”没有人唱得这么好，可知Gary唱得最好，又因为形容词最高级前需加定冠词the，故选D。

questions.prompt: How time flies! We  ______  traditional Chinese medicine here for two years.

questions.prompt: Luckily, Tom’s lost dog  ______  on the street corner yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：幸运的是，汤姆走失的狗昨天在街角被发现了。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。分析句子结构可知，主语dog与动词found之间是被动关系，由yesterday可知，时态为一般过去时，因此这里是一般过去时的被动语态，结构是：was/were+动词的过去分词。故选D。

questions.prompt: At this time yesterday, I  ______  the Capital Museum with my friend.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天的这个时候，我和我的朋友正在参观首都博物馆。 考查过去进行时。根据“At this time yesterday”可知，本句为过去进行时，过去进行时构成为：was/were+doing。空前主语为I，be对应为was。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______? I think we’re lost. —I’m not sure either. Let’s ask the policeman over there.

questions.prompt: World Book Day falls  ______  April 23th every year.

questions.prompt: Linda is friendly to everyone,  ______  we all like her.

questions.prompt: —  ______  did you pay for the summer camp? —About $100.

questions.prompt: — ______  you finish the project by yourself? —Of course, I can.

questions.prompt: Tony  ______  to work in the community last weekend.

questions.prompt: I  ______  biscuits for my family when Lisa called.
questions.explanation: 句意：丽莎打来电话时，我正在给家人做饼干。 考查动词时态。when引导时间状语从句，从句动作发生时，主句动作正在进行。结合“called”可知，从句是一般过去时，主句应为过去进行时。故选A。

questions.prompt: The Palace Museum is one of  ______  historical places all over the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：故宫是世界上最神奇的历史景点之一。 考查最高级。此处是句式：one of the+最高级+名词复数，意为“……中最……之一”。故选D。

questions.prompt: I still remember my first teacher though we  ______  each other since 2015.
questions.explanation: 句意：我仍然记得我的第一位老师，尽管我们自2015年以来就没有见过面。 考查时态。根据时间状语“since 2015”可知，时态用现在完成时，结构是：have/has done；否定形式为：haven’t/hasn’t done，主语为we，助动词用have，故选C。

questions.prompt: Don’t take the dictionary away. I  ______  it now.
questions.explanation: 句意：不要拿走字典。我现在正在用。 考查动词时态。根据“now”可知，此处指正在使用字典，应为现在进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: Keep on working! I believe you  ______  to take part in the football match next term.
questions.explanation: 句意：继续努力！我相信你会被选中参加下学期的足球赛。 考查动词时态及被动语态。主语“you”与动词“choose”之间是动宾关系，即你被选中，应为被动语态。结合“next term”可知，时态是一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: My brother loves birds, and  ______  often goes bird-watching in the wild.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥喜欢鸟，他经常去野外观鸟。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；it它；they他们。根据“My brother loves birds”可知，用he代替my brother，故选A。

questions.prompt: The best time to visit Beijing is  ______  autumn.
questions.explanation: 句意：游览北京的最佳时间是在秋天。 考查介词辨析。on在 (后跟日期、星期等) ；in在 (后跟年、月、季节)；at在 (后跟具体的几点)；to朝。根据autumn是季节，用in。故选B。

questions.prompt: Betty likes dancing,  ______  she’d like to join the Dance Club.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂喜欢跳舞，所以她想加入舞蹈俱乐部。 考查连词辨析。but但是；or或者；for因为；so所以，根据句意，可知“喜欢跳舞”和“想加入舞蹈俱乐部”，属于因果关系，后句表示结果，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  I do the art project on my own? —No, you don’t have to. You can work with your classmates.

questions.prompt: — ______  do you plan to go this May Day holiday? —Back to my mom’s hometown.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个五一假期你打算去哪里？ ——回到我妈妈的家乡。 考查特殊疑问句。How怎样；Why为什么；Where哪里；When什么时候。根据“Back to my mom’s hometown.”可知，这里应该用where提问。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mom, do you think that life is  ______  today than in the past? —Yes, of course, I do.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，你认为今天的生活比过去好吗？——是的，当然了。 考查形容词比较级。good好的；better更好的；best最好的；the best最好的。根据“today than in the past”可知，是现在和过去的比较，两者之间比较用比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: Look! It  ______  outside. Let’s take an umbrella

questions.prompt: We are from No. 1 Middle School. Miss Smith is  ______  English teacher.

questions.prompt: It often rains  ______  summer in the south of China.
questions.explanation: 句意：在中国南方，夏天总是有雨。 考查时间介词。at在，通常在具体的时刻之前；on在某一天；to朝着；in在……里，通常用于一天以上的时间。根据summer可知，“在夏天”in summer。故选D。

questions.prompt: —  ______  you ride a bike? — Of course, I can. My father taught me when I was 8.

questions.prompt: The Summer Palace is one of  ______  parks in Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：颐和园是北京最美丽的公园之一。 考查形容词的最高级。one of+the+形容词的最高级+名词的复数，表示“最……之一”，因此改空为the most beautiful。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you stay in Beijing for such a long time, Lily? —Because I like the places of interest here very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Lily，你为什么在北京待了这么长时间？——因为我非常喜欢这里的名胜古迹。 考查特殊疑问词。why为什么；who谁；how如何；when什么时候。根据“Because”可知，because回答why的疑问句，故选A。

questions.prompt: I’m free this afternoon,  ______  I’m going to do some reading.
questions.explanation: 句意：我今天下午有空，所以我要读一些书。 考查连词辨析。or或者；so所以；but但是；because因为。前后两句是因果关系，前因后果，用so连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s eight o’clock now. The students  ______  to the teacher carefully in class.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在是8点钟。学生们在课堂上认真地听老师讲课。 考查时态。根据“It’s eight o’clock now.”可知，此处描述8点钟时学生正在做的事情，应用现在进行时，结构为am/is/are doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Betty  ______  on a Silk Road trip last year. —Really? It must be a wonderful trip.
questions.explanation: 句意：——贝蒂去年去丝绸之路旅行了。——真的吗？这一定是一次美妙的旅行。 考查时态。根据last year可知，句子要用一般现在时，动词用过去式，即went。故选B。

questions.prompt: My mother  ______  in the nursing home for ten years.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈已经在护士之家工作了十年了。 考查现在完成时。根据“for ten years”可知，此题考查的是现在完成时，指的是，我妈妈从过去到现在在护士之家持续工作了十年。故选D。

questions.prompt: If you try your best to do everything, you  ______  a difference.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你尽全力做每一件事，那么你将会有所作为。 考查一般将来时。根据句意可知，当主从句动作均未发生，if“如果”引导的条件状语从句，应用主将从现的时态，故主句应用一般将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: What an amazing picture! It  ______  more than 900 years ago.

questions.prompt: — Do you know  ______? — Yes, it’s on March 3rd every year and we should protect animals and plants in danger.

Touched with the true meaning of Christmas, the joy of  ______ 17 ______, he decided to do for Parker what he could not do for himself. He read and read. He read as much as eight hours a day. The excitement of perhaps having such a wonderful gift to give kept him going. The  ______ 18 ______  came when the final lists were to be turned in. Jaron’s mother took him to the store, and he turned in his list. By reading 280 books, Jaron had won! questions.prompt: I’d like to go shopping with you,  ______  I’m too busy.

questions.prompt: With the help of teachers, my English is much  ______  than last year.

questions.prompt: —Peter,  ______  I use your ruler? —Of course you can.

questions.prompt: I  ______  a poster about sports when Mary called me last night.

questions.prompt: — ______  I hand in the painting now? — No you needn’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我必须现在交这幅画吗？——不，你不必。 考查情态动词辨析。can能够；must必须；should应该；could可以。根据答语“No, you needn’t”可知，这是must引导的一般疑问句，故选B。

questions.prompt: — What did you do last Sunday? —I  ______  table tennis with my friends.

questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，杰克在哪里？——他现在正在房间里制作风筝。 考查动词时态。根据“where is Jack”及“now”可知，问的是现在在哪里，所以用现在进行时，形式为“be+现在分词”，“He”第三人称单数，后面接is，make的现在分词为making，故选B。

questions.prompt: If it  ______  fine, we will go hiking tomorrow.

questions.prompt: Mr. Black is very kind to the students. They all like very much.

questions.prompt: I made a special card for my father  ______  Father's Day this year.
questions.explanation: 句意：今年我为父亲节做了一张特别的卡片。 考查介词辨析。in后面接不是具体的某一天；at后面接具体的某一时刻；on后面接具体的某一天；to到，给，由所给空后面的Father's Day可知，是具体的某一天，故选C。 【点睛】at, in, on与时间搭配： at加时间点、时刻以及节日前用at。如at noon, at night; at New Year。 in表示较长的时间（年、月、世纪、上午、下午、晚上等）。如in the 1990s, in the morning。 on用于具体到某一天的日子或早晨、下午、晚上前有修饰词的时候。如on October 1st, on the morning of January 4th。 例如题目中，由所给空后面的Father's Day可知，是具体的某一天，故选C。
