questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克，你能用英语写邀请函吗？——当然，我会。 考查情态动词。can能；may可以；must必须；need需要。根据“Of course, I can”可知此处表示能力，用can。故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  the mooncakes are！
questions.explanation: 句意：多美味的月饼啊！ 考查感叹句。根据句中mooncakes可知，不可用不定冠词a，C、D选项排除。句子主谓结构是the mooncakes are，前面的单词是形容词delicious，应用how修饰，故应选B。 【点睛】感叹句中how和what的用法区别 what修饰名词。例如： What a fool he is!（修饰名词a fool） how修饰形容词、副词或动词。例如： How hard he works!（修饰副词hard） How clever the boy is!（修饰形容词clever）

questions.prompt: —Where did you go during the Mid-Autumn Festival? —I  ______  to Beihai Park with my family.
questions.explanation: 句意：——中秋节期间你去了哪里？——我和家人一起去了北海公园。 考查一般过去时态。根据“Where did you go during the Mid-Autumn Festival? ”可知是问过去发生的动作，因此用一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式went。故选C。

questions.prompt: I wonder  ______  everyone can enjoy the English party this Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想知道是否每个人都能去这个星期五下午的英语聚会玩。 考查宾语从句引导词。if是否，如果（宾语从句从属连词，条件状语从句引导词）；that那（在宾语从句中不作任何成分）；what什么（在宾语从句中作主语，宾语，表语）；when何时（在宾语从句中作时间状语）。根据“wonder... everyone can enjoy the English party this Friday afternoon.”可知，应是询问是不是每个人都可以去这个聚会，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Hey, can you read out the Chinese on the book cover? —Sure just a piece of cake. I  ______  Chinese since I was 8 years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，你能读出书面上的汉字吗？——当然，很容易。自从我八岁我已经学中文。 考查现在完成时。learn一般现在时；have learnt现在完成时；am learning现在进行时；learnt一般过去时。根据since I was 8 years old.可知主句时态是现在完成时， 主语I接have+过去分词。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Could you tell me  ______  the Chinese-English dictionary? I want a same one for myself. —In a bookstore near my home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你在哪里买的英汉词典吗？我自己也想买个一样的。——在我家附近的一个书店。 考查宾语从句。分析句子成分可知，本句为含宾语从句的复合句。宾语从句应使用陈述句语序，排除B和D。结合语境，时态为一般过去时，所以设空处填写where you bought。故选C。 五、语法填空（每题1分, 共4分） 阅读下列短文，根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写1个适当的单词，在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空。 Good learners think about what they  ______ 9 ______ （be）good at and what they need to practice more. Remember, “Use it or lose it.” Even if you learn something well, you will forget it  ______ 10 ______  you use it. “Practice  ______ 11 ______ （make）perfect.” Good learners will keep practicing what they have learned, and they are not afraid of making mistakes. Alexander Graham Bell did not invent the telephone overnight. He succeeded by  ______ 12 ______ （try）many times and learning from his mistakes. 【答案】9. are 10. unless

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  we’ll have to wait another two hours for the next train.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则的话下一班火车还要再等两个小时。A. and和，表示前后是并列关系； B. but但是，表示前后是转折关系； C. or否则，要不然的话； D. so因此，表示前后是因果关系。根据句意故选C。

questions.prompt: The Great Barrier Reef lies  ______  the northeast coast of Australia.
questions.explanation: 句意：大堡礁位于澳大利亚东北海岸上。 考查介词辨析。in在……里；on在……上（相邻或接壤）；to表示在某地范围之外，且不接壤；off表示“在海岸线上”。根据“the northeast coast of Australia”可知是在海岸线上，应用off。故选D。

questions.prompt: My father is a tea lover. He tea every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲是个茶爱好者。他每天喝茶。考查动词时态辨析题。every day每天，用于一般现在时，he是单数第三人称，动词需用三单形式，可排除ACD三个选项；根据句意语境，可知选B。

questions.prompt: —We  ______  to the National History Museum with the exchange students this coming winter holiday. —That’s amazing!
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们将和交换生去国家历史博物馆在即将到来的寒假。——那很令人吃惊！ 考查将来时态。went一般过去时态；go一般现在时；have gone现在完成时；will go一般将来时。根据“this coming winter holiday”可知，时态为将来时态。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Have you seen the film The Battle at Lake Changjin? —Yes. I  ______  it twice. It is so moving.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你看过电影《长津湖》吗？——是。我已经看过两次了。太感人了。 考查现在完成时态。根据“Have you seen the film The Battle at Lake Changjin?”和“twice”可知，句子时态应该是现在完成时态，故选B。

questions.prompt: In winter, people usually wear scarves to  ______  themselves  ______  the cold wind.
questions.explanation: 句意：在冬天，人们通常戴上围巾来抵御寒风。 考查动词短语。keep...away远离，此处缺少介词from；cut off切断；brush off刷去；protect...against防范。根据“the cold wind”可知，戴上围巾来抵御寒风，故选D。

questions.prompt: ______  he doesn’t come back, I will still wait for him.
questions.explanation: 句意：即使他不回来，我也要等他。 考查连词辨析。because因为；when当……时；until直到；even though即使。根据前后两句内容可知，两句是让步关系，even though符合句意，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know that over one billion people are using WeChat? —Yes. It  ______  by more and more people around the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道超过10亿人在用微信吗？——是的。它被全世界越来越多的人所接受。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“It…by more and more people”可知It和accept是逻辑上的被动关系，陈述微信的现状，用一般现在时，所以这里应用一般现在时的被动语态。故选C。

questions.prompt: - What beautiful photos! Can you tell me _? - I took them in the Summer Palace.
questions.explanation: 句意：多美的照片呀！你能告诉我你在那里拍的吗？ ——我在故宫拍的这些照片。本题考查宾语从句。宾语从句的语序是陈述语序。可排除CD； 由I took them in the Summer Palace.知动作发生在过去，可排除B。故正确答案是A。

questions.prompt: A true friend is a person  ______  cares and supports you all the time.
questions.explanation: 句意：一个真正的朋友会一直关心和支持你。 考查定语从句。where哪里；who谁；which哪个；what什么。分析句子结构可知，此句是一个定语从句，先行词是person，用who引导定语从句，故选B。 五、完形填空。 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。（共12分，每小题1.5分） While I was living in the south of France, I drove all the way to Barcelona to buy a very special guitar. Once I was back home with my treasured, finely finished（抛光的）wooden instrument, my father asked if he could play it. He loved flamenco（弗拉曼柯舞曲）guitar music and decided to show off his skills.  ______ 11 ______  I knew it, he was tapping（轻敲）on the smooth top of my classical guitar with his fingernails（指甲）! Guitars that meant for playing lively flamenco music had tap plates（敲板）to protect themselves from fingernail damage. My father did not realize that my classical guitar did not have a tap plate. I was horrified, but I  ______ 12 ______  said, “Here, let me show you what I can play” as I took back my guitar. I  ______ 13 ______  to admit（承认）this, but for years, whenever I played my guitar, I couldn`t help noticing the marks. I felt bad about feeling annoyed because my father was so nice to me and I really loved everything about him. After having my third child, I didn’t have as much time to practice, so the guitar stayed safely in its case for years. During that time, my father  ______ 14 ______  away sadly and I was extremely sad for a long time. Then one day, I was in the mood to start playing my guitar and I opened the case for the first time in a long while. Once again, I noticed the fingernail marks on my guitar. It was a moment that took my breath  ______ 15 ______. Those marks—my father had made them—yes, my father had made them. He was there—a part of him was there on the bright and smooth top of my guitar. How wonderful! I was so happy to see those little scratches made by the tapping of his fingers and all of a sudden my guitar was even more  ______ 16 ______  than ever before. My father was a very wise man and I learned so much from him when he was alive—and now he was still  ______ 17 ______  me. My viewpoint on what was important changed. What had once seemed like defects（瑕疵）on my guitar were beautiful little souvenirs of time spent with my father. I promised from that day on to always appreciate life’s little  ______ 18 ______  with the people I loved. Whenever I find myself about to “sweat the small stuff”, I think of my father and my beautiful guitar with the lovely marks.

questions.prompt: Our classmate David is very friendly. We all like  ______  very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的新同学大卫很友好。我们都很喜欢他。 考查代词辨析。she她，主格；her她/她的，宾格/形容词性物主代词；him他，宾格；he他，主格。根据句子结构可知，空处的词是作“like”的宾语，应该用人称代词宾格形式，再结合主语“David”可知，是男性，空处应用him。故选C。

questions.prompt: In China, the Spring Festival always falls  ______  January or February. A on
questions.explanation: 句意：在中国，春节总是在一月或二月。 考查介词辨析。on其后加星期或具体的时间；with用；by到……为止；in其后加早中晚，月份，季节，年份等。根据“January or February”可知，月份前用in。故选D。

questions.prompt: Liu Yu’s parents believe that their son should study hard in the evenings  ______  they don’t allow him to practice running at night.
questions.explanation: 句意：刘宇的父母认为他们的儿子晚上应该好好学习，所以他们不允许他晚上练习跑步。 考查连词辨析。so所以；and和；but但是；or或者。根据“Liu Yu’s parents believe that their son should study hard in the evenings”（刘宇的父母认为他们的儿子晚上应该好好学习）及“hey don’t allow him to practice running at night”（他们不允许他晚上练习跑步）可知，前后句是因果关系，故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  dog is this? We need to find its owner. A What
questions.explanation: 句意：这是谁的狗？我们得找到它的主人。 考查特殊疑问句。What什么；Who谁；Which哪个；Whose谁的。根据“...dog is this? We need to find its owner.”可知，询问是谁的狗，故选D。

questions.prompt: The schoolbag  ______  belong to Tom. There is a camera in it and he’s the only person who brought a camera to the party yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个书包一定是汤姆的。里面有一个照相机，他是昨天唯一一个带照相机来参加聚会的人。 考查动词辨析。must必须，一定；might可能；could可以；need需要。根据“There is a camera in it and he’s the only person who brought a camera to the party yesterday.”可知，此处表示非常肯定的推测，故选A。

questions.prompt: I think skating is one of  ______  sports.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为滑冰是最令人兴奋的运动之一。 考查形容词最高级的用法。exciting令人激动的，原级；more exciting更令人激动的，比较级；most exciting最令人激动的，最高级；the most exciting最令人激动的，最高级。根据最高级句型结构：one of the+形容词最高级+可数名词复数，可知此处应填the most exciting。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Where is Jenny? —She  ______  a poster for the community in her study.
questions.explanation: 句意：——珍妮在哪里？——她正在书房里为社区做海报。 考查动词时态。makes一般现在时；is making现在进行时；will make一般将来时；have made现在完成时。根据问句“Where is Jenny?”可知答句应回答珍妮正在做的事情，用现在进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: I can’t go to see the film with you because I  ______  the ticket yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不能和你一起去看电影，因为我昨天把票弄丢了。 考查动词时态。根据“yesterday”可知此处时态是一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式。故选A。

questions.prompt: The book is wonderful. I  ______  it twice.
questions.explanation: 句意：这本书很棒。我已经读了两遍了。 考查动词的时态。根据“twice”可知，句子用现在完成时态，结构是has/have done。故选C。

questions.prompt: Don’t worry. He  ______  home when he finishes his work.
questions.explanation: 句意：别担心。他完成工作后就会回家。 考查时态。此处是when引导的时间状语从句，“come home”这一动作还未发生，用一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: Mickey Mouse, the famous cartoon character,  ______  in 1928, but it is still popular today.
questions.explanation: 句意：米老鼠，著名的卡通人物，创建于1928年，但它至今仍然很受欢迎。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。creates一般现在时；will create一般将来时；is created一般现在时的被动语态；was created一般过去时的被动语态。根据“in 1928”可知时态是一般过去时，且主语“Mickey Mouse”与动词之间是被动关系，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______? —Because she didn’t find her passport.

questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道露西为什么没赶上飞机吗？——因为她没找到护照。 考查宾语从句。此处是宾语从句，需用陈述语序，排除AC；结合“Because she didn’t find her passport.”可知，是一般过去时。故选B。 五、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Last year, I learned from a newspaper that some sick kids needed help. I phoned the newspaper and I was asked to  ______ 13 ______  a little girl named Lisa, who had mental illness. A short time later, I went for a  ______ 14 ______  to Lisa. After having been at the mental hospital for years, she had recently been allowed to be at home. In the beginning, I did most of the talking. Lisa, however, was too quiet and introverted(内向的), shyly sitting in the corner of the sofa and listening. She was careful not to allow our eyes to  ______ 15 ______. Over time, Lisa felt more comfortable little by little while I was  ______ 16 ______. Our weekly get-togethers usually meant  ______ 17 ______  a cup of hot coffee, window shopping or taking slow walks in the country. Lisa never discussed how she felt about our friendship, even after we completed our first year together. However, she knew she could always depend on me. Then one day I got a call from our volunteer group. “Mary, would you and Lisa like to be interviewed on a local TV news show?” Excited, I answered, “Wow! Let me discuss it with Lisa.” I didn’t think Lisa would be  ______ 18 ______  going on “live” television. But to my surprise, Lisa wanted to be interviewed, too. At the interview, she said, “If I can help other people understand how important our  ______ 19 ______  is, and how it has helped me, maybe they’ll volunteer, too. Mary, wouldn’t that be great?” With tears running down, we smiled at each other. From then on, Lisa never  ______ 20 ______  a chance to plant seeds about the volunteer group with others. Her face lit up whenever she talked about our special friendship.

questions.prompt: All my teachers are patient when I ask  ______  for help.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我向老师们求助时，他们都很耐心。 考查代词辨析。him他；us我们；them他们；you你。根据句意可知，空处是指“All my teachers”，故应用代词them代替。故选C。

questions.prompt: Peter usually plays the guitar in a music club  ______  Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：Peter通常在周六下午在音乐俱乐部弹吉他。 考查介词辨析。of……；in后面接季节/年/月等；at后面接某一时刻；on后面接具体的某一天，根据空后的“Saturday afternoon”是具体的某一天可知，空缺处应该用介词on，故选D。

questions.prompt: The book  ______ be Mary’s because it has her name on it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这本书一定是玛丽的，因为它上面有她的名字。 考查情态动词辨析。must一定；may可能；can’t不可能；might可能。根据“because it has her name on it.”可知，书上有玛丽的名字，因此这本书一定是玛丽的，must be意为“肯定是”，表示有把握的肯定推测。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you often take a walk? —In Beihai Park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你经常在哪里散步？——在北海公园。 考查疑问词辨析。Why为什么；Where在哪里；How如何；When何时。根据“In Beihai Park.”可知对位置提问，用Where。故选B。

questions.prompt: Nothing is  ______  than a walk in the forest.
questions.explanation: 句意：没有什么比在森林里散步更令人放松的了。 考查形容词比较级。relaxing令人放松的，形容词原级；more relaxing比较令人放松的，形容词比较级；most relaxing最令人放松的，形容词最高级，前面要加定冠词the；the most relaxing最令人放松的，根据空后的“than”可知，空缺处应该用形容词比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: We  ______  healthier if we eat enough fruit and vegetables every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果我们每天吃足够的水果和蔬菜，我们会变得更健康。 考查时态辨析。if引导的条件状语从句遵循主将从现原则，主句用一般将来时，其结构为will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: The famous French writer Charles Perrault  ______  to write his fairy tales in 1679.
questions.explanation: 句意：法国著名作家查尔斯·佩罗在1679年开始写他的童话。 考查时态辨析。根据“in 1679”可知用一般过去时，谓语用过去式began。故选B。

questions.prompt: Our school life  ______  a lot since we entered middle school.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我们进入中学以来，我们的学校生活改变了很多。 考查时态辨析。根据“since we entered middle school”可知要用现在完成时，其结构为have/has done。故选D。

questions.prompt: The 24th Winter Olympic Games  ______  in Beijing in February, 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：第24届冬奥会将于2022年2月在北京举行。 考查时态和语态辨析。主语“The 24th Winter Olympic Games”与动词hold之间是动宾关系，结合“in February, 2022”可知要用一般将来时的被动语态，其结构为will be done。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Judy, can you tell me  ______  this grammar book? It’s so useful. —Sure. I bought it at Xinhua Bookstore.
questions.explanation: 句意：——朱迪，你能告诉我你在哪儿买的这本语法书吗？它是如此有用。——确定。我在新华书店买的。 考查宾语从句。tell后缺少直接宾语，此处用宾语从句。宾语从句用陈述语序，排除AB；主现从不限，根据“I bought it at Xinhua Bookstore.”可知从句要用一般过去时，排除D。故选C。 五、完形填空（共12分，每小题1.5分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Steven's New Sled Steven woke on Christmas morning to find a new sled. “Oh, wow! ”he shouted. This was the best Christmas ______ 11 ______! Steven was still excited as the rest of his family opened their gifts. Secretly, he hoped he could get outside quickly to try out his new sled. Finally, Steven asked, “ Dad, is it okay if I try out my sled?" Dad  ______ 12 ______. Soon, Steven was sledding down Twin Hills in the neighbourhood park. He felt the wind against his face as he flew down. Later that day, Steven carefully leaned（靠）the sled up against the outside of his house under his bedroom window. The next day, Steven ran outside as soon as he could. “Oh, no! ”Steven shouted. His sled was missing! He ran as fast as he could to the park. There at Twin Hills he  ______ 13 ______  it! Steven's neighbour, Kevin, was on Steven's new sled! "Kevin! That's my sled! You stole my new sled! ”But Kevin just laughed and headed up the hill for another run down. Steven ran home, crying all the way. He found his dad in the garage and told him what had happened. Steven's dad said, "Calm down, Son. There may be another  ______ 14 ______  for the missing of your sled.” Steven couldn't believe his dad was  ______ 15 ______  with Kevin. “But, Dad. Kevin's at Twin Hills using my sled right now! We need to go to get it! ” Dad said  ______ 16 ______, "First of all, you need to make sure your sled is actually stolen. Look over there.” Steven was  ______ 17 ______  at what he saw. His sled leaned against the wall of the garage next to his bicycle. Dad put his arm around Steven and said, "I put your sled away last night when I saw you had left it outside.” Steven  ______ 18 ______  his head. He felt bad about the way he had spoken to his neighbour. "I should say sorry to Kevin, ”he said. Dad replied, “There's no time like the present.”

questions.prompt: Mr. Brown often visits the sick children in hospitals to cheer  ______  up.
questions.explanation: 句意：布朗先生经常去医院看望生病的孩子，使他们高兴起来。 考查代词辨析。him他；them他们；her她；us我们。根据“Mr. Brown often visits the sick children in hospitals”可知，此处是指使医院生病的孩子们高兴起来，用them指代孩子们。故选B。

questions.prompt: Mike and I like basketball, and both of us are  ______  our school team.
questions.explanation: 句意：迈克和我都喜欢篮球，我们都是校队的。 考查介词辨析。on在上面；by通过；at在；to到。根据“our school team”可知，在校队要用介词on，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  will the project of our city’s new library be completed? —It won’t take long. Just in about two weeks.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我市新图书馆的工程多久才能完工？——这不会花很长时间。大约两周后。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长，多久；How far多远；How soon多快，多久以后；How often多久一次。根据答语“It won’t take long. Just in about two weeks.”可知此处询问的是多久以后能完成工程，应用how soon来提问。故选C。

questions.prompt: He is getting heavy,  ______  he decides to do some exercise after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：他正在变重，所以他决定放学后做一些锻炼。 考查连词辨析。so所以；if如果；for为了；because因为。根据上文“He is getting heavy”和下文“he decides to do some exercise after school”可知，上下文是因果关系，前因后果，用so连接。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Someone is knocking the door. Is it your aunt? —It  ______  be her. She has gone to Thailand for traveling.
questions.explanation: 句意：——有人在敲门。是你阿姨吗？——不可能是她。她去泰国旅游了。 考查情态动词表示推测用法。needn’t 不必；mustn’t决不能；may not不可以；can’t不能。由答语可知，她去泰国旅游了，说明敲门的不可能是她。can’t 与be连用，意为“不可能是”，用于有把握的否定推测。故选D。

questions.prompt: Stonehenge is one of  ______  historical places in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：巨石阵是世界上最受欢迎的历史遗迹之一。 考查形容词最高级。根据“Stonehenge is one of...historical places in the world.”可知，此处指最受欢迎的历史遗迹之一，形容词应使用最高级，最高级前加the。故选D。

questions.prompt: To prevent the spread of disease, you’d better wash your hands as soon as you  ______  home.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了预防疾病的传播，你最好一到家就洗手。 考查时态。as soon as引导时间状语从句，时态遵循“主将从现”原则，此处从句应用一般现在时，从句主语为you，谓语应用动词get的原形。故选C。

questions.prompt: My family  ______  a lot of changes in Beijing since we moved here in 2010.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我们2010年搬到北京以来，我们家经历了很多变化。 考查动词时态。since+一般过去时的从句，主句用现在完成时结构，故选C。

questions.prompt: —I called you last night, but no one answered. —I  ______  my mom cook dinner when you called.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我昨晚给你打电话，但没人接。——你打电话的时候，我正在帮我妈妈做晚饭。 考查时态。根据“I... my mom cook dinner when you called.”可知，此处指你打电话时，我正在帮妈妈做晚饭；表示过去正在做某事用过去进行时，结构为was/were+doing；主语为“I”，be动词用was。故选A。

questions.prompt: Bob is interested in Chinese culture, and he  ______  Chinese at Peking University next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：鲍勃对中国文化很感兴趣，明年他将在北京大学学习汉语。 考查时态。根据“next year”可知，时态为一般将来时，结构是will+动词原形。故选B。

questions.prompt: Thousands of trees  ______  along streets last year to make our city more beautiful.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年，街道两旁种了成千上万棵树，使我们的城市更美丽。 考查动词时态和语态。planted种植，过去式；were planted被种植，一般过去时的被动语态；plant种植，原形；are planted被种植，一般现在时的被动语态。主语“Thousands of trees”和动词“plant”之间是动宾关系，所以用被动语态，结合“last year”可知，此处应用一般过去时的被动语态（was/were done），主语“Thousands of trees”表复数，be动词用were。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me, could you please tell me  ______? —It will start at 8:00 p.m.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰了，您能告诉我电影什么时候会开始吗？——它将在晚上8点开始。 考查when引导的宾语从句。when did the movie start错误表达，从句应用陈述语序；when the movie started电影什么时候开始；when will the movie start错误表达，从句应用陈述语充；when the movie will start电影什么时候会开始。根据“could you please tell me”可知后接宾语从句，从句应采用陈述语序。根据答句“It will start at 8:00 p.m.”可知从句应用一般将来时。故选D。 二、完形填空（每题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 My children went back to college after being home for the summer. I took the dogs for a walk. When I passed the Korean Tofu House, the smell made me hungry. “Why don’t we eat here tonight?” I thought. Then I realized that I was  ______ 13 ______. My children and I had been here together just a week before and we had a great time talking about coming back here again. Thinking about that, I couldn’t help  ______ 14 ______. When I got back home, the house was dark and quiet. It had been full of laughter and songs all summer when the kids were at home. We cooked and ate together. We went hiking in the hills and took the dogs to the beach. It was just like it had been in the good old days, before my kids had grown up and gone away. The next morning I got up and decided to make pancakes; the kids love blueberry pancakes. Then I realized they weren’t there, so I lost my  ______ 15 ______  and took the dogs for a walk without having breakfast. When I was walking along the road, an old lady looked at my dogs, smiled warmly and asked if she could pet my dogs. As she petted the dogs, she told her story. “I once had a golden dog, Chunky, and he lived to 15. I had never worried about  ______ 16 ______  him, because he was never sick a day in his life till the end. He wouldn’t eat so I put gravy on my finger for him to eat. But the doctor said to me, ‘You’ve got to let him go’.” She looked up to the sky and back at my dogs and said, “So I did. I let him go…But I’ve never had another dog after that.” She put her hand over her heart and her face expressed her  ______ 17 ______  as she said, “It hurts.” Before I said anything, she gave my dogs one more loving pet. She smiled bravely and said in a  ______ 18 ______  tone, “Whatever, let bygones be bygones.” Then she thanked me and walked away, relaxed. Letting go. Yes, I know that’s what we have to do. As I sat alone in the quiet house, I thought about the old lady and how she faced the loss of her dog through death. I suddenly realized I was a little  ______ 19 ______  crying over my loss, which is just a natural part of human development, not life and death. In this kind of loss, we can  ______ 20 ______  ourselves by celebrating the growth of our children, feeling the satisfaction of having done our best to prepare them to face the challenges in their lives. We can be glad that they are where they need to be, and grateful for our role in letting them go.

questions.prompt: In  ______  opinion, natural wonders are more fantastic than man-made ones.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我看来，自然奇观比人工奇观更奇妙。 考查代词辨析。me我，宾格；my我的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词；myself我自己。in one’s opinion“在某人看来”，此空应填my，故选B。

questions.prompt: He was born  ______  a cold winter evening 15 years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：他出生在15年前一个寒冷的冬天的晚上。 考查时间介词用法。from从；at后接具体的时刻；on后接具体的一天；in后接某年某月某季节。“a cold winter evening ”是具体的一天的晚上，所以此空应填on，故选C。

questions.prompt: When people  ______  the USA, they can see the Statue of Liberty.
questions.explanation: 句意：当人们参观美国时，他们可以看到自由女神像。 考查时态。此句是when引导的时间状语从句，根据“they can see the Statue of Liberty”可知，时态为一般现在时，主语为“people”，谓语动词用原形。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Why are you so late today? —Three buses went by without stopping while I at the bus stop.
questions.explanation: 句意：-你今天为什么怎么晚？-当我正在公交车站等车的时候，有三辆车经过但都没有停。am waiting正在等，现在进行时态；waited是过去式，一般过去时态；have waited现在完成时；was waiting过去进行时。根据对话的意思可知，等车是过去发生的事情，并且这里表示“正在等车的时候…”，故应用过去进行时，选D。

questions.prompt: Don’t worry. Bill will help you look after your dog when you  ______  away on business.
questions.explanation: 句意：别担心。你出差时比尔将帮助你照顾你的狗。 考查从句中的动词时态。When引导的时间状语从句时态是主将从现，可知本从句的时态是一般现在时，故选A。

questions.prompt: His grandparents live  ______ in a small house, but they don’t feel  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：他的爷爷奶奶单独住在一个小房子里，但是并不感到孤独。 考查形容词和副词的用法。alone作形容词时，意思为“独自的，单独的”只能做表语，做副词时意思为“独自，单独”；lonely作形容词意思为“孤独的，寂寞的，偏僻的，荒凉的”，既可作定语又可作表语。alone强调客观上“无伴，独自一人”；而lonely表示“感情上孤独，寂寞”，强调内心的主观感受。第一空需要填副词alone，表达“独自、单独”的意思，修饰动词live；第二空需要填形容词lonely，表达“孤独的，寂寞的”意思，作表语。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Is Cindy at home? —No, she  ______  the library. She  ______  there a moment ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Cindy在家吗？——不在，她去图书馆了。她刚才去那儿。 考查时态。have/has gone to“去了某地（未回来）”；have/has been to“去过某地（已经回来了）”。根据“Is Cindy at home?”和“No”可知，Cindy去了图书馆还未回来，应用has gone to；再根据“a moment ago”可知，第二空时态为一般过去时，应用过去式went。故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  we were tired, we didn’t stop doing our work.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然我们很累，但我们没有停止工作。 考查连词辨析。Because因为；If如果；Although尽管；But但是。根据“... we were tired, we didn’t stop doing our work.”可知，尽管很累，但没有停止工作；前后句为让步关系，故应用Although引导让步状语从句。故选C。

questions.prompt: You shouldn’t board the plane  ______  the announcer says it’s boarding time.
questions.explanation: 句意：在广播说该登机之前，你不应该登机。 考查连词辨析。after在……之后；for因为；because因为；until直到。根据“You shouldn’t board the plane... the announcer says it’s boarding time.”可知，你不应该登机，直到广播播报登机时间；not... until“直到……才”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mom, could you please  ______  the TV? I’m writing my homework right now and I need to be fully focused. —OK, my dear.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，你能把电视关了吗？我现在正在写作业，我需要全神贯注。——好的，亲爱的。 考查动词短语。turn up出现；turn down拒绝；turn on打开；turn off关闭。根据“I need to be fully focused”可知，做作业需要全神贯注，说明是要关掉电视机，turn off符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: He  ______  to pass the driving test, which made him pleased.
questions.explanation: 句意：他设法通过了驾驶考试，这使他很高兴。 考查动词辨析。manage设法做到；try尝试；succeed成功；operate操作。根据“which made him pleased.”可知他设法通过驾驶考试，所以很开心，succeed用于succeed in doing sth结构中，不符合，故选A。

questions.prompt: —I wonder when you  ______  the new car. Well, I  ______  it for two weeks.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想知道你什么时候买的这辆新车。我已经买了两个星期了。 考查动词的时态和延续性动词的用法。根据句意可知，空一强调动作发生的时间，应用一般过去时，动词用过去式bought，故排除A、D项；根据空后“for two weeks”可知，空二所在的句子应用现在完成时，构成形式为：have/has done；且动词要用延续性动词；buy为非延续性动词，应转化成延续性动词have，其过去分词为had。故选C。 五、完形填空（每小题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A 14-year-old boy from the USA was described as a hero yesterday. That’s because he saved the life of a girl in another country. Dean Bluey from Dallas, Texas, was a schoolboy who has much interest in going online. One day, he sent an email to a friend on the Internet. Suddenly he received a  ______ 13 ______  saying “Help! Pain! Help!” The message was from Finland, thousands of kilometers away from America. “I didn’t know what I should do,” Dean said to a reporter afterwards. “It was really  ______ 14 ______  to tell if the message was real.” So Dean did  ______ 15 ______  at first. But the message kept coming. “By then it was easy to see that someone was  ______ 16 ______,” Dean explained. He found that the sender was a student called Tarja, who was alone in a university library. She was ill. What was worse, there was no phone around her. Her only way of  ______ 17 ______  the world was by email. Dean got in touch with the police  ______ 18 ______. And they realized that the situation was quite serious. They called the police in Finland. Then an ambulance  ______ 19 ______  to the library.  ______ 20 ______, she was still alive and was sent to the hospital quickly. “I’m glad she’s OK,” Dean said. “It’s hard to believe, but the email saved her life.”

questions.prompt: I'm sorry I didn't call you. I didn't find  ______  phone number.
questions.explanation: 句意：很抱歉，我没给你打电话。我没找到你的电话号码。 考查代词辨析。my我的；his他的；your你的；her她的。根据上文“call you”，可知，没找到你的电话号码，故选C。

questions.prompt: The People’s Republic of China was founded  ______  October 1st, 1949.
questions.explanation: 句意：中华人民共和国成立于1949年10月1日。 考查介词辨析。in强调时间段，与年、月、周、季节、早晨（上午）、下午或晚上等名词连用；on用于星期几，节日，具体某一天或具体某一天的上午、下午或晚上前；at与具体时刻连用；of……的。根据“October 1st, 1949”可知，1949年10月1日为具体某一天，其前需用介词on修饰。故选B。

questions.prompt: Deng Yaping trained hard  ______  she became a great player later.
questions.explanation: 句意：邓亚萍努力训练所以她后来成为了一个伟大的运动员。 考查连词辨析。because因为，从属连词，表原因；if如果，从属连词，引导条件状语从句；so所以，并列连词，表结果；while当……的时候，从属连词，引导时间状语从句。根据语境可知，“Deng Yaping trained hard”与“she became a great player later.”之间为因果关系，且后句为结果，空处需填并列连词，表结果，so“所以”，并列连词，表结果，符合语境。故选C。

questions.prompt: We must hand in our homework  ______  we get to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们一到学校就必须交作业。 考查状语从句从属连词辨析。as soon as一……就……，引导时间状语从句，从句动作一方生，主句动作就随即发生；before在……之前，引导时间状语从句，主句动词在从句之前；although虽然，引导让步状语从句；so that所以，引导结果状语从句。根据语境可知，我们到学校就必须交作业，此处从句“我们到学校”一发生，主句“我们必须交作业”就随即发生，as soon as表示“一……就……”，引导时间状语从句，符合语境。故选A。

questions.prompt: I think the Terracotta Army is one of  ______  wonders in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为兵马俑是世界上最奇妙的奇迹之一。 考查最高级。one of the+形容词最高级+复数名词，表示“最……之一”，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Jason, don't make so much noise. Anna  ______  for her math exam. —Sorry, Mum. I won't.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰森，别这么吵。安娜正在为她的数学考试而学习。——对不起，妈妈。我不会了。 根据情景“don't make so much noise”可知安娜此时正在学习，所以用现在进行时；现在进行时结构为：be(am, is,are)+doing，故选B。

questions.prompt: Mum  ______  in the garden reading when I got home yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我到家时，妈妈正坐在花园里看书。 考查时态。A项是一般现在时；B项是一般过去时；C项是过去进行时；D项是现在进行时。根据从句when I got home yesterday可知，当我昨天到家时，爸爸正在做某事，所以应该使用过去进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: When I was on my way home, it  ______  to rain.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我回家的路上，天开始下雨了。 考查时态。A项为一般现在时；B项为一般过去时；C项为一般将来时；D项现在完成时。根据从句When I was on my way home可知，应该使用过去时态。故选B。

questions.prompt: It is really a great movie. I  ______  it several times.
questions.explanation: 句意：这真的是很棒的电影。我看过好几次了。 考查时态辨析。see看，一般现在时；saw一般过去时；will see一般将来时；have seen现在完成时。根据“several times”，表示看过几次，用现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: I will tell her the good news when she  ______  back from work.
questions.explanation: 句意：她下班回来时，我会告诉她这个好消息。 考查主将从现原则。comes动词come的三单形式；came动词come的过去式；will come一般将来时；has come现在完成时，主语为单数。根据“I will tell her the good news when she...back from work.”可知，句子为when引导的时间状语从句，且主句为一般将来时，遵循主将从现原则，从句时态为一般现在时，主语为she，第三人称单数，谓语动词用三单形式，comes为动词三单形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: 一 Do you know  ______  at weekends? — I'm not sure. You can check it online.

When they reached one of the famous mountains, they were surprised to see many people already climbing it. John and his friends put on their gear(装备)and started climbing. In no time at all, they reached the top of the mountain. His friends thought they could  ______ 13 ______  there for some time and then go back. Then John saw another mountain that only a handful of people were trying to climb. He told his friends, “Let’s go and climb that mountain instead of camping here. It will be fun and  ______ 14 ______!” A friend replied, “No way. It seems very difficult to climb and only a few people are climbing it now.” John wanted to take on the challenge and started walking toward the mountain. Two hours later he reached the top. The people at the top  ______ 15 ______  John with a round of applause(掌声). John was very happy to see the beautiful views of  ______ 16 ______. If people could reach that peak(顶峰), they can reach this one if they put in some  ______ 17 ______!” An experienced climber smiled and said, “Most people in the crowd down there are happy with what they find easy. They don’t think that it is possible to  ______ 18 ______  more. Even people who aren’t happy down there don’t want to take any risks. They think that if they take risks, they will  ______ 19 ______  what they already have. The reality is, to reach a new peak, you just need effort. Many of them do not show any  ______ 20 ______  and they remain part of the crowd their whole life. They also complain about the handful of courageous people by saying that they’re just lucky!” After hearing this, John thanked the experienced climber for explaining the importance of courage in life.

questions.prompt: Most people think that doing exercise can keep  ______  fit.
questions.explanation: 句意：大多数人认为做锻炼能让他们保持健康。 考查代词。they他们，是主格形式；them他们，是宾格形式；their他们的，是形容词性物主代词；theirs他们的（东西），是名词性物主代词。作为动词keep的宾语，用宾格形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: What do you plan to do for your mother  ______  Mother’s Day?
questions.explanation: 句意：你打算在母亲节为你的母亲做些什么？ 考查介词。in+年/月，表示在某年或某月；at+钟点，表示在几点钟；on+具体日期，表示在具体某一天，on+节日，表示在某个节日；to向。根据“Mother’s day”可知，在母亲节，用介词on，故选C。

questions.prompt: We must finish the work by Friday,  ______  we will miss the chance.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们必须在星期五之前完成这个工作，否则我们将错过这个机会。 考查连词。and而且；but但是；or否则；so所以。结合句意，如果我们不在星期五之前完成这项工作，我们将错过这个机会，因此用连词or，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Excuse me,  ______  I have the seat by the window? — Sorry. It has been taken.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰了，我可以坐靠窗户的位子吗？——对不起。它已经被占了。 考查情态动词。must必须；should应该；need需要；may可以。根据“Excuse me,”可知，此处表示请求允许，用May I...?“我可以……吗？”故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you help with clean-up at school? — Twice a month
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久在学校帮忙打扫一次卫生？——一个月两次。 考查特殊疑问句。how many多少，对可数名词的数量提问；how much多少钱，对价格提问；how long多长时间，对时间段提问；how often多久一次，对频率提问。根据“Twice a month.”可知，此处对频率提问，故选D。

questions.prompt: The film Hi, Mom makes us understand our parents  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：电影《你好，李焕英》让我们比以前更理解我们的父母。 考查副词。well好地；better更好地；best最好地；the best最好地。根据than可知，此处用比较级better，故选B。

questions.prompt: My father  ______  CCTV news when I arrived home yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我到家的时候，我爸爸正在看中央电视台的新闻。 考查时态辨析。根据“when I arrived home yesterday”可知此处是when引导的时间状语从句，表示某事发生的时候另一件事正在进行，从句用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时，其结构为was/were doing。故选A。

questions.prompt: Today, even children  ______  winter Olympic sports.
questions.explanation: 句意：如今，就连孩子们也喜欢冬季奥林匹克运动。 考查动词时态。根据“Today”可知本句是一般现在时，主语是复数名词，谓语动词用原形。故选D。

questions.prompt: Beijing  ______  several thousand volunteers to Hetian, Xinjiang since 1997.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从1997年开始，北京已经向新疆和田输送了好几千名志愿者。 考查时态。根据“since 1997”可知句子用现在完成时，其结构是have/has+done。故选C。

questions.prompt: Some trees  ______  in our neighborhood every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们小区每年都种一些树。 考查一般现在时的被动结构。根据“every year”可知，本句时态为一般现在时；主语Some trees与plant之间是动宾关系，因此此处用一般现在时的被动结构am/is/are done。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Tom is an honest boy,  ______  he? —Yes. We trust him all the time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆是一个诚实的孩子，不是吗? ——是的，我们一直信任他。 考查反意疑问句，由两部分组成：前一部分是一个陈述句，后一部分是一个简短的疑问句，两部分的人称时态应保持一致。 1．陈述部分肯定式+疑问部分否定式。 2．陈述部分否定式+疑问部分肯定式。这里前一部分是肯定的形式，所以后半部分用否定的形式，故排除B、C；因为前面的动词是系动词is，所以后半部分也用is，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Could you please tell me  ______  every day? — Usually in the evening.

choices.label: C
choices.text: when do you do some reading

choices.label: D
choices.text: when did you do some reading

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你每天什么时候阅读吗？——经常在晚上。 考查宾语从句。根据every day和usually可知，此处用一般现在时，排除BD;作为动词tell的宾语从句，用陈述语序，排除C。故选A。 二、完形填空（每小题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Magic of Waving It began a year ago, around Christmas. While driving around the corner of our townhouse sports center, I always noticed an old man sitting by his front yard. He was usually smoking or drinking and looked grumpy (脾气不好). One day, while I was driving past him with my daughter, I decided to  ______ 13 ______  at him with a lot of excitement. At the beginning, when he noticed me waving at him, he looked a bit shocked (惊愕的). Then, I saw his  ______ 14 ______  go up and he waved back. “Why did you wave at him?” my daughter asked. I told her that it was just an act of kindness that didn’t  ______ 15 ______  anything, and it gave both him and me a sense of joy. She responded by saying that she was a bit embarrassed (局促不安) to wave to a  ______ 16 ______, but next time she would try it as well. Lucky for us, we lived close to the old man, so we saw him rather often. Whenever we drove by, both of us would wave at him and, pretty soon, the old man  ______ 17 ______  waving at everyone who passed by his house. One day, my daughter’s friend came to visit and she told my daughter that she saw this strange old man near our home who waved at her very  ______ 18 ______. She mentioned that she waved back at him, even though she didn’t know him, and that it felt really good. Upon hearing this, my daughter told her friend the story of how all the waving began. Her friend responded, “Tell your mom that’s really  ______ 19 ______!” Other friends made similar comments (评论), and this response taught my daughter just how much an act of kindness can be very natural and effortless, if you really want to do it. It showed us how giving happiness benefited both both the giver and the receiver. Inspired by all these positive effects, we’re planning to give our elder waving neighbor a thank-you card, to express our thanks for the warmth that he communicated through his enthusiastic waves. And to thank him for  ______ 20 ______  this simple joy with all who pass by his house.

questions.prompt: Betty likes reading books. J. K. Rowling is  ______  favorite writer.
questions.explanation: 句意：Betty喜欢读书。J. K.罗琳是她最喜欢的作家。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；her她的；him他。此处是修饰writer，所以应用形容词性物主代词her，其他选项不符合，故选C。

questions.prompt: It’s getting cold. Everyone needs to wear warm clothes  ______  winter.
questions.explanation: 句意：天气变冷了。在冬天每个人都需要穿暖和的衣服。 考查介词辨析。in后接年、月、季节等；on后接具体某一天等；at后接具体时刻等；to到。根据“winter”可知此处表示“在冬天”，用介词in。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Jeff, whose book is this? —It  ______  be Carla’s. I found her name on its cover.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰夫，这是谁的书？——它一定是卡拉的。我在封面上发现了她的名字。 考查情态动词。 can能；may也许；must必须；need需要。根据“I found her name on its cover.”可知这本书一定是卡拉的。故选C。

questions.prompt: —How are you feeling now, Jane? —Much  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——简，你现在感觉怎么样？——好多了。 考查形容词比较级。good好的；better更好的；best最好的；the best最好的。much用来修饰比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: You’d better take a taxi,  ______  you will be late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：你最好乘出租车，否则你上学要迟到了。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；or否则；so所以。此句是“祈使句+and/or+陈述句”的结构，最好乘出租车，否则就要迟到，应用or，故选C。

questions.prompt: Peter didn’t feel like eating anything and his face  ______  so pale yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得昨天什么都不想吃，他的脸看起来很苍白。 考查一般过去时。根据“didn’t feel”和“yesterday”以及“and”可知，句子为一般过去时，故空格处应用过去式looked。故选D。

questions.prompt: Look! George  ______  an online lesson. Don’t make a noise.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！乔治正在网上上课。不要制造噪音。 考查现在进行时。根据“Look”可知，句子为现在进行时，故应用“be doing”结构。故选D。

questions.prompt: If Jeff loses the game, his coach  ______  him out of the team.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果杰夫输了比赛，他的教练就会把他踢出球队。 考查时态。if引导的条件状语从句遵循主将从现原则，主句用一般将来时，其结构为will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: Susan  ______  in her room when the alarm clock went off.
questions.explanation: 句意：闹钟响时，苏珊正在房间里睡觉。 考查动词时态。根据“Susan...in her room when the alarm clock went off.”可知，强调在过去的时间点，正在发生的动作，用过去进行时，故选A。

questions.prompt: Jim  ______  a lot from the social work since he joined the projects at school.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从吉姆参加学校的社会工作项目以来，他从社会工作中学到了很多东西。 考查时态。根据“since he joined the projects at school”可知用现在完成时，其结构为have/has done。故选D。

questions.prompt: Lots of flowers  ______  on both sides of the street on National Day every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年国庆节，街道两旁都有许多鲜花。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“every year”可知，句子为一般现在时，故排除选项C和D。根据“Lots of flowers”可知，“许多花”和“展示”为被动关系，故应用“be done”结构。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______, Mary? —Yes. Perhaps in a few months.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玛丽，你知道宇宙飞船什么时候回来吗？——知道。也许几个月后。 考查宾语从句。根据“Do you know”可知，空格处为宾语从句，此时从句应用陈述句语序，故排除选项B和D。根据“Perhaps in a few months”可知，引导词应用when。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分） Never Give Up My foot still didn’t heal(愈合) from an earlier injury(伤) before our school sports meeting. I even  ______ 13 ______  whether I should take part in the meeting. But finally I was standing at the starting line, ready for the 3000-meter run. “Ready…set…” the gun popped(砰) and we all rushed off. A few minutes later, when I saw the other  ______ 14 ______  running ahead(在前面) of me, I felt very ashamed(惭愧) as I fell farther and farther behind. “Hooray!” shouted the crowd. It was the loudest cheer I heard in the race. The first-place runner was two laps(圈) ahead of me when she  ______ 15 ______  the finishing line.” Maybe I should drop out.” I thought as I moved on along the track. However, I made up my mind to keep running. For the last two laps in the race, I ran in  ______ 16 ______  and decided not to take part in the race next year. “It won’t be worth(值得的) even if my foot has healed.” I thought. When I got to the finishing line, I heard another cheer,  ______ 17 ______  than the one I heard earlier. I turned around and saw the boys preparing for their race. I thought they must be cheering for the boys. I was leaving  ______ 18 ______  when several girls came up to me. “Wow, you’ve got courage(勇气)!” one of them told me. “Courage? I’ve just lost the race!” I thought. “All of us were  ______ 19 ______  for you. Did you hear us?” said one girl. After hearing these words, I suddenly regained(重新获得) hope. I realized strength and courage weren’t always measured(衡量) in medals and victories, but in the difficulties we  ______ 20 ______. The strongest people were not always the people who won, but the people who didn’t give up when they failed.

questions.prompt: Lucy and Ann are my classmates and  ______  often help me.
questions.explanation: 句意：Lucy 和 Ann是我的同学，而且他们经常帮助我。 考查人称代词辨析。A. they他们，主格；B. them他们，宾格；C. their他们的，形容词性物主代词；D. theirs他们的，名词性物主代词。缺少主语，所以代词要用主格形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: We 'll have a trip to America  ______  February.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们将会在2月去美国旅游。 考查介词的辨析。A. of……的；B. at在……点钟，后跟具体时间；C. on在……上，一般具体某一天的早中晚；D. in在，后跟月份。February是二月，接月份的介词用in。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tom was ill,  ______  he didn't come to the English party last Friday.
questions.explanation: 句意：Tom生病了，所以他上周五没有来英语派对。 考查连词辨析。A. for因为；B. or或者；C. so所以；D. but但是。根据句意可知，前后句表示因果关系。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is your best friend? —Linda. I like her very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：——谁是你最好的朋友？——Linda，我非常喜欢她。 考查疑问词辨析。A. What什么，指东西；B. Who谁，指人；C. Why什么，指原因；D. Where哪里，指地方。根据回答，指谁。故选B。

questions.prompt: Bob, you  ______  keep quiet in the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：Bob，你在图书馆里必须保持安静。 考查情态动词辨析。A. can可以；B. may可能；C. must必须；D. need需要。图书馆里有规定必须保持安静，所以表示“必须”的意思。故选C。

questions.prompt: Don't make a noise! My mother  ______  now.
questions.explanation: 句意：不要制造噪音，我妈妈现在正在睡觉。 考查现在进行时用法。A. will sleep一般将来时；B. is sleeping现在进行时；C. slept一般过去时；D. have slept现在完成时。根据now可知此句是现在进行时，结构是“be动词+动词ing形式”。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing at this time last night? —I  ______  a phone call.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天晚上这个时候你在做什么？——我在打电话。 考查过去进行时。根据“What were you doing at this time last night?”可知，这里应该用过去进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Oh, I left my notebook in your house. —Don't worry. I  ______  it to school tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——噢，我把我的笔记本落在你家了。——不要担心，我明天会把它带去学校。 考查一般将来时辨析。tomorrow“明天”是一般将来时的标志词，所以用一般将来时，结构“will+动词原形”。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Your dress looks really nice. —I  ______  it in a small shop last week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的裙子看起来很好看。——我上礼拜在一个小店里买的。 考查一般过去时态。根据last week“上周”可知是一般过去时，动词要用一般过去式，buy是不规则动词变化。故选D。

questions.prompt: Rose  ______  Chinese since 2012.She is a good teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：Rose自从2012年就教中文了。她是一位好老师。 考查现在完成时。根据since 2012可知是现在完成时，结构是“have/has+动词过去分词”，Rose是第三人称单数，所以用has。故选B。

questions.prompt: A new park  ______  near my home next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：一个新的公园明年将在我家附近建起来。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。A new park和“修建”是被动关系，所以要用被动语态，结构是“be动词+动词过去分词”；根据next year可知是一般将来时，所以be动词要用will be。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Lily, could you tell me ______ last night? —Oh, I went to the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Lily，你能告诉我昨晚去哪里了么？——嗯，我去了图书馆。 考查宾语从句时态和语序辨析。宾语从句用陈述语序：引导词+主语+谓语，排除BD；last night是过去时间，宾语从句中主句用一般过去式，从句如果不是客观事实或者真理，也要用一般过去式。故选A。 二、完形填空（共8分, 每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 One of my favorite high school teachers was Mrs. Ide. She was my  ______ 13 ______  teacher and the leader of our choir (合唱团). It was Mrs. Ide who asked me to  ______ 14 ______  the school choir. Mrs. Ide was a great teacher, because she believed in all of us and was a musical genius (天才). Mrs. Ide always had  ______ 15 ______  topics for her music class. She had ideas to make them fun every time. We worked in groups in class. We studied for musicals（like Cats, My Fair Lady）and everyone of us had a part to act and sing. When we  ______ 16 ______  studying our parts, we had a “creative evening”, where all our families, friends and teachers came and watched our play. Mrs. Ide believed in our musical talents. She taught us to be self-confident with our voices and how to use different skills to  ______ 17 ______  our singing. She told us every week that we all had great talent, and it felt really good that she had such confidence in our musical  ______ 18 ______. I can say that Mrs. Ide was the best teacher and she  ______ 19 ______  cared about us. She helped everyone in her class to be more self-confident. Also she taught us skills, so that we were able to train at home alone. She was the person who  ______ 20 ______  me to study singing. I really hope that there are other teachers like her, who are an inspiration (鼓舞人的人) for students and their future.

questions.prompt: We couldn’t finish the work so early  ______  your help.
questions.explanation: 句意：没有你的帮助，我们不可能这么早完成工作。 考查介词辨析。with有；for为了；by通过；without没有。根据“We couldn’t finish our work so early... your help”可推知，没有你的帮助，我们不可能这么早完成工作。故选D。

questions.prompt: Be quiet! The students  ______  a physics test in the next room.
questions.explanation: 句意：安静！学生正在隔壁房间进行物理测试。 考查现在进行时。根据“Be quiet!”可知，学生应该是“正在进行”测试，用现在进行时，其谓语结构是：am/is/are+动词的现在分词。故选A。

questions.prompt: We will stay at home if my aunt  ______  to visit us tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果我的阿姨明天要来看望我们，我们会待在家里。 考查条件状语从句的主将从现。根据“if my aunt…to visit us tomorrow”可知该句为if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，主句采用一般将来时，从句采用一般现在时来表示将来的动作。且主语my aunt为第三人称单数，因此谓语动词应用动词的第三人称单数形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: That’s not a hard job. I’m sure I can  ______  it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这不是一项困难的工作。我相信我能做到。 考查动词辨析。control控制；manage设法做到；rule统治；hold持有。根据“That’s not a hard job”可知这项工作自己可以做到，故选B。

questions.prompt: Write to me as soon as you  ______  to Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：你一到北京就给我写信。 考查动词时态。as soon as“一……就……”，引导时间状语从句，遵循主将从现原则，从句用一般现在时，主语是you，动词用原形，故选C。

questions.prompt: She was  ______  angry  ______  she couldn’t say a word.
questions.explanation: 句意：她气得一句话也说不出来。 考查结果状语从句。too...to...太……而不能；so...that...如此……以致于……；very...that...错误格式。根据“she couldn’t say a word”可知，是一个句子，因此用so...that...引导，故选B。

questions.prompt: The family had to stay at the hotel  ______  it was raining hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：因为雨下得很大，这家人不得不住在旅馆里。 考查从属连词。although尽管；because因为；until直到；unless除非。根据语境可知，此处存在因果关系，空格后为原因，故应用because引导原因状语从句。故选B。

questions.prompt: Jerry stayed up late last night.  ______  he was sleepy in the class.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰瑞昨晚熬夜了。难怪他上课昏昏欲睡。 考查词组辨析。No problem没问题；No idea不知道；No wonder难怪；No matter无论。根据“Jerry stayed up late last night”可知，他昨晚熬夜了，所以上课昏昏欲睡不足为奇。故选C。

questions.prompt: We were in Qingdao last week and  ______  great fun there.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周我们在青岛并且我们玩得很高兴。 考查时态。根据“We were in Qingdao last week and...great fun there”可知此处描述过去的动作，用一般过去时，动词用过去式。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Judy, you look so tired. —Yes, I didn’t go to bed  ______  12 o’clock last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Judy，你看起来很累。——是的，我昨天晚上直到12点才睡觉。 考查连词辨析。when当……时候；unless除非；after在……之后；until直到，经常和not连用。根据“I didn’t go to bed”以及“12 o’clock last night.”可知，直到12点才上床睡觉，not...until“直到……才……”，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Why were you in such a hurry yesterday morning? —I hurried  ______  I could catch the early bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天早晨你为什么这么匆忙？——我匆匆忙忙为了我可以赶上早班车。 考查连词辨析。so that因此，以便；since既然，由于；as if好像；but但是。根据“I hurried... I could catch the early bus.”可判断，我匆匆忙忙的目的是能赶上早班车，空后句子是目的状语从句，so that“以便”引导目的状语从句。故选A。

questions.prompt: —No one is allowed to use this room. Can’t you see the sign “ ______ ”. —Oh, sorry. I didn’t notice it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——任何人不允许使用这个房间。难道你没有看到这标牌吗？——哦，对不起。我没有注意到。 考查交际用语。No touching“不要触摸”；No entrance“禁止进入”，entrance入口，名词，指入口这个具体的事物；Don’t touch“请勿触摸”；No entry“禁止进入”，entry进入（权利），名词。强调进入的权利。根据“No one is allowed to use this room.”可推测，牌子上写的是“禁止进入”，强调的是禁止进入的权利。故选D。 二、完形填空（共8分, 每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Born to Draw Jenna looked at the calendar and sighed （叹气）. Even though she looked forward to the new term, she would miss spending her summer vacation  ______ 13 ______. It was so satisfying to see how her drawings could bring life to her storytelling! When she talked about her dream job with her parents, she expected them to  ______ 14 ______  her choice of becoming a comic illustrator. Instead, they explained that drawing comics was a hobby, not a career （职业）. Jenna couldn’t stop thinking about that unpleasant conversation, so she turned to her elder brother, James. But as she spoke, the look on her brother’s face told her that he agreed with their parents. Jenna politely listened to her brother and then she walked back to her room  ______ 16 ______. Jenna told Miss Bridwell that she was  ______ 17 ______  because her parents didn’t support （支持）her in becoming a comic illustrator. I simply told him the truth. I explained that I enjoyed writing, and that I wanted to get better and to write. I guess my  ______ 18 ______  came through, and he believed me. ” Miss Bridwell’s story  ______ 19 ______  Jenna a lot, so she decided to discuss her ideas with her parents again. It didn’t happen immediately, but in the end, they came to understand that Jenna’s  ______ 20 ______ for drawing comics was more important than whether it was the career they wanted for Jenna.

questions.prompt: —Where is Jack? I can’t find. —Look! He is over there.
questions.explanation: 句意：—杰克在哪里？我找不到他。—看！他在那边。 考查人称代词。me我；you你；him他；her她；根据文中的Jack及He可知，这里指代的是男性，find是动词，后面要接宾语，宾语用宾格充当，故选C。 【点睛】英语中人称代词分为主格和宾格。主格做主语，宾格做宾语，所以做题要理解句子结构，分析在句中的成分，本题代词做宾语，所以用宾格。

questions.prompt: I went to Tian’anmen Square with my friends National Day.
questions.explanation: 句意：国庆节我和我的朋友去了天安门广场。 考查介词辨析。in在……里；on在……时；at在……点钟；from从……起；根据句意理解可知，这里表达的是“在国庆节”，是指具体的某一天，英语中具体到某一天要用介词on，故选B。 【点睛】时间介词in，at，on的用法要注意区别。口诀为：时间长的要用in，年代、季节和月份；具体某天要用on，几月几号，星期几；时间点时用at，包括noon和night；上下午晚上很特殊，单独出现要用in，具体描述要用on。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Mike! Would you like to fly kites with me? —I’d like to go but I can’t,  ______  I have to finish my question survey first.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，迈克！你愿意和我一起放风筝吗？——我很想去，但是我不能去，因为我必须先完成我的问题调查。 考查连词辨析。because因为；until直到；so因此；while当……时。“I have to finish my question survey first”是“I’d like to go but I can’t”的原因，用because引导原因状语从句。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you help your parents with the housework, David? —Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——David，你多久帮父母做一次家务？——一周一次。 考查特殊疑问句。how much多少；how often多久一次；how long多久；how far多远。根据“Once a week”可知，此处对频率进行提问，用how often引导特殊疑问句，故选B。

questions.prompt: They to build Xinshougang Bridge in 2016. It was a great project!
questions.explanation: 句意：他们于2016年开始修建新首钢大桥。这是一个伟大的工程！ 考查一般过去时。根据句意理解及句中的in 2016可知，这里动词应该用一般过去时，start的过去式要加ed，故选C。 【点睛】动词时态的选择要根据时间标志词来判断，不同的时间标志词代表着不同的时态。本题中in 2016是过去时的标志词，所以动词用过去时。

questions.prompt: — Hi, Henry. I called you last night, but you didn’t answer. — Sorry. I TV at that time.
questions.explanation: 句意：—嗨，亨利。我昨晚打电话给你，但你没接。—对不起。我那时正在看电视。 考查过去进行时。根据句意理解及句中的at that time可知，这里表达的是“那时正在做某事”，英语中要用过去进行时，结构是was/ were doing形式，主语是I，所以要用was，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Tina, what do you usually do at weekends? —I  ______  swimming with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tina，你周末通常做什么？——我和我的朋友们去游泳。 考查时态。根据“what do you usually do at weekends”可知此处表示习惯性的动作，用一般现在时，主语是I，谓语动词用原形。故选B。

questions.prompt: The air this year is much than that of last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：今年的空气比去年好多了。 考查形容词的比较级。good好的；better更好的；best最好的，前面缺少the；the best最好的；根据句意理解及句中的than可知，这里要用比较级的形式，故选B。 【点睛】英语中形容词的形式要注意。用比较级还是最高级要根据句意理解及句中的某些标志词来判断。本题中根据句中的标志词than可知，要用比较级形式。

questions.prompt: Sarah to a concert during her stay in Shanghai last month.
questions.explanation: 句意：上个月Sarah在上海逗留期间被邀请去听音乐会。 考查被动语态。invites邀请，动词三单；invited邀请，过去式；is invited被邀请，一般现在时被动；was invited被邀请，一般过去时的被动；根据句意理解可知，这里主语和动词之间是被动关系，所以确定要用被动语态，而句中的时间是last month，所以要用一般过去时的被动语态，故选D。 【点睛】英语中被动语态的用法要注意。首先确定句子主语和动词之间是被动关系，然后再根据句中的时间判断用哪个时态的被动结构。

questions.prompt: — Mum, when can we eat? — Dinner ready in two minutes
questions.explanation: 句意：—妈妈，我们什么时候能吃？—晚饭两分钟后就好。 考查一般将来时。根据句意理解及句中的时间in two minutes可知，这里要用将来时，结构是will+动词原形，故选D。

questions.prompt: China national women’s volleyball team the world champion for many times.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国女排多次获得世界冠军。 考查现在完成时。根据句意理解可知，这里表达的是“赢得”，英语是win，而句中有for many times，由此判断为现在完成时，结构是have/ has+过去分词，主语是单数名词，所以这里用has，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me? —It makes me happy and relaxed.
questions.explanation: 句意：—你能告诉我你为什么喜欢摄影吗？—它使我快乐和放松。 考查宾语从句。根据句子结构可知，tell是动词。后面接的句子是宾语从句，首先根据宾语从句要用陈述句语序排除A/ C选项，再根据句中的makes可知，这里应该用现在时，排除D选项，故选B。 【点睛】英语中宾语从句的考题做题时要注意。可以分三步走。第一步：确定引导词。根据句意理解来确定用哪个词引导；第二步，看语序。根据“宾语从句必须用陈述句语序”的原则来排除一部分答案，比如本题中A/ C答案可直接排除；第三步，看时态。根据“主现从不限，主过从必过”的原则确定从句时态，但要排除从句表达客观事实或者真理时只用现在时；利用这三点即可确定选项答案。 五、完形填空：阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。（共 8 分，每小题 1 分） I looked out at the smiling faces packed into the school gym. questions.prompt: — ______  do you volunteer in the care home? —Once a week.

questions.prompt: We have a lovely room. It's one of  ______  in the hotel.

questions.prompt: —Can you ride a horse? —No, I  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会骑马吗？——不，我不会。 考查一般疑问句的否定回答。needn’t不需要；may not不可以；can’t不会；mustn’t禁止。根据题干可知，此句是以can开头的一般疑问句，且为否定回答，所以使用can’t。故选C。

questions.prompt: Paul and I  ______  tennis yesterday. He did much better than I.

questions.prompt: Where's Tom? His mother  ______  him now.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：汤姆在哪里？他的妈妈现在正在找他。根据句意及时间状语now可知此题应用现在进行时态，故选A。

questions.prompt: My aunt is a writer. She  ______  more than ten books since 1980.

questions.prompt: I will send you an e-mail as soon as I  ______  in Canada.
questions.explanation: 句意：我一到加拿大就给你发邮件。 考查动词的时态。as soon as “一……就……”，引导时间状语从句，如果主句是将来时或表示将来含义时，从句要用一般现在时，句中主句“I will send you an e-mail”是一般将来时，所以从句用一般现在时。故选A。

questions.prompt: Many accidents  ______  by careless drivers last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年许多事故是粗心的司机造成的。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。本题主语“Many accidents”与谓语动词“cause”是被动关系，而且整体时态从yesterday可知是一般过去时，因此这里是一般过去时的被动语态，且主语是复数，因此be动词是were，cause过去分词是caused。故选B。

questions.prompt: I love our teachers.  ______  are always ready to help us.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢我们的老师。他们总是乐于帮助我们。 考查代词辨析。they他们；you你/你们；we我们；he他。此空指代前文提到“teachers”，用代词they指代，故选A。

questions.prompt: The activity is going to begin  ______  3:30 this Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：活动将于本周五下午3:30开始。 考查时间介词辨析。at表示某一具体时刻（即几点几分时）；on表示“在具体的某一天”或“（在具体的某一天的）早上、中午、晚上”等；in用于表示一段时间，或用于年、月、日、世纪、四季或泛指一天的上午、下午、晚上等，还可用于表示“从现在起，多长时间以后或多久以后”；of……的，表示所属关系。根据3:30是具体时刻，可知应用at；故答案选A。

questions.prompt: —Must we get to the theater at 7: 00? —No, you  ______. The movie begins at 8: 00.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们必须在7点钟到达剧院吗？——不，你们不必。电影8点钟开始。 考查情态动词。can’t不可能，不能；mustn’t禁止；needn’t没必要；shouldn’t不应该。根据“Must we get to”及回答“The movie begins at 8: 00”可知表达“你们不必”，否定回答用“needn’t/don’t have to”。故选 C。

questions.prompt: Robin is a great actor, he is also a good father.
questions.explanation: 句意：罗宾是一个伟大的演员，他也是一个好父亲。 考查连词。or或者；but但是；so所以；and并且。前后句是并列关系，and表示并列，用于逻辑为并列关系的句子，在此题中符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: This postcard looks  ______  than the one I bought yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：这张明信片看起来比我昨天买的那张更好。 考查形容词比较级。good好的，形容词原级；better更好，比较级；best最好，最高级；the best最好，最高级。根据“than”可知，此处用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  Kenny since she went to England to study.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从Kenny去英国学习以来，我就没有收到过她的信。 考查动词时态。since+一般过去时的句子，主句用现在完成时结构，故选C。

questions.prompt: He you the answer as soon as he works it out.

questions.prompt: — Is Mike at home? — No. He  ______  with his friends now. A swims
questions.explanation: 句意：——迈克在家吗？——不，他现在正在和他的朋友们游泳。 考查现在进行时。根据“now”可知，该句为现在进行时，其谓语结构是：be+动词的现在分词。故选B。

questions.prompt: It was snowing when they  ______  at the railway station.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们到达火车站时正在下雪。 考查动词时态。arrive到达 ，一般现在时；are arriving现在进行时；arrived一般过去时；were arriving过去进行时。根据“It was snowing when…”可知此处是when引导的时间状语从句，主句时态是过去进行时，且“arrive”是短暂性动作，从句应用一般过去时，故选C。

questions.prompt: He was  ______  tired  ______  he fell asleep as soon as he lay down.
questions.explanation: 句意：他太累了，一躺下就睡着了。 考查so...that...结构。AC中to是不定式符号，其后加动词原形，“he fell asleep as soon as he lay down”是句子，排除AC。tired是形容词，用so修饰，such修饰名词。故选B。

questions.prompt: My grandma didn’t go to sleep  ______  I got back home.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的奶奶直到我回到家才去睡觉。 考查连词的用法。where在哪里；until直到；as soon as 一……就……；while当……时候。not....until....“直到……才……。” 故选B。

questions.prompt: My sister is only six, but  ______  can already help with some housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹只有六岁，但她已经能帮忙做一些家务了。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；it它；they他们。此处指“My sister”，用she，故选B。

questions.prompt: We plant trees in the park  ______  spring every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们每年春天都在公园里植树。 考查时间介词辨析。at后接具体时刻；to到；in后接某年某月某季节；on后接具体一天。spring“春天”，是指季节，前要用时间介词in修饰，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is your home from school? —About a 10-minute walk.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从你家到你的学校有多远？——大约10分钟的步行路程。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长，问的是物体的长度或多长时间；How often多久一次，问的是频率；How far多远；问的是两地之间的距离；How soon多久以后，对表示将来的一段时间进行提问。根据答语“About a 10-minute walk.”可知，这里回答的是两地的距离提问，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Must I return this book before Wednesday, Madam? —No, you  ______. You can keep it for two weeks.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我一定要在周三前还这本书吗，女士？——不，不需要。你可以借两个星期。 考查动词辨析。mustn’t禁止；can’t不能；needn’t不需要；shouldn’t不应该。must提问的疑问句的否定回答用“needn’t/don’t have to/doesn’t have to”。故选C。

questions.prompt: I think body language is  ______  the spoken language.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为肢体语言和口语一样重要。 考查形容词原级用法。important重要的，形容词；importantly重要地，副词。此空是作is的表语，应用形容词，排除AB选项。so...as“和……一样”，一般用于否定句，此处是肯定句，应用as...as。故选D。

questions.prompt: It might be a boy’s room  ______  the clothes look like a boy’s clothes.
questions.explanation: 句意：这可能是一个男孩的房间，因为衣服看起来像男孩的衣服。 考查连词辨析。when当……时候；because因为；but但是；so所以。分析题干可知，前后句是因果关系，前果后因，应用because引导原因状语从句，故选B。

questions.prompt: Alice often  ______  the fun of making kites with us. She is so creative.
questions.explanation: 句意：Alice经常和我们分享做风筝的乐趣。她很有创造力。 考查一般现在时。根据“often”可知，本句需用一般现在时，主语是“Alice”，谓语需用单数形式。“share”分享，是动词，其单数形式是“shares”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Zhang Guimei  ______  in less-developed areas for 40 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：张桂梅已经在欠发达地区工作40年了。 考查现在完成时。根据“for 40 years”可知她已经在欠发达地区工作40年了，句子应用现在完成时，谓语结构是have/has done。故选C。

questions.prompt: Don’t lose heart. If you keep working hard, you  ______  some day.
questions.explanation: 句意：不要灰心。如果你继续努力，将来某一天你会成功的。 考查if引导的条件状语从句。if表示“如果”时遵循“主将从现”原则，即主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时；空格处于主句位置，故用一般将来时。故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  for the bus after school when it began to rain cats and dogs.
questions.explanation: 句意：放学后我在等公共汽车时开始下大雨。 考查时态。根据“when it began to rain cats and dogs”可知下雨的时候正在等车，表示过去某个时间点正在做某事，用过去进行时was/were doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: On our farm, the tea leaves  ______  by hand when they are ready.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我们的农场，茶叶成熟时都是手工采摘的。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语“the tea leaves”是动作“pick”的承受者，时态是一般现在时，所以用一般现在时的被动语态。故选C。

questions.prompt: My mother is busy these days, so I often help  ______ with housework.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈最近很忙，所以我经常帮她做家务。 考查人称代词宾格。her她；him他；me我；you你，四个单词都是人称代词宾格。根据主语My mother is busy these days可知，帮助的对象是my mother，所以用her代替。故选A。

questions.prompt: There will be an English movie in our school  ______  the evening of June 30.
questions.explanation: 句意：6月30日晚上我们学校将有一场英语电影。 考查介词辨析。at后跟具体的时刻；in后跟年、月、季节或泛指的上午、下午、晚上；for为了；on后跟具体到天的时间。根据“the evening of June 30”可知，时间具体到了6月30日的晚上，所以用介词on，故选D。

questions.prompt: I thought the actor was famous,  ______  none of my friends has ever heard of him.

questions.prompt: — ______ does your mother go to the supermarket? —Once a week.

questions.prompt: — Peter, have you ever been to the English Corner? — Oh, yes. I  ______  there to practice speaking once a week last term.

questions.prompt: Zhaozhou Bridge is one of  ______  stone bridges in the world.

questions.prompt: David, you  ______  take your umbrella. It is not raining.

questions.prompt: ______  they are twin sisters,  ______  they don’t look like each other.

questions.prompt: If there  ______  anything I can do to help, please let me know.

questions.prompt: I  ______  that movie several times, and I still want to see it again.

questions.prompt: Mr. Johnson met an old friend when he  ______  down the street.

questions.prompt: The World Wildlife Day falls  ______  March 3rd every year.

questions.prompt: Our parents help and support us a lot,  ______  we should be thankful to them.

questions.prompt: My mother asks me to get up early  ______  I can catch the bus.

questions.prompt: Mrs. Young  ______  in Beijing since 2008. She loves this city.

We can add a sensor (传感器) to the door. So when our robot goes along and comes across those rocks, it will open the door and pick them up,” he explained. The team thought about it. “Actually, that might work. The fact that the robot is  ______ 17 ______  these things rather than just moving them might give us extra points,” Lily said. The four set to work,  ______ 18 ______  but quickly assembling their pre-designed robot, then adding the door with the extra parts they had brought. It was hard, and time was running out. As the buzzer (计时器) rang, Toby placed the last part on the robot. It was time for Toby’s team to compete. They set their robot on the course and watched it make its way and meet the first rock. It stopped for a second, and the members of the team  ______ 19 ______  their breath. Then the machine opened its door and slid (滑行) across the small rock. When it passed over the rock, the rock disappeared —  ______ 20 ______  in the robot’s secret box. The team cheered, knowing they were one step closer to the championship.

questions.prompt: Mr. Jackson is a popular writer, and we all like reading  ______  books.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克逊先生是个受欢迎的作家，我们都喜欢读他的书。 考查物主代词。his他的；her她的；their他们的；your你/你们的。根据空后有名词books，可知需要填形容词性物主代词；又根据前一句Mr. Jackson is a popular writer，可知此处是指“喜欢读他的书”，故选A。

questions.prompt: The 24th Beijing Winter Olympics opened  ______  February 4th, 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：第二十四届北京冬季奥运会在2022年2月4日开幕。 考查介词辨析。in表示在（年、月、季节）；on表示在具体的某一天；for后面加时间段；at表示在具体时间点。根据“February 4th, 2022”可知是具体的某一天。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the library to do volunteer work? —Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去图书馆做一次志愿者工作？——一周一次。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少，多少钱；How many多少，提问可数名词复数的数量；How often多久一次；How long多久。结合语境和答句可知第一个人一周去图书馆一次做志愿者工作，本题对频率进行提问，所以空处用How often。故选C。

questions.prompt: It’s very difficult for me to learn French,  ______  I don’t want to give it up.
questions.explanation: 句意：对我来说学法语很难，但是我不想放弃。 考查连词辨析。but但是，becasue因为，or或者，so所以。根据“difficult”和“don’t want to give it up”可知前后两句是转折关系，用but。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Mr. White, must I hand in my homework now? —No, you  ______. You can give it to me tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——怀特先生，我必须现在交作业吗？——不，你不需要。你可以明天交给我。 考查情态动词用法。mustn’t禁止；needn’t不需要；shouldn’t不应该；won’t不会。分析句子可知，问句是由must提问的，表示必须，肯定回答用must；否定回答用needn’t。故选B。

questions.prompt: Beijing, the capital of China, is one of  ______  cities in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意；北京，中国的首都，是世界上最现代化的城市之一。 考查形容词最高级的用法。根据“Beijing, the capital of China, is one of...cities in the world.”可知，此处是“one of+the+最高级+名词复数”结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: Jack will send you an e-mail as soon as he  ______  in London.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克一到伦敦就会给你发邮件。 考查动词的时态。as soon as “一……就……”，引导时间状语从句，遵循“主将从现”的原则，即主句使用一般将来时，从句使用一般现在时；主语he是第三人称单数，谓语动词应使用三单形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  Mr. Smith since he moved to Shanghai.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从史密斯先生搬到上海以来，我一直没有收到他的信。 考查现在完成时。根据“since he moved to Shanghai”可知，此处为现在完成时，因主语是I，故用助动词have not+过去分词，故选D。

questions.prompt: She is a great tennis player. She  ______  playing tennis when she was five.
questions.explanation: 句意：她是一位极好的网球运动员。她五岁时开始打网球。 考查动词时态。分析句子可知，本句为when引导的时间状语从句；由“when she was five.”可知，主句描述的是过去发生的事情，时态为一般过去时，谓语动词应使用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: The students  ______  about the art show happily when I passed by.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我经过时，学生们正在愉快地谈论艺术展。 考查动词时态。根据“when”以及分析题干可知，本句是含有when的过去进行时，表示过去正在发生的动作，故选D。

questions.prompt: Today Chinese is very popular and it  ______  by more and more people all over the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天，汉语非常流行，并且全世界讲汉语的人越来越多。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。speak，“说”，动词。speaks动词的单三形式，用于一般现在时；spoke动词过去式，用于一般过去时；is spoken，一般现在时的被动语态；was spoken，一般过去时的被动语态。根据“Today”今天，可知是要用一般现在时；it指代的是Chinese，与speak之间为被动关系，所以要用一般现在时的被动语态。故选C。

questions.prompt: — We had a hot discussion about our summer trip just now. — Cool! Have you decided?
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们刚刚就暑期旅行进行了一次热烈的讨论。 ——酷！你决定去哪儿了吗？根据Have you decided ______. 可知，本题考查了宾语从句，宾语从句中一般为陈述语序，选项A/B是疑问句语序，应排除掉；又因为about our summer表示一个将来的时间，所以问句应该用一般将来时，故选D。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选择能填入相应空白处的最佳选项，将其字母代号写在题前括号内。 I was crazy about baseball. My baseball glove was always close by: either under my desk or my chair at school. My biggest dream was to play big-league baseball like my favorite star, Billy Hawkins. My favorite  ______ 13 ______  of the school day was the time when I could take out my glove and play catch. My teacher, Ms. Welles, told me to leave my glove at home, but I was lost without my glove. During break, I stood around with sad eyes and drooping shoulders, and in class I was always quiet. She also told me that I could do better in my studies if I concentrated on(集中精力于……) them. It was true. One day, Ms. Welles introduced a special guest to the class—Billy Hawkins! I was  ______ 14 ______! Billy said, “If you want to be a ball player, it’s important to study bard in school.” “What does school have to do with baseball?” I asked. “I’ll show you by giving you a baseball  ______ 15 ______.” said Billy. “Here’re three questions. Each student who answers all the three questions correctly will win two tickets to a Leopards game!” I was sure I could answer the questions. The first question was, “How do you  ______ 16 ______  a player’s batting average (击球率)?” I wasn’t sure how to do the math on it. For the second question, Billy handed out an article about baseball. It  ______ 17 ______  several words I didn’t understand. The third question was which team had won the World Champion when George Bush became President.  ______ 18 ______  I knew about the World Champion winners, I didn’t know much about Presidents. Nobody got all the three answers right. Luckily, we would have another chance the following week. That week, we all helped each other. The students who were good with numbers taught the others how to work out the averages. The  ______ 19 ______  readers helped with the difficult words, and the best history students helped with important dates and names. When we took the second baseball test, we answered all the questions correctly, and the whole class won the tickets! That afternoon at the stadium, I asked my hero to  ______ 20 ______  on my souvenir (纪念品) baseball. It read, “Keep working hard in school. See you in the big leagues! Billy Hawkins.”

questions.prompt: —Amy, would you please pass  ______  the salt? —Sure, here you are.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Amy，请把盐递给我好吗？——当然，给你。 考查代词辨析。I我，人称代词主格；me我，人称代词宾格；my我的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词。此空位于动词pass后，应填代词宾格作宾语，故选B。

questions.prompt: —When do you leave home for school? —I usually leave  ______  7 o’clock in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你什么时候离开家去上学？——我通常在早上7点离开。 考查时间介词辨析。at后接具体时刻；on后接具体一天；in后接某年某月某季节；during在……期间。“7 o’clock”是具体的时刻，应填介词at，故选A。

questions.prompt: The invention of airplanes makes travelling much  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：飞机的发明让旅行比以前容易多了。 考查形容词比较级的用法。根据句中的than“比”可知，than是形容词比较级的标志词，所以空格处应填形容词的比较级形式，easy的比较级是easier。故选C。

questions.prompt: I will call you as soon as I  ______  the tickets for the concert.
questions.explanation: 句意：我一拿到音乐会的票就给你打电话。 考查时态辨析。as soon as引导的时间状语从句，遵循主将从现原则，从句用一般现在时表将来。故选A。

questions.prompt: The rain is heavy now. You need to put on your raincoat,  ______  you will get wet.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在雨下得很大。你需要穿上雨衣，不然你会淋湿的。 考查并列连词辨析。or否则，不然；and和，又；but但是；so因此。根据“you will get wet”可知，下雨了你得穿雨衣，否则会被淋湿，因此应用表示“否则”的连词or来连接。故选A。

questions.prompt: - ______  can you get to the airport? -In about 30 minutes. I'm on the way.
questions.explanation: 句意：-你多快能到达机场？-大约30分钟之后能到，我在路上呢。How soon多快，多久；How long多长时间；How much多少；多少钱；How often多久一次，提问频率。根据答语In about 30 minutes可知，这里应问的是“多快能…”，故应选A。

questions.prompt: ______  Aron has lost his right arm,he never gives up his dream to climb mountains.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然阿伦失去了右臂，但他从未放弃登山的梦想。 考查连词辨析。Since自从；Although尽管；Unless除非；If如果。根据“Aron has lost his right arm,he never gives up his dream to climb mountains”可知，前后句是让步关系，用although引导让步状语从句，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What did you do last weekend? —We  ______  a picnic in the park. It was a nice day.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上周末你做了什么？——我们在公园里野餐。那是一个美好的日子。 考查动词时态。根据“last weekend”可知问句是一般过去时，后面答句也用一般过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: —The water here is so clear, isn’t it? —Yes, I  ______  see the colorful fishes swimming in it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这里的水很清澈，不是吗？——是的，我能看到五颜六色的鱼在里面游泳。 考查情态动词。shouldn’t不应该；mustn’t禁止；need需要；can能。根据“Yes”可知认为水很清澈，能看到五颜六色鱼在里面游。故选D。

questions.prompt: My sister Ann  ______  as a nurse since she finished university.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹安从大学毕业后就一直当护士。 考查动词时态。根据“since”可知本句的时态是现在完成时：hav/has done，故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  the book to your mother if I can’t meet you this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果今天中午我见不到你的话，我会把这本书交给你的妈妈。 考查时态。if引导的条件状语从句，从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时，空格处属于主句部分，应用一般将来时，其结构为will do，所以用will give。故选D。

questions.prompt: 一Do you know  ______? 一Next Wednesday.

questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道寒假什么时候开始吗？——下周三。 考查宾语从句。根据句意理解可知，这里是宾语从句，首选宾语从句必须用“陈述句语序”，即引导词+主语+谓语+其他，所以排除A/ C，再由回答Next Wednesday可知，这里应该用将来时，故选B。 【点睛】英语中宾语从句的考题做题时要注意。可以分三步走。第一步：确定引导词。根据句意理解来确定用哪个词引导；第二步，看语序。根据“宾语从句必须用陈述句语序”的原则来排除一部分答案，比如本题中B/ C答案是疑问句语序，直接排除；第三步，看时态。根据“主现从不限，主过从必过”的原则确定从句时态，但要排除从句表达客观事实或者真理时只用现在时；利用这三点即可确定选项答案。 五、完形填空 (共12分，每小题1.5分) I used to consider being a line leader as something embarrassing.I felt ______ 13 ______ when I thought of having my classmates stare at the back of my head. Finally, it came.Waking up that morning, I tried not to think about it.I never considered myself much of a ______ 14 ______ or one to have such qualities, but little did I know I was wrong.As I was getting off the bus, I had that butterfly feeling in my stomach. I quietly sat down at my desk.I was ______ 15 ______ my teacher wouldn't notice me and maybe she would forget it was my day.When she announced that I was today's leader, I was terrified She asked everyone to line up behind me and announced that we would be going to the library.I ______ 16 ______ exactly where the library was. “This will be easy,” I said to myself. I turned off the lights, and headed to the library."Hey, this is kind of ______ 17 ______! My leadership qualities ______ 19 ______ me outside of school.In the soccer field, I gave a speech about how I thought I would be a great captain I was voted captain, which gave me even more ______ 20 ______ and made me feel that with my leadership, I could do anything.

questions.prompt: As a good teacher, Mrs. Green is always happy to answer  ______  questions.
questions.explanation: 句意：作为一个好老师，格林夫人总是乐于回答我们的问题。 考查代词辨析。we我们，人称代词主格；us我们，人称代词宾格；our我们的，形容词性物主代词；ours我们的，名词性物主代词。设空处修饰后面的名词复数“questions”。因此应用形容词性物主代词。 故选C。

questions.prompt: Chinese people always admire the full moon ______ the Mid-Autumn night.
questions.explanation: 句意：在中秋节夜晚中国人总是赏月。 根据考查介词。in+年/月，表示在某年或某月；at+钟点，表示在几点钟；on+具体日期，表示在具体的某一天；表示在某一天的上午、下午或晚上，用介词on。for+时间段，表示长达多长时间。此处接the Mid-Autumn night.，表示在中秋节的晚上，用介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: Amy used to be really short, but she looks much  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意: 艾米过去很矮, 但她现在看起来比以前高多了。 考查形容词比较级。tall，是形容词，意为“高的”；根据“than”，可知这里使用形容词比较级。 故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you improve your pronunciation, Jane? —By listening to a tape and repeating out aloud.
questions.explanation: 句意：——简，你是怎样提高你的发音的?——通过听磁带并大声地重复。 考查疑问词辨析。how如何；what什么；why为什么；when什么时候。根据答语“By listening to a tape and repeating out aloud.”可知，要问“你如何提高你的发音的”，要填“如何”， 故选A。

questions.prompt: Jack went to an international kite festival and he  ______  many different kinds of kites there.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克去参加一个国际风筝节，他在那里看到了许多不同种类的风筝。 考查一般过去时。根据“Jack went to an international kite festival”可知，时态是一般过去时，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Where is your little brother, Larry? —Look! He  ______  up for the Halloween there.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你小弟弟在哪里，拉里？ ——看！他正在那里为万圣节打扮。 考查现在进行时。dresses动词第三人称单数形式，在一般现在时中主语为第三人称单数时使用；will dress一般将来时；dressed一般过去时；is dressing现在进行时。由“Look!”可知本句时态是现在进行时，动词结构为“be+doing”。 故选D。

questions.prompt: If he keeps absent from class, he  ______  the examinations this term.
questions.explanation: 句意: 如果他一直缺课，他这学期的考试就会不及格。 考查动词时态。fail是动词。意为“失败”；根据“If he keeps absent from class”可知if引导条件状语从句用一般现在时，主语应该使用一般将来时“will+动词原形”。 故选A。

questions.prompt: Alice and Judy came into the concert while the musician  ______  the piano on the stage.
questions.explanation: 句意：当音乐家在舞台上弹钢琴时，爱丽丝和朱迪走进了音乐会。 考查时态。根据“Alice and Judy came into the concert while the musician...the piano on the stage”可知当她们进来时，音乐家正在弹钢琴，用过去进行时was/were doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: The teenagers  ______  a lot of social work since they became volunteers two years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从两年前成为志愿者以来，这些青少年做了很多社会工作。 考查现在完成时态。根据句中的“since”可知，其后跟一般过去时，主句用现在完成时，所以空白处填“have done”。 故选D。

questions.prompt: On our farm, the tea leaves  ______  by hand when they are ready.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我们的农场，茶叶成熟时都是手工采摘的。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语“the tea leaves”是动作“pick”的承受者，时态是一般现在时，所以用一般现在时的被动语态。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______  every day, Susan? —Yes. At 7:00 p.m.
questions.explanation: 句意：——苏珊，你知道书店每天什么时候关门吗？——知道。晚上7点。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句用陈述语序，排除BD；根据“At 7:00 p.m.”可知，询问的是书店关门的时候，应用when引导宾语从句。故选C。 Ⅱ、完形填空 Never Give Up My foot still didn’t heal(愈合) from an earlier injury(伤) before our school sports meeting. I even  ______ 13 ______  whether I should take part in the meeting. But finally I was standing at the starting line, ready for the 3000-meter run. “Ready…set…” the gun popped(砰) and we all rushed off. A few minutes later, when I saw the other  ______ 14 ______  running ahead(在前面) of me, I felt very ashamed(惭愧) as I fell farther and farther behind. “Hooray!” shouted the crowd. It was the loudest cheer I heard in the race. The first-place runner was two laps(圈) ahead of me when she  ______ 15 ______  the finishing line.” Maybe I should drop out.” I thought as I moved on along the track. However, I made up my mind to keep running. For the last two laps in the race, I ran in  ______ 16 ______  and decided not to take part in the race next year. “It won’t be worth(值得的) even if my foot has healed.” I thought. When I got to the finishing line, I heard another cheer,  ______ 17 ______  than the one I heard earlier. I turned around and saw the boys preparing for their race. I thought they must be cheering for the boys. I was leaving  ______ 18 ______  when several girls came up to me. “Wow, you’ve got courage(勇气)!” one of them told me. “Courage? I’ve just lost the race!” I thought. “All of us were  ______ 19 ______  for you. Did you hear us?” said one girl. After hearing these words, I suddenly regained(重新获得) hope. I realized strength and courage weren’t always measured(衡量) in medals and victories, but in the difficulties we  ______ 20 ______. The strongest people were not always the people who won, but the people who didn’t give up when they failed.

questions.prompt: My aunt is a doctor at a children’s hospital.  ______  always works very hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姑妈是一家儿童医院的医生。她总是工作很努力。 考查人称代词。She她；He他；We我们；They他们。根据“My aunt…”可知，此处指代上文中提到的“aunt”，故用She指代。故选A。

questions.prompt: He often plays basketball with his friends  ______  Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：他经常在星期天早上和朋友们一起打篮球。 考查介词辨析。at后加具体时刻；in后加某年某月某季节；on后加具体的某一天或某一天的早中晚；for后加一段时间。根据“Sunday morning”可知具体到星期天早上，应用介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Must I finish the task tonight? —No, you  ______. You can do it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天晚上我必须完成这项任务吗？——不，你不必。你可以明天完成。 考查情态动词。mustn’t禁止；shouldn’t不应该；needn’t没必要；can’t不能。根据“You can do it tomorrow.”可知今天晚上不必完成这项工作，在这里是作出否定回答。由must引导的一般疑问句表示否定回答时需要用needn’t或don’t have to来回答，故选C。

questions.prompt: She didn’t see the film yesterday  ______  she had a headache.
questions.explanation: 句意：她昨天没有看电影，因为她头疼。 考查连词辨析。because因为；so所以；but但是；or或者。根据“She didn’t see the film yesterday...she had a headache.”可知前后是因果关系，因为头疼，所以昨天没有看电影。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go swimming? —Once or twice a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去游泳一次？——一周一次或两次。 考查疑问词组辨析。How long多久；How far多远；How soon多快；How often多久一次。根据“Once or twice a week.”可知询问去游泳的频率，用How often提问。故选D。

questions.prompt: The band finished off their show with one of  ______  songs.
questions.explanation: 句意：乐队以一首最受欢迎的歌曲结束了他们的演出。 考查形容词的最高级。根据固定结构：one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数，表示“最……的……之一”，可知这里应用最高级形式，故选D。

questions.prompt: If you take this train, you  ______  in Shanghai in five hours.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你坐这趟火车，你将在五小时内到达上海。 考查时态。arrive一般现在时；will arrive一般将来时；arrived一般过去时；have arrived现在完成时。本题是以if引导的条件状语从句，时态上要符合“主将从现”，所以空格处应用一般将来时will do，故选B。

questions.prompt: The kids  ______  an online lesson when their parents arrived home yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天孩子们的父母回家时，他们正在上在线课程。 考查过去进行时。根据“when their parents arrived home yesterday”可知，句子强调过去某个时刻点正在发生的动作，主语为复数the kids，故用过去进行时were taking，故选D。

questions.prompt: When I  ______  at the hotel, it was very late.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我到达旅馆的时候，已经很晚了。 考查动词辨析。got后面接to，表示到达；reached到达，后面直接接地点，arrive到达，后面接介词at/in。根据“at the hotel”以及“it was very late”可知，时态是一般过去时，此处用arrived符合语境。故选C。

questions.prompt: All of us  ______  great progress since we started Grade 9.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从九年级开始，我们所有人都取得了很大的进步。 考查现在完成时。根据“since”可知，主句应用现在完成时：have/has+过去分词。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Could you please take a message for me to Jack? —Sure, I  ______  him about that as soon as I meet him.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能帮我带个信息给Jack吗？——当然，我一见到他就会告诉他。 考查动词时态。根据“I... him about that as soon as I meet him.”可知，as soon as引导的时间状语从句，从句为一般现在时，主句应用一般将来时will do。故选B。

questions.prompt: There is a new park next to my home. I  ______  a walk there every day. A took
questions.explanation: 句意：我家旁边有一个新公园。我每天都去那里散步。 考查时态辨析。根据“every day”可知要用一般现在时，主语“I”后接动词原形take。故选B。

questions.prompt: As soon as I  ______  to Guilin, I will send you a message.
questions.explanation: 句意：我一到桂林就给你写信。 考查动词时态。as soon as“一……就……”，引导时间状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，从句用一般现在时，故选A。

questions.prompt: My mother is a nurse,  ______  is very kind.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的妈妈是一名护士，她很善良。 考查人称代词。He他；She她；They它/她/他们；It它。根据题干My mother is a nurse,  ______  is very kind.可知My mother是女性，空后有系动词is，此处“她”为主语，所以用主格形式she，故答案选B。

questions.prompt: — What’s the weather like in Beijing  ______  October? — It is great, neither too hot nor too cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：——北京十月的天气怎么样？——它很棒，既不太热也不太冷。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体的时刻前面；on用于具体的某一天或具体某一天的上午、下午或晚上；in用在年、月、上下午的前面；with和、带有。根据“October”可知，在某月用介词in。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you clean your room, Cindy? —Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——辛迪，你多久打扫一次房间？——一周一次。 考查特殊疑问句。how long多久；how soon多久以后；how much多少；how often多久一次。根据“Once a week”可知，此处是对频率进行提问，用疑问词how often，故选D。

questions.prompt: She used to be shy and quiet,  ______  now she is outgoing..
questions.explanation: 句意：她过去害羞又安静，但是现在她很外向。 考查连词。or或者，否则；and和；so所以，因此；but但。空前“She used to be shy and quiet”和空后“now she is outgoing”有转折关系，所以用but表示转折。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mom,  ______  I watch the baseball game for a while? —Of course you can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我可以看一会儿棒球赛吗？——当然可以。 考查情态动词辨析。can能够，可以；must必须；should应该；need需要。根据“Of course you can”可知，一般疑问句用can开头，故选A。

questions.prompt: After years of practice, Jimmy can finally run  ______  than his older brother.
questions.explanation: 句意：经过多年的练习，吉米终于能跑得比他哥哥快了。 考查比较级。根据than可知，此处应用fast的比较级faster，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Your watch looks really nice. — I  ______  it in a small shop last week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的手表看起来真的很不错。——我上周在一个小商店买的。 考查时态。根据“ last week”可知描述的是过去发生的动作，用一般过去时态，动词用过去式bought。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Tim, you can read the Chinese on the menu! —Yeah. I  ______  Chinese for two years.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tim，你可以阅读菜单上的中文！——好的。我学中文已经两年了。 考查动词时态。for+一段时间，要与现在完成时一起连用，结构为have/has done，故选C。

questions.prompt: Kids  ______  to learn to cook some simple dishes now.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在的孩子们被要求学习烹饪一些简单的菜肴。 考查被动语态。根据now可知，此句是一般现在时。主语Kids与动词require之间是被动关系，所以此处用一般现在时被动语态am/is/are done的结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Peter, do you know  ______? —Next Monday..
