questions.explanation: 句意：——Peter，你知道读书报告什么时候到期吗？——下周一。 考查宾语从句。此处是宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，排除B和D选项。根据答语“Next Monday”可知，从句用一般现在时，故选A。 五、完形填空每题1.5分,共1阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 In the 7th grade, I was known as the smart girl—the girl who always got the highest grades. I don’t want my team to lose.” Anyway, the other team accepted me and the captain gave me a few  ______ 29 ______  before the game started. However, nothing worked. questions.prompt: My brother loves painting.  ______ often draws pictures after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥喜欢画画。放学后他经常画画。 考查代词辨析。I我；you你；he他；she她。根据“My brother”可知此处是指哥哥，应用he，故选C。

questions.prompt: In Beijing, more and more young children go skating  ______  winter.
questions.explanation: 句意：在北京，越来越多的孩子冬天滑冰。 考查介词辨析。at时间介词，后加具体时刻；in时间介词，后加年、月、季节；on时间介词，后加节日、星期和具体某一天；to方向介词，朝，向。表达“在冬季”用时间介词in。故选B。

questions.prompt: You  ______  stop at the red lights when you cross the road. A can
questions.explanation: 句意：过马路时，你必须在红灯时停下来。 考查情态动词辨析。can可以；would能；may可能；must必须。根据“…stop at the red lights when you cross the road.”和常识可知，此处指“你必须在红灯时停下来”。故选D。

questions.prompt: I am  ______  than my sister, so I often take care of her.
questions.explanation: 句意：我比我妹妹年纪大，所以我经常照顾她。 考查比较级。根据than可知，此空应填比较级older，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me,  ______  is the cap? —35 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——对不起，这顶帽子多少钱？——35元。 考查特殊疑问句。how much多少钱；how long多长时间；how big多大；how heavy多重。根据“35 yuan.”可知，此处提问价格。故选A。

questions.prompt: You need to take notes in class,  ______  you don’t have to write everything down.
questions.explanation: 句意：课堂上你需要记笔记，但你不必把所有的东西都写下来。 考查连词辨析。but但是；for因为；so因此；or或者。“You need to take notes in class”与“you don’t have to write everything down.”是转折关系，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Tony, where are you? I can’t find you. —I  ______  at the gate of the school.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼，你在哪里？我找不到你。——我正在学校门口等着。 考查现在进行时。根据“Tony, where are you? I can’t find you.”可知是问现在的情况，用现在进行时，表示正在发生的动作，其谓语动词构成为be+动词ing形式，主语是I，因此be动词用am。故选C。

questions.prompt: Jack  ______  an online meeting when suddenly the phone rang.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克正在网上开会，突然电话响了。 考查动词时态。根据“Jack...an online meeting when suddenly the phone rang.”可知，此处指电话铃声响的时候正在开会，句子时态为过去进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: Betty  ______  to the library every Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂每周六去图书馆。 考查一般现在时。根据时间状语“every Saturday”可知，句子的时态是一般现在时，表示经常性发生的动作，其谓语动词构成为：动词原形/动词第三人称单数，主语是“Betty”，因此此处用动词第三人称单数goes。故选A。

questions.prompt: I enjoy playing football. I  ______  football since I was five years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢踢足球。我从五岁起就踢足球了。 考查动词时态。根据“...since I was five years old.”可知，since+时间点，时态应使用现在完成时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Look! How beautiful the bowl is! I can’t believe it  ______  about 600 years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：看啊！这个碗多漂亮啊！我不能相信它是在大约600年前制造的。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。根据“I can’t believe it…about 600 years ago.”可知，it和谓语动词之间是被动关系，由“600 years ago”可知，事情发生在过去，因此此处用一般过去时的被动语态，其谓语动词构成是was/were done，主语是“it”，因此be动词用was。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Miss Li, could you tell us  ______  your winter holiday? — Sure. I will visit some museums.
questions.explanation: 句意：——李小姐，你能告诉我们你将如何度过寒假吗？——当然。我将参观一些博物馆。 考查宾语从句。句子是宾语从句，用陈述语序，排除BD；根据“I will...”可知从句用一般将来时will do。故选C。 Last Dance Every evening before my elder sister Anna and I went to sleep, we would spend five minutes having a dance party. After the five minutes were over, we were laughing so hard that both of us  ______ 15 ______  why we were angry. Mom made Anna’s favorite meal. Anna and I sat with Mom and Dad at the dinner table. I was  ______ 16 ______  to think this would be the last time we all ate together. But Anna ate  ______ 17 ______. “I want to go and say bye to my friend Jeanie!” she explained. Looking at the empty chair, I realized how much I  ______ 18 ______  those nightly dance parties with my sister. I couldn’t shake the feeling of how upset I would be if we didn’t have one last dance party. Some hours passed, and I began to get ready for bed, giving up on the thought that our last dance party would  ______ 19 ______. Suddenly I heard a knock on my door. “Are you still up?” “Yes. What are you doing?” Anna came in. “Julie, you didn’t seriously think I was going to leave tomorrow without us dancing one more time, did you?” Anna played the music and started dancing. I followed her lead, laughing. Though I hated to think of my sister leaving, the fact that this last dance was as  ______ 20 ______  to her as it was to me made the moment even more special.

questions.prompt: Sara is a kind girl and we all like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：Sara是个善良的女孩，我们都喜欢她。 考查人称代词。them他们；him他；his他的，形容词性物主代词/名词性物主代词；her她，人称代词宾格/形容词性物主代词。因为空前like为动词，所以此空应填人称代词宾格形式；又根据“Sara is a kind girl...”可知，Sara是女孩，应用人称代词her，故选D。

questions.prompt: I always visit my grandparents  ______  Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我总是在星期六下午去看望我的祖父母。 考查时间介词。on加具体某一天，具体某一天的早中晚；in加年月季节和早中晚；at加时刻点；of……的。因为“Saturday afternoon”为具体某一天的下午，所以应用介词on，故选A。

questions.prompt: I like reading books,  ______  I often go to the library after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢读书，因此我经常放学后去图书馆。 考查连词。and和；but但是；or否则；so因此。根据“I often go to the library after school”可知因为喜欢读书，所以才去图书馆，两句之间是因果关系，前因后果，应用so引导结果状语从句。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  I bring my ID card with me next time? — No, you needn’t. You can copy and store it in your phone.
questions.explanation: 句意：——下次我必须带来我的身份证吗？——不，你不必。你可以把它复制并储存在你的手机里。 考查情态动词的用法。May可以；Must必须；Should应该；Need需要。根据“No, you needn’t.”可知，此处使用must引导一般疑问句。故选B。

questions.prompt: My father is a common doctor, but he is  ______  of all in my heart.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父亲是一个普通的医生，但他在我心中是最伟大的。 考查最高级。根据“of all”可知，此处是三者及以上的比较，空处用最高级，且形容词最高级前需加冠词the。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  are you late again, Tom? — Sorry, Miss Li. Because I missed the early bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，为什么你又迟到了？——对不起，李女士，因为我错过了早班车。 考查特殊疑问句。Why为什么，询问原因；How怎么样，询问方式；When什么时候，询问时间；Where哪里，询问地点。根据答语“Because I missed the early bus.”可知，问句应是问迟到的原因。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Let’s make a cake, Linda. Is there any milk in the fridge? —Yes, mum. I  ______  some yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——琳达，我们一起去做蛋糕吧，冰箱里有牛奶吗？——有的，妈妈。我昨天买了一些。 考查一般过去时。have bought已经买（用于现在完成时）；bought买（用于一般过去时）；buy买（原形）；will buy将买（用于一般将来时）。根据“yesterday”可知，此句为一般过去时，谓语动词用过去式，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Sam is Jim in the classroom? Mr. Smith is looking for him. —No, he  ______  to the dining hall.
questions.explanation: 句意：——山姆，吉姆在教室吗？史密斯先生正在找他。——不，他去了食堂。 考查动词时态。根据“to the dining hall.”可知，这里指去了餐厅，没有回来，是过去的动作对现在产生了影响，应用现在完成时has gone to。故选C。

questions.prompt: My grandma  ______  dinner when I got home yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我到家时，我奶奶正在做晚饭。 考查时态。根据“when I got home yesterday”可知，when引导的时间状语从句时态为一般过去时，主句表示过去某一时间段正在做某事，用过去进行时，其谓语结构为：was/were+现在分词。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mum, don’t worry about me. I  ______  you as soon as I arrive in London. —Ok, take care of yourself.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，别担心我。我一到伦敦就给你打电话。——好的，照顾好你自己。 考查时态。根据“as soon as I arrive in London”可知，这是as soon as引导的时间状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，从句时态用一般现在时，主句时态用一般将来时。故选A。

questions.prompt: At the beginning of 2022, the Winter Olympic Games  ______  in Beijing and Zhangjiakou.
questions.explanation: 句意：2022年初，冬奥会在北京和张家口举行。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。“the Winter Olympic Games”与hold构成被动语态，根据“At the beginning of 2022”可知，时态为一般过去时，一般过去时的被动语态结构为：was/were+动词过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Peter, I want to visit the Capital Museum. Do you know  ______? —You can go with me this weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，我想参观首都博物馆。你知道我怎么去那里吗？——这个周末你可以和我一起去。 考查宾语从句。根据“Do you know...”可知，此空应填宾语从句，宾语从句应为陈述语序，所以排除选项A和C；又根据“You can go with me this weekend.”可知，本句时态应为一般现在时，故选B。 二、完形填空（共 8 分，每小题 1 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A Team for Trish Trish watched as all her classmates were divided into two teams for today’s lesson on basketball. Mr. Truman had named Amber and Jesse the two team leaders, and they were  ______ 13 ______  their teammates by who were the best athletes. That meant Trish was left last. “Trish, you’re with me,” Amber said, sounding  ______ 14 ______. Trish lowered her head and joined her team on the court. If only her classmates knew she was pretty good at basketball. Her older brother had taught her how to make a free throw, but Trish was sure no one in her class would give her a  ______ 15 ______  to show them. Once everyone was ready, Mr. Truman started the game. Jesse’s team was aggressive (有进攻性的). They covered all the players on Amber’s team, except for Trish. The girl who was supposed to cover Trish was blocking (阻拦) Amber from passing the ball. Trish moved across the court and met Amber’s  ______ 16 ______. She reached her hands out to show Amber she was open. Amber turned and looked for someone else to throw the ball to, but everyone was  ______ 17 ______. Trish lowered her arms thinking Amber was going to throw the ball away before she gave Trish a chance. But Amber passed the ball, bouncing (反弹) it under the arms of the two girls blocking her. Trish caught the ball and stared (盯着看) at it, still in  ______ 18 ______  that Amber had passed it to her. “Shoot(投篮)! ” Amber shouted. She threw the ball and watched as it bounced off the backboard and fell through the net. Trish’s teammates  ______ 19 ______. “Great shot!” Amber said, walking over to Trish. “Thanks,” Trish said. “My brother taught me how to play. We shoot baskets almost every night.” “You should come out and play with our team,” Amber said. “My friends and I play at the park every Saturday.” Trish thought about that. She thought playing basketball with the other girls would be  ______ 20 ______  and it might be a good chance for her to be a better self. “I think I will,” Trish said with a smile.

questions.prompt: My mother is a doctor in a hospital.  ______  always works very hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈是医院的一名医生。她工作总是很努力。 考查代词辨析。He他，主格；She她，主格；Him他，宾格；Her她，宾格。根据“... always works very hard.”可知，此处是作主语，应用主格形式；再根据“My mother”是女性可知，应用She。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tim often plays table tennis with his friends  ______  Saturday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：Tim经常在星期六早上和他的朋友们打乒乓球。 考查时间介词。for与一段时间连用；in用在年、月、季节等较长的时间前；on用于具体某一天的早中晚前；at用在时刻前。根据“Saturday morning”可知，应用时间介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Must I finish my homework tonight? —No, you  ______. You can do it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我今晚必须完成作业吗？——不，你没必要。你可以明天做。 考查情态动词的用法。mustn’t不得；needn’t不必；can’t不能；shouldn’t不应该。根据“Must I finish my homework tonight?”和“No”可知，must引导的一般疑问句，否定回答用needn’t/don’t have to。故选B。

questions.prompt: I didn’t go to school yesterday  ______  I had a terrible toothache.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我没有去上学，因为我牙痛得很厉害。 考查连词辨析。because因为；but但是；so因此；or或者。根据“I didn’t go to school yesterday... I had a terrible toothache.”可知，没去上学是因为牙疼得厉害，用because表示原因。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  did the three Chinese astronauts stay in the space station? —For six months.
questions.explanation: 句意：——三名中国宇航员在空间站待了多久？——六个月。 考查特殊疑问句。How often多久一次；How many多少；How soon多久以后；How long多久。根据“For six months.”可知，一段时间应用How long提问。故选D。

questions.prompt: In order to catch up with her classmates, Lily works  ______ than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了赶上同学，莉莉学习比以前更努力了。 考查比较级。hard努力的；harder更努力的；hardest最努力的；the hardest最努力的；根据句意理解及空格后的than可知，这里表达的是两者之间的比较，所以应该用比较级，表达“更努力的”，故选B。

questions.prompt: The children  ______  the volunteer work now.
questions.explanation: 句意：孩子们正在做志愿者工作。 考查时态。由“now”可知，时态为现在进行时，结构为be doing；主语是“The children”，故be动词应用are。故选D。

questions.prompt: Never give up. If you keep trying, you  ______  your goal some day.
questions.explanation: 句意：永不放弃。如果你继续努力，总有一天你会达到你的目标。 考查if条件从句。根据“If you keep trying”可知，此句是if条件从句，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时，故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  an online lesson when my phone rang yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我正在上网课，突然电话响了。 考查过去进行时。根据“when my phone rang yesterday”可知，强调电话响的那刻作者正在上网课，用过去进行时，故选C。

questions.prompt: Jack  ______  a lot about Chinese culture since he began to work in Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从杰克在北京工作以来，他学到了很多关于中国文化的知识。 考查时态。根据“since he began to work in Beijing”可知，该句是since引导的时间状语从句，主句应用现在完成时，结构为have done；主语为“Jack”，助动词用has。故选D。

questions.prompt: Two big natural parks  ______  near my hometown last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年在我家乡附近建了两个大的自然公园。 考查被动语态。分析句子可知，“公园”是“被建造”，故应用被动语态；再根据“last year”可知，时态为一般过去时，故应用一般过去时的被动语态，结构为was/were done；主语为“Two big natural parks”，be动词用were。故选B。

questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道运动会什么时候开始吗？——是的，我知道。明天早上八点。 考查宾语从句。根据“Do you know...”及选项可知考查宾语从句，应用陈述句语序，排除BD选项；再根据“At 8 o’clock tomorrow morning.”可知，从句时态为一般将来时，排除A选项。故选C。 二、完形填空。（共8分, 每小题1分） 阅读短文, 掌握其大意, 从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 ”You’re going to do WHAT?” I asked my best friend, Julie, in surprise. “I’m going to try out for the cheer-leading squad（啦啦队）,” she said, eyes fixed on the ground. We had been best friends since second grade and we did everything together, but now she was going off on her own. I was sure that if she joined the cheer-leading squad, she would become best friends with someone else and I couldn’t  ______ 13 ______  the thought. “Why are you doing this? Do you really want to hang around with those girls instead of me?” I cried  ______ 14 ______. “It’s not about the girls,” Julie said. “It’s about the  ______ 15 ______. I want to be on the squad at the high school level because they win scholarships（奖学金）at state competitions, and I have a better chance if I’m on the squad here,” she explained. “Besides, it’s not like I’m leaving the country or something.” “Goodbye,” I ran away, leaving Julie standing with a sad look on her face. The rest of that week I was unhappy, and I  ______ 16 ______  Julie in the hall. I planned to watch the first game and take no notice of Julie. Instead, I was  ______ 17 ______  by the enthusiasm（热情）and skill of Julie’s cheering. Although she was the youngest member of the team, Julie enthusiastically led cheer after cheer. I saw how her face  ______ 18 ______  up with joy. I was stunned（目瞪口呆）as I realized that she loved the sport. I walked to her, feeling ashamed（羞愧的）, but Julie smiled immediately. “Hey, you were really great. “I began, and then added quickly, “I’m so sorry I’ve been  ______ 19 ______  to you about your joining the squad.” Julie smiled and replied, “A group of us are going for ice cream. Why don’t you come along?” Julie’s warm reply made my eyes burn, but I smiled in return. As I walked toward the cheerleaders, I realized there was  ______ 20 ______  in Julie’s life for all of us.

questions.prompt: Grace likes reading books. J. K. Rowling is  ______  favorite writer.
questions.explanation: 句意：格蕾丝喜欢读书。J. K.罗琳是她最喜欢的作家。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；her她的；his他的。此处指“Grace”，作定语修饰“favorite writer”，故选C。

questions.prompt: It’s getting cold. Everyone needs to wear warm clothes  ______  winter.
questions.explanation: 句意：天气变冷了。在冬天每个人都需要穿暖和的衣服。 考查介词辨析。in后接年、月、季节等；on后接具体某一天等；at后接具体时刻等；to到。根据“winter”可知此处表示“在冬天”，用介词in。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Jeff, whose book is this? —It  ______  be Carla’s. I found her name on its cover.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰夫，这是谁的书？——它一定是卡拉的。我在封面上发现了她的名字。 考查情态动词。 can能；may也许；must必须；need需要。根据“I found her name on its cover.”可知这本书一定是卡拉的。故选C。

questions.prompt: —How are you feeling, Jane? —Much  ______. Thanks for your help.
questions.explanation: 句意：——简，你感觉怎么样？————好多了。谢谢你的帮助。 考查形容词比较级。much修饰形容词比较级，表示“好多了”，故选B。

questions.prompt: Betty prefers to watch horror movies on TV,  ______  she is too scared to watch them alone.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂更喜欢在电视上看恐怖电影，但她太害怕了，不敢一个人看。 考查连词辨析。and并且；but但是；or或者；so所以。根据“Betty prefers to watch horror movies on TV”和“she is too scared to watch them alone”可知，空格前后句为转折关系，故应用but。故选B。

questions.prompt: Peter didn’t feel like eating anything and his face  ______  so pale yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得昨天什么都不想吃，他的脸看起来很苍白。 考查一般过去时。根据“didn’t feel”和“yesterday”以及“and”可知，句子为一般过去时，故空格处应用过去式looked。故选D。

questions.prompt: Look! George  ______  an online lesson. Don’t make a noise.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！乔治正在网上上课。不要制造噪音。 考查现在进行时。根据“Look”可知，句子为现在进行时，故应用“be doing”结构。故选D。

questions.prompt: If Jeff loses the game, his coach  ______  him out of the team.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果杰夫输了比赛，他的教练就会把他踢出球队。 考查时态。if引导的条件状语从句遵循主将从现原则，主句用一般将来时，其结构为will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: Susan  ______  in her room when the alarm clock went off. She was frightened.
questions.explanation: 句意：闹钟响时，苏珊正在房间里睡觉。她很害怕。 考查过去进行时。根据“Susan...in her room when the alarm clock went off.”可知，强调在过去的时间点，正在发生的动作，用过去进行时，故选A。

questions.prompt: Jim  ______  a lot from the social work since he joined the projects at school.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从吉姆参加学校的社会工作项目以来，他从社会工作中学到了很多东西。 考查时态。根据“since he joined the projects at school”可知用现在完成时，其结构为have/has done。故选D。

questions.prompt: Lots of flowers  ______  on both sides of the street on National Day every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年国庆节，街道两旁都有许多鲜花。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“every year”可知，句子为一般现在时，故排除选项C和D。根据“Lots of flowers”可知，“许多花”和“展示”为被动关系，故应用“be done”结构。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______, Mary? —Yes. Perhaps in a few months.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玛丽，你知道宇宙飞船什么时候回来吗？——知道。也许几个月后。 考查宾语从句。根据“Do you know”可知，空格处为宾语从句，此时从句应用陈述句语序，故排除选项B和D。根据“Perhaps in a few months”可知，引导词应用when。故选C。 二、完形填空（每小题1分，共8分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Smart Game In our P. When we came into the court, I noticed that the other team had more experienced and athletic players than ours. At the beginning of the game, our team didn’t have a good start. We looked  ______ 16 ______  because our team had lost a few important teammates in a short time. Then I shouted at the moment: “Guys! Just keep our eyes on the balls and dodge!” To my joy, the light at the end of the tunnel（隧道）shone through. Our remaining teammates were making efforts to throw their balls and put many opponents out of the  ______ 17 ______. This made the other team disadvantaged with fewer numbers. Then all the members of our team nodded to each other and reached an agreement with a smile. We didn’t need to  ______ 18 ______  beat the other team. All we needed was just to have our last members try our best to avoid being hit and keep alive for the last five minutes! The plan  ______ 19 ______. All of our members played against the other team by dodging the balls. When the game came to an end, we had more people on the court! We won the match when the last whistle （哨声）blew. After the game, we realized that dodgeball also  ______ 20 ______  critical（批判性的）thinking. I learned that we could get out of the difficult situations successfully if we made good use of our brains.

questions.prompt: My brother and I like basketball.  ______  usually play together after school.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥和我喜欢篮球。我们通常放学后—起打。 考查代词辨析。I我；we我们；you你。根据“My brother and I like basketball”可知是我哥哥和我经常一起打篮球，用代词we。故选B。

questions.prompt: Her father is a doctor. He works  ______  a hospital.
questions.explanation: 句意：她的父亲是一名医生。他工作在一家医院。 考查介词辨析。on在……上；of……的；to朝……，位于；in在……内。分析句子可知，此处构成短语“in the hospital”，翻译为“在医院”，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me,  ______  is this hat? —It’s 20 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——对不起，这顶帽子多少钱？——20元。 考查特殊疑问句。how much多少钱；how many多少；how long多长时间；how old多大岁数。根据“20 yuan.”可知是问价格，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  you give me a hand? I can’t move the heavy desk by myself. —No problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能帮帮我吗？我一个人搬不动这个沉重的桌子。——没问题。 考查情态动词。must必须；need需要；could能；should应该。根据“give me a hand”可知，此处表示委婉地请求，应用情态动词could。故选C。

questions.prompt: He lived a hard life  ______  he didn’t give up writing.
questions.explanation: 句意：他过着艰苦的生活，但他没有放弃写作。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；so所以；because因为。根据“He lived a hard life”和“he didn’t give up writing”可知，前后两句表示转折，所以用转折连词but，故选B。

questions.prompt: This exercise is  ______  in the book. I can't do it at all.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个练习是书中最难的。我根本不会做。 考查形容词最高级。difficult困难的，形容词原级；more difficult更加困难的，形容词比较级；most difficult表述错误；the most difficult最困难的，形容词最高级。结合语境和空后“in the book”可知在这本书中，这个练习是最难的，作者一点儿都做不出来，因此这里用最高级。故选D。

questions.prompt: Listen! Mr. Li  ______  the erhu. How wonderful the music is!
questions.explanation: 句意：听!李先生在演奏二胡。多么美妙的音乐啊！ 考查时态。结合语境和空前“Listen!”可知，听的动作时正在进行的动作，用现在进行时。故选A。

questions.prompt: It’s nice to see you again. We  ______  each other since 2018. A won’t see
questions.explanation: 句意：很高兴再次见到你。我们自2018年以来就没有见过面。 考查现在完成时。根据“since 2018”可知，此句时态应用现在完成时，其否定形式的构成为“haven’t/hasn’t +过去分词”，主语we为第一人称，用haven’t，see的过去分词为seen。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where does your sister have lunch？ —She usually  ______  lunch at school.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妹妹在哪里吃午饭？——她通常在学校吃午饭。 考查动词时态。根据“usually”可知本句是一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数，动词用三单形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What are you going to do this winter vacation, Cindy? —I  ______  to Hainan with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——辛迪，这个寒假你打算做什么？——我将和我的父母去海南。 考查时态。根据问句“What are you going to do this winter vacatio”可知，答语应用一般将来时，可用“will do”构成，故选C。

questions.prompt: More natural parks  ______  in Beijing next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：明年北京将建设更多的自然公园。 考查被动语态。are built被建立，一般现在时的被动结构；build建立，动词原形；will be built将被建立，一般将来时的被动语态；will build将建立，一般将来时；根据句意理解及句子结构分析可知，句子主语parks与谓语动词之间是被动关系，所以要用被动语态，句中的时间是next year，所以应该用一般将来时的被动结构，故选C。 【点睛】英语中句中的动词用主动还是被动结构，要根据句子主语与动词之间的关系来选择。如果是主动关系，动词就选择对应的时态结构即可，但是如果是被动关系，一定要用被动结构，而至于用哪个时态的被动结构，要根据句中的时间标志词来判断。本题首先确定主语与动词之间是被动关系之后，还要根据句中的时间next year来确定用一般将来时态的被动。

questions.prompt: —Judy, could you tell me  ______  the schoolbag? —Oh, yes. I bought it in a store on the Internet.

questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽在学习上有一些困难。我决定帮助她。 考查代词辨析。me我；him他；her她；us我们。分析句子可知，此处位于动词help之后作宾语，应使用人称代词的宾格形式；联系上下文可知此处指代Mary”玛丽”，玛丽是女子，因此使用her代替。故选C。

questions.explanation: 句意：4 月 23 日是世界读书日。 考查介词辨析。in用于年、月和季节前；on用于具体的某一天前；at用于某一时刻前；of……的，表所属。根据“April 23”可知，此处表示具体某一天，应用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  I take photos here? —Sorry you can’t. It’s not allowed in the museum.

questions.prompt: Leonardo da Vinci was one of  ______  inventors in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：列奥纳多·达·芬奇是世界上最著名的发明家之一。 考查形容词最高级。one of +形容词最高级+名词的复数形式，表示“最……的……之一”，固定搭配，形容词最高级常被定冠词the修饰。故选D。

questions.prompt: Every day I  ______  sports with my parents to keep healthy.
questions.explanation: 句意：每天我和父母一起做运动来保持健康。 考查动词时态。根据“Every day”可知该句是一般现在时，主语是“I”，因此谓语动词用原形。故选B。

questions.prompt: We  ______  to the community to do some cleaning next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：下周日我们将去社区打扫卫生。 考查动词时态。根据“We...to the community to do some cleaning next Sunday.”可知，句子时态应使用一般将来时，结构为will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: When I got home yesterday, my father  ______  with my grandparents in the living room.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我回到家时，父亲正在客厅里和爷爷奶奶聊天。 考查过去进行时。根据时间状语从句“When I got home yesterday”可知，昨天回家时，正在做的事情，用过去进行时，构成为was/were + doing，主语为my father为单数，be动词应用was。故选D。

questions.prompt: China  ______  many satellites to space since 1970.
questions.explanation: 句意：自1970年以来，中国已经向太空发射了许多卫星。 考查现在完成时。根据“since 1970”可知，此处是现在完成时，其结构是have/has + done形式，主语China为单数形式，故助动词应用has。故选A。

questions.prompt: This book is very meaningful so it  ______  by many people.
questions.explanation: 句意：这本书非常有意义，因此它被很多人喜欢。 考查一般现在时被动语态。根据“This book is very meaningful”可知，该句时态用一般现在时；主语it和谓语动词enjoy之间是被动关系，即它被喜欢，所以应用被动语态。一般现在时的被动语态结构为“主语+am/is/are+动词的过去分词”，主语是it，为第三人称单数，be动词用第三人称单数形式is，enjoy的过去分词是enjoyed。故选D。

questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈的生日快到了。我决定给她做个蛋糕。 考查代词辨析。him他；her她；it它；them他/她/它们。根据“I’ve decided to make a cake for…”可知，此空位于介词“for”之后，作宾语，应使用代词的宾格形式；由“My mother’s birthday is coming.”可知，此处指代的是“My mother”，为女性，因此使用her代替。故选B。

questions.prompt: The north of China, unlike the south, is windy  ______  spring.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国的北方与南方不同，春天是多风的。 考查介词辨析。in在，后加某年某月某季节；on在，后加具体的某一天；at在，后加具体时刻；to朝，向。根据“spring”可知此处是指季节，应用介词in。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Tom,  ______  you talk with people in Chinese? —Sure. I can speak Chinese freely now.

questions.prompt: Table tennis is one of  ______  ball games in China.

questions.prompt: Mary likes reading a lot,  ______  she usually goes to the library. A or

questions.prompt: —Mike, what are you doing? —Oh, I  ______  a poster for Earth Day.

questions.explanation: 句意：如果我早点完成工作，明天我就和你一起去游泳。 考查动词时态。will go将去，一般将来时；go去，动词原形；went去，动词过去式；have gone已经去，现在完成时。根据题干“If I finish the work early”可知此处是if引导的条件状语从句，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时态，空处应用一般将来时。故选A。

questions.prompt: Lily is a helpful girl. She  ______  as a volunteer since 2020.

questions.prompt: Today, mind maps  ______  widely in learning by teenagers.

questions.prompt: The little girl was very happy  ______  her mother gave her a beautiful present.

questions.prompt: Look! Mr. Li  ______  at the school gate. He always welcomes us every morning.

questions.prompt: Don’t give up. If you work hard, your dream  ______  true.

questions.prompt: I  ______  to English songs when my sister came in. She enjoyed them too.

questions.prompt: China  ______  nine gold medals at the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国在2022年北京冬奥会赢得了9枚金牌。 考查时态。根据“...at the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics.”可知此处指发生过的事情，用一般过去时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mark fell over and hurt his feet while he  ______  down the steps.
questions.explanation: 句意：马克在跑下台阶时摔倒了，伤了脚。 考查时态。根据“Mark fell over and hurt his feet while he...down the steps”可知他当时正在下台阶，用过去进行时was/were doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: Betty wants to buy her mother a birthday present, but she  ______  what to buy.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂想给她妈妈买一件生日礼物，但她还没有决定买什么。 考查动词时态。根据“Betty wants to buy her mother a birthday present”及but引起的转折，可知是到现在为止还未决定买什么，用现在完成时，she后用助动词hasn’t表否定，其后接过去分词decided。故选C。

questions.prompt: This song  ______  ten years ago, but many people still like it now.
questions.explanation: 句意：这首歌是十年前写的，但现在很多人仍然喜欢它。 考查被动语态。句子主语与动词之间是被动关系，应用被动语态，结合“ten years ago”可知，应用一般过去时的被动语态was/were+done，故选D。

questions.prompt: We often go for a walk  ______  the park near our home.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们经常去我们家附近的公园里散步。 考查介词辨析。of属于……的；on在……上；in在……里；from从，来自。根据“go for a walk”和“the park”可知，此处应用介词in，表示在公园里。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Must I write the report by hand, Mrs. Taylor? — No, you  ______. You can write it on the computer.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我必须手写报告吗，泰勒夫人？——不，你不必。你可以把它写在电脑上。 考查情态动词。needn’t不需要；mustn’t禁止；can’t不可以；shouldn’t不应该。由must引导的一般疑问句的否定回答用don’t have to/needn’t；故选A。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me,  ______  is this coat? —It’s 168 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——请问，这件外套多少钱？——168元。 考查疑问词词组。how many多少；how old几岁；how long多长时间；how much多少钱。根据“It’s 168 yuan.”可知，空处是询问价格，所以用how much。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tony is  ______  than he was three years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：Tony比三年前更有耐心。 考查形容词的比较级。根据“than”可知空格处应用形容词的比较级作表语，patient“耐心的”的比较级形式为more patient。故选B。

questions.prompt: Helen is good at math, so she  ______  her brother with his math every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：海伦擅长数学，所以她每天都在数学方面帮助她弟弟。 考查动词的时态。根据时间状语“every day”可知，此处应用一般现在时，表示习惯性或经常性的动作。主语为she，谓语动词应用第三人称单数形式。故选C。

questions.prompt: Look! Some children  ______  up the rubbish.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！一些孩子正在捡垃圾。 考查动词时态。根据“Look”可知，时态是现在进行时（be doing）；“Some children ”作主语，be动词用are。故选C。

questions.prompt: We  ______  good friends since we were in middle school.

questions.prompt: I  ______  my physics notes at 9 o’clock last night.

However, I was too busy doing cheerleading, working at my part-time job, and keeping up with my schoolwork, so it seemed  ______ 13 ______  to add another activity to my already busy life. I still often thought about playing, but I never went to any tryouts. Last year, for the first time in years, I found my timetable almost completely empty. I stopped doing my part-time job, and my cheerleading practices were  ______ 14 ______. However, the town softball league（联赛）was starting up at the beginning of the summer. With the  ______ 15 ______  of a friend, I realized that this would probably be the last chance I ever had to play and I decided to try out for the town softball league. While I was really nervous during those first few practices and games, I was so  ______ 16 ______  I made the decision to try out. I was out  ______ 17 ______  and staying in shape. It was exciting to play my favorite childhood sport. Not only that, but as one of the only team members with a license, I got to drive my teammates to and back from practices and we became  ______ 18 ______. My summer that I thought to be boring was exciting and fun all because I decided to  ______ 19 ______  thinking too much about everything and play softball. I’m so thankful that I had the  ______ 20 ______  to play softball last summer. Now that the summer’s over and I’m happy knowing that I really will not play softball again, my memories will always be a reminder to myself to go for what I want in life.

questions.prompt: Betty is my sister.  ______  hobby is drawing.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂是我的妹妹。她的爱好是画画。 考查代词辨析。His他的；Her她的；Your你的；Their他们的。根据“Betty is my sister. ”可知，此处指“贝蒂的”，女性，所以用her。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What’s the weather like in Beijing  ______  July? —It’s very hot.
questions.explanation: 句意：——北京七月的天气怎么样？——很热。 考查介词辨析。in其后加早中晚，月份，季节，年份等；on其后加星期或具体的时间；at其后加点钟；with和。“July”是月份，所以用in，in July“在七月”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Put on your coat, you will get cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：穿上外套，否则你会感冒的。 考查句型“祈使句，and/or+一般将来时。” “祈使句，and +一般将来时的陈述句”：在这里祈使句相当于if 引导的条件状语从句（但此时去掉and），and后简单句一般是表示好的结果。“祈使句，or+一般将来时的陈述句”：在这里祈使句相当于if…not或unless 引导的条件状语从句（但此时去掉or），or后简单句一般是表不理想的结果。例如，（1）Give me one more hour, and I’ll get the work finished.（祈使句）=If you give me one more hour, I’ll get the work finished.（if条件句）（2）Listen to the teacher carefully in class, or you can’t catch what he is saying.=If don’t listen to the teacher carefully in class, you can’t catch what he is saying.结合句意可知填or；选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  apples would you like, Madam? —I’d like 5, thanks.
questions.explanation: 句意：——夫人，您想要几个苹果？——我要5个，谢谢。 考查疑问词词组辨析。How old几岁；How long多长时间；How much多少，询问不可数名词或价钱；How many多少，询问可数名词复数。根据“I’d like 5”可知是对数量提问，apples是可数名词复数，所以用how many，故选D。

questions.prompt: Running is one of  ______  sports in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：跑步是世界上最受欢迎的运动之一。 考查最高级。“one of the+最高级+复数名词”表示“最……之一”，D选项结构正确，故选D。

questions.prompt: I’m sorry I  ______  go now. My English lesson will start in five minutes.
questions.explanation: 句意：对不起，我现在得走了。 五分钟后我的英语课就要开始了。 考查情态动词辨析。may可能；must必须；can能够；could可以。根据“My English lesson will start in five minutes”可知，英语课要开始了，所以必须要走了，故选B。

questions.prompt: If it is sunny tomorrow, we  ______  the mountain together.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天晴天，我们会一起去爬山。 考查时态。句子是if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”，主句用一般将来时will do。故选C。

questions.prompt: Tom is very friendly. He often  ______  his classmates.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆很友好。他经常帮助他的同学。 考查时态。根据“Tom is very friendly. He often...his classmates.”可知，时态是一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数，动词用三单，故选B。

questions.prompt: My neighbor Ms Li  ______  piano lessons to children for three years.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的邻居李女士教孩子钢琴课已经三年了。 考查时态。根据“for three years”可知句子应使用现在完成时have/has done。故选C。

questions.prompt: My sister  ______  a model plane when I got home.
questions.explanation: 句意“当我到家时，我的妹妹正在做飞机模型”。A.一般现在时；B.过去进行时；C.现在进行时；D.现在完成时。根据when I got home可知，表示过去，且根据句意可知，表示“正在做飞机模型”，故选B。

questions.prompt: A new sports center  ______  in our community next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：明年在我们社区一个新大的体育中心将会被建成。 本题考查的是时态和语态，根据所给空后面的next year可知，是一般将来时，排除A和C，主语是A new sports center，谓语动词是build，主语发不出谓语动词的动作，所以要用被动语态，故答案选D。

questions.prompt: —Lily, could you tell me ______ last night? —Oh, I went to the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Lily，你能告诉我昨晚去哪里了么？——嗯，我去了图书馆。 考查宾语从句时态和语序辨析。宾语从句用陈述语序：引导词+主语+谓语，排除BD；last night是过去时间，宾语从句中主句用一般过去式，从句如果不是客观事实或者真理，也要用一般过去式。故选A。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 The Height of Life Michael Stone had always dreamed of flying. His mother read him so many stories about flying that they  ______ 13 ______  his dreams with color and beauty. His dad, on the other hand, believed in hard work. He always said, “If you want something, work for it!” From the age of 14, Michael started  ______ 14 ______  as a pole vaulter. He worked out every day with weightlifting and running, and he continued to help his parents with their farm work. His mother wished he could  ______ 15 ______  bit more, but his father would smile and say, “You want something, work for it!” Now Michael was standing in the stadium as one of the final two competitors in the pole-vaulting event in the National Junior Olympics. After a warm-up, he found his pole, and  ______ 16 ______  on the runway that led to the most challenging event of his 17-year-old life. Suddenly he became  ______ 17 ______. He had never experienced this before. Then he thought of his mother. She always told him to take deep breaths when he felt nervous. So he did. Slowly the nervousness was gone. He gently put down his pole, and began to stretch（伸展）out his arms and upper body. And then, he  ______ 18 ______  picked up his pole. He knew it was his time to fly. As he began sprinting （冲刺）down the runway, something felt wonderfully different, yet familiar （熟悉的）. When he took a deep breath, it happened. He began to fly, just like in his childhood dreams. Only this time he knew he wasn’t dreaming. The loud cheers from the audience brought Michael back. He could  ______ 19 ______  the smile on his parents’ faces. His life would never be the same. It wasn’t because he won the National Junior Olympics and  ______ 20 ______  a new world record. And it wasn’t because he had just increased his personal best. It was simply because Michael Stone was blind.

questions.prompt: My brother is very friendly.  ______  gets along well with others.
Wu Dajing, a gold medalist, started to practice speed skating  ______  the age of ten.
— ______  do you play basketball with your classmates, David? —Twice a week.
Our parents help and support us a lot,  ______  we should be thankful to them.
— ______  you lend me your dictionary, Laura? —Sorry, I can’t. I have just lent it to Eric.
We should keep in mind that nothing is  ______  than safety.
—Nick, take out the trash, please. —Wait a minute, Mom. I  ______  an e-mail to Mr. Smith now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——尼克，请把垃圾拿出去。——等一下，妈妈。我正在给史密斯先生写一封电子邮件。 考查现在进行时。根据“now”可知，是现在进行时，强调正在做某事，结构为“be动词+doing”。故选B。

questions.prompt: All of us  ______  great progress since we started junior high school.
The kids  ______  an online lesson when their parents arrived home yesterday.

—Tom do you know  ______? —Next Friday.

questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你知道我们什么时候举行运动会吗？——下个星期五。 考查宾语从句。此处是宾语从句，宾语从句是陈述语序，所以排除选项A和C；根据回答“Next Friday”可知句子用一般将来时，故选B。 二、完形填空（每题1分,共8分） 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 It was January 2021. My second term in high school had just ended. Two weeks earlier, my parents checked my grades and  ______ 13 ______  more than 20 missing tasks. Bright and able as I was, I had often struggled（挣扎）with  ______ 14 ______  and procrastination（拖延）, especially with writing tasks. But this time was different, and the pandemic（疫情）was to blame. I was doing my first year partly from home where I did my schoolwork on my own time, and, for the most part, without teacher guidance. The  ______ 15 ______  was too much. I could do a million other things rather than my homework. I told my mom what I was missing from my teachers and classmates, “When a teacher walks around the classroom, you want to be on task, and you don’t want to fall behind the other students.” My parents tried to help, but their  ______ 16 ______  fell far short of their expectations. Tired from working long days, they criticized rather than advised. Late-night learning hours ended in  ______ 17 ______  matches. All three of us were upset and stressed out. We knew we couldn’t solve this alone. So when my mom heard that Steve Merrill, an experienced teacher, could help, she  ______ 18 ______  out. Mr. Merrill told me that his students also had problems in the same areas: task organization and time management. He taught me to break down big tasks into small ones. We met twice a week, over video, where we could look over my tasks and put the skill into practice. After a few months, I started to see positive results. My grades were improving. My work habits were becoming more regular. There were  ______ 19 ______  late-night learning hours and fights. The other evening I came downstairs to ask my parents for help with a writing task. While I don’t expect this school year to be easy, I now have some of the tools I need to help me through it.

questions.prompt: Mr. Johnson often plays chess with his friends  ______  Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：约翰逊先生经常在星期六下午和他的朋友们下棋。 考查时间介词的用法。at后接具体时刻；in后接某年某月某季节；on后接具体一天；for后接一段时间。“Saturday afternoon”是具体的一天，所以空格处应填on，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  are you late again, Bob? — Sorry, Miss Lee. My alarm clock didn’t go off and I overslept.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Bob，你为什么又迟到了？——抱歉，李老师。我的闹钟没有响，我睡过头了。 考查特殊疑问句。why为什么；where哪里；when何时；what什么。根据“Sorry, Miss Lee. My alarm clock didn’t go off and I overslept”可知，询问再次迟到的原因，故选A。

questions.prompt: Stop eating junk food,  ______  you will put on much weight.
questions.explanation: 句意：停止吃垃圾食品，否则你会增加很多体重。 考查连词辨析。but但是；so所以；and和；or否则。根据“Stop eating junk food...you will put on much weight”可知不要吃垃圾食品，否则会增肥，用结构“祈使句，or+陈述句”。故选D。

questions.prompt: To protect the art pieces, we ______  follow the museum rules.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了保护艺术作品，我们必须遵守博物馆的规则。 考查情态动词。can能；must必须；might可能；may可能。根据“follow the museum rules”可知语气强烈，句子表达“必须遵守规则”，用情态动词“must”。故选B。

questions.prompt: The Dragon Boat Festival is one of  ______  traditional festivals in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：端午节是中国最古老的传统节日之一。 考查最高级。one of the+形容词最高级+复数名词，表示“最……之一”，故此空应填the oldest，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Turn down the music, David. Your little brother ______ now. — Sorry, Mom. I didn’t know that.
questions.explanation: 句意：——大卫，音乐声音小点，你的弟弟现在正在睡觉。——对不起，妈妈，我不知道弟弟正在睡。 考查动词的时态。根据“now”可知句子是现在进行时，根据“Turn down the music”可知表达“正在睡觉”，所以要把音乐声音调小，主语“Your little brother”是单数概念，动词用“is sleeping”。故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  computer games since March. Now I have more time to exercise.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从三月份以来我就没玩过电脑游戏了。 现在我有更多的时间锻炼。 考查动词时态。since+过去的时间点，要与现在完成时have/has done的结构一起连用，故选C。

questions.prompt: My class  ______  the Summer Palace next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：下周日我们班要去参观颐和园。 考查时态。根据“next Sunday”可知句子使用一般将来时will do/be going to do。故选D。

questions.prompt: Nancy  ______  at the old people’s home with her classmates last summer.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年夏天，南希和她的同学在老人之家做志愿者。 考查动词时态。根据“last summer”可知，此句用一般过去时，动词用过去式，故选B。

questions.prompt: The graduation ceremony ______  in our school hall every year. It has become a tradition. A holds
questions.explanation: 句意：毕业典礼每年将在我们学校大厅举行。它已经成为一个传统。 考查动词的时态和语态。根据“every year”可知句子是一般现在时，主语“The graduation ceremony”和动词“举行”之间是被动关系，主语是单数概念，表达“被举行”，动词用一般现在时的被动结构“is held”。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______  at 3 p.m. yesterday? —Yes. We were reading in the library together.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道艾米昨天下午3点在做什么吗？——知道。我们一起在图书馆看书。 考查宾语从句。此处是宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，排除A和C选项。根据“at 3 p.m. yesterday”可知，从句应用过去进行时was/were doing的结构，故选B。 二、完形填空（每题 1 分，共 8 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Race of the Robots The robotics competition was taking place. Lily and Toby followed their two other teammates David and Marcus, into the big hall. They laid out all their equipment on the table because the rules said the robot could not be assembled (组装) before the competition. They needed to build and program a robot that could make its way around an obstacle (障碍) course. It was said that judges often gave a surprise  ______ 13 ______  change that would require the students to change their robotic design at the last minute. “Teams, it is now time for the new rule,” the host announced. “Some rocks will be placed on the course. You will have to make your robot remove them from the course.” “We can build an arm to pick up the rocks and  ______ 14 ______  them on the side,” said David right away. “But that would take too much time,” Marcus replied. The team stood in  ______ 15 ______, each trying to think up new ideas. Toby thought hard about the design they had already planned out. Then he realized something special about their design — the secret box. “How about we create a door in the front of the  ______ 16 ______  space in the center of the robot? We can add a sensor (传感器) to the door. So when our robot goes along and comes across those rocks, it will open the door and pick them up,” he explained. The team thought about it. “Actually, that might work. The fact that the robot is  ______ 17 ______  these things rather than just moving them might give us extra points,” Lily said. The four set to work,  ______ 18 ______  but quickly assembling their pre-designed robot, then adding the door with the extra parts they had brought. It was hard, and time was running out. As the buzzer (计时器) rang, Toby placed the last part on the robot. It was time for Toby’s team to compete. They set their robot on the course and watched it make its way and meet the first rock. It stopped for a second, and the members of the team  ______ 19 ______  their breath. Then the machine opened its door and slid (滑行) across the small rock. When it passed over the rock, the rock disappeared —  ______ 20 ______  in the robot’s secret box. The team cheered, knowing they were one step closer to the championship.

questions.prompt: My uncle is coming back from London. We can’t wait to see  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的叔叔即将从伦敦返回。我们迫不及待地想看到他。 考查人称代词辨析。him他；her她；it它；them他们。根据“My uncle is coming back from London.”可知此处代my uncle，用him，故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you look worried, Mike? —I lost my new bike.
questions.explanation: ——你为什么看起来很烦恼，Mike？——我丢失了我的自行车。how如何；when什么时候；where哪里；why为什么。根据“I lost my new bike.”可知，提问的是Mike烦恼的原因。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Tom,  ______  you finish your homework in ten minutes? —Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你能在十分钟内完成你的作业吗？——是的，我能。 考查情态动词辨析。must必须；should应该；need需要；can能。根据答语“Yes, I can”可知空处应用can，故选D。

questions.prompt: This pair of shoes are nice,  ______  I don’t like the color.
questions.explanation: 句意：这双鞋不错，但我不喜欢它的颜色。 考查连词辨析。for因为；so因此；but但是；or或者。“This pair of shoes are nice”与“I don’t like the color”是转折关系，用but符合语境。故选C。

questions.prompt: My mother takes good care of my grandpa. She is  ______  than ever before.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的妈妈照顾我的爷爷。她比以前更有耐心了。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知应用比较级；patient“耐心的”，比较级为more patient。故选B。

questions.prompt: David  ______  with his friends every weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：大卫每个周末都和他的朋友们一起游泳。 考查动词时态。根据“ every weekend.”可知，时态用一般现在时，主语是David，谓语动词用三单形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Tina, what’s your dad doing? — He  ______  my computer.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tina, 你的爸爸正在做什么？——他正在修我的电脑。 考查现在进行时。根据问句“Tina, what’s your dad doing?”可知，本题是问爸爸正在做什么，所以答语要用现在进行时来回答。故选B。

questions.prompt: Our school life  ______  a lot since last term. We have more activities now.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从上学期，我们的校园生活改变了很多。我们现在有了更多的活动。 考查现在完成时。根据“ since last term”可知，本题是现在完成时，结构为have/has+现在分词；主语“Our school life”为单数，应用has，change的过去分词为changed。故选D。

questions.prompt: The three Chinese astronauts  ______  to the earth on April 16th, 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：三名中国宇航员于2022年4月16日返回地球。 考查动词时态。根据“April 16th, 2022”可知，此句用一般过去时，动词用过去式，故选A。

questions.prompt: These flowers  ______  only in autumn every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：这些花每年只有在秋天才有。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语“These flowers”是动作的承受者，结合“every year”可知，用一般现在时的被动语态。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Tony, do you know ______? —Yes. It’s behind the big supermarket.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你知道最近的电影院在哪里吗？——知道。它在大超市的后面。 考查宾语从句。根据“do you know…”可知，此处是宾语从句，故应该用陈述语序，排除A、C项。根据答语“It’s behind the big supermarket.”可知，be动词用is。故选B。 二、完形填空。（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I was a boy of nine in 1960. I used to mow the lawn for Mrs. Long. She paid me little for the job, but promised to give me a Christmas  ______ 13 ______. I spent much time wondering what it would be. Many boys had baseball gloves or ice skates and I was eager to have any of these. “It would hardly be a baseball glove,” I  ______ 14 ______  with myself.” She wouldn’t know much about baseball.” So I was quite sure that she would give me ice skates. I even imagined myself upon the skates. As Christmas was coming, it was  ______ 15 ______  for me not to ask Mrs. Long for my present. On December 22, I presented myself at the door of the house. Mrs. Long handed me a small box which couldn’t hold a pair of skates. I was  ______ 16 ______. When lifting it from her, I was curious about the lightness of the present. It weighed almost nothing. “What is it?” I asked “A kind of magic,” she said. Her words were enough to set my mind dancing with new  ______ 17 ______. On Christmas morning, I had this box on my knees. With great excitement I opened the box to find inside ten sheets (纸张) of black paper, each written in colorful letters, Carbon Paper Regal Premium. “What is it?” I asked. Mum took two pieces of white paper,  ______ 18 ______  between them one of the black paper, and wrote my name on the upper sheet. Then she handed me the second sheet without her pencil touching. There was my name! It was a miracle (奇迹) to my childish mind. In that one moment, I remembered the  ______ 19 ______  about the duplication (复制) of words and the printing. Thank Mrs. Long for her wisdom to guess that a boy might  ______ 20 ______  from a present completely outside of his ordinary experience.

questions.prompt: Nancy, thanks for inviting  ______  to dinner. I really enjoyed it.
questions.explanation: 句意：谢谢你邀请我吃饭，南希。我真的非常喜欢。 考查人称代词宾格辨析。me我；you你；her她；him他。根据“I really enjoyed it.”可知，此处是感谢别人邀请“我”吃饭。故选A。

questions.prompt: Lily often helps her mum do some gardening  ______  Sundays.
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉经常在星期天帮妈妈做些园艺活。 考查介词辨析。at在……，后加具体时间点； to到……；on在……，后加具体的日期，星期几，节日；in在……，后加一天的上午，下午或晚上，加年，月，季节。on Sundays“在周日”，故选C。

questions.prompt: I missed the last bus,  ______  I had to go home on foot.
questions.explanation: 句意：我错过了最后一班公共汽车，所以不得不步行回家。 考查并列连词的辨析。根据“I missed the last bus, …I had to go home on foot.”可知，我错过最后一班车，我不得不步行回家，前后两句是因果关系，需用连词so。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  did you pay for the magic show? — About $10.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你为这场魔术表演付了多少钱？——大约10美元。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少，对数量提问；How much多少钱，对价格提问；How often多久一次，对频率提问；How soon多久，对将要用的时间提问。根据“About $10.”可知，此处对价格提问，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  you work out the math problem by yourself? —Of course, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能自己算出这道数学题吗？——当然，我可以。 考查情态动词辨析。can能；need需要；must必须；should应该。一般疑问句答语通常遵循“用什么问，用什么答。”。根据“Of course, I can.”可知，本题用can来提问，用can来回答，表示“能够，可以”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Danny is not here. He  ______  the teacher in the lab now.
questions.explanation: 句意：Danny不在这里。他现在正在实验室帮助老师。 考查动词时态。根据“Danny is not here.”及时间状语now可知，此处用现在进行时，其结构是be doing的形式，主语是he，be动词用is，help“帮助”，是动词，此处用现在分词，故选C。

questions.prompt: Judy  ______  her first prize in chess when she was only six.
questions.explanation: 句意：朱迪六岁的时候就获得了象棋一等奖。 考查动词时态。win“获得，赢得”，是动词，根据“when she was only six”可知，此处是一般过去时，动词需用过去式。故选B。

questions.prompt: After doing sports for months, Mike has become much  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：在做了几个月的锻炼之后，迈克已经比以前强壮的多了。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知，此处需用形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: Rick  ______  a lot about Chinese culture since he came to China.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：自从里克来中国，他了解了许多有关中国文化的知识。A. has learned现在完成时态；B. will learn一般将来时态；C. learns一般现在时态；D. learned一般过去时态。本句描述的是从来到中国一直继续到现在的动作、状态，用现在完成时态。故选A. 考点：考查动词的时态辨析。

questions.prompt: My little brother  ______  a model plane when I came back from school.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我从学校回来的时候，我的弟弟正在制作飞机模型。 考查动词时态。根据“when I came back from school”可知，此处需用过去的时态，排除AC选项；再根据句意可知，此处是强调“过去这个时候我弟弟正在做飞机模型”，需用过去进行时(was/were doing)，故选D。

questions.prompt: If I’m free tomorrow, I  ______  you up at the train station.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果我明天有空，我会去火车站接你。 考查if引导的条件状语从句。pick采摘；pick sb. up “接人”，固定短语；分析句子可知，此句为if引导的条件状语从句，表示在某种条件下，某事很有可能发生，多用主将从现，即从句使用一般现在时，主句使用一般将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Miss Lin is very kind.  ______  always helps people in need.
questions.explanation: 句意：林小姐非常善良。她总是帮助有需要的人。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；they他们；it它。此空指代前文提到的Miss Lin，女性，故此空应填she，故选B。

questions.prompt: Let’s meet  ______  the bus stop after school and then go home together.
questions.explanation: 句意：放学后我们在公共汽车站见面，然后一起回家。 考查介词。at在……，后接小地点；to朝；of……的；with和……一起；根据“the bus stop after school and then go home together.”可知，此处指的是“在公共汽车站”，小地点前用介词at，故选A。

questions.prompt: Grandpa is over 70 years old,  ______  he still looks young.
questions.explanation: 句意：爷爷已经70多岁了，但他看起来还很年轻。 考查连词辨析。but但是；because因为；so因此；or或者。前后两句构成转折关系，用but连接，故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  are you going this weekend? — To the Summer Palace.

questions.prompt: Look at the sign. You  ______  take photos in this museum.
questions.explanation: 句意：看这个标志。禁止在这个博物馆里拍照。 考查情态动词辨析。couldn’t不能；needn’t不需要；mustn’t禁止；wouldn’t将不。根据“Look at the sign...take photos in this museum.”及常识可知，应该是“禁止拍照”，应用mustn’t。故选C。

questions.prompt: My father is a tea lover. He often  ______  tea after supper.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父亲是个茶艺爱好者。他经常在晚饭后喝茶。 考查一般现在时。根据句中“My father is a tea lover.”及频度副词often可知，该句为一般现在时，表示经常性的动作，主语为第三人称单数，谓语动词用单三形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: The First Beipan River Bridge in Gui Zhou is one of  ______  bridges in the world.

questions.prompt: I saw Lucy in the school hall. She  ______  for her speech at that time.

I don’t have any cash on me, but my son back here wants to give you everything he  ______ 17 ______  right now. The driver took my instructions but did not move off. Instead, he looked  ______ 20 ______  at me. “Raddar?” he said, using my childhood nickname. I was surprised at this familiar address. Unexpectedly! It was Ismail! Even after twenty years, we still recognized each other. Grasping his shoulder, I felt a true affection, something  ______ 21 ______  to describe. If we can allow our children to be themselves without prejudice (偏见), they’ll build friendships with people, regardless of race or religion, who will be by their side through thick and thin. On such friendships are societies built and then we can truly be, as William Shakespeare once wrote, “We few, we happy few, we band of brothers”.

questions.prompt: Mrs. Brown is very nice. All the teenagers like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：布朗夫人太好了。所有的青少年都喜欢她。 考查代词辨析。it它；him他；her她；them他们。此空指代前文提到的Mrs, Brown，女性，故选C。

questions.prompt: My brother will go to Wuhan on business  ______  December.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥要在12月份去武汉出差。 考查介词辨析。in在较长时间；at在某一时刻；on在具体某一天或某一天的早晨，上午，晚上；by到……为止。根据December可知，此处指在某月，月份较长时间。故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  shall we meet for the school trip? —At 8:00 o’clock in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——学校旅行我们什么时候见面？——早晨8点。 考查特殊疑问句。Why为什么；Where哪里；How怎样；When何时。根据回答“At 8:00 o’clock in the morning.”可知对时间的询问，用When引导的特殊疑问句。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Tim,  ______  you play ice-hockey? — Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tim，你会打冰球吗？——是的，我会。 考查情态动词。can能够；should应该；must必须；need需要。根据回答“Yes, I can.”可知问句是Can引导的一般疑问句，此处can表能力。故选A。

questions.prompt: There is no public transportation now,  ______  you’ll have to walk home.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在没有公共交通工具了，所以你将不得不走回家了。 考查并列连词辨析。or否则；so所以；but但是；for因为。分析两句的逻辑，可知后一句表结果，应该用so连接，故选B。

questions.prompt: Rose is  ______  than any other girl in her class.
questions.explanation: 句意：Rose在班上比其他任何一个女孩都受欢迎。 考查形容词比较级。根据than可知，此空用形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Sam, where is your brother? —He  ______  his friend in the study now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——萨姆，你哥哥呢？——他正在书房给他的朋友打电话呢。 考查动词时态。根据now和上文正在找人，可知此处用现在进行时表示“正做某事”，结构为be doing，故选C。

questions.prompt: —What did you do last weekend? —I  ______  Universal Studios Beijing (环球影城) with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——上周末你做了什么？——我和朋友们参观了北京环球影城 考查时态。根据“What did you do last weekend?”可知，回答应用一般过去时，动词用过去式；故选C。

questions.prompt: — Sam, what do you sometimes do on Saturday? — I  ______  exercise with my cousins.
questions.explanation: 句意：——山姆，你周六有时候会做什么？——我和我的堂兄弟们一起锻炼。 考查一般现在时。根据问句“what do you sometimes do on Saturday”可知，问句时态为一般现在时，回答时也应使用一般现在时，所以使用do。故选C。

questions.prompt: My sister Mary  ______  French for three years. She is much better at it now.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹玛丽学法语已经三年了。她现在更擅长了。 考查时态。根据“for three years”可知，句子要用现在完成时，结构是“have/has+过去分词”，故选D。

questions.prompt: In the story A Christmas Carol, Marley was mean, so he  ______  after he died.
questions.explanation: 句意：在故事《圣诞颂歌》中，马利很刻薄，所以他死后被惩罚了。 考查被动语态。punish意为“惩罚”，和主语he之间构成被动关系，应该用被动语态。根据从句“after he died”用了一般过去时，可知此处也用一般过去时。被动语态一般过去时的结构为was/were done，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Could you tell me  ______? — You can go to the town library.

choices.label: A
choices.text: where I can get some information about the town

choices.label: B
choices.text: where can I get some information about the town

choices.label: C
choices.text: where I could get some information about the town

choices.label: D
