questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我我在哪儿能获得关于这个小镇的信息吗？——你可以去小镇图书馆。 考查宾语从句。分析句子成分可知横线处为宾语从句，语序应为陈述语序，所以排除B、D；主句中could表委婉语气而不是过去时，根据主句时态为一般现在时，可知从句正常用一般现在时即可，故选A。 二、完形填空(每题1分，共10分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I was driving to the grocery store on a warm morning in May. I smiled as I watched the golden sunshine reflecting off the leaves. It was such a  ______ 13 ______  and heavenly time. My calm was broken, though, as I rounded a curve(拐弯处). A huge U Haul truck was coming my way several feet over the center line. I changed the direction as quickly onto the side of the road as I could to  ______ 14 ______  it. It was followed by not one but two other U Haul trucks just as the same  ______ 15 ______. I wondered if all the stuff inside of them belonged to the same person. I slowed down my car and waited for my heart rate to  ______ 16 ______. It was then that I  ______ 17 ______  a self storage business along the side of the highway, building new units for all the people who couldn’t fit their belongings into their houses. I saw a(n)  ______ 18 ______  couple carrying boxes into one of the units. It seemed strange that a couple just out of their teens could already have too much stuff. I lost my own  ______ 19 ______  for owning stuff when a house fire in the middle of the night destroyed everything my family owned. The only thing I had left was the underwear I was wearing. Yet, our whole family had awakened in time to escape. In the weeks that followed, friends and family gave us a lot of stuff to get us back on our feet, but none of it seemed as meaningful any more. What was important was seeing Mom’s smile, giving Nana a hug and a kiss, and watching Dad snooze(打盹) in his chair after a hard day’s work. What was important was the stuff of soul, not the stuff of this world. Since then I have tried to limit the things I would  ______ 20 ______. I didn’t want too much stuff to crowd up my life. I wanted to only buy what I needed and to spend my days in learning, growing, and  ______ 21 ______  my family and others. I believed that only by doing so could I make my  ______ 22 ______.

questions.prompt: —Whose ruler is this, Bill? —Oh, it’s ______. Thank you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这是谁尺子，比尔？——哦，是我的，谢谢你。 考查物主代词的用法。I 我，主格；me 我，宾格；my 我的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词。结合句意可知，答语回答是我的尺子，mine=“my” ruler，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Where do you usually have lunch? — ______  school.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你们通常在哪里吃午饭？——在学校。 考查介词辨析。Of……的；To向，朝着；At在；On在……上面。at school“在学校”，固定短语。故选C。

questions.prompt: He told his parents about his idea  ______ they thought it was great.
questions.explanation: 句意：他告诉他的父母有关他的想法，他们认为这个想法很棒。 考查连词的用法。but但是；and而且；or或者，否则；so因此。前后句表示并列关系。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Mum,  ______  will the breakfast be ready? — In five minutes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，早餐还要多久才能准备好？——五分钟后。 考查特殊疑问句。how soon多久以后；how long多久；how often多久一次；how many多少。根据“In five minutes”可知，对in+一段时间提问，用how soon，故选A。

questions.prompt: — How do you come to school every day, by bus or by underground? —By underground. It’s much  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你每天怎么来学校，乘公共汽车还是坐地铁？——坐地铁，它要快的多。 考查比较级。根据“by bus or by underground”可知，此处是两种交通方式的比较，故运用比较级的形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —May I speak to Judy? —Sorry, she  ______  a speech in the hall now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以和朱迪通话吗？——对不起，她现在正在大厅里演讲。 考查时态。根据“now”可知，此句应用现在进行时，结构为be doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: In 2022, the Winter Olympic Games  ______  in Beijing and Zhangjiakou.
questions.explanation: 句意：2022年，冬奥会将在北京和张家口举行。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。the Winter Olympic Games与hold构成被动语态，又根据“In 2022”可知，本句为一般将来时的被动语态，其构成为：will be done，故选D。

questions.prompt: We  ______  in our middle school for about 3 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们在我们的中学学习大约三年了。 考查时态。根据句中时间状语“for about 3 years”可知此题应用现在完成时态，结构为have/has done。故选C。

questions.prompt: She decided  ______  some English clubs and practise her spoken English.
questions.explanation: 句意：她决定参加一些英语俱乐部来练习英语口语。 考查非谓语。根据decide to do sth.“决定做某事”可知，此处应用不定式to join作宾语。故选D。

questions.prompt: My grandma dinner when I got home yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天当我到家的时候，我的祖母正在做晚饭。根据when I got home yesterday.可知，这里指的是昨天到家时，另一个动作正在发生，表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作，应该用过去进行时。其谓语动词的形式是：was/were doing，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Could you tell me  ______? — At the school gate, tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我我们将在什么地方见面吗？——明天上午，在学校门口。 考查宾语从句。根据时间状语可知，用一般将来时。这里是where引导的宾语从句，注意用陈述语序，结合语境，故选A。 二、完形填空（共8分, 每小题1分） It was the last figure skating competition for this season. Our team must beat every other team to enter the state competition.  Skaters were practicing all over the ice. Suddenly my teammate Danielle knocked her head hard on the ice and cried loudly, then she was carried out of the rink (冰场) and sent to hospital. “Allison,” Coach Janice came up to me, “Danielle can’t  ______ 13 ______  today. So I need you to do the axel（前外一周半跳）.” “Coach,” I couldn’t even think of words, “I only  ______ 14 ______  it for the first time three weeks ago! ” “I know, but you’re the only one besides Danielle who can do it.” At that moment, the weight of the world was on my shoulders. The axel is a high point jump, and it can make or break a team’s  ______ 15 ______. I couldn’t be the one to stop us from going to states. But I would be, I knew it. My teammates were all very  ______ 16 ______. They all came up, smiled and told me I would do great. But that only made me more nervous. It was my turn. Ready or not, I had to go. I built up some speed and jumped, hoping I would land  ______ 17 ______. But I didn’t. I fell on the ice, hard. I could feel the blood rushing to my cheeks. “Allison, take the reskate,” the coach came to me. Once, and only once in a competition, a team can have one skater skate again. It was still early, and someone else would need the chance later. I couldn’t use it, since I might fall again and  ______ 18 ______  it. “I can’t, Coach!” “Allison, you can do it. Calm down, jump high, and land it. Go!” So I went. I raised an arm towards the judges, letting them know I was going to take the reskate. The audience got into complete  ______ 19 ______. It seemed that everybody was holding their breath. I tried to focus. I took off and rotated（旋转）my body as much as possible in the air. Then I came down, landing on my feet. I did it! My teammates screamed with  ______ 20 ______. Finally, our team won! We were going to states! Landing that axel made me feel like I could do anything, and who knows, maybe I could.

questions.prompt: Look! That old man is crossing the road. Let’s go and help  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！那个老人在过马路，让我们去帮助他吧。me我，人称代词宾格；him他；her她；them他们。这几个选项中都是人称代词的宾格形式。根据句意可知，这个代词指代的是that old man，故应选B。

questions.prompt: In order to keep cool, many people go swimming  ______  summer．
questions.explanation: 句意：为了保持凉爽，在夏天很多人去游泳。in泛指在上午、下午或晚上；在季节、月份、年代前；at在具体时刻；on在具体某一天、星期；to到…。空后的summer是夏天，故应选A。

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  you’ll be late for school. A and
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则你上学就迟到了。 考查并列连词辨析。and又，和，表示并列关系；but但是，表示转折关系；so因此，表因果关系；or否则，表相反假设，用于警告或忠告。句型“祈使句+or+陈述句”表示以陈述句为条件下的相反假设，意为“否则，要不然”，所以用连词or。故选D。

questions.prompt: I think swimming is  ______  than running.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为游泳比跑步更刺激。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知，空处需用形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: Jack  ______  a good rest as soon as he finishes the exam.
questions.explanation: 句意：Jack一完成他的考试就要好好的休息一下。has第三人称单数形式；had是have的过去式；is having现在进行时态；will have一般将来时态。have a rest是固定短语，意思是“休息一下”，句中的as soon as引导的是时间状语从句，从句中用一般现在时态，主句用一般将来时态，故选D。

questions.prompt: Every year many foreigners  ______  to China to learn Chinese.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年许多外国人来中国学习汉语。根据Every year可知用一般现在时态；故选A

questions.prompt: — Where’s Bob? — He  ______  in the library now.
questions.explanation: 句意：-Bob在哪里？-他现在正在图书馆里读书。reads读，第三人称单数形式；read阅读，动词原形；is reading现在进行时；will read一般将来时态。根据句意可知，这里问的是Bob现在在哪里，而且句中有时间状语now，表示现在正在进行的动作，故应选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  a picnic with my brother last Sunday. It was great.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周日我和我的哥哥一起去野餐了，非常棒。have有，动词原形；had是have的过去式；will have将会有，一般将来时态；am having现在进行时态。have a picnic去野餐，是一个固定短语。根据句中的时间状语last Sunday可知，这里说的是过去的事情，应用一般过去时态，故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  my grandparents since 2016. I miss them very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从2016年以来我就没有见过我的爷爷、奶奶，我非常想念他们。won’t see一般将来时态，将不会看到；don’t see一般现在时，没有看到；haven’t see现在完成时；didn’t see一般过去时态。根据句中的时间状语since 2016可知，这里表示从2016年到现在，应用现在完成时态，故选C。

questions.prompt: My mother  ______  to music when I got home at five o’clock yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天五点当我到家的时候，我的妈妈正在听音乐。listens听，第三人称单数形式；listened是过去式；was listening过去进行时；has listened现在完成时态。根据语境when I got home at five o’clock yesterday可知，这里是一个过去的时间，并且动作在那个时候是正在进行的，应用过去进行时态，故选C。

questions.prompt: Some new computers  ______  to that village school last month.
questions.explanation: 句意：上个月一些新的电脑被送给了那所乡村学校。give给，动词原形；are given一般现在时的被动语态；gave是give的过去式；were given一般过去时态的被动语态。根据句意可知，该句的主语Some new computers与谓语动词give构成被动关系，这里应使用被动语态，排除A和C。根据句中的时间状语last month可知，应用一般过去时，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me, could you tell me  ______? —Sorry, sir. I wasn’t there at that time yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：-打扰一些，你能告诉我事故是怎样发生的吗？-对不起，先生，昨天那个时候我并不在那里。how the accident happens事故是怎样发生的，一般现在时；how the accident happened一般过去时；how does the accident happen和how did the accident happen都是疑问语序，根据句子结构可知，这里是how引导的宾语从句，从句中应用陈述语序，故将C和D排除。再根据对话中…at that time yesterday可知，这个事故是昨天发生的，应用一般过去时态，故选B。 二、完形填空（共8分, 每小题8分） Wallet Back This is a story about a learning experience. It had a big effect on the way I live my life. The  ______ 13 ______  in the story did not give me test or even grade me on my work. I was taught by one of the most effective methods of teaching, one that only people with lots of love can do. “My wallet（钱包）! Where is it?” were my first words before I found my wallet was missing. I  ______ 14 ______  my memory for a few good seconds, then realized that I had left my wallet in the library’s public restroom. Because the library was now closed, I had to wait until the next morning to look for it. When I got there the next day, all I found was a clean  ______ 15 ______. This was the first time I could remember ever hating to see a clean restroom. As I walked out, I looked at myself in the mirror and shook my head at the  ______ 16 ______  girl in front of me. I politely asked the librarian if a wallet had been found in the restroom yesterday. “No.” That was the answer. I walked off with a sense of sadness. I  ______ 17 ______  what I would do if I had found a wallet with sixty dollars, a phone card and other personal things.  ______ 18 ______  I accepted the fact that my wallet was gone. A week later, I received a package in the mail. It was my wallet! And most amazingly, nothing was  ______ 19 ______! But there was a letter in one of the wallet pocket that had not been there before. I took out the letter slowly and read something like this: “When we continue to help people around, we will live in a larger and more warding world.” This person didn’t even leave a return  ______ 20 ______. So I couldn’t admire（钦佩）whoever it was. But from that day on, I promised myself that I will follow this example and help others and make them as careful as I was when I received my wallet!

questions.prompt: Mr. Jackson is a popular writer, and we all like reading  ______  books.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克逊先生是个受欢迎的作家，我们都喜欢读他的书。 考查物主代词。his他的；her她的；their他们的；your你/你们的。根据空后有名词books，可知需要填形容词性物主代词；又根据前一句Mr. Jackson is a popular writer，可知此处是指“喜欢读他的书”，故选A。

questions.prompt: Usually I make breakfast for my family  ______  Saturdays
questions.explanation: 句意：通常我在星期六为我的家人做早餐。 本题考查介词。at+钟点，表示在几点钟；in+年/月，表示在某年或某月；on+星期/具体的日子，表示在星期几或某一天；to向。on Saturdays在星期六，故选C。

questions.prompt: Wash your hands before meals,  ______  you may get ill.
questions.explanation: 句意：饭前洗手，否则你可能会生病的。 本题考查连词。and而且，but但是，or否则，so所以。结合句意，“饭前不洗手”是“你可能会生病”的条件，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  you give me a hand? I can't move the box by myself. —No problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能帮我一下吗？我自己搬不动这个箱子。——没问题。 本题考查情态动词。could能，should应该，must必须，need需要。根据I can't move the box by myself可知，我自己搬不动这个箱子，因此请求别人帮助，Could you do sth？你能做某事吗？表示委婉地请求。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you visit your grandparents, Tom? —Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你多久去看一次你的祖父母？——一个月两次。 考查疑问词辨析。How much多少（钱），提问不可数名词的量或物品的价格；How often多久一次，提问频度；How long多久，对时间段进行提问；How soon多久以后，对“in+时间段”进行提问。根据答句“Twice a month.”表示的是频率，可知要用How often提问。故选B。

questions.prompt: Zhaozhou Bridge is one of  ______  stone bridges in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：赵州桥是世界上最古老的石桥之一。 考查形容词最高级。old古老的。old形容词原级；older形容词比较级；oldest形容词最高级；the oldest形容词最高级前加the。根据题干中“one of  ______  stone bridges in the world”可知此处是指世界上最古老的石桥之一，用“one of the +形容词最高级+名词复数”结构。故选D。

questions.prompt: If you take this train, you  ______  in Shanghai in five hours.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你坐这趟火车，你将在五小时内到达上海。 考查时态。arrive一般现在时；will arrive一般将来时；arrived一般过去时；have arrived现在完成时。本题是以if引导的条件状语从句，时态上要符合“主将从现”，所以空格处应用一般将来时will do，故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  on the computer when Frank called me last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：弗兰克昨晚打电话给我时，我正在用电脑工作。 考查过去进行时。work工作,动词原形；will work一般将来时；was working过去进行时；am working现在进行时。根据题干中“when Frank called me last night”可知此处表示当某件事情发生的时候，另一件事情正在进行，when引导的从句用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What’s that noise, Sam? —My little brother  ______  with his toy car now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——萨姆，那是什么声音？——我的弟弟现在正在玩他的玩具汽车。 考查现在进行时。play玩。will play一般将来时；is playing现在进行时；plays动词的第三人称单数形式；played动词的过去式。根据问句“What’s that noise, Sam?”可知提到的声响是现有的，结合答句中“now”可知是说现在正在进行的动作，用现在进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: We  ______  each other since I came to Beijing, but we send emails very often.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我来北京，我们就没见过面，但我们经常发电子邮件。 本题考查时态。don't see是一般现在时；didn’t see是一般过去时；won’t see是一般将来时；haven’t seen是现在完成时。根据since I came to Being可知，此处用现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: The kite  ______  in China more than 2000 years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：风筝是中国在2000多年前发明的。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。invent发明。invents动词的第三人称单数形式；invented动词的过去式；is invented一般现在时的被动语态；was invented一般过去时的被动语态。题中主语“The kite”与动词invent之间是动宾关系，此处用被动语态；结合题干中时间状语“2000 years ago”可知要用一般过去时的被动语态，其结构为was/were done。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Do you know  ______? —At 9:00 tomorrow morning.

choices.label: B
choices.text: when did the video meeting begin

choices.label: C
choices.text: when the video meeting will begin

choices.label: D
choices.text: when will the video meeting begin

questions.explanation: ——句意：你知道视频会议什么时候开始吗?——明天上午九点。 考查宾语从句。问句是一个含宾语从句的复合句，宾语从句中从句语序应该为陈述句语序，因此排除B和D；根据答语“At 9 o'clock tomorrow morning.”可知询问的应该是将来的事，用一般将来时，选项A是一般过去时，故选C。 二、完形填空 Love in a Box When I was a little girl, I found love in a box all because of a class assignment（作业）. On a Friday night I  ______ 13 ______  at dinner table, "My teacher said we have to bring a box,a special box, for our valentines on Monday". a valentine box Mother said, "We'll see," and she continued eating. What did "We'll see" mean? I had to have that box or my second grade Valentine's Day would be terrible. Maybe they didn't love me enough to help me with my  ______ 14 ______. All Saturday I waited  ______ 15 ______  and with Sunday arriving, my worry increased, but I knew an enquiry（询问）about the box might cause anger or loud voice, for in my house children only asked once. More than that  ______ 16 ______  trouble. Late Sunday afternoon, my father called me into the kitchen. The table was covered with colorful paper of different kinds. A(n)  ______ 17 ______  shoebox rested on top of it. A heavy stone dropped when Daddy said, "Let's get started on your project." In the next hour my father packed the shoebox into a surprising valentine box. Colorful paper covered the ugly cardboard with red hearts posted to what I considered all the right places. He sang while he worked. When he finished, he was so pleased that a broad smile spread over his face. "What do you think of that?" he asked. I answered him with a hug. But inside, joy danced all the way to my heart. It was the ﬁrst time that my father devoted（倾注）so much  ______ 18 ______  to me, for his world ﬁlled with work only. The holiday party arrived, and my classmates put cards and presents into the valentine boxes. Laughter ﬁlled our classroom. On the way home, I held out my valentine box for the world to  ______ 19 ______. The love that ﬁlled it meant more to me than all the valentines inside. The valentine box became a symbol（象征）of his love that  ______ 20 ______  through several years of other Valentine's Days. He gave me other gifts through the years, but none ever compared with the old, empty shoebox.

questions.prompt: Mary’s birthday is coming. We’ve decided to make a cake for  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽的生日快到了。我们决定为她做一个蛋糕。 考查代词辨析。him他；her她；you你/你们；them他们。根据“Mary’s birthday is coming.”可知，此处指Mary，女性，故选B。

questions.prompt: Space Day of China falls  ______  April 24th every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年的4月24日是中国的“航天日”。 考查介词辨析。on用在星期或具体时间前；by到……为止；at其后加点钟等；in其后加早中晚/月份/年份等。根据“April 24th”可知，此处加具体的时间，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Sam,  ______  I join you in the community service? —Of course you can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Sam，我能加入你的社区服务吗？——你当然可以。 考查动词辨析。can可以；must必须；should应该；need需要。根据“Of course you can.”可知，此处请求对方允许，用can，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Hi, Mary. Did you have fun last night? — Well, yes and no. The weather was terrible but we  ______  the concert.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，玛丽。你昨晚玩得开心吗？——嗯，是的，也不是。天气很糟糕，但我们很喜欢音乐会。 考查时态。由“last night”可知，此处描述的是过去的事情，应用一般过去时，动词应用过去式，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Peter, what are you doing? —Oh, I  ______  a report about national heroes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，你在干什么？——哦，我在写一篇关于国家英雄的报道。 考查现在进行时。根据“what are you doing”可知，此处强调动作正在发生，使用现在进行时，故选B。

questions.prompt: My grandma  ______  watch TV at home after supper. But now she always goes for a walk.
questions.explanation: 句意：我奶奶过去常常饭后在家看电视。但是现在她总是散步。 考查动词短语。used to do sth过去常常做某事；be used to do sth被用于做某事；be used to doing sth习惯做某事。根据“But now she always goes for a walk.”可知这是现在和过去的对比，过去常常看电视。故选A。

questions.prompt: Today, the Spring Festival  ______  in many Asian countries.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天，春节在许多亚洲国家被庆祝。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据句子可知，句子的主语the Spring Festival和动词celebrate之间是被动关系，即春节被庆祝，因此需要用被动语态结构；再根据“Today”可知，时态要用一般现在时，一般现在时的被动语态，即“主语+am/is/are+done”，the Spring Festival为第三人称单数，be动词用第三人称单数形式is，celebrate的过去分词是celebrated。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me  ______? —Next Thursday morning.

choices.label: A
choices.text: when we visited the Capital Museum

choices.label: B
choices.text: when did we visit the Capital Museum

choices.label: C
choices.text: when we will visit the Capital Museum

choices.label: D
choices.text: when will we visit the Capital Museum

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我我们什么时候去参观首都博物馆吗？——下个星期四早上。 考查宾语从句。此处是宾语从句，用陈述语序，排除BD；根据答语“Next Thursday morning.”可知，对将来时间提问，故选C。 二、完形填空（共8分, 每空1分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项. When most of us get a text message（短信）on our cell phone from an unknown person, we usually say “sorry, wrong number.” and move on. But when Dennis Williams received a text that clearly wasn’t intended for him, he did something  ______ 9 ______. On March 19, Dennis got a group text informing him that a couple he didn’t know were at the hospital, waiting for the  ______ 10 ______  of a baby. “Congratulations! But I think someone was mistaken,” Denis replied. The baby was born and update texts were coming in quickly from the overjoyed grandmother, Teresa. In her  ______ 11 ______, she didn’t seem to realize that she was sharing the baby’s photos with a complete stranger. “Well, I don’t know you all but I will get there to take pictures with the baby,” replied Dennis before asking which room the new  ______ 12 ______  were in. Dennis stuck to his promise! He  ______ 13 ______  at the hospital bringing gifts for the new mother Lindsey and her baby boy. Lindsey’s husband was really surprised by the unexpected visits. “I don’t think we would have randomly invited him over but we appreciated it and the gifts.” Teresa  ______ 14 ______  a photo of the chance meeting on a social networking website; accompanied by the touching words: “What a blessing this young man was to our family! He was so  ______ 15 ______  and kind to do this.” The post has since gained the  ______ 16 ______  of social media users all over the world, receiving more than 184, 000 shares and 61, 500 likes in just three days.

questions.prompt: Jack is my good friend.  ______  go to school together every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克是我的好朋友。我们每天都一起去上学。 考查代词辨析。He他；I我；We我们；They他/她/它们。根据前面的“Jack is my good friend.”以及后面的关键词“together”，可知是“我们”每天都一起去上学，因此人称代词用We。故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  they practised a lot, they lost the game.
questions.explanation: 句意：尽管他们练习了很多，但他们还是输掉了比赛。 考查连词辨析。Because因为；If如果；Although尽管；While当……时候。根据“they practised a lot, they lost the game.”可知前后句是有转折关系，应用although引导让步状语从句，故选C。

questions.prompt: Basketball is very popular. It ______  in many countries in the world nowadays.
questions.explanation: 句意：篮球很流行。现在世界上很多国家都打篮球。 考查被动语态。根据nowadays可知，此句是一般现在时，主语it与动词play之间是被动关系，故此处用一般现在时被动语态，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Mary,  ______  was your vacation? —Wonderful. I visited the Summer Palace with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玛丽，你假期过得怎么样？——太好了。我和父母一起参观了颐和园。 考查特殊疑问词。when什么时候；where哪里；what什么；how怎样。根据“Wonderful.”可知问句为“你假期过得怎么样”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —It seems that Mum isn’t happy. What happened? —Well, Dad  ______  his car key again.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈好像不太高兴。发生了什么事？——嗯，爸爸又把车钥匙弄丢了。 考查动词时态。根据上句“What happened?”可知，空处的动作发生在过去，故应用一般过去时，动词应用过去式。故选A。

questions.prompt: If Tom  ______  to the party, he will have a great time.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果汤姆来参加聚会，他会玩得很开心。 考查if引导的条件状语从句。条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”原则，主句用了一般将来时，从句用一般现在时，又因为主语“Tom”是第三人称单数，所以谓语动词“come”用第三人称单数形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: This problem  ______  at tomorrow’s class meeting.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个问题将在明天的课堂会议上进行讨论。 考查被动语态。根据“at tomorrow’s class meeting”，可知句子时态用一般将来时，且主语This problem和谓语动词discuss之间是被动关系，因此要用被动语态；一般将来时的被动语态结构为will be+动词的过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: Rose came to Beijing in 2002. she  ______  here for eight years.
questions.explanation: 句意：罗丝2002年来到北京。她在这里住了八年了。 考查动词时态。was living过去进行时；live一般现在时；will live一般将来时；has lived现在完成时。根据for eight years可知此句时态是现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: They arrived at the railway station  ______  late  ______  they failed to catch the train.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们到火车站太晚了，以至于没能赶上火车。 考查结果状语从句。too...to太……而不能……；so...that...如此……以至于……，so后加形容词或副词；such...that...如此……以至于……，such后加名词；enough to足够……能……。分析句子结构可知，空处的词是引导结果状语从句 ，且空一后是副词late，所以应用so...that...。故选B。

questions.prompt: Twenty thousand books  ______  last week. You can buy them in the bookstore now.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周印了两万本书。现在你可以在书店买它们。 考查时态和语态。根据“last week”可知，此处用一般过去时，主语twenty thousand books与谓语动词print之间是被动关系，用一般过去时被动结构，且主语是复数形式，谓语用复数形式，故选D。

questions.prompt: My sister  ______  to music when I got home at ﬁve o'clock yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我昨天五点钟到家的时候，我妹妹正在听音乐。 考查when引导的时间状语从句。listens一般现在时；was listening过去进行时；will listen一般将来时；has listened现在完成时。此句为when引导的时间状语从句，从句“昨天五点钟我到家的时候”为一般过去时态，主句“我妹妹正在听音乐”。根据语境可知，从句动作发生时，主句动作正在进行，故应用过去进行时态。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Tony could you tell me  ______  so many words last term? —By reading English as much as possible.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tony，你能告诉我上个学期你是怎样记住这么多单词的吗？——通过尽可能多读英语。 考查宾语从句。由句子结构可知，该空为宾语从句，从句中应用陈述语序，先排除A和B；由句中的“last term”可知，从句中说的是过去的事情，应用一般过去时。故选C。 二、完形填空。(每小题1 分，共8分)阅读短文，掌握其大意，从所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Teacher Tyler Henderson is color blind, and the world in his eyes is only black and white. When he directed a musical(音乐剧) at school, his students discovered his  ______ 13 ______. They wanted to do something to help him see the colorful world. These student actors began to  ______ 14 ______  money. With the donated(捐赠) money from their classmates, they bought a pair of Enchroma glasses, which allow color blind people to see red color. The students believed the  ______ 15 ______  would be a surprise to their respected teacher. The day eventually came. Standing on the stage, Mr. Henderson was going to give instructions. Suddenly, the students broke out into a song from the musical and presented their teacher with a banner(横幅): “You helped us see our colors. Now we’re helping you see yours.” Then the Enchroma glasses were  ______ 16 ______  to Henderson with a touching letter. All the students in the theatre were holding their breath and eagerly watching Mr. Henderson as he  ______ 17 ______  put on his new pair of glasses. One of the students couldn’t wait to ask if the glasses helped. “They  ______ 18 ______  very well,” Henderson answered in amazement. As he had never expected to receive such a gift, he was speechless. He sat down on the stage with tears of joy in his eyes. Hours after he received the gift, Henderson was still emotional(激动的). “I had trouble putting them on because my eyes were filled with tears.” Henderson said. The students know that the ability to see colors is especially important for Henderson. “He has devoted himself to theater, but he hasn’t been able to see the red color on stage,” student Ariana Brown said. “And now he will lead a  ______ 19 ______  life.” “The new glasses not only color my world, but also light up my life.” said Henderson. The  ______ 20 ______  in the glasses will inspire(鼓舞、激励) him to express his gratitude(感恩) on his life stage.

questions.prompt: — I like watching comedies. —  ______  are funny, but I prefer serious movies.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我喜欢看喜剧。 ——它们很有趣，但我更喜欢严肃的电影。 考查代词。A. It它；B. She她；C. We我们；D. They它们。根据句意及句中谓语are提示，空格处应填入指代上文comedies的代词。名词comedies为复数形式，指物，故应用第三人称复数代词they，故选D。

questions.prompt: The activity is going to begin  ______  3:30 this Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：活动将于本周五下午3:30开始。 考查时间介词辨析。at表示某一具体时刻（即几点几分时）；on表示“在具体某一天”或“（在具体的某一天的）早上、中午、晚上”等；in用于表示一段时间，或用于年、月、日、世纪、四季或泛指一天的上午、下午、晚上等，还可用于表示“从现在起，多长时间以后或多久以后”；of……的，表示所属关系。根据3:30是具体时刻，可知应用at；故答案选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the sports club? — At least once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去一次体育俱乐部？——每周至少一次。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长（对时间/长度提问）；How much多少/多少钱；How often多久一次；How far多远（对距离提问）。根据答语“At least once a week.”可知，此处应对频率提问，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to go with me? —I'd love to,  ______  I'm afraid I have to do my homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你愿意和我一起去吗?——我很想去，但恐怕我得做家庭作业。 考查并列连词辨析。and和，表示并列关系；or或者，表示选择关系；so因此、所以，表示因果关系；but但是，表示转折关系。根据“ I'd love to我很想去”以及“I'm afraid I have to do my homework. 恐怕我得做家庭作业”判断两句之间互为转折关系，所以用but连接，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Must I return the magazine to the library now? — No, you  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我现在必须把杂志还给图书馆吗？ ——不，你不需要。 考查情态动词。A. shouldn’t不应该；B. needn’t不需要；C. mustn’t禁止；D. can’t不能。根据英语语法，以must开头的一般疑问句，肯定回答要用must，否定回答要用needn’t或don’t have to。故选B。

questions.prompt: I had to take a taxi because the box was ______  than I expected.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不得不叫一辆出租车，因为箱子比我想象要重。 考查形容词比较级辨析。the heaviest形容词最高级；heaviest形容词最高级；heavy形容词原级；heavier形容词比较级。than表示两者进行比较，要用比较级，故选D。

questions.prompt: Victor will write to his mother as soon as he  ______  in Australia.
questions.explanation: 句意：Victor一到澳大利亚就会给他妈妈写信。 考查一般现在时。arrived一般过去时；arrive到达，动词原形，一般现在时；arrives一般现在时的第三人称单数；will arrive一般将来时。分析句子结构可知，本句是as soon as引导的时间状语从句，遵循主将从现的原则，主句是一般将来时will+动词原形，从句用一般现在时，而且从句的主语he是第三人称单数，所以谓语动词也要用第三人称单数形式；故选C。

questions.prompt: Listen! Grandpa  ______  in the living room now.
questions.explanation: 句意：听！爷爷现在正在客厅唱歌。 考查动词时态。根据Listen，可知听的是正在发生的事情，所以句子时态用现在进行时，其结构为am/is/are+动词的现在分词，主语是第三人称单数，be动词用is，sing的现在分词是singing；故选A。

questions.prompt: My friend, Jean,  ______  reading Good English since two years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的朋友吉恩两年前就已经阅读完《典范英语》。 考查动词的时态。根据“since two years ago”动作过去就已经发生并对现在造成影响“已经阅读完《典范英语》”，可知是现在完成时态，用has finished。故选B。

questions.prompt: Millions of children  ______  Shanghai Disneyland every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年都有数百万儿童参观上海迪士尼乐园。 考查动词时态。visited 一般过去时；will visit一般将来时；visit参观，动词原形，一般现在时；are visiting现在进行时。根据时间状语every year，可知句子时态用一般现在时，主语Millions of children是复数，所以谓语动词用原形；故答案选C。

questions.prompt: He  ______  as volunteer at the Beijing Marathon(马拉松) last month.
questions.explanation: 句意：上个月，他作为志愿者参加了北京马拉松比赛。 考查动词时态。are working现在进行时；work动词原形，一般现在时；worked一般过去时；will work；一般将来时。根据时间状语last month上个月，可知句子时态用一般过去时，故答案选C。

questions.prompt: I wonder  ______  the day after tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想知道他后天是否会来。 考查宾语从句。根据I wonder  ______ ，可知本题考查宾语从句，宾语从句的语序要用陈述语序，A、B选项是疑问语序，所以排除；再由the day after tomorrow后天，判断时态是一般将来时，谓语动词用will+动词原形，C选项是一般现在时态，排除；故选D。 二、完形填空 David had a new baby sister. She lay in a bassinet（婴儿摇篮）in the kitchen, and everyone thought she was wonderful. Aunt Sue came first thing in the morning to see her. She gave David a hug at the door and  ______ 13 ______  him a package. But when he started to open it, she said, “This is for the baby. You and I will have a treat later this week.” Slowly David walked outside. He had swept the front porch（门厅） this morning, even the leaves that were  ______ 14 ______  in the corners—but Aunt Sue hadn’t noticed. He heard whistling down the block. It was Mr. Larkin, the mailman. David decided to meet him. He jumped all the way down the sidewalk on one foot and didn’t even fall down. But Mr. Larkin just said, “I hear you have a new baby sister. Aren’t you  ______ 15 ______?” And he gave David the mail. David walked with heavy steps back to the house. Mother and Aunt Sue were still talking, even though it was almost lunchtime. He put the mail on the table and  ______ 16 ______  a peanut-butter-and-jelly sandwich. He made it just right. It wasn’t even drippy（滴水的）. His brother Jeff, home from kindergarten, rushed into the kitchen. David held up his sandwich. “Look, Jeff. I made my own  ______ 17 ______.” But Jeff just nodded and said, “Guess what? The baby smiled at me!” David ate his sandwich. It wasn’t that good after all. He could hardly taste the jelly. The house was quiet. Mother and the baby were taking a nap, and Jeff was outside playing. David got out his crayons and drew a whole page of turtles, each a different color. The front door opened. It was his big sister Beth, home from high school. He took his picture in to show her. She smiled. Then she took out a little package and said, “Look, David. I got these little shoes for  ______ 18 ______. Aren’t they cute?” And she ran upstairs to show Mother. David went outside and got his bike. He rode up and down the sidewalk, very slowly. His stomach hurt. Finally he went back in the house. Mother was just coming out of the kitchen. She held out her arms. “Come and give me a hug, David. I’ve hardly seen you all day. What have you been doing?” All of a sudden his stomach felt better. He gave his mother a big hug and took her hand. “I’ll show you,” he said. He took her out on the porch. “ David, you swept the porch — you even got the leaves in the corners!” He felt a big smile pop out on his face. He jumped down all the steps on one foot. She clapped. “And you didn’t even  ______ 19 ______.” He took her back in the house to see his turtle picture. She looked at each turtle carefully. “David, this is a wonderful picture. Let’s put it up on the refrigerator, so Daddy can see it when he gets home.” They walked together into the kitchen. There was the baby, still sleeping and making little wiggling noises. David looked at his mother, but she was busy taping his picture to the refrigerator. He reached over and touched the baby’s hand. She grabbed（抓住）his finger and held on  ______ 20 ______. A warm, wonderful feeling filled David. Mother walked over and put her arm around his shoulder. “I’m glad this baby has you for a big brother.” David smiled up at Mother. “Me too,” he said.

questions.prompt: Peter's sister is a manager and  ______ works in a big company.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得的姐姐是经理，她在一家大公司工作。 考查代词。he他，人称代词主格；she她，人称代词主格；his他的，物主代词；her她的，物主代词；根据句意理解及句子结构分析可知，空格在句中做主语，做主语用主格，所以排除C/ D选项，而前句说的是Peter’s sister，所以这里应该用she代替，故选B。 【点睛】英语中人称代词分为主格和宾格。主格做主语，宾格做宾语，所以做题要理解句子结构，分析在句中的成分，本题代词做主语，所以用主格，且指代的是女性，所以用she代替。

questions.prompt: We often have a family meeting  ______  Monday evenings.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们经常在星期一晚上举行家庭会议。 考查介词。on表示在具体的某一天或某一天的上午、下午、晚上；of表示……的；in表示在某年、某季、某月、某世纪，也可表示在上午、下午或晚上。at表示在某一具体时刻即几点几分。根据空后Monday evenings，结合句意可知，此空应填介词on，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______ does your mother go to the supermarket? —Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妈妈多久去一次超级市场？——一周一次。 考查特殊疑问句。How often多久一次；How long多长；How far多远；How soon还有多久；根据句意理解及回答Once a week.可知，这里是提问动作发生的频率，英语中提问频率用How often，故选A。 【点睛】英语中常用的几个特殊疑问词的用法要注意区别。How often多久一次，提问频率，本题就是提问频率；How many多少，提问可数名词复数；How much多少，提问不可数名词；How far多远，提问距离；How old多大，提问年龄；How long多长，提问时间持续多久或者具体物品的长度，做题时注意区分，根据句意理解来判断。

questions.prompt: I called Jim last night,  ______  he didn’t answer the phone.
questions.explanation: 句意：我昨晚给吉姆打了电话，但他没有接。 考查连词辨析。for因为；and和；but但是；or或者。根据题干“I called Jim last night…he didn’t answer the phone”可知，前后是转折关系，需用转折连词but。故选C。

questions.prompt: In order to catch up with her classmates, Lily works  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了赶上同学，Lily比以前更加努力学习。 考查副词的比较级。hard努力地，副词原形；harder更努力地，副词hard的比较级；hardest最努力地，副词hard的最高级；the hardest最努力地，副词hard的最高级，根据空前的“works”和空后的“than”可知，空缺处应该用副词hard的比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: David, you  ______  take your umbrella. It is not raining.
questions.explanation: 句意：大卫，你不必带伞。现在没有下雨。 考查情态动词辨析。needn’t不必，指没有必要；can’t 不可能，表否定推测； mustn’t不能，表禁止；might not也许不，表推测。根据下句“It is not raining”可知，是说没必要带伞，需用needn’t，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Tom, hurry up! We  ______  for you. —Just one minute.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆,快点!我们正在等你。——就一分钟。 考查时态。wait 一般现在时态；waited 过去式； are waiting 现在进行时态形式；have waited现在完成时态形式。根据Just one minute.可知，此空应填现在进行时态形式，表示将来的意思，结合句意可知，此空应填 are waiting ，故选C。

questions.prompt: If there  ______  anything I can do to help, please let me know.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果有什么我能帮忙的，请告诉我。 考查there be句型。is是，be动词的单数形式；will be一般将来时；was是，is的过去式；has been现在完成时，根据if引导的条件状语从句，时态遵循“主祈从现”原则可知，空缺处应该用一般现在时，故选A。

questions.prompt: Mr. Johnson met an old friend when he  ______  down the street.
questions.explanation: 句意：约翰逊先生在街上走的时候遇到了一位老朋友。 考查过去进行时态。walks一般现在时态的第三人称单数形式； is walking 现在进行时态的第三人称单数形式；will walk 一般将来时态形式；was walking过去进行时态的第三人称单数形式。根据 when当⋅⋅⋅⋅⋅⋅的时候，引导时间状语从句时从句的谓语动词用进行时态。且主句动词为met，可知从句用过去进行时。结合句意可知，此空应填 was walking，故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  that movie several times, and I still want to see it again.
questions.explanation: 句意：我已经看了那部电影好几次了，我仍然想去再看一次。 考查现在完成时。see“观看”，根据空后的“several times”可知，此处是指看过好几次了，应用现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Patients  ______  good care of when they stay in hospital.
questions.explanation: 句意：病人住院期间受到很好的照顾。 考查一般现在时态的被动语态。take 动词原形；took 过去式；are taken 一般现在时态的被动语态；were taken一般过去时态的被动语态。根据空前主语Patients可知，是表示被动关系，故排除A和B；根据从句when they stay in hospital.，可知，从句是一般现在时态的被动语态，故排除D，故选C。

questions.prompt: Mary is a very kind girl. We all like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：Mary是一个非常善良的女孩，我们都喜欢她。 考查代词。him他；her她；me我；them他们。前句提到girl“女孩”，此处代指女孩，故选B。

questions.prompt: Our school’s Talent Show will be  ______  November 2nd this year.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校的才艺表演将在今年11月2日举行。 考查介词辨析。on用于具体某一日之前；in用于年、月以及早中晚之前；at用于点时间之前；to对于。November 2nd是具体日子，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you usually do science experiments? —In the lab.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你通常在哪里做科学实验？——在实验室里。 考查特殊疑问词辨析。How怎样；When什么时候；Where哪里；Why为什么。根据“In the lab.”可知，实验室是地点，对地点进行提问应用疑问词where。故选C。

questions.prompt: I am very tired  ______  I want to go to bed early.
questions.explanation: 句意：我非常累，所以我想早点睡。 考查连词辨析。but但是；or或者；否则；so所以，因此；for因为。两句之间为因果关系，后句表结果，故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  I see your ID card, sir? We have to check your information.
questions.explanation: 句意：先生,我可以看看你的身份证吗？我们必须检查你的信息。 考查情态动词辨析。May可以，可能，表示请求许可；Must必须，一定；Should应该；Need需要。结合语境可知，本题为请求允许，故选A。

questions.prompt: Betty is  ______  than any other girl in her class.
questions.explanation: 句意：贝蒂比她班上的任何其他女孩都高。 考查形容词比较级。根据than可知是比较级的标志，意为“比”，形容词用比较级形式taller。故选B。

questions.prompt: Tom lives near school, so he usually  ______  to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆住在学校附近，所以他通常步行上学。 考查时态。根据usually可知频度副词是一般现在时的标志，且主语为he，故填第三人称单数形式。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  dinner when Jim telephoned me yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天晚上吉姆打电话给我时，我正在吃晚饭。 考查过去进行时。根据“when Jim telephoned me yesterday evening”可知“昨天晚上吉姆打电话给我时”是过去的具体时间，用过去进行时，结构为was/were doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: —What did you do last night? —I  ______  a report in the office.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你昨晚做了什么？——我在办公室写了一份报告。 考查一般过去时。wrote写，write的过去式；write写，动词原形；will write将要写，应用于一般将来时态；have written已经写了，应用于现在完成时态。通过“last night”可知，答句的时态为一般过去时，write的过去式为wrote。故选A。

questions.prompt: —I didn’t see Amy today. —She is ill. She  ______  in hospital since Monday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我今天没见到艾米。——她病了。她从星期一起一直住院。 考查现在完成时。根据时间状语“since Monday（从星期一起）”可知，“住院”这个状态从过去一直持续到现在，所以该句时态应用现在完成时，其构成为“have/has done”。故选D。

questions.prompt: The 2022 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games  ______  in Beijing and Zhangjiakou next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：2022年冬奥会和残奥会将于明年在北京和张家口举行。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。根据“next year（明年）”可知，此句时态应用一般将来时；根据语境可知，主语“The 2022 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games（2022年冬奥会和残奥会）”和谓语动词“hold（举办）”是被动关系，所以此句应用一般将来时的被动语态。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Lucy, do you know  ______? —Oh, yes. She comes from the USA.

choices.label: A
choices.text: where does Miss Smith come from

choices.label: C
choices.text: where did Miss Smith come from

questions.explanation: 句意：——Lucy，你知道Smith女士来自哪里？——哦，知道，她来自美国。 考查宾语从句。首先宾语从句为陈述句语序，故排除AC；根据“She comes from the USA.”可知是一般现在时，故选B。 二、完形填空(每题1分，共8分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Basketball Star Two seconds were left on the clock, we were down by one point, and I was at the free throw line. If I made the first shot, I would take a second shot. If we lost, we were out. It was the playoffs (决赛). I started playing basketball for fun in the sixth grade. From the beginning, I had to play hard. I am not a  ______ 13 ______  player, but I liked basketball. I practiced outside for hours and hours, days and days and my shot had become very good. I spent part of my summers at basketball camp, in spite of the Florida  ______ 14 ______. More importantly, I played as hard as I possibly could, every game. I was finally able to  ______ 15 ______  the school team in eighth grade, and had even worked my way up to being a starter. I was known as the unofficial re-bounder of the team. I would jump and grab the rebounds. And I could  ______ 16 ______  perfectly and score points. I could not run as fast or jump as high or dribble (运球) the ball as well as my naturally athletic teammates, but that never bothered me. We all have our gifts, but through hard work, I could do anything I wanted to do. So this was my  ______ 17 ______. I had the ball in my hand, all eyes on me. I was a good free throw shooter. I’d practiced a thousand times. But on that day, on that shot, I  ______ 18 ______. I immediately jumped up for the rebound. Someone from the other team got it though, and the game was over. The season was over. We were out. After the game, all the players and parents met outside for water. Coach thanked everyone for a great season. He mentioned a few people who he thought had a good game. Then he said, “Mallory, where’s Mallory?” He found me and pointed to me. “ ______ 19 ______,” he said and encouraged me. And everyone in the room started to clap hands for me. I learned that day that there isn’t such a thing as “your moment” in this life. Who you are does not come down to one success or one failure. What you do and how hard you work every single day that does  ______ 20 ______. And it is remembered.

questions.prompt: —Jane, do you know where the post office is? I want to buy some  ______. —Of course. Follow me, please.
questions.explanation: 句意：——简，你知道邮局在哪里吗？我想买一些邮票。——当然。请跟我来。 考查名词辨析。textbooks教科书；stamps邮票；shoes鞋子；lanterns灯笼。根据“Jane, do you know where the post office is?”可知空处指的是买邮票。故选B。

questions.prompt: — How does Tom go to the office? — He  ______  drive a car, but now he  ______  there to keep healthy.

choices.label: A
choices.text: used to; is used to walk

choices.label: B
choices.text: was used to; is used to walking

choices.label: C
choices.text: was used to; is used to walk

choices.label: D
choices.text: used to; is used to walking

questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆怎么去办公室？——他过去常常开车，可现在他为了保持健康习惯于走着去那里。 考查固定搭配。used to do sth.“过去常常做某事”；be used to doing sth.“习惯于做某事”。根据答语句意“他过去常常开车，可现在他为了保持健康习惯于走着去那里”，故选D。 【点睛】与use相关的几个较容易弄混的用法如下：①used to do sth.表示“过去常常做某事”；②be/get used to doing sth.表示“习惯于做某事”；③be used to do sth.表示“被用来做某事”。

questions.prompt: The boy is such an excellent table tennis player in our school that we  ______  him.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个男孩是我们学校如此优秀的一位乒乓球运动员，我们为他感到自豪。 考查形容词短语和动词短语。A. be proud of“为…….感到自豪”，相当于C. take pride in；B. be afraid of“害怕……”；D. take care of“照顾；照看”。从句的主语we为复数人称代词，谓语动词应为复数形式，故可排除C、D两项；由“这个男孩是我们学校如此优秀的一位乒乓球运动员”可推知“我们为他感到自豪”，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Your sweater looks nice. Is it made  ______  cotton? — Yes, and it was made  ______  Shanghai.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的毛衣看起来好看。它是由棉花制成的吗？——是的，它是上海被制作。 本题可用“辨析法”解答。be made of意为“用……制成（从成品中能看出原材料）”；be made from意为“用……制成（从成品中不能看出原材料）”；be made by意为“由……制造的”，by后接动作执行者；be made in意为“在……制造”，in后接地点。结合题干，棉（cotton）制的毛衣从成品是可以看出原材料的，故第一个空用of；第二个空后Shanghai是地点，故应用in。故选B。 【点睛】1.be made of 表示制成成品后，仍可看出原材料是什么，保留原材料的质和形状,制作过程仅发生物理变化.。如：The kite is made of paper．风筝是用纸做的。

questions.prompt: Most young people find  ______  exciting to watch a football match.
questions.explanation: 句意：大多数年轻人发现看足球比赛是非常令人激动的。 考查代词辨析。this这，这个；that那，那个；it它；one一个。根据句子结构可知，该句中使用了句型find it+形容词+to do sth.“发现做某事是……的”，其中it是形式宾语，动词不定式是真正的宾语。故选C。

questions.prompt: We all try to avoid useless things in order not to waste money.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了不浪费钱，我们都努力避免买没有用的东西。avoid doing sth避免做某事，故此处用动名词buying，故答案为C。

questions.prompt: My hometown is famous its seafood.Lots of visitors go there and enjoy the seafood every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的家乡以海鲜而闻名。每年很多游客去那里，品尝海鲜。根据be famous for因为……而出名；be famous as作为……而出名。结合句意，我的家乡因为海鲜而出名，故选C。

questions.prompt: A baby’s first month birthday is a special event in China and  ______  with a special party.
questions.explanation: 句意：在中国，婴儿的满月生日是一件特别的事情，人们会举行一个特别的派对来庆祝。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“is”可知，and连接的并列谓语时态保持一致，因此此处也用一般现在时；主语“A baby’s first month birthday”与celebrate之间是动宾关系，因此空处用一般现在时的被动语态am/is/are done。故选A。

questions.prompt: These old newspapers can be  ______  some beautiful and creative clothes. That sounds really interesting.
questions.explanation: 句意：这些旧报纸能被变成一些美丽的，有创意的衣服。那听起来非常有趣。turn on打开;turn off关闭;turn in 上交;turn into变成。结合本题语境可知,这些旧报纸可以被变成漂亮、有创意的衣服。故答案为D。

questions.prompt: —A number of students  ______  in the dining hall. —Let me count. The number of the students  ______  about 400.
questions.explanation: 句意：——许多学生在食堂里。——让我数一数。学生的数量大约是400名。 考查主谓一致以及be动词。a number of表示“许多”，修饰复数名词作主语，be动词用复数形式；the number of表示“……的数量”，修饰名词作主语，be动词用is，故选A。

questions.prompt: To help me get better grades this term, my mom warns me  ______  so many computer games, and my dad suggests  ______  more exercises.
questions.explanation: 句意：为了帮助我这学期取得更好的成绩，我妈妈警告我不要玩那么多电脑游戏，我爸爸建议我多做运动。 考查非谓语动词。not to play动词不定式的否定形式；don’t play一般现在时态的动词否定形式；to do动词不定式；doing现在分词/动名词。根据动词短语warn sb. not to do sth.“警告某人不要做某事”，可知第一个空填not to play；根据suggest doing sth.“建议做某事”可知，第二个空应填doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Judy, could you tell me  ______  the schoolbag? —Oh, yes. I bought it in a store on the Internet.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Judy，你能告诉我你在哪儿买的书包吗？——哦，可以。我在网上的一个店里买的。 考查宾语从句。where did you buy问句语序，一般过去时；where you bought陈述句语序，一般过去时；where will you buy问句语序，将来时；where you will buy陈述句语序，一般将来时。分析句子并结合“I bought it in a store on the Internet.”可知，横线上应是宾语从句，陈述句语序，一般过去时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —The doctor told me not to eat too much, but I find it is difficult. —The doctor is right.  ______  you eat  ______  you will be.
questions.explanation: 句意：——医生告诉我不要吃太多，但我发现这很困难。——医生是对的，你吃的越少，你就会越健康。 考查比较级。the+比较级…the+比较级...表示“越……就越……”，healthy的比较级是healthier，排除CD；根据“The doctor told me not to eat too much”可知，吃得“越少”，你就会“越健康”，第一个空用The less。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Did you watch the basketball match yesterday? —Yes, we were all  ______  about the  ______  match.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你昨天看篮球赛了吗？——是的，我们都为这场激动人心的比赛感到兴奋。 考查形容词辨析。exciting令人激动的，形容事物；excited感到激动的，形容人。第一空的主语是人，故用excited形容人的感受。第二空修饰名词match，形容事物，因此用exciting。故选D。

questions.prompt: We shouldn’t laugh at people.They need help and we should give them a hand.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们不应该嘲笑处于困境中的人。他们需要帮助，我们应该帮助他们． 考查介词短语。in trouble处于困境中；in public当众；in person亲自；in silence沉默地；根据They need help and we should give them a hand.可知是我们不应该嘲笑处于困境中的人，故答案选A。 二、完形填空（每小题 2 分，共 20 分） I’m a school teacher and I can only take long breaks during the Christmas holidays. This time, my good friend Vic and I decided to go  ______ 16 ______  through Europe. Venice is famous for its special canals（运河）, and it was the first place we chose. Venice is made up of 118 small islands separated by canals and connected by  ______ 17 ______. In the winter the city isn’t too crowded, and the environment is very  ______ 18 ______. Even though it was cold, the sun shone from a clear blue sky,  ______ 19 ______  it was perfect weather for visiting all of the narrow streets with shops, cafes and restaurants. We ate lots of different food! Every morning we had milk, cakes and fruit for  ______ 20 ______. We also had mouth-watering pizza, baked eggplants（茄子）and delicious spinach（菠菜）。 We saw the  ______ 21 ______  of the city’s most famous church—Saint Mark’s Basilica. We got there by water bus—a big boat that carried people across the canals. We  ______ 22 ______  the amazing old buildings, We also went to the island of Murano, which is  ______ 23 ______  for its beautiful color. You can’t  ______ 24 ______  Venice without taking a trip on a gondola（凤尾船）. The traditional boats are  ______ 25 ______  for people to travel in the narrow（窄）canals. For centuries the gondola has been the main way of transportation（交通）in Venice, and even today local people and tourists still use it to cross the Grand Canal.

questions.prompt: Miss Wang is our English teacher.  ______  is always patient with us.
questions.explanation: 王老师是我们的英语老师。她对我们总是很有耐心。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；we我们；they他们。根据题干“Miss Wang is our English teacher…is always patient with us”，可知是说王老师很有耐心，设空处指代Miss Wang需用she，故选B。

questions.prompt: Paper cuts are seen  ______  doors, walls and windows during the Spring Festival.
questions.explanation: 句意：春节期间，门上、墙上、窗户上的剪纸随处可见。 考查介词。in在……里面；to到；on在……上面；at在某时、某地。根据“...doors, walls, and windows...”可知，此处应用介词on，表示“在门上、墙上、桌子上”。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  can I read faster, Jack? —You can read faster by reading word groups.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我怎样才能读得更快，杰克？——通过阅读词组，你可以读得更快。 考查疑问词辨析。When什么时候；How如何，怎样；Why为什么；Where哪里。根据答语中的“by reading word groups”可知询问的是方式。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Must I finish reading this book today, Mr. Brown? —No, you  ______. It’s due next week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Brown老师，我必须今天读完这本书么？——没必要，截止日期是下个星期。 考查情态动词。needn’t没必要；can’t不可能；mustn’t禁止；shouldn’t不应该。根据提问“Must I finish reading this book today...”以及回答“No...”可知，此处应用needn’t，表示“没必要”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Paula used to be short and quiet,  ______  now she is tall and outgoing.
questions.explanation: 句意：保拉过去矮小安静，但现在她又高又外向。 考查转折连词but的用法。but但是；or或者；so所以；for因为。分析题干前后句可知是转折的关系，故选A。

questions.prompt: Basketball is  ______  than tennis among teenage boys.
questions.explanation: 句意：在十几岁的男孩中，篮球比网球更受欢迎。 考查形容词比较级。根据句中“than”和“is”可知，此处使用形容词比较级，popular的比较级为more popular。故选B。

questions.prompt: Don’t give up, Ben. If you keep on trying, you  ______  progress soon.
questions.explanation: 句意：别放弃，本。如果你继续努力，你很快就会进步的。 考查if引导的条件状语从句。make制作（动词原形）；made制作（make的过去式或过去分词）；will make制作（make的一般将来时结构）；are making制作（make的现在进行时结构）。根据句意可知，本题考查if引导的条件状语从句，如果主句用一般将来时，从句则用一般现在时。空格所在句为主句，应该用一般将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mr. Smith  ______  in an animal hospital since 2008.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯先生自2008年以来一直在一家动物医院工作。 考查动词时态辨析。分析句子可知，since 2008表示“自从2008年以来”，是一段持续至今的时间，句子需用现在完成时；结合选项，故选D。

questions.prompt: Chinese tea ______  to many countries around the world every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国茶每年被运往世界各地。 考查被动语态。Chinese tea与send构成被动关系，所以应用被动语态，表示“中国茶被运往”。再结合“every year”可知，本题应用一般现在时，一般现在时的被动语态构成是am/is/are done。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me  ______? —Sure. I bought them in the store next to our school.

choices.label: B
choices.text: where did you buy the shoes

choices.label: C
choices.text: where you will buy the shoes

choices.label: D
choices.text: where will you buy the shoes

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你在哪里买的鞋子吗？——当然，我在学校旁边的店里买的。 考查宾语从句。where you bought the shoes 你在哪里买的鞋子，陈述语序，一般过去时；where did you buy the shoes你在哪里买的鞋子，疑问语序，一般过去时；where you will buy the shoes你要去哪里买鞋子，陈述语序，一般将来时；where will you buy the shoes你要去哪里买鞋子，疑问语序，一般将来时。根据句意可知，空处的句子是宾语从句，应用陈述语序，故排除B、D项；主句是一般现在时，根据答语“I bought them in the store next to our school.”可知，宾语从句的动作发生在过去，故应用一般过去时，故排除C项。故选A。 五、完形填空（每题1.5分，共12分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Finding the Awesomeness My family hadn’t done anything different for long. So when my aunt invited us to her farm for a spring celebration last month, I was so excited that I decided to make some special cupcakes. On that day, everything went wrong. First we had to wait for Ted to find his shoes. On the half way, we had to go back to the house as Mom  ______ 11 ______  her wallet at home. Then, we drove far to find a restroom for Indi. After that, my parents decided to take a shortcut, which ended up turning into a long cut! We were driving forever on a winding road when our car started making a strange noise. “Sorry,” said my mom. “We have to pull over and call roadside service.” “Don’t worry,” said Dad. “I’m sure  ______ 12 ______  will come soon.” Actually, help did not arrive soon at all. “We’re going to  ______ 13 ______  everything!” said Ted. I just sighed (叹气). “Look on the bright side,” said Dad. “Our car couldn’t have picked a  ______ 14 ______  place to break down.” It was true. There were various wildflowers dancing on the sea of grass, with strong trees as their guards. Mom got the picnic blanket out. “How about walking over to that wildflower field and have our own  ______ 15 ______?” At first, we kids weren’t exactly jumping up and down about the idea. But as we looked around, cool things started happening. “Hey!” Indi said. “This huge butterfly  ______ 16 ______  on my knee! She’s so beautiful.” “Look!” Mom pointed at two cute rabbits happily eating grass. “We’re not the only ones who think this is a good spot for a  ______ 17 ______.” Just then, we noticed hundreds of birds rose up out of the trees and flew into the sky in the most amazing patterns! “Wow! That’s the most magical thing I’ve ever seen!” said Ted. Finally, we didn’t make it to the farm, and we ate my cupcakes — they were so delicious! Sometimes you can get discouraged, but do not give up! Try to stay  ______ 18 ______  to what’s happening around you! You might just discover unexpected awesomeness right under your nose!

questions.prompt: —Is this your ruler, Mary? —No. It’s not  ______. I think it’s Lily’s.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玛丽，这是你的尺子吗？——不，它不是我的。我认为这是丽丽的（尺子）。 考查代词辨析。hers她的；yours你的；mine我的；its它的。根据问句“Is this your ruler, Mary?”以及“No.”可知，应该回答“它不是我的。”故选C。

questions.prompt: Tom got a letter ______  his pen friend yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆昨天收到笔友的一封信。 考查动词短语。from“来自”；in“在……里面”；into“进入，朝”； at“在某地或某时”。get a letter from“收到某人的来信”，固定搭配。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Jack， ______  did you take this photo? —In Beijing. I went there with my uncle last summer holiday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jack，你在哪里拍的这张照片？——在北京。去年暑假我和我的叔叔去那里了。 考查疑问词词义辨析。when什么时候，对时间提问；where在哪里，对地点提问；who谁，对人提问；why为什么，提问原因。根据回答“In Beijing.”可知，此处要用where对地点提问，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Would you like to go to the Universal Beijing Resort with me? —I’d love to,  ______  I’m afraid I have no time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你想和我一起去北京环球度假区吗？——我想去，但是恐怕我没有时间。 考查连词辨析。because因为；and和；but但是；or或者。根据“I’d love to...I’m afraid I have no time.”可知句子前后是转折关系，故选C。

questions.prompt: The Yangtze River is  ______  river in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：长江是中国最长的河。 考查形容词最高级。long“长的”；longer“更长的”；longest“最长的”；the longest“最长”。根据“in China” 可知用最高级，最高级前要加冠词the，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Kate,  ______  you help me with my gardening this Sunday morning? —Of course I can, Mom.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Kate，这个星期天早上你能帮我做园艺吗？——我当然可以，妈妈。 考查情态动词。need需要；can能够，可以；must必须；should应该。根据语境和答语“Of course I can”可知，此处用can进行提问。故选B。

questions.prompt: If it  ______  tomorrow, the sports meet will be put off.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天下雨，运动会将推迟。 考查动词时态。if引导条件状语从句中，遵循“主将从现”原则，rain“下雨”，是动词，从句主语it是第三人称单数，此处要变第三人称单数，故选A。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing at about 4 o’clock yesterday afternoon? —I  ______  to music.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天下午4点左右你在做什么？——我在听音乐。 考查过去进行时。根据“What were you doing at about 4 o’clock yesterday afternoon?”可知，此处问过去的某个时间点正在发生的动作，用过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Jenny is my English teacher. She ______  English for 25 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：珍妮是我的英语老师。她教了25年英语。 考查动词时态。根据“for 25 years”可知本句是现在完成时，其结构为：have/has+done。主语是“she”，因此用has。故选B。

questions.prompt: Please be quiet. My sister  ______  an online class.
questions.explanation: 句意：请安静。我姐姐正在上网课。 考查动词时态。根据“Please be quiet.”可知，此句为现在进行时，即“主语+be+doing”。主语“My sister”是第三人单数，be动词用is。故选A。

questions.prompt: The Palace Museum is famous all over the world. It  ______  hundreds of years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：故宫在全世界很有名。好几百年前它被建立。 考查被动语态。结合时间状语“hundreds of ago”可知应该使用一般过去时，“it”指代“The Palace Museum”，和“build”是被动关系。使用一般过去时的被动语态：was/were+过去分词，主语是单数，应该是“was built”。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Excuse me. Could you tell me  ______  for Shanghai? —At 8:30 tomorrow morning.

choices.label: A
choices.text: when will the latest train leave

choices.label: B
choices.text: when did the latest train leave

choices.label: C
choices.text: when the latest train will leave

questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下。你能告诉我最近一趟去上海的火车什么时候离开？——明天早上八点半。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句需要使用陈述句语序，排除A和B。根据答语“At 8:30 tomorrow morning”，明天早上八点半，应该是一般将来时。故选C。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Beginner’s Mind When Helen chose to go to Taekwondo camp, she was really excited about her summer. However, when she was here, she felt differently. She was interested in Taekwondo for many years but had never  ______ 13 ______  before. Many of the campers here had come to this camp for several years. Helen  ______ 14 ______  a group of laughing girls on their way to the practice hall. They introduced themselves, told jokes and Helen laughed with them. At the door of the practice room, Jenny, a third-year camper, introduced herself as Helen’s  ______ 15 ______. Jenny told Helen how partnering worked: “You’ll take the place behind me, and follow what I do.” The campers took off their shoes, entered the big, bright space and  ______ 16 ______  lined (排成一队) up. The practice room was calm. Helen lined up behind Jenny, thankfully, in the very back row. Miss Johnson their instructor (教练), stepped to the front of the room and bowed. Everyone else returned the gesture. “Welcome,” said Miss Johnson. “We have a few  ______ 17 ______  with us, so let’s recite (背诵) the rules first.” As Helen recited them, she looked around and saw several other girls with beginner’s belts (腰带). “I’m not the only beginner,” she thought and felt  ______ 18 ______. Miss Johnson demonstrated (示范) some stretches (伸展). Then the campers did them by themselves while Miss Johnson walked around and  ______ 19 ______  their positions. Helen kept her eyes on Jenny. The stretching continued, and Helen started to feel more comfortable. All the campers were doing the same thing; she didn’t feel out of place, just part of the  ______ 20 ______. After the class, Helen followed the campers as they went out of the room. She was no longer worried about the summer ahead.

questions.prompt: My brother likes math.  ______  dream is to be a math teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：我弟弟喜欢数学。他的梦想是当一名数学老师。 考查代词。My我的；Her她的；Their他们的；His他的；根据“My brother likes math.”可知，此处指代的是“My brother”，应用his代替，故选D。

questions.prompt: The Beijing 2022 Olympic Winter Games will open  ______  February 4th.
questions.explanation: 句意：2022年北京冬奥会将于2月4日开幕。 考查介词。on在，表示具体的、特定的某一天；at在，表示具体的时间点；in在，表示某个时间段；from从，表示“从一个时间点到另外一个时间点”的时候，需要跟另外一个介词to或till连用。“February 4th”2月4日是一个具体的日子，应使用介词on。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the school library? — Twice a week. I love reading there.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去一次学校图书馆？——一周两次。我喜欢在那里读书。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少钱；How often多久一次；How long多长；How soon多久。根据答语“Twice a week.”可知，此处对频率进行提问，故选B。

questions.prompt: It was sunny last Sunday,  ______  we went to the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周日是晴天，因此我们去了公园。 考查连词辨析。or或者，否者；but但是；so因此，所以；for由于。由句中“晴朗的天气”与“去公园”可知两者是因果关系，故选C。

questions.prompt: Linda  ______  play the piano. She has never learned it.
questions.explanation: 句意：琳达不会弹钢琴。她从来没有学过。 考查情态动词。can’t不会；needn’t不必；mustn’t禁止；shouldn’t不应该；根据“She has never learned it.”可知，她不会弹钢琴，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Do you prefer to travel by train or by plane? — By plane, because it’s  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你喜欢坐火车还是飞机旅行？——坐飞机，因为它更快。 考查比较级。fast快的；faster更快的；fastest最快的；the fastest最快的；根据“Do you prefer to travel by train or by plane?”可知，此处隐含着两者之间的比较，应用比较级形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: Peter is my good friend. We often  ______  together.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得是我的好朋友。我们经常一起学习。 考查动词时态。study，动词，意为“学习”，根据“often”可知，句子时态为一般现在时，主语we是第一人称复数，动词用原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: They will have a party tomorrow, and now they  ______  for it.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们明天会有个派对，现在他们正在准备。 考查动词时态。prepare，动词，意为“准备”，prepare for...表示“为……做准备”，固定搭配；根据时间状语“now”可知，句子时态为现在进行时，其构成为：am/is/are+动词的现在分词；主语they是第三人称复数，be动词用are；prepare的现在分词是preparing。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  the floor when my mother came back home.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我妈妈回家时，我正在扫地。 考查时态辨析。根据“when my mother came back home”可知此处表示某一动作发生时，另一动作正在持续，从句用一般过去时，主句用过去进行时，其结构为was/were doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: Mr. Brown  ______  in Beijing for ten years. He enjoys his life here.
questions.explanation: 句意：布朗先生在北京生活了十年，他喜欢这里的生活。 考查动词时态。live，动词，意为“生活，居住”；根据时间状语“for ten years”可知，句子时态为现在完成时，其构成为：have/has+动词的过去分词；主语Mr. Brown是第三人称单数，助动词用has，live的过去分词是lived。故选B。

questions.prompt: Yuan Longping  ______  by Chinese people forever.
questions.explanation: 句意：袁隆平将被中国人民永远铭记。 考查动词语态。根据句意，主语和动词之间是被动关系，故应用被动语态，故排除A、C项；结合时间状语“forever”可知，应用一般将来时的被动语态，构成形式为：will be done，remember的过去分词是remembered。故选D。

questions.prompt: Kathy forgot  ______  her student card. It took her half an hour to find it.
questions.explanation: 句意：凯西忘了她把学生证放在哪里了。她花了半个小时才找到它。 考查宾语从句。此处是宾语从句，需用陈述语序，排除CD；根据“forgot”可知，时态是一般过去时，故选B。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Image（形象）Isn’t Everything Before I went to high school, I was eager to start my new life. I wanted to get into the  ______ 13 ______  of popular students at school, so I bought a new outfit（套装）to present a good image for myself. I was standing in the hall, looking  ______ 14 ______, when a short girl wearing glasses came up and asked, “Hi, my name is Judy. Are you new? Do you want me to help you find your class?” Although she seemed not the kind of girl I wanted to make friends with, I told her my name and followed her, making  ______ 15 ______  conversation the whole way. When we reached my classroom, she said, “It was nice meeting you. I hope your day goes all right. ”I said thanks and waved good-bye. In the classroom, I saw a big group of students around a girl wearing blue jeans with holes. She was talking about her adventures in summer. I thought this girl was popular. When the teacher came and told us to break up, I  ______ 16 ______  to get a seat next to her, and said, “Hi, my name is April and I’m new here.” She said, “Hi, I’m Ella.” Once the class was over, I turned to her and asked, “My next class is physics. Could you help me find it?” She said “No”  ______ 17 ______  and walked to her friends. I heard her say, “Did you see that new girl trying to get into our group? Her outfit is so strange.” They all looked at me and laughed. The same type of thing happened in other classes. When I was ready to go home, someone came up and said, “Hi, again. How was your first day?” It was Judy. I told her my day was not good. She said she was sorry and  ______ 18 ______  to walk me outside. Walking with Judy made me realize how  ______ 19 ______  it was to try to only make friends with popular people, and how nice it would be to have a friend like her. questions.prompt: Wang Yaping is the first Chinese woman to carry out a space walk. We are proud of  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：王亚平是第一位进行太空行走的中国女性。我们为她感到骄傲。 考查人称代词。me我，宾格；him他，宾格；her她，宾格或形容词性物主代词；them他们，宾格。根据“Wang Yaping is the first Chinese woman”可知，王亚平是女性。故选C。

questions.prompt: Many museums are closed  ______  Mondays.
questions.explanation: 句意：许多博物馆星期一闭馆。 考查介词辨析。to到；in在（某段时间）内，通常用于年月、季节、白天晚上等词前；at在（某时刻），通常用于钟点,夜晚中午或某些固定短语中；on在（某一天），通常用于星期、节日或具体的某一天。空后的“Mondays”是星期，因此此处用on。故选D。

questions.prompt: —  ______  does your mother go to work every day? —By underground.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妈妈每天怎么去上班？——乘地铁。 考查特殊疑问句。What“什么”；How“怎样，如何”；When“什么时候”；Why“为什么”。根据回答“By underground”可知询问上班的方式和乘坐的交通工具，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Jack,  ______  you ride a bike? — Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你会骑自行车吗？——是的，我会骑。 考查情态动词的用法。A．can能，会；B．may可以；C．need需要；D．must必须。“Can you…?”的肯定回答是：Yes，I /we can.否定回答是No，I/we can’t.。根据句意及答语可知，答案为A。

questions.prompt: Our school is tidy and clean,  ______  we often do the cleaning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的学校干净又整洁，因为我们经常打扫卫生。 考查连词辨析。or或者，否则；but但是；although虽然，尽管；because因为，由于。根据“Our school is tidy and clean...we often do the cleaning.”可知，句子前后为因果关系，后半句是原因，用because引导原因状语从句。故选D。

questions.prompt: The Internet is growing fast, and becomes  ______  than printing.
questions.explanation: 句意：互联网发展迅速，变得比印刷业更强大。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than printing”可知，此处使用形容词比较级，powerful的比较级为more powerful。故选B。

questions.prompt: Be quiet! Dad  ______  an online meeting now.
questions.explanation: 句意：安静！爸爸现在正在网上开会。 考查现进行时。根据“now”可知，此句用现在进行时be doing。故选B。

questions.prompt: If I start after dinner, I  ______  my task before I go to bed.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果在晚饭之后开始，在上床睡觉之前我会完成任务。 考查条件状语从句的时态。分析句子可知，此句为if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”。即主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时态。故选A。

questions.prompt: — What were you doing at four o’clock yesterday afternoon? — Oh, I  ______  a birthday cake for my mum.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天下午四点钟你在干什么？——哦，我在给我妈妈做生日蛋糕。 考查过去进行时。根据上文“What were you doing...”可知问句中用的是过去进行时，答句中也要用过去进行时回答，结构是“was/were doing”。主语是“I”是第一人称，所以用was doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: Many people  ______  the Forbidden City for many times, but they still want to go and enjoy literature and art there.
questions.explanation: 句意：很多人已经去过故宫很多次了，但他们仍然想去那里欣赏文学和艺术。 考查现在完成时。go to去，一般现在时；went to去，一般过去时；have been to去过，现在完成时；will go to将要去，一般将来时。根据“for many times”可知，此句用现在完成时，此处表示去过故宫很多次了，对故宫已有所了解。故选C。

questions.prompt: Look at the new park. It  ______  by the workers last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：看这个新公园。它是工人们去年建造的。 考查时态和语态。根据“last year”可知，句子时态用一般过去时；主语“It”指代“the new park”，它与谓语动词“build建造”构成被动关系。因此用一般过去时的被动语态：was/were+done。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me  ______? —Of course. It’s just next to the bank.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我最近的书店在哪里吗？——当然。就在银行旁边。 考查宾语从句。根据宾语从句用陈述语序的规则可知，选项C、D错误，故排除；主句中“Could”表示委婉语气，是一般现在时，对从句时态没有限制；由语境可知，从句应用一般现在时。故选A。 二、完形填空(每题1分，共8分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The season’s first snow made most kids cheerful, but Elton was not. But when the first snow of the winter came, Elton was always  ______ 13 ______  because he couldn’t swim, hike or ride his bike until spring. Elton’s mother knew he was unhappy. She tried to make him feel better with warm cookies. It only took him a few minutes to eat them all, and then his unhappy face returned. Elton’s mother told him to do his homework but he had finished it at school. “OK  ______ 14 ______  your room,” she suggested. Just then the doorbell rang—it was Lucy, Elton’s friend and neighbor. She  ______ 16 ______  Elton to come outside and make a snowman. Elton wrinkled(皱着) his nose. He didn’t like snow or winter. His mother said, “Yes, yes, he would like to go.” Then she sent her unhappy son out with Lucy. Lucy and Elton made the largest snowman they had ever seen. Elton’s mother sighed(叹气). Just then the doorbell rang again, it was Lucy. She asked Elton to go snowshoeing. Elton wrinkled his nose but said, “OK, I guess so.” Elton and Lucy wore the snowshoes and went snowshoeing through the trees behind the house. At lunchtime, Elton came inside with a happy look. He told his mom all about the  ______ 18 ______  he and Lucy had in the snow. Just then the doorbell rang it was Lucy. “Would you like to go sledding(滑雪橇)?” she said. questions.prompt: —Excuse me.  ______  is this pen? — It’s 15 yuan.

questions.prompt: —Tom, what did you do last weekend? — Oh, I  ______  TV at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tom，上周你做了什么？——哦，我在家看电视。 考查时态。根据“last weekend”可知询问上周的事情，用一般过去时。故选B。

questions.prompt: Look! “No food, please!” You  ______  eat in the library.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！“请勿吃东西！”你不准图书馆吃东西。 考查情态动词。can’t不能；needn’t不必；mustn’t禁止；couldn’t不能，是can’t的过去式。根据“No food, please!”可知，这是图书馆的“禁止标语”，所以禁止在这里吃东西。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mike, where is your dad? — He  ______  the car in the yard.

questions.prompt: Some people don’t have arms or legs,  ______  they can do lots of things.
questions.explanation: 句意：有些人没有胳膊或腿，但他们可以做很多事情。 考查连词辨析。so因此；but但是；and和；or或者。根据句意可知，空前空后之间是转折关系，应用but连接。故选B。

questions.prompt: Sam  ______  the piano every evening. He can play it very well.

questions.prompt: My mother works in our school. She an  ______  English teacher for 30 years.

questions.prompt: The 24th Winter Olympic Games  ______  on February 4th, 2022 in China.

questions.prompt: —Welcome to  ______  school! —Thank you. Your school is very beautiful.

questions.prompt: Yesterday I called him  ______  8:30, but nobody answered. A by
questions.explanation: 句意：我昨天在8:30给他打电话，但是没有接听。 考查时间介词。by+时间，表示“在……之前”；at表示“在某一时刻，某一时点”；in表示“在某世纪、年、季度、月、”以及泛指的上、下午、晚上；on表示“在具体某一天或某天的上、下午”。根据设空处后面的“ 8:30”。可知用at。故选B。

questions.prompt: He ran as fast as possible,  ______  he didn’t get there on time.

questions.prompt: —May I use your computer for games, Mum? —No. You  ______  finish your homework first.

questions.prompt: — ______  will you have the meeting? —Tomorrow morning.

questions.prompt: Beijing is one of  ______  cities in our country.

questions.prompt: If it  ______  tomorrow I won’t go to the park.

questions.prompt: —What were you doing when the fire broke out? —I  ______  my homework.
