questions.prompt: Mr. White  ______  us English for 3 years since he came here.
questions.explanation: 句意：怀特先生自从来到这里，已经教我们英语三年了。 考查时态。teach表示“教”，根据“since he came here”可知，此处用现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mom, where is Dad? —He  ______  newspapers in the study.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，爸爸在哪里？——他正在书房读书。 考查时态。read读；根据“where is Dad?”可知，此处用现在进行时，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Nowadays, phones  ______  in many ways. — Yes, they are the most useful inventions in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：——如今，手机被用在很多方面。——是的，它们是世界上最有用的发明。 考查被动语态。根据“Nowadays”可知句子时态是一般现在时，分析句子可知主语和动词之间是被动关系，应该用一般现在时的被动语态，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me, could you tell me  ______  tomorrow? —Well, it will start at 7:30.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，你能告诉我明天什么时候开会吗？——好的，会议将在7：30开始。 考查宾语从句。根据题干及备选项可知 ，这里考查宾语从句。宾语从句应用陈述句语序，所以可排除B、C两项。再根据“tomorrow”和“will”可知，宾语从句应用一般将来时，所以排除D选。故选A。 二、完形填空（每题 1 分，共 8 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Price of a Miracle Tess was an eight-year-old girl when she heard her Mom and Dad talking about her little brother, Andrew. All she knew was that he was very sick and they were completely out of money. Only a very expensive operation could save him now and it was looking like there was no one to  ______ 13 ______  them the money. She heard her Dad say to her Mom, “Only a miracle (奇迹) can save him now.” So she decided to do something for her brother by herself. Back to her bedroom, Tess pulled out a glass jar, took all the coins out on the floor and counted them carefully. No chance here for mistakes. With the jar in her hands, she went out the back door  ______ 14 ______  and walked a long way to a drug store. Tess waited patiently for the pharmacist to give her some  ______ 15 ______  but he was too entirely talking to a well-dressed man. Finally the pharmacist  ______ 16 ______  Tess. “And what do you want?” the pharmacist asked. “I’m talking to my brother whom I haven’t seen for ages,” he explained. “Well, I want to talk to you about my brother,” Tess answered back. “He’s really, really sick... and I want to buy a miracle.” “I beg your pardon?” said the pharmacist. “His name is Andrew and he is badly ill and my Dad says only a miracle can save him now.” Tess explained, “So how much does a miracle  ______ 17 ______?” Hearing this, the pharmacist was too confused to say a word. The pharmacist’s brother stooped (弯腰) down and asked the little girl, “What kind of a miracle does your brother need?” “I don’t know,” Tess replied with tears in her eyes. “I just know he needs an operation. But my Dad can’t pay for it, so I want to use my  ______ 18 ______.” “How much do you have?” asked the man. “One dollar and eleven cents.” Tess answered. “A dollar and eleven cents—the  ______ 19 ______  price of a miracle for your little brother.” Then he said, “Take me to where you live. Let’s see if I have the kind of miracle you need.” That well-dressed man was a famous doctor. The operation was  ______ 20 ______  with the “miracle” and it wasn’t long until Andrew was home again and doing well.

questions.prompt: Mary is a new student. I’m going to help  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：Mary是一名新生。我要去帮助她。 考查人称代词。you你，你们，宾格；her她，宾格；him他，宾格；them他们，宾格。根据“Mary is a new student.”可知，我要帮助的人是新生Mary，Mary是女生。故选B。

questions.prompt: The famous basketball player, Yao Ming joined the NBA  ______  2002.
questions.explanation: 句意：著名篮球运动员姚明于2002年加入了NBA。 考查介词辨析。on在（某一天），通常用于星期，节日，特指的上午、下午、晚上或具体的某一天；by通过；at在（某时刻），通常用于钟点，夜晚、中午或某些固定短语中；in在（某段时间）内，通常用于年，月，季节，泛指的白天晚上等词前。根据空后的2002，是年。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to see your grandparents? —Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去看望一次你的祖父母？——一周一次。 考查特殊疑问词。How soon多久以后，主要对表示将来的时间进行提问；How long多长时间，主要用于对“for+一段时间”进行提问；How often多长时间一次，主要强调动作发生的频率；How far多远，主要对距离进行提问。根据答语“Once a week.”可知，问句是对频率进行提问。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mum, can I play the computer games now? —Sorry, you  ______. You should finish your homework first.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我现在可以玩电脑游戏了吗？——对不起，你不能。你应该先完成作业。 考查情态动词。can’t不能；mustn’t禁止；wouldn’t将不；needn’t不必。以“can I”开头的一般疑问句，否定回答用：Sorry, you can’t. 故选A。

questions.prompt: J. K. Rowling lived a hard life,  ______  she didn’t give up writing.
questions.explanation: 句意：J. K.罗琳过着艰苦的生活，但她没有放弃写作。 考查连词辨析。so因此；for因为；but但是；or否则。“过着艰苦的生活”与“没有放弃写作”之间是转折关系，but连接并列句。故选C。

questions.prompt: We are proud that China has become one of  ______  countries in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们为中国已经成为世界上最强大的国家之一感到自豪。 考查形容词最高级。根据“one of...countries”可知，这里用到句型“one of+the+最高级+可数名词复数”，表示“最……的其中一个”。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Peter, what is your sister doing? — Oh, she  ______  her room.
questions.explanation: 句意：——皮特，你的妹妹在做什么？——哦，她正在打扫房间。 考查动词的时态。结合问句“what is your sister doing?”可知是现在进行时，询问妹妹正在做什么，回答也应该用现在进行时。结构为“be+动词现在分词”，故选A。

questions.prompt: — What was your mother doing when you got home yesterday evening? — She  ______  TV with my grandmother.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天晚上你回家时你妈妈在做什么？——她正在和我奶奶一起看电视。 考查过去进行时。根据上文“What was your mother doing”可知，此处是在问过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，故应用过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Peter, what will you do next Sunday morning? —I  ______  football with my classmates on the playground.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，下个星期天上午你干什么？——我将和我的同学在操场上踢足球。 考查时态辨析。根据“Peter, what will you do next Sunday morning?”可知问将来的事情，要用一般将来时，其结构为will do。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  in Beijing since I was born. I love living here.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我出生以来，我一直住在北京。我喜欢住在这里。 考查时态。从过去某一时刻开始延续至今，用现在完成时，故选C。

questions.prompt: Smartphones  ______  in our daily life now. They make our life more convenient.
questions.explanation: 句意：如今智能手机在我们日常生活中被使用。它们使我们生活更加便捷。 考查被动语态。句中“智能手机”和“使用”之间为被动关系，需要用被动语态，结构为be+动词过去分词；结合句中时间状语now可知，为一般现在时的被动语态。故选B。

questions.prompt: I have two little sisters. I love  ______  very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有两个小妹妹。我非常爱她们。 考查代词辨析。she她；them她们，人称代词宾格；they她们，人称代词主格；their她们的。根据“I have two little sisters.”可知此处是指非常爱她们，代词位于动词后，应用宾格形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: My father often does exercise  ______  the gym.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲经常在健身房锻炼。 考查介词辨析。on在……上面；to去、到……，表动作的方向；in在……里面（某范围或空间内）；of……的，表所属；根据“does exercise ”可知此处指“在健身房里锻炼”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Work harder,  ______  you won’t pass the final exam easily.
questions.explanation: 句意：努力学习，否则你不会轻易通过期末考试。 考查连词。or否则；and和，表顺承；but 但是，表转折；so因此，表因果；本句为“祈使句+or+陈述句”句式，表示在以祈使句为条件下的相反假设，意为“否则，要不然”。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the library? — Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多长时间去一次图书馆？——一周一次。 考查特殊疑问句。how long多长；how soon多久之后；how often多长时间一次；how much多少，接不可数名词。根据“once a week”表频度，疑问词用“how often”。故选C。

questions.prompt: I think science is as  ______  as art.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为科学和美术一样有趣。 考查形容词原级。interesting有趣的，原级；more interesting更有趣的，比较级；most interesting最有趣的，最高级；the most interesting最有趣的，最高级。此处是原级的比较，用“as+形容词/副词原级+as……”表示“像……一样”，此处用形容词原级interesting，表示“科学和美术一样有趣”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Mr. Li  ______  to a new house last Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周日，李先生搬进了一所新房子。 考查动词时态。短语move to...“搬到……”，根据时间状语last Sunday可知用一般过去时态，move的过去式是moved，故选B。

questions.prompt: — What will you do next weekend, Linda? — I  ______  camping with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Linda，下个周末你要做什么？——我跟我朋友去野营。 考查动词时态。根据“What will you do next weekend”可知，答语用一般将来时结构，故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  Kate since she studied abroad.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从凯特出国留学后我就没见过她。 考查时态辨析。根据“since she studied abroad”可知，要用现在完成时，其结构为have/has done。故选C。

questions.prompt: My brother  ______  TV when I got home yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我到家的时候，我的弟弟正在看电视。 考查过去进行时的用法。When引导的时间状语从句，从句时态使用一般过去时（表达的是时间点），主句使用过去进行时，表示“我”到家时，弟弟正在做的事情。故选D。

questions.prompt: After-school services  ______  every day this term.
questions.explanation: 句意：本学期每天都提供课外服务。 考查被动语态。主语 services与provide是被动关系，结合时间状语 this term可知句子是一般现在时被动语态（am/is/are+过去分词），主语是复数名词，be动词形式用are。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Could you tell me  ______  to Shanghai? — Sure, next Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你什么时候去上海吗？——当然，下周二。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句采用陈述语序：连接词+主语+谓语，据此排除BD选项。再由“next Tuesday.”可知句子时态是一般将来时，故选A。 二、完形填空(共 8 分,每小题 1 分) 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项 中,选择最佳选项。 Volleyball is a sport. You hit a ball with a group of six people. It requires stamina(耐力), reflexes(反应力) and strength. This was my first understanding. My start in volleyball was out of luck. My mother had trained me by herself, so I was full of  ______ 13 ______  that I could join senior school team and gave everyone a  ______ 14 ______. However, my dream was broken the next day. Our coach said that I could only join junior school team because I was not able to work well with the other teammates. I was really  ______ 15 ______  and could not understand why. Was I not skilled enough? Last month, we had our first match with another school. Most of my junior teammates had no competing experience while the other team was filled with energy. I could already predict we would  ______ 16 ______. Then, the ball went up. One “thump”, a second “thump” and I jumped into the air with a shout. A final “thump” and the ball flew over the net. I was  ______ 17 ______  caught up in the competition. At that moment, I felt a special connection with my teammates. All tiredness  ______ 18 ______. The sound of feet running across the court and loud cheers filled us with warmth. During the break, we excitedly  ______ 19 ______  our team strategy(策略). Finally we won the game. I still remember our coaches’ words that encouraged all of us and our chants across the court. Volleyball helps me find my true self and teaches me how to work together with my  ______ 20 ______. It helps me make friends, learn new things and experience moments of joy. I learn the beauty of teamwork and working together.

questions.prompt: My sister is a doctor.  ______  name is Nancy.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的姐姐是一名医生。她的名字是南希。 考查形容词性物主代词的用法。Her她的；His他的；Its它的；Your你的，你们的。根据“my sister”可知，这里应用形容词性物主代词“her”修饰名词“name”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Spring Festival this year is  ______  February 1st.
questions.explanation: 句意：今年的春节是在2月1日。 考查介词辨析。at表示在具体几点钟；in表示在年月等时间范围；on表示在具体某一天；to到。“February 1st”是具体的时间，用on。故选C。

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  you will miss the school bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则你会错过校车的。 考查连词辨析。or否则；but但是；and和；so因此。根据“Hurry up,...you will miss the school bus.”可知，不快点就会错过校车，强调一种否定的条件。故选A。

questions.prompt: I think Lu Xun is one of  ______  writers in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为鲁迅是中国最伟大的作家之一。 考查形容词最高级。“one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数”表示“最……之一”，空处用形容词最高级，且形容词最高级前要加the，故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  I return this book to the library today? —No, you needn’t. You can return it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我必须今天把这本书还给图书馆吗？——不，你不必。你可以明天还。 考查动词辨析和一般疑问句。Can可以；May也许；Must必须；Need需要。根据答语“No, you needn’t.”可知，此处应用must进行提问，故选C。

questions.prompt: They will have a trip to the Great Wall if it  ______  next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果下星期日不下雪，他们将去长城旅行。此处是if引导的条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”的原则，故答案为A。 点睛：if引导的条件状语从句，当主句是一般将来时，从句用一般现在时表示将来的含义，就是我们常说的“主将从现”，unless也有类似的用法，unless作为连词引导条件状语从句时，可以表示“如果不”或“除非”，unless=if not，如：We will go to the park if it doesn’t rain tomorrow. 可以改写为：We will go to the park unless it rains tomorrow.

questions.prompt: We  ______ in the same school since three years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们从三年前就在同一所学校学习。since three years ago自从3年前，表示的是截止到目前为止的时间段，用于现在完成时态的句子中，故答案为B。 点睛：since的用法：译作“自从…以来”，(1)接时间点：如 I have stayed in that country since 1995. 要求：谓v.用现在完成时，而且须是延续性动词。(2)接一段时间 + ago：如 They have lived in that house since two years ago. 要求：谓v.用现在完成时，而且须是延续性动词。(3)接时间状语从句：如 I have loved her since I met her last time. / Lily has stayed at home since she left school. 要求：主句的谓v.用现在完成时，而且须是延续性动词；从句的谓v.用一般过去时，而且须是终止性动词。 总之，since用作介词的简单句，时态为现在完成时；since用作连词，引导时间状语从句，从句用一般过去时，而主句用现在完成时。

questions.prompt: — Mum, where is Dad? — He  ______  a newspaper in the bedroom now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，爸爸在哪儿？——他现在正在卧室里看报纸。根据答语中的时间状语now和问句中“爸爸在哪儿”判断，答语要用现在进行时，故答案选D。

questions.prompt: My classmates  ______  as volunteers in the Science Museum last weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的同学上周末在科学博物馆做志愿者。 考查一般过去时。根据时间状语“last weekend”可知，时态为一般过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing when we were playing basketball yesterday afternoon? —I  ______  the classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天下午我们打篮球时你在干什么？——我正在打扫教室。 考查时态辨析。根据“What were you doing when we were playing basketball yesterday afternoon?”可知问句主句用过去进行时，答句也用过去进行时，此处表示“昨天下午当你们在打篮球时我正在打扫教室”。故选D。

questions.prompt: Now computers  ______  in many ways in our life and they are very useful.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在计算机在我们的生活中被用于许多方面，他们是非常有用的。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“Now”可知，时态是一般现在时，主语computers是动作use的承受者，所以是一般现在时的被动语态。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Can you tell me  ______  to London? —Sure. Next month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你什么时候去伦敦旅行吗？——当然可以。下个月。 考查宾语从句。这里是宾语从句，用陈述语序，排除CD；根据“Sure. Next month.”可知，上文宾语从句用一般将来时，故选A。 二、完形填空（每题1分, 共8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Smiling One day, Miss Ellis gave her pupils a new kind of homework: homework on happiness. Her pupils would be “happiness  ______ 13 ______ ”, and they wanted to see what would happen when they tried to bring happiness to those around them. As part of their homework, all the students did really wonderful things, but what Carla Chalmers did made everyone  ______ 14 ______. Several days after the homework had been handed out, Carla carried a big bag to the classroom. “Here in this bag I have all the happiness I’ve collected so far,” she said  ______ 15 ______. On seeing this, everyone was filled with expectation, but Carla didn’t want to show anyone what was in the bag. Instead, she pulled out a small box and gave it to her teacher with a big smile. When Miss Ellis had taken the box, Carla took an instant camera out of her own pocket and stood with it at the ready. “Open it, Miss Ellis.” The teacher slowly opened the box and looked inside. A big smile  ______ 16 ______  on her face, and at that moment Carla took a photo, Carla’s photo came out of the camera immediately, and she  ______ 17 ______  it to Miss Ellis along with a sheet of paper. The teacher read the paper in silence, and when she had finished, she pointed at the  ______ 18 ______. “Oh, So it’s…” “Yes!”, interrupted Carla, opening the bag. “It’s a great big pile of smiles!” She opened the bag and photos of different smiles fell out. The rest of the class wanted to  ______ 19 ______  how Carla had managed to create such a great big chain of happiness. All there in the box was a photo of a big smile. But everyone who had seen it felt happiness being transmitted(传送) to them, and in return, every person responded with a smile of their own. She managed to spread understanding of the smile truth that every time you  ______ 20 ______  you are sending a gift to the world.

questions.prompt: Mr. Smith is kind and friendly to everyone. We all like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯先生对每个人都很友好。我们都喜欢他。 考查代词辨析。her她；him他；it它；them他们。根据句意可知，空处指“史密斯先生”，故应用代词him“他”。故选B。

questions.prompt: What about playing tennis  ______  me in the new sports center?
questions.explanation: 句意：和我一起在新体育中心打网球怎么样？ 考查介词辨析。to到；of……的；with和某人一起；from来自。根据空后“me”可知，空处应是with“和某人一起”。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  was the concert last night? —It was fantastic.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨晚的音乐会怎么样？——太棒了。 考查特殊疑问句。How怎么样；Where 在哪里；When什么时候；What什么。根据回答“It was fantastic”可知，这里问对方对音乐会的感受如何。故选A。

questions.prompt: I don’t like rainy days  ______  wet weather makes me feel uncomfortable.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不喜欢下雨天，因为潮湿天气使我感到不舒服。 考查连词辨析。if如果；or或者；but但是；because因为。分析空前后句句意可知，空处的词引导的是原因状语从句，应用because“因为”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you finish the task tonight? —Sorry, I ______. I have too much homework to do.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天晚上你能完成这个任务吗？——对不起，我不能。我有太多的家庭作业要做。 考查情态动词。needn’t不需要，没有必要；can’t不能；mustn’t禁止，不要；shouldn’t不应该。根据问题“Can you finish the task…”可知，这里应用can’t回答。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Tommy, which kind of music do you like ______, rock music or pop music? —Rock music. It’s so cool!
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤米，你更喜欢哪种音乐，摇滚乐还是流行音乐？——摇滚乐。它太酷了！ 考查比较级。well好地，原级；better更好，比较级；best最好，最高级；the best最好，最高级。根据“rock music or pop music”可知，此处是两者进行比较，用比较级，like sth. better表示“更喜欢某物”。故选B。

questions.prompt: David is crazy about volleyball, and he  ______  volleyball every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：David对排球非常痴迷，他每天都打排球。 考查动词时态。play玩，打球，plays是第三人称单数形式；played是过去式或过去分词形式；will play一般将来时；is playing现在进行时。根据句中的“every day”可知，这里表示经常性的动作，应用一般现在时。故选A。

questions.prompt: —I called you at seven yesterday evening, but nobody answered. —I’m sorry. I  ______  my little sister with her homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我昨天晚上七点给你打电话，但没有人接。——抱歉。我在帮助我妹妹做作业。 考查动词的时态。根据“at seven yesterday evening”以及语境可知，没接到电话是因为昨晚七点的时候正在做别的事，表示过去某一时刻正在做某事，用过去进行时：主语+was/were+doing sth.。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Henry, your sweater is so beautiful! —Thanks. My mum  ______  it for me last weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：——亨利，你的毛衣真漂亮！——谢谢。我妈妈上周末给我买了它。 考查一般过去时。根据“last weekend”可知，时态是一般过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s nice to see you again. We  ______ each other since we graduated.
questions.explanation: 句意：再次见到你真的太高兴了。自从毕业我们就没有见过彼此了。 考查动词时态。see看见，是一个动词。根据“since we graduated”可知，since引导时间状语从句中使用了一般过去时态，主句应用现在完成时。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Grandma, who is the cute girl in this photo? —It’s your mother. It ______ about 30 years ago.

She took a deep breath. Two bounces. She jumped and let the ball fly. Swish. The crowd cheered. “One more,” Abby thought. She caught the ball. Bounce, bounce. Shoot. The Hawks won again! Abby’s time had come.

questions.prompt: All my teachers are patient when I ask  ______  for help.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我向老师们求助时，他们都很耐心。 考查代词辨析。him他；us我们；them他们；you你。根据句意可知，空处是指“All my teachers”，故应用代词them代替。故选C。

questions.prompt: Peter usually plays the guitar in a music club  ______  Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：Peter通常在周六下午在音乐俱乐部弹吉他。 考查介词辨析。of……的；in后面接季节/年/月等；at后面接某一时刻；on后面接具体的某一天，根据空后的“Saturday afternoon”是具体的某一天可知，空缺处应该用介词on，故选D。

questions.prompt: —What’s your favorite saying? —Smile at the world,  ______  the world will smile back at you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你最喜欢的谚语是什么？——对世界微笑，世界也会对你微笑。 考查连词辨析。and和，那么；but但是；until直到……为止；if如果。根据“Smile at the world,... the world will smile back at you.”可知此处用“祈使句and+陈述句”句式。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you often take a walk? —In Beihai Park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你经常在哪里散步？——在北海公园。 考查疑问词辨析。Why为什么；Where在哪里；How如何；When何时。根据“In Beihai Park.”可知对位置提问，用Where。故选B。

questions.prompt: My sister  ______  swim, so I plan to teach her this summer.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的妹妹不会游泳，所以我打算在这个夏天教她。 考查情态动词。can’t不会；shouldn’t不应该；mustn’t禁止；needn’t不需要。根据“I plan to teach her this summer”可知，我打算教她，那么妹妹应该是不会游泳。故选A。

questions.prompt: Nothing is  ______  than a walk in the forest.
questions.explanation: 句意：没有什么比在森林里散步更令人放松的了。 考查形容词比较级。relaxing令人放松的，形容词原级；more relaxing比较令人放松的，形容词比较级；most relaxing最令人放松的，形容词最高级，前面要加定冠词the；the most relaxing最令人放松的，根据空后的“than”可知，空缺处应该用形容词比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: We  ______  healthier if we eat enough fruit and vegetables every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果我们每天吃足够的水果和蔬菜，我们会变得更健康。 考查时态辨析。if引导的条件状语从句遵循主将从现原则，主句用一般将来时，其结构为will do。故选A。

questions.prompt: The famous French writer Charles Perrault  ______  to write his fairy tales in 1679.
questions.explanation: 句意：法国著名作家查尔斯·佩罗在1679年开始写他的童话。 考查时态辨析。根据“in 1679”可知用一般过去时，谓语用过去式began。故选B。

questions.prompt: Our school life  ______  a lot since we entered middle school.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我们进入中学以来，我们的学校生活改变了很多。 考查时态辨析。根据“since we entered middle school”可知要用现在完成时，其结构为have/has done。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  a sweet dream when my friend called me this morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天早上我朋友给我打电话时，我正在做一个美梦。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语从句“when my friend called me this morning.”的语境可知，空处表示一个过去的动作正在进行，故应用过去进行时，构成形式为：was/were doing；主语是第一人称单数形式，故助动词应用was，have的过去分词是having。故选C。

questions.prompt: The 24th Winter Olympic Games  ______  in Beijing in February, 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：第24届冬奥会将于2022年2月在北京举行。 考查时态和语态辨析。主语“The 24th Winter Olympic Games”与动词hold之间是动宾关系，结合“in February, 2022”可知要用一般将来时的被动语态，其结构为will be done。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Judy, can you tell me  ______  this grammar book? It’s so useful. —Sure. I bought it at Xinhua Bookstore.
questions.explanation: 句意：——朱迪，你能告诉我你在哪儿买的这本语法书吗？它是如此有用。——确定。我在新华书店买的。 考查宾语从句。tell后缺少直接宾语，此处用宾语从句。宾语从句用陈述语序，排除AB；主现从不限，根据“I bought it at Xinhua Bookstore.”可知从句要用一般过去时，排除D。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题 1 分，共 8 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Symbol for Happiness “We should carry a symbol that reminds us of a happy moment. Whenever we look at it, we should stop for a while and think about what it stands for.” I was enjoying the words in the book when my wife called me to help our neighbor, Mrs. Fitzpatrick. I opened the front door and saw Mrs. Fitzpatrick sitting on her porch,  ______ 13 ______  her lawn (草坪). “Ah, Tom! Good to see you!” she waved at me and smiled dandelion happily. “Here, come sit with me for a while. It’s a beautiful morning!” “Err, yes, it sure is,” I said. I hadn’t expected her to be this  ______ 14 ______  with a broken leg and all. “Look at my lawn! Isn’t it just beautiful?” she said. “Beautiful...?” I looked around. Weeds (杂草), dandelions... “Look at those dandelions. What a perfect symbol for happiness!” “I’m not sure I follow you. A dandelion as a symbol for happiness?” “Look at that bright beautiful yellow color! If that isn’t a happy cheerful color, I don’t know what is! And it  ______ 15 ______  just like happiness. If you are really happy, you do good things that bring joy to the people around you. Once they become happy, they do the same. So the  ______ 16 ______  spreads. And just like a dandelion—it blooms (开花), sharing its sunny color with everyone and sends its seeds (种子) into the wind. Before you know it, you have a hundred  ______ 17 ______  of the sunny little flower around you.” “But it is a weed...” I said. “A weed, that’s funny. I’m always watching everyone work on their garden. And I mean work. It doesn’t look very joyful—just working to make the lawn look short and thick and green. I never see any of the neighbors sit and just look at their beautiful lawn. They just work on it and don’t  ______ 18 ______  it.” Well she sure got that one right. I never heard anyone talk about their lawn unless it was to complain how much work it was. And then she said the thing I wrote down once I got home. I still write it on the first page of all my calendars when the new year  ______ 19 ______, and glue a little picture of a dandelion next to it. “What a bad day, they say. And I look at the dandelions and see a thousand little  ______ 20 ______.”

questions.prompt: Ren Changxia was a policewoman.  ______  worked hard to help a lot of people.
questions.explanation: 句意：任长霞是一名女警。她努力工作，帮助了很多人。 考查代词的辨析。She她；Her她的；Hers她的；Herself她自己。根据“…worked hard to help a lot of people.”可知，这里缺少主语，用she。故选A。

questions.prompt: China successfully launched the crewed spaceship Shenzhou-13 ______  October 16th, 2021.
questions.explanation: 句意：2021年10月16日中国成功发射神舟13号载人飞船。 考查介词。at用于具体的时刻前；by“通过”，后接名词或动名词；in用于年，月，上、下午或晚上前；on用于具体的某一天或具体某一天的上午、下午或晚上前。根据“October 16th, 2021“2021年10月16日”可知，在具体某一天前应用介词on。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know how astronauts have their meals in space? —They have special plates  ______  their food doesn’t float away.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道宇航员在太空是怎么吃饭的吗？——他们有特殊的盘子，这样食物就不会飘走。 考查连词辨析。because因为，引导原因状语从句；so that以便、为了，引导目的状语从句；as well as既……又……；since自从，引导时间状语从句。根据“their food doesn’t float away”可知，特殊的盘子是为了食物不飘浮，需要连词引导目的状语从句，故应用so that“为了”。故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  did you get the Harry Potter books? — I borrowed them from our school library.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你从哪里得到的哈利波特的书？——我从我们的学校图书馆借的。 考查特殊疑问句。What什么；When什么时候；Why为什么；Where在哪里。根据答语“from our school library”可知，是对地点提问，所以用特殊疑问词Where，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mike,  ______  I join the volunteer service in our community? —Of course you can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——麦克，我能参加我们社团的志愿者服务吗？ ——当然可以。 考查情态动词。can能够；must必须；should应该；need需要。根据“Of course you can.”可知，答语中用can，可知问句中也应用can。故选A。

questions.prompt: The cleaners worked for 3 hours,  ______  nobody stopped to have a rest.
questions.explanation: 句意：清洁工工作了3个小时，但是没有人停下来休息。 考查连词辨析。so所以；for因为；or或者；but但是。根据“The cleaners worked for 3 hours”和“nobody stopped to have a rest”可知，“清洁工工作三小时”与“没有人停下来休息”存在转折关系，应用but连接。故选D。

questions.prompt: The teacher is glad to see that Tony is  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师很高兴看到托尼比以前细心了。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than before”可知，此处需用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Peter, what were you doing at 7 o’clock yesterday evening? — Oh, I  ______  CCTV news with my parents.
questions.explanation: ——彼得，你昨天晚上七点钟的时候你干什么呢？——我正在和我父母一起看中央电视台新闻。 考查过去进行时。根据问句中“what were you doing at 7 o’clock yesterday evening?”可知，在询问过去具体某一时刻正在做什么，用过去进行时。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Lily, is your mother a nurse? — Yes, she is. She  ______  in that hospital since 2003.
questions.explanation: 句意：——莉莉，你妈妈是护士吗？——是的，她是。她自2003年以来一直在那家医院工作。 考查现在完成时。根据句中时间状语“since 2003”可知，应用现在完成时，其结构为“have/has+动词过去分词”，主语为she，助动词用has，work过去分词为worked，故选C。

questions.prompt: Anne wore an old brown hat ______ covered two braids of very long, thick, red hair.
questions.explanation: 句意：安妮戴着一顶棕色的旧帽子，帽子盖住了两条又长又厚的红发辫。 根据句子结构可知，此处考查定语从句。先行词是hat，指物，作主语，应用关系代词which。故选A。

questions.prompt: Leonardo da Vinci’s diaries  ______  more than 150 years after his death.
questions.explanation: 句意：列奥纳多·达·芬奇日记在他死后150多年才出版。 考查一般过去时被动语态。主语diaries与动词publish之间是被动关系，且描述过去发生的事情，句子用一般过去时被动语态，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Could you tell me  ______  the Space Museum? —Sure, next Monday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我我们什么时候去参观太空博物馆吗？——好的，下周一。 考查宾语从句。根据答语“next Monday”可知空缺部分是对时间提问，并且时态为一般将来时；且宾语从句的语序要用陈述语序，选项B和D都是疑问语序。故选C。 二、完形填空(每题1分，共8分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 David’s class know David is in the hall before they see him. He raps (说唱) when he passes in the hall. He raps when he comes into class. And he raps when he sits at his desk. He raps when he can and he  ______ 13 ______  about almost everything. David joined in a rap  ______ 14 ______  at school. When David rapped, his friends clapped (鼓掌) for him. The kids thought his rapping was great. But could David win? David did  ______ 15 ______! David got the top place! All his classmates gave him a big hand. “Now David is a star in our school!” Mike said. Ben stood up and shook David’s hand. “That was ______ 16 ______, David. You are a hero!” Miss Green said, “David did win! His next step is to rap on National Rap Star on TV. We can all give David a big hand.” The class clapped and  ______ 17 ______  for David. Miss Green smiled. Miss Green and his classmates were  ______ 18 ______, but David threw himself onto his chair, silent. David could not rap on TV. In class, David could not do his physics. He could not think. David was not a kid who got nervous a lot, but he did not wish to rap on TV. Could he be lucky again? Anyway, who wanted to lose? David thought perhaps he would not  ______ 19 ______ the national competition. Then he would not have to rap on TV. David’s friends  ______ 20 ______  something was going on his mind. They planned to give him some help. When David got to class the next day, he saw a sign on the wall. It said, “David, just rap like in our classroom! ” David smiled. “Perhaps it’s not that hard to rap on TV. ” he thought.

questions.prompt: Mr. Jackson is a popular writer, and we all like reading  ______  books.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克逊先生是个受欢迎的作家，我们都喜欢读他的书。 考查物主代词。his他的；her她的；their他们的；your你/你们的。根据空后有名词books，可知需要填形容词性物主代词；又根据前一句Mr. Jackson is a popular writer，可知此处是指“喜欢读他的书”，故选A。

questions.prompt: We usually have class meetings  ______  Monday afternoons.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们通常在周一下午开班会。 考查介词。of……的；in用在年、月、泛指的上下午的前面；on用于具体的某一天或具体某一天的上午，下午或晚上；at用于具体的时刻前面；根据“Monday afternoons”可知，在具体某一天下午用介词on，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  you please order less and clear your plate this time? —Sure, thanks for reminding me!
questions.explanation: 句意：——这次请你少点菜，把盘子里的菜都吃光好吗？——当然了，谢谢提醒。 考查情态动词。May可以（与第二人称连用，表示祝福）；Could能；Must必须；Should应该。Could you please…?“请你做某事好吗？”，表示委婉的请求。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you visit your grandparents? —Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去看望你的祖父母一次？——一个月两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少/多少钱；How long多久；How often多久一次；How soon多久。根据答语“Twice a month.”可知，问的是频度。故选C。

questions.prompt: Zhaozhou Bridge is one of  ______  stone bridges in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：赵州桥是世界上最古老的石桥之一。 考查形容词最高级。old古老的。old形容词原级；older形容词比较级；oldest形容词最高级；the oldest形容词最高级前加the。根据题干中“one of  ______  stone bridges in the world”可知此处是指世界上最古老的石桥之一，用“one of the +形容词最高级+名词复数”结构。故选D。

questions.prompt: She never stops trying,  ______  she is making progress.
questions.explanation: 句意：她从来没有停止过尝试，并且她正取得进步。 考查连词辨析。and和、并且；but但是；or或者、否则；if如果、是否。根据句意可知，空后“…is making progress”是空前“…never stops trying”的结果，前后为承接关系，应用and。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Susan, where are the kids? —Look! They  ______  “Trick or treat” at our neighbor’s door.
questions.explanation: 句意：——苏珊，孩子们在哪里？——看！他们在邻居家门口大喊“不给糖就捣蛋”。 考查时态。根据“Look!”可知，句子要用现在进行时，结构是“am/is/are+doing”，故选B。

questions.prompt: If you don't use your English, you  ______  it.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你不使用你的英语，你会忘记的。 考查时态。forget 动词原形；forgot 过去式；will forget 一般将来时态形式；have forgotten现在完成时态形式。结合句意可知，此句是条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，此空应填一般将来时态形式will forget ，故选C。

questions.prompt: Mike  ______ football since the fourth grade.
questions.explanation: 句意：迈克从四年级开始就踢足球了。 考查动词时态。since+一般过去时的从句，主句用现在完成时have/has done的结构，故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  late yesterday morning. As a result, I was 5 minutes late for the meeting.
questions.explanation: 句意：我昨天早上起晚了。结果，我开会迟到了5分钟。 考查一般过去时。get up一般现在时；have got up现在完成时；got up一般过去时；will get up一般将来时。根据“yesterday morning”可知，该句为一般过去时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing at 10 o’clock yesterday morning? —I ______  with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天早晨10点你在干什么？——我在和父母一起阅读。 考查动词时态。根据上文的时间标志词“at 10 o’clock yesterday morning”，可知是过去的具体时刻发生的动作，要用过去进行时，结构为was/were doing，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Could you tell me  ______? — Next Sunday.

choices.label: A
choices.text: when we will have a picnic

choices.label: C
choices.text: when will we have a picnic

choices.label: D
choices.text: when did we have a picnic

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我我们什么时候去野餐吗？ ——下个礼拜天。 考查宾语从句。根据英语语法，宾语从句应用陈述句语序，C、D选项可排除。根据答句Next Sunday提示，野餐还未进行，故问句宾语从句应用将来时，故选A。 【点睛】1. 一般过去时的被动语态的构成：was/ were +及物动词的过去分词+其他成分。例如： The house was built in 1967. 这房子是1967年建的。

questions.prompt: My sister and I like reading.  ______  often go to the library together.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姐姐和我喜欢读书。我们经常一起去图书馆。 考查人称代词。I我；We我们；You你（们）；They他们。根据语境可知，空格处应用人称代词指代上文提到的“My sister and I”，说话者以第一人称口吻来叙述，故应用人称代词we。故选B。

questions.prompt: Jack is my penfriend. He lives  ______  London.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克是我的笔友。他住在伦敦。 考查介词。in在……里；on在……上；to朝，向；of……的；live in+sp，表示“住在某地”，故选A。

questions.prompt: Tom, I wanted to phone you yesterday,  ______  I didn’t have your number.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆，我昨天想给你打电话，但我没有你的电话号码。 考查连词。and和；but但是；or或者；so因此。根据语境可知，此处存在转折关系，故应用表转折的连词but。故选B。

questions.prompt: — do you usually go to school, Kate? —On foot.
questions.explanation: 句意：——凯特，你通常怎么上学？——步行。 考查特殊疑问句。A. When什么时候；B. Where在哪里；C. How怎样，如何；D. Why为什么。根据回答“On foot”可知询问上学的方式，可知选C。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me,  ______  I take a photo of this beautiful drawing? —I’m afraid not. There is a sign “No Photo”.
questions.explanation: 句意：——对不起，我可以为这幅漂亮的画照张相吗？——恐怕不行。有“禁止拍照”的标志。 考查情态动词辨析。may可以，表示一种建议或者请求允许； must必须，不得不；should应该，表示情理上应当做；need需要，表示一种需求。根据答语“I’m afraid not”，可知本句是请求许可，需用情态动词 may。故选A。

questions.prompt: We are glad to see that our country is developing  ______  these years than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们很高兴地看到，我们的国家这些年比以前发展得更快。 考查副词比较级。根据“than”可知，此空要用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: Mary  ______  her grandparents every weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽每个周末都去看望她的祖父母。 考查一般现在时。根据句中“every weekend”提示，表示经常发生的动作，应用一般现在时，且主语Mary为第三人称单数，故动词visit应用第三人称单数形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: John  ______  to play tennis when he was six years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：约翰六岁时开始打网球。 考查一般过去时。根据句中从句“when he was six years old”可知，表示过去某一个时间点发生的事，应用一般过去时，故选D。

questions.prompt: — What were you doing at 10:00 yesterday morning? — I  ______  a kite in the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天上午10点你在干什么？——我在公园放风筝。 考查时态。问句用的是过去进行时，所以回答也用过去进行时，结构是was/were+doing，故选B。

questions.prompt: Chris  ______  in this hospital for eight years.
questions.explanation: 句意：克里斯在这家医院工作了八年。 考查现在完成时。根据句中“for eight years”提示，句子应用现在完成时，即“have +过去分词”结构，且主语Chris为第三人称单数形式，故have应用第三人称单数形式，故选D。

questions.prompt: More parks  ______  in Beijing next year. A build
questions.explanation: 句意：明年北京将建更多的公园。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。根据句中时间状语“next year”提示，此处应用将来时，A、B选项可排除。主语parks与谓语build之间存在被动关系，故应用一般将来时的被动语态。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Tony, do you know ______? Mrs. Black is looking for him. — Maybe he is in the lab.
questions.explanation: 句意：——托尼，你知道杰克在哪儿吗？布莱克太太在找他。——也许他在实验室。 考查宾语从句。分析句子结构可知，该句是宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，故排除A、B选项；根据“Maybe he is in the lab.”可知，从句的时态为一般现在时，故排除D选项。故选C。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 The day that I met my best friend for the first time, I was anxiously reviewing for an important exam in the local library. Because I kept being interrupted by others, I was unable to make any  ______ 13 ______. When I heard someone singing behind me, I couldn’t accept the situation any longer. I turned around and gave the person a dirty look. It was a tall girl about the same age as me. Standing near the “English Literature” section, she seemed to be looking for a book. “How could she think only about herself?” I thought  ______ 14 ______. I picked up my books, looked into her eyes and  ______ 15 ______. “You are being so selfish (自私的). I’ve been unable to study because of your terrible singing. Be considerate of other people in public.” Then I left the library in a hurry. Two hours later, I realized I’d  ______ 16 ______  my most important textbook in the library. What was worse, the library had already closed. I was close to tears. Just then, the phone rang. A soft voice introduced the speaker as Jenny and asked if I was Jane. After confirming (确认) that I was, she told me that she had  ______ 17 ______  my book in the library. As my phone number was in it, she called and told me she didn’t live far away and could  ______ 18 ______  it to me. I let out a deep breath with comfort and agreed to meet her at the store down the road. I was so  ______ 19 ______! When I met Jenny in the store I recognized her at once. She was the girl I had shouted at for singing. I was filled with  ______ 20 ______  and said sorry for my rudeness (无礼). But Jenny just laughed and told me she was glad that I had left her a dirty look in the library! Can you believe we became best friends? I often think how lucky I am. If Jenny hadn’t been a kind person who was willing to forgive (原谅) my rudeness, I would never have experienced such true friendship.

questions.prompt: Alice, can you write and tell us something about  ______?
questions.explanation: 句意：爱丽丝，你能写信告诉我们一些关于你自己的情况吗? 考查代词辨析，yours你的，名词性物主代词；your你的，形容词性物主代词；yourself你自己，反身代词；yourselves你们自己，反身代词。根据“can you write and tell us something”可知应该是你写信告诉关于你自己的事情，故选C。

questions.prompt: The cartoon first appeared  ______  November 18, 1928.
questions.explanation: 句意：这幅漫画第一次出现在1928年11月18日。 考查介词辨析，on后接具体的某一天或上/下午；in后接年/月/季节；to朝；at后接具体时间点。根据“November 18, 1928”1928年11月18日，可知应该用on，故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is she going to be a scientist? — She is going to study really hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：——她将如何成为一名科学家？——她将非常努力地学习。 考查疑问词辨析。How如何；Who谁；What什么；When什么时候。根据“She is going to study really hard.”她将非常努力地学习，可知上文应是问“她将如何成为一名科学家”，对方式提问用How。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  I go out to play basketball now, Mum? —Sure, but you  ______  finish your homework first.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我现在可以出去打篮球吗？——当然，但是你必须首先完成你的作业。 考查情态动词辨析。may可以，可能；must必须；can能，可能，可以；mustn’t禁止；needn’t不必。根据“...I go out to play basketball now, Mum”可知是提出请求，可用may/can；根据“but you...finish your homework first.”可知出去玩的前提是必须完成作业，应用must，故选C。

questions.prompt: I love skiing,  ______  I want to be a player like Eileen, Gu.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢滑雪，我想要成为像谷爱凌那样的运动员。 考查连词辨析。so所以；or或者；but但是；and和。根据“I love skiing”以及“I want to be a player like Eileen, Gu.”可知前后是递进关系，用and连接。故选D。

questions.prompt: Mrs. Smith was glad to see her daughter do her homework  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯太太很高兴看到女儿比以前更认真地做作业。 考查副词比较级，carefully认真地；more carefully更加认真地；careful认真的；more careful更加认真的。观察句子，这里是修饰动词do，可知应该用副词，并且注意到than一词，可知用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: Tony will play ice-hockey with his friends if he  ______  free time next Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果托尼下周六有空，他将和他的朋友们去打冰球。 考查if引导的条件状语从句。根据“Tony will play ice-hockey with his friends if he…free time next Saturday.”可知，空处是if引导的条件状语从句，应该遵循“主将从现”的原则，即从句部分用一般现在时，从句主语是he，动词应该用第三人称单数形式has。故选C。

questions.prompt: Li Hua  ______  the dog when it began to rain.
questions.explanation: 句意：当开始下雨的时候，李华正在遛狗。 考查过去进行时。根据“when it began to rain”可知，此处表示一个动作发生时，另一个动作正在进行。应用过去进行时，其谓语结构为“was/were+动词的现在分词”，主语李华为第三人称单数，应用was。故选D。

questions.prompt: The 25th Winter Olympics  ______  in Italy in 2026.
questions.explanation: 句意：第25届冬奥会将于2026年在意大利举行。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。will hold一般将来时；is held一般现在时的被动语态；will be held一般将来时的被动语态；was held一般过去时的被动语态。根据“in 2026”可知句子时态用一般将来时，主语“The 25th Winter Olympics”和谓语动词“hold”之间是被动关系，因此要用被动语态；一般将来时的被动语态结构为：will be+动词的过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: My brother likes history. He  ______  hundreds of history books already.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的哥哥喜欢历史。他已经读了几百本历史书。 考查现在完成时。根据already“已经”可知应用现在完成时，其谓语结构为“have/has+动词的过去分词。主语my brother为第三人称单数，所以应用has。故选C。

questions.prompt: Alex  ______  very hard to learn math, but he was still not good at it.
questions.explanation: 句意：亚历克斯非常努力地学习数学，但是他仍然不擅长它。 考查一般过去时。根据“but he was still not good at it.”可知应用一般过去时，谓语动词用动词过去式。故选D。

questions.prompt: Look! The kids  ______  a snowman—Bing Dwen Dwen. it is so cute.
questions.explanation: 句意：看！孩子们正在堆雪人——冰墩墩。它是如此的可爱。 考查现在进行时。根据“Look!”可知应用现在进行时，其谓语结构是“be动词+动词的现在分词”，主语the kids为复数，所以be动词应用are，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me  ______? —Of course. It’s behind Big Screen Cinema.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我好运旅馆在哪儿吗？——当然可以。它在大银幕电影院的后面。 考查宾语从句。根据“Could you please tell me…”可知，空处是宾语从句，故应该用陈述语序，故排除B、D项。又根据答语“It’s behind Big Screen Cinema.”可知，宾语从句用一般现在时，be动词用is。故选A。 二、完形填空(共8分，每小题1分)。 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 When my dad finally finished the triathlon (铁人三项) in Montauk, the crowd cheered. It showed me how his great effort  ______ 14 ______  off and it excited my curiosity. I wondered whether a small boy of my size could  ______ 15 ______  something like that. I found myself saying this out loud and my father overheard me. He encouraged me and said I could train with him. Training with my dad  ______ 16 ______  out to be very challenging. We would get up early for a morning jog, or go for a swim in the pool after school. After a few weeks of training, I signed up for my first triathlon. Before the competition, I nervously waited for the gun. When someone  ______ 17 ______  the gun, I was off, swimming towards the distant buoy (浮标) that marked my turn. I finished the half-mile swim and ran towards my bike. I was dripping  ______ 18 ______, trying to get on it. Once on my bike, I experienced a particular excitement of  ______ 19 ______. I went through the transition zone (转换区) again and switched to my running shoes. At the start of the run part of the triathlon, my legs already felt like they were made of cement (水泥). For me, the real competition began during the run, because now I could see each  ______ 20 ______  as a goal. No matter my position in the field, each racer was either following me or being followed. The run part of the race boiled down to pain tolerance. “Shut up, legs”, one of my favorite sayings, kept me from thinking about the  ______ 21 ______  feeling. Then I crossed the finish line. I took a breath and then began a celebration with the other finishers. The sense of achievement was there for all of us. Looking back, I remember the small boy on that day in Montauk who thought he couldn’t do it. Now, that same boy is not only a huge fan, but also a training partner.

questions.prompt: Miss Li is our math teacher.  ______  is from China.
questions.explanation: 句意：李老师是我们的数学老师。她来自中国。 考查代词辨析。She她；He他；It它；You你。根据“Miss Li”可知，是一位女性，故应用She。故选A。

questions.prompt: —When is Jack’s birthday party, Helen? —It’s  ______  about four o’clock on the afternoon of March 4.
questions.explanation: 句意：——海伦，杰克的生日派对是什么时候？——时间是3月4日下午4点左右。 考查介词辨析。on在……之时，后常接具体的某一天；at在，后常接时间点；to到，去；in在……期间。根据“about four o’clock”可知，此处表示时间点，故前面应用at。故选B。

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  we’ll be late for school!
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则我们上学要迟到了。 考查连词辨析。and和，并且；but但是；or否则，或者；so所以。根据“Hurry up”和“we’ll be late for school”可知，此处为“祈使句+or+陈述句”的结构，表示“做某事，否则将会……”，or后常表示一种不好的结果。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me.  ______  is it from here to the Science museum? —Quite near. It’s only about half a kilometer.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，请问从这里到科学博物馆有多远？——很近。大约只有半公里。 考查特殊疑问句。How often多久一次；How soon多久后；How much多少钱，多少；How far多远。根据“Quite near. It’s only about half a kilometer”可知，此处在询问距离，故应用How far。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you speak French? —No, I  ______. I can only speak a little English.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会说法语吗？——不，我不会我只会说一点英语。 考查情态动词。can’t不会，不能；shouldn’t不应该；mustn’t禁止；needn’t不必。根据“Can you speak French”可知，此处是询问是否具有某种能力，其答语应为“Yes, I can”或“No, I can’t”。故选A。

questions.prompt: Beijing is one of  ______  cities in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：北京是是世界上最著名的城市之一。根据题干中“one of+the+形容词最高级+名词复数。需要选择形容词最高级。选项 A 为形容词原级；选项 B 为形容词比较级；选项 C 为缺少 the 的形容词最高级；选项 D 为正确形式的形容词最高级。famous著名的，最高级是the most famous，根据题意，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Can your mother drive? — Yes, and she usually  ______  me to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你妈会开车吗？——是的，她经常开车送我去学校。 考查动词时态。根据“usually ”可知，时态一般现在时，主语是第三人称she，谓语动词用三单形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: I hope  ______  the farm this summer vacation.
questions.explanation: 句意：我希望这个暑假去参观农场。 考查非谓语动词。根据“hope”可知，hope to do sth.“希望做某事”，其后接动词不定式作宾语。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Anne, turn down the TV, please. I  ______  on the phone. — Oh, sorry.
questions.explanation: 句意：——安妮，请把电视声音关小点。我正在打电话。——好的，对不起。 考查动词时态。根据“Anne, turn down the TV, please. ”可知，应是正在打电话，电视声音太大造成了影响，空处用现在进行时，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Why don’t you leave school? It’s already eight o'clock. — Because I  ______  my homework yet.
questions.explanation: 句意：——为什么你不离开学校？已经八点了。——因为我还没有完成我的作业。 考查现在完成时的用法。根据“Why don’t you leave school?”可知，强调对现在的影响，故用现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: A lot of trees  ______  along Di’an Men West Street last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：去年，沿着地安门西大街种植了大量的树木。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。根据“last year”可知，句子应用一般过去时，故排除选项A和C。根据“A lot of trees”并结合选项单词plant可知，“树”和“种植”为被动关系，故此处应用一般过去时的被动语态，其结构为“was/were+过去分词”。故选D。

questions.prompt: My father has bought me a present today, but I don’t know  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爸爸今天给我买了一个礼物，但我不知道是什么。 考查宾语从句。根据“I don’t know”可知，空格处为宾语从句，故应用陈述句语序，排除选项A和C。根据“My father has bought me a present today”可知，我不知道它是什么，这是叙述的一个事实，再结合语境可知，此处应用一般现在时。故选B。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Girl No One Talked To Last year there was a girl at our school. Almost no one ever talked to her. I think it was because she seldom showered, and she kind of smelled bad. Her name was Cindy. We always got on the school bus at the same bus stop. Cindy didn’t have many friends. She seemed like a nice girl—who had an odor (气味) problem. One day, I was walking up to the bus stop and I saw Carl making fun of her. I couldn’t hear what he was saying, but I saw the way he was laughing and rolling his eyes in his  ______ 13 ______  poking-fun-at-you way. I also saw how sad it made Cindy. Holding her notebook tightly to her chest like a shield, she stared (盯着) at the ground and  ______ 14 ______  as far away from him as possible without leaving the bus stop completely. As soon as I got close enough, I glared at Carl to make him stop laughing. But he didn’t. So I walked over and stood closer to Cindy so she wouldn’t feel quite so bad. It was when you just knew someone needed someone to be a friend. She looked up from the ground and she whispered, “Hi.” “Hi,” I said. Then as loudly as I could, I said, “Don’t pay any attention to Carl. His parents have been  ______ 15 ______  in teaching him some manners.” By now everyone there was talking with a friend. Quietly, and with a(n)  ______ 16 ______  look on her face, Cindy said, “I don’t know why everyone hates me.” I was surprised at her words. “No one hates you,” I told her. “Then why don’t I have any friends?” she asked. Her question took me by surprise. I thought for a moment. “Well,” I began, wondering if I could tell her that maybe it was because she smelled so awful, “I think you’re smart, and you dress okay, and…” “So then, what is it?” “Well,” I hedged (躲闪) and then figured it’s now or never. “Maybe it’s because you…” I paused because I almost said “stink” but instead, “don’t smell so good.” She looked up,  ______ 17 ______  my face as if checking to see if I was making fun of her or being mean. I guess she decided I wasn’t. She nodded, like she believed what I said was true. Since she seemed to take this well, I added, “I think you’d probably make more friends if you took more baths.” She looked away. Worried that I might have gone too far, I shrugged and added, “It’s just a(n)  ______ 18 ______.” Turning back to face me, Cindy took a deep breath and said, “Thank you.” I was so relieved (放松的), and the next moment the bus arrived, and all the kids started piling on. “If I  ______ 19 ______  a seat for you on the bus tomorrow,” she asked, “Will you sit with me?” “Sure,” I said. I’m happy to report that Cindy did take more baths from that day on. And it wasn’t too long before she started to make friends at school. I was one of them. I made the  ______ 20 ______  for the better in Cindy’s life. And got a new friend, too!

questions.prompt: My sister is leaving for Shanghai, but I can’t go with  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姐姐就要去上海了，但我不能和她一起去。 考查人称代词宾格。him他；her她；us我们；them他们。此处作介词with的宾语，应该用人称代词宾格；此处指代“My sister”，所以应该用her，故选B。

questions.prompt: We need to finish writing a book review ______  English this weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：这周我们需要用英语写成一篇书评。 考查介词辨析。in用某种语言；at在某一时间、空间等；off从……离开；向下；by通过某种方式。根据介词后宾语English可知，此处表示“用英语”。故选A。 【点睛】表示用工具、手段和材料的介词： with多指用工具或用身体的某一部位或器官； by表示使用上的方法、手段； in指使用某种语言、工具的具体类型等。

questions.prompt: —Kate,  ______  did you go yesterday? —I went to the zoo with my friend.
questions.explanation: 句意：——凯特，你昨天去哪儿了？——我和我的朋友去了动物园。 考查特殊疑问句。where哪里，疑问副词，对地点提问；what什么，疑问代词，对事物提问；which哪个，疑问代词，对人或物提问；when什么时候，疑问副词，对时间提问。根据“I went to the zoo with my friend.”可知，答语为我和朋友去动物园了，可推测此处是对地点提问，即询问昨天凯特去哪里了，where“哪里”，对地点提问，符合语境。故选A。

questions.prompt: My Chinese teacher always  ______  us to read more books.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的语文老师总是告诉我们多读书。 考查时态。tell告诉，动词；is telling现在进行时，主语为单数；tells动词tell的三单形式；told动词tell的过去式/过去分词。根据“always”可知，事情为经常性的，时态为一般现在时，主语为My Chinese teacher，第三人称单数，谓语动词用三单形式，tells“告诉”动词三单形式，符合语境。故选C。

questions.prompt: Many people like paper books more  ______  they are comfortable to read.
questions.explanation: 句意：许多人更喜欢纸质书，因为它们读起来很舒服。 考查连词辨析。or或者，表选择，并列连词；and并且，表顺承，并列连词；but但是，表转折，并列连词；because因为，表原因，从属连词。根据语境可知，“许多人更喜欢纸质书”与“它们读起来很舒服”之间为因果关系，且后句为原因，空处需填从属连词，表原因，because“因为”，从属连词，符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: Tina runs  ______  than anyone else in her class.
questions.explanation: 句意：蒂娜在她班级里比其他人跑的快。 考查副词比较级辨析。fast 快；faster 更快；fastest最快，the fastest 最快。run是实义动词，空格处用副词修饰动词。根据句中than，可知用副词的比较级。所以空格处是faster。故选B。

questions.prompt: My classmates  ______  as volunteers in the Science Museum last weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的同学上周末在科学博物馆做志愿者。 考查一般过去时。根据时间状语“last weekend”可知，时态为一般过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: My sister  ______  TV when I got home yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天我回家的时候，我妹妹正在看电视。 考查动词时态。A. watch一般现在时；B. watched一般过去时；C. is watching现在进行时；D. was watching过去进行时。When引导的时间状语从句，从句时态使用一般过去时（表达的是时间点），主句使用过去进行时；故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  great progress in English since I started to read an English story.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我开始读英语故事以来，我的英语进步很大。 考查时态。根据“I...great progress in English since I started to read an English story.”可知，此处为since引导的的时间状语从句，从句为一般过去时，主句时态为现在完成时，谓语用“has/have+过去分词”的结构，主语为I，助动词用have，made为动词过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: The sports meeting  ______ because of the bad weather yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：因为昨天的坏天气，运动会被取消了。 考查被动语态辨析。cancels 一般现在时；cancelled 一般过去时；is cancelled 一般现在时的被动语态；was cancelled 一般过去时的被动语态。根据时间性状语yesterday判断，句子用一般过去时。主语sports meeting和cancel之间是被动的关系，所以用一般过去时的被动语态。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______? —Next Wednesday.

choices.label: A
choices.text: when did the winter vacation start

choices.label: B
choices.text: when will the winter vacation start

choices.label: C
choices.text: when the winter vacation will start

questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道寒假什么时候开始吗？——下周三。 考查宾语从句语序和时态。根据“Do you know...?”可知，此处为宾语从句，应用陈述句语序，排除A和B，又因主句为一般现在时，遵循主现从不限原则，此处是询问寒假开始的时间，答语为“Next Wednesday.”，下周三，即从句时态为一般将来时，谓语用“will+动词原形”的结构，start“开始”，动词。故选C。 六、完形填空。（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Sharing Hope with Refugees (难民) The night before she had a test at school, eight-year-old Trisha Rao was worried. To give herself  ______ 13 ______, she wrote a poem about believing in herself. Her words gave her courage, and she  ______ 14 ______  the test. One day while listening to the news with her father, Trisha learned about the war in Syria. Conditions in the country were tough, and many people were leaving for safer areas. “I was  ______ 15 ______  that they lost their homes and some of them lost their family,” Trisha said. “They didn’t have enough money to buy lunch even.” It made Trisha think. If the poem she had written the night before her test had given her  ______ 16 ______, maybe it could do the same for the refugee children. Trisha worked on her poem and turned it into a book called Believe in Yourself. It’s the story of a puppy named sunshine and his father, Papa Dog. The dogs travel around the jungle. From fellow animals, they learn  ______ 17 ______  about persistence, teamwork, loyalty, hard work, courage, and kindness. Trisha illustrated (加插图) the book, too. With the help of her mother and a family friend, she  ______ 18 ______  the book in English and Arabic． For a family vacation, Trisha asked whether she and her family could go to Turkey. Many Syrian children who lost their homes in the war were living there now, and Trisha wanted to  ______ 19 ______  their spirits up. Her family got in touch with Support to Life, an agency that provides emergency relief after a disaster with the group’s assistance, Trisha was able to meet refugee children and read her book to them. For every book she sells, Trisha gives away a free copy of Believe in Yourself to children around the world. Her purpose is simple but  ______ 20 ______  “I hope it will give them hope and that they will learn many lessons from the book and believe in themselves.”

questions.prompt: Miss Brown knows a lot about biology. We all like to ask  ______  about it.
questions.explanation: 句意：布朗老师知道很多有关于生物的东西，我们都喜欢问她关于生物的问题。 考查人称代词。she她，人称代词主格；he他，人称代词主格；her她，人称代词宾格；him他，人称代词宾格；此处是动词宾语，用人称代词宾格，Miss Brown是女性，用her指代。故选C。

questions.prompt: Many people like to see golden leaves  ______  autumn.
questions.explanation: 句意：很多人喜欢在秋天看黄色的叶子。 考查时间介词辨析。in在某年、某季、某月、某世纪，也可表示在上午、下午或晚上；on在具体的某一天或某一天的上午、下午、晚上；at在某一具体时刻即几点几分；to到……。“autumn”是季节，其前用in，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Do you know Paul is  ______  boy in Class 5? —Yes. He is very good at playing basketball. A tall
questions.explanation: 句意：—你知道保罗是5班最高的男孩吗？—是的。他非常擅长打篮球。 考查形容词最高级辨析。tall 高的，形容词原级；taller 更高的，形容词比较级；tallest 最高的，形容词最高级；the tallest 最高的，形容词最高级。根据空格后in Class 5，可知，比较范围是在5班，三者以上的比较用形容词最高级，且形容词最高级前要加定冠词the，所以空格处填the tallest。故选D。 【点睛】表三者以上的比较用最高级，后面常用in短语说明比较范围，且形容词最高级前要加定冠词the。

questions.prompt: My uncle likes books,  ______  he doesn't have much time to read.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的叔叔喜欢书，但他没太多时间读。 考查连词。for因为；or否则；but但是；so因此；空格前后两句之间表达的是转折关系，所以应该用表转折关系的连词but连接，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  is your favorite writer? —Charles Dickens. He wrote A Christmas Carol in 1843.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你最喜欢的作家是谁？——查理狄更斯，他在1843年写了《圣诞颂》一书。 考查特殊疑问词。what什么；who谁；why为什么；whose谁的。根据答语“Charles Dickens”可知问的是人。故选B。

questions.prompt: Taron ______  a cold yesterday, so he had to go to see a doctor.
questions.explanation: 句意：塔伦昨天感冒了，所以他不得不去看医生。 考查动词时态辨析。has caught 现在完成时；is catching 现在进行时；catches 一般现在时的三单形式；caught 一般过去时。根据句中时间状语yesterday，表示过去发生的动作，用一般过去时，所以空格处填caught。故选D。

questions.prompt: Today is Mark’s birthday, and he  ______  a big party with his family in the garden now.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天是马克的生日，现在他与他的家人正在花园里开一个盛大的派对。 考查动词时态辨析。had 一般过去时；is having 现在进行时；has had 现在完成时；was having 过去进行时。根据句中时间状语now，表示动作正在进行，主语he是第三人称，所以空格处填现在进行时is having。故答案为B。

questions.prompt: Emma  ______  a car when her phone rang.
questions.explanation: 句意：当艾玛的手机响起来的时候，她正在开车。 考查动词时态。根据“when her phone rang.”可知，此处是when引导的时间状语从句，主句动作发生时，从句动作正在进行；主句用一般过去时态，从句用过去进行时。其结构是was/were doing的形式，主语是Emma，是第三人称单数，be动词用was。故选C。

questions.prompt: Jessica really enjoys travelling, and she  ______  many foreign countries since 2010.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰西卡的确喜欢旅游，自从2010年她已访问许多外国国家。A. visit"参观，访问"，是动词原形，visits是第三人称的单数形式，用于一般现在时；B. has visited 已经访问，用于现在完成时；C. will visit将参观，用于一般将来时；D. was visiting 正在访问，用于过去将来时。由since 2010，“自从2010年”，表示一段时间，用现在完成时，故用has visited。语境是：杰西卡的确喜欢旅游，自从2010年她已访问许多外国国家。故选B。

questions.prompt: Colin’s home is far from school and he  ______  to school by bus every day.
questions.explanation: 科林的家离学校很远，他每天坐公交车上学。 考查动词时态辨析。goes 一般现在时的三单形式；has gone 现在完成时；is going 现在进行时；will go 一般将来时。根据句中时间状语every day，表示经常性的动作，可知，句子用一般现在时。主语he是第三人称，所以空格处用一般现在时的三单形式goes。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______? —Last year.

choices.label: A
choices.text: when will Professor Lee visit China

choices.label: B
choices.text: when Professor Lee will visit China

choices.label: C
choices.text: when did Professor Lee visit China

questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道李教授什么时候来中国访问的吗？——去年。 考查宾语从句。根据宾语从句要按照陈述句的语序的原则，排除选项A、C；宾语从句的时态“主现从不限”，根据答语“Last year”可知从句是一般过去时，排除选项B一般将来时。故选D。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 As the teacher called my name, I knew what lay ahead. She looked at me directly and made me to the whiteboard to perform a division (除法) problem. Division was my weakest subject. I repeatedly put the numbers in the  ______ 13 ______  places, or forgot to add in the zeros. I worriedly  ______ 14 ______  myself out of my seat. With every slow step I took, I grew more nervous. My stomach ached, and my whole body shook with  ______ 15 ______. The teacher read the problem aloud. Unsure of myself, I looked at the girl beside me, and tried to  ______ 16 ______  what she was writing, but she went faster than I could understand, writing down what seemed to be foreign symbols. My eyes fixed on the chicken scratch I had tried. Impossible to understand. Why me? Why couldn’t I work out the problem that seemed easy to all other kids? These questions filled my head. As the other girl finished and danced back to her seat, I wrote some random(胡乱的) numbers on the board, and  ______ 17 ______  back to mine. The teacher read over our work. “Now, class, Susie did this problem absolutely correctly.” “As for Tara,” the teacher said jokingly, “I don’t even know what she did.” The class burst into laughs, and I felt my face turn red as I tried to sink as low as possible into my seat, hoping to prevent them from  ______ 18 ______  me at all. But this memory is one I remember, surprisingly, in a positive way. It made me  ______ 19 ______, and gave me persistence. When I get a poor grade in school, or am put down by somebody, I think of that moment and every single one of those  ______ 20 ______  that I asked myself. The terrible ache in my stomach comes back and gives me the motivation to answer all of those whys and try hard until perfection, or as close as I can get.

questions.prompt: My grandfather lost his key.  ______  couldn’t find it anywhere.
questions.explanation: 句意：我祖父弄丢了钥匙。他到处都找不到它。 考查代词辨析。he他；she她；they他们；it它。此空指代前文提到的“grandfather”，男性，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Where is Jenny? — She is doing her homework  ______  the classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：——詹妮在哪里？——她在教室里做作业。 考查介词。短语“在教室里”英语表达为“in the classroom”，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  are your parents? —They're very well. Thanks.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的父母怎样？——他们很健康，谢谢。 考查特殊疑问句。who谁；what什么；where哪儿；how怎样。根据回答“They're very well”可知此处询问父母健康状况怎样，用疑问词how。故选D。

questions.prompt: Be careful with the knife,  ______  you’ll be hurt.
questions.explanation: 句意：小心刀，否则你会受伤。 考查连词辨析。so所以；or否则；but但是；and和。此句是“祈使句+or+陈述句”的结构，小心刀，否则会让刀伤到，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  I use your pen, please? — Certainly. Here you are.
questions.explanation: 句意：——请问我可以用你的钢笔吗？——当然。给你。 考查情态动词辨析。must必须；may可以；should应该；would将。根据“…I use your pen, please”可知，此处应用情态动词may表示请求允许，故选B。

questions.prompt: Last year we  ______  the city where my grandma grew up
questions.explanation: 句意：去年我们参观了我奶奶长大的城市。 考查动词时态。根据时间状语“last year”可知，句子用一般过去时，故选A。

questions.prompt: We sometimes  ______  out for a picnic on weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们周末有时出去野餐。 考查动词时态。根据“sometimes”可知，句子要用一般现在时，主语we是复数，动词用原形，故选C。

questions.prompt: We are sure one day the air in Beijing will be much  ______  than today.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们确信某一天北京的空气将会比今天干净的多。 考查形容词比较级。根据“than”可知，此处应使用形容词比较级作表语，故选B。

questions.prompt: Peter  ______  TV when I called him last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚我打电话给彼得时，他正在看电视。 考查动词时态。根据“when I called him last night”可知，主句表示在过去某个时段正在发生的事情，用过去进行时was/were doing的结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: All of us  ______  very happy if you can come with us tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你明天能和我们一起来，我们大家都会很高兴的。 考查动词时态。if表示“如果”，引导条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”，主句用一般将来时，结构为will do，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Alice, you  ______  on the phone. — I’m coming. Thanks.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爱丽斯，电话有人找。——我这就来。谢谢。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。根据“Alice, you…on the phone.”可知，你在电话中被人找，所以用被动语态，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Can you tell me  ______  to Paris? — Sure. Next month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你什么时候去巴黎旅行吗？——当然可以。下个月。 考查宾语从句。分析句子结构可知，这是一个宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，排除B和D选项。根据“next month”可知，从句要用一般将来时，结构为will do，故选A。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 I looked out at the smiling faces in the school hall. The applause (掌声) filled my ears. I could not believe I finally made it! I was such a  ______ 13 ______  girl that I had few friends. Even when I knew someone well, I was afraid to speak to her. But I changed a lot just because of my best friend, Lisa. She helped me find a new person inside me. It happened in my Grade Eleven. One day, our teacher Mrs. Sather told us that our class was going to perform (表演) a play. “I need someone to  ______ 14 ______  the lead of Dorothy,” she said, “Who wants to try?” A few students who like playing put their hands up  ______ 15 ______, but I, of course, didn’t put up mine. After class, Lisa came to me. “Dallas, I was thinking you would be the person for Dorothy. You’re great at  ______ 16 ______  things, so you won’t worry about forgetting words. Perfect for Dorothy!” she said. Lisa looked into my eyes as if seeing my inner self locked away inside. “I really want you to  ______ 17 ______  it for me. But if you really don’t want to, I won’t make you. It’s your choice.” Lisa wanted me in this role. She believed in me. I knew it was time to  ______ 18 ______  off my shy cloak (披风 ). After five-month practice with my classmates, we were ready to perform, but I was as  ______ 19 ______  as I had ever been. “It doesn’t matter how you do tonight,” said Lisa, “You have already shown yourself how wonderful you are and I know you will make it!” At the end of the play, when the audience (观众) stood and applauded, I knew they were not just cheering for my performance that night, but for the performances they knew would come in later years because of my new-found  ______ 20 ______. Thank you, Lisa, my best friend!

questions.prompt: My sister is leaving for Shanghai, but I can’t go with  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹要去上海，但我不能和她一起去。 考查代词辨析。him他；her她；us我们；them他们。此空指代前文提到的“my sister”，是女性，故填B。

questions.prompt: The children are very happy because they are having a trip  ______  Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：孩子们非常开心，因为他们周日在旅行。 考查介词辨析。on后接具体到某一天的时间或具体某一天的早晨、下午和晚上；in后加没有具体到某一天的时间（世纪、年、季节、月）或者早晨、下午和晚上；of……的，表示所属；to到。根据空后Sunday可知，表示具体某一天, 用on。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Mr. Black,  ______  did you spend on this dictionary? — Oh, it cost me 230 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：—— 布莱克先生，这本字典你花了多少钱？—— 哦，花了我230元。 考查特殊疑问词。how many多少，提问可数名词复数；how long多久，提问时段；how much多少，提问价格；how often多久一次， 提问频度。根据“it cost me 230 yuan.”可知，问的是价格。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Can you join us playing basketball after school today? —Sorry, I  ______. I have to go home and finish my homework first.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天放学后你能和我们一起打篮球吗？——对不起，我不能。我必须先回家完成作业。 考查情态动词。mustn’t禁止；can’t不能；needn’t不必；couldn’t不能（can’t的过去式）。以“Can you”开头的一般疑问句在此处表示邀请，根据“Sorry”及“I have to go home and finish my homework first.”可知要拒绝，表示不能去，用can’t符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: This coat looks great,  ______  I don’t think it looks good on me.
questions.explanation: 句意：这件外套看起来不错，但我觉得我穿起来不好看。 考查并列连词。and和；so所以；but但是；or或者、还是、否则；空格前后是转折关系，应用but连接，故选C。

questions.prompt: CITI Tower in Beijing is probably one of  ______  buildings in the whole world.
questions.explanation: 句意：北京的花旗大厦可能是全世界最高的建筑之一。 考查形容词最高级。“one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数”表示“最……的……之一”，此处用the tallest。故选D。

questions.prompt: Every morning, my father a newspaper on his way to work.
questions.explanation: 句意：每天早上，我父亲在上班的路上买报纸。 本题考查时态。选项 A 是一般现在时；选项 B 是一般过去时；选项 C 是现在进行时；选项 D 是一般将来时。根据句中的标志词“Every morning”可知该题应选择一般现在时态。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Where is your father, Linda? — He  ______  my bike in the yard now.
questions.explanation: 句意：—— 琳达，你爸爸在哪儿？—— 他现在正在院子里修我的自行车。 考查现在进行时。根据“now”可知，此句时态是现在进行时，因此is repairing符合句意。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  English for nearly 9 years and I can express myself in English now.
questions.explanation: 句意：我已经学习英语将近9年了，现在我可以用英语表达自己。 考查时态辨析。根据“for nearly 9 years”可知已经学了九年英语，用现在完成时，其结构为have/has done。故选D。

questions.prompt: — What were you doing at 8 o’clock yesterday evening? — I my homework.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天晚上8点你在做什么？——我在做作业。 本题考查时态。选项A为一般现在时；选项B为一般过去时；选项C为过去进行时；选项D为现在进行时。根据句中的标志词 “at 8 o’clock yesterday evening”可知该题应选择过去进行时态。故选C。

questions.prompt: If you want to visit the History Museum, I  ______  tickets for you tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你想要参观历史博物馆，我明天将会给你订票。 考查时态。句子是if引导的条件状语从句，从句中使用一般现在时，主句应用一般将来时，空处是主句的谓语，应用一般将来时结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Could you please tell me  ______  the 2020 Beijing International Automotive Exhibition? —Last Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——能请你告诉我他们什么时候参观的2020年北京国际汽车展览会吗？——上周二。 考查宾语从句。分析句子成分，可知此处是宾语从句，语序要用陈述语序，所以排除B、D；根据下文的答语“Last Tuesday”，可知是时态是一般过去时，故选A。 二、完形填空（本大题共1小题, 每小题8分, 共8分） Everyone knew that Stuti was the best speller in the whole class. She could spell difficult words like “encyclopedia” and “amendment” very  ______ 13 ______. She used to get perfect scores during each weekly spelling test. Ms. Daisy, her English teacher, made a  ______ 14 ______  for the spelling tests that any child who doesn’t get at least 60% correct spellings would have to correct each wrong word and copy three times for next week’s spelling test. Seema, who sat next to Stuti always struggled （挣扎） in spellings. Last Thursday, she received 56%, which meant she had to  ______ 15 ______  the rest 44% words three times. Stuti was so  ______ 16 ______  in her spelling abilities that she decided not to study for her next spelling test. The test began. Ms. Daisy pronounced each word and then repeated it. Everything was OK until she spoke “Handkerchief”. Stuti scribbled （匆匆书写） h-a-n-d-k-e-h...now what? Her mind was blank. Ms. Daisy started to move on to the next word. An idea came into Stuti’s mind that Seema  ______ 17 ______  how to spell it! Seema had written this word three times. There it was, spelled out in Seema’s handwriting. Her eyes went quickly back to her own paper and  ______ 18 ______  the word with the letters “i-e-f”. Stuti remained nervous as Ms. Daisy read the last spelling word. She had  ______ 19 ______  just for the first time in her life. She thought, “Is this the way I want to keep my perfect record—by being a cheater?” Finally she erased what she had written earlier and replaced it with what she knew was the wrong answer. She wrote “e-i-f”. As her hands put down her pencil and passed the test up to the front, she sighed with relief （解脱）. She thought, “So what if my perfect scores are no longer being kept? At least my  ______ 20 ______  is.”

questions.prompt: We plan to go boating in Beihai Park this Saturday morning. Would you like to join  ______?
questions.explanation: 句意：我们计划星期六上午去北海公园划船。你想加入我们吗? 考查代词辨析。we我们，主格；us我们，宾格；our我们的，形容词性的物主代词；ours我们的，名词性的物主代词。根据题干可知，join“加入”是动词，后接人称代词的宾格形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: Our school held a sports meeting  ______ September, 30.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校在九月三十号举行了一次运动会。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体的时刻前面；in用在年、月等的前面；to朝向；on用于具体的某一天或具体某一天的上午，下午或晚上。根据September, 30“九月三十日”，可知指的是具体的某一天，因此用介词on，故选D。

questions.prompt: ______  I have difficulties in learning math, I never give up.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然我在学习数学上有困难，但我从不放弃。 考查从属连词辨析。So因此；Although虽然、尽管；Because因为；Until直到。根据“I have difficulties in learning math,”以及“I never give up.”可知，前后句之间存在一种相反的让步关系，因此用Although引导让步状语从句，故选B。

questions.prompt: Daniel  ______  in the same school since he came back from England.
questions.explanation: 句意：丹尼尔从英国回来后就一直待在同一所学校。 考查现在完成时态。根据“since he came back from England”可知，本句是since引导的时间状语从句，表示从过去开始，一直持续到现在的状态，因此时态用现在完成时，其结构为have/has+动词的过去分词，主语Daniel是第三人称单数，用has，stay的过去分词是stayed，故选D。

questions.prompt: 一Eric, what did you do yesterday afternoon? 一I  ______  to the school reading room with Jack.
questions.explanation: 句意：——埃里克，昨天下午你做什么了？——我和杰克一起去了学校阅览室。 考查动词时态辨析。yesterday afternoon昨天下午，是一般过去时的标志。根据语境，动词需用过去式，went是go的过去式，故选A。

questions.prompt: Don't worry, mum! I'm feeling much  ______  than yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：别担心，妈妈!我感觉比昨天好多了。 考查形容词的比较级。good好的，形容词原级；well身体健康的，形容词原级；better更好的，比较级；best最好的，最高级。由后面的than可知是感觉比昨天好多了，应用比较级形式，故选C。

questions.prompt: —My friends and I  ______  Shanghai Disneyland this winter holiday. —Have a good trip!
questions.explanation: 句意：——我和我的朋友们今年寒假将去上海迪士尼参观。——祝你们旅途愉快。 考查一般将来时。根据“this winter holiday”结合语境，可知句子时态应用一般将来时，其结构为：will+动词原形，故选D。

questions.prompt: —What were you doing when others were busy doing cleaning? —I  ______  mistakes in my test paper.
questions.explanation: 句意：——别人忙着打扫卫生的时候，你在干什么？——我正在改试卷上的错误。 考查过去进行时。根据上文“What were you doing”，可知句子时态用过去进行时，其结构为was/were+动词的现在分词，主语是I，用was，correct的现在分词是correcting，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Sam,  ______  have you kept the book Journey to the West? —For more than a week
questions.explanation: 句意：——萨姆，这本《西游记》你借了多久了?——一个多星期了。 考查疑问词辨析。how often多久一次，提问频度；how many多少，提问数量；how long多久，提问时段；how far多远，提问距离；根据“For more than a week.”一个多星期，可知问的是时段，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Jerry, I've heard that you are coming to Beijing. —Yes. As soon as I  ______  in Beijing, I will call you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰瑞，我听说你要来北京。——是的。我一到北京就给你打电话。 考查动词时态。由题干可知，本句是“as soon as”“一……就”引导的时间状语从句，如果主句是一般将来时，则从句要用一般现在时，因此排除C、D选项；主语I是第一人称，谓语动词用原形，排除B选项；故选A。

questions.prompt: Our school has a long history and it  ______  in 1907.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校历史悠久，建于1907年。 考查动词语态辨析。it是指our school，是动词build的受动者，需用“be done”被动语态结构，可排除前两项。it是第三人称单数，由in 1907可知系动词用was，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Could you tell me  ______? —I bought it in the shopping mall near my home.

choices.label: A
choices.text: where will you buy the camera

choices.label: B
choices.text: where you will buy the camera

choices.label: C
choices.text: where did you buy the camera

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你在哪里买的照相机吗?——我在我家附近的购物中心买的。 考查宾语从句。根据“Could you tell me …？”可知本题考查宾语从句，宾语从句中的语序应用陈述语序，因此排除A、C选项；再由“I bought…”可知宾语从句的时态是一般过去时，因此排除B选项；故选D。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Queen of the Ice I get into position and take a deep breath. The music starts and my mind focuses on one thing: my figure skating (花样滑冰) routine. Dressed in my shining blue dress and  ______ 13 ______  across the ice, I feel free. I started figure skating again in 2018 after the Pyeong Chang Winter Olympic Games. However, relearning figure skating at an older age is not  ______ 14 ______. Balancing on those 1.5 mm wide steel blades (冰刀) and stepping onto the clear ice for the first time in years, feelings of excitement and panic overwhelmed (充满) me at the same time. I did not remember any of the  ______ 15 ______  or spins that I had learned as a child. To make my anxiety worse, kids much younger than me were doing double or triple rotation jumps (旋转与跳跃) and difficult spin variations. I felt so out of place. Did I really  ______ 16 ______  here?" You have as much right to be here as anyone else,” my Olympian coach encouraged me. I was very grateful that I had found a coach that treated me the same as her other students who competed internationally. Every day at practice, she  ______ 17 ______  me beyond my limits. The ice is as unforgiving as life. During the course of learning new jumps and spins, falls are unavoidable. Whenever I learn a move, I commit to practicing and falling for hours on end, and there would still be a large chance that I could not finish it. Many times I have asked myself, “Was it really worth it? So many hours of practice, and so much  ______ 18 ______  spent on coaching and skates, for what?" Despite these pains, every time I feel the wind rushing past my face as I glide across the ice, I am reminded of the reason that I started skating: this is the  ______ 19 ______  thing I will get to flying. The pain is temporary, but the joy of landing that jump I have worked on for months is something I would not  ______ 20 ______  for the world. Fall down seven times, get up eight!

questions.prompt: I’m talking to you, Jack. Are you listening to  ______?
questions.explanation: 句意：我在跟你说话呢，杰克。你在听我说话吗？ 考查代词辨析。me我，宾格代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词；my我的，形容词性物主代词；I我，主格代词。listen to听，后接宾格代词作宾语；结合选项，故选A。

questions.prompt: My uncle arrived in Beijing  ______  December 29 for a business meeting.
questions.explanation: 句意：我叔叔于12月29日到达北京参加一个商务会议。 考查介词辨析。to到，表方向；at在，用于钟点时间或时刻；of……的，表所属；on在，用于星期几等具体的日期。句中December 29“12月29日”是一个具体的日期，故选D。

questions.prompt: The classroom is very quiet. All the students  ______  carefully.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个教室非常安静。所有的学生都在认真地读书。 考查时态。由第一句“这个教室非常安静。”可以推断，因为学生们正在认真读书，所以教室才安静。这里用现在进行时。故选B。

questions.prompt: Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge is bridge I have ever seen.
questions.explanation: 句意：港珠澳大桥是我见过的最精彩的桥。 根据I have ever seen可知使用最高级，wonderful：精彩的，比较级是more wonderful，最高级是most wonderful；形容词最高级前加定冠词the；故选D。

questions.prompt: Tony and his friends often  ______  movies on weekends.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼和他的朋友们经常在周末看电影。 考查动词时态辨析。watched动词过去式；watch观看，动词原形；will watch一般将来时；are watch现在进行时。often经常，是一般现在时的标志；and连接两个并列的人称，Tony and his friends属于复数主语，动词需用原形。结合选项，故选B。

questions.prompt: Bill has asked me to be more careful  ______  I won't make so many mistakes next time.
questions.explanation: 句意：比尔要我更加小心，这样我下次就不会犯这么多错误了。 考查目的状语从句。until直到，和not连用表示“直到……才”；so that以便，表目的；as soon as一……就，表时间；although尽管，表让步。根据题干“Bill has asked me to be more careful…I won't make so many mistakes next time. ”，可知空后表示“更加小心”的目的，是目的状语从句，故选B。

questions.prompt: Paul and I  ______  tennis yesterday. He did much better than I.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天保罗和我打网球了。他比我打得好得多。 考查句子时态。A. play一般现在时；B. will play一般将来时；C. played一般过去时；D. are playing现在进行时。根据时间yesterday可知此句时态是一般过去时态，故选C。

questions.prompt: I tried to stop him,  ______  he didn't listen.
questions.explanation: 句意：我尝试去阻止他，但是他不听。 考查连词辨析。and 和；but 但是；or 或者；so 所以。根据句意，上文“我尝试阻止他”，和下文“他不听”是表示转折关系，所以用转折连词but。故选B。 【点睛】and/but/or/so都属于并列连词，区别是：and表示“和”，是并列关系的连词；but表示“但是”，是转折关系的连词；or表示“或者”，是选择关系的连词；so表示“所以”，是因果关系的连词。

questions.prompt: When I went to say goodbye to Ann, she  ______  for a writing competition.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我去和Ann道别时，她正在写作比赛做准备。 考查过去进行时。“当我去和Ann道别时”强调那个时候，对方正在做什么，表示过去正在进行用过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: We  ______  trees if it is sunny next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果下周日是晴天，我们要去植树。 考查时态。此句是if引导的条件状语从句，主句一般将来时，从句一般现在时，故选D。

questions.prompt: My aunt is a writer. She  ______  more than ten books since 1980.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的姑妈是个作家。自1980年以来，她已经写了十多本书。 考查时态辨析。根据“since 1980”可知要用现在完成时，其结构为has/have done。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______  the Capital Museum? —Next Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道他们什么时候参观首都博物馆吗？——下周六。 考查宾语从句。动词“know”后接宾语从句，宾语从句要用陈述语序，故排除AB；根据答语Next Saturday可知要用一般将来时，排除C。故选D。 二、完形填空。 I am the mother of two wonderful, beautiful and clever boys. I am also a policewoman who works on cases（案件）about children. It is my job to keep children  ______ 13 ______. Several months before my son Thomas's third birthday, he asked me what I did for work. I told him that it was to keep little boys and girls safe, but I did not go into any more details. Over the next several weeks I would hear my son telling people that his mommy's job was to keep little boys and girls safe. But then he seemed to  ______ 14 ______  about it and didn't mention it any more. The day after Thomas's third birthday, I decided to take the day off from work to spend time with Thomas and Alex, his twenty-one-month-old brother. After saying goodbye to their father, I turned to my boys and said  ______ 15 ______  that Mommy didn't have to go to work. She was going to spend the whole day with her boys! I looked down at Thomas,  ______ 16 ______  to see an excited look on his face, but instead I saw tears in his eyes. I bent down（弯腰）close to him and asked him what was wrong. He looked at me with tears  ______ 17 ______  down his face and said, "Who will keep the little boys and girls safe if you don't go to work?" I could not believe that my son who just  ______ 18 ______  three the day before was worried about the little boys and girls he did not even know. I took my son in my arms and gave him a big hug. And I  ______ 19 ______  that there were other people who worked with mommy to keep the little boys and girls safe. We hugged each other for several minutes. And I tried to make him believe that the little boys and girls would still be safe even if Mommy stayed home. When he finally felt better he went off to play with one of his new toys. I sat there on the floor for a few minutes longer and was just  ______ 20 ______  by the feelings my son had for these children that he had never met. I never explained what "safe" meant to three-year-old Thomas, but I believe that he understands its meaning very well.

questions.prompt: Last week, the twins chose a dress for  ______  mother as a birthday gift.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周，双胞胎为他们的妈妈选了一件连衣裙作为生日礼物。 考查代词辨析。her她的；them他们；their他们的；his他的。根据the twins可知“双胞胎为他们的妈妈买了生日礼物”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Stan Lee, the father of Marvel Comic, passed away  ______  Nov. 12th, 2018.
questions.explanation: 句意：2018年11月12日，漫威之父斯坦·李去世。 考查介词辨析。on表示具体的某一天或某一天的上午、下午、晚上；at表示具体的时间点；in用于较长的一段时间（世纪、年代、季节、月份等）或是表示泛指的上午、下午等前面；over超过。根据“Nov. 12th, 2018”可知，此处指的是2018年11月12日具体的这一天，所以用介词on，故选A。

questions.prompt: Sorry, I must go to the library. Lily  ______  for me there.
questions.explanation: 句意：对不起，我必须去图书馆。莉莉在那里等我。 考查动词的时态。waited一般过去时；is waiting现在进行时；waits一般现在时；was waiting过去进行时。结合语境、前一句“Sorry, I must go to the library.”和空后“for me there”可知作者现在必须得去图书馆，因为莉莉正在那里等作者，所以本句用现在进行时，表示作者说话时莉莉正在进行的动作。故选B。

questions.prompt: William Shakespeare is one of  ______  writers in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：威廉·莎士比亚是世界上最著名的作家之一。 考查形容词的最高级。famous著名的；more famous比较级；most famous最高级；the most famous最高级。根据比较范围in the world可知此处应用形容词最高级，且形容词的最高级前必须加定冠词the。故选D。 错因分析 ①考生没能根据“one of”与“in the world”判断出本题使用形容词的最高级；②考生忽略了形容词最高级前必须加the。 【点睛】形容词最高级用法： the+形容词最高级+名词+表示范围的短语或从句，如Jack is the tallest student in his class. one of the+形容词最高级+可数名词复数+表示范围的短语或者从句，如China is one of the largest countries in the world. 比较级形式表达最高级意义，“比较级+than any other+可数名词单数”“比较级+than the other+可数名词复数”或“比较级+than the rest of+the+可数名词复数”来表达最高级意义，如Julia is taller than any other girl in her class.

questions.prompt: — ______  you go to cinema with me this Saturday? — Sorry, I can’t. This Saturday is my mother’s birthday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个星期六你能和我一起去看电影吗?——对不起，我不能。 这个星期六是我妈妈的生日。 考查情态动词。May可以；Can能、能够； Must必须、一定；Need需要。根据答语“Sorry, I can’t.”使用了can来回答，可知前面的问句一般应是用can来引导，意为“能、会”，故选B。

questions.prompt: Wash your hands before meals,  ______  you may get ill.
questions.explanation: 句意：饭前洗手，否则你可能会生病的。 本题考查连词。and而且，but但是，or否则，so所以。结合句意，“饭前不洗手”是“你可能会生病”的条件，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  will the talk show start? — It will start at 8:00.
questions.explanation: 句意：——脱口秀什么时候开始？——它会在八点开始。 考查特殊疑问句。When什么时候；Why为什么；How怎样；Where在哪里，根据答句“It will start at 8:00”可知，问的是脱口秀什么时候开始，故选A。

questions.prompt: — What were you doing this time yesterday? — I  ______  the classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天这个时候你在干什么？——我在打扫教室。 考查动词时态。 根据上文“What were you doing this time yesterday?”可知，下文是过去进行时，其结构是be doing的形式。主语是I是第三人称单数，be动词用was。 I was cleaning the classroom.“我正在打扫教室”。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  playing this piece of music for two months, so I play it better.
questions.explanation: 句意：我已经练习弹这首音乐两个月了，所以弹得更好了。 考查现在完成时。根据for two months可知时态是现在完成时，结构是have/has+过去分词。故选D。 【点睛】

questions.prompt: My father often  ______  to the gym with me though he has lots of work to do.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然我爸爸有很多工作要做，但他经常和我一起去健身房。 考查动词时态。由often“经常”可知句子时态用一般现在时，go to the gym“去健身房”，主语My father是第三人称单数，所以谓语动词也要用第三人称单数形式，故选C。

questions.prompt: The 24th Winter Olympic Games  ______  in Beijing and Zhangjiakou in 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：在2022年第24届冬季奥运会将在北京和张家口举行。 根据in 2022可知此处用一般将来时，主语The 24th Winter Olympic Games与谓语hold之间是被动关系，故此处用一般将来时的被动语态，故为will be held。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Can you tell me  ______  next Sunday? —By train.

choices.label: A
