questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我下星期天我们怎么去上海吗？——坐火车。 考查宾语从句。根据句中时间状语“next Friday”可知时态为一般将来时，宾语从句的语序应用陈述句语序。故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 From paper to piano I was 11 years old when I asked my mom for piano lessons in 2010. We were poor, so she said a polite “no”. That didn’t  ______ 13 ______  me. I Googled the measurements for a keyboard, drew the keys on a piece of paper and stuck it on my desk. I would click notes on an online keyboard and “play” them back on my paper one—keeping the sound they made on the computer in my head. I spent six months playing without touching a real piano. Once my mom saw that I was  ______ 14 ______, she borrowed money and bought me 10 lessons. I still remember the first one. I was struck by how real the sound of the piano was. I  ______ 15 ______  my grade one after eight lessons. Once I started secondary school, we couldn’t afford lessons again. I passed grade three, then grade five, practicing only on my  ______ 16 ______. One evening, when I was about 13, my mom said she had a surprise for me; it was an electronic keyboard bought with more borrowed money. It was the first time I’d  ______ 17 ______  for her. She was in shock. My school didn’t offer music A-level. I found the Purcell School for young musicians, but the tryouts (选拔) were difficult. To my amazement, I was offered a place. At Purcell, I spent two years working as  ______ 18 ______  as I could. I performed to raise money and saved enough to buy my first piano. When I left Purcell, I was awarded the senior piano prize and senior academic music prize. I am now at the Guildhall School in London. I feel proud: it’s been 10 years since I  ______ 19 ______  my paper piano, and I’m at one of the world’s leading music schools. The paper piano helped spark my  ______ 20 ______  about how music works, the building blocks that form the pieces.

questions.prompt: — ______  you please tell us the way to the nearest park? —No problem. Follow me, please.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我们去最近的公园的路吗？——没有问题。请跟我来。 考查情态动词辨析。Could能够，表示委婉语气；Should应该；Must必须；Need需要。结合对话情景可知，作者一行人请求对方是否能够告知去最近的公园的路，对方欣然同意，所以这里用情态动词could，表示比较委婉客气地提出问题。故选A。

questions.prompt: 一 ______  is the train ride from Beijing to Tianjin? 一For half an hour.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从北京到天津坐火车要多长时间？——半个小时。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少，对可数名词的数量进行提问；How much多少（钱），对不可数名词的量或物品的价格进行提问；How long多长时间，对一段时间进行提问；How often多久一次，对频率进行提问。根据答语“For half an hour.”可知问的是多长时间，用How long符合语境。故 选C。

questions.prompt: My sister  ______  a model plane with my father in the yard now.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的妹妹现在正在院子里和我爸爸制作飞机模型。 考查现在进行时。由“now”可知表示动作正在进行，用现在进行时，结构是：am/is/are + doing，主语是“my sister”，be动词用is。故选A。

questions.prompt: He used to be quite shy, but he  ______  a lot since he joined the acting club.
questions.explanation: 句意：他过去相当害羞，但是自从他加入表演俱乐部之后改变了很多。 考查时态。根据“since he joined the acting club”可知句子用现在完成时，结构是：have/has + done，主语是“he”，用has changed。故选B。

questions.prompt: My father's birthday party  ______  last weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲的生日聚会是上周末举行的。 考查一般过去时、被动语态。根据时间状语last weekend可知，句子是一般过去时；主语My father's birthday party和动词hold是被动关系，可知句子是一般过去时、被动语态，其结构为“was/were+过去分词”，主语是单数，be动词形式用was。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know ______? —Next Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道他将什么时间过来拜访我们么？——下个周日的早上。 考查宾语从句。动词“know”后是宾语从句，用陈述句的语序“连接词+主语+谓语动词”，A和B的语序错误，排除A和B选项。根据“Next Sunday morning”可知此句的动作是将来发生的，用一般将来时态，从句动词用“will visit”。D选项时态错误。故选C。 五、语法填空 阅读下面的短文, 根据短文内容填空。在未给提示词的空白处仅填写一个适当的单词, 在给出提示词的空白处用括号内所给词的正确形式填空。 Full Moon, Full Feelings Chinese people have been celebrating Mid-Autumn Festival and enjoying mooncakes for centuries Mooncakes are in the shape of a full moon  ______ 7 ______ the Mid-Autumn night. They carry people's wishes to the families they love and miss. There ______ 8 ______  (be) many traditional folk stories about this festival. However, most people think that the story of Chang'e is the most touching. Chang'e was Hou Yi's  ______ 9 ______  (beauty) wife. After Hou Yi shot down the nine suns, a goddess gave him magic medicine to thank him. Whoever took this could live forever, and Hou Yi planed to take it with Chang'e. However, a bad man, Pang Meng, tried to steal the medicine  ______ 10 ______  Hou Yi was not home. Chang'e refused to give it to him and took it all. She became very light and flew up to the moon. Hou Yi was so sad that he  ______ 11 ______ (call) out her name to the moon every night. One night, he found that the moon was so bright and round that he could see his wife there. He quickly laid out  ______ 12 ______  (she) favorite fruits and desserts in the garden. How he wished that Chang'e could come back! After this, people started the tradition of admiring the moon and sharing mooncakes with their families. 【答案】7. on 8. are

questions.prompt: My sister Nancy is kind and helpful. Everybody likes  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妹妹南希很善良，乐于助人。每个人都喜欢她。 考查代词辨析。her她；him他；me我；you你/你们。根据“My sister Nancy is kind and helpful.”可知，我妹妹很善良且乐于助人，所以大家都喜欢她。故选A。

questions.prompt: 一Lucas, don't put your toys on the floor. Please put them  ______  the box. 一OK, Mum. I'll do it right away.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Lucas，不要把你的玩具放在地板上。请把它们放进盒子里。——好的，妈妈。我马上就做。 考查介词词义辨析。of 属于；in 在……里面；at 在（小）地点；from （表示起始点）从……起。根据“Lucas, don't put your toys on the floor.”可知，妈妈希望Lucas把玩具放进盒子里，介词“in”符合句意，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  will you cook dumplings for us, Grandma? —This Friday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——奶奶，您什么时候为我们煮饺子？——这周五。 考查特殊疑问词辨析。Where哪里；Why为什么；How怎么样；When什么时候。结合语境和答句可知，奶奶本周五会煮饺子，所以问句用When来提问。故选D。

questions.prompt: Elsa is from Canada. She can understand Chinese,  ______  she can't speak it.
questions.explanation: 句意：Elsa来自加拿大。她能听懂汉语，但不会说。 考查连词辨析。so所以；and和；but但是；or或者。“She can understand Chinese”和“she can't speak it”是转折关系，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mum, must I come back before five o'clock? —No, you  ______. Just get home before dinner.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我必须在五点前回来吗？——不，你不必。晚饭前回家就行了。 考查情态动词的辨析。mustn't禁止；needn't不必；shouldn't不应该；couldn't不可能。must引导的一般疑问句，否定回答用needn't或don't have to，故选B。

questions.prompt: This exercise is  ______  in the book. I can't do it at all.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个练习是书中最难的。我根本不会做。 考查形容词最高级。difficult困难的，形容词原级；more difficult更加困难的，形容词比较级；most difficult表述错误；the most difficult最困难的，形容词最高级。结合语境和空后“in the book”可知在这本书中，这个练习是最难的，作者一点儿都做不出来，因此这里用最高级。故选D。

questions.prompt: We  ______  to Ditan Park every Tuesday and practice running.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们每周二都去地坛公园练习跑步。 考查时态。根据时间状语every Tuesday可知，此处表示经常性行为，用一般现在时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Listen! Mr. Li  ______  the erhu. How wonderful the music is!
questions.explanation: 句意：听!李先生在演奏二胡。多么美妙的音乐啊！ 考查时态。结合语境和空前“Listen!”可知，听的动作时正在进行的动作，用现在进行时。故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  movies since I first went to the cinema.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我第一次去电影院，我就喜欢上了电影。 考查动词时态。since+过去时的句子，主句用现在完成时，结构为have/has done，故选C。

questions.prompt: 一 We're going on a trip this weekend. Would you like to come? — Sorry, I can't. I  ______  basketball practice on Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这个周末我们要去旅行。你愿意来吗？——对不起，我不能去。我星期六要练习篮球。 考查时态。句中的时间是“this weekend”，是将来的时间，描述的动作还没有发生，应用一般将来时，结构是“will+动词原形”，故选D。

questions.prompt: Mary looked very nervous when she  ______  to the famous scientist.
questions.explanation: 句意：当玛丽被介绍给那位著名的科学家时，她显得很紧张。 考查一般过去时被动语态。根据“looked”可知，句子要用一般过去时，主语“she”与动词“introduce”是被动关系，故此空应填一般过去时被动语态，结构为was/were done，故选B。

questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道明天我们在哪里上化学课吗？——在化学实验室里。 考查宾语从句。where we will have our chemistry class我们在哪里上化学课，陈述语序；where will we have our chemistry class疑问语序；where did we have our chemistry class一般过去时态，疑问语序；where we had our chemistry class陈述语序，一般过去时态。由句子结构可知，该空为宾语从句，从句中用陈述语序，先排除B和C；由句中的“tomorrow”可知应用一般将来时。故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选 项中，选择最佳选项。 One afternoon a couple of days before New Year's Eve, Dan and I were delivering packages （包裹）on a three-house block. As we pulled to a stop, a woman came up to the truck. “Do you have something for me?" she asked anxiously. "I'm sorry. Today's package is for the house next door." "Mine must have been lost," she said. Dan and I exchanged （交换）a look of worry. We'd delivered 1, 440 packages without any  ______ 13 ______. “Maybe your  ______ 14 ______  has it" I said. I checked at the house next door, but they had no extra （额外的） packages. No one  ______ 15 ______  at the house across the street. “They're the only other people on the block," I said. The woman looked  ______ 16 ______. “What was in it?” I asked. "The latest robot toy,” she said. "My husband  ______ 17 ______  it. We want to make this New Year special for our son. He's seven and he's been very sick." We had to find that package! But for the next two days? The house across the street stayed empty. As we passed the house yesterday, “Somebody's back," Dan said, pointing to the empty house. A couple was getting out of a car. I immediately ran over to  ______ 18 ______  them. "Did you find a package that doesn't belong here?" “Just a moment, please. I'm going to look around for you," one of them said. Moments later I was rushing across the street with the lost box in my hands. "We deliver!I said as I  ______ 19 ______  it to the woman. Just then a little boy came to the door with a box of fruitcake. "Happy New Year!" he said. "Looks like you got a  ______ 20 ______  too," Dan said when I got back to the truck with the box of fruitcake. I sure did.

questions.prompt: Peter and Mike like music. They are talking about  ______ favourite singers.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得和迈克喜欢音乐。他们正在谈论他们最喜欢的歌手。 考查代词辨析。his他的；her她的；its它的；their他们的。由“Peter and Mike”及“They”可知，此处指彼得和迈克在讨论自己喜欢的歌手，故用their指代“彼得和迈克的”。故选D。

questions.prompt: The post office is closed  ______  Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：邮局星期六下午关门。 本题考查介词。在表示时间时，at表示在时间的一点；on 表示在具体某一天； in表示在一个时间范围，或者接一段时间，表示多久之后；of大约……的，表示所有关系。本句中星期六下午是具体某一天的下午，故介词用on，选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you often do in your free time? — I often read books.
questions.explanation: 句意：——在空闲时间你经常干什么？——我经常读书。 考查特殊疑问句。What什么，疑问代词；Which哪个，疑问代词；When什么时候；疑问副词；Where什么地方，疑问副词。根据答语“I often read books.”，可知本句询问“做什么”，所以用疑问代词what作实义动词do“做，干”的宾语。故选A。

questions.prompt: She is very happy  ______  she has got many good friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：她很高兴，因为她有很多好朋友。 考查连词辨析。or或者；because因为；but但是；though尽管。根据“She is very happy… she has got many good friends”可知，高兴的原因是有了很多好朋友，用because引导原因状语从句，故选B。

questions.prompt: Lucy ______  her classmate Mary with her lessons every weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：Lucy每周末帮助她的同学Mary学习功课。 考查动词时态。根据“every weekend”可知，句子是一般现在时，主语Lucy是第三人称，动词用三单形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: His suit looks  ______  than the one I bought yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：他的西装比我昨天买的那一件看起来更好。 考查比较级。good好的，形容词原级；better更好的，形容词比较级；best最好的，形容词最高级；the best最好的，形容词最高级。根据“than”可知，此空要用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Must we finish our plan this week? —No, you ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们这个星期必须完成计划吗？——不，你们不必。 考查情态动词用法。mustn't表禁止；can't不能；shouldn't不应该；needn't不必。由“Must we finish our plan this week?”可知，本句为情态动词must开头的一般疑问句，其否定回答为No, 主语+needn't。故选D。

questions.prompt: John  ______  a volleyball game on TV now.
questions.explanation: 句意：约翰正在看电视上的排球比赛。 考查时态。结合语境“now”，可知本句描述的是现在正在进行的动作，所以用现在进行时态，其结构为“be +doing”。选D。

questions.prompt: This new hospital  ______  in our town last year.
questions.explanation: 句意为：去年，我们镇上建了一座新医院。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。根据时间状语“last year”，可知时态用一般过去时，所以排除A和D；根据hospital和build属于被动关系，因此需要用一般过去时的被动语态was/were done，主语“This new hospital”为名词单数形式，所以用“was”。故选C。

questions.prompt: We  ______  many trees along the road since 2018.
questions.explanation: 句意：自2018年以来，我们已经沿这条路种了很多树。 考查时态。plant种植，一般现在时；will plant一般将来时；have planted现在完成时；are planting现在进行时。根据“since 2018”，可知本句用现在完成时态，其构成为have/has +done，本句主语是“We”，所以用助动词have，plant的过去分词为planted。故选C。

questions.prompt: John's father  ______  to Shanghai to attend a meeting next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：约翰的父亲下星期天将飞往上海参加一个会议。 考查动词时态。由“next Sunday”可知，本句为一般将来时，即will do结构。故选B。

questions.prompt: Nobody knows  ______  yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：没有人知道昨天事故是怎样发生的。 本题考查宾语从句的用法。宾语从句要用陈述句语序，排除选项BD；事故发生在昨天，要用一般过去时，排除选项A。故选C。 二、完形填空 A New Friend and Perspective （视角） I picked up the phone, slowly dialing the number to her house. All I could think was what we could possibly have a  ______ 13 ______  about. Nothing! I didn't think I could have anything in common with someone who is 50 years older than me. "Your grandmother won't be around forever," my mom said, so I just did what she told me and painfully  ______ 14 ______  my grandmother. What I didn't know was that the phone call would change my perspective on life and my grandmother. When she answered the  ______ 15 ______, I planned to have a small conversation. Instead, she invited me to lunch. Hesitantly（犹豫地）, I replied with a "That sounds great". When I hung up the phone, I immediately  ______ 16 ______  agreeing to the lunch date. How was I going to fit this into my busy schedule of homework, games and friends? It was not my ideal Saturday, but I went anyway. Me and my grandmother... nothing to talk about.  ______ 17 ______, my Saturday morning wasn't painful. I was interested in listening about her recent trip to Europe and how she saw the famous Eiffel Tower. She told me stories about her sewing class and her friends. I didn't realize that 60-year-old people had a social life. It turned out that her life wasn't as  ______ 18 ______  as I thought. For once, I was happy and satisfied without friends and without my cell phone. We planned to meet again at her house. This time, my mom didn't have to beg me. During the next visit, we sorted through three shoeboxes of photographs. There was an interesting story for each one. I learned that as humans, we shared human  ______ 19 ______, no matter what age. Ever since I made the first phone call to my grandmother, we have talked at least once a week. I regret not calling her earlier. Her advice has taught me things that can't be learned in a textbook. She taught me to be  ______ 20 ______  to new things, to enjoy the simple things, and to appreciate what life has given me. I have gained a friend, a mentor（导师）, and a new perspective.

questions.prompt: The storybook is really interesting and I can’t  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：这本故事书很有趣，我爱不释手。 考查动副短语。put up举起，搭建；put down放下。根据“The storybook is really interesting“可知，书太有趣，所以无法放下它。put down是动副短语，it要放在中间，故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  honest man he is!
questions.explanation: 句意：他是多么诚实的一个人啊。 考查感叹句。强调名词短语，用what引出感叹句，honest的第一个音[ɒ]是元音，前加不定冠词an，故选B。

questions.prompt: You can improve your English  ______  practicing more.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：你可以通过更多的练习来提高你的英语。improve your English 提高你的英语；by +doing 表示通过某种方式。故选A。 考点：考查介词的用法。

questions.prompt: —How do you feel about your hometown? —It’s beautiful,  ______  in winter.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你觉得你的家乡怎么样？——它很美，尤其在冬天。 考查副词辨析。nearly几乎；deeply深深地；clearly清晰地；especially尤其。根据语境可知，询问对家乡的感觉如何，答语是它很美，可推测此处是尤其在冬天，especially“尤其”，副词，符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: —How long has Mr. Green lived  ______  Lanzhou? —He’s lived here  ______  1998.
questions.explanation: 句意：——格林先生在兰州已经居住多长时间了？——自从1998年他就已经居住在这了。 考查介词辨析。in后接大地点；at后接小地点。根据“Lanzhou”可知是大地点，应用in，排除CD；since后接时间点，和现在完成时连用 ；介词for后加时间段。根据“1998”可知空后是时间点，应用since。故选B。

questions.prompt: I saw Li Ming  ______  near the river on my way home.
questions.explanation: 句意：回家的路上我看见李明正在河边玩。考查动词固定用法，see sb. do sth.看见某人做了某事(的全过程)； see sb. doing sth.看见某人正在做某事（强调该动作正在进行）。故答案选B。

questions.prompt: —I feel very hungry now. —I think you can try  ______  some pizza. It may help.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我现在觉得很饿。——我想你可以试着吃些披萨。这可能会有所帮助。 考查动词短语和动名词作宾语。eating动词eat的动名词/现在分词；to eat动词不定式；ate动词eat的过去式；eat吃，动词。根据“I feel very hungry now.”和“try...some pizza”可知，我感觉非常饿，可推测此处是试着吃些披萨，try doing sth表示“尝试做某事”，空处需填动名词，eating“吃”，动名词。故选A。

questions.prompt: WeChat Pay(微信支付) makes our life convenient. We can buy things  ______  we don’t take any money.
questions.explanation: 句意：微信支付让我们的生活很便利，即使我们没带钱我们都能买东西。A. unless除非；B. because因为；C. even if即使；D. so that以便，为了。结合句意可知，此句是even if引导的让步状语从句．故答案选C。

questions.prompt: Knowledge is power, but sometimes I feel thoughts are  ______  than knowledge.
questions.explanation: 句意：知识就是力量，但有时我觉得思想比知识更强大。本题考查形容词比较级。根据题干中“than”可知，需要选择形容词比较级。选项A为形容词原级；选项B为形容词比较级；选项C为缺少the的形容词最高级；选项D为正确形式的形容词最高级。故正确答案为选项B。

questions.prompt: Every year  ______  birds come here.
questions.explanation: 句意：每年都有数百万只鸟来到这里。 考查数词的表达。表示确切的数量，用“基数词+数词的单数形式”；表示概数，用“数词的复数形式+of”，此处是表示概数，所以此空应填millions of，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Let’s  ______  some books to the children in the earthquake area. —Sounds like a good idea.
questions.explanation: 句意：——让我们给地震灾区的孩子们捐一些书吧。——听起来是个好主意。 考查动词短语辨析。give out分发；give up放弃；give off分发；give away赠送。根据“some books to the children in the earthquake area”可知，建议给地震灾区的孩子们捐赠一些书，故选D。

questions.prompt: After the Spring Festival,I  ______  3jin when I returned to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：春节过后，当我回到学校时，我的体重增加了三斤。 考查动词短语辨析。put away放好；put up张贴；put in放在……里；put on（体重）增加。根据句中“3 jin”可知，当我回到学校时，我的体重增加了三斤。故选D。

questions.prompt: My mother often encourages me English as much as possible．
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：我妈妈经常鼓励我多说英语。本题考查encourage的用法。encourage sb．to do sth．鼓励某人做某事。故选D。

questions.prompt: —It's ten years since we came here. —How time flies! We  ______  in China for so long.
questions.explanation: 句意：-自从我们来到这里已经有10年了。-时间过得真快啊！我们在中国工作了这么长时间了。work工作，动词原形；worked工作，一般过去时；will work一般将来时；have worked现在完成时。根据对话的情景以及句中的时间状语for so long可知，这里表示从过去一直持续到现在的一个动作，应用现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: The teacher warns us  ______  in the exams. We should be honest.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师警告我们不要在考试中作弊。我们应该诚实。 考查非谓语动词。warn sb (not) to do sth“警告某人（不）做某事”，动词不定式作宾补，故选C。

questions.prompt: The food reminds me  ______  my hometown, my mom’s cooking, and my childhood.
questions.explanation: 句意：这些食物让我想起了我的家乡，我妈妈做的菜，还有我的童年。 考查介词辨析。of……的；for为了；at在；with带有。remind sb of sth“使某人想起某事”，动词短语，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  will you come back? —In three days.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你什么时候回来？——三天后。 考查特殊疑问句。How often 多长时间一次，询问频度；How soon多久以后，询问再过多久做某事，用于将来时，一般用“in+时间段”回答；How long 多长时间，询问时间和物体的长度；How far(离……)多远，询问两地的距离。根据回答“In three days”，可知使用How soon，故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  great fun we had in Yandu Park last Sunday!
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：上周日我们在盐都公园玩得多开心啊！这是一个感叹句，How 和What都可以引导感叹句，句型是What a/an +形容词+可数名词单数或者What +形容词+可数名词复数或不可数名词；How +形容词+a/an+单数可数名词或How +形容词或副词。这句话中的fun是一个不可数名词，故应用What，选B。

questions.prompt: About of the students like keeping diaries in English in our class.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我们班大约有五分之二的学生喜欢用英语记日记。本题考查分数的表达方法，英语中分数的构成是，分子用基数词，分母用序数词，当分子多于一的时候，分母要用复数形式。故五分之二应该是two fifths，故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  breaks the traffic rules will get a fine from the policemen.
questions.explanation: 句意：任何违反交通规则的人都会被警察罚款。 考查连接代词和从属连词辨析。Wherever在任何……地方，从属连词，引导地点状语从句；Whatever所……任何东西，连接代词，相当于anything that，引导主语从句；Whenever无论何时，从属连词，引导时间状语从句；Whoever任何……的人，连接代词，相当于anybody who，作主语，引导主语从句。根据“...breaks the traffic rules will get a fine from the policemen.”可知，句子为主语从句，空处需填连接代词，排除A和C，又因此处指代人，即任何违反交通规则的人，whoever“任何……的人”，连接代词，符合语境。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Why won’t we play basketball with Class 4 this afternoon? — Because they _ Longzhong for a study trip.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天下午我们为什么不和四班一起打篮球?——因为他们去隆中研学旅行去了。考查现在完成时。A. have gone to现在完成时，表示去了某地，可能已到达某地，也可能在去某地的路途中；B. have been to现在完成时，表示去了某地，现在已经回来了；C. had gone to过去完成时，表示去了某地，说话时人不在这里；D. had been to过去完成时，表示去了某地，说话时人已经回来了。本题根据语境可知四班去隆中的动作发生在过去，对现在造成了影响和结果，所以应用现在完成时，排除C、D选项；再根据句意可知应用have gone to结构，排除B选项；故答案选A。

questions.prompt: I don’t know  ______  she could finish the work by the end of this month.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不知道她能否在这个月底前完成这项工作。 考查宾语从句的引导词。whether是否，在宾语从句中不充当句子成分；what什么，在宾语从句中作主语、宾语、表语或定语；when何时，在宾语从句中作时间状语；why为什么，在宾语从句中作原因状语。通过分析题干可知，宾语从句中不缺少句子成分，因此whether符合题意。故选A。

questions.prompt: ——What is the of your excellent spoken English? ——Practice makes perfect!
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的极好的英语口语的秘密是什么？——熟能生巧。 A. result结果； B. influence 影响； C. duty 职责； D. secret秘密；根据Practice makes perfect!可知是秘密；故选D

questions.prompt: Sarah  ______ many places of interest in Beijing already.
questions.explanation: 句意：Sarah已经参观过北京许多有趣的地方了。本题考查动词时态。根据句意和already可知此处要用现在完成时。故选B。

questions.prompt: My lovely bird  ______  for two days.
questions.explanation: 句意：我可爱的小鸟死了两天。 考查时态。died动词die的过去分词和过去式；has been dead现在完成时，主语为单数；was dead一般过去时，主语为单数；death死亡，名词。根据“for two days”可知，共计两天，for后接一段时间，要与延续性动词连用，应用be dead，排除A和D，又因此处是小鸟已经死了两天了，时态为现在完成时，谓语用“has/have+过去分词”的结构，主语为My lovely bird，单数，助动词用has，be的过去分词为been。故选B。

questions.prompt: -Have you seen the hot film Wandering Earth ______? -Yes, I have. ______  wonderful science fiction movie it is!
questions.explanation: 句意：----你看过电影《流浪地球》吗？-----是的，我看过了。这是一部多么精彩的科幻电影啊！考查副词辨析和感叹句。1.yet通常用于完成时的疑问句或否定句中，意思是“已经，还”； already通常用于现在完成时的肯定句中，意思是“已经”；本句是现在完成时的一般疑问句，可知填yet。2. 英语感叹句由what和how引导，what后面跟名词，how后面跟形容词或副词。具体构成如下：（1）what + a/an+形容词+可数名词单数+主语+谓语！（2）what +形容词+不可数名词或可数名词复数+主语+谓语！（3）how+形容词或副词+主语+谓语！本句的中心词movie是可数名词单数，可知此感叹句用what引导，填What a。故选C。 二、完形填空（每题 2 分，共 10 题，共 20 分） A little boy invited his mother to attend his school’s first teacher-parent meeting. To the little boy’s  ______ 27 ______, she said she would go. This would be the first time that his classmates and teacher  ______ 28 ______  his mother and he felt ashamed (羞愧) of her appearance.  ______ 29 ______  she was a beautiful woman, there was a severe scar (疤痕) that  ______ 30 ______  nearly the right side of her face. The boy never wanted to talk about why or  ______ 31 ______  she got the scar. At the meeting, the people were impressed (留下印象) by the kindness and natural beauty of his mother although there was a scar on her face. But the little boy still felt  ______ 32 ______  and hid himself from everyone. However, by accident, he heard a conversation between his mother and his  ______ 33 ______. The teacher asked  ______ 34 ______, “How did you get the scar on your face?” The mother replied, “When my son was a baby, he was in a room that caught fire. Everyone was  ______ 35 ______  afraid to go in because of the big fire. At last, I got in. A long piece of wood came down and knocked me senselessly…” She touched the scar. “This scar will be lasting, but to this day, I have never regretted what I did.” At this point, the little boy came  ______ 36 ______  running toward his mother with tears in his eyes. He held her in his arms and felt a great sense of the sacrifice(牺牲) that his mother had made for him.

questions.prompt: My aunt will come to Beijing this weekend. We’ll meet  ______ at South Railway Station.
questions.explanation: 句意：我阿姨这个周末要来北京。我们将在南站接她。 考查代词辨析。he他，主格；she她，主格；him他，宾格；her她，宾格。此处指“My aunt”，是女性，在动词后作宾语用宾格，应用her，故选D。

questions.prompt: My father is a doctor. He works  ______  a hospital.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲是一名医生。他在一家医院工作。 考查介词辨析。of……的；on在……之上；in在……里面；with和。根据“He works...a hospital”可知，指的是在一家医院里工作，in a hospital“在医院里”。故选C。

questions.prompt: Linda is 14 years old, but she is  ______  than her younger brother.
questions.explanation: 句意：Linda14岁，但她比她弟弟矮。 考查形容词比较级。short矮的，形容词原级；shorter更矮的，形容词比较级；shortest最矮的，形容词最高级；the shortest最矮的，形容词最高级。根据“than her younger brother.”可知，指的是比弟弟矮，用形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you have chemistry class in a lab? —Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久在实验室上一次化学课?——一个月两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How much多少钱，用于提问价钱；How many多少，用于提问可数名词的数量；How often多久一次，用于提问频率；How long多长时间。根据“Twice a month”可知，是在提问频率。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Tom, where did you go last weekend? —Oh, I ______  to see a movie with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，上周末你去哪儿了？——哦，我和父母去看电影了。 考查动词时态。根据“last weekend?”可知，去看电影是上周末的事情，应用一般过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  go home now, or I will miss the football match.
questions.explanation: 句意：我现必须回家了，否则我会错过足球比赛。 考查情态动词辨析。can能；may可能；must必须；could可以。根据“or I will miss the football match”可知，我不想错过看足球比赛，因此“必须回家”符合语境。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Where do you have lunch when you go to school? —I usually  ______  lunch at school.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你上学的时候在哪里吃午饭？ ——我通常在学校吃午饭。 考查动词时态。根据“Where do you have lunch when you go to school?”和“usually”可知，答句用一般现在时，主语是I，谓语动词用原形have。故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  I got home, my mother was cooking in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我到家时，妈妈正在厨房做饭。 考查连词辨析。When当……时候；Because因为；If如果；Though虽然，尽管。根据“...I got home, my mother was cooking”可知，指的是当我到家的时候，是when引导的时间状语从句。故选A。

questions.prompt: Please don’t make so much noise. My sister  ______  the exam online.
questions.explanation: 句意：请不要制造那么大的噪音。我妹妹正在网上参加考试。 考查动词时态。根据“Please don’t make so much noise”可知，妹妹此时正在网上考试，是正在发生的动作，时态是现在进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: It’s nice to see you again. We  ______  each other since 2018.
questions.explanation: 句意：很高兴再次见到你。自从2018年，我们就没见过面。 考查现在完成时。根据“since 2018”和选项可知，句子是现在完成时的否定形式，其结构为：haven’t+过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: A new airport  ______  in our city next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们城市明年将建成一个新机场。 考查时态和语态。主语“A new airport”与动词complete之间是动宾关系，结合“next year”可知用一般将来时的被动语态，其结构为will be done。故选D。

questions.prompt: My role model is Zhong Nanshan.  ______  was given the title “the People’s Hero”.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的榜样是钟南山。他被授予“人民英雄”的称号。 考查人称代词。He他，主格；Him他，宾格；She她，主格；Her她，宾格。空处缺少主语，应用主格形式，Zhong Nanshan“钟南山”男子名，用He作主语。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Where was Chang’e-5 launched, Kate? — ______  Hainan province.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嫦娥五号在哪里发射的，凯特？——在海南省。 考查介词辨析。At在，加小地点；On在上面；In在，加大地点；To到。“Hainan province”是大地点，用介词in。故选C。

questions.prompt: — Jimmy, you were late for the first class.  ______  happened? — I got up late and missed the first bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：——吉米，你第一节课迟到了。发生了什么事？——我起晚了，没赶上第一班公共汽车。 考查特殊疑问句。Where在哪里；When什么时候；How怎么；What什么。根据“you were late for the first class.”可知，此处是问发生了什么事导致第一节课迟到。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Can you go shopping with me, Jack? — Sorry, I  ______. I have to finish my homework first.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你能和我—起去购物吗？——对不起，我不能。我必须先完成作业。 考查一般疑问句的回答。can’t不能；shouldn’t不应该；couldn’t不能，过去式；needn’t不必。根据“Can you go shopping with me, Jack?”可知，can开头的一般疑问句，通常还是用can回答，结合“Sorry”和“I have to finish my homework first.”可知，应是说“不能一起去”，故选A。

questions.prompt: It is very cold outside. Put on warm clothes,  ______  you may get sick.
questions.explanation: 句意：外面很冷。穿上暖和的衣服，否则你可能会生病。 考查连词辨析。 and和； so因此；or 否则，或者；but但是。分析前后两个分句的逻辑关系可知，需要用or表示“否则”。故选C。

questions.prompt: The invention of mobile phones makes our life much  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：手机的发明使我们的生活比以前容易多了。 考查形容词比较级。根据than可知，此空应填比较级easier，故选B。

questions.prompt: Tina’s grandmother  ______  a walk with her after supper every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：蒂娜的奶奶每天晚饭后和她一起散步。 考查动词时态。根据every day可知，此句是一般现在时，主语Tina’s grandmother是单数形式，动词用三单，故选B。

questions.prompt: We  ______  our English if we read more English books.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果我们多读一些英语书，我们的英语水平就会提高。 考查动词的时态。分析句子，题干是if引导的条件状语从句，其主从句常遵循“主将从现”原则，即主句用一般将来时态，从句用一般现在时态表将来。故选D。

questions.prompt: My father  ______  English for twenty-five years in Beijing.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲在北京教英语已经二十五年了。 考查动词的时态。根据时间状语“for twenty-five years”可知，句子应用现在完成时。故选C。

questions.prompt: — What is your sister doing, Li Lei? — She  ______  a letter to her pen pal in English.
questions.explanation: 句意：——李雷，你姐姐在做什么？——她正在用英语给她笔友写信。 考查时态。根据问句“What is your sister doing, Li Lei?”可知，答语“写信”正在进行，故句子用现在进行时，其结构为“am/is/are + doing”，主语“she”是第三人称单数，所以用is。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Could you tell me  ______, Daming? — In 2022.

choices.label: B

questions.explanation: 句意：——大明，你能告诉我北京什么时候举办第24届冬季奥运会吗？——在2022年。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句要用陈述句语序，结合答语“In 2022.”可知，宾语从句的时态为一般将来时态。故选A。 二、完形填空（共8分, 每小题8分） How Does a Person Become Great One day, a little boy asked his father. “What does the word ‘Great’ mean?” Boy said, “I have read many times that this person is great, he did this and that. Please  ______ 13 ______  me who are these great people and how they become great. Father said, “Okay.” Father thought of an idea to teach his son about being great. Father asked his son to bring two  ______ 14 ______  and then told him to plant one of them inside house and the other outside house, boy did as his father said. Now, father called his son and asked, “Do you think which one of these two plants will be  ______ 15 ______  and safer?” Boy replied, “Papa, the plant which is inside our house will be safe, therefore it will grow big whereas the plant outside house is not safe at all, it will have to withstand（禁得起）many seasons and no one will be there to take care of it. It can be eaten by animals  ______ 16 ______.” Father smiled and said. “We will know this at right time and at that same time I will give you the answer for your question.” Boy left for higher studies and after four years he came back to his house. When he saw the plant which he had planted there before  ______ 17 ______, he said to his father, “See, told you that nothing will happen to this plant and it will be safe and grow big.” Father smiled and said, “You should go outside and see the other plant.” When boy went outside, he saw a big tree. Boy couldn’t  ______ 18 ______  his eyes. He couldn’t understand how the plant outside was able to grow much bigger than the plant inside house! Then father explained to his son that the plant outside was able to grow bigger because it faced every season and many difficulties. Because the plant inside was safe, it didn’t face any weather, nor did it  ______ 19 ______  proper sunlight, therefore it didn’t become big. The boy realized the answer: To become a great person, one failed many times, had to face many  ______ 20 ______  and overcome them with their will power and determination（决心）. Only after that, they were able to become great.

questions.prompt: I have a brother. ______  name is Simon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我有一个弟弟，他的名字叫西蒙。 考查代词的用法。Her她的；His他的；Their他们的；Your你的。根据前一句的“a brother”一个弟弟，可知是男孩，物主代词用His，故选B。

questions.prompt: — When do you leave home for school? — I usually leave  ______  7 o’clock in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你什么时候离开家去上学?——我通常早上7点离开。 考查时间介词，on后接具体的某一天或某一天上午/下午；in后接世纪/年份/月份/季节；at后接具体时间点；of……的。根据“7 o’clock in the morning.”早上7点，可知是具体时间点，应该用at，故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  you please tell us the way to the nearest post office? — Sure. Follow me, please.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我们去最近的邮局怎么走吗?——当然。请跟我来。 考查情态动词，Could能，语气比can更委婉；Should应该；Must必须；Need需要。根据“please tell us the way to the nearest post office?”可知应该是在请求帮助，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the train ride from Beijing to Shanghai? —For about four and a half hours.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这辆火车，从北京开到上海多长时间？——大约四个半小时。 考查特殊疑问词组。How long多长（时间），对一段时间或长度提问；How many多少，对可数名词的数量提问；How often每隔多久，多对频率提问；How much多少，对不可数名词的数量或对钱提问。根据“For about four and a half hours.”可知，问句是对一段时间提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: Yao Ming is one of  ______  basketball players in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：姚明是世界上最高的篮球运动员之一。 考查形容词最高级。根据“one of+形容词最高级+名词复数”表示“……之一”；所以此处用最高级，最高级前面需加the，故选D。

questions.prompt: Wash your hands before meals,  ______  you may get ill.
questions.explanation: 句意：饭前洗手，否则你可能会生病的。 本题考查连词。and而且，but但是，or否则，so所以。结合句意，“饭前不洗手”是“你可能会生病”的条件，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Lily, what is your dad doing? — He  ______  his car in the yard.
questions.explanation: 句意：——莉莉，你爸爸在干什么?——他正在院子里洗车。 考查动词时态，根据提问“what is your dad doing?”，是问正在干什么，可知应该用现在进行时（be + v.ing）来回答，这里主语为he，be动词用is，故选C。

questions.prompt: Millions of people  ______  the Great Wall every year
questions.explanation: 句意：每年有数百万人参观长城。 考查动词时态，根据“every year”可知应该用一般现在时表示经常性行为，并且主语Millions of people为复数，故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______  great progress in English since I started to read an English story every day
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我开始每天读一个英语故事以来，我在英语方面取得了很大的进步。 考查动词时态，观察句子，本句是含有since的复合句，从句用一般过去时，主句应该用现在完成时，故选C。

questions.prompt: The teacher often tells us  ______  careful when going on the road.
questions.explanation: 句意：老师经常告诉我们在路上要小心。 考查固定句型，根据固定句型：tell sb. to do sth“告诉某人做某事”，be careful“小心”，故选D。

questions.prompt: Many new buildings  ______  in that area next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：明年许多新大楼会在那片区域被盖起来。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。根据“next year”可知，句子要用一般将来时，而“buildings”是build这一动作的承受者，用被动语态，一般将来时的被动结构是“will be+过去分词”，故选D。

questions.prompt: I don’t remember  ______  my Chinese dictionary yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不记得昨天我把我的汉语字典放哪儿了。 考查宾语从句。根据“I don't remember”可知考查宾语从句，宾语从句为陈述语序，排除选项A、C；根据时间状语“yesterday”得知，从句应该用一般过去时态，排除选项D；故选B。 二、完形填空 （共 8 分，每小题 1 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 When you hear the word hero, you may think of someone like Mahatma Gandhi or Nelson Mandela. But there are also “everyday” heroes—they may not be well-known to the public, but they do what they can to help  ______ 13 ______  people’s lives as well. Everyday heroes are normal people who are working to make the world a better place. Among them is Robert Lee. Lee grew up in New York City. As his family was not rich, he learned from a young age the importance of  ______ 14 ______  the waste of food. When in college, he was part of a student group that gave out leftover (剩余的) food to homeless people. This experience made him realize how  ______ 15 ______  the problem of food wastage actually was. After he left university Lee and his friend set up an organization called Rescuing Leftover Cuisine (RLC). Its  ______ 16 ______  is to collect unsold food from restaurants and send it for free to shelters (收容所). Volunteers pick up the food from restaurants around the city and hand it out to those in need. RLC operates simply. Using an app developed by Lee’s team, restaurants  ______ 17 ______  how much leftover food they have each day. Then volunteers are sent to fetch it. The distance is usually short, so volunteers can just do their deliveries ( 递 送 ) by walking from the restaurants to the shelters. Lee believes this is a quick way of delivery. So far, Lee and his team have successfully  ______ 18 ______  over 150,000 kilograms of food, serving almost 300,000 meals to people who need them. Lee has shown that a  ______ 19 ______  action can help people around us greatly. It may have a greater influence than we imagine. When Lee is asked what his next plan is, he says there’s still a lot to do. “ It’s just the  ______ 20 ______. With more restaurants, who knows how much more we can do.”

questions.prompt: My sister is friendly and gentle with  ______  classmates.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的妹妹对她的同学们很友好、温和。 考查代词辨析。he人称代词主格，他；she人称代词主格，她；her人称代词宾格或形容词性物主代词，她，她的；his物主代词，他的；根据题干空格后的名词classmates, 可知要用形容词性物主代词来修饰，所以排除A、B项；主语My sister是女性，所以排除D项。故选C。

questions.prompt: I often take part in some volunteer activities  ______  Sundays.
questions.explanation: 句意：我经常在星期天参加一些志愿活动。 考查介词。in用于指某个较长的时间；at用于指某一特定的时刻；on用于指具体某一天，如星期几；with和……一起。空格后Sundays指星期，故应用介词on，故选C。

questions.prompt: Get up early,  ______  you’ll miss the early bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：早点起来，否则你就赶不上早班车了。 考查连词。or否则；and和；but但是；so因此。根据前句“Get up early”可知，此处指的是“否则你就赶不上早班车了”，故应填or，故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  I hand in the poster today, Miss Wang? — No, you needn’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：——王小姐，我今天必须交海报吗？ ——不，不需要。 考查情态动词。Can可以；Must必须；Should应该；Need需要。根据答句“No, you needn’t”可知，must开头的一般疑问句，否定回答用needn’t或don’t have to。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Excuse me,  ______  is the beef? —It’s 38 yuan a pound.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，牛肉多少钱？——38元一磅。 考查特殊疑问句。how long多长；how soon多久；how often多久一次；how much多少钱。根据答语“It’s 38 yuan a pound.”可知，是问价格，故选D。

questions.prompt: Although Tom plays basketball very well, he practices  ______  than anyone else.
questions.explanation: 句意：虽然汤姆篮球打得很好，但他比任何人都更加刻苦地训练。 考查副词比较级。根据“than”可知，此处应使用副词比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: We  ______  a sports meeting if it is fine next Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果下周二天气好，我们将举行运动会。 考查时态。if如果，引导条件状语从句，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时，故选C。

questions.prompt: — What happened to you, Linda? — A car hit me when I  ______  home yesterday. My leg was hurt.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你怎么了，琳达？ ——昨天我骑车回家时，一辆车撞了我。我的腿受伤了。 考查过去进行时。ride动词原形；will ride表一般将来时；am riding表现在进行时；was riding表过去进行时。根据句中“yesterday”提示，此处应用过去进行时，表示过去某一时刻正在发生的事，故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  200 stamps since my grandfather gave me the first one.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我祖父给我第一张邮票以来，我已经收集了200张邮票。 考查现在完成时。根据句中“since”提示，主句应用现在完成时，表示过去的动作持续到现在，并可能持续发生下去。故选A。

questions.prompt: —What is your father doing, Peter? —He  ______  an online meeting in his room.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，你爸爸正在做什么？——他正在房间里参加一个在线会议。 考查现在进行时。根据“What is your father doing, Peter?”可知时态是现在进行时，答语也应该用现在进行时，主语he后面应接is+doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: All the stadiums for the 24th Winter Olympic Games  ______  by August 2021.
questions.explanation: 句意：第24届冬奥会的所有场馆将于2021年8月完工。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。主语All the stadiums是动作complete的承受者，根据“August 2021”可知，此处应使用一般将来时的被动语态，结构为will be done。故选D。

questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道格林一家去年是怎么去旅行的吗？——知道。他们乘火车旅行的。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句用陈述语序，排除B和D；根据“last year”可知，时态是一般过去时，故选A。 二、完形填空（共8分, 每小题8分） 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Since the age of three, Dolores had dreamed of becoming a dancer. That  ______ 13 ______  nearly ended one night in 2010. Dolores, then a 17-year-old high school senior, was in a car accident that put her in the hospital for 51 days and left her paralyzed (瘫痪) from the waist down. For most people, that would have destroyed any hope of a dancing career. However, for Dolores, it was the beginning. She wanted to  ______ 14 ______  that she was still “normal”. Normal for her meant dancing, so Dolores did it in her wheelchair right alongside her nondisabled high school dance team. Because half of her body was taken away, she has to move it with her  ______ 15 ______. So, it surely took her a lot to learn and be patient. After graduation, Dolores wanted to  ______ 16 ______  her dance network to include women like her. She met people online who had suffered various spinal cord (脊椎) injuries. By sharing her determination, she invited them to dance with her. For her, it was such a(n)  ______ 17 ______  experience. Hoping to reach more people Dolores moved to Los Angeles where she formed a team of dancers with disabilities named the Rollettes. She wanted to show that “dance is dance,  ______ 18 ______  you’re walking or you’re rolling.” In disabled dance competitions, the Rollettes rocked their upper bodies, jerked their heads to beats, stroke poses, and steered their wheelchairs in well-timed, dynamic (动态). The audiences’ high-spirited reactions showed they had a  ______ 19 ______. Dolores has achieved what many of us never will: her childhood dream. But the Rollettes have helped her find something else just as satisfying. Every year she holds a dance camp for wheelchair users of all ages and abilities with an eye to helping them  ______ 20 ______  their goals. Until now, 173 participants from ten countries attended. For many, it was the first time they’d felt they belonged. Nothing can stop them from following their dream of dancing. When life gives you lemons, you can indeed make lemonade.

questions.prompt: Mr. Smith is a funny teacher. We all like  ______  lessons.
questions.explanation: 句意：史密斯先生是个有趣的老师。我们都喜欢他的课。 考查形容词性的物主代词。his他的；her她的；your你的，你们的；their他们的。根据“Mr. Smith is a funny teacher.”史密斯先生是个有趣的老师。可知，史密斯是男性，因此用形容词性的物主代词his。故选A。

questions.prompt: People usually visit Sanya  ______  winter.
questions.explanation: 句意：人们通常在冬天去三亚。 考查介词。at后接具体时刻；on后接具体一天；in后接某年某月某季节；of属于；根据“winter”是冬季，所以用“in”，故选C。

questions.prompt: Tom, hurry up,  ______  you will miss the school bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆，快点，否则你会赶不上校车的。 考查连词辨析。and和，又；but但是；or否则，要不然；so因此。根据“Tom, hurry up,”可知，此处是否则就赶不上校车。祈使句+or+陈述句，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you go to the chess club, Peter? — Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，你多久去一次象棋俱乐部?——一周一次。 考查特殊疑问句，How much多少或询问价格；How often多久一次；How long时间多长；How far距离多远。根据答语“Once a week.”，可知应该是问频率，多久一次，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  I borrow your eraser? I left mine at home. — Of course. Here you are.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我能借用一下你的橡皮吗?我把我的忘在家里了。——当然。给你。 考查情态动词，Can能；Should应该；Need需要；Must必须。根据“I left mine at home.”可知应该是忘记带橡皮，向他人请求借用一下，应该用can表示，故选A。

questions.prompt: The Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge is one of  ______  sea-crossing bridges in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：港珠澳大桥是世界上最长的跨海大桥之一。 考查形容词最高级用法。long长的，是原级；longer比较长的；longest最长的，形容词最高级，缺乏冠词the，格式不对；the longest最长的，是最高级。根据句尾的比较范围“in the world”在世界上，可知用形容词最高级，故选D。

questions.prompt: My father likes sports. He often  ______  in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我爸爸喜欢运动。他经常在早上跑步。 考查一般现在时。根据“often”可知是频率副词，可推测出是用一般现在时，结合主语是“He”，可知用“runs”，故选B。

questions.prompt: — What were you doing at 7:00 yesterday evening, Lisa? — I  ______  up the kitchen with my mother.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天晚上7点你在干什么，丽莎?——我和妈妈一起打扫厨房。 考查动词时态，根据提问“What were you doing at 7:00 yesterday evening, Lisa?”可知询问的是过去某个时候正在做什么，应该用过去进行时(was/were doing)，这里主语为I，故选C。

questions.prompt: Linda came to China in 2011. She  ______  here for ten years.
questions.explanation: 句意：琳达于2011年来到中国。她在这里已经住了十年了。 考查时态。根据“for ten years”可知是for+一段时间，用现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Please be quiet! Your little sister  ______  an online class now.
questions.explanation: 句意：请保持安静!你妹妹正在上网络课。 考查时态。根据“now”可知是现在正在进行中，可推测出是用现在进行时，故选B。

questions.prompt: The 24th Winter Olympics  ______  in Beijing in 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：第24届冬奥会将于2022年在中国举行。 考查被动语态。“in 2022”是将来时间，用于一般将来时，需借助will构成，可排除A、C选项。主语“The 24 Winter Olympics”是动词“held”的受动者，需用被动语态，可排除B项。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Could you tell me  ______  this English dictionary? — Sure. I bought it at Xinhua Bookstore.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你在哪儿买的这本英语词典吗?——当然。我在新华书店买的。 考查宾语从句，在英语中宾语从句应该用陈述语气，排除选项DB。观察句子，主句是一般现在时，从句时态不受限制，根据答语“I bought it at Xinhua Bookstore.”可知应该是过去时，故选A。 二、完形填空（共8分，每小题1分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A Second Chance I was in fifth grade and about to take a science test. Since first grade, I had always been good at school. Simple science was easy for me and I always did well on tests. When it came to fifth-grade science, however, I was struggling (挣扎). I couldn’t seem to  ______ 13 ______  it no matter how hard I tried. I was anxious. My mom and dad had always been so proud of my grade, and I didn’t want to let them down. So just before the test I had written several  ______ 14 ______  from the textbook on my desk in pencil. The writing was so light that it could hardly be seen. I sat  ______ 15 ______  as the teacher started to hand out to the test. I didn’t want to get caught, but I didn’t want to fail, either. As the teacher was starting down my row, suddenly the fire alarm went off. It was an unscheduled fire drill (消防演习).We all  ______ 16 ______  out of the door and stood together, waiting to be allowed back into the building. As I stood outside in the warm sunshine, I realized what a fool I had been. I knew my mom and dad would still love me no matter what my grade was. As soon as we came into the classroom, I walked to my desk and  ______ 17 ______  the notes away. I had been given a second chance, and I wasn’t going to waste it. I took the test, did my best and felt  ______ 18 ______. I don’t remember what my grade was, but what happened that day has  ______ 19 ______  in my heart and mind ever since. Life is full of second chances, but you have to be willing to take them. You have to be willing to accept your  ______ 20 ______  and grow from them. Every day when you wake up, you are given a second chance at life. Treasure it! And use it wisely!

questions.prompt: Mr. Wang in a friendly teacher, we all like  ______  very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：王先生在一个友好的老师。我们都很喜欢他。 考查代词辨析。her她，宾格或她的，形容词性物主代词；him他，宾格；them他们，宾格；us我们，宾格。根据“Mr. Wang”可知王先生是一位男老师，所以用人称代词单数形式him，作动词like的宾语，故选B。

questions.prompt: The famous basketball player, Yao Ming, joined the be NBA  ______  2002.
questions.explanation: 句意：著名篮球运动员姚明于2002年加入NBA。 考查介词辨析。at用于时间的某一点或某个时刻；in用于较长的的时间，如年、月、季节等；to朝，向；from来自，从。根据“2020”可知“在2020年”，所以用介词in，故选B。

questions.prompt: J K. Rowling lived a hard life  ______  she didn’t give up writing.
questions.explanation: 句意：J.K.罗琳过着艰苦的生活，但她没有放弃写作。 考查并列连词辨析。and和，表示顺承的并列连词；so因此，表示因果关系的并列连词；but但是，表示转折关系的并列连词；because因为，从属连词，引导原因状语从句。根据“lived a hard life”和“didn’t give up writing”，可知上下句属于转折关系，所以用but，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Mum, can I play with my dog for a while? —Sorry, you  ______. You should finish your homework first.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我可以和我的狗玩一会儿吗？ ——对不起，你不可以。你必须先完成作业。 考查情态动词。can’t不能，不可以；needn’t不必；mustn’t禁止，表示警告或禁止；wouldn't将不会，不愿意，表示意愿。根据问句中“can”，结合语境，可知此处表示请求许可，根据“Sorry”，可知没有得到妈妈的许可，can’t表示“不可以”。故选A。

questions.prompt: The time when I lived in the county was one of  ______  periods in my life.
questions.explanation: 句意：我住在县里的时候是我一生中最快乐的时期之一。 考查形容词的最高级。happy幸福，快乐的，形容词原级；happier形容词比较级；the happiest形容词最高级；happily快乐地，副词。根据空后的名词periods “时期”，可知空处需用形容词，故排除D；“one of +the +形容词最高级+名词复数”是英语中最高级的固定搭配。表示“……是……中最……之一”，所以空处应用形容词的最高级，故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you help in the Children’s House, Betty? — Twice a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久在儿童之家帮忙一次。贝蒂？——一个月两次。 考查特殊疑问句。How soon多久以后，常用于将来时；How long多长时间，用于时间段；How far多远，询问距离；How often多久一次，询问频率。根据答语“Twice a month.”可知“一个月两次”属于频率，故选D。

questions.prompt: Listen! Jack  ______  beautifully in the music classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：听！杰克在音乐教室里唱得很美。 考查时态和主谓一致。is singing现在进行时；are singing现在进行时；was singing过去进行时；will be singing一般将来进行时。根据“Listen!”可知句子用现在进行时，其结构为“am/is/are+doing”，主语“Jack”是第三人称单数，所以用助动词is，故选A。

questions.prompt: Our family will go hiking if it  ______  tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天不下雨，我们一家就去远足。 考查时态。doesn’t rain一般现在时；didn’t rain一般过去时；won't rain一般将来时；isn't raining现在进行时。本句中if意为“如果”，在if引导的条件状语从句，需满足“主将从现”原则，即主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时；这里rain“下雨”是一个实义动词，否定形式需要加助动词，主语it是第三人称单数，故加doesn't。故选A。

questions.prompt: Emily  ______  to learn English when she was 8 years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：艾米丽8岁时开始学英语。 考查时态辨析。根据“when she was 8 years old”可知，本句时态是一般过去时，所以使用过去式，故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  ten English novels since I joined the English reading club.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从我加入英语读书俱乐部以来，我已经读了十本英语小说。 考查时态。reads读，动词三单形式, 一般现在时；read一般现在时，动词原形；have read现在完成时；will read一般将来时。根据“since I joined the English reading club”可知时态用现在完成时，其结构为have/has+过去分词，主语I为第一人称，所以用助动词have，故选C。

questions.prompt: The first mobile phone  ______  in April, 1973 by Martin Lawrence Cooper.
questions.explanation: 句意：第一部手机是马丁·劳伦斯·库珀于1973年4月发明的。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。invent发明，动词原形；invented发明，过去式；is invented被发明，一般现在时的被动语态；was invented被发明，一般过去时的被动语态。根据“in April, 1973”，可知本句用一般过去时；根据主语“The first mobile phone”与动词“invent”的关系，可知用被动关系，所以一般过去时的被动语态。故选D。

questions.prompt: Do you know  ______  five years ago? —Yes. He lived in Shanghai.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道他五年前住在哪里吗？ ——是的。他住在上海。 考查宾语从句的语序和时态。宾语从句通常用陈述句句式，选项A、C为疑问句句式，所以排除A、C。根据“five years ago”，可知宾语从句时态为一般过去时，故选D。 二、完形填空 How school plays make a difference Everyone remembers their first time on stage. But after the boys before me couldn't finish their lines, it was my time to get right. I stepped forward, took a deep breath and went for it. I did it! I will never  ______ 17 ______  the moment I stood in the bright light with everyone's attention. I even remember the beautiful dress my mom made me to  ______ 18 ______  while narrating. For those young students who act in school plays, they build up strong confidence, a great power of learning and even a beautiful dream to be a real actor or actress in the future. That's why the black and gold  ______ 20 ______  still hangs in my old bedroom. And I have to be honest—it did look great in the light.

questions.prompt: Confucius is a great writer, and we still read ______ books.
questions.explanation: 句意：孔子是一位伟大的作家，我们仍然读他的书。 考查代词辨析。his他的；its它的；their他们的；your你的。此空指代前文提到的“Confucius”，是男性，故选A。

questions.prompt: May Day in China is  ______  May 1st every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国的五一劳动节是在每年的5月1日。 考查时间介词的用法。at后接具体的时刻；in后接某年某月某季节；on后接具体某一天；to到。“May 1st”是具体的一天，故选C。

questions.prompt: Liu Xiang suffered a lot from his foot problem,  ______ he didn’t give up.
questions.explanation: 句意：刘翔饱受脚伤之苦，但他没有放弃 考查连词辨析。or或者；so所以；for由于；but但是。“suffered a lot from his foot problem”与“he didn’t give up”是转折关系，虽然饱受脚伤之苦，但他没有放弃，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Must I hand in the report today? —No, you  ______. You can hand it in tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我必须今天交报告吗？——不，你不必。你可以明天交。 考查情态动词辨析。can’t不可能；needn’t不必；shouldn’t不应该；mustn’t禁止。must引导的一般疑问句，否定回答用don’t have to或needn’t，故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you usually go to school, Tom? —By bike.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Tom，你通常怎么去上学？——骑自行车。 考查特殊疑问句。when何时；where哪里；how怎样；why为什么。根据答语“by bike”可知，对上学的方式进行提问，用疑问词how，故选C。

questions.prompt: Tian’anmen Square is one of  ______ squares in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：天安门广场是世界上最大广场之一。 考查最高级的用法。one of+the+最高级+名词复数，最……之一，结合in the world给出的比较范围是表示三者以上，可知用最高级，故选D。

questions.prompt: We will play football if it  ______  this Saturday.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果这周六不下雪，我们会踢足球。 考查动词时态。if表示“如果”，引导条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”，从句主语it是第三人称，否定句借助于助动词doesn’t，后接动词原形，故选A。

questions.prompt: —Alice, what’s your brother doing? —He  ______  the guitar now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Alice，你弟弟正在做什么？——他现在正在谈吉他。 考查动词时态。根据“what’s your brother doing”及“now”可知，句子要用现在进行时，结构为be doing，故选B。

questions.prompt: Mrs. White is a teacher. She  ______  history for nearly 15 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：怀特夫人是一位老师。她教历史已经将近15年了。 考查动词时态。for+一段时间，要与现在完成时一起连用，结构为have/has done，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Hi, Mike. I called you last night, but you didn’t answer. —Sorry. I  ______  a movie at that time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，Mike。我昨晚打电话给你，但是你没接。——抱歉。那时我正在看电影。 考查动词时态。根据“I called you last night”和“at that time”可知，句子要用过去进行时，结构为was/were doing，故选B。

questions.prompt: I think paper books ______  by e-books in the future.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为纸质书将来会被电子书所取代。 考查一般将来时被动语态。根据“in the future”可知，句子要用一般将来时，根据”by e-books“可知，句子要用被动语态，故此空应填一般将来时被动语态will be done的结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mary, can you tell me  ______  Shanghai? —Sure. Next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——Mary，你能告诉我Jackson先生什么时候离开上海吗？——当然可以。下周日。 考查宾语从句。分析句子结构可知，此句是宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，排除B和D选项。根据答语“Next Sunday”可知，从句要用一般将来时，故选A。 二、完形填空 When my brother and I were children, we spent a few weeks in the countryside with our uncle. You did.” he said with a smile. “You didn’t know it, but I gave you a little attitude (态度) test today. Every time you were complaining（抱怨） ______ 18 ______, I put a stone in your bag. Whenever you talked about something with positive（积极的） thinking, I took out a stone. And now look at your bags.” The bags were almost full. “Your negative（消极的）thoughts are like stones. You carry them in your  ______ 19 ______  just like those stones in bags. With great love, our uncle  ______ 20 ______  us one of the most important lessons in life-the power of attitude. questions.prompt: We should value the time we spend with  ______  family and friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们应该珍惜与家人和朋友共度的时光。 考查代词辨析。their他们的；our我们的；his他的；my我的。根据“We should value the time we spend with … family and friends”可知，是珍惜我们跟家人和朋友相处的时光，故选B。

questions.prompt: Lisa always talks to me  ______  English to help with my speaking.
questions.explanation: 句意：丽莎总是用英语和我说话，帮助我提高口语。 考查介词辨析。in用某种语言；on在……上；to到；at在。根据“talks to me…English to help with my speaking”可知，为了帮我提高口语，她总是用英语跟我说话，in English“用英语”，故选A。

questions.prompt: I wanted to try the new ride,  ______  my mother said it was not safe.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想试试那辆新的车，但我妈妈说它不安全。 考查连词。so因此，表因果；or或者，表选择；but但是，表转折；and和，表等同。根据前后文可知，此处存在转折关系，故应用连词but。故选C。

questions.prompt: —I found a school uniform on the playground. —It  ______  belong to John. Look! His name card is here.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我在操场上发现了一套校服。——它一定是约翰的。看！他的名片在这里。 考查情态动词表推测。could能，表示能力；need需要，必要；must必须，或表示肯定性推测；would将，将会。根据“His name card is here.”，由此做出肯定性推测“它一定是约翰的”。所以此处用must表示肯定性推测，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  suggestions did Mr. Wang give you on table manners? —Three.
questions.explanation: 句意：——王先生在餐桌礼仪方面给了你多少建议？——三个。 考查特殊疑问句。How many多少，对可数名词复数的数量提问；How much多少，对不可数名词量或价格提问；How long多长；How often多久一次。根据“suggestions”和“Three.”可知，此处对可数名词复数的数量提问，所以用how many。故选A。

questions.prompt: Erquan Yingyue is one of  ______  pieces of music that I've ever heard.
questions.explanation: 句意：《二泉映月》是我听过的最动人的音乐之一。 考查最高级。“one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数”，表示“最……之一”，结合选项，故选D。

questions.prompt: Lily likes Cha Jing so much that she  ______  it for at least an hour every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉非常喜欢《茶经》，她每天至少看一个小时。 考查动词时态。根据“ likes及every day”可知，描述经常性的动作，句子用一般现在时，主语she是第三人称，动词用三单形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What was your little sister doing when I called you yesterday? —She  ______  for losing a game.
questions.explanation: 句意：——昨天我打电话给你时你妹妹在干什么？ ——她正在为输掉一场比赛而哭泣。 考查过去进行时。根据上文“What was your little sister doing”提示，此处应用过去进行时，其结构为was/were doing。故选D。

questions.prompt: —What’s your plan for the coming weekend? —I  ______  an invention museum with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你下个周末有什么计划？ ——我要和父母去参观一个发明博物馆。 考查一般将来时。根据上文“for the coming weekend”提示，周末还未到来，故空格处所在句子应用一般将来时，其结构为be going to do。故选D。

questions.prompt: I  ______  on the school swim team for nearly four years.
questions.explanation: 句意：我在学校游泳队已经快四年了。 考查动词时态。for+一段时间，要与现在完成时一起连用，结构为：have/has done，故选B。

questions.prompt: Our school restrooms  ______  by the cleaners three times a day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们学校的洗手间每天由清洁工打扫三次。 考查被动语态。句子主语“Our school restrooms”与动词“clean”之间是被动关系，应用被动语态，排除A/B选项；主语是复数名词，be动词应用are，故选C。

questions.prompt: Mr. Cooper is very popular, and we all enjoy  ______  classes.
questions.explanation: 句意：库珀先生很受欢迎，我们都喜欢上他的课。 考查动词辨析。his他的；her她的；their；他（她）们的；它们的；your你的。Mr.用于指称男性，根据上文“Mr. Cooper is very popular”，Cooper是单数第三人称，可知his符合语境，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Happy birthday, Jack! Here is a gift  ______  you. — Thanks. That’s very nice of you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——生日快乐，杰克！这是给你的礼物。——谢谢，你真好。 考查介词辨析。from从……；for对于……；on在……上；in在……里面。给你一个礼物，Here is a gift for you“给你一个礼物”。故选B。

questions.prompt: Put on your warm clothes before you go out,  ______  you may have a cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：在你出去之前，穿上暖和的衣服，否则你有可能感冒。 考查连词辨析。or否则，提醒后果；so所以，表因果；but但是，表转折；and并且，表并列。此句结构为“祈使句+and/or+陈述句”，根据“you may have a cold”可知，此处提醒不穿暖和衣服的后果，是会感冒。故选A。

questions.prompt: You  ______  cross the road when the traffic lights are red.
questions.explanation: 句意：当交通灯是红色时，你不能过马路。 考查情态动词辨析。couldn’t不可以；wouldn’t不会；mustn’t禁止；needn’t不需要。根据“You…cross the road when the traffic lights are red”可知，红灯时禁止过马路，故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you go to the cinema, Li Wen? — Once a month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——李文，你多久去看一次电影？——一个月一次。 考查疑问词。how many多少，对复数名词提问；how much多少（钱），对不可数名词提问；how often多久一次，对频率提问；how soon多久，多快，常对“in+时候段”提问。由答语“Once a month.”可知，此句是对频率进行提问，应用how often，故选C。

questions.prompt: Zhong Nanshan is one of  ______  scientists in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：钟南山是中国最著名的科学家之一。 考查最高级。“one of+形容词的最高级+复数名词”意为“最……之一”，famous的最高级由most构成，形容词最高级与定冠词the连用，故选D。

questions.prompt: Life is like a mirror. If you smile at it, it  ______  back.
questions.explanation: 如果：生活就像一面镜子。如果你对着它微笑，它也会对你微笑。 考查if引导的条件状语从句。If引导的条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”原则，即主句和从句如果要表将来，主句要用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时。空格处于主句位置，用一般将来时。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  an online test when my mum walked in.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈进来的时候我正在做一个在线测试。 考查动词时态辨析。本句是when引导的时间状语从句，根据从句“when my mum walked in”是一般过去时，可知主句需用过去时；was doing是过去进行时，符合语境语法，故选C。

questions.prompt: They  ______  each other since Lily left Beijing last year, but they stay in touch.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从莉莉去年离开北京后，他们就没见过面，但他们一直保持联系。 考查时态。since自从，是现在完成时的标志词，表示从过去持续到现在的动作，主句应用现在完成时，其构成为“have/has+过去分词”，故选D。

questions.prompt: — What is your little sister doing, Tom? — She  ______  with her toys now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你妹妹在干什么？——她现在在和她的玩具玩。 考查动词时态。根据上文“What is your little sister doing, Tom?”可知，下文是现在进行时，其结构是be doing的形式，短语play with...“和……一起玩”。故选B。

questions.prompt: Chinese spacecraft Chang’e 5  ______  into space on November 24th, 2020.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国航天器“嫦娥五号”于2020年11月24日发射升空。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。send发射；主语Chang’e 5是动词send的受动者，需用被动语态“be done”结构，可排除AB两项。结合“November 24th, 2020”是过去的时间，可知需用一般过去时的被动语态，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______? —At 2:00 tomorrow afternoon.

choices.label: B
choices.text: when did our class meeting begin

choices.label: C
choices.text: when our class meeting will begin

choices.label: D
choices.text: when will our class meeting begin

questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道我们的班会什么时候开始？——明天下午两点。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句需用陈述语序，B和D是疑问句语序，可排除。主句Do you know….是一般现在时，从句可用任何时态；根据回答“At 2:00 tomorrow afternoon”，可知宾语从句是一般将来时，故选C。 二、完形填空（共 8 分，每小题 1 分） 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中， 选择最佳选项。 Families That Care, Care about Families. My 10th Christmas was the one that I was not looking forward to. Money was limited. Mom said we were old enough now not to expect  ______ 13 ______. “How can I even wear the same old dress one more time?” I  ______ 14 ______  to my sister. “I know,” said my sister. “I have asked for a horse forever but it never happens.” The next day, Mom told us that she had been saving up and shopping around so that we could give the Walters family a Christmas basket. “If anyone needs some  ______ 15 ______, it’s the Walters,” Mom reminded us. Looking like a family of hobos ( 流 浪 汉 ), the Walters could hardly afford their food. I noticed that Mom had prepared a small gift for each of the children. How could Mom be so generous (慷慨的) with someone else’s kids when we didn’t have enough? We  ______ 16 ______  the basket to the Walters’, knocked hard on the door and then ran fast to hide behind a tree. When the family came out and picked up the basket, I saw their faces. They looked happy. But mostly, they looked like, well, like they were thinking, maybe we do belong here. Christmas morning arrived.  ______ 17 ______, I received a beautiful dress and my sister got a horse! “Mom, how did you manage to do all this?” I asked. “We were  ______ 18 ______  for a no-present Christmas.” “Oh, everybody helped. Mrs. Olsen at the dress shop sold me your gift at half price. Mrs. Marshall paid me to hang up her tree lights. Mr. Jones gave us one of his horses because we got your sister to love it. And the Larsens, down the way,  ______ 19 ______  some of their pasture (牧场) for us to keep the horse.” “But the Walters don’t have anything to give in return.” “Doesn’t matter who can or can’t give. If we just listen to our hearts, the right gifts will end up with the right families,” Mom said. That was the Christmas that I learned about the magic of  ______ 20 ______. The “belonging” feeling was more valuable than any of the gifts. And I thought families that care, care about families. All families.

questions.prompt: Mr. Lee likes reading and  ______  favorite book is The Adventures of Tom Sawyer.
questions.explanation: 句意：李先生喜欢读书，他最喜欢的书是《汤姆•索亚历险记》。 考查物主代词。her她的；his他的；their他们的；your你（们）的。根据并列句子主语Mr. Lee提示，此处指的是“他最喜欢的书”，故应用形容词性物主代词his，故选B。

questions.prompt: —Sam, what do you often do  ______  the science club? —We do many interesting experiments.
questions.explanation: ——山姆，你经常在科学俱乐部做什么? ——我们做了许多有趣的实验。 考查介词辨析。of……的；in在……里；to去，向，往；on在……之上。结合句意及the science club可知，这里是指在科学俱乐部里，故选B。

questions.prompt: Hurry up,  ______  we will miss the game.
questions.explanation: 句意：快点，否则我们就会错过游戏。 考查连词。and和；but但是；or否则；so所以；此处是结构“祈使句，and/or+简单句”，根据句意可知，这里表示“否则”，应用or连接，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Mom, must I clean my room now? — No, you  ______. You can do it after dinner.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，我现在必须打扫房间吗？ ——不，不需要。你可以在晚饭后做。 考查情态动词。needn’t不需要；mustn’t禁止；shouldn’t不应该；can’t不能。根据英语语法，对于must开头一般疑问句，若要作否定回答，可用needn’t，不用mustn’t。故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you visit your grandparents? — Once a week. We usually have a big dinner together.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你多久去看一次你的祖父母？ ——一周一次。我们通常一起吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。 考查特殊疑问句。How long多长时间，问一段时间；How far多远，提问两地之间的距离；How often多久一次，提问频率；How much多少，对不可数名词的量提问。根据答句“Once a week”可知，此处问的是频率，故选C。

questions.prompt: The  ______  you climb, the more you can see.
questions.explanation: 句意：爬得越高，你能看到的东西就越多。 考查固定句型。high高，副词原级；higher更高的，副词比较级；highest最高的，副词最高级；higher than比……高。“The+比较级，the+比较级”为固定句型，意为“越……越……”，故此处应用副词比较级形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: Betty’s family  ______  to New York if her father gets a job there.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果Betty的爸爸在纽约找到一份工作，他们一家会搬到那里。 考查时态。move移动；根据“…if her father gets a job there”可知句子是if引导的条件状语从句，此时遵循“主将从现”，主句用一般将来时，结构是：will+动词原形，即will move。故选B。

questions.prompt: —What do you think of the movie Black Beauty? —Fantastic. I ______ it twice.
questions.explanation: ——你觉得电影《黑美人》怎么样? ——太棒了。我看了两遍。 考查现在完成时。根据句中twice可知，此处表示已经看过这部电影两次，应用现在完成时，其结构为have/has+动词过去分词，主语为I，助动词用have，动词watch的过去分词为watched，故选D。

questions.prompt: Amy is a volunteer and she ______ with the waste sorting at school every Friday.
questions.explanation: 句意：Amy是一名志愿者，她每周五在学校帮忙垃圾分类。根据every Friday可知，此处描述经常性动作，用一般现在时，主语是she，动词用第三人称单数形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Peter, please be quiet. Your brother  ______  on the phone. —No problem.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，请安静。你哥哥正在手机上录音。——没问题。 考查时态。根据“Peter, please be quiet.”可知，现在要保持安静，此处表示你哥哥现在正在录音，因此用现在进行时am/is/are+doing结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: A monkey escaped from the zoo last month. But several days later, it  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：上个月一只猴子从动物园里逃跑了。但是几天后，它被抓住了。 考查时态和语态。根据“last month”可知，此处用一般过去时，结合句意，它被抓住了，因此用被动语态was/were+done结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: A friend is someone  ______  you know well and like spending time with.
questions.explanation: 句意：朋友就是你很了解并且喜欢花时间在一起的人。 考查定语从句。分析“A friend is someone…you know well and like spending time with.”可知，本句是定语从句，先行词是人，引导词在从句中作宾语，故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Graduation Ceremony (毕业典礼) Cindy and Daniel were waiting for their turn to go across the stage (舞台). No, it wasn’t the talent show. It was for graduation! They were both so nervous, and it was hard to think about anything except the huge stage. Daniel looked at his  ______ 13 ______  and gave her a nervous smile. She held his hand tightly for comfort. In both of their minds, they  ______ 14 ______  their turn walking across the stage, and they were both unknowingly thinking about the same thing: I’m going to trip and fall on the stage and everyone will laugh at me. Cindy  ______ 15 ______  his smile with her own uneven grin (笑容). Her hands were shaking. At least she didn’t have to give a speech like Sandra—that would have made it horrible. Daniel’s feet moved up and down nervously as the students were called one at a time to come up. Names were called and some special  ______ 16 ______  were presented to the best students in art music, PE, dance, math and science. Class by class, row by row, it was getting  ______ 17 ______  to their turn. It was just minutes away, but time went by so quickly. Oh, no! It was their turn now. Fearing it like a dentist’s visit, they both stood up with their class. They had to wait in line along the wall. Then, one at a time, the principal (校长) called their names. “Cindy Marie Godfrey, winner of a principal’s prize for great behavior and grades!” The audience cheered. Daniel  ______ 18 ______  his friend step across the stage, stop to shake hands, get pictures done, and then exit on the opposite side. “Daniel Adam Richmond, winner of a perfect attendance prize.” Daniel stepped out  ______ 19 ______, hearing his shoes sound loudly on the wooden stage. He took a breath, and walked across the stage. The principal shook his hand, smiled, and then he was done. Moments later, he  ______ 20 ______  his friend offstage and they took a collective breath of relief (轻松) together. It was over and they had graduated. The little piece of paper proved it, and neither of them had fallen down!

questions.prompt: Tom is very lovely. I often play with  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：汤姆很可爱。我经常和他一起玩。 考查代词。it它；him他；her她；them他们。空格处位于介词with之后，故填宾格代词作宾语，句子的主语Tom，是男性，所以此处用对应的宾格形式为him。故选B。

questions.prompt: My brother often gets up  ______  six o'clock in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我哥哥经常早上六点起床 考查时间介词。at用在具体的时刻前；on用在具体的某一天或具体某一天的上午、下午、晚上前；in用在年、月、季节、世纪等前或泛指的上午、下午、晚上前；of……的。根据空后的six o'clock可知，此处应该用at放在具体时刻前。故选A。

questions.prompt: I didn't like these shoes  ______  my mother wanted to buy them for me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我不喜欢这双鞋，但我妈妈想给我买。 考查连词辨析。and并且；so所以；or 否则；but但是。根据“I didn't like these shoes... my mother wanted to buy them for me.”结合句意可知，空格前后句是转折关系，用“but”。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Dad,  ______  you help me? —Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爸爸，你能帮我吗？——是的，可以。 考查情态动词辨析。need需要，指有必要；must一定，强调主观意愿，肯定回答用must；can可以，用于请求允许；should应该，表建议。根据回答“Yes, I can”，可知，问句是以can开头的句子，表示请求，故选C。

questions.prompt: Grace is  ______  than her sister so she often helps her sister hang the clothes.
questions.explanation: 句意：格蕾丝比她妹妹高，所以她经常帮她妹妹挂衣服。 考查形容词比较级。tall高的；taller是tall的比较级，更高的；tallest是tall的最高级，最高的。根据句中than可知，此处使用比较级taller，表示“比她妹妹高”。故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  do you get to school on weekdays? — I go there by bus with my friend.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你平日怎么去学校？——我和我的朋友乘公共汽车去那里。 考查特殊疑问句。How怎样，如何；Where哪里；When什么时候；Why为什么。根据答语中的“go there by bus”可知，空格所在句是在询问方式。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Sam, what is your brother doing now? —He  ______  some reading under the apple tree.
questions.explanation: 句意：——萨姆，你哥哥现在在干什么？——他正在苹果树下读书。 考查动词时态辨析。由问句“what is your brother doing now”，可知回答正在进行的动作，用现在进行时“be doing”结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: —What do your grandparents usually do on weekends? —They usually  ______  some vegetables in their garden.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的祖父母周末通常做什么？——他们通常在花园里种些蔬菜。 考查一般现在时态。观察句子关键词usually可知，本题考查一般现在时。因为空格句的主语they是复数，故谓语动词用原形。故选A。

questions.prompt: If my pen friend comes to our home, I  ______  her to visit our city.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果我的笔友来我们家，我会带她来参观我们的城市。 考查主将从现。句中if引导的是条件状语从句，时态为一般现在时，那么主句时态为一般将来时，遵循“主将从现”原则，所以使用will take。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  in the building since 2017. I don't want to move to a new place.
questions.explanation: 句意：我从2017年起就住在这栋楼里。我不想搬到一个新地方。 考查现在完成时。根据“since 2017”可知，该句是现在完成时，其谓语结构是：have/has+动词的过去分词。故选D。

questions.prompt: The bridge  ______  more than 100 years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：这座桥建于100多年前。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。主语the bridge与谓语build之间是逻辑上的动宾关系，应使用被动语态，所以排除A和B；根据“100 years ago”可知，句中时态为一般过去时，所以使用一般过去时的被动语态；is built为一般现在时的被动语态，所以排除C。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______  next summer? —Canada.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道他明年夏天将访问哪里吗？——加拿大。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句需用陈述句语序，BD两项都是疑问句语序，可排除。next summer“明年夏天”是一般将来时的标志，可排除A项，故选C。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The Boy Who Was Laughed at Got New Clothes from Students Michael Todd wore the same clothes every day for the first three weeks of school. When the other kids began to notice that he was wearing the same black pants and blue long-sleeve shirt day after day, Todd, a freshman at a high school in Memphis, became the target (目标) of laughter. But there was little Todd could do. His mother simply couldn’t afford to buy him new clothes because he was  ______ 13 ______  too fast. Antwan Garrett and Kristopher Graham were a pair of freshman football players of the school. Over time, they realized that their words felt like bullying (欺负) and seemed to be  ______ 14 ______ breaking Todd’s spirit. When I saw people laugh at and bully him, I felt like I needed to do something.” Graham said. So he and Garrett had a  ______ 15 ______. They went home and hunted through their own drawers and closets. The next day at school, they met Todd at their third-period class and asked him to come into the  ______ 16 ______. Todd wasn’t smiling or doing anything. “I think this is going to make you  ______ 17 ______,” Graham said. “We’re in the same third period, and I  ______ 18 ______  for laughing at you, and I want to give something to you to make it up.” He then handed Todd a bag. Inside the bag there were clean shirts, shorts, and a brand-new pair of New Balance sneakers. Todd was shocked completely. But he felt very  ______ 19 ______. And he got much more than a new wardrobe. After that, he no longer sits alone at lunch time and he  ______ 20 ______  with his new friends, Garrett and Graham. He called the day Garrett and Graham called him into the hall the best day of his whole life.

questions.prompt: Mrs. White is a popular teacher in our school, and we all like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：怀特太太是我们学校很受欢迎的老师，我们都喜欢她。 考查代词辨析。his他的，形容词性物主代词；her她的，作形容词性物主代词或者是she的宾格形式；their他们的，形容词性物主代词；your你的，形容词性物主代词。根据句意可知，空格所在句说的是“我们都喜欢她”，空格所填词作动词like的宾语，故用代词的宾格形式，结合选项可知，只有her“她”，是宾格形式。故选B。

questions.prompt: My family get together and have a big dinner  ______  Sundays.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的家人星期天聚在一起吃了一顿丰盛的晚餐。 考查介词辨析。at用于具体的某一时刻之前；in用于年、月、季节之前；on用于具体的某一天和星期几之前；分钟+to+整点，表示差几分钟到某个整点。句中空后Sundays是星期天，表达“在星期天”是on Sundays。故选C。

questions.prompt: Hurry up, John,  ______  you will be late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：John，快点，否则你会上学迟到。 考查连词辨析。and和；but但是；or否则；so所以。根据“Hurry up, John”及“you will be late for school”可知，要快点，否则就会上学迟到，这是“祈使句+or+陈述句”的结构，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  I help you? That box is too heavy. — It's nice of you!
questions.explanation: 句意：——需要帮忙吗？那个箱子太重了。——你真好！ 考查情态动词。May可以；Should应该；Must 必须；Need需要；英语中表达提供帮助的句子是Can/May I help you表示“我可以帮助你吗”，故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you read Duowei Reading books, Jack? — Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，你多久看一次多维阅读？——一周一次。 考查特殊疑问词。How much多少，提问不可数名词数量或价格；How often多久一次，提问频率；How long多长，提问时间持续多久或物体的长度；How soon还有多久，提问in+一段时间；根据回答“Once a week”可知，此处是提问动作发生的频率，故选B。

questions.prompt: Tom is  ______  than any other student in our class.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我们班汤姆比任何其他男孩都高。tall高的，是原级；taller更高的，是比较级；the tallest最高的，是最高级。根据“than any other student”可知此处用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: If you work hard, I think you  ______  English better.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你努力学习，我认为你英语会学的更好。 考查条件状语从句。if引导的条件状语从句，主句一般将来时，从句一般现在时。故选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  my project when mum came back last night.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨晚妈妈回来时我正在做作业。 考查过去进行时。do做，动词原形，用于一般现在时；will do将要做，用于一般将来时；was doing正在做，用于过去进行时；am doing正在做，用于现在进行时。根据空后“when Mum came back last night”可知，从句是一般过去时；结合句意可知，妈妈回来时我正在做作业，表示过去某个时间正在进行的动作，应该用过去进行时，其构成是was/were doing。故选C。

questions.prompt: Lily and I  ______  each other since we were young.
questions.explanation: 句意：莉莉和我从小就认识了。 考查动词时态辨析。since自从，用于表示一段时间，是现在完成时的标志。结合选项，have known是现在完成时结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: — Where's your dad, Sam? — He  ______  in the kitchen now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你爸爸呢，山姆？——他现在正在厨房做饭。 考查现在进行时。根据语境以及时间状语now可知，本题考查现在进行时。根据进行时结构：be+动词现在分词。句子的主语he是第三人称单数，be动词用is，现在分词为cooking，故选B。

questions.prompt: Huoshenshan Hospital  ______  for COVID-19 patients in ten days.
questions.explanation: 句意：火神山医院在10天内为COVID-19患者建成了。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。分析句子结构可知，主语Huoshenshan Hospital与谓语build“建造”之间存在动宾关系，且发生在过去，需用一般过去时的被动语态；结合选项，was built符合语法结构，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______  this coming vacation? —We will work together online.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道在即将到来的这个假期里我们如何学习吗？——我们将会在网上一起学习。 考查宾语从句。how we learned陈述语序，一般过去时；how did we learn疑问语序，一般过去时；how we will learn陈述语序，一般将来时；how will we learn疑问语序，一般将来时。宾语从句中从句部分语序为陈述语序，所以排除B和D；根据问句中do可知，主句时态为一般现在时，从句时态不受主句时态影响，根据实际情况选用合适的时态，根据问句中“this coming vacation”可知，此处是对将来要发生的事情进行提问，所以从句使用一般将来时，所以排除A。故选C。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 The teacher stood before his class and was going to hand out the final exam papers. "I know how hard you have all worked to prepare for this test," he said. "And because I know you can do it well, I am willing to offer a B to anyone who would prefer not to take the  ______ 13 ______. Many students jumped up to thank the teacher and left the classroom. The teacher looked at the remaining students and said, "Does anyone else want to get a B? This is your last  ______ 14 ______." Two more students decided to go. Seven students  ______ 15 ______. The teacher then handed out the papers. There were only three sentences typed on the paper: Congratulations! You have just  ______ 16 ______  an A in this class. Keep believing in yourself. I never had a teacher like that, but I think it is a test that any teacher could and should give. Students who are not  ______ 17 ______  in what they have learned are B students at best. The same is true in real life. The A students are those who believe in what they are doing because they have learned about both successes and failures. They have learned life's  ______ 18 ______, either from normal education or from events in their lives, and have become  ______ 19 ______  people. Scientists say that by the age of eight, 80% of what we believe about ourselves has already been formed. You are a big kid now, and you  ______ 20 ______  that you have some limits. However, there is nothing you can't do or learn or be. Sir Edmund Hillary, the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest said, "It's not the mountain we conquer but ourselves."

questions.prompt: J. K. Rowling is a famous writer, and we all like reading  ______  books.
questions.explanation: 句意：J.k. 罗琳是个著名作家，我们都喜欢读她的书。 考查代词辨析。her她的；his他的；their他们的；your你的。根据主语“J. K. Rowling”可知，空处应用her，她的。故选A。

questions.prompt: China’s first space program began  ______  1956.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国的第一个太空计划始于1956年。 考查介词辨析。at表示时间的某一点、某一时刻或年龄；in泛指一般意义的上午、下午或晚上以及月或年等较长的时间；on表示星期几或某一特定的日期；to到。由1956是年份，可知用in，故选B。

questions.prompt: I work hard at school  ______  I try to be helpful and kind all the time.
questions.explanation: 句意：我在学校努力学习，并且我一直试着乐于助人和友善。 考查连词辨析。or或者，选择关系；but但是，转折关系；and和，又，并列关系；so因此，因果关系。分析句子结构可知，句子“I work hard at school”与句子“I try to be helpful and kind all the time.”之间是并列关系，因此用and连接。故选C。

questions.prompt: —  ______  you let me paint the fence a little, Tom? — Well, no, Ben. I’m afraid….
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你能让我把篱笆漆一下吗？ ——不，本。恐怕……。 考查情态动词。need需要；should应该；must必须；could能，可以。分析语境可知，此处表示委婉的请求，因此用could来提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Who do you think was the greatest inventor? — Da Vinci was a great inventor  ______  he was a pioneer in many areas.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认为谁是最伟大的发明家?——达·芬奇是一位伟大的发明家，因为他是许多领域的先驱。 考查连词。because因为；as well as也；although尽管；so that以便；分析句子可知，空后是给出了原因，可推测出是因为，故选A。

questions.prompt: For language structures, the more you use them,  ______  learning English will be.
questions.explanation: 句意：对于语言结构，你用得越多，学英语就越容易。 考查形容词的比较级。 “the more you use them”可知，此处是“the+比较级+主谓，the+比较级+主谓”的用法，表示“越……就越……”；所以空格处应该用the easier。故选C。

questions.prompt: Steve Jobs’ inventions and creativity  ______  our way of life already.
questions.explanation: 句意：史蒂夫·乔布斯的发明和创造已经改变了我们的生活方式。 考查现在完成时。根据“already”可知，此题时态应该用现在完成时，结构为have/has done。主语为“inventions and creativity”，复数，故应该用have done结构。故选A。

questions.prompt: Matthew was a quiet man  ______  didn’t speak much to strangers.
questions.explanation: 句意：Matthew是个沉默寡言的人，他很少和陌生人说话。 考查定语从句。which关系代词，指物或事情，在定语从句中作主语或宾语；whom关系代词，指人，在定语从句中作主语；whose关系代词，指某人的或某人的，在定语从句中作定语；who关系代词，指人，在定语从句中作主语。根据句意可知，本题考查定语从句关系代词，所填词指代空格前的man并且在定语从句中做主语。故选D。

questions.prompt: In 2002, Yao Ming decided  ______  the NBA draft.
questions.explanation: 句意：2002年，姚明决定参加NBA选秀。 考查动词不定式。“decide to do sth”表示“决定做什么”，此处缺动词不定式作宾语，故选B。

questions.prompt: — Where are the officers? — Look! They  ______  the elephant in the palace now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——军官们在哪儿？——瞧！他们正在宫殿里摸象。 考查动词时态辨析。look“看”用于提醒，后面的句子需用现在进行时“be doing”结构。touch摸，主语they是复数人称，系词需用are，故选D。

questions.prompt: The book Alice’s Adventure in Wonderland  ______  in 1865.
questions.explanation: 句意：《爱丽丝梦游仙境》一书于1865年出版。 考查一般过去时的被动语态。根据句意可知，主语和动词之间是动宾关系，应用被动语态；结合时间状语“in 1865”可知，动作发生在过去，故应用一般过去式的被动语态，构成形式为was/were done。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Can you tell me  ______? —We came from the earth.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我你们来自哪里吗？——我们来自地球。 考查宾语从句。tell sb sth“告诉某人某事”，此处tell后接双宾语，故空格处为宾语从句。语序为陈述句语序，排除C, D；根据“Can you tell me”可知，主句时态为一般现在时，则从句可以用任何时态。根据答句 “We came from the earth.”可知，问句中从句时态为过去时，动词要用过去式。故选B。 二、完形填空(共8分，每小题1分) 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Do not Judge a Book by Its Cover “This is John,” said Mr. Turner. The boy standing next to him was tall, with a friendly face. I  ______ 13 ______  Adam and Chen give each other the thumbs (大拇指) up. That meant they were going to invite him to join the cool group.
