I wasn’t one of the cool kids. “Hyun, I want you to be John’s buddy this term,” said Mr. Turner. Me? I couldn’t  ______ 15 ______  my ears! Everyone in the class looked in my direction. Adam and Chen even looked unhappy. John walked over to my  ______ 16 ______  and sat down beside me. He smiled at me. “Hello,” he said in a confident voice. “Hello.” I replied, not looking at him. All morning I could feel the boys in the cool group looking  ______ 17 ______  at me, but John didn’t seem to notice. Finally the bell rang for a break. I had butterflies in my stomach. I knew that Adam and Chen were going to make  ______ 18 ______  of me in front of John, and that John would decide that he’d rather be buddies with them. Sure enough, as soon as we got outside, Adam and Chen swaggered (大摇大摆地走) up to us. “Mr. Turner says you’re a good basketball player, John,” said Adam.” “How’d you like to  ______ 19 ______  with us at lunch break? Hyun doesn’t know anything about basketball.” “No thanks,” said John. “I’d rather play chess with Hyun, if he doesn’t mind. Mr. Turner says he’s an excellent player.” I was walking on  ______ 20 ______  as John and I crossed the playground. I remembered the saying we learnt in class about not judging a book by its cover, I completely misjudged John.

questions.prompt: —  ______  pen is lost. Can I use yours for a while? — Certainly. Here you are.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的钢笔丢了。我能用你的钢笔一会儿吗？——当然。给你。 考查代词辨析。I我，主格形式；Me我，宾格形式；Mine我，名词性物主代词；My我的，形容词性物主代词。pen是名词，前面要用形容词性物主代词修饰。故选D。

questions.prompt: We usually have a sports meeting  ______  September. What about your school?
questions.explanation: 句意：我们通常在九月份开运动会。你的学校呢？ 考查介词辨析。on后面接具体的某一天；in后面接早中晚/月份/年份等；to给；at后面接具体的某一时刻。根据空缺处后面的“September”可知，是月份，所以用介词in，故选B。

questions.prompt: — You can drop by and pick up that book sometime. — Sure. But  ______  is your address?
questions.explanation: 句意：——你可以某个时候过来拿那本书。——好的。不过你的地址是什么？ 考查疑问词。what什么；how如何；who谁；when什么时候。根据address可知，这里是问地址是什么。故选A。

questions.prompt: — My brother doesn’t like milk. What about you? — I don’t,  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我弟弟不喜欢喝牛奶。那你呢？——我也不喜欢喝。 考查副词。either也，用于否定句句末；neither 也，常用于倒装句的开头，紧跟在一个否定句后面，其构成neither+助动词/情态动词/be动词+主语；too也，常用于肯定句或疑问句句末；also也，而且，用于肯定句或疑问句句中。本句是否定句，且位于句末，前有逗号与主句隔开，故选A。

questions.prompt: Which is  ______  in your shop, the chocolate ice cream or the vanilla ice cream?
questions.explanation: 句意：巧克力冰淇淋和香草冰淇淋哪个在你们店里更受欢迎？ 考查形容词比较级。the most popular形容词最高级；more popular形容词比较级形式；most popular形容词最高级形式；popular形容词原级。根据比较的范围“the chocolate ice cream or the vanilla ice cream”可知，这里是两者作比较，应用形容词比较级。故选B。

questions.prompt: —May I play football here? —No, you  ______. There’s a lot of traffic here.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以在这踢足球吗？——不，你不可以。这里交通很拥挤。 考查情态动词。needn’t不需要；won’t不会；wouldn’t不会；mustn’t不可以，根据“May I play football here?”和“No”以及“There’s a lot of traffic here”可知，应该是不可以，表“禁止”，用mustn’t，故选D。

questions.prompt: Please tell Peter  ______  us at the gate of the cinema at 7:00 p.m.
questions.explanation: 句意：请告诉彼得晚上7点在电影院门口等我们。 考查非谓语动词。meet sb见某人，根据固定搭配tell sb to do sth“告诉某人做某事”可知，应该填的是动词不定式作宾补，故选A。

questions.prompt: I think it’s a good idea to  ______  early in the morning and read English aloud.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为早上早起大声朗读英语是个好主意。 考查动词短语。get off下车；get up起床；get on上车，相处和睦，进展；get in进入， 收割，插话。根据下文“early in the morning and read English aloud”可知早起读书；故选B。

questions.prompt: — Hello! Is that Nancy speaking? — Sorry. This is Bob. Nancy  ______  some cleaning now. Hold on, please.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，你是南希吗？——抱歉，我是鲍勃。南希现在正在打扫卫生呢。等一下。 考查现在进行时。do some cleaning打扫卫生，根据“now”可知，时态是现在进行时，表“正在进行的动作”，构成：主语+be+动词现在分词，故选C。

questions.prompt: Jack will give the dictionary to you as soon as he  ______  back.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克一回来就把字典给你。 考查动词时态。as soon as一……就……，引导时间状语从句时态是主句使用一般将来时，从句使用一般现在时，本句主句是一般将来时，可知从句使用一般现在时。故选B。

questions.prompt: — I hear your uncle  ______  to South Africa once. — Yes, he went there last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我听说你叔叔曾经去过南非。——是的，他去年去的。 考查现在完成时。has been to去过某地；has gone to刚去（去了还没回来）；go去；goes动词第三人称单数形式，根据“once”是现在完成时标志词可知，应该表示“曾经去过南非”，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Excuse me, could you tell me  ______? — It’s brown.
questions.explanation: 句意：——打扰一下，你能告诉我这是什么颜色的吗？——它是棕色的。 考查宾语从句。根据“It’s brown.”可知，此处应对颜色提问，使用“what color”，本句是宾语从句，应用陈述语序。故选B。 五、完形填空。 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 David had a new baby sister. She lay in a bassinet（婴儿摇篮）in the kitchen, and everyone thought she was wonderful. Aunt Sue came first thing in the morning to see her. She gave David a hug at the door and  ______ 13 ______  him a package. But when he started to open it, she said, “This is for the baby. You and I will have a treat later this week.” Slowly David walked outside. He had swept the front porch（门厅） this morning, even the leaves that were  ______ 14 ______  in the corners—but Aunt Sue hadn’t noticed. He heard whistling down the block. It was Mr. Larkin, the mailman. David decided to meet him. He jumped all the way down the sidewalk on one foot and didn’t even fall down. But Mr. Larkin just said, “I hear you have a new baby sister. Aren’t you  ______ 15 ______?” And he gave David the mail. David walked with heavy steps back to the house. Mother and Aunt Sue were still talking, even though it was almost lunchtime. He put the mail on the table and  ______ 16 ______  a peanut-butter-and-jelly sandwich. He made it just right. It wasn’t even drippy（滴水的）. His brother Jeff, home from kindergarten, rushed into the kitchen. David held up his sandwich. “Look, Jeff. I made my own  ______ 17 ______.” But Jeff just nodded and said, “Guess what? The baby smiled at me!” David ate his sandwich. It wasn’t that good after all. He could hardly taste the jelly. The house was quiet. Mother and the baby were taking a nap, and Jeff was outside playing. David got out his crayons and drew a whole page of turtles, each a different color. The front door opened. It was his big sister Beth, home from high school. He took his picture in to show her. She smiled. Then she took out a little package and said, “Look, David. I got these little shoes for  ______ 18 ______. Aren’t they cute?” And she ran upstairs to show Mother. David went outside and got his bike. He rode up and down the sidewalk, very slowly. His stomach hurt. Finally he went back in the house. Mother was just coming out of the kitchen. She held out her arms. “Come and give me a hug, David. I’ve hardly seen you all day. What have you been doing?” All of a sudden his stomach felt better. He gave his mother a big hug and took her hand. “I’ll show you,” he said. He took her out on the porch. “ David, you swept the porch — you even got the leaves in the corners!” He felt a big smile pop out on his face. He jumped down all the steps on one foot. She clapped. “And you didn’t even  ______ 19 ______.” He took her back in the house to see his turtle picture. She looked at each turtle carefully. “David, this is a wonderful picture. Let’s put it up on the refrigerator, so Daddy can see it when he gets home.” They walked together into the kitchen. There was the baby, still sleeping and making little wiggling noises. David looked at his mother, but she was busy taping his picture to the refrigerator. He reached over and touched the baby’s hand. She grabbed（抓住）his finger and held on  ______ 20 ______. A warm, wonderful feeling filled David. Mother walked over and put her arm around his shoulder. “I’m glad this baby has you for a big brother.” David smiled up at Mother. “Me too,” he said.

questions.prompt: －What's the matter with your brother? － ______  has a cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你弟弟怎么了？——他感冒了。 考查代词。She：她，人称代词主格；He：他，人称代词主格；His：他的，形容词性物主代词或名词性的物主代词；Her：她，她的，人称代词宾格或形容词性物主代词。本句缺少主语，指代上文提到的“your brother”，可知填人称代词主格He；故选B。

questions.prompt: He ran quickly all the way to school  ______  he was still late.
questions.explanation: 句意：他一路上飞快地跑到学校，但还迟到了。考查连词。But：但是，表示转折关系；and：和，表示顺承和递进；or：或者，表示选择关系；so：因此，表示因果关系。根据句意可知前后句是转折，故选A。

questions.prompt: John starts work  ______  10 o’clock every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：约翰在每天十点钟开始工作。考查介词。in 在一个时间范围;on 在具体某一天; for接一段时间.在时间点前用介词at。根据下文10 o’clock可知本句表示在具体时间点,故选C。

questions.prompt: It is one of  ______  buildings in our hometown.
questions.explanation: 句意：它是我们家乡最高的建筑物之一。 考查形容词最高级。one of：……之一，后面跟可数名词复数，修饰名词的形容词通常使用最高级，形容词最高级前要加the，即one of the+形容词最高级+复数名词：最……之一；故选D。

questions.prompt: ---  ______ do you study for a test? ---By reading the textbook.
questions.explanation: 句意：你是如何为考试复习的？通过朗读课本。考查疑问词。What：什么；When：什么时候；How：如何；Where：哪里。根据By reading the textbook.可知问的是方式，故选C。

questions.prompt: Bill  ______  a picnic with the whole family yesterday. It was fantastic.
questions.explanation: 句意：比尔昨天和全家野餐了。太棒了。 考查句子时态。has一般现在时；will have一般将来时；had一般过去时；has had现在完成时。根据时间yesterday可知此句时态是一般过去时；故选C。

questions.prompt: Our team  ______  every match since April, but we still have three more games to play.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们队自四月以来每场比赛都赢了，但我们还有三场比赛要打。 考查时态。A. has won现在完成时；B. will won一般将来时；C. win一般现在时；D. won一般过去时。根据since April, 可知此句时态应用现在完成时，故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  the mooncakes are！
questions.explanation: 句意：多美味的月饼啊！ 考查感叹句。根据句中mooncakes可知，不可用不定冠词a，C、D选项排除。句子主谓结构是the mooncakes are，前面的单词是形容词delicious，应用how修饰，故应选B。 【点睛】感叹句中how和what的用法区别 what修饰名词。例如： What a fool he is!（修饰名词a fool） how修饰形容词、副词或动词。例如： How hard he works!（修饰副词hard） How clever the boy is!（修饰形容词clever）

questions.prompt: The camera is expensive I can't afford it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这相机太贵了，我买不起。考查固定句式。“such+a/an+形容词+名词+that从句”和“so+形容词/副词+that从句”结构不同，意义一致，都表示“如此/这么……以至于……”的意思；so as只要；too+形容词/副词+to，表示“太……而不能……”，表否定意义。根据句意和语境，可知后面三项结构都与句意不合，故选A。

questions.prompt: － Do you know  ______  for vacation? －Next month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道她什么时候去度假吗？——下个月。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句的语序是陈述语序，C和D是疑问句语序，应该排除；根据回答“Next month”可知宾语从句的时态是一般将来时，故选A。 完形填空 Hannah Taylor is a schoolgirl from Manitoba, Canada. One day, when she was five years old, she was walking with her mother in downtown Winnipeg. They saw a man eating out of a garbage can. She asked her mother why he did that, and her mother said that the man was homeless and hungry. Hannah was very  ______ 11 ______. She couldn't understand why some people had to live their lives without shelter or enough food. Hannah started to think about how she could  ______ 12 ______, but of course, there is not a lot one five-year-old can do to solve the problem of homelessness. Later, when Hannah attended school, she saw another homeless person. It was a woman  ______ 13 ______  an old shopping trolley (购物车) which was piled with bags. It seemed that everything the woman owned was in them. This made Hannah very sad, and even more  ______ 14 ______  to do something. She had been talking to her mother about the lives of homeless people since they first saw the homeless man. Her mother told her that if she did something to change the problem that made her sad, she wouldn't feel as bad. Hannah began to speak out about the homelessness in Manitoba and then in other provinces. She hoped to  ______ 15 ______  her message of hope and awareness. She started the Ladybug Foundation, an organization aiming at getting rid of homelessness. She began to host "Big Bosses" lunches where she would try to persuade local business leaders to  ______ 16 ______  to the cause. She also organized a fund raising drive in "Ladybug Jars" to collect everyone's spare change during "Make Change" month. More recently, the foundation began another activity called National Red Scarf Day—a day when people donate $20 and wear red scarves in support of Canada's hungry and homeless. There is an emergency shelter in Winnipeg called "Hannah's Place", something that she is very  ______ 17 ______  of. Hannah Places is divided into several areas, providing shelter for people when it's so cold that sleeping outdoors can mean death. In the more than five years since Hannah began her activities, she has received a lot of  ______ 18 ______. For example, she received the 2007 BRICK Award recognizing the  ______ 19 ______  of young people to change the world. But through all this, Hannah still has the life of a Winnipeg school girl, except that she pays regular visits to homeless people. Hannah is one of many examples of young people who are making a  ______ 20 ______  in the world. You can, too!

questions.prompt: We never visit a friend’s house without  ______  first.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们没有打电话决不能到朋友家拜访。 考查动名词。without是介词，后面用或动名词，此处用动名词calling。故选C。

questions.prompt: She had never been to the Great Wall before. Today she saw it  ______  the first time.
questions.explanation: 句意：她以前从未去过长城。今天她第一次看到它。 考查介词辨析。at在……；for对于；in在……里面；by通过。for the first time第一次，是固定搭配。故选B。

questions.prompt: Everyone is supposed  ______  a seat belt in the car.
questions.explanation: 句意：每个人在汽车里都应该系安全带。 考查非谓语动词。sb. be supposed to do sth.意“某人应该……”或“某人被期望……”，用来表示劝告、建议、责任等，故选项A与C不符合题意。主语everyone与动词wear构成主动关系，D选项表示被动关系，应排除。故选B。

questions.prompt: They go out  ______  their way to make me  ______  at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们不辞辛劳地让我感到宾至如归。 考查动词短语。go out of one’s way to do sth.不怕麻烦地去做某事，第一空用of；make sb do使某人做某事，省略to的不定式在句中作宾语补足语，第二空用feel。故选C。

questions.prompt: Chopsticks are used  ______. We Chinese are used  ______  with chopsticks.
questions.explanation: 句意：筷子被用来吃东西，我们中国人习惯于用筷子吃东西。 考查动词短语。be used to do表示某物被用来做某事；be used for doing表示某物被用来做某事；be used to doing表示某人习惯于做某事。第一空的主语是物，表示“筷子被用来吃东西”用are used to eat或者are used for eating；第二空的主语是人，表示“我们中国人习惯于用筷子吃东西”用are used to eating。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Will you come to the dinner party? —I won’t come until Jenny  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会来聚餐么？——直到珍妮被邀请我才会来。 考查动词的时态和语态。will be invited动词的一般将来时的被动；can be invited情态动词+被动的结构；was invited动词的一般过去时态的被动；is invited动词的一般现在时的被动。根据“I won’t come until”可知是时间状语从句的主将从现，主句用的是won’t，从句用一般现在时；从句的主语Jenny与invite之间是被动关系，用is invited。故选D。

questions.prompt: John  ______  Beijing the day before yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：约翰前天就到达北京 考查动词短语。arrived at到达小的地方；arrived to结构错误；reached to结构错误，reached表示“到达”直接接地点名词，不需要介词to；arrived in到达大的地方（城市或国家）。根据Beijing可知此处表示的是到达一个城市，用arrived in。故选D。

questions.prompt: Don’t  ______  the same mistake next time.
questions.explanation: 句意：下次不要犯相同的错误。 考查动词辨析。make制作；take带走；meet见面；get得到。此处表示“犯同样的错误”用动词短语make the same mistake。故选A。

questions.prompt: What do you plan  ______  next term?
questions.explanation: 句意：下学期你计划做什么？ 考查动词不定式。此处表示“计划做某事”用动词短语plan to do，此处用动词不定式。故选A。

questions.prompt: This nice T-shirt must be ______, because they both like wearing T-shirts.
questions.explanation: 句意： 这件好看的T恤肯定是玛丽的或琳达的，因为她们都喜欢穿T恤。 考查名词所有格。根据题干中“This nice T-shirt”指的是一件T恤，而T恤不可能是两人共同拥有，由此可推出此处是说“肯定是玛丽的或琳达的”，表示选择关系，用连词or，表示“玛丽的或琳达的”，用并列的所有格结构Mary's or Linda's。故选D。

questions.prompt: Everyone passed the exam  ______  him，so he was sad.
questions.explanation: 句意：除了他，每个人都通过了考试，因此他很伤心。 考查介词。except除了（排除某人或某物）；beside在旁边；besides除了，还包括；from从。根据“so he was sad”可知他没通过考试，用except him。故选A。

questions.prompt: Paul doesn’t have to be made  ______. He always works hard.
questions.explanation: 句意：保罗不必被迫去学习。他总是努力学习。 考查动词不定式作主语补足语。learn学习。learn动词原形；to leatn动词不定式；learning动名词；learned动词的过去式。根据题干中“to be made  ______ ”可知此处用be made to do sth.表示被迫做某事，被动语态中make后的动词不定式不能省略to。故选B。

questions.prompt: Gauss worked out the difficult math problem ______ a particular way.
questions.explanation: 句意：高斯以一种特别的方法解决了这道数学难题。 考查介词。by通过；with和；on关于；in在……里面。此处表示“以一种特别的方法”用介词短语in a particular way。by the way表示顺便提一下；on the way表示在去某地的路上。故选D。

questions.prompt: Why not read the novel? I think it is worth  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：为什么不读这个小说？我认为它值得一读。根据be worth doing是固定搭配，值得做某事。故选D。

questions.prompt: She doesn’t understand.  ______, she is only two years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：她理解不了。毕竟她只有两岁。 考查介词短语。After all毕竟；Above all首先；In all总共；As usual像往常一样。根据语境可知，她理解不了，毕竟只有两岁，故此处应用短语after all。故选A。

questions.prompt: In Maria’s country, when you are invited  ______  7:00, you are expected  ______  later.
questions.explanation: 句意：在玛丽亚的国家，如果你被邀请7点来，你应该晚一点来。 考查介词辨析和非谓语动词。for（安排或预定）在……时；at在……；come来。根据题干中“when you are invented  ______  7:00”可知此处是受到邀请，要7点钟出席，第一空用for；再由题干中“are expected  ______  later”可知第二空是说应该来晚些，用be expected to do sth.表示“（某人）被期望/应该做某事”，此处用动词不定式作主语补足语，第二空用to come。故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  my hand and to my surprise, Marie kissed me on both sides of my face.
questions.explanation: 句意：我伸出手，让我吃惊的是，玛丽吻了我的脸颊两侧。 考查动词短语辨析。hold on等一下；hold in约束；hold up举起；hold out伸出。根据题干中“to my surprise, Marie kissed me on both sides of my face”可知是打算伸手去握手问候对方，却被对方亲脸问候了，结合空后“my hand”可知要用hold out。故选D。

questions.prompt: In many eastern European countries, you are supposed to  ______  your gloves before shaking hands.
questions.explanation: 句意：在许多东欧国家，在你握手之前应该脱掉手套。 考查动词短语。clean off除去，清除；take off脱掉，起飞；put off推迟；show off炫耀。根据本题语境可知，在许多东欧国家，你在和人握手之前要“脱掉”手套，故take off符合题意。故选B。

questions.prompt: I was nervous before I came here, but there was no  ______  to be. My host family is really nice.
questions.explanation: 句意：我来这里之前很紧张，但没有理由这样。我的寄宿家庭非常好。 考查名词辨析。help帮助；result结果；hope希望；reason原因，理由。根据题干中“My host family is really nice.”可知寄宿家庭非常好，由此可推出没有理由紧张，用reason符合题意。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Do you know ______  in America? —Sure. It’s the third Sunday of June.
questions.explanation: 句意：你知道什么时候是父亲节吗？当然，六月第三个星期日。 考查宾语从句。当宾语从句是特殊疑问句时，用疑问词连接主从句，从句的语序为陈述句语序。根据答语回答的是时间，所以用疑问词when，排除B和D,采用陈述句语序排除C，故选A。 二、完型填空。 When I was 16 years old, I made my first visit to the United States. It wasn’t the first time I had been abroad. Like most English children, I ______ 21 ______  French at school and I had often been to France, so I  ______ 22 ______  speaking a foreign language to people who didn’t understand English. But when I went to America I was really looking forward to having a nice easy holiday without any ______ 23 ______  problems. How wrong I was! The misunderstanding  ______ 24 ______ at the airport. I was looking for a  ______ 25 ______ telephone to give my American friend Danny a  ______ 26 ______ and tell her that I had ______ 27 ______. A friendly old man saw me looking lost and asked  ______ 28 ______  he could help me. “Yes”, I said, “I want to give my friend a ring.” “Well, that’s nice.” he exclaimed. “Are you getting  ______ 29 ______? But aren’t you a bit  ______ 30 ______ ” “Who is talking about marriage?” I replied. “I just want to give my friend a ring to tell her I’ve got here. Can you tell me where there’s a phone box?” “Oh!” he said, “there’s a phone downstairs.” When at last we did meet up, Danny explained the misunderstanding to me. “Don’t worry,” she said to me. “I have so many  ______ 31 ______ at first. There are lots of words which the Americans  ______ 32 ______  differently in meaning from us British. You’ll soon get used to all the funny things they say. Most of the time British and American people understand each other!”

questions.prompt: A lady  ______  Grace helped me take these books to my car.
questions.explanation: 句意：一位名叫格蕾丝的女士帮我把这些书搬到车上。 考查动词辨析。acted行动；named命名；played玩；wrote写。根据“A lady... Grace”可知此处指名叫Grace的女士，用named。故选B。

questions.prompt: Listen, beautiful music! Who  ______  the piano in the next room?
questions.explanation: 句意：听，美妙的音乐！谁在隔壁房间弹钢琴？ 考查现在进行时。根据“Listen”可知，强调动作正在发生，时态是现在进行时，故选B。

questions.prompt: It’s easy  ______  the answer to this question.
questions.explanation: 句意：找到这个问题的答案很容易。 考查非谓语动词。固定句式：It’s+形容词+to do sth：做某事是……，动词不定式作主语，it作形式主语，故选C。

questions.prompt: My friend John  ______  me to his party just now.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的朋友John刚才邀请我去参加派对。 考查动词时态。根据“just now”可知，句子用一般过去时，动词用过去式，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Jim had to give up the race because of his foot. — ______!
questions.explanation: 句意：——因为脚的问题，吉姆不得不放弃比赛。——多可惜！ 考查情景交际。What a shame多可惜；Of course当然；He was so careless他太粗心了；No problem没问题。根据“Jim had to give up the race because of his foot.”可知Jim放弃比赛是可惜的。故选A。

questions.prompt: ______  interesting the movie is!
questions.explanation: 句意：这部电影多有趣啊！ 考查感叹句。本句的中心词为interesting“有趣的”，形容词，故应用How来引导感叹句，其句式结构为：How+形容词+主语+谓语！故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  Kate’s parents are teachers and they work in the same school.
questions.explanation: 句意：凯特的父母都是老师，他们在同一所学校工作。 考查代词辨析。All三者或三者以上都；Both两者都；Neither两者都不；Either两者之一。根据“Kate’s parents”可知此处指Kate的父母两人都是老师，用Both符合语境。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  did you meet at the first time? —In front of the shopping mall.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你们第一次是在哪里见面的？——在购物中心前面。 考查特殊疑问句。When何时；Who谁；Where哪里；What什么。根据答语“In front of the shopping mall.”可知，是在询问地点，故选C。

questions.prompt: We will have a party  ______  Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们将在星期六下午举行一个聚会。 考查时间介词。in后接年、月、季节等；on后接具体某一天或具体某一天的上下午、晚上等；at后接具体钟表时刻；of……的。根据“Saturday afternoon”可知此处指具体的周六下午，用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Can you tell me how to mend the computer? There’s  ______  with it. —Certainly. That’s not difficult.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我怎样修理电脑吗？它有点问题。——当然。这是不难的。 考查代词辨析和定语后置。something某事；nothing没有事。根据“Can you tell me how to mend the computer?”可知，电脑有问题，选择something，排除CD；形容词修饰不定代词时，需后置。故选A。

questions.prompt: You  ______  cross the road on a red light.
questions.explanation: 句意：你禁止在红灯时过马路。 考查情态动词。must必须；mustn’t禁止；can能；cannot不能。根据“on a red light”可知，此处是禁止穿过马路。故选B。

questions.prompt: Sir, would you mind not  ______  here, please?
questions.explanation: 句意：先生，请问你介意不在这吸烟吗？ 考查非谓语动词。would you mind not+doing表示介意不要做某事，故选C。

questions.prompt: Our teacher helped us  ______  the task.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的老师帮助我们完成任务。 考查非谓语动词。help sb do sth.帮助某人做某事，故选A。 五、完形填空。（共10分，每小题1分） Lucy was a new student. She stood in front of Mrs. Campbell’s third-grade class for the first time. She felt very  ______ 14 ______. The teacher pointed to a two-student desk that was empty (空的)  ______ 15 ______  told her to sit there. Lucy walked over to her desk quietly. However, her  ______ 16 ______  dropped (坠落) on the floor. Some of the kids in the class laughed because that’s the way some kids were. Lucy picked (拾) up her books and  ______ 17 ______  down. She was the only one without (没有) a desk partner. She was alone, and afraid to make friends  ______ 18 ______  anyone. Then one day, something different happened. The teacher said, “Class, this week we are glad to have  ______ 19 ______  new student, Henry.” The little boy came over and put his schoolbag on Lucy’s desk. He looked and  ______ 20 ______  at her. It was a shy kind of smile, but it was a nice smile. She smiled back. Lunch time came soon. Lucy sat on the bench (长椅) under the big tree  ______ 21 ______  her butter sandwich. She saw Henry playing soccer with some boys. Then a few minutes later, there was Henry standing right in front of  ______ 22 ______, with his lunch box in his hand. “Can I sit on this bench with you?” he asked. She nodded (点头). They  ______ 23 ______  to talk about everything they liked. At that time, Lucy knew she might have a friend. Henry was nice. Some kids were just like that way …

questions.prompt: I like sports very much and basketball is  ______  favorite game.
questions.explanation: 句意：我非常喜欢运动，篮球是我最喜欢的运动。 考查代词辨析。I我，主格；me我，宾格；my我的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词。根据“I like sports very much and basketball is...favorite game.”可知，此处指篮球是我最喜欢的比赛，名词前面需要加形容词性物主代词。故选C。

questions.prompt: 一Do you often get up early  ______  Sunday morning, Lingling? —Yes. Because I have to take some extra classes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——玲玲，星期天早上你经常早起吗？ ——是的。因为我得多上几门课。 考查介词辨析。at后接具体时刻；on后接具体某一天及具体的某一个早上、下午或晚上；in后接年、月、季节等，及泛指的早上、下午或晚上；of……的。根据“Sunday morning”可知，此处指具体某一天的早上，用介词on。故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is my e-dictionary? I can’t find it. —Oh, it’s in your bedroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我的电子字典在哪里？我找不到它。——哦，它在你的卧室里。 考查特殊疑问句。when何时；where哪里；what什么；how怎样。根据答语“Oh, it’s in your bedroom”可知，询问字典的位置，故选B。

questions.prompt: My friend, Li Ping, is  ______  than his father.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的朋友，李平，比他的爸爸更强壮。 考查比较级。根据“than”可知，此空应填比较级，strong的比较级是stronger，故选B。

questions.prompt: 一Must I return this book tomorrow? —No, you  ______. You can keep it until next week.
questions.explanation: 句意：—— 明天我必须还这本书吗？—— 不，你不必。你可以借到下周。 考查情态动词。can’t不可以；mustn’t禁止；needn’t不需要；shouldn’t不应该。根据“Must I return this book tomorrow?”可知，对must的否定回答，用needn’t和don’t have to回答，结合选项，need’t符合句意。故选C。

questions.prompt: She didn’t send the e-mail yesterday  ______  it was too late.
questions.explanation: 句意：她昨天没有发电子邮件，因为太晚了。 考查连词辨析。if如果；after在……之后；before在……之前；because因为。根据“She didn’t send the e-mail yesterday...it was too late.”可知，前后句子是因果关系，应用连词because连接。故选D。

questions.prompt: We  ______  to the History Museum last week and saw many interesting things.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周我们去了历史博物馆，看到了许多有趣的东西。 考查一般过去时。根据“last week”可知，此句时态是一般过去时，结合选项，went符合句意。故选C。

questions.prompt: I’m sure she will tell you how to do it if she  ______  it.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果她知道的话，肯定会告诉你怎么做的。 考查动词时态。if引导条件状语从句，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时，主语she是第三人称，动词用三单形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: Miss Wang told us  ______  2B pencils and erasers to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：王老师叫我们把2B铅笔和橡皮带到学校来。 考查非谓语动词。tell后面接带to的不定式作宾语补足语，即tell sb. to do sth.，表示“告诉某人去做某事”，固定搭配。故选D。

questions.prompt: Wait a moment, please. I have  ______  important to say.
questions.explanation: 句意：请稍等。我有重要的事要说。 考查不定代词。something某事，用于肯定句；anything任何事，用于否定句和疑问句；nothing没有什么事；everything每一件事情。这是一个肯定句，且结合句意，这里表示“某个重要的事”，故选A。

questions.prompt: 一May I speak to John, please? —I’m sorry. He  ______  for a meeting. He will be back in two days.
questions.explanation: 句意：—— 我可以跟约翰说话吗？ —— 对不起，他去开会了，他会在两天之后回来。 考查现在完成时态。根据“He will be back in two days.”可知，他还没有回来，而have gone表示去了某地还没有回来。故选D。

questions.prompt: The streets  ______  many times every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：街道每天被清扫很多次。 考查被动语态。“The streets”和“clean”是被动关系，应用被动语态，由“every day”可知，时态为一般现在时，所以此处为一般现在时的被动语态，结构为be done。故选D。

questions.prompt: Could you tell me  ______  tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 句意：你能告诉我明天聚会什么时候开始吗？ 考查宾语从句。宾语从句需用陈述语序，排除AC；Could you tell me...表请求，从句语序不限，根据“tomorrow”可知，时态是一般将来时，故选B。 二、完形填空（共10小题，每小题1分，共1吩） We wish that we could be better at sports or more attractive. We wish we had nicer clothes or more money. Everyone likes to feel that he or she is special. ______ 15 ______, many of us grow up believing that we’re not special at all. We believe we are not  ______ 16 ______  enough just as we are. Most parents want us to be the best we can be. Very often, they  ______ 17 ______  us to others. By doing this, they try to encourage us to do better. They mean well, but the message we often get is that we’re not good enough. We begin to believe that the only way we can be special is by being better than someone else, but we are often  ______ 18 ______. There will always be someone out there who is better than we are at  ______ 19 ______. Plenty of people around may not be as smart as we are, but they are better at sports. Or they may not be as  ______ 20 ______, but they have more money. It is  ______ 21 ______  for us to be better than everyone else all the time. We all want the things that we believe will make us better people. But very often we don’t realize that we already have  ______ 22 ______  us the very things that we want. These things make us different from others. When we are growing up,  ______ 23 ______  sometimes forget to tell us that we are special, that we are good enough. Maybe no one told them when they were growing up. Anyway, it’s up to us to  ______ 24 ______  them from time to time that each of us, in our own way, is special. What we are is enough.

questions.prompt: Alan and Jack like playing soccer.  ______  play it every Thursday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句意：Alan 和Jack喜欢踢足球。他们每个星期四下午踢足球。A. We我们；B. They他们； C. You你；你们；D. I我。上句Alan and Jack 是两个人，复数名词，故用代词they代替。故选B。

questions.prompt: Happy Chinese New Year! Here are gifts  ______  every one of you.
questions.explanation: 句意：春节快乐！这儿有给你们每个人的礼物。A. in介词，在……里面；B. with介词，和……一起；C. for介词，给……；D. from介词，来自……。固定搭配 gifts for sb.给某人的礼物。故选C。

questions.prompt: －  ______  do you study for a test? －By working with friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你怎样准备考试？——通过和朋友一起学习。A. How怎样，询问做某事的方式；B. Why为什么，询问原因；C. When什么时候，询问时间；D. Where哪里，询问地点。答语中by以……方式，故用how提问。故选A。

questions.prompt: Kevin can't take part in the meeting  ______  he has a serious cold.
questions.explanation: 句意：Kevin不能参加会议因为他得了重感冒。A. whether连词，是否； B. because连词，因为，说明原因； C. unless连词，除非，如果……不； D. although连词，尽管，引导让步状语从句。“Kevin不能参加会议”是结果，“他得了重感冒”是原因。故选B。

questions.prompt: －Must I clean the room now? －No, you  ______. You can do it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：−我现在必须打扫房间吗？−不，你不必，你可以明天做。A. mustn't表示禁止，"一定不要"；B. couldn't不能，不可以；C. shouldn't不应该；D. needn't不必，不需要。对于must引导的一般疑问句，肯定回答用must，否定回答用needn't或don't have to，根据You can do it tomorrow可知，不必今天就做这项工作。故选D。 【点睛】掌握情态动词的用法，结合题意，分析选项，灵活运用所学知识。记住must引导的一般疑问句，肯定回答用must，否定回答用needn't或don't have to。

questions.prompt: Carl runs  ______  in his class. He has won a lot of prizes for his class.
questions.explanation: 句意：Carl在他班里跑步最快。他为班级赢得了许多奖品。A. faster比较级，更快；B. fast原级，快地；C. fastest最高级，最快。D. most fast 表达错误。故排除D。in …，在……内，说明范围，故用最高级，fast属于规则变化，最高级fastest。故选C。

questions.prompt: － Let's go hiking if it  ______  snow the day after tomorrow. －Good idea!
questions.explanation: 句意：——如果后天不下雪，我们就去远足吧。——好主意！此句含有if引导的条件状语从句，主句是祈使句，遵循"主祈从现"的原则，从句要用一般现在时。从句中snow是实义动词，应选用助动词do，又因为主语是it，应用does，此处应填写其否定式doesn't。故选A。

questions.prompt: By the time he arrived at the airport, he found his flight  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：当他到达机场时，他发现了他的飞机已经起飞了。A. take off 起飞，一般现在时；B. took off起飞，一般过去时； C. has taken off已经起飞，现在完成时；D. had taken off已经起飞，过去完成时。从句By the time he arrived at the airport是一般过去时，“飞机起飞”发生在“到达机场”之前，即“过去的过去”，故主句用过去完成时。故选D。

questions.prompt: A coffee bar  ______  in our school next term.
questions.explanation: 句意：下学期我们学校将建一个咖啡馆。A. will build将建造，一般将来时主动语态； B. builds 建造，一般现在时主动语态；C. will be built将被建造，一般将来时态的被动语态；D. is built被建造，一般现在时被动语态。A coffee bar是动作的承受者，和动词built构成被动关系，应该用被动语态。根据句中的next term可知，应该用一般将来时，一般将来时态的被动语态的构成：will＋be＋及物动词的过去分词。故选C。

questions.prompt: －Hurry up! Someone  ______  for you at the school gate. －I'm sorry. I'm coming soon.
questions.explanation: 句意：−−快点，有人在学校大门口等你。−−抱歉，我很快就来了。A. waits等，一般现在时； B. is waiting正在等，现在进行时；C. has waited已经等，现在完成时；D. will wait将等，一般将来时。根据语境判断，空格处的动作"等待"在说话时刻正在进行着，所以用现在进行时。现在进行时的构成是：主语＋am/is/are＋动词的现在分词；主语Someone为不定代词，看作单数，be动词用is。故选B。

questions.prompt: Holly is really good at English. She  ______  to learn it when she was two years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：Holly非常擅长英语。她在两岁的时候就开始学习它。A. began开始，一般过去时；B. had begun已经开始，过去完成时； C. has begun已经开始，现在完成时；D. begins开始，一般现在时。由when she was two years old.可知，从句是一般过去时，结合句意，主句应是一般过去时。故选A。

questions.prompt: Joe asked me  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：Joe问我它是谁的故事书。根据Joe asked me 可知，本题考查宾语从句。宾语从句一般为陈述语序，故排除A、B；又因主句是一般过去时，所以从句应是过去时，故排除C。故选D。 【点睛】考查宾语从句，关键是连接词的选用和语序。因此，我们首先要搞清从句的意思，掌握各连接词的用法，在此基础上判断连接词。此外，从句用陈述语序。 二、完形填空 A I didn't have a very  ______ 13 ______  life when I entered the middle school. For a reason that I'm still not sure of, I was frequently disturbed by a girl named Alison. She told me I looked like a rat, that I had no  ______ 14 ______, and that everyone hated me. I would go to sleep  ______ 15 ______  night after night from the rude text messages I would receive from her. One night my mom came into my room and asked me what was wrong. As soon as I showed her all the terrible messages I had received, she became  ______ 16 ______. After a while, she stated that she was going to report this girl to the school. I tried to talk her out of it, afraid of being laughed by my classmates, but she was  ______ 17 ______. The next day during the first period of class I was called into the headmaster's office. I nervously walked into the  ______ 18 ______  and was asked to tell what had happened with Alison. I told Mr. Brown exactly everything, but he never asked to see the messages on my phone. Later that day my mom also had a meeting with him but unexpectedly Mr. Brown tried to pass the subject off,  ______ 19 ______,"This is just how girls are, and girls will be girls." Angrily, my mom threatened to bring her  ______ 20 ______  into the event if the school refused to take any action. However, Mr. Brown continued to treat my mom as the overreacting parent, ignoring her requests. He was  ______ 21 ______  the next morning by my mom and her lawyer outside his office. This is the best thing my mom has ever done for me. Although I hated her while she did it, I'm  ______ 22 ______  that she did. It taught me to fight for what I know is right.

questions.prompt: My grandma used to tell  ______  fun stories.
questions.explanation: 句意：我奶奶过去常常给我讲有趣的故事。A. I我（主格）；B. my我的（形容词性的物主代词）；C. me我（宾格）；D. mine我的（名词性的物主代词）；根据tell sb sth告诉某人某事，当sb是代词时，用宾格作宾语；故选C

questions.prompt: The meeting will begin  ______  Friday afternoon. Be sure to remember it.
questions.explanation: 句意：会议将会在星期五下午开始，一定记住。根据句意可知是在星期五下午，to到；根据at放在几点钟前，on用于具体的某一天前或者上午、下午、晚上有修饰词时，in用于上午、下午、晚上、年、月等；根据Friday afternoon可知用on；故选B 【点睛】介词可以用在时间和地点前。放在时间前的用法：at放在几点钟前，例如：at one o’clock；on用于具体的某一天前或者上午、下午、晚上有修饰词时，例如：on Thursday, on cold afternoon; in用于上午、下午、晚上、年、月等。

questions.prompt: － ______  do you study English? －By watching English movies and reading English books.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你怎么学英语？——通过看英语电影和读英语书。A. What什么；B. Why为什么；C. How怎样；D. When什么时候；根据By watching English movies and reading English books.可知是问怎么学；故选C

questions.prompt: Holly is a kind girl. She studies hard  ______  she also likes to help others.
questions.explanation: 句意：Holly是一个善良的女孩，她努力学习，她也喜欢帮助其他人。A. and和；B. but但是；C. or或者；D. so所以；根据She studies hard 和she also likes to help others之间是并列关系；故选A

questions.prompt: People  ______  cross the road when the traffic lights are red.
questions.explanation: 句意：当交通灯变成红色时，人们禁止过马路。A. mustn't禁止；B. needn't需要；C. must必须；D. need需要；根据when the traffic lights are red.可知是必须不能过马路；故选A 【点睛】can能，会 can’t不能，不可能，通常用于否定句的推测；should应该，shouldn’t不应该；may可以，可能，通常用于肯定句的推测， may not可能不；must必须，一定 mustn’t禁止。情态动词后接动词原形，变疑问句时把情态动词提前，变否定句在情态动词后加not 。must引导的一般疑问句，表示必须时，否定回答用needn’t；may引导的一般疑问句，否定回答用can’t

questions.prompt: Erquan Yingyue is one of  ______  pieces of folk music in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：二泉映月在中国是最著名的民族音乐之一。A. more famous比较著名；B. most famous最著名；C. famous著名的；D. the most famous最著名；根据one of ---之一，后用形容词最高级，根据in China可知用最高级，最高级前加冠词the；故选D

questions.prompt: － If it  ______  rain tomorrow, let's go for a picnic, Xiaoming. －Great idea!
questions.explanation: 句意：——如果明天不下雨，让我们去野餐吧，小明。——好主意。A. won't一般将时态的结构；B. doesn't一般现在时态的结构；C. wasn't一般过去时态的结构；D. isn't一般现在时态的结构；根据if引导的时间状语从句，不用将来时态，用一般现在时态来代替，排除A/C；根据rain可知是下雨，动词，否定句加doesn’t；故选B

questions.prompt: －What did you do on your winter vacation? － I  ______  at home for the Senior High School Entrance Examination.
questions.explanation: 句意：——在寒假你做什么了？——我在家为高中入学考试学习。A. study一般现在时态的结构；B. studied一般过去时态的结构；C. is studying现在进行时态的结构；D. was studying过去进行时态的结构；根据what did you do on your winter vacation?可知是过去时态；故选B

questions.prompt: －Peter, what were you doing at seven last night? －I  ______  a walk with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：——彼得，昨天晚上7点你在做什么？——我在和我的朋友散步。A. was taking过去进行时态的结构；B. take一般现在时态的结构；C. have taken现在完成时态的结构；D. will take一般将来时态的结构；根据at seven last night可知用过去进行时态的结构；故选A

questions.prompt: I  ______  this computer for 8 years. I'm thinking about buying a new one.
questions.explanation: 句意：我使用这台电脑8年了，我在考虑买一个新的。A. used一般过去时态的结构；B. will use一般将来时态的结构；C. use一般现在时态的结构；D. have used现在完成时态的结构；根据for 8 years可知用现在完成时态；故选D

questions.prompt: Mary went to the concert yesterday and the music which  ______  on the piano was wonderful.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽昨天去音乐会了，钢琴演奏的音乐非常精彩。根据句子结构可知这是定语从句，the music是先行词， which是引导词，在从句中做主语，和play之间是被动关系，所以用被动语态，排除A/B；根据yesterday，可知是过去时态；故选C

questions.prompt: I wonder  ______  the day after tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想知道她后天是否会来。根据疑问词和if/ whether引导的宾语从句要用陈述语序，排除B/C；根据the day after tomorrow.可知是将来时态；故选D 【点睛】疑问词引导的宾语从句要用陈述语序，例如：Do you know who they are waiting for?如果主句是一般过去时，从句要用过去的某一个时态，例如：I knew she had swept the floor.如果从句是叙述的客观真理/自然现象时，则不受主句时态的限制，仍用一般现在时态，例如：They knew the sun is much bigger than the earth. 五、完形填空 A few days ago, I bought some ink for my printer at my favorite $1 Supermarket, which sold everything from fresh produce to birthday cards at one dollar. Then I found a better  ______ 13 ______  at a computer store. So I went back to the supermarket to  ______ 14 ______  it for some other products. With nobody telling me exactly what to do, I put the ink into a plastic bag, tied it up, placed the bag into a push-cart and started shopping. I was midway through when a clerk suddenly stopped me. "You are not allowed to carry a bag around in this store. Open it and show me the thing!" she yelled coldly.  ______ 15 ______, I opened the bag and showed the ink to her. "I'm returning it. "I said. "You should have left the bag with the clerk upon entry. Let me see your receipt!" she asked. I did as told, looking around, embarrassed as if everyone was laughing at me. "Perhaps in the future you'll learn how to follow the store rules." she added. By the time I finished shopping, I was angry. How dare she treat me as a  ______ 16 ______? I went looking for her and asked for her  ______ 17 ______. She mumbled (嘀咕) something. I asked her again, and this time I heard "Ursula." "Ursula, what?" I asked. She yelled at me, "Ursula!" and stormed away. "This woman is about to become fired, "I  ______ 18 ______  when I got home. I rang their headquarters (总部). I described my unpleasant experience to the person in charge. She was understanding, "Our employees (雇员) are taught to be  ______ 19 ______. Give me your phone number and I will ring you back. " She did two days later. "I'm sorry," she said, "but there's no Ursula at that supermarket. Can you describe her so that I can find out who she is? I assure you, we do not stand rude behavior, nor do we stand ______ 20 ______ to our customers. " By this time, I had calmed down. I didn't really want the employee to lose her job. So I told her to forget about it.

questions.prompt: My mother is a teacher. She loves job very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈是一名老师。她非常喜欢她的工作。 A. his他的；B. her她的；C. our我们的；D. your你（们）的。根据前句My mother is a teacher.可知，此句应是：她非常喜欢她的工作。“she她”对应形容词性物主代词“her她的”。故选B。 【点睛】牢记人称代词以及对应的形容词性物主代词，如：“she她”是人称代词，对应形容词性物主代词“her她的”。名词的前面一定用形容词性物主代词。

questions.prompt: My favourite TV show is  ______  8 o’clock in the evening.
questions.explanation: 句意：我最喜欢的电视节目是晚上八点的。A. on 在……上；B. at 在几点；C. in 在……里；D. of……的。时间前用介词at。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Linda， is the man at the school gate? —He is Mr. Smith，our new head teacher.
questions.explanation: 句意：——琳达，学校门口的那个人是谁？——他是史密斯先生，我们的新班主任。 A. who谁；B. what什么；C. which哪个；D. how怎样。根据答语He is Mr. Smith，our new head teacher.可知，上句应询问一个人，故用疑问词who。故选A。

questions.prompt: Nancy didn't go to school yesterday she had a fever.
questions.explanation: 句意：南希昨天没去上学，因为她发烧了。 A. if如果；B. when当……时；C. though尽管；D. because因为。后面的句子“she had a fever她发烧了”是说明前面的句子“Nancy didn't go to school yesterday南希昨天没去上学”的原因。故选D。

questions.prompt: Jim wants to get better grades，so he studies than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆想取得更好的成绩，所以他比以前学习更努力了。 A. hard努力地；B. harder更努力；C. hardest最努力；D. the hardest最努力。“than比”是比较级的标志词；分析选项，hard努力地，副词，比较级harder。故选B。 【点睛】在平时学习中，理解比较级的用法，掌握比较级的标志词，牢记形容词和副词比较级的变化规则。

questions.prompt: — Must I leave now? — No, you  ______. You can stay here a little longer.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我必须现在离开吗？ ——不，你不需要。你可以在这里多呆一会儿。A. mustn’t千万不要，禁止；B. needn’t不需要；C. can’t 不能；D. wouldn’t不会。must的否定回答用needn’t。故选B。

questions.prompt: Keep quiet，Tom. Your sister in her room.
questions.explanation: 句意：保持安静，汤姆。你姐姐正在房间里学习。 A. studies学习，动词三单；B. has studied已经学习，现在完成时；C. is studying正在学习，现在进行时；D. studied学习，动词过去式。根据Keep quiet，Tom.可判断，汤姆的姐姐正在房间里学习。所以后句时态应是现在进行时（am/ is/ are +doing）；主语Your sister是单数，故用is。故选C。

questions.prompt: When we were in Sanya，we swimming in the sea every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们在三亚的时候，每天都去海里游泳。 A. went去，动词过去式；B. were going正在去，现在进行时；C. have gone已经去，现在完成时；D. go去，动词原形。分析句子，从句“When we were in Sanya”是一般过去时；主句中every day指过去的每一天，故主句应是一般过去时，谓语动词应用过去式。故选A。

questions.prompt: —Oh，Helen. You have so many photos of Shanghai Disneyland. —Yes，I there three times．It's fantastic.
questions.explanation: 句意：——哦，海伦。你有很多上海迪士尼乐园的照片。——是的，我去过三次。太棒了。 A. am一般现在时，用于主语I；B. was一般过去时，用于主语单数；C. have been现在完成时；D. will be一般将来时。根据上句Oh，Helen. You have so many photos of Shanghai Disneyland.可知，海伦去过上海迪士尼乐园。所以答语应是现在完成时；have been表示“去过某地”。故选C。

questions.prompt: David lives near school，so he to school every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：戴维住在学校附近，所以他每天步行上学。 A. walks步行，动词三单；B. is walking正在步行，现在进行时；C. will walk将步行，一般将来时；D. walked步行，动词过去式。此句是so连接的并列句；前面的句子“David lives near school”是一般现在时，所以后面的句子应是一般现在时；主语he是第三人称单数，故动词用三单。故选A。

questions.prompt: I think more and more work by robots in the future.
questions.explanation: 句意：我认为在将来越来越多的工作将由机器人做。 A. does做，动词三单；B. will do将做，一般将来时；C. is done被做，一般现在时被动语态；D. will be done将被做，一般将来时被动语态。分析句子，in the future在将来，故从句应是一般将来时；结合选项，主语work和动词do存在被动关系，故从句应是一般将来时被动语态，其结构：will be +过去分词。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Sam，can you tell me this math problem so fast? —Sure，let me show you.
questions.explanation: 句意：——萨姆，你能告诉我你是怎么这么快解出这道数学题的吗？——当然，让我给你看看。 分析句子结构及选项，上句含有how引导的宾语从句，从句应用陈述语序，故排除C、D。根据下句Sure，let me show you.可知，萨姆算出了这道数学题。所以上句中从句应是一般过去时。故选B。 完形填空 Building Our Community "Mom，I hope Steve can take me to the park next weekend，”I said. "Sorry，Lucy，”Mom said，“your brother is volunteering next weekend to help  ______ 13 ______  a house for a family.” I remembered Steve's eyes had lit up when he first told me about the community home-building project. He was good at building and fixing things，so he was  ______ 14 ______  to do something. Now that he was seventeen，he was finally old enough to take part in it. "It's not  ______ 15 ______  ，”I complained. "Steve can change a family's life，but what can I do? I'm only ten.” Mom put on her serious look.“Don't think about it like that，Lucy，”she said，“people make a  ______ 16 ______  by thinking about what they can do，rather than what they can't do.” Mom's words echoed in my head later that day. Maybe she was right. I might not be able to physically build a house，but I could  ______ 17 ______  money to help. The next day before class，I talked to my teacher，Mr. Brown，about my idea. "Well，we can brainstorm about it，”he said，“I bet your classmates will have some good ideas.  ______ 18 ______  will be the best way to make this happen.” After I explained my idea in class，Brason raised his hand.“My uncle owns a T-shirt shop. Maybe he can print some T-shirts that we can  ______ 19 ______  "Great idea！”Mr. Brown said. Then，after a lively discussion，we decided on“Building Our Community" as our slogan(口号）to print. Marla, our class artist，agreed to draw the design. By Friday，the T-shirts had been printed，and I had posted details about the sale on our class Web page. Our Saturday sale was a success. We earned ＄125．After the sale，we went to the community center. I  ______ 20 ______  handed over the money. Mom and Mr. Brown had both been right. Everyone can do something，and together we can achieve something great.

questions.prompt: National Day in China is 1st October.
questions.explanation: 句意：中国的国庆节是在十月一号。 考查介词辨析。in在……，表示泛指的时间；on在……，用在具体的某一天；at在……点，用在具体的钟点前；for为了；根据句意理解及空格后的1st October可知，具体到某一天前面要用介词on，故选B。 【点睛】时间介词in，at，on的用法要注意区别。口诀为：时间长的要用in，年代、季节和月份；具体某天要用on，几月几号，星期几；时间点时用at，包括noon和night；上下午晚上很特殊，单独出现要用in，具体描述要用on。

questions.prompt: We'll sit in the front rows as soon as the game.
questions.explanation: 句意：比赛一开始我们就坐在前排。 考查主将从现用法。根据句意理解及句中as soon as可知，这里是时间状语从句，英语中时间、条件状语从句中如果主句是一般将来时，从句要用一般现在时，构成主将从现的用法，而从句主语是the game单数名词，所以动词要用三单形式，故选C。 【点睛】英语中在条件状语从句和时间状语从句中一般会用到“主将从现”用法。即主句用将来时，结构是will+动词原形；从句用一般现在时，动词结构是原形或三单形式；做题要根据从句主语判断用原形还是三单。

questions.prompt: They managed the model plane by themselves.
questions.explanation: 句意：他们设法自己建造了模型飞机。 考查动词不定式做宾语。根据句意理解可知，这里表达的是“设法建造”，英语是manage to do sth，对照结构可知，这里要用to build形式，故选D。

questions.prompt: I back in ten minutes.
questions.explanation: 句意：我十分钟之后回来。 考查一般将来时。根据句意理解及句中的时间状语in ten minutes可知，英语中in+一段时间表示“……之后”，时间表达的是将来，所以动词要用一般将来时，结构是will+动词原形，故选C。

questions.prompt: —How long you English? —Since I was 22.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你教英语多久了？——从我22岁开始。 考查现在完成时。根据句意理解及句中的Since I was 22.可知，英语中since是现在完成时的标志词，现在完成时结构是have/ has+过去分词，句子的主语是you，所以选择have，疑问句把have提到主语前面，故选B。 【点睛】英语中不同时态的标志词要注意。每个时态都有不同的标志词。比如本题中since就是标志词，根据since判断用现在完成时，所以选择B。

questions.prompt: Of all the subjects, I think physics is.
questions.explanation: 句意：在所有的科目中，我认为物理是最难的。 考查形容词最高级。difficult困难的；most difficult最困难的，缺少the；more difficult更困难的；the most difficult最困难的；根据句意理解及句首的Of all the subjects可知，这里的比较范围是大于三者的，英语中表达三者或三者以上的比较要用最高级，difficult是多音节词，最高级要在前面加most，形容词的最高级前面必须加定冠词the，故选D。 【点睛】英语中表达三者或三者以上的事物之间的比较要用最高级，且要注意形容词的最高级前面必须要加定冠词the，而副词的最高级前面可以不用加the，做题时要注意区分。

questions.prompt: There’s on TV tonight. Let's go to the movies.
questions.explanation: 句意：今晚电视上没有什么有趣的节目。我们去看电影吧。 考查定语后置。nothing interesting没有有趣的事；interesting something结构错误；something interesting一些有趣的事；interesting nothing结构错误；英语中形容词修饰不定代词要放在不定代词的后面，由此可排除B/ D选项，根据后句Let’s go to the movies可知，这里表达的是“没有有趣的东西”，故选A。 【点睛】英语中形容词做定语的位置要注意。一般修饰名词作定语，是放在名词前面，而修饰不定代词作定语时，则要放在不定代词后面，也就是定语后置的情况，做题要区分是修饰名词还是代词，从而确定其位置。

questions.prompt: Laura opened the door and rushed into the rain  ______  I could stop her.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：萝拉打开门，在我能阻止她之前她冲进了雨中。A. until直到……； B. after在……之后；C. before在……之前；D. unless除非，rush into冲进，根据对句子的分析，可知在我能够阻止她之前，她冲进了雨中，故选择C。 考点：考查介词的用法。

questions.prompt: We eat in the museum. It's against the rules.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们禁止在博物馆吃。这是违反规定的。 考查情态动词的用法。should应该；needn’t不需要；mustn’t禁止，不许；can能；根据句意理解及后句It’s against the rules可知，这里表达的是“禁止，不允许”，英语是mustn’t故选C。

questions.prompt: I want my daughter a musical instrument.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想让我女儿学一种乐器。 考查非谓语结构。根据句意理解可知，这里表达的是“想要某人做某事”，英语是want sb to do sth，对照结构可知，这里应该用to learn作my daughter的补足语，故选B。

questions.prompt: Don’t watch too much TV, your eyes will hurt.
questions.explanation: 句意：不要看太多电视，否则你的眼睛会疼的。 考查并列连词辨析。and和；but但是；or或者，否则；根据句意理解及句子结构可知，这里符合固定句型“祈使句+or+陈述句”，or在此结构中表示在以祈使句为条件下的相反假设，意为“否则，要不然”。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Can you tell me when you are alone at home? —Free but lonely.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我当你独自在家的时候你感觉怎么样？——自由但很孤单。 考查宾语从句。首先根据宾语从句要用陈述句语序，即引导词+主语+谓语+……，排除B/ C选项；再根据句中的can和are可知，这里应该用现在时，所以排除A选项，故选D。 【点睛】英语中宾语从句的考题做题时要注意。可以分三步走。第一步：确定引导词。根据句意理解来确定用哪个词引导；第二步，看语序。根据“宾语从句必须用陈述句语序”的原则来排除一部分答案，比如本题中B/ C答案是疑问句语序，直接排除；第三步，看时态。根据“主现从不限，主过从必过”的原则确定从句时态，但要排除从句表达客观事实或者真理时只用现在时；利用这三点即可确定选项答案。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 “Mommy, look!” cried my daughter, Darla, pointing to a chicken hawk in the air. “Uh huh,” I answered, driving, lost in thought about the timetable of my day. Disappointment  ______ 13 ______  her face. “What's the matter, sweetheart?” I asked. “Nothing,” my seven-year-old daughter said. The moment was gone. Dinner, baths and phone calls filled the hours until bedtime. “Come on, Darla, time for bed! ” She raced past me up the stairs. Tired, I kissed her and hugged her. “Mom, I forgot to give you something!” she said. “Give it to me in the morning.” I said. My  ______ 14 ______  was gone. I could hardly stay cool. “You won't have time in the morning!” she talked back quickly. “I’ll take time,” I answered. Sometimes no matter how hard I tried. time was never enough. She wasn't ready to  ______ 15 ______  up yet. “No, you won't! It will be just like today when I told you to look at the chicken hawk. You didn't 4 listen to what I said. ” I was too tired to argue; she hit too close to the truth. “Good night!” I shut the door in anger. Later though, her gray-blue eyes filled my vision as I thought about how little time we really had until she was grown and gone. My husband asked me about what was going on and I told him. “Maybe she was not asleep yet. Why don't you  ______ 16 ______?” he said. I followed his advice,  ______ 17 ______  it was my own idea. I opened her door gently. In Darla's hand I could see her paper all crumpled up. She had torn into small pieces a big red heart with a poem she had written titled, “Why I Love My Mother?” Why I Love My Mother Although you're busy, and you work so hard You always take time to play with me I love you Mommy, Because I am the biggest part of your busy day! Tears filled my eyes. When I softly touched her face, she awakened from a dreamless sleep and asked, “Why are you  ______ 18 ______, Mommy?” “You are the most important part of my busy day!” She smiled and then went back to sleep, not really understanding how strongly I  ______ 19 ______  what I said.

questions.prompt: I can't find my pen. Could you help  ______?
questions.explanation: 句意：我找不到我的笔，你能帮我找到它吗？ 考查代词。me我，宾格；her 她，宾格或形容词性物主代词；him他，宾格； them他们，她们，它们。根据I can’t find my pen.我找不到我的笔，可知是帮我，应填me，故选A。

questions.prompt: Both my parents were born  ______  1970.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父母都是在1970年出生。本题是对介词的考查，在表示时间时，at表示在几点；in表示在一个时间范围；on表示在具体某一天；to表示差……到。结合语境可知选B。

questions.prompt: ______  I was in the US, I made a lot of American friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我在美国的时候，我交了很多美国朋友。 考查连词辨析。while当……的时候，表时间；although尽管，表让步；unless除非，表条件，相当于if not；until直到，与not连用表示“直到……才”。根据I made a lot of American friends我交了很多美国朋友，可知是在美国的时候，故选A。

questions.prompt: We  ______  in the same school since three years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从三年前我们就同一所学校里学习。 考查时态。 study动词原形；were studying过去完成生态形式； will study一般将来时态形式； have studied现在完成时态形式。根据时间状语since three years ago 结合句意"自从三年前我们就在同一所学校里学习．"判断用现在完成时．现在完成时的构成是：主语+have/has+动词的过去分词；此空应填have studied，故选D。

questions.prompt: – Mum，where is Dad? – He  ______  flowers in the garden now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，爸爸在哪儿？——他现在正在花园里浇花。 考查现在进行时。A. watered过去式；B. waters第三人称单数；C. will water 一般将来时；D. is watering现在进行时。根据答句中的now可知句子时态用现在进行时，其结构为：am/is/are+动词想现在分词，主语是he，用is，water的现在分词是watering；故答案选D。

questions.prompt: Last week，Ms．Tang  ______  a meeting to stress the importance of the mid-term exam.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周，唐女士召开了一次会议，强调期中考试的重要性。 考查一般过去时。A. holds第三人称单数；B. held过去式；C. will hold 一般将来时；D. was holding过去进行时。根据时间状语Last week上周，可知句子时态用一般过去时，hold的过去式为held，故答案选B。

questions.prompt: – We  ______  the National Forest Park next Sunday．Would you like to join us? – Sure!
questions.explanation: 句意：——下星期天我们将参观国家森林公园。你想加入我们吗?——当然！ 考查一般将来时。A. visit动词原形；B. visits第三人称单数；C. will visit一般将来时；D. visited过去式。根据句中的时间状语next Sunday下星期天，可知是一个将来的时间，所以句子时态用一般将来时，其结构为：will+动词原形，或be going to+动词原形；故答案选C。

questions.prompt: —What were Bill and David doing when the teacher came in? —They  ______  about school’s football match.
questions.explanation: 句意：——当老师进来的时候，比尔和大卫在做什么？——他们在谈论学校的足球比赛。 考查过去进行时。A. are talking现在进行时； B. have talked现在完成时；C. were talking过去进行时；D. talk动词原形。根据What were Bill and David doing when the teacher came in? 结合语境可知：当老师进来的时候，比尔和大卫正在谈论学校的足球比赛，所以时态用进行时；问句时态为过去时，所以这里应用过去进行时，其结构为：主语＋was/were＋动词的现在分词，主语是they，故用were，talk的现在分词是talking；故答案选C。

questions.prompt: --- Doctor, ______ do I have to take the medicine? --- Three times a day.
questions.explanation: 句意：---医生，我多久吃一次这种药？---一天三次。此题考查特殊疑问词，A多久一次；B多少；C多长时间；D多远。根据句意，应选A。

questions.prompt: －Is everyone here today? －No. Sara is at home  ______  she has got a fever.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天大家都到齐了吗？——不，露西在家因为她发高烧。 考查从属连词。until直到，引导时间状语从句；if如果，引导条件状语从句；because因为，引导原因状语从句；unless除非；引导条件状语从句。此题根据语境"露西在家因为她发高烧。"表示原因，应用because，故选C。

questions.prompt: ______  it snowed heavily yesterday, nobody in our class missed the lesson．
questions.explanation: 句意：尽管昨天下了大雪，我们班上没有人缺课。本题的含义虽然昨天的雪下得很大，但是没有人缺课，表示的是让步，用though来引导，故本题选A。

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我他什么时候买的这辆新自行车吗?——上周。 考查宾语从句。根据Can you tell me  ______?可知，本题考查宾语从句，宾语从句中一般为陈述语序，选项A、C是疑问语序，所以排除掉；再根据Last week，可知句子使用一般过去时态，B选项为一般将来时，所以排除；故答案选D。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A About ten years ago，a very successful businessman named Josh was traveling down a neighborhood street．He was going a little too fast in his new car. Suddenly，a stone  ______ 13 ______  his new car and broke the window．The  ______ 14 ______  driver jumped out of the car，caught the kid who threw the stone and shouted: “What are you doing? That’s a new car and that stone you threw is going to cost a lot of money．Why did you do it?” “I’m sorry for breaking your new car，but I didn’t know what else to do，” the young boy apologized．“I  ______ 15 ______  the stone because no one else would stop!” With tears on his face，the little boy said: “It’s my older brother．He fell out of his wheelchair. Would you please help me get him back into his wheelchair? He’s too heavy for me to lift him up.” The driver was greatly  ______ 16 ______ ．He quickly lifted the disabled boy back into the wheelchair and  ______ 17 ______  to see that he was going to be okay. “You are a nice man．Thank you，” the little child said．The businessman  ______ 18 ______  the little boy push the wheelchair down the sidewalk toward their home．It was a long，slow walk back to the car. After that，he kept the hole in his window to remind him of this message “Don’t go through life so  ______ 19 ______  that someone has to throw a stone at you to get your attention.” The world sends a message and speaks to our  ______ 20 ______ ．We all have the choice to listen...or wait for the stone!

questions.prompt: It’s  ______ time for me to visit the Guanyin Lake.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是我第五次游览观音湖。five 五，是基数词；fifth第五，是序数词；根据It’s+the+序数词+time for sb to do sth这是某人第几次做某事，故此处用序数词the fifth。故选D。

questions.prompt: I want to know how he will deal  ______ the problem.
questions.explanation: 句意： 我想知道他将会怎样处理这个问题。 本题考查介词辨析。on在……上面，by通过，with和……一起，of……的。deal with固定搭配，意为“处理”。故选C。

questions.prompt: ______ visitors came to take photos of Xiangshan Park during the National Day.
questions.explanation: 句意：在国庆节期间，成千上万的游客来给香山公园拍照。 本题考查数词的用法。当hundred、thousand、million、billion等数词表示大约数量时用“～s of”形式表示“数百/千/百万/十亿”。如果表示具体数字， hundred等词使用原形形式， 如five thousand五千。故选D。

questions.prompt: At the moment, Mr White is doing an to show students why it’s important to clean teeth.
questions.explanation: 句意： 那时，怀特先生正在做一个实验，展示给学生清洁牙齿为什么那么重要。 本题考查名词辨析。experiment意为“实验”，operation 意为“手术，操作”；instrument意为“仪器”；invention意为“发明”。由to show students why it’s important to clean teeth.可知，要给学生展示为什么清洁牙齿那么重要，这是做实验，故选A。

questions.prompt: Dragon Boat racing has been a much-loved sport all over the world,  ______ the US cities such as New York and Boston.
questions.explanation: 句意：龙舟赛已经成为全世界很受欢迎的运动，包括美国的纽约和波士顿等城市。 本题考查词性和词义辨析。句子有谓语动词has been ，空格处不能用作动词，include是动词，常作谓语，意为“包括;包含”；including是介词，意为“包括，包含”，位于名词或代词之前；included被包括，位于名词或代词后。此处作状语，位于名词短语the US cities之前，用介词including。故选D。

questions.prompt: Never put off  ______  tomorrow what you can do today.
questions.explanation: 句意：今天的事情不要推迟到明天去做。A. until直到；B. before在……之前；C. when当……时候；D. as因为。这是一句谚语，用的是祈使句，并且以never开头，语气很强；put off意思是“推迟”，根据句意“今天的事情不要推迟到明天去做”可知A选项符合题意，故答案选A。

questions.prompt: Many people like pandas they are cute.
questions.explanation: 句意：很多人喜欢熊猫，因为它们很可爱。考查从属连词的辨析。选项A意为：虽然；选项B意为：如果；选项C意为：当……时候；选项D意为：因为。结合句意：很多人喜欢熊猫，因为它们很可爱。故选D。

questions.prompt: Wu Dajing is a short track speed skater. He  ______ to practise skating when he was ten years old.
questions.explanation: 句意: 武大靖是一位短道速滑选手。他十岁时开始练习滑冰。 本题考查动词时态。begins是一般现在时，will begin是一般将来时，began是一般过去时，has begun是现在完成时。根据时间状语从句when he was ten years old判断主句时态使用一般过去时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Jack, remember  ______  off the lights when  ______ your bedroom. ----OK, I won’t forget, Mom.
questions.explanation: 句意：——杰克，记得离开卧室时把灯关掉。——好吧，妈妈，我不会忘记的。考查非谓语动词。上一句句意：杰克，离开卧室时记得关灯。remember to do sth.记得去做某事（未做）；remember doing sth.记得做过某事（已做）。when doing sth.是省略了主谓语的时间状语从句。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Oh, no, it’s raining. We can’t go skating on the square. — ______!
questions.explanation: 句意: ——噢, 不!下雨了。我们不能去广场滑冰了。——真遗憾！。 本题考查情景交际。No deal 意为“不行”；That’s no good意为“那没有好处”；What a shame 意为“真遗憾”；That’s not the point意为“那不是问题的关键”。根据We can’t go skating on the square.可知我们不能去广场上滑冰了，这是一件遗憾的事，故选C。 完形填空 Everyone has dreams. Lily dreamed of being a dancer. She took  ______ 11 ______  lessons and all her teachers thought she was an excellent student. One day she saw a notice. It said that a famous dancing group would be performing in her town. ______ 12 ______  thought “I must show the leader my dancing skills.”She waited for the group leader in the dressing room.  ______ 13 ______  the leader appeared, she came up and handed him the flowers she prepared. The thorns(刺) hurt her fingers and blood came out. But she was too  ______ 14 ______  to care about he pain. She expressed her strong wish to be a dancer and begged(乞求) to show her dance. “All right. You dance, ” the leader agreed. But half way through the dance, he stopped her, I’m sorry, in my mind you’re not good enough! ” On hearing this, Lily ______ 15 ______  out as fast as her legs could carry her. It was so hard for her to accept this. She lost heart and  ______ 16 ______  her dream. Several years later, the dancing group came to her town again. She decided to find out  ______ 17 ______  the leader had told her she was not good enough. This was his reply, “I tell this  ______ 18 ______ every student.” “You’ve ruined(毁掉)my life!” she shouted angrily. The leader went on, “I remember your present of  ______ 19 ______  and how the thoms had hurt your fingers but you carried on bravely. It was a pity that you didn’t take dancing like that and stopped trying so  ______ 20 ______. So you are still not good enough for dancing!”

questions.prompt: I can’t find my pen．Could you help ______  find it?
questions.explanation: 句意：我找不到我的钢笔。你能帮我找一下吗？考查代词辨析。作动词help的宾语，用宾格形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: Both my parents were born  ______  1970.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父母都是在1970年出生。本题是对介词的考查，在表示时间时，at表示在几点；in表示在一个时间范围；on表示在具体某一天；to表示差……到。结合语境可知选B。

questions.prompt: ______  I was in the USA, I made a lot of friends there.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我在美国时，我交了许多的朋友。A. While 当B. Although尽管 C. Unless如果不D. Until直到。根据句意，故选A。

questions.prompt: We  ______  in the same school since three years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从三年前我们就在同一所学校里学习。 考查现在完成时，根据时间状语since three years ago 结合句意"自从三年前我们就在同一所学校里学习。"判断用现在完成时，现在完成时的构成是：主语+have/has+动词的过去分词； 故答案为C。 【点睛】现在完成时的基本结构：主语+have/has+动词的过去分词(p.p）（V-ed） e.g done ①肯定句中：主语+has/have+动词的过去分词(p.p)（V-ed）+宾语（或者其他）. ②否定句中：主语+haven't/hasn't+动词的过去分词（p.p）（V-ed）+宾语. ③一般疑问句中：Have/Has+主语+动词的过去分词（p.p)（V-ed）+宾语（或者其他） 现在完成时的用法：

questions.prompt: – Mum，where is Dad? – He  ______  flowers in the garden now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，爸爸在哪儿？——他现在正在花园里浇花。 考查现在进行时。A. watered过去式；B. waters第三人称单数；C. will water 一般将来时；D. is watering现在进行时。根据答句中的now可知句子时态用现在进行时，其结构为：am/is/are+动词想现在分词，主语是he，用is，water的现在分词是watering；故答案选D。

questions.prompt: Last week，Ms．Tang  ______  a meeting to stress the importance of the mid-term exam.
questions.explanation: 句意：上周，唐女士召开了一次会议，强调期中考试的重要性。 考查一般过去时。A. holds第三人称单数；B. held过去式；C. will hold 一般将来时；D. was holding过去进行时。根据时间状语Last week上周，可知句子时态用一般过去时，hold的过去式为held，故答案选B。

questions.prompt: – We  ______  the National Forest Park next Sunday．Would you like to join us? – Sure!
questions.explanation: 句意：——下星期天我们将参观国家森林公园。你想加入我们吗?——当然！ 考查一般将来时。A. visit动词原形；B. visits第三人称单数；C. will visit一般将来时；D. visited过去式。根据句中的时间状语next Sunday下星期天，可知是一个将来的时间，所以句子时态用一般将来时，其结构为：will+动词原形，或be going to+动词原形；故答案选C。

questions.prompt: —What were Bill and David doing when the teacher came in? —They  ______  about school’s football match.
questions.explanation: 句意：——当老师进来的时候，比尔和大卫在做什么？——他们在谈论学校的足球比赛。 考查过去进行时。A. are talking现在进行时； B. have talked现在完成时；C. were talking过去进行时；D. talk动词原形。根据What were Bill and David doing when the teacher came in? 结合语境可知：当老师进来的时候，比尔和大卫正在谈论学校的足球比赛，所以时态用进行时；问句时态为过去时，所以这里应用过去进行时，其结构为：主语＋was/were＋动词的现在分词，主语是they，故用were，talk的现在分词是talking；故答案选C。

questions.prompt: --- Doctor, ______ do I have to take the medicine? --- Three times a day.
questions.explanation: 句意：---医生，我多久吃一次这种药？---一天三次。此题考查特殊疑问词，A多久一次；B多少；C多长时间；D多远。根据句意，应选A。

questions.prompt: — Is everyone here today? — No, Lucy is at home  ______  she has got a high fever.
questions.explanation: 句意：——今天大家都到齐了吗？——没有，露西因为发高烧呆在家里了。A. because因为；B. if如果；C. until直到……才；D. unless除非，如果不。露西呆在家里没有来是因为发高烧的原因。故答案为A。

questions.prompt: —Can you tell me  ______? —Last week.

choices.label: A
choices.text: when will he buy the new bike

choices.label: B
choices.text: when he will buy the new bike

choices.label: C
choices.text: when did he buy the new bike

choices.label: D
choices.text: when he bought the new bike

questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我他什么时候买的这辆新自行车吗?——上周。 考查宾语从句。根据Can you tell me  ______?可知，本题考查宾语从句，宾语从句中一般为陈述语序，选项A、C是疑问语序，所以排除掉；再根据Last week，可知句子使用一般过去时态，B选项为一般将来时，所以排除；故答案选D。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A About ten years ago，a very successful businessman named Josh was traveling down a neighborhood street．He was going a little too fast in his new car. Suddenly，a stone  ______ 13 ______  his new car and broke the window．The  ______ 14 ______  driver jumped out of the car，caught the kid who threw the stone and shouted: “What are you doing? That’s a new car and that stone you threw is going to cost a lot of money．Why did you do it?” “I’m sorry for breaking your new car，but I didn’t know what else to do，” the young boy apologized．“I  ______ 15 ______  the stone because no one else would stop!” With tears on his face，the little boy said: “It’s my older brother．He fell out of his wheelchair. Would you please help me get him back into his wheelchair? He’s too heavy for me to lift him up.” The driver was greatly  ______ 16 ______ ．He quickly lifted the disabled boy back into the wheelchair and  ______ 17 ______  to see that he was going to be okay. “You are a nice man．Thank you，” the little child said．The businessman  ______ 18 ______  the little boy push the wheelchair down the sidewalk toward their home．It was a long，slow walk back to the car. After that，he kept the hole in his window to remind him of this message “Don’t go through life so  ______ 19 ______  that someone has to throw a stone at you to get your attention.” The world sends a message and speaks to our  ______ 20 ______ ．We all have the choice to listen...or wait for the stone!

questions.prompt: The handsome boy is from Class 2.  ______  name is John.
questions.explanation: 句意：那个英俊的男孩来自2班。他叫约翰。考查形容词性物主代词辨析。A. Her她的；B. His他的；C. Your你的；D. Their他们的。结合句意、语境和选项可知选B。

questions.prompt: We drove 5 hours and finally got to the city  ______  Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们开了5个小时的车，终于在星期日早上到达了这个城市。考查介词辨析。A. on在…上，在具体某一天，或某一天的早上、晚上和下午时，用on；B. at在，在具体的某一时间点，或极短的时间段用at；C. of…的，属于；D. in在…里，在较长的时间段用in。在星期天上午用on，结合句意、语境可知选A。

questions.prompt: We didn’t enjoy the day  ______  the weather was too bad.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们不喜欢这一天因为天气太糟糕了。or或者；否则；but但是；because因为，引导原因状语从句；so因此，所以。根据句意可知，后面这句话解释前面不喜欢这一天的原因，故应选C。

questions.prompt: —Mum, must I wash the dishes right now? —No, you  ______.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意： ——妈妈，我必须马上涮牙吗？——不，你不必了。A. shouldn’t 不应该； B. wouldn’t 不愿意；C. mustn’t 禁止；D. needn’t不必。must或need位于句首提问的一般疑问句肯定回答用Yes,...must. 否定回答用No,...needn’t/don’t have to.故选D。 考点：考查情态动词的用法。

questions.prompt: After a lot of hard practice he was able to jump much  ______  than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：经过多次艰苦的练习，他跳得比以前高得多。考查形容词比较级。根据句中than（比）结合句意、语境可知用比较级，选B。

questions.prompt: I  ______  my homework on the computer when the power went out.
questions.explanation: 句意：停电时我正在电脑上做家庭作业。考查句子时态辨析。A. was doing过去进行时；B. will do一般将来时； C. do一般现在时；D. did一般过去式。When当…时候，它引导的时间状语从句，从句用一般过去式，主句一般用过去进行时；结合句意、语境和选项可知选A。

questions.prompt: Jane is very friendly. Sometimes she  ______  her neighbours to parties at the weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：简非常友好。周末她有时邀请邻居参加聚会。考查句子时态辨析。A. invite邀请，动词原形，一般现在时（主语非第三人称单数）；B. invites主语是第三人称时一般现在时；C. invited一般过去式；D. will invite一般将来时。根据频度副词Sometimes可知此句时态是一般现在时，结合句意、语境和选项可知选B。

questions.prompt: — Do you know each other? — Of course. We  ______  friends for almost twenty years!
questions.explanation: 句意：------你们认识吗？--------当然。我们已经是将近二十年的朋友了！考查句子时态辨析。A. are一般现在时；B. were一般过去式；C. will be一般将来时；D. have been现在完成时。For+时间段，表示“做某事做了多长时间”，一般用于完成时态。根据句中for almost twenty years可知结合句意、语境可知此句时态是现在完成时；结合句意和语境可知选D。

questions.prompt: I will give the book to him if he  ______  here next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果他下星期天来，我就把书给他。 考查if引导条件状语从句的“主将从现”原则。A. comes表一般现在时；B. came表一般过去时；C. will come表一般将来时；D. has come表现在进行时。根据英语语法，if 引导的条件状语从句中，如果主句的时态是一般将来时，那么从句要用一般现在时。空格处应填入从句谓语，故选A。 【点睛】“主将从现”原则是指在由when，as soon as，after，before，until，unless等引导的时间状语从句和由if 引导的条件状语从句中，如果主句的时态是一般将来时，那么从句要用一般现在时。例如： I will go to the park if it doesn’t rain tomorrow. 如果明天不下雨，我将去公园。

questions.prompt: I  ______  you as soon as he gets home.
questions.explanation: 句意：他一到家我就给你打电话。 考查as soon as引导时间状语从句的“主将从现”原则。A. call表一般现在时；B. am calling表现在进行时；C. will call表一般将来时；D. have called表现在完成时。根据英语语法，as soon as引导的时间状语从句中，如果主句的时态是一般将来时，那么从句要用一般现在时。空格处应填入主句谓语，故选C。

questions.prompt: Many roads  ______  for the coming Winter Olympics next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：明年冬季奥运会将修建许多道路。考查语态和时态辨析。A. build一般现在时的主动语态；B. will build一般将来时的主动语态；C. are built一般现在时的被动语态；D. will be built一般将来时的被动语态。根据时间next year可知此句的时态是一般将来时；根据语境可知用被动语态，结合语境、句意和选项可知选D。

questions.prompt: — What did Mr. Lee say just now? — He asked  ______  last week.

choices.label: A
choices.text: where did we have a picnic

choices.label: C
choices.text: where will we have a picnic

choices.label: D
choices.text: where we will have a picnic

questions.explanation: 句意：——李先生刚才说了什么？ ——他问我们上周在哪里野餐。 考查宾语从句。根据英语语法，宾语从句的语序应为陈述句的语序，A、C选项可排除。根据句中时间状语last week提示，问的是过去发生的事，故从句应用表示过去的某种时态，故选B。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 Jayce began notice when he started his schooling that he looked different from his classmates. They had two arms. He had one. It started when one boy laughed at him, said his mother, Lewis. He’d return to his home with questions: “Why am I  ______ 13 ______? Why me? His mother still remembered he was actually sad and angry with that. Lewis said she didn’t know what to do at that point. A few weeks later, Lewis turned on the TV to a news story about an eighth grader, Trashaun, becoming popular after sharing videos of his slam dunks(灌篮) on the Internet, and, like Jayce, he  ______ 14 ______  most of his left arm. Lewis called Jayce in. To her surprise, Jayce immediately got interested in the videos. At the time, it seemed that watching Trashaun was  ______ 15 ______  an encouraging moment for Jayce — he saw a role model with a similar  ______ 16 ______. If it had stayed just that, Lewis would have been happy enough. But little did she know that a family friend had already reached out to the newspaper to help set up a meeting with Trashaun to build Jayce’s confidence. The boys met and at once got on well with each other as both of them were in the same condition. They rode bikes, took photos, and shot basketball on the court. Instead of spending the whole day feeling  ______ 17 ______  for themselves, they had a lot of fun. Sometimes, they talked about the problem — the lost left arm. Trashaun told Jayce not to let anyone discourage him and not to let those words shake his  ______ 18 ______. Since that meeting, Lewis has seen a noticeable change in her son. As for Trashaun, his relationship with Jayce made him expect to help more kids. “Honestly, it  ______ 19 ______  a lot to know that I changed Jayce’s life”, Trashaun says. Still, he never dreamed that his  ______ 20 ______  would make such a great difference in others “life”. I just thought my friends would see them, and be like, “Oh, he dunked it!” He certainly did.

questions.prompt: This isn’t my T-shirt.  ______  is blue.
questions.explanation: 句意：这不是我的T恤，我的是蓝色的。 考查代词用法。I人称代词主格，我；Me人称代词宾格，我；Mine名词性物主代词，我的；My形容词性物主代词，我的。结合语境可知本句为名词性物主代词做主语，故选C。 【点睛】代词之间的最大区别就是指代对象不同，在句子中的语法功能不同。如主格人称代词不能作宾语，宾格人称代词不能作主语等。

questions.prompt: Flowers usually come out  ______  spring every year.
questions.explanation: 句意：花儿通常在每年春天开放。 考查介词用法。在表示时间时，in表示在一个时间范围；at表示在具体时刻；on表示在具体某一天；of关于……的。结合语境可知春天是一个时间范围，故用介词in，选A。 【点睛】英语介词的一个特点是一词多义，并且介词间语义交叉现象很多，习惯用法也很多，有时很难从词义上区分开来。故学习中要注意不断总结，熟记一些介词和动词的固定搭配用法及习惯用法，是完成此类问题的捷径。

questions.prompt: —  ______  is a ticket to Garden Expo? — It’s about 100 yuan.
questions.explanation: 句意：——园艺博览会的一张入场券多少钱？——大约100元 考查疑问词辨析。How much多少钱；How many多少个；How long多长；How often多久一次。根据下文，大约100元。可知选A， 【点睛】该题型是属于英语考试中的基础题型，是必考内容。答题前首先要理解每个选项的基本含义及用法，并注意交叉含义间的区别，然后根据问答语之间的逻辑关系，以及该疑问词在句子中承担的句子成分选择正确答案。

questions.prompt: —What did Mr. Brown do before he came to China? —He in a car factory.
questions.explanation: 句意：——布朗先生来中国之前做什么？——他在一家汽车厂工作。考查动词时态辨析题。根据问句What did Mr. Brown do before he came to China?，before在以前，可知需用一般过去时，动词需用过去式。worked是work的过去式，故选B。

questions.prompt: If you  ______ up late, you will feel tired the next day.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：如果你熬夜，第二天你会感到很累。If引导的条件状语从句，主将从现，故选C。 考点：考查条件状语从句的时态。

questions.prompt: Mr. King asks us  ______  a car with our friends to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：金先生要求我们安排一辆车和我们的朋友一块去学校。 考查非谓语动词。ask sb. to do sth.：要求某人做某事，是固定搭配。动词不定式作宾语补足语，故选D。

questions.prompt: My brother  ______  exercise every day and he likes sports very much.
questions.explanation: 解析：句意：我哥哥每天锻炼，他非常喜欢运动。A. did一般过去时；B. does一般现在时；C. will do一般将来时；D. is doing现在进行时；根据主语是“我哥哥”，是单数第三人称，时间状语是every day“每天”，可以判断句子应该用一般现在时态，表示经常或反复发生的动作，谓语动词还要与主语保持一致，本题主语是第三人称单数，谓语动词也要用动词的第三人称单数形式；故选B。

questions.prompt: I’d like to go with you,  ______  I’m afraid I have no time.
questions.explanation: 句意：我想和你一起去，但是我恐怕我没有时间。 考查连词词义辨析。but但；and而且；so所以，因此；or或者，否则。根据“I’m afraid I have no time”可知，表示转折关系，指虽然我愿意和你去，但是我恐怕我没有时间。故选A。

questions.prompt: — Dad, where is Mum? — She  ______  dinner in the kitchen now.
questions.explanation: 试句意：——爸爸，妈妈在哪？——她正在厨房煮饭。 考查动词时态。在后者的回答中，由于出现关键性的时间状语now，故可知要用现在进行时。根据句意，故选D。

questions.prompt: Ms.Wang  ______  PE in this school for about 18 years.
questions.explanation: 句意：王小姐在这个学校教体育大概18年了。 考查时态。has taught用于现在完成时，主语为第三人称单数；is teaching用于现在进行时，主语为第三人称单数；teaches用于一般现在时，主语为第三人称单数；taught用于一般过去时。根据句意及时间状语for about 18 years，可知此句用现在完成时，故选A。

questions.prompt: E-book  ______ by more and more people in our daily life now.
questions.explanation: 句意：如今，电子书被越来越多的人使用。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。由于本句的主语是E-book，与use之间是被动关系，又因为有时间状语now，故用一般现在时被动式。根据句意，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Can you tell me  ______? — Sure. It’s next to the supermarket.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我书店在哪吗？—— 当然可以。它就在超市对面。 考查宾语从句。分析句意可知这是一个宾语从句，故从句要用陈述句语序；又因为这是表示一般的情况，故用一般现在时。根据句意，故选C。 二、完形填空 通读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中， 选择最佳选项。 My name is Ben Mansury. I’m fifteen years old and study in a middle school. In school, I never join in any group discussion or stage (舞台) program. So, I never knew what stage nervousness was. Our community (社区) has a weekly “Students Ideas” program. About two years ago, I received a(n) call from the chairman of our community. He invited me to the “Students Ideas” talk the next morning to speak to the group. The time between his call to the next morning was like several weeks for me. The whole night, I could not sleep. Many  ______ 13 ______  were coming. One of them was to call the chairman, with regret, and tell him that I could not come. But finally, I thought, if I missed this  ______ 14 ______, the community would never invite me again to any of their programs. So, I decided to go. I reached the hall in time. When my turn came and I started, my heartbeat increased and my mouth went dry. I wasn’t even able to read the words on the paper properly. I had no idea where I was standing and what I was talking. That was the day when I  ______ 15 ______  my biggest weakness: public speaking. After I finished, I met with the chairman and  ______ 16 ______  what happened to me. He said that this happens to everyone. It is very  ______ 17 ______. He suggested that I should come again the next week. I  ______ 18 ______  a talk carefully. This time when I gave the talk, I was somewhat comfortable but not confident (自信的). Afterwards, I met with the chairman again and told him about the improvement I  ______ 19 ______  I had made. He was kind enough to invite me again. For around one month, I practiced a lot for my talk. This time I was feeling comfortable and both the chairman and my neighbors thought I did a good job. I learned that everything is  ______ 20 ______  if we take the first step, as the saying goes: A journey of thousand miles begins with the first step.

questions.prompt: My brother bought a toy as birthday present.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的哥哥给我买了一个玩具作为我的生日礼物。 考查代词辨析。分析第一空可知，此处构成buy sb sth短语，用于动词后需用人称代词宾格形式，排除C和D；又因为此处表达“我的哥哥给我买了一个玩具作为我的生日礼物”，排除A，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What are you going to wear ______  the show? —A yellow shirt, blue jeans and trainers.
questions.explanation: 句意：---你要穿什么来演出？----一件黄色衬衫，蓝色牛仔裤和运动鞋。A. for为了；B. with与……一起；C. as作；D. from来自。for表示目的，可以理解为“为了这场演出”，答案为A。

questions.prompt: — is the Amazon River? —Some experts say it’s 7,025 kilometers long but others say it’s 6,440 kilometers long.
questions.explanation: 句意：——亚马逊河有多长？——一些专家说它7025千米长但是其他专家说它6440千米长。 考查特殊疑问句。How far多远；How soon多久；How much多少钱/多少；How long多长。分析答语可知，此处是在回答长度，故选D。

questions.prompt: 一Must I come at 6: 30 tomorrow morning? —No,you needn’t. You come one hour later.
questions.explanation: 句意：-明天早上我必须6点半来吗？-不，你不需要。你可以晚来一个小时。can能，可以；need需要；should应该；must必须。根据句意可知，说话人可以晚来一个小时，故应选A。

questions.prompt: I tried calling you, your phone was out of service.
questions.explanation: 句意：我试着给你打电话，但你的电话不在服务区。 A. and和，而且；B. but但是；C. so因此；D. or或者，否则。结合语境可知，前后句表示转折关系，故答案为B。

questions.prompt: Chiang Mai (清迈) has been one of tourist places for Chinese since the movie Lost in Thailand (《泰囧》) was shown.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从电影《泰囧》被播出后，清迈已经成为中国人们最热门的旅游胜地之一。考查形容词最高级。one of+the+形容词的最高级表示……最之一，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Where is your brother? —He isn’t at home. He back in three days.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你哥哥在哪里？——他不在家。他三天后回来。 考查时态。will come一般将来时；comes一般现在时三单；coming动名词或现在分词形式；come动词原形。分析句子可知，句中有时间状语“in three days”表将来，所以此处应用一般将来时，故选A。

questions.prompt: I saw Ken in the meeting room, and he Joe for the school magazine.
questions.explanation: 句意：我看见肯在会议室里，并且他正在为学校杂志采访乔。 考查时态。interviews一般现在时三单；interview一般现在时（动词原形）；has interviewed现在完成时；was interviewing过去进行时。分析句子可知，句中有谓语动词“saw”表示过去时，所以此处也应选择过去时间；又因为此处表达“看见肯的时候，他正在采访乔”，所以用过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Hello. May I speak to Mary? —Sorry. She to museum just now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好。我可以和玛丽说话吗？——抱歉。她刚才去博物馆了。 考查时态。go动词原形；went一般过去时；goes一般现在时三单；will go一般将来时。分析句子可知，句中有时间状语“just now”翻译为“刚才”，表示过去时，所以此处应用一般过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: ----Would you like to watch the three-D film Titanic with me? ----Certainly. I don’t mind seeing it again although I  ______  it twice.
questions.explanation: 句意：你愿意和我一起看三维电影《泰坦尼克号》吗？----当然可以。我不介意再看一遍，尽管我已经看了两遍了。考查动词的时态用法。根据句意及句末的twice，可知这个片子我已经看过两次，不涉及过去时间，因此用现在完成时。故选C。

questions.prompt: A baby's first month birthday is a special event in China and ______ with a special party.
questions.explanation: 句意“在中国，小孩满月是一个特别的事件，并且会用一个特别的派对来庆祝”。A.一般现在时；B.一般现在时的被动语态；C.一般过去时的被动语态；D.一般将来时。本句话中，主语为A baby's first month birthday，与谓语celebrate之间为被动关系，用被动语态，排除A和D；且本句话描述的是一个客观事实，用一般现在时的被动语态，故选B。

questions.prompt: –I’m going to buy a car. Any advice, Charlie? -- Well, it depends on  ______. If money isn’t a problem, you can buy a BMW.
questions.explanation: 句意：―我要买车。查理，有什么建议吗？―哦，这取决于你能够负担多少钱。如果钱不是问题，你可以买一辆宝马。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句要用陈述句语序，A和B是疑问句语序，故排除；C. how much you can afford你可以负担多少钱；D. where you are driving你开去哪儿。根据后句“如果钱不是问题”，可以推测出前面谈论的是钱，故选C。 完形填空。 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 When I was a small boy, something happened to me that made me never put any wild creature in a cage. We lived near a forest, and every evening the mockingbird would come and ______ 13 ______. I decided to catch a young ______ 14 ______ and keep it in a cage, and in this way, I would have my own private musician. Then I succeeded in catching one and put it in a cage. At first, the bird was ______ 15 ______, so it fluttered (扑腾) in the cage. But finally it was used to living in its new home. I felt very excited with myself and look forward to some beautiful singing. On the second day, the little bird’s mother flew to the cage with ______ 16 ______ in her mouth. The baby bird ate everything. I was ______ 17 ______ to see this. Certainly the mother bird knew how to feed her baby better than I did. The following morning when I went to see my bird, I found it ______ 18 ______ on the floor of the cage. I was terribly surprised and sad! What had happened? Arthur Wayne, a famous biologist, happened to ______ 19 ______ my father at that time. After she knew my story, she explained to me, “A mother mockingbird, finding her young in a cage, will sometimes bring it poison berries. She thinks it better for her baby to die than to lose ______ 20 ______.” Since then I have never caught any living creature and put it in a cage. All living things have a right to live free.

questions.prompt: You should be patient and do not  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：你应该耐心点，不要轻易放弃。 give up是“动词+副词”短语，人称代词要放在动词和副词之间，用give it up；修饰动词短语要用副词，easily是副词，意为“容易”。故选D。 【点睛】“动词+副词”短语若与名词连用，名词放在副词前后均可；若与代词连用，代词放在副词之前。常见的这类短语有：put on穿上；put up抬起，举起；张贴；cut down砍倒；give up放弃；find out找出；查明（事实的真相）；look up查找；pick up捡起，拾起；用车去接……；ring up打电话；take off脱下；take away 带走；turn on打开；turn off关上；think over 仔细考虑；等等。

questions.prompt: The best way  ______  English is doing more practice.
questions.explanation: 句意：最好的学习英语的方法是多做练习。 考查动词不定式做定语。不定式作定语表示具体的将要进行的动作，The best way to learn English：最好的学习英语的方法；故选C。

questions.prompt: ______ clever the boy is!
questions.explanation: 句意：这个男孩多么聪明啊！感叹句的基本结构：How＋形容词/副词＋主语＋谓语+其它! What+（a/an）＋(形容词)＋名词＋主语+谓语+其它！clever是形容词，the boy是主语，is是谓语，符合How＋形容词/副词＋主语＋谓语+其它！故答案为A。 【点睛】判断感叹句是由what还是how引导的方法：首先，断句。从句子后面向前看，找到“主语+谓语+其它”部分，把句子断开；其次，观察。观察句子前面剩余部分为名词（词组），还是形容词或副词；再次，加词。若是名词（词组），那么本句是由what（a/an）引导；若是形容词或副词，那么本句就由how 引导。

questions.prompt: What do you think of Mr. Green? I find  ______  difficult to work with him.
questions.explanation: 句意：你认为Mr. Green怎么样？我发现和他共事很难。 考查it作形式宾语。this这；them他们；it它；that那。根据题干中“I find  ______  difficult to work with him.”可推出此处用it作形式宾语，真正的宾语是动词不定式“to work with him”。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  have you been here in Beijing? —Since last month.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你已经到北京这儿多长时间了？——从上个月以来。 考查疑问词组辨析。How often多久一次，对频度进行提问；How soon多久以后，用于一般将来时；How far多远，对距离进行提问；How long多长时间，对时间段进行提问。根据答句“Since last month.”表示从上个月到现在这个时间段，用How long提问。故选D。

questions.prompt: Students really like to practice  ______  English with foreigners.
questions.explanation: 句意：学生们真的喜欢和外国人练习英语口语。 考查形容词作定语。四个选项都有“说”的意思。speak动词原形；spoken动词的过去分词，也作形容词，意为“口头的，口语的”；speaks动词的第三人称单数形式；to speak动词过去式。spoken English意为“英语口语”。故选B。

questions.prompt: ______ the man is very old,  ______ he has never stopped studying.
questions.explanation: 句意：尽管这个人年纪非常大，但他从未停止学习。 考查从属连词。though尽管；but但是；and和。根据句意“ ______ 这个人年纪非常大， ______ 他从未停止学习”可知句子前后是让步关系，用though引导让步状语从句。though不与but和and连用。故选C。

questions.prompt: I don’t know  ______ read the information on the computer screen.
You won’t succeed  ______  you work harder than before.
questions.explanation: 句意：除非你比以前工作更努力，否则你将不会成功。 考查连词辨析。if如果，连词；whether是否，连词；unless除非，连词；why为什么，副词。根据句意“你将不会成功， ______ 你比以前工作更努力”可知工作更努力是取得成功的条件，用unless连接条件状语从句表示“除非，如果不”。故选C。

questions.prompt: You have made  ______  mistakes. You are  ______  careless.
questions.explanation: 句意：你已经犯了太多错，你太粗心大意了。 考查短语辨析。much too太……，后接形容词或副词；many too错误搭配；too much太多，后接不可数名词；too many太多，后接可数名词。根据题干中“mistakes”可知第一空用too many；根据题干中“careless”可知第二空用much too。故选D。

questions.prompt: He was  ______  happy  ______  he couldn’t help laughing.
questions.explanation: 句意：他很高兴以至于忍不住笑了起来。too+adj+to do意为“太…以至于不能”，to后要加动词原形，不能用在此句中，排除A，没有too…that结构，排除D。such…that和so…that均意为“如此…以至于”，但用法有区别，such后面可以接单数可数名词，复数可数名词，不可数名词，so后面可接“形容词，副词或分词，本句中happy“开心的”是一个形容词，用so…that结构，故选C。

questions.prompt: The old man doesn’t hear very well. There is  ______  with his ears.
questions.explanation: 句意：哪位老人听力非常不好，他的耳朵有些毛病。 考查不定代词及形容词的位置。anything任何事物，常用语疑问句和否定句；something某事，常用语肯定句；wrong有毛病的。根据题干中“There is  ______  with his ears.”可知句子是肯定句，用不定代词something；形容词修饰不定代词时要放在不定代词之后。故选B。

questions.prompt: ______  you read,  ______  you’ll be.
My sister will come to see me tomorrow. I’ll meet  ______  at the airport.
questions.explanation: 句意：我姐姐明天会来看我。我会去机场见她。 考查人称代词。you你；him他；her她；them他们。根据前文，可知此处是指“My sister”，应该用第三人称，且是女生，故选C。
