questions.prompt: Mrs. Green often goes to work  ______  8:00 in the morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：格林太太经常在早晨8点去上班。 考查介词。of……的；in用于世纪、年、季节、月份等前；on用于具体日期前；at用于具体时刻前。根据横线后为具体时刻点，可知其前时间介词用at，故选D。 【点睛】时间介词in和on都可以用于morning, afternoon, evening前，其区别在于：in放在泛指的早晨、下午、晚上之前，如in the morning；on用于具体的某个早晨、下午、晚上之前，比如被具体日期修饰或其他限定词修饰，如on a cold morning。

questions.prompt: —  ______  are these apples? — $3.99.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些苹果多少钱？——3.99美元。 考查特殊疑问词。How long多长时间；How much多少钱；How heavy多重；How big多大。根据下文是价钱，可知上文是询问苹果的价格，故选B。

questions.prompt: —  ______  I finish the work tonight? — No, you needn’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我必须今晚完成这个工作吗？——不，没必要。 考查情态动词。Can可以；Must必须；Shall将；Could可以，can的过去时或委婉语气。根据否定答语为“needn’t”没必要，可知上文是用must提问，故选B。 【点睛】用情态动词must提问，肯定回答用must；否定回答用needn’t或don’t/doesn’t have to，意为“没必要”，注意千万不能用mustn’t，意为“禁止”。

questions.prompt: I am very proud that Beijing is one of cities in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：我非常骄傲北京是世界上最大的城市之一。考查形容词的最高级。“one of the +形容词最高级+名词复数”：最……之一，结合比较范围in the world可知修饰名词的形容词使用最高级，故选D。

questions.prompt: Get up early, ______ you’ll be late for school.
questions.explanation: 句意：早点起床，否则你会上学迟到。考查祈使句+and/or+陈述句，祈使句相当于条件状语从句，后面陈述句表示结果。（1）“祈使句，+and + 陈述句”该句型表示如果做到了祈使句表示的事情，就会有后面句子表示的结果。（2）祈使句，+ or + 陈述句该句型表示如果不做到祈使句表示的事情，就会有后面句子表示的结果。根据句意及语境此题应选C。

questions.prompt: It was sunny last Sunday. My family ______  a picnic in the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：上个周日是晴天。我们一家去公园野餐了。 考查动词时态。have一般现在时；had一般过去时；has had现在完成时；will have一般将来时。根据上文“It was sunny last Sunday”，可知用一般过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: Be quiet. Grandma  ______  in her bedroom now.
questions.explanation: 句意：安静。祖母现在正在卧室睡觉呢。 考查动词时态。sleeps一般现在时；will sleep一般将来时；is sleeping现在进行时；was sleeping过去进行时。根据时间状语“now”，可知用现在进行时be doing，故选C。

questions.prompt: — Hi, Alice. I called you at 9 o’clock last night. But you didn’t answer. — Sorry. I  ______  a shower at that time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——嗨，爱丽丝。我昨晚九点给你打电话了。但是你没接。——抱歉。我当时正在洗澡。 考查动词时态。was taking过去进行时；am taking现在进行时；take一般现在时；will take一般将来时。根据上文的时间“at 9 o’clock last night”，可知用过去进行时was/were doing，故选A。

questions.prompt: It’s glad to see you again. We  ______  each other since 2017.
questions.explanation: 句意：很高兴再次见到你。我们自2017年就再没见过面了。 考查动词时态。won’t see一般将来时；don’t see一般现在时；haven’t seen现在完成时；didn’t see一般过去时。根据后文的since，可知是现在完成时的标志词，故选C。 【点睛】since引导时间状语从句，表示“自从”，通常主句用现在完成时，从句用一般过去时。

questions.prompt: A new car parking  ______  near our community in 2020.
questions.explanation: 句意：2020年我们社区附近将新建一个停车场。 考查时态和语态。will be built一般将来时，被动语态；will build一般将来时，主动语态；is building现在进行时，主动语态；built一般过去时，主动语态。根据时间状语“in 2020”，可知用一般将来时，所以排除CD；根据主语“A new car parking”是谓语动词build的承受者，应该用被动语态，故选A。 【点睛】一般将来时的被动语态形式为：will be done或be going to be done。

questions.prompt: — Could you tell me  ______? — She lives in Nanjing.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我玛丽住在哪儿吗？——她住在南京。 考查宾语从句。根据宾语从句的语序为陈述语序，AB选项为疑问语序，排除；根据上文提问的could为委婉语气，主句是一般现在时，从句根据语境，可知是用一般现在时，故选D。 【点睛】宾语从句的时态原则如下：主现从不限；主过从必过；真理永一现。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 “Paul must have been trying to carry his waste paper to garbage can and dropped a few pieces.” I  ______ 13 ______  picking them up one by one. However, I found more pieces a few moments later. No quiet complaining this time. I called out instead, “Who is throwing garbage?” No answer. As a result, I saw more bits of paper quietly flying down from upstairs. Looking up, I saw my seven-year-old son, Paul. “Stop making a mess anymore!” “It’s not a mess. They’re  ______ 14 ______.” “Sorry, what did you say?” I didn’t hear him clearly. He didn’t answer me. In fact, I was surprised indeed. Paul has autism (自闭症) and  ______ 15 ______  answers a question, especially when he’s focused attentively on something else. He ran down the stairs. “Where are my other butterflies?” he asked, looking around. Every time Paul  ______ 16 ______  five or more words together, my heart says a lot of thanks. Lately he seems to realize that the benefits of making sentences when communicating are worthy. “Butterflies, Of course.” I rushed to save them from the garbage, ______ 17 ______  them off and handed them to my young artist. “Want to see them fly again?” he asked with a shy smile. “Oh yes! They’re beautiful.” I whispered. He ran back upstairs quickly to fly his  ______ 18 ______  down again. They really did look like beautiful butterflies flying in the sky. That day, I said thanks to my son. Because Paul reminded me to look up at something  ______ 19 ______  instead of down at garbage. How many other artworks do I  ______ 20 ______ because I’m too caught up in my housework to take time to see what’s right in front of me? Life is not what happens to us. It’s how we look at it. Now, I look up often.

questions.prompt: Alex and Tom are brothers.  ______  often help their father wash the car.
questions.explanation: 句意：亚历克斯和汤姆是兄弟。他们经常帮助父亲洗车。 I我，you你，we我们，they他们。此处代指Alex and Tom故用代词they。故选D。

questions.prompt: I walk to the street corner and wait  ______  the school bus.
questions.explanation: 句意：我走到街拐角，等校车。 to向，for为了，at在，in在…..里。wait for sb/sth等某人或某物，wait at+地点，在某地等。此处表示等校车，故用wait for。故选B。

questions.prompt: — ______  did you do yesterday, Mary? —I went to the park to fly kites with my parents.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽，你昨天去做什么了？我和父母一起去公园放风筝了。 When何时，对时间提问；How 如何，对方式提问；What什么，对事物提问；Why为什么，对原因提问。根据I went to the park to fly kites with my parents.可知此处对做的事提问，故用疑问词what。故选C。

questions.prompt: Would you like to go to the museum with me? I’d love to,  ______  I’m afraid I have no time.
questions.explanation: 句意：你想要和我一起去看电影吗？我想要去，但是我恐怕没有时间。 but但是，and而且，or或者，so所以。根据句意，前半句表示想要去，后半句表示没有时间，前后表示转折关系，故用连词but。故选A。

questions.prompt: Must we leave the library before 5 o’clock? No, you  ______. You can stay here until 5:30.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们必须在5点钟之前离开图书馆吗？——不，你不必。你可以一直待到5点30分。 needn't不必，can’t不可能，mustn’t禁止，shouldn’t不应该。Must we……?“我们必须……吗？”肯定回答为: Yes, you must. 否定回答为:No, you needn’t.或No, you don’t have to.根据No可知此处用否定回答，故选A。

questions.prompt: Tony is my cousin. He is two years ______  than me.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼是我的表弟。他比我大两岁。 old年老的，older年长的，oldest最老的。根据than可知此处用比较级，故用older。故选B。

questions.prompt: Sun Li is a kind girl. She often  ______  the people in trouble.
questions.explanation: 句意：孙俪是一位善良的女孩。她经常帮助有麻烦的人。 根据often可知此处用一般现在时，主语she是第三人称单数，故谓语用第三人称单数helps。故选B。

questions.prompt: Lucy, why didn’t you come to the party yesterday? I  ______  my little sister at home.
questions.explanation: 句意：露西，你为什么昨天没有来参加聚会？我在家照顾我小妹妹。 根据yesterday可知此处用一般过去时，故用looked after。故选A。

questions.prompt: Tom, where is your mum? Oh, she  ______  in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，你妈妈在哪里？——哦，她正在厨房做饭。 根据where is your mum?可知此处询问你妈妈现在正在哪里，故用现在进行时be doing，故选C。

questions.prompt: Andrew likes English. He  ______  it for eight years.
questions.explanation: 句意：安德鲁喜欢英语。他学习它已经八年了。 根据时间段for eight years可知与时间段连用，故用现在完成过时has learned。故选C。

questions.prompt: The 24th Winter Olympic Games  ______  in Beijing and Zhangjiakou in 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：2022年第24届冬季奥运会将在北京和张家口举行。 根据in 2022可知此处用一般将来时，主语The 24th Winter Olympic Games与谓语hold之间是被动关系，故此处用一般将来时的被动语态，故为will be held。故选D。

questions.prompt: Nobody knows  ______  yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：没有人知道昨天事故是如何发生的。 根据yesterday可知此处用一般过去时，故排除BC两项。作为动词knows的宾语从句，故用陈述语序：疑问词+主语+谓语+宾语，故选A。 二、完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 A Bottle of Milk I recently heard a story about a very famous research scientist who was interviewed by a newspaper reporter. He was asked why he was able to be so much more  ______ 13 ______  than the other person. He said that it all came from an  ______ 14 ______  with his mother when he was young. He tried to remove a bottle of milk from the bridge when he lost his hold on the bottle, spilling the milk all over the kitchen floor! Instead of  ______ 15 ______  at him, his mother said, “Robert, what a great and beautiful mess you have made! I have never seen such a huge pool of milk. Well, the damage has already been done. Would you like to  ______ 16 ______  with the milk for a few minutes before we clean it up?” Indeed, Robert played it. After a few minutes, his mother said, “Robert, Whenever you make a mess like this, you have to clean it up. So we would use a sponge (海绵), a towel or a mop. Which do you prefer?” He  ______ 17 ______  the sponge and together they cleaned up the spilled milk. His mother then said, “You know, what we have here is a difficult experiment in how effectively to carry a big milk bottle with two tiny hands. Now, let’s  ______ 18 ______  a way to carry it without dropping it.” The little boy learned that if he grasped the bottle at the top neat the lip with both hands, he could carry it  ______ 19 ______. The scientist then said that it was at that moment that he knew he didn’t need to be afraid to make  ______ 20 ______  and he’d like to try a lot of things in different ways. Wouldn’t it be great if all parents would follow the example of Robert’s mother?

questions.prompt: Jim is a very kind boy. We all like  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：吉姆是个非常善良的男孩。我们都喜欢他。考查人称代词宾格。A. me我；B. him他；C. her她；D. you你，你们。根据句意可知本词指代前文提到的Jim，第三人称单数，男孩，可知使用him指代；故选B。

questions.prompt: I have dancing classes every Saturday. They start  ______  8 o’clock.
questions.explanation: 句意：我每个星期六都上舞蹈课。舞蹈课8点开始。 考查时间介词。A. at指“某一具体时刻（即几点几分时）”或表示“在中午、在夜晚、在周末”时或很短的时间；例如，at six/at that time/at night/at the moment；B. on“在具体的某一天”或“（在具体的某一天的）早上、中午、晚上”；例如，on May 10th 1982，on a rainy morning； C. in在较长的时间里用介词in，例如，在某年/月/季节/在某世纪/在某年代或特定世纪某年代/在早上、下午、晚上等（in 1967/in May/in winter/in the eighteenth century/in 1970s’/in the morning）；表示“从现在起一段时间以后，须用介词in；即“in+时间段”，要用于一般将来时；D. to：到，朝。本句指在“8点钟”， 指“某一具体时刻（即几点几分时）”，故用介词at；选A。

questions.prompt: We didn’t enjoy the day  ______  the weather was so bad.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们不喜欢这一天，因为天气太糟糕了。 考查连词辨析。if如果，表条件；but但是，表转折；or或者，表选择；because因为，表原因。分析前后句可知，两句话构成因果关系，此处表示原因。故选D。

questions.prompt: — ______  do you play tennis? —Once a week.
questions.explanation: 句意：----你多久打一次网球？-----一周一次。考查特殊疑问句。A. How soon多久，多长时间，询问再过多长时间做某事，一般用于一般将来时；B. How often多久一次，多长时间一次，询问“做某事”的频度；C. How much多少，询问不可数名词的数量；D. How many多少，询问可数名词的数量。根据回答“一周一次”可知询问“打网球的频度”；故选B。

questions.prompt: Excuse me, sir, you  ______  smoke in the forest. It's dangerous.
questions.explanation: 句意：对不起，先生，你不能在森林里抽烟。这很危险。考查情态动词。A. wouldn’t将不，一般过去时；B. couldn’t不能，一般过去时；C. mustn’t禁止，不可；D. needn’t不必要。根据下文It's dangerous.是一般现在时，可知此句时态是一般现在时。结合句意可知填mustn’t；选C。

questions.prompt: —Which is  ______  season to visit Yuyuantan Park? —Spring. It's fantastic.
questions.explanation: 句意：-----参观玉渊潭公园的最佳季节是哪一个？-----春天。它太漂亮了。考查形容词最高级。一年有四个季节，可知使用最高级；good好的，比较级better，最高级best，形容词最高级前使用定冠词the；故选D。

questions.prompt: — Mum, my friends and I  ______  to the cinema tonight. —Oh, lovely! I hope you enjoy the film!
questions.explanation: 句意：----妈妈，我和朋友今晚要去看电影。----哦，太好了！希望你喜欢这部电影！考查句子时态。A. go一般现在时；B. will go一般将来时；C. went 一般过去时；D. have gone现在完成时。根据时间“tonight今晚”可知此句时态是一般将来时；故选B。

questions.prompt: If it  ______  sunny tomorrow, we will have a picnic near the river.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果明天天气晴朗，我们将在河边野餐。考查条件状语从句的时态。If引导的条件状语从句，主语一般使用一般将来时，从句使用一般现在时。本从句的主语it第三人称单数，可知谓语动词使用单数，可知填is；故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  Sarah since she moved to England.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从莎拉搬到英国后，我就没见过她。考查句子时态。A. won’t see一般将来时；B. didn't see一般过去时；C. haven't seen现在完成时；D. wasn't seeing过去进行时。since：自从……以来，后面跟过去的时间点或一般过去时的从句，表示自从…以来，表示一段时间，谓语动词是延续性动词，句子时态一般使用现在完成时；根据时间状语从句since she moved to England可知此句时态使用现在完成时；故答案是C。

questions.prompt: When the telephone rang, I  ______  cookies.
questions.explanation: 句意：电话铃响时，我正在做饼干。考查句子时态。A. make一般现在时；B. made 一般过去时；C. will make一般将来时；D. was making过去进行时。本句是when引导的时间状语从句，when引导的时间状语从句，从句一般使用一般过去时，主句使用过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Mr. Smith's first book  ______  ten years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：----史密斯先生的第一本书十年前出版了。考查一般过去时的被动语态。A. published一般过去时；B. publishes一般现在时；C. is published一般现在时的被动语态；D. was published一般过去时的被动语态。根据时间状语ten years ago可知此句是一般过去时，根据句意可知主语是动词的受动者，可知此句是被动语态，故此句是一般过去时的被动语态；故选D。

questions.prompt: —Tom, can you tell me  ______  to Lao She Tea House tomorrow? —By subway
questions.explanation: 句意：------汤姆，你能告诉我明天怎么去老舍茶馆吗？-----坐地铁。考查宾语从句。根据宾语从句时间tomorrow可知宾语从句时态是一般将来时；B和D是一般过去时，故B和D排除；A和C是一般将来时，但宾语从句语序是陈述语序，A疑问句语序，C是陈述语序，可知选C。 【点睛】本题旨在考查宾语从句这一语法，做这类题时，要从三方面考虑：一、选准连接词（引导词）； 二、连接词后紧跟从句的主语（注意主谓一致等）； 三、若主句是过去时，从句要改为相对应的过去的某种时态（如果从句表达的是事实或真理、自然规律，从句时态是一般现在时）；四、主句是一般现在时，从句可以各种时态；五、需用陈述语序。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 Little Boxes of Chocolates Even though thirteen years had passed, it seemed like only yesterday when Dad was handing out those little boxes of chocolates to each of his sweethearts. Valentine's Day was my father's holiday My sisters and I learned early to be good on that day. We  ______ 13 ______ waited a long time for Dad to get home and then quickly lined up like good little soldiers as he gave each child a small, heart-shaped box, holding some chocolates. It caused  ______ 14 ______ reactions (反应)as we went through the periods in life. In the elementary school years, we would rush home and wait for Dad. In junior high, we felt a little embarrassed(尴尬的). In high school, we thought we were too cool to be rushing home. However, we were still comforted knowing that Dad was home waiting for us with his special  ______ 15 ______. My sisters and I thought the only way we would ever get out of this tradition was to move out of the house. We were ______ 16 ______. Even after we all moved out of the house, when Valentine's Day came, there was a little box of chocolates waiting for each of us. So we still made the trip over to  ______ 17 ______  it. When Mum passed away, we thought this whole tradition would disappear gradually. Wrong again. Grandchildren entered the picture and were also  ______ 18 ______  in this tradition from the day they were born. One year, everything changed. In that February, Valentine's Day ______ 19 ______ on Dad's bowling night, so he handed out the chocolates a day early. Then, Valentine's Day arrived. I was watching TV when the phone rang. It was the hospital. Dad had a heart attack, and he didn't make it. A few years later after his death, we finally went through the hard time and began ______ 20 ______ again. And come February, when those little heart-shaped boxes of chocolates appear in store windows. Dad's tradition lives on my heart.

questions.prompt: Mary is good at English. ______ studies English by watching English movies.
questions.explanation: 句意：玛丽擅长英语。她通过看英语电影学习英语。 本题考查代词。She她，He他，They他们，We我们。此处代指Mary，用代词she，故选A。

questions.prompt: Chinese people always admire the full moon ______ the Mid-Autumn night.
questions.explanation: 句意：在中秋节夜晚中国人总是赏月。 根据考查介词。in+年/月，表示在某年或某月；at+钟点，表示在几点钟；on+具体日期，表示在具体的某一天；表示在某一天的上午、下午或晚上，用介词on。for+时间段，表示长达多长时间。此处接the Mid-Autumn night.，表示在中秋节的晚上，用介词on。故选C。

questions.prompt: The Spring Festival ______ the Dragon Boat Festival are both traditional Chinese festivals.
questions.explanation: 句意：春节和端午节都是中国传统的节日。 本题考查连词。but但是，and而且，or或者，so所以。谓语are是复数形式，因此用and连接并列主语，故选B。

questions.prompt: -- ______ is Chinese clay art famous? --Because the clay pieces look very real.
questions.explanation: 句意：——为什么中国陶艺出名？——因为陶瓷作品看起来非常真实。 本题考查特殊疑问句。What什么，Where哪里，Why为什么，He他。根据Because the clay pieces look very real.可知，此处对原因提问，因此用疑问词why。故选C。

questions.prompt: --We plan to fly kites in the park. Can you go with us? --Sorry，I  ______.I have to prepare for the math test.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们计划在公园放风筝。你可以和我们一起去吗？——对不起，我不可以。我必须为数学考试做准备。 本题考查情态动词。can't不可以，can能，mustn’t禁止，must必须。根据I have to prepare for the math test.可知，我必须为数学考试做准备，因此我不可以去公园放风筝，故选A。

questions.prompt: Tony studies much ______ than he did in Grade Eight.
questions.explanation: 句意：托尼比在八年级的时候学习更努力了。 本题考查形容词。hard是副词原级；harder是副词的比较级；hardest是副词的最高级。根据than此处用比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: My mother used to watch TV at night, but now she often ______ books with me.
questions.explanation: 句意：我母亲过去常常在晚上看电视，但是现在她经常和我一起读书。 本题考查时态。reads是一般现在时的第三人称单数形式；is reading是现在进行时；read是一般现在时的复数形式；has read是现在完成时。根据often此处用一般现在时，主语she是第三人称单数形式，谓语用第三人称单数形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: If I have time this Sunday, I  ______ to the zoo with my friends.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果我这周日有时间，我会和朋友一起去动物园。 本题考查时态。go是一般现在时；went是一般过去时；have gone是现在完成时；will go是一般将来时。根据if引导的条件状语从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: --What were you doing when the rainstorm came? --We ______ an English class.
questions.explanation: 句意：——当暴雨来临的时候，你们正在做什么？——我们正在上英语课。 本题考查时态。have是一般现在时；had是一般过去时；are having是现在进行时；were having是过去进行时。根据What were you doing此处用过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: I ______ Ne Zha twice since it came out.
questions.explanation: 句意：《哪吒》上映以来，我看了两遍。 本题考查时态。am watching是现在进行时；have watched是现在完成时；watch是一般现在时；watched是一般过去时。根据since引导的时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时，故选B。

questions.prompt: Nowadays, the song My Motherland and Me ______ by people everywhere in China.
questions.explanation: 句意：现在，中国各地的人们都在唱《我和我的祖国》这首歌。 本题考查时态和语态。will be sung一般将来时的被动形式；will sing是一般将来时的主动形式；is sung是一般现在时的被动形式；sings是一般现在时的主动形式。根据by people此处用被动形式，根据nowadays此处用一般现在时，故选C。

questions.prompt: --Could you please tell me ______? ---It's at the east gate of the park.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能告诉我停车场在哪里吗?——在公园的东门。 本题考查宾语从句。此处作为宾语从句，用陈述语序：疑问词+主语+谓语+宾语，排除AB两项。根据It’s at the east gate of the park.此处表示客观事实，因此用一般现在时，故选D。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文,掌握其大意,然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中,选择最佳选项。 I used to consider being a line leader as something embarrassing.I felt ______ 13 ______ when I thought of having my classmates stare at the back of my head. Finally, it came.Waking up that morning, I tried not to think about it.I never considered myself much of a ______ 14 ______ or one to have such qualities, but little did I know I was wrong.As I was getting off the bus, I had that butterfly feeling in my stomach. I quietly sat down at my desk.I was ______ 15 ______ my teacher wouldn't notice me and maybe she would forget it was my day.When she announced that I was today's leader, I was terrified She asked everyone to line up behind me and announced that we would be going to the library.I ______ 16 ______ exactly where the library was. “This will be easy,” I said to myself. I turned off the lights, and headed to the library."Hey, this is kind of ______ 17 ______! I thought to myself.I felt surprisingly good to be in front and have control.I would never let myself forget that day. After I left primary school, it was off to the middle school where many leadership ______ 18 ______ waited for me.On the first day of the 7th grade, I organized a discussion about what class rules to follow.The next year,I was voted as head of the Birthday committee, where I showed my sense of leadership off to the other members. My leadership qualities ______ 19 ______ me outside of school.In the soccer field, I gave a speech about how I thought I would be a great captain I was voted captain, which gave me even more ______ 20 ______ and made me feel that with my leadership, I could do anything.

questions.prompt: I lost my student card. I’m looking for  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的学生证丢了。我正在找它。考查代词辨析题。look for寻找，需接宾格代词做宾语。her她；him他；it它；you你。前句宾语card（卡片）是物，后文提到需用指物代词it代替。根据句意语境，可知选C。

questions.prompt: In most western countries, Thanksgiving is  ______  the fourth Thursday of November.
questions.explanation: 句意：在大多数西方国家，感恩节在十一月的第四个星期四。 on在具体的某一天；at在具体的时间点；to到……；in泛指在上午、下午或晚上，在年代、月份前。空后the fourth Thursday of November指的是具体的一天，应用介词on。故选A。

questions.prompt: There were few doctors then,  ______  Bethune had to work hard on his own.
questions.explanation: 句意：那时医生很少，因此白求恩不得不独自努力工作。 and和，而且，表示并列或承接；but但是，表示转折；or或者，表示选择；否则；so因此，所以。根据句意可知，空后这句话表示前面造成的结果。故选D。

questions.prompt: Steven Maraski  ______ in our school since he came to China.
questions.explanation: 句意：Steven Maraski自从来到中国就一直在我们学校教书。 teaches教，第三人称单数形式；taught是teach的过去式或过去分词形式；was teaching过去进行时；has taught现在完成时。根据句意和句中的时间状语since he came to China可知，该句应用现在完成时态。故选D。

questions.prompt: -Sir, you cannot park here. See the sign “No parking” over there? – Sorry, I ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——先生，你不可以在这里停车。看到那边“禁止停车”的标牌了吗？——对不起，我没有注意到。 won’t notice不会注意，一般将来时；didn’t notice一般过去时；don’t notice一般现在时；hadn’t noticed过去完成时。根据语境可知，说话人这时已经意识到了自己的错误，故“没有注意标牌”是说过去的事情了，应用一般过去时。故选B。

questions.prompt: —Nowadays, more and more people just focus on their mobile phones. —Why not  ______  with each other face to face instead of just  ______  at the phones?
questions.explanation: 句意：——现如今，越来越多的人只关注他们的手机。——为什么不面对面地互相交流来代替只是看手机呢？ communicate交流，动词原形；to communicate动词不定式；look看，动词原形；looking动名词或现在分词形式。第一个空前是句型Why not…?表示提建议，后面跟动词原形，故先排除B和D；第二个空位于instead of这一短语之后，应用动名词形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: —The math exam was so hard! —I  ______  you. I don’t think I could pass it.
questions.explanation: 句意：——数学考试如此难！——我同意你的说法。我认为我不会及格。 help with帮助某人某事；discuss with和某人讨论；agree with同意某人的话；disagree with不同意某人的话。根据下句话I don’t think I could pass it可知，说话人与上一个人的观点一致。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Hi. Tom, how was the basketball game? —Not too bad. Nathan  ______  to get 3 points and we won.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你好，Tom，篮球比赛怎么样？——还不错。Nathan设法得到了3分，我们赢了。 tried尽力去做某事，结果未知；managed设法做到某事；wanted想要；hoped希望。根据句意…and we won可知，Nathan做到了，应用句型manage to do sth.。故选B。

questions.prompt: It was  ______  interesting work  ______  everybody loved to do it.
questions.explanation: 句意：这是如此有趣的工作以至于每个人都喜欢做。 这个题目考查“如此……以至于……”的用法，他们的句型是：so+形容词或副词+that从句或so+形容词+a/an+可数名词单数+that从句；such +a/an+形容词+可数名词单数+that从句或such+形容词+可数名词复数或不可数名词+that从句。这句话中work是一个不可数名词，不能用不定冠词修饰，排除C和D。结合句型可知A不对，故选B。

questions.prompt: Confucius was a great teacher and thinker. Even now we  ______  by his ideas.
questions.explanation: 句意：孔子是一个伟大的老师和思想家。甚至现在我们还被他的想法所影响。 will influence将会影响，一般将来时；will be influenced将被影响，一般将来时的被动语态；influence影响，动词原形；are influenced一般现在时的被动语态。根据句意可知，主语we与动词构成被动关系，应用被动语态，先排除A和C。根据句中的时间状语Even now可知，应用一般现在时态。故选D。

questions.prompt: —I want to know if Maria  ______  us in the concert tonight. —If she  ______  her homework, she will.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我想知道Maria今天晚上是否加入我们一起看音乐会。——如果她完成了她的家庭作业，她会来的。 考查条件状语从句。joins加入，参加，第三人称单数形式；will join一般将来时态；finishes完成，第三人称单数形式；will finish一般将来时。根据句意可知，在第一句话中if意为“是否”，引导宾语从句，从句中表示将来的事情，应用一般将来时态，故先排除A和B；第二句话中if意为“如果”，引导条件状语从句，从句中用一般现在时态，主句用一般将来时。故选C。

questions.prompt: —Do you know  ______  the meeting room early? —She had a headache
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道Ann为什么早早地离开会议室吗？——她头痛。 why Ann left意为“Ann为什么离开”；B和D都是疑问语序，在宾语从句中应用陈述语序，故排除这两个选项；why Ann will leave中用了一般将来时。根据句意和下面的回答She had a headache可知，宾语从句表示的是过去的事情，应用一般过去时态。故选A。 完形填空 The homeless hero For many, finding an unattended (unnoticed) wallet filled with ￡400 in cash would be a source (来源) of temptation (诱惑). But the urge (strong desire) would no doubt be greater if you were living on the streets with little food and money. AU of this makes the actions of the homeless Tom Smith even more remarkable. After spotting (noticing) a  ______ 13 ______  on the front seat inside a parked car with its window down, he stood guard in the rain for about two hours waiting for the  ______ 14 ______  to return. After hours in the cold and wet, he  ______ 15 ______  inside and pulled the wallet out hoping to find some ID so he could contact the driver, only to discover it contained ￡400 in notes, with another ￡50 in spare change beside it. He then took the wallet to a nearby police station after  ______ 16 ______  a note behind to let the owner know it was safe. When the car’s owner John Anderson and his colleague Carol Lawrence returned to the car—which was itself worth ￡35,000—in Glasgow city center, they were shocked to find two policemen standing next to it. The policemen told them what Mr. Smith did and that the wallet was  ______ 17 ______. The pair were later able to thank Mr. Smith for his kindness. Mr. Anderson said, “I couldn’t believe that the guy never took a penny. To think he is sleeping on the streets tonight  ______ 18 ______  he could have stolen the money and paid for a place to stay in. This guy has nothing and yet he didn’t take the wallet for himself. He thought about others  ______ 19 ______. It’s unbelievable. It just proves there are honest guys out there.” Mr. Smith’s act drew much of the public’s attention He also won praise from social media users after Mr. Anderson posted about the act of kindness on Facebook. Now Mr Anderson has set up an online activity to  ______ 20 ______  money for Mr. Smith and other homeless people in the area, which by yesterday had received ￡8,000. “I think the faith that everyone has shown  ______ 21 ______  him has touched him. People have been approaching (coining near to) him in the street He’s had job offers and all sorts,” Mr. Anderson commented. For Mr. Smith, this is a possible life-changing  ______ 22 ______. The story once again tells us that one good turn deserves another.

questions.prompt: Daming is good at playing ______ piano although he is only ______ 18-year-old boy.
questions.explanation: 句意：大明擅长弹钢琴，尽管他只是一个18岁的男孩。 play+the+乐器，play the piano”弹钢琴”；第二空表示泛指，18 eighteen是以元音音素开头的，用不定冠词an。an eighteen-year-old boy “一位十八岁的男孩”。根据题意， 故选A。 【点睛】不定冠词的用法 不定冠词有两个，a 和 an。a用在辅音音素开头的单词前面；an用于以元音音素开头的单词前。如：a book, an apple。 定冠词在play后和乐器连用 play the piano弹钢琴 play the flute吹长笛

questions.prompt: —How many times ______ you ever ______ to the West Lake? —Only once.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你曾经去过西湖几次？——仅仅去过一次。 根据下文Only once.可知上文是说去过几次，用现在完成时，排除AB；A是一般现在时态；B是一般过去时态；have been to“去过”(已回来); have gone to“去了”(没有回来)，这里是去过几次用have been to..表示去过……。根据题意，故选C。 【点睛】have/has gone to: 意为“到某地去”，说话时该人不在现场，一般不用第一人称、第二人称代词作句子的主语。如： ①A：Where is Jim？—吉姆在哪里？ B：He has gone to England．—他去英国了。（尚未回来） ②Mr Wang isn't here．He has gone to Qingdao．王先生不在这里。他去青岛了。 have/has been to: 意为“曾经去过某地”，现在已不在那里了，后可接次数，如once，twice，three times等，表示“去过某地几次”，也可和 just，never，ever等连用，但不可与一段时间或表过去的具体时间连用。 如：My father has been to Beijing twice．我父亲去过北京两次。 I have never been to the Great Wall．我从未去过长城。 have/has been in: 表示“在某地呆了多少时间”，常与时间段状语连用。如： I have been in Shanghai for three years．我到上海已有三年了。 He has been in London for half a month．他来伦敦已有半个月了。

questions.prompt: —Could you please not speak so loudly? There is a baby  ______  in the next room. —Sorry. I won’t.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你说话可以不那么大声吗？隔壁有个正在睡觉的婴儿。——抱歉，我不再大声（说话）了。 A. sleep睡觉，原形；B. sleeping睡觉，现在分词；C. slept睡觉，一般过去式； D. to sleep睡觉，动词不定式。sleeping动名词是后置定语“正在睡觉”修饰前面的婴儿，根据题意，故选B。

questions.prompt: —What’s the population of your city? — ______ about 301,000.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你的城市的人口是多少？——（人口）大约是301，000。 A. They’re他们是；B. There is有；单数；C. It’s它是；D. There are有，复数；population是不可数名词，提问人口用it回答。用it代替。故选C。

questions.prompt: —The air is so fresh here. —Of course. ______ of the land in this area is covered with trees and grass.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这里的空气真新鲜。——当然，这个地区五分之三的土地上长满了树和草。 分数：分子用基数词，分母用序数词，分子大于一，分母加s。因此五分之三用three fifths来表示。 故选B。

questions.prompt: —Jim, don’t play computer games any more. You’re  ______ your time. —Sorry, Mom. I won’t do it again. A making
questions.explanation: 句意：——Jim，不要再玩游戏了。你在浪费时间。——抱歉，妈妈。我不再玩（游戏）了。 A. making使，制作；B. taking带去；C. breaking破坏；D. wasting浪费。根据上文Jim, don’t play computer games any more.可知下文说浪费你的的时间。故选D。

questions.prompt: Loud music and red chairs in the restaurants make people ______ fast.
questions.explanation: 句意：餐馆里喧闹的音乐和红色的椅子使人们吃得很快。 A. to eat吃，动词不定式；B. eating吃，现在分词；C. eat吃，原形；D. ate吃，过去式。短语make sb. do sth.表示使某人做某事。根据题意，故选C。

questions.prompt: Nowadays, many young people like living in the city ______ the old get used to  ______ in the countryside.
questions.explanation: 句意：目前，年轻人喜欢住在城里，然而老年人喜欢住在乡村。 when当……时候；because因为； until 直到；while然而，表示两者对比，轻微转折，前后句表示年轻人和老人的对比，因此第一个空格用while “然而”；get/be used to doing表示习惯于做某事，因此第二个空格填living。根据题意，故选A。

questions.prompt: Please check your paper to  ______  there are no mistakes.
questions.explanation: 句意：请再次检查试卷，确保没有错误 考查短语 think of“想起”;try on “试穿”;talk about“讨论...”; make sure “确信/确保”。这里是说再次检查，目的是确保没有错误。根据题意， 故选D。

questions.prompt: —Does she like singing English songs? —Yes. She ______ to sing English songs in her room.
questions.explanation: 句意：——她喜欢唱英文歌吗？——是的，人们经常听到她在房间里唱英文歌。 短语hear sb. do sth.表示听见某人做某事，改为被动语态，是sb. be heard to do sth.表示某人被听到去做某事；频度副词often在句中位于be动词，情态动词，词后面，行为动词之前；而且通过问句可知句子时态是一般现在时的被动语态。根据题意，故选B。

questions.prompt: When he got home, he found his pet dog ______ on the ground.
questions.explanation: 句意：当他回家时，他发现他的宠物小狗躺在地板上，快死了。 A. dieing错误分词变法；B. die死，原形；C. dying死，现在分词；D. death名词，死。短语find sb./sth. doing sth.表示发现某人/物正在做某事。根据题意，故选C。

questions.prompt: There are so many kinds of T-shirts in the shop. I really don’t know ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：商店里有许多种T恤衫。我真的不知道买哪一种。 A. where to buy it在哪里去买它；B. when to buy it何时去买它；C. which one to buy买哪一个；D. what to buy买什么。根据上文There are so many kinds of T-shirts in the shop有许多种类T恤衫，我不知道买哪一个，前面已经有范围，因此选择which。根据题意， 故选C。

questions.prompt: —Why did Tom go to bed so late yesterday? —Because his homework  ______ on time.
questions.explanation: 句意：句意：——为什么Tom昨晚睡得那么晚？——因为他的作业没有准时完成。 A. didn’t finish没有完成；一般过去时态；B. wasn’t finished被完成，一般过去时态的被动语态；C. finish完成，原形；D. finished完成，过去式。这里表示被动 wasn’t finished。主语是his homework，根据上文Why did Tom go to bed so late yesterday?可知下文是一般过去时态的被动语态，其结果是was/were done的形式。根据题意，故选B。

questions.prompt: —We haven’t seen each other for a long time. —Yes. It has been two years ______ we met last time.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我们很久没见面了。——对。自从我们上次见面已经两年了。 A. before在……之前；B. after在……之后；C. for为了；D. since自从。这里是since引导时间状语从句，主句是现在完成时，从句用一般过去式。根据题意，故选D。

questions.prompt: —Yesterday was my birthday. My father sent me a CD  ______ was made by TF Boys. —You must be very happy to receive it.
questions.explanation: 句意：昨天是我的生日。我父亲送给我一张由TF男孩制作的CD。 A. who关系词，先行词指人；句中做主语或宾语；B. whom关系词，先行词指人；句中做宾语；C. which关系词，先行词指物；D. what不能引导定语从句，考查定语从句，先行词是CD表示物，定语从句中做主语，因此关系代词用which。 故选C.。 完形填空 A There are many different kinds of cars in the world. My aunt thinks that cars are  ______ 16 ______ their drivers. She says, “Rich people have expensive cars, big people have large cars, and old people drive old car. “But I don’t  ______ 17 ______ her. My neighbour, Mr. Hill, is 82 years old. She drives only on Tuesday, and drives only to the bank. She  ______ 18 ______ drives more than 30 kilometres an hour. Do you think Mrs. Hill has a very ______ 19 ______ and small car? No, her car is new. It’s very large, and it  ______ 20 ______  go 200 kilometres an hour. My friend is  ______ 21 ______. He draws beautiful pictures with lots of colours. But his car is black! Mrs. Bates has a very, very old one. There is often something  ______ 22 ______ with her car. Does she drive that kind of car because she is poor? No, she has four factories and ______ 23 ______ dollars in the bank. My aunt Mary has a very  ______ 24 ______ car, though she drives to the country with her husband, her two children, her mother and their dog. Now you have  ______ 25 ______ my friends and their cars. Do you agree with my aunt? Maybe you have a car. Does it say anything about you?

questions.prompt: This dictionary is your sister’s. Please give it to  ______.
questions.explanation: 试题解析：句意：这本字典是你姐姐的，请给她。“你的姐姐”是女性，用代词宾格her。故选C。

questions.prompt: There are thirty desks  ______  my classroom.
questions.explanation: 句意：在我的教室里有30张桌子。 考查介词辨析。in 在…里；on在…上，of…；from 从。根据句意，这些桌子是在我的教室里，用介词in。故选A。 【点睛】表示地点的介词：in和on的区别。in表示在…里，如in the box；on表示在…上（与物体表面接触），如on the chair。

questions.prompt: I tried to stop him,  ______  he didn't listen.
questions.explanation: 句意：我尝试去阻止他，但是他不听。 考查连词辨析。and 和；but 但是；or 或者；so 所以。根据句意，上文“我尝试阻止他”，和下文“他不听”是表示转折关系，所以用转折连词but。故选B。 【点睛】and/but/or/so都属于并列连词，区别是：and表示“和”，是并列关系的连词；but表示“但是”，是转折关系的连词；or表示“或者”，是选择关系的连词；so表示“所以”，是因果关系的连词。

questions.prompt: —I heard you had a basketball match.  ______  did you play? —Very well. We won the game.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我听说你有一场篮球比赛，打得怎么样？——很好，我们赢了。 考查疑问副词辨析。when 何时；where 在哪里；how 怎么样；why 为什么。根据下文回答，we won the game，结果是赢了比赛，可知是问比赛的结果怎么样，用副词how。故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______  you speak French? —Only a few words.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你能说法语吗？——只能说一些词语 考查情态动词辨析。can 能；need 需要；must 必须；should 应该。根据下文回答，可知，上文是问你能说法语吗，表示某种能力用情态动词can。故选A。

questions.prompt: Tina runs  ______  than anyone else in her class.
questions.explanation: 句意：蒂娜在她班级里比其他人跑的快。 考查副词比较级辨析。fast 快；faster 更快；fastest最快，the fastest 最快。run是实义动词，空格处用副词修饰动词。根据句中than，可知用副词比较级。所以空格处是faster。故选B。

questions.prompt: David can't go with us now because he  ______  the school project.
questions.explanation: 句意：大卫现在不能跟我们一起走，因为他正在做学校的项目。 考查动词时态辨析。does 一般现在时；has done 现在完成时；did 一般过去时；is doing 现在进行时。根据句中now可知，句子表示现在正在进行的动作，所以用现在进行时，结构为be doing，主语he是第三人称，所以be用is。故选D。

questions.prompt: Jack  ______  a math problem with his friends when I got there.
questions.explanation: 当我到那的时候，杰克正在跟他的朋友们讨论一个数学问题。 考查动词时态辨析。discusses 一般现在时；discussed 一般过去时；is discussing现在进行时；was discussing 过去进行时。when是引导的时间状语从句，根据句意，当我到那的时候，他正在跟他的朋友们讨论一个数学问题，所以主句用进行时。从句中got是一般过去时，所以主句用过去进行时。故选D。

questions.prompt: My dad is good at painting and he often  ______  in his free time.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的爸爸擅长绘画，并且他经常在闲暇时间画画。 考查动词时态辨析。paints 一般现在时；is painting 现在进行时；will paint 一般将来时；has painted 现在完成时。often经常，句子用一般现在时，主语he是第三人称，所以动词用三单形式。故选A。

questions.prompt: I am tired. I  ______  basketball for three hours.
questions.explanation: 句意：我很累。我已经打了三个小时的篮球。 考查动词时态辨析。play 一般现在时；played 一般过去时；have played 现在完成时；will play 一般将来时。根据时间性状语for+一段时间，句子用现在完成时。故选C。

questions.prompt: The sports meeting  ______ because of the bad weather yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：因为昨天的坏天气，运动会被取消了。 考查被动语态辨析。cancels 一般现在时；cancelled 一般过去时；is cancelled 一般现在时的被动语态；was cancelled 一般过去时的被动语态。根据时间性状语yesterday判断，句子用一般过去时。主语sports meeting和cancel之间是被动的关系，所以用一般过去时的被动语态。故选D。

questions.prompt: —Mum, do you know  ______? —Next week.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，你知道爸爸什么时候回来吗？——下周。 考查宾语从句。根据句子结构，空格处是一个宾语从句。从句要用陈述句语序，结构为主语+动词+其它。A和C选项都是疑问句语序，所以排除A和C选项。根据下文回复的是下周，可知从句表达的是将来要发生的动作，用一般将来时，D选项中came是一般过去时，所以排除D选项。故选B。 【点睛】宾语从句要注意的两点：从句语序和时态。从句要用陈述句语序，除了what’s wrong with you/what’s the matter语序不变。时态：主句用一般现在时，从句可以用任何时态；主句用一般过去时，从句用过去某种时态；从句表达客观事实或自然现象时，从句用一般现在时。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A,B,C,D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Steven's New Sled Steven woke on Christmas morning to find a new sled. “Oh, wow! ”he shouted. This was the best Christmas ______ 13 ______! Steven was still excited as the rest of his family opened their gifts. Secretly, he hoped he could get outside quickly to try out his new sled. Finally, Steven asked, “ Dad, is it okay if I try out my sled?" Dad  ______ 14 ______. Soon, Steven was sledding down Twin Hills in the neighbourhood park. He felt the wind against his face as he flew down. Later that day, Steven carefully leaned（靠）the sled up against the outside of his house under his bedroom window. The next day, Steven ran outside as soon as he could. “Oh, no! ”Steven shouted. His sled was missing! He ran as fast as he could to the park. There at Twin Hills he  ______ 15 ______  it! Steven's neighbour, Kevin, was on Steven's new sled! "Kevin! That's my sled! You stole my new sled! ”But Kevin just laughed and headed up the hill for another run down. Steven ran home, crying all the way. He found his dad in the garage and told him what had happened. Steven's dad said, "Calm down, Son. There may be another  ______ 16 ______  for the missing of your sled.” Steven couldn't believe his dad was  ______ 17 ______  with Kevin. “But, Dad. Kevin's at Twin Hills using my sled right now! We need to go to get it! ” Dad said  ______ 18 ______, "First of all, you need to make sure your sled is actually stolen. Look over there.” Steven was  ______ 19 ______  at what he saw. His sled leaned against the wall of the garage next to his bicycle. Dad put his arm around Steven and said, "I put your sled away last night when I saw you had left it outside.” Steven  ______ 20 ______  his head. He felt bad about the way he had spoken to his neighbour. "I should say sorry to Kevin, ”he said. Dad replied, “There's no time like the present.”

questions.prompt: My grandparents live in the countryside, and we often go to see  ______  on the weekend.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的祖父母住在乡下，我们经常在周末去看他们。 考查人称代词宾格。he他，主格；she她，主格；they他们，主格；them他们，宾格，根据所给空前面的go to see以及主语my grandparents可知，应该用的是them，故选D。

questions.prompt: We will have Spring Festival ______  January, 2020.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们将在2020年1月过春节。 考查介词辨析。of……的；at在，后面接某一时刻；in后面接不是具体的某一天；on后面接具体的某一天，根据所给空后面的January不是具体的某一天可知，应该用的是in，故选C。

questions.prompt: You can't take photos here,  ______  it's too dangerous.
questions.explanation: 句意：你不能在这里拍照，因为太危险了。 考查连词辨析。because因为；but但是；and并且；so所以，根据所给空前面的句子You can't take photos here和后面的句子it's too dangerous可知，应该是因为，故选A。

questions.prompt: —  ______  did you find out the cat? — In the garden. It slept behind the big tree.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你在哪找到这只猫的？——在花园，它睡在大树后面。 考查疑问词辨析。What什么；How怎样；Why为什么；Where在哪里，根据答句In the garden可知，提问的是地点，应该用的是where，故选D。

questions.prompt: Linda practices the piano very hard, but her sister practices  ______  than her.
questions.explanation: 句意：琳达练习钢琴很努力，但她姐姐比她更努力。 考查副词的比较级。hard努力地，副词原形；harder更努力的，副词比较级；hardest最努力地，副词最高级；more harder错误表达，根据所给空后面的than her可知，应该用副词的比较级，故选B。

questions.prompt: Jane is a very kind girl. She often  ______  her classmates.
questions.explanation: 句意：简是个很好的女孩。她经常帮助她的同学。 考查动词的第三人称单数形式。helps帮助，动词的第三人称单数形式，一般现在时；helped帮助，动词过去式，一般过去时；is helping正帮助，现在进行时；has helped已经帮助，现在完成时，根据所给空前面的she often可知，应该用一般现在时，主语she是第三人称单数，所以谓语动词也要用第三人称单数形式，故选A。

questions.prompt: — Mum, could you help me? — Wait a moment. I  ______  your clothes.
questions.explanation: 句意：——妈妈，你能帮我吗？——等一会，我正在洗衣服呢。 考查现在进行时。wash洗，一般现在时；am washing正在洗，现在进行时；washed洗，一般过去时；will wash将要洗，一般将来时，根据所给空前面的could you help me?和Wait a moment可知，应该用的是现在进行时，故选B。

questions.prompt: — David, ______  I use your computer for a while? — Of course, come on.
questions.explanation: 句意：——大卫，我可以用一会你的电脑吗？——当然，拿去吧。 考查情态动词辨析。must必须；need需要；can可以；should应该，根据答句Of course可知，应该用的是can表示请求允许，故选C。

questions.prompt: I  ______  the dog when it began to rain.
questions.explanation: 句意：当开始下雨的时候，我正在遛狗。 考查过去进行时。walk步行，一般现在时；walked步行，一般过去时；am walking正在步行，现在进行时；was walking正在步行，过去进行时，根据所给空后面的when it began to rain.可知，强调的是过去的某一时刻，发生的动作，所以要用过去进行时，故选D。

questions.prompt: My father loves history. He  ______  hundreds of history books already.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的爸爸喜欢历史，他已经读了几百本历史书了。 考查现在完成时。reads读，一般现在时；has read已经读，现在完成时；is reading正在读，现在进行时；will read将会读，一般将来时，根据所给空后面的already可知，时态是现在完成时，故选B。

questions.prompt: A new swimming pool in our school  ______  next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：明年在我们学校一个新的游泳池将会被建成。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。build建筑，动词原形；built建筑，动词过去式；will be built将被建，一般将来时的被动语态；was building正在建，过去进行时，根据主语A new swimming pool发不出谓语动词build的动作，所以用被动语态，由next year可知，应该用的是一般将来时的被动语态，构成：主语+will+be+done，故选C。

questions.prompt: I usually set  ______ goals at the beginning of each term.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：我通常在每学期的开始设定我的目标。A. I我，主格；B. me我，宾格；C. my我的，形容词性的物主代词；D. mine我的，名词性的物主代词。goals目标，名词，需要形容词性的物主代词修饰，故选C。

questions.prompt: —Are you familiar  ______ the movie, Melissa? —Yes, I’ve watched it twice.
questions.explanation: 试题分析：句意：你熟悉这部电影吗，梅丽莎?be familiar with：对……熟悉。故选B。 考点：考查介词。

questions.prompt: ______ it is raining heavily, we have to stay indoors.
questions.explanation: 句意：由于雨下得很大，我们不得不呆在室内。 考查连词。Unless除非；Even if即使；Though尽管；Since既然，由于；根据“we have to stay indoors.”我们不得不呆在室内，所以是因为前文“雨下得很大”，故选D。

questions.prompt: Yao Ming is one of  ______ basketball players in the world.
questions.explanation: 句意：姚明是世界上最高的篮球运动员之一。 考查最高级。根据one of+形容词最高级+名词复数表示“……之一”；所以此处用最高级，最高级前面需加the，故选A。

questions.prompt: - ______  you help me take out the waste in the kitchen, Jenny? -Yes, of course.
questions.explanation: 句意：——珍妮，你能帮我把厨房里的垃圾拿出去吗?——是的，当然。 考查情态动词。May可以，可能，许可（语气比较弱）；Must必须；Can能，可以；Should应该；根据“ ______  you help me take out the waste in the kitchen”你 帮我把厨房里的垃圾拿出去吗，此处是请求，许可，所以用can，故选C。

questions.prompt: If you stay up late, you  ______ tired tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你熬夜到很晚，明天你就会感到很累。 考查if条件句。feel一般现在时；felt一般过去时；have felt现在完成时；will feel一般将来时；if 用于条件和假设句中，主句用将来时，从句用一般现在时。所以此处缺一般将来时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Peter fell asleep and  ______ to set his alarm for the next morning.
questions.explanation: 句意：彼得睡着了，忘了设定第二天早上的闹钟。 考查一般过去时。forgets三单；forgot一般过去时；will forget一般将来时；has forgotten现在完成时；根据前文“fell asleep ”是一般过去时，所以此处是一般过去时，故选B。

questions.prompt: While Alice  ______ against the cold wind she covered her face with a scarf.
questions.explanation: 句意：当爱丽丝顶着寒风走的时候，她用围巾遮住了脸。 考查时态。was walking过去进行时；is walking现在进行时；walks三单；will walk一般将来时；根据while+长动作，用be doing，排除C、D；根据后文“covered her face with a scarf”，用的一般过去时，所以此处缺过去进行时，故选A。

questions.prompt: Jack  ______ a few discoveries in chemistry since he became a scientist.
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克自从成为科学家以来，在化学方面有了一些发现。 考查时态。is making现在进行时；will make一般将来时；made一般过去时；has made现在完成时；根据“since he became a scientist”，所以此处用现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Mr. King always asks us  ______ a car pool with our friends to school.
questions.explanation: 句意：金先生总是让我们和朋友合伙用车去学校。 考查动词不定式。organizing动名词，现在分词；organized一般过去时；to organize动词不定式；organize动词原形；根据ask sb to do sth表示“要求某人做什么”，所以此处缺动词不定式，故选C。

questions.prompt: Young trees  ______ in the city every spring.
questions.explanation: 句意：这个城市每年春天都种小树。 考查一般现在时的被动语态。are planted一般现在时的被动语态；were planted一般过去时的被动语态；plant一般现在时；planted一般过去时；根据“every spring”可知此处用一般现在时，结合主语是“Young trees”与“plant”之间是被动关系，所以此处是一般现在时的被动语态，故选A。

questions.prompt: -Alice, could you tell me  ______ the book? -Oh, yes. I bought it from a bookstore online.
questions.explanation: 句意：——爱丽丝，你能告诉我你在哪买的书吗?——哦，是的。我从网上书店买的。 考查宾语从句。根据宾语从句中从句要用陈述句语序，排除A、C；结合答句“I bought it from a bookstore online”是一般过去时，所以原句应该也用一般过去时，所以排除D；故选B； 【点睛】宾语从句： 考点1：引导词的选用。 考点2：语序。 (宾语从句中从句要用陈述句语序，即从句中的第1助动词在主语之后） 考点3：时态。（主句从句在时态上要一致） 完形填空 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A,B,C,D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Discovery In a vacation, my brother and I decided to go off for a long walk while we were staying in the countryside. On the top of a mountain, a sudden  ______ 13 ______  began to fall and the temperature dropped a lot. It became so dark that we couldn't see the path clearly. It was difficult for my brother and me to  ______ 14 ______  over rocks in the heavy rain. As I paused（停）under a tree, I noticed a cave between two huge rocks. I suggested to make a fire and warm ourselves in the cave. So my brother and I picked up some wood that was still  ______ 15 ______  and carried it back to the cave. I lit the fire with matches in my pocket. We sat down and ate our sandwiches around it. In the cave, the flames  ______ 16 ______  light onto its ceiling.“Funny,”said my brother, “You can see shapes on the rock. One of them looks a bit like a deer. There is its head and there are its feet. It almost looks as if someone has  ______ 17 ______  it.”I took a burning branch（树枝）and went to examine the rock. Now I could see a shape of a smaller deer. Then we went further into the cave. In front of us was a wall of  ______ 18 ______. There were birds, too, with the eyes carved（雕刻）out of the rock and painted white. We could see a snake, a bear, a wolf, but no people. At that night, my brother and I were so  ______ 19 ______  that we did not get to sleep until very late. We talked and wondered about the people who had lived here before. Neither of us realized that these carvings and paintings  ______ 20 ______  back 15,000 years, nor that the title in the newspaper would be“The Find of the Century-Children Aged 13 and 11 Discover Cave Paintings.”

questions.prompt: — George, the bike looks cool. Is it  ______? — Yes. My mother bought it for my birthday.
questions.explanation: 句意：——乔治，这辆自行车看起来很酷。它是你的吗？——是的。我妈妈给我买的生日礼物。 考查名词性物主代词。his他的；yours你的；hers她的；ours我们的。分析语境可知，此处询问乔治，表示“它是你的吗？”的含义，故选B。

questions.prompt: Her father is a doctor. He works  ______  a hospital.
questions.explanation: 句意：她的父亲是一名医生。他工作在一家医院。 考查介词辨析。on在……上；of……的；to朝……，位于；in在……内。分析句子可知，此处构成短语“in the hospital”，翻译为“在医院”，故选D。

questions.prompt: My parents are tea lovers. They  ______  green tea every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：我的父母是茶爱好者。他们每天喝绿茶。 考查一般现在时。drink一般现在时；have drunk现在完成时；drank一般过去时；are drinking现在进行时。分析句子可知，此处表示习惯性动作，所以用一般现在时，故选A。

questions.prompt: Chris ______  10 Chinese songs since he came to China.
questions.explanation: 句意：自从克里斯来到中国，他已经学了10首中文歌曲。 考查现在完成时。learns一般现在时的动词三单；learned一般过去时；has learned现在完成时；will learn一般将来时。分析句子可知，此处构成“现在完成时+since+一般过去时”结构，表示“已经学了10首中文歌曲”的含义，故选C。

questions.prompt: — ______ did you stop playing? — Because I was tired
questions.explanation: 句意：——你为什么不玩了？——因为我累了。 考查特殊疑问句。What什么；Why为什么；When什么时候；Where什么地方。根据答语“Because I was tired.”可知，此处是在询问原因，故选B。

questions.prompt: — I  ______  sleep well these days. — Maybe you should learn to relax.
questions.explanation: 句意：——这些天我睡不好。——也许你应该学会放松。 考查情态动词辨析。can’t不能；wouldn’t不会；needn’t不需要；mustn’t禁止。分析句子可知，此处表示“无法/不能入睡”，表能力，故选A。

questions.prompt: Work hard,  ______  you’ll have a big success.
questions.explanation: 句意：努力工作，你就会取得巨大的成功。 考查“祈使句+and+简单句”结构。and和，表并列/顺承；but但是，表转折；or或者，表选择；for因为/为了。分析句子可知，此处构成“祈使句+and+简单句”结构，故选A。 【点睛】“祈使句+and/or +简单句”结构 and：表示完成了前面的动作，就能够接着实现后面的；可根据上下文翻译为“然后”。 例句：Hurry up, and you will catch the bus. 快点，你就能赶上公共汽车了。 or：通常表示“否则”。 例句：Hurry up, or you will be late for the meeting. 快点，否则你开会要迟到了。

questions.prompt: — Which sport do you think is  ______, swimming or skating? — Skating.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你认为游泳和滑冰哪个运动更有趣？——滑冰。 考查形容词比较级。interesting形容词原级；more interesting形容词比较级；most interesting形容词最高级；the most interesting是the加形容词最高级。根据后文“swimming or skating”可知，是两者之间比较，所以需用形容词比较级形式，故选B。

questions.prompt: Linda is a tennis player. She  ______ to play tennis when she was five years old.
questions.explanation: 句意：琳达是个网球运动员。她五岁时开始打网球。 考查一般过去时。begins一般现时；has begun现在完成时；will begin一般将来时；began一般过去时。根据“when she was five years old”可知，此处表示一般过去时，故选D。

questions.prompt: Listen! Mr. Green  ______  a speech on AI in the hall.
questions.explanation: 句意：听！格林先生正在大厅里做关于人工智能的演讲。 考查现在进行时。gave一般过去时；will give一般将来时；is giving现在进行时；gives一般现在时。根据“Listen!”可知，此处表示现在进行时，强调正在发生的动作，故选C。

questions.prompt: We hope that more trees  ______  in our city next year.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们希望明年在我们的城市种更多的树。 考查一般将来时的被动语态。plant一般现在时；will plant一般将来时；were planted一般过去时的被动语态；will be planted一般将来时的被动语态。根据“next year”可知，此处表示一般将来时；又因为主语trees是动作plant的承受者，所以应用一般将来时的被动语态。故选D。

questions.prompt: — Susan, do you know  ______? Someone is looking for him. — Maybe he is on the playground.
questions.explanation: 句意：——苏珊，你知道托尼在哪儿吗？有人在找他。——也许他在操场上。 考查宾语从句语序和时态。where is Tony一般现在时+疑问语序；where was Tony一般过去时+疑问语序；where Tony is一般现在时+陈述语序；where Tony was一般过去时+陈述语序。分析句子可知，此处是宾语从句应用陈述语序，排除A和B；又根据答语“Maybe he is on the playground.”可知，此处表示一般现在时，故选C。 【点睛】解答和宾语从句有关的试题时，应遵循以下三点： (1)时态。一般情况下，宾语从句的时态和主句的时态保持一致。若主句时态为现在的时态，则宾语从句的时态根据实际情况而定。若主句时态为过去的时态，则宾语从句也要用过去的某种时态。若宾语从句描述的内容是客观真理时，宾语从句在任何时候都用现在时态。 (2)语序。宾语从句应该用陈述句语序，即“宾语从句引导词+主语+谓语+其他”。 (3)引导词。宾语从句的引导词取决于宾语从句要表达的意义。表示人物身份内容时要用who；表示事物内容时要用what；表示地点时用where；表示时间时用when；表示原因时用why；表示方式时用how。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的 A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 As a teenager I got angry quite easily and was not good at communicating with others. Because of that, I often made them feel uncomfortable. And now I often  ______ 13 ______  my bad action. I still remember it was early autumn. Some  ______ 14 ______  started to turn yellow and the weather became cool. One day, as I was getting ready for school, my mother carelessly handed me my father’s vest (背心) instead of mine. At that time, I was getting to have a  ______ 15 ______  size than my father, so when I put on the vest, I felt as if I wasn’t able to breathe! I realized that it was a small mistake which was  ______ 16 ______  by my mother, but somehow the breathless feeling was so strong that it made me very angry. My mother said sorry with a smile, but I shouted at her without thinking much. I was almost mad. I got it off my body so wildly that I made a hole in it. I put on my own vest and  ______ 17 ______  out of the house before my mother could stop me. Later, my mother shared her bad feelings with my father, “See what your son has done.” I got afraid because I didn’t know what he would do to me. Instead of saying he would blame or beat me, my father  ______ 18 ______  asked my mother to mend the vest. Later when my mother told me about my father’s response, I felt terribly sorry for my bad behavior. My father’s gentle kindness taught me a lesson which I would never forget. On that day, I decided not to let anger  ______ 19 ______  me any longer. Of course, there are times when I am angry. However, whenever that happens, I will try to remember my father’s  ______ 20 ______. It always reminds me to think about others’ feelings when I get angry.

questions.prompt: My mother is a good teacher.  ______ students all like her very much.
questions.explanation: 句意：我妈妈是个好老师。她的学生都很喜欢她。 考查物主代词。Our我们的；Her她的；His他的；Their他们的；由上文可知“My mother is a good teacher”，根据文字表达的逻辑关系，推断下文指“妈妈的学生很喜欢她”，即“她的学生很喜欢她”；故选B。

questions.prompt: I like reading. I often read books  ______ the library near my home.
questions.explanation: 句意：我喜欢读书。我经常在家附近的图书馆里看书。 考查介词辨析、地点介词。in在……里面；of……的，表所属；on在……上面；with和……一起，表伴随；从文字的表层意思推断空格指“在图书馆里”，表示“在……里面”；故选A。

questions.prompt: 一  ______ is it from here to Qinhu Park? 一It's about ten minutes' walk.
questions.explanation: 句意：——从这里到秦湖公园有多远？——大约10分钟走路的路程。 考查疑问词。how far 多远的距离，询问路程、距离；how long多长时间，对一段时间或长度提问；how much多少，后跟不可数名词；how soon再过多久，对表示将来的一段时间“in +一段时间”提问；根据答语“It's about ten minutes' walk.”，表示多远的路程；故选A。

questions.prompt: I  ______ go now, or I will be late for the party.
questions.explanation: 句意：我必须走了，否则我要迟到了。 考查情态动词。can能，表能力、可能；need需要，表必要性；应该，表义务；must必须，表必须；根据下文“or I will be late for the party.”——如果不走就会迟到；由此推断空格指“必须走”，故选D。

questions.prompt: It's difficult for me to learn physics well,  ______ I don't want to give it up.
questions.explanation: 句意：学好物理对我来说很难，但我不想放弃。 考查连词辨析。or 或者，表选择；and “和”，表顺承；but“但是”，表转折；so意为“因此”，表因果；前句“学好物理对我来说很难”和后句“ 我不想放弃”存在句意转折；由此判断空格填表示“转折”的连词；故选C。

questions.prompt: Emma looks after her grandparents carefully. She is  ______ than her sister.
questions.explanation: 句意：艾玛细心地照顾她的祖父母。她比她的姐姐更有耐心。 考查形容词比较级。patient原级；more patient比较级；most patient最高级；the most patient最高级；根据than的比较结构，判断空格填比较级；故选B。

questions.prompt: Sam  ______ his parents do housework every day.
questions.explanation: 句意：萨姆每天帮助他父母做家务。 考查时态。helps一般现在时、单三形式；is helping现在进行时；has helped现在完成时；was helping过去进行时；根据时间状语“every day”，可知句子是一般现在时；主语Sam是单数第三人称，谓语动词用单三形式；故选A。

questions.prompt: 一Tom, where is Miss Wang? 一She  ______ a speech on Chinese culture in the school gym.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，王老师在哪？——她正在学校体育馆作关于中国文化的演讲。 考查时态、现在进行时。gives 一般现在时、单三形式；gave一般过去时；is giving现在进行时；will give一般将来时；根据上文“where is Miss Wang?”，推断空格是表示说话时正在发生的动作，用现在进行时；故选C。

questions.prompt: Our hometown  ______ a lot since 2017. More beautiful parks have been built.
questions.explanation: 句意：我们的家乡自从2017年以来变化很大。更多美丽的公园已经（被）建成。 考查现在完成时。changes一般现在时、单三形式；changed一般过去时；has changed现在完成时；will change一般将来时；根据时间状语“since 2017”判断句子是现在完成时；故选C。

questions.prompt: If you keep studying hard, you  ______ your English.
questions.explanation: 句意：如果你继续努力学习，你的英语就会提高。 考查if条件状语从句。improve一般现在时；improved一般过去时；is improving现在进行时；will improve一般将来时；根据if引导的条件状语从句“主将从现”的原则，从句“If you keep studying hard”是一般现在时，判断主句是一般将来时；故选D。

questions.prompt: The 24th Winter Olympic Games  ______ in China in 2022.
questions.explanation: 句意：第24届冬奥会将在中国（被）举办。 考查一般将来时被动语态。hold一般现在时、主动语态；is held一般现在时、被动语态； will be held一般将来时、被动语态；will hold一般将来时、主动语态；根据时间状语“in 2022”判断句子是一般将来时；主语the 24th Winter Olympic Games是动作的承受者，所以，句子用被动语态；一般将来时的被动语态的构成为“will + be+过去分词”；故选C。

questions.prompt: 一Do you know  ______ next Friday? 一Yes. They'll go to the Summer Palace.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你知道下星期五学生们要去哪里吗？——知道。他们要去颐和园。 考查宾语从句。where the students went一般过去时，陈述句的语序；where the students will go一般将来时，陈述句的语序； where did the students go一般过去时，疑问句的语序；where will the students go一般将来时，疑问句的语序；根据时间状语“next Friday”判断句子是一般将来时，所以排除A、C；根据宾语从句要按照陈述句的语序，所以排除D，故选B。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文, 掌握其大意, 然后从短文后各题所给的A,B,C,D四个选项中, 选择最佳选项。 Is Started with a Bunch of Anthuriums My first job out of high school was at a science research center. As a youngster, I was pretty worried by the administrative supervisor（行政主管）. I wished I didn't have to pass her desk every morning. In the first month there, I don't think I ever saw her  ______ 13 ______. I am not sure what encouraged me but one day I decided to bring her flowers. They were bright red anthuriums. As soon as I walked into the office,  ______ 14 ______  her the flowers. But then, came the most beautiful smile. It spread across her face slowly and it seemed that the room got a bit  ______ 15 ______  too. I remembered my heart pounding out of my chest because I then realized I had certainly not seen her smile before. She  ______ 16 ______  me for the flowers and did so every day for as long as the flowers lasted. From then on, she always greeted me with a smile. Then, it became my  ______ 17 ______  to make her smile every day. Some days I'd bring her something I baked, tell a funny story, or invite her to lunch with our colleagues. Then things ______ 18 ______. She began to smile more and talk to people, even when she didn't need to. She just seemed lighter. Now you would think this  ______ 19 ______  was about the administrative supervisor. It's not. It's about how it changed me. I used to be pretty shy but after that day with the anthuriums, I started coming out of my shell too and I learned to smile more. I began to see people  ______ 20 ______, you know, actually " seeing" people by looking deeper rather than accepting the superficial（表面的）. That experience taught me a lesson for life：A loving act of kindness has a beautiful way of helping both the receiver and the giver in ways that we cannot imagine.

questions.prompt: Listen! That little girl is crying on the chair. Let's go and help ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：听！那个小女孩在椅子上哭。我们去帮助她吧。 考查人称代词辨析。me我，宾格；him他，宾格；her她，宾格；them他们，宾格。根据“That little girl is crying”可知，那个小女孩儿在哭，我们去帮她吧，应用人称代词宾格her代指小女孩儿。故选C。

questions.prompt: The autumn  ______  Beijing is very beautiful.
questions.explanation: 句意：北京的秋天非常美丽。 考查地点介词。on在……上面，强调和表面接触；in通常指大地点；at通常指小地方；to在……范围外，强调不接壤。根据语意可知，北京的秋天很美丽。北京是个大地点，应用介词in。故选B。 【点睛】拓展：时间介词辨析。on用在具体的某一天或具体的某一天上午、下午、晚上等；in用在年、月、季节、世纪等；at用在具体的时刻前；to表示时间范围，常与from连用。

questions.prompt: The fridge is empty,  ______  we may have to go out for dinner tonight.
questions.explanation: 句意：冰箱空了，所以我们今晚可能得出去吃饭。 考查连词辨析。for为了，给；or或者，表选择；but但是，表转折；so因此，表结果。根据语意可知，“冰箱空了”和“我们得出去吃饭”是因果关系，后者是结果，应用连词so连接。故选D。

questions.prompt: The Changjiang River is  ______  than the Huanghe River.
questions.explanation: 句意：长江比黄河长。 考查形容词比较级。long原形；longer较长的；longest最长的；the longest最长的，用在最高级。根据关键词“than”可知，本句为比较级句式，应用“long”的比较级形式“longer”来表示长江比黄河长。故选B。 【点睛】拓展：英语最高级前不用the的几种情况。（1）形容词最高级前加the，副词最高级前不加the。（2）形容词最高级作表语时，有时可以省略the。（3）最高级形容词作表语，副词作状语时，没和别人比较时不用加the。（4）最高级前已有名词所有格或物主代词时，不加the。（5）有时most表示“非常”，而不是最高级，不用the。

questions.prompt: — ______  is the winner in 100-meter race? —Lily. She's from Class One.
questions.explanation: 句意：——谁是一百米赛跑的冠军？——莉莉。她来自一班。 考查特殊疑问句。Who谁，对人提问；What什么，对事物提问；When何时，对时间提问；Where何地，对地点提问。根据答语“Lily. She's from Class One”可知，问句应是对人提问，应用疑问词Who。故选A。

questions.prompt: — ______  you swim? —Yes, but I’m not a good swimmer.
questions.explanation: 句意：——你会游泳吗？——是的，但是我不是一个好游泳员。 考查情态动词。Can会，能；May：可以；Need：需要；Must：必需，必须。根据下文“是的，但是我不是一个好游泳员。”可知问句是“你会游泳吗？”， 故选A。

questions.prompt: Jack  ______  to London after he ﬁnishes the ﬁnal exam next week
questions.explanation: 句意：杰克下周完成期末考试后将去伦敦。 考查after引导的时间状语从句。goes一般现在时；went一般过去时；has gone现在完成时；will go一般将来时。本句为after引导的时间状语从句，根据关键词“next week”可知本句遵循“主将从现”原则，杰克预计下周去伦敦，时态为一般将来时。故选D。

questions.prompt: —May I speak to Mrs. Smith? —Hold on, please. She  ______  in the kitchen now.
questions.explanation: 句意：——我可以和史密斯太太讲话吗？——请稍等。她现在正在厨房做饭。 考查动词时态。has cooked现在完成时；cooks一般现在时；is cooking现在进行时；will cook一般将来时。根据语境可知，此时正在打电话，史密斯太太不方便接听电话，因为她正在厨房做饭，故用现在进行时。故选C。

questions.prompt: Rose came to Beijing in 2002. she  ______  here for eight years.
questions.explanation: 句意：罗丝2002年来到北京。她在这里住了八年了。 考查动词时态。was living过去进行时；live一般现在时；will live一般将来时；has lived现在完成时。根据for eight years可知此句时态是现在完成时，故选D。

questions.prompt: My sister  ______  to music when I got home at ﬁve o'clock yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意：当我昨天五点钟到家的时候，我妹妹正在听音乐。 考查when引导的时间状语从句。listens一般现在时；was listening过去进行时；will listen一般将来时；has listened现在完成时。此句为when引导的时间状语从句，从句“昨天五点钟我到家的时候”为一般过去时态，主句“我妹妹正在听音乐”。根据语境可知，从句动作发生时，主句动作正在进行，故应用过去进行时态。故选B。

questions.prompt: — Look, what a nice house! It looks so great! — Yeah, it  ______  nearly 800 years ago.
questions.explanation: 句意：——看，多么漂亮的房子啊！它看起来太棒了，——是的，它大约八百年前被建造的。 考查被动语态。was built一般过去时的被动语态；is built一般现在时的被动语态；built一般过去时，主动语态；builds一般现在时，主动语态。根据关键词“800 years ago”可知，时态为一般过去时，且房子是被建造的，应用被动语态。故选A。

questions.prompt: --- Judy, could you tell me ______ the schoolbag? --- Oh, yes. I bought it in a store on the Internet.
questions.explanation: 句意：---朱蒂，你能告诉我你在哪里买的书包吗？------哦，是的。我在网上的一家商店买的。 考查宾语从句。宾语从句要用陈述语序，根据回答I bought it in a store on the Internet.的时态是过去式结合语境可知从句时态要用过去式，书包已经买完了。A和B是疑问句语序，排除，D是将来时排除，结合句意和语境可知选C。 完形填空 阅读下面的短文，掌握其大意，然后从短文后各题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中，选择最佳选项。 Free Sweets in His Taxi to Delight and Heal（治愈） Mansoor Khalid, a 37-year-old electrical engineer from Pakistan, has been driving a yellow taxi in New York City since 1996. In 2010, his son, Saad, was born with a heart disease. Every time Mr. Khalid visited him in the hospital after his day shift（轮班）, he would bring much  ______ 13 ______  to drink during nights to take care of his son. He even gave some to the doctors and nurses there, who called him "coffee man". Last April, Saad died at 18 months old. Although Mr. Khalid was so sad, he had to  ______ 14 ______  to work. After his son's death, he got into the habit of buying some sweets for his passengers, which nearly cost him $300 every month. From his experience in the hospital with his son, Mr. Khalid learned that giving to others could at least  ______ 15 ______  his feeling of loss, if not heal it. "I'd like to buy something for people; I feel  ______ 16 ______," Mr. Khalid said. "When you give something from your hand, someone gives a smile to you in return.” Since then, he has become famous on the Internet. His kind behavior  ______ 17 ______  a lot of customers, with more pickups from fans who send their positions to him on Twitter or Facebook. But he doesn't expect the 13,000 other yellow taxis to do the same. The $300 a month Mr. Khalid spends on candy would  ______ 18 ______  help many people to support their families for a time. Actually, it is not a small sum. "If you think about it, you will  ______ 19 ______  why he does it, after all, you don't get that sort of kindness very often." said Juan Miranda, who drives Mr. Khalid's taxi during the nights. "Everybody is sometimes unhappy and stressed. Living in New York City is not very easy, so when passengers see all the candies, chocolates, they will cheer up in a short time," Mr. Khalid explained. questions.prompt: Jim is a very kind boy. We all like  ______.

questions.prompt: I have dancing classes every Saturday. They start  ______  8 o’clock.

questions.prompt: —Tom, can you tell me  ______  to Lao She Tea House tomorrow? —By subway.

But remember to keep their names secret so that students won’t ______ 18 ______  them.” “You’ve saved the day, Margaret. Thanks!” Anna took a deep breath and smiled. “That’s the perfect ______ 19 ______.” Early the next day, Anna visited several teachers. They were all happy to help. questions.prompt: 一Tom, I can't find my dictionary! 一Don't worry. You can use  ______.
questions.explanation: 句意：——汤姆，我找不到我的字典！——别担心。你可以用我的。 考查代词。I我，主格；me我，宾格；my我的，形容词性物主代词；mine我的，名词性物主代词；根据句意理解可知，这里表达的是“我的”，且指代的是“我的字典”，而空格后面没有名词dictionary，所以这里应该用名词性物主代词，故选D。 【点睛】英语中形容词性的物主代词和名词性的物主代词用法要注意区别，根据句子结构来判断，如果所指代的名词有出现，就用形容词性的物主代词，如果没有所指代的名词，就要用名字性的物主代词代替。做题要根据具体的句子来判断。

questions.prompt: 一Where is Mr. Brown? 一I think he's  ______  the music hall.

questions.prompt: Many people think Erquan rngyue is too sad,  ______  it's my favorite.
questions.explanation: 句意：很多人认为《二泉映月》太悲伤了，但它是我的最爱。 考查并列连词。and和；so所以；or或者；but但是；根据句意理解可知，前后两句表达的意思的相反的，是转折关系，所以应该用转折关系的连词，故选D。 【点睛】英语中并列连词的选择主要是根据上下句句意来理解，如果关系是递进关系，就选择and，如果是转折就选择but，如果是选择关系，就选择or。

questions.prompt: 一 ______  do you have a medical examination? 一Once a year.

questions.prompt: The notebook  ______  be Linda's because it has her name on it.

questions.prompt: We don't think teenagers should be allowed to drive because they are not  ______  enough.

questions.prompt: When I was young, my mother  ______  by my side all the time.

questions.prompt: Look! All my classmates  ______  on the playground.

questions.prompt: 1 like musicians  ______  can write their own music.

questions.prompt: My father is a teacher and he  ______  in this school for about twenty years.
questions.explanation: 句意：我父亲是一名教师，他在这所学校工作了大约二十年。 考查时态。works工作，一般现在时的动词三单形式；is working正在工作，现在进行时；was working正在工作，过去进行时；has worked工作，现在完成时；根据句意理解及句中for about twenty years可知，这是现在完成时的标志词，所以要用现在完成时，结构是have/ has+过去分词，主语是he，所以用has，故选D。 【点睛】英语中不同的时态，有不同的时间标志词。做题时首先要找句中的时间标志词，根据标志词来判断时态，比如本题中for about twenty years是现在完成时的标志词，所以句子要用现在完成时。

questions.prompt: The first 5G mobile phone  ______  by a Chinese company last year.
questions.explanation: 句意：第一款5G手机是去年由一家中国公司生产的。 考查被动语态。is produced被生产，一般现在时被动语态；produces生产，动词三单；was produced被生产，一般过去时的被动语态；produced生产，过去式；根据句意理解可知，这里表达的是“被生产”，所以应该用被动结构，而时间是last year，所以应该用过去时的被动语态，故选C。 【点睛】英语中如果句子主语和谓语之间是动宾关系，则需要用被动结构，选择哪个时态的被动结构要看句中的时态标志词或者某个关键词判断。比如本题mobile phone与produce之间是动宾关系，所以要用被动语态，时间是last year，所以要用确定用一般过去时的被动语态。
